english_verse: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron: Take a few handfuls of ashes from a stove and you, Moses, throw them into the air. Be sure the king is watching.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses nɛ Aaron ye, “Gbin'emi tampɛligim dan'aŋin, ka kɛ ka Moses yɛligi li bas pɛbisimin ka Faaro nyɛ.

english_verse: The ashes will blow across the land of Egypt, causing sores to break out on people and animals.
translation_verse: Ka li na kilim uusʋg Egipt teŋin, ka na kɛ ka bʋmmɔta sig teŋ la ni na gban'e saalib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa Egipt teŋin.”

english_verse: So they took a few handfuls of ashes and went to the king. Moses threw them into the air, and sores immediately broke out on the Egyptians and their animals.
translation_verse: Ka ba gbin'e tampɛligim bugum la pʋʋgin zi'en Faaro tuon, ka Moses yɛlig tampɛligim la. Ka bʋmmɔta di'e teŋ la ka li kilim fɛn'ɛd saalib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa ni.

english_verse: The magicians were suffering so much from the sores, that they could not even come to Moses.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ tʋm nyalima la pʋ lɛn nyaŋi zi'e Moses tuon ya'asɛ, bɔzugɔ ba niŋgbina wʋsa da anɛ fɛn'ɛd nɛ mɔda ma'aa nɛ Egipt nidib la wʋsa.

english_verse: Everything happened just as the Lord had told Moses—he made the king too stubborn to listen to Moses and Aaron. Hailstones
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb da kɛ ka Faaro sʋnf digilim ka o pʋ wʋm tis Moses nɛ Aaron wʋʋ Zugsɔb la pʋn yɛl Moses si'em la. Sakuga li Egipt teŋin la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to get up early the next morning and say to the king: The Lord God of the Hebrews commands you to let his people go, so they can worship him!
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Duom bɛkɛungʋ sia'al Na'ab Faaro ka yɛl o ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Hibiru dim Wina'am la yɛl ye, ‘Kɛl ka m nidib la yii keŋ pʋ'ʋsim.

english_verse: If you don't, he will send his worst plagues to strike you, your officials, and everyone else in your country. Then you will find out that no one can oppose the Lord.
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' ala, m na kɛ ka namistita'ar lu fʋn nɛ fʋ kpɛɛmnam nɛ fʋ nidib la wʋsa zugin ka ya na baŋ ye sɔ' pʋ bɛ dunia nwa' ni nwɛnɛ mam.

english_verse: In fact, he could already have sent a terrible disease and wiped you from the face of the earth.
translation_verse: M naan tun'e kɛɛn ka ban'akpi'euŋ sigi ya teŋ nwa' ni na kʋ fʋn nɛ fʋ nidib la wʋsa ka hali baa ya nid yinne kʋ lɛm bɛɛn dunia nwa' nii.

english_verse: But he has kept you alive, just to show you his power and to bring honor to himself everywhere in the world.
translation_verse: Amaa nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka m kɛ fʋ an na'ab, ye m pa'alim paŋi zem si'em, ka li kɛ ka m yʋ'ʋr tiig dunia wʋsa.

english_verse: You are still determined not to let the Lord's people go.
translation_verse: Fʋ nan kpɛn dʋ'ʋsidi fʋ mɛŋ ka zan'as ye mam nidib la kʋ yii keŋɛ.

english_verse: All right. At this time tomorrow, he will bring on Egypt the worst hailstorm in its history.
translation_verse: Dinzug, bɛog anwa win m na kɛ ka sakugtitada banɛ nam zi' lu Egipt teŋin lin yii li pin'ilʋgʋ ti paae zina la li na.

english_verse: You had better give orders for every person and every animal in Egypt to take shelter. If they don't, they will die.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba mɔri ya bʋnkɔnbidi kuli ya yaan, ka ya'a ka' ala sakuga la ya'a ye li kena, li na kʋ nidib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ wʋsa pʋ bɛ yinne.’”

english_verse: Some of the king's officials were frightened by what the Lord had said, and they hurried off to make sure their slaves and animals were safe.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro kpɛɛmnam banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la keŋi mɔri ba yammis nɛ ba bʋnkɔnbidi kul na yɔ'.

english_verse: But others paid no attention to his threats and left their slaves and animals out in the open.
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ ki'is Zugsɔb nɔɔr la basi ba yammis nɛ ba bʋnkɔnbid la nɛ mɔɔgin.

english_verse: Then the Lord told Moses, “Stretch your arm toward the sky, so that hailstones will fall on people, animals, and crops in the land of Egypt.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Ʋkimi fʋ nu'ug agɔl ka sakuga na lu Egipt teŋin la wʋsa. Di na lu nidib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid nɛ mɔɔd wʋsa linɛ bɛ Egipt pʋʋgin.”

english_verse: Moses pointed his walking stick toward the sky, and hailstones started falling everywhere. Thunder roared, and lightning flashed back and forth, striking the ground. This was the worst storm in the history of Egypt.
translation_verse: Sakuga la da lutnɛ hali ka saa ɛɛn iank nya'aŋi gaad tuon. Nwa' da gaad sakuga sisi'em wʋsa din yi Egipt da pin'ili ti paae saŋkan la.

english_verse: People, animals, and crops were pounded by the hailstones, and bark was stripped from trees.
translation_verse: Ka lin yi Egipt teŋ la wʋsa sakuga la da kʋnɛ nidib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ wʋsa bɛ pɔɔdin. Ka san'am mɔɔd, ka kɔ' tiis buudi wʋsa.

english_verse: Only Goshen, where the Israelites lived, was safe from the storm.
translation_verse: Ka zin'ikanɛ ka sakuga la da bas anɛ Gosen ma'aa, bɔzugɔ teŋ kan ka Israel dim da bɛ.

english_verse: The king sent for Moses and Aaron and told them, “Now I have really sinned! My people and I are guilty, and the Lord is right.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro buol Moses nɛ Aaron ka ye, “Nannanna mam tʋm taal ka Zugsɔb on tʋm sʋm. Mam nɛ m nidib la tʋm bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: We can't stand any more of this thunder and hail. Please ask the Lord to make it stop. Your people can go—you don't have to stay in Egypt any longer.”
translation_verse: Sɔsim Zugsɔb ye o kɛ ka satansʋg nɛ sakuga la bas ala ka li sia'al ya. M na kɛ ka ba yii keŋ ka kʋ lɛn kpɛlim kpɛla.”

english_verse: Moses answered, “As soon as I leave the city, I will lift my arms in prayer. When the thunder and hail stop, you will know that the earth belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl o ye, “M ya'a yi tempʋʋg nwa' ni, m na ʋki m nu'ug ka sɔs Zugsɔb ye o kɛ ka satansʋg nɛ sakuga la bas. Ka nwa' na kɛ ka fʋ baŋ ye dunia la wʋsa bɛ nɛ Zugsɔb nu'usin.

english_verse: But I am certain that neither you nor your officials really fear the Lord God.”
translation_verse: Amaa m mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye fʋn nɛ fʋ kpɛɛmnam la pʋ zɔt Zugsɔb Wina'am.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the flax and barley crops had been destroyed by the storm because they were ready to ripen.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka ba gum puud ka mui mɛ bi'ig, amaa ba wʋsa da san'amnɛ.

english_verse: But the wheat crops ripen later, and they were not damaged.
translation_verse: Amaa ki sieba banɛ kpɛlim la on da pʋ san'am, bɔzugɔ ban da nam pʋ bi'igɛ.

english_verse: After Moses left the royal palace and the city, he lifted his arms in prayer to the Lord, and the thunder, hail, and drenching rain stopped.
translation_verse: Ka Moses bas Faaro ka yi tempʋʋg la yiŋ, ka ʋk o nu'us agɔla sɔs Zugsɔb la, ka satansʋg nɛ sakuga la bas ka saa la mɛ bas niib.

english_verse: When the king realized that the storm was over, he disobeyed once more. He and his officials were so stubborn
translation_verse: Faaro nyɛ ka saa nɛ sakuga nɛ satansʋg la bas la, ka o lɛn tʋm bɛ'ɛd. Ka on nɛ o kpɛɛmnam digilimi ba sʋnya.

english_verse: that he refused to let the Israelites go. This was exactly what the Lord had said would happen.
translation_verse: Faaro digilimi o sʋnf ka zan'as ye Israel dim la kʋ keŋɛ, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la pʋn yɛl Moses si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Go back to the king. I have made him and his officials stubborn, so that I could work these miracles.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Kem kpɛn' Faaro san'an ka m digilim on nɛ o kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa sʋnya, dinɛ na kɛ ka m tʋmmi m tʋʋmnyalima la ba san'an.

english_verse: I did this because I want you to tell your children and your grandchildren about my miracles and about my harsh treatment of the Egyptians. Then all of you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka ya na ti yɛli ya biis nɛ ya yaas mam da mugus Egipt dim ka tʋm nyalima si'em la. Ala ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron went to the king and told him that the Lord God of the Hebrews had said: How long will you stubbornly refuse to obey? Release my people so they can worship me.
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɛ Aaron keŋ Faaro san'an yɛl o ye, “Nwa' ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Hibiru dim Wina'am la yɛl: ‘Nɔɔra ala ka fʋ na zan'as ye fʋ kʋ sie fʋ mɛŋ mam san'anɛ? Saŋkanɛ ka fʋ na kɛ ka m nidib la yi ka wɔ'ɔgi ma?

english_verse: Do this by tomorrow, or I will cover your country with so many locusts
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a ye fʋ kʋ kɛ ka ba yii, m saa na mɔr na'azɔmnam bɛog na;

english_verse: that you won't be able to see the ground. Most of your crops were ruined by the hailstones, but these locusts will destroy what little is left, including the trees.
translation_verse: ka ba na di'e teŋ la wʋsa ka fʋ kʋ nyɛ titan nɛ. Ba na ɔnb dinɛ ka sakuga san'am ka li kpɛlim fiin la, ka ɔnb tibanɛ bɛ mɔɔgin la wʋsa.

english_verse: Your palace, the homes of your officials, and all the other houses in Egypt will overflow with more locusts than have ever been seen in this country. After Moses left the palace,
translation_verse: Ka ba na pɛ'ɛl fʋn nɛ fʋ kpɛɛmnam nɛ Egipt dim wʋsa yaan. Bʋnkaŋa na an linɛ ka ya saamnam nɛ ya yaanam banɛ da pin'ili bɛ teŋin la ti paae zina nan zi' nyɛɛ.’” Ka Moses fɛndigi yi ka bas Na'ab Faaro.

english_verse: the king's officials asked, “Your Majesty, how much longer is this man going to be a troublemaker? Why don't you let the people leave, so they can worship the Lord their God? Don't you know that Egypt is a disaster?”
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro kpɛɛmnam la ye, “Dau kaŋa na namisi ti anwa paae wala bɛnnɛ? Kɛl ka nidib la yii keŋ ka pʋ'ʋsi ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la. Fʋ nam pʋ baŋ ye Egipt san'amnɛɛ?”

english_verse: The king had Moses and Aaron brought back, and he said, “All right, you may go and worship the Lord your God. But first tell me who will be going.”
translation_verse: Ka ba mɔr Moses nɛ Aaron n lɛb Na'ab Faaro san'an na. Ka o ye, “Yim keŋ pʋ'ʋsinɛ ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la. Amaa m lɛɛ ye m bu'osnɛ baŋ ye, anɔ'ɔnamɛ na keŋɛ?”

english_verse: “Everyone, young and old,” Moses answered. “We will even take our sheep, goats, and cattle, because we want to hold a celebration in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses lɛbis ye, “Tinam nɛ ti biis nɛ ti kpɛɛmnam nɛ ti biribis nɛ bipumis nɛ ti bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa na keŋ. Bɔzugɔ ti na keŋ maal di'ema malʋŋʋ tis Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: The king replied, “The Lord had better watch over you on the day I let you leave with your families! You're up to no good.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro ye, “Zugsɔb la sid na bɛ nɛ ya, amaa man kʋ siak ka yanam nɛ ya pu'ab nɛ ya biis la yii! Bɔzugɔ m pʋn mi' ye ya gban'anɛ bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Do you want to worship the Lord? All right, take only the men and go.” Then Moses and Aaron were chased out of the palace.
translation_verse: Ayei! Kɛl ka dap la ma'aa keŋ pʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la, mɛ fʋn pʋn bɔɔdin si'eli la?” Ka ba kad Moses nɛ Aaron n yis Na'ab Faaro san'an.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “Stretch your arm toward Egypt. Swarms of locusts will come and eat everything left by the hail.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Tiesimi fʋ nu'ug teŋ la ni, ka na'azɔmnam na kena san'am si'el wʋsa dinɛ ka ba bʋd pɔɔdin la, nɛ banɛ ka sakuga pʋ san'am la.”

english_verse: Moses held out his walking stick, and the Lord sent an east wind that blew across Egypt the rest of the day and all that night. By morning, locusts
translation_verse: Ka Moses ʋk o dansaar la ties Egipt, ka Zugsɔb kɛ ka sisi'em yi ya-nya'aŋ na gilig teŋ la wʋsa keŋ paae yʋ'ʋŋ. Ka bɛogʋ ti nie naae la ka teŋ la wʋsa di'e nɛ na'azɔmnam.

english_verse: were swarming everywhere. Never before had there been so many locusts in Egypt, and never again will there be so many.
translation_verse: Ka ba di'e Egipt teŋ la wʋsa hali ka ka' kallɛɛ. Na'azɔmnam nan zi' kpɛn' teŋ la nii alaa, ka mɛ kʋ lɛn kpɛn' ya'asɛ.

english_verse: The ground was black with locusts, and they ate everything left on the trees and in the fields. Nothing green remained in Egypt—not a tree or a plant.
translation_verse: Ka ba pɛ'ɛl teŋ la wʋsa ka li sɔbig. Ka ba ɔnb la'abanɛ ka sakuga da pʋ san'am la, nɛ bʋmbʋta banɛ nan bɛ pɔɔdin, nɛ tiis wala la wʋsa. Ka vanma'asir baa yinne lɛn kae Egipt teŋin la ya'asɛ.

english_verse: At once the king sent for Moses and Aaron. He told them, “I have sinned against the Lord your God and against you.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro buol Moses nɛ Aaron tɔ'ɔtɔ ka ye, “Mam maal taali tis Zugsɔb Wina'am nɛ fʋn.

english_verse: Forgive me one more time and ask the Lord to stop these insects from killing every living plant.”
translation_verse: Kɛlli m taali bas, ka sɔs Zugsɔb Wina'am ka o yis namisʋg linɛ kʋʋdi ti la bas.”

english_verse: Moses left the palace and prayed.
translation_verse: Ka Moses naan Na'ab Faaro san'anɛ yi ka sɔs Zugsɔb la

english_verse: Then the Lord sent a strong west wind that swept the locusts into the Red Sea. Not one locust was left anywhere in Egypt,
translation_verse: ka o kɛ ka sisi'etita'ar yi ya-tuona na zi na'azɔmnam la wʋsa mɔri keŋ niŋ Atɛuk Zɛn'ug la ni, ka na'azɔm pʋ lɛn kpɛlim Egipt zin'isi'aa.

english_verse: but the Lord made the king so stubborn that he still refused to let the Israelites go. Darkness
translation_verse: Amaa ka Zugsɔb kɛ ka Na'ab Faaro sʋnf digilim ka o pʋ kɛ ka Israel dim la yii. Lik tita'ari lu Egipt teŋin si'em

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Stretch your arm toward the sky, and everything will be covered with darkness thick enough to touch.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Tiesimi fʋ nu'ug la kpa' saŋgbana ni, ka Egipt wʋsa na an lik. Lik kan na mɔr dabiem.”

english_verse: Moses stretched his arm toward the sky, and Egypt was covered with darkness for three days.
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɔk o nu'ugʋ tiesi kpa' saŋgbana la ni, ka lik di'e Egipt teŋ la wʋsa daba atan',

english_verse: During that time, the Egyptians could not see each other or leave their homes, but there was light where the Israelites lived.
translation_verse: ka sɔ' pʋ nyɛt o tiraan bɛɛ on wa'ae zin'isi'a. Amaa Israel dim la bɛ zin'isi'a la wʋsa da mɔr nɛɛsim.

english_verse: The king sent for Moses and told him, “Go worship the Lord! And take your families with you. Just leave your sheep, goats, and cattle.”
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro buol Moses ka ye, “Yim keŋ pʋ'ʋsi nɛ ya Zugsɔb, yanam nɛ ya pu'ab nɛ ya biis, amaa basimini ya bʋnkɔnbid la.”

english_verse: “No!” Moses replied. “You must let us offer sacrifices to the Lord our God,
translation_verse: Amaa Moses yɛl ye, “Asɛɛ ka fʋ basi ti ka ti mɔr bʋnkɔnbid la keŋ ka maal malima tisi ti Zugsɔb Wina'am.

english_verse: and we won't know which animals we will need until we get there. That's why we can't leave even one of them here.”
translation_verse: Ti bʋnkɔnbid la la'am kennɛ, hali ti pʋ ye ti bas tafɛɛgɔ; ti na nɔk sieba pʋ'ʋsi ti Zugsɔb Wina'am. Ka li ya'a ka' tinamɛ na paae nii, ti kʋ baŋ tinamɛ na nɔk bʋnkɔnbsi'a maal malʋŋ la tis Zugsɔba.”

english_verse: This time the Lord made the king so stubborn
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb digilim Na'ab Faaro sʋnf ka o pʋ siak ye Israel dim la yii keŋɛ.

english_verse: that he said to Moses, “Get out and stay out! If you ever come back, you're dead!”
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro tans Moses ye, “Mɛlimi m tuon, m pʋ lɛm bɔɔd ye m nyɛɛf ya'asɛ! Daakanɛ ka m nyɛɛf, fʋ na kpi.”

english_verse: “Have it your way,” Moses answered. “You won't see me again.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses lɛbis o ye, “Nwɛnɛ fʋn yɛl si'em la, fʋ mɛ kʋ lɛn nyɛɛ ma!”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: I am going to punish the king of Egypt and his people one more time. Then the king will gladly let you leave his land. In fact, he will even chase you out.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ya'as ye, “M na kɛ ka namistita'ar ayinne sig Na'ab Faaro nɛ Egipt teŋin na. Ka lin nya'aŋ o na kɛ ka ya wʋsa yi. Hali o na kadi ya yis o teŋin la.

english_verse: Now go and tell my people to ask their Egyptian neighbors for gold and silver jewelry.
translation_verse: Yɛlim nidib la wʋsa, dap nɛ pu'ab, ye ba yɛli ba kpi'es ka ba tisi ba anzurifa nɛ sanlima.”

english_verse: So the Lord made the Egyptians greatly respect the Israelites, and everyone, including the king's officials, considered Moses an important leader.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka Egipt dim la gɔs nidib la sʋ'ʋŋa, hali ka Faaro kpɛɛmnam nɛ o nidib la wʋsa tis Moses girima.

english_verse: Moses went to the king and said: I have come to let you know what the Lord is going to do. About midnight he will go through the land of Egypt,
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Faaro ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', ‘Yʋ'ʋŋ kaŋa m na gilig Egipt teŋ la wʋsa,

english_verse: and wherever he goes, the first-born son in every family will die. Your own son will die, and so will the son of the lowest slave woman. Even the first-born males of your cattle will die.
translation_verse: ka Egipt dim bikpɛɛmnam wʋsa na kpi, lin yi Na'ab Faaro onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug la biribiŋ kpɛɛm kem paae pu'a onɛ an yammʋg biribiŋ kpɛɛm, hali nɛ niigi bikpɛɛmnam wʋsa.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt there will be loud crying. Nothing like this has ever happened before or will ever happen again.
translation_verse: Ka Egipt wʋsa na mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ kanɛ ka li taab nan zi' bɛ teŋ la nii, ka mɛ kʋ lɛm bɛ ya'asɛ.

english_verse: But there won't be any need for the Israelites to cry. Things will be so quiet that not even a dog will be heard barking. Then you Egyptians will know that the Lord is good to the Israelites, even while he punishes you.
translation_verse: Amaa Israel dim la san'an, hali baa kʋ wɛsi vɔlis saal bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbʋgɔ’; ala ka ya na baŋ ye Zugsɔb bak Egipt dim nɛ Israel dim.

english_verse: Your leaders will come and bow down, begging me to take my people and leave your country. Then we will leave. Moses was very angry; he turned and left the king.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ kpɛɛmnam la na kena igin mam tuon ka nwɛ' nu'ug ka ye, ‘Fʋn nɛ fʋ nya'andɔlib la wʋsa yimi!’ Ka li nya'aŋ ka m yʋ'ʋn na yi.” Ka Moses sʋʋnr duoe ka o yi Na'ab Faaro san'an.

english_verse: What the Lord had earlier said to Moses came true. He had said, “The king of Egypt won't listen. Then I will perform even more miracles.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Na'ab Faaro kʋ siakɛ, dinɛ mɛ na kɛ ka m tʋʋmnyalima la nɔbig Egipt pʋʋgin.”

english_verse: So the king of Egypt saw Moses and Aaron work miracles, but the Lord made him stubbornly refuse to let the Israelites leave his country.
translation_verse: Moses nɛ Aaron tʋm tʋʋm nyalim bama wʋsa Na'ab Faaro nifin, amaa Zugsɔb kɛ nɛ ka Faaro sʋnf digilim ka o pʋ kɛ ka nidib la yii o teŋinɛ.

english_verse: Some time later the Lord said to Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses nɛ Aaron ban da nan bɛ Egipt teŋin la ye,

english_verse: This month is to be the first month of the year for you.
translation_verse: “Nwadkaŋa aan ya yʋʋm la pin'ilʋg nwadig.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that on the tenth day of this month the head of each family must choose a lamb or a young goat for his family to eat.
translation_verse: Alazug, yɛlim Israel nidib la wʋsa ye nwadig la dabpiiga daar, dau wʋsa ye o kʋnɛ pɛraugʋ tis o yidim, yir wʋsa mɔr pɛ'og yinne.

english_verse: Each family must take care of its animal until the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, when the animals are to be killed.
translation_verse: ka ya gʋ'ʋli ba sʋ'ʋŋa gur nwadig la dabpiiga nɛ anaasi daar. Ka winnig ya'a ti bɔɔd kpɛn'ɛb, Israel nidib wʋsa na kʋ bʋnkɔnbid la.

english_verse: Some of the blood must be put on the two doorposts and above the door of each house where the animals are to be eaten.
translation_verse: Li sʋm ye ba nɔk kɔnbʋg la ziim la buoɛn gilig dɔɔg za'anɔɔrin, zin'ikanɛ ka ba ɔnb ni'im la.

english_verse: That night the animals are to be roasted and eaten, together with bitter herbs and thin bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Daakan la yʋ'ʋŋ ka ya ye ya sɛn' ni'im la ɔnb nɛ vantɔɔd, nɛ bodobodo kanɛ ka danbin pʋ gɛndigɛ.

english_verse: Don't eat the meat raw or boiled. The entire animal, including its head, legs, and insides, must be roasted.
translation_verse: Da ɔnbi ni'im la kansa, bɛɛ ya dʋg nɛ ku'om, amaa sɛn'ɛmi bugumin, la'an nɛ zug nɛ nɔba nɛ dinɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa.

english_verse: Eat what you want that night, and the next morning burn whatever is left.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ni'im kpɛlim nie bɛogɔ, ka li ya'a nie bɛog, asɛɛ ya nɔk linɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa niŋ bugumin ka li kanb.

english_verse: When you eat the meal, be dressed and ready to travel. Have your sandals on, carry your walking stick in your hand, and eat quickly. This is the Passover Festival in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ na ɔnbi li si'em nwa'; ya na lɔɔ ya siaa nɛ sɛnbidis, ka pid ta'ada, ka ya dansaya bɛɛ ya nu'usin, ka ya na ɔnbid tɔ'ɔtɔ bɔzugɔ, li anɛ Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ.

english_verse: That same night I will pass through Egypt and kill the first-born son in every family and the first-born male of all animals. I am the Lord, and I will punish the gods of Egypt.
translation_verse: “Ka yʋ'ʋŋ kan la m na gaad Egipt teŋ la pʋʋgin, ka na kʋ bikpɛɛm wʋsa, nidib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa sʋʋgin, ka na kʋʋs Egipt bada la wʋsa bɛ'ɛd. Mam an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The blood on the houses will show me where you live, and when I see the blood, I will pass over you. Then you won't be bothered by the terrible disasters I will bring on Egypt.
translation_verse: Ka ziim la na an zanbinnɛ ya yaan la, ka m ya'a san'amid Egipt teŋ la, ka nyɛ ziim la m na gaad ka bas yikan la ka san'auŋ kʋ kɛn yin la naa.

english_verse: For seven days you must eat bread made without yeast. And on the first of these seven days, you must remove all yeast from your homes. If you eat anything made with yeast during this festival, you will no longer be part of Israel.
translation_verse: Ya na ɔnbid bodobodo kanɛ ka' dabinnɛ paae daba ayɔpɔi. Yisimi danbin nɛ ya yaan, malʋŋ pin'ilʋg la daar. Onɛ di danbinni li pin'ilʋg daar la m paae daba ayɔpɔi la kʋ lɛn an Israel nida.

english_verse: Meet together for worship on the first and seventh days of the festival. The only work you are allowed to do on either of these two days is that of preparing the bread.
translation_verse: Dabisir kanɛ an yiiga la, ya na la'as taaba ka li an man Zugsɔb la la'asʋg. Da tʋmmi tʋʋma dabisbama pʋʋginɛ, ya'a ka' yanamɛ na maal diib ma'aanɛ. Din ma'aa ka ya na tʋm.

english_verse: Celebrate this Festival of Thin Bread as a way of remembering the day that I brought your families and tribes out of Egypt. And do this each year.
translation_verse: Maalimi bodobodo linɛ ka' danbin di'ema, bɔzugɔ li anɛ daakan ka m baki ya nɛ Egipt dim. Maalimi ala saŋa wʋsa, yanam nɛ ya biis banɛ na ti duoe na.

english_verse: Begin on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month by eating bread made without yeast. Then continue this celebration until the evening of the twenty-first day.
translation_verse: Yiiga nwadig la, lin yi dabpii nɛ anaasi zaam ti paae dabpisi nɛ yinne zaam, ya na ɔnb bodobodo kanɛ ka' dabinnɛ.

english_verse: During these seven days no yeast is allowed in anyone's home, whether they are native Israelites or not. If you are caught eating anything made with yeast, you will no longer be part of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka daba ayɔpɔi la wʋsa da kɛ ka danbin bɛɛ ya yaanɛ, ka onɛ di si'el ka li mɔr danbin lɛn ka' Israel nida, baa o ya'a anɛ ya sankpan'as bɛɛ teŋin biiga.

english_verse: Stay away from yeast, no matter where you live. No one is allowed to eat anything made with yeast!
translation_verse: Ya ya'a bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa li pʋ sʋm ye ya di dikanɛ mɔr dabinnɛ. Dimi bodobodo kanɛ ka' dabinnɛ.”

english_verse: Moses called the leaders of Israel together and said: Each family is to pick out a sheep and kill it for Passover.
translation_verse: Ka Moses buol Israel kpɛɛmnam la ka yɛl ye, “Kemi nannanna gaŋi Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ kɔnbid la maali tis sɔ' wʋsa nɛ o yidim.

english_verse: Make a brush from a few small branches of a hyssop plant and dip the brush in the bowl that has the blood of the animal in it. Then brush some of the blood above the door and on the posts at each side of the door of your house. After this, everyone is to stay inside until morning.
translation_verse: Ka ya na nɔk nyulinnyu'usi tʋm ziim la bɛ laan la buoɛn li giligi ya dɔɔd za'anɔya. Mid ka sɔ' naan o zakin yi yiŋ hali nɛ bɛogʋ na ti nie.

english_verse: During that night the Lord will go through the country of Egypt and kill the first-born son in every Egyptian family. He will see where you have put the blood, and he will not come into your house. His angel that brings death will pass over and not kill your first-born sons.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb ya'a ti gat ye o kʋ Egipt dim la, o na nyɛ ziim la buoɛn la ka bas ka gaad ka kʋ kpɛn' yikan na kʋʋ.

english_verse: After you have entered the country promised to you by the Lord, you and your children must continue to celebrate Passover each year.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb da kaanb ye o na tisi ya la, yanam on tiɛnm malʋŋ kaŋa,

english_verse: Your children will ask you, “What are we celebrating?”
translation_verse: ka ya biis ya'a bu'osi ya ye, ‘Ka malʋŋ kaŋa an bɔɔ tisi ya?’

english_verse: And you will answer, “The Passover animal is killed to honor the Lord. We do these things because on that night long ago the Lord passed over the homes of our people in Egypt. He killed the first-born sons of the Egyptians, but he spared our children from death.” After Moses finished speaking, the people of Israel knelt down and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Yanam yɛlimi ba ye, ‘Li anɛ Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋʋ tis Zugsɔb, on da gaŋ Israel dim yaa bas ka kpɛn' Egipt dim yaanɛ kʋʋ ba bikpɛɛmnam la.’” Ka nidib la igin ka wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Then they left and did what Moses and Aaron had told them to do. Death for the First-Born Sons
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la keŋ maal ala; ba da maal wʋʋ Zugsɔbi yɛl Moses nɛ Aaron si'em la.

english_verse: At midnight the Lord killed the first-born son of every Egyptian family, from the son of the king to the son of every prisoner in jail. He also killed the first-born male of every animal that belonged to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋŋ tisʋʋs ka Zugsɔb kʋ Egipt bikpɛɛmnam wʋsa. Lin yi Na'ab Faaro onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug la bikpɛɛm hali paae onɛ bɛ sanrega ni bikpɛɛm, keŋ paae ba niigi bikpɛɛmnam wʋsa.

english_verse: That night the king, his officials, and everyone else in Egypt got up and started crying bitterly. In every Egyptian home, someone was dead. The People of Israel Escape from Egypt
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro duoe, ka o kpɛɛmnam la mɛ duoe, ka Egipt dim wʋsa duoe yʋ'ʋŋ tisʋʋs la, ka li anɛ kukuma; bɔzugɔ yir da kae ka kum pʋ kʋʋ.

english_verse: During the night the king sent for Moses and Aaron and told them, “Get your people out of my country and leave us alone! Go and worship the Lord, as you have asked.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ kan la ka Na'ab Faaro buol Moses nɛ Aaron ka ye, “Yimi ka basini m nidib, yanam nɛ Israel dim la wʋsa! Yim keŋ pʋ'ʋsinɛ ya Zugsɔb la wʋʋ yanamɛ sɔs si'em la.

english_verse: Take your sheep, goats, and cattle, and get out. But ask your God to be kind to me.”
translation_verse: Mɔri ya bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa yii keŋ; ka mɛ niŋ mam bareka.”

english_verse: The Egyptians did everything they could to get the Israelites to leave their country as quickly as possible. They said, “Please hurry and leave. If you don't, we will all be dead.”
translation_verse: Ka Egipt dim la ye ba niŋim tɔ'ɔtɔ ka yi, ka ya'a ka' ala ba na kpii naae.

english_verse: So the Israelites quickly made some bread dough and put it in pans. But they did not mix any yeast in the dough to make it rise. They wrapped cloth around the pans and carried them on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Ka nidib la nɔki ba bodobodo zɔ'ɔm kanɛ ka danbin nam pʋ gɛndig la niŋ laasin. Ba da nɔk laas la lɔ nɛ fuudi buki keŋ.

english_verse: The Israelites had already done what Moses had told them to do. They had gone to their Egyptian neighbors and asked for gold and silver and for clothes.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la tʋm wʋʋ Moses n yɛli ba si'em la, ka yɛl Egipt dim la ye ba tisimi ba anzurifa, nɛ sanlima nɛ fuud.

english_verse: The Lord had made the Egyptians friendly toward the people of Israel, and they gave them whatever they asked for. In this way they carried away the wealth of the Egyptians when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb kɛ ka Egipt dim la gɔsi ba sʋ'ʋŋa, ka tisi ba ban sɔs si'el la; ala ka ba da fan' Egipt dim la.

english_verse: The Israelites walked from the city of Rameses to the city of Succoth. There were about
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la yi Rameses n keŋ Sukot. Ba da anɛ dap tusa kɔbisyuobʋ (

english_verse: of them, not counting women and children.
translation_verse: ), ka pu'ab nɛ biis pʋ paasɛ.

english_verse: Many other people went with them as well, and there were also a lot of sheep, goats, and cattle.
translation_verse: Ka ninsieba banɛ ka Israel dim mɛ dɔlli ba yi, nɛ ba niigi nɛ bʋnkɔnbid.

english_verse: They left Egypt in such a hurry that they did not have time to prepare any food except the bread dough made without yeast. So they baked it and made thin bread.
translation_verse: Ka ba nɔk bodobodo zɔ'ɔm linɛ ka ba mɔri yi Egipt na la sɛn' maal bodobodo linɛ kae danbin nɛ, bɔzugɔ ba da kadi ba yis Egipt tɔ'ɔtɔ, ka saŋa kae ka ba na maal diibɔ.

english_verse: On that night the Lord kept watch for them, and on this same night each year Israel will always keep watch in honor of the Lord. Instructions for Passover
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ kan la Zugsɔb da gur Israel dim la mɔri ba yi Egipt teŋin. Alazug ban nɛ ba yaas nɔkid yʋ'ʋŋ kaŋa zin'inidi nied bɛog ka li an girima tisid Zugsɔb la. Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la tiɛnr yɛla

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses and Aaron the following instructions for celebrating Passover: Only Israelites may eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses nɛ Aaron ye, “Malʋŋ la kisa nwa': Teŋ zʋŋ nid pʋ ditta.

english_verse: Your slaves may eat the meal if they have been circumcised,
translation_verse: Yammʋg ya'a pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ o pʋ ditta.

english_verse: but no foreigners who work for you are allowed to have any.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a kena ye o bɛ dabisa bi'ela, bɛɛ fʋ nɔk sɔ' ye o tʋm si'eli tisif, o pʋ ditta.

english_verse: The entire meal must be eaten inside, and no one may leave the house during the celebration. No bones of the Passover lamb may be broken.
translation_verse: Malʋŋ la pʋ dit samannin nɛ, ni'im la mɛ pʋ yit yiŋa. Da kɔ'ɔgi kɔnbir baa yinne.

english_verse: And all Israelites must take part in the meal.
translation_verse: Di anɛ tilas ye Israel nidib wʋsa maal di'ema malʋŋ la.

english_verse: If anyone who isn't an Israelite wants to celebrate Passover with you, every man and boy in that family must first be circumcised. Then they may join in the meal, just like native Israelites. No uncircumcised man or boy may eat the Passover meal!
translation_verse: Ka saan kanɛ bɛ nɛ ya ka bɔɔd ye o maal Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la, on kpɛn'ɛsim dap banɛ bɛɛ o yin la wʋsa baŋʋ ka li nwɛnɛ ba du'a ba nɛ teŋin la. Amaa onɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ pʋ ditta.

english_verse: This law applies both to native Israelites and to those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Kisʋg la anɛ ala tis teŋin biis nɛ saam.”

english_verse: The Israelites obeyed everything the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron to tell them.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la sid da maal nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses nɛ Aaron si'em la.

english_verse: And on that same day the Lord brought Israel's families and tribes out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ka daakan la ka Zugsɔb mɔr Israel dim la ka ba dɔl taaba dɔɔg, dɔɔgʋ yi Egipt teŋin na.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: “Dedicate to me the first-born son of every family and the first-born males of your flocks and herds. These belong to me.” The Festival of Thin Bread
translation_verse: “Maalim bikpɛŋ wʋsa nyain tisim. Biribiŋ kpɛŋ wʋsa anɛ mam bʋn, o ya'a anɛ nid bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbʋgɔ.” Bodobodo linɛ pʋ gɛndig danbin la Malʋŋ

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors that he would bring you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites. It is a land rich with milk and honey. Each year during the month of Abib, celebrate these events in the following way:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ya'a mɔri ya keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka Keenan dim nɛ Hitti dim nɛ Amor dim nɛ Perizi dim nɛ Hivi dim nɛ Jebus dim bɛ la, teŋ kanɛ pʋbid bin'isim nɛ siind ka o da kaanb ye o na tisi ya yaanam la, yanam maalim malʋŋ di'em kaŋa nwadkaŋa ni.

english_verse: For seven days you are to eat bread made without yeast, and on the seventh day you are to celebrate a festival in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka lin yi zina ti paae daba ayɔpɔi, ɔmmi bodobodo dinɛ pʋ mɔr danbinnɛ, ka daba ayɔpɔi la daar, ya na maal malʋŋʋ tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: During those seven days, you must not eat anything made with yeast or even have yeast anywhere near your homes.
translation_verse: Ɔmmi bodobodo dinɛ ka danbin kae daba ayɔpɔi la wʋsa, da kɛ ka danbin bɛ disi'a ni baa bi'ela, bɛɛ li kpi'e ya teŋ laa.

english_verse: Then on the seventh day you must explain to your children that you do this because the Lord brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Daakan la yanam yɛlimi ya biis ye, ‘M maal nwa' nɛ ka li pa'al Zugsɔb la da tʋm si'em tis mam, man da yi Egipt na la.’

english_verse: This celebration will be like wearing a sign on your hand or on your forehead, because then you will pass on to others the teaching of the Lord, whose mighty power brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ka malʋŋ di'em kaŋa na an wʋʋ zanbinnɛ bɛɛ fʋ nu'ugin, ka lɛm bɛɛ fʋ gbɛ'ogʋn, ka Zugsɔb nɔzi'ela la na bɛɛ fʋ nɔŋgbanin. Ka li pa'al ye Zugsɔb la mɔri ya yi Egipt na nɛ o mɛŋ paŋ.

english_verse: Celebrate this festival each year at the same time.
translation_verse: Li sʋm ye fʋ tɛnr malʋŋ di'em kaŋa yʋʋm woo, li saŋa ya'a paae.” Bikpɛɛmnam yɛla ya'as

english_verse: The Lord will give you the land of the Canaanites, just as he promised you and your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛn yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la ya'a mɔri ya keŋ Keenan dim teŋin ka tisi ya teŋ la, wʋʋ on da kaanbi tisi ya yaanam si'em la,

english_verse: From then on, you must give him every first-born son from your families and every first-born male from your animals, because these belong to him.
translation_verse: ya na nɔk bʋnkɔnbkanɛ du'a yiiga tis o. Bʋnkɔnbkanɛ wʋsa du'a bʋndaug yiiga la anɛ Zugsɔb bʋn.

english_verse: You can spare the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must spare every first-born son.
translation_verse: Ya bʋŋ ya'a dɛŋin du'a bʋndibig, yanam tiakimi nɛ pɛribigi tis Zugsɔb la. Amaa ya ya'a pʋ lɛm bɔɔd ye ya tiakɛ, ya tun'e kɔ'ɔg bʋŋ la niŋgɔɔnri kʋ. Ala mɛn ka ya na tiaki ya bikpɛɛmnam wʋsa.

english_verse: In the future your children will ask what this ceremony means. Explain it to them by saying, “The Lord used his mighty power to rescue us from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ka bɛog sa, ya biis ya'a bu'osi ya ye, ‘Nwa' an bɔ?’ Yanam yɛlimi ba ye, ‘Tinamɛ da an yammis Egipt teŋin la, ka Zugsɔb la da faaɛn ti yi nɛ o mɛŋ paŋ tita'ar.

english_verse: The king stubbornly refused to set us free, so the Lord killed the first-born male of every animal and the first-born son of every Egyptian family. This is why we sacrifice to the Lord every first-born male of every animal and save every first-born son.”
translation_verse: Na'ab Faaro da maal zukpi'euŋʋ zan'as ye ti kʋ yi la, Zugsɔb la da kʋ Egipt nidib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid bikpɛɛmnam wʋsa. Dinɛ kɛ ka ti mɔr si'el wʋsa bikpɛɛm maan maana tisid Zugsɔb la, amaa di ya'a an ninsaal, ti nɔkid nɛ pɛ'ogʋ tiakid.

english_verse: This ceremony will serve the same purpose as a sign on your hand or on your forehead to tell how the Lord's mighty power rescued us from Egypt. The Lord Leads His People
translation_verse: Lina mɛ na an zanbinnɛ bɛɛ ya nu'usin nɛ ya gbɛ'ɛdin. Li anɛ linɛ pa'an ye li anɛ Zugsɔb la mɔri ti yi Egipt na nɛ o mɛŋ paŋ.’” Saŋgbauŋ nɛ bugum la yɛla

english_verse: After the king had finally let the people go, the Lord did not lead them through Philistine territory, though that was the shortest way. God had said, “If they are attacked, they may decide to return to Egypt.”
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro da bas nidib la ka ba keŋ la, Wina'am da pʋ mɔri ba dɔl suokanɛ dɔl Filistia dim teŋin la, la'an nɛ lin da pʋ lal Egipt nɛ Keenan teŋ la bɔzugɔ Wina'am da yɛl ye, “Nidib nwa' ya'a tʋ'ʋs zaba, ba na tiaki ba pʋtɛn'ɛr ka lɛb Egipt.”

english_verse: So he led them around through the desert and toward the Red Sea. The Israelites left Egypt, prepared for battle.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am nɔki ba dɔl mɔɔgin ken Atɛuk Zɛn'ug la baba. Ka Israel dim la bas Egipt ka dɔl taaba ken dɔɔg-dɔɔg.

english_verse: Moses had them take the bones of Joseph, whose dying words had been, “God will come to your rescue, and when he does, be sure to take my bones with you.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɔk Josef kɔnba, bɔzugɔ Josef da yɛl Israel dim ye, “Pɔɔm tisinim ye Wina'am ya'a mɔri yaa lɛbi ya teŋin la ya na mɔri m kɔnba la keŋ.”

english_verse: The people of Israel left Succoth and camped at Etham at the border of Egypt near the desert.
translation_verse: Ba da yi Sukot teŋin keŋ zin'in Etam teŋ kanɛ pʋ lal nɛ mɔɔgin la.

english_verse: At Etham the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel to turn back and camp across from Pi-Hahiroth near Baal-Zephon, between Migdol and the Red Sea.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim nidib Israel dim la ye ba dɔlli kpa' Pihahirot nɛ Migdol dinɛ kpi'e nɛ Atɛuk la. Zin'inimi Baal-Zafon nya'aŋ, atɛuk la gʋʋr.

english_verse: The king will think you were afraid to cross the desert and that you are wandering around, trying to find another way to leave the country.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro na tɛn'ɛs ye, ‘Israel dim la bɔdignɛ. O na ye mɔɔg nɛ Atɛuk la gu' ba nɛ.’

english_verse: I will make the king stubborn again, and he will try to catch you. Then I will destroy him and his army. People everywhere will praise me for my victory, and the Egyptians will know that I really am the Lord. The Israelites obeyed the Lord and camped where he told them.
translation_verse: Ka m na kɛ ka Faaro sʋnf digilim ka o kadi ya bugir. Mam gban'anɛ nwa' ye m paam girima Faaro nɛ o soogianam la san'an, ka li nya'aŋ ka Egipt dim na baŋ ye mam an Zugsɔb la.” Ka Israel dim la da niŋ ala.

english_verse: When the king of Egypt heard that the Israelites had finally left, he and his officials changed their minds and said, “Look what we have done! We let them get away, and they will no longer be our slaves.”
translation_verse: Ka labaari paae Egipt na'ab la ye Israel dim la kʋ lɛn lɛb Egipt na la, ka Na'ab la nɛ o kpɛɛmnam tiaki ba pʋtɛn'ɛr ka yɛl ye, “Gɔsima, bɔɔ lɛɛ kɛ ka ti bas Israel dim la ka ba keŋɛ? Ba wʋsa yii gaad ka kʋ lɛn aan ti yammisɛ!”

english_verse: The king got his war chariot and army ready.
translation_verse: Ka o lɔɔ o widi ka yɛl o soogianam ka ba dɔl o.

english_verse: He commanded his officers in charge of his
translation_verse: O da nɔk nɛ zaba widi tɛreko sʋma la kɔbisyuobʋ (

english_verse: best chariots and all his other chariots to start after the Israelites.
translation_verse: ), nɛ zaba tɛrekonam banɛ kpɛlim Egipt teŋin la wʋsa nɛ ba zaba kpɛɛmnam.

english_verse: The Lord made the king so stubborn that he went after them, while the Israelites proudly went on their way.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb digilim Egipt Na'ab Faaro sʋnf ka o kad Israel dim banɛ da yi nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ la.

english_verse: But the king's horses and chariots and soldiers caught up with them while they were camping by the Red Sea near Pi-Hahiroth and Baal-Zephon.
translation_verse: Ka Egipt dim la nɛ ba Na'ab la nɛ widi nɛ tɛrekonam la, nɛ wiedban'adib nɛ soogianam la wʋsa kad Israel dim hali ti paae ba ka ba bɛ atɛuk dinɛ kpi'e Pihahirot, Baal-Zafon nya'aŋ la.

english_verse: When the Israelites saw the king coming with his army, they were frightened and begged the Lord for help.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro da paadi ba la, Israel dim la da nyɛ ka Egipt soogianam la dɔlli ba nya'aŋ ka dabiem kpɛn' ba ka ba kaasi tis Zugsɔb la

english_verse: They also complained to Moses, “Wasn't there enough room in Egypt to bury us? Is that why you brought us out here to die in the desert? Why did you bring us out of Egypt anyway?
translation_verse: ka yɛl Moses ye, “Li anɛ yaadi ka' Egipt la zug ka fʋ mɔri ti na ye ti kpi mɔɔgin kpɛla, bɛɛ? Bɔ kimm kɛ ka fʋ mɔri ti yi Egipt na?

english_verse: While we were there, didn't we tell you to leave us alone? We'd rather be slaves in Egypt than die in this desert!”
translation_verse: Ti daa pʋ yɛlif ye fʋ basimi ti Egipt teŋin ka ti tʋmmi tisidi baa? Ti ya'a tʋmmi tisidi ba, li naan kʋ sɔn'ɔn tinamɛ ye ti kpi mɔɔgin nwaa?”

english_verse: But Moses answered, “Don't be afraid! Be brave, and you will see the Lord save you today. These Egyptians will never bother you again.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛli ba ye, “Da zɔti dabiem! Zi'enimi santir ka nyɛ Zugsɔb la na yisi ya si'em. Yanamɛ nyɛt Egipt dim nwa' si'em zina la, ya kʋ lɛn nyɛɛ ba ya'asɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will fight for you, and you won't have to do a thing.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb na zabi tisi ya, kʋdim zi'enimi santir!”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Why do you keep calling out to me for help? Tell the Israelites to move forward.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ kaasidi ziinnɛ ma? Yɛlim Israel dim la ye ba kem tuon!

english_verse: Then hold your walking stick over the sea. The water will open up and make a road where they can walk through on dry ground.
translation_verse: Ʋkimi fʋ dansaar la agɔl ka tiesi kpa' atɛuk la ka ku'om la na pʋdig, ka Israel dim la na dɔl teŋ kpi'emisi gaad.

english_verse: I will make the Egyptians so stubborn that they will go after you. Then I will be praised because of what happens to the king and his chariots and cavalry.
translation_verse: Ka m na digilim Egipt dim la sʋnya ka ba dɔlli ya ka m paam girima yi Faaro nɛ o wiedban'adib nɛ soogianam la san'an.

english_verse: All this time God's angel had gone ahead of Israel's army, but now he moved behind them. A large cloud had also gone ahead of them,
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am maliak onɛ daa bɛ Israel dim tuon la daa lɛb nya'aŋ; ka saŋgbauŋ la mɛ lɛb nya'aŋi zi'en,

english_verse: but now it moved between the Egyptians and the Israelites. The cloud gave light to the Israelites, but made it dark for the Egyptians, and during the night they could not come any closer.
translation_verse: ka bɛ Egipt soogianam nɛ Israel dim la teŋsʋk. Ka yʋ'ʋŋ kan la wʋsa zin'ig yinne da anɛ lik ka zin'ig yinne an nɛɛsim ka sɔ' pʋ nyaŋi paae o tiraana.

english_verse: Moses stretched his arm over the sea, and the Lord sent a strong east wind that blew all night until there was dry land where the water had been. The sea opened up,
translation_verse: Ka Moses da tiɛn o nu'ugʋ kpa' atɛuk la. Ka yʋ'ʋŋ kan la wʋsa ka Zugsɔb buak ku'om la nɛ sisi'etita'ar kanɛ yi ya-nya'aŋ na, ka zin'ikanɛ ka ku'om la buak la lieb kpi'emis.

english_verse: and the Israelites walked through on dry land with a wall of water on each side.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la nɔɔ atɛuk la pʋʋgin teŋ kpi'emisi gaad, ka ku'om la mɛ zaŋguom datiuŋ nɛ dagɔbʋg.

english_verse: But before daylight the Lord looked down at the Egyptian army from the fiery cloud and made them panic.
translation_verse: Ka bɛkɛung ka Zugsɔb da bɛ bugumin nɛ saŋgbauŋin gɔsid Egipt soogianam la, ka kɛ ka dabietita'ar kpɛn' ba ka ba pin'ili zɔt yaaŋ-yaaŋ.

english_verse: Their chariot wheels got stuck, and it was hard for them to move. So the Egyptians said to one another, “Let's leave these people alone! The Lord is on their side and is fighting against us.”
translation_verse: O daa kɛ ka ba tɛrekonam la nɔba fir ka ba pʋ tun'e kenna. Ka Egipt dim la yɛl ye, “Kɛlli ka ti zɔ ka bas Israel dim la ka Zugsɔb la zabidnɛ tisidi ba!”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “Stretch your arm toward the sea—the water will cover the Egyptians and their cavalry and chariots.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye, “Tiɛnmi fʋ nu'ugʋ kpa' atɛuk la ka ku'om la lɛb na di Egipt dim la nɛ ba tɛrekonam nɛ ba wiedban'adib la wʋsa.”

english_verse: Moses stretched out his arm, and at daybreak the water rushed toward the Egyptians. They tried to run away, but the Lord drowned them in the sea.
translation_verse: Ka Moses tiesi o nu'ugʋ kpa' atɛuk la, ka bɛogʋ ti yɔe nier la ka ku'om la lɛbi li naŋnaŋin, ka Egipt dim la mɔɔd ye ba zɔɔ yi la, Zugsɔb la tusi ba lɛbis ku'omin la.

english_verse: The water came and covered the chariots, the cavalry, and the whole Egyptian army that had followed the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them was left alive.
translation_verse: Ka ku'om la lɛb na di tɛrekonam la nɛ wiedban'adib la hali nɛ Faaro soogianam banɛ dɔlli sig atɛukʋn la wʋsa, baa ba nid yinne pʋ kpɛlim.

english_verse: But the sea had made a wall of water on each side of the Israelites, so they walked through on dry land.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Israel dim la on lɛɛ keŋ teŋ kpi'emisi yi atɛukʋn la na, ka ku'om la maal zaŋguommi ba datiuŋ nɛ ba dagɔbʋg.

english_verse: On that day, when the Israelites saw the bodies of the Egyptians washed up on the shore, they knew that the Lord had saved them.
translation_verse: Ala ka Zugsɔb la da faaɛn Israel dim la yis Egipt dim nu'usin; ka ba nyɛ ka Egipt dim la kpii digi dig atɛuk la gbɛog.

english_verse: Because of the mighty power he had used against the Egyptians, the Israelites worshiped him and trusted him and his servant Moses.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la da nyɛ Zugsɔbi zaŋ o paŋtita'ari nyaŋ Egipt dim si'em la ka niŋ o yadda ka mɛ niŋ Moses yadda.

english_verse: Moses and the Israelites sang this song in praise of the Lord: I sing praises to the Lord for his great victory! He has thrown the horses and their riders into the sea.
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɛ Israel dim la yʋ'ʋm yʋʋm kaŋa tis Zugsɔb la: “M na yʋʋm pian' Zugsɔb la, onɛ an girima daan ka lɛn nyaŋid. O nɔk wiedban'adib la nɛ widi la lɔsi Atɛuk la ni.

english_verse: The Lord is my strength, the reason for my song, because he has saved me. I praise and honor the Lord— he is my God and the God of my ancestors.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an mam paŋ, o zug ka m yʋ'ʋmid yʋʋm nwa', onɛ lieb mam faangid. Onɛ an mam Wina'am ka m na wɔ'ɔg o, mam yaanam Wina'am ka m na dʋ'ʋs o yʋ'ʋr!

english_verse: The Lord is his name, and he is a warrior!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb anɛ zabzabid. O yʋ'ʋri an Zugsɔb.

english_verse: He threw the chariots and army of Egypt's king into the Red Sea, and he drowned the best of the king's officers.
translation_verse: Na'ab Faaro tɛrekonam nɛ soogianam la wʋsa ka o lɔbi bas Atɛukʋn, hali nɛ o soogia kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa, Atɛuk Zɛn'ug dii ba.

english_verse: They sank to the bottom just like stones.
translation_verse: Ku'ozuluŋ la dii ba ka ba sim wʋʋ kugir nɛ.

english_verse: With the tremendous force of your right arm, our Lord, you crushed your enemies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba! Fʋ datiuŋ nu'ug la mɔr paŋ. Zugsɔba, fʋ datiuŋ nu'ug la nyaŋ dataas la.

english_verse: What a great victory was yours, when you defeated everyone who opposed you. Your fiery anger wiped them out, as though they were straw.
translation_verse: Fʋ paŋ la kɛnɛ ka fʋ nyaŋ banɛ wʋsa ki'isi fʋ nɔɔr. Ka fʋ sʋʋnr duoe ka ba kanb wʋʋ vaala nɛ mɔɔd nɛ.

english_verse: You were so furious that the sea piled up like a wall, and the ocean depths curdled like cheese.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ vʋ'ʋsʋg ma'aa kɛ ka ku'om la la'as taaba. Ka ku'okanɛ dammid la mɛ duoe zi'e wʋʋ zaŋguoma nɛ. Ka ku'om la kpɛ'ɛŋ kaŋ-kaŋ Atɛuk la teŋsʋk.

english_verse: Your enemies boasted that they would pursue and capture us, divide up our possessions, treat us as they wished, then take out their swords and kill us right there.
translation_verse: Dataas la da nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg ye, ‘Ti na kadi ba, Ti na paae ba ka nyaŋi ba, Ti na faaɛn ba la'ad la pʋdig, Ti na zaŋ tinamɛ bɔɔd si'el. Ti na fuoe ti sʋ'ʋs ka san'ami ba.’

english_verse: But when you got furious, they sank like lead, swallowed by ocean waves.
translation_verse: Fʋ vʋ'ʋsʋm ma'aa kɛ ka Atɛuk la dii ba ka ba sim wʋʋ dalbanam nɛ ku'otita'ar la ni.

english_verse: Our Lord, no other gods compare with you— Majestic and holy! Fearsome and glorious! Miracle worker!
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, wina wʋsa pʋʋginɛ anɔ'ɔnɛ nwɛnɛ fɔ? Anɔ'ɔnɛ nwɛnɛ fʋn kanɛ na'am an kasi, ka mɔr girima ka tʋm nyalima la?

english_verse: When you signaled with your right hand, your enemies were swallowed deep into the earth.
translation_verse: Fʋ ʋki fʋ nu'ug nɛ paŋ ka teŋ la vɔli ba wʋsa.

english_verse: The people you rescued were led by your powerful love to your holy place.
translation_verse: Fʋ na mɔri fʋ nimbanɛ ka fʋ faaɛn la nɛ nɔŋilim, fʋ na mɔri ba nɛ fʋ paŋ tita'ar la paae fʋ bɛllim zin'ig linɛ an kasi la.

english_verse: Nations learned of this and trembled— Philistines shook with horror.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns la na wʋm ka dabiem gban'e ba; ka sʋnsan'aŋ tita'ar na paae Filistia dim.

english_verse: The leaders of Edom and of Moab were terrified. Everyone in Canaan fainted,
translation_verse: Dabietita'ar na kpɛn' Edom na'anam; ka Moab kpɛɛmnam na kirid, ka Keenan dim giinla na kɛns ka ba mɛlim.

english_verse: struck down by fear. Our Lord, your powerful arm kept them still as a rock until the people you rescued to be your very own had marched by.
translation_verse: Dabietita'ar na paae ba. Fʋ nu'ug kanɛ mɔr paŋ la na kɛ ka ba ga'aŋi lieb wʋʋ kugir nɛ, asɛɛ ka fʋ nidib la ti gaad; hali ka nimbanɛ ka Zugsɔb da' ba la gaadi naae.

english_verse: You will let your people settle on your own mountain, where you chose to live and to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Fʋ na mɔri ba paae, ka zin'ili ba zuokanɛ aan fʋ mɛŋ din la zug. Zin'ikanɛ ka fʋn Zugsɔb maal ye fʋ bɛ la. Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kanɛ ka fʋn Zugsɔb mɛ nɛ fʋ mɛŋ-mɛŋ nu'ug la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will rule forever! The Song of Miriam
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na an Na'ab, saŋa dinɛ ka' naarɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord covered the royal Egyptian cavalry and chariots with the sea, after the Israelites had walked safely through on dry ground.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Faaro widi nɛ o tɛrekonam nɛ wiedban'adib la wʋsa sig Atɛukʋn la ka Zugsɔb kɛ ka ku'om la dii ba, amaa Israel dim la da dɔlnɛ Atɛuk la pʋʋgin gaad teŋ kpi'emis. Miriam yʋʋm

english_verse: Miriam the sister of Aaron was a prophet. So she took her tambourine and led the other women out to play their tambourines and to dance.
translation_verse: Ka Miriam onɛ an Wina'am nɔdi'es pu'ak ka an Aaron taʋn la nɔk siyaarig, ka pu'ab la wʋsa nɔk siyaarisi nwɛ'ɛdi dɔl o ka wa'ad.

english_verse: Then she sang to them: “Sing praises to the Lord for his great victory! He has thrown the horses and their riders into the sea.” Bitter Water at Marah
translation_verse: Ka Miriam yʋʋm tisi ba ye, “Yʋʋm tisi Zugsɔb la, bɔzugɔ onɛ nyaŋ nyaŋir ka nar nɛ girima O nɔk wiedban'adib la nɛ widi la lɔs Atɛuk la ni.” Mara teŋin ku'otɔɔg la yɛla

english_verse: After the Israelites left the Red Sea, Moses led them through the Shur Desert for three days, before finding water.
translation_verse: Ka Moses mɔr Israel dim la yii Atɛuk Zɛn'ug la ni keŋ teŋ kanɛ an pipirig ka ba buon ye Seur la. Daba atan' ka ba zaŋi keŋ mɔɔgin la ka pʋ nyɛ ku'om.

english_verse: They did find water at Marah, but it was bitter, which is how that place got its name.
translation_verse: Ka ban da paae Mara la, ba da pʋ nyaŋi nu ku'om la bɔzugɔ li da anɛ tɔɔg .

english_verse: The people complained and said, “Moses, what are we going to drink?”
translation_verse: Ka nidib la nyɔn Moses ye, “Ti na nu bɔ?”

english_verse: Moses asked the Lord for help, and the Lord told him to throw a certain piece of wood into the water. Moses did so, and the water became fit to drink. At Marah the Lord tested his people and also gave them some laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ka Moses fabili tis Zugsɔb la ka o pa'al o dasi'a ka o zaŋi lɔs ku'omin la ka li yʋ'ʋn malis. Anina ka Zugsɔb zi'el zi'elʋg nɛ kisa tisi ba ye o kpansi ba gɔs,

english_verse: Then he said, “I am the Lord your God, and I cure your diseases. If you obey me by doing right and by following my laws and teachings, I won't punish you with the diseases I sent on the Egyptians.”
translation_verse: ka ye, “Ya ya'a kɛlis mam Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔɔr, hali ka tʋm dinɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa m nifin ka siaki m yɛla, ka mɔri m nɔzi'ela la, wibanɛ ka m daa kɛ ka di gban'e Egipt dim la kʋ gban'e ya. Manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ tisidi ya laafi la.”

english_verse: Later the Israelites came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and
translation_verse: Ka ba paae Elim na, anina mɔr kɔlis pii nɛ ayi' nɛ kpʋkparis tiis pisyɔpɔi; ka ba zin'in anina kpi'e nɛ ku'om la.

english_verse: On the fifteenth day of the second month after the Israelites had escaped from Egypt, they left Elim and started through the western edge of the Sinai Desert in the direction of Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la duoe Elim keŋ paae teŋ kanɛ an pipirig ka ba buonnɛ li ye Sin, ka li bɛ Elim nɛ Sinai teŋsʋk la. Li da anɛ nwadis ayi' la dabpii nɛ anu daar ban yi Egipt na la.

english_verse: There in the desert they started complaining to Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Ka Israel nidib la wʋsa nyɔn Moses nɛ Aaron, pipirigin la

english_verse: “We wish the Lord had killed us in Egypt. When we lived there, we could at least sit down and eat all the bread and meat we wanted. But you have brought us out here into this desert, where we are going to starve.”
translation_verse: yɛt ye, “Ti ya'a daa kpi Zugsɔb la nu'usin Egipt teŋin di pʋ sɔn'oe yaa? Anina ka ti daa ɔnbid ni'im ka dit diibi tigid, amaa fʋ mɔri tii kɛn mɔɔgin kpɛla na ye kɔ'ɔm kʋʋ ti wʋsa.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I will send bread down from heaven like rain. Tell the people to go out each day and gather only enough for that day. That's how I will see if they obey me.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “M na kɛ ka diib yi arezana na tisi ya. Daar wʋsa ba yim vaae dinɛ na siaki ba daakan ma'aa, ka m gɔs ye ba na dɔl mam nɔɔr bɛɛ ba kʋ dɔlla.

english_verse: But on the sixth day of each week they must gather and cook twice as much.”
translation_verse: Amaa daba ayuobʋ daar la, ba na vaae ban ɛɛn pʋn vaad si'em la nɔɔr ayi'.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron told the people, “This evening you will know that the Lord was the one who rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɛ Aaron yɛl Israel dim la ye, “Zaama ya na baŋ ye Zugsɔb la sid mɔri ya yi Egipt na.

english_verse: And in the morning you will see his glorious power, because he has heard your complaints against him. Why should you grumble to us? Who are we?”
translation_verse: Bɛog bɛkɛung ka ya na nyɛ Zugsɔb girima la, bɔzugɔ, o wʋm yanamɛ nyɔn o si'em la. Tinam aan anɔ'ɔn ka ya nyɔnnɛ ti?”

english_verse: Then Moses continued, “You will know it is the Lord when he gives you meat each evening and more than enough bread each morning. He is really the one you are complaining about, not us—we are nobodies—but the Lord has heard your complaints.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la na tisidi ya ni'im zaam ka ya ɔnbid, ka tisidi ya diib bɛogʋn ka ya diti tigid. Ala ka ya na baŋ ye Zugsɔb la ka ya nyɔn ka ka' tinama. Tinam aan anɔ'ɔnɛ? Ya pʋ nyɔn tinama, amaa ya nyɔnnɛ Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: Moses turned to Aaron and said, “Bring the people together, because the Lord has heard their complaints.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Aaron ye, “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye ba kem na, ka Zugsɔb wʋmi ba nyɔnyɔlʋg la.”

english_verse: Aaron was speaking to them, when everyone looked out toward the desert and saw the bright glory of the Lord in a cloud.
translation_verse: Ka Aaron nan bɛɛ anina yɛt Israel dim la, ka ba gɔs mɔɔgin ka Zugsɔb girima nie saŋgbauŋin la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: “I have heard my people complain. Now tell them that each evening they will have meat and each morning they will have more than enough bread. Then they will know that I am the Lord their God.”
translation_verse: “M wʋm Israel dim nyɔnyɔlʋg la. Yɛlimi ba ye, ‘Zaam ya na ɔnbid ni'im ka bɛogʋn ka ya dit diib. Ala ka ya na baŋ ye mam an Zugsɔb ya Wina'am la.’”

english_verse: That evening a lot of quails came and landed everywhere in the camp, and the next morning dew covered the ground.
translation_verse: Ka zakan la ka kɔdis kena pɛ'ɛl ban gbɛɛnd zin'isi'a la. Ka bɛogʋn ka mɛligim lii madigi madig zin'ig la.

english_verse: After the dew had gone, the desert was covered with thin flakes that looked like frost.
translation_verse: Ka mɛligim la kʋdig la ka ba nyɛ bʋnsieba ka ba an lamma-lamma nwɛnɛ sa'apɛlaa bɛ teŋin la.

english_verse: The people had never seen anything like this, and they started asking each other, “What is it?” Moses answered, “This is the bread that the Lord has given you to eat.
translation_verse: Israel dimi nyɛɛ li la, ba bu'os taaba ye, “Ka nwa' an bɔ?” Bɔzugɔ ba da zi' lin an si'ela. Ka Moses yɛli ba ye, “Li anɛ dikanɛ ka Zugsɔb tisi ya ye ya di la.

english_verse: And he orders you to gather about two liters for each person in your family—that should be more than enough.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em nwa': ‘Sɔ' wʋsa vaam on na nyaŋi di si'em bɛn, ka mɛ vaae dinɛ na sia'al o yidim.’”

english_verse: They did as they were told. Some gathered more and some gathered less.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la tʋm wʋʋ ban yɛli ba si'em la, ka sieba vaae bɛdegʋ ka sieba vaae bi'ela.

english_verse: Moses told them not to keep any overnight.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛli ba ye, “Mid ka sɔ' digil ye bɛog ka o di.”

english_verse: Some of them disobeyed, but the next morning what they kept was stinking and full of worms, and Moses was angry.
translation_verse: Amaa sieba pʋ di'e Moses n yɛl si'el la, ka digil sieba ye bɛog. Ka zʋnzʋnya kpɛn' ka li pun'oe nyuusid. Ka Moses sʋʋnr duoe nɛ ba.

english_verse: Each morning everyone gathered as much as they needed, and in the heat of the day the rest melted.
translation_verse: Daar wʋsa bɛogʋn, sɔ' wʋsa vaadnɛ o paŋi tun'e si'em, ka nintaŋ ya'a mu'oe ka li nyɛlig.

english_verse: However, on the sixth day of the week, everyone gathered enough to have four liters, instead of two. When the leaders reported this to Moses,
translation_verse: Amaa daba ayuobʋ daar la, nid yinne wʋsa da vaadnɛ nwama ayi' ka li an daba ayi' din. Ka Israel kpɛɛmnam la kena yɛl Moses,

english_verse: he told them that the Lord had said, “Tomorrow is the Sabbath, a sacred day of rest in honor of me. So gather all you want to bake or boil, and make sure you save enough for tomorrow.”
translation_verse: ka o yɛli ba ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em nwa': ‘Bɛog anɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar, ka an kasi tis Zugsɔb la. Sɛn'ɛmi yanamɛ na sɛn' si'el, ka dʋg yanamɛ na dʋg si'el, ka digil dinɛ kpɛlim la gur bɛog.’”

english_verse: The people obeyed, and the next morning the food smelled fine and had no worms.
translation_verse: Ka ba sid kɛ sieba gur bɛog wʋʋ Moses n yɛl si'em la. Ka li pʋ pun'oe nyuusid bɛɛ bʋnvʋya kpɛn' baa.

english_verse: “You may eat the food,” Moses said. “Today is the Sabbath in honor of the Lord, and there won't be any of this food on the ground today.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛli ba ye, “Dimini li zina bɔzugɔ zina anɛ Zugsɔb dabisir. Ya kʋ nyɛ diib la teŋin la zinaa.

english_verse: You will find it there for the first six days of the week, but not on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Daba ayuobʋ la ka ya vaad, amaa daba ayɔpɔi daar ya kʋ nyɛɛ lii.”

english_verse: A few of the Israelites did go out to look for some, but there was none.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, sieba da yi daba ayɔpɔi la daar keŋ ye ba vaae diib, amaa ka li kae.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Moses, how long will you people keep disobeying my laws and teachings?
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Nɔɔr ala ka ya zan'as ye ya kʋ di'e mam nɔɔr nɛ mam nɔzi'ela?

english_verse: Remember that I was the one who gave you the Sabbath. That's why on the sixth day I provide enough bread for two days. Everyone is to stay home and rest on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Baŋim ye Zugsɔb la tisi ya o dabisir la. Din ka daba ayuobʋ la daar ka o tisi ya daba ayi' diib la. Ka sɔ' wʋsa na kpɛlim on bɛ zin'isi'a daba ayɔpɔi la daar. Sɔ' da yi yiŋa.”

english_verse: And so they rested on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ka nidib la da vʋ'ʋs daba ayɔpɔi la daar.

english_verse: The Israelites called the bread manna. It was white like coriander seed and delicious as wafers made with honey.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la buol bodobodo la ye manna. Li da anɛ piela-piela ka malis wʋʋ siind nɛ.

english_verse: Moses told the people that the Lord had said, “Store up two liters of this manna, because I want future generations to see the food I gave you during the time you were in the desert after I rescued you from Egypt.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛli ba ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em nwa': ‘Makimi manna la kuriba yinne digili ka ya bibanɛ ti duoe na nyɛ dikanɛ ka m tisi ya mɔɔgin mam mɔri ya yi Egipt na la.’”

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron, “Put some manna in a jar and store it in the place of worship for future generations to see.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Aaron ye, “Nɔkim yubigi mak manna kuriba yinne niŋ anina zi'el Zugsɔb la tuon ka li bɛɛ ani an kasɛti tis bibanɛ na ti duoe na.”

english_verse: Aaron followed the Lord's instructions and put the manna in front of the sacred chest for safekeeping.
translation_verse: Ka nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la, Aaron nɔk manna la zi'el nɔnaar zin'igin, ka li bɛɛ anina saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: The Israelites left the desert and moved from one place to another each time the Lord ordered them to. Once they camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for them to drink.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la kɛ ka Israel dim yi Sin pipirigin la keŋ paae Refidim na, zin'ikan la ku'om da kae ka nidib la na nuu.

english_verse: The people started complaining to Moses, “Give us some water!” Moses replied, “Why are you complaining to me and trying to put the Lord to the test?”
translation_verse: Ka nidib la pin'ili nyɔn ka yɛt Moses ye, “Tisimi ti ku'om ka ti nu!” Ka Moses lɛbisi ba baanlimm ye, “Bɔ ka ya nwa'asid nɛ mam? Bɔɔ maal ka ya makid Zugsɔb la?”

english_verse: But the people were thirsty and kept on complaining, “Moses, did you bring us out of Egypt just to let us and our families and our animals die of thirst?”
translation_verse: Amaa ku'onuudi wʋmi ba la zug ka ba zan'as ka nyɔn. Ka ye, “Bɔɔ pʋn maal ka fʋ yis tinam Egipt mɔri ti kɛn kpɛla na ye fʋ kɛ ka tinam nɛ ti biis nɛ ti bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa kpi ku'onuudɛ?”

english_verse: Then Moses prayed to the Lord, “What am I going to do with these people? They are about to stone me to death!”
translation_verse: Ka Moses bɛllim Zugsɔb ka yɛl ye, “M na niŋ nidib nwa' wala? Ba yʋ'ʋn kʋdim bɔɔd ye ba lɔb mam nɛ kuga!”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Take some of the leaders with you and go ahead of the rest of the people. Also take along the walking stick with which you struck the Nile River.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Nɔkimi fʋ kɔnbkem dansaar kanɛ ka fʋ daa nɔki tiesi kpa' Nail ku'om la, ka buol Israel kpɛɛmnam ka ya gaad nidib la tuon.

english_verse: When you get to the rock at Mount Sinai, I will be there with you. Strike the rock with the stick, and water will pour out for the people to drink.” Moses did this while the leaders watched.
translation_verse: M na sia'ali ya Sinai zuor la ni. Nwɛ'ɛm tampiing la ka ku'om na yina ka nidib la nu.” Ka Moses maal wʋʋ on wʋm si'em la ka kpɛɛmnam la nyɛ ka ku'om yit na.

english_verse: The people had complained and tested the Lord by asking, “Is the Lord really with us?” So Moses named that place Massah, which means “testing” and Meribah, which means “complaining.” Israel Defeats the Amalekites
translation_verse: Ka Moses pʋd zin'ikan la ye Masa nɛ Meriba, bɔzugɔ Israel dim la nwa'asnɛ Moses ka mak Zugsɔb ka yɛt ye, “Zugsɔb la sid bɛɛ ti nii?” Ban zabi nyaŋ Amalek dim la yɛla

english_verse: When the Israelites were at Rephidim, they were attacked by the Amalekites.
translation_verse: Israel dim la da nam bɛ Refidim la, Amalek zabzabidib la da kena zab nɛ ba.

english_verse: So Moses told Joshua, “Have some men ready to attack the Amalekites tomorrow. I will stand on a hilltop, holding this walking stick that has the power of God.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Josua ye, “Buolim Israel zabzabidib la na ka ba zab nɛ Amalek zabzabidib la. Bɛog m na nɔk Wina'am dansaar la m nu'uginɛ duoe zi'e zuor la zug.”

english_verse: Joshua led the attack as Moses had commanded, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur stood on the hilltop.
translation_verse: Ka Josua tʋm wʋʋ Moses yɛl o si'em la ka dɔl o zabzabidib la yii zab nɛ Amalek zabzabidib la. Amaa ka Moses nɛ Aaron nɛ Hur lɛɛ duoe zi'e zuor la zug.

english_verse: The Israelites out-fought the Amalekites as long as Moses held up his arms, but they started losing whenever he lowered them.
translation_verse: Ka Moses ya'a ʋk o dansaar la agɔl ka Israel zabzabidib la paam paŋ. Amaa o nu'ug la ya'a ti sigid la ka Amalek dim mɛ paamid paŋ.

english_verse: After a while, his arms were so tired that Aaron and Hur got a rock for him to sit on. Then they stood beside him and supported his arms in the same position until sunset.
translation_verse: Ka Moses nu'us gɛn ka pʋ lɛn nyaŋidi ʋkid dansaar la ka Aaron nɛ Hur bɔ kugiri tis o ka o zin' ka ban zi'e o baba ka mɔr o nu'us la, hali nɛ zaam.

english_verse: That's how Joshua defeated the Amalekites.
translation_verse: Ka Josua nɛ o zabzabidib la nyaŋ Amalek zabzabidib la.

english_verse: Afterwards, the Lord said to Moses, “Write an account of this victory and read it to Joshua. I want the Amalekites to be forgotten forever.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Sɔm nwa' digil ka li na an kasɛt, ka karim tis Josua ye m na san'am Amalek buudi hali ka sɔ' kʋ tɛnri ba yɛla dunia nwa' nii.”

english_verse: Moses built an altar and named it “The Lord Gives Me Victory.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses mɛ maan bimbim anina ka buoli li ye, Zugsɔb la An Mam Nyaŋir Tuuta.

english_verse: Then Moses explained, “This is because I depended on the Lord. But in future generations, the Lord will fight the Amalekites again and again.”
translation_verse: Ka ba ʋk nu'us Zugsɔb la tuon ka pɔ ye, “Din yi zina ken, Zugsɔb la na zabid nɛ Amalek buudi la zʋmaana wʋsa.”

english_verse: In the meantime, Moses had sent his wife Zipporah and her two sons to stay with Jethro, and he had welcomed them. Moses was still a foreigner in Midian when his first son was born, and so Moses said, “I'll name him Gershom.” When his second son was born, Moses said, “I'll name him Eliezer, because the God my father worshiped has saved me from the king of Egypt.”
translation_verse: Ka ban da du'a biribiŋ onɛ paas ayi' sɔb la, Moses da pʋd o yʋ'ʋr ye Elieza, bɔzugɔ o yɛl ye, “M yaanam Wina'am la an mam sʋŋid; o daa faaɛn mam ka Na'ab Faaro pʋ kʋʋ ma.”

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the desert near Mount Sinai, Jethro sent Moses this message: “I am coming to visit you, and I am bringing your wife and two sons.”
translation_verse: Ka ba yɛl Moses ye, “Fʋ diem Jetro kena ye o gɔsif, ka dɔlli fʋ pu'a nɛ fʋ biis ayi' la na.”

english_verse: When they arrived, Moses went out and bowed down in front of Jethro, then kissed him. After they had greeted each other, they went into the tent,
translation_verse: Ka Moses yii tʋ'ʋs o diem la igin nɛ girima pʋ'ʋs o tʋʋliga. Ka ba bu'os taaba laafi yɛla ka kpɛn' Moses fuug sʋgʋrin ye ba sɔns.

english_verse: where Moses told him everything the Lord had done to protect Israel against the Egyptians and their king. He also told him how the Lord had helped them in all of their troubles.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl o diem la Zugsɔb la tʋm si'el wʋsa, hali ka faaɛn Israel dimi yi Faaro onɛ an Egipt na'ab la ni si'em. O da lɛn yɛl o yɛlbanɛ paae ba suor zug la wʋsa ka Zugsɔb nyaŋi yisi ba yɛlban la ni.

english_verse: Now I know that the Lord is the greatest God, because he has rescued Israel from their arrogant enemies.”
translation_verse: Mam yʋ'ʋn baŋ ye Zugsɔb la mɔr paŋi gat wina wʋsa, bɔzugɔ o nyaŋi yis o nidib Egipt dim banɛ an nyɛɛsim dim la nu'usin.”

english_verse: Jethro offered sacrifices to God. Then Aaron and Israel's leaders came to eat with Jethro there at the place of worship. Judges Are Appointed (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Ka Jetro da nɔk bʋnkɔnbʋgʋ maal maan linɛ nyu'od bugum tis Wina'am, nɛ maan sieba ya'as. Ka Aaron nɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam la kɛɛn o san'an na ka ba la'as taaba di diib Wina'am tuon. Jetro sa'al Moses (Zie

english_verse: You and the people who come to you will soon be worn out. The job is too much for one person; you can't do it alone.
translation_verse: Fʋn nɛ nidib la wʋsa na gɛn. Tʋʋma la tɛbis nɛ fʋn na mɔri fʋ kɔn'ɔkɔn'.

english_verse: The next morning Moses sat down at the place where he decided legal cases for the people, and everyone crowded around him until evening.
translation_verse: Li yimbɛog ka Moses zin' maan nidib la antu'a tisidi ba. Ka nidib la la'asi zi'e gur Moses bɛogʋn hali paae zaam.

english_verse: Jethro saw how much Moses had to do for the people, and he asked, “Why are you the only judge? Why do you let these people crowd around you from morning till evening?”
translation_verse: Ka Moses diem la nyɛ on maan si'em la, o da bu'os o ye, “Bɔɔ maal ka fʋ kɔn'ɔkɔn' kad saria ka nimbama wʋsa zi'e giligif bɛogʋn paae zaam bɔɔd sʋŋirɛ?”

english_verse: Moses answered, “Because they come here to find out what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Ka Moses lɛbis ye, “Nidib la ken mam san'an na bɔɔd Wina'am sʋŋir.

english_verse: They bring their complaints to me, and I make decisions on the basis of God's laws.”
translation_verse: Ka yɛlsi'a ya'a bɛ, mam na maali tisi ba, ka pa'ali ba Wina'am bɔɔd si'el, nɛ o nɔzi'ela la.”

english_verse: Jethro replied: That isn't the best way to do it.
translation_verse: Ka o diem la yɛl ye, “Nwa' ka' sʋ'ʋm.

english_verse: God will help you if you follow my advice. You should be the one to speak to God for the people,
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m pa'alif bʋn kaŋa, ka Wina'am na bɛ nɛf ka fʋ an nidib la tuongat ka mɔri ba yɛla kennɛ o san'an na.

english_verse: and you should teach them God's laws and show them what they must do to live right.
translation_verse: Fʋ na pa'al nidib la Wina'am gban'e ye o maal si'el, nɛ o nɔzi'ela, ka pa'ali ba ban na bɛ si'em.

english_verse: You will need to appoint some competent leaders who respect God and are trustworthy and honest. Then put them over groups of
translation_verse: Amaa bɔɔm nimbanɛ an sida dim ka zɔt Wina'am ka pʋ bɔɔd bɛ'ɛdɛ, ka kɛ ka ba gɔsid nidib la yɛla maalʋg. Sieba na sʋ'oe nidib tusir, sieba nidib kɔbiga, sieba nidib pisnu, sieba nidib piig-piig.

english_verse: These judges can handle the ordinary cases and bring the more difficult ones to you. Having them to share the load will make your work easier.
translation_verse: Nimbama na sʋŋid nidib la ka maan yɛlbanɛ pʋ gaadi ba paŋa, ka yɛlkanɛ gaadi ba paŋ la ba na mɔri kena tisif. Amaa yɛlbibis la ka ba na maali ba mɛŋ. Ba na sʋŋidif ka tʋʋma la sie bi'ela tisif.

english_verse: This is the way God wants it done. You won't be under nearly as much stress, and everyone else will return home feeling satisfied.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a dɔlis sa'al kaŋa wʋʋ Wina'am yɛl ye fʋ maal si'em la, fʋ na nyɛ ka fʋ nyaŋ yɛl la, ka nidib la kul nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.”

english_verse: He chose some competent leaders from every tribe in Israel and put them over groups of
translation_verse: Ka o gaans ninsʋma ka kɛ ka ba gɔsid nidib la yɛla maalʋg. O tis sieba nidib tusir, ka tis sieba nidib kɔbiga, ka tis sieba nidib pisnu, ka tis sieba piiga.

english_verse: They served as judges, deciding the easy cases themselves, but bringing the more difficult ones to Moses.
translation_verse: Ka nimbama da bɛ saŋa wʋsa ka tʋm tʋʋma la, ka yɛlbanɛ ka ba kʋ nyaŋ la, ka ba mɔr na tisid Moses, amaa yɛlbibis la ba maannɛ ba mɛŋ.

english_verse: After Moses and his father-in-law Jethro had said goodbye to each other, Jethro returned home.
translation_verse: Lina nya'aŋ ka Moses kɛɛsi o diem la ka o lɛb o mɛŋ teŋin.

english_verse: Moses went up the mountain to meet with the Lord God, who told him to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ka Moses dʋ zuor la zug ye o sia'al Wina'am. Ka Zugsɔb buol zuor la zug ka yɛl o ye, “Yɛlim Jakob yaas banɛ an Israel dim la ye,

english_verse: You saw what I did in Egypt, and you know how I brought you here to me, just as a mighty eagle carries its young.
translation_verse: ‘Yanam mɛŋ nyɛ mam maal Egipt dim la si'em, ka nyɛ mam zii ya si'em wʋʋ silʋg kpʋkpama nɛ mɔri ya paae m san'an na.

english_verse: Now if you will faithfully obey me, you will be my very own people. The whole world is mine,
translation_verse: Dinzug ya ya'a siak mam nɔɔr ka di'e m kaanbʋg la, ya na an mam nyɔɔrin kɔnbʋg, ka m ba'a na bɛɛ ya ni gaad buudi wʋsa, bɔzugɔ dunia la wʋsa manɛ sʋ'oe.

english_verse: but you will be my holy nation and serve me as priests. Moses, that is what you must tell the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ka ya na an maanmaannib buudi tisim, ka lɛn an sʋ'ʋlim kanɛ an kasi tisim.’ Yɛlim nwa' tis Israel dim la.”

english_verse: After Moses went back, he reported to the leaders what the Lord had said,
translation_verse: Ka Moses sig na ka buol Israel kpɛɛmnam la yɛli ba linɛ ka Zugsɔb yɛl la wʋsa.

english_verse: and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded.” So Moses told the Lord about this.
translation_verse: Ka ba wʋsa siak ka yɛl ye, “Ti na tʋm dinɛ wʋsa ka Zugsɔb la yɛl la.” Ka Moses lɛm mɔr nidib la yɛl si'ela lɛbi yɛl Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I will come to you in a thick cloud and let the people hear me speak to you. Then they will always trust you.” Again Moses reported to the Lord what the people had said.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “M na bɛ saŋgbansabilin kɛɛn fʋ san'an na ka nidib la na wʋm mam pian'adi tisidif, ala ka ba na niŋif yadda hali zina zaŋi ken.” Ka Moses yɛl nidib la Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em.

english_verse: Once more the Lord spoke to Moses: Go back and tell the people that today and tomorrow they must get themselves ready to meet me. They must wash their clothes
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Sigim teŋin ka kɛ ka nidib la maali ti'eb ka m kena. Maalimi ba sʋ'ʋŋa zina nɛ bɛog, ka kɛ ka ba pie ba fuud nyain.

english_verse: and be ready by the day after tomorrow, when I will come down to Mount Sinai, where all of them can see me.
translation_verse: Maalimi siri daba atan' daar, ka mam Zugsɔb na sig Sinai zuor la ni na ka ba nini nyɛ.

english_verse: Warn the people that they are forbidden to touch any part of the mountain. Anyone who does will be put to death,
translation_verse: Maalim bɛŋi gilig zuor la ka nidib la da gaŋi kenaa. Sa'alimi ba ye ba gu'usim ka sɔ' da dʋ zuor la zug bɛɛ si'isi li zin'isi'a baa bi'elaa. Onɛ wʋsa si'is zuor la, asɛɛ ba kʋʋ o.

english_verse: either with stones or arrows, and no one must touch the body of the person being put to death in this way. Even an animal that touches this mountain must be put to death. You may go up the mountain only after a signal is given on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Ka nid bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg ya'a zɔɔ gaŋ bɛn la, ba kʋ si'is o sɔb nɛ nu'usɛ, amaa ba na lɔb o nɛ kuga kʋ, bɛɛ ba tɔɔn o nɛ piema kʋ. Nidib la na bɛ lalli, ka ba ya'a ti wʋm na'atan ka li pieb zuor la ni, asɛɛ ka ba li'el zuor la na.”

english_verse: After Moses went down the mountain, he gave orders for the people to wash their clothes and make themselves acceptable to worship God.
translation_verse: Ka Moses sig na ka kɛ ka nidib la ti'ebi ba mɛŋ ka pie ba fuud nyain.

english_verse: He told them to be ready in three days and not to have sex in the meantime. The Lord Comes to Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Ti'ebimini ya mɛŋ daba atan' nwa', ka din yi zina wa'ae la, mid ka ya digin nɛ pu'a.”

english_verse: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud covered the mountain, a loud trumpet blast was heard, and everyone in camp trembled with fear.
translation_verse: Daba atan' la bɛogʋn ka zin'ig la wʋsa dammidnɛ satansʋg nɛ sa-ian'asʋg hali nɛ sisi'etita'ar. Ka saŋgbana sig zuor la ni na, ka na'atan pieb ka nidib la wʋsa kirid.

english_verse: Moses led them out of the camp to meet God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Ka Moses kɛ ka nidib la dɔl o yi ye ba sia'al Wina'am, ka ba paae zi'en zuor la teŋir.

english_verse: Mount Sinai was covered with smoke because the Lord had come down in a flaming fire. Smoke poured out of the mountain just like a furnace, and the whole mountain shook.
translation_verse: Ka Sinai zuor la wʋsa kpan'alim nɛ nyɔ'ɔs, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb da sig nɛ na wʋʋ bugum nɛ. Ka nyɔ'ɔs la duoe agɔla paad saŋgbana ni, wʋʋ sian'anr ka ba nyu'oe bugum nɛ. Ka zuor la dam nɛ paŋ.

english_verse: The trumpet blew louder and louder. Moses spoke, and God answered him with thunder.
translation_verse: Ka na'atan la piebʋgʋ da dʋt hali la, Moses da pian'ad ka Wina'am lɛbisid o ka nidib la wʋm.

english_verse: The Lord came down to the top of Mount Sinai and told Moses to meet him there.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb sig Sinai zuor la zug na ka buol Moses ye o dʋ na. Ka Moses dʋ zuor la.

english_verse: Then he said, “Moses, go and warn the people not to cross the boundary that you set at the foot of the mountain. They must not cross it to come and look at me, because if they do, many of them will die.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Sigim ka yɛl nidib la ye ba da lɔ'ɔŋ bɛn la. Ba mɛ da dʋ kpɛla na ye ba nyɛ Zugsɔb la. Ka onɛ wʋsa maal ala na kpi.

english_verse: Only the priests may come near me, and they must obey strict rules before I let them. If they don't, they will be punished.”
translation_verse: Hali banɛ an maanmaannib ka ɛɛn kennɛ m san'an na la mɛ maalimi ba mɛŋ sʋ'ʋŋa, ka ya'a ka' alaa, m na san'ami ba.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told Moses, “Go down and bring Aaron back here with you. But the priests and people must not try to push their way through, or I will rush at them like a flood!”
translation_verse: Amaa ka Zugsɔb yɛl o ye, “Sigim mɔr Aaron na. Amaa da kɛ ka maanmaannib la bɛɛ nidib la sɔ' gaŋ bɛn la ye ba dʋ kpɛla naa, ka m na namisi ba.”

english_verse: After Moses had gone back down, he told the people what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Ka Moses sigi yɛl nidib la Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: God said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am yɛl nidib la ye,

english_verse: But when Moses went near the thick cloud where God was, the people stayed a long way off. Idols and Altars
translation_verse: Ka nidib la bɛ lallisa ka Moses on paae Wina'am bɛ si'el la, ka zin'ig la wʋsa an lik. Maan Bimbim yɛla

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: “Manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am ka yisi ya Egipt teŋin, zin'ikanɛ ka ya da an yammis ka ba namisidi ya la.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
