translation_verse: “Da dɔlli winsieba lɛm paas mam ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya maali wina linɛ an wʋʋ niiŋ bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg bɛɛ ziiŋa.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: ka pa'annɛ m nɔŋilim nɛ banɛ nɔŋ mam ka siakidi m yɛlʋg la hali ti paae zʋmaana tusa-tusa.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya mɔri Zugsɔb Wina'am yʋ'ʋri maan yɔɔg-yɔɔg. Ya ya'a maal ala Zugsɔb na namisi ya.

english_verse: Remember that the Sabbath Day belongs to me.
translation_verse: “Tiɛnmi Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la yɛla, ka kɛ ka li an kasi.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Nɔkimi daba ayuobʋ tʋmmini ya tʋʋma.

english_verse: but the seventh day of each week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your slaves, your animals, or the foreigners who live in your towns.
translation_verse: Amaa daba ayɔpɔi la anɛ Zugsɔb Wina'am din ka li pʋ sʋm ye ya tʋm tʋʋm si'a, yanam bɛɛ ya biribis bɛɛ bipumis, bɛɛ ya yamdaad bɛɛ ya yampu'ab, bɛɛ ya bʋnkɔnbid bɛɛ saam banɛ bɛ nɛ yaa.

english_verse: In six days I made the sky, the earth, the oceans, and everything in them, but on the seventh day I rested. That's why I made the Sabbath a special day that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb nɔk nɛ daba ayuobʋ maal agɔl nɛ teŋin nɛ atɛuk nɛ dinɛ wʋsa bɛɛ li ni, amaa ka vʋ'ʋs daba ayɔpɔi daar. Dinzugɔ Zugsɔb niŋ dabisir la nɛ bareka, ka kɛ ka li an kasi.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, and you will live a long time in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: “Tisimi fʋ saam nɛ fʋ ma girima ka ala ka fʋ nyɔvʋr na yuug teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na tisi ya la.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya kʋ nid.

english_verse: Be faithful in marriage.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya san'am pu'a bɛɛ dau.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya zu.

english_verse: Do not tell lies about others.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya di ziri kasɛti tisi ya tiraan.

english_verse: Do not desire to possess anything that belongs to another person—not a house, a wife, a husband, a slave, an ox, a donkey, or anything else. The People Are Afraid (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: “Mid ka fʋ kɛ ka fʋ ya'amlɛog kpɛn' fʋ tiraan yir bɛɛ o pu'a, bɛɛ o yamdau bɛɛ o yampu'ak, bɛɛ o bʋnkɔnbid, bɛɛ linɛ wʋsa ka o sʋ'oe ni.” Dabiem kpɛn' nidib la (Zie

english_verse: So you must never make idols of silver or gold to worship in place of me.
translation_verse: Da nɔki anzurifa bɛɛ sanlima mɛ' wina paas mam zugɔ.

english_verse: The people trembled with fear when they heard the thunder and the trumpet and saw the lightning and the smoke coming from the mountain. They stood a long way off
translation_verse: Ka nidib la nyɛ satansʋg nɛ sa-ian'asʋg ka wʋm na'atan la piebʋg la ka nyɛ ka zuor la wʋsa an nyɔ'ɔs la, ka dabiem mɔri ba. Ka ba lɛb lallisa

english_verse: and said to Moses, “If you speak to us, we will listen. But don't let God speak to us, or we will die!”
translation_verse: ka yɛl Moses ye, “Fʋn pian'am tisi ti ka ti na wʋm. Amaa da kɛ ka Wina'am pian' tisi tii ka ti na kpi.”

english_verse: “Don't be afraid!” Moses replied. “God has come only to test you, so that by obeying him you won't sin.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl nidib la ye, “Da zɔti dabiem. Ka Wina'am ye o maki ya nɛ gɔs, ka kɛ ka ya na zɔt o dabiem ka kʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people of Israel: With your own eyes you saw me speak to you from heaven.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Yɛlim Israel dim la nwa': ‘Ya mɛŋ nyɛ man naan arezana nii pian' si'em.

english_verse: Build an altar out of earth, and offer on it your sacrifices of sheep, goats, and cattle. Wherever I choose to be worshiped, I will come down to bless you.
translation_verse: Nɔkimi tanni mɛ' maan bimbim, ka maali ya malima dinɛ an pɛ'ɛs nɛ bʋʋs nɛ niigi li zug. Zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka m kɛ ka ya la'asi pʋ'ʋsim, anina ka m na kena niŋi ya bareka.

english_verse: If you ever build an altar for me out of stones, do not use any tools to chisel the stones, because that would make the altar unfit for use in worship.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a nɔk nɛ kuga maal bimbim la, yanam da nɔk kugbanɛ ka ba kpi'e ba la mɛɛ. Ya ya'a nɔk lieŋe kpi'e ba, li kʋ an sʋm tis mam.

english_verse: And don't build an altar that requires steps; you might expose yourself when you climb up.
translation_verse: Da maali dʋʋsa dʋʋ paae maan bimbim la zugɔ, ka ba na nyɛɛ ya nyan.’”

english_verse: Death is the punishment for attacking your father or mother.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ bʋ' o saam bɛɛ o ma, ban kʋʋm o.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for murder.
translation_verse: “Ka sɔ' ya'a nwɛ' o tiraanɛ kʋ, ban mɛ kʋʋm on sɔb.

english_verse: Suppose two of you are arguing, and you hit the other with either a rock or your fist, without causing a fatal injury. If the victim has to stay in bed,
translation_verse: Ka dapa ayi' ya'a zab ka yinne nɔk kugir bɛɛ o nu'ugʋ nwɛ' ayinne la pu'alim o ka o pʋ kpii ka pʋ tun'e yit paalʋʋ,

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses the following laws for his people:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye, “Zi'elbama ka m ye fʋ pa'ali ba ka ba dɔl:

english_verse: If you buy a Hebrew slave, he must remain your slave for six years. But in the seventh year you must set him free, without cost to him.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a da' Hibiru yammʋg, o na tʋm yʋma ayuobʋ tisif amaa yʋʋm kanɛ paasidi ayɔpɔi la, fʋn basim o ka o keŋ ka da lɛn tʋm ya'asɛ, ka mɛ da yɔ si'ela.

english_verse: If he was single at the time you bought him, he alone must be set free. But if he was married at the time, both he and his wife must be given their freedom.
translation_verse: O ya'a da kɛɛn o kɔn' na on kulimi o kɔn', ka o mɛ ya'a da mɔri pu'a on mɔr pu'a la kul.

english_verse: If you give him a wife, and they have children, only the man himself must be set free; his wife and children remain the property of his owner.
translation_verse: Ka li ya'a anɛ o zugdaan la da' pu'a la tis o ka o du'a dap nɛ pu'ab, o zugdaan la sʋ'oe pu'a la nɛ o biis la wʋsa, ka dau la ma'aa na kul o kɔn'.

english_verse: But suppose the slave loves his wife and children and his owner so much that he won't leave them.
translation_verse: Amaa yammʋg la ya'a yɛl ye, ‘Mam nɔŋi m zugdaan nɛ m pu'a nɛ m biis la zug, m pʋ bɔɔd ye m kul zaalim,’

english_verse: Then he must stand beside either the door or the doorpost at the place of worship, while his owner punches a small hole through one of his ears with a sharp metal rod. This makes him a slave for life.
translation_verse: alazugɔ o zugdaan la na nɔk o keŋ sariakatib san'an, ka dɔl o keŋ dɔɔg za'anɔɔrin ka nɔk piim vʋdigi o tʋbir, ka o na lieb o yammʋg hali nɛ o nyɔvʋr bɛn.

english_verse: A young woman who was sold by her father doesn't gain her freedom in the same way that a man does.
translation_verse: Amaa dau ya'a kuos o bipuŋi tis ye o lieb yammʋg, ba kʋ bas o ka o keŋ wʋʋ dau na keŋ si'em la.

english_verse: If she doesn't please the man who bought her to be his wife, he must let her be bought back. He cannot sell her to foreigners; this would break the contract he made with her.
translation_verse: Ka pu'asadir la ya'a pʋ paae o zugdaan la ya'am, asɛɛ ka o lɛbis o tis o saam ka di'e o ligidi. O zugdaan la ka' suor ka o na kuos o tis teŋ zʋŋ nida, bɔzugɔ o tʋm o linɛ pʋ nara.

english_verse: If he selects her as a wife for his son, he must treat her as his own daughter.
translation_verse: Ka o ya'a mɛ lɛn zaŋ o nɛ tis o biig, asɛɛ ka o gɔs o wʋʋ o pu'ayua.

english_verse: If the man later marries another woman, he must continue to provide food and clothing for the one he bought and to treat her as a wife.
translation_verse: Ka li ya'a lɛn anɛ o mɛŋi dii o, ka di pu'a paas ya'as, on da mɔŋ yiiga sɔb la diib nɛ fuud bɛɛ zan'as ye o kʋ gbɛn nɛ o.

english_verse: If he fails to do any of these things, she must be given her freedom without paying for it. Murder and Other Violent Crimes The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ka o ya'a pʋ nyaŋi maal bama atan' nwaa, pu'a la on basim o, ka da yɔ ligidi baa bi'ela. Zaba nɛ ninkʋʋr yɛla

english_verse: But if you did not intend to kill someone, and I, the Lord, let it happen anyway, you may run for safety to a place that I have set aside.
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a pʋ maal nɛ bugusim ka anɛ Wina'am bɔɔdim ye li kɛɛn ala na, m na pa'alif zin'isi'a ka o na zɔɔ keŋ anina.

english_verse: If you plan in advance to murder someone, there's no escape, not even by holding on to my altar. You will be dragged off and killed.
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' ya'a su'a kʋʋ o tiraan nɛ pɔn'ɔsim, hali baa o ya'a bɛɛ m maan bimbim la ni, yanam nɔkim o keŋ lalli kʋʋ o.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for kidnapping. If you sell the person you kidnapped, or if you are caught with that person, the penalty is death.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ mɛ su'a gban'e sɔ' kuos bɛɛ o nam mɔr o nɛ, ka ba gban'e o, ban kʋʋm o.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for cursing your father or mother.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a pɔ nɔɔri niŋ o saam bɛɛ o ma, asɛɛ ka ba kʋʋ o.

english_verse: and later has to use a stick when walking outside, you must pay for the loss of time and do what you can to help until the injury is completely healed. That's your only responsibility.
translation_verse: o ya'a tilig, ban da kʋ onɛ pu'alim o tiraan la, amaa li sʋm ye o yɔ on san'am si'el la wʋsa ka lɛn gɔs o ka o paam laafi naae.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for beating to death any of your slaves.
translation_verse: Ka dau ya'a bʋ' o yamdau bɛɛ o yampu'ak nɛ balaar ka o kpi, ban tɛɛgim dau la tʋbir.

english_verse: However, if the slave lives a few days after the beating, you are not to be punished. After all, you have already lost the services of that slave who was your property.
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a paam laafi ban da tɛɛg dau la tʋbirɛ bɔzugɔ on sʋ'oe yammʋg la zug.

english_verse: Suppose a pregnant woman suffers a miscarriage as the result of an injury caused by someone who is fighting. If she isn't badly hurt, the one who injured her must pay whatever fine her husband demands and the judges approve.
translation_verse: Ka dapa ayi' ya'a zabid ka nwɛ'ɛnɛ taab ka di gaadi gban'e pu'apʋʋg ka o kpa'ae, amaa ka pu'a la mɛŋ pʋ pu'alim, onɛ maal ala la na yɔ pu'a la sidi gban'e si'em ka sariakatib la siak la.

english_verse: But if she is seriously injured, the payment will be life for life,
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a pu'alim nɛ hali, asɛɛ ya nɔk nyɔvʋri yɔ nyɔvʋr sam.

english_verse: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
translation_verse: Nif yɔɔdi nif sam, ka nyin yɔɔd nyin sam, ka nu'ug yɔɔd nu'ug sam, ka nɔbir yɔɔd nɔbir sam.

english_verse: If you hit one of your slaves and cause the loss of an eye, the slave must be set free.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a nwɛ' o yamdaug bɛɛ o yampu'ak nif ka li san'am, o na bas o yammʋg la ka o keŋ zaalim, o nif la zug.”

english_verse: A bull that kills someone with its horns must be killed and its meat destroyed, but the owner of the bull isn't responsible for the death.
translation_verse: “Ka na'araug ya'a zɛ dau bɛɛ pu'a pu'alim ka o kpi, asɛɛ ka ba lɔb na'araug la nɛ kugaa kʋ mɛn, ka sɔ' mɛ da ɔnbi o ni'imi, amaa ba kʋ tɛɛg na'araug la sɔb tʋbirɛ.

english_verse: Suppose you own a bull that has been in the habit of attacking people, but you have refused to keep it fenced in. If that bull kills someone, both you and the bull must be put to death by stoning.
translation_verse: Amaa na'araug la ya'a anɛ onɛ zɛɛd, ka ba yɛl o sɔb ka o pʋ gur oo ka o kʋ nɛ dau bɛɛ pu'a, ban lɔm na'araug la kʋ, ka mɛ kʋ onɛ sʋ'oe o la.

english_verse: pieces of silver for the loss of the slave, and the bull must be killed by stoning.
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ kpi la nidib ya'a gban'e ye naaf la sɔb yɔ ligidi, asɛɛ ka o yɔ dinɛ ka ba bɔɔd la tiak o nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: This same law applies if the bull gores someone's son or daughter.
translation_verse: Kisʋg kaŋa mɛ la'am bɛ nɛ tis na'araugʋ na zɛ biribiŋ bɛɛ bipuŋi pu'alim.

english_verse: Suppose someone's ox or donkey is killed by falling into an open pit that you dug or left uncovered on your property.
translation_verse: “Ka dau ya'a pʋ pibili o bulig bɛɛ o pin'ilnɛ tuud bʋmbɔk ka pʋ pibilɛ, ka naaf bɛɛ bʋŋ luu anina,

english_verse: You must pay for the dead animal, and it becomes yours.
translation_verse: asɛɛ ka onɛ sʋ'oe bulig bɛɛ bʋmbɔk la yɔɔ tis bʋnkɔnbʋg la sɔb ka sʋ'oe bʋnkɔnb kpiiluŋ la.

english_verse: If your bull kills someone else's, yours must be sold. Then the money from your bull and the meat from the dead bull must be divided equally between you and the other owner.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' na'araug ya'a zɛɛ o tiraan na'araugʋ pu'alim ka o kpi, asɛɛ ka ba pʋdig onɛ kpi la ni'im, ka kuos onɛ vʋe la pʋdig ligidi la.

english_verse: If you refuse to fence in a bull that is known to attack others, you must replace any animal it kills, but the dead animal will belong to you.
translation_verse: Amaa li ya'a anɛ na'akanɛ nɔŋ zaba ka o daana pʋ lɔɔ o, asɛɛ ka o yɔ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ ka o kʋ la yɛla, ka zaŋ bʋnkpiilʋŋ la.”

english_verse: If you steal an ox and slaughter or sell it, you must replace it with five oxen; if you steal a sheep and slaughter it or sell it, you must replace it with four sheep.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am da lɛn yɛl Moses ye, “Dau ya'a zunɛ naaf bɛɛ pɛ'ogʋ kuos bɛɛ kʋ asɛɛ ka o yɔ niigi anu naaf yinne la zug, ka mɛ yɔ pɛ'ɛs anaasi pɛ'og yinne la zug.

english_verse: If you allow any of your animals to stray from your property and graze in someone else's field or vineyard, you must repay the damage from the best part of your own harvest of grapes and grain.
translation_verse: “Ka dau ya'a nɔk o bʋnkɔnbidi keŋ sɔ' pɔɔgin bɛɛ o vain tiis pɔɔgin ka ba ɔnb, asɛɛ ka o nɔk o mɛŋ pɔɔgʋ yɔɔ o sɔb.

english_verse: If you carelessly let a fire spread from your property to someone else's, you must pay the owner for any crops or fields destroyed by the fire.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a nyu'oe bugum ka li faaɛn la'aŋ mɔɔgi di hali ti la'am di nɛ zʋʋd linɛ ka ba bunɛ digil, nɛ linɛ nan zi'e, hali nɛ pɔɔg la wʋsa, asɛɛ ka onɛ nyu'oe bugum la nɔk o mɛŋ zʋʋdi yɔ.

english_verse: Suppose a neighbor asks you to keep some silver or other valuables, and they are stolen from your house. If the thief is caught, the thief must repay double.
translation_verse: Ka dau ya'a nɔk ligidi bɛɛ la'adi tis o tiraan ye o di'em su'a, ka na'ayiig kɔɔ kpɛn' zu ka ba gban'e na'ayiig la, asɛɛ ka o yɔ nɔɔra ayi'.

english_verse: But if the thief isn't caught, some judges will decide if you are the guilty one.
translation_verse: Amaa ba ya'a pʋ nyɛ na'ayiig la, asɛɛ ka ba mɔr yir la daana keŋ sariakatib san'an ka ba vɛɛnsi gɔs ye onɛ zu la'ad la bɛɛ ka' onɛ?

english_verse: Suppose two people claim to own the same ox or donkey or sheep or piece of clothing. Then the judges must decide the case, and the guilty person will pay the owner double.
translation_verse: Nidib ayi' ya'a zabid nɛ taaba bʋŋ bɛɛ naaf bɛɛ pɛ'ɛs bɛɛ fuug linɛ bɔdig ka ba keŋ nyɛ ka li bɛ sɔ' san'an ka yinne ye li anɛ on bʋn, ka ayinne mɛ ye li anɛ on bʋn, asɛɛ ba mɔri ba wʋsa keŋ sariakatib san'an ka ba vɛɛnsi gɔs ka onɛ ka' bʋʋd la na yɔ nɔɔra ayi' tis onɛ mɔr bʋʋd la.

english_verse: Suppose a neighbor who is going to be away asks you to keep a donkey or an ox or a sheep or some other animal, and it dies or gets injured or is stolen while no one is looking.
translation_verse: Dau ya'a nɔk bʋŋ bɛɛ naaf bɛɛ pɛ'og bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbsi'a wʋsa tis o kpi'a ye o gɔsi tis o, ka bʋnkɔnbʋg la kpi bɛɛ pu'alim bɛɛ sɔ' nɔk ka ba pʋ nyɛɛ,

english_verse: If you swear with me as your witness that you did not harm the animal, you do not have to replace it. Your word is enough.
translation_verse: lin na niŋ si'em ka yɛl la maal anɛ ba kɛ ka bʋnkɔnbʋg la bɛ sɔ' san'an la pɔ Zugsɔb la tuon ye on pʋ nɔk o nu'ugʋ si'isi o kpi'a la laukɔ. Ka onɛ sʋ'oe bʋnkɔnbʋg la sʋm ye o siak ka da kɛ ka o kpi'e la yɔ si'ela.

english_verse: But if the animal was stolen while in your care, you must replace it.
translation_verse: Amaa li ya'a anɛ onɛ gɔti ba la zu, asɛɛ ka o yɔɔ lɛbis o kpi'a la.

english_verse: If the animal was attacked and killed by a wild animal, and you can show the remains of the dead animal to its owner, you do not have to replace it.
translation_verse: Ka li ya'a lɛn anɛ wɛog bʋnyua gban'e bʋnkɔnbʋg la ɔnb, asɛɛ ka o mɔr on ɔnb ka nya'al si'el la na ka ba nyɛ, ka o kʋ yɔɔ lɛbisɛ.

english_verse: Suppose you borrow an animal from a neighbor, and it gets injured or dies while the neighbor isn't around. Then you must replace it.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a pɛ'ɛŋ bʋnkɔnbʋgʋ o kpi'a san'an ka o pu'alim bɛɛ kpi ka o kpi'a la ka' anina yamma ka nyɛɛ, asɛɛ ka o yɔɔ lɛbis.

english_verse: But if something happens to the animal while the owner is present, you do not have to replace it. If you had leased the animal, the money you paid the owner will cover any harm done to it. Laws for Everyday Life The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ sʋ'oe bʋnkɔnbʋg la ya'a bɛɛ anina ka nyɛ, o kʋ yɔɔ. O ya'a hanɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg la, lin nwɛnɛ sam kan yɔnɛ la.” Pu'asadir san'auŋ yɛla

english_verse: Suppose a young woman has never had sex and isn't engaged. If a man talks her into having sex, he must pay the bride price and marry her.
translation_verse: “Ka dau ya'a digin nɛ pu'asadir kanɛ nan zi' dau, ka ba mɛ nam pʋ tis pu'asadir la pu'a-ɛliŋ-yirɛ, asɛɛ ka dau la yɔ pu'asadir la yɔɔd ka o lieb o pu'a.

english_verse: But if her father refuses to let her marry the man, the bride price must still be paid.
translation_verse: Ka pu'asadir la saam ya'a zan'as kpan-kpan ye o bipuŋ la kʋ kul oo, asɛɛ ka o yɔ pu'asadir la yɔɔd, on san'am o ka o nam zi' dau la zug.” Zi'ela linɛ paas

english_verse: Death is the punishment for witchcraft.
translation_verse: “Pu'a kanɛ an teŋgban-kpɛn'ɛd ban kʋʋm o.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for having sex with an animal.
translation_verse: Kʋʋmi ninkanɛ wʋsa bɔ bɛɛ digin nɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for offering sacrifices to any god except me.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ wʋsa maal malʋŋʋ tis ba'ar bɛɛ win ka ya'a ka'anɛ Zugsɔb ma'aanɛ, yanam san'am ninkan sɔb.

english_verse: Do not mistreat or abuse foreigners who live among you. Remember, you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: “Da namisidi saamma ka yanam mɛ da anɛ saam Egipt teŋin.

english_verse: Do not mistreat widows or orphans.
translation_verse: Da mugusidi pʋkɔnya bɛɛ kpiibisɛ.

english_verse: If you do, they will beg for my help, and I will come to their rescue.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a maali ba linɛ ka' sʋm ka ba kaasi tisim, mam na wʋmi ba fabʋlʋg,

english_verse: In fact, I will get so angry that I will kill your men and make widows of their wives and orphans of their children.
translation_verse: ka m sʋʋnr na duoe ka m kɛ ka ya kpi tanpin ka ya pu'ab mɛ lieb pʋkɔnya ka ya biis lieb kpiibis.

english_verse: Don't charge interest when you lend money to any of my people who are in need.
translation_verse: “Ya ya'a pɛ'ɛŋ ligidi tisim nidib la yinne onɛ an nɔŋdaan ka bɛɛ ya san'an, yanam on da niŋ wʋʋ ligidpɛ'ɛmisa dim banɛ pɛ'ɛsid nyɔɔd la.

english_verse: Before sunset you must return any coat taken as security for a loan,
translation_verse: Ka fʋ ya'a di'e fʋ kpi'a fugɔbʋgʋ o pɛ'ɛm yɛla, fʋn lɛbisim tis o ka winnig nyaan lu,

english_verse: because that is the only cover the poor have when they sleep at night. I am a merciful God, and when they call out to me, I will come to help them.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ lin ka o mɔri pinnɛ o mɛŋ. Ya'a ka' alaa, o ye o nɔk bɔɔ pil o mɛŋ yʋ'ʋŋ kanɛ? Ka o ya'a kaas ka fabili tisim, mam na wʋm, bɔzugɔ m anɛ nimbaanlzɔt.”

english_verse: Don't speak evil of me or of the ruler of your people.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya san'am Wina'am yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ pɔ nɔɔri niŋ tuongat onɛ guri ya nidib la.

english_verse: and the first-born of your cattle and sheep. Let the animals stay with their mothers for seven days, then on the eighth day give them to me, your God.
translation_verse: Maalimi nɛ ala nɛ ya niigi nɛ kɔnbid. Ba na bɛ nɛ ba manamɛ paae daba ayɔpɔi, amaa daba anii daar la ka ya mɔri ba na tisim.

english_verse: You are my chosen people, so don't eat the meat of any of your livestock that was killed by a wild animal. Instead, feed the meat to dogs.
translation_verse: “Ya na anɛ nimbanɛ an kasi tisim, dinzugɔ, da ɔnbi ni'im linɛ ka wɛog bʋn tɔɔnsi tɔɔnsɛ. Lɔm tisi baas.”

english_verse: Always tell the truth in court, even if everyone else is dishonest and stands in the way of justice.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ paas nimbabig zug ka ya tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. Ka fʋ mɛ ya'a yɛl si'el sariakatib tuon, fʋn da kɛ ka nimbabig fɛndigi fʋ ya'am ka fʋ di ziri kasɛt ka su'a sida laa.

english_verse: And don't favor the poor, simply because they are poor.
translation_verse: Mɛ da mɔŋ nɔŋdaan bʋʋd sariakadibin o nɔŋ la zugɔ.

english_verse: If you find an ox or a donkey that has wandered off, take it back where it belongs, even if the owner is your enemy.
translation_verse: “Fʋ dataa naaf bɛɛ o bʋŋ ya'a bɔdig ka fʋ nyɛɛ o, fʋn kpɛ'ɛŋimi fʋ mɛŋ ka gban'e o mɔri keŋ tis o.

english_verse: If a donkey is overloaded and falls down, you must do what you can to help, even if it belongs to someone who doesn't like you.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ ya'a nyɛ onɛ kisif ka o bʋŋ luu dig nɛ la'ad fʋn sʋŋim duoe o.

english_verse: Make sure that the poor are given equal justice in court.
translation_verse: “Nɔŋ dim ya'a mɔr sida sariakadibin fʋn da mɔŋi ba.

english_verse: Don't bring false charges against anyone or sentence an innocent person to death. I won't forgive you if you do.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ ma'aa ziri tabil sɔ', ka mɛ da kʋ ninkanɛ pʋ tʋm taalɛ. Onɛ niŋ ala, m kʋ bas o ka o keŋ zaalim.

english_verse: Don't mistreat foreigners. You were foreigners in Egypt, and you know what it is like. Laws for the Sabbath The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Da namisidi saamma, ka ya mɛŋ mi' fʋn na an saan ka li an si'em, bɔzugɔ ya da anɛ saam Egipt teŋin.” Vʋ'ʋsʋm yʋʋm nɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm daar la yɛla

english_verse: Plant and harvest your crops for six years,
translation_verse: “Ya na bʋd ka buni ya pɔɔd zʋʋd la yʋma ayuobʋ.

english_verse: but let the land rest during the seventh year. The poor are to eat what they want from your fields, vineyards, and olive trees during that year, and when they have all they want from your fields, leave the rest for wild animals.
translation_verse: Amaa yʋʋm kanɛ paas ayɔpɔi la yanam basim pɔɔd la ka da kuaa, ka nɔŋ dim banɛ bɛɛ ya san'an la mɛ paam diibi di, ka linɛ kpɛlim la ka wɛog bʋnkɔnbid mɛ ɔnb. Maaliminɛ ala nɛ ya vain nɛ olif tiis pɔɔd la.

english_verse: Work the first six days of the week, but rest and relax on the seventh day. This law is not only for you, but for your oxen, donkeys, and slaves, as well as for any foreigners among you.
translation_verse: Daba ayuobʋ ka m tisi ya ye ya tʋmmi ya tʋʋma, amaa mid ka ya tʋm daba ayɔpɔi la daar, dabiskan la ka ya na'araad nɛ ya bʋmis na vʋ'ʋs, ka ya yammis banɛ du'a ya yin nɛ ya saam la wʋsa mɛ na vʋ'ʋs.

english_verse: Make certain that you obey everything I have said. Don't pray to other gods or even mention their names. Three Annual Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Gu'usimi ka tʋm mam yɛli ya si'el la wʋsa. Mid ka ya pʋdig bada la yʋda, pʋn da kɛ ka sɔ' wʋmi ba yɛla ya nɔɔrinɛ.” Yʋʋm-yʋʋm malima yɛla (Yib

english_verse: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. And make sure that the fat of the animal is burned that same day.
translation_verse: “Da maali malʋŋ kanɛ an ziim malʋŋ nɛ bodobodo kanɛ mɔr dabinnɛ. Da nɔk ni'im kpaam dinɛ an malʋŋ din la digil ka bɛog nie.

english_verse: Your women will give birth to healthy children, and everyone will live a long life.
translation_verse: Ka pu'a kʋ kpa'ae bɛɛ an kʋndu'ari ya teŋin laa. Ka m na kɛ ka ya na kʋdigi paae ya nyɔvʋr bɛn.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Maalimi Bʋndɛɛnna Di'ema Malʋŋ linɛ ka ya bʋdi ya pɔɔdin la. “Ka lɛn maali Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ la saŋkanɛ ka ya bun zʋʋdi naae ka zii kul yin na la.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye ya dap la wʋsa kɛn man Zugsɔb Wina'am tuon na nɔɔra atan' yʋʋm yinne pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: Dimi diib di'ema malʋŋ kanɛ maan nɛ bodobodo kanɛ ka' danbin la. Ya na ɔnb bodobodo kanɛ paae daba ayɔpɔi wʋʋ mam yɛli ya si'em la. Maalimi nwa' nwadkanɛ ni ka ya da yi Egipt na la. Sɔ' da kɛn man san'an na nɛ nu'uzaalisɛ.

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Mɔrini ya yiiga zʋʋd dinɛ ka ya bʋn ka di an sʋm la kɛn Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la Yin na. “Mid ka ya nɔk bʋbil kanɛ nam mu'ad ni'imi dʋg nɛ o ma bin'isim.” Zugsɔb maliak na maal suor ka ba zabi nyaŋ

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am da lɛn yɛl Moses ye, “M ye m kɛnɛ ka maliak gaadi ya tuon ka mɔri ya keŋ paae zin'ikanɛ ka m ti'ebi tisi ya la.

english_verse: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimini o ka siak on yɛt si'el, bɔzugɔ ya ya'a ki'isi o, o kʋ kɛɛ ya taali basɛ, man tis o m kpi'euŋ la zug.

english_verse: If you faithfully obey him, I will be a fierce enemy of your enemies.
translation_verse: Ka ya ya'a siak o nɔɔr ka tʋm man yɛl si'el la wʋsa, ya dataas na aan m dataas, ka m mɛ na kis banɛ kisi ya.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: Ka m maliak na gaad tuon ka mɔri ya keŋ paae teŋ kanɛ ka Amor dim nɛ Hitti dim nɛ Perizi dim nɛ Keenan dim nɛ Hivi dim nɛ Jebus dim bɛ la. Ka o na san'ami ba ka kɛ ka ya kpɛn' zin'in anina.

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: Ka ya na pʋ'ʋsidi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la ka o na niŋi ya diib nɛ ya ku'om albareka, ka na yis ban'as wʋsa ya san'an.

english_verse: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.
translation_verse: Ka m na kɛ ka dabiem kpɛn' ya dataas la, ka kɛ ka ba nini fɛndig ka ba zi' ban na maal si'ela. Hali ba na fɛndigi zɔ ka basi ya.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: Ka m kɛ ka Hivi dim nɛ Keenan dim nɛ Hitti dim la ya'a nyɛɛ ya, ba ya'am na iank ka ba zɔ.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: Amaa m kʋ kɛ ka ba yi teŋin la wʋsa yʋʋm yinnee, bɔzugɔ m ya'a niŋ ala, teŋ la na lieb wɛog, ka sian'anr bʋnkɔnbid na di'e zin'ig la wʋsa.

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: M na kati ya dataas la yisid bi'el-bi'el, hali ka ya ti nɔbigi sʋ'ʋg teŋ la.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ya bɛn la yi Atɛuk Zɛn'ug la ti paae Filistia dim Tɛukʋn la, ka mɛ yi mɔɔgin ti paae Efiritis mu'ar la. M na kɛ ka ya nyaŋ nimbanɛ bɛɛ anina la yis nɛ paŋ.

english_verse: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.
translation_verse: Amaa da maal nɔnaar nɛ ba bɛɛ ba bada la.

english_verse: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ba kpɛlim bɛ nɛ ya teŋin laa; ya'a ka' alaa ba na kɛ ka ya dɔlli ba bada la ka tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi tis mam.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Dʋm zuor la zugʋ m san'an na. Dɔl Aaron nɛ o biribis ayi', Nadab nɛ Abihu, nɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam pisyɔpɔi na. Asɛɛ ka ba bɛ lallisa ka pʋ'ʋsid mam,

english_verse: but you are to come near. Don't let anyone else come up.”
translation_verse: amaa fʋn ma'aa kem li'el kpɛla na. Da kɛ ka nidib la sɔ' dɔlli fʋ pɛ'ɛsɛ.”

english_verse: Moses gave the Lord's instructions to the people, and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded!”
translation_verse: Ka Moses keŋ yɛl nidib la Zugsɔb la yɛl si'el la nɛ o kaanbʋg la, ka ba siak nɛ nɔɔr yinne ye, “Ti na tʋm linɛ wʋsa ka Zugsɔb yɛl ye ti tʋm la.”

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Moses sɔb Zugsɔb la yɛl si'el la. Ka bɛog nie ka Moses duoe mɛ' maan bimbim zuor la gbinnin, ka nɔk kugtitada zi'eli tis Israel dɔɔd pii nɛ ayi' la.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka o tʋm Israel dim dasam sieba ye ba nɔk na'araadi maal malʋŋ dinɛ nyu'od nɛ bugum tis Zugsɔb la, ka mɛ maal taaba la'asʋg maana la.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Ka Moses bu'oe ziim la pʋsʋkʋ niŋ laasin ka nɔk linɛ kpɛlim la kpa'ae siɛn maan bimbim la.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Ka o nɔk Zugsɔb nɔnaar gbauŋ la karim tis nidib la, ka ba siak ka ye, “Ti na siak Zugsɔb nɔɔr ka tʋm on yɛl si'el la wʋsa.”

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɔk ziim la mis nidib la, ka yɛli ba ye, “Zikaŋa ka Zugsɔb nɔk ye o maal nɔnaar nɛ ya ka li dɔl on yɛli ya si'em la.” Moses n bɛ Wina'am zuor zug la yɛla

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Ka Moses, nɛ Aaron nɛ o biribis ayi' Nadab nɛ Abihu, nɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam pisyɔpɔi la dʋ zuor la zug,

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: ka nyɛ Israel Wina'am la, ka gɔs ka li nwɛnɛ kugkanɛ ka ba buon ye safir la dig o nɔba teŋir, ka li nie nyain wʋʋ saŋgbana nɛ.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: La'an nɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam la da nyɛ Wina'am la, o da pʋ tɛɛgi ba tʋbirɛ, hali ka ba la'am di ka nu.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye, “Dum zuor zug kpɛla na bɛ dabisa bi'ela ka m tisif kuglamma ayi' dinɛ ka m sɔbi m nɔzi'ela niŋ ye nidib la dɔl la.”

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl nidib la ye, “Gu'usimi kpɛla ka ti keŋ ka lɛb na. Aaron nɛ Hur na bɛ nɛ ya, ka yɛlkanɛ bɛ wʋsa ba na nyaŋi maal, tinamɛ kae la zug.” Ka on nɛ Josua onɛ sʋŋid o la dɔl taaba keŋ, ka Moses gaadi dʋ Wina'am zuor la zug.

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Ka Moses dʋ Sinai zuor la zug ka saŋgbana lus zin'ig la wʋsa.

english_verse: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb girima la nie nyain bɛɛ anina. Ka saŋgbana lus zuor la daba ayuobʋ, ka daba ayɔpɔi la daar ka Zugsɔb naan saŋgbana la nii buol Moses.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye ba mɔr piini na tisim. Onɛ mɛkama tis nɛ o sʋʋnr wʋsa fʋn di'em o piini la.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Piinbanɛ ka fʋ na di'e ba san'an anɛ sanlima nɛ anzurifa nɛ kʋntzɛn'ug;

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices to mix with the incense and with the oil for dedicating the tent and ordaining the priests;
translation_verse: nɛ olif kpaam dinɛ na nyu'od bugum, nɛ malʋŋ kpaam dinɛ ka ba nɔkidi suond maanmaannib, nɛ bʋnnyubisa dinɛ ka ba mɔri maan pʋ'ʋsim tudaari la.

english_verse: and onyx stones and other gems for the sacred vest and the breastpiece.
translation_verse: Kugvɛnla banɛ ka ba na nɔki sɛɛn niŋ maanmaan dansikin la nɛ dinɛ lɔɔd nyɔ'ɔgin la.

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye ya ti' Fuug Sʋgʋr ka m na bɛɛ m nidib la sʋʋgin.

english_verse: The lamp on the top and those at the end of each of its six branches must be made so as to shine toward the front of the lampstand.
translation_verse: Maalim kpaam fita ayɔpɔi sʋn'ʋl fita zi'esir la zug, ka nyu'oe ba ka ba na nie zin'ig la tuon.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Nɔkim sanlima bʋligi li pʋʋgin nɛ li nya'aŋ la wʋsa ka dɔlisi li nɔya la wʋsa.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Kudim sanlima baans anaasi ka lɔɔ ba yinne-yinne tabil daka la nɔba anaasi la.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Nɔkim na'aziinr daad ayi' ka nɔk sanlima bʋligi ba.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Nɔkim daad la tʋ baans ayi' banɛ bɛ daka la lʋga la ni. Ala ka ba na nyaŋi gban'e daad la ʋk daka la mɔri keŋ.

english_verse: Don't ever remove the poles from the rings.
translation_verse: Da lɛn yis daad la baans la nii.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka yinne zi'e daka la liŋ la datiuŋ, ka yinne mɛ zi'e li dagɔbʋg, ka ban nɛ liŋ la wʋsa an sanlim yinne.

english_verse: The creatures must face each other with their wings spread over the chest.
translation_verse: Maalim Kerubnam la ka ba kpʋkpama yadiga agɔla ka li ma'asim pil liŋ la. Li sʋ'ʋm ye ba kpa' taaba ka sʋnri gɔt liŋ la.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Nɔkim liŋ la pibil daka la zug. M ya'a tisif nɔzi'ela kuglamma la, fʋ na di'e niŋ daka la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: M na kɛɛn fʋ san'an zin'ikanɛ ka Kerubnam ayi' la bɛ daka liŋ teŋsʋk la; anina ka m na tisi fʋ m nɔzi'ela la wʋsa ka fʋ di'e tis Israel dim la.” Sanlima teebul la yɛla (Yib

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Nɔkim dabibisi tabili gilig teebul la ka ba wa'alim an wʋʋ nu'ug yalʋŋ nɛ, ka nɔk sanlima bʋligi ba wʋsa.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Maalim sanlima baans anaasi ka lɔɔ ba yinne-yinne tabil teebul la nɔba anaasi la ni.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Nɔkim na'aziinr daad ka bʋligi ba nɛ sanlima ka ba na mɔri ʋgisid teebul la ken.

english_verse: Make a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered gold
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb da lɛn yɛl ye, “Nɔkim sanlima kʋnt fita zi'esir, ka nwɛ'-nwɛ' li ka li gbin an lammiri, ka li teŋsʋk daug la an sappi. Fita la zi'esir nɛ li daug nɛ li bʋnvɛnla banɛ nwɛnɛ tipuum la wʋsa na an yinne.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Nɔkim sanlim yinne maal fita zi'esir la, nɛ li wila nɛ li puum nɛ vaand la wʋsa.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Ka nɔk sanlima maal ma'adiŋ kanɛ ka ba na mɔri zin'ed lauŋʋ la nɛ tampɛligim laas.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka fʋ maali li ka li nwɛnɛ mam pa'alif si'em zuor zug la dede.”

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: Nɔkim fuug linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa ka an bʋlʋ nɛ pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'isi sɛɛn, sɛn ka li vɛnl, ka zaŋi ligil Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔr la.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: Fuud pii nɛ yinne la na zem taaba ka ba wa'alim na an nɔba makir pisnaasi nɛ anu ka ba yalʋŋ na an nɔba makir ayuobʋ.

english_verse: ) The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: ka nɔk anzurifa maal zi'esa pisnaasi, ka dalammir wʋsa mɔr zi'esa ayi'.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: “Maalim Wina'am Fuug Sʋgʋr la nɛ pien pielig fuud piiga banɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ gum kanɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ gum sʋma banɛ an pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'is, ka kɛ ka onɛ mi' ʋgʋb ʋg linɛ ka ba buon ye Kerubnam la niŋ fuudin la.

english_verse: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.
translation_verse: Nɔkim fuud anu sɛɛn tɔ'ɔŋ taaba ka mɛ nɔk fuud anu banɛ kpɛlim la sɛɛn tɔ'ɔŋ taaba.

english_verse: The panel of goat hair will be a meter longer than the tent itself, so fold
translation_verse: Fuug la nɔbir makir ayinne nɛ pʋsʋk na yul Fuug Sʋgʋr zin'ig ayinne ka nɔbir makir ayinne nɛ pʋsʋk mɛ yul zin'ikaŋa la bʋʋli li wʋsa.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Nɔkim fuud anu tɔ'ɔŋ taaba ka mɛ nɔk fuud ayuobʋ banɛ kpɛlim la tɔ'ɔŋ taaba. Fʋ kanɛ paas ayuobʋ la, ya na pɔnbili li nɔɔra ayi' lɛbisi pa'al za'anɔɔr la zug.

english_verse: and fasten the two panels at the loops with
translation_verse: Nɔkim kʋntzɛn'ugʋ maal ga'adiŋgɔnlima pisnu ka li na ga'al fuud la ka di vɛ'ɛg Sʋgʋr la naal taaba.

english_verse: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka nɔk pɛraad gbana dinɛ ka ba mɔ'ɔnsi li ka di mu'oe la sɛɛn tɔ'ɔŋ taaba pili paas. Ka nɔk gbansʋma linɛ vɛnli pili tak.” Kʋlis nɛ li dazi'eda yɛla

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Nɔkim suguru sɔsʋg liŋ la pibil Nɔnaar Daka dinɛ bɛ Wina'am zin'ikanɛ an Kasi wʋsa Kasi la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: “Nɔkim na'aziinr daad la maal dalamma kpɛn'ɛs Fuug Sʋgʋr la.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: ka nɔk anzurifa maal zi'esa pisnaasi ka dalammir wʋsa na tʋ zi'esa ayi' la ni.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Maalim dalamma ayuobʋ Fuug Sʋgʋr la nya'aŋ linɛ bɛ ya-tuona la.

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka lɔdis dalamma la ta'al taab teŋiri dʋ zugin, ka baŋ yinne mɛ na mɔri ba wʋsa, ka ayi' la wʋsa na nwɛn taaba,

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: ka li na paae dalamma anii nɛ li anzurifa zi'esa pii nɛ ayuobʋ, ka dalammir wʋsa na mɔr zi'esa ayi'.

english_verse: with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Ka dapuudir kanɛ bɛ teŋsʋk la na wa'ami paae dalamma la wʋsa.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Bʋligim dalamma la nɛ sanlima ka maal sanlima baans linɛ na nyaŋi mɔr dapuuda la, ka mɛ bulig daad la nɛ sanlima.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Maalim Fuug Sʋgʋr la wʋʋ mam pa'alif zuor la zug si'em la tituaa.” Fugɔbʋg nɛ Fuug Sʋgʋr la la'ad yɛla

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Ka nɔk teebul la zi'el Fuug Sʋgʋr la pʋʋg datiuŋ ka mɛ nɔk fita zi'esir la zi'el dagɔbʋg ka ba kpa' taaba.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Ya'alim fuug la kpa'as la ni ka li sig teŋin, ka nɔk Nɔnaar Daka la niŋ fuug la nya'aŋ; ka fuug la na pʋdig Fuug Sʋgʋr la zin'is ayi'. Fuug la na pʋdig zin'ikanɛ an Kasi la nɛ linɛ an Kasi Wʋsa Kasi la.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Maalim sanlima baansi niŋ fukaŋa, ka nɔk sanlima bʋlig na'aziinr daad anu ka nɔk kʋntzɛn'ugʋ maali ba zi'esa.”

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Nɔkim daad la tʋ baans la pʋʋgin ka ba na bɛ maan daka la lʋga ayi' ni. Dinɛ na kɛ ka ba nyaŋi gban'e daad la ʋk maan daka la mɔri ken.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Nɔkim kʋntzɛn'ugʋ maali li la'ad la wʋsa. Maalim dʋgid banɛ ka ba mɔri vaad tampɛligim nɛ soobulnam nɛ labanɛ ka ba mɔri misid nɛ linɛ ka ba mɔri liebid ni'im nɛ ban mɔr si'eli vaad bugum saanna la.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Nɔkim dalamma maal maan daka la ka li pʋʋgin an vɔɔsim. Maalim wʋʋ mam pa'alif zuor la zug si'em la yim.” Zak nɛ li fuud la yɛla (Yib

english_verse: Command the people of Israel to supply you with the purest olive oil. Do this so the lamp will keep burning
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am da lɛn yɛl Moses ye, “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye asɛɛ ka ba mɔr olif kpaam linɛ an nyain na ka ba nyu'oe fita la ka li dit saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: for the west. Then hang a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. Place three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hang a curtain
translation_verse: Ka nɔk kʋntzɛn'ugʋ maal kʋnt daad pisi, ka maal zi'esa tʋʋ ba ka ba zi'e sappi. Amaa kɛl ka li kpa'as nɛ baans la an anzurifa.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔr la, nɔkim fuud linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa ka an bʋlʋ nɛ pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'is nɛ pien pielig, ka onɛ mi' sɛɛnb sɛn fuug ka li wa'alim an nɔba makir pistan'. Nɔkimi li ya'al kʋntzɛn'ug daad anaasi nɛ ba zi'esa anaasi la ni.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: Nɔkim kʋntzɛn'ugʋ maal linɛ wʋsa ka ya mɔri tʋm Fuug Sʋgʋr la tʋʋma, la'an nɛ Fuug Sʋgʋr la nɛ zak la kpada wʋsa.” Fita la kpaam yɛla (Lev

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fita zi'e Fuug Sʋgʋr kanɛ ka ba la'asid anina la pʋʋgin, fukanɛ ka ba bɛŋ la tuon, ka Aaron nɛ o biribis na gɔsid ka bugum la dit zaam hali ti nie bɛogʋ tis Zugsɔb la. Li anɛ zi'elʋg kanɛ bɛ saŋa wʋsa tis Israel dim ka ba na la'asid taaba maan hali nɛ zʋmaana banɛ kenna la.”

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb da lɛn yɛl ye, “Kɛl ka fʋ bier Aaron nɛ o biribis Nadab nɛ Abihu nɛ Eleazar nɛ Itamar li'eli fʋ san'an na ka na an maanmaannibi tis mam.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Yɛlim banɛ ka m tisi ba ya'am ka ba mi' sɛɛnb sʋŋa la ka ba sɛn fuud la ka Aaron bɛɛ o kɔn' nɛ nidib la ka na an maanmaanni tis mam.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Fubanɛ ka ba na maal anɛ linɛ lɔɔdi tabin nyɔ'ɔgin, nɛ dansik nɛ fuwɔk linɛ an bʋlʋ, nɛ fuwɔk pielig linɛ nu'usi wa'am la, ka ba sɛɛn maal ka li vɛnl nɛ zupibig nɛ sɛnbidiŋ. Ba na sɛn fubama tisi fʋ bier Aaron nɛ o biribis la, ka ba an maanmaannib banɛ na tʋmmi tisid mam.

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Ba na nɔk gum kanɛ nyɛɛn wʋʋ salima nɛ, nɛ gum linɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'is nɛ fupiel sʋŋʋ sɛn fuud la.” Dansik la yɛla

english_verse: Put two onyx stones in gold settings, then attach one to each of the shoulder straps. On one of these stones engrave the names of Israel's first six sons in the order of their birth. And do the same with his remaining six sons on the other stone. In this way Aaron will always carry the names of the tribes of Israel when he enters the holy place, and I will never forget my people.
translation_verse: Lɔɔmi ba tabil dansik la ban'ad la zug, ka ba na an kugbanɛ na tɛɛnsid Israel biribis la. Ka yʋda la na bɛ Aaron ban'ad zug ka tiɛnd o ba yɛla, saŋa kanɛ wʋsa ka o kpɛn'ɛd Zugsɔb la tuon.

english_verse: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold. The Breastpiece for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: ka maal sanlima baans ka ba nwɛnɛ nwiis nɛ, ka fʋ nɔk baans la lɔɔ tɔ'ɔŋ nwiis la.” Linɛ lɔɔd maanmaan nyɔ'ɔgin la yɛla

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Nɔkim kugvɛnla pii nɛ ayi' kpɛn'ɛsi ba gʋʋdis anaasi la, ka gʋʋdiŋ yinne wʋsa mɔr kuga atan'. Atan' banɛ bɛɛ agɔl la na an kanelian nɛ kirisolat nɛ emeral,

english_verse: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
translation_verse: ka kugbanɛ tia'al la mɛ an takuos nɛ safir nɛ bʋmpielig,

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: ka banɛ paas atan' la an yasin nɛ agat nɛ ametis,

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: ka banɛ paas anaasi la an bɛril nɛ onik nɛ jaspa; ka kɛ ka ba maal sanlima dɔlis kuga la nɔya la.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: ka ba gaadi paae lɔ baans banɛ bɛ dansikin la, ka li kɛ ka li tabil dansik la kpʋkpama tuon.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Ba na nɔk gum kanɛ an bʋlʋ lɔ baans banɛ bɛ nyɔ'ɔgin la ken tabil nɛ baans banɛ bɛ dansik la nii tɔ'ɔŋ nɛ sɛnbidiŋ la, ka li kɛ ka nyɔ'ɔgin pien la kʋ yi ka bas dansik la.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: “Nɔkim pien kanɛ an bʋlʋ sɛn dansik.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Maalim vɔɔnr fuug la teŋsʋk ka zug na nyaŋi kpɛn'; ka nɔk gumme kpamisi giligi li, dinɛ na kɛ ka li kʋ aaɛn.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: Sanlima lʋmma nɛ pomanganɛt la na lʋʋm taaba fuug la nɔɔr teŋir.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Li sʋm ye Aaron ya'a tʋmm o maanmaan tʋʋma la on yɛɛ li. O ya'a kpɛn'ɛd zin'ikanɛ an Kasi la, lʋmma la na nwɛ'ɛd, ka o ya'a yit na ba na nwɛ'ɛd ka o kʋ kpii.

english_verse: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: “Dedicated to the Lord.”
translation_verse: “Nɔkim sanlima zan' lammiri bi'ela ka sɔbi pa'ali li zug ye li an, ‘KASI TIS ZUGSƆB’ la,

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: ka nɔk nwiig dinɛ an bʋlʋ lɔɔ tabil maanmaan zupibig la tuon.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Ka Saŋkanɛ wʋsa ka Aaron maan maannɛ tisid man Zugsɔb la, li na bɛɛ o gbɛ'ogʋn ka li pa'al ye o ziid Israel taal wʋsa. Li na bɛ Aaron gbɛ'ogʋn la saŋa wʋsa, ka di na kɛ ka man Zugsɔb na di'e Israel dim.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: “Ka sɛn fuwɔk piela banɛ nu'usi wa'am nɛ sɛnbidis nɛ zupibisi tis Aaron biis la mɛn ka ba na mɔr girima nɛ na'asi nidib la tuon.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Nɔkim fuud la yɛɛl Aaron nɛ o biis la, ka nɔk malʋŋ kpaam la bu'oe niŋi ba ka tisi ba suor ka ba liebi m maanmaannib.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Maalim pien pielig kurgimis ka li wa'alim paae duma ka li lusi ba nyan.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Aaron nɛ o biribis la na sɔɔnd kurigimbama saŋkanɛ wʋsa ka ba kpɛn'ɛd Fuug Sʋgʋr kanɛ ka ba la'asid taaba la, bɛɛ ba ya'a li'el maan daka la ye ba maal maan zin'ikanɛ an Kasi la ni. Dinɛ na kɛ ka ba kʋ maal taal ka kpii. “Nwa' na an Aaron nɛ o yaas tʋʋma saŋa wʋsa.”

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: “Daar wʋsa fʋn kʋʋm na'araug ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, ka lɛm maal malʋŋ kanɛ an suguru sɔsʋg maannɛ pie maan daka la ka li an kasi, ka nɔk malʋŋ kpaam bu'oe niŋi li, ka li an Wina'am din.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: ka nɔk zɔmbaanlig dinɛ pʋ gɛndig dabinnɛ sɛn' bodobodo, ka maal ma'asa gɛndig nɛ kpaam, ka maal si'el ka li nwɛnɛ sa'akɔnt kpi'emis ka nɔk kpaam niŋ.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Nɔkim bama atan' nwa' niŋ pɛogʋn, ka mɛ nɔk na'arapɔl nɛ pɛraad ayi' la mɔr na.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn mɔr Aaron nɛ o biis la keŋ Fuug Sʋgʋr kanɛ ka ba la'asid taaba za'anɔɔrin la, ka nɔk ku'om sʋʋ ba.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.
translation_verse: Nɔkim fuud la yɛɛl Aaron. Nɔkim fuwɔk la yɛɛl o, ka pa'al yinne kanɛ pʋ paae ala la, ka yʋ'ʋn zaŋ dansik la pa'al zugin, nɛ linɛ lɔɔd nyɔ'ɔgin la, ka mɛ nɔk sɛnbidiŋ linɛ vɛnl la lɔ o.

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: Ka nɔk malʋŋ kpaam kanɛ ka ba bu'odi niŋid nidib zug la bu'oe niŋ o zug.

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Mɔr na'araug la kɛn Fuug Sʋgʋr la tuon na, ka Aaron nɛ o biis la na nɔki ba nu'usi pa'al o zugin.

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: Kʋʋmi naaf la Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin Zugsɔb la tuon.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: Ka nɔki fʋ nu'ubili tin'e ziim la keŋ niŋ iila banɛ bɛ maan daka la ni, ka nɔk dinɛ kpɛlim la kpa'ae sɛɛnr maan daka la teŋir.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Amaa ni'im dinɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa nɛ gbauŋ nɛ pʋt la, asɛɛ ka ba mɔri yi yanamɛ gbɛɛnd zin'isi'a la yiŋi nyu'oe, ka li na an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd malʋŋ.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Nɔkim pɛraad la yinne ka kɛ ka Aaron nɛ o biis la nɔki ba nu'usi pa'al o zug,

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ka kɔdig o ka nɔk ziim la kpa'asi sɛɛnr maan daka la gilig.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Waansim ni'im la ka nɔk ku'om pie pʋʋgin la'ad nɛ nɔba la wʋsa ka nɔk zug nɛ ni'imbaanlʋg la wʋsa pɛ'ɛsi

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Nɔkim pɛrakanɛ kpɛlim la ka kɛ ka Aaron nɛ o biribis la na pa'ali ba nu'usi o zug

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ka kɔdig o ka ti'el ziim la bi'ela niŋ Aaron nɛ o biis la datiuŋ tʋba, nɛ ba datiuŋ nu'uraad nɛ ba datiuŋ nɔbraad, ka nɔk ziim la kpa'asi sɛɛnri gilig maan daka la.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Nɔkim ziim linɛ bɛ maan daka zugin la nɛ malʋŋ kpaam bi'ela zu'as Aaron nɛ o biis la nɛ ba fuud la wʋsa, ka ba na an nyain tis Wina'am.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: Yisim pɛraug la kpaam bi'ela, nɛ o zʋgan'ar nɛ li kpaam la wʋsa, ka nwaae sɔɔnr la bi'ela, ka nɔk siyaanini la nɛ li kpaam la wʋsa, nɛ o datiuŋ gbɛr la. Bɔzugɔ ba nɔkidnɛ pɛraug nwa' maan banɛ na an maanmaannib la malʋŋ.

english_verse: Take one loaf of each kind of bread from the basket,
translation_verse: Yisim bodobodo kanɛ ka' danbinnɛ ka zi'e Zugsɔb tuon la yinne, nɛ ma'asir yinne nɛ linɛ nwɛnɛ sa'akɔnt kpi'emis la yinne

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: niŋ Aaron nɛ o biribis la nu'usin ka nyɔɔsimi li wʋʋ ban niŋid nyɔɔsʋŋ malʋŋ si'em tisid Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Di'emi li ba nu'usin keŋ nyu'oe maan daka la zugin ka li nyɔ'ɔs la nyuug na malisi tis Zugsɔb la. Li anɛ bugum malʋŋʋ tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a kɔdig pɛrakanɛ ka fʋ na nɔki maal malʋŋ kanɛ na kɛ ka Aaron lieb maanmaan la, nɔkim kugsir la Zugsɔb la tuon ka nyɔɔsimi li wʋʋ ban nyɔɔsim maannɛ tisid Zugsɔb si'em la, ka li na aan fʋ din.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Ka o bikanɛ na ti di'e o lieb maanmaan kpɛɛm, ka na kpɛn' Fuug Sʋgʋr zin'ikanɛ ka ba La'asid ka li an Kasi la ni maal maan, asɛɛ ka o yɛ fuud nwa' daba ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place,
translation_verse: “Nɔkim pɛrakanɛ ka ba kɔdigi maal maan ka ba lieb maanmaannib la ni'imi dʋg zin'isʋŋin la.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ka Aaron nɛ o biis la na ɔnb pɛraug la ni'im Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin, nɛ bodobodo dinɛ bɛ pɛogʋn la.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Ban ma'aa na di dikanɛ ka ba zaŋi maal suguru sɔsʋg maan ka ba lieb maanmaannib la. Da kɛ ka sɔ' dii pɛ'ɛsi ba zugɔ, bɔzugɔ li anɛ kasi tis Wina'am.

english_verse: If any of the sacred food is left until morning, it must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Ka ya ya'a di ka li kpɛlim ka bɛog nie, yanam nɔkim ni'im la nɛ bodobodo la wʋsa nyu'oe bugum ka li anɛ kasi.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: “Maalim Aaron nɛ o biis la wʋʋ mam yɛlif si'em la. Nɔkim daba ayɔpɔi maali ba malʋŋ la.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Nɔkim daba ayɔpɔi maal suguru sɔsʋg daka la zug ka li kɛ ka li an Wina'am din. Ala ka maan daka la na an kasi ka bʋn linɛ si'is maan daka la mɛ na an kasi.” Daar wʋsa malʋŋ yɛla (Kal

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Zaŋimi yinne maal maan bɛogʋn ka maal yinne la zaam.

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Kɔdigim pɛraug kaŋa zaam, ka maal wʋʋ fʋn maal oŋa la si'em bɛogʋn la, nɛ li zʋʋd malʋŋ nɛ daam la, ka li na an malʋŋ kanɛ ka li nyuug malisi tis Zugsɔb la ka an malʋŋ kanɛ an nyu'or maan.

english_verse: You and your descendants must always offer this sacrifice on the altar at the entrance to the sacred tent. People of Israel, I will meet and speak with you there, and my shining glory will make the place holy.
translation_verse: Anina mɛn ka m na sia'al Israel dim la ka m na'am pipilim na kɛ ka zin'ig la an kasi.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Ka m na kɛ ka la'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la nɛ maan daka la an kasi, ka mɛ kɛ ka Aaron nɛ o biis la lieb maanmaannibi tisim.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: M na bɛ nɛ Israel dim la, ka na aan ba Wina'am.

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: Ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ aan ba Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ mɔri ba yi Egipt na ka na bɛ nɛ ba. Sida manɛ aan ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la.”

english_verse: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Da maal tudaari kaŋa buudi tisi fʋ mɛŋa, gɔsimi li ka li an kasi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Mix four liters of olive oil with the following costly spices: six kilograms of myrrh, three kilograms of cinnamon, three kilograms of cane, and six kilograms of cassia. Measure these according to the official standards. Then use this sacred mixture
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ mi' bʋnnyubisa maalʋg nɔk nwa' wʋsa maal malʋŋ kpasʋŋ ka ba mɔri suond ka li an Wina'am din.

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb da lɛn yɛl Moses ye, “Nɔkim na'aziinr daadi maal maan daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od tudaari li zug la.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Nɔkim maan daka nwa' zi'el fukanɛ bɛŋ Kasi Zin'ig nɛ Kasi Wʋsa Kasi Zin'ig la nya'aŋ. Nɔnaar daka kanɛ mɔr sanlima suguru sɔsʋg liŋ la bɛ nɛ fukaŋa nya'aŋ. Anina ka m na si'anif.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Da nɔki tudaar si'a ya'asi niŋ Zugsɔb tudaari daka la nii, bɛɛ maal nyu'or maan bɛɛ zʋʋd maannɛ li zugɔ. Mɛ da bu'oe daam basi li zugɔ.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Aaron na zaŋ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ ka ba kʋ ye ba maal suguru sɔsʋg malʋŋ la ziim niŋ maan daka iila la ni yʋʋm wʋsa. Li anɛ tilas ye ya maan yʋʋm-yʋʋm suguru sɔsʋg nwa' nɛ suguru sɔsʋg tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan ziim zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ dɔl la wʋsa. Maan Daka kaŋa anɛ kasi tis Zugsɔb la.” Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd suguru yɔɔb ligidi

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: “Fʋ ya'a ye fʋ kaal Israel dim la sɔbi ba yʋda digil, asɛɛ sɔ' wʋsa yɔ si'eli tis Zugsɔb la o nyɔvʋr zug. Linɛ na kɛ ka yɛlbɛ'og kʋ paae sɔ' kaalʋg la saŋaa.

english_verse: , whether rich or poor, must pay me the same amount of money, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Ka Aaron nɛ o biis la na piesidi ba nu'us nɛ ba nɔba anina.

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Di'em suguru sɔsʋg maan la Israel dim la wʋsa ni, ka nɔki maal Fuug Sʋgʋr kanɛ ka ba la'asid nɛ taaba la. Dinɛ na kɛ ka Israel dim la na tiɛn Zugsɔb la yɛla, ban yɔɔ ba nyɔvʋr yɛla la zug.” Laa kanɛ ka ba na piesid la maalʋg yɛla

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a maal tudaar kan la buudi on bɔɔdi li nyuug la zug, ban yisim o sɔb buudi la ni.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.
translation_verse: Maalimi ba ka ba an kasi; hali dinɛ wʋsa si'isi ba na lieb kasi.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils,
translation_verse: la'an nɛ teebul nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa, nɛ fita zi'esir nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa, nɛ daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od tudaari la,

english_verse: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil,
translation_verse: Nɔkim kpaam la bu'oe niŋ Aaron nɛ o biis la, ka maali ba ka ba na an maanmaannibi tisim.”

english_verse: and say to the people of Israel: “This oil must always be used in the ordination service of a priest. It is holy because it is dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb da lɛn yɛl Moses ye, “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye kpakaŋa anɛ malʋŋ kpaam kanɛ an mam Zugsɔb din. Li na bɛɛ ala tis Israel dim saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: If you do, you will no longer belong to the Lord's people.” The Sweet-Smelling Incense
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a maal kpakan la buudi, ka sɔ' nɔki li bu'oe niŋ onɛ ka' maanmaana, ban yisim niŋkan sɔb buudi ni.”

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.
translation_verse: Nɔkimi li wʋsa ka maali li wʋʋ banɛ mi' bʋnnyubisa nɛ tima tʋʋma maan tudaar zɔ'ɔm si'em la. Niŋimi yaarim ka li an nyain ka aan m din.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.
translation_verse: Nɔkimi li bi'ela tua ka li kilim wʋʋ zɔ'ɔm nɛ, ka nɔki li zi'el sʋgʋrin la Nɔnaar Daka la tuon, ka m na sia'ali fʋ anina. Li sʋm ye li an kasi tisif.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.
translation_verse: “Gɔsima! M gaŋnɛ Uri biig Bezalel onɛ an Hur yaaŋ, ka an Juda dɔɔg nid la.

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: M mɛ gaŋnɛ Akisamak biig Oholiyab onɛ yi Dan dɔɔgin na la ye o sʋŋ o, ka nɔk baŋiri tis banɛ mi' tʋʋma kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb la, hali ka ba na nyaŋi tʋm tʋʋm kanɛ ka m yɛlif ye fʋ tʋm la wʋsa.

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye ba tɛnr Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la yɛla. Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la anɛ zanbin linɛ na pa'al ye mam nɛ yanam nɛ ya zʋmaana banɛ na ti duoe na wʋsa anɛ yinne. Li na kɛ ka ya baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la, ka kɛ ka ya an kasi.

english_verse: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Tʋmmi daba ayuobʋ ma'aa, amaa daba ayɔpɔi la anɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir linɛ an kasi tis Zugsɔb la. Onɛ wʋsa tʋm Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la ba na kʋʋ o.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: Li anɛ zanbin linɛ na pa'al ye mam nɛ yanam nɛ ya zʋmaana banɛ na ti duoe na wʋsa anɛ yinne. Li pa'al ye daba ayuobʋ ka Zugsɔb maal agɔl nɛ teŋ ka vʋ'ʋs daba ayɔpɔi la daar.” Wina'am sɔb o nɔzi'ela la yɛla

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la pian' tis Moses Sinai zuor zugʋ naae la, ka yʋ'ʋn nɔk kuglamma ayi' tis o, banɛ ka on Wina'am mɛŋ sɔb o nɔnaar la nɔzi'ela la.

english_verse: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb lɛn yɛl o ye, “M nyɛ nidib nwa' tʋbzian'asim nɛ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi an si'em.

english_verse: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.
translation_verse: Ka nidib la duoe bɛkɛungʋ maal malima banɛ nyu'od bugum nɛ taaba la'asʋg maana, ka zin'ini di ka nu, ka duoe wa'a ba'amaannib wa'a.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Levi dim la ye, “Zina ya anɛ banɛ na tʋm Zugsɔb la tʋʋma bɔzugɔ ya siaki kʋʋ ya pitib nɛ ya biis, ka nwa' zug Zugsɔb na niŋi ya zug bareka zina.”

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Nidib la da nyɛ ka Moses yuug zuor la zug ka nam pʋ sig na la, ka ba keŋ gilig Aaron ka yɛl o ye, “Gɔsima, maalim wina tisi ti ka ba gaadi ti tuon ka ti dɔl ka ti zi' dinɛ niŋ Moses onɛ mɔri ti yi Egipt teŋin la naa!”

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Ka Aaron yɛl ba ye, “Yɛlimini ya pu'ab, nɛ ya biribis nɛ ya bipumis ye ba nɔki ba sanlima tʋblɛma la mɔr na.”

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Ka Aaron nɔk sanlima la nyɛligi maal na'apɔl. Ka nidib la yɛl ye, “Israel dima, wʋmmiya! Ya teŋgbana banɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt na la nwa'.”

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ka Aaron nyɛ nidib la tʋm si'em la, ka o mɛ' maan bimbim na'apɔl la tuon ka mɔɔli yɛli ba ye, “Bɛog ti na maal malʋŋʋ tis Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Sigim zuor la zug tɔ'ɔtɔ ka nidib la ka fʋ mɔri ba yi Egipt na la, ba tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd!

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ba ta'an kɛɛs mam yɛl ye ba dɔl si'em la bas, ka maal bʋn ka li nwɛnɛ na'apɔl nɛ ka ba pʋ'ʋsidi li ka maal malʋŋʋ tisi li, ka yɛt ye, ‘Israel dima, wʋmmiya! Ya wina banɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt na la nwa'.’”

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: Moses! Kɛl ka m san'ami ba! Ka m na kɛ ka fʋn Moses yaas zu'oe lieb bɛdegʋ.”

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ka Moses fabili tis o Zugsɔb Wina'am ye, “M Zugsɔba, da tʋm alaa! Bɔ ka fʋ sʋʋnr duoe nɛ fʋ nimbanɛ ka fʋ mɔri ba yi Egipt na nɛ fʋ paŋ tita'ar la?

english_verse: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!
translation_verse: Egipt dim na yɛl ye fʋ mɔri pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd ka ma'aa mɔri ba paae zuorin nwa' na ye fʋ kʋʋ ba ka li' ba buudi dunia nwa' ni. Ayei, da kɛ ka ba yɛl ala! Kɛl ka fʋ sʋʋnr digin ka fʋ tiaki fʋ ya'am ka yɛl kaŋa da paae ba.

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsim fʋn mɛŋ mɛŋi da kaanb si'em tisi fʋ tʋmtʋmnib Abraham nɛ Isaak nɛ Jakob ye, ‘M na kɛ ka ya yaas zu'oe nwɛnɛ nwadbibisi bɛ saazug si'em la, ka na tisi ba teŋ kaŋa wʋsa ka m da kaanb la ka li aan ba din saŋa wʋsa.’”

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la sik o sʋʋnr ka pʋ san'am nidib la wʋʋ on gban'e si'em laa.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Ka Josua wʋm ka nidib la maan tʋkpiidʋg ka li nwɛnɛ zaba la, ka o yɛl Moses ye, “Zaba tʋkpiidʋg bɛɛ anina!”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Ka Moses lɛbis o ye, “Ayei! Nɛ'ɛŋa ka' zaba tʋkpiidʋgɔ; li ka' banɛ zabi nyaŋ bɛɛ banɛ zabi gʋ'ʋŋ tʋkpiidʋgɔ; amaa li anɛ di'ema nɛ yʋ'ʋma tʋkpiidʋg!”

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Ka ba duoe ken paae ban bɛ zin'isi'a la nyɛ ka ba maal na'apɔlli zi'el, ka wa'adi tisidi li. Ka Moses sʋʋnr duoe ka o nɔk kuga la lɔbi bas zuor la teŋir ka li nwa'ae.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɔk na'apɔl la bas bugumin ka li nyɛligi ga'aŋ ka o nɛɛmi li baanlig ka nɔki yugus ku'omin tisi ba ye ba num, ka ba nu.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Ka Moses bu'os Aaron ye, “Nidib la maal bɔ ka fʋ mɔr tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kaŋa na tisi ba?”

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Ka Aaron lɛbis ye, “M zugdaana, m bɛlimnɛ, da kɛ ka nɛ' daami fɔ. Fʋ mɛŋ mi' nidib la an bɛ'ɛd si'em.

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Ba yɛlim ye, ‘Gɔsima, maalim wina tisi ti banɛ na gaadi ti tuon ka ti dɔl. Ka ti zi' dinɛ niŋ Moses onɛ mɔri ti yi Egipt teŋin la naa!’

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛli ba ye, ‘Mɔri ya sanlima tʋblɛma la na.’ Ka ba mɔri ba na ka m di'e nɔki bas bugumin la, ka na'apɔl nwa' yina.”

english_verse: Moses knew that the people were out of control and that it was Aaron's fault. And now they had made fools of themselves in front of their enemies.
translation_verse: Moses daa nyɛ ka nidib la tʋm yɔɔg-yɔɔg, ka li anɛ Aaron n kɛ ka ba niŋid ala, ka ba dataas yʋ'ʋn la'adi ba.

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: Ka o zi'e za'anɔɔrin la ka yɛl ye, “Yanam banɛ wʋsa dɔl Zugsɔb la, kemini m san'an na.” Ka banɛ an Levi dɔɔg dim la wʋsa la'as o san'an na.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Ala ka Zugsɔb Israel Wina'am yɛt ye, ‘Sɔ' woo yisimi o sʋ'ʋraug ka gilig nidib la ni kʋʋ ya pitib nɛ ya bieya, nɛ ya zuanam, nɛ ya kpi'es wʋsa!’”

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Ka Levi dɔɔg dim la siak Moses nɔɔr ka kʋ nidib tusa atan' daakan.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Ka li yimbɛog ka Moses yɛl nidib la ye, “Ya tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd hali, amaa m na lɛn lɛbi dʋ Zugsɔb san'an zuor la zugʋ, sɔs suguru ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug ka daasi'erɛɛ o na kɛɛ ya taali bas.”

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Ka Moses lɛb Zugsɔb san'an ka yɛl o ye, “Nimbama tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ba nɔk sanlima maal wina tisi ba mɛŋ.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna m bɛlimnɛ, kɛl nidib la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la bas, ya'a ka' ala fʋn yis mam yʋ'ʋri fʋ gbauŋ la ni!”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Ayei, amaa li anɛ onɛ wʋsa tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka m na yis o bas.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
