translation_verse: Lɛm mɔr nidib la keŋ mam ye fʋ mɔri ba keŋ si'el la. Gɔsima, m maliak na gaad tuon ka ba dɔl. Amaa m ya'a ti ye m buol nidib la gɔs banɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa, m na tɛɛgi ba tʋbir.”

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb kɛ ka tɔɔg paae ba, ban kɛ ka Aaron maal na'apɔl la zug.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Mɔri fʋ nimbanɛ ka fʋ mɔri yi Egipt la duoe yi zin'ikanɛ ka ya bɛ nwa' la. Mɔri ba keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka m kaanbi tis Abraham nɛ Isaak nɛ Jakob ye m na nɔki tisi ba yaas la.

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: Kemi teŋ kanɛ ka bin'isim nɛ siind pʋbid wʋʋ ku'om la, amaa man kʋ dɔlli ya keŋɛ. Bɔzugɔ ya anɛ nimbanɛ ki'isidi m nɔɔr ka m ya'a dɔlli ya m na kʋʋ ya suor zug.”

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye o yɛlimi ba ye, “Ya anɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam nɛ banɛ tʋbaa ziank. M ya'a ye m dɔl yanam hali saŋa bi'ela, m na san'ami ya tɔ'ɔtɔ. Yisiminɛ ya niŋgɔnkɔris nɛ ya bʋnvɛnla wʋsa ka m gɔsi baŋ mam na maali ya si'em.”

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: Dinzug saŋkanɛ ka ba da yit Sinai zuorin la, Israel dim la da pʋ lɛn kɔr niŋgɔnkɔrisɛ. La'asʋg fuug sʋgʋr la

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Moses da ɛɛnti ti'inɛ la'asʋg fuug sʋgʋr nidib la bɛ si'el la yiŋ sa ka li wa'am bi'ela. Ba da buonnɛ li yʋ'ʋr ye, “La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr.” Ka onɛ bɔɔd ye o paae Zugsɔb la da ɛɛnti keŋnɛ anina.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ wʋsa ka Moses ti keŋ La'asʋg Sʋgʋrin la, nidib la duodnɛ zi'e ba sʋga za'anɔya ni gɔsid Moses hali ka o ti kpɛn' naae.

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: Ka La'asʋg Sʋgʋrin la ka Zugsɔb pian'adi tisid Moses wʋʋ nid nɛ o tiraanɛ na sɔnsid si'em. Ka li nya'aŋ ka Moses lɛb nidib la san'an na, ka Josua onɛ an Nun biig, ka sʋŋid o la, nam bɛ Fuug Sʋgʋr la ni. Moses nyɛ Zugsɔb la girima

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Zugsɔb la ye, “Fʋ yɛtim ye m mɔr nidib la keŋi ba ken zin'ig la, amaa fʋ pʋ yɛl onɛ ka fʋ na tʋm ka o na sʋŋi ma. Fʋ da buol mam nɛ ka yɛlim ye, ‘M mi' fʋ yʋ'ʋr, ka m nini mɛ tigif.’

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Tɔ', li ya'a sid aan ala, pa'alim fʋn gban'e si'em ka m baŋ, ka na tʋm wʋʋ fʋn bɔɔd ye m tʋm si'em la. Da tam ye nimbama anɛ fʋ mɛŋ nidiba.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛbis ye, “Mam mɛŋ na dɔllif ka ti keŋ ka m na tisif vʋ'ʋsʋm.”

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Ka Moses lɛbis ye, “Fʋ ya'a kʋ dɔlli ti keŋi da kɛ ka ti yi kpɛla.

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: Ka fʋ ya'a pʋ dɔlli tii keŋɛ, nidib na niŋ wala baŋ ye fʋ nini sid tig mam nɛ nimbama ka fʋ gaŋ ye ti bɛɛ ti kɔn' nɛ dunia dim wʋsa la?”

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb lɛbis o ye, “M na niŋ fʋn sɔs ye m tʋm si'em la. Bɔzugɔ, m mi' fʋ yʋ'ʋr ka m nini tigif.”

english_verse: Then Moses said, “I pray that you will let me see you in all of your glory.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl ya'as ye, “Kɛl ka m nyɛɛ fʋ girima la kpɛla.”

english_verse: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord, and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb lɛbis ye, “M na kɛ ka fʋ nyɛɛm tʋʋm sʋma la ka m na buonnɛ m mɛŋ yʋ'ʋr ye, ‘Zugsɔb’ fʋ san'an. Man na zɔ nimbanɛ ka m gban'e ye m zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig, ka zʋ'ʋs nimbanɛ ka m gban'e ye m zʋ'ʋsi ba.

english_verse: but I won't let you see my face, because anyone who sees my face will die.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋ kʋ nyaŋi gɔsi kpa' m nindaa, bɔzugɔ sɔ' ka' na nyɛ m nindaa ka lɛn vʋeya.”

english_verse: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it,
translation_verse: Ka o lɛn yɛl ye, “Gɔsima! Fʋ na tun'e zi'enɛ m san'an tampiing la zug kpɛla.

english_verse: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.
translation_verse: M girima la ya'a ti gat m na nɔki fʋ niŋ tampiing la yɔkin ka nɔki m nu'ugi ligilif, hali nɛ mam na ti gaadi naae.

english_verse: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.
translation_verse: Ka nyaan yisi m nu'ug ka fʋ nyɛ m nya'aŋ, amaa fʋ kʋ nyɛ m nindaa.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I promise to perform miracles for you that have never been seen anywhere on earth. Neighboring nations will stand in fear and know that I was the one who did these marvelous things.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb lɛbis ye, “M nɔnaar kaanbir kaŋa ka m ye m tisi ya. M ye m na maal nyalima linɛ nan zi' tʋm dunia kaŋa bɛɛ teŋ si'a nii, ka fʋ nidib wʋsa na nyɛ. Ka nimbanɛ bɛ kpɛla na nyɛ mam Zugsɔb paŋ la an si'em. Bɔzugɔ tʋʋm nyalim titada ka m ye m tʋmmi ya san'an.

english_verse: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.
translation_verse: Ti'ebim ka bɛog ka fʋ dʋ Sinai Zuor la zug na zaŋi fʋ mɛŋi pa'alim.

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka sɔ' dɔlli fʋ kenaa bɛɛ pʋn li'el zuor la gbinnɛ, hali bʋnkɔnbid da ɔnb yaamaa anina babaa.”

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ka Moses kpi'a kuglamma ayi' ka ba nwɛnɛ banɛ ka o daa kpi'a yiiga la, ka duoe bɛogʋn dʋ Sinai Zuor la zug wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la, ka mɔr kuga la o nu'usin.

english_verse: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, “I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ka o dɔl Moses tuonnɛ gaad ka yɛl ye, “Manɛ an Zugsɔb la, manɛ an Zugsɔb la! M anɛ Wina'am onɛ an nimbaanlzɔɔr sɔb ka zɔt saalib nyɔɔg. M anɛ baanlimm ka m sʋnf pʋ duod tɔ'ɔtɔɔ, ka m nɔŋilim nɛ sida ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Moses igini zaŋ o zugɔ kpa' teŋ ka wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb la,

english_verse: He prayed, “Lord, if you really are pleased with me, I pray that you will go with us. It is true that these people are sinful and rebellious, but forgive our sin and let us be your people.” A Promise and Its Demands (Exodus
translation_verse: ka yɛl o ye, “M Zugsɔba, fʋ nini ya'a sid tig mam, alaa fʋn dɔlli tii keŋ. Sida nidib la anɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam amaa m sɔsidif ye fʋ kɛɛ ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd taali bas, ka di'e ti ka ti aan fʋ nimbanɛ ka fʋ gaŋ.” Zugsɔbi lɛn kaanb nɔnaar si'em (Yib

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɔɔr atan' yʋʋm pʋʋgin, ya dap la wʋsa na kɛn Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la san'an na.

english_verse: I demand your complete loyalty—you must not worship any other god!
translation_verse: Da pʋ'ʋsi win si'a ya'asɛ amaa Zugsɔb la ma'aa; bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Nyuur la sid anɛ nyuur sɔb.

english_verse: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.
translation_verse: Bikpɛŋ wʋsa anɛ mam bʋn, la'an nɛ bʋnkɔnbkpɛŋ wʋsa,

english_verse: Don't make metal images of gods.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya mɛ nɔk kʋnti maal wina.

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ na niŋ si'em anɛ ya siaki m nɔɔr, ka m na kad banɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa, banɛ an Amor dim nɛ Keenan dim nɛ Hitti dim nɛ Perizi dim nɛ Hivi dim nɛ Jebus dim la.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya maal nɔnaar kaanbʋg nɛ nimbanɛ ka ya keŋ paae ba teŋin la, ya ya'a niŋ ala an bɛndigʋ san'ami ya suoya.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Amaa Nwa'amini ba winpʋ'ʋsʋg bimbima la, ka nwa'a ba teŋgban kuga la, ka kɔ' Asera daad la.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya maal nɔnaar kaanbʋg nɛ nimbanɛ ka ya keŋ paae ba teŋin la. Ba ya'a maannɛ ba bada nɛ wina la, li nwɛnɛ wʋʋ dau bɔɔd pu'agɔɔndir si'em la, ka ba ya'a buoli ya, ya na ɔnbi ba bada malʋŋ ni'im la.

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: “Maalimi malʋŋ kanɛ maan nɛ bodobodo linɛ ka' danbin la. Ya na ɔnb bodobodo la daba ayɔpɔi nwɛnɛ mam pa'ali ya si'em la. Maalimi na ala nwadkanɛ ka ba buon ye Abib la, bɔzugɔ nwadkan la ni ka ya da yi Egipt na.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: ka ya bʋŋ ya'a kiibi du'a, o ya'a anɛ bʋndibig, ya na tiak nɛ pɛribigi tis Zugsɔb la. Amaa ya ya'a pʋ lɛm bɔɔd ye ya tiakɛ, ya tun'e kɔ'ɔg bʋŋ la niŋgɔɔnri kʋ. Ala mɛn ka ya na tiaki ya biribiŋ kpɛɛm wʋsa. “Sɔ' da kɛn mam san'an na ka pʋ mɔr si'eli kenaa.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: “Tʋmmini ya tʋʋma daba ayuobʋ, amaa Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la Vʋ'ʋsimi, baa li ya'a anɛ kuob bɛɛ bunib saŋaa.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Maalimi Bakuainam Malʋŋ saŋa kanɛ ka ya buni ya ki dɛɛnna la. Ka maali ya Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ saŋa kanɛ ka ya buni ya sapal zʋʋd la.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ken mam Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la san'an nɔɔr atan' yʋʋm yinne pʋʋgin na, sɔ' kae na zabi nyaŋi faaɛn ya teŋ la, ka m na kad buudbanɛ bɛ nɛ ya la wʋsaa yis, ka kɛ ka ya teŋ la yalig hali.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: Da maali malʋŋ kanɛ an ziim malʋŋ nɛ bodobodo kanɛ mɔr dabinnɛ. Mɛ da kɛ ka Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la pɛraug la ni'im diginɛ nie bɛogɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: “Mɔrini ya yiiga zʋʋd dinɛ ka ya bʋn ka di an sʋm la kɛn Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la Yin na. Mid ka ya nɔk bʋbil kanɛ nam mu'ad ni'imi dʋg nɛ o ma bin'isim.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye, “Sɔm nwa' digil ka li na zi'enɛ an nɔnaar kaanbiri tis Israel dim la wʋsa.”

english_verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.
translation_verse: Ka Moses n da sigid na ka mɔr kuglamma banɛ ka Nɔzi'ela sɔbi li zugʋ o nu'ugin la, o da pʋ baŋ ye on pian' tis Zugsɔb la zugɔ o nindaa nyɛɛnnɛ.

english_verse: When Aaron and the others looked at Moses, they saw this, and they were afraid to go near him.
translation_verse: Ka Aaron nɛ Israel dim la nyɛ ka Moses nindaa la nyɛɛn la, ka dabiem mɔri ba ka ba pʋ bɔɔdi li'el o naa.

english_verse: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.
translation_verse: Ka Moses buoli ba ka Aaron nɛ kpɛɛmnam la kɛɛn o san'an na, ka o pian' tisi ba.

english_verse: Then the rest of the people of Israel gathered around Moses, and he gave them the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la yʋ'ʋn li'el o na ka o tisi ba Zugsɔb nɔzi'ela wʋʋ Zugsɔb la zi'el si'em Sinai Zuor zugin la.

english_verse: The face of Moses kept shining, and after he had spoken with the people, he covered his face with a veil.
translation_verse: Ka Moses pian' naae ka nɔk pien nɛ lus o nindaa.

english_verse: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord. And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.
translation_verse: Amaa saŋkanɛ wʋsa ka Moses kpɛn' ye o pian' tis Zugsɔb la, asɛɛ ka o yis pien la hali nɛ on na ti yina. Ka o ya'a ti yina pian' tis Israel dim la Zugsɔb la yɛl o si'em la,

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.
translation_verse: ba da nyɛ ka o nindaa pɛlig ka nyɛɛn pil-pil. Alazug o na lɛn nɔk pien la lɛbisi lus hali nɛ on na ti lɛn lɛbi kpɛn' pian' tis Zugsɔb la ya'as.

english_verse: You have six days in which to do your work. But the seventh day must be dedicated to me, your Lord, as a day of rest. Whoever works on the Sabbath will be put to death.
translation_verse: Tʋmmini ya tʋʋma daba ayuobʋ, amaa daba ayɔpɔi la anɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir ka li nar ye ya vʋ'ʋs, bɔzugɔ li anɛ Zugsɔb la din; ka onɛ tʋm tʋʋma daakan la, ba na kʋʋ o sɔb.

english_verse: Don't even build a cooking fire at home on the Sabbath. Offerings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Da nyu'oe bugum yanamɛ bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa daakan la.” Fuug Sʋgʋr piini yɛla

english_verse: The women who were good at weaving cloth brought the blue, purple, and red wool and the fine linen they had made.
translation_verse: Ka pu'ab banɛ wʋsa mi' gum nwiib la da nwi gum dinɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ bʋnsʋma dinɛ an pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'is, nɛ pien piela, mɔr na n tis,

english_verse: onyx stones or other gems for the sacred vest and breastpiece.
translation_verse: nɛ kugvɛnla banɛ na nɔki sɛɛn niŋ maanmaan dansikin la nɛ dinɛ lɔɔd nyɔ'ɔgin la.

english_verse: And he has given them all kinds of artistic skills, including the ability to design and embroider with blue, purple, and red wool and to weave fine linen.
translation_verse: Ka o tisi ba baŋir kanɛ ka ba na nyaŋi maal si'el wʋsa dinɛ anɛ fuud ʋgʋb bɛɛ ba na nɔk nɛ gum dinɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ bʋnsʋma dinɛ an pipɛl-zɛn'ug, nɛ bʋnzɛn'is, nɛ pien piela sɛn, ka mɛ mi' tʋʋma buudi wʋsa.”

english_verse: If you have any skills, you should use them to help make what I have commanded:
translation_verse: “Banɛ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin mi' la'ad maalʋg na la'as na maal si'el mɛkama wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛli zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons. Gifts for the Lord
translation_verse: nɛ maanmaannib fubanɛ vɛnl hali ka ba yɛɛdi tʋm kasi zin'ig la tʋʋma; nɛ fubanɛ na tis Aaron nɛ o biis banɛ an maanmaannib la.” Nidibi da tisid piini si'em

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel that the Lord had said:
translation_verse: Ka Moses pian' tis Israel dim la wʋsa ye, “Zugsɔb la zi'el nɔɔr ye ya tʋm si'em nwa':

english_verse: I will welcome an offering from anyone who wants to give something. You may bring gold, silver, or bronze;
translation_verse: Mɔri ya piini na tisi Zugsɔb la. Onɛ ka o sʋʋnr gban'e ye o tis si'el wʋsa on mɔr na tis Zugsɔb la. Li ya'a anɛ sanlima nɛ anzurifa nɛ kʋntzɛn'ug nɛ

english_verse: blue, purple, or red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: gum dinɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ bʋnsʋma dinɛ an pipɛlig nɛ bʋnzɛn'is nɛ pien piela nɛ bʋʋs kɔnbid fuud,

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices for the oil of dedication and for the incense; or
translation_verse: nɛ olif kpaam dinɛ na nyu'od bugum, nɛ malʋŋ kpaam dinɛ ka ba nɔkidi suond maanmaannib, nɛ bʋnnyubisa dinɛ ka ba mɔri maan pʋ'ʋsim tudaari la,

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles, its place of mercy, and the curtain in front of it;
translation_verse: nɛ Nɔnaar Daka la nɛ li dazi'eda la wʋsa, nɛ li suguru sɔsʋg liŋ la, nɛ fugɔbʋg kanɛ lusid la;

english_verse: the table with its carrying poles and all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: nɛ teebul nɛ li daad nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa, nɛ bodobodo linɛ pa'annɛ li zug Zugsɔb la tuon daar woo;

english_verse: the incense altar with its carrying poles and sweet-smelling incense; the ordination oil; the curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent;
translation_verse: maan daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od tudaari la nɛ li daad; nɛ malʋŋ kpaam nɛ tudaar zɔ'ɔm dinɛ nyuugʋ malis nɛ fuug linɛ ligin za'anɔɔr la

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: nɛ maan daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od maan la nɛ li kʋntzɛn'ug bʋn linɛ nwɛnɛ ziiŋ-ɔɔnliŋ la, nɛ li daad nɛ la'ad la wʋsa, nɛ latita'ar la nɛ li zi'esir la,

english_verse: the curtains with the posts and stands that go around the courtyard and the curtain at the entrance;
translation_verse: nɛ fubanɛ ya'ali gilig zak la, nɛ li dabanɛ zi'e sappi la nɛ zi'esa nɛ fuug linɛ na ya'ali lusi li za'anɔɔr la, nɛ li nwiis,

english_verse: Moses finished speaking, and everyone left.
translation_verse: Din nya'aŋ ka Israel dim la yi Moses san'an lɛbi kul.

english_verse: Then those who wanted to bring gifts to the Lord, brought them to be used for the sacred tent, the worship services, and the priestly clothes.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ sʋʋnri da ma'ae ka ba gban'e ye ba tis piini la wʋsa da lɛb na mɔri ba piini ye ba maal Fuug Sʋgʋr kanɛ ka ba na la'asid anina la. Ba da mɔr dinɛ wʋsa nar ye ba nɔki tʋm tʋʋma nɛ maanmaannib fuud la.

english_verse: Everyone brought their blue, purple, and red wool, their fine linen, and their cloth made of goat hair, as well as their ram skins dyed red and their fine leather.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ wʋsa mɔr gum dinɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ pipɛl-zɛn'ug, nɛ bʋnzɛn'is; nɛ pien piela, nɛ bʋʋs kɔnbid fuud, nɛ pɛraad gbana dinɛ ka ba mɔ'ɔnsi li ka li mu'oe sʋee, nɛ gbansʋma da mɔr na.

english_verse: Anyone who had silver or bronze or acacia wood brought it as a gift to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ wʋsa mɔr piini na ka li anɛ anzurifa nɛ kʋntzɛn'ug da mɔri li na tis Zugsɔb la. Banɛ wʋsa da mɔr na'aziinr daad da mɔri kena ka li sʋŋ tʋʋma la.

english_verse: And the women who knew how to make cloth from goat hair were glad to do so.
translation_verse: ka pu'a sieba banɛ mi' li tʋʋma da nwi bʋʋs kɔnbidi mɔr na tis.

english_verse: The leaders brought different kinds of jewels to be sewn on the special clothes and the breastpiece for the high priest.
translation_verse: Ka kpɛɛmnam la nɔk kugvɛnla banɛ na sɛɛn niŋ maanmaan dansikin la nɛ li fubil kanɛ lɔɔd nyɔ'ɔgin la m mɔra.

english_verse: They also brought sweet-smelling spices to be mixed with the incense and olive oil that were for the lamps and for ordaining the priests.
translation_verse: Ba mɛ da mɔr bʋnnyubisa nɛ olif kpaam dinɛ na nyu'oe bugum, nɛ malʋŋ kpaam dinɛ ka ba nɔkidi suond maanmaannib la, nɛ dinɛ ka ba mɔri maan pʋ'ʋsʋg tudaar la.

english_verse: Moses had told the people what the Lord wanted them to do, and many of them decided to bring their gifts. Bezalel and Oholiab (Exodus
translation_verse: Israel dim dap nɛ ba pu'ab banɛ sʋʋnri da gban'e ye ba sʋŋ Wina'am tʋʋma la da mɔr piini na tis Zugsɔb la wʋʋ Moses n yɛli ba si'em la. Bezalel nɛ Oholiyab la yɛla

english_verse: Moses said to the people of Israel: The Lord has chosen Bezalel of the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Israel dim la ye, “Gɔsima Zugsɔb gaŋ Uri biig Bezalel onɛ an Hur yaaŋ ka an Juda dɔɔg nid la,

english_verse: The Lord is urging him and Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to teach others.
translation_verse: Ka mɛ mɔr ya'am kanɛ na pa'al nidib la tʋʋma, on nɛ Akisamak biig Oholiyab onɛ yi Dan dɔɔgin na la.

english_verse: and he gave them the gifts that the people of Israel had donated for building the place of worship. In fact, so much was being given each morning,
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɔk piinkanɛ wʋsa ka Israel dim la mɔr na ye li tʋm Fuug Sʋgʋr la tʋʋma la tisi ba. Hali daar wʋsa nidib la da nan mɔri piini kenna.

english_verse: and said, “Moses, there is already more than we need for what the Lord has assigned us to do.”
translation_verse: yɛl Moses ye, “Nidib la mɔri kenna ka li gaad Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.”

english_verse: But there was already more than enough to do what needed to be done. The Curtains and Coverings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ba pʋn tis dinɛ na nyaŋi tʋm tʋʋma la naae. Ban da maal Fuug Sʋgʋr la si'em nwa'

english_verse: The skilled workers got together to make the sacred tent and its linen curtains that were woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Each of the ten panels was twelve meters long and two meters wide,
translation_verse: Ka fuud la wa'alim an nɔba makir pisnaasi nɛ ayi' ka ba yalʋŋ an nɔba makir ayuobʋ ka ba wʋsa zem taaba.

english_verse: and they were sewn together to make two curtains with five panels each.
translation_verse: Ba da nɔk fuud anu sɛɛn tɔ'ɔŋ taaba ka mɛ nɔk fuud anu banɛ kpɛlim la tɔ'ɔŋ taaba.

english_verse: These eleven sections were joined to make two panels, one with five and the other with six sections.
translation_verse: Ba da nɔk fuud anu tɔ'ɔŋ taaba ka mɛ nɔk fuud ayuobʋ banɛ kpɛlim la tɔ'ɔŋ taaba.

english_verse: Fifty loops were put along one of the wider sides of each panel,
translation_verse: Ba daa yʋ'ʋn nɔk pienni sɛɛn maal ga'adiŋvɔnya pisnu niŋi li fuud ayi' la nɔya ni.

english_verse: and the two panels were fastened at the loops with
translation_verse: Ba daa nɔk kʋntzɛn'ugʋ maal ga'adiŋgɔnlima pisnu ye ba ga'al taaba ka li an yinne.

english_verse: Two other coverings were made—one with fine leather and the other with ram skins dyed red. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka ba yʋ'ʋn nɔk pɛraad gbana dinɛ ka ba mɔ'ɔnsi li ka di mu'oe la sɛɛn tɔ'ɔŋ taabaa pili paas. Ka nɔk gbansʋma linɛ vɛnli pili tak.

english_verse: Altogether, along the back wall there were eight frames with two silver stands under each of them.
translation_verse: Ka li paae dalamma anii nɛ li anzurifa zi'esa pii nɛ ayuobʋ, ka dalammir wʋsa mɔr zi'esa ayi'.

english_verse: Six frames were used for the back wall along the west side
translation_verse: Ka maal dalamma ayuobʋ Fuug Sʋgʋr la nya'aŋ linɛ bɛ ya-tuona la.

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. These corner frames were joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: ka lɔdis dalamma la ta'al taab teŋiri dʋ zugin, ka baŋ yinne mɛ mɔri ba wʋsa.

english_verse: Five crossbars were made for each of the wooden frames, with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Ba daa maal teŋsʋk dapuudir la ka li wa'ami paae dalamma la wʋsa.

english_verse: The frames and crossbars were covered with gold, and gold rings were attached to the frames to run the crossbars through. The Inside Curtain for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka ba bulig dalamma la nɛ sanlima ka maal sanlima baans linɛ na nyaŋi mɔr dapuuda la, ka mɛ bulig daad la nɛ sanlima.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, they used a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: Ka nɔk fuug linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa ka an bʋlʋ nɛ bʋnsʋma banɛ an pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'isi sɛn ka li vɛnl, ka ba zaŋi ligil Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔr la.

english_verse: They made the inside curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: Ba da nɔk fuud linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa ka an bʋlʋ nɛ bʋnsʋma banɛ an pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'is n sɛɛn tɔ'ɔŋ taaba n maal fugɔbʋg, ka banɛ mi' ʋgʋb sʋ'ʋŋa ʋg Kerubnam la niŋ anina.

english_verse: They also made four acacia wood posts and covered them with gold. Then gold rings were fastened to the posts, which were set on silver stands.
translation_verse: Ka mɛ maal na'aziinr daad anaasi ka bʋligi ba nɛ sanlima, ka ba ga'adis la an sanlima; ka nɔk anzurifa maal zi'esa anaasi ka daad la na zi'e ba zug.

english_verse: They made five posts, covered them completely with gold, and set each of them on a gold-covered bronze stand. Finally, they attached hooks for the curtain.
translation_verse: Ba daa maal zan'antɔlis anu nɛ ba baans. Ka bʋligi ba zugin nɛ teŋir la nɛ sanlima ka nɔk kʋntzɛn'ugʋ maali ba zi'esa la.

english_verse: He covered it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the top.
translation_verse: ka nɔk sanlima bʋligi li pʋʋgin nɛ li nya'aŋ la wʋsa ka maali kuoɛn dɔlis nɔya la.

english_verse: He made four gold rings and attached one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Ka maal sanlima baans anaasi ka lɔɔ ba yinne-yinne tabil daka la nɔba anaasi la ni.

english_verse: Then he made two poles of acacia wood, covered them with gold,
translation_verse: Ka nɔk na'aziinr daad ayi' ka nɔk sanlima bʋligi ba.

english_verse: On each of the two ends of the chest he made a winged creature of hammered gold. They faced each other, and their wings covered the place of mercy. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka Kerubnam la kpa' taaba n sʋnri gɔt daka la, ka ba kpʋkpama la yadig ka ba ma'asim pil liŋ la. Sanlima teebul la yɛla

english_verse: He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Ba daa nɔk dabibisi tabili gilig teebul la ka ba wa'alim an wʋʋ nu'ug yalʋŋ nɛ, ka nɔk sanlima bʋligi ba wʋsa.

english_verse: He made four gold rings and attached one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Ka o maal sanlima baans anaasi ka lɔɔ ba yinne-yinne tabil teebul la nɔba anaasi la ni.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table were placed through these rings
translation_verse: Baans la da kpi'enɛ dabibis banɛ gilig daka la, ka li kɛ ka ba na tun'e tʋʋdi ʋkid teebul la mɔri ken.

english_verse: and were made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Ka o nɔk na'aziinr daad ka bʋligi ba nɛ sanlima ye ba mɔri ʋgisid teebul la ken.

english_verse: Everything that was to be set on the table was made of pure gold—the bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings. The Lampstand (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka ba nɔk sanlima maal laas nɛ dʋgid nɛ bʋtiis la wʋsa, ka ba na mɔri maan bʋnnuuda maana. Fita zi'esir la yɛla

english_verse: Bezalel made a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, was made from a single piece of hammered gold,
translation_verse: Ka Bezalel da nɔk sanlima kʋnt fita zi'esir ka nwɛ'-nwɛ' li ka li gbin an lammiri ka li teŋsʋk daug la an sappi. Fita la zi'esir nɛ li daug nɛ li bʋnvɛnla banɛ nwɛnɛ tipuum la wʋsa da anɛ yinne.

english_verse: The lamp and its equipment, including the tongs and trays, were made of about
translation_verse: Ba daa nɔknɛ sanlimgbila pisyuobʋ nɛ anii maal fita zi'esir la nɛ li la'abanɛ paas la. Bʋnyubisa Maan Daka la yɛla

english_verse: Bezalel mixed the sacred oil for dedication and the pure spices for the sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Bezalel da maal bʋnnyubisa nɛ malʋŋ kpasʋŋ linɛ an Wina'am din ka ba mɔri kpa'adi niŋid maanmaan zug la, nɛ tudaari zɔ'ɔm linɛ nyuugʋ malis.

english_verse: Bezalel made a large bowl and a stand out of bronze from the mirrors of the women who helped at the entrance to the sacred tent. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka o di'e gɔtis pu'a banɛ tʋm pʋ'ʋsim Fuug Sʋgʋr za'anɔɔrin la ka nɔki li kʋntzɛn'ug la maal latita'ar nɛ li zi'esir. Fuug Sʋgʋr la zak yɛla

english_verse: Then he attached a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners to put the poles through.
translation_verse: Ka nɔk kʋntzɛn'ugʋ maal bʋn linɛ nwɛnɛ ziiŋ-ɔɔnliŋ nɛ, ka maal kʋnt baansi tabili li lɔdis anaasi la wʋsa, ka nɔki sa'al maan daka la pʋʋgin, ka li ziiŋ-ɔɔnliŋ la sigi paae li pʋsʋk.

english_verse: And it was used to make the stands for the entrance to the tent, the altar and its grating, the equipment for the altar,
translation_verse: ka ba nɔki maal dazi'edis banɛ bɛ za'anɔɔrin la, ka lɛn maal maan daka la nɛ li bʋn linɛ nwɛnɛ ziiŋ-ɔɔnliŋ la, nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa.

translation_verse: ka mɔr dabanɛ an sappi anaasi ka ba mɔr kʋntzɛn'ug zi'esa anaasi. Ka nɔk anzurifa maali li baans nɛ kpa'as la, ka bʋligi ba zut nɛ ba baans la wʋsa nɛ anzurifa.

translation_verse: ka nɔk daad pisi, ka maal zi'esa tʋʋ ba' ka ba zi'e sappi, amaa ka li kpa'as nɛ baans la an anzurifa;

translation_verse: ka Akisamak biig Oholiyab onɛ yi Dan tuŋʋn na la da sʋŋid o, ka an onɛ kpi'ed daad nɛ kuga, ka mi' la'ad la na gʋl si'em, ka lɛn nɔk gum dinɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ bʋnsʋma dinɛ mu'oe zim-zim, nɛ bʋnzɛn'is, nɛ pien piela sɛɛn, sɛn ka fuud la vɛnl.

english_verse: Two thousand four hundred and twenty-five kilograms of bronze were given.
translation_verse: Ka nidib la lɛm mɔr kʋntzɛn'ug gbila tusa anaasi nɛ kɔbisnii na

english_verse: the stands for the posts that surrounded the courtyard, including those at the entrance to the courtyard, and the pegs for the tent and the courtyard.
translation_verse: Ba da lɛm maal zi'esa linɛ ba'a daad banɛ gu'ud fubanɛ gilig zak la, nɛ banɛ bɛɛ li za'anɔɔrin la, nɛ kpada banɛ gban'e fuud la gilig wʋsa kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Beautiful priestly clothes were made of blue, purple, and red wool for Aaron to wear when he performed his duties in the holy place. This was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ba da nɔk gum dinɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'isi sɛn tis maanmaannib la, ye ba ya'a ti kpɛn' Fuug Sʋgʋrin la tʋmmi ba tʋʋma ba na yɛ fuud nwa'. Ba mɛ da maal fubanɛ bɛɛ li kɔn' tis Aaron wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la.

english_verse: and on each of them was engraved the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Kuga pii nɛ ayi' nwa' zug, ba da sɔb Israel biis pii nɛ ayi' la yʋda yinne-yinne, ka li pa'an Israel dim dɔɔd pii nɛ ayi' la wʋsa yɛla.

english_verse: The entire priestly vest was made of fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Thin sheets of gold were hammered out and cut into threads that were skillfully woven into the vest.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ mi' sanlima tʋʋma la nɔk sanlima la zan' nwaasi maal wʋʋ gum nɛ nɔki tabil gum dinɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'is nɛ pien piela.

english_verse: It had two shoulder straps to support it and a sash that fastened around the waist.
translation_verse: Ka nɔk sanlima nɛ gum dinɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ gum pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'isi ʋg sɛnbidiŋ ka din nɛ dansik la an yinne nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la tisi ba nɔɔr si'em la.

english_verse: Onyx stones were placed in gold settings, and each one was engraved with the name of one of Israel's sons.
translation_verse: Ka ba maal kugvɛnla ayi' banɛ ka ba nɔk sanlima dɔlisi li nɔya la ka li gban'e nwɛnɛ nu'ubibis nɛ, ka sɔb Israel biribis la yʋda niŋ anina.

english_verse: Then these were attached to the shoulder straps of the vest, so the Lord would never forget his people. Everything was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Breastpiece (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka ba nɔki lii tabil dansik la ban'ad la zug, ka ba an kugbanɛ na tɛɛnsid Israel biribis nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la tis Moses nɔɔr si'em la.

english_verse: The words “Dedicated to the Lord” were engraved on a narrow strip of pure gold,
translation_verse: Ka o nɔk sanlimmɛŋiri maal bʋngbilig wʋʋ tipuum nɛ, ka sɔbi niŋ ye, “Li anɛ KASI TIS Zugsɔb” la,

english_verse: The priestly robe was made of blue wool
translation_verse: Ba da nɔk pien kanɛ an bʋlʋ sɛn dansik la,

english_verse: a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond were in the second row;
translation_verse: ka kugvɛnla banɛ tia'al mɛ an takuos nɛ safir nɛ bʋmpielig,

english_verse: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst were in the third row;
translation_verse: ka banɛ paas atan' la an yasin nɛ agat nɛ ametis,

english_verse: and a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper were in the fourth row. They were mounted in a delicate gold setting,
translation_verse: ka banɛ paas anaasi la an bɛril nɛ onik nɛ jaspa. Ba da maal sanlima bʋnkanɛ na nyaŋi gban'e kuga la nɔya.

english_verse: Two gold rings were attached to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fastened with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: ka ba gaadi paae lɔ baans banɛ bɛ dansikin la, ka li kɛ ka li tabil dansik la kpʋkpama tuon zin'is;

english_verse: and two more near the bottom of the shoulder straps right above the sash.
translation_verse: Ba da maal sanlima baans ayi' ya'asi sɛɛn tabil dansik la biankimpiiung teŋir ka li kpi'e dansik la sɛnbidiŋ lɛbisid zugin.

english_verse: To keep the breastpiece in place, a blue cord was used to tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Clothes for the Priests (Exodus
translation_verse: Ba da nɔk gum kanɛ an bʋlʋ n lɔ baans banɛ bɛ nyɔ'ɔgin la ken tabil nɛ baans banɛ bɛ dansik la ni n tɔ'ɔŋ nɛ sɛnbidiŋ la, ka li kɛ ka nyɔ'ɔgin pien la kʋ yi ka bas dansik la, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la da pa'al Moses si'em la.

english_verse: which was fastened to Aaron's turban. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Work Is Completed (Exodus
translation_verse: ka nɔk gum dinɛ an bʋlʋ lɔɔ li tabil maanmaan zupibig la tuon. Ka zupibig nɛ li sanlima bʋmbil la an wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la. Tʋʋma la naar yɛla

english_verse: When Moses saw that the people had done everything exactly as the Lord had commanded, he gave them his blessing.
translation_verse: Ka Moses da nyɛ ka ba tʋm naae wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la, ka kaanb, kaanb sʋŋʋ tisi ba.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for the head. The material around the collar was bound so as to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: ka maal vɔɔnr fuug la teŋsʋk ka zug na nyaŋi kpɛn'; ka nɔk gumme kpamisi giligi li, dinɛ na kɛ ka li kʋ aaɛn.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe were woven pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a bell of pure gold between each of them. This robe was to be worn by Aaron when he performed his duties.
translation_verse: Lʋmma la nɛ pomanganɛt la da lʋʋm nɛ taaba fukanɛ ka ba yɛɛdi maan maana la teŋir nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la zi'el Moses si'em la.

english_verse: Everything that Aaron and his sons wore was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, including their robes and turbans, their fancy caps and underwear, and even their sashes that were embroidered with needlework.
translation_verse: ka nɔk gum dinɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ pipɛl-zɛn'ug nɛ bʋnzɛn'is nɛ pien piela la ka li vɛnl hali sɛn sɛnbidiŋ ka nwɛ' li nɛ gum ka li vɛnl. Ka maanmaannib fuud la an wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la.

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy;
translation_verse: nɛ Nɔnaar Daka la nɛ li daad nɛ li suguru sɔsʋg liŋ la;

english_verse: Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands;
translation_verse: Ka ba yʋ'ʋn mɔr Fuug Sʋgʋr la na pa'al Moses nɛ fuud banɛ liginnɛ li la nɛ di la'ad wʋsa nɛ di ga'adiŋgɔnlima nɛ dalamma nɛ dapuuda banɛ wa'am nɛ dabanɛ zi'e sappi nɛ zi'esa;

english_verse: the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: nɛ teebul la nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa, nɛ bodobodo linɛ pa'annɛ li zug Zugsɔb tuon daar woo;

english_verse: the lampstand of pure gold, together with its equipment and oil;
translation_verse: nɛ fita zi'esir ka fita la bɛɛ li zug, nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa, nɛ kpaam linɛ na nyu'od bugum;

english_verse: the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
translation_verse: nɛ sanlima maan daka, nɛ malʋŋ kpaam nɛ tudaar zɔ'ɔm dinɛ nyuugʋ malis, nɛ fuug linɛ na ya'ali lus Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔr la;

english_verse: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: nɛ kʋntzɛn'ug maan daka nɛ li bʋn linɛ nwɛnɛ ziiŋ-ɔɔnliŋ la, nɛ li daad nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa; nɛ latita'ar la nɛ li zi'esir;

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: Set up my tent on the first day of the year
translation_verse: “Nɔkim Fuug Sʋgʋr la ti' pin'ilʋg nwadig la, li yiiga dabisir la ni, ka li na an nidib la la'asʋg zin'ig.

english_verse: and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain.
translation_verse: Nɔkim Nɔnaar Daka la niŋ Fuug Sʋgʋr la pʋʋgin, ka nɔk fuug la lus daka la.

english_verse: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.
translation_verse: Mɔr teebul la na ka nɔk linɛ wʋsa nar ye li bɛɛ li zugin la pa'al nwɛnɛ lin nar si'em; ka mɔr fita zi'esir la na, ka mɛ nɔki li fita la sʋn'ʋl li zug.

english_verse: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Nɔkim sanlima maan daka kanɛ ka ba na nyu'od tudaari li zug la mɔr na, ka li na zi'e Nɔnaar Daka la tuon. Ka nɔk fugɔbʋg linɛ bɛŋid la ya'ali lus Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔr.

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: Nɔkim maan daka kanɛ ka ba na nyu'od malima li zug la mɔr na zi'el Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔr tuon.

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: Nɔkim laa la mɔr na zi'el Fuug Sʋgʋr la nɛ maan daka la teŋsʋk, ka mɔr ku'om na niŋ.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: Ti'im zak la gilig Fuug Sʋgʋr la, ka nɔk fuug la ya'ali gilig, ka nɔk fukanɛ lusid za'anɔɔr la ya'ali lus.

english_verse: Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment
translation_verse: Ka mɛ bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam la niŋ nyu'or maan daka la nɛ di la'ad la wʋsa ka li an kasi hali tis mam Zugsɔb.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Mɔr Aaron nɛ o biis la kɛn la'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr za'anɔɔrin la na, ka sʋʋ ba ku'om.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: Nɔkim maanmaan fuud la yɛɛl Aaron ka nɔk malʋŋ kpaam bu'oe niŋ o ka pɛsig o tisim ka o an maanmaan,

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: ka lɛm mɔr o biis la na ka yɛɛli ba fupiela,

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Ba da ti' Fuug Sʋgʋr la naae, yʋʋm kanɛ paas ayi' ban yi Egipt na la, li yiiga nwadig la pin'ilʋg daar.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: Ka o nɔk nɔzi'ela la niŋ Nɔnaar Daka la pʋʋgin ka zaŋi li dapuuda la tʋ baansin la, ka nɔki li suguru sɔsʋg liŋ la pibil.

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn nɔk Nɔnaar Daka la mɔri kpɛn' Fuug Sʋgʋr la pʋʋgin digil Kasi Wʋsa Kasi zin'igin la, ka nɔk fugɔbʋg linɛ bɛŋid la ya'ali lus Nɔnaar Daka la, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl o ye o niŋ si'em la.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɔk teebul la kpɛn' zi'el Wina'am Kasi Zin'ig, Fuug Sʋgʋr la datiuŋ baba, ka li bɛ fugɔbʋg linɛ bɛŋid la nya'aŋ,

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: ka nɔki li fita la sʋn'ʋl zi'esir la zug, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl o si'em la.

english_verse: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain,
translation_verse: O da nɔk sanlima maan daka linɛ nyu'od tudaar la kpɛn' zi'el Fuug Sʋgʋr la pʋʋgin, fugɔbʋg la nya'aŋ na,

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: ka yʋ'ʋn nɔk tudaar zɔ'ɔm nyu'oe li zug, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl o ye o niŋ si'em la.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ka nɔk fuug la lus La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔr.

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: O da nɔk maan daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od maana li zug la zi'eli kpi'el Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin, ka maal nyu'or malʋŋ, ka mɛ lɛm maal zʋʋd maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la, nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la pa'al Moses si'em la.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Ka o zaŋ latita'ar la zi'el La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la nɛ maan daka la teŋsʋk, ka wik ku'om kpa'ae niŋi li pʋʋgin ka li an ku'opiedim;

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: ka Moses, nɛ Aaron nɛ o biis la, piesidi ba nu'us nɛ ba nɔba.

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ wʋsa ka ba kpɛn'ɛd La'asʋg Sʋgʋrin la, asɛɛ ba zi'enɛ pie ba nu'us nɛ nɔba nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la pa'al Moses si'em la.

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka saŋgbauŋ la sig na n ligil La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la, ka Zugsɔb girima nie nyɛɛn pil-pil Fuug Sʋgʋr la pʋʋgin wʋsa,

english_verse: And so, Moses could not enter the tent.
translation_verse: ka Moses pʋ nyaŋi kpɛn' saŋgbauŋin la, ka li anɛ Zugsɔb girima nɛɛsim la zug.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka saŋgbauŋ la ʋk ka bas Fuug Sʋgʋr la, Israel dim duodnɛ gban'e suori ken.

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: Amaa saŋkanɛ ka saŋgbauŋ la pʋ ʋkɛ, ba mɛ pʋ ken si'ela, hali nɛ li ʋkir saŋa ya'as.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Ala ka Zugsɔb la saŋgbauŋ da ligil Fuug Sʋgʋr la nintaŋ, ka yʋ'ʋŋ ka li an bugum niedi tisid Israel dim la ba ken wʋsa pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: O na nɔk o nu'ugʋ pa'al bʋnkɔnbʋg la zugin ka Zugsɔb la di'e li ka li an suguru sɔsʋg maannɛ tis o.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn kɔdig bʋnkɔnbʋg la Zugsɔb la san'an; ka Aaron yaas banɛ an maanmaannib la na mɔr ziim la na, misi mis maan daka linɛ bɛ dɔɔg la za'anɔɔrin la gilig.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: O na si bʋnkɔnbʋg la bɛs baanlʋg-baanlʋg,

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: ka Aaron yaas banɛ an maanmaannib la na nyu'oe bugum la maan daka la zug ka paas daad bugum la ni,

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ba na nɔk ku'om pie li pʋʋgin la'ad la nɛ li nɔba la, ka maanmaan la na nyu'oe li wʋsa maan daka la zug. Li anɛ maan kanɛ nyu'od ka li nyuug la malisi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Maan la ya'a anɛ bʋʋs bɛɛ pɛ'ɛs ka o ye o maal nyu'or maan, li sʋm ye o nɔk pɛraug bɛɛ bʋrakanɛ ka' dɛŋŋa.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: O na kɔdig bʋnkɔnbʋg la maan daka la datiuŋ baba Zugsɔb la san'an, ka Aaron yaas banɛ an maanmaannib la na nɔk ziim la misi mis maan daka la gilig wʋsa.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ba na nɔk ku'om pie li pʋʋgin la'ad la nɛ li nɔba la, ka maanmaan la na mɔri li wʋsa kena nyu'oe daka la zug. Li anɛ maan kanɛ nyu'od ka li nyuug malisi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: “Maan la mɛ ya'a anɛ bʋn-ian'ada ka o ye o maal nyu'or maan, li sʋm ka li an sian'adawan bɛɛ na'adawan.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na mɔri keŋ maan daka la ni ka nwɛligi fi'igi li zugʋ nyu'oe daka la zug, ka kpa'ae ziim la siɛn daka la kpikpɛŋ.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: O na yis yɛog nɛ kɔnbid la bas daka la nya'aŋ, zin'ikanɛ mɔr tampɛligim la,

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: ka aaɛn biinr la vɛbil amaa ka lɛɛ kʋ yisi li nyainnɛ, ka maanmaan la na nyu'oe li daka la zug. Li anɛ maan kanɛ nyu'od ka li nyuug malisi tis Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: Sɔ' mɛ ya'a mɔr ki na ye o tis Zugsɔb ka li an zʋʋd maan, li sʋm ye ba nɛɛmi li ka li an zɔmbaanlig, ka o niŋ kpaam ka paas tudaar,

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: ka nɔki tis Aaron biribis banɛ an maanmaannib la, ka ba na gbin'e zɔ'ɔm la nu'ukukudug la'an nɛ kpaam la nɛ tudaar la wʋsa nyu'oe daka la zug, ka li an tiɛnr maan, ka an maan kanɛ malisi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Ka linɛ kpɛlim la na an Aaron nɛ o biribis la bʋn, bɔzugɔ li anɛ maan kanɛ ka ba maal ka li an kasi hali tis Zugsɔb.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: Sɔ' mɛ ya'a mɔr zʋʋd maan linɛ ka ba maal wʋʋ bodobodo nɛ, asɛɛ ka o nɔk zɔmbaanlig linɛ pʋ gɛndig danbinni maal. Nɔkim gɛndig kpaam sɛn'; bɛɛ sɛn' li naae ka yʋ'ʋn niŋ kpaam.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ zʋʋd maan linɛ ka ba maali li wʋʋ pɛmpɛm nɛ, li sʋm ye li an zɔmbaanlig ka gɛndig kpaam amaa ka danbin kae.

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: Ka gbin'esi li zɔra-zɔra ka niŋ kpaam bɔzugɔ li anɛ zʋʋd maan.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Ka maan la ya'a anɛ bodobodo ka ba maal bodobodo laasin, li sʋm ye li an zɔmbaanlig ka gɛndig kpaam.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Mɔri zʋʋd maan la wʋsa na tis Zugsɔb la, ka nɔki tis maanmaannib la ka ba mɔri keŋ nyu'or malʋŋ daka la ni.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ba na yis tiɛnr maan la zʋʋd maan la ni nyu'oe daka la zug, ka li nyuug la malisi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Ka linɛ kpɛlim la na an Aaron nɛ o biribis la bʋn. Li anɛ maan kanɛ an kasi ka ba nyu'oe li tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya gɛndig danbin zʋʋd maan kanɛ wʋsa ka ya ye ya maali tis Zugsɔb la; li pʋ sʋm ye ya nyu'oe maan la ka danbin bɛɛ siind bɛɛ anina.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Ya tun'e mɔr danbin nɛ siindi kena tis Zugsɔb ka li pa'al ye ya yiiga bunib maana la, amaa maan ban pʋ maannɛ nyu'od daka la zug wʋʋ linɛ tisid nyuug linɛ malis la.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a mɔr ki dɛɛnna na ye ya maal zʋʋd maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la, asɛɛ ka ya kiimi li arig kayaama.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Pɛ'ɛsimi kpaam nɛ tudaar ka li anɛ zʋʋd maan.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na gbin'e zɔ'ɔm kayaama nɛ kpaam la bi'ela la'an nɛ tudaar la wʋsa nɔki nyu'oe, ka li na an nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a bɔɔd ye o maal taaba la'asʋg maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la ka li anɛ na'araug bɛɛ na'anya'aŋ, li pʋ sʋm ka bʋnkɔnbʋg la mɔr dɛŋŋa.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: O nɔkimi o nu'ugʋ pa'al naaf la zugin ka kɔdig o Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin, ka Aaron biribis banɛ an maanmaannib la na nɔk ziim la misi mis maan daka la gilig wʋsa.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: O yisim siyaanini la nɛ kpaam linɛ bɛɛ li ni la wʋsa, ka nwaae sɔɔnr la bi'ela,

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: ka Aaron biribis la na nyu'oe li maan daka la zug. Li anɛ maan kanɛ nyu'od ka li nyuug la malisi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: O ya'a ye o maal taaba la'asʋg maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la, ka li anɛ pɛ'og bɛɛ bʋʋg, li ya'a anɛ pɛraug bɛɛ bʋraug, li pʋ sʋm ka li mɔr dɛŋŋa.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: O ya'a mɔr pɛ'og na ye o maal maan, on nɔkim tis Zugsɔb la,

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ka nɔk o nu'ugʋ pa'ali li zugin ka kɔdigi li Fuug Sʋgʋr za'anɔɔrin la ka Aaron biribis la nɔk ziim la misi mis maan daka la lʋga wʋsa gilig.

english_verse: Offer the fat on the tail, the tailbone, and the insides,
translation_verse: O na yis kpaam nɛ zʋgan'ar la nɛ kpakanɛ ligil kɔnbʋg la pʋʋgin la'ad la wʋsa nyu'oe tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: O na yis siyaanini la nɛ kpaam linɛ bɛɛ anina la wʋsa, ka nwaae sɔɔnr la bi'ela,

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: ka maanmaan la na nyu'oe li maan daka la zug ka li an nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: O ya'a mɔr bʋʋg na ye o maal maan, on nɔkimi li tis Zugsɔb la,

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ka nɔk o nu'ugʋ pa'ali li zugin ka kɔdigi li Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin, ka Aaron biribis la na nɔk ziim la misi mis maan daka la lʋga wʋsa gilig.

english_verse: Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides,
translation_verse: O maan la pʋʋgin, o yisim la'abama wʋsa nyu'oe tis Zugsɔb la: Kpaam linɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la wʋsa

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: nɛ siyaanini la nɛ kpaam linɛ bɛɛ li ni la wʋsa, ka nwaae sɔɔnr la bi'ela paas

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: ka maanmaan la na nyu'oe li maan daka la zug. Li anɛ maan kanɛ nyu'od ka li nyuug la malisi tis Zugsɔb la. Kpaam la wʋsa anɛ Zugsɔb din.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya ɔnb kpaam la bɛɛ ziim la. Li anɛ zi'elʋgʋ tis yanam nɛ ya yaas wʋsa zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka ya na bɛ.

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: ka nɔk o nu'ubili tʋm ziim la nii mis nɔɔra ayɔpɔi tis Zugsɔb la fuug linɛ ka ba ya'al Kasi Wʋsa Kasi Zin'ig la nya'aŋ la.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: ka pa'al o nu'ug bʋʋg la zugin ka kɔdigi li zin'ikanɛ ka ba kɔdigid nyu'or maannɛ tisid Zugsɔb la, ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na nɔk o nu'ubili tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la ziimin niŋ iila banɛ bɛ maan daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od maan la zug la, ka kpa'ae ziim la daka la gbinnin.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim ye sɔ' ya'a tʋm nyɔsig Zugsɔb zi'elʋg ka li ka' o mɛŋ bɔɔdim, yanamɛ na niŋ si'em nwa':

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ maanmaan kpɛɛm la tʋm bɛ'ɛd ka li kɛ ka taal dɔl nidib la wʋsa, o na tis Zugsɔb la na'arapɔl kanɛ ka' dɛŋŋa.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: O na nɔk na'araug la tis Zugsɔb la Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin ka pa'al o nu'ug na'araug la zug ka kɔdigi li tis Zugsɔb la anina.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: O na bu'oe ziim la mɔri kpɛn' sʋgʋrin la,

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Maanmaan kpɛɛm la yʋ'ʋn na nɔk ziim la bi'ela niŋ iila banɛ bɛ maan daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od bʋnnyubisa li zug, ka li bɛ Zugsɔb tuon sʋgʋrin la. Na'araug la ziim kanɛ kpɛlim la, ba na kpa'ae li niŋ daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od maana la gbinnin, ka li bɛ Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔr yiŋ la.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: asɛɛ ba mɔri lii yi la'asʋg zin'ig la kpikpɛŋ, zin'ikanɛ an maan zin'isʋŋ ka ba kpa'asid tampɛligim la, ka nyu'oe li wʋsa ani.”

english_verse: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.
translation_verse: “Li ya'a anɛ Israel dim la tʋm nyɔsig Zugsɔb zi'elʋg ka li ka' ba mɛŋ bɔɔdim, ka ba sɔ'ɔsɔ pʋ baŋi li yɛlaa, li taal dɔl nɛ nidib la wʋsa.

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ba ya'a ti baŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla, la'asʋg dim la na mɔr na'araugʋ kɛn Zugsɔb tuon Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin na ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnam la na pa'ali ba nu'us na'araug la zugin ka kɔdigi li tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na mɔr ziim la bi'ela kpɛn' sʋgʋrin la

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: ka nɔk o nu'ubili tʋm ziim la ni n mis nɔɔra ayɔpɔi tis Zugsɔb la, fuug linɛ ka ba ya'al Kasi Wʋsa Kasi zin'ig la nya'aŋ.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ka lɛn nɔk ziim la bi'ela niŋ iila banɛ bɛ maan daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od bʋnnyubisa li zug la, ka li bɛ Zugsɔb la tuon, sʋgʋrin la. Na'araug la ziim kanɛ kpɛlim la, ba na kpa'ae li niŋ daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od maana la gbinnin, ka li bɛ sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔr yiŋ.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven. When a Tribal Leader Sins The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na nɔk dinɛ kpɛlim la yi teŋ la kpikpɛŋ sa nyu'oe wʋʋ maanmaan kpɛɛm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la nyu'od si'em la. Nwa' anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maannɛ tis Israel dim la wʋsa.”

english_verse: Any tribal leader who disobeys me without knowing it is still guilty.
translation_verse: “Li ya'a anɛ Israel kpɛɛm sɔ' tʋm nyɔsig Zugsɔb zi'elʋg ka li ka' o mɛŋ bɔɔdim, ka li kilim taali dɔl o,

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: o ya'a ti baŋ ye o maal bɛ'ɛd, o na tis maan dinɛ an bʋraug ka ka' dɛŋŋa,

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na nɔk o nu'ubili tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan ziim la ni niŋ iila banɛ bɛ daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od maan la zug, ka kpa'ae ziim la daka la gbinnin,

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: ka na nyu'oe bʋʋg la kpaam wʋsa maan daka la zug, wʋʋ taaba la'asʋg maan kpaam n nyu'od si'em la. Anwana ka maanmaan la na maal suguru sɔsʋg maan ka ba na kɛ dau la taali bas.”

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: “Li ya'a anɛ Israel nidi zi' ka tʋm nyɔsig Zugsɔb la zi'elʋg ka li ka' o mɛŋ bɔɔdim, taal dɔl o nɛ.

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a baŋ ye o tʋm bɛ'ɛd o na mɔr bʋnya'aŋ kanɛ pʋ mɔr dɛŋ na tis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: O na nɔk o nu'ugi pa'al bʋʋg la zugin ka kɔdigi li zin'ikanɛ ka ba kɔdigid nyu'or maan la.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: O na yis bʋʋg la kpaam wʋsa wʋʋ ban yisid taaba la'asʋg maan kpaam si'em la ka maanmaan la na nyu'oe li maan daka la zug ka li nyuug malisi tis Zugsɔb la. Ala ka maanmaan la na maal suguru sɔsʋg maan ka ba na kɛɛ o taali bas.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Sɔ' ya'a mɔr pɛ'og na ye o maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, li sʋm ka li an pɛnya'aŋ kanɛ ka' dɛŋŋa.

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ka o na nɔk o nu'ugi pa'al tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pɛ'og la zugin ka kɔdigi li zin'ikanɛ ka ba kɔdigid nyu'or maan la.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na nɔk o nu'ubili tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan ziim la ni niŋ iila banɛ bɛ daka kanɛ ka ba nyu'od maan la zug la, ka kpa'ae ziim la daka la gbinnin.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: O na yis pɛ'og la kpaam wʋsa wʋʋ ban yisid taaba la'asʋg maan kpaam si'em la ka maanmaan la nɔki li pa'al maan banɛ bɛ daka la zug ka nyu'oe li tis Zugsɔb la. Ala ka maanmaan la na maal suguru sɔsʋg maan ka ba na kɛɛ o taali bas.”

english_verse: You are guilty and unfit to worship me, if you accidentally touch the dead body of any kind of unclean animal.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ sɔ' ya'a si'is si'el dinɛ ka' nyainnɛ, wʋʋ bʋnkpiilʋŋ kanɛ an yin bʋnkɔnbʋg bɛɛ sian'arin bʋnkɔnbʋg bɛɛ bʋnvuudir, o sɔb tʋm taal, baa o ya'a la'am zi'.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ sɔ' ya'a si'is saal dian'ad buudi wʋsa linɛ na kɛ ka o lieb dian'ad sɔb, hali la'an nɛ on zi' la, o ya'a ti baŋ nya'aŋ, o sɔb tʋm taal.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ sɔ' ya'a pʋ gu'usɛ ka pɔ nɔɔri zi'el ye o na tʋm sʋ'ʋm bɛɛ bɛ'ɛd baa o ya'a zi' on maal si'el la, o sɔb ya'a ti baŋ, taal na bɛɛ o zug.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a baŋ ye o tʋm taal nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa ni, asɛɛ ka o pɛlig o pʋʋgʋ tu'asi o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: ka mɔr pɛnya'aŋ bɛɛ bʋnya'aŋ na tis Zugsɔb la, ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan; ka maanmaan la na maal suguru sɔsʋg maan o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: O na mɔri keŋ maanmaan la san'an, ka o nɔk yinne maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la maan. O na nwɛligi li niŋgɔɔnr amaa ka kʋ fi'igi li zugɔ,

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: ka nɔk tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan ziim la bi'ela mis maan daka la lʋga ni, ka kpa'ae dinɛ kpɛlim la bas daka la gbinnin.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a kʋ nyaŋi mɔr sian'adawana bɛɛ na'adawana ayi' la naa, on mɔr zɔmbaanlig kuriba yinne na ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan. Din an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la zug, li pʋ sʋm ka kpaam bɛɛ tudaar gɛndigi lii.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: O na nɔk zɔ'ɔm la tis maanmaan la, ka o gbin'e li nu'ukukudug ka li an tiɛnr maan, ka nyu'oe li maan daka la zug wʋʋ nyu'or maan ka ba maannɛ tisid Zugsɔb si'em la. Ka li na an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Anwana ka maanmaan la na niŋ ka li pie o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd banɛ ka o tʋm la bas ka o paam suguru. Zɔm kanɛ kpɛlim la na an maanmaan la bʋn wʋʋ zʋʋd maana an si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: “Sɔ' ya'a pʋ baŋɛ ka tʋm taal nɛ Zugsɔb la'abanɛ an kasi la, asɛɛ ka o mɔr pɛrakanɛ ka' dɛŋ na ka li na an taal maan. Li sʋm ye kɔnbʋg la ligidi zu'oe paae Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir ligidi makiri an si'em la.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Bɛog ya'a nie maanmaan la na yɛ fuug ka sɔɔn o kurigiŋ kanɛ ka ba zaŋ pien pielsʋŋʋ sɛn la ka keŋ vaae nyu'or maan bugum tampɛligim la daka la zugʋ basi li kpikpɛŋ,

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord: You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
translation_verse: bɛɛ sɔ' si'eli bɔdig ka o pi'ig ka ma' ye o pʋ pi'igɛ, bɛɛ o ma'anɛ ziri ka pɔ ye li anɛ sida, bɛɛ sɔ' ya'a tʋm

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: “Daakanɛ ka ba na nɔk malʋŋ kpaam bu'oe niŋ Aaron nɛ o biribis la zug ka ba lieb maanmaannib la, asɛɛ ka ba nɔk zɔmbaanlig kuriba wʋʋ daar wʋsa zʋʋd maannɛ mɔr na, pʋdig zin'is ayi', maal yinne bɛogʋn ka maal yinne zaam.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib nɛ ba biribis ma'aa na ɔnb maan kaŋa ni'im bɔzugɔ li anɛ kasi.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Ka ya ya'a nɔk tan dʋkʋ dʋg ni'im la naae yanam nwa'am dʋg la. Ya ya'a nɔk kʋntzɛn'ug dʋkʋ dʋg yanam piemi li hali ka li yi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: pa'alim Aaron nɛ o biribis nyu'or maan la na an si'em. Nyu'or maan la sʋm ye li kpɛm bɛ maan daka la zug yʋ'ʋŋ hali nie bɛog. Asɛɛ bugum kanɛ bɛ maan daka la zug mɛ kpɛn dit ala.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: ka yʋ'ʋn tiak o fuud la ka nyaan mɔr tampɛligim la yi ban la'asi bɛ zin'isi'a la keŋi bas zin'ikanɛ an maan zin'isʋŋ la kpikpɛŋ.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Amaa bugum la na kpɛn dit maan daka la zug saŋa wʋsa. Li pʋ sʋ'ʋm ye li kpiisɛ. Maanmaan la na paasid daad bugum la ni bɛkɛung wʋsa, ka na maan daar wʋsa nyu'or maan la nyu'oe li zug, nɛ taaba la'asʋg maana kpaam la.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Baŋim ye bugum la pʋ kpiisid maan daka la zugɔ. Zʋʋd maan

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: Zʋʋd maan la pa'ala nwana: Aaron biribis la na nɔki li maali tis Zugsɔb la maan daka tuon.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na gbin'e zɔ'ɔm la nu'ukukudug ka li an kisir, la'an nɛ kpaam nɛ tudaar la wʋsa, n nyu'oe maan daka la zug ka li nyuug malisi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Baŋim ka zɔ'ɔm kaŋa pʋ maan si'el ka danbin bɛɛ. M nɔki linɛ tis maanmaannib la ka li aan ba pʋʋri yit maan kanɛ ka nidib la tis mam ka li an bugum maan la ni na. Li nwɛnɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan nɛ taal maan la, li anɛ kasi hali.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Aaron yaas banɛ an dap la na nyaŋi di dikaŋa bɔzugɔ li anɛ ba bʋn ka mam Zugsɔb tisi ba, hali saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Bʋn linɛ si'is dikaŋa na lieb kasi.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ba na gɛndig kpaam maali sɛn'. Ba ya'a sɛn' naae ba na zaŋi mɔr na ka pʋdigi li bi'el bi'eli tis Zugsɔb la ka li nyuug malisi tis o.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Aaron nɛ o biribis la ye ban na dɔlis si'em nwa' maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la sʋm ye ba kɔdig bʋnkɔnbʋg la Zugsɔb la tuon zin'ikanɛ ka ba kɔtid nyu'or maan la; li anɛ kasi hali.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan kanɛ maali li la na ɔnbi li zin'ikanɛ an kasi la, Fuug Sʋgʋr la zakin.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a si'is ni'im kaŋa, asɛɛ ka o lieb man Zugsɔb la bʋn. Ka ziim la ya'a si'is sɔ' fuug on yɛɛgimi li pie zin'ikanɛ an kasi la ni.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Amaa mid ka sɔ' ɔnb tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan linɛ ka ya mɔri li ziim kpɛn' Fuug Sʋgʋrin la ye ya maal suguru sɔsʋg maan zin'ikanɛ an Kasi Zin'igin la. Asɛɛ ka ya nyu'oe ni'im la wʋsa nɛ bugum.”

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: ka maanmaan la na nyu'oe li daka la zug ka li an nyu'or maannɛ tis mam Zugsɔb la. Li anɛ taal maan.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: O na mɔr nwa' buudi wʋsa yinne-yinne kena tis Zugsɔb la. Maanmaan onɛ nɔk ziim la misi gilig daka la ka maal taaba la'asʋg maana la sʋ'oe li wʋsa.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Ni'im kanɛ wʋsa si'is linɛ an dian'ad la pʋ sʋm ye ya ɔnbi li. Di sʋm ye ba nɔki nyu'oe bugum. Amaa ni'im banɛ kpɛlim la, onɛ wʋsa an nyain na nyaŋi ɔnb.

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: “Nɛ'ɛŋa an taal maan zi'ela. Li anɛ man Zugsɔb la din ka an kasi.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ba na kɔdig taal maan bʋnkɔnbʋg la zin'ikanɛ ka ba kɔdigid nyu'or maan la, ka nɔk ziim la misi mis maan daka la gilig.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na nɔk zʋʋr la nɛ pʋʋgin la'ad la nɛ kpaam la wʋsa nyu'oe tis Zugsɔb la,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ka yis kpaam linɛ bɛ siyaanini la ni wʋsa, nɛ siyaanini la, ka nwaae sɔɔnr la yis bi'ela,

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib nɛ ba biribis ma'aa na ɔnb maan kaŋa ni'im zin'ikanɛ an kasi la bɔzugɔ li anɛ kasi.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: “Taal maan la nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la nwɛnɛ taaba. Ba wʋsa zi'ela la anɛ yinne. Maanmaan onɛ maan suguru sɔsʋg maan la sʋ'oe ni'im kan la.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Maanmaan ya'a maal nyu'or maan, onɛ sʋ'oe gbauŋ la.

english_verse: just as he may eat the bread from a sacrifice to give thanks to me.
translation_verse: Maanmaan onɛ maal zʋʋd maan wʋsa linɛ ka ba maal wʋʋ bodobodo nɛ, bɛɛ linɛ ka ba sɛn' bugum zugin, bɛɛ linɛ ka ba maal ma'aslaasin, na sʋ'oe diib la.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ka zʋʋd maan linɛ kpɛlim ka an zɔ'ɔm ka kpaam gɛndig bɛɛ linɛ pʋ gɛndig la na an Aaron biribis wʋsa din.” Taaba la'asʋg maan

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa an taaba la'asʋg maan zi'ela, linɛ ka nid na tun'e maali tis Zugsɔb la:

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
