translation_verse: O ya'a ye o maal ka li anɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsʋg maan, li sʋm ka o maal bodobodo linɛ ka danbin kae ka gɛndig nɛ kpaam, nɛ linɛ nwɛnɛ sa'akɔnt kpi'emis linɛ pʋ gɛndig danbinnɛ ka niŋi li kpaam, nɛ zɔmbaanlig ka ba nɔki maal ma'asa ma'aslaasin.

english_verse: You must also make some bread with yeast.
translation_verse: O mɛ na maal bodobodo linɛ mɔr danbin la paas taaba la'asʋg bareka pʋ'ʋsim la.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Taaba la'asʋg maan ni'im la ɔnbidnɛ daakan la nɔɔ. Li ni'im pʋ nied bɛogɔ.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Maan la ya'a anɛ o kaanbnɛ zi'el bɛɛ ya'amlɛog maan, li sʋm ye ba ɔnbi li wʋsa daakan la nɔɔ, amaa li ya'a kpɛlim bi'ela ba na nyaŋi ɔnbi li, di yimbɛog,

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a ɔnb taaba la'asʋg maan ni'im kanɛ paae daba atan', Zugsɔb la kʋ di'e lii. Maan la na lieb zaalim, bɔzugɔ ni'im la dian'a nɛ; ka onɛ ɔnbi li la, taal na dɔl on sɔb.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a si'is bʋnkanɛ wʋsa ka' nyainnɛ, ka li anɛ ninsaal bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg dian'ad, bɛɛ bʋnsi'a wʋsa linɛ kis ka an dian'ad, ka ɔnb taaba la'asʋg maan ni'im kanɛ ka ba maali tis Zugsɔb la, o tʋm taal ka ba na yis on sɔb Israel nidib la kallin.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye sɔ' da ɔnb naaf kpaam, bɛɛ pɛ'og kpaam, bɛɛ bʋʋg kpaam.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ kpi, bɛɛ o bʋnkɔnbtaaba gban'e o kʋ, sɔ' da ɔnb o kpaam la, amaa ya na tun'e nɔki li maali ya tʋʋm si'a wʋsa.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a ɔnb kpakanɛ ka ba maal nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la asɛɛ ka ba yis o Israel nidib la kallin.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Yanamɛ bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa, yanam da di bʋnkɔnbʋg ziim, bɛɛ bʋn-ian'adir ziim;

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: ka onɛ di ziim ban yisim o sɔb Israel nidib la kallin.”

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ka on sɔb na mɔr maan la o mɛŋ nu'usin na ka ba nyu'oe maali tis Zugsɔb la. O na mɔr kpaam nɛ kugsir la na ka nɔk kugsir la nyɔɔsim ka pʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb ka li an nyɔɔsʋŋ maan,

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: ka maanmaan la na nyu'oe kpaam la daka la zug. Amaa kugsir la anɛ Aaron nɛ o biribis la bʋn.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Aaron biig onɛ zaŋ ziim nɛ kpaam maal taaba la'asʋg maana la na sʋ'oe datiuŋ gbɛr la.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Man Zugsɔb nɔk kugsir kanɛ ka ba nyɔɔsim nɛ datiuŋ gbɛr kanɛ ka ba yis Israel dim taaba la'asʋg maannin la wʋsa tis Aaron nɛ o biribis la ka li aan ba pʋʋr saŋa wʋsa yit Israel dim nu'usin.

english_verse: These are the ceremonies for sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessing or his forgiveness, as well as the ceremonies for those sacrifices that demand a payment and for the sacrifices that are offered when priests are ordained.
translation_verse: Nwa' wʋsa pa'an maan la nyu'ore na dɔl si'em, nɛ zʋʋd maan, nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, nɛ taal maan, nɛ maanmaannib liebʋg maan, nɛ taaba la'asʋg maana la wʋsa.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Zi'elbama ka Zugsɔb la da tis Moses Sinai zuor zug, saŋkanɛ ka o da yɛl Israel biribis la ye ba mɔri ba maana na tis o, Sinai sian'arin la.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Ka mɛ nɔk kugsir linɛ an Moses pʋʋr ka an maanmaannib liebʋg malʋŋ pɛraug la nyɔɔsimi li Zugsɔb tuon, wʋʋ nyɔɔsʋŋ malʋŋ nɛ, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Mɔr Aaron nɛ o biribis la na, nɛ maanmaannib fuud la nɛ malʋŋ kpaam la, m paas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan na'araug la, nɛ pɛraad ayi', ka nɔk bodobodo linɛ ka danbin kae la niŋ pɛogʋnɛ mɔr na;

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ka buol nidib la wʋsa La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin la.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord, and when everyone had come together,
translation_verse: Ka Moses maal wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la. Ka nidib la la'as La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: ka Moses yɛl nidib la ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye m niŋ si'em nwa'.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Ka Moses mɔr Aaron nɛ o biribis la yi tuon na ka nɔk ku'om sʋʋ ba,

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: ka nɔk fuwɔk la yɛɛl Aaron ka nɔk sɛnbidiŋ la lɔɔ o, ka nɔk fukanɛ pʋ paae fuwɔk la yɛɛli pa'al, ka yʋ'ʋn nɔk dansik la pa'al zugin, ka nɔki li pien vɛnliŋi lɔɔ o siaa ka li gban'e sʋ'ʋŋa,

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: ka nɔk linɛ lɔɔd nyɔ'ɔgin la lɔɔ paas, ka nɔk ban buon si'el ye Urim nɛ Tummim la suu li gɛfa ni,

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: ka nɔk zupibig la pid o zug, ka nɔk sanlima baŋ kanɛ pa'al ye o anɛ Wina'am nid la tabili li tuon, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Moses da nɔk malʋŋ kpaam la bu'oe niŋ Fuug Sʋgʋr la nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa ka pɛsigi li tis Zugsɔb la;

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: ka lɛn nɔk kpaam misi gilig daka la nɔɔra ayɔpɔi, nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa, nɛ ku'om latita'ar nɛ lin sʋn'e si'el zug la, ka pɛsigi li tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam la niŋ Aaron zug ka pɛsig o tis Wina'am ka o lieb maanmaan,

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: ka mɛ mɔr Aaron biribis la yina ka yɛɛli ba dansikanam, ka nɔk piena lɔɔ ba sies ka pili ba zupibis wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Ka o yʋ'ʋn nɔk na'araug linɛ ka ba na maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la ka Aaron nɛ o biribis la nɔki ba nu'usi pa'al o zug.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ka Moses kɔdig na'araug la ka ti'el ziim la nɔk o nu'ubili tin'e niŋ iila banɛ bɛ daka la ni la ka kɛ ka daka la an nyain, ka kpa'ae ziim kanɛ kpɛlim la bas daka la gbinnin. Ala ka o pɛsigi li ka maal suguru sɔsʋg maannɛ li zug.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yis kpaam linɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la'ad la ni, nɛ siyaanini nɛ li kpaam la wʋsa, ka nwaae sɔɔnr la bi'ela, n nyu'oe daka la zug.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Amaa ka mɔr na'araug la gbauŋ, nɛ li ni'im banɛ kpɛlim la nɛ pʋʋgin la'ad nɛ pʋt la wʋsa yi teŋ la kpikpɛŋi nyu'oe li wʋsa anina, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Ka Moses mɔr pɛraug na ye ba maal nyu'or maan, ka Aaron nɛ o biribis la nɔki ba nu'usi pa'ali li zugin

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ka o kɔdig pɛ'og la ka nɔk ziim la kpa'asi sɛɛnr daka la gilig;

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: ka nɔk ku'om pie li pʋʋgin la'ad la nɛ li nɔba la, ka nyu'oe li wʋsa nyu'or daka la zug ka li an maan kanɛ nyu'od ka li nyuug la malisi tis Zugsɔb la, wʋʋ on Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Ka o mɔr pɛrakanɛ kpɛlim ka o ye o maal banɛ na an maanmaannib maan la, ka Aaron nɛ o biribis la pa'ali ba nu'us pɛraug la zug,

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: ka Moses kɔdigi li ka ti'el ziim la niŋ Aaron datiuŋ tʋbirin, nɛ o datiuŋ nu'uraug nɛ o datiuŋ nɔbraug.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka kɛ ka Aaron biribis la yi tuon na, ka niŋ ziim la ba datiuŋ tʋba ni, nɛ ba datiuŋ nu'uraad nɛ ba datiuŋ nɔbraadin, ka nɔk ziim la kpa'asi sɛɛnr daka la gilig.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Ka o yis pɛraug la kpaam bi'ela, nɛ o zʋʋr, ka nwaae sɔɔnr la yis bi'ela, ka nɔk siyaanini la nɛ li kpaam la wʋsa, nɛ o datiuŋ gbɛr.

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka yis bodobodo kanɛ ka' danbinnɛ ka zi'e Zugsɔb tuon la yinne, nɛ ma'asir yinne nɛ linɛ nwɛnɛ sa'akɔnt kpi'emis la yinne, ka pa'ali li kpaam la'ad nɛ datiuŋ gbɛr la zug.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka o daa nɔki li wʋsa niŋ Aaron nɛ o biribis la nu'usin ka nyɔɔsimi li wʋʋ ban niŋid nyɔɔsʋŋ malʋŋ si'em tisid Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Ka Moses di'e li wʋsa ba nu'usin nyu'oe maan daka la zugin ka li an maanmaannib liebʋg malʋŋ ka li nyɔ'ɔs la nyuug malisi tis Zugsɔb la. Li da anɛ maan kanɛ ka ba nyu'oe bugum tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ani ka Moses da nɔk malʋŋ kpaam la bi'ela, nɛ ziim linɛ bɛ daka la zugin bi'ela, mis Aaron nɛ o biribis maanmaannib fusʋma la, ka pɛsig Aaron nɛ o biribis la nɛ ba fuud wʋsa tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Moses da yɛl Aaron nɛ o biribis la ye, “Nɔkimi ni'im la dʋgi La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin ka ɔnbi li nɛ maanmaan liebʋg bodobodo linɛ bɛ pɛogʋn la, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la ye, ‘Aaron nɛ o biribis la an banɛ na dii li la.’

english_verse: Burn what is left over
translation_verse: Nɔkimi bodobodo nɛ ni'im linɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa nyu'oe.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya yi La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin hali ti paae dabisa ayɔpɔi ka ya maanmaannib liebʋg malʋŋ la ti paae li bɛn.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ tʋm si'em zina la anɛ Zugsɔb la zi'el nɔɔr ye ti tʋm ala, ka li anɛ suguru sɔsʋg maannɛ tisi ya.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Alazug, asɛɛ ka ya bɛ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin la ka li paae dabisa ayɔpɔi, nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ, ka tʋm wʋʋ Zugsɔb la zi'eli ya si'em la; ka li ya'a ka' alaa, ya na kpi. Ala ka Zugsɔb la yɛli tisim.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Ka Aaron nɛ o biribis la sid tʋm wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye ba tʋm si'em la.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Ka daba anii daar ka Moses buol Aaron nɛ o biribis la nɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam,

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: ka yɛl Aaron ye, “Nɔkim na'araug ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, ka mɛ nɔk pɛraug ka li an nyu'or maan. Bʋnkɔnbid la pʋ sʋm ye ba mɔr dɛŋŋa; ka fʋ na nɔki maali tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Yɛlim Israel dim la ka ba nɔk bʋʋg ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan ka nɔk yʋʋm na'abil nɛ yʋʋm pɛraug ka li an nyu'or maan. Bʋnkɔnbid nwa' mɛ pʋ sʋm ye ba mɔr dɛŋŋa.

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye ba nɔk na'araug nɛ pɛraug linɛ na an taaba la'asʋg maan ka nɔk zɔ'ɔm gɛndig nɛ kpaam ka li an zʋʋd maannɛ maali tis Zugsɔb la, ka o na nie o mɛŋ zina tisi ya.”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la sid da mɔr la'abanɛ ka Moses yɛli ba la keŋ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la tuon, ka nidib la wʋsa kena zi'en Zugsɔb tuon.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛli ba ye, “Anwana ka Zugsɔb yɛli ya ye ya tʋm, ka Zugsɔb girima nɛɛsim na nie tisi ya.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Aaron ye, “Kem maan daka la nii maali fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la, nɛ fʋ nyu'or maan ka maal suguru sɔsʋg maannɛ tisi fʋ mɛŋ nɛ nidib la wʋʋ Zugsɔb la zi'el si'em la.”

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Ka Aaron keŋ daka la ni n kɔdig na'abil la ka li an o mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan,

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: ka o biribis la mɔr ziim la na tis o ka o nɔk o nu'ubili tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan ziim la ni n niŋ iila banɛ bɛ daka la ni la, ka kpa'ae ziim la daka la gbinnin,

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: ka yis naaf la kpaam, nɛ siyaanini la, ka nwaae sɔɔnr la bi'ela, nyu'oe daka la zug, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la;

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: ka mɔr gbauŋ la nɛ ni'im la yi teŋ la kpikpɛŋi nyu'oe bugum.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka o da kɔdig nyu'or maan kɔnbʋg la, ka o biribis mɔri li ziim na tis o ka o di'e mis daka la gilig wʋsa,

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: ka ba mɔr bʋnkɔnbʋg la ni'im la yinne-yinne nɛ li zug la na ka o nyu'oe daka la zug,

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: ka pie pʋʋgin la'ad la nɛ nɔba la nyu'oe daka la zugʋ pa'al nyu'or maan la zugin.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Ka Aaron yʋ'ʋn mɔr bʋkanɛ ka o ye o nɔki maal nidib la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la na kɔdigi li maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la wʋʋ on maal yiiga bʋʋg la tis o mɛŋ si'em la,

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: ka lɛm mɔri ba nyu'or maan la wʋsa na maal wʋʋ lin nar si'em la;

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: ka lɛm mɔr zʋʋd maan la na ka gbin'e zɔ'ɔm la nu'ukukudugu nyu'oe daka la zugʋ paas bɛogʋn nyu'or maan la.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka o kɔdig na'araug nɛ pɛraug la ka li an taaba la'asʋg maannɛ tis nidib la, ka o biribis la mɔr ziim la na ka o mis daka la wʋsa gilig.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Ka yis na'araug nɛ pɛraug la zʋʋr la nɛ pʋʋgin la'ad la kpaam wʋsa, nɛ siyaanini la, ka nwaae sɔɔnr la yis bi'ela,

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Ka Aaron nyɔɔsim kugsa nɛ datiuŋ gbɛr la tis Zugsɔb ka li an nyɔɔsʋŋ maan wʋʋ Moses n yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ka on maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, nɛ nyu'or maan, nɛ taaba la'asʋg maannɛ naae la, Aaron da ʋk o nu'us agɔl ka sɔs Wina'am albareka tis nidib la, ka nyaan naam daka la nii sig na.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Moses nɛ Aaron da kpɛn' La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin la ka yina niŋ nidib la zug bareka, ka Zugsɔb girima nɛɛsim nie tis nidib la wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka bugum da yi Zugsɔb san'an na di nyu'or maan nɛ kpaam la daka la zug, ka li malis nidib la ka ba maal tʋkpiidʋg ka igin teŋinɛ tis Zugsɔb la na'asi.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Aaron biribis banɛ yʋda da buon Nadab nɛ Abihu la da zan'as Zugsɔb la nɔɔr ka zaŋ laa dinɛ ka ba niŋid tudaar la nyu'oe bugum la maal tudaar maan linɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Ka bugum da kpɛn yi Zugsɔb la san'an na dii ba ka ba kpi o tuon.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Aaron ye, “Ala ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Banɛ li'el man san'an na la, li nar ye ba baŋ ye m anɛ kasi. Asɛɛ ka m paam zun'ori m nidib la wʋsa san'an.” Ka Aaron kpɛn an baanlimm.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses buol Misael nɛ Elizafan banɛ an Aaron saambil Uziel biribis la yɛli ba ye, “Kemi na zaŋi ya ba'abiis banɛ kpi nwa' n yi Fuug Sʋgʋrin la ka mɔri ba yis teŋ la kpikpɛŋ!”

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Aaron nɛ o biribis Eleazar nɛ Itamar ye, “Da basi ya zuobid yɔri-yɔri ka maali sʋnsa'aŋa; mɛ da aansi ya fuudɛ, ya'a ka' alaa ya na kpi, ka Zugsɔb la sʋʋnr mɛ duoe nɛ nidib la wʋsa. Amaa kɛl ka ya ba'abiis banɛ an Israel dim la wʋsa maal sʋnsa'aŋ banɛ ka bugum di la yɛla.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya yi Fuug Sʋgʋr la yiŋ, ya'a ka' alaa ya na kpi. Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la gaŋi ya ka bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam la niŋi ya ye ya an maanmaannib.” Ka Aaron nɛ o biribis ayi' la da siak Moses nɔɔr. Maanmaannib kisʋg

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Aaron ye,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “Fʋn bɛɛ fʋ biribis la ya'a ye ya kpɛn' Fuug Sʋgʋrin la, yanam da nu daam; ya ya'a niŋ ala, ya na kpi. Nwa' anɛ zi'elʋgʋ tisidi ya zʋmaana wʋsa ni.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Li anɛ tilas ye ya baŋ linɛ an kasi nɛ linɛ an daar wʋsa din, nɛ linɛ an nyain nɛ linɛ ka' nyainnɛ,

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: ka mɛ pa'al Israel dim la zi'elʋg linɛ ka Zugsɔb pian' tis Moses la wʋsa.” Malʋŋ diib la kisʋg

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Aaron nɛ o biribis Eleazar nɛ Itamar banɛ kpɛlim la ye, “Zaŋimi zʋʋd linɛ ka ba maal bugum maannɛ tis Zugsɔb ka li kpɛlim la, li maan daka la baba; da nɔk danbinnɛ niŋi li, bɔzugɔ li anɛ kasi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Dimini li zin'ikanɛ an kasi la bɔzugɔ, li anɛ fʋn nɛ fʋ biribis la din, ka an bugum maan kanɛ ka ba maali tis Zugsɔb la. Ala ka Zugsɔb zi'eli tisim.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Ka gbɛr la, nɛ kugsir kanɛ nyɔɔsim la, ba na mɔri li kena nɛ li kpaam la ka li an bugum maan, ka nyɔɔsimi li tis Zugsɔb la ka li an nyɔɔsʋŋ maan, ka nwa' na an fʋn nɛ fʋ biribis la pʋʋr saŋa wʋsa, nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la zi'el si'em la.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Moses da bu'os bʋkanɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la yɛla ka baŋ ye ba nyu'oe li nɛ la, ka o sʋnf duoe nɛ Aaron biribis Eleazar nɛ Itamar banɛ kpɛlim la, ka o yɛl ye

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ka ya pʋ ɔnbid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la ni'im zin'ikanɛ an kasi la ni? Bɔzugɔ, li anɛ bʋnkanɛ ka Zugsɔb la sʋ'oe ka li an kasi, ka o zaŋi tisi ya ye ya maan suguru maannɛ tisid Zugsɔb la ka o yisid nidib la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi basid.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Kɔnbʋg la Ziim la sadigim pʋ kpɛn' Zin'ikanɛ an kasi la, li narin ye ya ɔnbi li Fuug Sʋgʋr la baba wʋʋ man zi'el si'em la.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Ka Aaron yɛl Moses ye, “Ba maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan nɛ nyu'or maan la zina, ka yɛlbama paae mam; ka m ya'a ɔnbin nwa', Zugsɔb la sʋnf naan malisinɛɛ? Ayei!”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Moses n wʋm nwa' la, li da malisi o sʋʋnr.

english_verse: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.
translation_verse: Ya na tun'e ɔnb bʋnkɔnbʋg kanɛ ka o tafɛɛd buak ayi' ka o mɛ ʋgʋsid yaama bugusid la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la da lɛm pian' tis Moses nɛ Aaron ye,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: “Pian'am tisi Israel dim la ye, bʋnvʋbanɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ zug ka ya na di anɛ bama:

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Amaa bʋn-ian'ada banɛ vuud teŋin ka mɔr nɔba anaasi ken la anɛ ya kisi ba.

english_verse: Don't even touch the dead bodies of animals that have divided hoofs but don't chew the cud. And don't touch the dead bodies of animals that have paws. If you do, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ wʋsa mɛ vaae li bʋnkpiilʋŋʋ mɔri keŋ, na pie o fuud ka an dian'ad sɔb hali ti paae zaam. Ba anɛ dian'adi tisi ya.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: nɛ akɔn'ɔs nɛ gbanzaug, nɛ abanja nɛ abaŋkʋsɔl nɛ dindɛog.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Banɛ wʋsa vuud teŋin ka' nyain tisi ya. Ba ya'a kpinɛ ka sɔ' si'isi ba o na an dian'ad sɔbi ti paae zaam.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ka ba yinne ya'a lu tandʋkʋn, linɛ wʋsa bɛɛ li ni ka' nyainnɛ, asɛɛ ya nwa'ae dʋk la.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Dikanɛ wʋsa ka ya na di ka dʋk nwa' ku'om si'isi li, diib la ka' nyainnɛ, nɛ bʋnnuuda linɛ ka ya na nu la ya'a bɛ dʋk la pʋʋgin, li wʋsa ka' nyainnɛ.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Bʋn linɛ wʋsa ka bʋnkpiilʋŋ luu li zugʋ si'isi li la lieb nɛ dian'ad. Li ya'a anɛ siŋ bɛɛ dan'anvi'and, asɛɛ ba nwa'ae ba bɔzugɔ ba ka' nyainnɛ, ka na kpɛn an linɛ ka' nyain tisi ya hali ken sa.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Li ya'a lu nɛ buligin bɛɛ kɔlʋgin, ku'om la kpɛn anɛ nyain, amaa sɔ' ya'a gban'e bʋnkpiilʋŋ la, on sɔb kʋ an nyainnɛ.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Ka bʋnkpiilʋŋ la ya'a si'is bʋmbʋʋda linɛ ka ya ye ya zaŋi bʋd la, li na kpɛn anɛ nyain,

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: amaa sɔ' ya'a zaŋ ku'om niŋ bʋmbʋʋda la ni ka bʋnkpiilʋŋ si'isi li, li anɛ linɛ ka' nyain tisi ya.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Bʋnkɔnbʋg kanɛ ka ya zaŋ ka li an diibi tisi ya la ya'a kpi nɛ, ka sɔ' si'isi li, o kʋ an nyainnɛ ti paae zaam.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa ɔnb bʋnkpiilʋŋ la piemi o fuud ka an dian'ad sɔbi ti paae zaam, ka onɛ vaae bʋnkpiilʋŋ la mɔri keŋ la piemi o fuud ka an onɛ ka' nyainnɛ ti paae zaam.

english_verse: Don't eat any of those disgusting little creatures that crawl or walk close to the ground.
translation_verse: Ya mɛ da ɔnb bʋnvʋr kanɛ vuud o pʋʋr zug teŋin bɛɛ linɛ mɔr nɔba bɛdegʋ, li anɛ linɛ ka ya kis.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Da ganlimi ya mɛŋ nɛ bʋnvʋr bamanam taabaa. Da kɛ ka bamanam kɛ ka ya dian'a ya mɛŋa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am, zaŋimi ya mɛŋi tis mam, aaɛn kasi bɔzugɔ, mam anɛ kasi. Da kɛ ka bʋnvʋr kanɛ vuud teŋgbauŋ nwa' zug kɛ ka ya kʋ an nyainnɛ.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb onɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt teŋgbauŋʋn na ye m aan ya Wina'am la. Alazugɔ, bɛɛi kasi, bɔzugɔ, mam anɛ kasi.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka ya bakid dinɛ an nyain nɛ dinɛ ka' nyainnɛ, nɛ bʋnvʋr kanɛ ka ya ɔnbid nɛ linɛ ka ya pʋ ɔnbida.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “Pian'am tis Israel nidib la ye pu'a ya'a gban'e pʋʋgʋ du'a biribiŋ, o kʋ an nyainnɛ ti paae daba ayɔpɔi nwɛnɛ on ka' nyain o nwadig pier saŋa si'em la.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Ba kpɛn'ɛsim biig la baŋʋ daba anii la daar.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: O ya'a du'a bipuŋ, asɛɛ ka o zaŋ dabis pii nɛ anaasi bɛ yin nwɛnɛ o pier saŋa la; o na zaŋ dabisa pisyuobʋ nɛ ayuobʋ ka ba nyaan zuŋ o.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “Onɛ du'a biribiŋ bɛɛ bipuŋ ka o zuŋur saŋa ti gaad, on zaŋim yʋʋm pɛribig n keŋ Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin n tis maanmaan la ka li an nyu'or maan, nɛ sian'adawan bɛɛ na'adawanbil ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na zaŋi ba maal Zugsɔb la tuon ka li an suguru sɔsʋg maan linɛ na zuŋ pu'a la ka o yʋ'ʋn an nyain o ku'od yiib la zug. Nwa' ka m zi'eli tis pu'a kanɛ du'a biribiŋ bɛɛ bipuŋ.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Onɛ kʋ nyaŋ pɛribiga, on zaŋim sian'adawan ayi', bɛɛ na'adawanbibis ayi' na; yinne anɛ ba nyu'oe li ka li an nyu'or maan, ka onɛ kpɛlim la an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan. Anwa ka maanmaan la na maal suguru sɔsʋg maan pu'a la yɛla.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛm pian' tis Moses nɛ Aaron ye,

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: “Sɔ' ya'a mɔr fɛn'ɛdi o niŋgbina ni bɛɛ mɔda bɛɛ li fʋlisnɛ nyɛɛnnɛ bɔɔdi kilim niŋgbina ban'as, on kem Aaron onɛ an maanmaan la san'an bɛɛ o biribis banɛ an maanmaannib la yinne san'an.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na gɔs fɛn'ʋg la o niŋgbiŋin la ka niŋkɔnbilʋg banɛ bɛ fɛn'ʋgʋn la ya'a pɛlig ka nɔbigidi kpɛn'ɛdi o niŋgbina la ni, li anɛ niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as; ka maanmaan la ya'a gɔs o, o na yɛl ye o ka' nyainnɛ.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Amaa li ya'a pʋ nɔbigi kpɛn' pʋʋginɛ, ka niŋkɔnbilʋg la mɛ pʋ pɛligɛ, maanmaan la na kɛ ka o bɛɛ o kɔn'ɔkɔn' ti paae daba ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Ka daba ayɔpɔi la daar ya'a paae, maanmaan la na lɛn gɔs o, ka li ya'a pʋ tiakɛ ka fɛn'ʋg la pʋ lɔ'ɔŋ o niŋgbiŋ la zin'isi'a, maanmaan la na lɛn kɛ ka o bɛɛ o kɔn'ɔkɔn' daba ayɔpɔi ya'as.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na lɛn gɔs o daba ayɔpɔi daar la, ka fɛn'ʋg la ya'a bɔdig ka pʋ lɔ'ɔŋ o niŋgbiŋ la zin'isi'a, li pa'al ye li kʋdim anɛ sankpana ka maanmaan la yʋ'ʋn na yɛl o ye o anɛ nyain, ka o pie o fuud la ka lieb nyain.

english_verse: However, if the disease comes back, you must return to the priest.
translation_verse: Amaa sankpana la ya'a tiigi o niŋgbina wʋsa on pa'al o mɛŋ la nya'aŋ, on kem nɔk o mɛŋi pa'al o ya'as.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na gɔs o ka o sankpana la ya'a tiigidi o niŋgbina la wʋsa, o na yɛl ye o ka' nyainnɛ; ka li anɛ niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: “Sɔ' ya'a mɔr niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as, ban mɔr o keŋ maanmaan la ni.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Maanmaan la ya'a gɔs o ka o niŋgbiŋ zin'isi'a ya'a mɔdi pɛligi tiak niŋkɔnbilʋg la ka kɛ ka li pɛlig, ka fɛn'ɛpaala bɛ,

english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: o na gɔs o niŋgbina la wʋsa, ka yɛl o ye o an nyain; li wʋsa ya'a pɛligi naae, li pa'al ye o lieb nyain.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Maanmaan la ya'a nyɛ fɛn'ʋg la o na yɛl o ye o ka' nyainnɛ, ka li anɛ niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: ka maanmaan la ya'a gɔs ka zin'ig la pɛlig wʋsa, o na yɛl o ye o anɛ nyain.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: ka li isir la an piel, bɛɛ mɔdi an wiya-wiya, o na pa'al o mɛŋ maanmaan la.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la ya'a gɔs fɛn'ʋg la ka li kpɛn' o niŋgbina la pʋʋgin, ka niŋkɔnbilʋg la pɛlig, maanmaan la na yɛl o ye o ka' nyainnɛ. Fɛn'ʋg la anɛ niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Amaa maanmaan la ya'a gɔs o ka fɛn'ʋg la bas ka niŋkɔnbilʋg la pʋ pɛligɛ, ka li pʋ kpɛn' o niŋgbiŋinɛ, amaa ka mu'oe bi'ela, maanmaan la na kɛ ka o bɛɛ o kɔn'ɔkɔn' daba ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Ka o fɛn'ɛd la ya'a kpɛn paasid, maanmaan la na yɛl o ye o ka' nyainnɛ, o mɔr niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Amaa fɛn'ʋg la ya'a nam bɛ zin'ig yinne ka pʋ lɔ'ɔŋ niŋgbina zin'isi'a, li anɛ natiŋkpi'eŋ la isir, ka maanmaan la na yɛl o ye o an nyain.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: “Bugum bɛɛ bʋntʋʋl ya'a pu'alim sɔ' niŋgbiŋ zin'isi'a ka li pɛlig bɛɛ an wiya-wiya,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: maanmaan la na gɔsi li, ka niŋkɔnbilʋg la ya'a pɛlig ka li kpɛn' o niŋgbina la pʋʋgin, li anɛ niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as la yi fɛn'ʋgin la na. Maanmaan la na yɛl o ye o ka' nyainnɛ, li anɛ niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Amaa ka maanmaan la ya'a gɔs o ka fɛn'ʋg la bas ka niŋkɔnbilʋg la pʋ pɛligɛ, ka li pʋ kpɛn' o niŋgbiŋin laa, amaa ka mu'oe bi'ela o niŋgbina ni, maanmaan la na kɛ ka o bɛɛ o kɔn'ɔkɔn' daba ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Daba ayɔpɔi la daar ya'a paae, maanmaan la na gɔs o ka o fɛn'ɛd la ya'a kpɛn paasid, maanmaan la na yɛl o ye o ka' nyainnɛ, o mɔr niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Amaa isir la ya'a kpɛm bɛ ka pʋ lɔ'ɔŋ o niŋgbina la wʋsa, ka mu'oe bi'ela, li anɛ isir la fʋlis, ka maanmaan la na yɛl o ye o anɛ nyain, li kʋdim anɛ pu'alʋŋ la isir.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: “Dau bɛɛ pu'a zug bɛɛ tieŋgu'or ya'a mɔr fɛn'ʋg,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: maanmaan la na gɔsi o fɛn'ʋg la ka li ya'a kpɛn' o niŋgbina ni ka kɔnbilʋg la nwɛnɛ dɔnbʋʋlim nɛ ka tulisi tulis, maanmaan la na yɛl o ye o ka' nyainnɛ, li anɛ niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'asi bɛɛ o zug nɛ tieŋgu'or la ni.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Amaa maanmaan la ya'a gɔs fɛn'ɛd la ka li pʋ kpɛn' o niŋgbina la nii ka kɔnbilʋg la pʋ sɔbigɛ, maanmaan la na kɛ ka o bɛɛ o kɔn'ɔkɔn' daba ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Daba ayɔpɔi la daar maanmaan la gɔsim o fɛn'ɛd la ya'as, ka fɛn'ɛd la ya'a pʋ tiig niŋgbiŋ laa, ka kɔnbilʋg la pʋ nwɛnɛ dɔnbʋʋlim, ka pʋ kpɛn' o niŋgbiŋin laa,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: ban pʋnimi o zug ka kɛ fɛn'ʋg la zin'ig la. Ka maanmaan la kɛ ka o bɛɛ o kɔn'ɔkɔn' daba ayɔpɔi ya'as.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Daba ayɔpɔi la daar, maanmaan la na gɔs o fɛn'ʋg la, ka fɛn'ʋg la ya'a pʋ tiigid niŋgbina la, maanmaan la na yɛl o ye o an nyain; o piem o fuud ka lieb nyain.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: maanmaan la na gɔs o ya'as ka fɛn'ʋg la ya'a tiigidi o niŋgbina la, on pʋn da lɛn gɔs ye niŋkɔnbilʋg la nwɛnɛ dɔnbʋʋlim; ka o pʋn ka' nyainnɛ.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: “Dau bɛɛ pu'a ya'a mɔr ban'asi'a o niŋgbiŋin ka li pɛlig,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: maanmaan la na gɔs o, ka linɛ pɛlig la ya'a mu'oe bi'ela, li anɛ isir linɛ bɛɛ o niŋgbiŋin ma'aa, alazug o anɛ nyain.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: O gbɛ'og baba ya'a pie ka o lieb zupieʋŋ, o anɛ nyain.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na gɔs o, ka fɛn'ʋg kanɛ bɛɛ o gbɛ'ogʋn bɛɛ o zugin la ya'a fʋlisi mu'oe pɛlig nwɛnɛ niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as nɛ,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: “Ninkan daana yɛɛm fubanɛ aans, ka bas o zuobid ka li zunnim-zunnim, ka mɛ zaŋ si'eli lus o nɔŋgban baba, ka kennɛ maan vuudi yɛt ye ‘M ka' nyainnɛ, m ka' nyainnɛ!’

english_verse: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as mɔr o la, o ka' nyainnɛ, li anɛ ye o bɛɛ o kɔn'ɔkɔn' kpikpɛŋ sa.” Fuug kanɛ guunlim yɛla

english_verse: because the mildew has spread.” Then he will burn the clothing or the piece of leather.
translation_verse: Li anɛ o nyu'oe fuug la, baa li ya'a anɛ lauk si'a wʋsa, lin guunlim la zug, asɛɛ ba nyu'oe li nɛ bugum.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the mildew hasn't spread,
translation_verse: “Amaa maanmaan la ya'a gɔs ka guunluŋ la pʋ tiig fuug la bɛɛ lauk laa,

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: o na kɛ ka ba pie fuug la ka zaŋi li niŋ zin'isi'a li kɔn' daba ayɔpɔi ya'as.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: Ka ba ya'a pie lauk la, maanmaan la na lɛn gɔsi li, ka guunluŋ la ya'a pʋ tiakɛ, li ka' nyainnɛ. Guunluŋ la ya'a si'isi li pʋʋgin bɛɛ li nya'aŋ o na nyu'oe li nɛ bugum.

english_verse: But if the spot has faded after being washed, he will tear away the spot.
translation_verse: “Maanmaan la ya'a gɔsi li ka zin'ikanɛ guunlim la lɛn kae ban pie li la zug, on aam zin'ikanɛ guunlim la bas.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Amaa ba ya'a pie fuug la ka guunluŋ la lɛn nie ya'as, ban nyu'omi li.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ fuug bɛɛ fukanɛ ka ba ʋg bɛɛ li anɛ gbauŋ lauk ka ba pie li ka guunluŋ la yi wʋsa, ba na lɛm pie li ya'as ka li an nyain.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye;

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: maanmaan la na kɛ ka ba zaŋ bʋn-ian'ada ayi' banɛ vʋe ka an nyain, nɛ na'aziinr daug nɛ pien zɛn'ug nɛ nyulinnyu'usi tis onɛ ka ba ye ba maal o ka o lieb nyain la.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na tis nɔɔr ye ba nɔkim tandʋkʋ niŋ ku'osʋŋ ka kɔdig bʋn-ian'ada la yinne niŋ ziim la dʋkʋn la;

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: ka bʋn-ian'adir kanɛ vʋe la, o na nɔki li, la'an nɛ na'aziinr daug la nɛ pien zɛn'ug nɛ nyulinnyu'us la lɔsi ba wʋsa bʋn-ian'adir kanɛ ka ba kɔdig o ku'osʋŋin la ziimin.

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: O na misi mis onɛ ka o ye o maal o nyain la nɔɔr ayɔpɔi ka yʋ'ʋn mɔɔl ye o anɛ nyain, ka bas bʋn-ian'adir onɛ vʋe la ka o ianki keŋ mɔɔgin sa.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Ani ka onɛ ka ba ye ba maal o nyain la yʋ'ʋn na pie o fuud ka pʋn o zug, ka sʋ ku'om an nyain. Lin nya'aŋ o na kpɛn' la'asʋg zin'igin la, ka lɛɛ kʋ kpɛn' o dɔɔginɛ hali ka li ti paae daba ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Li ya'a paae daba ayɔpɔi daar la, o na maligim pʋni o zug la nyain, ka kɔɔnsi o tieŋ nɛ o ninkʋgʋdis kɔnbid, hali nɛ o niŋgbiŋ kɔnbilʋg wʋsa, ka yʋ'ʋn pie o fuud wʋsa ka sʋ, ka nyaan lieb nyain naae.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: “Daba anii daar, asɛɛ ka o zaŋ pɛribis ayi' banɛ ka' dɛŋŋa nɛ pɛsa'a kanɛ an yʋʋm yinne ka pʋ mɔr dɛŋŋa, nɛ zɔmbaanlig kuribir pʋdigir piiga, ka vaae atan' gɛndig nɛ kpaam ka li an zʋʋd maan, ka bɔ kpaam kɔlibir pʋsʋki paas.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan onɛ na maal o nyain la na mɔr dau la nɛ la'ad la wʋsa na zi'el Zugsɔb la tuon La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na zaŋ pɛribig yinne kɔdig ka paas kpaam kɔlibir pʋsʋki maal taal maan ka nyɔɔsimi li Zugsɔb la tuon ka li an nyɔɔsʋŋ maan.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: O na kɔdig pɛribig la zin'ikanɛ an kasi ka ba kɔtid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan nɛ nyu'or maana la. Taal maan la anɛ maanmaan la din wʋʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la aan o din si'em la. Li anɛ kasi.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na zaŋ taal maan la ziim tin'e niŋ onɛ ka ba ye ba maal o nyain la datiuŋ tʋbir nɛ o datiuŋ nu'uraug nɛ o datiuŋ nɔbraugin.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Ka bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam kɔlibir pʋsʋk la bi'ela niŋ o mɛŋ dagɔbʋg nu'ugin

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ o datiuŋ nu'ubili tʋm kpaam linɛ bɛɛ o dagɔbʋg nu'ugin la mis nɔɔra ayɔpɔi, Zugsɔb la tuon.

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: Ka kpaam kanɛ kpɛlim bɛɛ o nu'ugin la, maanmaan la na tin'e li bi'ela niŋ onɛ ka o ye o maal o nyain la datiuŋ tʋbir, nɛ datiuŋ nu'uraug nɛ datiuŋ nɔbraugin, m paas taal maan ziim la zug.

english_verse: If you are poor and cannot afford to offer this much, you may offer a ram as a sacrifice to make things right, together with
translation_verse: “Ka o ya'a anɛ nɔŋdaan ka kʋ nyɛ la'ad la wʋsaa, on zaŋim pɛribig yinne ka li an taal maan ka ba nyɔɔsim maal suguru maannɛ tis o, ka lɛn zaŋ zɔmbaanlig kuriba pʋdigir piiga pɔɔgin yis ayinne gɛndig nɛ kpaam ka li an zʋʋd maan, nɛ kpaam kɔlibir pʋsʋk,
