translation_verse: O yʋ'ʋn na yii keŋ maan daka linɛ bɛ zakin Zugsɔb la tuon la, ka maal suguru sɔsʋg maannɛ li zug, ka zaŋ na'araug la ziim nɛ bʋʋg la ziim, niŋ maan daka la iila la wʋsa ni.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: O na zaŋ o nu'ubili tin'e ziim la misi-misi li nɔɔra ayɔpɔi ka li pie li nyain, kɛ ka li bɛɛ li kɔn'. Anwa ka o na niŋi pie li Israel dim la tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi dian'a li la zug.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: “Aaron ya'a maal suguru sɔsʋg maan la zin'ikanɛ an Kasi Wʋsa Kasi la, nɛ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr nɛ maan daka la wʋsa naae, o na mɔr bʋkanɛ vʋe la yina,

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ o nu'us ayi' la wʋsa pa'al bʋʋg la zugin ka kaanb Israel dim la wʋsa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ ba taal nɛ ba dian'ad yɛla ka li kpɛlim bʋʋg la zug, ka kɛ ka onɛ sʋ'oe li tʋʋma la mɔr o keŋ sian'arin

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: bas o anina. Ka bʋʋg la na zi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa keŋ sian'akanɛ ka ninsaal kae la.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: O na sʋ zin'ikanɛ an Kasi la ka zaŋ o mɛŋ fuud la yɛ, ka yina maal nyu'or maannɛ tis o mɛŋ, ka mɛ maali tis nidib la sɔs suguru tis o mɛŋ nɛ nidib la wʋsa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ka zaŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la kpaam nyu'oe maan daka la zug.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Onɛ zaŋ bʋʋg la keŋ bas ka li lieb teŋin bɔɔm la, o sɔb na pie o fuud ka sʋ, ka yʋ'ʋn lɛb la'asʋg zin'igin la na.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Ba na zaŋ na'araug nɛ bʋkanɛ ka ba zaŋi maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan ka mɔri ba ziim la kpɛn' zin'ikanɛ an Kasi Wʋsa Kasi la sɔs suguru tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla la gbana nɛ ni'im la wʋsa nɛ li pʋʋgin la'ad la yi yiŋi nyu'oe.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ka onɛ nyu'oe li la na pie o fuud ka sʋ ka nyaan kpɛn' la'asʋg zin'igin la.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: “Nwa' na an zi'elʋgʋ tisi ya saŋa wʋsa, nwadis ayɔpɔi la ni, li dabisa piiga la daar. Yanam nɛ saam banɛ la'am bɛ nɛ ya la na lɔ nɔɔr ka kʋ tʋm si'el daakan la,

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ daakan la maanmaan la na maal maannɛ sɔs suguru yisi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka kɛ ka ya an nyain Zugsɔb la tuon.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Li anɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm daare tisi ya, ka ya na sigisi ya mɛŋ ka lɔ nɔɔr; nwa' anɛ zi'elkanɛ na bɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: O na maal maannɛ sɔs suguru tis zin'ikanɛ an Kasi Wʋsa Kasi la, nɛ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la wʋsa, nɛ maan daka la, ka maal maana la sɔs suguru tis maanmaannib la, nɛ nidib la wʋsa.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Nwa' anɛ zi'elkanɛ na bɛ saŋa wʋsa tisi ya. Ka li na an maan kanɛ sɔsid suguru tisid Israel dim la wʋsa ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla, yʋʋm wʋsa pʋʋgin.” Ka o niŋ nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la zi'el si'em tis Moses la wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: “Pian'am tis Aaron nɛ o biribis la nɛ Israel dim la wʋsa ye Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye,

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: asɛɛ ka o mɔri li keŋ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin, ka li an maan Zugsɔb la tuon; ya'a ka' ala ninkan sɔba mɔr taal on yis ziim la zug, ba na yis o buudi la ni.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na zaŋ ziim la mis maan daka la gilig La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin, Zugsɔb la tuon, ka zaŋ kpaam la nyu'oe ka li an maan kanɛ malisi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye, “Ninkanɛ wʋsa an Israel buudi, bɛɛ o anɛ saan ka zaŋ nyu'or maana tis

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: ka pʋ mɔri li keŋ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrini tis Zugsɔb la, ba na yis ninkan sɔba Israel nidib la kallin.”

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Israel nid bɛɛ saan ya'a bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin, ka dit ziim, m sʋnf na duoe ka m yisi o sɔbi m nidib kallin.

english_verse: That's also why I have forbidden you to eat blood.
translation_verse: Alazug ka m da yɛl Israel dim ye, “Yanam Israel dim bɛɛ saan kanɛ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin da di ziim.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Israel nid sɔ' ya'a keŋ ieeb, ka kʋ bʋnkɔnbʋg bɛɛ bʋn-ian'adir linɛ ka ya na ɔnb, on kpa'ami li ziim la pin' teŋin.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ bʋnvʋr wʋsa vʋm bɛ nɛ o ziimin. Lin ka m yɛl Israel dim la ye ba da di ziim, ka bʋnvʋr wʋsa vʋm bɛ nɛ o ziimin la. Onɛ wʋsa dii li, ba na yis o sɔb o nidib kallin.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ wʋsa ɔnb bʋnkɔnbʋg kanɛ kpi, bɛɛ kɔnbkanɛ ka wɛɛgʋn bʋnkɔnbʋg kʋ, o sɔb ya'a anɛ ya mɛŋ nid bɛɛ saan, on piem o fuud la ka sʋ, ka an onɛ ka' nyainnɛ ti paae zaam ka yʋ'ʋn na an nyain.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a pʋ pie o fuud la ka sʋʋ o niŋgbina laa, o na mɔr taal.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛl Moses ye o

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: yɛlim Israel dim la ye: Man Zugsɔb la aan ya Wina'am.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya tʋm wʋʋ yanamɛ daa bɛ Egipt teŋin ka ba tʋm si'em la. Mid ka ya mɛ tʋm wʋʋ teŋ kanɛ buon Keenan ka m ye m mɔri ya keŋ la. Kʋdim da tʋmi ban tʋm si'em la baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Di anɛ tilas ye ya siaki m wada la ka tʋmi m nɔzi'ela la. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: Mid ka ya sɔ' digin nɛ o du'ad. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ mɛ digin nɛ fʋ saam pu'a sɔ', bɔzugɔ fʋ ya'a niŋ ala fʋ na diisi fʋ saam nyan.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ digin nɛ fʋ taʋn, o ya'a anɛ fʋ saam biig bɛɛ fʋ ma biiga, ba ya'a du'a o nɛ yin bɛɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa.

english_verse: Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter
translation_verse: Da digin nɛ fʋ biribiŋ pu'ayua bɛɛ fʋ pu'ayua biiga, ka li na an zufa'asim tisif.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ digin nɛ pu'a ka mɛ lɛn digin nɛ o pu'ayua. Mɛ da digin nɛ o biribiŋ bɛɛ o bipuŋ pu'ayua, bɔzugɔ ba du'am pʋ laligɛ. Li anɛ bʋn linɛ bi'e hali.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ nɔki fʋ pu'a bier bɛɛ o pitʋ ka o lieb o nintaa ka fʋ mɔr o dig ka fʋ pu'a nam vʋe.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ digin nɛ pu'a kanɛ nan nyɛ nu'ug saŋa kanɛ ka o ka' nyain la.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ digin nɛ fʋ tiraan pu'a bɔzugɔ, li na kɛ ka fʋn nɛ pu'a la wʋsa lieb dian'ad dim.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ zaŋi fʋ biigi tis ye ba nyu'oe o maal maannɛ tis win kanɛ ka ba buon ye Molek la, ka fʋ na san'am Wina'am yʋ'ʋr. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ digin nɛ fʋ dau tiraan wʋʋ ban dig nɛ pu'ab si'em la, ka li anɛ tʋʋmfɛn'ɛsʋg.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: Mid ka ya san'ami ya mɛŋ nɛ tʋʋm bama, bɔzugɔ buudbanɛ ka m ye m kadi ba yis ka tisi ya teŋ la tʋmnɛ tʋʋm bama san'ami ba mɛŋ.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Ala nɔɔ ka ba daa niŋi san'am teŋ la hali ka m tɛɛgi ba tʋbir ka kadi ba yis teŋin la.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, nimbanɛ da bɛ teŋin la da tʋm tʋʋm bama wʋsa ka li kɛ ka teŋ la lieb dian'ad.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a zan'as ka kɛ ka teŋ la dian'a, li na tʋbisi ya yis wʋʋ banɛ da dɛŋin bɛɛ ani la.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, dɔlli mam bɔɔd si'em la ka da dɔlli nimbanɛ da dɛŋin bɛɛ ani tʋm tʋʋmfɛn'ɛs-sieba ka yanam nyaan kenna la. Da dian'a ya mɛŋ nɛ tʋʋm banɛ. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel nidib la wʋsa ye, ‘Aaɛn kasi, bɔzugɔ, mam Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la anɛ kasi.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya bas mam ka dɔlli bada, bɛɛ nɔk kʋnti maal bʋnsi'a tisi ya mɛŋa. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.’”

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ye ya maal taaba la'asʋg maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la, yanam maali li lin nar si'em ka o di'e ya maan la.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Ya na dii li daakanɛ ka ya maal maan la, nɛ bɛkanɛ nied la, amaa linɛ kpɛlim la ya'a paae dabatan', ya na nyu'oe li.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a di dikanɛ kpɛlim daba atan' daar la, li ka' nyainnɛ ka Zugsɔb la kʋ di'e maan la.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɛkama dii li na nyɛ yɛltɔɔd, bɔzugɔ, o san'am bʋnsʋŋ linɛ an kasi tis Zugsɔb la. Asɛɛ ka ba yis ninkan sɔba o nidib kallin.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ɛɛnti bunni ya pɔɔd zʋʋd, yanam da bunni paad titɔndigin bɛɛ buni naae ka lɛn wi'isɛ.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya pɔn' ya vain tiis pɔɔd wala tak bɛɛ pi'is banɛ li teŋin la, amaa ya na kɛɛ li ka nɔŋ dim nɛ saam mɛ paam. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: Da zuu, bɛɛ tʋm ziri tʋʋma, bɛɛ pan'asidi taaba.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Da mɔri m yʋ'ʋri pɔɔd ziri pɔɔr ka li kɛ ka ya san'ami ya Wina'am yʋ'ʋrɛ. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: Da zammi fʋ tiraan bɛɛ faaɛn o. Sɔ' ya'a tʋm tisif, fʋn da kɛ ka o yɔɔd kpɛlimmi fʋ san'anɛ nie bɛogɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Da pɔ nɔɔri tis tʋbkpida bɛɛ nɔk linɛ ka nid na tu'ugi digil zu'om suorinɛ. Amaa fʋ na tisi fʋ Wina'am na'asi; manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Da ginnɛ ma'ad ziri tisidi fʋ taaba, bɛɛ di ziri kasɛt ka ba kʋʋ fʋ tiraan zaalim-zaalim. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: Da kisi fʋ ba'abiigi fʋ sʋnfʋnɛ; fʋ tiraan ya'a tʋm linɛ pʋ nara fʋn yɛl o nyain ka ala ka fʋn nɛ on kʋ la'am kpɛn' taalinɛ.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a maalif bɛ'ɛd fʋn da lɛbis o bɛ'ɛd bɛɛ gɛn'ɛd nɛ o sɔba. Amaa fʋ na nɔŋi fʋ tiraan wʋʋ fʋn nɔŋi fʋ mɛŋ si'em la. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Dɔlli nɛ m nɔzi'ela nwa'. Da kɛ ka bʋnkɔnbid banɛ ka' buudi yinne dʋ taabaa. Da bʋd bʋmbʋʋda buudi ayi' pɔɔg yinne nii. Da yɛ fukanɛ ka ba nɔk gum buudi ayi' ʋgɛ.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a digin nɛ pu'a kanɛ an yammʋg ka ba zaŋ o tis dau ye o lieb o pu'a, ka o nam pʋ yɔɔ o sam bɛɛ digin nɛ o, asɛɛ ka ba tɛɛg dau la nɛ pu'a la tʋbir. Li pʋ sʋ'ʋm ye ba kʋʋ ba, bɔzugɔ pu'a la nam pʋ sʋ'oe o mɛŋa.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan la na nɔk taal maan pɛraug la maal Zugsɔb la tuon, o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ ka o maal la yɛla, ka sɔs suguru tis o ka Zugsɔb na kɛɛ o taali bas.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a kpɛn' teŋin la bʋd tiwanna buudi wʋsa ka ba pin'il walib, ya na kisi ba wala la yʋma atan' ka kʋ dii lii.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Ka yʋʋm kanɛ paasid anaasi la, ba wala wʋsa na an kasi, ka an bareka pʋ'ʋsim piini tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Amaa yʋma anu la ni, ya na di wala la. Ala ka ba na wal wala pamm. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: Ya da ɔnb ni'im linɛ mɔr ziim. Mɛ da tʋmmi sɔnpʋt tʋʋma bɛɛ bʋgʋd ba'akɔnnɛ.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Ya da kisi ya mɛŋ niŋgbina nid onɛ kpi zugɔ, bɛɛ kisi ya niŋgbina gʋl si'elnama. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ kɛ ka fʋ pu'ayua tʋm pu'agɔɔndir tʋʋma ka san'am o yʋ'ʋr, ka teŋ la lieb pu'agɔɔnda teŋ, ka pɛ'ɛl nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Dɔllisiminɛ m Vʋ'ʋsʋm Dabisa la ka na'asidi m pʋ'ʋsim zin'ig la. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: Ya da fɛndigi ken ba'abʋgʋdib nɛ tima dim san'anɛ. Ya ya'a niŋ ala, ya na ganlimi ya mɛŋ. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Tisimi ya kpɛɛmnam nɛ bʋnkʋd na'asi, ka zɔti ya Wina'am la. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Teŋ zʋŋ nid ya'a bɛ nɛ yaa ya teŋin la, yanam da tʋm o linɛ an bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Teŋ zʋŋ nid ya'a bɛɛ ya san'an yanam maalim o wʋʋ teŋin biig nɛ. Ka nɔŋ o wʋʋ yanamɛ nɔŋi ya mɛŋ si'em; ka yanam mɛ da anɛ saam Egipt teŋin. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Li sʋm ye ya mɔr taslaas nɛ kuribanam nɛ la'abanɛ wʋsa ka ya na mɔri ma'ad la'ad la makid wʋʋ din nar si'em. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt teŋin na la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye o

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: yɛlim Israel dim la, ye ninkanɛ wʋsa an Israel nid, bɛɛ teŋ zʋŋ nid onɛ bɛ Israel teŋin ya'a nɔk o biigi kaanbi tis Molek Win la, ban kʋʋm o sɔba. Nimbanɛ bɛ teŋin la na lɔb o nɛ kugaa kʋ.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Mam mɛ na bid o kʋdʋg, ka yis o Israel nidib kallin, bɔzugɔ, o zaŋ o biribis sieba kaanbi tis Molek linɛ na dian'a m Fuug Sʋgʋrin la, ka san'ami m yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Ka teŋ la nidib ya'a nyɛ ka dau sɔ' nɔk o biigi kaanbi tis Molek ka sin ka pʋ kʋʋ o,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: mam mɛŋ na zab nɛ dau la nɛ o yidim wʋsa ka yis on nɛ nimbanɛ wʋsa dɔl o kaanbid Molek la ba nidib kallin.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ pʋ bɛɛ m san'anɛ ka dɔl ba'abʋgʋdib nɛ tima dimi tʋm nwɛnɛ pu'agɔɔndir nɛ, m na fɛndigi m nindaa o san'an, ka na yis o sɔba o nidib kallin.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Maalimi ya mɛŋ nyain ka an kasi, bɔzugɔ manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Dɔllini m wada nɛ m nɔzi'ela la ka tʋmi ba. Manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ maannɛ ya ka ya an kasi la.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a pɔ nɔɔri tis o saam bɛɛ o ma, ban kʋʋm o ka o taal bɛɛ o mɛŋ zug, on pɔ nɔɔri tis o saam bɛɛ o ma la zug.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Dau sɔ' ya'a san'am o tiraan pu'a, pu'a la nɛ dau la wʋsa anɛ ba kʋʋ ba.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Dau sɔ' ya'a digin nɛ o saam pu'a, o diis o saam nyan. Asɛɛ ka ba kʋʋ babayi' la, ka ba taal na bɛɛ ba mɛŋ zugin.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ka dau sɔ' ya'a digin nɛ o bipu'a, babayi' la nar ye ba kʋʋ ba, bɔzugɔ li anɛ tuugir ka pʋ tu'al baa bi'elaa. Ba taal na bɛɛ ba mɛŋ zugin.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ka dau sɔ' ya'a digin nɛ o dau tiraan wʋʋ ban digi nɛ pu'ab si'em la, babayi' la wʋsa tʋm dian'ad, li nar ye ba kʋʋ ba, ka ba taal bɛɛ ba mɛŋ zugin.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ka dau sɔ' ya'a di pu'a nɛ o ma, li anɛ pu'asan'auŋ, dau la nɛ pu'ab la nar ye ba nyu'oe ba nɛ bugum, ala na kɛ ka pu'asan'auŋ nwa' kʋ lɛm bɛɛ ya sʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ka pu'a sɔ' ya'a zaŋ o mɛŋi tis bʋnkɔnbʋg ka o dʋʋ o, ban kʋʋm pu'a la nɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg la wʋsa. Li nar ye ba kʋʋ ba, ka ba taal bɛɛ ba mɛŋ zug.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: Ka dau sɔ' ya'a dii o taʋn onɛ aan o saam pu'ayua bɛɛ o ma pu'ayua ka digin nɛ o, li anɛ zufa'asim. Asɛɛ ka ba kadi ba yisi ba nidibin. Dau la san'am o taʋn la zug, o taal bɛ nɛ o mɛŋ zugin.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka dau sɔ' ya'a digin nɛ pu'a kanɛ nyɛ nu'ug, o pa'al nɛ pu'a la nyan ka pu'a la mɛ bas o mɛŋ biel. Yisiminɛ babayi' la ya nidib kallin.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ digin nɛ fʋ ma bier bɛɛ o pitʋ, bɛɛ fʋ saam taʋn, bɔzugɔ li san'amnɛ du'am. Ya ya'a niŋ ala, taal bɛɛ ya babayi' la zugin.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Dau sɔ' ya'a digin nɛ o bier pu'a bɛɛ o pitʋ pu'a, li anɛ dian'ad, o diis o bier bɛɛ o pitʋ la nyan. Ba kʋ du'a biiga.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, tɛnri ka tʋmmi m nɔzi'ela nɛ m yɛla, ka teŋ kanɛ ka m mɔri ya keŋ ye ya zin'in la da tiin ya basɛ.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya dɔlli malima banɛ ka teŋ la dim dɔl ka m ye m kadi ba yisi ya nini ni la. Ba tʋʋm bama nwa' zug ka m sʋʋnr duoe nɛ ba hali.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Amaa mam mɛŋi yɛli ya ye ya na sʋ'ʋg teŋ la; m mɛŋi ye m zaŋi tisi ya ka li liebi ya faar. Li anɛ teŋ kanɛ ka siind nɛ bin'isim pʋbid. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ wɛligi ya yis nidib wʋsa sʋʋgin la.

english_verse: That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean—this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, li bɔɔd ye ya wɛlig bʋnkɔnbid banɛ an nyain nɛ banɛ ka' nyain nɛ. Ka wɛlig bʋn-ianda banɛ an nyain nɛ banɛ ka' nyain nɛ. Da ganlimi ya mɛŋ nɛ bʋnkɔnbid bɛɛ bʋn-ianda bɛɛ bʋnkanɛ vuud teŋgbauŋʋn ka m wɛligi tisi ya ye ba ka' nyain la.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Bɛɛi kasi tis mam, ka mam Zugsɔb la anɛ kasi; ka manɛ gaŋi ya ka ya bɛɛ ya kɔn' nɛ buudi wʋsa ye ya an mam din.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Dau bɛɛ pu'a onɛ tʋm ba'abʋgʋdib tʋʋma, bɛɛ sɔntʋʋma ban kʋʋm o. Ba lɔmmi ba nɛ kuga kʋ, ka ba taal na bɛɛ ba mɛŋ zugin.

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye, “Yɛlim maanmaannib banɛ an Aaron biribis la ye, ba du'ad ya'a kpi ban da si'is kum la ka lieb dian'ad dima.

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: bɛɛ o taʋn onɛ ka' sida ka o gɔsid o. On zug, o na tun'e lieb dian'ad sɔb.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Amaa o da dian'a o mɛŋi o pu'a kpin sɔ' kum yɛlaa.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Li pʋ sʋm ye maanmaannib pʋni ba zut, bɛɛ kɔɔnsi ba tieŋ, bɛɛ kisi ba niŋgbiŋ zin'isieba.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Sɛɛ ba an kasi tisi ba Wina'am, ka da san'ami ba Wina'am la yʋ'ʋrɛ. Ban an banɛ zaŋid nyu'or maannɛ tisid Wina'am, nɛ o diib la zug, li bɔɔd ye ba an kasi tis Wina'am.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Maanmaannib mid ka ba di pu'a kanɛ nan mi' an pu'agɔɔndir, bɛɛ pu'a kanɛ bas o sid, bɔzugɔ, ba anɛ kasi tisi ba Wina'am la.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi ba ka ba an kasi tis Wina'am, bɔzugɔ banɛ zaŋidi ya Wina'am diib la tisid o. Bɔzugɔ, man onɛ aan ya Zugsɔb la anɛ kasi ka mɛ maannɛ ya ka ya an kasi.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan sɔ' pu'ayua ya'a san'am o mɛŋ, ka lieb pu'agɔɔndir, o san'amnɛ o saam la zug, ba nɔkim o nyu'oe nɛ bugum.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: “Ka maanmaan onɛ an kpɛɛm, ka ba gaŋ o, o ba'abiisin la ka bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ o zug, ka lɛn gaŋ o ka o na yɛ fuud la, o da bas o zuobid ka li zunnim bɛɛ aans o fuud sʋnsa'aŋ zugɔ.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: O da si'is kum bɛɛ o san'am o mɛŋa, hali baa li ya'a anɛ o saam bɛɛ o maa.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: O da yi ka bas Fuug Sʋgʋr la, bɛɛ san'ami li, bɔzugɔ, ba bu'oe Wina'am malʋŋ kpaam niŋ o zug ka o lieb kasi. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: O dim pu'a kanɛ nan zi' dau.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: O da di pʋkɔɔnr, bɛɛ pu'a kanɛ bas o sid bɛɛ onɛ sidi bas o, bɛɛ onɛ an pu'agɔɔndirɛ; amaa o dim pu'asadir onɛ nan zi' dau, ka yii o mɛŋ nidibin na.

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: Ala ka o kʋ diis o biis nyannɛ o nidib sʋʋginɛ; manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ maal o kasi la.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ wʋsa mɔr dɛŋ da li'el naa. O ya'a anɛ zu'om bɛɛ wabʋg bɛɛ onɛ nindaa mɔr dɛŋ bɛɛ o lɔsi'a san'am,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: bɛɛ dau onɛ nɔbiri wabilim, bɛɛ o nu'ugʋ gɔŋ,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: bɛɛ onɛ kɔ' sakpanlʋŋ bɛɛ digir, bɛɛ on nif bɛɛ o niŋgbina mɔr wiim buudi wʋsa, bɛɛ onɛ ka ba zan' o.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Amaa on mɔr dɛŋ la zug, o da kpɛn' Fuug Sʋgʋrin paae fukanɛ bɛŋ la, bɛɛ li'el maan daka la; ala ka o kʋ san'ami m zin'ibanɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa la. Bɔzugɔ, manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ maannɛ ba kasi la.”

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ala ka Moses da pian' tis Aaron nɛ o biribis nɛ Israel dim wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Aaron nɛ o biribis la ye ba tisim maana banɛ an kasi ka Israel biribis la mɔri li na tisid mam Zugsɔb la girima. Linɛ na kɛ ka ba kʋ san'ami m yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye, ba dɔɔg ninkanɛ wʋsa ka' nyainnɛ ka ti li'el maan banɛ an nyain ka Israel dim zaŋi tis Zugsɔb la, m na yis ninkan sɔba m san'an. Mam anɛ Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Aaron yaaŋ ya'a mɔr niŋgbina san'auŋ ban'as, bɛɛ mɛt ya'a yiti o niŋgbina ni na, o da di maan piini diib linɛ an nyain la, asɛɛ ka ba maal o ka o lieb nyain. Sɔ' mɛ ya'a si'is bʋn linɛ kpi wʋsa, bɛɛ o daulim ku'om ya'a yit,

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Amaa zaam ya'a ma'ae, o na an nyain ka li nya'aŋ ka o nyaan di dikanɛ an nyain la, bɔzugɔ, li anɛ o diib.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: O da ɔnb bʋnkɔnbkpiilʋŋ, bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg kanɛ ka o bʋnkɔnbtiraan kʋʋ, ka li ka' nyainnɛ; mam anɛ Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Ba siakim tʋm linɛ ka m zi'el la, linɛ na kɛ ka ba kʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka kpii. Manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ kɛt ka ba an kasi la.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: “Onɛ ka' maanmaan la dɔɔg nid da di dikanɛ an maan la diibɔ, hali li ya'a anɛ maanmaan la saan bɛɛ o tʋmtʋm, on da dii lii.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Amaa maanmaan ya'a da' o sankpan'as nɛ ligidi bɛɛ sankpan'as kanɛ ka ba du'a o yin, ba mɔr suor ye ba dii o diib la.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la bipuŋ ya'a kul onɛ ka' maanmaan la dɔɔg nid, o da di dikanɛ an piinkanɛ an nyain laa.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan bipuŋ sɔ' ya'a lieb pʋkɔɔnr, bɛɛ o yinɛ ka bas o sid, ka pʋ mɔr biiga, ka lɛb o saam yin wʋʋ on da nam pʋ kul dau saŋsi'a la, o na tun'e dii o saam diib la; amaa onɛ pʋ yi maanmaan dɔɔgin da dii lii.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Da zaŋ bʋn linɛ wʋsa mɔr dɛŋi maal maannɛ, ka li kʋ di'e.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Aaron nɛ o biribis nɛ Israel dim la wʋsa ye, ‘Onɛ wʋsa an Israel nid, bɛɛ saan onɛ bɛ Israel dim sʋʋgin ka ye o zaŋ o piini tis, ka li ya'a anɛ o pʋ'ʋlʋmnɛ zi'el bɛɛ ya'amlɛog maan ka ba ye ba zaŋi tis Zugsɔb ka li an nyu'or piini,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a maal nɛ taaba la'asʋg maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la ye o lɛbis on pʋ'ʋlʋm zi'el la, bɛɛ ya'amlɛog piini, li ya'a anɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg buudi wʋsa, li sʋm ka li an sʋ'ʋŋa ka ka' dɛŋŋa; ya'a ka' ala, li kʋ di'e.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Ya na tun'e nɔk naaf bɛɛ pɛ'og kanɛ wabilim bɛɛ pʋ nɔbigi paae lin nar si'em maal ya'amlɛog piini maan, amaa ya ya'a nɔk bʋnkɔnbban taaba maal maan kanɛ ka ya pʋ'ʋlʋm zi'elɛɛ, li kʋ di'e.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Da zaŋi bʋnkɔnbkanɛ ka ba zan' o bɛɛ li mɔr dɛŋ bɛɛ fɛn'ɛdi maal maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la. Mid ka ya maal lina ya mɛŋ teŋin.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ya mɛ da di'e bʋnkɔnbbama taaba teŋ zʋŋ nid san'anɛ maali maan kanɛ an diib maannɛ tisi ya Wina'am la. Ban mɔr dɛŋ la zug, ba kʋ di'e baa.’”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la da lɛm pian' tis Moses ye,

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Naaf bɛɛ pɛ'og bɛɛ bʋʋg ya'a du'a, li sʋm ye li bɛ nɛ o ma la daba ayɔpɔi. Ka daba anii la fʋ tun'e zaŋ bʋmbil la maal nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la ka o na di'e.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ na'anya'aŋ bɛɛ pɛnya'aŋ, da zaŋ o kɔdig nɛ o biig daar yinne.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a maannɛ piinkanɛ anɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsʋg maan, fʋn maalimi li lin nar si'em ka Wina'am na di'e tisif.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka ya ɔnbi li daakan la wʋsa ka si'el da kpɛlim ka bɛog nie; manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: “Ya na mɔri m zi'ela la ka dɔlli ba sʋ'ʋŋa. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Daba ayuobʋ ka ya na tʋmmi ya mɛŋ tʋʋma, amaa daba ayɔpɔi la anɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir, li anɛ la'asʋg dabisir ka an mam Zugsɔb la din nyain. Yanamɛ bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa, yanam da tʋmmi dabiskan la daarɛ, li anɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisire tis Zugsɔb la. Kum Maliak Gaadʋg nɛ bodobodo linɛ pʋ gɛndig danbin malʋŋ la yɛla (Kal

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kʋ tʋm si'el daakan la bɔzugɔ li anɛ Suguru Sɔsʋg Maan dabisir, ka ya na maal Suguru Sɔsʋg Maannɛ tisi ya Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la.

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la pin'inɛ nwadig kanɛ an yiiga la dabpiiga nɛ anaasi daar zaam, winnig ya'a ti kpɛn'ɛd saŋa si'a la.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Daba ayɔpɔi ka ya na maal nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la. Ka daba ayɔpɔi la daar yanam on la'asim la'asʋg linɛ an kasi. Mid ka ya tʋm dabiskaŋa.” Zʋʋd linɛ an yiiga malʋŋ la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye, ‘Ya ya'a ti kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka m ye m tisi ya la, ka buni li zʋʋd, yanam mɔr zʋʋd linɛ ka ya bʋn yiiga la na tis maanmaan la.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: la'an nɛ zɔmbaanlig kuriba atan' ka ba gɛndig nɛ kpaam ka li an zʋʋd maan ka li anɛ maan kanɛ nyu'od ka li nyuug la malisi tis Zugsɔb la, nɛ bʋnnuuda maan daam kɔlibir yinne.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Mid ka ya nɔk zʋʋd linɛ an bʋndɛɛnna la maal bodobodo bɛɛ ya sɛn' li zʋʋd la di, asɛɛ yanamɛ na ti maal malimbama tisi ya Wina'am la naae. Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ malʋŋ kanɛ ka ya na maan nɛ ya yaas banɛ na ti duoe na, yanamɛ bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa.’” Bakuainam Malʋŋ yɛla (Kal

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Da tʋmi si'el baa bi'elaa. Nɛ' anɛ zi'elʋg kanɛ na bɛ saŋa wʋsa hali nɛ zʋmaana banɛ na ti duoe na, yanamɛ kʋdim bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a maali ya zʋʋd maan kanɛ an nyɔɔsʋŋ la Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir ka bɛog nie, yanam kaalimi dabisa hali ti paae bakuainama ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa ya na yisi li nɛɛm zɔmbaanlig kuriba atan' gɛndig nɛ dabinnɛ maali sɛn' bodobodo gbila ayi' mɔri kena tis Zugsɔb la, ka li an nyɔɔsʋŋ maan kanɛ an zʋʋd kanɛ ka ya dɛŋi bʋn la maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Nɔkim bodobodo kaŋa paas nɛ pɛribis ayɔpɔi banɛ nan an yʋʋm yinne ka pʋ mɔr dɛŋŋa n maal maan la, nɛ na'arapɔl nɛ pɛraad ayi'. Li na anɛ nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la, la'an nɛ ba zʋʋd piini nɛ daam piini; li anɛ maan kanɛ nyu'od bugum ka li nyuug la malisi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Ka nɔk bʋraugʋ maal maan ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, nɛ pɛbibis ayi' ka ba wʋsa an yʋʋm yinne-yinne ka li an taaba la'asʋg maan.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na nɔk pɛbibis ayi' la nyɔɔsim Zugsɔb la tuon ka li an nyɔɔsʋŋ maan, la'an nɛ bodobodo linɛ ka ba nɔk zʋʋd kanɛ ka ba bʋn yiiga maal la. Maan bama anɛ linɛ ka ba pɛsigi tis Zugsɔb la ka li an nyain ka an maanmaan la din.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a buni fʋ pɔɔg zʋʋd, fʋn da buni paae titɔndiginɛ bɛɛ fʋ buni naae ka lɛn wi'isɛ. Basim tis nɔŋ dim bɛɛ banɛ an saam la. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la. Na'atana di'ema (Kal

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: “Nwadis ayɔpɔi nwa' dabpiiga daare na an Suguru Sɔsʋg Maan dabisir. Nidib la na la'as taaba la'asʋg kanɛ an Zugsɔb la din nyain la, ka sigisi ba mɛŋ ka lɔ nɔɔr, ka maal nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Li anɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm daare tisi ya, ka ya na sigisi ya mɛŋ ka lɔ nɔɔr. Lin yi nwadig la daba awai la daar zaam, asɛɛ ka ya tiɛn vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la yɛla ti paae li yimbɛog zaam.” Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ (Kal

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Dabisir kanɛ an yiiga la, zaŋimi tiis wala banɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa la, nɛ kpʋkparis wila, nɛ tiis banɛ wila mɔr vaandi maal sumalisim Zugsɔb la tuon daba ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye, ‘Nwadis ayɔpɔi la dabpiiga nɛ anu la daar ka Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ la na pin'ili mɔr ala paae daba ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Dabisir kanɛ an yiiga la, nidib la na la'as taaba la'asʋg kanɛ an Zugsɔb la din nyain la, ka kʋ tʋm ban ɛɛnti tʋm si'em dabisir wʋsa laa.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Daba ayɔpɔi ka ya na maal nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la, ka daba anii la daar ka ya na la'as taaba la'asʋg kanɛ an Zugsɔb la din nyain la, ka maal nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la. Li anɛ malʋŋ la naar la'asʋg, da tʋmi tʋʋma daakan la.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: “‘Malimbama ka Zugsɔb la da zi'el, ka ya na mɔɔl ka nidib la la'as taaba la'asʋg kanɛ an kasi tis Zugsɔb la, ka maal maan banɛ ka ba nyu'od bugum tisid Zugsɔb la. Maana la anɛ nyu'or maan nɛ zʋʋd maan nɛ taaba la'asʋg maan nɛ bʋnnuuda maan linɛ nar ye ya maan dabisir wʋsa la.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Malimbama ka ya na maali paas Zugsɔb Vʋ'ʋsʋm Dabisa la ka mɛ paas piini banɛ ka ya tisid saŋa wʋsa la, nɛ linɛ wʋsa ka ya pʋ'ʋlʋm zi'el, nɛ ya ya'amlɛog piini linɛ ka ya tisid Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: “‘Lin yi nwadis ayɔpɔi la dabpiiga nɛ anu la daar, saŋkanɛ ka ya buni ya zʋʋdi naae la nya'aŋ, yanam on maal malʋŋ kaŋa di'ema daba ayɔpɔi. Dabisir kanɛ an yiiga la anɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir, daba anii la mɛ lɛn anɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Maalimi di'ema malʋŋ kaŋa tis Zugsɔb la daba ayɔpɔi yʋʋm wʋsa pʋʋgin. Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ zi'elkanɛ na bɛ saŋa wʋsa hali nɛ zʋmaana banɛ na ti duoe na la, maalimi di'ema la nwadis ayɔpɔi la ni.

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ala ka ya yaas na baŋ ye, man da yis Israel dim Egipt teŋin na la, ba da bɛnɛ sʋga ni. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.’”

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Ka Moses mɔɔl malima banɛ ka Zugsɔb la zi'el la yɛla tis Israel dim la.

english_verse: a broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, or a tooth for a tooth.
translation_verse: Onɛ kɔ'ɔg sɔ' kɔnbir ba mɛ na kɔ'ɔgi o kɔnbir; nif yɔɔdi nif sam ka nyin mɛ yɔɔd nyin sam. On pu'alim sɔ' la, li anɛ ba pu'alim o mɛn.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa kʋ bʋnkɔnbʋg asɛɛ ka o yɔɔ li sam, amaa onɛ kʋ ninsaal, asɛɛ ba kʋʋ o mɛn.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye asɛɛ ka ba mɔr olif kpaam linɛ an nyain na ka ba nyu'oe fita la ka li dit saŋa wʋsa ka kʋ kpiigɛ.

english_verse: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change. The Sacred Bread The Lord said:
translation_verse: Li anɛ tilas ye o gɔsid fita banɛ sʋn'e zi'esa banɛ ka ba maal nɛ sanlima ma'aa ka li zi'e Zugsɔb tuonnɛ kpɛn dit saŋa wʋsa la.” Malʋŋ bodobodo la yɛla

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: “Nɔkim zɔmbaanlig kuriba ayi' maal bodobodo gbila piiga nɛ ayi'.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Zi'elimi ba kuurig kuurigi tuunl taaba zin'is ayi' teebul kanɛ ka ba nɔk sanlima ma'aa maal ka li zi'e Zugsɔb tuon la, ka kuurig yinne wʋsa mɔr bodobodo gbila ayuobʋ.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Nɔkim bʋnnyubisa niŋ kuurig wʋsa ni ka li an tiɛnr bʋn linɛ zi'e bodobodo la zi'esim ka na an nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Bodobodo kaŋa ba na zi'el Zugsɔb la tuon Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir wʋsa, ka li yinɛ Israel dim san'an, ka an nɔnaar linɛ na bɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Bodobodo kaŋa na anɛ Aaron nɛ o biribis din, ka ba na diti li zin'ikanɛ an kasi la, bɔzugɔ li anɛ kasi tis Zugsɔb la, ka aan ba pʋʋr linɛ ka ba na di'esid saŋa wʋsa yit piini linɛ an nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la ni.” Ban da lɔb onɛ san'am Zugsɔb yʋ'ʋr nɛ kuga la

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Ka ba yɔɔ o gur Zugsɔb la na ti nie pa'ali ba ban na niŋ si'em.”

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye;

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Mɔri onɛ san'am Zugsɔb yʋ'ʋr la yii ya la'asʋg zin'ig la yiŋ. Banɛ wʋsa wʋm ka o pian'ad ala la na nɔki ba nu'usi pa'al o zugin, ka banɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa lɔb o nɛ kuga.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Onɛ san'am Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, asɛɛ ba kʋ o sɔb. Nidib la wʋsa na lɔb o nɛ kuga. Onɛ an saan bɛɛ onɛ ka ba du'a o teŋin la wʋsa, o sɔb ya'a san'am Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, asɛɛ ba kʋʋ o.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: “‘Sɔ' ya'a kʋʋ o tiraan, asɛɛ ka ba mɛ kʋʋ o.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a kʋʋ o tiraan bʋnkɔnbʋg, asɛɛ ka o yɔɔ li sam nɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg kanɛ zem ala. Nyɔvʋri yɔɔd nyɔvʋr sam.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a pu'alimi o tiraan, on pu'alim o zin'isi'a la wʋsa asɛɛ ka ba mɛ pu'alim o sɔb zin'ikan la yɔ sam.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Ya na mɔri wada yinne tis onɛ an saan nɛ onɛ an teŋin biig wʋsa. Manɛ an Zugsɔb, onɛ aan ya Wina'am la.’”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Moses da pian' tis Israel dim la, ye ba yisim onɛ san'amid Zugsɔb yʋ'ʋr la ba la'asʋg zin'ig la yiŋi lɔb o nɛ kuga. Ka Israel dim la sid da niŋ wʋʋ Zugsɔb la zi'eli tis Moses si'em la.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Fʋ na da' li yii fʋ teŋ nid la san'an ka li dɔl wʋʋ yʋma banɛ kpɛlim malʋŋ di'ema nya'aŋ la, ka onɛ mɛ kuos ka li dɔl wʋʋ yʋma banɛ kpɛlim ka ya na bun zʋʋd la.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses Sinai Zuor la zug ye,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye, ‘Ya ya'a ti kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka m bɔɔd ye m tisi ya la, nwɛnɛ yanamɛ mɔr Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir si'em la, li anɛ tilas ye teŋ la mɛ mɔr vʋ'ʋsʋm saŋa tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Amaa yʋʋm kanɛ paasid ayɔpɔi la na anɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm yʋʋme tis teŋ la. Li anɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm saŋa tis Zugsɔb la. Da bʋdi ya pɔɔd la bɛɛ ya maali pɛsi ya tiwanna yʋʋm kan la.

english_verse: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ pʋ kuod la, kiyɛɛd ya'a yi, yanam da buni li suu ya bʋya nii, ka yanamɛ pʋ pɛsid tiwanna la, walyɛɛd ya'a bɛ yanam mɛ da pɔn' ba kuosɛ. Pɔɔd la sʋm ka ba vʋ'ʋs yʋʋm yinne.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ya yin bʋnkɔnbid la nɛ sian'arin bʋnkɔnbid banɛ bɛ teŋin la. Zʋʋd wʋsa linɛ yi teŋin la na anɛ diibi tisi ya.’” Malʋŋ di'ema yʋʋm

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: O saam kpɛɛm bɛɛ o saambil bɛɛ o ba'abiig sɔ' na nyaŋi yɔ ka di'e o, bɛɛ onɛ kpinnɛ ba tuŋ la, bɛɛ o mɛŋ ya'a paam ligidi, o na nyaŋi yɔ ka di'e o mɛŋ.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Nwadkanɛ paas ayɔpɔi la dabpiiga daar ka ya na pieb na'atana ya teŋin la zin'ig wʋsa. Dabiskanɛ an Suguru Sɔsʋg Malʋŋ la daar, piebimi na'atana zin'ig wʋsa teŋ la zug.

english_verse: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.
translation_verse: Maalimi yʋʋm kanɛ paas pisnu la ka li an kasi tis Zugsɔb la, ka mɔɔli tis teŋ la nidib wʋsa yɔlisim yʋʋm la yɛla. Li anɛ malʋŋ di'ema tisi ya, ka sɔ' wʋsa na lɛb o mɛŋ paalʋ ni nɛ o yidimin nɛ o tuŋ dimin.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Li anɛ malʋŋ di'ema ka an kasi tisi ya. Dimi bʋn linɛ wʋsa yii li mɛŋ pɔɔdin la.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: “Yʋʋm kanɛ an malʋŋ di'ema la, sɔ' wʋsa na lɛbi kua paalʋ kanɛ ka o sʋ'oe la.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Yʋma la ya'a zu'oe li sʋm ka ligidi la mɛ zu'oe, amaa yʋma la ya'a pɔɔd ligidi la mɛ na sie, bɔzugɔ on kuosid si'eli tisidif la anɛ fʋn na bʋd yʋma si'em bɛn.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Da nɔki dinzugʋ filim taabaa, amaa zɔmini ya Wina'am la. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Ala ka teŋ la zʋʋd na maal sʋ'ʋŋa, ka ya dii tig ka bɛ teŋ la zug ka dabiem kae.”

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Daasi'erɛɛ ya na bu'os ye, “Ti ya'a pʋ bʋd bɛɛ bun zʋʋd yʋʋm kanɛ paas ayɔpɔi la, ti na di bɔ?”

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: M na niŋi ya bareka yʋʋm kanɛ paasi ayuobʋ la ni, ka ya pɔɔd la zʋʋd na maal ka li sia'al yʋma atan' diib.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti bʋd yʋʋm anii la saŋa; ya na kpɛn dit dikʋdʋg la. Hali ya na dii ala paae bunib saŋa, yʋma awai la ni.

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: “‘Mid ka ya kuosi paalʋ tis sɔ' ka o sʋ'oe li saŋa wʋsa bɔzugɔ, manɛ sʋ'oe teŋ la, amaa ka yanam lɛɛ bɛɛ m san'an wʋʋ saam ka guri li.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ kanɛ ka ya sʋ'oe la bɛn wʋsa, ya'a nwɛnɛ sɔ' kuosi o pɔɔg, yanam maal suor ka o na tun'e yɔ ka di'e pɔɔg la.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: “‘Ya nid yinne ya'a ti lieb nɔŋdaan ka kuosidi o faar, onɛ kpin nɛ o la na yɔ ka di'e li.

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: asɛɛ o gɛligi li ligidi gɔs on da' saŋsi'a, ka yɔ sam kanɛ kpɛlim la tis onɛ da' pɔɔg la, o ya'a niŋ ala o na nyaŋi lɛbi di'e li sʋ'oe ya'as.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a kʋ nyaŋi nyɛ ligidi yɔɔ, on kuos si'el la na kpɛm bɛ onɛ da' la nu'usin ti paae yʋʋm kanɛ an yʋʋm pisnu malʋŋ di'ema la. Ba na lɛbisi tis o nɛ malʋŋ di'ema la saŋa, saŋkan ka o yʋ'ʋn na lɛbi sʋ'oe o bʋn.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: “‘Sɔ' ya'a kuosi o yir tempʋkanɛ ka ba mɛ zaŋguommi gilig la pʋʋgin, o mɔr suori na lɛn di'e li yʋʋm yinne saŋa. Saŋkan ya'a nam pʋ gaadɛ o na nyaŋi di'e li.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a pʋ di'e li ka yʋʋm yinne la ya'a gaad, yir kanɛ bɛ tempʋʋgin la yʋ'ʋn na kpɛn anɛ onɛ da' la bʋn, ka o sʋ'oe li saŋa wʋsa, on nɛ o yaas, ka kʋ lɛn lɛbisi li tis onɛ da kuosi li yʋʋm pisnu malʋŋ di'ema saŋa la ya'asɛ.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Amaa ya' banɛ bɛ teŋkpɛmbanɛ ka ba pʋ mɛ zaŋguoma gilig la, ya na niŋi ba wʋʋ pɔɔd nɛ. Yir la sɔb na tun'e yɔɔ lɛbis ka di'e li yʋʋm kanɛ ka ba lɛbisid la'adi tisid la.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: “‘La'an nɛ nɛ' wʋsa, Levi dim la mɔr suori na lɛn di'e ba ya' banɛ bɛɛ ba Levi dim tempʋʋg si'a ni saŋsi'a wʋsa.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amaa paalʋ banɛ ka ba kem kɔnbid ka li kpi'enɛ ba tempʋʋd la, ba sɔ' kʋ kuosɛ bɔzugɔ, li anɛ ba din saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: “‘Nid yinne ya'a bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin ka nɔŋ kpɛn' o ka o pʋ tun'e gɔsid o mɛŋa, yanam sʋŋim o wʋʋ saanne na bɛɛ ya teŋin bɛɛ sɔ' na kena ye o bɛ nɛ ya saŋa bi'ela ka ya na sʋŋ o si'em la. Ala ka o na nyaŋi kpɛm bɛ nɛ ya.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Da pɛ'ɛŋ ligidi tis o ka pa'al nyɔɔdi li zugɔ, bɛɛ, kuos diibi tis o ka pa'al nyɔɔdi li zugɔ.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb onɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt teŋin na ye m tisi ya Keenan teŋ la, ka aan ya Wina'am.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: “‘Ya nid yinne ya'a ti lieb nɔŋdaan ka kuosi o mɛŋi tisi ya nid yinne, on da kɛ ka o tʋm wʋʋ o anɛ yammʋga.

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: Niŋim o wʋʋ fʋn na nɔk sɔ' ye o tʋm sʋ'ʋŋif, bɛɛ sɔ' na kena ye o bɛ nɛ ya dabisa bi'ela, o na tʋmmi tisidif hali ti paae yʋʋm pisnu kanɛ an malʋŋ di'ema la.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la fʋ na bas on nɛ o biribis la ka ba lɛbi ba dɔɔg dimi bɛ zin'isi'a, nɛ o yaanam sʋ'ʋlimin.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, Israel dim la anɛ man yammis banɛ ka m mɔri ba yi Egipt na, li pʋ sʋm ka ba kuosi ba wʋʋ ba anɛ sankpan'ansnama.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Zɔmi ya Wina'am la ka da maali ba bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.
translation_verse: Ya mɛ na nyaŋi da' banɛ nam bɛ nɛ ya la, nɛ ba nimbanɛ ka ba du'a ba ya teŋin la, ka na sʋ'oe ba.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Ya mɛ na nyaŋi pian' zi'el ka ya biribis ti sʋ'oe ba ka li aan ba faar, ka ba na aan ba sankpan'asnam ba nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsa, amaa da mɔri ya taaba banɛ an Israel dim la mugusida.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: “‘Saan bɛɛ onɛ kena ye o zin'inɛ ya san'an bi'ela ka lieb bʋmmɔr, ka ya nid yinne lieb nɔŋdaan ka kuosi o mɛŋi tis saan la bɛɛ saan la dɔɔg buudi nid,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: suor bɛ ka ba na ti yɔ ka di'e o, la'an nɛ on kuosi o mɛŋi tis la, o sizua bɛɛ o dɔɔg la nid na nyaŋi yɔ ka di'e o.

english_verse: The longer the time until then, the more you will have to pay.
translation_verse: Yʋʋm pisnu malʋŋ di'ema la ya'a kpɛlim pʋ zu'oe, asɛɛ ka o gɛligi li yɔ ka di'e o mɛŋ nwɛnɛ lin nar si'em.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka ya niŋ o wʋʋ onɛ ka ba nɔkid o yʋʋm wʋsa ka o tʋm nɛ, asɛɛ ya gɔs ka onɛ da' o la da mɔr o mugusida.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: “‘Hali baa ba ya'a pʋ yɔ ka di'e o yʋʋm bama nii, on nɛ o biribis la anɛ ba tisi ba yɔlisim Yʋʋm pisnu malʋŋ di'ema saŋa la.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Manɛ sʋ'oe Israel dim la, ba anɛ mam yammis banɛ ka m mɔri ba yi Egipt na. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.’”

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɔlli m Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la sʋ'ʋŋa ka na'asi m Pʋ'ʋsim Zin'ig la; manɛ an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: mam na kɛ ka saa niid lin nar saŋa si'a ka kɛ ka teŋgbauŋ zʋʋd du'a, ka tiis la na wali ba wala.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: M mɛ na kɛ ka sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛ teŋin la, ka ya ya'a digi, sɔ' kʋ kɛ ka dabiem mɔri ya. M mɛ na lɛn kad mɔɔgin bʋnyuos teŋ la zugʋ yis, ka tanp kʋ li'eli ya teŋin la na.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Amaa ya na nyaŋi kadi ya dataas la paae ba kʋ.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Man na mɔr nyɔɔg nɛ ya, ka kɛ ka ya nɔbig ka paas kal pʋʋgin, ka kɛ ka m nɔnaar na bɛ nɛ ya.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Ka linɛ lɛm pɛ'ɛs, m na bɛ nɛ ya ka kʋ zan'asi ya kpan-kpan nɛ.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: M mɛ na la'am ken nɛ ya ka aan ya Wina'am, ka yanam mɛ na aan m nidib.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la, manɛ da mɔri ya yi Egipt teŋin la na, ye ya kʋ lɛn aan ba yammisɛ, ka kɔ' yɔksin dabanɛ gɛɛli ya niŋgɔnya la ka tisi ya yɔlisim, ka kɛ ka ya ken ka ya zug pʋ lɛn ziida, ka bi'esʋg kae.

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: ya ya'a ki'isi m wada la, ka zan'asi m zi'ela ka pʋ dɔlisi m nɔzi'ela la wʋsa sʋ'ʋŋaa ka san'ami m nɔnaar la,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: ya ya'a niŋ ala man ye m tʋmi ya si'em nwa': M na gbirigi mɔr mugustita'ar na namisi ya, ka na mɔr ban'as linɛ ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi ti'ebɛ nɛ niŋtʋʋlʋg linɛ na kɛ ka ya zu'om ka kʋ mɔr sumalisim. Linɛ lɛm pɛ'ɛs, ya na bʋdi ya pɔɔd zaalim, bɔzugɔ, ya dataas na faaɛn li ka dii li zʋʋd la wʋsa.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: M na bidi m kʋdig ka basi ya, ka ya dataas na nyɛ suori nyaŋi ya, ka banɛ kisi ya la na paam paŋi sʋ'oe ya; ka ya na zɔt zaalim hali ka sɔ' pʋ kati yaa.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Ka linɛ lɛm pɛ'ɛs ya'asɛ, yɛlbama ya'a gaad ka ya nam pʋ siak m nɔɔrɛ, alaa m na tɛki ya tʋbir nɔɔrim bʋyɔpɔi, ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: Ka na lɛn sie ya nyɛɛsim la, ka mɛ na lɛm maal ka saŋgbauŋ la na nwɛnɛ kʋnt nɛ tisi ya, ka ya teŋgbauŋ la mɛ na kpi'em wʋʋ kʋntzɛn'ug nɛ.

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: Ya paŋ na san'am zaalim, bɔzugɔ, ya teŋgbauŋ zʋʋd kʋ maalɛ, ka tiis banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋʋn la kʋ wali ba walaa.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: “Ya ya'a nam zan'asidi m nɔɔr ka pʋ di'edi m sa'alʋgɔ, m na kɛ ka ya tɔɔg la paas zin'is ayɔpɔi, wʋʋ ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la nar si'em.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka mɔɔgin bʋnyuos kena zab nɛ ya, ka ba na kʋʋ ya biribis, ka san'ami ya niigi, ka sie ya kal, ka ya suoya dig zaalim.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: M mɛ na lɛn kɛ ka tanp duoe ka ba kʋʋ ya, ka li an sam yɔɔb, m nɔnaar san'auŋ la yɛla. Ka ya ya'a zɔɔ la'as taaba ya tempʋʋdin la, m na kɛ ka tɔɔg sigi ya sʋʋgin na, ka li na kɛ ka ya dataas na nyaŋi ya.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: M na sie ya diib hali ka pu'ab piiga na tun'e maali ya diib dan'aŋ yinne ni, ka sie li tɛbisim, ka ya dit ka pʋ tigida.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: m sʋnf na pɛlig nɛ ya ka m mɛ zan'asi ya ka namisi ya nɔɔr ayɔpɔi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Ya na ɔnbi ya biribis nɛ ya bipumis, kɔ'ɔm zug.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Ka m na san'ami ya teŋgbana nɛ maana zin'ibanɛ bɛ kʋkʋna zut la, ka nwa'ae daka banɛ ka ya nyu'od bʋnnyubisa li zutin la. M na kɛ ka ya kpii pa'ae ya bada banɛ ka' nyɔvʋr la zug, bɔzugɔ mam na kisigi ya.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ya tempʋʋd la lieb dabɔɔd, ka lɛn kɛ ka ya pʋ'ʋsim zin'is lieb nɛɛm. Hali ya ya'a nyu'od maan li nyuug kʋ lɛm malisi ma.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: M na san'ami ya teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa ka ya dataas banɛ na kpɛn' bɛɛ anina la na lidigi li yɛla.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Man na widigi ya tɛɛns la sʋʋgin ka na fuoe m sʋ'ʋgʋ kadi ya. Ya teŋ la na kpɛlim zaalim, ka ya tempʋʋd la nwa'a-nwa'a lieb dabɔɔd.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ wʋsa ka li dig zaalim la li na vʋ'ʋs vʋ'ʋsʋm kanɛ ka li da pʋ nyɛɛ, yanamɛ da bɛɛ ani la.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Ya na tu'usidi lit taaba zug wʋʋ zabzabidibi kati ya nɛ, la'an nɛ sɔ' pʋ kati ya la, ka kʋ nyaŋi zi'enɛ zab nɛ ya dataasɛ.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ kpɛlim bɛɛ ya dataas tɛɛnsin la na yaali ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug; ya yaanam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug ba na san'am.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: ka lin zug ka mam mɛ da zan'asi ba ka nɔki ba niŋi ba dataas tɛɛnsin la. Amaa ba ya'a sigisi ba mɛŋ ka tiaki ba sʋnya linɛ digilim la, ka yɔɔ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sam,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: m mɛ na tiɛn m nɔnaar nɛ Jakob, nɛ Isaak, nɛ Abraham, ka la'am tiɛn teŋgbauŋ la yɛla.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, ba na bas teŋgbauŋ la ka li vʋ'ʋs, saŋkanɛ ka li dig zaalim ka ba kae la. Ba na yɔɔ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la sam, bɔzugɔ ba nɛ'ɛsi m wada la ka zan'asi m zi'ela.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Ka la'an nɛ nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa, ba ya'a bɛɛ ba dataas teŋin, m kʋ zan'asi ba bɛɛ kisigi ba ka san'ami ba nyainnɛ, bɛɛ san'ami m nɔnaar nɛ ba. Bɔzugɔ manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba Wina'am la.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Amaa ba yɛla ka m na tiɛn m nɔnaar nɛ ba yaanam banɛ ka m da mɔri ba yi Egipt teŋin na la, ye m na aan ba Wina'am ka buudi bɛdegʋ nidib da nyɛ la. Manɛ an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Bama an zi'ela nɛ wada banɛ ka Zugsɔb la da maali digili tis o mɛŋ nɛ Israel dim ka li yit Moses san'an na, Sinai Zuor zugin la.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: Yɛlim Israel dim la ye sɔ' ya'a kaanb linɛ an nimmua kaanbʋgʋ zi'el, ka li anɛ ye o na nɔk ninsaali pɛsigi tis Zugsɔb la, ka o nɔk ligidi linɛ na zem wʋʋ ninsaal nɛ,

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: Ki bɛɛ bʋmbʋta wʋsa linɛ ka ya bʋd teŋ la zug, li ya'a anɛ zʋʋd linɛ yit teŋin na bɛɛ wala linɛ yi tiig zug na, li pʋdigir piiga wʋsa yinne anɛ Zugsɔb la din ka li an kasi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
translation_verse: O mid ka o lɛbis bɛɛ tiaki li, ka nɔk bʋnkɔnbsʋŋʋ tiak bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og, bɛɛ nɔk bʋnkɔnbbɛ'ogʋ tiak bʋnkɔnbsʋŋ; o ya'a nɔk bʋnkɔnbʋgʋ tiak bʋnkɔnbsi'a, babayi' la wʋsa na lieb Zugsɔb la din ka an kasi.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Amaa o paŋ ya'a pʋ paae ban gɛlig ligidi la si'em la, ba na zaŋ o niŋ maanmaan la nu'ugin ka maanmaan la gɛlig lin nar ye ba da' o si'em, ka li dɔlnɛ on kaanbi zi'el la paŋi an si'em la.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: O ya'a kaanbnɛ bʋnkɔnbʋgʋ zi'el ye ba maal maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la, bʋnkɔnbkan la na lieb Zugsɔb la din ka an kasi.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Ka linɛ ka o kaanbi zi'el la ya'a anɛ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ ka' nyainnɛ ka kʋ nyaŋi maal maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la, alaa o na mɔri li keŋ tis maanmaan la

english_verse: But if you want to buy it back, you must pay an additional
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a bɔɔd ye o tiaki yɔ ligidi ka kpɛn mɔri li, alaa o na yɔ ligidi pʋdigir anu paasi li zug.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a zaŋ pɔkanɛ aan o yidim faari tis Zugsɔb la ka li an kasi, li ligidi sʋm ye li zemis nɛ bʋmbʋʋda kanɛ na bʋd pɔɔg la. Li ya'a na bʋd ki bielim bɔto atan', li sʋ'ʋm ye di ligidi an anzurifa ligidi pisnu.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: Ka nɔk gbansʋma ligil, ka yadig futɛbisir linɛ an bʋlʋ pa'al gbauŋ la zug, ka yʋ'ʋn nɔk dabanɛ ka ba gban'adi ʋkidi li mɔri ken la tʋ.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: Ba na nɔk fukanɛ an bʋlʋ yadig teebul kanɛ ka ba ɛɛnti nɔkid bodobodo kanɛ ka ba tisid Zugsɔb la pa'annɛ li zug la, ka nɔk laas la, nɛ dʋgid nɛ bʋtiis banɛ mɔri maan bʋnnuuda maan la wʋsa pa'ali li zug, ka mɛ nɔk bodobodo kanɛ pa'a li zug saŋa wʋsa la pa'al.

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: Li anɛ ye ba nɔk fukanɛ an bʋlʋ ligil fita zi'esir la la'an nɛ li fita la, nɛ ma'adis linɛ na gban'e bugumsaana la, nɛ li tampɛligim laas nɛ kpaam laas la,

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: ka viligi li la'ad la wʋsa nɛ gbansʋma pa'al dabanɛ ka ba mɔri ziid la zug.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Ba na nɔk fukanɛ an bʋlʋ pil sanlima maan daka la ka ligili li wʋsa nɛ gbansʋma, ka nɔk dabanɛ ka ba gban'adi ʋkidi mɔri ken la tʋ.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Ba na nɔk la'abanɛ ka ba mɔri tʋm Fuug Sʋgʋr tʋʋma la wʋsa pil nɛ fukanɛ an bʋlʋ, ka ligil nɛ gbansʋma pa'al dabanɛ ziid la zug.
