english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: Ba na vaae tampɛligim la wʋsa yis kʋntzɛn'ug maan daka la zugʋ bas, ka nɔk fukanɛ mu'oe zim-zim ligili li.

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn nɔk la'abanɛ ka ba mɔri maan maana la wʋsa pa'ali li zug, la'an nɛ la'aban ka ba mɔri mu'od bugum la, nɛ laas, nɛ ban ka ba mɔri yaad ni'im la, ka ligili li wʋsa nɛ gbansʋma, ka nɔk dabanɛ ka ba gban'adi ʋkidi mɔri ken la tʋ.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: “Aaron nɛ o biis la ya'a ti ligil la'abanɛ an kasi la naae ka nidib la ti'eb ye ba duoe tɔɔm la, Kohat dim la na kena zii li wʋsa keŋ. Amaa ba mid ka ba si'is la'abanɛ an kasi la ka ba na kpi. Kohat dimi nar ye ba zi la'abanɛ bɛ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin la.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: Maanmaan kpɛɛm Aaron biig Elieza na suoɛn kpakanɛ ka ba mɔri nyu'od fita la nɛ bʋnnyubisa la, nɛ saŋa wʋsa maan la, nɛ malʋŋ kpaam la. Onɛ na gɔsid Fuug Sʋgʋr la wʋsa yɛla, nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa, la'an nɛ la'abanɛ an kasi tis Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: Ba na ziid fuud linɛ pili bʋʋl La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la, nɛ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la mɛŋ, nɛ linɛ pili li pɛ'ɛs la, nɛ gbansʋma linɛ pili li wʋsa tak la, nɛ fubanɛ geŋ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr za'anɔɔr la,

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: nɛ fubanɛ geŋ zak kanɛ gilig Fuug Sʋgʋr la nɛ maan daka la, nɛ fubanɛ geŋ za'anɔɔr linɛ kpɛn'ɛd pʋʋgin la, nɛ nwiis nɛ la'abanɛ wʋsa ka ba mɔri tʋm tʋʋma la. Gerson tuŋ la na tʋm linɛ wʋsa nar ye ba tʋm nɛ la'abama.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Tʋʋm kanɛ ka Gerson tuŋ la na tʋm La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin la nwa'. Ba tʋʋma anɛ ye ba siak maanmaan kpɛɛm Aaron biig Itamar na pa'annɛ ba si'em wʋsa.” Merari tuŋ la tʋʋma an si'em

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Ban na tʋm si'em nwa': ba ya'a ye ba tʋm La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin la, ba na zi' La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la dalamma la nɛ li dabanɛ zi'e sappi la, nɛ li dawa'a, nɛ li zi'esa la.

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: La'an nɛ dabanɛ zi'e sappi gilig zak la nɛ li zi'esa la wʋsa, nɛ kpada nɛ nwiis la, nɛ li la'ad nɛ linɛ wʋsa ka ba mɔri tʋm. Kɛl ka sɔ' wʋsa baŋ on na zi si'el.

english_verse: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Levites Are Counted Again
translation_verse: Merari tuŋ la na tʋm tʋʋm si'a La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin si'em la, ka li dɔl nɛ maanmaan kpɛɛm Aaron biig Itamar n na pa'ali ba si'em. Levi dim kal

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da zi'el nɔɔri tis Moses ye o pa'al sɔ' wʋsa o tʋʋma, nɛ sɔ' wʋsa na zi la'asi'a. Ala ka ba da kaali ba, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la zi'el si'em tis Moses la.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
translation_verse: Ba ya'a anɛ dap bɛɛ pu'ab, ya na yisi ba ya gbɛɛnsa zin'ig la kpikpɛŋ. Mid ka ya kɛ ka mam bɛ nɛ ya zin'isi'a la lieb dian'ad bamanam yɛla.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye, ‘Dau bɛɛ pu'a ya'a tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd buudi wʋsa pɔ'ɔg o tiraan ka ka' sida sɔbi tis Zugsɔb la, on sɔb tʋm taal.

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: Li anɛ tilas ye o yɛl on tʋm taal si'a la, ka yɔ sam kanɛ nar ye o yɔ ka paam taal pɛ'ɛŋir, ka pɛ'ɛs o sam la pʋdigir zin'is anu tis onɛ ka o pɔ'ɔg la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ ka ba tʋm o taal la ya'a kpinɛ, ka o du'ad kae na di'e yɔɔd la, li na anɛ Wina'am din, ka li sʋ'ʋm ye ba nɔki tis maanmaan la, la'an nɛ pɛrakanɛ ka o di'e maali sɔs suguru tis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb la.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: sɔ' wʋsa piini anɛ o din, amaa o ya'a nɔki tis maanmaan la, li anɛ maanmaan la din.’” Pu'a kanɛ ka' sida sɔb kpansib yɛla

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: o sid la ya'a ti pin'ili bi'esid ka pʋ lɛn niŋ pu'a la yadda ye o sid tʋm dian'ad bɛɛ o pʋ tʋm,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: on dɔl pu'a la keŋ maanmaan san'an. Dau la mɛ na nɔk bodobodo zɔ'ɔm wʋʋ ki kuriba ayi' o pu'a la yɛla. O da nɔk kpaam bɛɛ bʋnnyubisa gɛndigɛ, bɔzugɔ li anɛ zʋʋd maan linɛ an nyuur yɛla, ka na kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yi paalʋ na.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na kɛ ka pu'a la kena zi'en Zugsɔb la tuon,

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ka gbin'e ku'okanɛ an kasi bɛ yʋʋrin ka vaae Fuug Sʋgʋr la teŋ titani niŋ ku'omin la.

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Ka Maanmaan la na sɔb nɔpɔɔr la niŋ gbauŋʋn ka pie li niŋ ku'otɔɔgin

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: ka kɛ ka pu'a la nu ku'otɔɔg kanɛ ziid nɔpɔɔri kenna la, ka ku'om la kpɛn' o tis o tɔɔg ka o namis.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na di'e maan la o nu'ugin, ka nyɔɔsimi li Zugsɔb la tuon ka mɔri li kɛn maan daka la ni na,

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: ka yʋ'ʋn gbin'e zɔ'ɔm la nu'ukukudug ka li an tiɛnr maan ka o nyu'oe maan daka la zug; lin nya'aŋ la, o na kɛ ka pu'a la nu ku'om la.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Amaa pu'a la ya'a pʋ tʋm dian'adɛ ka o pʋʋg an nyain, nɔpɔɔr la kʋ gban'e o ka o mɛ na nyaŋi du'a biis.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: bɛɛ dau ya'a ti pʋ lɛn niŋ o pu'a yadda. Maanmaan la na kɛ ka pu'a la zi'en Zugsɔb la tuon ka ba maal malʋŋ bama wʋsa.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Taal kʋ dɔl o sid la, amaa o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd taal na kpɛm bɛɛ o zug.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye; ‘Dau bɛɛ pu'a ya'a bɔɔd ye o kaanb kaanbʋg kanɛ bɛɛ li kɔn' ye o yis o mɛŋi lieb Naazir nid,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: li anɛ tilas ye on sɔb luak o mɛŋ nɛ daam buudi wʋsa, ka da nu linɛ nwɛnɛ daam wʋsaa. O mɛ da nu tikanɛ wala ka ba mɔri maan daam la ku'om, bɛɛ o dii li bʋmma'asa bɛɛ li bʋnkpi'emisɛ.

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: Lin yi saŋkan la wʋsa, o mid ka o li'el kum.

english_verse: not even that of your father, mother, brother, or sister. That would make you unclean. Your hair is the sign that you are dedicated to me, so remain holy.
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ ka o kaanb ye o pɛsig o mɛŋ la o na an kasi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: Li ya'a an wʋʋ sɔ' kpi'e nɛ o ka gbirigi kpi, ka li kɛ ka zuobid kanɛ ka o pɛsig la pʋ lɛn an kasi, asɛɛ o pʋn zuobid la daba ayɔpɔi la daar, linɛ aan amaalim-mɛŋ-nyain dabisir la.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ka daba anii daar la o yʋ'ʋn na mɔr sian'adawana ayi' bɛɛ na'adawana ayi' kɛn maanmaan la san'an na, za'anɔɔr kanɛ kpɛn'ɛd La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr zakin la,

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: ka maanmaan la na kʋ yinne ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, ka yinne mɛ an nyu'or maan ka li an suguru sɔsʋgʋ tis o, bɔzugɔ o tʋm bɛ'ɛd on la'am bɛ nɛ kum la zug. Daakan nɔɔ li anɛ ye o maligim pɛsig o zug la.

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Li mɛ anɛ tilas ye o lɛm maligim pɛsig o mɛŋi tis Zugsɔb la saŋkanɛ ka o daa gban'e ye o wɛlig o mɛŋ la, ka mɔr pɛbil kanɛ an yʋʋm yinne na maal taal maan. Dabisbanɛ gaad la kʋ kaali paasɛ, bɔzugɔ o bakir la saŋa o daa liebnɛ dian'ad sɔb.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: “‘Nwa' an zi'elʋgʋ tis onɛ wʋsa an Naazir nid o kaanbʋg dabisa la ya'a ti gaad. O na kɛn La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin na.

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Ani ka o na maal maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la: pɛdibpɔl onɛ an yʋʋm yinne ka pʋ mɔr dɛŋŋa maal maannɛ nyu'oe tis Zugsɔb la, nɛ pɛsa'apɔl onɛ an yʋʋm yinne ka dɛŋ kae maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, nɛ pɛraug yinne kanɛ ka' dɛŋ ka li anɛ taaba la'asʋg maan,

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: nɛ zʋʋd maannɛ pɛ'ɛs nɛ bʋnnuuda maan, la'an nɛ pɛog nɛ bodobodo linɛ pʋ mɔr dabinnɛ, nɛ ma'asa, nɛ linɛ nwɛnɛ sa'akɔnt kpi'emis.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na mɔri li keŋ Zugsɔb la tuonnɛ maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan nɛ nyu'or maan.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Naazir nid la na pʋn o zuobid kanɛ ka o pɛsigi tis Zugsɔb la La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr za'anɔɔrin la. O na nɔk zuobid la niŋ bugum kanɛ bɛ maan bimbimin dit o maan linɛ an taaba la'asʋg maan la.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: Naazir nid la ya'a pʋn o zuobid linɛ pa'al ye o pɛsig o mɛŋ la naae, maanmaan la na nɔk gbɛr linɛ dʋg, ka yis bodobodo linɛ ka' danbin la yinne nɛ linɛ nwɛnɛ sa'akɔnt la yinne niŋ Naazir nid la nu'usin.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na nyɔɔsimi ba Zugsɔb la tuon ka li an nyɔɔsʋŋ maan. Ba anɛ kasi ka an maanmaan la din, la'an nɛ kugsir linɛ nyɔɔsim Zugsɔb tuon la nɛ gbɛr linɛ an maanmaan tɔnsir la. Lin nya'aŋ la Naazir la tun'e nu daam.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Aaron nɛ o biis la ye, ‘Yanamɛ na sɔsid albareka tisid Israel dim la si'em nwa': yɛlimi ba ye,

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: “‘Zugsɔb na niŋi ya bareka ka guri ya,

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb na zɔɔ ya nimbaanlig ka tʋm sʋ'ʋm tisi ya,

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb na fɛndig o nindaa kpa' ya ka tisi ya sumbʋgʋsʋm.’

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: “Ala ka ba na nɔki m yʋ'ʋri sɔs albareka tisi ba, ka m sid na niŋi ba bareka.”

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Moses n da ti' Fuug Sʋgʋr la naae la, o da bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋi li, ka pɛsigi li nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa ye li an kasi tis Zugsɔb la. O mɛ da lɛn bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ maan daka la nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa.

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim tuongatib da tis maan piini. Ba da anɛ yidaannam banɛ an dɔɔg-dɔɔg tuongatib ka da gɔt nidib la kaalʋg yɛla la. Ba da la'as taaba

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: mɔr maana tɛrekonam ayuobʋ nɛ lɔlis pii nɛ ayi' kɛn Zugsɔb la tuon na. Tuongat wʋsa da mɔr lɔlig yinne ka tuongatib ayi' wʋsa la'asi mɔr tɛreko yinne. Ba da mɔr nɛ'ɛnamɛ kɛn Fuug Sʋgʋrin la na.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋn da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: “Di'em la'abama ba san'an ka li sʋŋ nɛ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr zin'ig la maalʋg. Nɔkimi ba pʋdigi tis Levi dim la ka li dɔl nɛ sɔ' wʋsa tʋʋma nar ye o di'e si'em.”

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Dinzug, Moses da nɔk tɛrekonam la nɛ niigi la tis Levi dɔɔg dim la.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: ka mɛ nɔk tɛrekonam anaasi nɛ niigi anii tis Merari tuŋ la wʋʋ ba tʋʋma nar ye ba di'e si'em. Maanmaan kpɛɛm Aaron biig Itamar da pa'annɛ ba ban na tʋm si'em.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Amaa Moses da pʋ nɔki tis Kohat tuŋ dim laa, bɔzugɔ ba tʋʋm da anɛ ye ba bugid la'abanɛ an kasi la ba biankimpiind zug.

english_verse: On the day the altar was dedicated, the twelve leaders brought offerings for its dedication.
translation_verse: Ban da bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ maan daka la ni la, tuongatib la da mɔri ba maana kennɛ digin maan daka la tuon

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la da pʋn yɛl Moses ye, “Dabisir wʋsa tuongat yinne na mɔr o maan na maal maan daka la pɛsigir yɛla.”

english_verse: kilograms, according to the official standards;
translation_verse: nɛ bʋribig linɛ na maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan,

english_verse: rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: Dabiskanɛ da pɛ'ɛs awai la Abidan onɛ an Gideon biig, Benjamin dɔɔg tuongat la, da mɔr o maan na.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Moses ya'a da kpɛn' La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr pʋʋgin ye o sɔns nɛ Zugsɔb la, o na wʋm ka li pian'adi yit Nɔnaar Daka liŋ linɛ an suguru zin'igin la, Kerubnam ayi' la sʋʋgin. Ala ka Zugsɔb la da sɔnsid nɛ o.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Aaron ye o ya'a nyu'oe bugum fita ayɔpɔi la, li anɛ o sʋn'ʋl fita zi'esir la zug ka li nie lɛbisi li tuon baba.”

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Ban da maal fita zi'esir la si'em nwa': lin yi li gbinnin ti paae li zugin linɛ nwɛnɛ puum nɛ ka ba zan' sanlima maali li. Ba da maal fita zi'esir la ka li dɔl nɛ Zugsɔb la pa'al Moses ye ba maal si'em la. Ban wɛlig Levi dɔɔg dimi ba kɔn' la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: The Levites must be acceptable to me before they begin working at the sacred tent. So separate them from the rest of the Israelites
translation_verse: “Yisim Levi dɔɔg dim la Israel dim la sʋʋgin ka maal maan kanɛ na kɛ ka ba lieb nyain.

english_verse: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.
translation_verse: Fʋn na niŋ si'em ka ba lieb nyain anɛ nwa': misigimɛ ba nɛ ku'okanɛ kɛt ka ba na an nyain la. Ka kɛ ka ba pʋni ba niŋgbiŋ kɔnbilʋg wʋsa ka piesi ba fuud, ka li kɛ ka ba lieb nyain.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba nɔk na'arapɔl nɛ zʋʋd maan linɛ an zɔ'ɔm baanligi gɛndig nɛ kpaam: ka lɛn nɔk na'arapɔl ya'as ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Mɔr Levi dim la na ka ba zi'en La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la tuon, ka la'as Israel nidib la wʋsa na.

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: ka Aaron an ye o mɔr Levi dɔɔg dim la kɛn Zugsɔb tuon na tis wʋʋ nyɔɔsʋŋ maan linɛ yit Israel dimin la na, ka li kɛ ka ba na an banɛ ti'eb ye ba tʋm Zugsɔb la tʋʋma.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Levi dɔɔg la dim ya'a nɔki ba nu'ugi pa'al na'araad la zugʋ naae, fʋn on nɔk yinne maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan ka kɛ yinne la maal nyu'or maan ka li an suguru sɔsʋg maannɛ tis Levi dɔɔg dim la.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka Levi dɔɔg dim la zi'en Aaron nɛ o biis la tuon ka fʋ nɔki ba maal nyɔɔsʋŋ maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a niŋ ala li pa'al ye fʋ wɛlig Levi dɔɔg la nɛ zi'eli ba kɔn' nɛ Israel dim la, ka Levi dim la na an man nidib.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: “Fʋ ya'a maal maan kanɛ kɛt ka Levi dɔɔg la an nyain la naae, ka niŋi ba wʋʋ nyɔɔsʋŋ maan la, ba yʋ'ʋn na kpɛn' La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin la tʋmmi ba tʋʋma.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Linɛ du'a Israel wʋsa ka an bʋndaug anɛ man din, li ya'a anɛ nid bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg. Man da kʋ bʋnkpɛŋ wʋsa Egipt teŋin la, m da bas ban nɛ ye ba an man din.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Man nɔk Levi dɔɔg la nɛ ka ba lɛdig Israel bikpɛɛmnam la wʋsa zin'ig.

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: Israel nidib la wʋsa sʋʋgin, man nɔk Levi dɔɔg la dimi tis Aaron nɛ o biis, ye ba zi'en Israel dim nɔba zugʋ tʋm La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la tʋʋma, ka sɔsid suguru tisidi ba ka li na kɛ ka ba ya'a li'el Fuug Sʋgʋr la ba kʋ paam san'auŋɔ.”

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Moses nɛ Aaron nɛ Israel dim la wʋsa da maal Levi dɔɔg dim la wʋʋ Zugsɔb la da ye ba maal si'em la.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Levi dɔɔg la da maali ba mɛŋ nyain ka pie ba fuud, ka Aaron nɔki ba keŋ Zugsɔb la tuon nyɔɔsimi ba wʋʋ nyɔɔsʋŋ maannɛ sɔs suguru tisi ba, ka li kɛ ka ba lieb nyain.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: Ba tun'e sʋŋi ba taaba la ka ba tʋm La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la tʋʋma, amaa bam mɛŋ da tʋm tʋʋma la. Ala ka fʋ na pʋdig tʋʋma tis Levi dim dɔɔg la.”

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da pian' tis Moses Sinai mɔɔgin ban da yi Egipt la yʋma ayi' nya'aŋ, li nwadig kanɛ pin'in yiiga ni la ye,

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Ba maalimi li saŋa kanɛ nar, ka li anɛ nwadig nwa', li dabis pii nɛ anaasi daar, winnig ya'a ti bɔɔd kpɛn'ɛb, ka li dɔl nɛ li suor nɛ li zi'ela wʋsa an si'em nɔɔ.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Ka ba sid da niŋ ala Sinai mɔɔgin nwadkanɛ pin'in la li dabpii nɛ anaasi la daar, winnigi da bɔɔd kpɛn'ɛb la saŋa. Israel dim la da maal si'el wʋsa wʋʋ Zugsɔb la pa'al Moses si'em la.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Amaa ba sieba da pʋ nyaŋi di Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la daakanɛ, bɔzugɔ ba da si'is nɛ kum ka ba malima pʋʋgin ba ka' nyainnɛ. Alazug ba da kɛn Moses nɛ Aaron san'an na daakan la nɔɔ,

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: yɛl Moses ye, “Tinam ka' nyainnɛ bɔzugɔ, ti si'is nɛ kum, ka lina na kɛ ka ti kʋ nyaŋi la'as nɛ ti taaba banɛ an Israel dim la nɔki ti maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la?”

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Ka Moses lɛbisi ba ye, “Gu'usimi ka m bu'os Zugsɔb la gɔs ye o na yɛl ye bɔɔ ya yɛla.”

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛbis Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Israel dim la ye, ‘Ya sɔ' bɛɛ ya yaas ya'a ti ka' nyainnɛ ka li anɛ ye o si'is nɛ kum, bɛɛ o duoe nɛ suori bɛ lallisa, o na tun'e di Malʋŋ kanɛ an Zugsɔb Kum Maliak Gaadʋg la.

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: Ba na di Malʋŋ la nɛ nwadkanɛ paas ayi' la li dabpii nɛ anaasi daar. Li anɛ ye ba ɔnb pɛribig la ni'im, la'an nɛ bodobodo linɛ ka' danbin la nɛ zɛnvantɔɔd la.

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: Ba mid ka ba ɔnb ni'im la ka si'el kpɛlim nie bɛog, bɛɛ kɔ'ɔgi li kɔnbir. Ba ya'a di Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la diib, ban dɔlli li suoya.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' ya'a an nyain ka mɛ pʋ duoe suorɛ, ka pʋ siak ye o di Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la, ba na yis ninkan daan o buudi ni, bɔzugɔ o pʋ nɔk maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la saŋa kanɛ nar ye o tis la. Ninkan daan tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la taal na kpɛlim o zugin.

english_verse: As soon as the sacred tent was set up, a thick cloud appeared and covered it. The cloud was there each day, and during the night, a fire could be seen in it.
translation_verse: Saŋa wʋsa li da anɛ ala, saŋgbauŋ la da ligili li nintaŋ, ka yʋ'ʋŋ ya'a sɔb ka li an wʋʋ bugum nɛ.

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Saŋgbauŋ la ya'a kpɛm bɛ Fuug Sʋgʋr la zugʋ paae dabis ayi', bɛɛ nwadig, bɛɛ yʋʋm mum, Israel dim la mɛ da gur ala ka pʋ vurigida, amaa li ya'a ti dʋʋ agɔla, ba mɛ duod nɛ gban'ad suor.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: “Zan'am anzurifa maal na'atana ayi', ka mɔri li buon nidib la la'asid, ka li ya'a ti anɛ ye ba tɔlis ban on wʋmi li ka tɔlis.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na'atana ayi' la wʋsa ya'a ti pieb, nidib la wʋsa na la'asi fʋ tuon La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Amaa na'atan yinne ya'a pieb, li anɛ banɛ an dɔɔd la tuongatibi na la'asi fʋ san'an na.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: onɛ pɛ'ɛs ayi' la ya'a pieb, banɛ bɛ dagɔbʋg la na duoe gban'e ken. Piebʋg la na an zanbinnɛ pa'al ye ba duom keŋ.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Ban na niŋ si'em la'as nidib la anɛ ba pieb na'atana la. Amaa li sʋm ye piebkan bɛɛ li kɔn' ka kɛ ka ken piebʋg la mɛ bɛɛ li kɔn'.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: “Aaron bibanɛ an maanmaannib la na piebid na'atana la. Ba na sʋ'oe tʋʋm kaŋa saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti bɛɛ ya mɛŋ teŋinɛ zabid nɛ ya dataas banɛ namisidi ya la, yanam on pieb na'atana la, ka li na kɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la tiɛn ya yɛla ka faaɛn ya yii ya dataas la nu'usin.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Linɛ paas, ya ya'a ti maan sumalisim saŋa si'a, nɛ ya malima, nɛ nwadpaalig di'ema la, asɛɛ ya pieb na'atana la yanamɛ maannɛ ya nyu'or maana saŋsi'a la, nɛ ya taaba la'asʋg maana la, ka li na an tiɛnr yanam nɛ ya Wina'am la teŋsʋk. Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am.” Israel dim la da duoe Sinai sian'arin la yɛla

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka ba da dɛŋi duoe yii keŋ wʋʋ Zugsɔb la dɔlis Moses san'anɛ tisi ba nɔɔr si'em la.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Juda dɔɔg la da gaad tuon nɛ ba tuuta, ka Nason onɛ an Aminadab biig la luu ba tuon;

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: ka Netanɛl onɛ da an Zuar biig la da lu Isaka dɔɔg la tuon,

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: ka Eliab onɛ an Helon biig la mɛ lu Zebulun dɔɔg la tuon.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Ba yʋ'ʋn da kpilim Fuug Sʋgʋr la ka Gerson tuŋ la nɛ Merari tuŋ banɛ ziidi li la duoe keŋ.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Reuben dɔɔg la da tia'al nɛ ba tuuta. Elizu onɛ an Sediu biig la da luu ba tuon;

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: ka Selumiel onɛ da an Zurisiadai biig la da lu Simeon dɔɔg la tuon;

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: ka Eliasaf onɛ an Duodi biig lu Gad dɔɔg la tuon.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Ka Kohat tuŋ la yʋ'ʋn duoe dɔl, ka ziid la'abanɛ an kasi la. Li da anɛ ye ba ti' Fuug Sʋgʋr la naae ka ba nyaan paae na.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Efiram dɔɔg la da tia'al nɛ ba tuuta. Elisama onɛ an Ammihud biig la da luu ba tuon.

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: Ka Gamaliel onɛ an Pedazu biig la da lu Manase dɔɔg la tuon;

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: ka Abidan onɛ an Gideon biig la da lu Benjamin dɔɔg la tuon.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Li naarin la, Dan dɔɔg la an banɛ da kpɛlim nya'aŋi dɔl ka gur nidib la. Ahieza onɛ an Amisiadai biig la da luu ba tuon.

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: Pagiel onɛ an Okiran biig la da lu Aser dɔɔg la tuon.

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: Ka Ahira onɛ an Enan biig la da lu Naftali dɔɔg la tuon.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Israel buudi la da tuunl taaba yi si'em la.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Moses da yɛl Hobab onɛ an Reuel biig ka an Midian nid la, ka mɛ an Moses diem la ye, “Ti yitnɛ wa'ae zin'ikanɛ ka Zugsɔb da yɛl ye o na nɔki tisi ti la. Dɔlli ti keŋ ka ti na maalif sʋ'ʋm, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la kaanb ye o na tis Israel dim bʋnsʋma.”

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “Ayei, man kʋ keŋɛ. Man lɛbidnɛ m mɛŋ teŋin nɛ m mɛŋ nidibin.”

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Amaa Moses da yɛl o ye, “M bɛlimnɛ, da lɛb ka basi tii. Fʋn mi' zin'ikanɛ ka ti na la'as taaba mɔɔgin la, fʋ na tun'e pa'annɛ ti.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a dɔlli ti, tinam nɛ fʋ na pʋdig la'asʋma banɛ wʋsa ka Zugsɔb la na tisi ti.”

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Alazug ba da naam Sinai Zuokanɛ an Zugsɔb Zuorin la keŋ daba atan'. Zugsɔb Nɔnaar Daka la ka ba da zii bɛ tuon daba atan' ken la pʋʋgin ye li ie zin'ikanɛ ka ba na la'as anii vʋ'ʋs.

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ wʋsa ka Nɔnaar Daka la da duoe gaad tuon, Moses yɛti ye, “Zugsɔba, duom! Kɛl ka fʋ dataas widig, ka banɛ kisif zɔɔ yii fʋ tuon!”

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Daka la ya'a ti paae zin'ikanɛ an ye li digin la, o yɛti ye, “Zugsɔba, lɛm na! Kemi fʋ nidib Israel dim banɛ ka' bɛn la san'an na!”

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Saŋkaŋa nidib la da nyɔnnɛ lin tɔi si'em tisi ba, ka Zugsɔb la wʋm, ka o sʋnf duoe. Bugum da naam Zugsɔb la san'anɛ sig na diti ba la'asʋg zin'ig la kpikpɛŋ.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Nidib la da kaasi tis Moses, ka o sɔs Zugsɔb la ka bugum la kpiig.

english_verse: They named the place “Burning,” because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire. The People Grumble about Being Hungry
translation_verse: Alazug ba da pʋd zin'ikan la yʋ'ʋr ye Tabera; bugum naam Zugsɔb la san'anɛ sigi ba teŋsʋk na dit la zug. Zugsɔb tis Israel dim kɔdis

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Ninzʋna banɛ da gɛndigi ba la da gɛn'ɛd diib yɛla, ka Israel dim la lɛm pin'ili nyɔnnɛ yɛt ye, ba pʋ mɔr ni'imi na ɔnbɛ.

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Ba da yɛt ye, “Ti tiɛn zimi banɛ ka ti daa ɔnbid Egipt teŋin zaalim nɛ gɔla banɛ ka ti daa dʋgidi ɔnbid nɛ wɔtamɛlɔn nɛ gabʋ buudi wʋsa la.

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna ti ya'amlɛog wʋsa gaadya; ti pʋ lɛn nyɛt si'ela asɛɛ dikanɛ buon manna nwa' ma'aa.”

english_verse: The manna was like small whitish seeds
translation_verse: Manna la da anɛ bʋngbilis wʋʋ ma'anbiili ka an pipɛl-zɛn'ug.

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: O da fabili tis Zugsɔb la ka bu'os o ye, “M Zugsɔba, m anɛ fʋ sankpan'as; bɔ ka fʋ zi yɛl kaŋa na ziili ma? M maal bɔ kimm ka li pʋ malisi fɔ ka fʋ nɔk nimbama wʋsa ziidi ziil mam?

english_verse: but they're not my children. You told me to nurse them along and to carry them to the land you promised their ancestors.
translation_verse: Manɛ gban'e nimbama wʋsa pʋʋgɔɔ? Manɛ du'a baa? Bɔ ka fʋ ye m zanli baa m nu'ugin nwɛnɛ biyuole na zanl biigi wa'ae teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ kaanbi zi'el ye fʋ tisi ba yaanam la?

english_verse: They keep whining for meat, but where can I get meat for them?
translation_verse: Man na nyɛ ni'im yaanɛ tis nimbama wʋsa? Ba kaasidi saŋa wʋsa m tʋba ni ye, ‘Tisimi ti ni'im ka ti ɔnb!’

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: Man kʋ nyaŋi zi nimbama nɛ m mɛŋ paŋa. Ziid la tɛbis nɛ hali gaad mam.

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Li ya'a aan anwa ka fʋ ye fʋ maal mam, lɛɛ kpɛn kʋʋm nannanna. M ya'a paae fʋ ya'am, fʋn da kɛ ka m vʋe ti nyɛɛm san'auŋɔ.”

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: M na sig na ka pian' tisi ya anina ka kɛ ka Siig kanɛ bɛɛ fʋ ni la mɛ na bɛɛ ba ni, ka ba nyaŋi sʋŋi fʋ zi nidib la ziid ka fʋ da lɛn ziidi fʋ kɔn'ɔkɔn'.”

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: Yɛlim nidib la ye, “Maalimi ya mɛŋ nyain ka bɛog, ya na paam ni'imi ɔnb. Zugsɔb la wʋm yanamɛ fabin ka yɛt ye, ‘Ti ya'a nyɛɛn ni'imɛɛ, ti naan kʋ ɔnbinɛɛ! Tinamɛ daa bɛ Egipt la, li daa an sʋ'ʋm tisi ti.’” Nannanna Zugsɔb la na tisi ya ni'im, ka ya ɔnb.

english_verse: . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.
translation_verse: amaa nwadmum, hali ka li ti yiti ya nyɔnya ni. Bɔzugɔ, ya zan'as Zugsɔb onɛ bɛ nɛ ya la ka nyɔnnɛ yɛt ye, “Bɔzug kimm ka ti lɛɛ da yi Egipt teŋin la na?”

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”
translation_verse: Ti na nyɛ niigi nɛ pɛ'ɛsi kʋʋ tisi ba ka li siaki baa? Zimi banɛ bɛɛ atɛukʋn la na la'asi sia'ali baa?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “I can do anything! Watch and you'll see my words come true.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛbis ye, “Mam paŋ la mɔr bɛnnɛɛ? Li kʋ yuugɛ ka fʋ baŋ ye man yɛl si'el la na niŋ bɛɛ li kʋ niŋɛ!”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said. Then he chose
translation_verse: Moses da yii yɛl nidib la Wina'am yɛl si'em. O da la'as tuongatib pisyɔpɔi la ka kɛ ka ba zi'enɛ gilig Fuug Sʋgʋr la.

english_verse: Eldad and Medad were two leaders who had not gone to the tent. But when the Spirit took control of them, they began shouting like prophets right there in camp.
translation_verse: Nidib ayi' pisyɔpɔi la sʋʋgin, ka ba yʋda buon Elidad nɛ Miedad da kpɛlim la'asʋg zin'igin la ka pʋ yii keŋ Sʋgʋrin laa. La'an nɛ ala, Siig la da sigi ba zugin na, ka ban mɛ pin'ili maan tʋkpiidʋg wʋʋ nɔdi'esidib nɛ.

english_verse: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.
translation_verse: Dasaŋ sɔ' da zɔɔ keŋ yɛl Moses ye, “Elidad nɛ Miedad bɛ la'asʋg zin'igin pian'ad nwɛnɛ nɔdi'esidib nɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
translation_verse: Ka Josua onɛ an Nun biig ka da sʋŋid Moses o biilimin sa la da yɛl Moses ye, “M zugdaana, m bɛlimnɛ, gu'omi ba!”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.”
translation_verse: Moses da lɛbis ye, “Fʋ bɛn'ɛdnɛ fufummɛ? Man bɔɔdin si'el anɛ ye Zugsɔb la Siig sig sɔ' wʋsa zugin ka ba pian'ad wʋʋ nɔdi'esidib nɛ!”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.
translation_verse: Li da pʋ yuugɛ, ka Zugsɔb la kɛ ka sisi'etita'ar da'ae yi atɛuk baba na mɔr kɔdisi kɛɛn ba san'an na ka ba ian'ad yammin-yammin. Ba da tiigi zin'ig la wʋsa, ka fʋ ya'a ye fʋ dɔlis li wa'alim paae ba bɛn li na an wʋʋ dabismum ken, lʋga anaasi la wʋsa.

english_verse: The people picked up quails for two days—each person filled at least ten large baskets. Then they spread them out to dry.
translation_verse: Alazug daakan la nɛ li yʋ'ʋŋ, nɛ dabisir kanɛ tia'al la, nidib la tʋʋm da anɛ kɔndis la gban'ab; sɔ' wʋsa da la'as ka li pʋ pɔɔda. Ba da dɛlig kɔndis la giligi ba la'asʋg zin'ig la wʋsa.

english_verse: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.
translation_verse: Ban da nam ɔnbid ni'im la, Zugsɔb la sʋnf duoe nɛ nidib la ka o kɛ ka ban'atita'ar luu ba sʋʋgin.

english_verse: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place “Graves for the Greedy.”
translation_verse: Ba da pʋd zin'ikan yʋ'ʋr ye Kibrof-Hataava bɔzugɔ ani ka ba mum banɛ da kpiid ni'im yɛla la.

english_verse: Israel then broke camp and traveled to Hazeroth.
translation_verse: Nidib la da yii ani keŋ Hazerof, n la'asi bɛ ani.

english_verse: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses nɛ Aaron nɛ Miriam ye babatan' la yim keŋ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin la, ka ba sid da yii keŋ.

english_verse: There the Lord appeared in a cloud and told Aaron and Miriam to come closer.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la sig na bɛ saŋgbauŋinɛ zi'e Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin ka buol Aaron nɛ Miriam, ka babayi' la da yi tuon na.

english_verse: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: “I, the Lord, speak to prophets in visions and dreams.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Kɛlisimi m pian'ad la sʋ'ʋŋa. Mam Zugsɔb nɔdi'es ya'a bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin, man nied nɛ m mɛŋi pa'al o, ka pian'adi tisid o zaansʋŋ pʋʋgin.

english_verse: But my servant Moses is the leader of my people.
translation_verse: Amaa ya'a an man tʋmtʋm Moses, li ka' ala, m yin la wʋsa onɛ an sida sɔb;

english_verse: He sees me face to face, and everything I say to him is perfectly clear. You have no right to criticize my servant Moses.”
translation_verse: man nɛ on ɛɛnti kpa' nɛ taaba ka m pian'adi tisid o nyain-nyain, ka' nɛ siilimaa. Bɔɔ kɛ ka ya pʋ zɔ dabiem ka zɛrig Moses onɛ aan m tʋmtʋm la?”

english_verse: The Lord became angry with Aaron and Miriam. And after the Lord left
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋnf da duoe ya ka o gaad ka basi ba.

english_verse: and the cloud disappeared from over the sacred tent, Miriam's skin turned white with leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her,
translation_verse: Saŋgbauŋ la da naam Fuug Sʋgʋr la zugʋ dʋ agɔl la, ka Miriam kpɛn lieb kʋkɔmi zi'e pɛlig farr wʋʋ sakugir nɛ. Aaron da gi'e nyɛ ka o zi'e an kʋkɔm,

english_verse: he said to Moses, “Sir, please don't punish us for doing such a foolish thing.
translation_verse: ka o yɛl Moses ye, “M zugdaana, bɛlimnɛ, kɛlli ti taali bas nɛ tinamɛ tʋm yalim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛsi'a la.

english_verse: Don't let Miriam's flesh rot away like a child born dead!”
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka o nwɛnɛ bikpi'iŋi yit o ma pʋʋgin na ka o pʋsʋk kae la.”

english_verse: Moses prayed, “Lord God, please heal her.”
translation_verse: Alazug Moses da kaasi tis Zugsɔb ye, “M Zugsɔb Wina'am, m bɛlimnɛ, ti'ebim o!”

english_verse: But the Lord replied, “Miriam would be disgraced for seven days if her father had punished her by spitting in her face. So make her stay outside the camp for seven days, before coming back.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛbis ye, “O saam ya'a tʋbisin nitɔɔndi niŋ o nindaa, nyan kʋ kpɛn' o daba ayɔpɔi, bɛɛ ka' alaa? Alazug asɛɛ ka o yi la'asʋg zin'ig la yiŋi niŋ bakuai ka li nya'aŋ ka ya nyaan mɔr o lɛb na.”

english_verse: The people of Israel did not move their camp until Miriam returned seven days later.
translation_verse: Alazug ba da yis Miriam la'asʋg zin'ig la yiŋ daba ayɔpɔi, ka nidib la da pʋ duoe tɔɔm hali ka o ti lɛb na.

english_verse: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Lin nya'aŋ ka nidib la da bas Hazerof ka la'asi digin Paran mɔɔgin.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: In fact, we saw the Nephilim who are the ancestors of the Anakim. They were so big that we felt as small as grasshoppers.”
translation_verse: Ti nyɛ Nefil dima ani.” “Tinam mɛŋ gɔsi ti mɛŋ ka ti an wʋʋ sisɔma ba tuon, ka ti mi' ye ban mɛ gɔs ka ti anɛ ala mɛn.”

english_verse: “Choose a leader from each tribe and send them into Canaan to explore the land I am giving you.”
translation_verse: “Tʋm dap sieba ka ba keŋ labisi gɔs Keenan teŋ linɛ ka m nɔkid ye m tis Israel dim la. Gaŋim dɔɔg wʋsa ni nid yinne onɛ an tuongat.”

english_verse: Before Moses sent them into Canaan, he said: After you go through the Southern Desert of Canaan, continue north into the hill country
translation_verse: Moses n da tʋmi ba ye ba labisi gɔs teŋ la, o da yɛli ba ye, “Dɔlli pipirkanɛ buon Negef la paae teŋ kanɛ an kʋkʋna la.

english_verse: and find out what those regions are like. Be sure to remember how many people live there, how strong they are,
translation_verse: Gɔsimi teŋ la an si'em, nɛ nimbanɛ bɛɛ ani la ye ba mɔr paŋ bɛɛ ba ka' paŋa, ba zu'oya bɛɛ ba pʋ zu'oe.

english_verse: and if they live in open towns or walled cities. See if the land is good for growing crops and find out what kinds of trees grow there. It's time for grapes to ripen, so try to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.
translation_verse: Teŋ la ta'am an wala? Li mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm bɛɛ li kae? Tiis bɛ teŋin la bɛɛ li kae? Kpɛ'ɛŋimini ya mɛŋ ka mɔri teŋ la tiwala na!”

english_verse: The twelve men left to explore Canaan from the Zin Desert in the south all the way to the town of Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Ba sid da keŋ ye ba labisi gɔs teŋ la, lin pin'il Zin mɔɔgin la hali ti paae teŋ kanɛ buon Rehob linɛ bɛ Lebo-Hamat kpikpɛŋ la.

english_verse: As they went through the Southern Desert, they came to the town of Hebron, which was seven years older than the Egyptian town of Zoan. In Hebron, they saw the three Anakim clans of Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai.
translation_verse: Ba da dɔlli yi Negef keŋ paae Hebron teŋ zin'ikanɛ ka Ahiman nɛ Siesai nɛ Talimai banɛ an Anak yaas la da bɛ la.

english_verse: After exploring the land of Canaan for
translation_verse: Ba da nɔk nɛ dabisa pisnaasi labisi gɔs teŋ la ka nyaan lɛb na.

english_verse: the twelve men returned to Kadesh in the Paran Desert and told Moses, Aaron, and the people what they had seen. They showed them the fruit
translation_verse: Ba da lɛb Moses nɛ Aaron nɛ Israel dim la wʋsa san'an, teŋ kanɛ buon Kades, Paran mɔɔgin la. Ani ka ba da yɛl nidib la ban nyɛ si'el ka pa'ali ba teŋ la diib nɛ li tiwala an si'em.

english_verse: and said: Look at this fruit! The land we explored is rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Ban da yɛl Moses si'eli nwa': “Ti keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ tʋmi ti la, ka bin'isim nɛ siind pʋbid! Nɛɛ li tiwala nwa'.

english_verse: But the people who live there are strong, and their cities are large and walled. We even saw the three Anakim clans.
translation_verse: Amaa nimbanɛ bɛɛ ani la anɛ ninkpi'ema, ka ba tɛɛns la mɛ an tembɛda ka mɔr zaŋguom kpi'ema; hali ti nyɛ Anak yaas la ani.

english_verse: Besides that, the Amalekites live in the Southern Desert; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites are in the hill country; and the Canaanites live along the Mediterranean Sea and the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Amalek buudi la zin'inɛ Negef mɔɔgin la, ka Hitti dim nɛ Jebus dim nɛ Amor dim la zin' teŋ kanɛ an kʋkʋna la, ka Keenan buudi la zin' kpi'e nɛ Atɛuk nɛ Joodan kɔldaug la.”

english_verse: Caleb calmed down the crowd and said, “Let's go and take the land. I know we can do it!”
translation_verse: Ani ka Kaleb da yɛl nidib la ye ba kɛl vuud Moses tuon, ka yɛl ye, “Ayei! Ti kem di'e teŋ la sʋ'ʋg, bɔzugɔ ti sid na nyaŋi sʋ'ʋgi li.”

english_verse: But the other men replied, “Those people are much too strong for us.”
translation_verse: Amaa nimbanɛ ka on nɛ ban da la'am keŋ gɔs teŋ la da yɛl ye, “Ti kʋ nyaŋi zab nɛ nidib la; ba kpi'emi gati ti.”

english_verse: Then they started spreading rumors and saying, “We won't be able to grow anything in that soil. And the people are like giants.
translation_verse: Ka ba yʋ'ʋn pin'ili pian'ad teŋ kanɛ ka ba keŋ gɔs la yɛla bɛ'ɛd bɛ'ɛdi tisid Israel dim la yɛt ye, “Teŋ kanɛ ka ti keŋ gɔsi gilig la ka' sʋ'ʋm, ti kʋ nyaŋi bɛɛ ani. Nimbanɛ bɛɛ ani la wʋsa anɛ nimbɛda ka wa'am.

english_verse: and complained to Moses and Aaron, “We wish we had died in Egypt or somewhere out here in the desert!
translation_verse: ka pin'ili nyɔn Moses nɛ Aaron. Nidib la wʋsa da yɛti ba ye, “Ti ya'a pʋn daa kpiin Egipt bɛɛ sian'akaŋa ni sɔn'oe.

english_verse: Is the Lord leading us into Canaan, just to have us killed and our women and children captured? We'd be better off in Egypt.”
translation_verse: Bɔ ka Zugsɔb la mɔri tii kɛn teŋ kaŋa na ye ti kpi zaba ni? Ba na gban'e ti pu'ab nɛ biis la ka ba kilim yammis. Ti ya'a lɛbin Egipt li pʋ sɔn'oe nɛɛ?”

english_verse: Then they said to one another, “Let's choose our own leader and go back.”
translation_verse: Ba da pin'ili yɛt taaba ye, “Ti gaŋim tuongat ka o dɔlli ti lɛb Egipt!”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron bowed down to pray in front of the crowd.
translation_verse: Moses nɛ Aaron da igin Israel nimbanɛ la'as la wʋsa tuon ka ba nindaas kpa' teŋin.

english_verse: and said: We saw the land ourselves, and it's very good.
translation_verse: ka yɛl Israel nidib la wʋsa ye, “Teŋ kanɛ ka tinam kaae giligi gɔs la anɛ teŋ sʋŋ hali.

english_verse: If we obey the Lord, he will surely give us that land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋnf ya'a malis nɛ ti, o na mɔri ti kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka bin'isim nɛ siind pʋbid la, ka nɔki li tisi ti.

english_verse: So don't rebel. We have no reason to be afraid of the people who live there. The Lord is on our side, and they won't stand a chance against us!
translation_verse: Mid ka ya ki'is Zugsɔb la nɔɔr. Ka mɛ da zɔti dabiem nɛ nimbanɛ bɛ teŋin la, bɔzugɔ ti na nyaŋi vɔli ba wʋʋ sa'ab nɛ. Linɛ guri ba la gaadya, amaa tinam Zugsɔb bɛ nɛ ti, da zɔti nɛ ba dabiem.”

english_verse: The crowd threatened to stone Moses and Aaron to death. But just then, the Lord appeared in a cloud at the sacred tent. Moses Prays for the People
translation_verse: Amaa nidib la wʋsa da gban'e nɛ ye ba lɔbi ba nɛ kuga. Ka Zugsɔb girima da kɛn La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin la na ka Israel nidib wʋsa nyɛɛ li.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I have done great things for these people, and they still reject me by refusing to believe in my power.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da bu'os Moses ye, “Bʋndaar ka nimbama na tis mam girima? Bɔ ya'as ka mam na tʋm ka ba niŋ mam yadda, la'an nɛ tʋʋmnyalima banɛ ka mam tʋmmi ba san'an la?

english_verse: So they will no longer be my people. I will destroy them, but I will make you the ancestor of a nation even stronger than theirs.”
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ban'abɛ'og luna gban'e ba ka ba kpi, ka lɛɛ kɛ ka fʋn tuŋ la zu'oe ka kpi'em hali gat ban an si'em la.”

english_verse: Show us your great power, Lord. You promised
translation_verse: Tɔ', ka nannanna, Zugsɔba, pa'alimi fʋ paŋ wʋʋ fʋn yɛl ye li an si'em la, ye

english_verse: You are merciful, and you treat people better than they deserve. So please forgive these people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, nwɛnɛ fʋ nɔŋilim la pʋn an si'em la, kɛl nimbama taali bas, nwɛnɛ fʋn ɛɛnti pʋn kɛti ba taal si'em lin pin'il daakanɛ ka ba yi Egipt hali ti paae zina la.”

english_verse: But as surely as I live and my power has no limit,
translation_verse: Amaa asida ka m yɛtif ye mam onɛ vʋe ka m girima pɛ'ɛl teŋgbauŋ la yʋ'ʋr zug,

english_verse: I swear that not one of these Israelites will enter the land I promised to give their ancestors. These people have seen my power in Egypt and in the desert, but they will never see Canaan. They have disobeyed and tested me too many times.
translation_verse: ba nid baa yinne kʋ nyɛ teŋ kanɛ ka m pɔ ka kaanbi tisi ba yaanam la. Onɛ wʋsa ki'is mam kʋ maligim nyɛ teŋ la.

english_verse: But my servant Caleb isn't like the others. So because he has faith in me, I will allow him to cross into Canaan, and his descendants will settle there.
translation_verse: Amaa m sankpan'as Kaleb bɛɛ o kɔn' ka dɔl man nɛ o sʋnf wʋsa la zug, m na kɛ ka o kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka o daa keŋ kaae la ka o yaas na sʋ'ʋgi li.

english_verse: Now listen, Moses! The Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys of Canaan. And tomorrow, you'll need to turn around and head back into the desert toward the Red Sea. The Israelites Are Punished for Complaining
translation_verse: Tɔ', Amalek nɛ Keenan buudi la sadigim bɛ bɔn'ɔg la baba la, bɛog, asɛɛ ka ya saa lɛb nya'aŋi lɛbisid sian'anr la baba, suokanɛ ken Atɛuk Zɛn'ugʋn la.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses nɛ Aaron ye,

english_verse: to give this message to the people of Israel: You sinful people have complained against me too many times! Now I swear by my own life that I will give you exactly what you wanted.
translation_verse: Alazug yɛlimi ba ye, ‘Man Zugsɔb onɛ vʋe la yʋ'ʋr zug m yɛti ye, m na maali ya nwɛnɛ man wʋm ka ya pian'ad si'em la.

english_verse: You will die right here in the desert, and your dead bodies will cover the ground. You have insulted me, and none of you men who are over
translation_verse: Sian'akaŋa ni ya niŋgbiŋ ye li yadig nɛ zin'ig wʋsa. Onɛ wʋsa an wʋʋ yʋʋm pisi bɛɛ gaad ala ka ya daa kaal kaalʋg la saŋa la, ka o nyɔn mam la,

english_verse: will enter the land that I solemnly promised to give you as your own—only Caleb and Joshua will go in.
translation_verse: ya nid baa yinne kʋ kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka m da pɔ nɛ nimmua ye li na liebi ya teŋ la, ya'a ka' Kaleb onɛ an Jefune biig la nɛ Josua onɛ an Nun biig la ma'aanɛ.

english_verse: You were worried that your own children would be captured. But I, the Lord, will let them enter the land you have rejected.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlimmi ya biis banɛ ka ya fabin ye ba na gban'e ba keŋ ka ba kilim yammis la, m na mɔri ba na ka ba na di malisim teŋ kanɛ ka ya zan'asi li la ni.

english_verse: You will die here in the desert!
translation_verse: Amaa yanam niŋgbiŋ ye li yadig nɛ sian'akaŋa ni.

english_verse: So they got up early the next morning and got ready to head toward the hill country of Canaan. They said, “We were wrong to complain about the Lord. Let's go into the land that he promised us.”
translation_verse: Ba da duoe bɛkɛung asuba kennɛ kpa'ad teŋ kanɛ ka kʋkʋna bɛ la, ka yɛl ye, “Ti tʋm bɛ'ɛd. Ti na keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka Zugsɔb kaanb la.”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “You're disobeying the Lord! Your plan won't work,
translation_verse: Amaa Moses da yɛl ye, “Bɔ ka ya zan'as Zugsɔb nɔɔr zi'elʋgɔ? Nɛ' kʋ nyaŋi sʋŋi yaa!

english_verse: The Amalekites and the Canaanites came down from the hill country, defeated the Israelites, and chased them as far as the town of Hormah.
translation_verse: Dinzug Amalek nɛ Keenan dim banɛ bɛ kʋkʋna ni la da sig na tʋ'ʋsi ba nyaŋi ba ka kʋʋ ba hali ti paae Horma.

english_verse: The people of Israel were very sad after Moses gave them the Lord's message.
translation_verse: Moses n da yɛl Israel dim labaar kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la tis o la, ba da kaas nɛ hali.

english_verse: so don't even try it. The Lord refuses to help you, because you turned your backs on him. The Amalekites and the Canaanites are your enemies, and they will attack and defeat you.”
translation_verse: Amalek nɛ Keenan dim la na tʋ'ʋsi ya ani. Yanamɛ fɛndig ka bas Zugsɔb la zug, o kʋ bɛ nɛ yaa, ba na kʋʋ ya zaba la ni!”

english_verse: But the Israelites ignored Moses and marched toward the hill country, even though the sacred chest and Moses did not go with them.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, ban tɛn'ɛs ye ba na nyaŋ la, ba da keŋ kʋkʋna teŋin la la'an nɛ Moses nɛ Nɔnaar Daka la pʋ yi la'asʋg zin'igin la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Zugsɔb da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: Bulls or rams or goats are the animals that you may burn on the altar as sacrifices to please me. You may also offer sacrifices voluntarily or because you made a promise, or because they are part of your regular religious ceremonies. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: ba na maal maana tis man onɛ an Zugsɔb la ka li nyuug na malisi tisim. Ba ya'a maan nyu'or maan bɛɛ maan kanɛ ka ba kaanbi zi'el bɛɛ ya'amlɛog maan bɛɛ maan sieba, linɛ aan ya niigi bɛɛ kɔnbid,

english_verse: If you sacrifice a young ram or goat, you must also offer a kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil as a grain sacrifice. A liter of wine must also be poured on the altar.
translation_verse: Pɛribig wʋsa linɛ na maal nyu'or maan la bɛɛ maan buudi wʋsa, on bɔɔm daam yubʋg yinne pɛ'ɛs ka li an bʋnnuuda maan.

english_verse: If a bull is offered as a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing,
translation_verse: O ya'a mɔr na'araug na ye o maal maan linɛ nyu'od, bɛɛ maal maan ka li anɛ kaanbʋg, bɛɛ taaba la'asʋg maan na tis Zugsɔb,

english_verse: you must offer three kilograms of flour mixed with two liters of olive oil.
translation_verse: on mɔr na'araug nɛ zʋʋd maan linɛ an zɔ'ɔm kuriba anu gɛndig nɛ kpaam kɔliba ayi'.

english_verse: Two liters of wine must also be poured on the altar. The smell of this smoke is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Ka mɛ mɔr daam yubis ayi' na ka li an bʋnnuuda maan. Li anɛ piinkanɛ nyu'od ka li nyuug la malisi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: If you are a native Israelite, you must obey these rules each time you offer a bull, a ram, or a goat as a sacrifice.
translation_verse: “Onɛ ka ba du'a o ka o an Israel nid wʋsa anɛ ye o maal anwa o ya'a mɔr maan kanɛ nyu'od bugum ka li nyuug la na malisi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: This law will never change. I am the Lord, and I consider all people the same, whether they are Israelites or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Zi'ela la nɛ malima la na an yinne tis yanam nɛ saam banɛ wʋsa bɛɛ ya san'an la.”

english_verse: When you eat food in the land that I am giving you, remember to set aside some of it as an offering to me.
translation_verse: ka di teŋ la diib, yanam on gbin'e sieba ka li an maannɛ tis man onɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: From the first batch of bread dough that you make after each new grain harvest, make a loaf of bread and offer it to me, just as you offer grain.
translation_verse: Yʋʋm wʋsa ya ya'a bʋn bʋmpaala yanam on maalim ma'asa yiiga tis wʋʋ maana la ka ya ɛɛnti tisid zieŋin si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses to tell the people what must be done if they ever disobey his laws:
translation_verse: zi'elbanɛ wʋsa ka Zugsɔb dɔlis Moses ni tisi ya la, lin pin'il daakanɛ ka Zugsɔb da dɛŋin tisi ti la ti paae zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ na ti kena la;

english_verse: If all of you disobey one of my laws without knowing it, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice, a wine offering, and a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: ka nɛ' ya'a niŋ ka li ka' pitɔɔgɔ ka teŋ la dim zi' li yɛlaa, ba wʋsa na nɔk na'arapɔlli maal maan kanɛ nyu'od ka li nyuug la malisi tis Zugsɔb la, la'an nɛ li zʋʋd maan nɛ li bʋnnuuda maan, wʋʋ zi'elʋg suori an si'em la, ka nɔk bʋribigi maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan.

english_verse: Then the priest will pray and ask me to forgive you. And since you did not mean to do wrong, and you offered sacrifices,
translation_verse: Maanmaan la anɛ o maal suguru sɔsʋg maannɛ tis Israel nidib la wʋsa, ka Zugsɔb la na kɛɛ ba taali bas, bɔzugɔ ba pʋ tʋmi li nɛ pɔn'ɔsim, ka mɛ mɔr maan linɛ nyu'od nɛ bugum nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan na tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong without knowing it, you must sacrifice a year-old female goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Amaa nid yinne ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛd ka li ka' pɔn'ɔsim, o na mɔr bʋsa'a onɛ an yʋʋm yinne na maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan.

english_verse: The law will be the same for anyone who does wrong without meaning to, whether an Israelite or a foreigner living among you.
translation_verse: Zi'elkan bɛnɛ tis sɔ' wʋsa, o sɔb ya'a anɛ Israel nid bɛɛ saan.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong on purpose, whether Israelite or foreigner, you have sinned against me by disobeying my laws. You will no longer belong to my people. A Man Put to Death for Gathering Firewood on the Sabbath
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ o zan'as Zugsɔb nɔɔr ka san'am o zi'elʋg, ka li an tilas ye ba yis o, o nidibin; ka o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la na kpɛlim o mɛŋ zugin. Dau kanɛ san'am Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la yɛla

english_verse: Once, while the Israelites were traveling through the desert, a man was caught gathering firewood on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Israel nidib la da nam bɛ mɔɔgin la, Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar yinne ka ba da nyɛ dau sɔ' pi'isid daad.

english_verse: He was taken to Moses, Aaron, and the rest of the community.
translation_verse: Banɛ da nyɛɛ o la da mɔr o kɛn Moses nɛ Aaron nɛ nidib la wʋsa tuon na,

english_verse: But no one knew what to do with him, so he was not allowed to leave.
translation_verse: ka ba nɔk o kpar dɔɔgin, bɔzugɔ ba da zi' ban na tɛɛg o tʋbir si'em.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Tell the people to take that man outside the camp and stone him to death!”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses, ye, “Dau la anɛ o kpi. Li anɛ tilas ye nidib la wʋsa yis o yiŋ ka lɔb o nɛ kuga ka o kpi.”

english_verse: So he was killed, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Tassels on the People's Clothes
translation_verse: Ka nidib la sid nɔk o yis yiŋ ka lɔb o nɛ kuga kʋ wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses si'em la. Linɛ na sɛɛn tabili ba fuud zug la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Sew tassels onto the bottom edge of your clothes and tie a blue string to each tassel.
translation_verse: “Pian'am tis Israel nidib la ye, ‘Lin yi zina ken sa ya na sɛn futusa tabili ya fuud nɔɔr, ka nɔk nwiig linɛ an bʋlʋ niŋi li wʋsa.

english_verse: These will remind you that you must obey my laws and teachings. And when you do, you will be dedicated to me and won't follow your own sinful desires.
translation_verse: Ka ya na tiɛn ka siaki m zi'ela la ka pɛsigi ya mɛŋi tisi ya Wina'am ka an kasi.

english_verse: Korah son of Izhar was a Levite from the Kohathite clan. One day he called together Dathan, Abiram, and On from the Reuben tribe, and the four of them decided to rebel against Moses. So they asked
translation_verse: ka ki'is Moses. Banɛ da pɛ'ɛsi ba zug da anɛ Israel nidib dap kɔbisyi' nɛ pisnu, banɛ ka ba mi' ba sʋ'ʋŋa nidibin la, ka mɛ lɛn gaŋi ba ka ba bɛ tu'am zin'igin la.

english_verse: and Aaron and said, “Why do you think you're so much better than everyone else? We're part of the Lord's holy people, and he's with all of us. What makes you think you're the only ones in charge?”
translation_verse: Ba da la'as taaba kena ye ba ki'is Moses nɛ Aaron ka yɛli ba ye, “Ya bʋn la yʋ'ʋn tʋʋg nɛ! Israel la'asʋg pʋʋgin sɔ' wʋsa anɛ kasi, ka Zugsɔb la bɛɛ ba ni. Bɔ ka yanam maali ya mɛŋ kpɛɛmnamɛ dʋ'ʋsi ya mɛŋ Zugsɔb nidib la wʋsa tuonnɛ?”

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he knelt down to pray.
translation_verse: Moses n da wʋm nɛ' la o da luu avanba,

english_verse: Then he said to Korah and his followers: Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us the person he has chosen to be his priest, and that man will faithfully serve him.
translation_verse: ka yɛl Kora nɛ o nya'andɔlib la ye, “Bɛkɛung, Zugsɔb la na pa'al banɛ aan o nidib nɛ banɛ an kasi la, ka kɛ ka ba vurigi li'el o tuon. On gaŋ dau sɔ' la o na kɛ ka o kɛɛn o tuon na.

english_verse: Korah, here is what you and your followers must do: Get some fire pans, fill them with coals and incense, and place them near the sacred tent. And the man the Lord chooses will be his priest. Korah, this time you Levites have gone too far!
translation_verse: Fʋn Kora, nɛ fʋ nya'andɔlib la wʋsa saa na niŋ si'eli nwa': bɛog, ya na nɔk bʋnnyubisa nyu'or laas, ka nɔki bʋnnyubisa nyu'oe laasin la keŋ Zugsɔb la tuon. Dau kanɛ ka Zugsɔb gaŋ la, onɛ an kasi. Yanam Levi dɔɔg dim la fannɛ nu'ug.”

english_verse: You know that the God of Israel has chosen you Levites from all Israel to serve him by being in charge of the sacred tent and by helping the community to worship in the proper way. What more do you want?
translation_verse: Li pʋ sia'ali ya nɛ Israel Wina'am la gaŋi ya yisi ya taaba banɛ an Israel buudi la sʋʋgin laa? Ka o pʋ vurigi ya li'el o tuon ye ya tʋm o Pʋ'ʋsʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin tʋʋma ka zi'en nidib la tuonnɛ tʋmmi tisidi ba la?

english_verse: The Lord has given you a special responsibility, and now, Korah, you think you should also be his priest.
translation_verse: O vurig yanam nɛ ya Levi dim taab la miri o mɛŋ, amaa nannanna ya lɛm bɔɔd ye ya di'enɛ maanmaannib tʋʋma la ya'as. Ayei, ala ka' suorɛ.

english_verse: You and your followers have rebelled against the Lord, not against Aaron.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ la'asidi zabid sɔ' anɛ Zugsɔb la. Aaron aan anɔ'ɔn ka ya nyɔn o yɛla?”

english_verse: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, but they sent back this message: “We won't come!
translation_verse: Moses da tʋm buol Datan nɛ Abiram banɛ an Eliab biis la, ka ba yɛl ye, “Ti kʋ kenaa!

english_verse: It's bad enough that you took us from our rich farmland in Egypt to let us die here in the desert. Now you also want to boss us around!
translation_verse: Fʋn mɔri ti yi teŋ kanɛ pʋbid bin'isim nɛ siind la ni kena ye fʋ kʋʋ ti mɔɔgin kpɛla la pʋ siakɛɛ ka lɛm bɔɔd ye fʋ mugusi tii?

english_verse: Moses was very angry and said to the Lord, “Don't listen to these men! I haven't done anything wrong to them. I haven't taken as much as a donkey.”
translation_verse: Moses sʋnf da duoya ka o yɛl Zugsɔb la ye, “Da lɛn di'e ba maannɛ. Bɔzugɔ mam pʋ di'e si'eli ba san'anɛ, hali baa bʋŋ yinne gba, ka mɛ pʋ maali ba sɔ' si'el linɛ an bɛ'ɛdɛ!”

english_verse: Then he said to Korah, “Tomorrow you and your followers must go with Aaron to the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Moses da yɛl Kora ye, “Bɛog fʋn nɛ fʋ nya'andɔlib wʋsa na kɛn Zugsɔb la tuon na, la'an nɛ Aaron.

english_verse: The next day the men placed incense and coals in their fire pans and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa sid da nɔk o laa niŋ bugum li pʋʋgin nɛ bʋnnyubisa ka zi'en Moses nɛ Aaron tuon La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Korah had convinced the rest of the Israelites to rebel against their two leaders. When that happened, the Lord appeared in all his glory
translation_verse: Kora da la'as o nimbanɛ maan taawai la na ka ba zi'en La'asʋg Fuug sʋgʋr za'anɔɔrin la. Ka Wina'am girima kpɛn nie na ka nidib la wʋsa nyɛ.

english_verse: and said to Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses nɛ Aaron ye,

english_verse: “Get away from the rest of the Israelites so I can kill them at once!”
translation_verse: “Bakimi ya mɛŋ ka kɛ nimbama, ka m kʋʋ ba vuguri.”

english_verse: But the two men bowed down and prayed, “Our God, you gave these people life. Why would you punish everyone here when only one man has sinned?”
translation_verse: Amaa Moses nɛ Aaron da luu avanba kaas ye, “Wina'am, Wina'am, fʋn onɛ an ninsaal wʋsa vʋm, fʋ sʋʋnr na duoe nɛ nimbama wʋsa nid yinne tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zugɔɔ?”

english_verse: The Lord answered Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: “Tell the people to stay away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
translation_verse: “Yɛlim nidib la ye ba yisimi ba mɛŋ paalʋ ka bas Kora nɛ Datan nɛ Abiram sʋga la.”

english_verse: Moses walked over to Dathan and Abiram, and the other leaders of Israel followed.
translation_verse: Moses da dɔl Israel kpɛɛmnam la keŋ Datan nɛ Abiram san'an

english_verse: Then Moses warned the people, “Get away from the tents of these sinful men! Don't touch anything that belongs to them or you'll be wiped out.”
translation_verse: ka yɛl nidib la ye, “Da li'eli nimbɛ'ɛd bama sʋga laa, bɛɛ si'isi linɛ wʋsa aan ba laukɔ ka ya na kpi nɛ ba, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug.”

english_verse: So everyone moved away from those tents, except Korah, Dathan, Abiram, and their families.
translation_verse: Alazug ba da vurig ka bas Kora nɛ Datan nɛ Abiram dɔɔd la. Ka ba yina zi'enɛ ba dɔɔd la za'anɔɔrin nɛ ba pu'ab nɛ ba biis wʋsa.

english_verse: Moses said to the crowd, “The Lord has chosen me and told me to do these things—it wasn't my idea. And here's how you will know:
translation_verse: Moses da yɛl nidib la ye, “Anwana ka ya na baŋ ye Zugsɔb la tʋm mam na ye m maal nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa, ka ka' mam mɛŋ ya'am.

english_verse: If these men die a natural death, it means the Lord hasn't chosen me.
translation_verse: Nimbama ya'a kpi a-daar-paaeya kum, alaa Zugsɔb la pʋ tʋm mam naa.

english_verse: But suppose the Lord does something that has never been done before. For example, what if a huge crack appears in the ground, and these men and their families fall into it and are buried alive, together with everything they own? Then you will know they have turned their backs on the Lord!”
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la ya'a kɛ ka yɛl saaŋ niŋ, ka teŋ la buaki vɔli ba vʋt nɛ ba la'ad wʋsa, lin ka ya na baŋ ye nimbama sid tʋm Zugsɔb la linɛ kae.”

english_verse: As soon as Moses said this, the ground under the men opened up
translation_verse: Moses n pian' naae la nɔɔ, ka ban zi'e zin'isi'a la buak zin'is ayi'

english_verse: and swallowed them alive, together with their families and everything they owned. Then the ground closed back up, and they were gone.
translation_verse: Ba da sig bʋmbɔk la pʋʋg la'an nɛ ba la'ad wʋsa, ka teŋ la lɛbi mubil ka ba kpɛlim ani.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites heard their screams, so they ran off, shouting, “We don't want that to happen to us!”
translation_verse: Ban da kaasid kuŋ la ka Israel dim banɛ bɛɛ ani la da zɔt ka tansid ye, “Teŋ la mɛ bɔɔdi vɔli ti nɛ!”

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron's son Eleazar to take the fire pans from the smoldering fire and scatter the coals. The pans are now sacred,
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Elieza onɛ an Aaron biig ka an maanmaan la ye o yisim laas banɛ ka bugum la di nɛ nidib la, ka ba anɛ kasi. Ka kɛ ka ba mɔri ba keŋ lallisa kpa'as bugumsaana nɛ bʋnnyubisa la bas.

english_verse: because they were used for offering incense to me. Have them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar. Those men died because of their sin, and now their fire pans will become a warning for the rest of the community.”
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ kpi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug la laasi la. Ya nɔkimi lii zan' lammiri ligil maan daka la, bɔzugɔ ba daa nɔki li tis Zugsɔb la ka li lieb kasi tis o. Kɛl ka li an zanbinnɛ tis Israel buudi la.”

english_verse: Eleazar collected the pans and had them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar,
translation_verse: Eleazar sid da vaae kʋntzɛn'ug laas banɛ ka bugum la da dii ba la mɔr na zan' ligil maan daka la,

english_verse: just as the Lord had told Moses. The pans were a warning to the Israelites that only Aaron's descendants would be allowed to offer incense to the Lord. Anyone else who tried to would be punished like Korah and his followers. The Israelites Rebel and Are Punished
translation_verse: nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la pa'al o si'em yi Moses san'an la. Nɛ' da anɛ ye li tiɛn Israel dim ye ya'a ka' Aaron tuŋ la ma'aanɛ, sɔ' ka' suori na kɛn Zugsɔb la tuon na maal maannɛ. Onɛ mak, li na niŋ o wʋʋ Kora nɛ o nya'andɔlib la nɛ.

english_verse: The next day the people of Israel again complained against Moses and Aaron, “The two of you killed some of the Lord's people!”
translation_verse: Bɛogʋ da nie la, Israel dim la wʋsa da nyɔnnɛ Moses nɛ Aaron ye, “Yanamɛ kʋ Zugsɔb nidib la!”

english_verse: As the people crowded around them, Moses and Aaron turned toward the sacred tent, and the Lord appeared in his glory in the cloud covering the tent.
translation_verse: Amaa ban da pian' Moses nɛ Aaron n naae ka fɛndigi kpa' La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la, tɔ'ɔtɔ ka saŋgbauŋ sigi li zugin na ka Zugsɔb girima nie na.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron walked to the front of the tent,
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɛ Aaron keŋ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la tuon,

english_verse: where the Lord said to them,
translation_verse: ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: “Stand back! I am going to wipe out these Israelites once and for all.” They immediately bowed down and prayed.
translation_verse: “Yim nimbama sʋʋgin ka m san'ami ba vuguri.” Ka babayi' la wʋsa vanbin teŋin.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron, “Grab your fire pan and fill it with hot coals from the altar. Put incense in it, then quickly take it to where the people are and offer it to the Lord, so they can be forgiven. The Lord is very angry, and people have already started dying!”
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Aaron ye, “Nɔkimi fʋ laa la ka niŋ bʋnnyubisa li pʋʋgin, nɛ bugum linɛ bɛ maan daka la zug, ka keŋ nidib la bɛ si'el la tɔ'ɔtɔɔ maal maannɛ sɔs suguru tisi ba. Zugsɔb la sʋnf pʋn duoe nɛ nidib la nɛ ka tɔɔg pʋn pin'il.”

english_verse: Aaron walked back and stood with Moses at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Aaron da lɛb Moses san'an La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr za'anɔɔrin, bɔzugɔ tɔɔg la da gu'oya.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: Place these sticks in the tent right in front of the sacred chest where I appear to you.
translation_verse: Ti'ilimi ba La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin Nɔnaar Daka la tuon, zin'ikanɛ ka m ɛɛn kena sia'ali ya la.

english_verse: I will then choose a man to be my priest, and his stick will sprout. After that happens, I won't have to listen to any more complaints about you.
translation_verse: Man gaŋ sɔ' la dansaar na bus vaand, ala ka m na kɛ ka nyɔnyɔlis linɛ ka Israel dim la nyɔnnif daar wʋsa la kpi.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had commanded, and they gave him the walking sticks from the twelve tribal leaders, including Aaron's from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Moses da yɛl Israel dim la ka ba tuongatib la tis o dansaya piiga nɛ ayi', dɔɔg tuongat wʋsa nɛ o dansaar ka Aaron dansaar mɛ pɛ'ɛs.

english_verse: Moses took them and placed them in the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Moses da ti'il dansaya la Zugsɔb la tuon Nɔnaar Fuud Sʋgʋrin la.

english_verse: The next day when Moses went into the tent, flowers and almonds were already growing on Aaron's stick.
translation_verse: Bɛogʋ da nie ka Moses kpɛn' Sʋgʋrin la ka nyɛ ka Aaron dansaar, linɛ zi'e Levi dɔɔg yɛla la bus vanpɔla hali ka pu puum ka wal wala.

english_verse: Moses brought the twelve sticks out of the tent and showed them to the people. Each of the leaders found his own and took it.
translation_verse: Moses da vaae dansaya la wʋsa Zugsɔb Fuug Sʋgʋrin la yina. Ba da gɔsi ba, ka sɔ' wʋsa nɔk o dansaar.

english_verse: But the Lord told Moses, “Put Aaron's stick back! Let it stay near the sacred chest as a warning to anyone who might think of rebelling. If these people don't stop their grumbling about me, I will wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses ye, “Lɛbisim Aaron dansaar la ti'il Nɔnaar Daka la tuon ka li an zanbinnɛ tis banɛ nyɔn la. Nɛ' na kɛ ka ba bas man nyɔnyɔlʋg, ka da kpii.”

english_verse: Moses did what he was told.
translation_verse: Moses da niŋ wʋʋ Zugsɔb la pa'al o si'em la.

english_verse: The Israelites cried out to Moses, “We're done for
translation_verse: Israel dim la da yɛl Moses ye, “Ti na kpi! Ti bɔdig nɛ, ti wʋsa bɔdig nɛ!

english_verse: and doomed if we even go near the sacred tent!”
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa li'el Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la na kpi. Ti wʋsa ye ti kpinɛɛ?”

english_verse: The Levites are your relatives and are here to help you in your service at the tent.
translation_verse: Mɔri fʋ Levi taaba la kena ka ba sʋ'ʋŋif fʋn nɛ fʋ biis la ya'a ti maan maana Nɔnaar Fuug Sʋgʋr la tuon.

english_verse: You must see that they perform their duties. But if they go near any of the sacred objects or the altar, all of you will die.
translation_verse: Ba anɛ ye ba kɛlis fʋn yɛt si'el, ka tʋm tʋʋma la wʋsa Pʋ'ʋsim Sʋgʋrin la, amaa ba mid ka ba li'el Fuug Sʋgʋr la la'ad la ka ban nɛ fʋn wʋsa na kpi.
