english_verse: After I gave these instructions to the judges, I taught you the Lord's commands. Men Were Sent To Explore the Hill Country (Numbers
translation_verse: Saŋkan la mɛn, m da pa'ali ya si'el wʋsa dinɛ ka ya na tʋm. Ban tʋm sieba ye ba labisi gɔs teŋ la yɛla (Kal

english_verse: You stayed in your tents and grumbled, “The Lord must hate us—he brought us out of Egypt, just so he could hand us over to the Amorites and get rid of us.
translation_verse: Ya da kpɛm bɛɛ ya sʋga la ni ka nyɔnnɛ yɛt ye, “Zugsɔb la kisi ti nɛ, ka yisi ti Egipt teŋin ye o zaŋi ti niŋ Amor dim nu'usin ka ba san'ami ti.

english_verse: Right after the Lord commanded us to leave Mount Sinai, I told you: Israel, being your leader is too big a job for one person.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka m da yɛli ya ye, “Ya anɛ zitita'are tisim ka m kʋ tun'e ziidi ya m kɔn'ɔkɔn'.

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya yaanam Wina'am la kɛl ka ya maligim paas nɔɔr tusir ya'as ka niŋi ya bareka nwɛnɛ on da zi'el si'em la!

english_verse: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.
translation_verse: Amaa m na niŋ wala zii ya yɛla nɛ ya ziid nɛ ya zaba la wʋsa m kɔn'ɔkɔn'?

english_verse: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of
translation_verse: Ala ka m nɔk tuongatibi ya buudi la ni banɛ mɔr ya'am ka nidib na'asidi ba la, gaŋi ba ye ba mɔr kpi'euŋʋ sʋ'oe ya, ka sieba sʋ'oe nidib tusir-tusir, ka sieba sʋ'oe kɔbig-kɔbig, ka sieba sʋ'oe pisnu nu, ka sieba sʋ'oe piig-piig; ka ba an dɔɔd la kpɛɛmnam.

english_verse: and others became judges. I gave these judges the following instructions: When you settle legal cases, your decisions must be fair. It doesn't matter if the case is between two Israelites, or between an Israelite and a foreigner living in your community.
translation_verse: Saŋa kan la ka m da tisi ya sariakatib la nɔɔr ye ba kɛlisi ya antu'a ka tis bʋʋd ka li dɔl suor, pian'ad la ya'a anɛ Israel dim nɛ taaba bɛɛ banɛ an saam la.

english_verse: And it doesn't matter if one is helpless and the other is powerful. Don't be afraid of anyone! No matter who shows up in your court, God will help you make a fair decision. If any case is too hard for you, bring the people to me, and I will make the decision.
translation_verse: Ya da kɛ ka baregaŋ bɛ sariakadib la nii; kɛlisim banɛ an tadimnam nɛ banɛ an kpi'emnam wʋsa pian'ad. Da zɔ dau sɔ' dabiem; sariakadib anɛ Wina'am din. Pian'ad kanɛ kpi'emi tisi ya, mɔri kɛɛn m san'an na ka mam mɛŋ kɛlis pian'ad la.

english_verse: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.
translation_verse: hali nɛ on da gaadi ya tuonnɛ ya suor duor la pʋʋgin, an bugum yʋ'ʋŋ ka an saŋgbauŋ nintaŋi tisi ya ye o pa'ali ya zin'ikanɛ ka ya na vʋ'ʋs nɛ suokanɛ ka ya na dɔl la.” Wina'am tɛɛg Israel dim tʋbir (Kal

english_verse: The Lord had commanded us to leave Mount Sinai and go to the hill country that belonged to the Amorites, so we started out into the huge desert. You remember how frightening it was, but soon we were at Kadesh-Barnea,
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la zi'el nɔɔr si'em tisi ti la, ti da yi Horeb kennɛ kpa'ad Amor dim teŋ kanɛ an kʋkʋna teŋ la, ka ti dɔlli yi sian'atita'ar linɛ mɔr dabiem la, ka yʋ'ʋn paae Kades Banɛa na.

english_verse: and I told you, “We have reached the hill country. It belongs to the Amorites now, but the Lord our God is giving it to us. He is the same God our ancestors worshiped, and he has told us to go in and take this land, so don't hesitate and be afraid.”
translation_verse: Gɔsimiya, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la tisi ya teŋ la. Kem kpɛn' ka sʋ'ʋgi li, nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya yaanam Wina'am la yɛli ya si'em la. Da zɔti dabiem, mɛ da kɛ ka ya giinla siɛn.”

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Ka ya wʋsa kɛɛn m san'an na yɛl ye, “Kɛl ka ti tʋm nidib ka ba keŋ tuonnɛ labisi gɔs teŋ la ka lɛb na yɛli ti suor kanɛ ka ti na dɔlli kpɛn', nɛ tempʋʋd banɛ ka ti na paae.

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Gban'akaŋa da an sʋm tisim, ka m gaŋi ya nidib piiga nɛ ayi'; dɔɔg wʋsa nid yinne.

english_verse: They explored the hill country as far as Bunch Valley
translation_verse: Ka ba duoe keŋ kʋkʋna teŋin ti paae Esikol bɔn'ɔgin gɔɔndi giligid.

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: Ka mɔr teŋ la zʋʋdi lɛb na pa'ali ti, ka yɛl ye teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am tisi ti la anɛ teŋ sʋŋ.”

english_verse: Then you came back to the place of worship at Kadesh-Barnea and wept, but the Lord would not listen to your prayers. Israel Spent Years in the Desert Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ka ya yʋ'ʋn lɛb na kum Zugsɔb la tuon; amaa ka o pʋ kɛlisi ya kukuma la, ka ɛndi o tʋba.

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Amaa ya da pʋ bɔɔd ye ya keŋɛ, ka zan'as Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am nɔzi'elʋg la.

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Ya ka ti na keŋɛ? Ti ba'abiis la kɛ ka ti giinla kɛns nɛ; ba yɛl ye, nidib la wa'am ka mɔr paŋi gati ti; tempʋʋd la anɛ tempʋbɛda, ka li zaŋguoma wa'ami paae saŋgbauŋ, hali ba nyɛ Anak dim banɛ an gandaad la anina!”

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am onɛ gati ya tuon la na zabi tisi ya, nwɛnɛ on da niŋ Egipt si'em tisi ya ka ya nini nyɛ la.

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: Sian'arin la mɛn, ya da nyɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la mɔri ya nwɛnɛ dau na ziid o biig si'em la, din yi zin'ikanɛ ka ya yina la ti paae kpɛla na.

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: La'an nɛ nɛ' wʋsa ni, ya pʋ tisi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la sidaa,

english_verse: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da wʋm yanamɛ yɛl si'el la, o sʋnf pɛlig nɛ ka o pɔ ye,

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: “Zʋmaaŋ bɛ'ɛd nwa' nid baa yinne kʋ nyɛ teŋ sʋŋ kanɛ ka m kaanb ye m tisi ya yaanam la,

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: asɛɛ Kaleb onɛ an Jefune biig la ma'aa. O na nyɛɛ li ka mam na tis o yaas teŋ kanɛ ka o nɔk o nɔbiri nɔ wʋsa, bɔzugɔ, o dɔl Zugsɔb la nɛ o sʋnf wʋsa.”

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Yanam zug ka Zugsɔb la sʋnf pɛlig nɛ mam ka yɛlim ye, “Fʋn mɛ kʋ kpɛn' anii,

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: amaa fʋ nya'andɔl Josua onɛ an Nun biig la na kpɛn'. Kpɛmisim o bɔzugɔ, onɛ na gaad Israel dim tuon ka ba sʋ'ʋgi li.

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Ka bibibis banɛ ka ya ye ba na gban'e ba ka ba lieb yammis nɛ ya biis banɛ nan zi' sʋm nɛ bɛ'ɛdi bakid la na kpɛn' teŋin la. M na nɔki li tisi ba ka ba na sʋ'ʋgi li.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Ani ka ya lɛbis ye, “Ti tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb la. Ti na lɛbi zab wʋʋ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la tisi ti nɔɔr si'em la.” Ala ka sɔ' wʋsa nɔk o zaba la'ad, ka tɛn'ɛs ye, zuoya teŋ la kpɛn'ɛb na an na'ana.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Yɛlimi ba ye, ‘Da keŋ zabinya, bɔzugɔ man kʋ bɛ nɛ ya. Ya dataas la na nyaŋi ya.’”

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Ala ka m yɛli ya, amaa ya pʋ kɛlisɛ. Ya da zan'as Zugsɔb la nɔɔr ka nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgʋ duoe keŋ zuoya teŋin la.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Ka Amor dim banɛ bɛ zuoya teŋin la da yina zab nɛ ya; ka kadi ya nwɛnɛ siins nɛ. Ba da nyaŋi ya Seir teŋinɛ kadi ya hali paae Horma teŋin.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye,

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: ‘Ya giilim kʋkʋna teŋ nwa', ka li yuugi galis; nannanna fɛndigim kpa'ae datiuŋ baba.’”

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: Tisim nidib la nɔkaŋa: “Ya yʋ'ʋn bɔɔdi kpɛn' nɛ ya ba'abiis banɛ an Esau yaas sʋ'ʋlimin linɛ bɛ Seir teŋin la. Ba na zɔti ya dabiem amaa gu'usimi

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: ka da kɛ ka ba sʋnya duoe ka ba zab nɛ ya, ka man pʋn kʋ tisi ya ba teŋ la baa bi'ela ka li siaki ya nɔbpauŋ zi'eligɔ. M da nɔk Seir dinɛ an kʋkʋna teŋ la tis Esau ye o sʋ'oe.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka ya nɔk ligidi da' diib linɛ ka ya na dit nɛ ku'om linɛ ka ya na nuud la.”

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Ka ti mɔr kennɛ ti tʋʋgi ti ba'abiis banɛ an Esau yaas ka bɛ Seir teŋin la, ka fɛndigi yi Araba suorin dinɛ yit Elaf nɛ Eziyon Geber n dʋt na la, ka dɔl Moab sian'anr suori keŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Da daami Moab nidib la bɛɛ ya kɛ ka ba sʋnya duoe ka ba zab nɛ ya, ka m kʋ tisi yaa ba teŋ la zin'isi'a baa bi'elaa. Man nɔk Ar teŋ la tis Lot yaas ye ba sʋ'oe.”

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: (Saŋa linɛ gaad la, Emi dim banɛ mɔr paŋ ka zu'oe ka wa'ami nwɛnɛ Anak dim la da bɛɛ ani.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Ban nɛ Anak dim la wʋsa, ba da buonnɛ ba ye Refa dim, amaa Moab dim la da buonnɛ ba ye Emi dim.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Hor dim la mɛ da ɛɛnti bɛ Seir, amaa Esau yaas la kadi baa yis. Ba da san'am Hor dim la ka zin'inɛ ba bɛllim zin'ig la sʋ'ʋgi li, nwɛnɛ Israel dim la da niŋ si'em teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la tisi ba ka ba sʋ'ʋgi li la.)

english_verse: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Nannanna, duom lɔ'ɔŋi Zered bɔn'ɔg la.” Ala ka ti sid lɔ'ɔŋ bɔn'ɔg la.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: Zabzabidib la yʋ'ʋn da kpii naae nidib la sʋʋgin la,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye,

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: “Zina ka ya na dɔlli yi Moab sʋ'ʋlim linɛ an Ar teŋin la.

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti paae Ammon dim teŋin na, yanam da daami ba, bɛɛ ya kɛ ka ba sʋnya duoe ka ba zabɛ, ka man kʋ tisi ya Ammon dim teŋ paalʋ la zin'isi'a ka ya sʋ'ʋgɛ, li anɛ Ammon dim teŋ ka m nɔki li tis Lot yaas ye ba sʋ'oe.”

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: (Nidib da buon zin'ikan la ye Refa dim teŋ bɔzugɔ Refa dim la da pʋn bɛɛ anina, amaa Ammon dim la da buonnɛ ba ye Zamzum dim.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mɛ da niŋnɛ ala tis Esau yaas banɛ da bɛ Seir la. O da san'am Hor dimi ba nini ni. Ba da kadi baa yis ka zin'inɛ ani ti paae zina.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim Avi dim banɛ da bɛ teŋkpɛmisin hali mɔri paae Gaza la, Kafitor dim banɛ yi Kafitor la da kenna san'ami ba ka zin'inɛ ba zin'igin la.)

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: “Duomi nannanna keŋ tuonnɛ lɔ'ɔŋ Arnon bɔn'ɔg la. Gɔsimiya, m nɔk Sihon onɛ an Ammon nid ka an Hesbon na'ab nɛ o teŋgbauŋ la niŋi ya nu'ugin. Pin'ilim sʋ'ʋginɛ li ka tʋ'ʋs o nɛ zaba.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Din yi zina, m na kɛ ka nidib ya'am ian'ad ka dabiem mɔr buudi wʋsa banɛ bɛ dunia nwa' ni la yanam zug. Ba na wʋmi ya labaar ka kirid ka ba sʋnya san'am yanam yɛla.” Ba nyaŋ Hesbon na'ab Sihon (Kal

english_verse: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:
translation_verse: M da tʋm nidib ka ba yi Kedemof sian'arin keŋ Sihon onɛ an Hesbon na'ab la san'an tisid o sumbʋgʋsʋm, yɛt o ye,

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: “Kɛl ka ti dɔlli fʋ teŋgbauŋʋn la gaad. Ti na bɛ suoraug la zug ka kʋ fɛndig datiuŋ bɛɛ dagɔbʋga.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: nwɛnɛ Esau yaas banɛ bɛ Seir nɛ Moab dim banɛ bɛ Ar la niŋ si'em tisi ti, hali ti paae tinamɛ lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan n paae teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am tisi ti la.

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Gɔsima, m pin'ili nɔkid Sihon nɛ o teŋgbauŋ la niŋidi ya nu'usin; nyaŋimini ba ka sʋ'ʋg o teŋ la.”

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Sihon nɛ o soogianam la wʋsa da yi ye ba tʋ'ʋsi ti Jahaz teŋinɛ zab nɛ ti la,

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la nɔk o niŋi ti nu'usin ka ti nyaŋ o, on nɛ o biis nɛ o soogianam la wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Din yi Aroa linɛ bɛ Arnon bɔn'ɔg nɔɔrin la nɛ tempʋʋg dinɛ bɛ bɔn'ɔgin la, mɔr hali paae Gilead, tempʋʋg baa yinne kae gaadi ti paŋa. Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la zaŋi ba wʋsa tisi ti.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Amaa nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am nɔɔr zi'elʋgʋ an si'em la, ya pʋ kpɛn' Ammon dim tɛɛnsin la, bɛɛ teŋ linɛ bɛ Yabok kɔldaug nɔɔrin la, bɛɛ tɛɛns banɛ bɛ kʋkʋna ni la.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Da zɔt o dabiem, ka m zaŋ on nɛ o soogianam la wʋsa nɛ o teŋ la tisi ya. Niŋim o nwɛnɛ fʋn niŋ Sihon onɛ an Amor dim na'ab ka sʋ'oe Hesbon teŋ si'em la.”

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Ka ti san'ami ba wʋsa, nwɛnɛ tinamɛ niŋ Sihon Hesbon na'ab si'em la. Ka ti san'am tempʋʋd la nidib, dap nɛ pu'ab nɛ biis wʋsa.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Ala ka saŋa kan la ka ti nyaŋ Amor na'anama ayi' nwa' ka faaɛn ba sʋ'ʋlim dinɛ bɛ Joodan nya'aŋ la, din yi Arnon bɔn'ɔgin la mɔri paae Hemon zuorin la.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Ti da faaɛn tɛɛns banɛ bɛ kʋkʋna zug nɛ Gilead teŋgbauŋʋn la nɛ Basan wʋsa mɔri paae Saleka nɛ Edire; linɛ an Na'ab Og tempʋʋd banɛ bɛ Basan la.

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: ti paae saŋa kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la na tisi ya ba'abiis nwɛnɛ on tisi ya si'em la, ka ban mɛ na sʋ'ʋg teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am na tisi ba Joodan lɔ'ɔm la. Din nya'aŋ la sɔ' wʋsa na lɛbi sʋ'ʋg dinɛ ka m tisi ya la.”

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: Saŋa kan la ka m bɛllim Zugsɔb la ye,

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: “M Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, fʋ pin'ili pa'alim fʋn zu'oe si'em nɛ fʋ nu'ug la kpi'em si'em. Win kan bɛ yaanɛ, arezana bɛɛ dunia zugʋ na nyaŋi tʋm fʋn maal si'el nɛ tʋʋm kpi'ema banɛ ka fʋ tʋm la?

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m keŋ gɔs teŋ sʋŋ dinɛ bɛ Joodan kɔldaug lɔm la; kʋkʋna teŋ kanɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa la nɛ Lebanon.”

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Amaa yanam zug, Zugsɔb la sʋnf da pɛlig nɛ mam ka o kʋ kɛlisi m pian'adɛ, ka yɛl ye, “Di sia'al ya, da lɛn pian'adim nɛ' yɛlaa!

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Kem dʋ Pisiga zuor zugʋ gɔs ya-tuona nɛ ya-datiuŋ, ka gɔs ya-dagɔbʋg nɛ ya-nya'aŋ. Gɔsim teŋ la nɛ fʋ mɛŋ nini, fʋn sadigim kʋ lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan kaŋa la.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Amaa zaŋim Josua zi'el nidib la tuon ka kpɛmis o ka tis o paŋ, ka onɛ na dɔlli baa lɔ'ɔŋ ka na kɛ ka ba sʋ'ʋg teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ na nyɛ la.”

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Ani ka ti kpɛlim bɔn'ɔg linɛ kpi'e Befipeor la.

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Alazug nannanna nwa', yanam Israel dima, kɛlisimi zi'ela nɛ wada banɛ ka m bɔɔd ye m pa'ali ya la; dɔlisimi nɛ ba ka ya na vʋe, ka na kpɛn' sʋ'ʋg teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya yaanam Wina'am ye o tisi ya la.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Da paasi bɛɛ yisi si'el nɔzi'ela banɛ ka m tisidi ya la, amaa dɔlli Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am zi'ela banɛ ka m tisi ya la.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: amaa yanam banɛ gban'e Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am nu'us ayi' la nan kpɛn vʋe zina.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Kʋdim gu'usimi ka gɔsi ya mɛŋ sʋ'ʋŋa, ka ala ka ya kʋ tam dinɛ ka ya nini nyɛ la, bɛɛ li yii ya pʋtɛn'ɛrinɛ ya vʋm saŋa wʋsa. Pa'alimini ya biis ka ban mɛ ti pa'ali ba biis.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Tɛnri dabiskanɛ ka ya da zi'en Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la tuon Horeb zuorin la, saŋkan ka o da yɛlim ye, “La'asim nidib la m tuon ka ba wʋmi m pian'ad, ka na zamis ka zɔt mam ba bɛllim saŋa wʋsa teŋgbauŋ kaŋa ni, ka na pa'ali ba biis.”

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Ya da li'el na zi'en zuor la gbinnin, saŋa kanɛ ka bugum diti yit arezana ni na nɛ saŋgbansabilis nɛ lik tita'ar.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb pian'ad bugumin la tisidi ya. Ka ya wʋm pian'ad la, ka lɛɛ pʋ nyɛ si'ela. Kʋkɔr ma'aa da bɛɛ ani pian'ad.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: O da nie o nɔnaar la nyain, nɛ zi'ela piiga banɛ ka o zi'eli tisi ya ye ya dɔl la, ka sɔbi li niŋ kuglamma ayi' ni.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la tisim suor saŋkan la ye m pa'ali ya zi'ela nɛ wada banɛ ka ya na dɔl, yanamɛ lɔ'ɔŋid Joodan ye ya sʋ'ʋg teŋ si'a la.

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: Daakanɛ ka Zugsɔb la da pian'adi tisidi yaa yit bugumin Horeb zuorin la, ya da pʋ nyɛt si'el si'ela. Dinzugɔ, gu'usimi nɛ ya mɛŋ sʋ'ʋŋa

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: ka da tʋmmi dian'ad tʋʋma ka li kɛ ka ya maal bada bɛɛ ya'ab bada banɛ nwɛnɛ dau, bɛɛ pu'a tisi ya mɛŋa.

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Ka ya ya'a ti gɔs saŋgbauŋin la, ka nyɛ winnig nɛ nwadig nɛ nwadbibis nɛ dinɛ bɛɛ agɔl la wʋsa, yanam da kɛ ka li ma'aa ya ka ya igini ba tuon ka zun'e linɛ wʋsa ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la nɔki tis buudi wʋsa dunia kaŋa ni la.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋnf da pɛlig nɛ mam yanam zug, ka o pɔɔ zi'el ye mam kʋ lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan mu'ar nwaa kpɛn' teŋ sʋŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la ye o tisi ya ka li liebi ya faar la.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Man na kpi teŋ kaŋa ni; m kʋ lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan nɛ, amaa yanam lɔ'ɔŋid nɛ ye ya sʋ'ʋg teŋ sʋŋ la.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Gu'usimi, ka da tam Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am nɔnaar dinɛ ka o naal nɛ ya la; da maali ba'ar dinɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am kis la tisi ya mɛŋa.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la anɛ fufum Wina'am, ka an bugum kanɛ kanbid.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na widigi ya nidib la sʋʋgin, ka ya bi'ela ma'aa na kpɛlim buudbanɛ ka Zugsɔb la na mɔri ya keŋ la ni.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Anina ka ya pʋ'ʋsid daad nɛ kuga bada banɛ ka ninsaalib maal ka ba pʋ nyɛta ka pʋ wʋm bɛɛ dit bɛɛ wʋm nyuugɔ.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti bɛ namisʋg pʋʋgin, ka yɛlbama wʋsa paae ya, dabisa banɛ kpɛlim nya'aŋ la, ya na fɛndigi lɛb Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la san'an na ka siak o nɔɔr,

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la anɛ nimbaanlzɔɔr Wina'am. O kʋ basi ya bɛɛ o san'ami ya bɛɛ o tam nɔnaar dinɛ ka o maal nɛ ya yaanam, ka siaki pɔɔ zi'el la. Zugsɔb la an Wina'am

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Win si'a nan mi' mɔ ye o yis buudi yinne buudsi'a pʋʋgin tis o mɛŋ ka li an makir, nɛ zanbin nyalima nɛ yɛl nyalima nɛ zaba nɛ nu'ug kpi'euŋ nɛ nu'ug kanɛ mɔr paŋ hali tiɛnd la, nɛ kilima tʋʋma, nwɛnɛ dinɛ wʋsa ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am tʋm tisi ya Egipt teŋinɛ ya nini ni laa?

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: O naam arezana ni kɛ ka ya wʋm o kʋkɔr ye o tɛɛgi ya tʋbir. Teŋgbauŋʋn nwa' mɛn, o pa'ali ya o bugum tita'ar, ka ya wʋm ka o pian'ad ka li yit bugumin na.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: On nɔŋi ya yaanam la zug, ka o gaŋ yanam banɛ aan ba yaas banɛ duoe ba nya'aŋ la mɔri ya yi Egipt na nɛ o mɛŋ paŋ tita'ar la,

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: ka kad buudbanɛ bɛɛ ya tuonnɛ zu'oe ka kpi'emi gati ya la, amaa o mɔri ya kpɛn' ba teŋin na, ka nɔki li tisi ya ka li aan ya faar wʋʋ lin an si'em zina la.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ka nɔki li lɔɔ ya sʋnfʋn zina ye, Zugsɔb la anɛ Wina'am bɛ arezana linɛ bɛɛ agɔla, ka bɛ dunia linɛ bɛ teŋir la, ka sɔ' lɛn kae.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Tɛnri nɛ o nɔzi'elʋg dinɛ ka m tisidi ya zina la, ala ka si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya biis banɛ na duoe ya nya'aŋ na la, ka ya bɛllim na yuug teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am tisi ya la ni saŋa wʋsa. Suak tɛɛns la yɛla

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: ka bɛ bɔn'ɔgin kpi'e Befipeor, Joodan nya'aŋ la. Li da bɛnɛ Amor na'ab Sihon teŋin onɛ dit na'am Hesbon, onɛ ka Moses nɛ Israel dim da nyaŋ, ban da yi Egipt na la.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Ba da faaɛn o teŋ nɛ Basan na'ab Og teŋ mɛn, Ammon dim na'anama ayi' banɛ bɛ Joodan nya'aŋ la.

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Teŋ kaŋa da naanɛ Aroa, Aanon bɔn'ɔg nɔɔrin la, paae Siriyon zuorin .

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: Ka li kpanb nɛ Araba dinɛ bɛ Joodan nya'aŋ la wʋsa hali ti paae Araba Atɛuk dinɛ bɛ Pisig zuor teŋir la.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Moses da la'as Israel dim ka yɛli ba ye yanam Israel dima, kɛlisimi zi'ela nɛ wada banɛ ka m nied nyain tisidi ya zina la! Zamisiminɛ li ka siaki dɔlisi li.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: “Mid ka fʋ kʋ nid.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la da naal nɔɔr nɛ ti Horeb zuorin la.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Li da ka'anɛ ti yaanam ka Zugsɔb la naal nɔɔr nɛ ba, amaa li anɛ tinam banɛ wʋsa la'asi zi'e kpɛla zina la.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da pian' tisi ya, ya nini ni, yit bugumin zuorin la.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: “Manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am ka yisi ya Egipt teŋin, zin'ikanɛ ka ya da an yammis ka ba namisidi ya la.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya dɔl winsieba lɛm paas man zug.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya maali wina linɛ an wʋʋ niiŋ bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg bɛɛ ziiŋa.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Da pʋ'ʋsi ba bɛɛ igini tisi ba girimaa. Mam onɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la, m anɛ nyuur sɔb, ka pʋ siak ye m pʋdigi m girima nɛ sɔ'ɔɔ. Banɛ ki'is mam la, m na namisi ba biisi ba saamnam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla, hali ti paae zʋmaana atan' nɛ anaasi,

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: ka pa'annɛ m nɔŋilim nɛ banɛ nɔŋ mam ka siaki m yɛlʋg la hali ti paae zʋmaana tusa-tusa.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya mɔri Zugsɔb Wina'am yʋ'ʋri maan yɔɔg-yɔɔg. Ya ya'a maal ala Zugsɔb na namisi ya.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Nɔkimi daba ayuobʋ tʋmmini ya tʋʋma.

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: Amaa daba ayɔpɔi la anɛ Zugsɔb Wina'am din ka li pʋ sʋm ye ya tʋm tʋʋm si'a, yanam bɛɛ ya biribis bɛɛ bipumis, bɛɛ ya yamdaad bɛɛ yampu'ab, bɛɛ ya bʋnkɔnbid, bɛɛ saam banɛ bɛ nɛ ya la. Ala ka ya sankpan'as dap nɛ pu'ab na vʋ'ʋs wʋʋ yanamɛ vʋ'ʋsid si'em la.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: “Tisimi fʋ saam nɛ fʋ ma girima wʋʋ Zugsɔb onɛ aan fʋ Wina'am la zi'el si'em tisif la, ka fʋ nyɔvʋr na yuug ka si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisif teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am ye o tisif la.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: “Mid ka fʋ zu.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛli ba ye, “Nɔzi'ela bama ka Zugsɔb la dʋ'ʋs o kʋkɔtita'ari yit bugumini tisi ya, yanamɛ da la'as taaba zuorin la ka saŋgbana nɛ lik da bɛ la. O da pʋ lɛm pian' si'eli paasɛ. Ani ka o sɔbi niŋ kuglamma ayi' ni tisim.

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Yanamɛ da wʋm o kʋkɔr likin saŋkanɛ ka zuor la da dit bugum la, ya buudi tuongatib nɛ kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa da kɛɛn m san'an na

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: ka yɛl ye, ‘Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la pa'ali ti o na'am paŋ nɛ o kpi'euŋ, ka ti wʋm ka li yi bugumin na. Zina ti baŋ ye, ninsaal na nyaŋi vʋe baa Wina'am ya'a pian'ad nɛ o.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Ka nannanna bɔ ka ti kpiida? Bugum tita'ar kaŋa na kanbi ti, ka ti ya'a lɛn wʋm Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la ti na kpi.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Ninsaal kan bɛ ya nan mi' wʋm Wina'am Kanɛ Vʋe la ka o pian'ad bugumin wʋʋ tinamɛ nyɛ si'em la ka lɛn vʋeya?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Fʋn li'elim kɛlis dinɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la yɛt. Ka yɛli ti Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la yɛlif si'el wʋsa, ka ti na kɛlis ka siak.’”

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la wʋm yanamɛ yɛl mam si'em la, o yɛlim ye, “M wʋm nidib la pian' si'em tisif la. Ban yɛl si'el la wʋsa an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye ba zɔtim dabiem nɛ ba sʋnf wʋsa ka dɔlisi m nɔzi'ela la saŋa wʋsa, ka si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ba biis saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ!

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Kem yɛli ba ye ba lɛm kuli ba sʋga la ni.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn kpɛlim kpɛla ka m tisif nɔzi'ela nɛ wada dinɛ ka fʋ na pa'ali ba ka ba na dɔlisi li teŋ kanɛ ka m tisi ba ka ba sʋ'ʋg la ni.

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Dɔlli suokanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am zi'eli tisi ya la, ala ka ya na vʋe, ka si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya, ka ya dabisa na yuug teŋ kanɛ ka ya na sʋ'ʋg la ni.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: Moses da maligim yɛl Israel dim la ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa an nɔzi'ela nɛ wada ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la yɛl ye m pa'ali ya; ka ya na dɔlisidi li wʋsa, yanamɛ lɔ'ɔŋid Joodan ye ya sʋ'ʋg teŋ si'a la.

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ala ka yanam nɛ ya biis nɛ ya yaas na zɔt Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la ya nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsa. Ya ya'a dɔlis nɔzi'ela nɛ wada banɛ ka m tisi ya la, ala ka ya na nyɛ nyɔvʋwɔk.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, yanam Israel dima, kɛlisimi! Gu'usimi ka siak, ka ala ka li na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya, ka ya na nɔbigi zu'oe teŋ kanɛ pʋbid bin'isim nɛ siind la ni, nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an ya yaanam Wina'am la zi'el nɔɔr si'em tisi ya la.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: “Israel dima, kɛlisimi. Ti Zugsɔb Wina'am anɛ Zugsɔb yinne.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Nɔŋimi fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am nɛ fʋ sʋʋnr wʋsa, nɛ fʋ siig wʋsa, nɛ fʋ ya'am wʋsa, nɛ fʋ paŋ wʋsa.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Zaŋiminɛ ba pa'ali ya biis. Pian'amini li yɛla ya ya'a ti zin' ya yaan, nɛ ya ya'a ti ken suor zug, nɛ ya ya'a ti digi nɛ yanamɛ na ti duoe.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Lɔɔmi li ya nu'usin ka li an zanbina, ka lɔɔ li ya gbɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Sɔm niŋini ya dɔɔd za'anɔya ni nɛ ya yaŋa ni.” Banɛ pʋ siakid la sa'alʋg

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la ya'a ti mɔri ya kpɛn'ɛs teŋ kanɛ ka o da pɔɔ zi'eli ya yaanam Abraham nɛ Isaak nɛ Jakob ye o tisi ya la, teŋ kanɛ ka tempʋbɛda bɛ linɛ ka ya mɛŋ pʋ mɛɛ,

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: nɛ ya' sʋma banɛ ka la'asʋma pɛ'ɛl ka li ka'anɛ yanamɛ iee li kpɛn'ɛsɛ, nɛ bulis banɛ ka ya pʋ tuu, nɛ olif tiis pɔɔd nɛ olif tiis banɛ ka ya pʋ sɛɛ. Ka ya ya'a ti dii tig,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: yanam gu'usim ka da tam Zugsɔb onɛ yisi ya Egipt teŋin la yɛllɛ; teŋ kanɛ ka ya da an yammis la.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Zɔmini ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la gʋllim ka tʋm tis o, ka o yʋ'ʋr ma'aa ka ya na zaŋi pɔ nɔɔri zi'el.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Da dɔlli winsieba, nwɛnɛ wina banɛ ka nimbanɛ giligi ya maan la.

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am kanɛ bɛ nɛ ya la anɛ nyʋʋr sɔb, ka o sʋnpɛɛn na la'aŋi ya wʋʋ bugum nɛ, ka o na san'ami ya teŋgbauŋ kaŋa zugin.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya maki ya Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la, nwɛnɛ yanamɛ da niŋ Masa teŋin si'em la.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ya dɔlis Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am nɔzi'ela nɛ o wada banɛ ka o zi'eli tisi ya la.

english_verse: and live in a way that pleases him. Then you will be able to go in and take this good land from your enemies, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: ka na kadi ya dataas wʋsa nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.” Du'adib sa'alimi ba biis

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: Li ya'a ti paae saŋa si'a ka fʋ biig bu'osif ye, “Zi'ela nɛ wada banɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am zi'eli tisi ya la gbin an bɔ?”

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: Yɛlim o ye, “Ti da anɛ Na'ab Faaro yammis Egipt teŋin, amaa Zugsɔb la da nɔk nɛ o nu'ug kanɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ la yisi ti Egipt na.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Ti nini ni ka Zugsɔb la tʋm nyalima nɛ kilima ka maal zanbina nɛ bʋnnyalima, ka tʋm tʋʋmnyalima nɛ yɛltɔɔd Faaro nɛ o yidim sʋʋgin,

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: ka da mɔri ti yis anina na, ka tisi ti teŋ kanɛ ka o da pɔ zi'eli ti yaanam la.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Ka ti ya'a gu'usid ka dɔlisid o wada bama wʋsa ti Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la tuon nwɛnɛ on zi'el si'em tisi ti la, di na anɛ pʋpielim tisi ti.”

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, gu'usimi ka dɔlis m nɔzi'ela nɛ m wada nɛ gban'abanɛ ka m tisi ya zina la.” Wada la dɔllim mɔr albareka (Zie

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ya san'am nimbanɛ wʋsa ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am nɔki niŋi ya nu'usin la ka da zɔɔ ba nimbaanliga. Mɛ da maalinɛ ba wina la, ka li na an wʋʋ baŋi gban'e ya.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la ya'a ti nɔki ba niŋi ya nu'usin ka ya nyaŋi ba, asɛɛ ka ya kpɛn san'ami ba nyain. Da maal nɔnaar nɛ ba, bɛɛ ya zɔɔ ba nimbaanliga.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: ka ba na kɛ ka ya biribis la fɛndig ka kʋ dɔlli ya Zugsɔb la, ka na pʋ'ʋsid winsieba. Ka Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn na kanbi ya ka san'ami ya tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Yanamɛ na niŋi ba si'em nwa': Nwa'amini ba winpʋ'ʋsʋg bimbima la, ka nwa'a ba teŋgban kuga la, ka kɔ' Asera daad la, ka nyu'oe ba bada wʋsa nɛ bugum.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Ya anɛ nimbanɛ an kasi tis Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la. Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la gaŋi ya yis nidib bɛdegʋ sʋʋgin dunia nwa' ni, ka ya aan o nyɔɔrin kɔnbʋg.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Amaa li anɛ Zugsɔb la nɔŋi ya ka pʋ tammid nɔzi'elʋg dinɛ ka o da pɔɔ tisi ya yaanam la zug ka o mɔri ya yis nɛ o nu'ug kanɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ ka faaɛn ya yis teŋ kanɛ ka ya da an sankpan'asnam la nɛ Egipt Na'ab Faaro nu'usin.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ye Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la an Wina'am; o anɛ sida Wina'am ka pɛ'ɛnnɛ o nɔŋilim nɔnaar la sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ nimbanɛ nɔŋ o ka dɔl o nɔzi'ela la hali ti paae zʋmana nidib tusa-tusa.

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ kis o la, o na yɔɔ ba nɛ san'auŋ; o na yɔ banɛ kis o la tɔ'ɔtɔ ka ba nini nyɛ.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Ya na mɔr albareka gaad nimbanɛ bɛ la wʋsa. Dau bɛɛ pu'a kʋ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin ka kɔ'ɔŋ biiga, ka ya bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa na du'a biis.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Da mɔr dinɛ an bʋnkisa kpɛn' ya yaan na, ya'a ka' ala, ba na san'ami ya wʋʋ ban san'ami ba si'em la. Asɛɛ ka ya kisigi ba nyain, bɔzugɔ ba yisi ba zi'el ye ba san'ami ba.”

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: O na nɔŋi ya ka niŋi ya bareka ka kɛ ka ya zu'oe. O na niŋi ya du'am nɛ ya bʋmbʋta nɛ ya zʋʋd nɛ ya daam nɛ kpaam nɛ ya niigi nɛ ya pɛ'ɛs du'am bareka teŋ kanɛ ka o pɔɔ zi'eli ya yaanam ye o tisi ya la ni.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a kɛlis wada nwa' ka dɔlli ba sʋ'ʋŋa, ala ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na dɔlis o nɔŋilim nɔnaar dinɛ ka o da pɔɔ zi'eli ya yaanam la.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kʋ kɛ ka wiim gban'e ya, bɛɛ ban'abɛ'ɛd banɛ ka ya da mi' Egipt teŋin la gban'e ya, amaa o na kɛ ka li gban'e banɛ kisi ya la wʋsa.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: Daasi'erɛɛ ya na yɛl ye, “Buudbama kpi'emi gati ti, ti na niŋ wala kadi ba yisɛ?

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Amaa da zɔtinɛ ba dabiem, tɛnri Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la da niŋ Faaro nɛ Egipt dim wʋsa si'em la.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Ya mɛŋ nini nyɛ maktitada nɛ zanbina banɛ an nyalima nɛ kilima la, nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la da tiɛn o nu'utita'ar nɛ paŋi mɔri ya yis anina na si'em la. Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na niŋ ala mɛn nɛ buudbanɛ ka ya zɔti ba zina la.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Hali Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na kɛ ka tangbɛɛnlnam sigi ba sʋʋgin na tɔɔn ba hali ka banɛ nyaŋi vʋ'ʋg ka su'a ya sʋʋgin la ti bɔdig.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ya ya'am ian'adi ba yɛlaa, ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am onɛ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin la anɛ Wina'am Tita'ar nɛ bʋnzɔtir.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na kad buudbanɛ bɛɛ ya tuon la bi'el-bi'el. O kʋ kɛ ka ya kpɛn li' ba wʋsa saŋa yinnee, ya'a ka' ala sian'anr bʋnkɔnbid na nɔbigi gɛɛli ya.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: O na nɔki ba na'anamɛ niŋi ya nu'usin, ka ya na yisi ba yʋ'ʋr dunia nwa' ni. Sɔ' kae na duoe zi'en ye o zab nɛ ya, hali nɛ yanamɛ na ti san'ami ba wʋsaa naae.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Ba wina banɛ ka ba maal la, ya na nyu'oe ba nɛ bugum. Da mɔri ya'amlɛog nɛ anzurifa nɛ sanlima linɛ bɛ wina la ni la, ka mɛ da nɔk ye ya sʋ'oe ya, ka li na an wʋʋ baŋi bɛndi ya, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la kisʋgʋ la.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: Moses da yɛl Israel dim la ye, “Gu'usimi ka dɔlis nɔzi'elʋg kanɛ wʋsa ka m tisidi ya zina la, ala ka ya na vʋe ka nɔbig ka na kpɛn' sʋ'ʋg teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am da pɔɔ zi'eli ya yaanam la.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: O da sie ya nɛ, ka kɛ ka kɔ'ɔm mɔri ya ka o diisi ya nɛ manna dinɛ ka yanam nɛ ya yaanam da zi' li. O da niŋ ala ye o pa'ali ya ye, ninsaal pʋ vʋe nɛ diib yɛla ma'aanɛ, amaa nɛ pian'akanɛ wʋsa yit Wina'am nɔɔrin na.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ya sʋnya ni ye, ninsaali san'anɛ o biig si'em la, ala ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am mɛ san'anɛ ya.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ tɛnri Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am nɔzi'ela la ka dɔlisid o suoya la ka zɔt o.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la mɔri ya keŋ teŋ sʋŋin, teŋ kanɛ mɔr kɔlis nɛ bulis, ka ku'om tansidi yit bɔn'ɔdin nɛ kʋkʋna zut,

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: teŋ kanɛ ka kɔ'ɔm kʋ bɛɛ, ka si'el kʋ pɔ'ɔgi yaa, teŋ kanɛ ka tampiins la mɔr kʋnt ka ya na nyaŋi tu kʋntzɛn'ug kʋkʋna ni la.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti dii tig, yanam pʋ'ʋsim Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la bareka on tisi ya teŋ sʋŋ la.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Mid ka ya tam Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la yɛla nɛ o zi'ela nɛ wada nɛ o gban'ar dinɛ ka m tisidi ya zina nwa' la.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' ala, ya ya'a ti dii tig ka mɛ' ya' sʋma yʋ'ʋn zin'in,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: ka ya niigi nɛ ya kɔnbid ya'a ti nɔbig, ka ya sanlima nɛ anzurifa ya'a yʋ'ʋn ti zu'oe, ka yanamɛ mɔr si'el wʋsa paas,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: ani ka ya na dʋ'ʋsi ya mɛŋ ka tam Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am, ka mɔri ya yi Egipt teŋ kanɛ ka ya da an sankpan'asnam la na yɛla.

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: O mɔri ya yi sian'akanɛ yalim ka mɔr dabiem la zin'igin na, teŋ kanɛ ka ku'om kae ka ku'onuud bɛ hali la, zin'ikanɛ ka wa'abɛ'ɛdnam nɛ namis bɛ la, ka o kɛ ka ku'om yi tampiingin na tisi ya.

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: O da tisi ya manna sian'arin la ka ya di, dinɛ ka ya yaanam zi'. O da niŋ ala ye o kpansi ya ka ya sie ya mɛŋ, ka li naarin la, si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: Daasi'erɛɛ ya na ti tɛn'ɛs ye, ‘Ti nɔki ti mɛŋ nu'us nɛ ti paŋi tʋm nyɛ kpan'am nwa'.’

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Amaa tɛn'ɛsimi ye, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la tisi ya paŋ ka ya nyɛ kpan'am la. O niŋ nɛ'ɛŋa ye on da pɔ nɔɔrɛ zi'eli ya yaanam la niŋ amɛŋa wʋʋ din an si'em zina la.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ buudbanɛ bɛɛ ya tuon ka Zugsɔb san'ami ba si'em la, ala ka o mɛ na san'ami ya, yanamɛ zan'as Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔɔr la zug.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: Moses maligim yɛli ba ye, “Yanam Israel dima, kɛlisimi, ya yʋ'ʋn bɔɔd nɛ Joodan lɔ'ɔŋiri la ka na sʋ'ʋg buudbanɛ zu'oe ka kpi'emi gati ya, ka tempʋʋd la mɔr zaŋguoma ka li wa'ami paae saŋgbana la.

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: Nidib la wa'am ka mɔr paŋ, ba anɛ Anak dim gandaad. Ya mi' ba yɛla ka wʋmi ba yɛla ye, ‘Anɔ'ɔnɛ bɛ na nyaŋi zab Anak dim la?’

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Amaa mɔri ti'ir zina ye, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na lɔ'ɔŋi gaadi ya tuon nwɛnɛ bugum kanɛ dit nɛ. O na san'ami ba, ka na nyaŋi ba tisi ya. Ka ya na kadi ba yis ka san'ami ba tɔ'ɔtɔ, nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la tisi ya nɔɔr si'em la.”

english_verse: After the Lord helps you wipe out these nations and conquer their land, don't think he did it because you are such good people. You aren't good—you are stubborn! No, the Lord is going to help you, because the nations that live there are evil, and because he wants to keep the promise he made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. When Israel Made an Idol (Exodus
translation_verse: Gban'aminɛ li gbin ye, li ka'anɛ ya pʋpielim zug ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la tisidi ya teŋ sʋŋ la ye ya sʋ'ʋgɛ, ya pʋn anɛ nimbanɛ ka ya tʋba zian'as. Sanlim na'apɔl la yɛla

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Tɛnri ka da tam yanamɛ da niŋ si'em sian'arin ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am sʋnf pɛlig nɛ ya la. Din yi dabiskanɛ ka ya yi Egipt n ti paae kpɛla na la, ya kʋdim zan'asid nɛ Zugsɔb la nɔɔr.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Horeb zuorin la, ya da kɛya ka Zugsɔb la sʋnf duoe ka o sʋnf san'am hali ka o ye o san'ami ya.

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Duom sig tɔ'ɔtɔ bɔzugɔ, fʋ nimbanɛ ka fʋ mɔri ba yi Egipt na la zan'as nɛ ka tʋm bɛ'ɛd. Ba fɛndigi yi man zi'el nɔɔr si'em tisi ba la ni tɔ'ɔtɔ, ka maal ba'ari tisi ba mɛŋ.”

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛlim ye, “Man nyɛ nimbama ka ba tʋbir sid zian'as hali.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Basim ka m san'ami ba, ka yisi ba yʋ'ʋr dunia nwa' ni, ka kɛ ka fʋ gbin la lieb buudtita'are mɔr paŋ hali ka wiaki gaad ban an si'em la.”

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Ala ka m naam zuor la zugʋ sig na saŋkan ka bugum la nan dit zuor la zug. Ka kuglamma ayi' dinɛ an nɔnaar la bɛɛ m nu'usin.

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: Man gɔs la, m nyɛ ka ya tʋm bɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔgi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la. Ya maal ba'ar ka o nwɛnɛ na'apɔl nɛ tisi ya mɛŋ. Ya fɛndig tɔ'ɔtɔ ka bas suokanɛ ka Zugsɔb zi'eli tisi ya la.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Ala ka m nɔk kuglamma ayi' la lɔbi bas teŋin ka li nwa'asi ya nini ni.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la sʋnf pɛligi sia'al on na san'am Aaron, amaa ka m sɔsi tis Aaron mɛn saŋkan la.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: M mɛ da lɛn nɔk bʋnkanɛ aan ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, dinɛ an na'apɔl kanɛ ka ya maal la, nyu'oe nɛ bugum. M nwa'asi li nɛɛm ka li lieb zɔ'ɔm nwɛnɛ titanbʋʋlʋg nɛ, ka nɔki li lɔb ku'om dinɛ pʋbidi sigid zuorin la.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Ya da lɛn kɛ ka Zugsɔb la sʋnf pɛlig Tabera nɛ Masa nɛ Kibrof-Hataava tɛɛnsin la.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka ya yi Kades Banɛa teŋin la, o yɛli ya ye, “Kem sʋ'ʋgi teŋ kanɛ ka m tisi ya la.” Amaa ya zan'as Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la nɔzi'elʋg. Ya pʋ tis o sida bɛɛ ya siak o nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Ya pʋn dɛŋi zan'as Zugsɔb la nɔɔr man pin'ili baŋi ya sa.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: M da vanbin Zugsɔb la tuon dabisa pisnaasi, yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa la nɛ Zugsɔb la na san'ami ya la zug,

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: ka m sɔs Zugsɔb la ka yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, da san'ami fʋ nidib la, banɛ an fʋ faar ka fʋ faaɛn ba nɛ fʋ mɛŋ paŋ tita'ar ka mɔri ba yi Egipt na nɛ fʋ nu'ug kanɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ la.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Tɛnri fʋ yammis, Abraham nɛ Isaak nɛ Jakob yɛla. Da gɔsid nimbama tʋbpʋwʋmnim la, ba bugusim nɛ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛlaa.

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' ala, teŋgbauŋ kanɛ ka fʋ mɔri ti yina la dim na yɛl ye, ‘Zugsɔb la pʋ nyaŋi mɔri ba paae teŋ kanɛ ka o zi'el nɔɔr ye o mɔri ba keŋ la, on kisi ba la zug, ka o mɔri ba kɛn sian'arin na ye o kʋʋ ba.’

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Amaa ba anɛ fʋ nidib, fʋ faar kanɛ ka fʋ tiɛn fʋ nu'utita'ar nɛ paŋi mɔri ba yisi anina na la.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Kpi'em kuglamma ayi' wʋʋ yiiga bʋnam la, ka dʋ zuor la zug na. Nɔkim daadi maal daka.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: Ka m na sɔb kuglamma la ni, pian'abanɛ daa bɛ yiiga kuglamma la ni ka fʋ nwa'ae la. Ka fʋ na nɔki li niŋ daka la ni.”

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Ala ka m nɔk gun'a tiig daadi maal daka, ka kpi'a kuglamma ayi' ka ba nwɛnɛ banɛ ka m daa kpi'a yiiga la. Ka m dʋ zuor la zug ka kuglamma la bɛɛ m nu'usin.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la sɔb pian'abanɛ ka o da dɛŋi sɔb la nɔɔ kugban zugʋ tisim. Zi'ela piiga banɛ ka o da pian' tisi ya zuorin la. Daakanɛ ka ya la'as ka o pian'ad ka li yit bugumini tisidi ya la.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: Ani ka m naam zuor la zugʋ lɛbi sig teŋin na, ka nɔk kuga la niŋ daka kanɛ ka m maal la ni, nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la yɛlim si'em la, ka ba nam kpɛm bɛɛ li ni nannanna.

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Siakim Zugsɔb la nɔɔr ka tʋm tis o. Gban'ami nɛ o nu'us ayi' ka ya nɔpɔɔr na anɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋrin.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: (Ka Israel dim bɛ Jaakan dim bulisin la ka dʋʋ keŋ Mosera teŋin. Ani ka Aaron kpi ka ba mum o ka o biig Eleazar di'e o zin'igi an maanmaan.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ka ba naanɛ ani keŋ Guduguda ka lɛn gaadi paae Jotabat teŋ kanɛ mɔr kɔldaad ka ku'om bɛ la.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka Zugsɔb la gaŋ Levi dim buudi la ma'aa ye ba zi Zugsɔb Nɔnaar Daka la, ka zi'en Zugsɔb la tuonnɛ tʋm o tʋʋma ka zaŋid o yʋ'ʋri niŋid nidib la albareka wʋʋ ban niŋid si'em zina la.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, ‘Kem gaad nidib la tuon ka ba keŋ paae kpɛn' sʋ'ʋg teŋ la wʋʋ man pɔɔ zi'el si'em ye m na tisi ba yaanam la.’” Mɔr zɔtim nɛ Zugsɔb la

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: Nannanna Israel dima, ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la pʋ bɔɔd si'eli ya san'anɛ gaad yanamɛ na gi'ig o ka dɔlis o suoya la wʋsa, ka nɔŋ o ka tʋmmi tisidi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɛ ya sʋnf wʋsa, nɛ ya siig wʋsa,

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: ka tɛnr Zugsɔb la zi'ela nɛ o gban'ar linɛ ka m tisidi ya zina la ka li anɛ linɛ na an sʋm tisi ya la.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la sʋ'oe arezana ka lɛn sʋ'oe saazug nɛ teŋgbauŋ nɛ dinɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, Zugsɔb la pa'al o nɔŋilim an si'em nɛ ya yaanam, ka nɔŋi ba ka gaŋ yanam banɛ aan ba yaas la, ka kɛ buudbanɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa, nwɛnɛ lin an si'em zina la.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ pieminɛ ya sʋnya ka da lɛm mɔri tʋbzian'asim ya'asɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la anɛ wina wʋsa Wina'am nɛ zugsɔbnam Zugsɔb. O anɛ Wina'am tita'ar, o mɔr paŋ ka mɔr zɔtim, o pʋ mɔr baregaŋ ka di'ed sɔ' si'el on na sʋŋ o la zugɔ.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: O zabid kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya yɛla, o nɔŋ onɛ an saan ka tisid o diib nɛ fuud.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Li nar ye yanam mɛ nɔŋ banɛ an saam bɔzugɔ, yanam mɛŋ da anɛ saam Egipt teŋin.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Zun'omin o ka o anɛ ya Wina'am onɛ tʋm nyalim titada banɛ mɔr dabiem ka ya mɛŋ nini nyɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ka Moses maligim yɛli ba ye, Nɔŋim Zugsɔb fʋ Wina'am ka dɔl o bɔɔdim, dɔl o zi'ela nɛ wada banɛ ka o tis la wʋsa.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Tɛnri zina ye, li ka' ya biis la ka m pian'adi tisida, bɔzugɔ ba da pʋ nyɛ ka baŋ Zugsɔb la yɛlaa, on zu'oe si'em nɛ o nu'ug kanɛ kpi'em nɛ o paŋ tita'ar la.

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: Ya biis la pʋ nyɛ zanbina banɛ ka o maal ka tʋm si'em Egipt teŋin ka li paae Na'ab Faaro nɛ o teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa,

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: bɛɛ on da niŋ Egipt soogianam nɛ ba widi nɛ ba zaba tɛrekonam si'em, bɛɛ on kɛ ka Atɛuk Zɛn'ug ku'om pili ba saŋkanɛ ka ba da kati dɔlli ya bugir la. Ka ya Zugsɔb la mɔr san'auŋ tita'ari kɛɛn ba zugin na, hali ti paae zina.

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: Li mɛ ka'anɛ ya biisi da nyɛ on da maal si'em tisi ya sian'arin la ti paae saŋa kanɛ ka ya paae kpɛla na laa,

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: bɛɛ on da niŋ Datan nɛ Abiram banɛ an Eliab biis ka an Reuben buudi ka teŋ da ya'ae Israel dim la sʋʋgin vɔli ba, ban nɛ ba yidim wʋsa nɛ ba sʋga nɛ bʋnvʋr linɛ wʋsa aan ba din la.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: Ayei! Ka' ya biisɛ, amaa li da anɛ ya mɛŋ nini da nyɛ yɛltitada banɛ ka Zugsɔb maal la.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: Tɛnri nɔzi'ela banɛ ka m tisidi ya zina la, ala ka ya na mɔr paŋi keŋ kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka ya lɔ'ɔŋid Joodan ye ya keŋ sʋ'ʋg la.

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka ya vʋm na yuug teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la pɔ tisi ya yaanam ye o na kɛ ka ban nɛ ba yaas di'e teŋ kanɛ pʋbid bin'isim nɛ siind la.

english_verse: It's better land than you had in Egypt, where you had to struggle just to water your crops.
translation_verse: Ya pʋ nyɛ? Teŋ kanɛ ka ya kpɛn'ɛd ye ya sʋ'ʋg la ka' wʋʋ Egipt teŋin, zin'ikanɛ ka ya yina la. Zin'ikanɛ ka ya bʋdi ya bʋmbʋta ka dɔn'ɔsidi ya mɛŋ nwɛnɛ zɛnma'asa lɔmbɔn'ɔg nɛ.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Amaa teŋ kanɛ ka ya lɔ'ɔŋid Joodan ye ya sʋ'ʋg la anɛ zuoya teŋ nɛ bɔn'ɔd zin'ikanɛ ka saa ku'om dɔn'ɔsidi li.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: Li anɛ teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la guri li. Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la nini gɔsidi li, yʋʋm la pin'ilʋg ti paae li naar.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: Ka ya ya'a sid siaki di'e nɔzi'ela banɛ ka m tisidi ya zina la, ka nɔŋi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la ka tʋmmi tisid o nɛ ya sʋnf wʋsa nɛ ya siig wʋsa,

english_verse: he will send rain at the right seasons, so you will have more than enough food, wine, and olive oil, and there will be plenty of grass for your cattle.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka mɔɔd bɛ sian'arin la ka ya niigi ɔnbid, ka yanam mɛ na diti tigid.

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Mid ka ya kɛ ka ba ma'aa ya ka ya fɛndigi lɛbi dɔl winsieba ka iginid tuonnɛ pʋ'ʋsidi ba.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la sʋnf la na la'aŋ bugum ya yɛla, ka o na yɔ saazug ka saa kʋ ni ka ya nyɛ zʋʋdi bunɛ, ka ya na bɔdig teŋ sʋŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb tisi ya la ni tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Niŋimini m pian'ad nwa' ya sʋnya nɛ ya pʋtɛnda ni. Lɔɔmini li ya nu'usin ka li an zanbina, ka lɔɔ ya gbɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Pa'alimini ya biis; ya ya'a zin' yin yanam pian'amini li yɛla, ya ya'a ken suor zug bɛɛ ya ya'a digin bɛɛ ya ya'a duoe yanam pian'amini li yɛla.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Sɔm tabili ya dɔɔd za'anɔya ni nɛ ya yaŋa ni.

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: Ala ka yanam nɛ ya biis na nyɛ nyɔvʋwɔk teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la pɔɔ zi'el ye o tisi ya yaanam la ni. Ka ya na yuug wʋʋ agɔl nɛ teŋgbauŋʋ na kpɛm bɛ si'em la.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Ya ya'a sid tɛnr zi'ela banɛ ka m tisidi ya ye ya dɔlis, ka nɔŋi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am ka dɔl o suoya la wʋsa ka gban'e o kiŋ-kiŋ,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: din ka Zugsɔb la na kad buudbama wʋsa yisi ya tuon. Ka ya na yis buudbanɛ zu'oe ka kpi'emi gati ya.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ nɔki ya nɔbiri zi'el zin'isi'a wʋsa la na anɛ ya din. Ya sʋ'ʋlim na yi sian'arin la paae Lebanon, ka yi Efiritis kɔldaugin la paae Atɛuk kanɛ bɛ tuon la.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kae na nyaŋi zab nɛ ya. Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am zi'el nɔɔr si'em la, o na kɛ ka teŋ la dim wʋsa zɔti ya dabiem yanamɛ keŋ zin'isi'a wʋsa.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a siaki ya Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔzi'ela banɛ ka m tisidi ya zina la, ya na nyɛ albareka.

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a zan'asi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔzi'ela la, ka fɛndigi yi suokanɛ ka m tisi ya zina la ni, ka dɔl winsieba banɛ ka ya zi' baa, ya na nyɛ nɔpɔɔr.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la ya'a ti mɔri ya kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka ya bɔɔd kpɛn'ɛb la, ya na niŋ Gerizim Zuor la albareka ka pɔ nɔpɔɔri niŋ Ebal zuor la.

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: Ya pʋn mi' zuoya nwa' yɛla: ye ya ya'a lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan n keŋ tuonnɛ lɛbis winnigi lit zin'isi'a la, ya na paae ba. Ba bɛ Keenan dim banɛ bɛ Araba sʋ'ʋlimin la, ka kpi'e Moreh tititada, nɛ Gilgal teŋ la.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Ya bɔɔdi Joodan lɔ'ɔŋiri la, ka na sʋ'ʋg teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am tisidi ya la. Ya ya'a ti di'e li ka bɛɛ ani,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: baŋimi sʋ'ʋŋa ye ya na siak wada nɛ gban'abanɛ ka m zi'eli ya tuon zina la.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: Ka Moses da lɛn yɛli ba ye, “Gban'ar nɛ wada bama ka ya na gu'us ka dɔlis teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya yaanam Wina'am tisi ya ye ya sʋ'oe, saŋkanɛ wʋsa ka ya bɛ teŋin la.
