english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: San'ami zin'ibanɛ bɛ zuoya ni nɛ kʋkʋna zug nɛ tititada gbina ni, zin'ibanɛ ka buudbanɛ ka ya wa'ae ye ya sʋ'ʋgi ba teŋ la maannɛ ba wina la.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Nwa'amini ba winpʋ'ʋsʋm bimbima la, ka nwa'a ba teŋgban kuga la, ka nyu'oe ba teŋgban Asera daad la nɛ bugum, ka vɔɔn ba bada nɛ ba wina la bas, ka kpiisi ba yʋda zin'iban la ni.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: Da pʋ'ʋsidi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la wʋʋ ban pʋ'ʋsid si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Zin'ikanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am gaŋ ye o niŋ o yʋ'ʋr la ya'a lal, ya na tun'e kʋʋ ya niigi nɛ pɛ'ɛs banɛ ka Zugsɔb tisi ya la wʋʋ man yɛli ya si'em la. Ya mɛŋ tempʋʋdin la, ɔmmi yanamɛ bɔɔd si'em.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Ɔmmi nɛ ba, wʋʋ yanamɛ ɔnbid kɔɔng bɛɛ walig ni'im si'em la. Sɔ' wʋsa na tun'e ɔnb, onɛ an nyain maan pʋʋgin la bɛɛ onɛ ka' nyainnɛ.

english_verse: But don't eat the blood. It is the life of the animal, so let it drain out on the ground before you eat the meat.
translation_verse: Da ɔnb nɛ ziim la, dɛŋim kpa'ae zikanɛ yi ni'imin la bas teŋin wʋʋ ku'om nɛ ka nyaan dʋgi ɔnb.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Da ɔnbi nɛ lii, ka ala ka li na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya, nɛ ya yaas banɛ na dɔlli ya nya'aŋ la, yanamɛ na tʋm nɛ linɛ an sʋm Zugsɔb la tuon la zug.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Mɔri ya maana dinɛ nyu'od la kɛɛn ya Zugsɔb Wina'am malʋŋ daka la ni na nyu'oe ni'im nɛ ziim la wʋsa ani. Ka kpa'ae maana la ziim dɛn'ɛli ya Zugsɔb Wina'am maan daka la amaa ya tun'e ɔnb ni'im la.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Gu'usimi ka dɔlis man tisi ya gban'asieba la, ala ka si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya, yanam nɛ ya yaas banɛ dɔlli ya nya'aŋ la saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ, bɔzugɔ, ya na tʋm linɛ an sʋm ka dɔl suor la ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la nindaan.” Sa'alʋgʋ zaŋi ken bada maalʋgin

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: “Ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la na yis buudbanɛ bɛ teŋ kanɛ ka ya ye ya kpɛn' faaɛn ba teŋ la. Amaa ya ya'a ti kadi ba yis ka di'e ba teŋ la zin' anina,

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: yanam gu'usim ka da kɛ ka ba wina la an linɛ na bɛndi ya, ka ya ti bu'osid ye buudbama da maannɛ ba wina la wala-wala? Tinam mɛ bɔɔd ye ti maal ala!”

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya ti pʋ'ʋsi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la wʋʋ ban niŋid si'em la, bɔzugɔ ba wina la malima la ni, ba maan si'elnam dinɛ an yɛlkisa dinɛ ka Zugsɔb la kis. Hali ba mɔri ba biribis nɛ ba bipumisi nyu'od bugum maan maana tisidi ba wina la.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: Dɔlli man yɛli ya si'el la, da paas si'el bɛɛ ya yis si'ela.

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: ka zanbina bɛɛ tʋʋmnyalima banɛ ka o yɛl la ya'a sid ti niŋ, ka o yʋ'ʋn yɛl ye “Kɛlli ka ti dɔl winsieba , kɛlli ka ti pʋ'ʋsi ba,”

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: yanam da kɛlis nɔdi'es kan bɛɛ zaansʋŋ sɔb la. Ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la bɔɔd ye o kpansi ya gɔs ye ya nɔŋ o nɛ ya sʋnf nɛ ya siig wʋsa bɛɛ?

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: Li anɛ ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la ma'aa ka ya na dɔl, on ka ya na tʋm tis. Dɔlli nɛ o nɔzi'elʋg, ka siak o nɔɔr. Tʋm tisi nɛ o ka gban'e o nu'us ayi'.

english_verse: because he rescued you from slavery in Egypt. If a prophet tells you to disobey the Lord your God and to stop worshiping him, then that prophet is evil and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Nɔdi'es kan bɛɛ zaansʋŋ sɔb la, anɛ ba kʋʋ o bɔzugɔ, o pian'ad nɛ ye ya zan'asi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ mɔri ya yis Egipt na ka faaɛn ya yis yanamɛ da an yammis teŋ si'a la. O mɔɔdi ye o fɛndigi ya yis Zugsɔb Wina'am la zi'el suosi'a ye ya dɔl la. Ala ka ya na yis yɛlbɛ'ɛd la ya sʋʋgin.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Ala ka Israel dim wʋsa na wʋm ka zɔ dabiem, ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kan buudi ya'asɛ.

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti wʋm ka ba yɛt ye nimbanɛ an bugusim dim duoe teŋ kanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am ye o tisi ya la pan'asidi ba teŋ dim ka ba yidig ka yɛt ye, “Kɛlli ka ti keŋ pʋ'ʋsi winsieba banɛ ka ya zi',”

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: asɛɛ ka ya bu'osi baŋ ka vɛɛns sʋ'ʋŋa, ka li ya'a sid an sida ye yɛlkisʋg maali ya sʋʋgin,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: asɛɛ ka ya ba'asi kʋ nimbanɛ bɛ teŋ la pʋʋgin wʋsa. San'amini li nyain, nidib la nɛ ba bʋnkɔnbid la wʋsa.

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Bʋn linɛ na san'am la wʋsa ka ya na san'am, da lɛn kɛ ka si'el kpɛlim ya san'anɛ: ala ka Zugsɔb la na yis o sʋnpɛɛn linɛ mɔr dabiem la ya san'an. O na zɔɔ ya nimbaanlig ka mɔri ya nyɔɔg, ka kɛ ka ya wiaki zu'oe wʋʋ on da zi'eli ya yaanam si'em la,

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ yanamɛ siaki ya Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔɔr, ka dɔl o zi'ela banɛ ka m tisidi ya zina nwa' ka niŋid linɛ dɔl suor Zugsɔb nini ni la.

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ya anɛ nimbanɛ an kasi tisi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am. Nidib banɛ bɛ dunia ni la wʋsa, yanam ka Zugsɔb la gaŋi ya ye ya aan o nyɔɔrin kɔnbʋg, nɛ o faar.” Diib linɛ kis nɛ linɛ pʋ kisa (Lev

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: Niiŋ kanɛ an nyain wʋsa yanam ɔmmi.

english_verse: Don't eat any disgusting animals.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya di bʋn linɛ kis.

english_verse: You may eat the meat of cattle, sheep, and goats; wild sheep and goats; and gazelles, antelopes, and all kinds of deer.
translation_verse: walig, nɛ kɔɔng nɛ mɔlif nɛ sibig nɛ bama buudi wʋsa, nɛ sian'arin bʋʋg nɛ zuoya ni pɛ'og.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Ya tun'e ɔnb bʋnkɔnbʋg kanɛ ka o tafɛɛd buaki ayi' ka o mɛ ʋgʋsid yaama bugusid la.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Amaa da ɔnbi bʋnkɔnbid banɛ ʋgʋsid yaama bugusid ka ba tafɛɛd pʋ buak nyain la, nwɛnɛ yʋgʋm nɛ su'oŋ nɛ zuobʋʋgɔ, ka ba anɛ kisʋgʋ tisi ya.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Kukur mɛ anɛ kisʋg, la'an nɛ o nɔba buak la, o pʋ nyaŋidi ʋgʋsid yaama bugusida. Da ɔnbi ba ni'im bɛɛ ya si'isi ba.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: Bʋnvʋya banɛ bɛ ku'omin la wʋsa, ya na nyaŋi ɔnb banɛ mɔr pa'ad nɛ kpʋkpama la.

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Amaa ku'omin bʋn linɛ wʋsa pʋ mɔr pa'ad nɛ kpʋkpama yanam da dii, li anɛ kisʋgʋ tisi ya.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: Bʋn-ian'ad-baanlʋg wʋsa anɛ kisʋgʋ tisi ya, ka li pʋ sʋ'ʋm ye ya ɔnbi baa.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Amaa niiŋ kanɛ wʋsa mɔr kpʋkpama ian'ad ka an nyain la, ɔmmi nɛ li.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: Da ɔnbi bʋnkanɛ ka ya nyɛ ka li kpii digiya. Nɔkimi li tis saan onɛ bɛ teŋin la ka o ɔnb, bɛɛ ya kuosi tis teŋ zʋŋ nid. Amaa yanam anɛ nimbanɛ an kasi tisi ya Zugsɔb la. Mid ka ya nɔk bʋbil ni'imi dʋg o ma bin'isimin. Piig pʋʋr

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a bun zʋʋd la yʋʋm wʋsa, asɛɛ ka fʋ pʋdig zin'is piiga yis yinne digil.

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Dimmi yinne kanɛ ka ya yis ka li an; ki nɛ daam nɛ kpaam nɛ na'abibis banɛ ka ba du'a yiiga la, nɛ kɔnbid la, ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la tuon, zin'ikanɛ ka o na gaŋ ye o yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ anina la. Ala ka ya na zamis yanamɛ na na'asid Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la si'em saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb onɛ aan fʋ Wina'am gaŋ zin'isi'a ye o yʋ'ʋr bɛ la ya'a lal nɛ fʋn yi zin'isi'a la na,

english_verse: then sell this part and take the money there instead.
translation_verse: fʋn tiakimi fʋ pʋʋr piiga la nɛ ligidi mɔri keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka Zugsɔb fʋ Wina'am gaŋ la,

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: keŋ paae ka nɔk ligidi la da' fʋn bɔɔd si'el nwɛnɛ niigi bɛɛ pɛ'ɛs bɛɛ daam bɛɛ bʋnnuuda dinɛ mi'ig bɛɛ fʋn bɔɔd si'el wʋsa. Ani ka fʋn nɛ fʋ yidim wʋsa na dii li Zugsɔb la tuon ka maal sumalisim.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Da tami Levi dim banɛ bɛɛ ya tempʋʋdin la yɛlaa, ban pʋ mɔr pʋʋr bɛɛ faar ka li aan ba mɛŋ din la zug.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Yʋma atan' wʋsa, yanam mɔr yʋʋm kan la pʋʋr piiga la wʋsa mɔri keŋ su'a li ya tempʋʋdin la.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ala ka Levi dim banɛ pʋ mɔr pʋʋr bɛɛ ba mɛŋ faar la nɛ saam nɛ kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya banɛ bɛɛ ya tempʋʋdin la na kena dii tig. Ala ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na niŋ yanamɛ nɔki ya nu'ugʋ si'is si'el wʋsa bareka.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a an nɔŋdaani ya ba'abiis la sʋʋgin, teŋ kanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am tisi ya la, yanam da digilimi ya sʋnfʋ kpiank ka mɔŋi ya ba'abiig onɛ an nɔŋdaan la,

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ na niŋ si'em nwa': onɛ wʋsa pɛ'ɛŋ ligidi tis o tiraan onɛ an Israel nid o kɛɛsim bas. Li pʋ sʋm ye fʋ di'e sam onɛ aan fʋ ba'abiig bɛɛ Israel nid san'anɛ bɔzugɔ lin paae saŋa kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la zi'el ye ba kɛɛs sama bas, ka ba mɔɔli li la.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Ya na nyaŋi di'esi ya sama banɛ bɛ saam la san'an amaa da di'e samme fʋ ba'abiig onɛ dii fʋ sam la san'anɛ.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na niŋi ya bareka wʋʋ on zi'el si'em la. Tɛɛns bɛdegʋ dim na kɛɛn ya san'an na pɛ'ɛŋ amaa, yanam kʋ pɛ'ɛŋ sɔ' nii. Ya na sʋ'ʋg tɛɛns bɛdegʋ amaa teŋ kae na sʋ'ʋgi ya.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.
translation_verse: amaa lɛɛ tiɛnmini ya nu'us ka siaki pɛ'ɛŋi on bɔɔd si'el la tis o nɛ ya sʋnf wʋsa.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Gu'usimi ka da su'a pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd kaŋa ya sʋnya ni ye, “Yʋma ayɔpɔi dinɛ ka ba na kɛɛs sama bas la li'el ya,” ka lin zug kɛ ka ya zan'as tisib ka mɔŋi ba. Ya ya'a niŋ ala ka o fabili tis Zugsɔb la, ya na kpɛn' taalin.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Tisimi nɛ ya sʋʋnr wʋsa ka da tisidi nɛ ɛndʋgɔ, bɔzugɔ, dinɛ na kɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na niŋi ya tʋʋma wʋsa bareka nɛ dinɛ wʋsa ka ya si'is.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Amaa bʋnkɔnbʋg la ya'a mɔr dɛŋ, nwɛnɛ on na an wabʋg bɛɛ zʋnzɔŋ bɛɛ o mɔri dɛŋ kanɛ sid ka' sʋ'ʋm, da nɔki li maal maannɛ tisi Zugsɔb fʋ Wina'am la.

english_verse: If any of you buy Israelites as slaves, you must set them free after six years.
translation_verse: Fʋ Hibiru tiraan, o ya'a anɛ dau bɛɛ pu'a, ya'a kuos o mɛŋi tisif, o na tʋm tisif yʋma ayuobʋ, yʋʋm kanɛ paas ayɔpɔi la fʋn basim o suor ka o keŋ.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a tis o suor, da kɛ ka o keŋ nu'uzaalisɛ.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Yisimi fʋ kɔnbid nɛ fʋ zieŋin zʋʋd nɛ daam la tis o nwɛnɛ fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am niŋif bareka si'em la.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Amaa fʋ tʋmtʋm ya'a yɛlif ye, “Mam pʋ bɔɔdi basi fɔ.” Ka li anɛ on nɔŋ fʋn nɛ fʋ yidim la zug,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: fʋn nɔkim o keŋ za'anɔɔrin ka nɔk vʋʋndiŋi vʋdig o tʋbir ka o na liebi fʋ tʋmtʋm o nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsa, ka niŋ ala nɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm pu'ak mɛn.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: Gaŋim niigi nɛ kɔnbid bikpɛɛm banɛ an bʋndibis la ka li an Zugsɔb fʋ Wina'am la din. Da nɔki fʋ na'adibig kpɛɛm kpɛn'ɛs kuobɔ, ka mɛ da pʋni fʋ pɛ'og bikpɛŋ kɔnbidɛ.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Ɔmmini li ya tempʋʋdin. Sɔ' wʋsa na tun'e ɔnb, onɛ an nyain maan pʋʋgin la bɛɛ onɛ ka' nyainnɛ, wʋʋ yanamɛ ɔnbid kɔɔng bɛɛ walig ni'im si'em la.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Amaa da ɔnb nɛ ziim la, dɛŋim kpa'ae zikanɛ yi ni'imin la bas teŋin wʋʋ ku'om nɛ ka nyaan dʋgi ɔnb.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: Tɛnri Abib nwadig la ka maal malʋŋ di'ema dinɛ an Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋʋ tisi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la, bɔzugɔ Abib nwadig la ni ka o da yisi ya Egipt teŋin yʋ'ʋŋ na.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɔl sida ma'aa, ka ala ka fʋ na vʋe ka sʋ'ʋg teŋ kanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am tisi ya la. Win sieba pʋ'ʋsʋg yɛla

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Daba ayuobʋ la pʋʋgin, ɔmmi bodobodo dinɛ ka' dabinnɛ, ka daba ayɔpɔi la daar yanam la'asim pʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la; da tʋmi ya tʋʋmaa. Bakuainam Malʋŋ yɛla (Yib

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Gban'am naaf bɛɛ kɔnbʋgʋ maal Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la tisi fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am, zin'ikanɛ ka Zugsɔb la na gaŋ ye o yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ anina la.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: Da maali Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la tempʋʋd banɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am tisi ya la nii,

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: asɛɛ zin'ikanɛ ka o gaŋ ka o yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ anina la. Ani ka ya na maal Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la zaam, winnig ya'a ti kpɛn'ɛd, saŋkan nɔɔ ka ya da yi Egipt la.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Sɛn'ɛminɛ lii ɔnb zin'ikanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am na gaŋ la. Ka bɛog ya'a nie yanam lɛn kuli ya sʋga la ni.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: ka mɛ da zi'el teŋgban kugirɛ; ka nɛ'ɛnam ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am kis la.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Da sɛ teŋgban Asera daug ka li kpi'enɛ bimbim kanɛ ka ya mɛ' tis Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la,

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Ka maali sumalisim Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la tuon, zin'ikanɛ ka o na gaŋ ye o yʋ'ʋr bɛ anina la, la'an nɛ ya dasam nɛ ya pu'ayuos, nɛ ya sankpan'as dap nɛ pu'ab, nɛ Levi dim banɛ bɛɛ ya tempʋʋdin la, saam nɛ kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya banɛ bɛ nɛ ya la wʋsa.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: asɛɛ sɔ' wʋsa mɔr maan ka li zemis nɛ fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am la tisif albareka si'em la. Sariakatib yɛla

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔɔr atan' yʋʋm pʋʋgin, ya dap la wʋsa na kɛn Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la tuon zin'ikanɛ ka o na gaŋ ka maal Di'ema Malʋŋ linɛ an; Bodobodo Dinɛ Ka' Danbin nɛ, nɛ Bakuainam Malʋŋ nɛ Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ. Sɔ' da kɛn Zugsɔb la tuon na nɛ nu'uzaalisɛ,

english_verse: After you are settled in the towns that you will receive from the Lord your God, the people in each town must appoint judges and other officers. Those of you that become judges must be completely fair when you make legal decisions, even if someone important is involved. Don't take bribes to give unfair decisions. Bribes keep people who are wise from seeing the truth and turn honest people into liars.
translation_verse: Da zan'asi sida la bɛɛ ya maal baregaŋa. Mid ka ya kɛ ka ba da' ya nɛ ligidi ka ya bas sida la, ka li kɛt nɛ ka ya'am sɔb lieb zu'om ka kɛt ka onɛ mɔr sida kɔ'ɔŋ bʋʋd.

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Da nɔk naaf bɛɛ pɛ'og kanɛ mɔr dɛŋi maal maannɛ tisi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am. Ka lin la anɛ kisʋgʋ tis o.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: ka ya baŋ, yanam vɛɛnsimi li yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa. Ka li ya'a an sida ye yɛlkisʋg kaŋa maal Israel teŋin,

english_verse: But you will need two or three witnesses—one witness isn't enough to prove a person guilty. Get rid of those who are guilty of such evil. Take them outside your town gates and everyone must stone them to death. But the witnesses must be the first to throw stones. Difficult Cases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Banɛ di kasɛt la, banɛ na dɛŋi kpɛn'ɛsi ba nu'ug o kʋʋb yɛla. Ka banɛ kpɛlim la nyaan kpɛn'ɛsi ba nu'us. Asɛɛ ya yis bɛ'ɛd kanɛ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin la. Kɔɔtʋ ni antu'a

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Nidib la wʋsa na wʋm ka zɔ dabiem ka kʋ lɛm mɔr ziemis tʋʋmaa. Na'am yɛla

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am ye o tisi ya ka ya sʋ'oe ka zin'inɛ anina la, ka tɛn'ɛs ye “Kɛlli ka ti diis na'ab ka o sʋ'oe ti wʋʋ buudbanɛ giligi ti la mɔr si'em la,”

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: yanam on gɔsim sʋ'ʋŋa ka gaŋ na'ab onɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am gaŋ la. Asɛɛ ka o aan ya ba'abiis la yinne, da diisi saan onɛ ka' Israel nid ka o sʋ'oe ya.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Na'ab la mɛ da bɔɔd ye o mɛŋ mɔr widi bɛdegʋ bɛɛ o kɛ ka nidib la lɛb Egipt n da' widi na tis o. Zugsɔb la pʋn yɛli ya ye, “Da lɛn lɛbi suokan la ni ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: O da di pu'ab bɛdegʋ ka ba fɛndig o ya'am; ka mɛ da la'as anzurifa nɛ sanlima bɛdegʋʋ.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: O ya'a ti zin'in o na'am gbauŋ la zug, asɛɛ ka o sɔb wada gbauŋ kaŋa tis o mɛŋ, dinɛ ka Levi dim maanmaannib mɔr la.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka li bɛɛ o san'an, ka o na karim daar wʋsa o nyɔvʋr bɛllimin. Ala ka o na zamis ka na'as o Zugsɔb Wina'am ka dɔlis wada kaŋa yɛt si'em la nɛ gban'abama wʋsa.

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: O da gɔsi nyɛ ka on sɔn'oe o ba'abiis ka fɛndig wada la datiuŋ bɛɛ dagɔbʋga. Din ka on nɛ o yaas na di na'am la yuug Israel teŋin.

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: M na yis nɔdi'esi ba ba'abiis la sʋʋgin na ka o nwɛnɛ fʋn nɛ. M na nɔki m nɔɔr yɛlʋgʋ niŋ o nɔɔrin, ka o na pian'adi tisidi ba mam na yɛl o si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: On nɛ ban na pʋdigi ba pʋʋr la azinzema, la'an nɛ on di'e ligidi yi la'abanɛ ka o yidim kuos la. Yɛlkisa yɛla

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: Maanmaannib banɛ an Levi dim la, sida Levi dɔɔg la wʋsa kʋ mɔr pʋʋr bɛɛ faar nɛ Israel dim la. Ba diib na anɛ maan linɛ ka nidib la maali tis Zugsɔb la bugumin la, linɛ na aan ba faar.

english_verse: because he has promised to provide for them in this way.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ mɔr pʋʋri ba ba'abiis la sʋʋginɛ. Zugsɔb la aan ba faar, wʋʋ on pɔɔ zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa an maanmaannib la pʋʋri yit nimbanɛ nɔk na'araad nɛ pɛ'ɛsi maal maan; li na anɛ biaunk nɛ yier nɛ pʋʋgin la'ad.

english_verse: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka ya tisi ba zʋʋd linɛ ka ya bʋn yiiga la nɛ daam nɛ kpaam, nɛ ya pɛ'ɛs kɔnbid linɛ ka ya kies yiiga la.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la gaŋnɛ ban nɛ ba yaasi yii ya dɔɔd la wʋsa sʋʋgin ye ba zi'eni tʋm Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr zug saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: Levi nid ya'a yii ya tempʋʋg yinne linɛ bɛ Israel teŋ si'a wʋsa, ka kpɛ'ɛŋi keŋ Zugsɔb la na gaŋ zin'isi'a la ni, o sʋnf bɔɔdim zug,

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: o na nyaŋi tʋm Zugsɔb Wina'am yʋ'ʋr zug nwɛnɛ o Levi dim taaba tʋm Zugsɔb la tuon si'em la.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am ye o tisi ya la, da zamisidi ka tu'asid banɛ an yɛlkisa ka buudbanɛ bɛɛ anina la dɔlisid la.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa tʋm nɛ'ɛnam li anɛ yɛlkisa tis Zugsɔb la, bɔzugɔ li anɛ yɛlkisa bama zug ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la kad buudbama yisi ya tuon la.

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns banɛ ka ya ye ya sʋ'ʋg la kɛlisid nɛ ba'akɔn dim bɛɛ sɔnpʋttib. Amaa ya'a kpɛlim nɛ yanam, ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la pʋ tisi ya suor ye ya niŋ ala.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na gaŋ nɔdi'esi ya ba'abiis la sʋʋgin na ka o nwɛnɛ mam nɛ. Asɛɛ ka ya kɛlis bʋn linɛ wʋsa ka o na tu'asi ya.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Yanamɛ da la'as Horeb zuorin la, ya da yɛli ya Zugsɔb Wina'am ye, “Da kɛ ka ti lɛn wʋm Zugsɔb Wina'am la bɛɛ ti lɛn nyɛ bugum kaŋa ya'asɛ ka ti na kpi.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Ban yɛl si'el la an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa pʋ kɛlisi m pian'ad banɛ ka nɔdi'es la na pian' mam yʋ'ʋrin la, mam mɛŋ na buol o ka o tu'asi li gbin.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Amaa nɔdi'es kanɛ zi'enɛ tɛn'ɛs o mɛŋi pian' man yʋ'ʋr zug ka m pʋ tis o nɔɔrɛ, bɛɛ nɔdi'es kanɛ pian'ad winsieba yɛla, asɛɛ ka ba kʋʋ o.”

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Daasi'erɛɛ ya na bu'os ye, “Ti na niŋ wala baŋ ye li ka' Zugsɔb la pian' tisi ti?”

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka nɔdi'es ya'a yɛl si'el Zugsɔb yɛla ka li pʋ niŋ amɛŋa, lin anɛ labaar kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la pʋ pian', ka nɔdi'es la tɛn'ɛs nɛ o mɛŋi pian'. Da zɔti nɛ o dabiem.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ya dɔlis wada kanɛ ka m tisi ya zina la, ka nɔŋi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la, ka dɔl o suoya la saŋa wʋsa, ani ka ya na bɔ tempʋʋd atan' paas.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la ya'a ti san'am buudbanɛ bɛɛ ya tuon la ka tisi ya ba teŋ la, ka ya di'e ba tempʋʋd nɛ ba ya' la,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: Ya'a nwɛnɛ nid nɛ o kpi'a na keŋ mɔɔgin ye ba nwaae daad, ka on ʋk zɛnnir ye o nwaae daug la ka zɛnnir la fʋki ianki nwɛ' o tiraan la kʋ, o na nyaŋi zɔɔ keŋ tembama yinne ni faaɛn o nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: Amaa teŋ la ya'a lal, onɛ nar ye o yɔ sam la sʋnf ya'a duoe, o na kadi paae o ka kʋʋ o, la'an nɛ lin pʋ nar ye ba kʋʋ o la bɔzugɔ, o pʋ dɛŋi gban'e pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd o sʋʋnrin ye o kʋʋ o kpi'a la.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m tis nɔɔr ye ya gaŋ tempʋʋd atan' la.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: Tʋmmini ala ka ba da ti kʋ sɔ' zaalim ka o pʋ maal bugusim teŋ kanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am ye o tisi ya ka li an ya faar la. Ala ka ya kʋ, kʋ sɔ' ka paam taalɛ.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' ya'a kis o kpi'a ka su'a gu' nwɛ' o kʋ, ka zɔɔ keŋ tempʋbama ni,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: o teŋ la kpɛɛmnam na tʋm tempʋʋgin la ka ba mɔr o na, ka ba nɔk o tis onɛ ye o yɔ sam la ka o kʋʋ o.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Da zɔɔnɛ o nimbaanliga. Asɛɛ ka ya yis bɛ'ɛd linɛ an ninkʋʋr Israel teŋin, ala ka si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya.

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Da tɔlisi fʋ kpi'a titɔndig kugir linɛ ka ba da digil kʋdimin sa, ka fʋ di faar teŋ kanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am tisi ya ye ya sʋ'oe la. Kasɛt diib yɛla

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Nid yinne ma'aa ya'a di kasɛt ye sɔ' tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd buudi wʋsa, li pʋ siakɛ. Amaa asɛɛ ka kasɛtib paae nidib ayi' bɛɛ atan' ka pian'ad la nyaan zi'en.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Nid ya'a maal kisidim duoe zi'enɛ ma' ziri ye sɔ' tʋm bɛ'ɛd,

english_verse: then both you and the accused must be taken to the court at the place where the Lord is worshiped. There the priests and judges will find out if you are lying or telling the truth. If you are lying and the accused is innocent,
translation_verse: Asɛɛ maanmaannib la vɛɛns sʋ'ʋŋa, ka li ya'a ti nie pa'al ye nid la anɛ ziri sɔb, ka di ziri kasɛti tis o ba'abiig,

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: Moses da yɛli ba ye, “Ya ya'a keŋ zabid nɛ ya dataas ka nyɛ ka ba mɔr widi nɛ zaba tɛrekonam nɛ soogianam ka ba zu'oe gati ya, yanam da zɔt dabiem, bɔzugɔ, ya Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt na la na bɛ nɛ ya.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti bɔɔd ye ya keŋ zab, maanmaan la na yii ya tuon na pian' tisi ya.

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: O na yɛl ye, ‘Yanam Israel dima, kɛlisimi! Zina ka ya wa'ae ye ya zab nɛ ya dataas la. Da kɛ ka ya ya'am iank bɛɛ dabiem mɔri ya. Da kiridi ka dabiem kpɛn' ya.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Li anɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na dɔlli ya keŋ zab nɛ ya dataas la ka ya na nyaŋi ba.’

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnam la mɛ na yɛl soogianam la ye, ‘Sɔ' mɛ' yipaal ka nam pʋ yɔ'ɔgi lii? O sɔb lɛm kul, ka o na ti keŋ kpi zaba la ni ka sɔ' sa lɛdigi yɔ'ɔgi li.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Sɔ' mɛ sɛ vain tiis pɔɔg ka nam pʋ dii li nyɔɔdɛɛ? On sɔb lɛm kul, ka o na ti keŋ kpi zaba la ni ka sɔ' sa lɛdigi dii li nyɔɔd.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Ba tis sɔ' pu'a ka o nam pʋ dii? On sɔb lɛm kul, ka o na ti keŋ kpi zaba la ni ka sɔ' sa lɛdigi dii o pu'a la.’

english_verse: Finally, if any of you are afraid, you may go home. We don't want you to discourage the other soldiers.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnam la na lɛm bu'os ye, ‘Sɔ' zɔt dabiem bɛɛ o ya'am ian'adaa? O lɛm kul ka da ti taas o ba'abitaaba laa.’

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnam la ya'a ti pian' naae, ba na gaansi ba tuongatibi tisi ba.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Amaa tɛɛns banɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔki tisi ya ka li aan ya faar la, da basi bʋnvʋr linɛ vʋ'ʋsid baa yinnee.

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: San'ami Hitti dim nɛ Amor dim wʋsa nɛ Keenan dim nɛ Perizi dim nɛ Hivi dim nɛ Jebus dim la wʋsa nyain, nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la yɛli ya si'em la.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' ala, ba na pa'ali ya yɛlkisa banɛ ka ba niŋid ka pʋ'ʋsidi ba wina la ka ya na tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔgi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a paae tempʋsi'a ye ya zabi faaɛn sʋ'ʋgi li ka giligi li ka li yuug, yanam da nɔk zɛnnire nwaae li tiisi lugɛ, bɔzugɔ ya na dii ba wala. Tiis la ka'anɛ nidib ka ya ye ya giligi ba zabɛ!

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala ya na tun'e nwa' tibanɛ ka ya mi' ye ba pʋ wan la ka nɔki maal la'abanɛ na sʋŋi ya ti paae saŋa kanɛ ka ya zabi nyaŋ tempʋʋg la.”

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a kpii dig paalʋ, teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am tisi ya ye ya sʋ'oe la ni, ka sɔ'ɔsɔ zi' onɛ kʋʋ o,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: ya kpɛɛmnam nɛ sariakatib la na yii keŋ mak on kpi zin'isi'a la lallim nɛ tempʋʋd banɛ kpi'e anina la,

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: ka baŋ tempʋkanɛ kpi'e kum la dig si'el la. Ka teŋ la kpɛɛmnam na nɔk na'asa'a kanɛ nam pʋ kuaa ka nam pʋ kɔr yɔksin daug o niŋgɔɔnrinɛ,

english_verse: They and some of the priests will take this cow to a nearby valley where there is a stream, but no crops. Once they reach the valley, the leaders will break the cow's neck. The priests must be there, because the Lord your God has chosen them to be his special servants at the place of worship. The Lord has chosen them to bless the people in his name and to be judges in all legal cases, whether property or injury is involved.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la nɛ Levi dim la na gaad tuon bɔzugɔ, ban ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la gaŋ ye ba tʋmmi tisid o ka sɔsid albareka tisidi ya on Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr zug, ka na maan antu'a nɛ zaba yɛla wʋsa.

english_verse: The town leaders will wash their hands over the body of the dead cow
translation_verse: Lin mɛn kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa banɛ bɛ tempʋkanɛ kpi'e kum la na pie ba nu'us na'asa'a kanɛ ka ba kʋ la zug,

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: ka na pian' nie nyain ye, “Ti nu'us kae nid nwa' kum la ni bɛɛ ti nini nyɛɛ o kum.

english_verse: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a keŋ zab nɛ ya dataas, ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la nɔki ba niŋi ya nu'usin ka ya nyaŋi gban'e ba ka ba aan ya yammis,

english_verse: One of these prisoners may be a beautiful woman, and you may want to marry her. But first you must bring her into your home, and have her shave her head, cut her nails, get rid of her foreign clothes, and start wearing Israelite clothes. She will mourn a month for her father and mother, then you can marry her.
translation_verse: ka yis fubanɛ ka o yɛ ka fʋ gban'e o la. O ya'a bɛɛ fʋ yin la ka kaas o ba' nɛ o ma' yɛla nwadig mummi naae, fʋ yʋ'ʋn na keŋ nɔk o ka fʋ lieb o sid ka on mɛ liebi fʋ pu'a.

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'am ya'a ti pʋ lɛm bɔɔd o, fʋn basim o ka o keŋ on bɔɔd si'el. Da kuos o bɛɛ fʋ maal o wʋʋ yammʋga, bɔzugɔ, fʋnɛ nɛ'ɛs o. Biribiŋ kpɛɛm faar

english_verse: Suppose a man has two wives and loves one more than the other. The first son of either wife is the man's first-born son, even if the boy's mother is the wife the man doesn't love. Later, when the man is near death and is dividing up his property, he must give a double share to his first-born son, simply because he was the first to be born. A Son Who Rebels Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Asɛɛ o baŋ ye o pu'a kanɛ ka o pʋ nɔŋ la biig la an kpɛɛm, ka tis o pʋʋr la zin'isa ayi' on mɔr si'el wʋsa. Onɛ an zanbinnɛ pa'an o saam paŋ. Linɛ wʋsa an bikpɛŋ din la anɛ o bʋn. Wada nɛ biig kanɛ tʋbiri zian'as

english_verse: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.
translation_verse: Dau ya'a mɔr biribiŋ ka o zug kpi'em ka o tʋbir pʋ wʋmma ka pʋ siakid o saam nɛ o ma nɔɔrɛ, ka pʋ kɛlisidi ba sa'alʋgɔ,

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: on nɛ o ma la na mɔr o keŋ kpɛɛmnam la tuon tempʋʋg la yaŋirin.

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: Ka ba na yɛl kpɛɛmnam la ye, “Ti bikaŋa anɛ onɛ zugʋ kpi'em ka o tʋbir pʋ wʋmma. O pʋ siakidi ti nɔɔrɛ, o anɛ danuud ka san'amid ligidi.”

english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: O teŋ dim la na lɔb o nɛ kuga kʋ. Asɛɛ ya yis bɛ'ɛd linɛ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin la, ka Israel nidib wʋsa na wʋm ka zɔ dabiem. Wada kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb yɛla

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ nar nɛ kum, ka ba kʋʋ o ya'al tiig zug,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: yanam da bas o niŋgbiŋ la ka li kpɛlim tiig la zugʋ nie bɛogɔ. Baŋimi ye ya na mum o dabiskan la bɔzugɔ, Wina'am nɔpɔɔr bɛ nɛ onɛ wʋsa kpi ka ba ya'al o tiig zug. Da kɛ ka teŋ kanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am tisi ya la mɔr dian'adɛ.

english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ ya'a nyɛ fʋ kpi'a naaf bɛɛ o pɛ'og ka o bɔdigid, fʋn da yisi fʋ nifɔ, amaa gban'am o mɔri keŋ tis o sɔb.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Fʋ kpi'a la ya'a pʋ kpi'e nɛ fʋn bɛ si'el la, bɛɛ fʋ ya'a zi' o sɔba, fʋn mɔr o kuli fʋ yin, ti paae saŋa kanɛ ka o sɔb ti iee paae na, ka fʋ nɔki tis o.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Niŋim ala mɛn nɛ fʋn na nyɛ fʋ kpi'a bʋŋ bɛɛ o fuug bɛɛ o si'el ya'a bɔdig ka fʋ nyɛ li. Fʋn da niŋ ka li nwɛnɛ fʋ pʋ nyɛɛ.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Pu'a da yɛ dap fuud bɛɛ dau yɛ pu'ab fuudɛ, bɔzugɔ, ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la kisʋg anɛ onɛ niŋ ala.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a mɛ' yir, fʋn maalim gʋʋdiŋi gilig yir la zug ka sɔ' kʋ lii anina kpi ka taal bɛ yin la.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: Da la'as bʋmbʋʋda buudi ayi' bʋdi fʋ vain tiis pɔɔginɛ; fʋ ya'a niŋ ala, li ka'anɛ bʋmbʋʋda banɛ ka fʋ bʋd la ma'anɛ, amaa vain tiis pɔɔg wala la wʋsa lieb nɛ dian'ad.

english_verse: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.
translation_verse: Da yɛ fukanɛ ka ba ʋg gum nɛ bʋnkɔnbid kɔnbidi gɛndig taaba la.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Maalim tusa fʋ fuug la nɔya anaasi la ni. Dau na san'am o pu'a yʋ'ʋr yɛla

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: Dau ya'a di pu'a ka o ya'amlɛog ti yi pu'a la ka o pʋ lɛm bɔɔd o,

english_verse: He might tell ugly lies about her, and say, “I married this woman, but when we slept together, I found out she wasn't a virgin.”
translation_verse: ka san'am o yʋ'ʋri tis o yʋ'ʋbɛ'ɛd ye, “Man di pu'a kaŋa ka digin nɛ o la, si'el-si'el pʋ pa'al ye o zi' dau.”

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: Alazug, bipuŋ la saam nɛ o ma na kɛn kpɛɛmnam la tuon na teŋ la yaŋirin ka mɔr linɛ an kasɛti pa'al ye o bipuŋ la zi' dau.

english_verse: Her father will say, “I let my daughter marry this man, but he started hating her
translation_verse: Bipuŋ la saam na yɛl kpɛɛmnam la ye, “M nɔki m bipuŋi tis dau kaŋa, amaa ka o pʋ bɔɔd o.

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: Nannanna o san'am o yʋ'ʋr ka yɛl ye, ‘Mam dii fʋ pu'ayua la ka o pʋn baŋ dau sa.’ Amaa mam mɔr kasɛt linɛ pa'al ye, o zi' dau.” Ani ka bipuŋ la saam nɛ o ma na nɔk fukanɛ an kasɛti pa'al ye o zi' dau la yadig kpɛɛmnam la tuon.

english_verse: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip
translation_verse: Ka kpɛɛmnam la na bʋ' dau la.

english_verse: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin,
translation_verse: Amaa ya'a nwɛnɛ dau la pian'ad anɛ sida, ka si'el kae pa'al ye bipuŋ la zi' dau,

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: ba na mɔr o keŋ o saam la yinne zi'el o za'anɔɔrin la ka teŋ la dap lɔb o nɛ kuga kʋ. O tʋm linɛ an nyan Israel sʋ'ʋlimin, on maal o mɛŋ pu'agɔɔndir ka nan bɛɛ o saam yin la zug. Asɛɛ ya yis bɛ'ɛd la ya sʋʋgin.

english_verse: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.
translation_verse: Dau ya'a digin nɛ o tiraan pu'a ka ba kuki ba, asɛɛ dau la nɛ pu'a la wʋsa kpi. Asɛɛ ya yis bɛ'ɛd la Israel dimin.

english_verse: If a man is caught in town having sex with an engaged woman who isn't screaming for help, they both must be put to death. The man is guilty of having sex with a married woman. And the woman is guilty because she didn't call for help, even though she was inside a town and people were nearby. Take them both to the town gate and stone them to death. You must get rid of the evil they brought into your community.
translation_verse: asɛɛ ya mɔri babayi' la wʋsa keŋ teŋ la yaŋirini lɔbi ba nɛ kuga kʋ, bɔzugɔ, bipuŋ la bɛ tempʋʋgin ka pʋ kaas ka ba faaɛn o, ka dau la mɛ san'am sɔ' pu'a la zug. Asɛɛ ka ya yis bɛ'ɛd la ya sʋʋgin.

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: Amaa li ya'a anɛ mɔɔgin ka dau bibig pu'a kanɛ an sɔ' pu'a-ɛliŋ, dau kanɛ tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la ma'aa na kpi.

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: Amaa pu'asadir la mɛn, da niŋ o si'ela ka o pʋ tʋm taali. O pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ nar ye o kpii. Yɛl kaŋa nwɛnɛ sɔ' na zab nɛ o kpi'a kʋʋ o.

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: Li anɛ dau la bibig pu'asadir la, la'an nɛ pu'a-ɛliŋ la kaas la sɔ' kae yamminɛ na faaɛn o.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: Dau ya'a sia'al pu'asadir ka ba nam pʋ tis o sida ka bibig o ka ba kʋk o,

english_verse: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.
translation_verse: Li pʋ nar ye sɔ' dii o saam pu'a, li pʋ nar ye o nɛ'ɛs o saama.

english_verse: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Dau onɛ wʋsa ka ba zan' bɛɛ nwaae o daulim yis kʋ kpɛn' Zugsɔb nidib la sʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Onɛ an tampiinr bɛɛ ka' saam, nɛ o yaas wʋsa kʋ kpɛn' Zugsɔb nidib la sʋʋginɛ, hali din yi zʋmaʋŋ yinne ti paae zʋmaʋŋ piiga la zin'igin.

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Ammon bɛɛ Moab nidib la bɛɛ ba yaas kʋ kpɛn' Zugsɔb la nidib sʋʋginɛ, hali din yi zʋmaʋŋ yinne ti paae zʋmaʋŋ piiga la,

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: ban da pʋ tʋ'ʋsi ya nɛ diib nɛ ku'om yanamɛ da yi Egipt teŋin kenna la zug, ka ba da da' Balaam onɛ an Beor biig ka yi Petor teŋin ka bɛ Aram Naharam sʋ'ʋlimin dinɛ bɛ Mesopotamia la ka o kaanb kaanbbɛ'ɛdɛ tisi ya.

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la pʋ kɛlis Balaam kaanb bɛ'ɛd la, amaa ka lɛɛ tiaki li ka li lieb albareka tisi ya bɔzugɔ ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɔŋi ya.

english_verse: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.
translation_verse: Da bɔɔd ye ya maal nɔɔr yinne nɛ ba, ya nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsaa.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: Da ziem Edom dima, ka ba anɛ ya ba'abiis. Da ziem Egipt dim la, bɔzugɔ ya da anɛ saamme ba teŋin.

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ba biis la yaas banɛ paas atan' la na nyaŋi kpɛn' Zugsɔb la nidib sʋʋgin. Dian'adi na bɛ yɛla

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti la'as ye ya zab nɛ ya dataas, da li'eli dinɛ an dian'adɛ.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Ya dap la yinne ya'a mɔr dian'ad ka li anɛ o zaansim nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ ka o daulim ku'om yina, asɛɛ ka o yi la'asʋg la yiŋi bɛɛ anina,

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: amaa zaam ya'a ti bɔɔd ma'ar la, o na sʋ ku'om, ka winnig ya'a ti kpɛn' o na nyaŋi lɛb la'asʋg la zin'igin na.

english_verse: Set up a place outside the camp to be used as a toilet area.
translation_verse: Bɔɔmi zin'igi ya la'asʋg la yiŋ, ka sɔ' ya'a bɔɔd ye o nyɛ' bin on keŋ anina nyɛ'.

english_verse: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka kʋsiig bɛɛ ya la'adin la, ka ya na mɔri li tuud bʋmbɔk, ka fʋ ya'a ti naae, fʋn lɛbisim pin' bin la.

english_verse: You must keep your camp clean of filthy and disgusting things. The Lord is always present in your camp, ready to rescue you and give you victory over your enemies. But if he sees something disgusting in your camp, he may turn around and leave. Runaway Slaves from Other Countries Moses said:
translation_verse: Ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la kaadi ya nɛ ya la'asʋg la zin'igin guri ya, ka na kɛ ka ya nyaŋi ya dataas la. Asɛɛ ka ya la'asʋg zin'ig la an kasi, ka o kʋ nyɛ dian'adi ya sʋʋgin ka fɛndig ka basi ya. Wada banɛ bɛ

english_verse: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.
translation_verse: Teŋ si'a yammʋg ya'a zɔɔ kena su'a ya san'an, yanam da nɔk o tis o zugdaan la.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka o bɛɛ ya san'an, kɛlli ka o gaŋ on bɔɔd zin'isi'a nɛ on bɔɔd tempʋsi'a wʋsa, ka da mugusin oo.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.
translation_verse: Israel nidib la ni dau bɛɛ pu'a mɛ da bɛ teŋgban dɔɔgini digi nɛ nidiba.

english_verse: The Lord your God is disgusted with men and women who are prostitutes of any kind, and he will not accept a gift from them, even if it had been promised to him. Interest on Loans Moses said:
translation_verse: Da mɔri pu'agɔɔnda nɛ dapgɔɔnda la yʋ'ʋn paam la'asieba la kpɛn' Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la san'an yɔ pʋ'ʋlʋm zi'el sammɛ, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la kisi li.

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: Da pɛ'ɛŋi fʋ ba'abiig si'el ka paas nyɔɔdɛ, li ya'a anɛ ligidi bɛɛ diib bɛɛ linɛ wʋsa ka o pɛ'ɛŋ ka li nar ye o paas nyɔɔd.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Ya na nyaŋi di'e nyɔɔd onɛ an saan san'an, amaa ka' ya ba'abiig onɛ an Israel nida, ala ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la na niŋi ya bareka ya nu'ug tʋʋma wʋsa ni teŋ kanɛ ka ya kpɛn'ɛd ye ya sʋ'ʋg la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a yɛl nɔɔri zi'eli tis Zugsɔb la, fʋn da bʋgis nɛ li yɔɔbɔ, ka Zugsɔb fʋ Wina'am la na bu'osif ka fʋ na kpɛn' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋ ya'a pɔ nɔɔri zi'el, fʋ pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔɔr ya'a yɛl si'el, asɛɛ ka fʋ kpɛ'ɛŋi tʋmi li bɔzugɔ, fʋ mɛŋ ya'am ka fʋ yɛl nɔɔri tis Zugsɔb fʋ Wina'am la.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a kpɛn' fʋ tiraan vain tiis pɔɔgin nyɛ si'el wʋsa fʋn dim, amaa da vaae niŋi fʋ pɛogʋnɛ mɔri keŋɛ.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a kpɛn' fʋ tiraan kawɛnna pɔɔgin fʋ na nyaŋi ɔnb kawɛnna linɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la, amaa da nɔk kʋsiigi keŋ ki'eda.

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: Ka dau ya'a di pu'a ka ti nyɛ ka o mɔr itʋŋ si'a ka li ka' sʋ'ʋm, on tisim o kasɛta gbauŋ linɛ pa'an ye o lɛbis pu'a la nɛ.

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: o sid kʋdig la pʋ mɔr suor ka o lɛn di pu'a la ya'asɛ, li anɛ yɛlkisʋg: ya da kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bɛ teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am tisi ya la nii. Zi'ela banɛ paas

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dau ya'a di pu'a ka li pʋ yuugɛ, da kɛ ka o keŋ zaba ni bɛɛ ya tis o tʋʋm si'a pɛ'ɛs o mɛŋ tʋʋma la. Asɛɛ ka o bɛ yin yʋʋm mum, ka kɛ ka o pu'a la mɔr sumalisim.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that they will pay back the loan. But don't take one or both of their millstones, or else they may starve. They need these stones for grinding grain into flour to make bread. Kidnapping Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a pɛ'ɛŋ si'eli fʋ san'an, da nɔk o nɛɛr bɛɛ o niŋkaŋ ye o ya'a ti yɔ on di'e, bɔzugɔ yir la dim mɔri dinɛ maannɛ ba diibi dit ka vʋe.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a gban'e o ba'abiig Israel nidi maal o yammʋg bɛɛ kuos o, asɛɛ ka o sɔb kpi. Asɛɛ ka ya yis bɛ'ɛd dinɛ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin la.

english_verse: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.
translation_verse: Niŋgbiŋ ban'as wʋʋ kʋkɔm ya'a li na, yanam gu'usim ka niŋ wʋʋ Levi dim banɛ an maanmaannib la yɛli ya si'em la. Asɛɛ ka ya dɔlis wʋʋ man yɛli ba si'em la.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsimi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la da niŋ Miriam si'em suorin yanamɛ da yi Egipt n kenna la.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a pɛ'ɛŋ sɔ' si'el, da kpɛn' o zakin ye fʋ di'e on ye o nɔk si'eli tis ka fʋ digil ka o ya'a ti yɔ on di'e la.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: Zi'enim yiŋ ka o nɔk on pian' zi'el ye o tisif si'el la mɔri yina tisif.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Zaam ya'a ti ma'ae fʋn lɛbisim o fuugʋ tis o ka o pil o mɛŋi gbis. Ala ka o na pʋ'ʋsif ka li na pa'al ye fʋ anɛ pʋpielim sɔb Zugsɔb fʋ Wina'am la san'an.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: Da nyɛ onɛ an tadim ka an nɔŋdaan la bɔɔd ye o tʋm zaalim tisi fɔ, baa o ya'a anɛ fʋ ba'abiig Israel nid bɛɛ saanne bɛɛ ya tempʋʋd la yinne nii.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yɔɔm o dabisir wʋsa ka winnig nyaan li, on an nɔŋdaan ka ti'enɛ lin yɛla ma'aa la, ya'a ka' ala o na kaasi tis Zugsɔb la fʋ yɛla, ka fʋ na kpɛn' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Saamnam kʋ kpii ba biis yɛlaa ka biis mɛ kʋ kpii ba saamnam yɛlaa, sɔ' wʋsa na kpinɛ o mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla.

english_verse: Make sure that orphans and foreigners are treated fairly. And if you lend money to a widow and want to keep something of hers to guarantee that she will pay you back, don't take any of her clothes.
translation_verse: Da mɔŋ saam bɛɛ banɛ an kpiibis bʋʋdɛ, mɛ da faaɛn pʋkɔɔnr fuug on dii fʋ sam la zugɔ.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsim ye ya da anɛ yammis Egipt teŋin ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am faaɛn ya yis anina, dinɛ kɛ ka m yɛli ya ye ya tʋmmi ala la.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti bʋn ka ya ki, yanam da lɛbi wi'isi li ya'asɛ; basim tis saam nɛ kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya, ala ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la na niŋi ya nu'ug tʋʋma wʋsa bareka.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a kpa'asi ya olif kpaam tiis la la'as wala la, yanam da lɛn lɛbi pɔn' wila la ni takɛ, basimi dinɛ kpɛlim la tis saam nɛ kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a pɔn' ya vain tiis la wala pɔɔgin la, yanam da lɛn lɛbi pɔn' tak ya'asɛ. Basim tis saam nɛ kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsimi ye ya da anɛ saam Egipt teŋin, dinɛ kɛ ka m yɛli ya ye ya tʋmmi anwa la.

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: Li ya'a nar ye ba bʋ' onɛ ka' bʋʋd la, sariakat la na kɛ ka o digin avanba ka ba bʋ' o. Ba na bʋ' o nɛ o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la nar ye o di'e kpa'asa si'em bɛn.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Suor bɛ ye ba bʋ' o kpa'asa pisnaasi, amaa li da gaad ala bɔzugɔ, li ya'a gaad ala ya diisi ya ba'abiig la nɛ nyannɛ ya sʋʋgin.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mid ka ya pid na'araad banɛ kuod la nɛ yʋgʋd.

english_verse: Suppose two brothers are living on the same property, when one of them dies without having a son to carry on his name. If this happens, his widow must not marry anyone outside the family. Instead, she must marry her late husband's brother, and their first son will be the legal son of the dead man.
translation_verse: Ba'abiis ya'a la'am bɛ ka yinne kpi ka pʋ mɔr biribiŋa, o pʋkɔɔnr la da yii kul sɔ' yiŋa, asɛɛ ka o kul yin la ka o sid pitʋ na dii o ka biribiŋ kanɛ ka o du'a yiiga la na sig nɛ onɛ kpi la ka o yʋ'ʋr da bɔdig Israel buudi la nii; sid piti nar ye o tʋm si'em la.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ kpi la ba'abiig la ya'a pʋ bɔɔd pʋkɔɔnr la, pu'a la na keŋ teŋ la kpɛɛmnam san'an yɛli ba ye, “M sid la ba'abiig zan'as ye o kʋ diimi du'a biigi tis o ba'abiig la ka li kɛ ka o yʋ'ʋr da bɔdig Israel teŋinɛ.”

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Teŋ la kpɛɛmnam la na buol o pian' tis o, ka o ya'a nam zan'as ka ye, “Mam kʋ di pʋkɔɔnr la.”

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: Pʋkɔɔnr la na duoe kpɛɛmnam la tuonnɛ pidig onɛ zan'as ye o kʋ dii o la ta'adir ka tʋbis nintɔɔndi niŋ o nindaan ka yɛl o ye, “Ban niŋid onɛ zan'as ye o kʋ mɛɛ o ba'abiig yir si'em la.”

english_verse: From then on, that man's family will be known as “the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.” When Two Men Fight Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Israel teŋin sɔ' wʋsa na baŋ ye dau kanɛ ka ba pidig o ta'adir la tuŋʋ nwa' ka li an yʋ'ʋbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: Dapa ayi' ya'a zabid ka yinne pu'a kena ye o sʋŋ o sid ka gban'e o sidi zabid nɛ sɔ' la daulim,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: yanam fi'igim o nu'ug, ka da zɔɔnɛ o nimbaanliga.

english_verse: Don't try to cheat people by having two sets of weights or measures, one to get more when you are buying, and the other to give less when you are selling.
translation_verse: Da mɔri dinɛ makid kuosim la zin'is ayi' ya yaanɛ, ka yinne zu'oe ka yinne pɔɔda.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ bʋmbanɛ ka ya mɔri makid la'ad tɛbisim la an wʋʋ din nar si'em; ka ala ka ya na yuug teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am tisi ya la.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Banɛ mɔr labanɛ pʋ paae ma'asid la'ad la anɛ zam dim ka ba pʋʋg pʋ paada. Zugsɔb Wina'am kis nimbamanam.

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsimi Amalek dim la da maali ya si'em suorin yanamɛ da yi Egipt na la.

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ da gɛn ka tadig la, ba da pʋ zɔ Wina'am amaa ka zab nɛ ya kʋ banɛ tadig ka kpɛlim nya'aŋi kennɛ gɛrid la.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la ya'a ti tisi ya vʋ'ʋsʋm ya dataas banɛ giligi ya la wʋsa sʋʋgin, teŋ kanɛ ka ya kpɛn'ɛd ye ya sʋ'ʋg ka li aan ya faar la ni, baŋimi ye ya na kʋ Amalek dim la wʋsa ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn tiɛn ba yɛl dunia nwa' nii. Da tamiya.

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am ye o tisi ya la, ka zin'in ka sʋ'ʋgi li ka li liebi ya faar,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: gbin'emi zʋʋd linɛ ka ya bʋn yiiga wʋsa teŋ kanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am tisidi ya la niŋ pɛogʋnɛ mɔri keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am na gaŋ ka o yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ anina la.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Yɛlim maanmaan kanɛ sʋ'oe malima tʋʋma saŋkan la ye, “M zi'en zina yɛti fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am la ye, m yʋ'ʋn paae teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb da pɔ zi'eli ti yaanam ye o na tisi ti la.”

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la na di'e pɛog la fʋ nu'usinɛ zi'eli fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am bimbim la tuon.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ mɛŋ na yɛl Zugsɔb fʋ Wina'am la tuon nyain ye, “M yaab da anɛ Aram nid onɛ gɔɔndi giligid, ka da nɔk o yidim bi'ela mɔri ba keŋ Egipt teŋin zin'in anina, ka ba da lieb buudtita'are mɔr paŋ ka zu'oe.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Amaa Egipt dim la da pʋ maali ti sʋ'ʋm, ka namisi ti hali, ka kɛ ka ti tʋm tʋʋm kpi'ema.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Ka ti kaasi tis Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti yaanam Wina'am la, ka Zugsɔb la wʋmi ti kaasig nɛ ti yaalʋg nɛ tinamɛ tʋm tʋʋm kpi'ema ka ba mugusidi ti si'em la.

english_verse: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ala ka Zugsɔb la da tiɛn o nu'ug kpi'euŋ nɛ nu'ug kanɛ mɔr paŋ hali mɔri ti yis Egipt na, ka tʋm tʋʋmnyalima nɛ linɛ mɔr dabiem.

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: O mɔri ti paae kpɛla na ka zaŋ teŋ kaŋa tisi ti, teŋ kanɛ pʋbid bin'isim nɛ siind.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Lin ka m mɔr zʋʋd linɛ ka m bʋn yiiga teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ tisim la ni kena.” Zi'elim pɛog la Zugsɔb la tuon ka igin o tuon.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ka fʋn nɛ Levi dim nɛ saam banɛ bɛ nɛf la na maal sumalisim yɛlsʋma banɛ ka Zugsɔb fʋ Wina'am maali tis fʋn nɛ fʋ yidim la.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: Yʋma atan' wʋsa nɔkimi fʋ zʋʋd la yinne pʋdigir piiga pʋʋgin tis Levi dim nɛ kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya, ala ka nidib na diti tigid ka diib kʋ pɔ'ɔg sɔ' ya tempʋʋdin nɛ.

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Yɛlim Zugsɔb fʋ Wina'am la ye, “M pʋn yis pʋdigir linɛ an kasi la wʋsa yinne tis Levi dim nɛ saam nɛ kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya la, wʋʋ fʋn zi'el si'em la. M pʋ yii fʋ nɔzi'ela yiŋ bɛɛ m tami lii.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: M pʋ di linɛ an kasi la baa bi'elaa m kukuma la saŋa, bɛɛ m gbin'e li saŋa kanɛ ka m da ka' nyain la, ka mɛ pʋ gbin'e li maal maannɛ tis kpi'imnama. M siaki m Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɔɔr, ka tʋm linɛ wʋsa ka fʋ ye m tʋm la.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Naanimi fʋ bɛllim zin'ikanɛ an kasi la gɔs na ka niŋi fʋ nidib Israel dim zug bareka nɛ teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ tisi ti wʋʋ fʋn da pɔ nɔɔri zi'eli ti yaanam si'em ye fʋ na tisi ba teŋ kanɛ pʋbid bin'isim nɛ siind la.” Dɔl Zugsɔb la nɔɔr

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la tis nɔɔr ye ya dɔl o nɔzi'elʋg nɛ wada banɛ ka o tisidi ya zina nwa' la; gu'usimi ka dɔlisi li nɛ ya sʋnf wʋsa nɛ ya siig wʋsa.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Zina nwa' ya nie nyain pa'al ye, Zugsɔb la aan ya Wina'am, ka ya na dɔl o suoya la nɛ o nɔzi'ela nɛ o wada la wʋsa, ka siak o nɔɔr.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Zina nwa' Zugsɔb la nie pa'al nyain ye ya sid anɛ o nyɔɔrin kɔnbʋg wʋʋ on zi'el si'em la, ka ya na dɔl o nɔzi'elʋg la wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
