translation_verse: O zi'el nɔɔr ye o na dʋ'ʋsi ya ka kɛ ka ya mɔr na'asi gaad buudbanɛ ka o maal la wʋsa, ka ya na an nimbanɛ an kasi tis Zugsɔb Wina'am wʋʋ on yɛl si'em zi'el la.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Moses nɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam la da yɛl nidib la ye, “Dɔlli zi'ela banɛ ka m tisidi ya zina la wʋsa.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Mɛɛmi bimbim anina tisi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la. Nɔkimi kuga mɛ' bimbim la, da nɔki kʋnt la'adi mɛɛ li.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Mɛɛmi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am bimbim la nɛ kuga banɛ ka ba pʋ kpi'e baa, ka maal nyu'or maan bimbim la zugʋ tisi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ka Moses nɛ maanmaannib banɛ an Levi dim la yɛl Israel dim wʋsa ye, “Yanam Israel dima, aaɛn baanlimm ka kɛlis! Ya yʋ'ʋn liebi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la nidib.

english_verse: So you must obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you.”
translation_verse: Siakimi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɔɔr ka dɔl o zi'ela nɛ gban'ar banɛ ka m tisidi ya zina la.”

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Daakan la ka Moses lɛn zi'el nɔɔrɛ tis nidib la ye,

english_verse: Today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. Always obey them, and the Lord will make Israel the most famous and important nation on earth, and he will bless you in many ways.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a siaki ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɔɔr, albareka bama wʋsa na kɛn ya zugin na, ka kpɛm bɛ nɛ ya.

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na niŋi ya zug bareka tempʋʋgin ka niŋi ya pɔɔd wʋsa bareka.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na niŋi ya bareka ya biis du'am pʋʋgin, ka tisi ya zʋʋd bɛdegʋ nɛ niigi nɛ kɔnbid bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na niŋi ya zʋʋd nɛ ya diib wʋsa bareka.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb na niŋi ya kpɛn'ɛb nɛ ya yiib bareka.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na niŋi ya bʋya la bareka ka kɛ ka li pɛ'ɛl, ka ya nu'ug tʋʋma wʋsa mɔr bareka. Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la na niŋi ya bareka teŋ kanɛ ka o tisidi ya la ni.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a dɔlisid Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɔzi'ela la nɛ o suoya la wʋsa, Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka ya aan o mɛŋ nidib banɛ an kasi nwɛnɛ on da pɔ nɔɔri zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Ala ka dunia nidib wʋsa na baŋ ye ba nɔk Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋri buoli ya, ka na zɔti ya.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na tisi ya du'am bɛdegʋ, nɛ niigi nɛ zʋʋd bɛdegʋ, teŋ kanɛ ka o da pɔɔ zi'eli ya yaanam ye o na tisi ya la ni.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na yɔ'ɔg agɔla, ka kɛ ka saa nii ya teŋin la saŋa kanɛ nar, ka niŋi ya nu'ug tʋʋma wʋsa bareka. Buudi bɛdegʋ na kɛɛn ya san'an na pɛ'ɛŋ amaa yanam kʋ pɛ'ɛŋ si'el si'ela.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a kɛlis nɔzi'ela banɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am tisi ya zina la, o na kɛ ka ya an zut ka ka' zʋyaa. Ya ya'a dɔlisi li sʋ'ʋŋa, ya na bɛ nɛ saazug saŋa wʋsa ka ka' teŋinɛ.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ya niŋgbiŋ la na anɛ diibi tis niimis banɛ ian'ad agɔla la nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋʋn la, ka sɔ' kae na kadi baa.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Li na anɛ zanbin nɛ yɛlpakiri tisi ya nɛ ya yaas wʋsa saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a pʋ siaki ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɔɔrɛ ka pʋ dɔl o nɔzi'ela banɛ ka m tisidi ya zina la wʋsa, nɔpɔɔr bama wʋsa na kɛɛn ya zugin na, ka na dii ya.

english_verse: Your businesses and farms will fail.
translation_verse: Nɔpɔɔr na bɛ nɛ ya tempʋʋgin nɛ ya pɔɔdin la wʋsa.

english_verse: You won't have enough bread to eat.
translation_verse: Nɔpɔɔr na bɛɛ ya zʋʋdin nɛ ya diibin nɛ ya niigi nɛ kɔnbidin.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Nɔpɔɔr na bɛɛ ya zugin ka ya kʋ mɔr biis bɛdegʋʋ, ka ya zʋʋd nɛ ya niigi nɛ kɔnbid mɛ kʋ zu'oe.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ya yiib nɛ ya kpɛn'ɛb na anɛ nɔpɔɔr.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔpɔɔr na kɛɛn ya san'an na, ka bɛ'ɛd na paae ya nɛ linɛ wʋsa ka ya nɔki ya nu'ugʋ si'is la, ti paae saŋkanɛ ka o na san'ami ya nyain, yanamɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd ka tam Zugsɔb la zug.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na tiak saa ka li lieb titan nɛ uusʋg, li na liti ya zuginɛ ti paae saŋkanɛ ka ya na kpi.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka ya dataas nyaŋi ya. Ya na dɔl suor yinne keŋ, amaa ya na zɔɔ widigi dɔl suoya ayɔpɔi ka basi ba, ka dunia nidib wʋsa na lidig ka zɔt dabiem bʋnkanɛ maali ya la zug.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka natiŋkpi'emis banɛ da tɔn Egipt dim la tɔɔn ya, ka kɛ ka ya niŋgbina wʋsa an fɛn'ɛd ka ya ɛnbisid ka kʋ nyɛ li tiim.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka gɛɛmis mɔri ya, ka zʋnzɔnnim na paae ya, nɛ ya'ambudimis.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Ya na babin nintaŋ tisʋʋs nwɛnɛ zʋnzɔɔs nɛ. Ya tʋʋma wʋsa kʋ maalɛ; ba na namisidi ya daar wʋsa ka faandi ya, ka sɔ' kae na faaɛn ya basɛ.

english_verse: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.
translation_verse: Ya na mɔri ya pu'a-ɛlis ka ba faaɛn ba di ka kɛɛ ya. Ya na mɛ' ya' ka kʋ kpɛn'. Ya na kua vain tiis pɔɔd ka kʋ dii li wala.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Ba na kʋʋ ya na'araadi ya nini ni, amaa ka ya nɔɔr kʋ lɛm ni'im laa. Ba na faaɛn ya bʋmisi keŋ ka kʋ lɛbisi tisi yaa. Ba na faaɛn ya pɛ'ɛsi tisi ya dataas ka sɔ' kʋ faaɛn lɛbisi tisi yaa.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Ba na faaɛn ya na'akim nɛ pu'asada tis teŋ zʋŋ dim ka ba an yammis ka ya kʋ mɔr paŋi na faaɛn baa, ka ya na midigidi ya nini gɔsidi ya biis la suor zug daar wʋsa ka paŋ ti naae.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Teŋ zʋŋ dim na kena faaɛn yanamɛ nɔki ya paŋi kuaa nyɛ si'el la, ka ya kʋ mɔr si'ela, amaa ya na nyɛt nɛ mugusʋg daar wʋsa.

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: Namisʋg kanɛ ka ya na nyɛ la na kɛ ka ya ya'am bɔdig.

english_verse: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka natiŋkpi'emis tɔɔn ya; din yii ya zupaasʋʋgʋ paae ya nɔbpansimpana, ka tiim kae na nyaŋi ti'ebi li.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka ba gban'e yanam nɛ ya na'ab la mɔri keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka yanam nɛ ya yaanam zi'. Ani ka ya na pʋ'ʋs wina banɛ ka ba nɔk daad nɛ kuga maal.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Li na pak tɛɛns banɛ nidib ka Zugsɔb la na widigi ya kpɛn'ɛs la, yɛlkanɛ paae ya la zug; ba na gɔsidi ya ka panrisid taaba la'ad.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: Ya na bʋd bɛdegʋ ka bʋn fiin, bɔzugɔ na'azɔmnam na ɔnbi li.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Ya na sɛɛ ya tiwanna pɔɔd ka kuaa li, amaa ya kʋ nuu li daam bɛɛ ya pun'oe li walaa, bɔzugɔ zʋnzʋnya na dii ba.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Olif tiis na bɛɛ ya teŋ la wʋsa ni amaa ya kʋ nyɛɛ li kpaam bɔzugɔ li wala la na pɔn' kansa li teŋin.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Na'azɔmnam na yadigi ya teŋ la ɔnbid tiis nɛ ya pɔɔd zʋʋd la wʋsa.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Saam banɛ bɛɛ ya teŋin la na kpɛn dʋt amaa ka yanam na sigid teŋin.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Ya na keŋi ba san'anɛ pɛ'ɛŋ, amaa ba kʋ kɛɛn ya san'an na pɛ'ɛŋɛ. Ba na an zut ka ya an zʋya.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Nɔpɔbama na dɔlli ya, ka na kadi gban'e ya ti paae saŋkanɛ ka ya na kpi, bɔzugɔ ya pʋ siaki ya Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔɔr nɛ o nɔzi'ela nɛ gban'ar banɛ ka o tisi ya la.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: Yanamɛ pʋ dɔlli ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɛ ya ya'amlɛogɔ, ka mɛ pʋ maal sumalisim saŋkanɛ ka si'el wʋsa da an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya la zug,

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: dinzugɔ kɔ'ɔm nɛ ku'onuud na mɔri ya, ka ya na an bi'ela ka si'el wʋsa pɔ'ɔgi ya, amaa ya na la'am tʋmmi tisidi ya dataas banɛ ka Zugsɔb la na nɔki ya niŋi ba nu'usin la. Dataas la na ziili ya tʋʋm kpi'ema wʋʋ kʋnt yɔksin daugʋ bɛ ya niŋgɔɔnrin nɛ, hali ka ya ti san'am naae.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka buudsi'a yi lalli kena zab nɛ ya. Ba na yi lalli zulig tɔ'ɔtɔ na nwɛnɛ silʋg nɛ. Buudkaŋa na anɛ banɛ ka ya kʋ wʋmmi ba pian'adɛ,

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: ka ba nindaa na mɔr dabiem, ka ba kʋ na'asid kpɛɛmnam bɛɛ ba zɔt biis nimbaanliga.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Ba na lɔbi giligi ya tempʋʋd la wʋsa ti paae saŋkanɛ ka ya teŋ kpi'ema la na lii naae; la'an nɛ yanamɛ mɔr ti'ir ye li na faaɛn ya la. Ba na lɔbi gilig tempʋʋd banɛ bɛ teŋ kanɛ ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am tisi ya la wʋsa.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: Ya dataas la na giligi ya, ka kɔ'ɔm nɛ namisʋg kanɛ na paae ya la zug ya na kʋ biribis nɛ bipumis banɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am tisi ya la ɔnb.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: Bama wʋsa baa yinne o kʋ tisi ba biig kanɛ ka o ɔnbid la ni'imi, ka li na anɛ ya dataas la giligi ya tempʋʋd ka ya bɛ namisʋgʋn ka diib kae la zug.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ka biis banɛ ka o mɛŋ du'a la, o na bɔɔd ye o su'a ɔnbi ba, saŋkanɛ ka ya dataas na ti giligi ya tempʋʋd la, namisʋg kanɛ na paae ya la zug.

english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: Ya ya'a kʋ siaki dɔlis wada banɛ sɔb gbauŋ kaŋa ni la wʋsaa, ka na'as yʋ'ʋkanɛ zu'oe ka mɔr dabiem nwa', ye Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la,

english_verse: like those you were so afraid of in Egypt.
translation_verse: O na kɛ ka ban'abɛ'ɛd banɛ da gban'e Egipt dim la gban'e ya ka kʋ basi yaa.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka hali ban'abɛ'ɛd banɛ pʋ sɔb wada gbauŋ kaŋa ni la gban'e ya, ti paae saŋkanɛ ka ya na san'am naae.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ da zu'oe nwɛnɛ nwadbibis banɛ bɛ saŋgbana ni la yʋ'ʋn na anɛ bi'ela bɔzugɔ, ya pʋ siaki ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ lin da an Zugsɔb la bɔɔdim ye o kɛ ka ya bɛllim an sʋ'ʋŋa ka ya wiak ka ya kal zu'oe la, ala mɛn ka li na aan o bɔɔdim ye o mɔr san'auŋʋ kɛɛn ya san'an na ka san'ami ya. O na kadi ya yis teŋ kanɛ ka ya kpɛn'ɛd ye ya sʋ'ʋgi li la.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na widigi ya kpɛn'ɛs dunia buudi la wʋsa sʋʋgin, yi dunia kpikpɛŋ yinne keŋ paae kpikpɛŋ yinne. Ani ka ya na pʋ'ʋsid winsieba, wina banɛ an daad nɛ kuga banɛ ka yanam nɛ ya yaanam maal la.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Ka li ya'a an bɛogʋn ya na yɛl ye, “Li ya'a aannɛ zaam li naan sɔn'ɔn.” Ka zaam ka ya yɛl ye, “Li ya'a aannɛ bɛogʋn li naan sɔn'ɔn.” Dabiem kanɛ na kpɛn' ya nɛ ya nini na nyɛ si'el la zug.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka ya kpɛn' anrima lɛb Egipt, la'an nɛ on zi'el nɔɔr ye ya da lɛb Egipt teŋin la. Ani ka ya dap nɛ ya pu'ab na nɔki ya mɛŋi kuosid ye ba da' ya ka ya na an yammis, amaa ka sɔ' kʋ siaki da' yaa.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Ka yanamɛ paae zin'ikaŋa la, Sihon onɛ an Hesbon na'ab la, nɛ Og onɛ an Basan na'ab la, yina ye ba zab nɛ ti; amaa ka ti nyaŋi ba

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: ka faaɛn ba tɛɛns la tis Reuben nɛ Gad dim nɛ Manase dɔɔg la pʋsʋk.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Gu'usimi ka dɔlis nɔnaar la pian'abama, ala ka yanamɛ tʋm si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya.

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ya da nyɛ bʋnkisa banɛ da bɛɛ ba sʋʋgin nɛ bada linɛ an daad nɛ kuga nɛ linɛ an anzurifa nɛ sanlima.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ka dau bɛɛ pu'a bɛɛ dɔɔg bɛɛ tuŋ si'a da bɛ yanam banɛ zi'e nwa' sʋʋgin ka o ya'am fɛndigi yi Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la san'an ka o keŋ pʋ'ʋsid wina banɛ ka buudbama pʋ'ʋsid la. Mid ka tuŋ si'a bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin tʋm yɛlbɛ'ɛd kaŋa buudi ka li na nwɛnɛ nya'ar kanɛ an yabid ka tɔi hali nɛ.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Ninkaŋa sɔb ya'a ti wʋm nɔzi'elkaŋa pian'ad la, o na mɔɔd ye o iee albareka tis o mɛŋ dinzugɔ o na tɛn'ɛs ye, “Si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisim la'an nɛ man zan'as ka nan kpɛn tʋmmi m ya'am bɔɔdim la.” Nɛ'ɛŋa na mɔr tɔɔgʋ kɛn banɛ tʋm sʋm nɛ banɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd wʋsa zugin na.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na fuoe on sɔb Israel buudi la wʋsa sʋʋgin, ka kɛ ka yɛltɔɔd paae o wʋʋ nɔnaar nɔpɔɔr banɛ sɔb wada gbauŋ kaŋa ni la.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: Zʋmaana banɛ aan ya yaas nɛ saam banɛ yi teŋ lalli na ti duoe na ka nyɛ tɔɔg nɛ namisʋg nɛ ban'as banɛ ka Zugsɔb la mɔri kɛn teŋ la zugin na.

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Teŋ la wʋsa na san'am lieb yaarim nɛ kidibir nɛ bugum, ka si'el pʋ bʋta, ka si'el mɛ pʋ yit anii. Mɔɔg bɛɛ tiig kʋ tilig anina. Li na nwɛnɛ Sodom nɛ Gomora san'auŋʋ da an si'em la, nɛ Adma nɛ Zeboim dinɛ ka Zugsɔb da san'am, o sʋnfʋ da pɛlig hali la.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Buudi wʋsa na bu'os ye, “Bɔ ka Zugsɔb la niŋ teŋ kaŋa wala? Bɔ ka o mɔr sʋnpɛɛn kaŋa buudi?”

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Ka lɛbisʋg la na anɛ “Di anɛ nimbama zan'as Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am nɔnaar linɛ ka o da tisi ba saŋa kanɛ ka o mɔri ba yi Egipt teŋin na la zug.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: Ba da keŋɛ pʋ'ʋsid winsieba banɛ ka ba zi' ka Zugsɔb mɛ pʋ tisi ba la.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka o da fuoe ba yisi ba teŋinɛ da'ae ba bas teŋ si'a ni, wʋʋ lin an si'em hali ti paae zina.”

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: Asida sida Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la kɛ yɛlsu'ada la wʋsa tis o mɛŋ, amaa linɛ ka o nie nyain pa'ali ti la, anɛ tinamɛ sʋ'oe li wʋsa, tinam nɛ ti yaas, hali ti paae saŋa kanɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, lin na kɛ ka ti na dɔlis wada nwa' wʋsa.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: Albareka nɛ nɔpɔɔr banɛ ka m tisi ya zina la ya'a ti paae ya na, ka ya di'e ba ya sʋʋnrin, zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la widigi ya kpɛn'ɛs buudbama sʋʋgin la,

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: ka yanam nɛ ya biis la ya'a ti lɛbi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am san'an na ka siak o nɛ ya sʋnf wʋsa nɛ ya pʋtɛn'ɛr wʋsa, nwɛnɛ mam zi'el nɔɔri tisi ya si'em zina la,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Hali ya ya'a widigi kpɛn' zin'ikanɛ lalli ka' bɛnnɛ, ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la na ku'oli ya mɔri lɛbis na.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: O na mɔri ya lɛbisi ya yaanam teŋin na, ka ya na sʋ'ʋgi li. O na kɛ ka ya mɔr laafi ka wiaki zu'oe gati ya yaanam la.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la na tiaki ya sʋnya nɛ ya yaas sʋnya ka ya na nɔŋ o nɛ ya sʋnya nɛ ya pʋtɛnda wʋsa ka na kpɛn vʋe.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la na kɛ ka nɔpɔbama wʋsa paae ya dataas nɛ banɛ kisi ya la wʋsa.

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: Ka ya na lɛn lɛbi dɔl Zugsɔb la nɔzi'ela banɛ ka m tisi ya zina la.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ala ka ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la na niŋi ya albareka, yanamɛ nɔki ya nu'ugʋ tʋm si'el wʋsa, nɛ ya biis nɛ ya bʋnkɔnbid la wʋsa. Ya pɔɔd la zʋʋd na maal sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya. Zugsɔb la na nɔŋi ya ka o sʋnf na ma'ae ya zug, nwɛnɛ on da nɔŋi ya yaanam si'em la.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ya ya'a siaki ya Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔɔr, ka dɔl o nɔzi'elʋg nɛ o gban'ar linɛ sɔb wada gbauŋʋn la, ka fɛndigi lɛbi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la san'an nɛ ya sʋnf nɛ ya pʋtɛn'ɛr wʋsa, li sid na niŋ ala. Vʋm nɛ kum gaŋir yɛla

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: Gɔsima! Nɔzi'elkanɛ ka m tisidi ya zina la anɛ linɛ pʋ tɔi tisi ya ka ya na ye ya kʋ nyaŋɛ.

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Li ka' linɛ bɛɛ agɔl ka ya na bu'osid ye “Anɔ'ɔn na dʋ arezana nii mɔr na tisi ti ka ti wʋm ka tʋm?”

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Li mɛ pʋ lɔ'ɔŋ Atɛuk la ka ya na bu'os ye, “Anɔ'ɔn na lɔ'ɔŋ Atɛuk la mɔr na tisi ti ka ti wʋm ka tʋm?”

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Ayei, pian'ʋk la kpi'e nɛ ya ka bɛɛ ya nɔɔrin nɛ ya sʋnfʋn. Li bɛɛ ya nɔɔrin ka bɛɛ ya sʋnya ni ka ya na siaki li.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, zina nwa', m nɔknɛ vʋm nɛ bʋnsʋma la digili ya tuon, ka mɛ nɔk kum nɛ san'auŋʋ digili ya tuon.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Zina dabisir la, m buon agɔl nɛ teŋgbauŋ ye ba di kasɛt ye m digil vʋm nɛ kum ya tuon, ka digil albareka nɛ nɔpɔɔri ya tuon. Gaŋimi vʋm ka yanam nɛ ya biis na vʋe yuug,

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: ka nɔŋi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la. Kɛlisimini o ka gban'e o nɛ nu'us ayi', ka Zugsɔb la aan ya nyɔvʋr. Ka onɛ na kɛ ka ya yʋma zu'oe teŋ kanɛ ka o pɔɔ zi'el ye o tisi ya yaanam Abraham nɛ Isaak nɛ Jakob la.

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Moses da yina pian' naar pian'abama tis Israel dim ye,

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Zi'enimi sʋ'ʋŋa, ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya sʋnf. Da zɔti dabiem bɛɛ kɛ ka dabiem kpɛn' ya ba yɛlaa. Ya Zugsɔb Wina'am na bɛ nɛ ya la zug, o kʋdim kʋ basi ya bɛɛ tami ya yɛlaa.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Moses da buol Josua ka o yi Israel dim wʋsa tuon na ka o yɛl o ye, “Zi'enim sʋ'ʋŋa ka kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ sʋnf. Asɛɛ ka fʋ dɔl nidib nwa' keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la da pɔ ye o na tisi ba yaanam la, ka na pʋdigi tisi ba ka li aan ba faar.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mɛŋ na gaadi fʋ tuon ka na bɛ nɛf. O kʋdim kʋ basif bɛɛ o tami fʋ yɛlaa. Da zɔt dabiem, da kɛ ka fʋ giinla siɛn.”

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Alazug Moses da sɔb wadkaŋa tis maanmaannib banɛ an Levi biis ka an banɛ da ziid Zugsɔb Nɔnaar Daka la, nɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa.

english_verse: Moses told these priests and leaders: Each year the Israelites must come together to celebrate the Festival of Shelters at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. You must read these laws and teachings to the people at the festival every seventh year, the year when loans do not need to be repaid.
translation_verse: saŋkanɛ ka yanam Israel dim wʋsa la'asidi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am tuon na zin'ikanɛ ka o na gaŋ la, fʋnɛ na karim wada nwa' ba tuon ka ba wʋm.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Ba biis banɛ nan zi' wada kaŋa yɛla la, asɛɛ ka ba wʋmi li ka zamisi li, din ka ba na zɔti ya Zugsɔb Wina'am, ya ya'a lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan kɔldaug la sʋ'ʋg teŋ kanɛ ka ya kpɛn'ɛd la.” Israel tʋbzian'asim la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye, “Nannanna fʋ kum dabisir li'el ya. Buolim Josua ka ya keŋ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin la, ka m na bas o suor ka o pin'il tʋʋma.” Ka Moses nɛ Josua dɔl taaba keŋ La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋrin la.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la nie o mɛŋ Sʋgʋrin la nwɛnɛ saŋgbauŋ nɛ, zi'en Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔrin.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Moses ye, “Fʋ yʋ'ʋn na maal ka'alim. Li kʋ yuugɛ ka nidib la na maali ba mɛŋ wʋʋ pu'agɔɔnda nɛ, dɔl teŋ zʋŋ wina teŋ kanɛ ka ba kpɛn'ɛd la ni. Ba na bas mam, ka san'am nɔnaar kanɛ ka m maal nɛ ba la.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Dabiskan la daar m sʋnf na pɛlig ka m basi ba. M na su'a m nindaa ka kɛɛ ba ka ba san'am. Tɔɔg nɛ yɛlmugusa na lii ba zugin. Daakan ka ba na bu'osid taaba ye, ‘Yɛlpakir kanɛ yʋ'ʋn bɛɛ ti zugin nwa' ka'anɛ ti Wina'am la pʋ lɛm bɛ nɛ ti laa?’

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: M sid na su'a m nindaa daakan la, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka ba tʋm ka fɛndigi dɔl winsieba la zug.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: M ya'a ti mɔri ba kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ pʋbid bin'isim nɛ siind ka m da yɛl nɔɔri zi'eli ba yaanam la, ka ba ya'a ti dii tig ka li an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ba, ba na fɛndigi dɔl winsieba wɔ'ɔgidi ba, ka zan'as man ka san'am m nɔnaar la.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Ka tɔɔg nɛ mugusʋg bɛdegʋ ya'a ti paae ba, yʋʋm kaŋa na an kasɛti dii ba bɔzugɔ ba yaas kʋ tam. M pʋn mi' ba pʋtɛn'ɛr nɛ ban an ninsieba hali ka m nam pʋ mɔri ba kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka m pɔɔ zi'el ye m tisi ba la.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ka Moses sɔb yʋʋm kaŋa pa'al Israel dim la daakan la.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da zi'el nɔkaŋa tis Josua onɛ an Nun biig la ye, “Zi'enim sʋ'ʋŋa ka kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ sʋnf, ka fʋnɛ na mɔr Israel dimi keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka m pɔ nɔɔri zi'el la, ka mam mɛŋ na bɛ nɛf.”

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Moses n da sɔb wada la niŋ gbauŋʋn la yii li pin'ilʋgʋn keŋ paae li naarin nya'aŋ la,

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: o da zi'el nɔkaŋa tis Levi dim banɛ ziid Zugsɔb Nɔnaar Daka la,

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba ye, “Nɔkimi wada gbauŋ kaŋa digili kpi'eli ya Zugsɔb Wina'am Nɔnaar Daka la bɛ si'el la. Ka li na bɛɛ ani ka an kasɛti dii ya.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: M mi' ya zuti kpi'em ka pʋ siakid na'ana si'em. Mam ya'a nan vʋe ka bɛ nɛ ya, ka ya zan'as Zugsɔb la nɔɔr, ka m ya'a ti kpi?

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: La'asimini ya buudi kpɛɛmnam wʋsa nɛ ya tuongatib, ka m pian' pian'abama ka ba wʋm ka buol agɔl nɛ teŋgbauŋ ka ba di kasɛt.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: M mi' ye m kum nya'aŋ, ya na kpɛn' filʋŋ ka fɛndig suokanɛ ka m pa'ali ya la ni. Dabisa kenna ka tɔɔg nɛ yɛlpakir na paae ya, bɔzugɔ, ya na tʋm bɛ'ɛd Zugsɔb la san'an ka o sʋnf na pɛlig nɛ ya nu'usi tʋm si'el la zug.”

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Ka Moses pin'ili karim yʋʋma gbauŋ la pin'ilʋgʋn ti paae li naar bɛn, ka Israel dim la wʋsa wʋm.

english_verse: Earth and Sky, listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Banɛ bɛɛ agɔlɛ, kɛlisimi ka m na pian'; Teŋgbauŋɔ, wʋmmi m nɔɔr yɛlʋg!

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m pa'ala nwɛnɛ saa niid nɛ, ka m pian'ad nwɛnɛ mɛligim lit nɛ. Ka pian'ad la na nwɛnɛ saa niid mɔpaala zug nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ satita'ari niid tutuud zug nɛ.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: M na mɔɔl Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr. Zun'omi ti Wina'am la ye, o zu'oe gat si'el wʋsa!

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty rock, and he never does wrong. God can always be trusted to bring justice.
translation_verse: O anɛ tampiing ka o tʋʋma wʋsa an sʋ'ʋŋa, ka dɔl suor. O anɛ onɛ an sida sɔb ka pʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ; o anɛ pʋpiel ka o zi'esim an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Amaa ba tʋm bɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔg o, ka pʋ nar ye ba aan o nidiba. Ba anɛ zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ an ziri dim ka ba tʋʋma pʋ dɔl suorɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ yɔɔd Zugsɔb la si'em laa? Ya anɛ zɔn nɛ yalimnam! Li ka' onɛ aan ya saam ka ya'abi yaa? Ka' onɛ maali yaa?

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: Tɛnri kʋdimin yɛla, ka tɛn'ɛs zʋmaana banɛ gaad la. Bu'osimi fʋ saam ka o na yɛlif, bu'osimi kpɛɛmnam ka ba na tu'asi ya li gbin.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: O da nyɛ ba sian'arin la, zin'ikanɛ ma'ae sillimm ka nidib kae, ka mɔri ba yina ka lusi ba ka gɔsidi ba. O guri ba nwɛnɛ o mɛŋ nimbielim nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Ka nwɛnɛ silʋgʋ zamisid o biis ian'ab nɛ ka yadig kpʋkpama laannɛ bɔɔd ye o gɛ'ɛŋi ba.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ma'aa da dɔl o nidib la. Win zʋŋ da pʋ pɛ'ɛs o san'anɛ.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: O da kɛya ka ba sʋ'ʋg tɛɛns banɛ bɛ kʋkʋna nɛ zuoya ni la, ka diisi ba nɛ zʋʋd linɛ bɛ pɔɔdin la, nɛ siind linɛ bɛ tampiingin la, nɛ kpaam linɛ yit kugkpi'ema ni na.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: Niigi nɛ bʋʋs la da mɔr bin'isim bɛdegʋ. Ba da mɔr pɛ'ɛsʋma nɛ bʋsʋma nɛ na'asʋma. Ki nɛ ban bɔɔd dansi'a wʋsa da bɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you grew fat and rebelled against God, your Creator you rejected the Mighty Rock, your only place of safety.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb nidib la da mɔr kpan'am nɛ zʋʋd bɛdegʋ ka nɔbi vɛnl la, ba yʋ'ʋn da basi ba Wina'am onɛ maali ba la. Ba da zan'asi ba Faangid onɛ aan ba Tampiing la.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Ba da kɛya ka o mɔr fufum nɛ win zʋna, ka kɛ ka o sʋnf pɛlig nɛ bada banɛ an yɛlkisa la.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Ba da maan maana tisid kikiris banɛ ka' Wina'am; wina banɛ ka ba da nan zi', wina banɛ ka ba nyɛ ka li pʋ yuugɛ, nɛ wina banɛ ka ba yaanam da pʋ na'asida.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: Ya bas Tampiing onɛ aan ya ba' la, ka tam Wina'am kanɛ du'a ya la.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nyɛnɛ nɛ' ka zan'asi ba bɔzugɔ, o biribis nɛ o bipumis la da kɛ ka o sʋnf pɛlig.

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “M na bidi ba kudug ka gɔs ye ba naar na an wala. Ba anɛ zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ ka ba zut kpi'em ka ba ka' sida dima.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Ba kɛya ka m mɔr fufum nɛ linɛ ka' winaa, ka pɛligi m sʋnf nɛ ba ba'ayaalis la. M mɛ na kɛ ka ba mɔr nyuur nɛ buudbanɛ ka' vɔɔnrɛ, m na kɛ ka ba sʋnf duoe nɛ nidib banɛ an yalimnam ka pʋ gban'ad yɛla gbinnɛ.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ m sʋnf pɛlignɛ hali dit nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ. Li ditnɛ hali paad teŋ teŋir, li na dii kanb teŋgbauŋ nɛ li zʋʋd wʋsa ka zuoya gbina ni wʋsa la'aŋ bugum.

english_verse: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka yɛltɔɔd lii ba zugin, ka tɔɔn ba wʋʋ piema nɛ.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka Apʋnya'aŋ-laal kɔ'ɔm la buudi li na kʋʋ ba. Ban'abɛ'ɛd na gban'e ba ka ba kpi. M na kɛ ka bʋnyuos gban'e ba, ka wa'abɛ'ɛdnam dumi ba.

english_verse: Young and old alike will be killed in the streets and terrified at home.
translation_verse: Ba na zabi kʋʋ ba suoya ni, ka ba ya' pʋʋgin dabiem na bɛ. Ba na'akim nɛ pu'asada wʋsa na kpi, bilies nɛ bʋnkʋd kʋ kpɛlim.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: M gban'e ye m na widigi ba ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn tiɛn ba yɛl ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: Amaa m zɔtnɛ ba dataas la kʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ, ka yɛl ye, “Tinam mɛŋ paŋ ka ti nyaŋi ba. Li ka' Zugsɔb la tʋm nɛ' wʋsa.”

english_verse: People of Israel, that's what the Lord has said to you. But you don't have good sense, and you never listen to advice.
translation_verse: Ba anɛ buudkanɛ ka ba ya'am kae, ka ba mɛ pʋ mɔr baŋirɛ.

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Nid yinne na niŋ wala kad nidib tusirɛ? Bɛɛ nidib ayi' kad tusa piiga ka ba zɔ, ka li ya'a ka'anɛ ba Tampiing la kuosi ba? Ya'a ka'anɛ Zugsɔb la zaŋi ba niŋi ba nu'uginɛ.

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: Ba tampiing la pʋ nwɛnɛ tinam Tampiing la. Hali ti dataas la mɛŋ mi'.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Ba vain tiig la yinɛ Sodom vain tiigin la na ka yi Gomora pɔɔdin na. Ka ba tiis wala la an yabid, ka li wʋsa la'asi tɔi hali.

english_verse: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.
translation_verse: Ba daam nwɛnɛ waaf yabid bɛɛ yabid linɛ bɛ dunduug nɔɔrin.

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Mam gban'e ye m niŋ Israel dim nɛ ba dataas si'em la, bɛ nɛ m sʋʋnrin, ka m guri li nwɛnɛ m arezak nɛ.

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: “Manɛ na yɔ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sam. Saŋa kenna ka ba na sadigi li. Ba dabisbɛ'og daar pʋ lalla. Ka namisʋg zɔt tɔ'ɔtɔ paadi ba.”

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb na kad o nidib saria ka zɔɔ o yammis nimbaanlig, o ya'a ti nyɛ ka ba paŋ naae ka banɛ an yammis bɛɛ banɛ sʋ'oe ba mɛŋ lɛn ka' kpi'euŋɔ.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: O yʋ'ʋn na bu'os ye, “Ba wina la bɛ yaanɛ? Tampinkanɛ ka ba su'a ba mɛŋ la bɛ yaanɛ?

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: Wina banɛ ɔnbi ba maana ni'im linɛ mɔr kpaam ka nuu ba bʋnnuuda maana daam la bɛ ya? Kɛl ka bama sʋŋi ya, kɛl ka ba faaɛn ya!

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: Nannanna, gɔsimi ya, Manɛ la, Win si'a lɛn kae asɛɛ mam ma'aa. Manɛ kʋʋd ka lɛn tisid vʋm. Manɛ pu'alim ka maligim ti'ebid. Sɔ' kae na yis linɛ bɛ man nu'uginɛ.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: M ʋki m nu'us agɔla ka ye, nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ vʋe saŋa wʋsa la yʋ'ʋr zug.

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: M ya'a saasi m sʋ'ʋraug kanɛ diti nyɛɛn pil-pil la, ka m nu'ug gban'e li sariakadib zin'igin, m na yɔ m dataas la sam ka yɔ banɛ kisi m la sam.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka m piema la nu ziim kʋʋl, ka m sʋ'ʋraug la na kʋ banɛ wʋsa zan'asi m nɔɔr. Hali ba tuongatib nɛ ban gban'e sieba la wʋsa na kpi.” Ba pa'al nidib la yʋʋm la

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl nidib la ye, “Buudi wʋsa, maalimi sumalisim la'an nɛ Zugsɔb nidib la, Bɔzugɔ, o na yɔ sam o yammis la yɛla. O na yɔ o bi'emnam la sam ka sɔs suguru o nidib nɛ o teŋ la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug.”

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: o da yɛli ba ye, “Nɔkimi mam pian' si'el wʋsa tisi ya zina la niŋi ya sʋʋnrin. Ala ka ya na nyaŋi sa'ali ya biis ka ba na gu'us ka dɔl wada kanɛ ka m tisi ya la.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Li ka'anɛ pian'ad linɛ an zaalim, li anɛ ya nyɔvʋr. Dɔlisiminɛ li ka lin ka ya na yuug teŋ kanɛ ka ya lɔ'ɔŋid Joodan kɔldaug ye ya sʋ'ʋg la.” Moses na kpi Nebo Zuor zug

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Dabiskan la daar ka Zugsɔb yɛl Moses ye,

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: “Kemi Abarim zuoya la ni, n dʋ Nebo zuor dinɛ bɛ Moab teŋin kpa'ad Jeriko tempʋʋg la. Gɔsim Keenan teŋ la, teŋ kanɛ ka m ye m tis Israel ka ba sʋ'oe la.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Zuokanɛ ka fʋ dʋt la zug ka fʋ na maal ka'alim, wʋʋ fʋ bier Aaron n da kpi Hor zuor zug si'em la,

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ya babayi' la da pʋ tis man sida Israel dim la wʋsa sʋʋgin yanamɛ da bɛ Meriba ku'om linɛ pʋ lal nɛ Kades teŋ kanɛ bɛ Zin sian'arin la. Ya da pʋ kɛ ka m yʋ'ʋr an kasi Israel dim sʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, fʋ na nyɛ teŋ la nɛ lallisa, amaa fʋ kʋ kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka m zi'el nɔɔr ye m tis Israel dim la pʋʋginɛ.”

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Moses onɛ an Wina'am nid la da niŋ Israel dim albareka si'em nwa' ka nyaan kpi.

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: O yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la da sig Israel dim san'an Sinai zuorin la, ka nie o mɛŋ Seir teŋin, ka mɛ pa'al o mɛŋ Paran zuoya la zug. O da kena nɛ maliaknam banɛ an kasi la tusa-tusa, yi nya'aŋ zuor la sisɛrim.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Sida fʋnɛ sid nɔŋ nidib la. Fʋ mɛŋ nidib banɛ an kasi la wʋsa bɛnɛ fʋ nu'usin. Ba wʋsa da pɔndi ba nɔba zin'ini fʋ tuon ka di'e fʋ pa'alʋg

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: linɛ an wada kanɛ ka Moses tisi ti ka li anɛ Jakob nidib faar la.

english_verse: Then you and your leaders made the Lord your king.
translation_verse: Nidib la tuongatib da la'as nɛ Israel buudi la, Zugsɔb la da anɛ Israel na'ab.”

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: Ka Moses yɛl Reuben yɛla ye, “Reuben na vʋe ka kʋ kpii, ka o nidib mɛ kʋ an fiin nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Ka yɛl Juda yɛla ye, “Zugsɔba, kɛlisim Juda kaasig, mɔr o lɛb o mɛŋ nidibin na. Kɛl ka o zab nɛ o mɛŋ nu'usi faaɛn o mɛŋ. Sʋŋim o ka nyaŋ o dataas.”

english_verse: At Massah and Meribah Spring, the Lord tested you, tribe of Levi. You were faithful, and so the priesthood belongs to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Levi buudi la o yɛli ba ye, “Onɛ aan fʋ mɛŋ nid kasi la, ka Urim nɛ Tummim na bɛɛ o san'an Fʋ da kpans o Masa teŋin, ka nyɛ ka o paae fʋ ya'am Meriba ku'om bɛ zin'isi'a la.

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: O yɛl o saam nɛ o ma ye, ‘Mam ba'a kae nɛ ba.’ O pʋ gɔsi nyɛɛ o bieya nɛ o pitiba bɛɛ o tiɛn o mɛŋ biis yɛllɛ, amaa ka guri fʋ pian'ad la nɛ fʋ nɔnaar la ma'aa.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: O pa'an Jakob fʋ suoya la ka kɛt ka Israel dim baŋi fʋ wada la. O maan maana linɛ an bʋnnyubisa, nɛ maana linɛ nyu'od, fʋ maan daka la zug.

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: O yɛl Benjamin yɛla ye, “Kɛl ka Zugsɔb nɔŋilim la bɛɛ o san'an nɛ laafi, on gur o daar wʋsa la zug. Zugsɔb la nɔŋ o la zug, ka kɛ ka o bɛɛ o san'an.”

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Ka mɛ yɛl Josef yɛla ye, “Zugsɔb na niŋ o pɔɔd bareka ka kɛ ka saa nɛ mɛligim naan agɔla niidi li zug ka ku'om naan teŋin bunna.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: Fʋ na nyɛ zʋʋd bɛdegʋ ka li zu'oe gaad yʋʋmpʋkʋda zuoya la din, nɛ bareka linɛ yit kʋkʋna ni na la.

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: Teŋ la na tis o piinsʋŋ ka li pɛ'ɛl ka onɛ da nie o mɛŋ tutukanɛ ka bugum da dit la, albareka na bɛ nɛf. Lina wʋsa na bɛ Josef zugin, ka kɛ ka o dit na'am o ba'abiis wʋsa sʋʋgin.

english_verse: Be happy, Zebulun, as your boats set sail; be happy, Issachar, in your tents.
translation_verse: O yɛl Zebulun yɛla ye, “Zebulun dima, ya ya'a yit ya na mɔr sumalisim: Isaka nidib mɛ na mɔr sumalisim ba yin.

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Ba na buol nidibi la'as zuoya ni, ka maal pʋpielim maana. Ba na di diib linɛ bɛɛ atɛukʋn bɛdegʋ la, nɛ kpan'am linɛ su'a titanbin'isʋgin la.”

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Gad yɛla o yɛl ye, “Albareka bɛ nɛ onɛ yalig Gad sʋ'ʋlim. Gad na bɛɛ anina wʋʋ gbigim nɛ ka na aansid kpʋkpama bɛɛ zut.

english_verse: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.
translation_verse: O gaŋ paalʋ linɛ an sʋm hali la tis o mɛŋ; tuongatib pʋʋr ka o tis o mɛŋ. Nidib la zugdaannamɛ la'as la, o tʋm Zugsɔb pʋpielim tʋʋma nɛ o sariakadib Israel dim yɛla.”

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Ka pian' Dan yɛla ye, “Dan anɛ wʋʋ gbigimbili naam Basan zuoya ni iank na.”

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: O yɛl Naftali yɛla ye, “Naftali ka Zugsɔb la nimbaanlig bɛ nɛ o, ka o albareka bɛɛ o san'an bɛdegʋ. O na sʋ'oe bɛuŋ tita'ar teŋ la mɔri keŋ paae li dagɔbʋg baba.”

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: O mɛ yɛl Aser yɛla ye, “O na nyɛ zugsʋŋʋ gaad biis wʋsa. O ba'abiis la na nɔŋ o hali. O na mɔr kpaam piesid o nɔba.

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Fʋ gam tabidis la na anɛ kʋnt ka fʋ na mɔr paŋi paae fʋ nyɔvʋr bɛn.” Wina'am zʋn'or

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: “Sɔ' lɛn kae nwɛnɛ Israel Wina'am. Onɛ bɛ agɔla ka sʋŋidif la, ka an kpi'euŋ sɔb saŋgbana ni.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Wina'am kanɛ pʋ mɔr naar la aan fʋ gu'ud, ka o nu'us banɛ bɛ saŋa wʋsa la lusif. O na kadi fʋ dataa la yisi fʋ tuon, ka na yɛl ye, ‘San'am o!’

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Israel na bɛɛ o gʋllim ka daamʋg kae. Jakob nidib na bɛ teŋ kanɛ mɔr zʋʋd nɛ danpaalig, Ka mɛligim na lit zin'ig kan la.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: Israel, fʋ na mɔr albareka. Anɔ'ɔnɛ bɛɛ nwɛnɛ fʋ ka Zugsɔb la faaɛn ba? O anɛ fʋ gbanti'edʋg ka sʋŋidif, ka aan fʋ zaba sʋ'ʋg kanɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ. Fʋ dataas wʋsa na vanbini fʋ tuon ka fʋ nɔɔdi ba nya'aŋi gat.”

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Moses yʋ'ʋn da yi Moab teŋ kanɛ an sassi la ni keŋ dʋ Nebo zuoya la zin'ikanɛ buon Pisig Zuor ka kpa'ad Jeriko teŋ la. Ani ka Zugsɔb la da pa'al o teŋ la wʋsa: linɛ an Gilead sʋ'ʋlim paae Dan sʋ'ʋlim la,

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: nɛ Naftali sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa, nɛ Efiram nɛ Manase sʋ'ʋlim, nɛ Juda teŋ wʋsa mɔr ala paae Atɛuk linɛ bɛ ya-tuona la,

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: nɛ Negef teŋgbauŋ la, nɛ Joodan bɔn'ɔg din yi Jeriko, linɛ an Kpʋkparis Tempʋʋg la, mɔr ala paae Zoar teŋ.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛl o ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa an teŋ kanɛ ka m pɔ nɔɔri zi'el Abraham nɛ Isaak nɛ Jakob, man da yɛli ba ye, m na nɔki li tisi ba yaas la. Nannanna, m kɛya ka fʋ nyɛɛ li nɛ fʋ nini, amaa fʋ kʋ lɔ'ɔŋi kpɛn' ani.” Moses kum

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Moses onɛ an Zugsɔb tʋmtʋm la da kpi Moab teŋin wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: O da mum o nɛ Moab teŋin bɔn'ɔg linɛ kpi'e Bet Peor la, amaa lin keŋ paae zina sɔ' zi' o yaʋg la bɛ zin'isi'a.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Josua onɛ da an Nun biig la da pɛ'ɛl nɛ siig ka paam ya'am bɔzugɔ, Moses da nɔk o nu'usi pa'al o zug. Israel dim la da kɛlisid o pian'ad ka tʋm Zugsɔb la da yɛl Moses si'em la. Ban dʋ'ʋs Moses yʋ'ʋr

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Lin yi saŋkan la Wina'am nɔdi'es pʋ lɛn duoe Israel teŋin nwɛnɛ Moses ya'as ka on nɛ Zugsɔb nindaa kpa'ad taabaa.

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' mɛ pʋ lɛn tʋm tʋʋmnyalima nɛ kilima zanbina wʋʋ Zugsɔb la da tʋm o ka o tʋm Egipt Na'ab Faaro nɛ o na'ayikpɛm nɛ teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa zugin si'em la.

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Sɔ' nan zi' pa'al paŋ tita'ar bɛɛ maal bʋnnyalima banɛ ka Moses da maal Israel teŋin la.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: Moses onɛ da an Zugsɔb tʋmtʋm la kum nya'aŋ la, Zugsɔb la da pian' tis Josua onɛ an Nun biig ka sʋŋid Moses la ye,

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: “M tʋmtʋm Moses kpiya. Maalim siri nannanna, dɔl Israel nidib la wʋsa ka ya lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan kɔldaug la keŋ kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka m ye m tisi ba la.

english_verse: Wherever you go, I'll give you that land, as I promised Moses.
translation_verse: M na tisi ya zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka ya nɔba nɔ, nwɛnɛ man da kaanbi tis Moses si'em la.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ sʋ'oe zin'isi'a la na pin'il sian'arin la paae Lebanon ka lɛn yi Efiritis kɔldatita'ar nɛ Hitti dim tɛɛns la wʋsa ni ti paae Atɛuk Tita'ar linɛ bɛ tuon la baba.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kae na nyaŋ fʋn Josua hali nɛ fʋ nyɔvʋr bɛnnɛ. Man da bɛ nɛ Moses si'em la, ala ka m na bɛ nɛf. M kʋ maligim basif bɛɛ zan'asi fɔ.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka Zugsɔb Zi'elʋg Gbauŋ la bɛɛ fʋ nɔɔrin saŋa wʋsa. Tɛn'ɛsimi li yɛla nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ, linɛ na kɛ ka fʋ nyaŋi tʋm linɛ bɛɛ li ni. Ala ka fʋ na nyɛ nyɔɔd nɛ nyaŋir.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Ka' manɛ yɛlif ye fʋ zi'enim sʋ'ʋŋa ka kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ sʋnfɔɔ? Da zɔt dabiem, da kɛ ka fʋ sʋʋnr san'am, ka fʋ Zugsɔb na bɛ nɛf zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka fʋ keŋ.”

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Ka Josua yɛl nidib la kpɛɛmnam la ye,

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: “Kem giligi nidib la sʋʋgin ka yɛli ba ye ba maalim siri nɛ ba diib, ka daba atan' nwa' ni ba na lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan kɔldaug la keŋ sʋ'ʋg teŋ la. Ya Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔki li tisi ya ka li aan ya din.”

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Ka Josua yɛl Reuben dɔɔg nɛ Gad dɔɔg nɛ Manase dɔɔg pʋsʋk la, ye

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: hali ka Zugsɔb la ti kɛ ka ban mɛ zin'in teŋ la nii bɛ baanlimm nwɛnɛ on tisi ya si'em la. Ka lin nya'aŋ ka ya na lɛbi sʋ'oe ya teŋ kanɛ ka Moses onɛ an Zugsɔb tʋmtʋm la da tisi ya Joodan nya'aŋ la.”

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Ka ba lɛbis Josua ye, “Fʋn yɛli ti si'el wʋsa, ti na tʋm, ka zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka fʋ tʋmi ti, ti na keŋ.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ ki'isi fʋ nɔɔr ka pʋ siak fʋn yɛli ba si'em wʋsa, ti na kʋʋ o. Zi'enim sʋ'ʋŋa ka kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ sʋnf.”

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Ka Josua tʋm nidib ayi' ka ba yi Sittim teŋin ye ba keŋ vɛɛns teŋ la gɔs, linɛ gaad wʋsa anɛ Jeriko tempʋʋg la. Ka ba keŋ kpɛn' pu'agɔɔndir onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Rahab la yin ka gbɛɛn anina.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Ba da yɛl Jeriko na'ab la ye, “Gɔsima! Israel ninsieba kɛn kpɛla yʋ'ʋŋa na ye ba vɛɛns teŋ la gɔs.”

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Banɛ da kena ye ba vɛɛns teŋ la da ye ba digin saŋsi'a la, Rahab duoe dʋʋ ba san'an dɔɔg la zug

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba ye, “M mi' ye Zugsɔb la zaŋ teŋ kaŋa tisi ya, ka ya yɛla kɛ ka dabiem gban'e ti wʋsa. Dabiem kpɛn' banɛ wʋsa bɛ teŋ kaŋa ni hali.

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ti wʋm Zugsɔb la da niŋ si'em tisi ya, yanamɛ da yi Egipt teŋin na saŋa si'a la. Ti wʋm ye o da kɛ ka Atɛuk Zɛn'ug ku'om wie tisi ya ka teŋ kʋdig, ka lɛn wʋm yanamɛ da san'am Sihon nɛ Og, na'anam ayi' banɛ da bɛ Amor teŋin Joodan nya'aŋ la nyain si'em.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ wʋmi li la, ti sʋʋnr san'amnɛ hali ka ti giinla siɛn ya zug. Bɔzugɔ ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la anɛ onɛ sid bɛɛ agɔla nɛ teŋin wʋsa.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Nannanna nwa', pɔɔm tisinim nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr ye ya na zɔ mam nɛ m yidim la nimbaanlig mam maali ya sʋm la zug. Tisiminim zanbin linɛ na kɛ ka m niŋ yadda

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: ye ya na faaɛn man nɛ m ba', nɛ m ma nɛ m ba'abiis nɛ m yidim wʋsa yi kumin.”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Ka dap la lɛbisi yɛl pu'a la ye, “Tinam ya'a pʋ tʋm nwɛnɛ tinamɛ yɛl si'em la, Wina'am on kʋʋmi ti. Fʋ ya'a pʋ yɛl sɔ' tinamɛ bɛ kpɛla maan si'ela, ti kaanb ye Zugsɔb la ya'a ti nɔk teŋ la tisi ti, ti na maalif sʋ'ʋŋa.”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Rahab da bɛnɛ yikanɛ ka ba mɛɛ tabil tempʋʋg zaŋguom la ni, ka o zaŋ nwiigi lɔ takoro la ni ka kɛ ka ba dɔlisi sig.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Kemi kʋkʋna la ni su'a; ya'a ka' ala na'ayikpɛm la na nyɛɛ ya. Su'amini anina daba atan' ti paae saŋkanɛ ka ba na lɛb na. Ka lin nya'aŋ ya na tun'e keŋ yanamɛ ken zin'isi'a.”

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Ka o siak ka kɛ ka ba keŋ. Ka ban gaadi naae la, o da lɔ nwizɛn'ug la o takoro la ni.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Banɛ da keŋ ye ba vɛɛns teŋ la gɔs la da keŋ su'a kʋkʋna la ni hali ka na'ayikpɛm iee ba daba atan' ka pʋ nyɛɛ baa ka lɛb Jeriko teŋin la na.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Ka nidib ayi' banɛ ka ba da tʋm la yi kʋkʋna la ni na, ka lɔ'ɔŋ kɔldaug la lɛb Josua onɛ an Nun biig la san'an ka yɛl o dinɛ wʋsa daa maal,

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: ka yɛl o ye, “Ti sid mi' ye Wina'am nɔk teŋ la wʋsa tisi ti. Nimbanɛ wʋsa bɛ teŋin la zɔti ti nɛ dabiem.”

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Ka bɛogʋ da nie la, Josua nɛ Israel nidib la da dɛŋi duoe Sittim teŋin keŋ Joodan kɔldaug baba; ani ka ba da gbɛn ka nyaan lɔ'ɔŋ.

english_verse: Two days later their leaders went through the camp,
translation_verse: Daba atan' la nya'aŋ ba kpɛɛmnam da gilig zin'ikanɛ ka ba la'as la

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: Ala ka ya na baŋ yanamɛ na dɔl si'el, bɔzugɔ ya nan zi' dɔl kpɛlaa. Amaa mid ka ya miri Nɔnaar Daka la. Lɛmmini li nya'aŋ nwɛnɛ nɔba makir tusa ayi' nɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Ka Josua yɛl nidib la ye, “Maalimi ya mɛŋ nyain, bɔzugɔ bɛog Zugsɔb la na tʋm nyalima tʋʋma ya san'an.”

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛl maanmaannib la ye ba zaŋim Nɔnaar Daka la dɛŋ nidib la tuon, ka ba sid da maal nwɛnɛ on yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am yɛl Josua ye, “M na maal si'el zina linɛ na kɛ ka Israel dim wʋsa na pin'ili tisif girima ka baŋ ye fʋ anɛ dau kanɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ. Ka ba na lɛm baŋ ye m kpɛm bɛ nɛf nwɛnɛ man daa bɛ nɛ Moses si'em la.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Yɛlim maanmaannib banɛ ziid Nɔnaar Daka la ye ba ya'a paae kɔldaug nɔɔrin la ban da lɔ'ɔŋɛ, asɛɛ ka ba keŋ tuon bi'ela sigi zi'en kɔldaug la pʋʋg.”

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Ka Josua yɛl nidib la ye, “Kemi kpɛla na ka kɛlisi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am mɔr si'el ye o yɛli ya.

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Dinɛ na kɛ ka ya baŋ ye Wina'am onɛ vʋe la sid bɛɛ ya san'an ka na kad Keenan dim nɛ Hitti dim nɛ Hivi dim nɛ Perizi dim nɛ Girgas dim nɛ Amor dim nɛ Jebus dim la yis teŋin la.

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaannib banɛ ziid Nɔnaar Daka linɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ sʋ'oe dunia wʋsa la din la ya'a ti nɔki ba nɔba pu'al ku'omin la, Joodan kɔldaug la na gu'oe ka ku'opʋbidim la na mɛ' wʋʋ zaŋguom nɛ.”

english_verse: The Israelites packed up and left camp. The priests carrying the chest walked in front,
translation_verse: Ka nidib la duoe ye ba lɔ'ɔŋ kɔldaug la, maanmaannib banɛ da ziid Nɔnaar Daka la da gaadi ba tuon.

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: Li da anɛ ba zʋʋd nɔkir saŋa, ka Joodan kɔldaug la da pɛ'ɛli badigi dʋ gbɛog na. Ka maanmaannib la sid sigisi ba nɔba la ku'omin la,

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Nidib la da lɔ'ɔŋid la, maanmaannib banɛ da ziid Zugsɔb Nɔnaar Daka la da zi'enɛ teŋ kpi'emisin kɔldaug la teŋsʋk, hali ka nidib la wʋsa ti lɔ'ɔŋi naae.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Nidib la wʋsa da lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan kɔldaug la naae la, Zugsɔb la da yɛl Josua ye,

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba ye ba nɔk kuga pii nɛ ayi' Joodan kɔldaug la sʋʋgin zin'ikanɛ ka maanmaannib la zi'en la mɔri keŋ digil zin'ikanɛ ka ba na gbɛn yʋ'ʋŋa la.”

english_verse: Joshua chose twelve men; then he called them together
translation_verse: Ka Josua buol dap pii nɛ ayi' banɛ ka o pʋn gaŋ la,

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba ye, “Kemi Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la Nɔnaar Daka dinɛ bɛ Joodan Kɔldaugin la tuon. Ka ya yinne-yinne nɔk kugir kɔldaugin la pa'ali ya biankimpiiung zug, ka li pa'an Israel dɔɔd pii nɛ ayi' la kal.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: ya na yɛli ba ye li pa'annɛ Joodan kɔldaug ku'om da gu'oe si'em, ban da zaŋ Zugsɔb Nɔnaar Daka la lɔ'ɔŋ kɔldaug la. Kugbama na tiɛnd Israel dim la linɛ maal kpɛla la.”

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la sid niŋ nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la yɛli ba si'em la. Ba da nɔk kuga pii nɛ ayi' kɔldaug la sʋʋgin na, yinne wʋsa zi'enɛ Israel dɔɔd pii nɛ ayi' la yɛla, ka digili ba anina.

english_verse: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river. The People of Israel Set Up Camp at Gilgal
translation_verse: Josua da nɔk kuga pii nɛ ayi' ya'asi ba'a zi'el sappi Joodan kɔldaug la sʋʋgin, zin'ikanɛ ka maanmaannib la da mɔr Nɔnaar Daka zi'e la. Kuga la kpɛm bɛɛ anina hali ti paae zina.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Nidib la da lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan kɔldaug la saŋa si'a la da anɛ yiiga nwadig la dabisa piiga la daar. Ba la'as taaba Gilgal teŋin, Jeriko tempʋʋg la nya'aŋ.

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Anina ka Josua da kɛ ka ba nɔk kuga pii nɛ ayi' banɛ ka ba zii yi Joodan kɔldaugin la na ba'a zi'el sappi;

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Years from now your children will ask you why these rocks are here.
translation_verse: ka yɛl Israel nidib la ye, “Ya biis ya'a ti bu'osi ya kuga nwa' gbin,

english_verse: Tell them, “The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea,
translation_verse: ya Zugsɔb Wina'am da kɛ ka Joodan kɔldaug la kpiɛn ka ti lɔ'ɔŋ nwɛnɛ on da kɛ ka Atɛuk Zɛn'ug kpiɛn si'em tisi ti la.’

english_verse: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.”
translation_verse: Bʋnkaŋa na kɛ ka dunia nidib wʋsa na baŋ Zugsɔb la paŋi an si'em, ka ya na na'asidi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.”

english_verse: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan River and the Canaanite kings along the Mediterranean Sea lost their courage and their will to fight, when they heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River to let Israel go across. Israel Gets Ready To Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Ammon dim na'anam banɛ da bɛ Joodan kɔldaug tuon nɛ Keenan dim na'anam banɛ da bɛɛ Atɛuk la nɔɔrin baba la da wʋm Zugsɔb la kɛ ka Joodan kɔldaug ku'om la kpiɛn hali ka Israel dim la wʋsa ti lɔ'ɔŋi naae la, ba giinla wʋsa da siɛnnɛ ka ba pʋ lɛm mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ kanɛ na zab nɛ Israel dim la. Ba kpɛn'ɛs dap la baŋʋ

english_verse: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, “Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb yɛl Josua ye, “Gaŋim ninsieba ka ba maal kuga baris, ka gaans banɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ la kpɛn'ɛsi ba.”

english_verse: Joshua made the knives, then circumcised those men and boys at Haaraloth Hill.
translation_verse: Ka Josua siak Zugsɔb la nɔɔr ka kɛ ka ba niŋ ala, ka ba da pʋd zin'ikanɛ ka ba kpɛn'ɛsid baŋʋ la yʋ'ʋr ye Gibeaf Haralof.

english_verse: This had to be done, because none of Israel's baby boys had been circumcised during the
translation_verse: Ba biribis la ka Zugsɔb da kɛ ka ba nɔbigi di'e ba zin'ig, amaa ba da nam pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋʋ. Linɛ kɛ ka Josua da kpɛn'ɛsi ba baŋʋ la.

english_verse: Everyone who had been circumcised needed time to heal, and they stayed in camp.
translation_verse: Ban da kpɛn'ɛsi ba naae la, nidib la wʋsa da la'as nɛ kpɛm bɛ ban bɛ si'el la, hali ka banɛ kpɛn' baŋʋ la fɛn'ɛd bin'ei naae.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace.” So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Josua ye, “Ya da anɛ yammis Egipt teŋin ka dit nyan, amaa zina ka m yisi ya nyannɛ bas.” Lina zug ka ba buon zin'ig la ye Gilgal, ka yʋ'ʋr kan kpɛm bɛ hali nɛ zina. Israel dim maal Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ

english_verse: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.
translation_verse: Israel dimi da nam bɛ Gilgal teŋin Jeriko teŋ kanɛ an sassi ni la, ba da maal Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malima la nɛ nwadig dabis pii nɛ anaasi daar zaam.

english_verse: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields. Israel Captures Jericho
translation_verse: Ka ban pin'ili dit teŋ la diib la, manna la da pʋ lɛn lit naa. Israel dim la sid da pʋ lɛn nyɛ manna la ya'asɛ, asɛɛ Keenan teŋ diib la ma'aa. Zugsɔb tanp tuongat la
