translation_verse: Nɔdi'esidib la yinne pu'a da keŋ kaasi tis Elasia ye, “Fʋ sankpan'as onɛ aan m sid la kpinɛ, ka fʋ mɛ mi' ye o daa anɛ onɛ tisid Zugsɔb la girima. Amaa nannanna la o sam daan kena ye o faaɛn o biribis ayi' la mɔri keŋ kɛ ka ba lieb o yammis.”

english_verse: “Maybe there's something I can do to help,” Elisha said. “What do you have in your house?” “Sir, I have nothing but a small bottle of olive oil.”
translation_verse: Ka Elasia bu'os o ye, “M ye m sʋ'ʋŋif wala? Yɛlimim, fʋ mɔr bɔɔ fʋ yinnɛ?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “M zugdaana, m pʋ mɔr si'el si'ela asɛɛ kpaam fiin bɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha told her, “Ask your neighbors for their empty jars. And after you've borrowed as many as you can,
translation_verse: Ka Elasia lɛbisi yɛl o ye, “Kemi fʋ kpi'es la yaanɛ sɔs dʋkzaala bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: go home and shut the door behind you and your sons. Then begin filling the jars with oil and set each one aside as you fill it.”
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a di'esi naae, fʋn kpɛn'ɛm dɔɔgin nɛ fʋ biis la ka yɔ kʋlʋŋ la lɛbis. Bu'osim kpaam la niŋ dʋgid la pʋʋgin, linɛ pɛ'ɛl fʋn on vuugi labil.”

english_verse: The woman left. Later, when she and her sons were back inside their house, the two sons brought her the jars, and she began filling them.
translation_verse: O da bas o ka kuli sid kpɛn' dɔɔgin on nɛ o biis la ka yɔ, ka ba ʋgʋs dʋgid la tis o ka o bu'osidi niŋid.

english_verse: At last, she said to one of her sons, “Bring me another jar.” “We don't have any more,” he answered, and the oil stopped flowing from the small bottle.
translation_verse: Dʋgid la wʋsaa da pɛ'ɛl la, o da yɛl o biis la ye, “Mɔri sieba na ya'as.” Amaa ba da lɛbis o ye, “Dʋkzaal lɛn kae.” Ka kpaam la gu'oe.

english_verse: After she told Elisha what had happened, he said, “Sell the oil and use part of the money to pay what you owe the man. You and your sons can live on what is left.” Elisha Brings a Rich Woman's Son Back to Life
translation_verse: O da keŋ yɛl Wina'am nid la, ka o yɛl o ye, “Kem kuos kpaam la yɔ sam la. Ka linɛ kpɛlim la fʋn nɛ fʋ biis la nɔkim sʋŋi ya mɛŋ.” Seunim nid biigi vʋ'ʋg la yɛla

english_verse: Once, while Elisha was in the town of Shunem, he met a rich woman who invited him to her home for dinner. After that, whenever he was in Shunem, he would have a meal there with her and her husband.
translation_verse: Daar yinne ka Elasia keŋ Seunim teŋin ka pu'a bɛɛ ani an bʋndaan, ka sɔs Elasia ye o gu'us ka o maal diibi tis o. Dinzug saŋa kanɛ wʋsa ka Elasia lɛb ani baba na, o kennɛ anii dit.

english_verse: Some time later the woman said to her husband, “I'm sure the man who comes here so often is a prophet of God.
translation_verse: Pu'a la da yɛl o sid ye, “Mam mi' ye dau kanɛ ken kpɛla la anɛ Wina'am nid, ka an pʋpiel.

english_verse: Why don't we build him a small room on the flat roof of our house? We can put a bed, a table and chair, and an oil lamp in it. Then whenever he comes, he can stay with us.”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ti mɛ' dɔbili ti dɔɔg la zug ka niŋ gadʋg nɛ teebul nɛ kʋk nɛ fitir ani tis o. Ka o ya'a ti kaae kpɛla na, on gbɛn.”

english_verse: The next time Elisha was in Shunem, he stopped at their house and went up to his room to rest.
translation_verse: Daar yinne, Elasia da kena dʋʋ kpɛn' o dɔɔgin la dig ani.

english_verse: He said to his servant Gehazi, “This woman has been very helpful. Have her come up here to the roof for a moment.” She came, and Elisha told Gehazi to say to her, “You've gone to a lot of trouble for us, and we want to help you. Is there something we can request the king or army commander to do?” The woman answered, “With my relatives nearby, I have everything I need.”
translation_verse: Ka Elasia yɛl Gehazi ye, “Yɛlim pu'a la ye, ‘Fʋ mugusidi fʋ mɛŋ anwa wʋsa nɛ tinam yɛla. Nannanna fʋ bɔɔd ye ti maal bɔɔ tisi fɔ? Fʋ bɔɔd ye ti yɛl Na'ab la, bɛɛ soogianam kpɛɛm la fʋ yɛlaa?’” Ka o lɛbis o ye, “M bɛ nɛ m mɛŋ nidibin.”

english_verse: “Then what can we do for her?” Elisha asked Gehazi. Gehazi replied, “I do know that her husband is old, and that she doesn't have a son.”
translation_verse: Ka Elasia bu'os ye, “Bɔ ka ti na nyaŋi maali tis o?” Ka Gehazi lɛbis ye, “O ka' biribiŋa ka o sid mɛ kʋdig.”

english_verse: “Ask her to come here again,” Elisha told his servant. He called for her, and she came and stood in the doorway of Elisha's room.
translation_verse: Ka Elasia yɛl ye, “Buolim o na!” Ka o buol o na. Ka o kena zi'en dɔɔg la za'anɔɔrin.

english_verse: Elisha said to her, “Next year at this time, you'll be holding your own baby son in your arms.” “You're a man of God,” the woman replied. “Please don't lie to me.”
translation_verse: Ka Elasia yɛl o ye, “Yʋʋm anwa win la, fʋ na zanl biribiŋi fʋ nu'ugin.” Ka pu'a la pʋ niŋ yadda ka ye, “Ayei, m zugdaana, fʋ anɛ Wina'am tʋmtʋm! Da ma'aa ma!”

english_verse: But a few months later, the woman got pregnant. She gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had promised.
translation_verse: Amaa pu'a la sid da gban'e pʋʋgʋ du'a biribiŋ saŋa kanɛ ka Elasia da yɛl o la nɔɔ.

english_verse: One day while the boy was still young, he was out in the fields with his father, where the workers were harvesting the crops.
translation_verse: Biig la da nɔbig ya, ka daar yinne ka o saam bɛ pɔɔgin nɛ bunnib ka o keŋ o san'an.

english_verse: Suddenly he shouted, “My head hurts. It hurts a lot!” “Carry him back to his mother,” the father said to his servant.
translation_verse: Ka biig la yɛl o saam ye, “M zug! M zug!” Ka o saam la yɛl sankpan'as yinne ye, “Mɔr o keŋ o ma san'an!”

english_verse: loaves of bread made from the first barley that was harvested. Elisha said, “Give it to the people so they can eat.”
translation_verse: Sankpan'as la ʋk biig la mɔr o keŋ tis o ma la, ka biig la zin'inɛ o nɔba zug hali ka nintaŋ ti bul, ka o kpɛn kpi.

english_verse: She carried him upstairs to Elisha's room and laid him across the bed. Then she walked out and shut the door behind her.
translation_verse: O da mɔr biig la kpɛn' digil Wina'am tʋmtʋm la gadʋg zug, ka yi ka lɛbisi yɔ'.

english_verse: The woman called to her husband, “I need to see the prophet. Let me use one of the donkeys. Send a servant along with me, and let me leave now, so I can get back quickly.”
translation_verse: Ka buol o sidi yɛl o ye, “M bɛlimnɛ, tisim yammis la yinne nɛ bʋŋ ka m keŋ Wina'am tʋmtʋm la san'an ka lɛb tɔ'ɔtɔ na.”

english_verse: “Why do you need to see him today?” her husband asked. “It's not the Sabbath or time for the New Moon Festival.” “That's all right,” she answered.
translation_verse: Ka o bu'os o ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ kennɛ o san'an zina? Li ka' nwadpaalig bɛɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daarɛ.” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Li ka' si'ela.”

english_verse: She saddled the donkey and said to her servant, “Let's go. And don't slow down unless I tell you to.”
translation_verse: O da ban' bʋŋ la ka yɛl yammʋg la ye, “Gaadim tuon, da sie kennɛ, ya'a ka' mam na yɛl ye fʋ siema.”

english_verse: She left at once for Mount Carmel to talk with Elisha. When Elisha saw her coming, he said, “Gehazi, look! It's the woman from Shunem.
translation_verse: Alazug o da yii keŋ Wina'am tʋmtʋm la san'an Kaamel zuorin la. On da nyɛ ban bɛ lalli la, ka Wina'am nid la yɛl o yammʋg Gehazi ye, “Gɔsima, li anɛ Seunim pu'a la, la!

english_verse: Run and meet her. And ask her if everything is all right with her and her family.” “Everything is fine,” she answered Gehazi.
translation_verse: Yim tʋ'ʋs o, ka bu'os o ye, ‘Li malisaa? Fʋ sid an sʋm? Fʋ biig an sʋm?’” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Yɛlsi'a kae”

english_verse: But as soon as she got to the top of the mountain, she went over and grabbed Elisha by the feet. Gehazi started toward her to push her away, when Elisha said, “Leave her alone! Don't you see how sad she is? But the Lord hasn't told me why.”
translation_verse: On da paae Wina'am tʋmtʋm la san'an zuor la zug la, o da gban'e o nɔba. Ka Gehazi kena ye o tɛbig o yis, amaa Wina'am tʋmtʋm la da yɛl o ye, “Basim o! O mɔri sʋnsa'aŋ bɛdegʋ, amaa Zugsɔb la su'a li nɛ ka pʋ nie tisi ma, ka mɛ pʋ yɛl dinɛ kɛɛ.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I begged you not to get my hopes up, and I didn't even ask you for a son.”
translation_verse: O da bu'os o ye, “M zugdaana, m daa yɛlif ye m bɔɔd biigaa? M daa pʋ yɛlif ye fʋ da kɛ ka biig ya'amlɛog mɔrim zaalim-zaalim?”

english_verse: “Gehazi, get ready and go to her house,” Elisha said. “Take along my walking stick, and when you get there, lay it on the boy's face. Don't stop to talk to anyone, even if they try to talk to you.”
translation_verse: Elasia da yɛl Gehazi ye, “Maalimi fʋ fuug la lɔ nɛ sɛnbidiŋ ka zaŋi m dansaar la zɔ. Fʋ ya'a tʋ'ʋs sɔ' fʋn da pʋ'ʋs oo, ka sɔ' mɛ ya'a pʋ'ʋsif fʋn da siakɛ. Nɔkimi m dansaar la pa'al biig la nindaan.”

english_verse: But the boy's mother said to Elisha, “I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I won't leave without you.” So Elisha got up and went with them.
translation_verse: Amaa biig la ma daa ye, “Asida ka m yɛtif, nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ vʋe la yʋ'ʋr zug, mam kʋ basif ka keŋɛ!” Dinzug, o daa gʋ'ʋŋi duoe dɔl o.

english_verse: Gehazi ran on ahead and laid Elisha's walking stick on the boy's face, but the boy didn't move or make a sound. Gehazi ran back to Elisha and said, “The boy didn't wake up.”
translation_verse: Gehazi da gaad tuonnɛ nɔk dansaar la pa'al biig la nindaan, amaa biig la da pʋ damm. Dinzug, Gehazi da lɛbi tʋ'ʋs Elasia ka yɛl o ye, “Biig la pʋ vʋ'ʋgɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha arrived at the woman's house and went straight to his room, where he saw the boy's body on his bed.
translation_verse: Elasia da paae yin la, o nyɛ ka biig la kpinɛ dig o dɔɔgin.

english_verse: He walked in, shut the door, and prayed to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka o da kpɛn' dɔɔgin la ka yɔɔ lɛbis, ka babayi' la ma'aa bɛ pʋʋgin, ka o sɔs Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Then he got on the bed and stretched out over the dead body, with his mouth on the boy's mouth, his eyes on his eyes, and his hand on his hands. As he lay there, the boy's body became warm.
translation_verse: Ka duoe dʋ gadʋg la zugʋ digin biig la zug, ka o nɔɔr kpa' o nɔɔr, ka o nini kpa' o nini, ka o nu'us kpa' o nu'us. O da tiɛn o mɛŋ biig la zug ka biig la niŋgbiŋ pin'ili tʋligid.

english_verse: Elisha got up and walked back and forth in the room, then he went back and leaned over the boy's body. The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.
translation_verse: Elasia da duoe giilim-giilim dɔɔgin la ka lɛbi dʋ gadʋg la zugʋ lɛn tiɛn o mɛŋ biig la zug ya'as. Biig la da tɛnsim nɔɔr ayɔpɔi ka lak o nini.

english_verse: Elisha called out to Gehazi, “Ask the boy's mother to come here.” Gehazi did, and when she was at the door, Elisha said, “You can take your son.”
translation_verse: Ka Elasia buol Gehazi ka yɛl o ye, “Buolim Seunim pu'a la na!” Ka o buol o na. On da kena la ka Elasia yɛl o ye, “Di'emi fʋ biig!”

english_verse: She came in and bowed down at Elisha's feet. Then she picked up her son and left. Elisha Makes Some Stew Taste Better
translation_verse: O da kpɛn' na igin o nɔba ni ka su'un o nindaa teŋin. Ka zaŋ o biig la yi. Yabidi bɛ dʋkin la yɛla

english_verse: Later, Elisha went back to Gilgal, where there was almost nothing to eat, because the crops had failed. One day while the prophets who lived there were meeting with Elisha, he said to his servant, “Prepare a big pot of stew for these prophets.”
translation_verse: Elasia da lɛb Gilgal, ka kɔ'ɔm lu teŋ kan la. Nɔdi'esidib la da la'as na ye ba nyɛɛ o la, o yɛl o sankpan'as la ye, “Nɔkim dʋgtita'ari dʋg zɛɛndi tisi ba!”

english_verse: One of them went out into the woods to gather some herbs. He found a wild vine and picked as much of its fruit as he could carry, but he didn't know that the fruit was very sour. When he got back, he cut up the fruit and put it in the stew.
translation_verse: Ba nid yinne da yii keŋ pɔɔdin la bɔ zɛnma'asa, ka nyɛ sian'arin zɛnvaand ka pɔn' li wala la, la'asi li bɔbig o fuugin. On lɛb na la ka sɛ sieba niŋ dʋkʋn la la'an nɛ sɔ' daa zi' lin an si'el la.

english_verse: The stew was served, and when the prophets started eating it, they shouted, “Elisha, this stew tastes terrible! We can't eat it.”
translation_verse: Ba daa kpa'ae zɛɛnd la tis nidib la ye ba di, amaa ban daa pin'ili dit la ba daa kaas kuŋ ye, “Wina'am tʋmtʋmma, yabid bɛ dʋkʋn la!” Ba daa pʋ nyaŋi dii lii.

english_verse: “Bring me some flour,” Elisha said. He sprinkled the flour in the stew and said, “Now serve it to them.” And the stew tasted fine. Elisha Feeds One Hundred People
translation_verse: Ka Elasia yɛl ye, “Bɔɔmi zɔ'ɔm na.” Ka o niŋi li dʋk la pʋʋg ka ye, “Bɛsigimi li tis nidib la ka ba di.” Ka ba di'e li di ka yabid la lɛn kae ya'asa. Nidib kɔbiga di ka li kpɛlim la yɛla

english_verse: So the servant served the bread and grain to the people. They ate and still had some left over, just as the Lord had promised.
translation_verse: Ka o sid nɔki li zi'eli ba tuon ka ba di, ka li kpɛlim nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Naaman was the commander of the Syrian army. The Lord had helped him and his troops defeat their enemies, so the king of Syria respected Naaman very much. Naaman was a brave soldier, but he had leprosy.
translation_verse: Saŋkaŋa Naaman da anɛ Aram Na'ab la soogianam kpɛɛm. O da anɛ nintita'ar ka ba tisid o na'asi hali, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la da dɔlis o ni ka Aram dim paam nyaŋir. O da anɛ soogia kanɛ sʋnfʋ kpi'em, amaa ka an kʋkɔm.

english_verse: One day while the Syrian troops were raiding Israel, they captured a girl, and she became a servant of Naaman's wife.
translation_verse: Saŋkaŋa nidib da yi Aram keŋ Israel teŋin zabi gban'e nidib na, ka yinne an bipuŋ ka tʋmmi tisid Naaman pu'a.

english_verse: When Naaman told the king what the girl had said,
translation_verse: Naaman da keŋ o zugdaan Na'ab la san'an yɛl o bipuŋ kanɛ yi Israel na la yɛl si'em.

english_verse: the king replied, “Go ahead! I will give you a letter to take to the king of Israel.” Naaman left and took along
translation_verse: Aram Na'ab la da lɛbis ye, “Li ya'a an si'em wʋsa fʋn kem!” M na sɔb gbauŋʋ tis Israel Na'ab la. Dinzug Naaman da duoe nɔk anzurifa ligidi bɛdegʋ, nɛ sanlima ligidi, pɛ'ɛs nɛ fusʋma piiga.

english_verse: He also carried the letter to the king of Israel. It said, “I am sending my servant Naaman to you. Would you cure him of his leprosy?”
translation_verse: Gbauŋ kanɛ ka o da di'e wa'ae ye o tis Na'ab la da sɔb si'em nwa': “Gbauŋ nwa' ya'a paaf na, fʋn baŋim ye manɛ tʋm Naaman onɛ aan m tʋmtʋm la fʋ san'an ye fʋ ti'eb o kʋkɔm ban'as la.”

english_verse: Elisha sent someone outside to say to him, “Go wash seven times in the Jordan River. Then you'll be completely cured.”
translation_verse: Elasia da tʋm o tʋmtʋm ye o yim yɛl o ye, “Kem mi'isi fʋ mɛŋ nɔɔr ayɔpɔi Joodan mu'arin la, ka fʋ niŋgbiŋ la na lɛn lɛbi li zin'igin ka fʋ an nyain.”

english_verse: When the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes in fear and shouted, “That Syrian king believes I can cure this man of leprosy! Does he think I'm God with power over life and death? He must be trying to pick a fight with me.”
translation_verse: Israel Na'ab la da karim gbauŋ la naae la, o sʋʋnr da duoe nɛ ka o aans o fuud ka bu'os ye, “Mam anɛ Wina'am na nyaŋi kʋ, ka lɛn tis vʋmm? Oŋa daana niŋ wala tʋm sɔ' man san'an na ye m ti'eb o kʋkɔm ban'asɛ? Gɔsim on bɔɔdi niŋ si'em nyɛɛm taal!”

english_verse: As soon as Elisha the prophet heard what had happened, he sent the Israelite king this message: “Why are you so afraid? Send the man to me, so that he will know there is a prophet in Israel.”
translation_verse: Elasia onɛ an Wina'am tʋmtʋm la da wʋm ye Israel Na'ab aans o fuud la, o da tʋm ye ba keŋ yɛl o labakaŋa: “Bɔ ka fʋ aansi fʋ fuudɛ? Kɛl ka dau la kɛɛn m san'an na ka o na baŋ ye nɔdi'es sid bɛ Israel teŋin!”

english_verse: Naaman left with his horses and chariots and stopped at the door of Elisha's house.
translation_verse: Naaman da keŋ nɛ o widi nɛ tɛrekonam la paae zi'en Elasia samannin.

english_verse: But Naaman stormed off, grumbling, “Why couldn't he come out and talk to me? I thought for sure he would stand in front of me and pray to the Lord his God, then wave his hand over my skin and cure me.
translation_verse: Amaa Naaman sʋnf da duoya ka o fɛndigi lɛbid ka ye, “Man tɛn'ɛs ye o na yii m san'an na ka zi'en ka buol o Zugsɔb onɛ aan o Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr, ka ʋk o nu'ugi nyɔɔsim ban'a la bɛ zin'isi'a la ka ti'ebi m ban'a la.

english_verse: What about the Abana River or the Pharpar River? Those rivers in Damascus are just as good as any river in Israel. I could have washed in them and been cured.”
translation_verse: Abana nɛ Faapa kɔldaad linɛ bɛ Damaskus teŋin la ka' sʋ'ʋm gat Israel teŋin kɔldaad wʋsa? Mam kʋ tun'e sʋʋn anina ka lieb nyainnɛɛ?” Alazug o da fɛndigi lɛbid nɛ ɛndʋg.

english_verse: His servants went over to him and said, “Sir, if the prophet had told you to do something difficult, you would have done it. So why don't you do what he said? Go wash and be cured.”
translation_verse: Amaa Naaman yammis da keŋ o san'an yɛl o ye, “Ti Saamma, nɔdi'es la ya'a yɛlin ye fʋ niŋ linɛ tɔi gaad ala, fʋ naan kʋ niŋinɛ? Ka o ya'a yɛlif ye fʋ sʋʋm ka kilim nyainnɛ, li tɔɔg an bɔ?”

english_verse: Naaman walked down to the Jordan; he waded out into the water and stooped down in it seven times, just as Elisha had told him. At once, he was cured, and his skin became as smooth as a child's.
translation_verse: Ka o sigi mi' Joodan ku'omin la nɔɔr ayɔpɔi, nwɛnɛ Wina'am tʋmtʋm la yɛl o si'em la, ka o niŋgbiŋ la lɛbi li zin'igin ka o an nyain nwɛnɛ bilia nɛ.

english_verse: Naaman and his officials went back to Elisha. Naaman stood in front of him and announced, “Now I know that the God of Israel is the only God in the whole world. Sir, would you please accept a gift from me?”
translation_verse: Ka Naaman nɛ o nidib la wʋsa lɛn lɛb Wina'am tʋmtʋm la san'an. O da zi'en o tuon ka yɛl ye, “M zugdaana, nannanna mam baŋ ye Wina'am ka' dunia wʋsaa asɛɛ Israel teŋin ma'aa. M bɛlimnɛ, di'em piinkanɛ ka m mɔr na la.”

english_verse: “I am a servant of the living Lord,” Elisha answered, “and I swear that I will not take anything from you.” Naaman kept begging, but Elisha kept refusing.
translation_verse: Ka nɔdi'es la lɛbis ye, “Nɛ Zugsɔb kanɛ vʋe ka m dɔl o la zugɔ, m kʋ di'e si'ela!” Ka Naaman la'am bɛlim o hali, ka o zan'as.

english_verse: Finally Naaman said, “If you won't accept a gift, then please let me take home as much soil as two mules can pull in a wagon. Sir, from now on I will offer sacrifices only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Naaman da yɛl o ye, “M bɛlimnɛ fʋ ya'a kʋ di'e, fʋn kɛl ka ba vaae titan bɛdegʋ ka bʋmis ayi' zii mɔri kul, ka m kʋ lɛm maal maan buudi wʋsa tis teŋgban si'aa asɛɛ Zugsɔb la ma'aa.

english_verse: But I pray that the Lord will forgive me when I go into the temple of the god Rimmon and bow down there with the king of Syria.”
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la kɛlli m taali bas bʋn yinne zug: M ya'a dɔlli m zugdaan la ka o kpɛn' Rimmon teŋgban malʋŋ zin'igin igin o tuon, ka mam mɛ igin, Zugsɔb la on kɛlli m taali bas nɛ' yɛla.”

english_verse: “Go on home, and don't worry about that,” Elisha replied. Then Naaman left. Elisha Places a Curse on Gehazi After Naaman had gone only a short distance,
translation_verse: Ka Elasia lɛbisi yɛl o ye, “Kem nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.” Naaman n daa keŋ lalig bi'ela la,

english_verse: Gehazi said to himself, “Elisha let that Syrian off too easy. He should have taken Naaman's gift. I swear by the living Lord that I will talk to Naaman myself and get something from him.”
translation_verse: Gehazi, onɛ an Wina'am tʋmtʋm la sankpan'as la, daa tɛn'ɛs o pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye o zugdaan la bas Naaman onɛ an Aram nid la nɛ zaalim, ka pʋ di'e si'el la'abanɛ ka o mɔr na la nii. Ka ye, “Nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ vʋe la yʋ'ʋr zug, mam na zɔɔ bɛɛn o di'e si'el o san'an!”

english_verse: So he hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw Gehazi running after him, he got out of his chariot to meet him. Naaman asked, “Is everything all right?”
translation_verse: Alazug Gehazi da zɔ tɔ'ɔtɔ bɛn' Naaman. Naaman n da nyɛ ka o zɔti kennɛ o san'an na la, o da sig o widi tɛreko la zugʋ tʋ'ʋs o. Ka bu'os o ye, “Li malisaa?”

english_verse: “Yes,” Gehazi answered. “But my master has sent me to tell you about two young prophets from the hills of Ephraim. They came asking for help, and now Elisha wants to know if you would give them
translation_verse: Ka Gehazi lɛbis ye, “Li malis. M zugdaan la tʋmim ye m kena yɛlif ye, dasamma ayi' naam nɔdi'esidib la la'asʋg zin'igin Efiram linɛ an kʋkʋna teŋin la kɛɛn o san'an na, ka o bɛllim ye fʋ tis o anzurifa ligidi buorig yinne nɛ fuud zin'isa ayi' ka o tisi ba.”

english_verse: “Sure,” Naaman replied. “But why don't you take twice that amount of silver?” He convinced Gehazi to take it all, then put the silver in two bags. He handed the bags and the clothes to his two servants, and they carried them for Gehazi.
translation_verse: Ka Naaman lɛbis ye, “Li ya'a an si'em wʋsa, nɔkim buoris ayi'!” O da bɛlim Gehazi hali ye o di'em, ka lɔ anzurifa la nɛ bɔto ayi', nɛ fuud la zin'isa ayi' ka nɔki tis o yammis ayi' ka ba zii gaad Gehazi tuon.

english_verse: When they reached the hill where Gehazi lived, he took the bags from the servants and placed them in his house, then sent the men away. After they had gone,
translation_verse: Gehazi daa keŋ paae Elasia yin kʋkʋn zug la, o daa di'e la'ad la yammis la san'an su'a yin ani, ka yɛli ba ye ba lɛm, ka ba sid lɛb.

english_verse: Gehazi went in and stood in front of Elisha, who asked, “Gehazi, where have you been?” “Nowhere, sir,” Gehazi answered.
translation_verse: O daa kpɛn' zi'en o zugdaan Elasia tuon, ka Elasia bu'os o ye, “Gehazi, fʋn keŋ yaanɛ?” Ka Gehazi lɛbis ye, “M zugdaana, m pʋ keŋ si'ela.”

english_verse: Elisha asked, “Don't you know that my spirit was there when Naaman got out of his chariot to talk with you? Gehazi, you have no right to accept money or clothes, olive orchards or vineyards, sheep or cattle, or servants.
translation_verse: Amaa Elasia yɛl o ye, “Mam pʋ bɛɛn nɛ fʋ san'an siig pʋʋgin saŋkanɛ ka dau la naanɛ o widi tɛreko la zugʋ sigi tʋ'ʋsif laa? Saŋkaŋa nar ye fʋ di'e ligidi bɛɛ fuud bɛɛ olif tiis bɛɛ vain tiis pɔɔd bɛɛ kɔnbid bɛɛ niigi bɛɛ yampu'ab nɛ yamdapaa? Ayei, li pʋ nara!

english_verse: Because of what you've done, Naaman's leprosy will now be on you and your descendants forever!” Suddenly, Gehazi's skin became white with leprosy, and he left.
translation_verse: Alazug Naaman ban'as la na lɔ'ɔŋif nɛ fʋ yaas la wʋsa saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.” Ka Gehazi yi Elasia san'an lieb kʋkɔmi yuod bɔr-bɔr.

english_verse: One day the prophets said to Elisha, “The place where we meet with you is too small.
translation_verse: Daar yinne ka nɔdi'esidib la yɛl Elasia ye, “Gɔsima, tinamɛ la'asid nɛf zin'isi'a la yʋ'ʋn pɔɔdnɛ tisi ti.

english_verse: Why don't we build a new meeting place near the Jordan River? Each of us could get some wood, then we could build it.” “That's a good idea,” Elisha replied, “get started.”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ti keŋ Joodan mu'arin ka nid wʋsa nwaae daug yinne-yinne zi na ka kɛ ka ti mɛ' zin'ikanɛ ka ti na bɛ.” Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Kemi!”

english_verse: “Aren't you going with us?” one of the prophets asked. “Yes, I'll go,” Elisha answered,
translation_verse: Ba nid yinne da yɛl o ye, “Ti zugdaana, m bɛlimnɛ, fʋ kʋ dɔlli ti keŋɛ?” Ka Elasia lɛbis ye, “Tɔ', m na keŋ.”

english_verse: and he left with them. They went to the Jordan River and began chopping down trees.
translation_verse: Ka dɔlli ba keŋ. Ban da keŋ paae Joodan mu'arin pin'ili nwaad tiisi lugid la,

english_verse: “Where did it fall in?” Elisha asked. The prophet pointed to the place, and Elisha cut a stick and threw it into the water at that spot. The ax head floated to the top of the water.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am tʋmtʋm la bu'os ye, “Yaanɛ ka di li?” Ka o pa'al o din lu zin'isi'a la, ka Elasia kɔ'ɔg daugʋ lɔb ani, ka kɛ ka lieŋ la puk na.

english_verse: “Now get it,” Elisha told him. And the prophet reached in and grabbed it. Elisha Stops an Invasion of the Syrian Army
translation_verse: Ka o yɛl o ye, “Yaami li!” Ka dau la tiɛn o nu'ugʋ yaae li. Elasia kɛ ka Aram dim lieb zʋnzɔɔs si'em

english_verse: Time after time, when the king of Syria was at war against the Israelites, he met with his officers and announced, “I've decided where we will set up camp.”
translation_verse: Aram Na'ab la da tʋ'ʋs Israel dim nɛ zaba. O da zin'in nɛ o na'ayikpɛm ka gban'e ye, “M na la'asi m soogianam la gu' ba kpɛ', bɛɛ kpɛ'.”

english_verse: Each time, Elisha would send this warning to the king of Israel: “Don't go near there. That's where the Syrian troops have set up camp.”
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am tʋmtʋm la da tʋm yɛl Israel Na'ab la ye, “Baŋim ka da dɔl zin'ikanɛ, bɔzugɔ Aram dim la kennɛ ani baba.”

english_verse: The king of Syria was furious when he found out what was happening. He called in his officers and asked, “Which one of you has been telling the king of Israel our plans?”
translation_verse: Nɛ' da kɛ ka Aram Na'ab la sʋnf duoe. Ka o la'as o na'ayikpɛm la wʋsa bu'osi ba ye, “Ya kʋ yɛlim onɛ yit kpɛla ken Israel Na'ab la san'an yɛɛsid laa?”

english_verse: “None of us, Your Majesty,” one of them answered. “It's an Israelite named Elisha. He's a prophet, so he can tell his king everything—even what you say in your own room.”
translation_verse: Ka na'ayikpɛm la yinne yɛl o ye, “Ka' tinam na'ayikpɛm laa, amaa Elasia onɛ an nɔdi'esi bɛ Israel la yɛt Israel Na'ab pian'abanɛ ka fʋ pian'adi fʋ dɔgbɛɛndigin la wʋsa.”

english_verse: “Find out where he is!” the king ordered. “I'll send soldiers to bring him here.” They learned that Elisha was in the town of Dothan and reported it to the king.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab la tis nɔɔr ye, “Kem ieenɛ o zin'ig ka m tʋm nidib ka ba keŋ gban'e o na.” Ka ba keŋ ka lɛb na yɛl o ye, “O bɛ Dotan teŋin.”

english_verse: He ordered his best troops to go there with horses and chariots. They marched out during the night and surrounded the town.
translation_verse: Ka o tʋm widi nɛ zaba tɛrekonam nɛ ninkpi'ema ani. Ba da keŋ paae yʋ'ʋŋʋ lɔbi gilig teŋ la.

english_verse: When Elisha's servant got up the next morning, he saw that Syrian troops had the town surrounded. “Sir, what are we going to do?” he asked.
translation_verse: Wina'am tʋmtʋm la sankpan'as da yi bɛogʋn asuba na, ka nyɛ ka soogianam lɔbi gilig teŋ la nɛ widi nɛ zaba tɛrekonam. Ka sankpan'as la ye, “Waai, m zugdaana, ti di'ed ya?”

english_verse: “Don't be afraid,” Elisha answered. “There are more troops on our side than on theirs.”
translation_verse: Wina'am tʋmtʋm la da lɛbisi yɛl o ye, “Da zɔt dabiem, banɛ bɛ nɛ tinam la gat banɛ bɛ nɛ ba la.”

english_verse: Then he prayed, “Lord, please help him to see.” And the Lord let the servant see that the hill was covered with fiery horses and flaming chariots all around Elisha.
translation_verse: Elasia da sɔs ye, “Zugsɔba, lakim o nini ka o na nyaŋi nyɛ!” Zugsɔb la da lak sankpan'as la nini ka o gɔsi nyɛ ka kʋkʋna la pɛ'ɛl nɛ widi nɛ zaba tɛrekonam nɛ bugum gilig Elasia.

english_verse: As the Syrian army came closer, Elisha prayed, “Lord, make those soldiers blind!” And the Lord blinded them with a bright light.
translation_verse: Dataas la da sigi kennɛ o san'an na la, Elasia da sɔs Zugsɔb la ye, “Kɛl ka nimbama wʋsa kilim zʋnzɔɔs!” Ka o kɛ ka ba kilim zʋnzɔɔs nwɛnɛ Elasia sɔs si'em la.

english_verse: Elisha told the enemy troops, “You've taken the wrong road and are in the wrong town. Follow me. I'll lead you to the man you're looking for.” Elisha led them straight to the capital city of Samaria.
translation_verse: Elasia da yɛli ba ye, “Li ka' suor la nwaa. Li mɛ ka' teŋ kanɛ ka ya ken la nwaa. Dɔlli nɛ m nya'aŋ ka m mɔri ya keŋ dau kanɛ ka ya ieed la san'an.” Ka o dɔlli ba keŋ Samaria tempʋʋgin.

english_verse: When all the soldiers were inside the city, Elisha prayed, “Lord, now let them see again.” The Lord let them see that they were standing in the middle of Samaria.
translation_verse: Ban da kpɛn' teŋ la pʋʋgin naae la ka Elasia yɛl ye, “Zugsɔba, lakim nimbama nini ka ba nyaŋi nyɛt!” Ka Zugsɔb la laki ba nini ka ba gɔsi nyɛnɛ ban bɛ Samaria teŋ la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: The king of Israel saw them and asked Elisha, “Should I kill them, sir?”
translation_verse: Israel Na'ab la da nyɛɛ ba la, o bu'os Elasia ye, “M kʋʋmi baa? M saama, m kʋʋmi baa?”

english_verse: “No!” Elisha answered. “You didn't capture these troops in battle, so you have no right to kill them. Instead, give them something to eat and drink and let them return to their leader.”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “Ayei, da kʋʋ baa! Fʋ na kʋ nimbanɛ ka fʋ gban'e ba zaba nii? Tisimi ba diib nɛ ku'om ka ba di ka nu ka lɛbi ba zugdaan la san'an!”

english_verse: The king ordered a huge meal to be prepared for Syria's army, and when they finished eating, he let them go. For a while, the Syrian troops stopped invading Israel's territory. King Benhadad of Syria Attacks Samaria
translation_verse: Dinzug, o da maal diib sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ba, ka ban di ka nuu naae la o basi ba ye ba kulim, ka ba lɛbi ba zugdaan la san'an. Lin yii anina, Aram nimbanɛ da ken Israel titɔndigin faand la da bas faaung la. Kɔ'ɔm gban'e Samaria dim banɛ ka ba lud la

english_verse: Some time later, King Benhadad of Syria called his entire army together, then they marched to Samaria and attacked.
translation_verse: Lin nya'aŋ la Ben-Hadad onɛ da an Aram Na'ab la da la'as o soogianam la wʋsa ka ba keŋ lɔbi gilig Samaria tempʋʋg.

english_verse: They kept up the attack until there was nothing to eat in the city. In fact, a donkey's head cost
translation_verse: Kɔ'ɔm tita'ar da lu teŋin la; ba da lɔbi gilig teŋ la ka li yuug hali, ka ba ti kuosid bʋŋ zug anzurifa ligidi pisnii, ka kakpɛɛd kʋŋkɔŋ mɛ an anzurifa ligidi anu.

english_verse: One day as the king of Israel was walking along the top of the city wall, a woman shouted to him, “Please, Your Majesty, help me!”
translation_verse: Israel Na'ab la da dɔl teŋ la zaŋguom la zugʋ gat, ka pu'a sɔ' kaas kuŋ ye, “M zugdaan onɛ an Na'aba, sʋŋim!”

english_verse: “Let the Lord help you!” the king said. “Do you think I have grain or wine to give you?”
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab la lɛbis ye, “Zugsɔb la ya'a pʋ sʋŋi fɔ, man na paam sʋŋir yaanɛ sʋŋi fɔ? Mam mɔri ki zieŋin la bɛɛ daam na tisi fɔɔ?”

english_verse: Then he asked, “What's the matter anyway?” The woman answered, “Another woman and I were so hungry that we agreed to eat our sons. She said if we ate my son one day, we could eat hers the next day.
translation_verse: Ka bu'os o ye, “Yɛl la an bɔ?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Pu'a kaŋa yɛl man ye, ‘Mɔri fʋ biig la na ka ti ɔnb zina, ka bɛog ka ti mɛ ɔnb on biig la.’

english_verse: So yesterday we cooked my son and ate him. But today when I went to her house to eat her son, she had hidden him.”
translation_verse: Ka ti sa dʋg mam biig la ɔnb, ka bɛog nie ka man yɛl o ye, ‘Mɔri fʋ biig la na ka ti ɔnb!’ Amaa ka o zaŋ o su'a.”

english_verse: The king tore off his clothes in sorrow, and since he was on top of the city wall, the people saw that he was wearing sackcloth underneath.
translation_verse: Na'ab la da wʋm pu'a la pian'ad la, o sʋnf da san'amnɛ hali ka o aans o fuud. Ka on da dɔlisid zaŋguom la zug la, nidib la da nyɛ on yɛ bɔtkɛɛnd, sʋnsa'aŋ zug.

english_verse: He said, “I pray that God will punish me terribly, if Elisha's head is still on his shoulders by this time tomorrow.”
translation_verse: O da ye, “M pɔya mɛnɛ, mam na fi'ig Elasia onɛ an Safat biig la zug zina ka Zugsɔb la ya'a na maalim si'em on maal!”

english_verse: Then he sent a messenger to Elisha. Elisha was home at the time, and the important leaders of Israel were meeting with him. Even before the king's messenger arrived, Elisha told the leaders, “That murderer is sending someone to cut off my head. When you see him coming, shut the door and don't let him in. I'm sure the king himself will be right behind him.”
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Elasia da zin'inɛ o yin, ka kpɛɛmnam la la'an zin' nɛ o. Na'ab la da tʋm biig ka o gaad tuon, ka on nam bɛ suor la, Elasia da yɛl kpɛɛmnam la ye, “Ya pʋ nyɛ ninkʋʋd la tʋm sɔ' si'em ye o kena fi'ig man zugɔɔ? Gɔsimi, onɛ ka o tʋm la ya'a paae na yanam on yɔɔm o lɛbis ka din kʋlʋŋ la mɔri kiŋ-kiŋ. Ka' o zugdaan la nɔbkida dɔl o nya'aŋ laa?”

english_verse: Before Elisha finished talking, the messenger came up and said, “The Lord has made all these terrible things happen to us. Why should I think he will help us now?”
translation_verse: On daa nam pian'adi tisidi ba la, ka onɛ ka ba tʋm la paae na. Ka Na'ab la yɛl ye, “Yɛl kaŋa yinɛ Zugsɔb la san'an na. Bɔ ka m na lɛn gur Zugsɔb la ya'asɛ?”

english_verse: Elisha answered, “I have a message for you. The Lord promises that tomorrow here in Samaria, you will be able to buy a large sack of flour or two large sacks of barley for almost nothing.”
translation_verse: Ka Elasia yɛli ba ye, “Kɛlisimi Zugsɔb la pian'ʋk! Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': ‘Bɛogʋ anwana win la, ba na da' mui kuriba anzurifa la'af yinne ka ki kuriba ayi' mɛ na da' anzurifa la'af yinne Samaria tempʋʋg za'anɔɔrin la.’”

english_verse: The chief officer there with the king replied, “I don't believe it! Even if the Lord sent a rainstorm, it couldn't produce that much grain by tomorrow.” “You will see it happen, but you won't eat any of the food,” Elisha warned him. The Syrian Army Stops Its Attack
translation_verse: Na'ayikpɛɛm onɛ da kpi'e Na'ab la da yɛl Zugsɔb tʋmtʋm la ye, “Gɔsima, hali baa Zugsɔb la ya'a yɔ'ɔg saŋgbana wʋʋ za'anɔya nɛ, nɛ' na nyaŋi niŋɛɛ?” Elasia da lɛbis o ye, “Fʋ na nyɛɛ li nɛ fʋ mɛŋ nini amaa fʋ nɔɔr kʋ lɛmmi lii!” Aram dim la zɔya

english_verse: About the same time, four men with leprosy were just outside the gate of Samaria. They said to each other, “Why should we sit here, waiting to die?
translation_verse: Saŋkaŋa nidiba anaasi daa an kʋkɔma ka bɛ teŋ la za'anɔɔrin. Ba da yɛl taaba ye, “Bɔ ka ti zin' kpɛla hali ti kpiida?

english_verse: There's nothing to eat in the city, so we would starve if we went inside. But if we stay out here, we will die for sure. Let's sneak over to the Syrian army camp and surrender. They might kill us, but they might not.”
translation_verse: Ti ya'a ye ti kpɛn' teŋ la pʋʋgin, kɔ'ɔm bɛɛ ani, ti na kpi. Ti mɛ ya'a lɛn kpɛlim kpɛla ti na kpi. Alazug kɛlli ka ti keŋi Aram dim la san'an lɛɛ zaŋi ti mɛŋi tisi ba. Ba ya'a basi ti, tinam on vʋe; ba ya'a lɛn kʋʋ ti, tinam on kpi.”

english_verse: They said to each other, “This isn't right. Today is a day to celebrate, and we haven't told anyone else what has happened. If we wait until morning, we will be punished. Let's go to the king's palace at once and tell the good news.”
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn yɛl taaba ye, “Ti pʋ tʋm linɛ nara. Zina anɛ labasʋŋ dabisir ka ti pʋ kɛ ka sɔ' wʋmm. Ti ya'a gu'us ka bɛog nie, tɔɔg na paae ti. Ti kemi na'ayin la tɔ'ɔtɔ yɛli ba.”

english_verse: They went back to Samaria and shouted up to the guards at the gate, “We've just come from the Syrian army camp, and all the soldiers are gone! The tents are empty, and the horses and donkeys are still tied up. We didn't see or hear anybody.”
translation_verse: Dinzug ba daa keŋ banɛ gur teŋ la za'anɔɔr la san'anɛ yɛli ba ye, “Tinam keŋ nɛ Aram dim la gbɛɛnd zin'isi'a la ka nid baa yinne ka' ani; ti pʋm pʋ wʋm sɔ' dammirɛ, widi nɛ bʋmis ma'aa lɔɔ zi'e, ka sʋga la kpɛn an lin an si'em la.”

english_verse: The guards reported the news to the king's palace.
translation_verse: Banɛ gu'ud yaŋir la daa kaas kuŋi mɔɔl labaar la, ka ba zɔɔ keŋ yɛl na'ayin.

english_verse: The king got out of bed and said to his officers, “I know what those Syrians are doing. They know we're starving, so they're hiding in the fields, hoping we will go out to look for food. When we do, they can capture us and take over our city.”
translation_verse: Na'ab la da duoe yʋ'ʋŋ la yɛl o na'ayikpɛm la ye, “M na yɛli ya Aram dim la gban'e si'em. Ba mi' ye kɔ'ɔm mɔri ti. Dinzug ka ba bas zin'ig la ka su'a teŋ la kpikpɛŋ ka tɛn'ɛsid ye, ti na yina ka ba gban'e ti vʋt ka kpɛn' tempʋʋgin la!”

english_verse: One of his officers replied, “We have a few horses left—why don't we let some men take five of them and go to the Syrian camp and see what's happening? We're going to die anyway like those who have already died.”
translation_verse: Na'ayikpɛm la yinne da lɛbis ye, “Tɔ'! Ka kɛl ka dap sieba nɔk widi anu banɛ kpɛlim teŋin la keŋ gɔs. Bɔzugɔ, ban ya'a kpi, tinam banɛ kpɛlim kpɛla la wʋsa kʋ pɔnsɛ. Alazug kɛl ka ti tʋmi ba ka ba keŋ gɔs linɛ maal.”

english_verse: They found two chariots, and the king commanded the men to find out what had happened to the Syrian troops.
translation_verse: Dinzug ba daa gaŋ zaba tɛrekonam ayi' nɛ ba widi la ka Na'ab la tʋmi ba ye ba keŋ gɔs linɛ maal Aram dim zabzabidib. O daa tis banɛ tɛɛd widi la nɔɔr ye ba kem gɔs linɛ maal.

english_verse: The men rode as far as the Jordan River. All along the way they saw clothes and equipment that the Syrians had thrown away as they escaped. Then they went back to the king and told him what they had seen.
translation_verse: Ba daa dɔlisi ba bugir hali ti paae Joodan mu'arin la. Ba daa nyɛ ka suor la pɛ'ɛl nɛ fuud nɛ la'abanɛ ka Aram dim la zɔt ka yɛɛsidi lɔbid la. Ka ba lɛbi yɛl Na'ab la.

english_verse: At once the people went to the Syrian camp and carried off what was left. They took so much that a large sack of flour and two large sacks of barley sold for almost nothing, just as the Lord had promised.
translation_verse: Nidib la daa yii keŋ gilig Aram dim la'asʋg zin'ig la vaae ba la'ad la. Linɛ daa kɛ ka zɔ'ɔm kuriba da'ad anzurifa la'af yinne ka mui kuriba ayi' mɛ da'ad anzurifa la'af yinne, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la sa yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The king of Israel had put his chief officer in charge of the gate, but he died when the people trampled him as they rushed out of the city.
translation_verse: Na'ab la daa kɛ ka o na'ayikpɛɛm onɛ zin' kpi'enɛ o la yʋ'ʋn gur teŋ la za'anɔɔr la, ka nidib la la'asi muk za'anɔɔr la nɔɔ o ka o kpi, nwɛnɛ Wina'am tʋmtʋm la pʋn dɛŋi yɛl si'em saŋkanɛ ka Na'ab la sa kɛɛn o san'an na la.

english_verse: Earlier, when the king was at Elisha's house, Elisha had told him that flour or barley would sell for almost nothing.
translation_verse: Li daa tʋm nwɛnɛ Wina'am tʋmtʋm la yɛl Na'ab la si'em la ye, “Bɛog anwana win, zɔ'ɔm kuriba na da' anzurifa la'af yinne ka mui kuriba ayi' mɛ na da' anzurifa la'af yinne Samaria teŋ za'anɔɔrin la.”

english_verse: But the officer refused to believe that even the Lord could do that. So Elisha warned him that he would see it happen, but would not eat any of the food.
translation_verse: Na'ayikpɛɛm la daa yɛl Wina'am tʋmtʋm la ye, “Gɔsima, hali baa Zugsɔb la ya'a yɔ'ɔg saŋgbana wʋʋ za'anɔya nɛ, nɛ' na nyaŋi niŋɛɛ?” Ka Wina'am tʋmtʋm la lɛbis o ye, “Fʋ na nyɛɛ li nɛ fʋ mɛŋ nini amaa fʋ nɔɔr kʋ lɛmmi lii!”

english_verse: And that's exactly what happened—the officer was trampled to death.
translation_verse: Ka li sid niŋ o ala bɔzugɔ nidib la da nɔɔ o nɛ za'anɔɔrin la ka o kpi.

english_verse: Then she returned to Israel and immediately begged the king to give back her house and property.
translation_verse: Yʋma ayɔpɔi la nya'aŋ ka o naam Filistia dim teŋin la lɛb na ka keŋ Na'ab la san'an ye o sɔs ka ba lɛbis o yir la nɛ o paalʋ la tis o.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the king was asking Gehazi the servant of Elisha about the amazing things Elisha had been doing.
translation_verse: Na'ab la da pian'ad nɛ tisid Gehazi, onɛ an Wina'am tʋmtʋm sankpan'as la, ka bu'os o ye, “Yɛlimim tʋʋm titada banɛ ka Elasia tʋm.”

english_verse: While Gehazi was telling him that Elisha had brought a dead boy back to life, the woman and her son arrived. “Here's the boy, Your Majesty,” Gehazi said. “And this is his mother.”
translation_verse: Gehazi nam bɛɛ ani yɛt Na'ab la ye Elasia da kɛ ka kum vʋ'ʋg la ka pu'a kanɛ biig ka Elasia da vʋ'ʋg o kumin la mɛ kena ye o bɛllim Na'ab la di'e o yir nɛ paalʋ la. Ka Gehazi yɛl ye, “Pu'a la nwa', m zugdaan nɛ m Na'aba. O bikanɛ ka Elasia daa vʋ'ʋg kumin la nwa' mɛn!”

english_verse: Some time later Elisha went to the capital city of Damascus to visit King Benhadad of Syria, who was sick. And when Benhadad was told he was there,
translation_verse: Elasia da keŋ Damaskus tempʋʋgin, ka Ben-Hadad onɛ an Aram Na'ab la bɛn'ɛd. Ban da yɛl Na'ab la ye Wina'am tʋmtʋm la keŋ hali paae ba teŋin na la,

english_verse: Hazael left with forty camel loads of the best things made in Damascus as a gift for Elisha. He found the prophet and said, “Your servant, King Benhadad, wants to know if he will get well.”
translation_verse: Hazael da keŋ tʋ'ʋs Elasia ka nɔk la'asʋma banɛ bɛ Damaskus wʋsa lɔɔ ziil yʋgʋma pisnaasi. O da kpɛn' zi'enɛ o tuon, ka yɛl ye, “Fʋ biig Ben-Hadad onɛ an Aram Na'ab la tʋmim ye m bu'os ye, o na tilig ban'a kaŋa nii?”

english_verse: “Tell him he will,” Elisha said to Hazael. “But the Lord has already told me that Benhadad will definitely die.”
translation_verse: Elasia da gandig ye, “Kem yɛl o ye, ‘Fʋ sid na tilig’, amaa Zugsɔb la nie pa'alim ye o lɛɛ na kpi.”

english_verse: Elisha stared at him until Hazael was embarrassed, then Elisha began crying.
translation_verse: O da kpa' gɔt o kii hali ka nyan ti gban'e Hazael. Ka Wina'am tʋmtʋm la pin'ili kum.

english_verse: “Sir, why are you crying?” Hazael asked. Elisha answered, “Because I know the terrible things you will do to the people of Israel. You will burn down their walled cities and slaughter their young men. You will even crush the heads of their babies and rip open their pregnant women.”
translation_verse: Ka Hazael bu'os ye, “M zugdaana, bɔ ka fʋ kumma?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Mam mi' tɔɔg kanɛ ka fʋ ye fʋ tʋm tis Israel dim la zug! Fʋ na nyu'oe zin'ibanɛ aan ba paŋ zin'is la, ka kʋʋ ba dasam la wʋsa nɛ sʋ'ʋg, ka nɔki ba bilies la fanbig teŋ, ka lati ba pu'a pʋʋs la pʋya.”

english_verse: “How could I ever do anything like that?” Hazael replied. “I'm only a servant and don't have that kind of power.” “Hazael, the Lord has told me that you will be the next king of Syria.”
translation_verse: Hazael daa yɛl ye, “Ayei, m zugdaana! Man, tadimbʋkaŋa, na niŋ wala tʋm tʋʋmfɛn'ɛskaŋa?” Ka Elasia lɛbis ye, “Zugsɔb la pa'alim ye fʋ na di Aram Na'am.”

english_verse: But the very next day, Hazael got a thick blanket; he soaked it in water and held it over Benhadad's face until he died. Hazael then became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Amaa bɛogʋ da nie la o da nɔk futɛbisʋgʋ lɔs ku'omin ligil Na'ab la nindaa ka o kpi. Ka Hazael di'e o zin'igi di na'am la. Jehoram onɛ an Juda Na'ab la yɛla (

english_verse: So Jehoram and his cavalry marched to Zair, where the Edomite army surrounded him and his commanders. During the night he attacked the Edomites, but he was defeated, and his troops escaped to their homes.
translation_verse: Dinzug Jehoram da keŋ Zair nɛ o zaba tɛrekonam la wʋsa, ka Edom dim la da gilig on nɛ o kpi'emnam banɛ gɔt zaba tɛrekonamin la, amaa o da duoe yʋ'ʋŋʋ aaɛn yi. O soogianam la lɛɛ da zɔnɛ lɛbi kul.

english_verse: While Jehoram was king, the people of Edom rebelled and chose their own king.
translation_verse: Jehoram saŋa la, Edom da zan'as Juda dim ka diisi ba mɛŋ na'ab.

english_verse: Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat became king of Judah in Joram's fifth year as king of Israel, while Jehoshaphat was still king of Judah.
translation_verse: Israel na'ab Joram onɛ an Ahab biig la da di na'am paae yʋma anu la, ka Jehoram onɛ da an Jehosafat biig la mɛ di Juda na'am.

english_verse: Jehoram disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He married Ahab's daughter and was as sinful as Ahab's family and the kings of Israel.
translation_verse: O da dinɛ Ahab pu'ayua ka dinzugʋ kɛ ka o da dɔlis wʋʋ Israel na'anamɛ da dɔlisid si'em la, nwɛnɛ Ahab yidimi da niŋ si'em, ka tʋm bɛ'ɛd pamm Zugsɔb tuon la.

english_verse: But the Lord refused to destroy Judah, because he had promised his servant David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, Zugsɔb la da pʋ siak ye o san'am Juda teŋ la, David n aan o sankpan'as la zug. O da kaanb ye o na kɛ ka fitir si'a kpɛm bɛɛ tis David nɛ o yaas, saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoram did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Ya'a anɛ yɛla banɛ da maal Jehoram na'am saŋa nɛ on da tʋm si'el la, ba da sɔbi niŋ Juda Na'anam Gbauŋʋn la.

english_verse: Jehoram died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Ahaziah then became king. King Ahaziah of Judah (
translation_verse: Jehoram da maal ka'alim ka ba mum o David mɛŋ tempʋʋgin. Ka o biig Ahazaya lɛdigi di'e na'am la. Ahazaya di Juda na'am la (

english_verse: Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah in the twelfth year of Joram's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Ahab biig Joram da di Israel na'am ka li ti paae yʋma pii nɛ ayi' la, Na'ab Jehoram biig Ahazaya n da di na'am.

english_verse: Since Ahaziah was related to Ahab's family, he acted just like them and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong.
translation_verse: O da dɔlisid wʋʋ Ahab yidimi niŋ si'em la ka tʋm bɛ'ɛd Zugsɔb la tuon, nwɛnɛ Ahab yidimi da niŋ si'em la, bɔzugɔ o kpinɛ Ahab yidim la nɛ on di pu'a ani la zug.

english_verse: Ahaziah went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Ahazaya da dɔl Ahab biig, Joram keŋ zab nɛ Hazael onɛ an Aram Na'ab la, Ramot Gilead teŋin. Aram dim la da pu'alim Joram

english_verse: One day, Elisha called for one of the other prophets and said: Take this bottle of olive oil and get ready to go to the town of Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Nɔdi'es Elasia da buol dasaŋ sɔ' nɔdi'esidibin la yɛl o ye, Lɔɔmi fʋ fuug la nɛ sɛnbidiŋ, ka nɔk malʋŋ kpaam nɛ buuta nwa' n keŋ Ramot-Gilead teŋin.

english_verse: When you get there, find Jehu son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi. Take him to a place where the two of you can be alone,
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a paae ani, fʋn ieem Jehu onɛ an Jehosafat biig, ka o yaab mɛ an Nimsi la bɛ zin'isi'a. Ka keŋ o san'an dɔl o yii o taaba la san'anɛ kpɛn' pʋʋgin dɔɔgin la sa.

english_verse: then pour olive oil on his head to show that he is the new king. Say to him, “The Lord has chosen you to be king of Israel.” Then leave quickly—don't wait around for anything!
translation_verse: Ka nɔk buuta la bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam la niŋ o zugin ka yɛl nyain ye, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye: “Manɛ gaŋif ye fʋ di Israel na'am.” Ka yɔ'ɔg za'anɔɔr la yii zɔ, ka da yuug anii!

english_verse: The young prophet left for Ramoth.
translation_verse: Dasaŋ onɛ an nɔdi'es la sid daa keŋ Ramot-Gilead.

english_verse: When he arrived, the army officers were meeting together. “Sir, I have a message for you,” he said. “For which one of us?” Jehu asked. “You, sir,” the prophet answered.
translation_verse: On daa paae la, o daa nyɛ soogia kpɛɛmnam la ka ba la'as taaba zin'. Ka o yɛl ye, “Soogiakpɛɛm, m mɔri labaar ye m yɛlif.” Ka Jehu bu'os o ye, “Kpɛɛm kanɛ?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Fʋn onɛ an soogianam kpɛɛm la.”

english_verse: So Jehu got up and went inside. The prophet poured olive oil on Jehu's head and told him: The Lord God of Israel has this message for you: “I am the Lord, and I have chosen you to be king of my people Israel.
translation_verse: Jehu da duoe kpɛn' yir la pʋʋg, ka nɔdi'es la bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam la niŋ o zugin ka yɛl o ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la yɛl ye, ‘Manɛ gaŋif ye fʋ di na'am sʋ'oe Zugsɔb la nidib Israel teŋin.

english_verse: I want you to wipe out the family of Ahab, so Jezebel will be punished for killing the prophets and my other servants.
translation_verse: Li anɛ ye fʋ san'am Ahab onɛ daa aan fʋ zugdaan la zak, ka m yɔɔ m yammis la sam, banɛ an nɔdi'esidib nɛ Zugsɔb la yammis banɛ ka Jezebɛl kʋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: Every man and boy in Ahab's family must die, whether slave or free.
translation_verse: Ahab zak la wʋsa na san'am. M na nwaae Ahab yin la biribiŋ kpaanr wʋsa Israel teŋin, o ya'a anɛ yammʋg bɛɛ o ya'a ka' yammʋga.

english_verse: His whole family must be destroyed, just like the families of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka Ahab zak la an wʋʋ Jeroboam onɛ an Nebat biig la zaki an si'em la, ka mɛ nwɛnɛ Baasa onɛ an Ahija biig la zak mɛn.

english_verse: As for Jezebel, her body will be eaten by dogs in the town of Jezreel. There won't be enough left of her to bury.” Then the young prophet opened the door and ran out.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ Jezebɛl, baasi ye ba ɔnb o Jezireel teŋgbauŋʋn la. Ka sɔ' kʋ mum oo!’” Ka o kpɛn yɔ'ɔg za'anɔɔr la ka yii zɔ.

english_verse: Jehu went back to his officers, and one of them asked, “What did that crazy prophet want? Is everything all right?” “You know him and how he talks,” Jehu answered.
translation_verse: Jehu n da yii o kpɛɛm taaba la ni na la, ka ba yinne bu'os o ye, “Li malisaa? Bɔɔ kɛ ka gɛɛŋ kaŋa kɛɛn fʋ san'an na?” Ka Jehu lɛbis ye, “Ayei, ya mi' dau kaŋa nɛ o pian'ayaalis la yɛla!”

english_verse: “No, we don't. What did he say?” they asked. “He had a message from the Lord,” Jehu replied. “He said that the Lord has chosen me to be the next king of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ka ba lɛbis ye, “Ayei li ka' sidaa, yɛlimi ti on yɛl si'el!” Ka Jehu lɛbis ye, “O yɛlim ye, ‘Zugsɔb la yɛl ye manɛ bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋi fʋ zugin ye fʋ di Israel na'am.’”

english_verse: They quickly grabbed their coats and spread them out on the steps where Jehu was standing. Someone blew a trumpet, and everyone shouted, “Jehu is king!” Jehu Kills Joram and Ahaziah
translation_verse: Ba da niŋ tɔ'ɔtɔ yɛɛsi ba fuudi yadig o tuon na'am bimbim la zug. Ka pieb na'atan, ka tans nɛ kʋkɔtita'ari yɛl ye, “Jehu di na'am!” Jehu n kʋ Joram nɛ Ahazaya la yɛla

english_verse: When the guard in the watchtower at Jezreel saw Jehu and his men riding up, he shouted to the king, “I see a large group of men coming this way.” Joram ordered, “Send someone out to ask them if this is a friendly visit.”
translation_verse: Onɛ ya'ae Jezireel girimbisa zugʋ gur teŋ la nyɛ Jehu nɛ o nidib la li'en na la, ka o tans ye, “Mam nyɛ nidibi la'asi kenna.” Ka Joram tis nɔɔr ye, “Bɔɔm wiedban'ad ka o yii keŋ tʋ'ʋs o bu'os ye o kennɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm kennaa?”

english_verse: One of the soldiers rode out and said to Jehu, “King Joram wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just stay behind me with the rest of my troops!” About the same time the guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back.”
translation_verse: Wiedban'ad la da tʋ'ʋs Jehu ka yɛl o ye, “Na'ab ye m bu'osif ye sumbʋgʋsʋm ken ka fʋ kennaa?” Ka Jehu lɛbis o ye, “Fʋ bɔɔd sumbʋgʋsʋm ye fʋ niŋ bɔ? Gaadim dɔllim nya'aŋ!” Onɛ ya'ae agɔlli gur teŋ la da yɛl ye, “Onɛ ka fʋ tʋm la paae ba, amaa o pʋ lɛbid naa.”

english_verse: So Joram sent out another rider, who rode up to Jehu and said, “The king wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just get behind me with the rest of my troops!”
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab la lɛn tʋm wiedban'adi pɛ'ɛs ayi'. On da tʋ'ʋs o la o da yɛl o ye, “Na'ab ye m bu'osif ye fʋ ken la anɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm?” Ka Jehu lɛbis o ye, “Fʋ bɔɔd sumbʋgʋsʋm ye fʋ niŋ bɔ? Gaadim dɔllim nya'aŋ!”

english_verse: The guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back either. Wait a minute! That one man is a reckless chariot driver—it must be Jehu!”
translation_verse: Ka onɛ ya'ae agɔlli gur teŋ la yɛl ye, “O paae ya, amaa o pʋ lɛbid na mɛnɛ; onɛ dɔribid zaba tɛreko la nwɛnɛ Nimsi biig Jehu nɛ, bɔzugɔ o dɔribidnɛ nwɛnɛ gɛɛŋ!”

english_verse: Joram commanded, “Get my chariot ready.” Then he and Ahaziah got in their chariots and rode out to meet Jehu. They all met on the land that had belonged to Naboth.
translation_verse: Ka Joram tans ye, “Lɔɔmi m zaba tɛreko tisim!” Ka ban lɔɔ naae la, Joram onɛ an Israel Na'ab nɛ Ahazaya onɛ an Juda Na'ab la da ban'a yi, sɔ' wʋsa nɛ o mɛŋ zaba tɛreko, ye ba tʋ'ʋs Jehu. Ba da tʋ'ʋs o nɛ pɔkanɛ an Nabof onɛ an Jezireel teŋ nid la din la zinzema.

english_verse: Joram asked, “Jehu, is this a peaceful visit?” “How can there be peace?” Jehu asked. “Your mother Jezebel has caused everyone to worship idols and practice witchcraft.”
translation_verse: Joram n da nyɛ Jehu la o da bu'os o ye, “Jehu, fʋ ken la anɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm?” Ka Jehu lɛbis ye, “Li ye li niŋ wala ka sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛ, teŋgbana la wʋsa nɛ fʋ ma Jezebɛl sɔɔng la ya'a nam bɛ?”

english_verse: “Ahaziah, let's get out of here!” Joram yelled. “It's a trap!” As Joram tried to escape,
translation_verse: Joram da fɛndigi zɔ, ka yʋ'ʋn buonnɛ yɛt Ahazaya ye, “Ahazaya, zɔm ka li mu'oe nɛ, ba yii ti nya'aŋ!”

english_verse: Jehu shot an arrow. It hit Joram between his shoulders, then it went through his heart and came out his chest. He fell over dead in his chariot.
translation_verse: Jehu da tɛk o tiraugʋ tɔn ka li gban'e Joram gʋrʋgʋ gaadi kʋns o susʋnya ka o luu o zaba tɛreko la pʋʋgin galli!

english_verse: Jehu commanded his assistant Bidkar, “Get Joram's body and throw it in the field that Naboth once owned. Do you remember when you and I used to ride side by side behind Joram's father Ahab? It was then that the Lord swore to Ahab that he would be punished in the same field where he had killed Naboth and his sons. So throw Joram's body there, just as the Lord said.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Su'os man sa nyɛ Nabof nɛ o biis ziim, ka m na kɛ ka fʋ yɔɔ li sam pɔkaŋa ni’ Dinzugɔ, nannanna ʋkimi nɛ o lɔb pɔɔgin la nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la da yɛl si'em la.”

english_verse: Ahaziah saw all of this happen and tried to escape to the town of Beth-Haggan, but Jehu caught up with him and shouted, “Kill him too!” So his troops shot Ahaziah with an arrow while he was on the road to Gur near Ibleam. He went as far as Megiddo, where he died.
translation_verse: Juda Na'ab Ahazaya nyɛ bʋn linɛ maal la, o daa zɔɔ dɔl suori keŋ Bef-Hagan, ka Jehu mɛ zɔɔ dɔl o tansid ye, “Kʋʋmi nɛ o mɛn!” Ba da pu'alim o, o zaba tɛreko la pʋʋgin, on da dɔl suori wa'ae Gur linɛ kpi'e Ibilam teŋin la, amaa o da zɔɔ pɔns ka keŋ Megido teŋin kpii ani.

english_verse: Ahaziah's officers put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried him beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: O yammis da zii o nɛ zaba tɛreko keŋ Jerusalem mum o, o yaanam yaadin David tempʋʋgin la.

english_verse: Jehu headed toward Jezreel, and when Jezebel heard he was coming, she put on eye shadow and brushed her hair. Then she stood at the window, waiting for him to arrive.
translation_verse: Jehu da keŋ Jezireel teŋin. Jezebɛl n da wʋm la o da kir kirʋ, ka maali maal o zuobid ka zin' takoro ni.

english_verse: As he walked through the city gate, she shouted down to him, “Why did you come here, you murderer? To kill the king? You're no better than Zimri!”
translation_verse: Jehu da kpɛn' za'anɔɔrin la, o da bu'os o ye, “Li malis ka fʋ kennaa, Zimiri, fʋn kanɛ kʋʋ fʋ zugdaan la?”

english_verse: He looked up toward the window and asked, “Is anyone up there on my side?” A few palace workers stuck their heads out of a window,
translation_verse: Jehu da gɔdigi gɔs takoro la ni ka tans ye, “Anɔ'ɔnɛ zi'e m nya'aŋa? Anɔ'ɔnɛ?” Nidiba ayi' bɛɛ atan' banɛ ka ba fuoe ba ye ba gɔsid pu'ab la daa su'uni gɔs o.

english_verse: and Jehu shouted, “Throw her out the window!” They threw her down, and her blood splattered on the walls and on the horses that trampled her body.
translation_verse: Ka Jehu lɛbis ye, “Yisimi nɛ o lɔb na!” Ba da sid yis o lɔbi bas na, ka o ziim la tɔn'ɔsi mad dɔkpin la nɛ widi banɛ nɔ o nɛ nɔba la.

english_verse: Jehu left to get something to eat and drink. Then he told some workers, “Even though she was evil, she was a king's daughter, so make sure she has a proper burial.”
translation_verse: Jehu da kpɛn' di ka nu. Ka yʋ'ʋn yɛl ye, “Zaŋimi pu'a kanɛ ka nɔpɔɔr bɛɛ o zug la keŋ mum o, bɔzugɔ o anɛ na'abiig.”

english_verse: But when they went out to bury her body, they found only her skull, her hands, and her feet.
translation_verse: Amaa ban da yi ye ba mum o la, ba da pʋ nyɛ si'ela asɛɛ o zuwauŋ nɛ nɔba nɛ nu'us.

english_verse: They reported this to Jehu, and he said, “The Lord told Elijah the prophet that Jezebel's body would be eaten by dogs right here in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Ka ba lɛb Jehu san'anɛ yɛl o. Ka o lɛbis ye, “Nɛ' anɛ Zugsɔb pian'akanɛ ka o daa pian' dɔlisi yii Elasia onɛ an Tisib teŋ nid la ni na ye, ‘Jezireel teŋgbauŋʋn ka baas ye ba ɔnb Jezebɛl niŋgbiŋ.

english_verse: And he warned that her bones would be spread all over the ground like manure, so that no one could tell who it was.”
translation_verse: Jezebɛl niŋgbiŋ na nwɛnɛ sa'adi dig Jezireel teŋgbauŋ zug, ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi yɛl ye Jezebɛl niŋgbiŋi nwa'.’”

english_verse: Your town is strong, and you're protected by chariots and an armed cavalry. And I know that King Ahab's descendants live there with you. So as soon as you read this letter,
translation_verse: “Ya zugdaan la biis la sadigim bɛɛ ya san'an, ka ya mɛ mɔr zaba tɛrekonam nɛ widi, nɛ teŋ kanɛ kpi'em, nɛ zaba la'ad la, gbauŋ kaŋa ya'a paae ya san'an na,

english_verse: choose the best person for the job and make him the next king. Then be prepared to defend Ahab's family.
translation_verse: yanam gaŋimi bisʋŋ nɛ onɛ nari ya zugdaan biis la sʋʋgin kɛ ka o zin'inɛ o saam na'am gbauŋ la zug ka ya zi'enɛ o nya'aŋi zab.”

english_verse: The officials and leaders read the letters and were very frightened. They said to each other, “Jehu has already killed King Joram and King Ahaziah! We have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Amaa dabiem da gban'e ba ka ba ye, “Na'anama ayi' ya'a daa pʋ nyaŋ oo, tinam na nyaŋɛɛ?”

english_verse: The prime minister, the mayor of the city, as well as the other leaders and Ahab's supporters, sent this answer to Jehu, “We are your servants, Your Majesty, and we will do whatever you tell us. But it's not our place to choose someone to be king. You do what you think is best.”
translation_verse: Alazug onɛ da gɔsid na'am yɛla la, nɛ teŋ la tuongat nɛ na'ayikpɛm nɛ banɛ gur la da tɔlim labakaŋa yɛl Jehu: “Ti anɛ fʋ yammis ka na tʋm fʋn ye ti tʋm si'el wʋsa. Tinam kʋ gaŋ sɔ' ye o an na'aba; fʋn maalim linɛ ka fʋ tɛn'ɛs ka li an sʋm tisif.”

english_verse: Jehu then wrote another letter which said, “If you are on my side and will obey me, then prove it. Bring me the heads of the descendants of Ahab! And be here in Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” The
translation_verse: Jehu da lɛn sɔb gbauŋʋ pɛ'ɛs ayi' yɛti ba ye, “Ya ya'a sid zi'e m nya'aŋ ka siak man yɛl si'el la, alaa fi'igimi ya zugdaan la biis la zuti kɛɛn m san'an Jezireel teŋin bɛog anwa win na.” Na'ab la biis pisyɔpɔi daa bɛ teŋ la tuongatib la san'an ka ba gɔsidi ba.

english_verse: When Jehu was told what had happened, he said, “Put the heads in two piles at the city gate, and leave them there until morning.”
translation_verse: Onɛ daa keŋ nɛ labaar la paae la, o daa yɛl Jehu ye, “Ba mɔr na'abiis la zut la na.” Ka Jehu tis nɔɔr ye, “Digilimini ba dʋya ayi' teŋ la za'anɔɔrin, hali ka bɛog ti nie!”

english_verse: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood where everyone could hear him, and he said, “You people are not guilty of anything. I'm the one who plotted against Joram and had him killed. But who killed all these men?
translation_verse: Bɛogʋ da nie la Jehu daa yina zi'en nidib la wʋsa tuon ka yɛl ye, “Ya wʋsa zi' linɛ maal la ti'irɛ. Manɛ daa yii m zugdaan la nya'aŋ ka kʋʋ o, ka anɔ'ɔnɛ kʋ bama?

english_verse: Listen to me. Everything the Lord's servant Elijah promised about Ahab's family will come true.”
translation_verse: Baŋimi ye, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli zaŋi ken yɛlkanɛ na paae Ahab yidim la sid niŋ ya. Zugsɔb la tʋmnɛ nwɛnɛ on kaanb si'em yii o sankpan'as Elaja ni la.”

english_verse: Then Jehu killed the rest of Ahab's relatives living in Jezreel, as well as his highest officials, his priests, and his closest friends. No one in Ahab's family was left alive in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Dinzug Jehu da kʋ onɛ wʋsa an Ahab yin la nid ka bɛ Jezireel, nɛ o kpɛɛmnam nɛ o zuanam nɛ o maanmaannib, ka sɔ'ɔsɔ pʋ kpɛlim.

english_verse: Jehu left for Samaria, and along the way, he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah at a place where shepherds meet. He asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered. “We're going to visit his family.”
translation_verse: ka sia'al ninsieba banɛ kpin Ahazaya ka bu'osi ba ye, “Ya aan anɔ'ɔnama?” Ka ba lɛbis ye, “Tinam kpinnɛ Ahazaya ka kena ye ti kaae Na'ab la nɛ na'apu'a la yidim.”

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Jehu said to his officers. So they grabbed them and led them to the well near the shepherds' meeting place, where they killed all
translation_verse: Ka o tis nɔɔr ye ba gban'ami ba vʋt ka kɔti ba Beteked bulig la baba. Ba da anɛ dap pisnaasi nɛ ayi'. O da pʋ bas baa nid yinne.

english_verse: As Jehu went on, he saw Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him, then said, “Jehonadab, I'm on your side. Are you on mine?” “Yes, I am.” “Then give me your hand,” Jehu answered. He helped Jehonadab into his chariot
translation_verse: On da yii ani la, o da keŋ sia'al Rekab biig Jehonadab ka o bɛ suori kennɛ o san'an na. Jehu da pʋ'ʋs o ka bu'os ye, “Fʋ anɛ yinne nɛ mam wʋʋ man an yinne nɛ fʋ si'em laa?” Ka Jehonadab lɛbis o ye, “Man anɛ ala mɛn.” Ka Jehu lɛbis ye, “Ya'a aan ala, fʋn gban'ami m nu'ug!” Ka o ʋk o nu'ug ka Jehu gban'e o nu'ugʋ sʋŋ o, ka o dʋʋ kpɛn' zaba tɛreko la ni.

english_verse: and said, “Come with me and see how faithful I am to the Lord.” They rode together in Jehu's chariot
translation_verse: Jehu da yɛl o ye, “Dɔllim ka nyɛ Zugsɔb la yɛla pakim si'em!” Ka o kɛ ka o la'am bɛ nɛ o, o mɛŋ tɛreko la ni ka ba keŋ.

english_verse: to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah. Jehu Kills All the Worshipers of Baal
translation_verse: Jehu n da paae Samaria la, o da kʋ Ahab yidim banɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa. O da san'ami ba, nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la pian' si'em tis Elaja la. Jehu n kʋ Baal nidib wʋsa la yɛ

english_verse: Jehu called together the people in Samaria and said: King Ahab sometimes worshiped Baal, but I will be completely faithful to Baal.
translation_verse: Jehu daa yʋ'ʋn la'as nidib la wʋsa yɛli ba ye, “Ahab da tʋm nɛ bi'ela tis Baal teŋgban, amaa man Jehu na dɔl o nɛ nimmua.

english_verse: I'm going to offer a huge sacrifice to him. So invite his prophets and priests, and be sure everyone who worships him is there. Anyone who doesn't come will be killed. But this was a trick—Jehu was really planning to kill the worshipers of Baal.
translation_verse: Nannanna la'asim Baal nɔdi'esidib la nɛ banɛ tʋmmi tisid o nɛ maanmaannib la wʋsa na. Mɔɔmi ka sɔ' da kpɛlim, bɔzugɔ m bɔɔdi maal nɛ maantita'ari tis Baal. Onɛ pʋ kenaa, m na kʋʋ o!” Amaa Jehu daa ma'ad ala ye ba la'as na ka o kʋʋ ba.

english_verse: He said, “Announce a day of worship for Baal!” After the day had been announced,
translation_verse: Jehu da yɛl ye, “Mɔɔlimi nɛ nimmua ye Baal nidib la la'asim na ka ti tis Baal girima!” Dinzug ba daa sid mɔɔl ala.

english_verse: Jehu sent an invitation to everyone in Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came, and the temple was filled from one end to the other.
translation_verse: Ka o tʋm ka ba giligi mɔɔl Israel wʋsa ka banɛ an Baal nya'andɔlib la wʋsa yina, sɔ' da pʋ kpɛlim. Ba da la'as teŋgban onɛ buon Baal la dɔɔgin hali ka zin'ig la pɛ'ɛl wʋsa.

english_verse: Jehu told the official in charge of the sacred robes to make sure that everyone had a robe to wear.
translation_verse: Ka Jehu yɛl onɛ gur la'ad dɔɔg la ye, “Mɔri fusʋma na pʋdig Baal nya'andɔlib la wʋsa!” O da yis na tɛn'ɛli ba wʋsa.

english_verse: Jehu and Jehonadab went into the temple, and Jehu said to the crowd, “Look around and make sure that only the worshipers of Baal are here. No one who worships the Lord is allowed in.”
translation_verse: Jehu nɛ Jehonadab onɛ an Rekab biig la da kpɛn' Baal maan dɔɔgin la. Jehu da yɛl Baal maanmaannib la ye, “Gɔsimi ka sɔ' da kpɛn' kpɛla na ka ya'a ka' onɛ maan maannɛ tisid Baal ma'aanɛ. Banɛ dɔl Zugsɔb la da pɛ'ɛs kpɛla baa yinne.”

english_verse: As soon as Jehu finished offering the sacrifice, he told the guards and soldiers, “Come in and kill them! Don't let anyone escape.” They slaughtered everyone in the crowd and threw the bodies outside. Then they went back into the temple
translation_verse: Jehu da naae maan kanɛ nyu'od la, o da tis banɛ gur nɛ tuongatib la nɔɔr ye, “Kpɛn'ɛm kʋʋnɛ ba; mid ka ya bas sɔ' ka o pɔns.” Ba da kie-kie ba nɛ sʋ'ʋsi kʋ. Banɛ da gur nɛ tuongatib la da vaae kum la lɔb yiŋ, ka yʋ'ʋn kpɛn' Baal onɛ an teŋgban la dɔkanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la

english_verse: and carried out the image of Baal. They burned it
translation_verse: ka yis teŋgban kugir la na nyu'oe.

english_verse: and broke it into pieces, then they completely destroyed Baal's temple. And since that time, it's been nothing but a public toilet.
translation_verse: Ba da nwa'asi nwa'as kugir la nɛ teŋgban dɔɔg la, ka nidib nɔk zin'ig la maal bangida zin'ig hali ti paae zina.

english_verse: But he did not stop the worship of the gold statues of calves at Dan and Bethel that Jeroboam had made for the people to worship.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala o da pʋ nyaŋi fɛndig ka bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ ka Jeroboam onɛ an Nebat biig la da kɛ ka Israel dim tʋm la, nwɛnɛ ban da wɔ'ɔgid sanlima na'apɔla teŋgbana linɛ ka ba maali zi'el Betel nɛ Dan tɛɛnsin la.

english_verse: Later the Lord said, “Jehu, you have done right by destroying Ahab's entire family, just as I had planned. So I will make sure that the next four kings of Israel will come from your own family.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Jehu ye, “Fʋn sadigim maal sʋ'ʋm tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa man nini ni ka maal Ahab zak la wʋʋ mam pʋn gban'e ye m niŋ si'em la, alazug mam mɛ na kɛ ka fʋ yaan-naas gba ti kpɛn diti fʋ na'am la Israel teŋin.”

english_verse: But Jehu did not completely obey the commands of the Lord God of Israel. Instead, he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam had caused the Israelites to do. Jehu Dies
translation_verse: Nɛ wala Jehu da pʋ gu'usi o mɛŋ ka dɔl Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am zi'ela la nɛ o sʋnf wʋsaa. O da pʋ bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka Jeroboam da kɛ ka Israel dim tʋm la. Jehu kum yɛla

english_verse: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria defeated the Israelites and took control
translation_verse: Dabisban la, Zugsɔb da pin'ili bu'od Israel dim sʋ'ʋlim la. Na'ab Hazael da zabi nyaŋ Israel dimi ba teŋ titɔndis la wʋsa ni.

english_verse: of the regions of Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan River and north of the town of Aroer near the Arnon River. This was the land where the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh had once lived.
translation_verse: O da nyaŋi ba lɛbid Joodan mu'ar dagɔbʋg baba linɛ bɛ Gilead teŋin . Lin yi Aroa teŋin, hali ti paae Gilead nɛ Basan tɛɛns wʋsa.

english_verse: Everything else Jehu did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim yɛla banɛ da maal Na'ab Jehu na'am diib saŋa la, on da tʋm si'el nɛ on da nyaŋi maal si'el la, ba da sɔbi li kpɛn'ɛs Israel Na'anam Gbauŋʋn la.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David and gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: O da yis Na'ab David zaba la'ad linɛ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na tis soogiakpɛɛmnam la.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought Joash outside, where he placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, while the crowd clapped and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Jehoyada da yis na'ab biig la paalʋ na, ka nɔk na'am zupibig la pid o, ka nɔk wada gbauŋʋ tis o ka diis o na'am. Ba da nɔk malʋŋ kpaam bu'oe niŋ o zugin. Ka nidib la nwɛ' nu'us pʋra-pʋra ka tans nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Win na tis Na'ab nyɔvʋr wɔk!”

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with Jehosheba for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah. Jehoiada Makes Joash King of Judah (
translation_verse: On nɛ o biyuol la da kpɛm bɛ suakin Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la yʋma ayuobʋ, Atalia da di na'am saŋsi'a la. Ban da ki'is Atalia la yɛla

english_verse: Joash was only seven years old when this happened.
translation_verse: Joas da anɛ yʋma ayɔpɔi ka di na'am.

english_verse: Joash son of Ahaziah had hidden in the Lord's temple six years. Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest sent for the commanders of the king's special bodyguards and the commanders of the palace guards. They met him at the temple, and he asked them to make a promise in the name of the Lord. Then he brought out Joash
translation_verse: Atalia da dii o na'am la, li yʋma ayɔpɔi saŋa la, Jehoyada da tʋm buol soogianam kpɛɛmnam banɛ sʋ'oe nidib kɔbig-kɔbig la, la'as nɛ banɛ an Kar dim nɛ banɛ gu'ud zin'ig la wʋsa, ye ba la'as Zugsɔb la Pʋ'ʋsim Yin na. O da naal nɔɔr nɛ ba ka kɛ ka ba pɔɔ tis o, Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la pʋʋgin. Ka o yis Na'ab la biig na pa'ali ba.

english_verse: and said to them: Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace.
translation_verse: Ka tis nɔɔr ye, “Yanamɛ ye ya tʋm si'em nwa': Ya ya'a kɛn tʋʋma Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la na, pʋdigir yinne na gur na'ayir la,

english_verse: Another unit will guard Sur Gate, and the third unit will guard the palace gate and relieve the palace guards.
translation_verse: ka yinne gur Sur Yaŋir la, ka banɛ paas atan' la mɛ gur yaŋir kanɛ bɛ banɛ gur Pʋ'ʋsim Zin'igi tia'asid la nya'aŋ.

english_verse: The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash.
translation_verse: Ka yanam banɛ kpɛlim pʋdigir ayi' ka pʋ gur zin'isi'a Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la wʋsa na gur Pʋ'ʋsim Zin'ig la gur na'ab la.

english_verse: Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa zanl o zaba lauk ka ya zi'enɛ gilig na'ab la. Sɔ' ya'a li'el yanamɛ bɛ zin'isi'a la yanam on kʋʋm o. Na'ab la ya'a ken zin'isi'a wʋsa yanam on dɔl o vɛn'-vɛn'.”

english_verse: Then they gave the weapons to their guards, who took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect Joash on every side.
translation_verse: Banɛ gur la wʋsa da mɔri zaba la'adi ba nu'usin ka zi'enɛ gilig na'ab la kpi'e nɛ maan daka Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la naan tuonnɛ keŋ paae nya'aŋ.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns, which was the usual place for the king. The singers and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the people were celebrating and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: O da gɔsi nyɛ Na'ab la zi'e kpi'e zan'antɔlig la nwɛnɛ ba na'am diisʋg malʋŋʋ an si'em la. Kpɛɛmnam la nɛ banɛ piebid na'atana la da zi'e kpi'e Na'ab la, ka nidib la wʋsa yina maan sumalisim ka piebid na'atana. Ka Atalia aans o fuud sʋnsa'aŋ zug, ka tans nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Biriku'annim ye! Biriku'annim ye!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Kill her! But don't do it anywhere near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops and kill anyone who is with her!”
translation_verse: Jehoyada onɛ an maanmaan la da yɛl soogiakpɛɛmnam la nɛ tuongatib la ye, “Mɔr o dɔl soogianam la teŋsʋkʋ yina ka onɛ wʋsa dɔl, yanam on kʋʋm o!” Bɔzugɔ maanmaan la da yɛl ye, “Li pʋ nar ye ba kʋʋ o Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Zin'igin laa.”

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest asked King Joash and the people to promise that they would be faithful to each other and to the Lord.
translation_verse: Jehoyada da naal nɔɔr nɛ Zugsɔb la, nɛ Na'ab la nɛ nidib la, ye ba na an Zugsɔb la nidib. O mɛ da naal nɔɔr nɛ Na'ab la nɛ nidib la.

english_verse: Then the crowd went to the temple built to honor Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal right in front of the altars. After Jehoiada had placed guards around the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Teŋ la nidib wʋsa da la'asi keŋ Baal teŋgban pʋ'ʋsim dɔɔgin la nwa'ae li ka da'ae teŋgban la bas teŋin. Ba da san'am si'el wʋsa, ka gban'e Matan onɛ an Baal maanmaan la kʋʋ o maan bimbima la tuon. Lin nya'aŋ Maanmaan la da bɔ nidibi gu'ul Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Zin'ig la.

english_verse: he called together all the commanders, the king's special bodyguards, the palace guards, and the people. They led Joash from the temple, through the Guards' Gate, and into the palace. He took his place on the throne and became king of Judah.
translation_verse: O da nɔk soogiakpɛɛmnam banɛ sʋ'oe nidib kɔbig-kɔbig nɛ Kar dim nɛ banɛ gu'ud, nɛ nimbanɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa, la'as taaba yis Na'ab la Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Zin'igin la dɔl za'anɔkanɛ ka gu'udib bɛ la ni keŋ na'ayin la. Na'ab la yʋ'ʋn da zin'in o na'am zin'igin.

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Ka teŋ la nidib wʋsa da maal sumalisim. Ka tempʋʋg la da lɛbi niŋ baanlimm, bɔzugɔ ba da kʋ Atalia nɛ sʋ'ʋg na'ayin la.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord.
translation_verse: Joas da tʋm linɛ nar Zugsɔb la nini ni yʋma banɛ wʋsa ka Jehoyada onɛ da an Maanmaan la da san'an o la.

english_verse: The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.
translation_verse: Maan linɛ an taal maan nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan ligidi la da pʋ paasid Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin laa; maanmaannib la da sʋ'oe din. Aram Na'ab Hazael n zab nɛ Juda dim la

english_verse: But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Amaa o da pʋ yis teŋgbana malima zin'ibanɛ bɛ kʋkʋna la zut la, ka nidib la da kpɛm maan maana ani ka nyu'od bʋnnyubisa.

english_verse: and use it to repair the temple whenever you see the need.”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka maanmaan wʋsa di'e ligidi ligidsu'adib la san'anɛ maal zin'ikanɛ san'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la wʋsa.”

english_verse: But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule,
translation_verse: Amaa Joas na'am da mɔr ala ti paae yʋma pisi nɛ atan' ka maanmaannib la nam pʋ maal Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zin'ibanɛ san'am la.

english_verse: Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why aren't you using the money to repair the temple? Don't take any more money for yourselves. It is only to be used to pay for the repairs.”
translation_verse: Alazug Na'ab Joas da la'as Jehoyada onɛ an maanmaan la nɛ o maanmaan taaba la wʋsa bu'osi ba ye, “Bɔ ka ya pʋ maal zin'ibanɛ san'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la? Da lɛn di'e ligidi ya mɛŋa, amaa kɛl ka ba nɔki li maal Yir la.”

english_verse: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la da siakya ye ba kʋ lɛn di'e ligidi ya'asɛ, ka mɛ kʋ maal Pʋ'ʋsim Yir laa.

english_verse: Jehoiada found a wooden box; he cut a hole in the top of it and set it on the right side of the altar where people went into the temple. Whenever someone gave money to the temple, the priests guarding the entrance would put it into this box.
translation_verse: Jehoyada onɛ an Maanmaan la da nɔk la'ad su'ab daka tita'ari kibigi li liŋ la. O da nɔki li zi'eli kpi'el maan daka la, ka li zi'e sɔ' na kpɛn'ɛd Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la datiuŋ baba. Maanmaannib banɛ gur Yir la za'anɔɔr la da nɔkidi ligidbanɛ ka nidib la mɔri ken Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na wʋsa niŋid daka la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags.
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ wʋsa ka ba ti baŋ ye ligidi zu'oe daka la pʋʋgin la, na'ayir gbansɔbid la nɛ maanmaan kpɛɛm la na kenna kaal ligidbanɛ ka nidib la mɔri kɛn Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na nɔki niŋ bɔtnamin.

english_verse: Then they would give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. Some of the money was used to pay the builders, the woodworkers,
translation_verse: Ba ya'a kaali naae, ba zaŋid ligidi la nɛ tis ban gaŋ sieba ye ba gɔs Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la. Ligidkan la ka ba yɔɔd kampintanam nɛ banɛ mɛɛd tan,

english_verse: the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.
translation_verse: nɛ banɛ mɛɛd kuga nɛ banɛ nwa'ad kuga la. Ka da'ad daad nɛ kuga banɛ ka ba kpi'a ye ba maal Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la ka yɔ sam kanɛ wʋsa ka ba kpɛn' maal Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la.

english_verse: While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple.
translation_verse: Ba da pʋ nɔkid ligidkanɛ ka ba mɔri ken Pʋ'ʋsim Yin na la tisid ka ba maan anzurifa laas nɛ la'abanɛ ka ba niŋid ku'om misid nɛ na'atana bɛɛ la'abanɛ wʋsa ka ba nɔkid sanlima bɛɛ anzurifa maannɛ niŋid Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la.

english_verse: The men in charge were honest, so no one had to keep track of the money.
translation_verse: Ba da pʋ kɛt ka nidib la gi'ennɛ pa'an ban di'e li ka yɔɔd tʋmtʋmnib la si'em-si'em, bɔzugɔ ba da tʋmnɛ nɛ pʋpielim.

english_verse: About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Hazael onɛ an Aram Na'ab la da keŋ zab nɛ Gaf dimi nyaŋi ba. Ka lɛn yuki keŋ zab nɛ Jerusalem dim.

english_verse: So Joash collected everything he and his ancestors Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, as well as the gold in the storage rooms in the temple and palace. He sent it all to Hazael as a gift, and when Hazael received it, he ordered his troops to leave Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amaa Joas onɛ da an Juda Na'ab la da nɔk la'asʋma banɛ ka Jehosafat nɛ Joram nɛ Ahazaya banɛ aan o yaanam ka da an Juda na'anam ka pɛsigi tis Zugsɔb la nɛ piinbanɛ ka on mɛ da pɛsig la, nɛ sanlima banɛ ka ba da nyɛ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir suak zin'igin nɛ na'ayin la wʋsa, ka mɔri li wʋsa keŋ tis Hazael onɛ an Aram Na'ab la, ka o nyaan yi ka bas Jerusalem. Joas kum yɛla

english_verse: Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim bʋmbanɛ da maal Joas na'am saŋa nɛ on da tʋm si'el la, ba da sɔbi niŋ Juda Na'anam Gbauŋʋn la.

english_verse: At the end of his rule, some of his officers rebelled against him. Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer murdered him in a building where the land was filled in on the east side of Jerusalem, near the road to Silla. Joash was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Amaziah became king.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛm banɛ da kʋʋ o la da anɛ Jozakar, onɛ an Simeaf biig, nɛ Jozabad onɛ an Seoma biig la. O da kpiya ka ba mum o yaanam yaadin linɛ bɛ David tempʋʋgin la. Ka o biig Amazaya di na'am la.

english_verse: Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in the twenty-third year of Joash's rule in Judah. Jehoahaz ruled
translation_verse: Ahazaya biig Joas n da di Juda na'am la, li yʋma pisi nɛ atan' saŋa la, Jehu biig Jehoahas da di Israel na'am Samaria tempʋʋgin. O da di na'am la yʋma pii nɛ ayɔpɔi.
