english_verse: Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Hebron biribis la: Jeria da an kpɛɛm, ka Amaraya tia'ali ayi' ka Jahaziel tia'al atan' ka Jekameam tia'al anaasi.

english_verse: Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish.
translation_verse: Merari biribis da anɛ: Mahli nɛ Musi. Mahli biribis da anɛ: Eleazar nɛ Kis.

english_verse: Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons.
translation_verse: Eleazar da kpiya ka pʋ mɔr biribisɛ. O da mɔr nɛ bipumis ma'aa. Ba saam pitʋ Kis biribis la da dii ba.

english_verse: Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
translation_verse: Musi biribis da anɛ: Mahli nɛ Eda nɛ Jerimof. Ba wʋsa da la'as nɛ atan'.

english_verse: David said: The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever.
translation_verse: David da dɛŋi yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la sadigim tis o nidib vʋ'ʋsʋm ka kena zin'in Jerusalem saŋa linɛ ka' bɛn la,

english_verse: And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place.
translation_verse: li pʋ lɛn sʋm ye Levi dɔɔg la ziid Pʋ'ʋsim Sʋgʋr la bɛɛ la'abanɛ ka ba mɔri tʋm ani la.”

english_verse: will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure.
translation_verse: Levi dɔɔg dim la tʋʋma da anɛ ba sʋŋ Aaron yaas la ka ba tʋm Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la tʋʋma: banɛ na gur za'ambɛŋ la, nɛ dɔbanɛ bɛ kpikpɛŋ la, ka maan la'ad la ka ba lieb kasi, ka lɛn tʋm tʋʋm sieba banɛ bɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la.

english_verse: They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.
translation_verse: Ba tʋʋma da anɛ ba nɔk bodobodo la pa'al teebul la zug, ka lɛn gɔsid zɔmbaanlig linɛ maan zʋʋd maan la nɛ linɛ nwɛnɛ sa'akɔnt kpi'emis linɛ pʋ gɛndigid danbin la; banɛ da maan bodobodo buudi wʋsa, ka makid la'ad nɛ piini buudi wʋsa.

english_verse: They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done.
translation_verse: Ba da lɛn tʋmnɛ saŋa kanɛ wʋsa ka ba maal nyu'or maan Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar bɛɛ nwadpaalig bɛɛ malima banɛ bɛ wʋsa, ka tʋm Zugsɔb la tuon saŋa wʋsa nɛ lin nar ye ba kal an si'em nɛ ban pa'al ye ba maal si'em la.

english_verse: They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Alazug, Levi dim la da sʋ'oe La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la nɛ zin'ikanɛ an nyain la yɛla, ka sʋŋidi ba ba'abiis banɛ an Aaron yaas la tʋm Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la tʋʋma.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants were then divided into work groups. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Ban da pʋdig Aaron yaas la si'em nwa': Aaron biribis la da anɛ Nadab nɛ Abihu nɛ Eleazar nɛ Itamar.

english_verse: But Nadab and Abihu died long before their father, without having any sons. That's why Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
translation_verse: Amaa Nadab nɛ Abihu da dɛŋi kpi ka ba saam nam pʋ kpii, ba da nam pʋ mɔr biisɛ: alazug Eleazar nɛ Itamar n da tʋm maana la tʋʋma.

english_verse: David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.
translation_verse: Zadok onɛ an Eleazar yaaŋ la nɛ Ahimelek onɛ da an Itamar yaaŋ la da sʋŋ Na'ab David ka o pʋdig tʋʋma la kɔn'ɔb kɔn'ɔbi tis Levi dim la ka pa'ali ba ban na tʋm si'em.

english_verse: groups, and Ithamar's were divided into eight groups, because Eleazar's family included more family leaders.
translation_verse: Ka pii nɛ awai la gaŋ Petahaya, ka pisi la gaŋ Jehezekel.

english_verse: However, both families included temple officials and priests, and so to make sure the work was divided fairly, David asked God what to do.
translation_verse: Ba da pʋdigi ba nɛ ka baregaŋ kae, ba da maalnɛ bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm gaŋ, bɔzugɔ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la kpɛɛmnam nɛ Wina'am gaŋ sieba ka ba tʋmm o tʋʋma la mɛ da bɛ Eleazar nɛ Itamar yaasin la.

english_verse: As each group was assigned their duties, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the Levite wrote down the name of the family leader in charge of that group. The witnesses were David and his officials, as well as Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the family leaders from the clans of the priests and the Levites.
translation_verse: Pa'an onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Semaya ka an Netanɛl biig ka an Levi dɔɔg nid la da sɔbid yʋda la Na'ab la nɛ kpɛɛmnam la tuon: kpɛɛmnam la da anɛ Zadok onɛ an maanmaan kpɛɛm la, nɛ Ahimelek onɛ da aan Abiata biig la, nɛ banɛ gat maanmaannib nɛ Levi dɔɔg dim tuon la. Ba da gaŋ nid yinne Eleazar gbinnin ka gaŋ yinne mɛn Itamar gbinnin la.

english_verse: These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron. The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Ban da tɛn'ɛli ba si'em nwa' ka ba tʋm Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma la, saŋkanɛ wʋsa ka ba kpɛn' ye ba tʋm nwɛnɛ zi'ela banɛ ka ba da di'e ba yaab Aaron san'an la, ka dɔlisid wʋʋ Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la da pa'al o si'em la. Levi dim banɛ kpɛlim la nwa'

english_verse: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
translation_verse: Levi dim la ni banɛ kpɛlim nwa': Amram tuŋʋn la ba da gaŋnɛ Subael; ka Subael tuŋʋn la ka ba gaŋ Jehideya.

english_verse: Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.
translation_verse: Rehabia tuŋʋn la Isaaya da an kpɛɛm.

english_verse: Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
translation_verse: Izar tuŋʋn la ba da gaŋnɛ Sielomof; ka Sielomof tuŋʋn la ka ba gaŋ Jahaf.

english_verse: Hebron had four sons, in the following order: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Hebron biisin la Jeria da an kpɛɛm, ka Amaraya tia'al ayi', ka Jahaziel tia'al atan', ka Jekameam tia'al anaasi.

english_verse: Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
translation_verse: Uziel biig da anɛ Maika; ka Maika biig da an Siamir.

english_verse: Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.
translation_verse: Maika ba'abiig da anɛ Isaaya; ka Isaaya biig an Zakaria.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah.
translation_verse: Merari biribis da anɛ: Mahli nɛ Musi: Jaazia biig da anɛ Beno.

english_verse: Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
translation_verse: Merari yaas banɛ da yit Jaazia ni da anɛ; Beno nɛ Seoham nɛ Zakur nɛ Ibri.

english_verse: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans.
translation_verse: Musi biribis da anɛ Mahli nɛ Eder nɛ Jerimof. Bama da an Levi dim la ka li dɔl wʋʋ ba tuŋʋ an si'em.

english_verse: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_verse: Ba mɛ da maal bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm, wʋʋ ba ba'abiis banɛ an Aaron yaas la da niŋ si'em la, Na'ab David nɛ Zadok nɛ Ahimelek nɛ maanmaannib tuongatib nɛ maanmaannib la wʋsa tuon. Ba da maan bikpɛɛmnam nɛ banɛ an bibaanlʋg la nɛ azinzema.

english_verse: David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:
translation_verse: Na'ab David nɛ zabzabidib tuongatib la da gaŋ Asaf nɛ Heman nɛ Jedutun biribis la ye ba zun'od Wina'am ka nwɛ'ɛd kɔna nɛ siyada banɛ ka ba mɔri yʋ'ʋm la. Nimbanɛ da tʋm tʋʋm kaŋa la nwa':

english_verse: Asaph's four sons, Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, were under the direction of their father and played music whenever the king told them to.
translation_verse: Asaf biisin la ba da gaŋnɛ: Zakur nɛ Josef nɛ Netanaya nɛ Asarela. Asaf biribis la, Asaf mɛŋi da gɔsidi ba ka ba tʋm, ka Na'ab la mɛ gɔsid o ka o tu'asid Zugsɔb la yɛla.

english_verse: His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.
translation_verse: Dap bama wʋsa, ba saamnamɛ da gɔsidi ba ka ba yʋ'ʋm Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la nɛ siyada nɛ kɔna nɛ wiis linɛ ka ba mɔri tʋm Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la. Na'ab la da gɔsid Asaf nɛ Jedutun nɛ Heman ka ba tʋm.

english_verse: David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.
translation_verse: Dasam nɛ bʋnkʋd nɛ pa'annib nɛ zamisidib wʋsa da maal nɛ bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm ye ba baŋ sɔ' wʋsa na tʋm si'em.

english_verse: Obed-Edom had been blessed with eight sons: Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sachar, Nethanel, Ammiel, Issachar, and Peullethai.
translation_verse: ka Ammiel da paas ayuobʋ ka Isaka paas ayɔpɔi ka Pueletai paas anii.

english_verse: Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan.
translation_verse: Semaya biribis da anɛ: Ofini nɛ Refael nɛ Obɛd nɛ Elzabad; o du'adib la sʋʋgin Elihu nɛ Semakaya mɛ da anɛ banɛ nanɛ ba mɛŋ.

english_verse: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
translation_verse: Hilkia da tia'al ka Tabalaya paas atan' ka Zakaria paas anaasi. Hoosa biribis nɛ o du'adib la da la'as nɛ pii nɛ atan' (

english_verse: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.
translation_verse: Ba da pʋdig za'anɔgu'udib la ka li dɔlli ba tuongatib la an si'em, ba tʋʋm da anɛ ba tʋm Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la tʋʋma wʋʋ ban da gaŋi ba Levi taaba si'em la.

english_verse: Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
translation_verse: Za'anɔɔr wʋsa ba da maal nɛ bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm gaŋ banɛ na gur, ka li dɔl yir-yir, bʋnkʋd nɛ bibaanlʋg wʋsa.

english_verse: Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate.
translation_verse: Ya-nya'aŋ za'anɔɔr la bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm da linɛ Sielemaya zug. Ba da bʋgʋlʋm gaŋ o biig Zakaria, onɛ mɔr ya'am ka mi' sa'alʋg sʋ'ʋŋa la, ba da bʋgʋlʋm ka o di'e ya-datiuŋ za'anɔɔr la.

english_verse: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.
translation_verse: Ya-dagɔbʋg za'anɔɔr la, ba da bʋgʋlʋm gban'e nɛ Obededom, ka bʋgʋlʋm la'ad dɔɔg la ka li lii o biribis la zug.

english_verse: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. The guards were assigned the following work schedule:
translation_verse: Ya-tuona za'anɔɔr la, nɛ Salekɛf za'anɔɔr linɛ bɛ suor kanɛ dʋt zugin la, bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm la da lu nɛ Seupim nɛ Hoosa zugin. Banɛ gu'ud la da di'esid nɛ taaba.

english_verse: Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms,
translation_verse: Levi dim banɛ tʋm la, dabisir wʋsa pʋʋgin nidiba ayuobʋ da zi'e ya-nya'aŋ za'anɔɔrin la, gu'ud, ka anaasi zi'e ya-datiuŋ ka anaasi zi'e ya-dagɔbʋg la, ka ayi', yi' tʋm la'ad dɔɔdin la.

english_verse: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim za'ambɛŋ la lɛbisid ya-tuona la, nidiba anaasi da gu'ud ka bɛ suorin la, ka ayi' bɛ za'ambɛŋin la.

english_verse: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari. Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
translation_verse: Ban da pʋdig za'anɔgu'udib la si'em la, banɛ da an Kore nɛ Merari yaas. Banɛ gur ligidi la nɛ kpɛɛm sieba

english_verse: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Ba Levi taaba la da gɔsid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la la'ad ka sieba gɔsid la'abanɛ ka ba pɛsigi tis ka li an kasi la.

english_verse: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.
translation_verse: Ladan yaasi nwa': Ladan da yinɛ Gerson tuŋʋn na, ba da anɛ yidaannam, ba tuongat da anɛ Jehel,

english_verse: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
translation_verse: Jehel biribis da anɛ Zetam nɛ o pitʋ Joel. Banɛ da gɔt Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la la'ad.

english_verse: Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Amram nɛ Izar nɛ Hebron nɛ Uziel yaasi nwa':

english_verse: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.
translation_verse: Subael onɛ da an Gersom onɛ an Moses biig la yaaŋ, onɛ da an kpɛɛm kanɛ gɔsid la'ad la yɛla.

english_verse: The descendants of Gershom's brother Eliezer included Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zichri, and Shelomoth.
translation_verse: O du'adib banɛ yi Elieza gbinnin la da anɛ: Rehabia nɛ Jesaya nɛ Joram nɛ Zikir nɛ Sielomif.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.
translation_verse: Sielomif nɛ o du'adib da sʋ'oe la'ad la wʋsa gɔsig, linɛ ka Na'ab David da pɛsigi tis ka li yi yir tuongatib banɛ da sʋ'oe nidib tusir-tusir nɛ kɔbig-kɔbig, nɛ zabzabidib tuongatib la.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.
translation_verse: Ba da nɔk la'abanɛ ka ba faaɛn zaba ni la sieba tis ye li sʋŋi mɛ' Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Linɛ wʋsa ka Samuel onɛ da an nɔdi'es la nɛ Saul onɛ an Kis biig la nɛ Abner onɛ an Nier biig la nɛ Joab onɛ an Zeruyia biig la da tis la, nɛ la'abanɛ ka ba da pɛsig la wʋsa, Sielomif nɛ o du'adib la da gɔsidi li yɛla.

english_verse: Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
translation_verse: Izar tuŋʋn la, Kanania nɛ o biribis la tʋʋma da pʋ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, ba da anɛ gbansɔbidib nɛ sariakatib Israel nidib la wʋsa ni.

english_verse: of his relatives, who were all respected family leaders, to be the officials in charge of all religious and government business in the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. David found out about these men during the fortieth year of his rule, when he had a list made of all the families in the Hebron clan. They were from the town of Jazer in the territory of Gilead.
translation_verse: ); ba da anɛ banɛ nanɛ ba mɛŋ ka lɛn an yir kpɛɛmnam, Na'ab David da kɛ ka ba gɔsid Reuben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase dɔɔg pʋsʋk la, zaŋi ken linɛ wʋsa an Wina'am nɛ na'ab la yɛla ni.

english_verse: Jerijah was the leader of the Hebron clan. David assigned him and
translation_verse: Jeria du'adib la da la'as nɛ tusa ayi' nɛ kɔbisyɔpɔi (

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records. Officials in Charge of the King's Property
translation_verse: Joab onɛ an Zeruyia biig la da pin'ili kaal dap la, amaa o da pʋ kaali naae. Yɛltɔɔg da kɛn Israel dim zugin na kaalʋg la zug, ka ba kal la pʋ sɔbi niŋ David na'am gbana la nii. Na'ab la tʋmtʋmnib yɛla

english_verse: who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and whose son Ammizabad was also an army commander;
translation_verse: Benaya kaŋa da an ninkpi'euŋ nidib pistan' la sʋʋgin, ka aan ba tuongat. O biig Amizabad da aan o nidib la tuongat.

english_verse: in the fourth month, Asahel the brother of Joab, whose son Zebadiah took over command after him;
translation_verse: Nwadkanɛ paas anaasi la ni tuongat da anɛ Asahel onɛ da an Joab pitʋ la; o biig Zebadaya da di'e o zin'ig. Ban mɛ da la'as nɛ tusa pisi nɛ anaasi (

english_verse: years of age, because the Lord had promised long ago that Israel would have as many people as there are stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Efiram dɔɔg la ni, Hosea onɛ an Azazaya biig la da aan ba tuongat. Manase dɔɔg pʋsʋk la, Joel onɛ an Pedaya biig la da aan ba tuongat.

english_verse: Azmaveth the son of Adiel was in charge of the king's personal storage rooms. Jonathan the son of Uzziah was in charge of the king's other storerooms that were in the towns, the villages, and the defense towers in Israel.
translation_verse: Azmavef onɛ an Adiel biig la da gur na'ayir la'ad dɔɔg la. Jonatan onɛ an Uzia biig la da gɔsid la'ad dɔɔd banɛ bɛ sʋ'ʋlim bibisin la nɛ tempʋʋsin la'an nɛ tembibisin nɛ zaŋguom banɛ ka ba dʋti gu'ud teŋ la.

english_verse: Ezri the son of Chelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the king's land.
translation_verse: Ezir onɛ an Kɛlub biig la da gɔsid tʋmtʋmnib banɛ tʋm pɔɔdin la.

english_verse: Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the vineyards, and Zabdi from Shepham was in charge of storing the wine.
translation_verse: Simie onɛ an Rama teŋ nid la da gɔsid tiwanna pɔɔd la. Zabdi onɛ da an Siefam teŋ nid la da gɔsid tiwala linɛ ka ba mɔri maan daam la.

english_verse: Baal Hanan from Geder was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the western foothills, and Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.
translation_verse: Baal-Hanan onɛ an Geder teŋ nid la da gɔsid olif tiis nɛ kekama banɛ bɛ Sefela teŋgbauŋʋn la. Joas n da sʋ'oe olif tiis la pʋdigir.

english_verse: Shitrai from Sharon was responsible for the cattle that were kept in Sharon Plain, and Shaphat son of Adlai was responsible for those kept in the valleys.
translation_verse: Sitiraae onɛ an Saron teŋ nid la da gɔsid niigi yaama yɛla Saron teŋgbauŋʋn. Safat onɛ an Adilai biig la da gɔsid niigi banɛ bɛ bɔn'ɔdin la.

english_verse: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, Jehdeiah from Meronoth was in charge of the donkeys, and Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the sheep and goats.
translation_verse: Obil onɛ an Isimael buudi la da gɔsid yʋgʋma yɛla. Jehideya onɛ an Meronof teŋ nid la da gɔsid bʋmis yɛla.

english_verse: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.
translation_verse: Jonatan onɛ an David saambil la da anɛ onɛ san'an nidib, ka an dau kanɛ mɔr ya'am, ka lɛn an pa'an. Jehel onɛ an Hakmon biig la da gɔsid Na'ab la biribis.

english_verse: Ahithophel and Hushai the Archite were two of David's advisors.
translation_verse: Ahitofel da anɛ Na'ab la sa'ansa'an. Husai onɛ da an Arik nid la da anɛ Na'ab Zua.

english_verse: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.
translation_verse: Banɛ da di'e Ahitofel zin'ig la da anɛ Jehoyada onɛ an Benaya biig la nɛ Abiata. Joab n da an Na'ab zabzabidib la kpɛɛm.

english_verse: David called a meeting in Jerusalem for all of Israel's leaders, including the tribal leaders, the government officials, the army commanders, the officials in charge of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, and the brave warriors.
translation_verse: David da buol Israel kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa ka ba la'as Jerusalem tempʋʋgin na. Ba da anɛ dɔɔd la kpɛɛmnam, nɛ kpɛɛm banɛ gɔsid banɛ tʋm Na'ab tʋʋma la, nɛ banɛ gat zabzabidib tusir-tusir bɛɛ kɔbig-kɔbig tuon la, nɛ kpɛɛm banɛ gɔsid Na'ab la nɛ biribis la la'ad nɛ ba bʋnkɔnbid la, la'an nɛ na'ayikpɛm, nɛ zaba tuongatib nɛ zabzabidib banɛ sʋnfʋ kpi'em la.

english_verse: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple,
translation_verse: Na'ab David da duoe zi'enɛ o nɔba zug ka yɛli ba ye, “Kɛlisimi, m ba'abiis nɛ m nidiba! M daa gban'e m sʋnfʋn ye m mɛ' yir ka li an vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'igi tis Zugsɔb nɔnaar Daka la, ka an Wina'am nɔba zi'elʋg zin'ig. M daa gban'e ye m mɛɛ li,

english_verse: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
translation_verse: amaa Wina'am daa yɛlim ye, ‘Li ka' fʋnɛ na mɛ' yiri tis mam yʋ'ʋrɛ, bɔzugɔ fʋ anɛ zabzabid ka yis ziim bɛdegʋ.’

english_verse: The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings.
translation_verse: “La'an nɛ wala Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la gaŋ mam, m yidim la wʋsa sʋʋgin ye m an Israel na'ab yʋma linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. O da gaŋ Juda ye o an tuongat, Juda dɔɔg la ni ka o gaŋ man zakin la, ka li niŋ o malisim ka o gaŋ mam m saam biisin la diis Israel wʋsa na'ab.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la tisim biribis bɛdegʋ, ka ba wʋsa sʋʋgin o gaŋi m biig Solomon ye o zin'in na'am gbauŋ la zugʋ sʋ'oe Zugsɔb sʋ'ʋlim gɔsid Israel wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.
translation_verse: O da yɛlim ye, ‘Solomon onɛ aan fʋ biig la na mɛɛ m yir la, bɔzugɔ manɛ gaŋ o ye o aan m biig ka mam na aan o saam.

english_verse: If he continues to obey my laws and commands, his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka o sʋ'ʋlim la zi'en saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, o ya'a kpɛn siakidi m nɔzi'elʋg nɛ wada la wʋʋ lin an si'em nannanna.’”

english_verse: My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: Na'ab David da lɛn yɛli ba ye, “Alazug m yɛli ya, Israel dim wʋsa nini ni, nɛ Zugsɔb nimbanɛ la'as la tuon, nɛ Wina'am mɛŋ tʋba ni: gu'usimi ka dɔl Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la, ka sʋ'ʋgi teŋ la hali ka ti basi tisi ya yaas ka li an faar saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever.
translation_verse: Ka fʋn onɛ aan m biig Solomon nɛ, baŋim Wina'am onɛ aan fʋ saam Wina'am la, ka dɔl o nɛ fʋ sʋnf wʋsa ka pɛsigi fʋ mɛŋi tis o, ka Zugsɔb la mi' sɔ' wʋsa sʋnf ka mi' sɔ' wʋsa pʋtɛn'ɛri tɛn'ɛsid si'el nɛ linɛ dɔlli li nya'aŋ. Fʋ ya'a ieed o, fʋ na nyɛɛ o; amaa fʋ ya'a ki'is o, o na zan'asif saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
translation_verse: Gu'usimi fʋ mɛŋ nannanna, ka Zugsɔb la gaŋif ye fʋ mɛ' yir ka li lieb o pʋ'ʋsim zin'ig. Kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ mɛŋ ka tʋm tʋʋma la.”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.
translation_verse: David da pa'al o biig Solomon Yir la na mɛ' si'em. O da pa'al o za'ambɛŋ nɛ li la'ad su'ab dɔɔd, nɛ dɔɔd banɛ na bɛɛ agɔla, nɛ dɔɔd banɛ na bɛ teŋsʋk nɛ zin'ikanɛ na maal suguru sɔsʋg maan la.

english_verse: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: O da pa'al o suobanɛ ka Siig la nɔki niŋ o pʋtɛn'ɛrin zaŋi ken Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la za'as la, nɛ dɔbanɛ gilig la, nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la'ad dɔɔd la nɛ dɔbanɛ ka ba na su'a la'abanɛ ka ba pɛsigi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.
translation_verse: O da pa'al o on na pʋdig maanmaannib la nɛ Levi dim la si'em, nɛ ban na tʋm si'em Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, nɛ la'abanɛ wʋsa ka ba na nɔki tʋm Yin la.

english_verse: the gold table which held the sacred loaves of bread, the tables made of silver,
translation_verse: Ka pa'al o bodobodo teebul la sanlima la nar ye li tɛbisim zem si'em, nɛ anzurifa teebul la tɛbisim nar ye li zem si'em;

english_verse: the gold incense altar, and the gold statue of a chariot for the winged creatures which were on the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Sanlim sʋŋ kanɛ na maal bimbim kanɛ nyu'od bʋnyubisa la tɛbisim nar ye li tɛbis si'em. O mɛ da pa'al o on na maal tɛreko la si'em. Ka linɛ an sanlim kɛrubnam banɛ yadigi ba kpʋkpama ka li ma'asim ligil Zugsɔb nɔnaar Daka la maalʋg.

english_verse: David then said to Solomon: The Lord showed me how his temple is to be built.
translation_verse: David da yɛl o ye, “Nɛ' wʋsa anɛ Zugsɔb la sɔbi tisim, ka kɛ ka m baŋ mɛɛb la na an si'em ka gban'e li gbin sʋ'ʋŋa.”

english_verse: But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him.
translation_verse: Na'ab David mɛ da lɛn yɛl o biig Solomon ye, “Kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ sʋnf ka tʋm tʋʋma la nɛ kpi'euŋ, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ an man Wina'am la bɛ nɛf. O kʋ kɛ ka fʋ di nyan bɛɛ basi fɔ, hali ka tʋʋma la wʋsa linɛ an Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la mɛɛb la ti naae.

english_verse: The priests and Levites have been assigned their duties, and all the skilled workers are prepared to do their work. The people and their leaders will do anything you tell them.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la na pʋdig tʋʋma la tʋm Wina'am Yin la wʋʋ lin zi'el si'em, ka dau kanɛ wʋsa mi' tʋʋma na bɔɔd ye o sʋŋi fʋ tʋm tʋʋma la. Kpɛɛmnam la nɛ nidib la wʋsa na siak fʋn tis nɔsi'a wʋsa.”

english_verse: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
translation_verse: ba na nɔki li wʋsa tʋm sanlima nɛ anzurifa tʋʋma, nɛ nimbanɛ wʋsa mi' tʋʋma ka na tʋm la. Nannanna anɔ'ɔnɛ bɔɔd ye o pɛsig o mɛŋ zina tis Zugsɔba?”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, the family leaders, the tribal leaders, the army commanders, and the government officials voluntarily gave gifts
translation_verse: Ka yir tuongatib nɛ dɔɔd kpɛɛmnam nɛ banɛ gat zabzabidib tusir-tusir nɛ kɔbig-kɔbig tuon la nɛ kpɛɛm banɛ gɔsid Na'ab tʋʋma la tis nɛ ba ya'amlɛog.

english_verse: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
translation_verse: Onɛ da mɔr kugsʋma wʋsa da nɔki tis la'ad suak zin'ig linɛ ka Jehel onɛ yi Gerson tuŋʋn la da gur la, ye li sʋŋ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la mɛɛb.

english_verse: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated. David Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Nidib la da mɔr sumalisim ba kpɛɛmnam la da tis nɛ ba sʋʋnr wʋsa la zug, bɔzugɔ ba da nɔk la'ad la tis Zugsɔb la nɛ ba sʋʋnr wʋsa. Na'ab David sʋnf mɛ da ma'aya hali. Na'ab David pʋ'ʋsʋg yɛla

english_verse: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord: I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.
translation_verse: David da wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr nidib la wʋsa tuonnɛ yɛt ye, “Wɔ'ɔgir anɛ fʋ din, o Zugsɔb Wina'am, fʋn kanɛ an Israel ba', saŋa linɛ ka' bɛn la.

english_verse: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world,
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ sʋ'oe kpi'euŋ nɛ paŋ nɛ girima, bɔzugɔ linɛ wʋsa bɛɛ agɔl nɛ teŋin anɛ fʋ din. Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ sʋ'oe sʋ'ʋlim la: Fʋ paamid girima ka li pa'al ye fʋʋ an si'el wʋsa kpɛɛm.

english_verse: and you rule with strength and power. You make people rich and powerful and famous.
translation_verse: Arezak nɛ na'asi yitnɛ fʋ san'an na; fʋnɛ sʋ'oe si'el wʋsa. Fʋ nu'usin ka paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ bɛ, fʋnɛ dʋ'ʋsid ka tisid sɔ' wʋsa na'asi nɛ paŋ.

english_verse: We thank you, our God, and praise you.
translation_verse: Nannanna, ti Wina'am, ti pʋ'ʋsidif bareka ka zun'odi fʋ yʋ'ʋtita'ar la.”

english_verse: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.
translation_verse: Na'ab David da lɛn yɛl ye, “Amaa man aan anɔ'ɔnɛ, ka m nidib la aan anɔ'ɔnam ka nyaŋi tis bɛdegʋ anwana? Si'el wʋsa yinɛ fʋ san'an na, tinam tis nɛ linɛ yii fʋ nu'ugin na ma'aa.

english_verse: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
translation_verse: Ti anɛ buudzʋŋ nɛ saamme fʋ nini ni wʋʋ ti yaanam wʋsa da an si'em la. Ti bɛllim dunia nwa' ni nwɛnɛ ma'asim nɛ ka pʋ ya'asid gaadigɔ, ka ti'ir kae.

english_verse: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am, ya'a kpɛlim tinamɛ tis si'el ye li sʋŋi mɛ' yiri tisi fʋ yʋ'ʋr linɛ an kasi la, li yinɛ fʋ nu'ugin na, li wʋsa anɛ fʋ din.

english_verse: But we are happy, because everyone has voluntarily given you these things. You know what is in everyone's heart, and you are pleased when people are honest.
translation_verse: M Wina'am, mam mi' ye fʋ kpansid ninsaal sʋnf, ka sɔ' ya'a mɔr girima nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛsʋma li na malisif. M tis nɛ' wʋsa nɛ ya'amlɛog nɛ pʋʋg nyain. Ka nannanna m mɛ nyɛɛ fʋ nimbanɛ bɛ kpɛla la tisif nɛ sumalisim si'em nɛ pʋʋg nyain.

english_verse: Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔb, Wina'am onɛ an Abraham nɛ Isaak nɛ Israel ba', kɛl ka fʋ nidib la kpɛm mɔr ya'amlɛog kaŋa ba sʋnfʋn saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, ka kɛ ka ba pɛligi ba pʋʋgʋ tisif.

english_verse: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.
translation_verse: Ka tisim biig Solomon pʋtɛn'ɛr linɛ ka o na pɛsig o mɛŋi dɔlli fʋ nɔzi'elʋg la, fʋn bɔɔd si'el nɛ fʋ gban'ar la, ka mɔɔ mɛ' yir tita'ar linɛ ka m la'asi li la'adi digil la.”

english_verse: David then said to the people, “Now it's your turn to praise the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped!” So everyone praised the Lord, and they bowed down to honor him and David their king. Solomon Is Crowned King
translation_verse: David da yɛl nidib la wʋsa ye, “Wɔ'ɔgimi Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la!” Ka ba wʋsa wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la; ba wʋsa da vanbin Zugsɔb nɛ Na'ab la tuon. Solomon n di na'am la yɛla

english_verse: The people were very happy, and they ate and drank there at the Lord's altar. That same day, Solomon was again crowned king. The people celebrated and poured olive oil on Solomon's head to show that he would be their next king. They also poured oil on Zadok's head to show that he was their priest.
translation_verse: Ba da di ka nu nɛ sumalisim daakan la, Zugsɔb la tuon. Ka lɛn siak ye Solomon onɛ an David biig la anɛ na'ab, ka bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ o zugin Zugsɔb la tuon ye o an tuongat, ka mɛ bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ Zadok zug ye o an maanmaan.

english_verse: So Solomon became king after David his father. Solomon was successful, and everyone in Israel obeyed him.
translation_verse: Alazug Solomon da zin'in na'am gbauŋ la zug Zugsɔb sʋ'ʋlimin la, lieb na'abi di'e o saam David zin'ig. Si'el wʋsa da keŋ sʋ'ʋŋa tis o, ka Israel dim siak o nɔɔr.

english_verse: Every official and every soldier, as well as all of David's other sons, were loyal to him.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa nɛ ninkpi'ema la nɛ Na'ab David biribis la wʋsa da siak ka zi'el nɔɔr ye ba na sie ba mɛŋi tis Na'ab Solomon.

english_verse: The Lord made Solomon a great king, and the whole nation was amazed at how famous he was. In fact, no other king of Israel was as great as Solomon. David Dies
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da dʋ'ʋs Solomon ka Israel wʋsa nyɛ, ka kɛ ka o na'am la paam girima, linɛ ka na'asɔ' nan zi' paami li tiraan Israel teŋinɛ. David kum yɛla

english_verse: David the son of Jesse was king of Israel
translation_verse: David onɛ an Jese biig la da an Israel wʋsa na'ab.

english_verse: David was rich and respected and lived to be an old man. Then he died, and his son Solomon became king.
translation_verse: O yʋma da yuug ya, ka o paam arezak nɛ girima, ka kʋdig sʋ'ʋŋa ka nyaan kpi; ka o biig Solomon da di'e na'am la di.

english_verse: Everything David did while he was king is included in the history written by the prophets Samuel, Nathan, and Gad.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim Na'ab David na'am pin'ilʋgʋ keŋ paae li bɛn la, ba sɔbi li yɛla niŋ Samuel nɛ Natan nɛ Gad banɛ da an Wina'am nɔdi'esib la gbana ni,

english_verse: They wrote about his powerful rule and about the things that happened not only to him, but also to Israel and the other nations.
translation_verse: la'an nɛ o na'am nɛ o paŋ yɛla, nɛ bʋmbanɛ wʋsa da tʋm o saŋa la, nɛ Israel la'an nɛ tembanɛ gilig la wʋsa.

english_verse: While Solomon was king of Israel, there was silver and gold everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.
translation_verse: Na'ab la da kɛ ka anzurifa nɛ sanlima an na'ana Jerusalem tempʋʋgin nwɛnɛ kuga nɛ, ka na'aziinr dasʋma zu'oe nwɛnɛ kekama daadi zu'oe mɔɔgin si'em la.

english_verse: and there at the bronze altar, Solomon offered a thousand animals as sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Solomon da kpɛn' Zugsɔb La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la zakin la maal nyu'or maana tusir, kʋntzɛn'ug bimbim la zug.

english_verse: God appeared to Solomon that night in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Wina'am da nie o mɛŋi pa'al Solomon yʋ'ʋŋ kan la ka yɛl o ye, “Sɔsim fʋn bɔɔd ye m tisif si'el wʋsa.”

english_verse: Solomon answered: Lord God, you were always loyal to my father David, and now you have made me king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Solomon lɛbis Wina'am ye, “Fʋ pa'ali fʋ nɔŋilim nɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm David onɛ aan m saam la ka kɛ ka man lɛdig o zin'igi dii o na'am.

english_verse: I am supposed to rule these people, but there are as many of them as there are specks of dust on the ground. So keep the promise you made to my father
translation_verse: Nannanna, Zugsɔb Wina'am, fʋ tʋm sida tisim saam Na'ab David ka kɛ ka m di na'am sʋ'oe fʋ nimbanɛ zu'oe wʋʋ teŋin titan nɛ.

english_verse: God replied: Solomon, you could have asked me to make you rich or famous or to let you live a long time. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom and knowledge to rule my people.
translation_verse: Wina'am da yɛl Na'ab Solomon ye, “Tɔ'! Fʋ sʋnfʋ gban'e si'em la an sʋm. Fʋ pʋ sɔs kpan'am nɛ la'ad nɛ na'asi fʋ mɛŋ yɛllɛ, bɛɛ sɔs ye fʋ bi'emnam kpii, fʋ mɛ pʋ sɔs ye fʋ kpɛn vʋe yuug halii, amaa ka sɔs nɛ ya'am nɛ baŋir ye fʋ guri m nidib la nɛ sida. Fʋn sadigim gban'e ala la,

english_verse: Solomon then left Gibeon and returned to Jerusalem, the capital city of Israel. Solomon's Wealth (
translation_verse: Na'ab Solomon yʋ'ʋn da naan Fuug Sʋgʋrin la Gibeon teŋin yii lɛb Jerusalem tempʋʋginɛ zin'in na'am gbauŋ la zug. Na'ab Solomon kpan'am la yɛla (

english_verse: horses that he kept in Jerusalem and other towns.
translation_verse: ), ka kɛ ka ba bɛɛ o widi tempʋʋdin la, ka sieba mɛ bɛɛ o san'an Jerusalem tempʋʋgin.

english_verse: This will be a great temple, because our God is greater than all other gods.
translation_verse: Yir kanɛ ka m ye m mɛ' la na an yitita'ar bɔzugɔ ti Wina'am la anɛ Wina'am tita'ari gaad wina wʋsa.

english_verse: Praise the Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth! He has given David a son who isn't only wise and smart, but who has the knowledge to build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Ka Hiram lɛn yɛl ye, “Bareka bɛ nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la, onɛ maal agɔl nɛ teŋ! Onɛ tis Na'ab David bikanɛ mɔr ya'am, ka tis o baŋir ka kɛ ka o mi' bɛog yɛla, onɛ ye o mɛ' yiri tis Zugsɔb la nɛ na'ayiri tis o mɛŋ.

english_verse: of them to cut stone from the hills. He chose
translation_verse: ) ka ba bɛ zuoya la ni, nɛ tusa atan' nɛ kɔbisyuobʋ (

english_verse: others to supervise the workers and to make sure the work was completed.
translation_verse: ) banɛ na gɔt banɛ tʋm la.

english_verse: I am building a temple where the Lord my God will be worshiped. Sweet-smelling incense will be burned there, and sacred bread will be offered to him. Worshipers will offer sacrifices to the Lord every morning and evening, every Sabbath, and on the first day of each month, as well as during all our religious festivals. These things will be done for all time, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Nannanna m mɔɔdnɛ ye m mɛ' yiri tisim Zugsɔb Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr ka pɛsigi tis o, ka ba nyu'od bʋnnyubisa ani, ka digin pɛsigir bodobodo la saŋa wʋsa, ka nyu'od nyu'or maan la bɛogʋn nɛ zaam wʋsa nɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar nɛ Nwadpaalig nɛ malima banɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am yɛli zi'el la. Nɛ'ɛŋa an bʋn linɛ ka Israel dim na maan saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Send me a worker who can not only carve, but who can work with gold, silver, bronze, and iron, as well as make brightly colored cloth. The person you send will work here in Judah and Jerusalem with the skilled workers that my father has already hired.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ gaŋim dau kanɛ mi' tʋʋma tisim na. Kɛl ka o anɛ onɛ mi' sanlima nɛ anzurifa nɛ kʋntzɛn'ug nɛ kʋnt, nɛ fuud gʋlib tʋʋma nɛ li buudi wʋsa, ka o kena la'as nɛ m nidib la Juda nɛ Jerusalem teŋin, nɔk la'abanɛ ka m saam David la'asi digil la tʋm.

english_verse: I know that you have workers who are experts at cutting lumber in Lebanon. So would you please send me some cedar, pine, and juniper logs? My workers will be there to help them,
translation_verse: Tisim na'aziinr daad nɛ dasʋma buudi wʋsa linɛ bɛ Lebanon teŋin na, bɔzugɔ m mi' ye fʋ nidib la mi' daad tʋʋma anina. Man nidib la nɛ fʋ nidib la na la'asi tʋm;

english_verse: because I'll need a lot of lumber to build such a large and glorious temple.

translation_verse: Solomon n da mɛ' Zugsɔb Yir nɛ na'ayir la naae ka maal on bɔɔd ye o maal Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la nɛ na'ayir linɛ ka o bɛ la si'em la,

translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da nie o mɛŋi pa'al o yʋ'ʋŋ ka yɛl ye, “M wʋmi fʋ sɔsʋg ka gaŋ zin'ikaŋa tisim mɛŋ ka li na an maan Yir.

english_verse: Suppose I hold back the rain or send locusts to eat the crops or make my people suffer with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: M ya'a ti yɔɔ agɔl ka saa pʋ niida, bɛɛ kɛ ka na'azɔmnam kena san'am zʋʋd la, bɛɛ kɛ ka ban'as kɛɛn m nidib la san'an na,

english_verse: I will hear the prayers made in this temple,
translation_verse: Nannanna m nini na yɔ'ɔg ka m tʋba kɛlisid winsɔsʋg kanɛ ka ya sɔsid kpɛla.

english_verse: because it belongs to me, and this is where I will be worshiped forever. I will never stop watching over it.
translation_verse: Man gaŋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yikaŋa ka maali li nyain linɛ na kɛ ka m yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ ani saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. M nini nɛ m sʋnf na bɛɛ ani saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Your father David obeyed me, and now, Solomon, you must do the same. Obey my laws and teachings,
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlimnɛ fʋ, fʋ ya'a dɔllim nɛ pʋʋg nyain nɛ sida, wʋʋ fʋ saam David n da tʋm si'em la, ka dɔlis man yɛlif si'em la ka tɛnri m nɔzi'ela nɛ m wada la,

english_verse: and I will keep my solemn promise to him that someone from your family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: m na kɛ ka fʋ na'am zi'en kiŋ-kiŋ Israel teŋin saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, wʋʋ man da zi'el nɔɔri tisi fʋ saam David ye o kʋ kɔ'ɔŋ dau onɛ na zin'in Israel na'am gbauŋ zug la.

english_verse: But if you or any of the people of Israel disobey my laws or start worshiping foreign gods,

english_verse: Solomon did not force the Israelites to do his work. Instead, they were his soldiers, officers, army commanders, and cavalry troops. translation_verse: Amaa Solomon da pʋ kɛ ka Israel nidib la baa yinne tʋm alaa. Ba da anɛ zabzabidib nɛ na'ayikpɛm nɛ kpi'emnam nɛ o soogianam tuongatib nɛ o zaba tɛrekonam tuongatib nɛ banɛ gɔsid tɛrekonam la.

english_verse: After that, Solomon had his workers rebuild the towns that Hiram had given him. Then Solomon sent Israelites to live in those towns.
translation_verse: Na'ab Solomon da maligim mɛ' teŋkpɛmis banɛ ka Na'ab Hiram da tis o la, ka zin'il Israel dim ani.

english_verse: Solomon attacked and captured the town of Hamath-Zobah.
translation_verse: Solomon yʋ'ʋn da keŋ Hamat Zoba teŋin zabi faaɛn li.

english_verse: He ordered his workers to build the town of Tadmor in the desert and some towns in Hamath where he could keep his supplies.
translation_verse: O mɛ da mɛ' Tadimɔ tempʋʋg linɛ bɛ pipirigin la, nɛ tempʋbanɛ bɛ Hamat sʋ'ʋlimin la nɛ ba la'ad dɔɔd.

english_verse: He did the same thing to the town of Baalath and to the cities where he kept supplies, chariots, and horses. Solomon ordered his workers to build whatever he wanted in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and anywhere else in his kingdom.
translation_verse: la'an nɛ Baalaf tempʋʋgin mɔr ala paae tempʋbanɛ ka o nɔk o la'adi digil la, nɛ tɛɛns banɛ ka o zaba tɛrekonam nɛ widi bɛ la. Ka lɛn kɛ ka ba mɛ' on da bɔɔd ye o mɛ' si'el Jerusalem tempʋʋgin nɛ Lebanon teŋgbauŋʋn nɛ sʋ'ʋlim kanɛ ka o sʋ'oe la wʋsa.

english_verse: Solomon's wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, moved from the part of Jerusalem called David's City to her new palace that Solomon had built. The sacred chest had been kept in David's City, which made his palace sacred, and so Solomon's wife could no longer live there.
translation_verse: Solomon da nɔk Faaro pu'ayua la yi David tempʋʋgin la mɔr o lɛb na'ayir kanɛ ka o mɛɛ tis o la. O da yɛl ye, “M pu'a nwa kʋ bɛ David onɛ da an Israel na'ab la yinnɛ, bɔzugɔ zin'ibanɛ ka Zugsɔb daka la keŋ la anɛ kasi.”

english_verse: Solomon offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar he had built in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb maan daka linɛ ka Na'ab Solomon da mɛ' Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg za'ambɛŋ la tuon la zugin ka o da maan nyu'or maana tisid Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: He followed the requirements that Moses had given for sacrifices offered on the Sabbath, on the first day of each month, the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Ka li dɔl wʋʋ daar wʋsa maannɛ nar ye li maal si'em, wʋʋ Moses n da tis nɔɔr si'em zaŋi ken Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la yɛla, nɛ nwadpaalig nɛ malima atan' banɛ maan yʋʋm-yʋʋm ka an Bodobodo Dinɛ Ka' Danbin Malʋŋ la, nɛ Bakuainam Malʋŋ nɛ Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ la.

english_verse: Solomon then assigned the priests and the Levites their duties at the temple, and he followed the instructions that his father, the man of God, had given him. Some of the Levites were to lead music and help the priests in their duties, and others were to guard the temple gates
translation_verse: O da dɔl o saam David suoya la, ka gaŋ maanmaannibi pʋdigi ba niŋ sɔ' wʋsa nɛ o tʋʋma zin'ig, nɛ Levi dɔɔg dim la ye ba gaad yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la tuon ka sʋŋid maanmaannib la wʋʋ daar wʋsa tʋʋma nari li an si'em. english_verse: Everything Solomon had planned to do was now finished—from the laying of the temple's foundation to its completion.

translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Hiram da tis o anrintitada ka o mɛŋ nimbanɛ mi' anrʋŋ tʋʋma sʋ'ʋŋa la mɔri keŋ, bama nɛ Solomon mɛŋ nidib la da mɔr anrima la lɔ'ɔŋ Ofir sʋ'ʋlim ka mɔr sanlima lɛb na tis Na'ab Solomon ka li tɛbisim zu'oe hali.

translation_verse: Amaa m pʋ niŋin ban yɛl si'el la yaddaa, asɛɛ mam kena ka nyɛ nɛ m mɛŋ nini la. Sida, hali man wʋm si'em fʋ ya'am nɛ fʋ kpan'am la yɛla la pʋ paae man kena nyɛ si'el la pʋsʋkɔ.

english_verse: Your people and officials are lucky to be here where they can listen to the wise things you say.

english_verse: I praise the Lord your God. He is pleased with you and has made you king of Israel. God loves the people of this country and will never desert them, so he has given them a king who will rule fairly and honestly.
translation_verse: Na'asi bɛ nɛ fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ nɔŋif ka zin'ilif Israel na'am gbauŋ zug la. Bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb la nɔŋilim nɛ Israel dimi ka' naar la zug ka o diisif na'am ye fʋ kɛ ka sida nɛ pʋpielim bɛ.”

english_verse: The Queen of Sheba gave Solomon more than four tons of gold, a large amount of jewels, and the best spices anyone had ever seen.
translation_verse: O da nɔk sanlima tis Na'ab la ka li tɛbisim zu'oe hali, nɛ bʋnnyubisa nɛ kugsʋma banɛ ligidi zu'oe bɛdegʋ: lin yi saŋkan la ti paae zina, sɔ' nan zi' mɔri bʋnnyubisa na ka li zu'oe paae Seeba pu'ana'ab la da mɔr si'el na laa.

translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim bʋmbanɛ da maal Solomon na'am diib saŋa la, lin yi pin'ilʋgʋn ti paae li bɛn la, li sɔb Natan onɛ an Wina'am nɔdi'es la labaya gbauŋʋn la, nɛ Ahija onɛ an Siilo nid la nɔdi'esʋg gbauŋʋn, nɛ Iddo onɛ nyɛt nier yɛla la da nyɛ si'eli zaŋi ken Jeroboam onɛ an Nebat biig la yɛla.

english_verse: His throne was made of ivory and covered with pure gold.

english_verse: and there were two lion statues on each of the six steps leading up to the throne. No other throne in the world was like Solomon's.

english_verse: Solomon had a lot of seagoing ships. Every three years he sent them out with Hiram's ships to bring back gold, silver, and ivory, as well as monkeys and peacocks.
translation_verse: Na'ab la da mɔr anrintitada bɛdegʋ banɛ ka ba mɔri kpiisid, ka Na'ab Hiram nidib da tʋmmi li tʋʋma. Yʋma atan' wʋsa ba na lɛb na ka ziid sanlima nɛ anzurifa nɛ wabʋg nyina nɛ nwaamis nɛ kpanda.

english_verse: Solomon was the richest and wisest king in the world.
translation_verse: Na'ab Solomon kpan'am nɛ o ya'am da gat dunia na'anam la wʋsa.

english_verse: Year after year, other kings came to hear the wisdom God had given him. And they brought gifts of silver and gold, as well as clothes, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
translation_verse: Yʋʋm wʋsa banɛ kennɛ o san'an na la wʋsa da mɔri piini na tisid o, nwɛnɛ sanlima nɛ anzurifa, fuud nɛ zaba la'ad, nɛ bʋnnyubisa, nɛ widi.

english_verse: horses that he kept in Jerusalem and other towns.
translation_verse: ), ka ba bɛɛ o widi tempʋʋsin la, ka sieba mɛ bɛɛ o san'an Jerusalem tempʋʋgin.

english_verse: He ruled all the nations from the Euphrates River in the north to the land of Philistia in the south, as far as the border of Egypt.
translation_verse: O da sʋ'oe na'anam la wʋsa lin pin'il Kɔldaugin la keŋ paae Filistia dim teŋin la ti paae Egipt titɔndigin.

english_verse: While Solomon was king, there was silver everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as the sycamore trees in the western foothills.
translation_verse: Na'ab la da kɛ ka anzurifa anɛ na'ana Jerusalem tempʋʋgin nwɛnɛ kuga nɛ, ka na'aziinr dasʋma zu'oe nwɛnɛ kekama daadi zu'oe mɔɔgin si'em la.

translation_verse: Solomon da da'ad o widi la nɛ Musir teŋin nɛ tembanɛ bɛ wʋsa. Solomon kum yɛla (

translation_verse: Ka da maal ka'alim ka ba mum o, o yaanam san'an David tempʋʋgin. Ka o biig Rehoboam di'e o zin'igi di na'am la.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to Shechem where everyone was waiting to crown him king.
translation_verse: Rehoboam da keŋ Sekɛm teŋin bɔzugɔ, Israel dim wʋsa da la'as anina ye ba diis o na'am.

english_verse: Jeroboam son of Nebat heard what was happening, and he returned from Egypt, where he had gone to hide from Solomon.
translation_verse: Jeroboam onɛ an Nebat biig la da wʋmi li yɛla la o da yi Egipt n lɛb na.

english_verse: The people from the northern tribes of Israel sent for him. Then together they went to Rehoboam and said,
translation_verse: Ka ba tʋm buol Jeroboam ka on nɛ Israel dim wʋsa keŋ Rehoboam san'an yɛl o ye,

english_verse: “Your father Solomon forced us to work very hard. But if you make our work easier, we will serve you and do whatever you ask.”
translation_verse: “Fʋ saam daa nɔk zitɛbisa ziili ti, amaa nannanna siem tʋʋm kpi'ema la nɛ zitɛbisa banɛ ka o daa ziili ti la, ka ti na tʋmmi tisidif.”

english_verse: Rehoboam replied, “Come back in three days for my answer.” So the people left.
translation_verse: Rehoboam da lɛbisi ba ye, “Lɛmmi ka daba atan' daar ka ya lɛbi m san'an na.” Ka nidib la widigi kul.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to some leaders who had been his father's senior officials, and he asked them, “What should I tell these people?”
translation_verse: Na'ab Rehoboam da bu'os kpɛɛm kʋda banɛ da bɛɛ o saam na'am saŋa la ye, “Nidib la sɔs si'em la m na lɛbisi ba ye bɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “If you want them to serve and obey you, then you should be kind and promise to make their work easier.”
translation_verse: Ka ba lɛbis ye, “Fʋ ya'a siaki maal nidib la bɔɔd si'el la ka lɛbisi ba sʋ'ʋŋa, nidib nwa' na liebi fʋ yammis saŋa wʋsa.”

english_verse: But Rehoboam refused their advice and went to the younger men who had grown up with him and were now his officials.
translation_verse: Amaa Rehoboam da zan'as kpɛɛmnam la sa'alʋg ka keŋ nwɛ' o taaba banɛ ka on nɛ ban da la'an duoe na ka ba tʋmmi tisid o la sɔɔra.

english_verse: He asked, “What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier?”
translation_verse: Ka bu'osi ba ye, “Yanam sa'alʋg an bɔ? Ti na lɛbis nimbanɛ yɛlim ye m siem zitɛbisa banɛ ka m saam da ziili ba la ye bɔ?”

english_verse: He made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: M saam daa nɔk nɛ zitɛbisa ziili ya, amaa mam na kɛ ka li maligim tɛbisi gaad ala; m saam da mɔri sisanbisi namisidi ya, amaa mam na namisi ya nɛ namis!’”

english_verse: Rehoboam ignored the advice of the older advisors. He spoke bluntly
translation_verse: Na'ab la da lɛbis nidib la nɛ yɔɔgʋ sa, ka zan'as kpɛɛmnam la sa'al o si'em la.

english_verse: and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested. He said: “My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: O da dɔl nɛ na'akim la sa'al o si'em ka ye, “M saam daa nɔk nɛ zitɛbisa ziili ya, mam mɛ na kɛ ka li maligim tɛbisi gaad ala; m saam da mɔri sisanbisi namisidi ya, amaa mam na namisi ya nɛ namis!”

english_verse: After Rehoboam returned to Jerusalem, he decided to attack Israel and regain control of the whole country. So he called together
translation_verse: Rehoboam n da paae Jerusalem la, o da la'as Juda yidim la wʋsa nɛ banɛ an Benjamin dɔɔg la dap banɛ mi' zaba la, nidib tusa kɔbiga nɛ pisnii (

english_verse: as well as with shields and spears. He used these fortified cities to keep control of Judah and Benjamin. The Priests and the Levites Support Rehoboam
translation_verse: O da bɔ linɛ lusid nyɔ'ɔg la nɛ kpana niŋ tɛɛns la wʋsa ni ka li kɛ ka tɛɛns la wʋsa kpi'em. Alazug Juda nɛ Benjamin da anɛ o din.

english_verse: soldiers from the tribes of Judah and Benjamin.
translation_verse: ), ye ba keŋ zab nɛ Israel nidibi di'e na'am la lɛbisi tis Rehoboam.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the Lord had told Shemaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am labakaŋa da kɛn Semaya onɛ an Wina'am nid la san'an na yɛl ye,

english_verse: “The Lord warns you not to go to war against the people from the northern tribes—they are your relatives. Go home! The Lord is the one who made these things happen.” Rehoboam and his army obeyed the Lord's message and did not attack Jeroboam and his troops. Rehoboam Fortifies Cities in Judah
translation_verse: ‘Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': Da keŋ zabi nɛ ya ba'abiis Israel dim la. Ya wʋsa lɛm kuli, ka nɛ' anɛ manɛ tʋmi li.’” Ka ba siak ka lɛbi kul wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛli ba si'em la, ka ba fɛndigi lɛb ka pʋ lɛn tʋ'ʋs ye ba zab nɛ Jeroboam ya'asɛ. Rehoboam lɛn kɛ ka Juda teŋ kpi'em si'em

english_verse: Rehoboam ruled from Jerusalem, and he had several cities in Judah turned into fortresses so he could use them to defend his country. These cities included
translation_verse: Rehoboam da bɛ nɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin ka mɛ' Juda tempʋʋs la giŋ Jerusalem lɛbis, ba da anɛ:

english_verse: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
translation_verse: Betilehem nɛ Etam nɛ Tekoa

english_verse: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
translation_verse: nɛ Gaf nɛ Maresa nɛ Zif

english_verse: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
translation_verse: nɛ Adoram nɛ Lakis nɛ Azeka

english_verse: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron. After he had fortified these cities in the territories of Judah and Benjamin,
translation_verse: nɛ Zora nɛ Aijalon nɛ Hebron. Tembama da maal nɛ ka li kpi'em Juda nɛ Benjamin dɔɔd sʋ'ʋlimin.

english_verse: he assigned an army commander to each of them and stocked them with supplies of food, olive oil, and wine,
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka tɛɛns la zaba zin'is la kpi'em sʋ'ʋŋa, ka kɛ ka soogia kpɛɛmnam bɛɛ ani, ka o tisidi ba diib nɛ olif kpaam nɛ daam.

english_verse: The priests and Levites from the northern tribes of Israel gave their support to King Rehoboam.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la da bɛ zin'isieba Israel teŋin la wʋsa da zi'e nɛ o nya'aŋ.

english_verse: And since Jeroboam and the kings of Israel that followed him would not allow any Levites to serve as priests, most Levites left their towns and pasturelands in Israel and moved to Jerusalem and other towns in Judah.
translation_verse: Levi dim la da basi ba kɔnbkemsʋg zin'is la nɛ ban mɔr si'el wʋsa ka keŋ Juda nɛ Jerusalem na bɔzugɔ Jeroboam nɛ o biis da zan'as nɛ ye ba kʋ lɛn an Zugsɔb la maanmaanniba.

english_verse: Jeroboam chose his own priests to serve at the local shrines in Israel and at the places of worship where he had set up statues of goat-demons and of calves.
translation_verse: Ka Jeroboam lɛɛ da gaŋ o mɛŋ maanmaannib ka ba bɛ maana zin'is la ni la kaanbid Bʋʋg nɛ Na'abil bada banɛ ka o maal la.

english_verse: But some of the people from Israel wanted to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done. So they followed the priests and Levites to Jerusalem, where they could offer sacrifices to the Lord.
translation_verse: Banɛ da yi Israel dɔɔg wʋsa ka lɔɔ ba sʋnfʋn ye ba dɔl Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la da dɔl Levi dim la nya'aŋi lɛb Jerusalem tempʋʋgin ye ba maal maannɛ tis Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la.

english_verse: For the next three years, they lived in Judah and were loyal to Rehoboam and his kingdom, just as they had been loyal to David and Solomon. Rehoboam's Family
translation_verse: Ba da kɛ ka Juda sʋ'ʋlim la paam paŋ ka sʋŋ Rehoboam onɛ an Solomon biig la yʋma atan', ka dɔl suobanɛ ka Na'ab David nɛ Solomon bɔɔd la. Rehoboam yidim yɛla

english_verse: Rehoboam and Mahalath had three sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
translation_verse: O da du'a biribisi tis o, Jeus nɛ Semaraya nɛ Zaham.

english_verse: Then Rehoboam married Maacah the daughter of Absalom. Their sons were Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
translation_verse: O mɛ da lɛn di Absalom pu'ayua Maaka, onɛ da du'a Abija nɛ Atai nɛ Ziza nɛ Sielomif.

english_verse: Rehoboam was wise enough to put one of his sons in charge of each fortified city in his kingdom. He gave them all the supplies they needed and found wives for every one of them.
translation_verse: O da maalnɛ ya'am, ka da widig o biis la sieba gilig Juda nɛ Benjamin sʋ'ʋlim nɛ tembanɛ ka o maal ka li kpi'em la wʋsa. O da tisi ba areza'as bɛdegʋ ka di pu'ab bɛdegʋ tisi ba.

english_verse: but he still did wrong and refused to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Na'ab Rehoboam da tʋm bɛ'ɛd bɔzugɔ o da pʋ gban'e o sʋʋnrin ye o dɔl Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: So in the fifth year of Rehoboam's rule, the Lord punished them for their unfaithfulness and allowed King Shishak of Egypt to invade Judah.
translation_verse: Ban da pʋ dɔl Zugsɔb la nɛ sida la zug, Egipt na'ab Sisiak da kena ye o zab nɛ Jerusalem, Rehoboam da di na'am la, li yʋma anu saŋa.

english_verse: Shishak attacked with his army of
translation_verse: Na'ab Sisiak da dɔl zaba tɛrekonam tusir nɛ kɔbisyi' (

english_verse: cavalry troops, as well as countless Egyptian soldiers from Libya, Sukkoth, and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: ) nɛ Libiya zabzabidib banɛ ka' bɛnnɛ kena. Suk dim nɛ Kus dim mɛ da dɔl o yi Egipt teŋin na.

english_verse: He captured every one of the fortified cities in Judah and then marched to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: O da nyaŋi faaɛn teŋ kpi'ema banɛ bɛ Juda la, hali mɔr ala paae Jerusalem na.

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah had gone to Jerusalem to escape Shishak's invasion. And while they were there, Shemaiah the prophet told them, “The Lord says that because you have disobeyed him, he has now abandoned you. The Lord will not help you against Shishak!”
translation_verse: Na'ab Rehoboam nɛ Juda kpɛɛmnam la da la'as taaba Jerusalem tempʋʋgin ban zɔ Sisiak dabiem la zug. Semaya onɛ da an nɔdi'es la da kɛɛn ba san'an na, ka yɛli ba ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em nwa': ‘Ya kɛɛsimi bas ka m mɛ kɛɛsi ya basi tis Sisiak.’”

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders were sorry for what they had done and admitted, “The Lord is right. We have deserted him.”
translation_verse: Israel kpɛɛmnam la nɛ Na'ab la yʋ'ʋn da sie ba mɛŋ ka yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la anɛ pʋpiel.”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he told Shemaiah: The people of Judah are truly sorry for their sins, and so I won't let Shishak completely destroy them. But because I am still angry,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da nyɛ ka ba sie ba mɛŋ la, o da kɛ ka labakaŋa kɛn Semaya san'an na, ye, “Ban sadigim sie ba mɛŋ la, m kʋ san'ami baa, amaa m lɛɛ na tisi ba yɔlisim ka li kʋ yuugɛ. M kʋ kɛ ka m sʋnpɛɛn la dɔlis Sisiak san'anɛ lu Jerusalem dim zugɔ.

english_verse: he will conquer and rule them. Then my people will know what it's like to serve a foreign king instead of serving me.
translation_verse: Amaa ba na tʋmmi tisid o ka linɛ na kɛ ka ba baŋ ban na tʋmmi tisid Zugsɔb la nɛ ban na tʋmmi tisid teŋ zʋŋ na'abi bɛ kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb si'em.”

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Alazug Na'ab Rehoboam da maal kʋntzɛn'ug zaba la'abanɛ ti'ed nyɔ'ɔg la lɛbis, ka nɔki ba gu'ul banɛ gur na'ayir la kpɛɛmnam.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he had finished worshiping.
translation_verse: Na'ab la ya'a ɛɛnti kpɛn' Zugsɔb Yin la, banɛ gur la na mɔr la'ad nwa' dɔl o keŋ, ka li nya'aŋ la ba na lɛbisi li na'ayir dɔkanɛ ka ba gur la ni.

english_verse: Rehoboam turned back to the Lord, and so the Lord did not let Judah be completely destroyed, and Judah was prosperous again. Rehoboam's Rule in Judah (
translation_verse: Na'ab Rehoboam n da sie o mɛŋ la zug, Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn da pʋ san'am o nyainnɛ. Ya'a an sida, bʋnsʋŋ da kpɛm bɛ Juda teŋin bi'ela.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king, including a history of his family, is written in the records of the two prophets, Shemaiah and Iddo. During Rehoboam's rule, he and King Jeroboam of Israel were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim yɛla banɛ da maal Rehoboam na'am saŋa nɛ on da tʋm si'el la, ba da sɔbi niŋ Semaya onɛ da an nɔdi'es la gbana ni, nɛ Iddo onɛ nyɛt nier yɛla la gbauŋ kanɛ pa'an tuŋ-tuŋ yɛla la ni. Rehoboam nɛ Jeroboam da kpɛn zabid nɛ taaba ala saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: When Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Abijah became king.
translation_verse: Ka Rehoboam maal ka'alim ka ba mum o David tempʋʋgin. Ka o biig Abija di'e o zin'igi di na'am.

english_verse: Abijah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Nebat biig Jeroboam na'am diib yʋma pii nɛ anii saŋa la, Abija da di Juda na'am,

english_verse: and the troops let out a battle cry. Then with Abijah leading them into battle, God defeated Jeroboam and Israel's army.
translation_verse: Ka Juda dim la wɔɔl tanp wɔɔlʋg, ka ban wɔɔli naae la ka Zugsɔb la kɛ ka Na'ab Abija nɛ Juda dim nyaŋ Jeroboam nɛ Israel dim la wʋsa.

english_verse: Now you and your powerful army think you can stand up to the kingdom that the Lord has given to David's descendants. The only gods you have are those gold statues of calves that Jeroboam made for you.
translation_verse: “Ka nannanna ka ya gban'e ye ya zan'as Zugsɔb la sʋ'ʋlim linɛ bɛ David yaas nu'usin la. Ya sid anɛ zabzabidib banɛ zu'oe, ka mɔr sanlima na'abibis banɛ ka Jeroboam da maal ye li aan ya Wina'am la.

english_verse: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Some time later, Abijah and King Jeroboam of Israel went to war against each other.
translation_verse: ka sʋ'oe Jerusalem yʋma atan'. O ma yʋ'ʋri da buon Maaka, onɛ an Uriel onɛ yi Gibea la pu'ayua. Na'ab Abija nɛ Na'ab Jeroboam da tʋ'ʋs taaba nɛ zaba.

english_verse: Abijah went to the top of Mount Zemaraim in the hills of Ephraim and shouted: Listen, Jeroboam and all you Israelites!
translation_verse: Abija da duoe zi'e zuokanɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Zemaram ka bɛ Efiram linɛ an kʋkʋna teŋ la zug, ka yɛl ye, “Jeroboam fʋn nɛ Israel dim wʋsa, kɛlisimi!

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has made a solemn promise that every king of Israel will be from David's family.
translation_verse: Ya zi' ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la digil nɛ nɔnaar kpi'euŋ ka nɔk Israel na'am la niŋ David yaas nu'usin saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ?

english_verse: Then right after Rehoboam became king, you and your bunch of worthless followers challenged Rehoboam, who was too young to know how to stop you.
translation_verse: Ninyaalis sieba mɛ da keŋ la'asi gilig o ka zan'as Na'ab Rehoboam onɛ an Na'ab Solomon biig la saŋa kanɛ ka o da nan an dasaŋ ka kʋ nyaŋi ki'isi ba pian'ad la.

english_verse: You don't even have descendants of Aaron on your side, because you forced out the Lord's priests and Levites. In their place, you appoint ordinary people to be priests, just as the foreign nations do. In fact, anyone who brings a bull and seven rams to the altar can become a priest of your so-called gods.
translation_verse: Ya daa pʋ kad Zugsɔb maanmaannib banɛ an Aaron biis nɛ Levi dim la yis ka bɔɔ ya mɛŋ maanmaannib wʋʋ teŋ zʋna la maan si'em la? Ka onɛ wʋsa kena nɔk na'arapɔl bɛɛ pɛraad ayɔpɔi maal o mɛŋ kasi na lieb maanmaanni tis bʋn banɛ ka' Wina'am.

english_verse: But we have not turned our backs on the Lord God! Aaron's own descendants serve as our priests, and the Levites are their assistants.
translation_verse: “Amaa Zugsɔb la sadigim aan ti Wina'am ka tinam pʋ ki'is o la, maanmaannib banɛ tʋmmi tisid Zugsɔb la anɛ Aaron biis ka Levi dim la sʋŋidi ba.

english_verse: Two times every day they offer sacrifices and burn incense to the Lord. They set out the sacred loaves of bread on a table that has been purified, and they light the lamps in the gold lampstand every day at sunset. We follow the commands of the Lord our God—you have rejected him!
translation_verse: Bɛkɛung nɛ zaam wʋsa ba maan nyu'or maan nɛ bʋnnyubisa tisid Zugsɔb la. Ba pa'an maan bodobodo la teebul kanɛ an kasi la zug, ka nyu'od fita banɛ bɛ sanlima fitazi'esa zug la zaam wʋsa. Tinam dɔlisid Zugsɔb la bɔɔdim wʋsa. Amaa yanam bas o nɛ.

english_verse: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Wina'am bɛnɛ nɛ tinam. Onɛ aan ti tuongat. O maanmaannib banɛ mɔr na'atana la na pieb zaba piebʋgʋ tʋ'ʋsi ya. Israel dima, da zabi nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya yaanam Wina'am laa, bɔzugɔ ya kʋ nyaŋɛ.”

english_verse: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.
translation_verse: Saŋa kan la Jeroboam da kɛ ka o zabzabidib gaadi keŋ dɔl sian'anr la giligi kaae Juda dim la nya'aŋ, ka on gaadi tʋ'ʋs Juda dim la ka banɛ gu' la bɛɛ ba nya'aŋ.

english_verse: Judah's army won because they had trusted the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ba da nyaŋ Israel dim la zabkan la ni. Juda dim la da nyaŋ ya bɔzugɔ ba da ti'enɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la.

english_verse: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.
translation_verse: Na'ab Abija da kad Jeroboam hali ka faaɛn Betel nɛ Jesiana nɛ Efiron nɛ teŋkpɛmis banɛ kpi'e ba la wʋsa.

english_verse: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.
translation_verse: Abija na'am saŋa la Jeroboam da pʋ maligim nyɛ nyaŋirɛ, hali nɛ Zugsɔb la ti nwɛ' o ka o kpi.

english_verse: Everything Abijah said and did while he was king is written in the records of Iddo the prophet.
translation_verse: Bʋmbanɛ wʋsa da maal Abija na'am saŋa la, nɛ on da maal si'el nɛ on da yɛl si'el wʋsa la, sɔbi bɛ nɔdi'es Iddo yɛlkʋda gbana la ni.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord his God and did right.
translation_verse: Na'ab Asa da tʋm linɛ an sʋm ka dɔl suor Zugsɔb onɛ aan o Wina'am la nini ni.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: O da yis teŋ zʋna maana bimbima la nɛ kʋkʋna zug maana zin'is la, ka nwa' kugbanɛ ka ba zi'eli maal la, ka nwa'ae teŋgban Asera daad la bas.

english_verse: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ka tis Juda dim nɔɔr ye ba dɔl Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la, ka dɔl o wada nɛ o nɔzi'ela la.

english_verse: The Lord blessed Judah with peace while Asa was king, and so during that time, Asa fortified many of the towns.
translation_verse: Juda teŋ la da dig nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm la zug, o da maligim mɛ' Juda sʋ'ʋlim teŋ kpi'ema la. Yʋʋm ban la sɔ' da pʋ zabid nɛ o, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la da tis o vʋ'ʋsʋm.

english_verse: He said to the people, “Let's build walls and defense towers for these towns, and put in gates that can be locked with bars. This land still belongs to us, because we have obeyed the Lord our God. He has given us peace from all our enemies.” The people did everything Asa had suggested.
translation_verse: O da yɛl Juda dim ye, “Kɛlli ka ti mɛ' tɛɛns la, ka mɛ' zaŋguoma giligi li, nɛ dɔwa'ama, nɛ za'anɔya nɛ dapirida. Bɔzugɔ teŋ la nan anɛ ti din, tinamɛ dɔl Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am bɔɔdim la. Ti dɔl o nɛ ka o tisi ti vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'ig wʋsa.” Alazug ba da mɛ' ya', ka paam kpan'am hali.

english_verse: Asa had a large army of brave soldiers:
translation_verse: Asa da mɔri soogianam tusa kɔbistan' (

english_verse: chariots to the town of Mareshah in Judah.
translation_verse: ) kena hali ti paae Maresa teŋin.

english_verse: Asa met him there, and the two armies prepared for battle in Zephathah Valley.
translation_verse: Na'ab Asa da yii keŋ ye o tʋ'ʋs o, ka ba kpa' taaba Zefata Bɔn'ɔgin linɛ kpi'e Maresa teŋ la.

english_verse: Asa prayed: Lord God, only you can help a powerless army defeat a stronger one. So we depend on you to help us. We will fight against this powerful army to honor your name, and we know that you won't be defeated. You are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Asa buol Zugsɔb onɛ aan o Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr ka yɛl ye, “Zugsɔba, sɔ' kae nwɛnɛ fʋn ka na nyaŋi sʋŋ tadimnam ba ya'a ti ye ba tʋ'ʋs kpi'emnama. O ti Zugsɔb Wina'am, sʋŋimi ti ka ti ti'enɛ fʋn. Fʋ yʋ'ʋr la ka ti nɔkidi tʋ'ʋsid soogia banɛ zu'oe nwa'. O Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ aan ti Wina'am; da kɛ ka ninsaal nyaŋi fɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Asa and his army defeat the Ethiopians. The enemy soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da kʋ Kus dim la Asa nɛ Juda dim tuon. Kus dim la da zɔya,

english_verse: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.
translation_verse: ka Asa nɛ o zabzabidib la dɔlli ba, hali ti paae Gera teŋin. Kus nimbanɛ da kpi la da zu'oe si'em la da kɛ ka ba pʋ lɛn zi'enɛ. Ba da nyaŋi ba Zugsɔb la nɛ o nidib la tuon. Juda nidib la da paam la'ad bɛdegʋ vaae.

english_verse: The people who lived in the villages around Gerar learned what had happened and were afraid of the Lord. So Judah's army easily defeated them and carried off everything of value that they wanted from these towns.
translation_verse: Ba da san'am teŋkpɛmis banɛ gilig Gera teŋ la wʋsa bɔzugɔ dabiem da gban'e ba Zugsɔb la tʋʋma zug. Juda dim da faaɛn tembama wʋsa bɔzugɔ la'ad bɛdegʋ da bɛɛ anina ka ba na vaae.

english_verse: They also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took a lot of sheep, goats, and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba mɛ da keŋi ba kɔnbkemnib la da bɛ zin'isieba la zabi faaɛn pɛ'ɛs nɛ bʋʋs nɛ yʋgʋma bɛdegʋ ka yʋ'ʋn lɛb Jerusalem.

english_verse: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.
translation_verse: Wina'am Siig la da kɛn Azaria onɛ an Oded biig la ni na.

english_verse: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.
translation_verse: Ka o yii tʋ'ʋs Na'ab Asa suorin ka yɛl o ye, “Fʋn na'ab Asa nɛ Juda nɛ Benjamin dima, kɛlisimi sʋ'ʋŋa! Ya ya'a bɛ Zugsɔb la san'an o mɛ na bɛɛ ya san'an. Ya ya'a iee o, ya na nyɛɛ o; amaa ya ya'a zan'as o, o mɛ na zan'asi ya.

english_verse: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.
translation_verse: Li da yuug ya ka Israel da bɛ ka Wina'am onɛ an sida Wina'am la ka' ba san'anɛ, ka maanmaan kae na pa'ali baa, ka wada la mɛ kae.

english_verse: But whenever trouble came, Israel turned back to the Lord their God and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Amaa ba namisʋg la pʋʋgin ba da fɛndigi lɛb Zugsɔb la san'an, onɛ an Israel Wina'am la, iee o ka nyɛɛ o.

english_verse: There was so much confusion in those days that it wasn't safe to go anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Saŋa kan la li da ka' na'ana ka fʋ gɔɔndi fʋ ya'aminɛ bɔzugɔ daamʋg nɛ tɔɔg da bɛ tɛɛnsin la wʋsa.

english_verse: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.
translation_verse: Teŋ yinne da ɛɛn duoe zabid nɛ teŋ yinne, ka tempʋʋg duoe zabid nɛ tempʋʋg, bɔzugɔ Wina'am da daamidi ba nɛ yɛla kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb.

english_verse: As soon as Asa heard what Azariah the prophet said, he gave orders for all the idols in Judah and Benjamin to be destroyed, including those in the towns he had captured in the territory of Ephraim. He also repaired the Lord's altar that was in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Na'ab Asa n da wʋm pian'abama Oded biig Azaria onɛ an nɔdi'es la san'an la, o sʋnf da kpɛ'ɛŋ nɛ. O da yis bada banɛ ka Zugsɔb kis la Juda teŋin la wʋsa nɛ Benjamin sʋ'ʋlim nɛ tembanɛ ka o zabi nyaŋ ka li bɛ Efiram linɛ an kʋkʋna teŋin la wʋsa. O da maligim maal Zugsɔb maan daka linɛ bɛ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg za'ambɛŋ tuon la.

english_verse: Asa called together the people from Judah and Benjamin, as well as the people from the territories of Ephraim, West Manasseh, and Simeon who were living in Judah. Many of these people were now loyal to Asa, because they had seen that the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: O yʋ'ʋn da la'as Juda nɛ Benjamin nidib wʋsa nɛ nimbanɛ yi Efiram nɛ Manase nɛ Simeon dɔɔd ni na la ka zin'in nɛ ba. Bɔzugɔ nidib pamm da naan Israel teŋin kɛɛn o san'an na, ban da nyɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Wina'am la bɛ nɛ o la zug.

english_verse: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba da la'as nɛ Jerusalem teŋin, Asa na'am la yʋʋm pii nɛ anu, li nwadkanɛ paas atan' la ni.

english_verse: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped,
translation_verse: Ba da naal nɔɔr ye ba dɔl Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la nɛ ba sʋnf wʋsa nɛ ba siig wʋsa.

english_verse: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord, then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.
translation_verse: Ba da kaanb nɛ zi'el Zugsɔb la tuon, ka yɛli li nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar nɛ tansʋg nɛ na'atana nɛ wiis.

english_verse: Everyone was happy because they had made this solemn promise, and in return, the Lord blessed them with peace from all their enemies.
translation_verse: Israel wʋsa sʋnf da malis nɛ kaanbʋg la zug bɔzugɔ ba da pɔnɛ nɛ ba sʋnf wʋsa. Ba da ie Wina'am nɛ, nɛ ba sʋnf wʋsa, ka o kɛ ka ba nyɛɛ o. Alazug Zugsɔb la da tisi ba yɔlisim zin'ig wʋsa.

english_verse: Asa's grandmother Maacah had made a disgusting idol of the goddess Asherah, so he cut it down, crushed it, and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Na'ab Asa mɛ da pidig o yaapu'a Maaka onɛ da an pu'ana'ab la bɔzugɔ o da sɛ teŋgban Asera dazi'edir la pʋ'ʋsid. Asa da kɔ'ɔg daug la lɔbi bas Kidron bɔn'ɔgin la ka nyu'oe li nɛ bugum.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines in Israel.
translation_verse: Hali on da pʋ yis teŋgbana banɛ bɛ kʋkʋna zut la, Asa da kpɛm pɛsig o sʋnf wʋsa tis Zugsɔb Wina'am hali nɛ o nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsa.

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to God.
translation_verse: O da mɔr anzurifa nɛ sanlima la'abanɛ ka on nɛ o saam da pɛsigi tis Wina'am kɛn Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na.

english_verse: There was peace in Judah until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's rule.
translation_verse: Asa na'am saŋa la li da nɔk wʋʋ yʋma pistan' nɛ anu ka zabir kae.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Asa da nɔk anzurifa nɛ sanlima linɛ da kpɛlim Zugsɔb Yir la suak dɔɔdin la wʋsa nɛ linɛ bɛɛ o mɛŋ na'ayin la. O da nɔki li tɔlim tis Aram Na'ab onɛ yʋ'ʋri da buon Ben-Hadad ka o sʋ'oe Damaskus tempʋʋg la.

english_verse: “I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: Ka yɛl o ye, “Kɛl ka nɔnaar bɛ man nɛ fʋ sʋʋgin, nwɛnɛ m saam nɛ fʋ saamme da mɔr nɔɔr yinne si'em la. Gɔsima, anzurifa nɛ sanlima ka m nɔki tisidif ka li an piini. Nannanna yisimi fʋ nɔnaar Israel Na'ab Baasa san'an ka li na kɛ ka o fuoe o nu'ug man san'an.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.
translation_verse: Ben-Hadad da siak Na'ab Asa nɔɔr ka tʋm o zabzabidib tuongatib ka ba keŋ zab nɛ Israel tɛɛns la. O da nyaŋ Iyon teŋ nɛ Dan teŋ, nɛ Abɛl-Bet-Maaka teŋ, la'an nɛ Naftali dɔɔg sʋ'ʋlim la'ad suak tɛɛns la wʋsa.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped his work on the town of Ramah.
translation_verse: Baasa n da wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la, o da bas Rama mɛɛb, ka kɛɛs o tʋʋma bas.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood. Hanani the Prophet Condemns Asa
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Asa yʋ'ʋn tis nɔɔr ye Juda dim wʋsa kem fuos kuga nɛ daad banɛ bɛ Rama ka Baasa da mɔri tʋm anina la wʋsa mɔri keŋ. O da nɔki li mɛ' Geba teŋ linɛ bɛ Benjamin teŋin la, nɛ Misipa teŋ.

english_verse: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.
translation_verse: Saŋa kan la, Hanani onɛ da nyɛt nier yɛla la da kɛn Juda na'ab Asa san'an na yɛl o ye, “Fʋn ti'enɛ Aram na'ab la ka ka' Zugsɔb onɛ aan fʋ Wina'am la, Aram na'ab zabzabidib la yii fʋ nu'ugin ka fʋ kʋ lɛn nyaŋi baa.

english_verse: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.
translation_verse: Kus nɛ Libiya zabzabidib la da pʋ zu'oe hali, ka mɔr zaba tɛrekonam nɛ wiedban'adib bɛdegʋ? Amaa fʋn daa ti'e Zugsɔb la o daa kɛ ka fʋ nyaŋi ba.

english_verse: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la nini ieed nɛ dunia wʋsa ye o kpɛmis banɛ nɔki ba sʋnf wʋsa pɛsig o. Fʋ tʋmnɛ gaan tʋʋma, ka lin yi zina mɔri ken fʋ na bɛ tanp nɛ zaba pʋʋgin.”

english_verse: When Asa heard this, he was so angry that he put Hanani in prison. Asa was also cruel to some of his people. Asa Dies (
translation_verse: Asa sʋnf da duoe nɛ onɛ nyɛt nier yɛla la tis o labasi'a la zug. O sʋnf da pɛlig nɛ hali ka o gban'e o yɔ' sanrega ni. Li Saŋa nɔɔ Asa da muk nidib la sieba bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Everything Asa did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim yɛla banɛ da maal Asa na'am diib saŋa, li pin'ilʋgʋn ti paae li naarin la, ba da sɔbi li niŋ Juda Na'anam nɛ Israel Na'anam Gbauŋʋn la.

english_verse: In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, he got a very bad foot disease, but he relied on doctors and refused to ask the Lord for help.
translation_verse: Asa na'am yʋʋm pistan' nɛ awai saŋa la ban'a da gban'e o nɔba. La'an nɛ o ban'a la da mugus o hali la o da pʋ bɔ sʋŋir Zugsɔb la nii, ka lɛɛ ieed du'atanamin.
