english_verse: Earlier, Asa had his own tomb cut out of a rock hill in Jerusalem. So he was buried there, and the tomb was filled with spices and sweet-smelling oils. Then the people built a bonfire in his honor.
translation_verse: ka ba mum o yaʋg kanɛ ka o mɛŋ da tu David tempʋʋgin la. Ba da digil o sɔnduoya zug ka niŋ bʋnnyubisa nɛ tudaari nɛ li buudi wʋsa. Ba da mum o ka maali nyu'oe bugum tita'ari tis o girima.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king and strengthened his defenses against Israel.
translation_verse: Jehosafat onɛ an Na'ab Asa biig la da lɛdigi di na'am la ka kpɛ'ɛŋ o mɛŋ ye Israel da nyaŋ o.

english_verse: He assigned troops to the fortified cities in Judah, as well as to other towns in Judah and to those towns in Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
translation_verse: O da gu'ul zabzabidib tempʋbanɛ kpi'em Juda teŋin la wʋsa, ka nɔk soogia banɛ gu'ud la gu'ul Juda tempʋʋsin nɛ tempʋbanɛ da bɛ Efiram dɔɔg sʋ'ʋlimin ka o saam Na'ab Asa da zabi di'e la.

english_verse: and helped him keep firm control of his kingdom. The people of Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, but even after he became very rich and respected,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka o sʋ'ʋlim la zi'en kiŋ-kiŋ ka Juda nidib wʋsa mɔr piini na tis o, ka li kɛ ka o lieb arezak sɔb ka mɔr girima bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: he remained completely faithful to the Lord. He destroyed all the local shrines in Judah, including the places where the goddess Asherah was worshiped.
translation_verse: O da nɔk o sʋnf wʋsa pɛsigi dɔl Zugsɔb la suoya. Linɛ pɛ'ɛs, o da san'am maana zin'is la ka vɔn' Asera daad linɛ bɛ Juda teŋin la.

english_verse: Their assistants were the following nine Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-Adonijah. Two priests, Elishama and Jehoram, also went along.
translation_verse: Levi nidib sieba da paas ya, ka ban da anɛ Semaya nɛ Netanaya nɛ Zebadaya nɛ Asahel nɛ Siemiramof nɛ Jehonatan nɛ Adonija nɛ Tobaya nɛ Tobadonija, nɛ maanmaannib ayi', ka ba da anɛ Elisama nɛ Jehoram.

english_verse: They carried with them a copy of the Lord's Law wherever they went and taught the people from it.
translation_verse: Ba da nɔknɛ Zugsɔb Wada Gbauŋ la gilig Juda tempʋʋs la wʋsa pa'an nidib la.

english_verse: The nations around Judah were afraid of the Lord's power, so none of them attacked Jehoshaphat.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la dabiem da kpɛn' sʋ'ʋlim linɛ gilig Juda la wʋsa nidib, ka sɔ'ɔsɔ pʋ duoe zab nɛ Jehosafat.

english_verse: Philistines brought him silver and other gifts to keep peace. Some of the Arab people brought him
translation_verse: Filistia nidib sieba da mɔr anzurifa nɛ piinsieba na tis Na'ab Jehosafat ye ba na'as o, ka Arab buudi la mɛ mɔr kɔnbid na, ka li da anɛ pɛraad tusa ayɔpɔi nɛ kɔbisyɔpɔi (

english_verse: As Jehoshaphat became more powerful, he built fortresses and cities
translation_verse: Jehosafat da maligim paam paŋ hali, ka mɛ' zin'ikpi'ema nɛ la'ad dɔɔd Juda teŋin,

english_verse: where he stored supplies. He also kept in Jerusalem some experienced soldiers
translation_verse: ka mɛ digil la'ad bɛdegʋ Juda sʋ'ʋlim tɛɛnsin la. O mɛ da kɛ ka banɛ mi' zaba hali bɛ Jerusalem teŋin.

english_verse: from the Judah and Benjamin tribes. These soldiers were grouped according to their clans. Adnah was the commander of the troops from Judah, and he had
translation_verse: Yir wʋsa pʋʋgin ban da zi'eli ba si'em nwa': Juda dɔɔgin la zaba tuongatib banɛ gat nidib tusir tuon da anɛ Adina onɛ da an tuongat la ka soogianam tusa kɔbistan' (

english_verse: soldiers under him.
translation_verse: ) banɛ ti'ebi gur zaba.

english_verse: Amasiah son of Zichri, who had volunteered to serve the Lord, was third in command, with
translation_verse: onɛ paas da anɛ Amasaya onɛ an Zikir biig ka da pɛsig o mɛŋ ye o tʋm Zugsɔb la tʋʋma la, ka o soogianam da an tusa kɔbisyi' (

english_verse: Eliada was a brave warrior who commanded the troops from Benjamin. He had
translation_verse: Benjamin tuŋʋn la: Eliada onɛ an soogia kpi'euŋ ka soogianam tusa kɔbisyi' (

english_verse: These were the troops who protected the king in Jerusalem, not counting those he had assigned to the fortified cities throughout the country.
translation_verse: Dap bama da tʋmnɛ tisid Na'ab la, hali ka banɛ wʋsa ka o niŋi ba Juda teŋ kpi'ema ni la wʋsa la pʋ paasɛ.

english_verse: Ahab and Jehoshaphat led their armies to Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Israel Na'ab nɛ Jehosafat onɛ an Juda Na'ab la da duoe keŋ Ramot Gilead teŋin.

english_verse: One day, Jehoshaphat went to visit Ahab in his capital city of Samaria. Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle and prepared a big feast to honor Jehoshaphat and the officials with him. Ahab talked about attacking the city of Ramoth in Gilead,
translation_verse: Yʋma atan' nya'aŋ, o da keŋ Samaria tempʋʋgin ye o pʋ'ʋs Na'ab Ahab. Ahab da kʋ pɛ'ɛs nɛ niigi bɛdegʋ tis on nɛ o nya'aŋ dim la, ka yʋ'ʋn yɛl o ye li nar ye ba zab nɛ Ramot Gilead tempʋʋg la.

english_verse: and finally asked, “Jehoshaphat, would you go with me to attack Ramoth?” “Yes,” Jehoshaphat answered. “My army is at your command.
translation_verse: Ka o bu'os Na'ab Jehosafat ye, “Fʋ na dɔllim ka ti keŋ zab nɛ Ramot dinɛ bɛ Gilead laa?” Ka o lɛbis Israel Na'ab ye, “Man nɛ fʋ anɛ yinne, m nidib anɛ fʋ nidib; ti na dɔlli fʋ keŋ tanpin la.”

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Amaa Na'ab Jehosafat da bu'os ye, “Ka Zugsɔb la nɔdi'es lɛn ka' kpɛla ka ti na bu'osɛɛ?”

english_verse: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.
translation_verse: Israel Na'ab la da yɛl o na'ayikpɛm la yinne ye, “Kem tɔ'ɔtɔ buol Mikaya onɛ an Imla biig la, na!”

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria, listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Israel Na'ab nɛ Jehosafat onɛ an Juda Na'ab la da yɛnɛ ba na'am fuudi zin' ba na'am gbana zut zieŋ dinɛ bɛ Samaria yaŋir la kpikpɛŋ, ka nɔdi'esidib la bɛɛ ba tuonnɛ pian'adi ba nɔdi'esʋg pian'ad.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Zedekaya onɛ an Kenaana biig la da maal kʋnt iila ka kʋʋs ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', ‘Fʋ na nɔk nɛ'ɛŋa zab Aram dim la, hali nɛ fʋn na ti san'ami ba wʋsa!’”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth and promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Nɔdi'esidib banɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa mɛ da yɛl ala ye, “Naa! Zam nɛ Ramot dinɛ bɛ Gilead la ka fʋ na nyaŋ! Zugsɔb la na nɔki li niŋ fʋ nu'usin.” Mikaya kena pian' ye ba na zabi gʋ'ʋŋ

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Onɛ ka ba tʋm ye o keŋ buol Mikaya na la da yɛl o ye, “Gɔsima, nɔdi'es bama la la'am pian'adnɛ wʋʋ ba maal nɛ nɔɔr yinne nɛ, ye Na'ab la na nyaŋ. Siakim tisi ba ka pian' dinɛ na malis Na'ab la!”

english_verse: “I'll say whatever the living Lord my God tells me to say,” Micaiah replied.
translation_verse: Amaa Mikaya yɛl ye, “Nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ vʋe la yʋ'ʋr zug, mam ye m yɛl nɛ Zugsɔb la yɛlim si'el ma'aa.”

english_verse: Then Micaiah went up to Ahab, who asked, “Micaiah, should we attack Ramoth?” “Yes!” Micaiah answered. “The Lord will help you capture the city.”
translation_verse: On paae na la ka Na'ab la bu'os o ye, “Mikaya, ti kem zab nɛ Ramot teŋ dinɛ bɛ Gilead sʋ'ʋlimin la bɛɛ ti kɛla?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Naa! Zam ka fʋ na nyaŋ! Zugsɔb na nɔki li niŋi fʋ nu'usin!”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth! What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Ka na'ab la bu'os o ye, “Nɔɔr ala ka m na yɛlif nɛ nimmua ye fʋ pian' dinɛ an sida ma'aa nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋrɛ?”

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers wandering around, lost in the hills like sheep without a shepherd. The Lord said, ‘These troops have no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Mikaya da lɛbis o ye, “Man nyɛ ka Israel dim wʋsa zɔɔ widig kʋkʋna ni nwɛnɛ pɛ'ɛs banɛ ka' kɔnbkem nɛ. Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Nimbama pʋ mɔr zugdaana, kɛl ka sɔ' wʋsa lɛbi kul o yin nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm!’”

english_verse: Ahab turned to Jehoshaphat and said, “I told you he would bring me bad news!”
translation_verse: Israel Na'ab la da yɛl Na'ab Jehosafat ye, “M pʋn pʋ yɛlif ye o kʋ di'e pian'asʋŋʋ tisi ma, amaa bɛ'ɛd ma'aanɛɛ?”

english_verse: Micaiah replied: I then saw the Lord seated on his throne with every creature in heaven gathered around him.
translation_verse: Mikaya da lɛn yɛli ba ye, “Dinzugɔ kɛlisimi Zugsɔb la labaar: m nyɛ ka Zugsɔb la zin' o na'am gbauŋ zug ka banɛ bɛ arezana ni la wʋsa la'asi gilig o datiuŋ nɛ o dagɔbʋg.

english_verse: The Lord asked, “Who can trick Ahab and make him go to Ramoth where he will be killed?” They talked about it for a while,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Anɔ'ɔnɛ na pan'as Ahab ka o keŋ zab nɛ Ramot dinɛ bɛ Gilead la ka ba kʋʋ o ani?’ Ka oŋa yɛl ye anwa ka oŋa ye anwa.

english_verse: then finally a spirit came forward and said to the Lord, “I can trick Ahab.” “How?” the Lord asked.
translation_verse: Li naarin la ka siig yina zi'en Zugsɔb la tuon ka yɛl ye, ‘Man na pan'as o.’ Ka Zugsɔb la bu'os ye, ‘Suobɔ ka fʋ na dɔlisɛ?’

english_verse: “I'll make Ahab's prophets lie to him.” “Good!” the Lord replied. “Now go and do it. You will be successful.”
translation_verse: Ka o ye, ‘M na keŋ nɛ dama'am siig o nɔdi'esidib la nɔya ni.’ Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl o ye, ‘Kem ka fʋ na nyaŋ, kem tʋmi li!’”

english_verse: Zedekiah walked over and slapped Micaiah on the face. Then he asked, “Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me?”
translation_verse: Ani ka Zedekaya onɛ an Kenaana biig la keŋ nwɛ' Mikaya tampiank ka ye, “Zugsɔb Siig la dɔl suokanɛ yi man san'anɛ kena pian' tisi fɔ?”

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “You'll find out on the day you have to hide in the back room of some house.”
translation_verse: Mikaya da lɛbis ye, “Fʋ ya'a ti zɔɔ kpɛn' dɔkanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la daasi'eri su'a, daakan ka fʋ na baŋ!”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Arrest Micaiah! Take him to Prince Joash and Governor Amon of Samaria.
translation_verse: Israel Na'ab la da tis nɔɔr ye, “Gban'ami Mikaya mɔr o lɛb Ammon onɛ an tempʋʋg zugdaan nɛ Joab onɛ an na'abiig la san'an,

english_verse: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.”
translation_verse: ka yɛl ye, ‘Na'ab la yɛl ye ya yɔɔmi ninkaŋa sanrega ni ka da tis o si'el si'ela asɛɛ bodobodo nɛ ku'om ma'aa hali nɛ mam na ti lɛb laafi na.’”

english_verse: Micaiah said, “If you do come back, I was wrong about what the Lord wanted me to say.” Then he told the crowd, “Don't forget what I said!” Ahab Dies at Ramoth (
translation_verse: Ka Mikaya lɛbisi yɛl o nyain ye, “Fʋ ya'a sid nyaŋi lɛb laafi na, alaa Zugsɔb la pʋ pian' dɔlisi yi man san'anɛ!” Ka lɛm paas ye, “Kpansimi m pian'ad la, yanam banɛ bɛ kpɛla la!” Ahab kum yɛla (

english_verse: Before they went into battle, Ahab said, “Jehoshaphat, I'll disguise myself, but you wear your royal robe.” Ahab disguised himself and went into battle.
translation_verse: Israel Na'ab da yɛl Na'ab Jehosafat ye, “Man na tiaki m mɛŋi kpɛn' zaba la pʋʋgin, amaa fʋn yɛɛmi fʋ na'am fuud.” Ka o sid da tiak o mɛŋi kpɛn' zaba la ni.

english_verse: The king of Syria had ordered his chariot commanders to attack only Ahab.
translation_verse: Aram Na'ab da pʋn tis o zaba tɛrekonam tuongatib nɔɔr ye, “Da zab nɛ sɔ'ɔsɔ, li ya'a anɛ kpi'em bɛɛ tadim, asɛɛ Israel Na'ab la ma'aa!”

english_verse: So when they saw Jehoshaphat in his robe, they thought he was Ahab and started to attack him. But Jehoshaphat prayed, and the Lord made the Syrian soldiers stop.
translation_verse: Tɛrekonam zabzabidib tuongatib la nyɛ Na'ab Jehosafat la, ba da tɛn'ɛs ye, “Nɛ' lɛn ka' bi'esʋgɔ, Israel Na'ab la nwa'!” Ka ba fɛndig ye ba zab nɛ o, ka Jehosafat nwɛ' kuŋ, ka Zugsɔb la sʋŋ o ka kɛ ka ba bas o.

english_verse: And when they realized he wasn't Ahab, they left him alone.
translation_verse: Ka tɛrekonam la tuongatib la gɔs ka li ka' Israel Na'ab laa, ka ba bas ka pʋ lɛn kad o.

english_verse: However, during the fighting a soldier shot an arrow without even aiming, and it hit Ahab between two pieces of his armor. He shouted to his chariot driver, “I've been hit! Get me out of here!”
translation_verse: Amaa ka Aram nid tɛk o tiraugʋ tɔn yɔɔgʋ ka li keŋ gban'e Israel Na'ab la, ka piim la wiee o zaba la'ad la kpɛn' kʋns o. Na'ab la da yɛl onɛ dɔribid o zaba tɛreko la ye, “Fɛndigim tɛreko la ka ti yi zaba la yiŋ, ka m pu'alim nɛ.”

english_verse: The fighting lasted all day, with Ahab propped up in his chariot so he could see the Syrian troops. He stayed there until evening, and by sundown he was dead.
translation_verse: Zaba la da mu'oe daakan ka Na'ab la zi'enɛ kpa' Aram dim la, ka zaam ti ma'ae la ka o kpi.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Juda na'ab Jehosafat n da lɛb o yin Jerusalem nɛ laafi la,

english_verse: But the prophet Jehu son of Hanani met him and said: By helping that wicked Ahab, you have made friends with someone who hates the Lord. Now the Lord God is angry with you!
translation_verse: Hanani biig Jehu onɛ da nyɛt nier yɛla la da yina ye o tʋ'ʋs o, ka bu'os o ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ sʋŋid nimbɛ'ɛdnam ka maan nɔɔr yinne nɛ banɛ kis Zugsɔb la? Nɛ'ɛŋa zug Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn bɛɛ fʋ zug.

english_verse: But not everything about you is bad. You destroyed the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah—that shows you have tried to obey the Lord. Jehoshaphat Appoints Judges To Settle Cases
translation_verse: Amaa bʋnsʋŋ si'a bɛɛ fʋ ni, fʋ mɔɔ yis Asera teŋgban daad la teŋ la wʋsa ni ka nɔki fʋ sʋnf wʋsa dɔl Wina'am.” Na'ab Jehosafat n gaans sariakatib si'em

english_verse: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but he often traveled through his kingdom, from Beersheba in the south to the edge of the hill country of Ephraim in the north. He talked with the people and convinced them to turn back to the Lord God and worship him, just as their ancestors had done.
translation_verse: Na'ab Jehosafat da bɛ nɛ Jerusalem, ka lɛn keŋ nimbanɛ bɛ Beerseba nɛ Efiram linɛ an kʋkʋna teŋ la kɛ ka ba lɛbi dɔl Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la.

english_verse: He assigned judges to each of the fortified cities in Judah
translation_verse: O da gaans sariakatib zin'ikpi'euŋ wʋsa linɛ bɛ Juda teŋin la.

english_verse: and told them: Be careful when you make your decisions in court, because you are judging by the Lord's standards and not by human standards, and he will know what you decide.
translation_verse: Ka yɛli ba ye, “Gu'usimi nɛ yanamɛ maan si'el wʋsa, bɔzugɔ ya pʋ kad saria la tisid ninsaala, amaa Zugsɔb onɛ bɛ nɛ ya hali nɛ yanamɛ na ti kʋʋs antu'a la.

english_verse: So do your work in honor of him and know that he won't allow you to be unfair to anyone or to take bribes.
translation_verse: Nannanna kɛlli ka Zugsɔb la dabiem bɛɛ ya ni. Kadimi saria la sʋ'ʋŋa. Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la kʋ siak zam, bɛɛ baregaŋ, bɛɛ ban na da'af nɛ ligidii.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat also chose some Levites, some priests, and some of the family leaders, and he appointed them to serve as judges in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Jehosafat mɛ da gaans Levi dim nɛ maanmaannib nɛ Israel tuŋ kpɛɛmnam Jerusalem teŋin ye ba pa'al Zugsɔb wada la ka maal yɛla. Ba da zin' nɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin.

english_verse: The people of Judah will bring you legal cases that involve every type of crime, including murder. You must settle these cases and warn the people to stop sinning against the Lord, so that he won't get angry and punish Judah. Remember, if you follow these instructions, you won't be held responsible for anything that happens.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a mɔr antu'a si'a wʋsa kɛɛn ya san'an na ka li anɛ ya teŋ nid onɛ bɛ tempʋʋgin la yɛla; o ya'a kʋnɛ nid, bɛɛ tʋm linɛ pʋ dɔl nɛ wada bɛɛ zi'ela bɛɛ gban'ar bɛɛ malima la, asɛɛ ya sa'ali ba ye ba da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi san'am Zugsɔb la sʋnfɔ, ka li ya'a ka' ala o sʋnpɛɛn na lu yanam nɛ ya ba'abiis la zug. Niŋimi nɛ' ka ya kʋ kpɛn' taali nɛ.

english_verse: Amariah the high priest will have the final say in any religious case. And Zebadiah, the leader of the Judah tribe, will have the final say in all other cases. The rest of the Levites will serve as your assistants. Be brave, and I pray that the Lord will help you do right.
translation_verse: Amaraya onɛ an maanmaan kpɛɛm la na sʋ'oe si'el wʋsa linɛ an Zugsɔb la tʋʋma, ka Zebadaya onɛ an Isimael biig ka gat Juda dɔɔg dim la tuon la mɛ na sʋ'oe na'am yɛla tisi ya. Levi dim na sʋŋi ya yɛla wʋsa ni. Alazug mɔri sʋnkpi'euŋ, ka Zugsɔb la na bɛ nɛ banɛ tʋm sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Messengers told Jehoshaphat, “A large army from Edom east of the Dead Sea has invaded our country. They have already reached En-Gedi.”
translation_verse: Dap sieba da kena yɛl Jehosafat ye, “Zabzabidib bɛdegʋ yi Edom nɛ Atɛuk la nya'aŋ baba kenna ye ba zab nɛf. Ba pʋn paae Hazazɔn Tamar.” .

english_verse: Jehoshaphat was afraid, so he asked the Lord what to do. He then told the people of Judah to go without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Dabiem da kpɛn' Jehosafat ka o keŋ ye o bu'os Zugsɔb la ka yɛl Juda teŋ nidib wʋsa ye ba lɔɔm nɔɔr.

english_verse: After everyone from Judah and Jerusalem had come together at the Lord's temple, Jehoshaphat stood in front of the new courtyard
translation_verse: Ka Jehosafat duoe zi'en Juda nɛ Jerusalem tɛɛns la ni, Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zak paalig la tuonnɛ

english_verse: and prayed: You, Lord, are the God our ancestors worshiped, and from heaven you rule every nation in the world. You are so powerful that no one can defeat you.
translation_verse: yɛl ye, “Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ aan ti yaanam Wina'am. Fʋ ka'anɛ Wina'am bɛ arezana nii? Fʋnɛ sʋ'oe dunia sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa. Paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ bɛ nɛ fʋ nu'usin, ka sɔ' kae na nyaŋi zi'enɛ fʋ tuonnɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you forced out the nations who lived in this land before your people Israel came here, and you gave it to the descendants of your friend Abraham forever.
translation_verse: Oo ti Wina'am, ka' fʋʋ da kad teŋ la nidib ka bas suori tisi fʋ nidib Israel, ka lɛn nɔki li tis Abraham onɛ aan fʋ zua la yaas laa?

english_verse: Our ancestors lived in this land and built a temple to honor you.
translation_verse: Ba zin'inɛ ani ka mɛ' Pʋ'ʋsim Yir ani tisi fʋ yʋ'ʋri yɛt ye,

english_verse: They believed that whenever this land is struck by war or disease or famine, your people can pray to you at the temple, and you will hear their prayer and save them.
translation_verse: ‘Tɔɔg ya'a ti paae ti, ka li anɛ zaba bɛɛ ban'as bɛɛ kɔ'ɔm, ti na zi'enɛ fʋ tuon Pʋ'ʋsim Yir linɛ ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ ani la kaasi ti sʋnsa'aŋ la pʋʋgin ka fʋ wʋm tisi ti ka faaɛn ti.’

english_verse: You can see that the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Edom are attacking us! Those are the nations you would not let our ancestors invade on their way from Egypt, so these nations were not destroyed.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna dap nwa' yit Ammon nɛ Moab nɛ Zuokanɛ buon Seir la kenna. Israel dimi da yi Egipt na la fʋ da pʋ siak ye ba kpɛn' ba tɛɛnsin la daami ba; ka ba sid fɛndig ka pʋ keŋ daami ba.

english_verse: Aren't you going to punish them? We won't stand a chance when this army attacks. We don't know what to do—we are begging for your help.
translation_verse: Oo ti Wina'am, fʋ kʋ kadi ba sariaa? Ka tinam ka' paŋ kanɛ na tʋ'ʋs zabzabidib banɛ wʋsa kenna ye ba zab nɛ ti la. Ti zi' tinamɛ ye ti niŋ si'em, amaa ti kpɛn gɔsidnɛ fʋ.”

english_verse: While every man, woman, and child of Judah was standing there at the temple,
translation_verse: Juda dap la wʋsa nɛ ba pu'ab nɛ dasam nɛ biis da zi'en ani Zugsɔb la tuon.

english_verse: Then Jahaziel said: Your Majesty and everyone from Judah and Jerusalem, the Lord says that you don't need to be afraid or let this powerful army discourage you. God will fight on your side!
translation_verse: ka yɛl ye, “Kɛlisimi, Na'ab Jehosafat nɛ banɛ wʋsa bɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalem! Zugsɔb la yɛt si'eli nwa' tisidi ya: ‘Da kɛ ka dabiem mɔri ya bɛɛ ya sʋnf san'amnɛ soogianam banɛ zu'oe la yɛllɛ. Bɔzugɔ zaba la ka' ya dinnɛ, amaa Zugsɔb la din.

english_verse: So here's what you must do. Tomorrow the enemy armies will march through the desert around the town of Jeruel. March down and meet them at the town of Ziz as they come up the valley.
translation_verse: Bɛog yanam on duom keŋ tʋ'ʋsi ba. Ba saa na dʋt Ziz Suor la baba ka ya saa na nyɛɛ ba ka ba bɛ bɔn'ɔfalig linɛ zulim la naar zin'ig linɛ bɛ Jeruel pipirigin la.’

english_verse: You won't even have to fight. Just take your positions and watch the Lord rescue you from your enemy. Don't be afraid. Just do as you're told. And as you march out tomorrow, the Lord will be there with you.
translation_verse: Li ka' yanamɛ na zab zabkaŋaa. Maalim zi'enɛ sʋ'ʋŋa ka gɔs yɔlisim kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la na tisi ya, yanam Juda nɛ Jerusalem dima. Da zɔti dabiem; mɛ da kɛ ka ya ya'am ian'ada. Bɛog yanam on yim tʋ'ʋsi nɛ ba ka Zugsɔb la na bɛ nɛ ya.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat bowed low to the ground and everyone worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Jehosafat da su'un ka o zug kpa' teŋin, ka Juda nɛ Jerusalem nidib la wʋsa igini wɔ'ɔgid Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Then some Levites from the Kohath and Korah clans stood up and shouted praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Levi dim sieba banɛ yi Kohat nɛ Kora tuŋ ni la da duoe zi'enɛ pian'ad Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar.

english_verse: Early the next morning, as everyone got ready to leave for the desert near Tekoa, Jehoshaphat stood up and said, “Listen my friends, if we trust the Lord God and believe what these prophets have told us, the Lord will help us, and we will be successful.”
translation_verse: Bɛkɛung asuba ba da yii keŋ Tekoa pipirigin la. Ban da yit la, Na'ab Jehosafat da zi'en ka yɛl ye, “Kɛlisimi, Juda nɛ Jerusalem nidiba! Niŋimini ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la yadda ka o na guri ya, ka niŋ o nɔdi'esidib la yadda ka ya na nyaŋ.”

english_verse: Then he explained his plan and appointed men to march in front of the army and praise the Lord for his holy power by singing: “Praise the Lord! His love never ends.”
translation_verse: Jehosafat da nwɛ' nidib la sɔɔra ka gaans dapsieba ye ba yʋʋm tis Zugsɔb la ka wɔ'ɔg o na'am pipilim linɛ pa'annɛ o kasi yɛla la, ka yii gaad tuongatib la tuonnɛ yɛt ye, “Pʋ'ʋsimi Zugsɔb la bareka; bɔzugɔ o nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.”

english_verse: so that the Ammonite and Moabite troops attacked and completely destroyed those from Edom. Then they turned against each other and fought until the entire camp was wiped out!
translation_verse: Dap banɛ yi Ammon nɛ Moab la da duoe zab nɛ dap banɛ yi Seir Zuorin na la nyaŋi ba kʋʋ ba wʋsa. Ban yʋ'ʋn da kʋ Seir nidib la naae la ka yʋ'ʋn lɛbi kʋʋd taaba.

english_verse: When Judah's army reached the tower that overlooked the desert, they saw that every soldier in the enemy's army was lying dead on the ground.
translation_verse: Juda dap la da kena zi'en zin'ikanɛ ka ba na naami gɔsidi nyɛt pipirig la, ka gɔs soogianam la bɛ zin'isi'a la, ba da nyɛ nɛ nidibi kpii dig teŋin: sɔ'ɔsɔ da pʋ pɔnsɛ.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day, everyone came together in Beracah Valley and sang praises to the Lord. That's why that place was called Praise Valley.
translation_verse: Daba anaasi daar la ba da la'as taaba Beraka Bɔn'ɔgin zun'e Zugsɔb la. Linɛ kɛ ka ba buon zin'ikan ye Beraka Bɔn'ɔg hali ti paae zina.

english_verse: When the other nations heard how the Lord had fought against Judah's enemies, they were too afraid
translation_verse: Ban da wʋm Zugsɔb la zab nɛ Israel dim dataas la si'em la, Wina'am dabiem da kpɛn' na'abanɛ bɛ tembama la ni.

english_verse: to invade Judah. The Lord let Jehoshaphat's kingdom be at peace. Jehoshaphat Dies (
translation_verse: Jehosafat sʋ'ʋlim la da mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm bɔzugɔ Wina'am da tis o vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'ig wʋsa. Jehosafat na'am la naar (

english_verse: While Jehoshaphat was king, he signed a peace treaty with Ahaziah the wicked king of Israel.
translation_verse: Li nya'aŋ la Jehosafat da naal nɔɔr nɛ Ahazaya onɛ an Israel na'ab onɛ da an bugusim sɔb la.

english_verse: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Amaa teŋgbana la o da pʋ yisi ba, ka nidib la pʋ nɔki ba sʋnya dɔlli ba yaanam Wina'am la.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ yɛla banɛ da maal Jehosafat na'am diib saŋa, lin yi li pin'ilʋgʋn ti paae li naarin la, li wʋsa sɔb Hanani biig Jehu yɛlkʋda labaya gbana la ni, linɛ bɛ Israel Na'anam Gbauŋ la ni.

english_verse: They agreed to build several seagoing ships at Ezion-Geber.
translation_verse: On nɛ Ahazaya da naal nɔɔri kpiisid nɛ anrintitada. Ba da kpa' li Eziyon Geber teŋin.

english_verse: But the prophet Eliezer warned Jehoshaphat, “The Lord will destroy these ships because you have supported Ahaziah.” The ships were wrecked and never sailed.
translation_verse: Elieza onɛ an Dodavahu biig ka yi Maresa teŋin na la da pian' zɛrig Jehosafat ye, “Fʋn naal nɛ Ahazaya la zug, Zugsɔb la na san'am fʋn maal si'el la wʋsa.” Anrima la da san'am ya, ka ba pʋ lɛn nyaŋidi mɔri kpiisida.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Jehosafat da maal ka'alim ka ba mum o, David tempʋʋgin. Ka o biig Jehoram da di'e o zin'igi di na'am la.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem. He died, and no one even felt sad. He was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Jehoram saŋa la, Edom da zan'as Juda dim ka diisi ba mɛŋ na'ab.

english_verse: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka Filistia dim nɛ Arab dim banɛ da kpi'e nɛ Kus buudi la sʋnf duoe nɛ Jehoram.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.
translation_verse: Ba saam da tisi ba piini bɛdegʋ linɛ an anzurifa nɛ sanlima nɛ la'ad linɛ mɔr nyɔɔd la'an nɛ teŋ kpi'ema banɛ bɛ Juda sʋ'ʋlimin, amaa o da nɔk na'am sʋ'ʋlim la nɛ tis Jehoram bɔzugɔ onɛ da aan o bikpɛŋ. Jehoram onɛ an Juda na'ab la yɛla (

english_verse: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Jehoram da ba' nya'a sʋ'ʋŋa o saam sʋ'ʋlim la ni la, o da kʋʋ o pitib la wʋsa la'an nɛ kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛ Israel la sieba.

english_verse: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong,
translation_verse: O da di Ahab pu'ayua ka dinzug o da dɔlis wʋʋ Israel na'anamɛ dɔlisid si'em la, nwɛnɛ Ahab yidimi da niŋ si'em la, ka tʋm bɛ'ɛd pamm Zugsɔb la tuon.

english_verse: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, o sankpan'as David zugɔɔ, Zugsɔb la da pʋ siak ye o san'am Juda teŋ laa. O da kaanb ye o na kɛ ka fitir si'a kpɛm bɛɛ tis David nɛ o yaas, saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Jehoram, his officers, and his cavalry marched to Edom, where the Edomite army surrounded them. He escaped during the night,
translation_verse: Dinzug Jehoram da keŋ Zair teŋin nɛ o zaba tɛrekonam la wʋsa, ka Edom dim la da gilig on nɛ o kpi'emnam banɛ gɔt zaba tɛrekonam la, amaa o da duoe yʋ'ʋŋʋ aaɛn yi.

english_verse: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Hali ti paae zina Juda pʋ lɛn sʋ'oe Edom dim la. Libna teŋ dim mɛ da zan'as nɛ saŋa kan mɛn, bɔzugɔ Jehoram da ki'is Zugsɔb onɛ aan o yaanam Wina'am la.

english_verse: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.
translation_verse: O mɛ da mɛ' bada zin'is linɛ bɛ Juda zuoya la zug, ka kɛ ka Jerusalem dim yʋ'ʋn tʋm nwɛnɛ pu'agɔɔnda nɛ ka kɛ ka Juda kpɛn' mɔɔg.

english_verse: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.
translation_verse: Jehoram da di'e gbauŋʋ yi Wina'am nɔdi'es Elaja san'an ka li yɛt ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ aan fʋ yaab David Wina'am la yɛl si'em nwa' ye: ‘Fʋ pʋ dɔl suokanɛ ka fʋ saam Na'ab Jehosafat da dɔl la, bɛɛ Juda na'ab Asa n da an si'em la.

english_verse: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord, just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋ dɔlli Israel dim na'anam suoya, ka kɛ ka Juda nɛ Jerusalem nidib pʋ bɛ zin'ig yinnee ka yuod wʋʋ Ahab zaki maal si'em la. Fʋ mɛ kʋʋ fʋ mɛŋ pitib, fʋ saam yir nidib, dap banɛ da sɔn'ɔf.

english_verse: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.
translation_verse: Nannanna Zugsɔb la ti'ebnɛ ye o nwɛ' fʋ nidib la. Fʋ biribis, nɛ fʋ pu'ab, nɛ linɛ wʋsa aan fʋ din, o na nwɛ' ba kpisinkpil tita'ar.

english_verse: You will be struck with a painful stomach disease and suffer until you die.
translation_verse: Fʋ mɛŋ ye fʋ bɛn'ɛnɛ ban'abɛ'og, ban'akanɛ pʋ basid na gban'e fʋ gbinvɔ-nyɔɔg, hali ka ban'a la ti kɛ ka fʋ gbinvɔ-nyɔɔg la yi paalʋ na.’”

english_verse: They invaded Judah and stole the royal property from the palace, and they led Jehoram's wives and sons away as prisoners. The only one left behind was Ahaziah, his youngest son.
translation_verse: Ba da keŋ zab nɛ Juda dim la nyaŋi ba, ka vaae la'asʋma banɛ ka ba nyɛ na'ayin la wʋsa, la'an nɛ na'ab la pu'ab nɛ o biis. Biig baa yinne da pʋ kpɛlim o san'anɛ asɛɛ Ahazaya onɛ an kpaanr la.

english_verse: After this happened, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable stomach disease.
translation_verse: Nɛ' nya'aŋ Zugsɔb la sid da kɛ ka ban'akanɛ ka' ti'ebʋg gban'e o gbinvɔ-nyɔɔg.

english_verse: About two years later, Jehoram died in terrible pain. No bonfire was built to honor him, even though the people had done this for his ancestors.
translation_verse: Lin da bɛɛ ala zaŋi ken yʋma ayi' la o gbinvɔ-nyɔɔg la da yi paalʋ na ban'a la zug, zabid hali ka o ti kpi zabir la zug. O nidib la da pʋ nyu'oe bugum tis o na'asi wʋʋ ban da niŋ si'em tis o yaanam la.

english_verse: and while Jehu was doing that, he saw some of Judah's leaders and Ahaziah's nephews who had come with Ahaziah. Jehu killed them on the spot,
translation_verse: On da nan kʋʋd Ahab yidim la, o da nyɛ Juda kpɛɛmnam nɛ Ahazaya du'adib bibanɛ da sʋŋid Ahazaya la, ka mɛ kʋʋ ba pɛ'ɛs.

english_verse: then gave orders to find Ahaziah. Jehu's officers found him hiding in Samaria. They brought Ahaziah to Jehu, who immediately put him to death. They buried Ahaziah only because they respected Jehoshaphat his grandfather, who had done his best to obey the Lord. There was no one from Ahaziah's family left to become king of Judah. Queen Athaliah of Judah (
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn kpɛn' ieed Na'ab Ahazaya mɛŋ, on da su'ad Samaria tempʋʋgin la. Ka Jehu nidib la da nyɛɛ o ani gban'e o. Ba da mɔr o keŋ Jehu san'an na n kʋʋ o. Ba da mum o, bɔzugɔ ba da yɛl ye, “O anɛ Jehosafat onɛ da dɔl Zugsɔb la nɛ o sʋnf wʋsa la biig.” Alazug sɔ' da lɛn kae Ahazaya yin la an wisiŋa na di'e na'am la. Atalia nɛ Joas yɛla (

english_verse: In fact, after his father's death, Ahaziah sinned against the Lord by appointing some of Ahab's relatives to be his advisors. Their advice led to his downfall.
translation_verse: O da tʋm bɛ'ɛd Zugsɔb la tuon, nwɛnɛ Ahab yidimi da niŋ si'em la, bɔzugɔ o saam kum nya'aŋ la banɛ da sa'al o ka o tʋm linɛ pʋ nar la, da san'am o yɛla.

english_verse: He listened to them and went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: O mɛ da dɔlli ba sa'ala on da dɔl Ahab biig, Joram n keŋ zab nɛ Hazael onɛ an Aram Na'ab la, Ramot Gilead teŋin. Aram dim la da pu'alim Joram

english_verse: It was during that visit that God had Ahaziah put to death. When Ahaziah arrived at Jezreel, he and Joram went to meet with Jehu grandson of Nimshi. The Lord had already told Jehu to kill every male in Ahab's family,
translation_verse: Ahazaya n da kaae Joram la zug, Wina'am da kɛ ka Ahazaya lu. Ahazaya n da paae la, o da dɔl Joram nya'aŋi yi ye o tʋ'ʋs Jehu onɛ an Nimsi biig onɛ ka Zugsɔb la gaŋ ye o san'am Ahab zak la.

english_verse: but Jehosheba rescued Joash son of Ahaziah just as the others were about to be murdered. Jehosheba, who was Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's half sister, was married to Jehoiada the priest. So she was able to hide her nephew Joash and his personal servant in a bedroom in the Lord's temple where he was safe from Athaliah.
translation_verse: Amaa Jehoseba, onɛ da an Na'ab Joram pu'ayua la, da nɔk o taʋn Na'ab Ahazaya biig Joas n yis na'ayin la mɔr o zɔɔ yi banɛ da bɔɔd ye ba kʋʋ o la san'an. O da nɔk o nɛ o biyuol la su'a dɔgbɛɛndigin, zin'ikanɛ ka Atalia kʋ nyɛɛ o: li da kɛ ka ba pʋ nyaŋi kʋʋ o.

english_verse: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done just that,
translation_verse: Na'ab Ahazaya ma la yʋ'ʋri da buon Atalia. On da nyɛ ka ba kʋ o biig Na'ab Ahazaya la, o da duoe gban'e na'am tuŋ la dim wʋsa kʋ.

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with them for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.
translation_verse: On nɛ ban da kpɛm bɛ suakin Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la yʋma ayuobʋ, Atalia da di na'am saŋsi'a la.

english_verse: These five men went to the towns in Judah and called together the Levites and the clan leaders. They all came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ba da kaae Juda sʋ'ʋlim tɛɛns la wʋsa ka la'as Levi dim nɛ Israel dim wʋsa yidaannam la na. Ban da paae Jerusalem tempʋʋgin na la,

english_verse: Jehoiada and his sons brought Joash outside, where they placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of the instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, and the crowd cheered and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Jehoyada nɛ o biis la da yis Na'ab biig la paalʋ na, ka nɔk na'am zupibig la pid o, ka nɔk wada gbauŋʋ tis o ka diis o na'am. Ba da nɔk malʋŋ kpaam bu'oe niŋ o zugin ka tans nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Win na tis Na'ab nyɔvʋr wɔk!”

english_verse: Here is what we will do. Three groups of priests and Levites will be on guard duty on the Sabbath—one group will guard the gates of the temple,
translation_verse: Ka yanamɛ ye ya tʋm si'em nwa': yanam maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim banɛ ka ba pʋdig zin'is atan' ye ya pʋdigir yinne tʋm Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la, kɛlli ka pʋdigir yinne gur za'anɔya la,

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Teŋ la nidib wʋsa da maal sumalisim. Ka tempʋʋg la da lɛbi niŋ baanlimm, bɔzugɔ ba da kʋʋ Atalia.

english_verse: After Ahaziah's son Joash had hidden in the temple for six years, Jehoiada the priest knew that something had to be done. So he made sure he had the support of several army officers. They were Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
translation_verse: Atalia da dii o na'am la, li yʋma ayɔpɔi saŋa la, Jehoyada da tʋm buol soogianam kpɛɛmnam la banɛ sʋ'oe nidib kɔbig-kɔbig, ka ba yʋda aan Azaria Jeroham biig, nɛ Isimael Jehohanan biig, nɛ Azaria sɔ' onɛ saamme da an Obɛd la, nɛ Maaseya Adaya biig, nɛ Zikir biig Elisafat.

english_verse: and gathered at the temple, where they agreed to help Joash. Jehoiada said to them: Joash will be our next king, because long ago the Lord promised that one of David's descendants would always be king.
translation_verse: nidib wʋsa da la'as Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na naal nɔɔr nɛ Na'ab la. Jehoyada da yɛli ba ye, “Na'ab biig la na di na'am sʋ'oe sʋ'ʋlim la wʋʋ Zugsɔb la da zi'el nɔɔr si'em tis Na'ab David yaas la.

english_verse: one will guard the palace, and the other will guard Foundation Gate. The rest of you will stand guard in the temple courtyards.
translation_verse: ka pʋdigir yinne mɛ gur na'ayir la, ka yinne mɛ gur ɛɛnbir Yaŋir la: ka banɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa na zi'en Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'asin la gu'ud.

english_verse: Only the priests and Levites who are on duty will be able to enter the temple, because they will be the only ones who have gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable. The others must stay outside in the courtyards, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Mid ka sɔ' kpɛn' Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka li ya'a ka'anɛ maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim banɛ bɛɛ li tʋʋma ni la ma'aanɛ; banɛ na nyaŋi kpɛn' bɔzugɔ ba anɛ banɛ maali ba mɛŋ kasi. Banɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa anɛ ye ba gur zin'ibanɛ ka Zugsɔb la pa'ali ba ye ba gur la.

english_verse: You Levites must protect King Joash. Don't let him out of your sight! And keep your swords ready to kill anyone who comes into the temple.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka Levi dim wʋsa zanli ba zaba la'ad ka zi'enɛ gilig Na'ab la. Sɔ' ya'a kpɛn' Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la yanam on kʋʋm o. Dɔlli Na'ab la vɛn'-vɛn' on ken zin'isi'a wʋsa.”

english_verse: The Levites and the people of Judah followed Jehoiada's orders. The guards going off duty were not allowed to go home, and so each commander had all his guards available—those going off duty as well as those coming on duty.
translation_verse: Levi dim nɛ Juda nidib la wʋsa da niŋ nwɛnɛ Maanmaan Jehoyada yɛli ba si'em la wʋsa. Sɔ' wʋsa da buol o nimbanɛ gur Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la nɛ banɛ pʋ gur daakan la mɔri ba kɛn Jehoyada onɛ an Maanmaan la san'an na.

english_verse: Jehoiada went into the temple and brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David, and he gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: O da yis Na'ab David zaba la'ad linɛ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na tis soogiakpɛɛmnam la.

english_verse: They gave the weapons to the guards, and Jehoiada then made sure that the guards took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect the king on every side.
translation_verse: Banɛ gur la wʋsa da mɔr zaba la'adi ba nu'usin ka zi'enɛ gilig Na'ab la kpi'e nɛ maan daka Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, lin naan ya-dagɔbʋgʋ keŋ paae datiuŋ.

english_verse: As soon as Queen Athaliah heard the crowd cheering for Joash, she went to the temple.
translation_verse: Atalia n da wʋm nidib la maan tʋkpiidʋg nɛ ban zɔti zɔt ka dʋ'ʋsid Na'ab la si'em la, o da kpɛn' ba san'an Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns near the entrance, which was the usual place for the king. The commanders and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the musicians were playing instruments and leading the people as they celebrated and blew trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: Ka gɔsi nyɛ Na'ab la zi'e kpi'e o zan'antɔlig la bɛ za'anɔɔrin baba la. Ka mɛ nyɛ kpɛɛmnam la nɛ banɛ piebid na'atana la da zi'e kpi'e Na'ab la, ka nidib la wʋsa maan sumalisim ka piebid na'atana la. Ka Atalia aans o fuud, ka tansi kaasi yɛl ye, “Biriku'annim ye! Biriku'annim ye!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Don't kill her near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops, and be sure to kill all of her followers!”
translation_verse: Jehoyada onɛ an Maanmaan la da yɛl soogia kpɛɛmnam nɛ tuongatib la ye, “Mɔr o dɔl soogianam la teŋsʋkʋ yii na ka onɛ wʋsa dɔl, yanam on kʋʋm o!” Bɔzugɔ Maanmaan la da yɛl ye, “Li pʋ nar ye ba kʋʋ o Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin laa.”

english_verse: She tried to escape, but the commanders caught and killed her near the gate where horses are led into the palace.
translation_verse: Dinzug on da paae widi dɔl suosi'a kpɛn'ɛd na'ayin la ba da gban'e o kʋʋ ani.

english_verse: Jehoiada asked King Joash and the people to join with him in being faithful to the Lord. They agreed,
translation_verse: Jehoyada da naal nɔɔr nɛ Zugsɔb la nɛ Na'ab nɛ nidib la, ye ba na an Zugsɔb la nidib.

english_verse: then rushed to the temple of the god Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and the idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
translation_verse: Teŋ la nidib wʋsa da la'asi keŋ Baal teŋgban Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la nwa'ae li ka da'ae teŋgban la bas teŋin. Ba da san'am si'el wʋsa, ka gban'e Matan onɛ an Baal maanmaan la kʋ maan bimbima la tuon.

english_verse: Jehoiada assigned the priests and Levites their duties at the temple, just as David had done. They were in charge of offering sacrifices to the Lord according to the Law of Moses, and they were responsible for leading the celebrations with singing.
translation_verse: Jehoyada yʋ'ʋn da nɔk Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma sʋ'ʋlim niŋ maanmaannib banɛ da yi Levi dɔɔgin na la nu'usin. Bama ka Na'ab David da pʋn zi'eli ba tʋʋma Pʋ'ʋsim Yir pʋʋgin, ye ba maan nyu'or maana tisid Zugsɔb la wʋʋ lin sɔb si'em Moses Wada Gbauŋʋn la, ka tʋmmi ba tʋʋma nɛ sumalisim nɛ yʋʋma, wʋʋ Na'ab David n da zi'eli ba si'em la.

english_verse: Jehoiada ordered the guards at the temple gates to keep out anyone who was unclean.
translation_verse: O da zi'el za'anɔgu'udib ye ba zi'e Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔya la ni, linɛ na kɛ ka onɛ wʋsa an dian'ad sɔb kʋ kpɛn' ani.

english_verse: Finally, Jehoiada called together the army commanders, the most important citizens of Judah, and the government officials. The crowd of people followed them as they led Joash from the temple, through the Upper Gate, and into the palace, where he took his place as king of Judah.
translation_verse: O da nɔk soogiakpɛɛmnam banɛ sʋ'oe nidib kɔbig-kɔbig, nɛ banɛ gu'ud, nɛ nimbanɛ bɛ teŋ la ni wʋsa n zi'el. Ka yis na'ab la Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la dɔl Za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ zugin la keŋ na'ayin la. Na'ab la yʋ'ʋn da zin'inɛ o na'am zin'igin la.

english_verse: While Jehoiada the priest was alive, Joash obeyed the Lord by doing right.
translation_verse: Joas da tʋm linɛ nar Zugsɔb la nini ni yʋʋm banɛ wʋsa ka Jehoyada da an Maanmaan la.

english_verse: Joash and Jehoiada turned the money over to the men who were supervising the repairs to the temple. They used the money to hire stonecutters, carpenters, and experts in working with iron and bronze.
translation_verse: Na'ab la nɛ Jehoyada da nɔkidnɛ ligidi la tisid dap banɛ gɔsid tʋʋm kanɛ nar ye ba tʋm Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la. Ka ba haad banɛ mɛɛd nɛ kampintanam ye ba maligim maal Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la, nɛ banɛ tʋm nɛ kʋnt nɛ kʋntzɛn'ug la.

english_verse: and he was buried in the royal tombs in Jerusalem, because he had done so much good for the people of Israel, for God, and for the temple. Joash Turns Away from the Lord
translation_verse: Ba da mum o nɛ na'anam yaadin David tempʋʋgin la, on da tʋm tʋʋm sʋma Israel teŋin tis Zugsɔb la nɛ o Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la zug. Na'ab Joas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla

english_verse: And now we need it to repair the temple because the sons of that evil woman Athaliah came in and wrecked it. They even used some of the sacred objects to worship the god Baal.”
translation_verse: Atalia onɛ da an pu'a kanɛ an bugusim sɔb la saŋa la, o biis da kpɛn' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir pʋʋginɛ nɔk Wina'am mɛŋ la'ad linɛ an kasi la mɔri keŋ pʋ'ʋs Baal teŋgbana la.

english_verse: Jehoiada even chose two women for Joash to marry so he could have a family.
translation_verse: Jehoyada da di pu'ab ayi' tis o, ka on nɛ ban du'a biribis nɛ bipumis.

english_verse: Some time later, Joash decided it was time to repair the temple.
translation_verse: Li da yuug bi'ela ka Na'ab Joas yʋ'ʋn gban'e ye o na maligim maal Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la.

english_verse: He called together the priests and Levites and said, “Go everywhere in Judah and collect the annual tax from the people. I want this done at once—we need that money to repair the temple.” But the Levites were in no hurry to follow the king's orders.
translation_verse: O da buol maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la ye ba la'as taaba o san'an na ka yɛli ba ye, “Kem giligi Juda tɛɛns wʋsa di'e ligidkanɛ ka Israel dim yɔɔd yʋʋm wʋsa la na ka ti maligim maal Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la. Kem niŋ ala tɔ'ɔtɔ.” Amaa Levi dim la da pʋ niŋ ala tɔ'ɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: So he sent for Jehoiada the high priest and asked, “Why didn't you send the Levites to collect the taxes? The Lord's servant Moses and the people agreed long ago that this tax would be collected and used to pay for the upkeep of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Alazug Na'ab Joas da buol Jehoyada onɛ an maanmaan kpɛɛm la na bu'os o ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ nam pʋ kɛ ka Levi dim la la'as Juda nɛ Jerusalem dim lampɔ ligidi la na? Li da anɛ zi'elʋgʋ yit Zugsɔb la tʋmtʋm Moses nɛ Israel dim la san'an na ye ba nɔki tis Nɔnaar Fuug Sʋgʋr la yɛla.”

english_verse: Joash gave orders for a wooden box to be made and had it placed outside, near the gate of the temple.
translation_verse: Na'ab la da tis nɔɔr ka ba maal daka zi'el yiŋ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la za'anɔɔrin.

english_verse: He then sent letters everywhere in Judah and Jerusalem, asking everyone to bring their taxes to the temple, just as Moses had required their ancestors to do.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn yɛl Juda nɛ Jerusalem dim ye ba mɔr lampɔ kanɛ ka Moses onɛ an Wina'am tʋmtʋm la da yɛl Israel dim ye ba yɔɔm sian'arin la.

english_verse: The people and their leaders agreed, and they brought their money to Jerusalem and placed it in the box.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa da kɛ ka tuongatib la nɛ nidib sʋnf ma'ae, ka ba mɔri ba ligidi na niŋ daka la ni, hali ka li ti pɛ'ɛl.

english_verse: Each day, after the Levites took the box into the temple, the king's secretary and the high priest's assistant would dump out the money and count it. Then the empty box would be taken back outside. This happened day after day, and soon a large amount of money was collected.
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ wʋsa ka Levi dim la mɔr daka la kpɛn' na'ayikpɛm la san'an ka ba nyɛ ka ligidi la zu'oe, na'ayir gbansɔbid la nɛ maanmaan kpɛɛm la ɛɛn baae ligidi la nɛ ka kɛ ka ba mɔr daka la lɛbisi zi'eli li zin'igin. Ba da niŋid nɛ ala saŋa wʋsa ka paamid ligidi bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: They did not use all the tax money for the repairs, so the rest of it was handed over to Joash and Jehoiada, who then used it to make dishes and other gold and silver objects for the temple. Sacrifices to please the Lord were offered regularly in the temple for as long as Jehoiada lived.
translation_verse: Ban da naae la ba da nɔk ligidkanɛ kpɛlim la mɔri kena tis Na'ab la nɛ Jehoyada, ka ba nɔki li maal la'adi niŋ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim yin la: la'abanɛ na nɔki tʋm nɛ la'abanɛ na nyu'oe nyu'or maan la, nɛ labibis, la'an nɛ sanlima nɛ anzurifa la'ad. Jehoyada saŋa la wʋsa nyu'or maan da pʋ viigid Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la.

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the leaders of Judah went to Joash and talked him into doing what they wanted.
translation_verse: Jehoyada kum nya'aŋ la, Israel kpɛɛmnam da keŋ pʋ'ʋs Na'ab la ka sa'al o ka o wʋm tisi ba.

english_verse: The people of Judah soon stopped worshiping in the temple of the Lord God and started worshiping idols and the symbols of the goddess Asherah. These sinful things made the Lord God angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ba da kɛɛs Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la bas ka pʋ'ʋsid Asera onɛ an ba'ar la dazi'eda, nɛ winsieba. Ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug ka Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka tɔɔg sig Juda nɛ Jerusalem teŋin na.

english_verse: but he still sent prophets who warned them to turn back to him. The people refused to listen.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da tʋm o nɔdi'esidib ye ba pian' tis nidib la ka ba tiak. Ka nɔdi'esidib la sid yɛli ba ban tʋm si'el ka li pʋ nar la, amaa ka ba pʋ kɛlisɛ.

english_verse: God's Spirit spoke to Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and Zechariah told everyone that God was saying: “Why are you disobeying me and my laws? This will only bring punishment! You have deserted me, so now I will desert you.”
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am Siig sig Zakaria onɛ saamme an Jehoyada onɛ da an Maanmaan la zugin na. Ka o duoe zi'en nidib la tuon ka yɛli ba ye, “Wina'am bu'os ye, ‘Bɔ ka ya zan'as Zugsɔb la nɔɔrɛ? Ya kʋ nyɛ arezaka. Yanamɛ zan'as Zugsɔb la zug, o mɛ zan'asi ya.’”

english_verse: King Joash forgot that Zechariah's father had always been a loyal friend. So when the people of Judah plotted to kill Zechariah, Joash joined them and gave orders for them to stone him to death in the courtyard of the temple. As Zechariah was dying, he said, “I pray that the Lord will see this and punish all of you.” Joash Is Killed
translation_verse: Na'ab Joas da pʋ tiɛn tʋʋm sʋma banɛ ka Zakaria saam Jehoyada da tʋm tis o la ka kʋʋ o biig. Zakaria n da bɔɔd kum la ka yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la gɔsim yanamɛ tʋm si'el la ka kɛ ka ya namisi li yɛla!”

english_verse: In the spring of the following year, the Syrian army invaded Judah and Jerusalem, killing all of the nation's leaders. They collected everything of value that belonged to the people and took it back to their king in Damascus.
translation_verse: Yʋʋm kan la Aram soogianam da kena zab nɛ Joas, ka nyaŋ Juda nɛ Jerusalem ka kʋ kpɛɛmnam la nɛ nidib la wʋsa. Ka vaae la'abanɛ ka ba faaɛn la wʋsa kuli ba teŋin Damaskus n tisi ba na'ab la.

english_verse: The Syrian army was very small, but the Lord let them defeat Judah's large army, because he was punishing Joash and the people of Judah for turning away from him.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ Aram dim la da mɔr soogianam bi'ela kena la, Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka ba nyaŋ soogianam bɛdegʋ. Juda dimi da zan'as Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la zug ka tɔɔg da paae Joas.

english_verse: Joash was severely wounded during the battle, and as soon as the Syrians left Judah, two of his officials, Zabad and Jehozabad, decided to revenge the death of Zechariah. They plotted and killed Joash while he was in bed, recovering from his wounds. Joash was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Banɛ da gban'e o yɛla bɛ'ɛd la da anɛ, Zabad onɛ ma yʋ'ʋri buon Simeaf ka o an Ammon buudi la nɛ Jehozabad onɛ ma yʋ'ʋri buon Simirif ka o an Moab nid la.

english_verse: The History of the Kings also tells more about the sons of Joash, what the prophets said about him, and how he repaired the temple. Amaziah son of Joash became king after his father's death.

english_verse: Ahaz collected all the furnishings of the temple and smashed them to pieces. Then he locked the doors to the temple and set up altars to foreign gods on every street corner in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ahaz da la'as la'abanɛ bɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la wʋsa mɔri gaadi nwa' ba zɔra-zɔra. O da kpar Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la kɔlis ka maal maan bimbima gilig Jerusalem teŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: In every city and town in Judah he built local shrines to worship foreign gods. All of this made the Lord God of his ancestors very angry.
translation_verse: O da mɛ' bimbima zi'el tempʋbanɛ wʋsa bɛ Juda ye ba maan bada ka li duoe Zugsɔb onɛ aan o yaanam Wina'am la sʋnf.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim yɛla banɛ da maal o na'am saŋa nɛ o suoya wʋsa lin yi pin'ilʋgʋn keŋ paae li bɛn la, ba sɔbi ba niŋ Juda nɛ Israel Na'anam Gbana la ni.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs. His son Hezekiah then became king.
translation_verse: Ahaz da maal ka'alim ka ba mum o Jerusalem tempʋʋgin, amaa ba da pʋ mum o Israel na'anam yaadin laa. Ka o biig Hezekia lɛdigi di na'am la.

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord by doing right, just as his ancestor David had done. The Temple Is Purified
translation_verse: O da maan linɛ an sʋm Zugsɔb la nini ni wʋʋ o yaab David n da tʋm si'em la.

english_verse: they went back to Hezekiah and said: Your Majesty, we have finished our work. The entire temple is now pure again, and so is the altar and its utensils, as well as the table for the sacred loaves of bread and its utensils.
translation_verse: Ba da keŋ Na'ab Hezekia san'anɛ yɛl o ye, “Ti maal Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la kasi naae, nɛ nyu'or maan daka nɛ li la'ad wʋsa, nɛ teebul kanɛ ka ba nɔkid maan bodobodo pa'annɛ li zugin la nɛ li la'ad la wʋsa.

english_verse: Next, Hezekiah assigned the Levites to their places in the temple. He gave them cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments, according to the instructions that the Lord had given King David and the two prophets, Gad and Nathan.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka maanmaannib la zi'en Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la nɛ bʋnnwɛ'ɛda nɛ li buudi wʋsa wʋʋ David nɛ Gad onɛ an onɛ nyɛt bɛog sa yɛla ka tu'asid Wina'am yɛla la nɛ Natan onɛ an Zugsɔb nɔdi'es la da pa'al si'em la; Zugsɔb la da dɔlis o nɔdi'esidibin tis nɔɔr kaŋa.

english_verse: After that, Hezekiah and the crowd of worshipers bowed down and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Maan la da naae la, Na'ab la nɛ onɛ wʋsa da bɛɛ ani da igin teŋin pʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Then he called the priests and Levites to the east courtyard of the temple
translation_verse: O da la'as maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la ka ba la'asi zi'en paalʋ si'a linɛ bɛ ya-tuona baba la,

english_verse: and said: It's time to purify the temple of the Lord God of our ancestors. You Levites must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean, then go into the temple and bring out everything that is unclean and unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: ka yɛl ye, “Yanam Levi dima, kɛlisimi man yɛt si'el la! Maaliminɛ ya mɛŋ kasi nannanna ka mɛ maali Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya yaanam Wina'am la Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la kasi. Yisimi dian'ad bʋn wʋsa dɔɔgin la.

english_verse: Some of our ancestors were unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord our God. Not only did they turn their backs on the Lord, but they also completely ignored his temple.
translation_verse: Ti yaanam la da ka' sida dima; ba da tʋm linɛ pʋ malis Zugsɔb la ka zan'as o. Ba da fɛndigi ba nindaas ka bas zin'ikanɛ ka Zugsɔb la bɛ la, ka bid o kʋdig.

english_verse: They locked the doors, then let the lamps go out and stopped burning incense and offering sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Ba da kpar Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la kʋlis ka kpiis bugum la. Ba da pʋ nyu'oe bʋnnyubisa bɛɛ maal nyu'or maan Israel Wina'am Yin la.

english_verse: The Lord became terribly angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and everyone was shocked and horrified at what he did to punish them. Not only were
translation_verse: Alazug Zugsɔb la sʋnf da duoe nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalem dim; dinzug o da kɛ ka ba di nyan ka nidib wʋsa la'adi ba ka gɔsidi ba nɛ pakir, wʋʋ yanamɛ nyɛt nɛ ya nini si'em zina la.

english_verse: our ancestors killed in battle, but our own children and wives were taken captive.
translation_verse: Linɛ da kɛ ka ti yaanam kpi zaba ni ka ti biribis nɛ ti bipumis nɛ ti pu'ab bɛ yammid pʋʋgin la.

english_verse: So I have decided to renew our agreement with the Lord God of Israel. Maybe then he will stop being so angry with us.
translation_verse: Nannanna m gban'e nɛ ye m naal nɔɔr nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la, linɛ na kɛ ka o sʋnpɛɛn la yii ti san'an.

english_verse: Let's not waste any time, my friends. You are the ones who were chosen to be the Lord's priests and to offer him sacrifices.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, da basini ya mɛŋa, saŋa kaŋa ka Zugsɔb gaŋi ya ye ya zi'enɛ o tuonnɛ tʋmm o tʋʋma, ka pʋ'ʋs o ka nyu'oe bʋnnyubisa tis o.”

english_verse: These leaders gathered together the rest of the Levites, and they all went through the ceremony to make themselves clean. Then they began to purify the temple according to the Law of the Lord, just as Hezekiah had commanded.
translation_verse: Ban da la'asi ba ba'abiis la ka maali ba mɛŋ kasi naae la, ba da kpɛn' maal Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la kasi, wʋʋ Na'ab la tis nɔɔr si'em ka li dɔl nɛ Zugsɔb yɛla.

english_verse: The priests went into the temple and carried out everything that was unclean. They put these things in the courtyard, and from there, the Levites carried them outside the city to Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la da kpɛn' Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la ye ba maali li kasi. Ba da yis linɛ wʋsa ka' sʋm ka ba nyɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la na niŋ zakin la. Levi dim la da zii li keŋ lɔbi bas Kidron bɔn'ɔgin la.

english_verse: The priests and Levites began their work on the first day of the first month. It took them one week to purify the courtyards of the temple and another week to purify the temple. So on the sixteenth day of that same month
translation_verse: Ba da pin'il nɛ nwadig kanɛ an yiiga la si'iŋir daar ye ba maal Dɔɔg la kasi, lin ti paae daba anii la ka ba maali paae za'ambɛŋ kanɛ ka ba dɔlli kpɛn'ɛd Dɔɔgin la, ka lin ti paae dabpiiga nɛ anii la ka ba naae Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la maalʋg.

english_verse: And we have brought back all the things that King Ahaz took from the temple during the time he was unfaithful to God. We purified them and put them back in front of the altar. Worship in the Temple
translation_verse: Ti nɔk la'abanɛ ka Na'ab Ahaz da yis on da an na'ab ka ka' sida sɔb saŋsi'a la maali li kasi. Ba wʋsa zi'e Zugsɔb maan daka la tuon.”

english_verse: At once, Hezekiah called together the officials of Jerusalem, and they went to the temple.
translation_verse: Bɛog da nie bɛkɛung asuba ka Na'ab Hezekia la'as tempʋʋg la kpɛɛmnam ka ba keŋ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la.

english_verse: They brought with them seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven goats as sacrifices to take away the sins of Hezekiah's family and of the people of Judah, as well as to purify the temple. Hezekiah told the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, to sacrifice these animals on the altar.
translation_verse: Ba da mɔri na'araad ayɔpɔi nɛ pɛraad ayɔpɔi nɛ pɛribis ayɔpɔi nɛ bʋraad ayɔpɔi linɛ maan tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan teŋ la yɛla, nɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg nɛ Juda dim la yɛla. Na'ab la da tis nɔɔr ye maanmaannib banɛ an Aaron yaas la nɔkim kɔnbid la maal Zugsɔb maan daka la zug.

english_verse: They took the goats to Hezekiah and the worshipers, and they laid their hands on the animals.
translation_verse: Bʋʋs banɛ da an ye ba nɔki maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la, ba da mɔri ba kɛn Na'ab la nɛ nidib la san'an na ka ba nɔki ba nu'usi pa'ali ba zug.

english_verse: The priests then killed the goats and splattered the blood on the altar as a sacrifice to take away the sins of everyone in Israel, because Hezekiah had commanded that these sacrifices be made for all the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Maanmaan la yʋ'ʋn kɔt bʋʋs la nɔki ba ziim la sʋn'ʋl bimbim la zug ka li an Israel dim wʋsa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan.

english_verse: The Levites were ready to play the instruments that had belonged to David; the priests were ready to blow the trumpets.
translation_verse: Alazug Levi dim la da zanli David bʋnnwɛ'ɛda la ka maanmaannib la mɛ zanl na'atana la.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah gave the signal for the sacrifices to be burned on the altar, the musicians began singing praises to the Lord and playing their instruments,
translation_verse: Na'ab Hezekia da tis nɔɔr ye ba maal nyu'or maan daka la zug. Ban da pin'il maan la maalʋg la, ka mɛ pin'ili yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma tisid Zugsɔb la nɛ na'atana nɛ yʋʋma la'abanɛ an Israel na'ab David din la.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing the songs of praise that David and Asaph the prophet had written. And so they bowed down and joyfully sang praises to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na'ab Hezekia nɛ o kpɛɛmnam la da yɛl Levi dim la ye ba yʋ'ʋm yʋʋm banɛ ka David nɛ Asaf onɛ an onɛ nyɛt la da sɔbi digil la. Dinzug, ba da yʋ'ʋm sumalisim yʋʋma ka su'uni ba zut teŋin wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Hezekiah said to the crowd, “Now that you are once again acceptable to the Lord, bring sacrifices and offerings to give him thanks.” The people did this, and some of them voluntarily brought animals to be offered as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ka Hezekia yɛl ye, “Ya yʋ'ʋn pɛsigi ya mɛŋi tis Zugsɔb. Mɔri maana nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim kɛɛn Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la na.” Dinzug nidib la wʋsa da mɔr maana nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim piini na, ka banɛ sʋnfʋ mɛ ma'ae zi nyu'or maan na.

english_verse: There were not enough priests to skin all these animals, because many of the priests had not taken the time to go through the ceremony to make themselves clean. However, since all the Levites had made themselves clean, they helped the priests until the last animal was skinned.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la da pʋ zu'oe na nyaŋi si maan kɔnbid la, ka Levi dim la da sʋŋi ba hali ka tʋʋma la ti naae nɛ ban ti maal maanmaannib sieba kasi paas, bɔzugɔ Levi dim la da dɔlisid malima la gat maanmaannib la.

english_verse: Besides all the sacrifices that were burned on the altar, the fat from the other animal sacrifices was burned, and the offerings of wine were poured over the altar. So the temple was once again used for worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyu'or maana la da zu'oya, nɛ taaba la'asʋg maana bʋnkɔnbid nɛ ba kpaam la, nɛ bʋnnuuda maan linɛ dɔl nyu'or maan la. Alazug li da kɛ ka Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la tʋʋma lɛn duoe ya'as.

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people of Judah celebrated, because God had helped them make this happen so quickly.
translation_verse: Hezekia nɛ nidib la wʋsa sʋnf da ma'ae nɛ Wina'am tiak nidib si'em la, bɔzugɔ tiakir la da niŋnɛ tɔ'ɔtɔ hali.

english_verse: Everyone from Beersheba in the south to Dan in the north was invited. This was the largest crowd of people that had ever celebrated Passover, according to the official records.
translation_verse: Ba da gban'e ye ba mɔɔl Israel teŋin wʋsa lin pin'il Beerseba teŋin hali ti paae Dan teŋinɛ buol nidib la ka ba la'as Jerusalem na ka ba pʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la. Ba da nan zi' la'as taaba bɛdegʋ pʋ'ʋs wʋʋ lin sɔb si'em la.

english_verse: Hezekiah's messengers went everywhere in Israel and Judah with the following letter: People of Israel, now that you have survived the invasion of the Assyrian kings, it's time for you to turn back to the Lord God our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob worshiped. If you do this, he will stop being angry.
translation_verse: Na'ab la da tis nɔɔr ka banɛ mɔɔn la di'e gbana Na'ab la nɛ o kpɛɛmnam san'an mɔri keŋ gilig Israel nɛ Juda wʋsa, lin da sɔb si'em nwa' ye, “Yanam Israel nidiba, fɛndigim lɛbi Abraham nɛ Isaak nɛ Jakob Wina'am la san'an na, ka o mɛ na fɛndigi lɛb yanam banɛ kpɛlim la san'an na, banɛ nyaŋi yi Asiria na'ab nu'usin la.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. Decide now to obey the Lord our God! Come to Jerusalem and worship him in the temple that will belong to him forever. Then he will stop being angry,
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ya zut kpi'em wʋʋ ya yaanam la da an si'em la; sigisimi ya mɛŋi tis Zugsɔb la. Kemi Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg kanɛ ka o maali li kasi saŋa linɛ ka' bɛn la ni na. Dɔlli Zugsɔb Wina'am nɛ ya sʋnf wʋsa ka o sʋnpɛɛn na yii ya san'an.

english_verse: and the enemies that have captured your families will show pity and send them back home. The Lord God is kind and merciful, and if you turn back to him, he will no longer turn his back on you.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a fɛndigi lɛb Zugsɔb la san'an na li na kɛ ka banɛ gban'e ya ba'abiis nɛ ya biis la zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig ka kɛ ka ba lɛb teŋ kaŋa ni na, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la mɔri nyɔɔg ka zɔt nimbaanlig. O kʋ fɛndig o nindaa ka basi ya, ya ya'a lɛb o san'an na.”

english_verse: Only a few people from the tribes of Asher, West Manasseh, and Zebulun were humble and went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amaa Aser nɛ Manase nɛ Zebulun tɛɛnsin ninsieba da sie ba mɛŋ ka keŋ Jerusalem.

english_verse: God also made everyone in Judah eager to do what Hezekiah and his officials had commanded. Passover Is Celebrated
translation_verse: Wina'am mɛ da sʋŋ Juda dim ka ba niŋ nɔɔr yinne nɛ ya'am yinne ye ba tʋm Na'ab la nɛ o na'ayikpɛm la yɛl si'el la, ka li da anɛ wʋʋ Zugsɔb la pian' si'em la.

english_verse: In the second month, a large crowd of people gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Nidib pamm da la'as ye ba pʋ'ʋs Bodobodo Linɛ Ka' Danbin Dabisir la, nwadig kanɛ tia'al ayi' la ni.

english_verse: They took all the foreign altars and incense altars in Jerusalem and threw them into Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Ba da vuoɛn maan bimbima buudi wʋsa linɛ bɛ Jerusalem la mɔri keŋ bas Kidron bɔn'ɔgin.

english_verse: The Lord answered Hezekiah's prayer and did not punish them.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da wʋm Hezekia pʋ'ʋsʋg ka ma'ae nidib la ban'as.

english_verse: The worshipers in Jerusalem were very happy and celebrated the Festival for seven days. The Levites and priests sang praises to the Lord every day and played their instruments.
translation_verse: Israel dim banɛ da bɛ Jerusalem la wʋsa da pʋ'ʋs Bodobodo Linɛ Ka' Danbin Malʋŋ la daba ayɔpɔi ka maal sumalisim bɛdegʋ, ka maanmaannib la nɛ Levi dim la yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma tis Zugsɔb la daar wʋsa nɛ Zugsɔb yʋʋma la'ad la.

english_verse: Hezekiah thanked the Levites for doing such a good job, leading the celebration. The worshipers celebrated for seven days by offering sacrifices, by eating the sacred meals, and by praising the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Hezekia da pian' kpɛmis Levi dɔɔg dim la, banɛ sid da pa'al ye ba gban'e Zugsɔb tʋʋma la gbin la. Bɔzugɔ daba ayɔpɔi la wʋsa ba da di taaba la'asʋg maan la, ka wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la.

english_verse: Everyone was so excited that they agreed to celebrate seven more days.
translation_verse: Nidib la wʋsa da gban'e ye ba na di malʋŋ la daba ayɔpɔi paas; alazug ba da lɛm maal sumalisim daba ayɔpɔi ya'as.

english_verse: Everyone was very happy, including those from Judah and Israel, the priests and Levites, and the foreigners living in Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Juda nidib la wʋsa nɛ maanmaannib la nɛ nimbanɛ da yi Jerusalem keŋ la wʋsa da maal sumalisim, la'an nɛ saam banɛ da yi Israel sʋ'ʋlimin keŋ la nɛ banɛ da bɛ Juda la.

english_verse: It was the biggest celebration in Jerusalem since the days of King Solomon, the son of David.
translation_verse: Sumalistita'ar da bɛ Jerusalem, bɔzugɔ lin pin'il David biig Solomon onɛ da an Israel na'ab la saŋa sa, li buudi nan zi' maal Jerusalem teŋinɛ.

english_verse: The priests and Levites asked God to bless the people, and from his home in heaven, he did.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la nɛ Levi buudi la da duoe zi'en ka kaanb bareka niŋ nidib la, ka Wina'am gandig, bɔzugɔ ba sɔsʋg la da paae arezana ni, zin'ikanɛ an kasi ka o bɛ la.

english_verse: Hezekiah divided the priests and Levites into groups, according to their duties. Then he assigned them the responsibilities of offering sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He also appointed people to serve at the temple and to sing praises at the temple gates.
translation_verse: Hezekia da pʋdig maanmaannib nɛ Levi dɔɔg dim la ka li dɔl wʋʋ ba tʋʋma an si'em ye ba maal taaba la'asʋg nɛ nyu'or maana la ka tʋm tʋʋma Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔya la ni ka yʋʋm sumalisim yʋʋma.

english_verse: The official records also included their wives and children, because they had also been faithful in keeping themselves clean and acceptable to serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba da la'am paas maanmaannib la bibaanlʋg nɛ ba pu'ab nɛ ba bipumis nɛ biribis wʋsa banɛ bɛ teŋin la ka ba yʋda sɔb gbauŋʋn la, bɔzugɔ ba da maali ba mɛŋ kasi nɛ ba sʋnf wʋsa.

english_verse: He told the people of Jerusalem to bring the offerings that were to be given to the priests and Levites, so that they would have time to serve the Lord with their work.
translation_verse: O da tis nɔɔr ye banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la tisim linɛ an maanmaannib la nɛ Levi dim la din, ka li kɛ ka ba pɛsigi ba mɛŋi dɔl Zugsɔb wada la bɔɔd ye ba maal si'em.

english_verse: After the Festival, the people went to every town in Judah and smashed the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. They destroyed all the local shrines and foreign altars in Judah, as well as those in the territories of Benjamin, Ephraim, and West Manasseh. Then everyone went home. Offerings for the Priests and Levites
translation_verse: Malʋŋ la da naae la, Israel buudbanɛ da bɛɛ ani la da yii kpɛn' Juda tempʋʋsin nwa' maana kuga la ka vuoɛn Asera dazi'eda la. Ba da san'am maana zin'ibanɛ bɛ Juda nɛ Benjamin nɛ Efiram nɛ Manase tɛɛnsin la wʋsa. Ban da niŋ ala naae la, ka lɛbi ba mɛŋ tɛɛnsin. Ban la'as la'ad ye li sʋŋ ka ba pʋ'ʋs la

english_verse: Hezekiah provided animals from his own herds and flocks to use for the morning and evening sacrifices, as well as for the sacrifices during the Sabbath celebrations, the New Moon Festivals, and the other religious feasts required by the Law of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na'ab la da yis nɛ o mɛŋ arezak ka ba maan bɛogʋn nɛ zaam nyu'or maana la, nɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar maana la, nɛ nwadpaalig nɛ maan banɛ bɛ wʋʋ lin sɔb si'em Zugsɔb wada gbauŋʋn la.

english_verse: As soon as the people heard what the king wanted, they brought a tenth of everything they owned, including their best grain, wine, olive oil, honey, and other crops.
translation_verse: Labaar la da paae la, Israel buudi la da tisi ba bʋndɛɛnna la'ad nɛ ba zʋʋd nɛ ba danpaalig nɛ kpaam nɛ siind nɛ linɛ wʋsa aan ba pɔɔg zʋʋd. Ba da pʋdig si'el wʋsa zin'is piiga ka yis yinne tis.

english_verse: The people from the other towns of Judah brought a tenth of their herds and flocks, as well as a tenth of anything they had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel nɛ Juda nimbanɛ da bɛ tempʋʋsin la da tisi ba niigi nɛ bʋnkɔnbid pʋʋr piiga nɛ bʋmbanɛ wʋsa ka ba pɛsigi tis Zugsɔb la. Ba da mɔri li na digil dʋʋr-dʋʋr.

english_verse: The people started bringing their offerings to Jerusalem in the third month, and the last ones arrived four months later.
translation_verse: Ba da pin'il piinkaŋa tisib nɛ nwadkanɛ paas atan' la ni ti paae nwadis ayɔpɔi la ni.

english_verse: When Hezekiah and his officials saw these offerings, they thanked the Lord and the people.
translation_verse: Hezekia nɛ o kpɛɛmnam la da kena nyɛ la'ad la dig dʋʋr si'em la, ba da pian' Wina'am ka kaanb bareka niŋ Israel nidib la.

english_verse: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the large amount of offerings.
translation_verse: Hezekia da bu'os maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la la'abanɛ dig kuda-kuda la yɛla;

english_verse: The high priest at the time was Azariah, a descendant of Zadok, and he replied, “Ever since the people have been bringing us their offerings, we have had more than enough food and supplies. The Lord has certainly blessed his people. Look at how much is left over!”
translation_verse: ka Azaria onɛ an maanmaan kpɛɛm ka an Zadok yaaŋ la lɛbis ye, “Nidib la pin'ili ziidi ba piini la ken Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin na la, li kɛ ka ti paam diib bɛdegʋ di ka li kpɛlim pamm, bɔzugɔ Wina'am niŋ o nidib la zug bareka linɛ kɛ ka li kpɛlim zu'oe anwa la.”

english_verse: So the king gave orders for storerooms to be built in the temple, and when they were completed,
translation_verse: Hezekia da tis nɔɔr ye ba maal la'ad dɔɔg Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, ka ba sid niŋ ala.

english_verse: all the extra offerings were taken there. Hezekiah and Azariah then appointed Conaniah the Levite to be in charge of these storerooms. His brother Shimei was his assistant, and the following Levites worked with them: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah.

translation_verse: Linɛ paas la ba da lɛm pʋdigi tisid biribis banɛ an yʋma atan' bɛɛ gaad ala ka ba yʋda paas tʋʋma dimin la banɛ na kpɛn' Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la tʋm dabisir wʋsa tʋʋma nɛ li buudi, ka li dɔl nɛ ban pʋʋ ba si'em la.

translation_verse: Da kɛ ka Hezekia ma'aa ya kpɛn'ɛs mɔɔgɔ. Da niŋ o yadda, bɔzugɔ win si'a kae teŋ si'a bɛɛ sʋ'ʋlim si'a nyaŋi faaɛn o nidibi yi man bɛɛ m yaanam nu'uginɛ, ka yanam Wina'am la ye o niŋ wala faaɛn ya yis man nu'uginɛ?”

translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim linɛ wʋsa da maal Na'ab Manase na'am saŋa la, la'an nɛ on sɔs o Wina'am, nɛ linɛ ka nɔdi'esidib pian' tis o nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr la wʋsa, li sɔbi bɛ Israel Na'anam Gbana la ni.

translation_verse: O da mɛ' ba'ar bimbima Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la, zin'ikanɛ ka o ye, “Man yʋ'ʋr na bɛ Jerusalem saŋa wʋsa la.”

english_verse: Josiah destroyed all the idols in the territories of Israel, and he commanded everyone in Israel to worship only the Lord God. The people did not turn away from the Lord God of their ancestors for the rest of Josiah's rule as king.
translation_verse: Na'ab Josia da yis bada la wʋsa Israel dim la bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa, ka kɛ ka banɛ bɛ Israel wʋsa dɔl Zugsɔb onɛ an Wina'am la. On da vʋe saŋa si'a la wʋsa ba da pʋ gu'oe Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la dɔllim.

english_verse: During the battle an Egyptian soldier shot Josiah with an arrow. Josiah told his servants, “Get me out of here! I've been hit.”

english_verse: Neco sent the following message to Josiah: I'm not attacking you, king of Judah! We're not even at war. But God has told me to quickly attack my enemy. God is on my side, so if you try to stop me, he will punish you.
translation_verse: Amaa Neko da tʋm yɛl o ye, “Israel Na'aba, zab bɔɔ bɛ man nɛ fʋn teŋsʋkɔ? Li ka' fʋn ka man yina ye m zab saŋa kaŋaa, amaa banɛ aan m dataas la. Wina'am yɛlim ye m niŋim tɔ'ɔtɔ; alazug kɛl, ka da zab nɛ Wina'am onɛ bɛ nɛ mam la, ka o na kʋʋf.”

english_verse: Josiah commanded that Passover be celebrated in Jerusalem to honor the Lord. So, on the fourteenth day of the first month, the lambs were killed for the Passover celebration.
translation_verse: Josia da pʋ'ʋs Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la Jerusalem tempʋʋgin, ka ba da kɔt malʋŋ la pɛ'ɛs yiiga nwadig la dabpii nɛ anaasi daar.

english_verse: Get ready to do the work that David and Solomon assigned to you, according to your clans.
translation_verse: Yir wʋsa dim ti'ebimi ya mɛŋ wʋʋ David onɛ an Israel na'ab nɛ o biig Solomon n sɔbi pa'al si'em la.

english_verse: When the people bring you their Passover lamb, you must kill it and prepare it to be sacrificed to the Lord. Make sure the people celebrate according to the instructions that the Lord gave Moses, and don't do anything to make yourselves unclean and unacceptable.
translation_verse: Kɔtimi Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ pɛ'ɛs la, ka maali ya mɛŋ kasi ka ti'eb malʋŋ la yɛla zi'e ye ya sʋŋi ya taaba la ka li dɔl wʋʋ Zugsɔb la da pa'al Moses si'em la.”

english_verse: Josiah's officials also voluntarily gave some of their animals to the people, the priests, and the Levites as sacrifices. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, who were the officials in charge of the temple, gave the priests
translation_verse: O kpɛɛmnam la mɛ da tis nidib la nɛ maanmaannib la nɛ Levi dim la nɛ ba ya'amlɛog. Hilkia nɛ Zakaria nɛ Jehel onɛ an tʋʋma la tuongat Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, da tis maanmaannib la malʋŋ la piini ka li anɛ pɛribis nɛ bʋribis tusa ayi' nɛ kɔbisyuobʋ nɛ na'araad kɔbistan'.

translation_verse: Konania onɛ ba'abiisi an Semaya nɛ Netanɛl la, nɛ Hasiabiya nɛ Jeiel nɛ Jozabad banɛ an Levi dim tuongatib la da nɔk pɛribis nɛ bʋribis tusa anu nɛ na'araad kɔbisnu linɛ an Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ piini tis Levi dim la.

english_verse: When everything was ready to celebrate Passover, the priests and the Levites stood where Josiah had told them.

english_verse: Then the Levites killed and skinned the Passover lambs, and they handed some of the blood to the priests, who splattered it on the altar.
translation_verse: Ba da kɔt Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ pɛ'ɛs la, ka maanmaannib la di'e ziim kanɛ ka ba tisi ba la misig, ka Levi dɔɔg dim la si kɔnbid la.

english_verse: The Levites set aside the parts of the animal that the worshipers needed for their sacrifices to please the Lord, just as the Law of Moses required. They also did the same thing with the bulls.
translation_verse: Ba da bɛŋ nyu'or maan la li kɔn' ye ba tis nidib la lin dɔlisi ba yaanam tuŋʋ an si'em la ye ba nɔki tis Zugsɔb la wʋʋ lin sɔb si'em Moses gbauŋʋn la. Ala mɛn ka ba da niŋ nɛ na'araad la.

english_verse: They sacrificed the Passover animals on the altar and boiled the meat for the other offerings in pots, kettles, and pans. Then they quickly handed the meat to the people so they could eat it.
translation_verse: Ba da sɛn' Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la kɔnbid la wʋʋ lin dɔl si'em, ka dʋg maan ni'im linɛ an kasi la dʋgidin nɛ laasin pʋdigi keŋ tis nidib la wʋsa tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: All day long, the priests were busy offering sacrifices and burning the animals' fat on the altar. And when everyone had finished, the Levites prepared Passover animals for themselves and for the priests.
translation_verse: Nɛ' nya'aŋ ka ba yʋ'ʋn ti'ebi ba mɛŋ nɛ maanmaannib la din, bɔzugɔ maanmaannib banɛ an Aaron yaas la da bɛɛ ani maan nyu'or maana nɛ ni'im kpama la hali ka zaam ti ma'ae. Alazug Levi dim la da ti'eb nɛ ba mɛŋ nɛ Aaron tuŋ maanmaannib la dinɛ pɛ'ɛs.

english_verse: During the celebration some of the Levites prepared Passover animals for the musicians and the guards, so that the Levite musicians would not have to leave their places, which had been assigned to them according to the instructions of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king's prophet. english_verse: The people of Judah and even the priests who were their leaders became more unfaithful. They followed the disgusting example of the nations around them and made the Lord's holy temple unfit for worship.
translation_verse: Linɛ paas la, maanmaannib kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa nɛ nidib la da lieb nɛ zamdimi kpɛn ken tuon ka dɔl tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka tɛɛns la nidib da tʋm, ka san'am Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir girima, kanɛ ka o da maal ka li an kasi Jerusalem teŋin la. Jerusalem san'auŋ la yɛla

translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la da tʋm o nidibi ba san'anɛ pɛndigi pɛndig nɛ o labaar, on zɔt o nidib la nɛ o teŋ la nimbaanlig la zug.

english_verse: But the people only laughed and insulted these prophets. They ignored what the Lord God was trying to tell them, until he finally became so angry that nothing could stop him from punishing Judah and Jerusalem. Jerusalem Is Destroyed (
