english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's troops burned down the temple and destroyed every important building in the city. Then they broke down the city wall.
translation_verse: Ba da nyu'oe Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la nɛ bugum, ka nwa'ae Jerusalem zaŋguoma la wʋsa; ba da nyu'oe na'anam ya' la nɛ linɛ wʋsa an sʋm.

english_verse: Everyone else must provide what is needed. They must give money, supplies, and animals, as well as gifts for rebuilding God's temple.
translation_verse: Ka Israel nimbanɛ nam bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa ka kʋ keŋɛ, bam mɔr anzurifa nɛ sanlima nɛ bʋnkɔnbid nɛ la'ad na tisi ya, ka mɛ tisi ya linɛ na maal ya'amlɛog maan Wina'am yin dinɛ bɛ Jerusalem la.

english_verse: The others helped by giving silver articles, gold, personal possessions, cattle, and other valuable gifts, as well as offerings for the temple.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa sid da sʋŋi ba nɛ sanlima nɛ anzurifa nɛ la'asieba nɛ bʋnkɔnbid nɛ piinsʋma, la'an nɛ ba ya'amlɛog piini.

english_verse: King Cyrus gave back the things that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Lord's temple in Jerusalem and had put in the temple of his own gods.
translation_verse: Dinɛ lɛm paas la, Na'ab Sarus da yis la'abanɛ ka Nebukadnɛza da faaɛn Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin Jerusalem ka zii kuli kpɛn'ɛs o mɛŋ win dɔɔgin la.

english_verse: Cyrus placed Mithredath, his chief treasurer, in charge of these things. Mithredath counted them and gave a list to Sheshbazzar, the governor of Judah.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka Mitredaf onɛ aan o ligidgur la mɔr la'ad la na kaali tis Siesibaza onɛ an Juda na'abiig la.

english_verse: gold and silver dishes, bowls, and other articles. Sheshbazzar took them with him when he and the others returned to Jerusalem from Babylonia.
translation_verse: ). Siesibaza da mɔr la'abama dɔl nimbanɛ ka ba da gban'e ba keŋ Babilon la lɛb Jerusalem na.

english_verse: The families of Habaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai could not prove that they were priests. The ancestor of the family of Barzillai had married the daughter of Barzillai from Gilead and had taken his wife's family name. But the records of these three families could not be found, and none of them were allowed to serve as priests.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib tuŋ banɛ yʋda dɔl nwa' daa pʋ nyaŋi vɛɛnsi baŋi ba yaanamɛ an sieba. Banɛ an: Hobaya nɛ Hakos nɛ Barizila. . Ban da pʋ baŋi ba yaanam yʋda la zug ba da pʋ tisi ba suor ye ba an maanmaanniba.

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until we find out if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Gɔmena la da pʋ siak ye ba di dikanɛ an kasi la asɛɛ ka ba ti paam maanmaan onɛ na nyaŋi tʋm nɛ Urim nɛ Tummim m baŋ Wina'am gban'ar.

english_verse: When the people came to where the Lord's temple had been in Jerusalem, some of the family leaders gave gifts so it could be rebuilt in the same place.
translation_verse: Ban da paae Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin Jerusalem tempʋʋgin na la, yir kpɛɛmnam la sieba da tis ya'amlɛog piini ban da ye ba lɛbisi mɛ' Wina'am Yir la li zin'igin la zug.

english_verse: They gave all they could, and it came to a total of
translation_verse: Ba da tis nɛ ba paŋi zem si'em ka li wʋsa la'as sanlima ligidi tusa pisyuobʋ nɛ yinne (

english_verse: Everyone returned to the towns from which their families had come, including the priests, the Levites, the musicians, the temple guards, and the workers.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib nɛ za'anɔgu'udib nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir yammis la da zin'inɛ ba mɛŋ tɛɛnsin ka nidib la sieba la'asi bɛɛ ba san'an. Israel dim banɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa da zin'inɛ ba mɛŋ tempʋʋsin.

english_verse: During the seventh month of the year, the Israelites who had settled in their towns went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Israel dimi zin'ini ba tempʋʋsin la yʋʋm si'a la, li nwadis ayɔpɔi la saŋa, nidib la da la'as nɛ nɔɔr yinne Jerusalem.

english_verse: The priest Joshua son of Jozadak, together with the other priests, and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his relatives rebuilt the altar of Israel's God. Then they were able to offer sacrifices there by following the instructions God had given to Moses, the man of God.
translation_verse: Ka Jesua onɛ an Jehozadak biig la nɛ o maanmaan taaba, nɛ Zerubabɛl onɛ an Sealtiel biig la nɛ o taaba, da pin'ili mɛɛd Israel Wina'am la maan bimbim ye ba maal nyu'or maana li zug, nwɛnɛ lin sɔb Moses onɛ da an Wina'am nid la wada gbauŋʋn si'em la.

english_verse: And they built the altar where it had stood before, even though they were afraid of the people who were already living around there. Then every morning and evening they burned sacrifices and offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ban da zɔt nimbanɛ giligi ba la dabiem la, ba da mɛ' bimbim la li zin'igin ka maal maana li zugʋ tis Zugsɔb la. Ba da maannɛ bɛogʋn nɛ zaam maana la wʋsa.

english_verse: The people followed the rules for celebrating the Festival of Shelters and offered the proper sacrifices each day.
translation_verse: Ba da maal Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ nwɛnɛ lin da sɔb si'em la, ka maal maana linɛ nar ye ba maal dabisa wʋsa si'em.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices to please the Lord, sacrifices at each New Moon Festival, and sacrifices at the rest of the Lord's festivals. Every offering the people had brought voluntarily was also presented to the Lord.
translation_verse: Lin nya'aŋ ka ba maal maana linɛ ka ba maan saŋa wʋsa la. Ba da maal nwadpaalig maana, nɛ dabisbanɛ ka ba maan maana tisid Zugsɔb la, ka la'am maan ya'amlɛog maana tisid o.

english_verse: Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year. The Rebuilding of the Temple Begins
translation_verse: Nwadis ayɔpɔi la pin'ilʋg daar ka ba pin'ili maal nyu'or maana tis Zugsɔb la, la'an nɛ saŋkan la ka ba da nam pʋ ɛɛnb Zugsɔb Yir la.

english_verse: King Cyrus of Persia had said the Israelites could have cedar trees brought from Lebanon to Joppa by sea. So they sent grain, wine, and olive oil to the cities of Tyre and Sidon as payment for these trees, and they gave money to the stoneworkers and carpenters.
translation_verse: Ka ba nɔk ligidi tis tanmɛɛdib nɛ kampintanam. Ka tis Sidon nɛ Taya dim la diib nɛ bʋnnuuda nɛ kpaam ka kɛ ka ba mɔr na'aziinr daadi yi Lebanon n dɔlis atɛuk la kɛn Joppa teŋin na wʋʋ Pesia na'ab Sarus tis nɔɔr si'em la. Ban ɛɛnb Zugsɔb la Pʋ'ʋsim Yir nɛ sumalisim la yɛla

english_verse: During the second month of the second year after the people had returned from Babylonia, they started rebuilding the Lord's temple. Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned started working. Every Levite over
translation_verse: Ban da paae Wina'am Yin Jerusalem teŋin na la, li yʋma ayi' saŋa nwadig kanɛ pɛ'ɛs ayi' la, Zerubabɛl onɛ an Sealtiel biig la nɛ Jesua onɛ an Jozadak biig la nɛ ba ba'abiis la wʋsa da pin'il tʋʋma la. Ba da gaans Levi dim banɛ an yʋma pisi bɛɛ gaad ala ye ba an tʋʋma la kpɛɛmnam ka gɔs Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la mɛɛb yɛla.

english_verse: The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.
translation_verse: Jesua nɛ o biis nɛ o ba'abiis, nɛ Kadmiel nɛ o yaas nɛ Henadad biribis nɛ ba biis nɛ ba ba'abiis nɛ Levi dim la wʋsa da la'as nɛ sʋŋidi gɔsid banɛ tʋm Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma la.

english_verse: When the builders had finished laying the foundation of the temple, the priests put on their robes and blew trumpets in honor of the Lord, while the Levites from the family of Asaph praised God with cymbals. All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David.
translation_verse: Tanmɛɛdib la da ɛɛnb ɛɛnbiri naae la, maanmaannib la da yɛɛ ba fuud ka nɔki ba na'atana, ka Levi dim banɛ an Asaf tuŋ dim la da mɔri ba galana duoe zi'enɛ ba zi'esa ni ye ba zun'e Zugsɔb la wʋʋ Na'ab David n da zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing: “The Lord is good! His faithful love for Israel will last forever.” Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun.
translation_verse: Ba da yʋ'ʋmmi zun'od Zugsɔb la ka pʋ'ʋsid o bareka ye, “Zugsɔb la an sʋm o nɔŋilim la bɛnɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ tisid Israel dim la.” Ka nidib la zun'od Zugsɔb la agɔla gɔla, ban ɛɛnb Zugsɔb Yir la zug.

english_verse: Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Amaa maanmaan kʋda la bɛdegʋ nɛ Levi dim la nɛ yir kpɛɛmnam banɛ da mi' nyɛ Wina'am yikanɛ da dɛŋi bɛ la da kumnɛ agɔla gɔla ban nyɛ ka ba ɛɛnb ɛɛnbir la si'em la zug, amaa ka ninsieba mɛ maan sumalisim.

english_verse: Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.
translation_verse: Sɔ' da kʋ nyaŋi bak sumalisim tʋkpiidʋg la nɛ banɛ kaasid la tʋkpiidʋgɔ bɔzugɔ, tʋkpiidʋg la da zu'oe nɛ galis. Banɛ wʋsa bɛ lalli la da wʋm tʋkpiidʋg la.

english_verse: The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Juda nɛ Benjamin dataas la da wʋm ye banɛ da an yammis ka lɛb na la mɛɛd Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am Yir la,

english_verse: So they went to Zerubbabel and to the family leaders and said, “Let us help! Ever since King Esarhaddon of Assyria brought us here, we have worshiped your God and offered sacrifices to him.”
translation_verse: ba da kɛn Zerubabɛl nɛ kpɛɛmnam la san'an na yɛli ba ye, “Kɛlli ka ti mɛɛ sʋŋi ya bɔzugɔ, tinam nɛ yanam anɛ yinne, ka ti pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am kanɛ ka ya pʋ'ʋsid la ka maan maana tisid o lin yi saŋkanɛ ka Asiria na'ab Esaraddon mɔri ti kɛn kpɛla na la.”

english_verse: But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
translation_verse: Amaa Zerubabɛl nɛ Jesua nɛ kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛ Israel la wʋsa da lɛbisi ba ye, “Ya ba'a ka' ti san'an ka ya na sʋŋi mɛɛ ti Wina'am Yir la. Tinam ma'aa na mɛɛ ti Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la Yir, nwɛnɛ Pesia na'ab Sarus n tisi ti nɔɔr si'em la.”

english_verse: Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building.
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ giligi ba la wʋsa yina mɔɔd ye ba kpɛn'ɛs Juda dim la dabiem ka li kɛ ka ba tadig ka mɛɛb la da keŋ tuonnɛ.

english_verse: During the time that Cyrus was king and even until Darius became king, they kept bribing government officials to slow down the work. Trouble Rebuilding Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ka ba da' nidib ye ba kpɛ'ɛŋi san'ami ba gban'ar la Pesia na'ab Sarus na'am diib saŋa la wʋsa, keŋ paae Pesia na'ab Darius na'am diib saŋa. Na'ab Atazeesis tis nɔɔr ye ba basim Jerusalem mɛɛb

english_verse: In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Li da anɛ ala ya'as saŋkanɛ ka Pesia na'ab Atazeesis da dii o na'am yʋʋm si'a la, ka ba da ma' ziri ziil Juda nɛ Jerusalem dim.

english_verse: Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
translation_verse: Bisilam nɛ Mitredaf nɛ Tabeel nɛ ba taaba la wʋsa la'asi sɔb gbauŋʋ tis Na'ab Atazeesis. Gbauŋ la da sɔbnɛ nɛ Aram buudi pian'ad.

english_verse: This letter said: Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
translation_verse: Ban sɔb gbauŋ si'a tis o la yɛl si'em nwa': “Na'ab Atazeesis, Tinam banɛ aan fʋ yammis ka bɛ Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm sʋ'ʋlimin la sɔbidi tisidif ye,

english_verse: You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations.
translation_verse: Na'aba, baŋim ye Jew dim banɛ yii fʋ san'an kena la keŋ Jerusalem lɛm mɛɛd tempʋkanɛ an tembɛ'ɛd ka ki'isid na'anam nɔɔr la. Ba lɛb nɛ mɛɛd zaŋguoma la ka maannɛ li ɛɛnbir la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
translation_verse: Na'aba, mɛ baŋim ya'as ye, ba ya'a mɛ' tempʋkaŋa nɛ li zaŋguoma la wʋsa lɛbisi zi'el, ba kʋ lɛn yɔ lampɔ nɛ ligidkanɛ nar ye ba yɔ wʋsa bɛɛ ba na'as fʋn na'ab la. Ba ya'a niŋ ala fʋ na'ayir ligidi la na sie.

english_verse: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ an banɛ bɔɔd na'ayir la yɛla hali la, li pʋ sʋm ka ti zin' gɔsid ka ba nɛ'ɛsid Na'ab la anwana. Linɛ kɛ ka ti tisid Na'ab la labakaŋa.

english_verse: If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place.
translation_verse: Ti sɔs nɔɔri yɛt ye, fʋ ieem yɛlkʋda bɛ zin'isi'a ka na'anam banɛ da dɛŋi gaad da sɔbi ba gbana digil la. Fʋ ya'a gɔs gbambama ni fʋ na nyɛ ka tempʋʋg kaŋa nidib anɛ banɛ zan'asid na'anam nɔɔr ka an banɛ ieed yɛla kʋdimin sa. Linɛ da kɛ ka ba san'am tempʋkaŋa la.

english_verse: If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
translation_verse: Ti yɛt na'ab la nɛ ye, ba ya'a mɛ' tempʋkaŋa nɛ li zaŋguoma la wʋsa lɛbisi zi'el, fʋ kʋ lɛn nyɛ si'el Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm la ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: King Artaxerxes answered: Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
translation_verse: Na'ab la lɛbis si'eli nwa': “Rehum onɛ an kpɛɛm nɛ Simsaae onɛ an gbansɔbid, nɛ ba taaba banɛ bɛ Samaria nɛ banɛ bɛ Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm sʋ'ʋlimin la, m pʋ'ʋsidi ya wʋsa.

english_verse: After your letter was translated and read to me,
translation_verse: Gbauŋ kanɛ ka ya sɔb la, ba karimi li ka tu'asi li gbinni m tuon.

english_verse: I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations.
translation_verse: M tis nɔɔr ka ba vɛɛnsi nyɛ ka tempʋʋg la mɔr pian'akʋda linɛ pa'al ye ba anɛ banɛ pʋ na'asid na'anama ka an banɛ duoe zi'e na'anam yɛla, ka ieed yɛla.

english_verse: And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.
translation_verse: Jerusalem da mɔr na'anam banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ, ka sʋ'oe Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm sʋ'ʋlim la wʋsa ka ba yɔɔd lampɔ nɛ ligidkanɛ nar ye ba yɔ wʋsa tisidi ba.

english_verse: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.
translation_verse: Nannanna, yɛlimi nidib la ka ba bas tempʋʋg la mɛɛbi ti paae saŋkanɛ ka m na bas suor ye ba mɛɛm.

english_verse: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city. Work on the Temple Starts Again
translation_verse: Ban da karim Na'ab Atazeesis gbauŋ la tis Rehum nɛ Simsaae onɛ an gbansɔbid nɛ ba taaba la, ba duoe tɔ'ɔtɔ keŋ Jew dim la san'an Jerusalem teŋin yɛli ba ye ba da lɛm mɛ' tempʋʋg la ya'asɛ. Ka mugusi ba ka ba bas mɛɛb la.

english_verse: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_verse: Alazug ka Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma Jerusalem teŋin la da pʋ lɛn keŋ tuonnɛ ti paae Pesia na'ab Darius n da dii o na'am la yʋma ayi' saŋa la.

english_verse: Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did.
translation_verse: Wina'am nɔdi'esidib Hagai nɛ Zakaria onɛ an Iddo yaaŋ la, da di'e Wina'am pian'adi tis Jew dim banɛ bɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalem. Ba da pian'adi tisidi ba nɛ Israel Wina'am onɛ sʋ'oe ba la yʋ'ʋr zug.

english_verse: So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
translation_verse: Sealtiel biig Zerubabɛl nɛ Jesua onɛ an Jozadak biig la da duoe zi'en ye ba mɛ' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la Jerusalem teŋin. Ka Wina'am nɔdi'esidib bɛɛ ani sʋŋidi ba.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple?
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Tatenaae onɛ an Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm Gɔmena la nɛ Siefa-Bozenaae nɛ ba taaba la keŋ bu'os ye, “Anɔ'ɔn tisi ya suor ye ya lɛbisi mɛ' Pʋ'ʋsim yir nwa'?”

english_verse: Give us the names of the workers!”
translation_verse: Ka lɛm bu'os ye, “Anɔ'ɔnama mɛɛd Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim yir la?”

english_verse: But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am nini da kpɛn kpa'anɛ gɔsid Jew dim kpɛɛmnam la ka ba da pʋ nyaŋi kɛ ka ba bas mɛɛb la ti paae saŋkanɛ ka labaar paae Na'ab Darius ka o sɔbi lɛbis na la.

english_verse: which said: King Darius, we wish you the best!
translation_verse: Ban da sɔbi li si'em nwa': Ti sɔbid nɛ tisid Na'ab Darius: Naa, ti pʋ'ʋsidif sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
translation_verse: Naa, Na'aba, ti bɔɔd ye fʋ baŋ ye ti keŋ Juda teŋin Wina'am onɛ galis la Pʋ'ʋsim Yin. Nidib la mɛɛdi li nɛ kugtitada ka pa'an dabɛda zaŋguom la zug. Ba mɛɛdi li sʋ'ʋŋa ka tʋʋma la ken tituaa nwɛnɛ ban bɔɔd si'em.

english_verse: We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple.
translation_verse: Ka ti bu'os kpɛɛmnam la ye, “Anɔ'ɔn tisi ya suor ye ya lɛbisi mɛ' nɛ'ɛŋa zi'elɛ?”

english_verse: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
translation_verse: Ti mɛ lɛm bu'os ye ti baŋi ba tuongatib la yʋda ka tisif labaar.

english_verse: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
translation_verse: Ban lɛbisi ti si'em nwa': “Ti anɛ Arezana nɛ Dunia Wina'am la yammis, ka ti lɛbisidi mɛɛd o yir linɛ ka ba da mɛ' yʋma bɛdegʋ banɛ gaad la, yir kanɛ ka Israel na'atita'ar sɔ' da mɛɛ naae la.

english_verse: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple,
translation_verse: Amaa ti yaanam da kɛ ka Arezana Wina'am la sʋnf pɛlig ka o kɛ ka Babilon na'ab Nebukadnɛza, onɛ da an Kaldea buudi na'am tuŋʋn nid la, zabi nyaŋ teŋ la ka san'am Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim yikaŋa ka gban'e nidib la mɔri keŋ Babilon teŋin.

english_verse: Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
translation_verse: Siesibaza sid da duoe kena ɛɛnb Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la Jerusalem teŋin. Lin yi saŋkan la paae nannanna ba nan kpɛm bɛ nɛ yir la mɛɛbin, amaa li nam pʋ naae.

english_verse: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_verse: Naa, Na'aba, fʋ ya'a bɔɔd fʋn kɛ ka ba gɔs Babilon na'am gbana la ni vɛɛnsi gɔs ye, Na'ab Sarus sid da tis nɔɔr ye ba lɛbisi mɛ' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la Jerusalem teŋin, bɛɛ o da pʋ tisɛ? Ka yɛli ti fʋn gban'e si'em yɛl kaŋa pʋʋgin.”

english_verse: King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Na'ab Darius tis nɔɔr ka ba ie gbana dɔɔg linɛ bɛ Babilon la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said: This official record will show
translation_verse: Ba da nyɛ gbansi'a ka li kpilim bɛ Egbatana Media teŋ sʋ'ʋlimin na'ayin, ka li pʋʋgin la sɔb ye, “Tiɛnr gbauŋ:

english_verse: that in the first year Cyrus was king, he gave orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem, so that sacrifices and offerings could be presented there. It is to be built
translation_verse: Sarus n da di na'am yʋʋm si'a la, o da tis nɔɔr Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir linɛ bɛ Jerusalem la yɛla ye, ‘Lɛbisim mɛɛi Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la ka ba na maan maana anina. Ɛɛnbimi ɛɛnbir la, ka li wa'alim agɔla na an nɔba makir piswai ka li yalʋŋ an piswai.

english_verse: with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything.
translation_verse: Ka nɔki kugbɛda mɛɛ sʋn'ʋl nɔɔr atan', ka linɛ paas la na an daad. Na'ayir ligidi la ni ka ba na yɔɔ li sam.

english_verse: Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places. King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
translation_verse: Sanlima nɛ anzurifa la'abanɛ ka Na'ab Nebukadnɛza da yis Wina'am yin Jerusalem mɔri keŋ Babilon teŋin la, lɛbisimini ba, ba zin'igin Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la.’”

english_verse: King Darius sent this message: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Darius da sɔbi lɛbis ye, “Dinzug fʋn Tatenaae onɛ an Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm Gɔmena la nɛ Siefa-Bozenaae nɛ yanam banɛ aan ba kpɛɛm taaba sʋ'ʋlim kan ni la, da li'elinɛ anii.

english_verse: Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
translation_verse: Da nɔki ya nu'ugʋ kpɛn'ɛs Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma la nii. Kɛlli ka Jew dim Gɔmena nɛ ba kpɛɛmnam la lɛbisi mɛ' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la li zin'igin.

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Tisimi ba ban bɔɔd si'el wʋsa, li ya'a anɛ na'araad bɛɛ pɛraad, bɛɛ pɛribis ka ba bɔɔd ye ba maal maana tis Arezana Wina'am la, bɛɛ ba bɔɔdi ki bɛɛ yaarim bɛɛ daam bɛɛ kpaam. Maanmaannib banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la ya'a yɛli ya, yanam tisimi ba daar wʋsa

english_verse: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
translation_verse: ka ba maal maana tis Arezana Wina'am la ka sɔs Wina'am tis Na'ab nɛ o biis la.

english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: M lɛn tis nɔɔr ye, onɛ zan'as nɔzi'elkaŋa, ba na vuoɛn datita'ari o yin ka pʋlisi li nɔɔr yinne kʋns o niŋgbina tɔlig, ka kɛ ka o yir la lieb tampʋʋr.

english_verse: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully. The Temple Is Dedicated
translation_verse: Wina'am kanɛ kɛ ka o yʋ'ʋr bɛ anina la na kɛ ka na'ab bɛɛ ninkanɛ wʋsa duoe zi'en ye o tiak gban'akaŋa bɛɛ o san'am pʋ'ʋsim yikaŋa, o na'am la na li, ka gban'ar kan mɛ kʋ zi'enɛ. Man Darius n tis nɔkaŋa. Kɛlli ka li tʋm wʋʋ man yɛl si'em la.” Pʋ'ʋsim yir la mɛɛ naae ka ba yɔ'ɔgi li

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Ala ka Jew dim kpɛɛmnam la kpɛn ken tuon nɛ mɛɛb la, ka Wina'am nɔdi'esidib Hagai nɛ Zakaria onɛ an Iddo yaaŋ la da kpɛmisidi ba. Ba da mɛ' Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la naae wʋʋ Israel Wina'am yɛli ba si'em la. Ka mɛ dɔl wʋʋ Pesia na'anam Sarus nɛ Darius nɛ Atazeesis zi'el nɔɔr si'em la.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la mɛɛb da naae nɛ Ada nwadig la daba atan' daar, Na'ab Darius n da di na'am la li yʋma ayuobʋ saŋa.

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Ka Israel nidib la nɛ maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim nɛ banɛ da an yammis ka lɛb na la da di'em di'ema bɛdegʋ ban da pɛsig Wina'am Yir la tis o la.

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir pɛsigir la daar, ba da kʋnɛ na'araad kɔbiga maal maana, nɛ pɛraad kɔbisyi' nɛ pɛribis kɔbisnaasi, ka mɛ pɛ'ɛs bʋʋs pii nɛ ayi' ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan Israel dim dɔɔd pii nɛ ayi' la yɛla.

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: Ka ba kɛ ka maanmaannib la zin'ini ba zin'isa ni, ka Levi dim la zin' bɛn-bɛn ye ba tʋm Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma Jerusalem teŋin ka li dɔl wʋʋ Moses Gbauŋʋ sɔb si'em la.

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Nwadig kanɛ an yiiga la dabpii nɛ naasi daar, banɛ da naan Babilon n kul na la da maal Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ.

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la wʋsa da dɛŋi pie ba mɛŋ ka maali ba mɛŋ nyain wʋʋ malima la sʋm ye ba maali ba mɛŋ nyain si'em la. Levi dim la da maal Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ pɛribis la tis banɛ da lɛb na la nɛ ba ba'abiis nɛ maanmaannib la nɛ ba mɛŋ wʋsa.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim banɛ da lɛbi kul na la dii li, nɛ banɛ maali ba mɛŋ nyain baki ba mɛŋ nɛ dian'ad tʋʋma linɛ ka ba kpi'es banɛ ka' Israel dim da tʋm la, ye ba nyaŋi li'el Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la.

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: Daba ayɔpɔi ka ba maal bodobodo linɛ pʋ gɛndig danbin la di'ema nɛ sumalisim bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka ba sʋnf ma'ae nɛ on tiak Asiria Na'ab la pʋtɛn'ɛr ka o sʋŋi ba nɛ Israel Wina'am yir tʋʋma la.

english_verse: Much later, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylonia. Ezra was the son of Seraiah and the grandson of Azariah. His other ancestors were Hilkiah, Shallum, Zadok, Ahitub, Amariah, Azariah, Meraioth, Zerahiah, Uzzi, Bukki, Abishua, Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron, the high priest. Ezra was an expert in the Law that the Lord God of Israel had given to Moses, and the Lord made sure that the king gave Ezra everything he asked for.
translation_verse: Ezra kaŋa da yinɛ Babilon na. O da anɛ pa'an ka mi' Moses wada linɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am da tis la sʋ'ʋŋa. Na'ab la da tis o on sɔs si'el wʋsa, Zugsɔb onɛ aan o Wina'am la paŋi da bɛɛ o san'an la zug.

english_verse: Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
translation_verse: Israel dim la sieba mɛ da kɛn Jerusalem na, la'an nɛ maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim, nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib nɛ banɛ gur Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔya la nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir yammis la sieba, ka li da anɛ Na'ab Atazeesis na'am la yʋma ayɔpɔi saŋa.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: O da duoe Babilon nwadkanɛ pin'il la ni li dabisir yinne daar, ka paae Jerusalem na nwadis anu la dabisir yinne daar. O da pʋ yuug suor zugɔ, o Wina'am onɛ an pʋpiel la paŋi da bɛɛ o san'an la zug.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Na'ab Atazeesis da sɔb gbansi'a tis Ezra onɛ an maanmaan ka an pa'an la nwa': dau nwa' zamis nɛ Zugsɔb zi'ela nɛ o gban'ar wʋsa tis Israel dim la:

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: Atazeesis onɛ an Na'anam Na'ab la sɔbidi tisid Ezra onɛ an maanmaan ka pa'an Arezana Wina'am wada la. M pʋ'ʋsidif.

english_verse: Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
translation_verse: Na'ab la nɛ o nidib ayɔpɔi banɛ sa'an o la la'asi tʋmif ye fʋ keŋ Juda nɛ Jerusalem vɛɛnsi gɔs nidib la siakid Wina'am wada linɛ ka fʋ pa'an la si'em.

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dinɛ lɛm paas anɛ ye fʋ nɔk anzurifa nɛ sanlima linɛ ka Na'ab la nɛ o nidib tis Israel Wina'am onɛ ka o bɛllim zin'ig an Jerusalem la mɔri keŋ.

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: La'an di'e anzurifa nɛ sanlima Babilon sʋ'ʋlimin la wʋsa nɛ piini linɛ ka nidib nɛ maanmaannib la na tis nɛ ba ya'amlɛog, ka mɔri keŋ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir linɛ bɛ Jerusalem la.

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kpɛmisimim ka nɔk ligidkaŋa da' na'araad nɛ pɛraad nɛ pɛribis nɛ zʋʋd nɛ bʋnnuuda maana keŋ Jerusalem teŋin maal maan Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir daka la zug.

english_verse: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.
translation_verse: Linɛ wʋsa ka fʋn nɛ fʋ nidib la gɔs ka li an sʋm ka ya na nɔk anzurifa nɛ sanlima linɛ kpɛlim la maal, yanam maalim, ka kɛ ka li dɔlli ya Wina'am la bɔɔdim an si'em.

english_verse: Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple.
translation_verse: Nɔkim la'abanɛ ka ba niŋi fʋ nu'ugin la tis Jerusalem Wina'am la ka ba na mɔri tʋmmi fʋ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ bɔɔd si'el wʋsa ya Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, fʋn yisim na'ayir ligidi la nii da'.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: Mam Na'ab Atazeesis tis nɔɔr ye banɛ su'ad ligidi zin'ikanɛ lɔ'ɔŋ Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm sʋ'ʋlim la ye, Ezra onɛ an maanmaan ka an onɛ pa'an Arezana Wina'am wada la ya'a bɔɔd si'eli ya san'an, yanam tisim o.

english_verse: tons of silver,
translation_verse: nɛ Zerahaya nɛ Uzi nɛ Buki

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: Arezana Wina'am la bɔɔd si'el yanam maalimi li sʋ'ʋŋa tis o Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la. Ya ya'a niŋ ala, bɔɔ na lɛn kɛ ka Zugsɔb la sʋnf pɛlig nɛ Na'ab la nɛ o biisɛ?

english_verse: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ye ya pʋ mɔr suori na mugus maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib nɛ banɛ gur Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔya la nɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib bɛɛ banɛ sʋŋid nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma la ye ba yɔ lampɔɔ.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: Ka fʋn Ezra na zaŋ ya'am kanɛ ka fʋ Wina'am tisif la gaans sariakatib ka ba gur nimbanɛ mi' fʋ Wina'am wada la wʋsa ka bɛ Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm sʋ'ʋlimin la nɛ sida. Ka mɛ pa'al banɛ zi' wada la ka ba baŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Onɛ pʋ siaki fʋ Wina'am la wada bɛɛ Na'ab la wada ban namisim o. Li ya'a sʋm ye ba kʋʋ o bɛɛ ba kad o yis teŋin la, bɛɛ ba faaɛn o la'ad, bɛɛ ba kpɛn'ɛs o sanrega, ban niŋim ala. Ezra pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: M zun'od Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti yaanam Wina'am la, on kɛ ka Na'ab la tʋm linɛ mɔr na'asi ken Zugsɔb la Yin Jerusalem teŋin na la.

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: O mɛ pa'al on nɔŋim si'em Na'ab la nɛ o nidib nɛ o na'ayikpɛm banɛ mɔr paŋ hali la tuon. Zugsɔb onɛ aan m Wina'am la paŋi bɛɛ m san'an la zug ka m kpɛ'ɛŋi m mɛŋ ka la'as Israel tuongatib ka ba dɔllimi keŋ.

english_verse: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Bama an kpɛɛmnam banɛ da sɔbi ba yʋda nɛ banɛ dɔllimi yi Babilon n lɛb na, saŋkan ka Na'ab Atazeesis da an Na'ab la:

english_verse: Gershom of the Phinehas family; Daniel of the Ithamar family; Hattush son of Shecaniah of the David family; Zechariah and
translation_verse: Bigvai tuŋ kpɛɛmnam da anɛ Utaae nɛ Zakur, ka dap pisyɔpɔi (

english_verse: men of the Pahath Moab family; Shecaniah son of Jahaziel with
translation_verse: ) da sɔbi ba yʋda paas o zug;

english_verse: men of the Zattu family; Ebed son of Jonathan with
translation_verse: ) da sɔbi ba yʋda paas o zug;

english_verse: men of the Adin family; Jeshaiah son of Athaliah with
translation_verse: ) da sɔbi ba yʋda paas o zug;

english_verse: men of the Shephatiah family; Obadiah son of Jehiel with
translation_verse: ) da sɔbi ba yʋda paas o zug;

english_verse: men of the Joab family; Shelomith son of Josiphiah with
translation_verse: ) da sɔbi ba yʋda paas o zug;

english_verse: men of the Bani family; Zechariah son of Bebai with
translation_verse: ) da sɔbi ba yʋda paas o zug;

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛli ba ye, “Yanam nɛ la'abama wʋsa anɛ linɛ ka ba gaŋ ka ya an Zugsɔb la din ka an kasi tis o. Anzurifa nɛ sanlima la anɛ piini ka ba tis Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti yaanam Wina'am la nɛ ya'amlɛog.

english_verse: men of the Azgad family; Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah who returned sometime later with
translation_verse: ) da sɔbi ba yʋda paas o zug;

english_verse: men of the Adonikam family; Uthai and Zaccur with
translation_verse: ) mɛ paas ba zug;

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: Ka m la'asi ba ku'osuor kanɛ pʋbidi ken Ahava teŋ baba la, ka ti bɛɛ anina daba atan'. Man gɔs nidib la sʋʋgin la, m pʋ nyɛ Levi nida asɛɛ maanmaannib la ma'aa.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: Ka m buol Elieza ye o kemi m san'an na, nɛ Ariel nɛ Semaya nɛ Elinatan nɛ Jarib nɛ Elinatan sɔ' ya'as nɛ Natan nɛ Zakaria nɛ Mesulam banɛ an tuongatib la, nɛ Joyaarib nɛ Elinatan sɔ' ya'as banɛ da zamis hali la.

english_verse: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.
translation_verse: Ka m tʋmi ba Iddo, onɛ an tuongat Kasifia teŋin la ka pa'ali ba ban na pian' si'em tis on nɛ o nimbanɛ an Wina'am Yir tʋmtʋmnib la, ka ba na mɔr tʋmtʋmnib na tisi ti ka ba tʋm Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la tʋʋma.

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: Ka Hasiabiya mɛ da pɛ'ɛs, la'an nɛ Jesaya onɛ an Merari tuŋ nid, on nɛ o ba'abiis nɛ ba biis ka ba wʋsa la'as nidib pisi (

english_verse: others came to help the Levites in the temple. The ancestors of these workers had been chosen years ago by King David and his officials, and they were all listed by name. Ezra Asks the People To Go without Eating and To Pray
translation_verse: ) banɛ an Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib la na. Tʋmtʋmnib la da anɛ banɛ ka David nɛ o na'ayikpɛm da gaŋi ba yaanamɛ zi'el ye ba sʋŋid Levi dim la. Ba wʋsa yʋda da sɔbi digil gbana la ni.

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: Ahava ku'osuor la baba ka m tis nɔɔr ye ti wʋsa lɔ nɔɔr ka sie ti mɛŋi ti Wina'am la tuon ka sɔs o ye o kɛ ka tinam nɛ ti biis nɛ ti la'ad la na paae laafi.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: Ala ka ti lɔ nɔɔr ka sɔsi ti Wina'am la li yɛla ka o di'e ti sɔsʋg.

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: Ka m gaŋ maanmaannib tuongatib pii nɛ ayi', ban nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Hasiabiya nɛ ba ba'abiis piiga,

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Mɔri nɛ ba sʋ'ʋŋa paae Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka maki li tɛbisim maanmaannib la dɔɔdin Jerusalem teŋin ka maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim nɛ Israel dim kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa nini ni.”

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ka maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la da di'e anzurifa nɛ sanlima nɛ la'abanɛ an Wina'am la din la ka maki li tɛbisim ye ba mɔri li keŋ kpɛn'ɛs Wina'am yin la Jerusalem teŋin.

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Nwadkanɛ an yiiga la, li dabisa pisi daar, ka ti duoe yi Ahava ku'osuorin la ye ti keŋ Jerusalem. Ti Wina'am la paŋ da bɛɛ ti san'an ka o gu' ti dataas nɛ banɛ na su'a daami ti suorin la.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: Ka ti paae Jerusalem na vʋ'ʋs daba atan'.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Daba anaasi la daar ka ti da mak anzurifa nɛ sanlima la tɛbisim nɛ la'abanɛ an kasi la ti Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la. Ka nɔki niŋ Meremof onɛ an Uria biig ka an maanmaan la nu'usin, ka Eleazar onɛ an Finehas biig la da bɛɛ ani nɛ Levi dim ayi', ban da anɛ Jozabad onɛ an Jesua biig la nɛ Noadaya onɛ an Binnu biig la.

english_verse: goats were sacrificed for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Azigad tuŋ kpɛɛm da anɛ Johanan onɛ da an Hakatan biig, ka dap kɔbiga nɛ piiga (

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Ka ba da nɔk gbana banɛ ka Na'ab la tisi ba la pa'al Gɔmena la nɛ kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛ Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm sʋ'ʋlimin la ka ba sʋŋ nidib la nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la.

english_verse: Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said: Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋanamɛ niŋ la nya'aŋ, ka tuongatib la kɛɛn m san'an na yɛl ye, “Israel nidib la la'an nɛ maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la pʋ baki ba mɛŋ nɛ nimbanɛ aan ba kpi'es banɛ tʋm linɛ kis la. Ba tʋmnɛ nwɛnɛ Keenan dim nɛ Hitti dim nɛ Perizi dim, nɛ Jebus dim nɛ Amor dim nɛ Moab dim nɛ Egipt dim nɛ Ammon dim la wʋsa.

english_verse: Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
translation_verse: Ban nɛ ba biribis dit buudbama pu'ayuos, ka li kɛ ka ba gɛndig nɛ teŋ la nimbanɛ ka' kasi la. Hali tuongatib nɛ kpɛɛmnam la da gaad tuonnɛ kɛ ka ba kpɛn' mɔɔg.”

english_verse: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock
translation_verse: Man wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la, ka m sʋnf san'am ka m tɛki m fuugʋ aaɛn ka tɛki m zuobid nɛ m tieŋi vɔn' ka zin'in teŋin nɛ pakir.

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Li saŋa ka banɛ wʋsa da wʋm Israel Wina'am pian'ad ka dabiem gban'e ba la da la'as na giligim ka li anɛ nimbanɛ lɛb na la pʋ dɔl o nɛ sida la zug. Ka m zin'in anina nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ hali ti paae zaam maan saŋa.

english_verse: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms,
translation_verse: Ka zaam maan saŋa paae la, ka m duoe man digin nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ zin'isi'a nɛ m fu-aanlima la, igini m duma zug ka ʋki m nu'us agɔla tisim Zugsɔb Wina'am,

english_verse: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.
translation_verse: ka sɔs ye, “O Wina'am, nyan mɔrim nɛ hali nɛ mam na gɔdigi m nindaa kpa'af, m Wina'am, bɔzugɔ ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zu'oe nɛ hali limi ti zut ka ti nyan dʋʋ paae agɔla.

english_verse: Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
translation_verse: Lin yii ti yaanam saŋa paae zina ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zu'oe nɛ. Ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug ka teŋ zʋŋ na'anam la kʋʋ ti nɛ ti na'anam nɛ ti maanmaannib ka faaɛn ti la'ad ka gban'e ti sieba maali ti yammis ka namisi ti sieba diisi ti nyan hali ti paae zina.

english_verse: But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna ti nyɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm bi'ela, ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la kɛya ka ti bi'ela kpɛlim. Ka o tisi ti paalʋ o mɛŋ zin'ikanɛ an kasi la ni. Ti Wina'am la nie ti nini ka tisi ti yɔlisim bi'ela.

english_verse: We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ tinamɛ an yammis la, ti Wina'am la pʋ basi ti ka ti kpɛn an yammisɛ, amaa ka pa'ali ti o pʋpielim ka kɛ ka Pesia Na'ab la tisi ti suor. O tisi ti bɛllim paal ye ti lɛbisi mɛ' Wina'am Yir la ka maal zin'ibanɛ san'am la lɛbis. O mɛ' zaŋguom Juda nɛ Jerusalem gu' ti.

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: Amaa ti na lɛn yɛl ye bɔ? Hali la'an nɛ wala wʋsa, ti pʋ nyaŋi dɔlisi fʋ nɔzi'elʋg

english_verse: that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things.
translation_verse: linɛ ka fʋ da pian' tisi fʋ nɔdi'esidibi yɛt ye, ‘Teŋ kanɛ ka ya kpɛn'ɛd ye ya sʋ'ʋg la anɛ teŋ kanɛ ka nidib la an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim ka mɔr bugusim. Ba maan linɛ an yɛlkisa ka ba dian'ad tʋʋma la pɛ'ɛl zin'ig la wʋsa.

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Dinzug, da nɔki ya bipumisi tisi ba biribis bɛɛ ya nɔki ba bipumisi tisi ya biribisɛ. Da bɔɔd ye yanam nɛ ban mɔr zuod baa bi'ela, ala ka ya na mɔr paŋ ka di bʋnsʋma banɛ bɛ teŋin la ka basi tisi ya biis ka li an faar linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ tisi ba.’

english_verse: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.
translation_verse: Bʋn linɛ maali ti la anɛ ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ ti nyan tʋʋma la yɛla. La'an nɛ ala, ti Wina'am, ti namisʋg la pʋ zu'oe paae tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka ti tʋm la. Amaa fʋ kɛya ka ti sieba nan vʋe.

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: Ka ti ya'a lɛn san'ami fʋ nɔzi'ela la ka di nimbanɛ tʋm yɛlbɛ'ɛd bama nwa' la pu'asada, fʋ sʋnf kʋ pɛlig hali ka fʋ kɛ ka ti wʋsa kpi ka nid baa yinne kʋ kpɛlim?

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am, fʋ anɛ sida sɔb ka kɛ ka ti sieba nan vʋe la. Tinamɛ nwa' zi'e fʋ tuon nɛ nyannɛ ti taal zug, nɛ' zug ka ti nid baa yinne kʋ nyaŋi zi'enɛ fʋ tuonnɛ.”

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Ezra da sɔsid Wina'am ka yɛt ban tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd si'em ka kaasidi mɔr o mɛŋi lɔbid teŋin Wina'am Yir tuon la, ka Israel dim bɛdegʋ dap nɛ pu'ab nɛ biis da la'as na gilig o. Ban mɛ da pin'ili kaasid hali.

english_verse: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Ani ka Jehel biig Siekania onɛ an Elam yaas la yinne da yɛl Ezra ye, “Ti pʋ tisi ti Wina'am la sidaa, ka di buudzʋna banɛ giligi ti la biisi maali ti pu'ab. Amaa la'an nɛ wala wʋsa, Israel nam mɔr ti'ir.

english_verse: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
translation_verse: Nannanna, kɛl ka ti maal nɔnaar nɛ ti Wina'am la, ka yis pu'a bama nɛ ba biis la ka li dɔlli fʋ sa'alʋg nɛ banɛ wʋsa zɔti ti Wina'am nɔzi'ela la. Kɛl ka li dɔl wada la an si'em.

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Duom zi'en! Yɛlkaŋa bɛ nɛ fʋ nu'usin. Ti na zi'eni fʋ nya'aŋ. Alazug, kpɛ'ɛŋimi fʋ mɛŋ ka tʋmi li!”

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Ani ka Ezra duoe zi'en ka yɛl maanmaannib tuongatib nɛ Levi dim nɛ Israel dim wʋsa ye ba pɔɔm zi'el ye ba na tʋm wʋʋ ban gban'e si'em la. Ka ba da sid zi'en ka pɔ.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: Ka Ezra da yi Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la keŋ Jehohanan onɛ an Eliyaasib biig la dɔɔgin. On da bɛɛ ani la, o da pʋ di diib bɛɛ nu ku'om, bɔzugɔ o nan kpɛm kumnɛ nidib la da tʋm si'el la zug.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: ka li anɛ tuongatib la wʋsa nɔɔri zi'el si'em la. Ba mɔɔl ye onɛ pʋ kɛn daba atan' nwa' sʋʋgin naa, o kʋ lɛn nyɛɛ o la'ad la wʋsa, ka on sɔb mɛ kʋ lɛn la'as o mɛŋ nɛ banɛ da lɛb na la.

english_verse: Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
translation_verse: Daba atan' la sʋʋgin dap banɛ bɛ Juda nɛ Benjamin sʋ'ʋlimin la da la'as Jerusalem na. Nwadis awai la dabpisi daar, nidib la wʋsa da la'asi zin' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zakin la, ka ba sʋnya san'amnɛ linɛ niŋid la nɛ sakʋdir linɛ daa niid la zug.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Ezra onɛ an maanmaan la da duoe zi'en ka yɛli ba ye, “Ya ka' sida dima, ya di buudzʋna pu'ab la maligim paas taali ziil Israel zug.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: Nannanna viigimi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi tis Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya yaanam Wina'am la, ka tʋm o bɔɔdim. Bakimi ya mɛŋ nɛ nimbanɛ giligi ya la wʋsa nɛ buudzʋna pu'ab banɛ ka ya dii ba la.”

english_verse: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ la'as la wʋsa siak nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Fʋ yɛl sida, asɛɛ ti tʋm wʋʋ fʋn yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: Amaa nidib la zu'oe kpɛla ka li mɛ an sɛɛung la zug, ti kʋ nyaŋi zi'en yiŋa. Ya'a pʋn ka' linɛ, ti kʋ nyaŋi nɔk dabisir yinne bɛɛ dabisa ayi' maal yɛlkaŋa, bɔzugɔ, ti tʋm bɛ'ɛd hali yɛlkaŋa pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ti tuongatib la zi'en nidib la wʋsa nɔba zugʋ tʋmi li. Zi'elim saŋa ka sariakatib nɛ kpɛɛmnam na yi teŋ wʋsa ni na ka dɔlli ba teŋ biis banɛ wʋsa di buudzʋŋ pu'a, hali ti paae saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn linɛ duoe nɛ ti yɛlkaŋa zug la ma'ae.”

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Jonatan onɛ an Asahel biig la, nɛ Jazeaya onɛ an Tikiva biig la ma'aa da pʋ siakɛ, ka Mesulam nɛ Siabetaae onɛ an Levi nid la da zi'e ba nya'aŋ.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Ka nidib la niŋ wʋʋ ban gban'e si'em la. Ezra onɛ an maanmaan la da gaans dap banɛ an kpɛɛmnam la. Tuŋ wʋsa da mɔr sɔ' ka o zi'e tuŋ la yʋ'ʋr yɛla. Ka nwadis piiga la dabisir yinne daar ka ba zin'in ye ba vɛɛns yɛla la gbinnɛ gɔs.

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: Ka nwadig kanɛ an yiiga la dabisir yinne daar ka ba naae dap banɛ di buudzʋŋ pu'ab la pian'ad. Banɛ da di buudzʋŋ biis la yɛla

english_verse: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;
translation_verse: Imer yaas da anɛ Hanani nɛ Zebadaya.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Harim yaas da anɛ Maaseya nɛ Elaja nɛ Semaya nɛ Jehel nɛ Uzia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
translation_verse: Pasur yaas da anɛ Eliyona nɛ Maaseya nɛ Isimael nɛ Netanɛl nɛ Jozabad nɛ Elasa.

english_verse: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation_verse: Levi dim la sʋʋgin da anɛ: Jozabad nɛ Simie nɛ Kɛlaya nɛ Petahaya nɛ Juda nɛ Elieza.

english_verse: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation_verse: Yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la ni da anɛ Eliyaasib. Za'anɔgu'udib la da anɛ Sallum nɛ Telem nɛ Uri.

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Israel dim banɛ kpɛlim la nwa': Paros yaas da anɛ Aramaya nɛ Izzia nɛ Malkija nɛ Mijamin nɛ Eleazar nɛ Malkija nɛ Benaya.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Elam yaas da anɛ Matanaya nɛ Zakaria nɛ Jehel nɛ Abidi nɛ Jerimof nɛ Elaja.

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Zatu yaas da anɛ Elyona nɛ Eliyaasib nɛ Matanaya nɛ Jerimof nɛ Zabad nɛ Aziza.

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Bebai yaas da anɛ Jehohanan nɛ Hanania nɛ Zabai nɛ Atilai.

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Bani yaas da anɛ Mesulam nɛ Maluk nɛ Adaya nɛ Jasub nɛ Seal nɛ Jerimof.

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Pahaf-Moab yaas da anɛ Adina nɛ Kielal nɛ Benaya nɛ Maaseya nɛ Matanaya nɛ Bezalel nɛ Binnu nɛ Manase.

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Hasuem yaas da anɛ Matena nɛ Matata nɛ Zabad nɛ Elifelet nɛ Jeremaae nɛ Manase nɛ Simie.

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Nebo yaas da anɛ: Jeyel nɛ Matitia nɛ Zabad nɛ Zebina nɛ Jaddaae nɛ Joel nɛ Benaya.

english_verse: These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_verse: Bama wʋsa da di nɛ buudzʋŋ biis, ka ba sieba pu'ab du'a biis ka ba la'am lɛbisi ba nɛ ba biis la.

english_verse: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa,
translation_verse: Nehemaya onɛ an Hakalaya biig la pian'adi nwa': Atazeesis n da di na'am la li yʋma pisi saŋa, nwadig kanɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Kisilef la ni, ka m bɛ Suosa tempʋʋgin.

english_verse: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ka Hanani onɛ aan m ba'abiis la yinne nɛ o taaba da yi Juda kɛɛn m san'an na, ka m bu'osi ba Jew dim yɛla, ye m baŋ banɛ da an yammis Babilon teŋin ka lɛb na la an si'em, nɛ Jerusalem yɛla.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: Ka ba yɛlim ye, “Banɛ lɛb na la bɛ nɛ yɛla ni hali, ba bɛllim an si'em la mɔri nyan. Jerusalem zaŋguoma la li nɛ, ka bugum di kʋlis banɛ bɛ za'anɔya ni la.”

english_verse: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
translation_verse: Man wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la ka zin'in teŋin kum. Dabisa bɛdegʋ ka m maal sʋnsa'aŋ ka lɔ nɔɔri sɔs Arezana Wina'am la.

english_verse: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ bɛ arezana, Wina'am tita'ar onɛ an nyalima sɔba, fʋ dɔlli fʋ nɔŋilim nɔnaar nɛ banɛ nɔŋif ka siakidi fʋ nɔzi'ela la.

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: Yɔ'ɔgimi fʋ tʋba ka laki fʋ nini ka wʋmi m sɔsʋg kanɛ ka m sɔsid nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa fʋ sankpan'asnam banɛ an Israel dim la zug. Man viigid tinam Israel dim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, la'an nɛ mam mɛŋ nɛ m saam yidimi tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd si'em pɔ'ɔgif la.

english_verse: by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.
translation_verse: Ti sid tʋm bugusim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔgif. Ti pʋ siaki dɔlli fʋ nɔzi'ela nɛ gban'ar nɛ wada banɛ ka fʋ da tisi fʋ tʋmtʋm Moses la.

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsim fʋn da gban'e si'em tis Moses la: fʋ da yɛl ye, ‘Ya ya'a pʋ dɔllim nɛ sidaa, m na widigi ya kpɛn'ɛs buudbanɛ bɛ la ni.

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a fɛndigi lɛbi m san'an na ka siak man zi'eli ya nɔsieba la, hali ya nidib ya'a bɔɔd ban widigi paae dunia nwa' wʋsa, m na lɛn la'asi ba mɔri ba keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka m gaŋ ye ba pʋ'ʋsim la na.’

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: Ba anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋmnib, nɛ fʋ mɛŋ nidib, ka fʋ da faaɛn ba yis na nɛ fʋ nu'ukpi'euŋ nɛ fʋ paŋ tita'ar la.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: M Zugsɔba, kɛl ka fʋ tʋbir kɛlisi m sɔsʋg nwa'. M anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm, ka man nɛ fʋ tʋmtʋmnib banɛ wɔ'ɔgidi fʋ yʋ'ʋr nɛ sumalisim la bɛ kpɛla kpɛn sɔsidif nɛ nimmua. Man ye m kpɛn' dau nwa' san'an zina la, asɛɛ fʋ kɛ ka m yɛla la maal.” M da sɔs ala bɔzugɔ m da anɛ onɛ kuobid daam tisid Na'ab la.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Na'ab Atazeesis n da dii o na'am la, li yʋma pisi saŋa, nwadkanɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Nisan la ni, ka ba mɔr o daam na, ka m nɔk daam la tis Na'ab la, ka man nan zi' kpɛn' o san'an nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ la zug

english_verse: So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.” Even though I was frightened,
translation_verse: ka o bu'osim ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ nindaa pʋ lɔdigɛ ka fʋ mɛ pʋ bɛn'ɛda? Nɛ'ɛŋa ka' si'ela amaa li anɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ma'aa.” Ka dabiem kpɛn'ɛm hali.

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: Amaa ka m yɛl Na'ab la ye, “Naa, Na'aba, Wina'am na tisif nyɔvʋwɔk! M sʋnf na niŋ wala da san'am, bam mumi m yaanam zin'isi'a la on san'am ka kpɛlim dabɔɔd, ka bugum dii li za'anɔya la?”

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab la bu'osim ye, “Fʋ bɔɔd ye m niŋ bɔ tisi fɔ?” Ka m sɔs Arezana Wina'am la,

english_verse: Then I told the king, “Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.”
translation_verse: ka lɛbis o ye, “Naa, Na'aba, m anɛ fʋ sankpan'as. Li ya'a na malisi fʋ sʋnf, ka m ya'a na nyɛ suor, fʋn kɛl ka m keŋ Juda bam mumi m yaanam tempʋsi'a la mɛɛ li ya'as.”

english_verse: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
translation_verse: Na'ab la da zin'inɛ kpi'e nɛ o pu'a kpɛɛm, ka bu'osim ye, “Fʋ ken la na yuugi paae wala; ka fʋ na lɛb saŋkanɛ na?” Ka linɛ pa'al ye Na'ab la da siak ye m keŋ. Ka m gban'e saŋa ka yɛl o.

english_verse: Then I asked, “Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah?
translation_verse: M da lɛn yɛl Na'ab la ye, “Li ya'a paae fʋ ya'am, fʋn tisimim gbana ka m tis gɔmenanam banɛ bɛ Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm sʋ'ʋlim la ka ba basim suor ka m gaadi keŋ Juda.

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: Ka tisim gbauŋ ka m tis Asaf onɛ gur Na'ab tiis la, ka o tisim daad ka m maal kʋlisi kpɛn'ɛs Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la kpi'euŋ zin'ig za'anɔya, ka mɛ maal tempʋʋg la zaŋguoma, ka mɛ' zin'ikanɛ ka mam mɛŋ na bɛ.” Ka Na'ab la siak bɔzugɔ, m Wina'am la paŋ daa bɛ nɛ m ka kɛ ka Na'ab la tisim man sɔs si'el la.

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Ala ka m keŋ Gɔmenanam banɛ bɛ Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm sʋ'ʋlim la tisi ba Na'ab gbana la. Na'ab la mɛ da kɛ ka soogianam nɛ banɛ ban'ad widi la dɔllimi keŋ.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amaa Sambalat onɛ an Horon nid la nɛ Tobaya onɛ an Ammon dim kpɛɛm yinne da wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la, li da daami banɛ, nɛ ban wʋm ye sɔ' kena ye o sʋŋ Israel dim ka ba bɛllim an sʋ'ʋŋa la. Nehemaya kaae Jerusalem zaŋguoma gɔs

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: m da duoe yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ dap bi'ela, ka nam pʋ yɛl sɔ'ɔsɔ m Wina'am la nɔk si'eli niŋi m sʋnfʋn Jerusalem yɛla laa. Ti da pʋ mɔr baa bʋnkɔnbsi'a keŋɛ, asɛɛ bʋŋ kanɛ ka m ban'ad la ma'aa.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋʋ sɔb la, ka m yii dɔl Bɔn'ɔg Za'anɔɔr la, dɔlli keŋ yi suor kanɛ ken Wɛbaas Buligin la ka gaadi keŋ Na'ambin Za'anɔɔrin la gɔsid Jerusalem zaŋguoma banɛ li la, nɛ za'anɔya banɛ ka bugum san'ami ba la an si'em.

english_verse: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.
translation_verse: Ka naanɛ ani kpa' Bulig Za'anɔɔr la, nɛ Na'ab Bɛuŋ la baba, amaa ka paalʋ la pɔɔd ka m bʋŋ la pʋ nyaŋi gaadɛ.

english_verse: So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.
translation_verse: Ala ka m lɛbi keŋ Kidron bɔn'ɔgin la yʋ'ʋn gɔsid zaŋguoma la. Man naae la ka dɔl Bɔn'ɔg Za'anɔɔr la lɛb.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnam la da pʋ baŋ man keŋ si'el bɛɛ man tʋm si'ela, bɔzugɔ m pʋ yɛl Jew dim la bɛɛ maanmaannib la. Ka mɛ pʋ yɛl tuongatib la bɛɛ kpɛɛmnam la bɛɛ banɛ na tʋm tʋʋma la si'ela.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Ka m yɛli ba ye, “Ya nyɛ tinamɛ bɛ yɛlsi'a nii? Bugum di Jerusalem za'anɔya la ka li lieb dabɔɔd. Kɛlli ka ti lɛbisi mɛ' Jerusalem zaŋguoma la, ka nyan kʋ lɛm bɛɛ ti zugin ya'asɛ!”

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: M mɛ yɛli ba m Wina'am la paŋi pʋn bɛɛ m san'an si'em, nɛ Na'ab la yɛlim si'em. Ka ba lɛbis ye, “Kɛlli ka ti lɛbisi mɛ' zaŋguoma la!” Ala ka ba da pin'il tʋʋm sʋŋ kaŋa.

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Amaa Sambalat onɛ an Horon nid la nɛ Tobaya onɛ an Ammon dim kpɛɛm la, nɛ Gesem onɛ an Arab buudi la da wʋmi li, ka pin'ili tʋ'ʋd ka la'ad ka yɛt ye, “Ya niŋid bɔɔ nwa'? Ya duonɛ zi'en ye ya zan'as Na'ab la nɔɔrɛ?”

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: Ka m gandigi ba ye, “Arezana Wina'am la na sʋŋi ti ka ti nyaŋ. Tinam banɛ aan o sankpan'asnam la na mɛɛ li, amaa yanam banɛ bɛ la, ya pʋ mɔr pʋʋr bɛɛ faar Jerusalem bɛɛ ya yʋ'ʋr pʋdig anii.”

english_verse: These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem: The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
translation_verse: Eliyaasib onɛ an maanmaan kpɛɛm la nɛ o maanmaan taaba la da keŋ tʋʋma la ni mɛ Pɛ'ɛs Za'anɔɔr la ka yɔ'ɔgi li ka maali li kʋlis la lɛbisi li zin'igin. Ka mɛ' zaŋguom la tɔ'ɔŋi paae zin'ikanɛ buon Kɔbiga Girimbisa la ka yɔ'ɔgi li, ka lɛm mɛɛ tɔ'ɔŋi paae Hananɛl Girimbisa la.

english_verse: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Nidib banɛ bɛ Jeriko la da mɛɛ tɔlis ka Zakur onɛ an Imer biig la mɛɛ tɔlis.

english_verse: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Hasenaa biis la da mɛ' Zimi Za'anɔɔr la, ka da digil dabɛda la li zin'igin ka kpɛn'ɛs kʋlis la, ba mɛ da kpɛn'ɛs kʋntnam nɛ li daad banɛ ka ba kparid la.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: Uria biig Meremof onɛ an Hakos yaaŋ la da mɛɛ tɔlis. Onɛ da mɛɛ tɔ'ɔŋ ban tuon la da anɛ Berekaya biig Mesulam onɛ an Mesiezabɛl yaaŋ la. Baana biig Zadok da mɛɛ tɔlis.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: Linɛ kpɛlim la Tekoa dimi da mɛɛ tɔlis amaa ka ba tuongatib la zan'as ye ba kʋ tʋm nwɛnɛ banɛ gɔsid tʋʋma la yɛl ye ba mɛ' si'em la.

english_verse: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Pasia biig Joyada nɛ Besodeya biig Mesulam da mɛ' Jesiana Za'anɔɔr la. Ba da digil nɛ dabɛda ka kpɛn'ɛs kʋlis nɛ kʋntnam nɛ li daad.

english_verse: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
translation_verse: Banɛ da mɛɛ tɔlis la anɛ nimbanɛ yi Gibeon nɛ Misipa na, ka ba anɛ Melataya onɛ yi Gibeon na nɛ Jadon onɛ yi Meronof na la. Efiritis Kɔldaug Lɔm sʋ'ʋlim Gɔmena la da sʋ'oe ba.

english_verse: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
translation_verse: Uziel onɛ an Harhaya biig da mɛ' zin'ikan la tɔlis. O da anɛ banɛ kʋnt nɛ sanlima la yinne. Ka Hanania onɛ maan bʋnnyubisa la da mɛ' zin'ikan la tɔlis. Ba da mɛɛ li paae Zaŋguom yalʋŋ la ni.

english_verse: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Rafaya onɛ an Hur biig ka sʋ'oe Jerusalem sʋ'ʋlim pʋsʋk la da mɛ' zaŋguom la zin'ikan la tɔlis.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Onɛ da mɛɛ tɔ'ɔŋ ani da anɛ Jedaya onɛ an Harumaf biig la, onɛ da mɛ' zin'ikanɛ tɔlis ka li kpi'e nɛ o yir la. Hasiabineya biig Hatus da mɛɛ tɔlis on zugin la.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
translation_verse: Harim biig Malkija nɛ Hasueb onɛ an Pahaf-Moab biig la da mɛ' zaŋguom la zin'ikan, nɛ Bodobodo Girimbisa la.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Halohes biig Salum onɛ da sʋ'oe Jerusalem sʋ'ʋlim pʋsʋk la da mɛɛ tɔ'ɔŋ ka o bipumis la sʋŋ o.

english_verse: Hanun and the people who lived in the town of Zanoah rebuilt Valley Gate. They hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. They also rebuilt the wall for
translation_verse: Hanun nɛ banɛ bɛ Zanoak teŋin la da mɛ' Bɔn'ɔg Za'anɔɔr la. Ba da mɛɛ li ka kpɛn'ɛs kʋlis nɛ kʋnt nɛ daad banɛ puug la li zin'igin. Ba mɛ da mɛ' zaŋguom la keŋ paae Na'ambin Za'anɔɔrin la, ka li wa'alim an nɔba makir tusir nɛ kɔbisnaasi nɛ pisnaasi la.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Rekab biig Malkija onɛ an Befihakɛrem sʋ'ʋlim tuongat la da mɛ' Na'ambin Za'anɔɔr la. O da mɛɛ naae ka kpɛn'ɛs kʋntnam nɛ kʋlis nɛ li daad banɛ pʋʋg la lɛbisi li zin'igin.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Kol-Hose biig Salum onɛ sʋ'oe Misipa sʋ'ʋlim la da mɛ' Bulig Za'anɔɔr la. O da mɛɛ li ka pili li ka kpɛn'ɛs kʋlis nɛ kʋntnam nɛ daad banɛ puug la. O da lɛm mɛ' Siloam Bɛuŋ zaŋguom linɛ kpi'e Na'ab Lɔmbɔn'ɔg la mɔri paae dʋʋsa linɛ sigidi yit David Tempʋʋgin la.

english_verse: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks. Levites Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: On zugin la ka Azbuk biig Nehemaya onɛ an tuongat onɛ sʋ'oe Betzur teŋ sʋ'ʋlim pʋsʋk la da mɛɛ li. O da mɛɛ li lɛbisi keŋ paae David yaʋg baba mɔri paae bɛuŋ kanɛ ka ba gaae la nɛ zabzabidib la yir la.

english_verse: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;
translation_verse: On zugin la Levi dim da mɛɛ tɔlis. Bani biig Rehum da aan ba tuongat. Ka on zugin la, Hasiabia onɛ an tuongat ka sʋ'oe Kiela teŋ sʋ'ʋlim pʋsʋk la da mɛɛ tis o sʋ'ʋlim dim la.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah;
translation_verse: Henadad biig Binnu onɛ da sʋ'oe Kiela teŋ pʋsʋk la, da gaad tuon ka o teŋ dim mɛɛ tɔlis.

english_verse: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;
translation_verse: On zugin la Jesua biig Ezer onɛ an Misipa teŋin tuongat la da mɛɛ yi zin'ikan la dʋʋ paae zaba la'ad dɔɔg la keŋ paae zin'ikanɛ ka lɔdig bɛ la.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Zabai biig Baruk da kpɛ'ɛŋ o mɛŋi mɛɛ tɔlis. O da pin'il nɛ lɔdigin la mɛɛ keŋ paae maanmaan kpɛɛm Eliyaasib yir za'anɔɔrin la.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Uria biig Meremof onɛ an Hakos yaaŋ la da mɛ' Eliyaasib yir za'anɔɔrin la paae yir la bɛn.

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Banɛ da mɛɛ tɔlis anɛ maanmaannib banɛ gilig Jerusalem baba la. Ba da mɛ' zin'ikan la tɔlis.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Banɛ da mɛɛ tɔlis ban zugin la anɛ Benjamin nɛ Hasueb. Ba da mɛnɛ ba mɛŋ ya' tuon la. Maaseya biig Azaria onɛ an Ananaya yaaŋ la mɛ da mɛ' zin'ikanɛ kpi'e nɛ o mɛŋ yir la.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Henadad biig Binnu da lɛm mɛ' zin'ikan la tɔlis. O da mɛnɛ Azaria yin n keŋ paae lɔdig la nɛ gɔnligir la zin'igin.

english_verse: Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Uzai biig Palal da mɛ' zin'ikanɛ kpa' lɔdig la nɛ Na'ayir linɛ bɛ Zugin la nɛ li girimbisa la, ka kpi'e teŋgu'udib zak la. On zugin la, Paros biig Pedaya

english_verse: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived. Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib banɛ bɛ Ofel zuorin la da mɛ tɔlisi paae zin'ikanɛ kpa' Ku'om Za'anɔɔr la, lɛbis nya'aŋ, girimbisa la baba.

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Ban zugin la, Imer biig Zadok da mɛ' zin'ikanɛ kpa' o yituon la. Onɛ da mɛɛ tɔlis anɛ Siekania biig Semaya onɛ gur Ya-nya'aŋ Za'anɔɔr la.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Ban zugin la Sielemaya biig Hanania nɛ Hanun onɛ an Zalaf biig kanɛ paas ayuobʋ la, da la'am mɛ' zin'ig yinne. Ban zugin la, Berekaya biig Mesulam da mɛ' zin'ikanɛ kpa' nɛ o mɛŋ dɔɔg la.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: On zugin la, Malkija onɛ kʋnt sanlima la da mɛɛ keŋ paae yir si'a ka Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib nɛ banɛ kpiisid la kpɛn'ɛd la, linɛ kpa' Viisʋg Za'anɔɔr la keŋ paae dɔkanɛ ka ba mɛɛ sʋn'ʋl lɔdig zaŋguom la zug.

english_verse: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_verse: Ka dɔkaŋa nɛ Pɛ'ɛs Za'anɔɔr la teŋsʋk la, banɛ kʋnt sanlima nɛ banɛ kpiisid la da mɛɛ li.

english_verse: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.
translation_verse: Sambalat n da wʋm ye ti lɛbi mɛɛd zaŋguom la, o sʋnf da pɛlig nɛ hali, ka o tʋ'ʋd Jew dim la ka la'adi ba.

english_verse: In front of his friends and the Samaritan army he said, “What is this feeble bunch of Jews trying to do? Are they going to rebuild the wall and offer sacrifices all in one day? Do they think they can make something out of this pile of scorched stones?”
translation_verse: O da zi'en o taaba nɛ Samaria soogianam la sʋʋgin ka yɛl ye, “Jew dim banɛ ka' kibar la maan bɔɔ la? Ba na nyaŋi mɛ' zaŋguom laa?
