Ba tɛn'ɛs ye ba ya'a maal maana ba na nyaŋi mɛɛ li daar yinne naae? Ba tɛn'ɛs ye ba na vaae kuga banɛ ka bugum di la yis sa'ad la ni na mɛ' ka li an sʋ'ʋŋa?”

english_verse: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, “Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.”
translation_verse: Tobaya onɛ an Ammon nid la da zi'e kpi'e nɛ o ka yɛl ye, “Ban mɛɛd si'el la, hali baa piif ya'a ianki dʋʋ li zug ba kuga zaŋguom la na birig!”

english_verse: But I prayed, “Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Ka m sɔs Wina'am ye, “Naa, ti Ba' Wina'am! Kɛlisim ban tʋ'ʋdi ti siem! Wʋmmi ti sɔsʋg, ka kɛ ka ba tʋ'ʋd la lɛbi ba zutin. Kɛl ka ba gban'e ba mɔri keŋ teŋ si'a ka ba an yammis.

english_verse: Don't forgive the mean and evil way they have insulted the builders.”
translation_verse: Da yis nyannɛ ba zugin bɛɛ kɛɛ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi basɛ, bɔzugɔ ba tʋ'ʋdi fʋ nimbanɛ mɛɛd zaŋguom la.”

english_verse: The people worked hard, and we built the walls of Jerusalem halfway up again.
translation_verse: Ka ti lɛbisi mɛ' zaŋguom la paae li wa'alim la pʋsʋk bɔzugɔ nidib la da tʋmnɛ nɛ nimmua nɛ ba sʋnf wʋsa.

english_verse: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry
translation_verse: Amaa Sambalat nɛ Tobaya nɛ Arab dim nɛ Ammon dim nɛ Asdod dimi wʋm ye Jerusalem zaŋguom la mɛɛb ken tuon ka wɛn la wʋsa ɛnd la, ka ba sʋnf pɛlig hali.

english_verse: and decided to stir up trouble, and to fight against the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ka ba gban'e ye ba kena zab nɛ Jerusalem dim ka bɔ yɛla tisi ba.

english_verse: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.
translation_verse: Amaa ka ti sɔsi ti Wina'am la, ka zi'el nidib ye ba bɛ nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa gu' banɛ bɔɔd ye ba zab nɛ ti la.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Judah were singing a sorrowful song: “So much rubble for us to haul! Worn out and weary, will we ever finish this wall?”
translation_verse: Juda dim mɛ da fabinnɛ yʋ'ʋm ye, “Tʋmtʋmnib la gɛnnɛ, tandia'ana mɛ zu'oe galis. Ti kʋ nyaŋi mɛ' zaŋguom laa.”

english_verse: Our enemies were saying, “Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.”
translation_verse: Ka ti dataas la mɛ yɛl ye, “Ban ti ye ba baŋ bɛɛ nyɛɛ ti la, ka ti libigi ba kʋʋ ba ka ba tʋʋma la gu'oe.”

english_verse: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side,
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim banɛ kpi'e nɛ ba la kena sa'ali ti nɔɔr piiga ye, “Baŋimi ka ba na nyaŋi dɔl zin'isi'a wʋsa kena libigi ya.”

english_verse: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m zi'el ninsieba zaŋguom la zin'ibanɛ pʋ dʋ la ni, ka sieba zi'en yir-yir nɛ ba sʋ'ʋraad, nɛ kpana nɛ tiraad nɛ piema.

english_verse: Then I looked things over and told the leaders, the officials, and the rest of the people, “Don't be afraid of your enemies! The Lord is great and fearsome. So think of him and fight for your relatives and children, your wives and homes!”
translation_verse: Man gɔs si'el wʋsa naae la, m yʋ'ʋn yɛl tuongatib la nɛ kpɛɛmnam nɛ nidib la wʋsa ye, “Da zɔti ya dataas la dabiem! Tɛn'ɛsimi ya Zugsɔb onɛ galis ka an bʋnzɔtir la yɛla, ka zabi faaɛn ya ba'abiis nɛ ya biribis nɛ ya bipumis nɛ ya pu'ab nɛ ya yidim wʋsa.”

english_verse: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.
translation_verse: Ti dataas la wʋm ye ti baŋi ba gban'ar la, ka Wina'am kɛnsi ba giinla, ka ti wʋsa lɛb zaŋguomin la ka sɔ' wʋsa lɛb o tʋʋma ni.

english_verse: From then on, I let half of the young men work while the other half stood guard. They wore armor and had spears and shields, as well as bows and arrows. The leaders helped the workers
translation_verse: Lin yi daakan la, m nidib la pʋsʋk da bɛ nɛ tʋʋma la ni ka pʋsʋk mɛ zi'e nɛ kpana, nɛ gbanti'edis, nɛ tiraad nɛ piema. Zaba tuongatib la wʋsa da zi'en nɛ Juda nidib la wʋsa nya'aŋ,

english_verse: who were rebuilding the wall. Everyone who hauled building materials kept one hand free to carry a weapon.
translation_verse: saŋkanɛ ka ba mɛɛd zaŋguom la. Banɛ ziid mɛɛb la'ad la da tʋmnɛ nɛ nu'ug yinne ka zanl zaba la'ad nu'ug yinne.

english_verse: Even the workers who were rebuilding the wall strapped on a sword. The worker who was to blow the signal trumpet stayed with me.
translation_verse: Banɛ mɛɛd la mɛ da lɔnɛ ba zaba sʋ'ʋsi ba siesin ka mɛɛd. Amaa ka onɛ piebid na'atan la kpɛm bɛ man san'an.

english_verse: I told the people and their officials and leaders, “Our work is so spread out, that we are a long way from one another.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl tuongatib nɛ kpɛɛmnam nɛ nidib la wʋsa ye, “Tʋʋma la zu'oya ka ti mɛ lal nɛ taaba zaŋguomin la.

english_verse: If you hear the sound of the trumpet, come quickly and gather around me. Our God will help us fight.”
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti wʋm na'atan la piebʋg zin'isi'a, yanam la'asim anina ka ti Wina'am la na zabi tisi ti.”

english_verse: Every day from dawn to dark, half of the workers rebuilt the walls, while the rest stood guard with their spears.
translation_verse: Ka ti kpɛn tʋmmi ken tuon ka nidib la pʋsʋk zanl kpana, lin yi bɛogʋn ti paae yʋ'ʋŋ ka nwadbibis yina.

english_verse: I asked the men in charge and their workers to stay inside Jerusalem and stand guard at night. So they guarded the city at night and worked during the day.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka m mɛ yɛl nidib la ye, “Kɛl ka dau wʋsa nɛ o tʋmtʋmnib gbɛɛnd Jerusalem tempʋʋgin. Ala ka ti na mɔr nidib ka ba gur yʋ'ʋŋ ka mɛ mɔr banɛ na tʋm nintaŋ.”

english_verse: I even slept in my work clothes at night; my relatives, the workers, and the guards slept in theirs as well. And we always kept our weapons close by.
translation_verse: Mam bɛɛ m biis bɛɛ banɛ gur la pʋ yɛɛg fuugɔ. Sɔ' wʋsa da mɔr o zaba la'ad hali baa o ya'a keŋ ye o nu ku'om.

english_verse: Some of the men and their wives complained about the Jews in power
translation_verse: Dap nɛ pu'ab da fabinnɛ ba Jew taaba maannɛ ba si'em la yɛla.

english_verse: and said, “We have large families, and it takes a lot of grain merely to keep us alive.”
translation_verse: Sieba yɛt ye, “Tinam nɛ ti biribis nɛ ti bipumis la zu'oya; ti ya'a pʋ nyɛ diibɔ ti kʋ tiligɛ.”

english_verse: Others said, “During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.”
translation_verse: Ka sieba mɛ yɛt ye, “Kɔ'ɔm saŋa la ti daa mɔri ti paalʋ nɛ vain tiis pɔɔd nɛ ya' tisid ka li an kasɛt ka ti di'esid diibi dit ka kɔ'ɔm da kʋʋ tii, ka ti ya'a ti nyaŋi yɔ tinam on di'e.”

english_verse: Then others said, “We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Ka sieba mɛ yɛt ye, “Ti daa pɛ'ɛŋ nɛ ligidi yɔ Na'ab lampɔ ti vain tiis pɔɔd yɛla.

english_verse: We are Jews just as they are, and our children are as good as theirs. But we still have to sell our children as slaves, and some of our daughters have already been raped. We are completely helpless; our fields and vineyards have even been taken from us.”
translation_verse: La'an nɛ tinam nɛ areza'as dim la an buudi yinne ka ti biribis an sʋ'ʋŋa wʋʋ ba biribisi an sʋ'ʋŋa si'em la, ti gʋ'ʋŋi kuosi ti biribis nɛ ti bipumisi tisi ba ka ba liebi ba yammis. Ti bipumis la sieba pʋn anɛ yammis ka ti pʋ mɔri li paŋa bɔzugɔ ti paalʋ nɛ ti tiis pɔɔd la pʋn bɛ nɛ sieba nu'usin sa.”

english_verse: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.
translation_verse: Man wʋmi ba kaasig nɛ yɛlbanɛ ka ba yɛlim la ka m sʋʋnr da pɛlig hali.

english_verse: So I thought it over and said to the leaders and officials, “How can you charge your own people interest?” Then I called a public meeting and accused the leaders
translation_verse: Ka m tɛn'ɛsi li yɛla m sʋʋnrin sa ka zɛrig tuongatib nɛ kpɛɛmnam la, ka yɛli ba ye, “Ya namisidi ya taaba banɛ an Jew dim la la'apɛ'ɛŋir yɛla.” Ka m buol nidib la bɛdegʋ ye ba la'asim taaba maal yɛl la.

english_verse: by saying, “We have tried to buy back all of our people who were sold into exile. But here you are, selling more of them for us to buy back!” The officials and leaders did not say a word, because they knew this was true.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, “Tinam mɔɔd hali ye ti da' ti Jew taaba banɛ ka ba kuosi tis teŋ zʋŋ dim la. Amaa yanamɛ kuosidi ya ba'abiis la tisid yiŋ, ka ba lɛn kuosi ba tis tinam ya'as!” Ka ba sin bɔzugɔ ba zi' ban na yɛl si'ela.

english_verse: I continued, “What you have done is wrong! We must honor our God by the way we live, so the Gentiles can't find fault with us.
translation_verse: M lɛn yɛli ba ye, “Yanamɛ niŋid si'el la pʋ dɔl suorɛ. Li pʋ sʋm ye ya bɛ bɛllim kanɛ pa'al ye ya zɔti ti Wina'am laa? Amaa li ya'a ka' ala ti na di nyannɛ ti dataas banɛ ka' Jew dim la tuon!

english_verse: My relatives, my friends, and I are also lending money and grain, but we must no longer demand payment in return.
translation_verse: Man nɛ m ba'abiis nɛ m nidib la sieba mɛ pɛmisid ligidi nɛ diibi tisid, amaa basimi ligidi pɛ'ɛŋir ye ya na di'e nyɔɔd bɛdegʋ!

english_verse: Now give back the fields, vineyards, olive orchards, and houses you have taken and also the interest you have been paid.”
translation_verse: Nɔkimi ba tiis pɔɔd nɛ ba ya' la lɛbisi tisi ba nannanna, nɛ nyɔɔd linɛ ka ya pʋn di'esi ba san'an linɛ an ligidi nɛ olif tiis pɔɔd nɛ zʋʋd nɛ vain tiis pɔɔd nɛ kpaam la.”

english_verse: The leaders answered, “We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid.” So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.
translation_verse: Ka ba lɛbis ye, “Ti na lɛbisi tisi ba. Ti kʋ lɛn di'e si'eli ba san'an ya'asɛ. Ti na niŋ wʋʋ fʋn yɛli ti si'em la.” Ka m buol maanmaannib la ka kɛ ka tuongatib nɛ kpɛɛmnam la pɔɔ zi'el ye ba na tʋm wʋʋ ban yɛli zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: Then I emptied my pockets and said, “If you don't keep your promise, that's what God will do to you. He will empty out everything you own, even taking away your houses.” The people answered, “We will keep our promise.” Then they praised the Lord and did as they had promised. Nehemiah Is Generous
translation_verse: Ka mam mɛ yisi m fuug sɛnbidiŋ linɛ lɔɔm fuug la vɛnsigi vɛnsig ka yɛl ye, “Onɛ pʋ dɔl kaanb kaŋa, Wina'am na yis o sɔba vɛnsigi yis o, o yir la ni nɛ on mɔr si'el wʋsa ka kɛɛ o zaalim.” Ani ka nidib la wʋsa lɛbis ye, “Ami! Zun'omi Zugsɔb la.” Ka nidib la daa sid tʋm wʋʋ ban yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: I was governor of Judah from the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king until the thirty-second year. And during these entire twelve years, my relatives and I refused to accept the food that I was allowed.
translation_verse: Na'ab Atazeesis n da di na'am la li yʋma pisi saŋa, ka ba da gaŋim ye m an Juda gɔmena la, hali ti paae yʋma pistan' nɛ ayi' nwa' saŋa, man bɛɛ m ba'abiis la pʋ di diib linɛ ka ba pʋdigidi tisid ye li anɛ gɔmena diib la.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.
translation_verse: Amaa gɔmenanam banɛ dɛŋ man tuon la da ziil nidib la zitɛbisa bɔzugɔ, ba da di'esid nɛ anzurifa ligidi pisnaasi daar wʋsa ka lɛn di'esid diib nɛ daam paasid. Ba nya'andɔlib la mɛ da mugusid nidib la. Amaa Wina'am zɔtim zug mam pʋ niŋid alaa.

english_verse: I spent all my time getting the wall rebuilt and did not buy any property. Everyone working for me did the same thing.
translation_verse: Man lɛɛ da pɛsig nɛ m mɛŋ ye m tʋm zaŋguom la tʋʋma. M nidib la wʋsa da la'as anina ye ba tʋm, ka da pʋ ieed paalʋ baa yinne ye ti sʋ'oe ya.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Dabisir wʋsa m kʋʋdi lɔlig yinne, nɛ pɛ'ɛs ayuobʋ nɛ nɔɔs bɛdegʋ. Dabpiiga wʋsa m di'esid daam buudi wʋsa bɛdegʋ tisidi m saam. La'an nɛ nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa mam pʋ di'esid si'el man an gɔmena la zugɔ, bɔzugɔ m mi' ye ziid kanɛ bɛɛ ba zugin la zu'oya.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.
translation_verse: M Wina'am, m sɔsidif ye fʋ tɛnri m yɛla, nɛ man tʋm si'eli tis nimbama nwa' la.

english_verse: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.
translation_verse: Labaar yʋ'ʋn da paae Sambalat onɛ an Horon nid la nɛ Tobaya nɛ Gesem onɛ an Arab buudi la nɛ banɛ wʋsa aan ti dataas la ye m mɛ' zaŋguom la ka wɛlʋg pʋ kpɛlim, hali saŋkan la ka m nam pʋ kpɛn'ɛs kʋlis za'anɔya la nii.

english_verse: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.
translation_verse: Sambalat nɛ Gesem da tisim tɔlʋŋ kaŋa ye, “Kem na ka ti sia'al taaba tembibis linɛ bɛ Ono paalʋ la yinne ni.” Amaa ba da dɔlisidim nɛ suobɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: So I sent messengers to tell them, “My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.”
translation_verse: Ka m tɔlim lɛbisi ba ye, “M mɔri tʋʋm tita'ar hali ka kʋ nyaŋi kenaa, m na niŋ wala bas tʋʋma la ka kɛɛn ya san'an na?”

english_verse: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!
translation_verse: ka gbauŋ la pʋʋgin sɔb ye, “Tɛɛns banɛ giligi ti la dim nɛ Gesem mɛ yɛl ye li anɛ sida ye fʋn nɛ Jew dim gban'e nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd, ye ya zan'as Na'ab la nɔɔr, linɛ kɛ ka ya mɛɛd zaŋguom la. Gbauŋ kaŋa pʋʋgin la lɛn sɔb ye, fʋ bɔɔd ye fʋ liebi ba na'ab,

english_verse: You even have prophets in Jerusalem, claiming you are now the king of Judah. You know the Persian king will hear about this, so let's get together and talk it over.
translation_verse: hali ka gaans nɔdi'esidib ye ba mɔɔnnɛ fʋ yɛla Jerusalem ye; ‘Na'ab yʋ'ʋn bɛ Juda teŋin!’ Labakaŋa na paae Na'ab la dinzug, kem na ka ti pian' li yɛla.”

english_verse: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, “None of this is true! You are making it all up.”
translation_verse: Ka m lɛbis o ye, “Fʋn pian'ad si'el la wʋsa ka' sidaa, li kʋdim anɛ fʋ mɛŋ pʋtɛn'ɛr ka fʋ pian'ad.”

english_verse: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa da mɔɔdnɛ ye ba kpɛn'ɛsi ti dabiem ka tɛn'ɛsid ye li na kɛ ka ti bas ka tʋʋma la gʋ'ʋŋ naar. Ka m sɔs Wina'am ye, “Kpɛmisimim!”

english_verse: One day I went to visit Shemaiah. He wasn't supposed to leave his house, but he said, “Let's hurry to the holy place of the temple and hide there. We will lock the temple doors, because your enemies are planning to kill you tonight.”
translation_verse: Daar yinne ka m keŋ Delaya biig Semaya, onɛ yaabi an Mehetabɛl la yin ka o yɛl ye, “Kɛl ka ti keŋ kpɛn' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la Dɔɔg la pʋʋgin ka yɔ' Dɔɔg la za'anɔya bɔzugɔ, nidib kenna ye ba kʋʋf. Ba na kɛn yʋ'ʋŋa na kʋʋf.”

english_verse: I answered, “Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go!”
translation_verse: Amaa ka m lɛbis o ye, “Mam bʋrakaŋa na niŋ wala zɔt dabiem? Bɛɛ man tiraana na kpɛn' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin ye m faanm nyɔvʋrɛ? Ayei, m kʋ keŋɛ!”

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me
translation_verse: M da baŋ ye li ka' Wina'am tʋm o naa, amaa li anɛ o mɛŋ pʋtɛn'ɛr ka o pian'adi m yɛla bɔzugɔ, Tobaya nɛ Sambalat da da' o.

english_verse: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.
translation_verse: Ba da' o nɛ ye o kpɛn'ɛs man dabiem ka m tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka ba tisim yʋ'ʋbɛ'ɛd ka faki m zug.

english_verse: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me. The Work Is Finished
translation_verse: Ka m sɔs Wina'am ye, “M Wina'am, tɛnr Tobaya nɛ Sambalat yɛla, ban tʋm si'el la zug, ka mɛ tɛnr nɔdi'espu'ak Noadaya nɛ nɔdi'esidib banɛ bɔɔd ye ba kpɛn'ɛsim dabiem la.” Tʋʋma la naar

english_verse: On the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, the wall was completely rebuilt. It had taken
translation_verse: Zaŋguom la mɛɛb da naae nɛ nwadig kanɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Elul la dabpii nɛ anu daar. Dabpisnu nɛ ayi' ka ti nɔki tʋm naae.

english_verse: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.
translation_verse: Ti dataas la wʋsa da wʋm la, dabiem da kpɛn' tembanɛ giligi ti la nidib, ka ba ti'ir wʋsa naae bɔzugɔ ba da baŋ ye ti Wina'am la sʋŋ ka tʋʋm kaŋa tʋm.

english_verse: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.
translation_verse: Dabisban la ni ya'as, Juda tuongatib da sɔbid gbana bɛdegʋ tisid Tobaya ka on mɛ sɔbidi tisidi ba.

english_verse: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translation_verse: Juda dim la da dɔl o nɛ yɛla ayi' yɛla, bɔzugɔ o diemi da an Arah biig Siekania, ka o biig Jehohanan mɛ di Berekaya biig Mesulam pu'ayua.

english_verse: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ da kenna yɛt o tʋʋm sʋma yɛla ka m wʋm, ka lɛbidi yɛt o man yɛt si'el wʋsa. Ka Tobaya mɛ sɔbid gbana mɔɔd ye o kpɛn'ɛsim dabiem.

english_verse: Although Jerusalem covered a large area, not many people lived there, and no new houses had been built.
translation_verse: Tempʋʋg la da zu'oya ka paalʋ mɛ zu'oe pʋʋgin la, amaa nidib la nɛ ba ya' la da pʋ zu'oe.

english_verse: Here are the names of Solomon's servants whose descendants returned: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida, Jaala, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Amon.
translation_verse: nɛ Sefatia tuŋ nɛ Hatil tuŋ nɛ Pokɛref-Hazebam tuŋ nɛ Ammon tuŋ.

english_verse: who returned from the families of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda, though they could not prove they were Israelites. They had lived in the Babylonian towns of Tel-Melah, Tel-Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer.
translation_verse: ). Amaa ba da pʋ nyaŋi pa'al nyain ye ba tuŋ yinɛ Israel buudi ni naa.

english_verse: The families of Hobaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai could not prove they were priests. The ancestor of the family of Barzillai had married the daughter of Barzillai from Gilead and had taken his wife's family name. But the records of these three families could not be found, and none of them were allowed to serve as priests.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib tuŋ banɛ yʋda dɔl nwa' daa pʋ nyaŋi vɛɛnsi baŋi ba yaanamɛ an sieba. Banɛ an: Hobaya nɛ Hakos nɛ Barizila. . Ban da pʋ baŋi ba yaanam yʋda la zug ba da pʋ tisi ba suor ye ba an maanmaanniba.

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until he lets us know if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Gɔmena la da pʋ siak ye ba di dikanɛ an kasi la ti paae saŋkanɛ ka maanmaannib tʋʋma na bɛ ka ba tʋm nɛ Urim nɛ Tummim m baŋ Wina'am gban'arɛ.

english_verse: Many people gave gifts to help pay for the materials to rebuild the temple. The governor himself gave
translation_verse: Nidib banɛ kpɛlim la da tis nɛ sanlima ligidi tusa pisi (

english_verse: bowls to be used in the temple, and
translation_verse: ) nɛ maanmaannib fuud kɔbisnu nɛ pistan' (

english_verse: On the first day of the seventh month, the people came together in the open area in front of the Water Gate. Then they asked Ezra, who was a teacher of the Law of Moses, to read to them from this Law that the Lord had given his people. Ezra the priest came with the Law and stood before the crowd of men, women, and the children who were old enough to understand.
translation_verse: Li da anɛ nwadis ayɔpɔi la dabisir yinne daar ka Ezra onɛ an maanmaan la mɔr wada la nidib la tuon na. Banɛ da bɛɛ ani da anɛ dap nɛ pu'ab nɛ banɛ wʋsa na nyaŋi gban'e pian'ad gbin.

english_verse: Ezra stood on a high wooden platform that had been built for this occasion. Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah were standing to his right, while Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash Baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam were standing to his left.
translation_verse: Ba da maalnɛ daadi kpa' ka li dʋ ka Ezra dʋʋ zi'enɛ li zug, ba da maali li nɛ dabiskan la yɛla. Matitia nɛ Sema nɛ Anaya nɛ Uria nɛ Hilkia nɛ Maaseya da zi'enɛ o datiuŋ, ka banɛ da zi'e o dagɔbʋg la da anɛ Pedaya nɛ Misael nɛ Malkija nɛ Hasuem nɛ Hasiabadana nɛ Zakaria nɛ Mesulam.

english_verse: Ezra was up on the high platform, where he could be seen by everyone, and when he opened the book, all the people stood up.
translation_verse: Ezra da lak gbauŋ la ka nidib la wʋsa nyɛt o bɔzugɔ, on da zi'e si'el la ba da maali li ka li dʋʋ gaad nidib la zi'e si'el la.

english_verse: Ezra praised the great Lord God, and they lifted their hands, shouting “Amen! Amen!” Then they bowed with their faces to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ezra da zun'e Zugsɔb onɛ an Wina'am tita'ar la ka nidib la wʋsa ʋki ba nu'us ka siak ye, “Ami! Ami!” Ka igin teŋinɛ zun'e Zugsɔb la ka ba nindaas kpa' teŋin.

english_verse: After this, the Levites Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah went among the people, explaining the meaning of what Ezra had read.
translation_verse: Ba da karim Wina'am wada gbauŋ la, nie li pa'al nyain ka pa'ali li gbin ye nidib la gban'e ban karim si'el la gbin.

english_verse: The people started crying when God's Law was read to them. Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher, and the Levites who had been teaching the people all said, “This is a special day for the Lord your God. So don't be sad and don't cry!”
translation_verse: Nehemaya onɛ an gɔmena la nɛ Ezra onɛ an maanmaan ka an onɛ pa'an wada la nɛ Levi dim banɛ da pa'annɛ ba ka ba gban'adi li gbin la, yʋ'ʋn daa yɛli ba ye, “Dabiskaŋa anɛ ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la mɛŋ dabisir linɛ an kasi, dinzug, da kummi bɛɛ kaasida.” Bɔzugɔ nidib la wʋsaa da wʋm ka ba karim wada la, ba da kaasidnɛ.

english_verse: Nehemiah told the people, “Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord, and he will make you happy and strong.”
translation_verse: Nehemaya da yɛl ye, “Kem maali sumalisim, dimi disʋma ka nuue bʋmmalisa ka tis banɛ pʋ mɔr la. Dabiskaŋa anɛ Zugsɔb la din, da maannɛ sʋnsa'aŋa bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb la sumalisim aan ya paŋ.”

english_verse: The Levites encouraged the people by saying, “This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn!”
translation_verse: Levi dim la da giligidi bɛlisid nidib la ka yɛti ba ye, “Aaɛn baanlimm ka zina anɛ kasi dabisiri tis Zugsɔb la, da maannɛ sʋnsa'aŋa.”

english_verse: When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them. Celebrating the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Ka nidib la keŋ di ka nu, ka tisid banɛ pʋ mɔr diibi na di la, ka maal sumalisim bɔzugɔ ba yʋ'ʋn da gban'e pian'ad linɛ ka ba pa'ali ba la gbin.

english_verse: On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law
translation_verse: Dabiskanɛ paas ayi' la, yir kpɛɛmnam nɛ maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim da la'as Ezra onɛ pa'an wada la san'an na ye ba kɛlis wada la.

english_verse: that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year.
translation_verse: Ba da nyɛ wada gbauŋ la pʋʋgin ka Wina'am zi'el wada tis Moses ye Israel dim la anɛ ba bɛ sʋga ni nwadis ayɔpɔi malʋŋ la saŋa.

english_verse: They also learned that they were to go into the woods and gather branches of leafy trees such as olives, myrtles, and palms for making these shelters.
translation_verse: Ka li lɛm pa'al ye, ba mɔɔlim labakaŋa ba tempʋʋs la wʋsa nɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin, ka ye, “Yim keŋ kʋkʋna teŋin nwaae olif tiis banɛ bɛ pɔɔdin nɛ mɔɔgin la wila mɔri kena, ka bɔ tutuud nɛ kpʋkparis nɛ tiis banɛ mɔr ma'asim wila mɔri kena maal sʋga wʋʋ lin sɔb si'em la.”

english_verse: So the people gathered branches and made shelters on the flat roofs of their houses, in their yards, in the courtyard of the temple, and in the open areas around the Water Gate and Ephraim Gate.
translation_verse: Alazug ka nidib la da yii keŋ mɔr wila la lɛb na maal sʋga ba mɛŋ dɔɔd zugin nɛ ba za'asin nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zakin la nɛ paalʋ zin'is linɛ bɛ Ku'om Za'anɔɔrin nɛ Efiram Za'anɔɔrin la.

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from Babylonia built shelters. They lived in them and joyfully celebrated the Festival of Shelters for the first time since the days of Joshua son of Nun.
translation_verse: Banɛ da yi Babilon n lɛb na la wʋsa da maali ba mɛŋ sʋga bɛɛ ani. Din yi Nun biig Josua saŋa ti paae daakan la, Israel dim nan zi' maal di'ema wʋʋ daakan la. Ba sumalisim la da zu'oe nɛ hali.

english_verse: On each of the first seven days of the festival, Ezra read to the people from God's Law. Then on the eighth day, everyone gathered for worship, just as the Law had said they must.
translation_verse: Dabisir wʋsa lin yi malʋŋ la pin'ilʋg daare ti paae li naar daar la, Ezra da karim Wina'am gbauŋ la. Ba da maal malʋŋ tiɛnr di'ema la nɛ daba ayɔpɔi, ka daba anii la daar ka ba wʋsa la'as zin'ig yinne nwɛnɛ wada la da zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month, the people of Israel went without eating, and they dressed in sackcloth and threw dirt on their heads to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Nwadkan la dabpisi nɛ anaasi daar Israel dim da la'asi lɔ nɔɔr ka yɛ bɔto fuud ka bugi ba zut nɛ titan ka li anɛ sʋnsa'aŋ malʋŋ.

english_verse: They refused to let foreigners join them, as they met to confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Israel dim banɛ da an Israel dim amɛŋa la da baki ba mɛŋ nɛ buudzʋna la. Ba da zi'enɛ ba zi'esa ni ka viigi ba mɛŋ nɛ ba yaanam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi yɛl Wina'am.

english_verse: For three hours they stood and listened to the Law of the Lord their God, and then for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba da zi'en ban bɛ zin'isi'a la ka karimi ba Zugsɔb Wina'am wada gbauŋ la dabisir la pʋʋgin, ka viigi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka wɔ'ɔgi ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the special platform for the Levites and prayed aloud to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Levi dim banɛ da zi'e ba zin'igin bimbim la zug la da anɛ Jesua nɛ Bani nɛ Kadmiel nɛ Siebanaya nɛ Buni nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Bani nɛ Kenani, ka ba da buoli ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar.

english_verse: Then the Levites Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said: “Stand and shout praises to your Lord, the eternal God! Praise his wonderful name, though he is greater than words can express.” The People Pray
translation_verse: Ka Jesua nɛ Kadmiel nɛ Bani nɛ Hasiabineya nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Hodaya nɛ Siebanaya nɛ Petahaya banɛ an Levi dim la da yɛl ye, “Zi'enimi ka wɔ'ɔgi Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am ka vʋe saŋa linɛ ka' bɛn la.” Ka nidib la wʋsa da yʋʋm yɛt ye, “Albareka bɛ nɛ fʋ yʋ'ʋtita'ar linɛ nar girima, ka gaad zʋn'or nɛ na'asi linɛ bɛ wʋsa la!

english_verse: You alone are the Lord, Creator of the heavens and all the stars, Creator of the earth and those who live on it, Creator of the ocean and all its creatures. You are the source of life, praised by the stars that fill the heavens.
translation_verse: Fʋn ma'aa an Zugsɔb, fʋnɛ maal agɔl nɛ saŋgbauŋ nɛ nwadbibis banɛ bɛɛ li ni la, ka maal teŋgbauŋ nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li ni wʋsa, ka maal atɛuk nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa. Fʋnɛ tisid si'el wʋsa nyɔvʋr, ka bʋn linɛ bɛɛ agɔl la wʋsa zun'odif.

english_verse: You are the Lord our God, the one who chose Abram— you brought him from Ur in Babylonia and named him Abraham.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ an Zugsɔb Wina'am kanɛ da gaŋ Abram mɔr o yi Ur linɛ bɛ Kaldea teŋgbauŋʋn la na ka pʋd o yʋ'ʋr ye Abraham.

english_verse: Because he was faithful, you made an agreement to give his descendants the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, and of the Jebusites and Girgashites. Now you have kept your promise, just as you always do.
translation_verse: On da pa'al ye o anɛ sida sɔb la, fʋ da maal nɔnaar nɛ o. Fʋ zi'el nɔɔr ye fʋ na nɔk Keenan dim teŋ la tis o yaas, ka li anɛ Hitti dim nɛ Amor dim la din, nɛ Perizi dim nɛ Jebus dim nɛ Girgas dim din la. Fʋ pʋ tami fʋ kaanbʋg la, fʋ pʋpielim la zug.

english_verse: When our ancestors were in Egypt, you saw their suffering; when they were at the Red Sea, you heard their cry for help.
translation_verse: Fʋn da nyɛɛ ti yaanam namisʋg Egipt teŋin la; fʋ da wʋmi ba kaasig Atɛuk Zɛn'ugʋn la.

english_verse: You knew that the King of Egypt and his officials and his nation had mistreated your people. So you worked fearsome miracles against the Egyptians and earned a reputation that still remains.
translation_verse: Fʋ da maal zanbina nɛ nyalima nɛ kilima pa'al Faaro nɛ o na'ayikpɛm nɛ teŋ la nidib wʋsa, bɔzugɔ fʋ mi' Egipt dim la da dʋ'ʋsi ba mɛŋ ka namisidi fʋ nidib la si'em. Fʋ maal yʋ'ʋri tisi fʋ mɛŋ ka li kpɛm bɛ hali nɛ zina.

english_verse: You divided the deep sea, and your people walked through on dry land. But you tossed their enemies in, and they sank down like a heavy stone.
translation_verse: Fʋ buak atɛuk ku'om, ka ba dɔl teŋ kpi'emisi lɔ'ɔŋ, amaa ka fʋ lɛbis ku'om la pil banɛ kati ba la, ka ba sim wʋʋ kugir nɛ.

english_verse: Each day you led your people with a thick cloud, and at night you showed the way with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Fʋ gaadi ba tuonnɛ an saŋgbauŋ nintaŋ ka lɛn an nɛɛsim yʋ'ʋŋʋ nie tisi ba pa'annɛ ba ban na dɔl suosi'a la.

english_verse: At Sinai you came down from heaven, and you gave your people good laws and teachings that are fair and honest.
translation_verse: Fʋ sig Sinai Zuor zug na. Fʋ naam arezana ni ka pian' tisi ba. Fʋ tisi ba zi'ela nɛ wada ka li an sʋm tisi ba ka li an linɛ nar ka dɔl suor.

english_verse: You commanded them to respect your holy Sabbath, and you instructed your servant Moses to teach them your laws.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka ba baŋi fʋ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la yɛla, ka tis Moses zi'ela nɛ wada nɛ fʋ gban'ar wʋsa ye o tisi ba.

english_verse: When they were hungry, you sent bread from heaven, and when they were thirsty, you let water flow from a rock. Then you commanded them to capture the land that you had solemnly promised. *
translation_verse: Kɔ'ɔm da mɔri ba ka fʋ kɛ ka diib yi arezana ni na ka ba di. Ku'onuud da mɔri ba ka fʋ kɛ ka ku'om yi tampiingin na ka ba nu. Fʋ yɛli ba ye ba kem sʋ'ʋg teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ da pɔɔ zi'el ye fʋ na tisi ba la.

english_verse: Our stubborn ancestors refused to obey— they forgot about the miracles you had worked for them, and they were determined to return to Egypt and become slaves again.
translation_verse: Amaa ti yaanam la da mɔr nyɛɛsim ka maal zukpi'euŋ ka pʋ siaki fʋ nɔɔr zi'elʋgɔ.

english_verse: not even when they made an idol shaped like a calf and insulted you by claiming, “This is the god who rescued us from Egypt.”
translation_verse: hali baa ban da maal na'abil ba'ari tisi ba mɛŋ ka yɛl ye, ‘Ya teŋgban onɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt na la nwa' la,’ bɛɛ ban da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi san'ami fʋ yʋ'ʋr la.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, you never abandoned them in the desert. And you always guided them with a cloud by day and a fire at night.
translation_verse: Fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔri zu'oe la zug, fʋ da pʋ basi ba sian'arin la. Nintaŋ wʋsa saŋgbauŋ la pʋ bɔdigid ka basidi baa, bɛɛ nɛɛsim kanɛ pa'annɛ ba suor yʋ'ʋŋ la bɔdig ka kɛɛ baa.

english_verse: You took good care of them, and for forty years they never lacked a thing. Their clothes didn't wear out, and their feet were never swollen.
translation_verse: Yʋma pisnaasi ka fʋ guri ba mɔɔgin, si'el da pʋ pɔ'ɔgi ba, ba fuud pʋ kpii ka ba nɔba mɛ pʋ mɔdɛ.

english_verse: You let them conquer kings and take their land, including King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka ba nyaŋ na'anam nɛ buudi bɛdegʋ, fʋ tisi ba teŋ la bɛn wʋsa. Ba da faaɛn Hesbon na'ab Sihon teŋ nɛ Basan na'ab Og teŋgbauŋ.

english_verse: You brought them into the land that you had promised their ancestors, and you blessed their nation with people that outnumbered the stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka ba biribis zu'oe nwɛnɛ nwadbibis banɛ bɛ saŋgbauŋin la, ka mɔri ba keŋ kpɛn' teŋ la ni, teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ da pɔɔ zi'eli ba yaanam ye ba sʋ'oe la ni.

english_verse: They captured strong cities and rich farmland; they took furnished houses, as well as cisterns, vineyards, olive orchards, and numerous fruit trees. They ate till they were satisfied, and they celebrated your abundant blessings.
translation_verse: Ba da faaɛn tɛɛns banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ nɛ zin'ibanɛ ka teŋ la mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm la. Ba da faaɛn ya' banɛ ka la'asʋma pɛ'ɛl la sʋ'ʋgi li, nɛ bulis banɛ dɛŋi bɛɛ ani la, nɛ vain tiis pɔɔd nɛ olif tiis, ka tiis banɛ da wan la da ka' bɛnnɛ. Ba da dii tig ka maal sumalisim ka li anɛ yɛlsʋm kanɛ ka fʋ maali tisi ba la zug.

english_verse: In spite of this, they rebelled and disobeyed your laws. They killed your prophets, who warned them to turn back to you, and they cursed your name.
translation_verse: Amaa ba da pʋ siakɛ, ka zan'asi fʋ nɔɔr. Ba da zan'asi fʋ wada la, ka kʋʋ fʋ nɔdi'esidib banɛ da san'anɛ ba ye ba lɛmmi fʋ san'an na la, ka san'ami fʋ yʋ'ʋr hali.

english_verse: So you handed them over to their enemies, who treated them terribly. But in their sufferings, they begged you to help. From heaven you listened to their prayers and because of your great mercy, you sent leaders to rescue them.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ nɔki ba niŋi ba bi'emnam nu'usin ka ba namisi ba. Amaa ban da nyɛ namisʋg ka kaasi tisif la, fʋ naam arezana ni wʋm. Fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔri zu'oe hali la zug fʋ da tʋm tuongatibi tisi ba na ka ba faaɛn ba, ba bi'emnam la nu'usin.

english_verse: But when they were at peace, they would turn against you, and you would hand them over to their enemies. Then they would beg for help, and because you are merciful, you rescued them over and over again.
translation_verse: Amaa ban da nyɛ yɔlisim la ba da lɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi fʋ tuon, fʋ da basi ba tisi ba bi'emnam ka ba sʋ'oe ba. Ban da lɛn kaasi tisif la ka fʋ bɛ arezana ni ka wʋm, ka fʋn an nimbaanlzɔt la zug ka fʋ faandi ba saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: For years, you were patient, and your Spirit warned them with messages spoken by your prophets. Still they refused to listen, and you handed them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Yʋma bɛdegʋ ka fʋ mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ ba. Fʋ siig la ka fʋ nɔki dɔlisi fʋ nɔdi'esidib la ni sa'ali ba. La'an nɛ wala ba pʋ kɛlisɛ, ka fʋ nɔki ba niŋi ba kpi'es nu'usin.

english_verse: But you are merciful and kind, and so you never forgot them or let them be destroyed.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔri zu'oe la zug ka fʋ pʋ basi ba ka li naae bɛɛ fʋ tami ba yɛla, fʋn an pʋpiel nɛ nimbaanlzɔɔr Wina'am la zug.

english_verse: Our God, you are powerful, fearsome, and faithful, always true to your word. So please keep in mind the terrible sufferings of our people, kings, leaders, priests, and prophets, from the time Assyria ruled until this very day.
translation_verse: Oo ti Wina'am, fʋ anɛ Wina'am tita'ar ka mɔr kpi'euŋ ka an onɛ ka ba zɔt! Fʋ dɔlli fʋ nɔŋilim nɔnaar la. Da kɛ ka namisʋg linɛ kɛɛn ti zugin na la an zaalim tisi fɔ; namisʋg linɛ paae tinam nɛ ti na'anam nɛ tuongatib, nɛ ti maanmaannib nɛ nɔdi'esidib la wʋsa, namisʋg kanɛ da paae ti yaanam nɛ fʋ nidib la, lin yi Asiria na'anam saŋa ti paae zina.

english_verse: Our kings and leaders, our priests and ancestors have never obeyed your commands or heeded your warnings.
translation_verse: Ti na'anam nɛ ti tuongatib nɛ ti maanmaannib la nɛ ti yaanam la wʋsa pʋ dɔlli fʋ wada la, ba pʋ kɛlisi fʋ nɔzi'ela bɛɛ nimmua sa'al kanɛ ka fʋ sa'ali ba la.

english_verse: You blessed them with a kingdom and with an abundance of rich, fertile land, but they refused to worship you or turn from their evil.
translation_verse: Hali la'an nɛ ban da sʋ'oe ba na'am la ka dit yɛlsʋm kanɛ ka fʋ tisi ba la ka bɛ teŋ kanɛ yalim ka mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm la, ba pʋ na'asif bɛɛ fɛndig ka basi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la.

english_verse: Its plentiful harvest is taken by kings you placed over us because of our sins. Our suffering is unbearable, because they do as they wish to us and our livestock. The People Make an Agreement
translation_verse: Ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug ka fʋ kɛ ka Na'abama sʋ'oe tinam nɛ ti bʋnkɔnbid, ka maannɛ ti ban bɔɔd si'em, ka ti yʋ'ʋn bɛ namisʋg pʋʋgin la.” Nidib la maal nɔnaar ka sɔbi digil

english_verse: And so, a firm agreement was made that had the official approval of the leaders, the Levites, and priests.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim la da lɛn yɛl ye, “Nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa zug, ti na maal nɔnaar, ka sɔbi li ka ti tuongatib nɛ Levi dim nɛ maanmaannib la tiki ba nu'us.”

english_verse: As governor, I signed the agreement together with Zedekiah and the following priests:
translation_verse: Banɛ da tik nu'ug la da anɛ: Hakalaya biig Nehemaya onɛ an Gɔmena la nɛ Zedekaya. Banɛ pɛ'ɛs anɛ:

english_verse: The Levites who signed were: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the clan of Henadad, Kadmiel,
translation_verse: Levi dimi nwa': Jesua onɛ an Azanaya biribiŋ nɛ Binui onɛ an Henadad tuŋ nid la nɛ Kadmiel

english_verse: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
translation_verse: Maika nɛ Rehob nɛ Hasiabiya nɛ

english_verse: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
translation_verse: Zakur nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Siebanaya

english_verse: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
translation_verse: nɛ Hodaya nɛ Bani nɛ Beninu.

english_verse: The leaders who signed were: Parosh, Pahath Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
translation_verse: Nidib la tuongatib da anɛ: Paros nɛ Pahaf-Moab nɛ Elam nɛ Zatu nɛ Bani

english_verse: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
translation_verse: Adonija nɛ Bigvai nɛ Adin nɛ

english_verse: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
translation_verse: Ater nɛ Hezekia nɛ Azur nɛ

english_verse: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
translation_verse: Hodaya nɛ Hasuem nɛ Bezaae nɛ

english_verse: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

english_verse: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah. The Agreement
translation_verse: Maluk nɛ Harim nɛ Baana. Nɔnaar la yɛla

english_verse: All of us, including priests, Levites, temple guards, singers, temple workers and leaders, together with our wives and children, have separated ourselves from the foreigners in this land and now enter into an agreement with a complete understanding of what we are doing. And so, we now place ourselves under the curse of the Lord our God, if we fail to obey his laws and teachings that were given to us by his servant Moses.
translation_verse: Tinam nimbanɛ kpɛlim an maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim nɛ banɛ gur Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔɔr nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib nɛ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib nɛ banɛ baki ba mɛŋ nɛ nimbanɛ aan ba kpi'es Wina'am wada la zug la, ban nɛ ba pu'ab nɛ biribis nɛ ba bipumis banɛ na nyaŋi gban'e pian'ad gbin la. Ti wʋsa la'as taaba gban'e nɔɔr yinne pɔ nɔɔri zi'el ye, Ti na dɔl Wina'am wada linɛ ka o tʋmtʋm Moses da tisi ti la, ye ti siak ka gu'usid ka dɔl Zugsɔb gban'ar nɛ o zi'ela la wʋsa.

english_verse: We won't buy goods or grain on the Sabbath or on any other sacred day, not even from foreigners. Every seven years we will let our fields rest, and we will cancel all debts.
translation_verse: Nidib banɛ kpi'e nɛ ti la ya'a mɔr la'ad bɛɛ diibi kena ye ba kuosi tisi ti Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar bɛɛ dabisa banɛ an kasi la ni, ti kʋ da'. Yʋʋm kanɛ paas ayɔpɔi wʋsa ti kʋ kuaa ti pɔɔd la, ka onɛ dii ti sam wʋsa ti kʋ lɛn di'e.

english_verse: This is to pay for the sacred bread, as well as for the daily sacrifices and special sacrifices such as those offered on the Sabbath and during the New Moon Festival and the other festivals. It will also pay for the sacrifices to forgive our sins and for all expenses connected with the worship of God in the temple.
translation_verse: Ti gban'e ye yʋʋm wʋsa ti na tis anzurifa bi'ela ka li sʋŋ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma, linɛ an: Bodobodo kanɛ ka ba pa'an teebul zugʋ tisid Zugsɔb la, nɛ daar wʋsa zʋʋd maan la nɛ daar wʋsa maan kanɛ nyu'od nɛ bugum la nɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Dabisa malima maan la nɛ Nwadpaalig di'ema tiɛnr maan nɛ malima banɛ ka ba gban'e li yɛla zi'el la nɛ kasi malima la nɛ Israel tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd suguru sɔsʋg maan nɛ tʋʋma linɛ kpɛlim tis Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la wʋsa.

english_verse: We have decided that the families of priests, Levites, and ordinary people will supply firewood for the temple each year, so that sacrifices can be offered on the altar, just as the Lord our God has commanded.
translation_verse: Tinam banɛ an maanmaannib la nɛ Levi dim nɛ nidib la maal bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm ye ti baŋ saŋa kanɛ ka yir wʋsa na la'asid daad saŋa kanɛ nar yʋʋm wʋsa pʋʋgin linɛ ka ba na nyu'od maan daka la zug, ti Zugsɔb Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la nwɛnɛ lin sɔb wada gbauŋʋn si'em la.

english_verse: Each year we will bring to the temple the first part of our harvest of grain and fruit.
translation_verse: Ti mɛ lɛm gban'e ye yʋʋm wʋsa ti na mɔr zʋʋd linɛ an bʋndɛɛŋ wʋsa nɛ tiis wala kɛn Zugsɔb Yin la na.

english_verse: We will bring our first-born sons and the first-born males of our herds and flocks and offer them to the priests who serve in the temple, because this is what is written in God's Law.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ lin sɔb wada la ni si'em la, ti na mɔri ti bikpɛŋ wʋsa, nɛ niigi nɛ kɔnbdɛɛna kɛn Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin na tis maanmaan kanɛ tʋm Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma la.

english_verse: To the priests in the temple of our God, we will bring the bread dough from the first harvest, together with our best fruit, and an offering of new wine and olive oil. We will bring ten percent of our grain harvest to those Levites who are responsible for collecting it in our towns.
translation_verse: Linɛ lɛm paas, ti na mɔr ki linɛ ka ti bʋn yiiga la zɔ'ɔm kɛn Pʋ'ʋsim Yin na tis maanmaan la, nɛ ti zʋʋd piini, nɛ tiis wala nɛ daam nɛ kpaam linɛ an yiiga la. Ti mɛ na mɔri ti zʋʋd la pʋʋr piiga wʋsa kena tis Levi dim la, bɔzugɔ, li anɛ Levi dim la di'esidi ti pʋʋr piiga la'ad tinamɛ tʋm teŋ si'a ni wʋsa,

english_verse: A priest from the family of Aaron must be there when we give this to the Levites. Then the Levites will put one tenth of this part in the temple storeroom,
translation_verse: ka ba ya'a ti ye ba di'e la'ad la, Aaron yaaŋ kanɛ an maanmaan la na dɔlli ba keŋ. Levi dim la na di'e la'ad la yisi ba pʋʋr piiga mɔri keŋ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yinnɛ kpɛn'ɛsi li la'ad dɔɔdin la su'a.

english_verse: which is also the place for the sacred objects used by the priests, the temple guards, and the singers. Levites and everyone else must bring their gifts of grain, wine, and olive oil to this room. We will not neglect the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Israel nidib nɛ Levi dim la wʋsa na mɔri ba zʋʋd nɛ daam nɛ kpaam piini la na kpɛn'ɛs la'ad dɔɔdin la, zin'ikanɛ ka Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la'ad bɛ la, nɛ maanmaannib la nɛ banɛ gur za'anɔɔr la nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la bɛ si'el la. Ti kʋ bas bɛɛ tam Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la yɛla baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: The nation's leaders and their families settled in Jerusalem. But there was room for only one out of every ten of the remaining families, and so they asked God to show them who would live there.
translation_verse: Nidib la tuongatib da zin'in Jerusalem, ka banɛ kpɛlim la mɛ da bʋgʋlʋm gaŋ nid yinne nidib piiga wʋsa pʋʋgin, ye o kem zin'in Jerusalem tempʋkanɛ an Zugsɔb la din ka an kasi la ni, ka banɛ kpɛlim la zin'ini ba mɛŋ tɛɛnsin.

english_verse: Then everyone else asked God to bless those who were willing to live in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nidib la da faas banɛ wʋsa siak ye ba na lɛbi zin'in Jerusalem la.

english_verse: Some of the people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple workers, and the descendants of Solomon's servants lived on their own property in the towns of Judah. But the leaders of the province lived in Jerusalem with their families. The Judah Tribe
translation_verse: Banɛ da an sʋ'ʋlimnam la tuongatib sieba da lɛbi zin'in Jerusalem teŋin la. Israel dim la sieba mɛ da lɛbi zin'in Juda tɛɛnsin, sɔ' wʋsa nɛ o mɛŋ paalʋ, tɛɛns la ni. Ba da anɛ maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib nɛ Solomon yammis yaas la.

english_verse: From the Judah tribe, two leaders settled in Jerusalem with their relatives. One of them was Athaiah son of Uzziah. His ancestors were Zechariah, Amariah, Shephatiah, Mahalalel, and Perez, the son of Judah. From the descendants of Perez,
translation_verse: Perez yaas banɛ da bɛ Jerusalem ka an nintitada la wʋsa da anɛ nidib kɔbisnaasi nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ anii (

english_verse: Joel son of Zichri was their leader, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in command. Priests
translation_verse: Zikir biig Joel da anɛ ba tuongat ka Hasenua biig Juda da sʋ'oe tempʋʋg sʋ'ʋlim kanɛ tia'al ayi' la.

english_verse: Four priests settled in Jerusalem. The first was Jedaiah; he was the son of Joiarib and the uncle of Jachin.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la da anɛ: Jedaya onɛ an Joyaarib biig la nɛ Jakin.

english_verse: The second priest to settle there was Seraiah son of Hilkiah. His ancestors were Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub, who had been a high priest.
translation_verse: Banɛ paas anɛ Hilkia biig Seraya onɛ yaanamɛ da an Mesulam nɛ Zadok nɛ Merayof nɛ Ahitub onɛ da gɔsid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la

english_verse: from his clan who served in the temple. The third priest to settle there was Adaiah son of Jeroham. His ancestors were Pelaliah, Amzi, Zechariah, Pashhur, and Malchijah.
translation_verse: ). Ba sieba anɛ Jeroham biig Adaya onɛ yaanamɛ da an Pelalaya nɛ Amzi nɛ Zakaria nɛ Pasur nɛ Malkija,

english_verse: clan leaders among his relatives. The fourth priest to settle there was Amashsai son of Azarel. His ancestors were Ahzai, Meshillemoth, and Immer.
translation_verse: ); Azarel biig Amasisai onɛ yaanamɛ da an Ahizai nɛ Mesielemof nɛ Imer,

english_verse: brave warriors from their clans, and their leader was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim. Levites
translation_verse: ). Ba kpɛɛm da anɛ Zabdiel onɛ an Hagedolim biig la.

english_verse: Several Levites settled in Jerusalem. First, there was Shemaiah son of Hasshub. His ancestors were Azrikam, Hashabiah, and Bunni.
translation_verse: Levi dim la da anɛ: Hasueb biig Semaya onɛ yaanamɛ da an Azirikam nɛ Hasiabiya nɛ Buni;

english_verse: Next, there were Shabbethai and Jozabad, the Levite leaders in charge of the work outside the temple.
translation_verse: Siabetaae nɛ Jozabad banɛ da an Levi dɔɔg kpɛɛmnam la da gɔsid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la yiŋ tʋʋma;

english_verse: Then there was Mattaniah son of Mica. His ancestors were Zabdi and Asaph. Mattaniah led the temple choir in the prayer of praise. Bakbukiah, who also settled in Jerusalem, was his assistant. Finally, there was Abda son of Shammua; his grandfather was Galal, and his great-grandfather was Jeduthun.
translation_verse: Matanaya onɛ saamme an Maika ka on Saam mɛ an Zabdi ka on saam mɛ an Asaf la da an kpɛɛm onɛ gat tuon winsɔsʋg nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim saŋa la, Bakbukia da dɔl o nya'aŋ nɛ Sammua biig Abida onɛ yaanamɛ da an Galal nɛ Jedutun.

english_verse: One hundred seventy-two temple guards settled in Jerusalem; their leaders were Akkub and Talmon.
translation_verse: Za'anɔgu'udib la da anɛ: Akub nɛ Talimon nɛ ba taaba. Banɛ da zin' gɔsid za'anɔɔr la da anɛ dap kɔbiga nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ ayi' (

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites, including priests and Levites, lived on their own property in the other towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Israel dim banɛ kpɛlim la, nɛ maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la, da bɛ nɛ Juda tempʋʋs la wʋsa ni, sɔ' wʋsa da zin'inɛ o yaab paalʋ ni.

english_verse: But the temple workers lived in the section of Jerusalem known as Ophel, and the two men in charge of them were Ziha and Gishpa.
translation_verse: Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib la da bɛ nɛ Ofel zuorin: Ziha nɛ Gisipa da aan ba tuongatib.

english_verse: Uzzi son of Bani was the leader of the Levites in Jerusalem. His grandfather was Hashabiah, his great-grandfather was Mattaniah, and his great-great-grandfather was Mica. He belonged to the Asaph clan that was in charge of the music for the temple services,
translation_verse: Levi dim banɛ da bɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la tuongat da anɛ Bani biig Uzi onɛ yaanamɛ da an Hasiabiya nɛ Matanaya nɛ Maika. Uzi da anɛ Asaf tuŋ nid, banɛ da an yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la ka da gɔsid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma la.

english_verse: though the daily choice of music and musicians was decided by royal decree of the Persian king.
translation_verse: Na'ab la da tis nɔɔr ban na tʋm si'em dabisir wʋsa pʋʋgin.

english_verse: The people of Israel were represented at the Persian court by Pethahiah son of Meshezabel from the Zerah clan of the Judah tribe. The People in the Other Towns and Villages
translation_verse: Mesiezabɛl biig Petahaya, onɛ yaabi da an Zera onɛ da an Juda mɛŋ biig la da bɛ Na'ab la tuon nidib la wʋsa sʋʋgin.

english_verse: Some of the people of Judah lived in the following towns near their farms: Kiriath-Arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel,
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ teŋkpɛmis nɛ li paalʋ la, Juda nidib la da zin'inɛ Kiriaf Ariba nɛ zin'ibanɛ giligi li la, Dibon nɛ zin'ibanɛ giligi li la, nɛ Jekabzeel nɛ li tembibis.

english_verse: Zanoah, Adullam, Lachish, and Azekah. In fact, they settled the towns from Beersheba in the south to Hinnom Valley in the north.
translation_verse: Zanoak nɛ Adullam nɛ ba teŋkpɛmis nɛ Lakis nɛ li paalʋ la wʋsa nɛ Azeka nɛ li tembibis. Ala ka ba da zin'in lin yi Beerseba mɔri paae Ben Hinnom Bɔn'ɔgin la.

english_verse: The people of Benjamin lived in the towns of Geba, Michmash, Aija, Bethel with its nearby villages,
translation_verse: Benjamin yaas la da zin'inɛ ba mɛŋ tɛɛnsin Geba nɛ Mikmas nɛ Aija nɛ Betel nɛ tɛɛns banɛ gilig la,

english_verse: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
translation_verse: nɛ Anatof nɛ Nob nɛ Ananaya

english_verse: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
translation_verse: nɛ Hazo nɛ Rama nɛ Gitam

english_verse: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
translation_verse: nɛ Hadid nɛ Zeboim nɛ Neballat

english_verse: Lod, and Ono, as well as in Craft Valley.
translation_verse: nɛ Lod nɛ Ono nɛ Ge-Haharasim.

english_verse: Several groups of Levites from the territory of Judah were sent to live among the people of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Levi dim banɛ bɛ Juda la sieba mɛ da zin'inɛ Benjamin teŋin.

english_verse: Many priests and Levites had returned from Babylonia with Zerubbabel and Joshua as their leaders. Those priests were Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
translation_verse: Bama an maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim banɛ da dɔl Sealtiel biig Zerubabɛl nɛ Jesua lɛb na la: Seraya nɛ Jeremia nɛ Ezra

english_verse: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
translation_verse: nɛ Amaraya nɛ Maluk nɛ Hatus

english_verse: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
translation_verse: Iddo nɛ Ginɛton nɛ Abija

english_verse: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
translation_verse: nɛ Mijamin nɛ Moadia nɛ Bilga

english_verse: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,
translation_verse: nɛ Semaya nɛ Joyaarib nɛ Jedaya

english_verse: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and another Jedaiah. These were the leading priests and their assistants during the time of Joshua.
translation_verse: nɛ Salu nɛ Amok nɛ Hilkia nɛ Jedaya. Bama da an maanmaannib la tuongatib nɛ ba taaba Jesua saŋa la.

english_verse: The Levites who returned were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah. They and their assistants were responsible for the songs of praise,
translation_verse: Levi dim la da anɛ: Jesua nɛ Binnu nɛ Kadmiel nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Juda nɛ Mattania, on nɛ o taaba da sʋ'oe bareka pʋ'ʋsim yʋʋma.

english_verse: while Bakbukiah and Unno, together with their assistants, were responsible for the choral responses. Descendants of Joshua the High Priest
translation_verse: Ka Bakbukia nɛ Uni nɛ ba taaba da zi'e kpa' ba pʋ'ʋsim zin'igin la.

english_verse: Joshua was the father of Joiakim, the grandfather of Eliashib, and the great-grandfather of Joiada.
translation_verse: Josua tuŋ dimi nwa', Josua biig da anɛ Joyakim ka on biig da anɛ Eliyaasib; Eliyaasib mɛ biig da anɛ Joyada.

english_verse: Joiada was the father of Jonathan and the grandfather of Jaddua. Leaders of the Priestly Clans
translation_verse: Joyada biig da anɛ Jonatan ka on biig mɛ da an Jadua.

english_verse: When Joiakim was high priest, the following priests were leaders of their clans: Meraiah of the Seraiah clan, Hananiah of Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Joyakim saŋa la, bama da an maanmaannib la yir kpɛɛmnam: Meraya da an Seraya yir kpɛɛm ka Hanania an Jeremia yir kpɛɛm

english_verse: Meshullam of Ezra, Jehohanan of Amariah,
translation_verse: ka Mesulam an Ezra yir kpɛɛm ka Jehohanan an Amaraya yir kpɛɛm

english_verse: Jonathan of Malluchi, Joseph of Shebaniah,
translation_verse: ka Jonatan an Maluk yir kpɛɛm ka Josef an Siekania yir kpɛɛm

english_verse: Adna of Harim, Helkai of Meraioth,
translation_verse: ka Adina an Harim yir kpɛɛm ka Helika an Meremof yir kpɛɛm

english_verse: Zechariah of Iddo, Meshullam of Ginnethon,
translation_verse: ka Zakaria an Iddo yir kpɛɛm ka Mesulam an Ginɛton yir kpɛɛm

english_verse: Mattenai of Joiarib, Uzzi of Jedaiah,
translation_verse: ka Matena an Joyaarib yir kpɛɛm ka Uzi an Jedaya yir kpɛɛm

english_verse: Kallai of Sallai, Eber of Amok,
translation_verse: ka Kalla an Salu yir kpɛɛm ka Ebɛr an Amok yir kpɛɛm

english_verse: Hashabiah of Hilkiah, and Nethanel of Jedaiah. The Priestly and Levite Families
translation_verse: ka Hasiabiya an Hilkia yir kpɛɛm ka Netanɛl an Jedaya yir kpɛɛm.

english_verse: During the time of the high priests Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, and including the time that Darius was king of Persia, a record was kept of the heads of the Levite and priestly families.
translation_verse: Pesia Na'ab Darius saŋa ka ba da sɔb Levi dim la kpɛɛmnam yʋda, banɛ da bɛ Eliyaasib nɛ Joyada nɛ Johanan nɛ Jadua saŋa la.

english_verse: However, no official record was kept of the heads of the Levite clans after the death of Johanan, the grandson of Eliashib.
translation_verse: Levi dim la kpɛɛmnam la, lin pin'ili ba yaanam la ti paae Eliyaasib biig Johanan saŋa la, ba sɔbi ba yʋda kpɛn'ɛs yaanam gbana la ni.

english_verse: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their assistants organized two choirs of Levites to offer praises to God, just as King David, the man of God, had commanded.
translation_verse: Levi dim la tuongatib da anɛ Hasiabiya nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Kadmiel biig Jesua nɛ ba taaba banɛ zi'e kpa' ban dʋ'ʋsid Wina'am ka tisid o bareka di'esid taaba nwɛnɛ Na'ab David onɛ da an Wina'am nid la da zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were responsible for guarding the storerooms near the temple gates.
translation_verse: Mattania nɛ Bakbukia nɛ Obadia nɛ Mesulam nɛ Talimon nɛ Akub da anɛ banɛ gur za'anɔya; ba da gur la'ad dɔɔd banɛ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔya ni la.

english_verse: All of these men lived during the time of Joiakim and during the time that I was governor and Ezra, a teacher of the Law of Moses, was priest. Nehemiah Dedicates the City Wall
translation_verse: Ba da tʋm nɛ saŋa kanɛ ka Joyakim onɛ saamme da an Jesua ka o yaab an Jozadak la, saŋkan ka Nehemaya onɛ an Gɔmena nɛ Ezra onɛ da an maanmaan nɛ gbauŋ sɔbid la da bɛ la. Jerusalem zaŋguom pɛsigir

english_verse: When the city wall was dedicated, Levites from everywhere in Judah were invited to join in the celebration with songs of praise and with the music of cymbals, small harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Ban da ye ba pɛsig Jerusalem zaŋguom saŋsi'a la, ba da buol Levi dim la ban bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa la'asi ba Jerusalem na ka ba maal sumalisim ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma tis Wina'am bareka pʋ'ʋsim, ka nwɛ'ɛd bʋnnwɛ'ɛda di'em zaŋguom la pɛsigir zug.

english_verse: The Levite singers lived in villages around Jerusalem, and so they came from there, as well as from the villages around Netophah, Beth-Gilgal, Geba, and Azmaveth.
translation_verse: nɛ Bet Gilgal nɛ zin'ibanɛ bɛ Geba nɛ Azmavef la. Yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la da mɛɛ ba mɛŋ temkpɛmisi gilig Jerusalem.

english_verse: The priests and Levites held special ceremonies to make themselves holy, and then they did the same for the rest of the people and for the gates and walls of the city.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la maali ba mɛŋ kasi naae la, ba yʋ'ʋn maal nidib la nɛ za'anɔya nɛ tempʋʋg la zaŋguoma la kasi mɛn.

english_verse: I brought the leaders of Judah to the top of the city wall and put them in charge of the two groups that were to march around on top of the wall, singing praises to God. One group marched to the right in the direction of Garbage Gate.
translation_verse: Man Nehemaya da kɛ ka Juda tuongatib la dʋ zaŋguom la zugin, ka m da la'as yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la bɛdegʋ zin'is ayi' ye ba yʋ'ʋm pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka. Ka banɛ yʋ'ʋm la, zin'ig yinne dʋ zaŋguom la zugin ye ba dɔl ya-dagɔbʋgʋ kpa'ad Na'ambin Za'anɔɔr la baba.

english_verse: Hoshaiah and half of the leaders followed them.
translation_verse: Banɛ da dɔlli ba da anɛ Hosaya nɛ Juda tuongatib la pʋsʋk,

english_verse: Then came the priests Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
translation_verse: nɛ Azaria nɛ Ezra nɛ Mesulam

english_verse: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
translation_verse: nɛ Juda, Benjamin nɛ Semaya nɛ Jeremia,

english_verse: and his relatives, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani. They played musical instruments like those that had been played by David, the man of God. And they marched behind Ezra, the teacher of the Law.
translation_verse: nɛ o taaba Semaya nɛ Azarel nɛ Milala nɛ Gilala nɛ Maai nɛ Netanɛl nɛ Juda nɛ Hanani ka ba mɔr bʋnnwɛ'ɛda wʋʋ David onɛ an Wina'am nid la da pa'al si'em la. Ban da ken la Ezra onɛ an gbauŋmi'id la da anɛ ba tuongat.

english_verse: When they reached Fountain Gate, they climbed the steps to David's City and went past his palace, before stopping at the Water Gate near the eastern wall of the city.
translation_verse: Ka ba yi Bulig Za'anɔɔrin la, ka dɔlisi dʋʋ kpa' David tempʋʋgin la dʋt David yir zaŋguom la zugin gaadi paad Ku'om Za'anɔɔr linɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ la.

english_verse: The second group of singers marched along the wall in the opposite direction, and I followed them, together with the other half of the leaders of Judah. We went past Oven Tower, Broad Wall,
translation_verse: Yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib banɛ kpɛlim la mɛ da fɛndigi lɛbid ya-datiuŋ, ka mam mɛŋ mɔr nidib la pʋsʋkʋ dɔlli ba dʋ zaŋguom la zugin keŋ dɔl Seneb Girimbisa la ti paae Zaŋguom yalʋŋ la.

english_verse: Ephraim Gate, Old Gate, Fish Gate, Hananel Tower, Hundred Tower, and on to Sheep Gate. Finally, we stopped at Gate of the Guard,
translation_verse: Ka ti yii ani keŋ tʋʋg Efiram Za'anɔɔr zugin, linɛ ka ba buon Jesiana Za'anɔɔr bɛɛ Za'anɔkʋdʋg la, nɛ Zimi Za'anɔɔr la, nɛ Hananɛl Girimbisa, nɛ Kɔbiga Girimbisa la ni, mɔri ala keŋ paae Pɛ'ɛs Za'anɔɔrin la, hali ti paae Teŋgu'udib Za'anɔɔrini zi'e ani.

english_verse: where we stood in front of the temple with the other group, praising God. In the group with me were half of the leaders,
translation_verse: Yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib zin'is ayi' banɛ yʋ'ʋm pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka la yʋ'ʋn da paae Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka keŋ zi'e ba zi'esa ni, ka mam nɛ kpɛɛmnam la pʋsʋk mɛ zi'e ti zi'esa ni,

english_verse: as well as the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, who were blowing trumpets.
translation_verse: tinam nɛ maanmaannib la Eliakim nɛ Maaseya nɛ Minyamin nɛ Mikaya nɛ Eloanai nɛ Zakaria nɛ Hanania nɛ ba na'atana.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer also stood there, as Jezrahiah led the singers.
translation_verse: Banɛ paas da anɛ; Maaseya nɛ Semaya nɛ Eleazar nɛ Uzi, Jehohanan nɛ Malkija nɛ Elam nɛ Ezer. Jezrahaya da gaad yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la tuonnɛ pa'annɛ ba ka ba yʋ'ʋm agɔla gɔla.

english_verse: God had made the people very happy, and so on that day they celebrated and offered many sacrifices. The women and children joined in the festivities, and joyful shouts could be heard far from the city of Jerusalem. Preparation for Worship
translation_verse: Daakan la ka ba maal maana bɛdegʋ, ka maal sumalisim bɔzugɔ Wina'am tisi ba sumalistita'ar. Ka pu'ab nɛ biis mɛ maan sumalisim. Ka sumalisim tʋkpiidʋg kanɛ ka ba da maan Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la wʋm lallisa.

english_verse: On that same day, some leaders were appointed to be responsible for the safekeeping of gifts for the temple and to be in charge of receiving the first part of the harvest and the ten percent of the crops and livestock that was offered to God. These same leaders also collected the part of crops that the Law of Moses taught was to be given to the Levites. Everyone was pleased with the work of the priests and Levites,
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka ba gaans nimbanɛ na gur la'ad dɔɔd la. La'ad la anɛ zʋʋd linɛ ka ba bʋn yiiga la nɛ ba pʋʋr piiga la'asʋg. Pɔɔd banɛ giligi ba tempʋʋs la wʋsa anɛ ba mɔri ba la'adi kena wʋʋ wada la zi'el si'em ye ba tis maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la bɔzugɔ, maanmaannib la nɛ Levi dim tʋʋma da paae Juda dim ya'am hali.

english_verse: when they performed the ceremonies to make people acceptable to worship God. And the singers and the temple guards did their jobs according to the instructions given by David and his son Solomon.
translation_verse: Ba da tʋmmi ba Wina'am la tʋʋma ka maannɛ ba mɛŋ ka an kasi nyain, ka yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la nɛ banɛ gur za'anɔɔr la mɛ tʋm ala nwɛnɛ Na'ab David nɛ o biig Na'ab Solomon n da zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: In fact, ever since the days of David and Asaph, there had been song leaders and songs of praise and worship.
translation_verse: Yʋma banɛ da gaad la sa, Na'ab David nɛ Asaf saŋa la, ba da mɔr kpɛɛmnam banɛ sʋ'oe yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la nɛ yʋʋma linɛ zun'od Wina'am, nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim.

english_verse: During the time that Zerubbabel and I were in charge, everyone in Israel gave what they were supposed to give for the daily needs of the singers and temple guards from the Levi tribe. Then the Levites would give the priests their share from what they had received.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ Zerubabɛl saŋa nɛ Nehemaya saŋa la, Israel dim da la'asid nɛ diib daar wʋsa tisid yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib nɛ banɛ an za'anɔgu'udib la. Ba mɛ da bɛŋ Levi dim banɛ kpɛlim la dinnɛ tisi ba, ka mɛ tis Levi dim banɛ an Aaron yaas la ba din.

english_verse: On that day when the Law of Moses was read aloud to everyone, it was discovered that Ammonites and Moabites were forbidden to belong to the people of God.
translation_verse: Daakan la ba da karim Moses wada gbauŋ la agɔla gɔla ka nidib la wʋsa wʋm. Ani ka ba nyɛ ka li sɔb ye, suor kae ka ba kɛ ka Ammon nid bɛɛ Moab nid kpɛn' Zugsɔb la nidib sʋʋginɛ,

english_verse: This was because they had refused to give food and water to Israel and had hired Balaam to call down a curse on them. However, our God turned the curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ba da pʋ tʋ'ʋs Israel dim la tisi ba diib bɛɛ ku'om, amaa ka da' Balaam ka o kaanb kaanbbɛ'ɛdi tisi ba.

english_verse: Following the reading of the Law of Moses, the people of Israel started sending away anyone who had any foreign ancestors. Nehemiah Makes Other Changes
translation_verse: Nidib la wʋsa wʋm wada la, ba pʋ gɛlig banɛ yaanamɛ ka' Israel dim la paas Israel dim la nii.

english_verse: The priest Eliashib was a relative of Tobiah and had earlier been put in charge of the temple storerooms.
translation_verse: Ba da pʋn gaŋ Eliyaasib onɛ an maanmaan la ye o gur Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la'ad dɔɔg la, saŋkan la ka on nɛ Tobaya pʋn an nɔɔr yinne sa,

english_verse: So he let Tobiah live in one of these rooms, where all kinds of things had been stored—the grain offerings, incense, utensils for the temple, as well as the tenth of the grain, wine, and olive oil that had been given for the use of the Levites, singers, and temple guards, and the gifts for the priests.
translation_verse: ka o nɔk dɔtita'are tis o, dɔkan la ka ba daa ɛɛnti su'ad zʋʋd nɛ bʋnnyubisa nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la'ad la, la'an nɛ zʋʋd linɛ an pʋdigir piiga pʋʋgin vaar yinne dinɛ an zʋʋd nɛ daam nɛ kpaam linɛ ka ba tisid Levi dim la nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib nɛ za'anɔgu'udib la, la'an nɛ la'abanɛ ka ba la'asidi tisid maanmaannib la.

english_verse: This happened in the thirty-second year that Artaxerxes ruled Babylonia. I was away from Jerusalem at the time, because I was visiting him. Later I received permission from the king
translation_verse: Amaa nɛ'ɛnamɛ da niŋid la ka mam ka' Jerusalem, saŋkan la da an Babilon Na'ab Atazeesis n da dii o na'am la li yʋma pistan' nɛ ayi' saŋa la, ka m lɛb Na'ab la san'an. Lin nya'aŋ ka m sɔs suor o san'an ka

english_verse: to return to Jerusalem. Only then did I find out that Eliashib had done this terrible thing of letting Tobiah have a room in the temple.
translation_verse: lɛb Jerusalem na. Ani ka m wʋm Eliyaasib n tʋm bɛ'ɛd si'em nɔk dɔɔg Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la tis Tobaya,

english_verse: It upset me so much that I threw out every bit of Tobiah's furniture.
translation_verse: ka m sʋnf da pɛlig hali ka m vaae Tobaya la'ad linɛ bɛ dɔɔgin la wʋsa lɔbi bas yiŋ.

english_verse: Then I ordered the room to be cleaned and the temple utensils, the grain offerings, and the incense to be brought back into the room.
translation_verse: Ka tis nɔɔr ye ba maal malima pie dɔɔg la, ka kɛ ka m lɛbis Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la'ad la kpɛn'ɛs, la'an nɛ zʋʋd piini la nɛ bʋnnyubisa la.

english_verse: I also found out that the temple singers and several other Levites had returned to work on their farms, because they had not been given their share of the harvest.
translation_verse: M mɛ lɛn wʋm ye ba pʋ nɔk la'ad linɛ an Levi dim din la tisi baa, ka Levi dim wʋsa nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la lɛbi ba pɔɔdin.

english_verse: I called the leaders together and angrily asked them, “Why is the temple neglected?” Then I told them to start doing their jobs.
translation_verse: Ka m sa'al kpɛɛmnam la ka bu'osi ba ye, “Bɔ ka ya tam Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la yɛllɛ?” Ani ka m buol Levi dim la kɛ ka ba lɛbi ba tʋʋma ni na.

english_verse: After this, everyone in Judah brought a tenth of their grain, wine, and olive oil to the temple storeroom.
translation_verse: Ka Juda dim wʋsa yʋ'ʋn pin'ili mɔri ba pʋdigir piiga vaar yinne linɛ an zʋʋd nɛ daam nɛ kpaam kenna kpɛn'ɛsid la'ad dɔɔgin la.

english_verse: Finally, I appointed three men with good reputations to be in charge of what was brought there and to distribute it to the others. They were Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the teacher of the Law, and Pedaiah the Levite. Their assistant was Hanan, the son of Zaccur and the grandson of Mattaniah.
translation_verse: Ka m kɛ ka Sielemaya onɛ an maanmaan la nɛ Zadok onɛ an gbauŋmi'id la nɛ Levi nid onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Pedaya la gur la'ad dɔɔg la, ka kɛ ka Hanani onɛ an Zakur biig ka o yaab an Matanaya la sʋŋidi ba, bɔzugɔ, ba da yɛt nimbama yɛla ye ba anɛ sida dim. Ba da kɛ ka ban tʋʋm anɛ ba pʋdigid la'adi tisidi ba ba'abiis la.

english_verse: I pray that my God will remember these good things that I have done for his temple and for those who worship there. The Sabbath
translation_verse: Oo m Wina'am, tɛnri m yɛla ka da kɛ ka man maal si'eli tisi fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir nɛ li tʋʋma la keŋ zaalim!

english_verse: I also noticed what the people of Judah were doing on the Sabbath. Not only were they trampling grapes to make wine, but they were harvesting their grain, grapes, figs, and other crops, and then loading these on donkeys to sell in Jerusalem. So I warned them not to sell food on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Dabisban la ni ka m nyɛ ka Juda dim da nwiakid daam ba daam nwiasʋg zin'igin la Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar, ka mɔr zʋʋdi kenna lɔɔdi pa'annɛ ba bʋmis la'an nɛ daam nɛ tiis wala nɛ la'ad buudi wʋsa. Ka ba mɔri li wʋsa kenna ye ba kuosi li Vʋ'ʋsʋm daare tis Juda dim; hali nɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin mɛn! Dinzug ka m sa'ali ba ye ba da kuosid diib Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daarɛ.

english_verse: People who had moved to Jerusalem from the city of Tyre were bringing in fish and other things to sell there on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ninsieba banɛ yi Taya ka bɛ Jerusalem la mɛ da mɔr zimi nɛ la'ad buudi wʋsa ken Jerusalem na kuosidi tisid Juda nidib Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar.

english_verse: I got angry and said to the leaders of Judah, “This evil you are doing is an insult to the Sabbath!
translation_verse: Ka m sa'al Juda tuongatib la ka yɛli ba ye, “Bɔ ka ya tʋm bɛ'ɛdi san'amid Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar kisʋgɔ?

english_verse: Didn't God punish us and this city because our ancestors did these very same things? And here you are, about to make God furious again by disgracing the Sabbath!”
translation_verse: Ya yaanam da pʋ niŋnɛ ala ka ti Wina'am la mɔr yɛltɔɔd bama kɛn tinam nɛ tempʋʋg la wʋsa zugin na? Lin pʋ siakɛ ka ya yʋ'ʋn maligim san'amid Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la ye ya kɛ ka Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn lii ti zugɔɔ!”

english_verse: I ordered the gates of Jerusalem to be closed on the eve of the Sabbath and not to be opened until after the Sabbath had ended. Then I put some of my own men in charge of the gates to make certain that nothing was brought in on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar ya'a na bɛ wʋʋ bɛog la, zaam ya'a ma'ae ka ma'asim tuligi paae Jerusalem za'anɔya la, m ɛɛn tis nɛ nɔɔr ka ba yɔ' za'anɔya la ka kʋ lɛn yɔ'ɔgɛ asɛɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir daar la ya'a ti gaad. M ɛɛn zi'el nɛ m mɛŋ nidib za'anɔya la ni ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi mɔr la'adi kpɛn' tempʋʋgin la Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daarɛ.

english_verse: Once or twice some merchants spent the night outside Jerusalem with their goods.
translation_verse: Nɔɔr yinne bɛɛ nɔɔra ayi' ka banɛ kpiisid la'ad nɛ li buudi la da gbɛn Jerusalem tempʋʋg la yiŋ.

english_verse: But I warned them, “If you do this again, I'll have you arrested.” From then on, they did not come on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Amaa m sa'ali ba ka yɛli ba ye, “Bɔ ka ya gbɛɛnd zaŋguom la yiŋ yʋ'ʋŋɔ? Ya ya'a lɛn niŋ ala ya'as ya na baŋ!” Lin yi saŋkan la ba pʋ lɛn lɛb Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar na ya'asɛ.

english_verse: I ordered the Levites to make themselves holy and to guard the gates on the Sabbath, so that it would be kept holy. God is truly merciful, and I pray that he will treat me with kindness and bless me for doing this. Mixed Marriages
translation_verse: Ani ka m tis Levi dim la nɔɔr ye ba maali ba mɛŋ nyain ka keŋ gur za'anɔya la, ka li kɛ ka Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la an kasi. O m Wina'am, tɛnri m yɛla lina wʋsa zug ka zɔɔ m nimbaanlig fʋ nɔŋilim tita'ar la zug.

english_verse: I discovered that some Jewish men had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
translation_verse: Dabisban la ni ya'as ka m nyɛ Juda dim banɛ di pu'ab Asdod nɛ Ammon nɛ Moab dimin la.

english_verse: About half of their children could not speak Hebrew—they spoke only the language of Ashdod or some other foreign language.
translation_verse: Ka ba biis la pʋsʋk pian'ad nɛ Asdod dim pian'ad bɛɛ buudbanɛ kpɛlim la pian'ad, ka kʋ nyaŋi pian' Juda dim pian'adɛ.

english_verse: So in my anger, I called down curses on those men. I had them beaten and even pulled out the hair of some of them. Then I made them promise: In the name of God we solemnly promise not to let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.
translation_verse: Ka m tansi ba ka pɔ nɔɔri tisi ba. Ka bʋ' sieba ka vɔɔn ba zuobid. Ka m kɛ ka ba pɔ nɔɔr ye ba kʋ lɛn nɔki ba pu'ayuosi tis buudzʋŋ bɛɛ ba kɛ ka ba biribis bɛɛ ba mɛŋ di buudzʋŋ ya'asɛ.

english_verse: So we will obey you and not rebel against our God by marrying foreign women.
translation_verse: Li sʋm ye nannanna tinam wʋm ye yanam mɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd kaŋa buudi ka pʋ dɔlli ti Wina'am la nɛ sidaa, ka dit teŋ zʋŋ pu'abaa?”

english_verse: Jehoiada, the son of the high priest Eliashib, had a son who had married a daughter of Sanballat from Horon, and I forced his son to leave.
translation_verse: Joyada biig yinne onɛ yaabi an Eliyaasib onɛ an maanmaan kpɛɛm la diem dau da an Sambalat onɛ an Horon nid la, ka m da kad o yisi m san'an.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish them for breaking their priestly vows and disgracing the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Tɛnri ba yɛla, O m Wina'am, ban san'am maanmaannib tʋʋma ka kɛ ka dian'ad bɛ li ni la, nɛ nɔnaar linɛ an maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim din la.

english_verse: Then I made sure that the people were free from every foreign influence, and I assigned duties for the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Ala ka m maal malima pie maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la yis linɛ an teŋ zʋŋ la'ad wʋsa, ka lɛbisi ba, ba tʋʋma ni, ka kɛ ka sɔ' wʋsa mi' o tʋʋmmi an si'el.

english_verse: I also arranged for the people to bring firewood to the altar each day and for them to bring the first part of their harvest to the temple. I pray that God will bless me for the good I have done.
translation_verse: Ka m mɛ lɛn zi'el saŋa kanɛ nar ye nidib la la'as daad na nɛ zʋʋd linɛ ka ba bʋn yiiga la. Tɛnri m yɛla, O m Wina'am, ka kɛ ka m paae fʋ ya'am.

english_verse: King Xerxes of Persia lived in his capital city of Susa and ruled
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Zeesis da bɛ nɛ Susa linɛ an o na'am zin'ig ka an teŋ kpi'euŋ ka soogianam bɛ ka gɔt teŋ la.

english_verse: During the third year of his rule, Xerxes gave a big dinner for all his officials and officers. The governors and leaders of the provinces were also invited, and even the commanders of the Persian and Median armies came.
translation_verse: On da di na'am la, li yʋma atan' saŋa ka o da la'as o ninkpi'ema nɛ kpɛɛmnam maal diibi tisi ba. Soogia kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛ Pesia nɛ Media la wʋsa da bɛ, nɛ na'ayikpɛm nɛ banɛ sʋ'oe sʋ'ʋlim kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb wʋsa da bɛ.

english_verse: At the end of this time, King Xerxes gave another dinner and invited everyone in the city of Susa, no matter who they were. The eating and drinking lasted seven days in the beautiful palace gardens.
translation_verse: Lina nya'aŋ ka Na'ab la da maal diibi buol nidib ka ba zin'in lɔmbɔn'ɔg kanɛ bɛ Na'ayin la, daba ayɔpɔi. O da buol biis nɛ ninkʋda wʋsa banɛ bɛ Susa na'am zin'igin la, ka ba kena.

english_verse: The area was decorated with blue and white cotton curtains tied back with purple linen cords that ran through silver rings fastened to marble columns. Couches of gold and silver rested on pavement that had all kinds of designs made from costly bright-colored stones and marble and mother-of-pearl.
translation_verse: Ba da lɔ pien piela nɛ pien dɛn'ɛm bɛŋi ba diib zin'ig, ka da nɔk nwiis nɛ anzurifa baansi lɔɔ ga' zan'antɔlis banɛ ka ba kpi'e kugsʋma maal la. Ba da zin'in kʋgbanɛ ka ba nɔk sanlima nɛ anzurifa bulig la. Ka ba nɔk kuglamma banɛ an pʋpɔnra ka ba ligidi kpi'emi maal zak la teŋ.

english_verse: The guests drank from gold cups, and each cup had a different design. The king was generous
translation_verse: Ba da nɔknɛ sanlima la'ad banɛ gʋl kɔn'ɔb, kɔn'ɔbi kuob daam tis na'anam la. Na'ab la da tisi ba daam bɛdegʋ ka li pa'al o na'am paŋi zem si'em.

english_verse: and said to them, “Drink all you want!” Then he told his servants, “Keep their cups full.”
translation_verse: Na'ab la da tis nɔɔr ye sɔ' wʋsa num o paŋ bɛn, ka mɛ yɛl banɛ pʋʋd la ye ba tisim sɔ' wʋsa on bɔɔd dansi'a buudi wʋsa.

english_verse: While the men were enjoying themselves, Queen Vashti gave the women a big dinner inside the royal palace.
translation_verse: Na'ab la pu'a onɛ yʋ'ʋri da buon Vasiti la mɛ da maal diibi tis pu'a banɛ bɛ Na'ab Zeesis yin la.

english_verse: By the seventh day, King Xerxes was feeling happy because of so much wine. And he asked his seven personal servants, Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carkas,
translation_verse: Li daba ayɔpɔi daar Na'ab la da nu daam kʋʋl ka buol o tʋmtʋmnib ayɔpɔi banɛ bɛɛ o san'an la. Ba yʋda da anɛ Mehuman nɛ Bizita nɛ Habona nɛ Bigita nɛ Abagita nɛ Zeta nɛ Kakas. Ban da kena la, ka o yɛli ba ye

english_verse: to bring Queen Vashti to him. The king wanted her to wear her crown and let his people and his officials see how beautiful she was.
translation_verse: ba kem yɛl o pu'a Vasiti ka o pidi o na'am zupibig la kɛɛn o san'an na. Na'apu'a la da vɛnl nɛ hali ka Na'ab la bɔɔd ye o zaŋ o pa'al nidib la nɛ kpɛɛmnam la on vɛnl si'em.

english_verse: The king's servants told Queen Vashti what he had said, but she refused to go to him, and this made him terribly angry.
translation_verse: Amaa dap ayɔpɔi la da keŋ tis o Na'ab la labaar la, Na'apu'a Vasiti da zan'as ye o kʋ keŋɛ. Nɛ'ɛŋa da kɛ ka Na'ab la sʋnf duoe hali.

english_verse: The king called in the seven highest officials of Persia and Media. They were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan. These men were very wise and understood all the laws and customs of the country, and the king always asked them what they thought about such matters.
translation_verse: Banɛ da li'el Na'ab la da anɛ Kasena nɛ Sieta nɛ Adimata nɛ Tarsis nɛ Meres nɛ Masena nɛ Memukan, ya'am dima ayɔpɔi nwa' da an Pesia nɛ Media tɛɛns kpi'emnam la ka mɛ mɔr suori na tun'e kpɛn' Na'ab la san'an.

english_verse: The king said to them, “Queen Vashti refused to come to me when I sent my servants for her. What does the law say I should do about that?”
translation_verse: O da bu'osi ba ye, “Wada pʋʋgin, li nar ye ba niŋ Na'apu'a Vasiti wala? O zan'as nɔɔr kanɛ ka man Na'ab Zeesis, tʋmi m tʋmtʋmnib ye ba keŋ yɛl o la.”

english_verse: Then Memucan told the king and the officials: Your Majesty, Queen Vashti has not only embarrassed you, but she has insulted your officials and everyone else in all the provinces.
translation_verse: Ani ka Memukan da yɛl Na'ab la nɛ ya'am dim la tuon ye, “Naa, li ka'anɛ Na'ab la ma'aa ka Na'apu'a Vasiti nɛ'ɛsɛ amaa o mɛ nɛ'ɛs nɛ ya'am dim nɛ nimbanɛ bɛɛ fʋ sʋ'ʋlimin la wʋsa.

english_verse: The women in the kingdom will hear about this, and they will refuse to respect their husbands. They will say, “If Queen Vashti doesn't obey her husband, why should we?”
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Na'apu'a la tʋm si'el la, pu'ab la wʋsa na wʋm, ka lin na kɛ ka ba nɛ'ɛsi ba sidib mɛn ka yɛl, ye, ‘Na'ab Zeesis da tis nɔɔr ye ba mɔr Na'apu'a Vasiti na, amaa ka o pʋ siakɛ.’

english_verse: Before this day is over, the wives of the officials of Persia and Media will find out what Queen Vashti has done, and they will refuse to obey their husbands. They won't respect their husbands, and their husbands will be angry with them.
