translation_verse: Ba pʋn gban'e ye m lu ya nwa', ka bɔ ka m lɛn gɛɛndi m mɛŋ zaalim-zaalim?

english_verse: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
translation_verse: Hali baa m ya'a sʋʋ m mɛŋ nɛ ki'ibʋ nyain ka pie m nu'us nɛ zɛɛm,

english_verse: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
translation_verse: la'an nɛ wala fʋ na lɔsim bian'arin hali ka fubanɛ ka m yɛ la yaama yiim.

english_verse: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
translation_verse: O ka' ninsaal nwɛnɛ mam ka m na tun'e gandig oo, bɛɛ ti mɔr taaba keŋ kɔɔtʋ nii.

english_verse: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
translation_verse: Yɛlmaan ya'a bɛɛn man nɛ on teŋsʋk ka kpɛn'ɛsin o nu'ugʋ ti yɛl la ni,

english_verse: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
translation_verse: ka yisin balaar kanɛ ka Wina'am mɔri bʋ'ʋdim la, ka dabiem kanɛ ka o kpɛn'ɛsidim la gaad,

english_verse: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
translation_verse: m naan pian'adin nɛ o ka dabiem kae. Amaa din bɛ si'em nannanna nwa' la, m kʋ nyaŋi pian' nɛ oo.”

english_verse: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
translation_verse: Ka Job lɛn yɛl ye, Man ya'am yii m bɛllim nwa' nɛ; kɛl ka m nyɔli m ya'am bɔɔd si'em ka pian' nɛ m sʋntɔɔg.

english_verse: Don't just condemn me! Point out my sin.
translation_verse: M na yɛl Wina'am ye: Da kʋʋsim bɛ'ɛdɛ, amaa lɛɛ yɛlimi m taali an si'el kimm.

english_verse: Why do you take such delight in destroying those you created and in smiling on sinners?
translation_verse: Fʋn mugusid onɛ ka fʋ mɛŋ nu'ug maal la, li malisi fɔɔ? Ka fʋ lɛɛ bas pitɔɔg dim ka ba tʋm bam bɔɔd si'el!

english_verse: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
translation_verse: Fʋ mɔri ninsaalib ninii? Ninsaalibi nyɛt si'em la, ala ka fʋ mɛ nyɛtaa?

english_verse: Is your life as short as ours?
translation_verse: Fʋ dabisa gimnɛ nwɛnɛ ninvʋsaal dabisaa? Bɛɛ fʋ yʋma gimnɛ nwɛnɛ o yʋma?

english_verse: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
translation_verse: Ka dinzug ka fʋ vɛɛnsid ye fʋ nyɛɛm taal ka ieedi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛɛ?

english_verse: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
translation_verse: Fʋ la'am mi' ye m pʋ tʋm taalɛ, ka mɛ mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye sɔ' kae na faanmi fʋ nu'usinɛ.

english_verse: Will you now destroy someone you created?
translation_verse: Fʋ mɛŋ-mɛŋ nu'us ka fʋ zaŋi maalim, dinzug, fʋ na siaki san'ami maa?

english_verse: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
translation_verse: Tɛnr ye fʋnɛ ya'abim wʋʋ ya'ad nɛ. Alazug, fʋ na kɛ ka m lieb titan ya'asɛɛ?

english_verse: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
translation_verse: Ka' fʋnɛ daa kpa'am wʋʋ bin'isim la niŋi m ma pʋʋgin, ka maalim wʋʋ bam mɔr bin'isim maan waagazi si'em laa?

english_verse: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ daa zaŋ giinla tɔ'ɔŋi m kɔnba wʋsa ka zaŋ niŋgbina nɛ niŋgbauŋʋ pilim.

english_verse: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ tisim vʋm nɛ nɔŋilim, ka guri m siig.

english_verse: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
translation_verse: M ya'a tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd fʋ gɔsidim nɛ ka kʋ kɛɛ m taali basɛ.

english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: M ya'a ʋki m zug agɔla fʋ kemmim nɛ nwɛnɛ gbigim nɛ ka lɛm pa'alimi fʋ paŋ la nyalima an si'em.

english_verse: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.
translation_verse: Daar woo fʋ nyɛti m gbɛlima, ka linzug ka fʋ sʋʋnr maligim pɛligid nɛ mam; ka fʋ namisʋg gaad ala.

english_verse: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
translation_verse: “Bɔzug kimm ka fʋ kɛ ka ba du'a ma? M ya'a da kpiinɛ m du'am saŋa ka sɔ'ɔsɔ pʋ nyɛɛ ma di naan sɔn'ɔn.

english_verse: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
translation_verse: M dabisa dinɛ an bi'ela la pʋn pʋ naae nɛ laa? Basim mam ka m nyɛ nimma'asim bi'ela

english_verse: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
translation_verse: Fʋ tɛn'ɛs ye fʋ pian'ayɛɛd nwa' na kɛ ka nid mɔdigi sinnaa? Fʋ na maan siaa ka ba kʋ zɛrigi fɔɔ?

english_verse: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Fʋ yɛt Wina'am ye, ‘Man niŋi fʋ yɛlʋg la yadda ka gbɛlʋŋ kae, ka bɛ nyain fʋ nini ni.’

english_verse: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
translation_verse: ka viigi pa'alif yɛlsu'ada linɛ yit ya'amin na ka mɛ kɛ ka fʋ baŋ ye ya'am bɛ nɛ ka ya'am bɛ. Baŋim ye Wina'am tami fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la sieba yɛla nɛ gba.

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Li dʋʋ gaad saŋgbana wʋsa, ka bɔ kimm ka fʋ na tun'e niŋɛ? Li zulimmi gat yaʋg, ka fʋn mi' bɔ?

english_verse: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?
translation_verse: Li wa'alim gat teŋgbauŋ ka li labisim gat atɛuk.

english_verse: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
translation_verse: O ya'a zaŋi fʋ niŋ sanrega ni ka mɔri fʋ dʋ kɔɔtʋ, anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e ki'is o?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
translation_verse: Bi'esʋg kae, o mi' pʋʋs ayi' dim ka nyɛt banɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa.

english_verse: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg ya'a ti gban'e pian'ad gbinnɛɛ, alaa bʋŋ na du'a ninsaal.

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, fʋ ya'a dɔl o nɛ fʋ sʋʋnr wʋsa ka tiɛn fʋ nu'ugʋ sɔs o,

english_verse: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
translation_verse: ka bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kanɛ bɛɛ fʋ sʋʋnrin la, ka da siak ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd tʋmi fʋ yin ya'asɛ,

english_verse: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.
translation_verse: ala ka fʋ na duoe fʋ zug agɔla ka nyan kae, fʋ na zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ ka dabiem kae.

english_verse: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
translation_verse: Fʋ na tami fʋ yɛla wʋsa, ka li nwɛnɛ saa nii gaadnɛ.

english_verse: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.
translation_verse: Fʋ na zin' ka dabiem kae, fʋn mɔr ti'ir la zug. Fʋ na gɔs gɔbʋg nɛ diiug wʋsa ka li anɛ nimma'asim ma'aa ka dabiem kae.

english_verse: You will sleep without fear and be greatly respected.
translation_verse: Fʋ na diginɛ gbis ka onɛ na vɔlisif kae. Nidib bɛdegʋ na bɔɔd sʋŋiri fʋ san'an.

english_verse: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
translation_verse: Amaa pitɔɔg dim ti'ir na bɔdig ka kɛɛ ba ka ba zi' ban zɔti ken si'ela, ba ti'ir la na ba'as nɛ kumin.”

english_verse: Job said to his friends:
translation_verse: Ka Job lɛbis ye,

english_verse: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
translation_verse: “Waii, bi'esʋg kae, ya sid anɛ a-mi'-wʋsa dim, ya ya'a kpii, ya'am mɛ kpiya!

english_verse: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
translation_verse: Amaa baŋimi ka m mɔr ya'am nwɛnɛ yanam nɛ; sida, ya pʋ gati ma. Anɔ'ɔnɛ zi' yanamɛ yɛt si'el la wʋsa?

english_verse: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.
translation_verse: M yʋ'ʋn lieb nɛ bʋnla'adiri tisim zuanam, hali baa man buol Wina'am ka o gandig la. La'an nɛ man an pʋpiel ka ka' gbɛlʋŋ la, m lieb nɛ bʋnla'adir!

english_verse: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka si'el-si'el pʋ paki ba la ziemid banɛ bɛ yɛla ni, ka tusid banɛ sadigidi bɔɔd liig la.

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Bɔɔ kɛ ka banɛ faand mɔr yɔlisim? Bɔ ka sɔ' pʋ daamid banɛ kis Wina'am la? Ka la'am yɛl ye Wina'am bɛ nɛ ba nu'usin.

english_verse: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
translation_verse: Bu'osim bʋnkɔnbid ka ba pa'alif, bɛɛ niis banɛ ian'ad agɔla la ka ba na yɛlif;

english_verse: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka m kaal nwa' wʋsa mi' ye Zugsɔb la tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa nwa'.

english_verse: Every living creature is in the hands of God.
translation_verse: O nu'ugin ka bʋnvʋr wʋsa bɛ, hali nɛ saalib wʋsa vʋm.

english_verse: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, tʋbiri wɛligid pian'ad wʋʋ zilimi lɛmmid diib si'em la, bɛɛ m ma'aanɛɛ?

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Mɛ ya'am bɛ nɛ zuobpielim dim ni? Li ka'anɛ kʋdigire an baŋirɛɛ?

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: Ya'am nɛ paŋ anɛ Wina'am din; mi'ilim nɛ baŋir mɛ anɛ o din.

english_verse: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.
translation_verse: O ya'a nwa'ae, anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi mɛ'? Ka ninkanɛ ka o yɔɔ o sanrega ni, anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi yis o?

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Paŋ nɛ nyaŋir anɛ o din; banɛ pan'asid nidib nɛ banɛ ka ba pan'asid wʋsa anɛ o din.

english_verse: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools,
translation_verse: Onɛ kɛt ka mi'ilim dim lieb zaalim ka sariakatib lieb zɔn.

english_verse: God removes priests and others who have great power—
translation_verse: Onɛ yisid maanmaannibi ba kpi'euŋin ka kɛt ka paŋ dim lieb zaalim.

english_verse: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
translation_verse: Onɛ diisid na'ayikpɛm nyan ka kɛt ka paŋ dim liebid zaalim.

english_verse: he makes nations strong, then shatters their strength.
translation_verse: Onɛ kɛt ka tɛɛns nɔbigid onɛ lɛn san'amidi ba, onɛ yaligid tɛɛns, onɛ lɛn widigidi ba.

english_verse: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
translation_verse: Onɛ mɔŋid tɛɛns na'anam ya'am; ka kɛt ka ba gɔɔndi gin yɔɔg-yɔɔg.

english_verse: lost in the dark, staggering like someone drunk.
translation_verse: Ba babinnɛ likin ka nɛɛsim kae ka kɛ ka ba gɛnnim wʋʋ danuudib nɛ.”

english_verse: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ mi' si'el la wʋsa mam mɛ mi' mɛn; ya pʋ gati ma.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Dama'am ma'aa ka ya ma'adi tabin mam; ya nwɛnɛ tima dim banɛ kʋ nyaŋi ti'eb nida.

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: Ya ya'a sinni ya nɔɔr baanlimm, li na kɛ ka ya nwɛnɛ ya'am dim nɛ.

english_verse: and listen to my argument.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi ka m yisi m nɔɔr pian'ʋk; wʋmminɛ m fabʋlʋg.

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Ya na nyaŋi mɔr baregaŋ man nɛ Wina'am teŋsʋkɔɔ? Bɛɛ ya zabi tis o?

english_verse: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
translation_verse: O ya'a vɛɛnsi ya sʋnya gɔs, li na an sʋ'ʋŋaa? Ya na nyaŋi pan'as o nwɛnɛ yanamɛ pan'asid saalib si'em laa?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Ayei! Ya ya'a su'a mɔr baregaŋ, o na zɛrigi ya.

english_verse: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
translation_verse: Ya siilima la anɛ zaalim nwɛnɛ tampɛligim nɛ; yanamɛ mɔr si'eli gu'udi ya mɛŋ la anɛ ya'ad, li sid kʋ ya'as nwa'arɛ.

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: Fɔɔnmɛ baanlimm ka kɛ ka m pian'; ka linɛ na niŋ, lin niŋ.

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: Bɔzug ka m mɔr nyɔvʋri nwɛ'ɛdi kpɛɛsid wʋʋ siya'ar ka mɔri m vʋm maan galima?

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Hali o ya'a bɔɔd, on kʋʋmim; ka m ti'ir nan kpɛm bɛ nɛ o ni. M na tu'asi m yɛla wʋsa o tuon.

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: M mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye m sʋnkpi'euŋ la na kɛ ka m paam faangir, bɔzugɔ onɛ zi' Wina'am pʋn kʋ li'el o san'anɛ!

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: Man maal siri ye m tu'asi fʋ m yɛl la, m mi' ye m na di bʋʋd.

english_verse: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
translation_verse: Sɔ' mɔr antu'a kanɛ na zɛrig mam bɛɛ? Alaa m na sin baanlimm hali ti paae m kum.

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: Wina'am, niŋim bʋnama ayi' nwa' ma'aa tisim, ka m kʋ lɛn su'a m mɛŋi fʋ san'anɛ:

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: Ala ka fʋ ya'a buolim, m na siak, bɛɛ fʋn kɛ ka m pian' ka fʋ gandig.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: M taal nɛ m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kal aan ala? Pa'alimi m gbɛlʋŋ nɛ m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi zu'oe si'em.

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ zan'as ye fʋ kʋ gɔsi ma ka zaŋim ka m liebi fʋ dataa?

english_verse: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?
translation_verse: Fʋ na namis man kanɛ nwɛnɛ vaung ka sisi'em da'ad laa? Fʋ na kati dɔl udugɔɔ?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: Fʋ sɔbnɛ yɛltɔɔdi gi' mam ka kɛ ka m namisidi m biilimin sa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
translation_verse: Fʋ ba'a m nɔba nɛ ba'an; fʋ guri m suoya ka gɔsid ye fʋ baŋ man ken si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Ala ka ninsaal bɛdigid nwɛnɛ bʋmpɔn'ɔsir nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ fuug ka sibig mu'anɛ.”

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: Job da lɛn yɛl ye, “Ninsaal mɛkama dunia nwa' pʋʋgin dabisa anɛ bi'ela ka pɛ'ɛl nɛ yɛla.

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi yis bʋn dinɛ an nyain dian'ad pʋʋginɛ? Sida, li sɔb kae!

english_verse: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋn gban'e ninsaal nyɔvʋr bɛnnɛ naae; fʋ mɛ gban'e on na vʋe nwadis si'em ka o kʋ tʋʋgi li bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: Alazug, yisimi fʋ nini ka bas o baanlimm, ka o di nyɛlʋg o vʋm dabisa la pʋʋgin nwɛnɛ onɛ tʋm lɛbir nɛ.

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: Hali tiig gba mɔr ti'ir, bɔzugɔ ba ya'a nwaae li ka bas gbi'ir, li na lɛm bus ya'as ka li bulpaala la kʋ sʋʋgɛ.

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ ku'om ɛɛn naae atɛukʋn si'em la bɛɛ ku'om ɛɛnti kpiɛn kɔlʋgin ka li kʋdigi tans si'em la,

english_verse: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: ala ka ninsaal kpiid ka pʋ duoda. Ya'a ka' saazugʋ na ti gaadɛ, saalib kʋ maligim lɛb naa bɛɛ nie gbɛɛm pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a pʋn su'anim kpi'im teŋ ka lusinim ka fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la gaadin, li pʋ sɔn'oe yaa? Fʋ ya'a zi'elin saŋa ka lɛn tiɛn m yɛla ya'asɛ!

english_verse: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
translation_verse: Ninsaal ya'a kpi o na lɛn vʋ'ʋg ya'asɛɛ? Li ya'a aan ala m na mɔdig m tʋʋm kpi'ema la wʋsa ni hali ka ti paam vʋ'ʋsʋm.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Fʋ na buolim ka m na siak; fʋ sʋnf na malis nɛ man onɛ ka fʋ maal nɛ fʋ nu'us la.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Asida, fʋ na gur man sʋ'ʋŋa saŋa wʋsa ka kʋ lɛn gi'ennɛ m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi zem si'em.

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: Fʋ na zaŋi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi su'a bɔto ni lɔ, ka pin' m taal wʋsa.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: Amaa nwɛnɛ zuoya birigidi lit ka kugbɛda vurigid si'em la,

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: ka lɛn nwɛnɛ ku'om dit kuga ka ku'okanɛ zɔt pied tanni ken si'em la, ala ka fʋ san'amid ninsaal ti'ir.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Fʋ nyaŋ o vuguri ka o mɛlim; fʋ tiak o nindaa nwɛnɛ onɛ kpi nɛ ka o gaad sa.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Nidib ya'a na'asid o biis, o zi'isigɛ; ba ya'a mɛ pɔ'ɔgidi ba, o pʋ nyɛtaa.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: O mi'inɛ o mɛŋ niŋgbina zabir ma'aa ka kaasid o mɛŋ yɛla ma'aa.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
translation_verse: Ka Elifaz onɛ an Teman nid la lɛbis ye,

english_verse: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb na nwa'asid nɛ pian'ayɛɛdɛɛ, bɛɛ o tu'asid pian'ad kanɛ ka' vɔɔnrɛ?

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋ pʋn pʋ lɛn zɔt Wina'am ka mɛ kɛ ka nidib kʋ lɛn tis o girima.

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔɔr pian'ad pa'annɛ fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi zem si'em; fʋ mɔri nɔmalisim pan'asid nidib.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: Fʋ mɛŋ nɔɔri ditif ka ka' manɛ, fʋ mɛŋ pian'adi zɛrigidif.

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: Ba da dɛŋi du'anɛ fʋn yiiga bɛɛ? Wina'am da maan zuoya la fʋ da bɛɛ?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: Wina'am da gban'ad on na maal si'em la, fʋ da wʋm yaa? Fʋnɛ fʋ kɔn'ɔkɔn' mɔr dunia la wʋsa ya'am?

english_verse: Do you know and understand something we don't?
translation_verse: Fʋ mi' bɔ ka tinam zi'? Ya'am gɔnlʋŋ bɔ ka fʋ mɔr ka tinam pʋ mɔra?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: Tinam ya'am la yit nɛ zugpielim dimin na, ba da bɛ hali ka fʋ saam nan kae.

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: Bɔzug ka fʋ zan'asid sumbʋgʋsʋm linɛ ka Wina'am tisidif la? La'an nɛ tinamɛ pian' baanlimm tisif la wʋsaa?

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Bɔzug ka fʋ kɛ ka fʋ sʋʋnr duoe wala? Bɔzug ka fʋ nini mu'oe hali

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: ka fʋ sʋʋnr duoe nɛ Wina'am ka fʋ pian'ad pian' linɛ pʋ nari tisid o?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Wina'am ya'a pʋ niŋ o mɛŋ-mɛŋ maliaknam yadda, hali ka arezana ka' nyain o nini nii,

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: ka ninsaal onɛ an pitɔɔg nɛ bugusim sɔb ka nuud tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋʋ ku'om la yʋ'ʋsɛ?

english_verse: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
translation_verse: Job, kɛlisim sʋ'ʋŋa ka m tu'asi pa'alif; kɛl ka m yɛlif man nyɛ si'el.

english_verse: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
translation_verse: Bama ka ba pɔnsi zaŋ teŋ la tisi ba ka saan baa yinne pʋ gɛndigi ba sʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
translation_verse: Pʋtɔɔg sɔb na namis hali nɛ o nyɔvʋr bɛn. Onɛ bɔɔd zaba la kʋ yuug dunia nwa' nii.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: O yiridnɛ gin, ka na ba'asi kilim zʋʋnd diib. O mi' ye lik dabisir la na paae o.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ tɔɔg dabiem mɔr o ka libig o nwɛnɛ na'abi yi tanp ye o zab nɛ o.

english_verse: and have attacked him with their weapons.
translation_verse: O maal tʋbzian'asim ka zaŋ o zaba la'akpi'ema zabid nɛ Wina'am.

english_verse: but they will live in the ruins of deserted towns.
translation_verse: o na bɛ teŋ kanɛ an dabɔɔd, nɛ ya' banɛ an wɛn ma'aa ka nidib kae.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: O kʋ nyaŋi zɔɔ yi likin la; bugum na zɛɛlim o ka o zɛndig wʋʋ tiig vaand nɛ.

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: O mid ka o ma'aa o mɛŋi ti'e linɛ ka' vɔɔnrɛ, bɔzugɔ o kʋ nyɛ sʋŋiri yii aninaa.

english_verse: like a date palm tree without a leaf.
translation_verse: O saŋa kʋ paae ka o pʋn zɛndig ka o wila kʋ lɛn sɔbig lim-lim nɛ.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: O na nwɛnɛ tiig wil kanɛ ka ba fanri li wala pilɛɛd, ka nwɛnɛ olif tikanɛ puum sʋʋg wʋsa.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ pʋ zɔt Wina'am na kilim kʋnduada, bugum mɛ na di banɛ nɔŋ filʋŋ la ya'.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Ba gban'adnɛ yɛla pʋʋg ka du'ad tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd; ba pʋʋs anɛ dama'am ma'aa.”

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: “Man wʋm yɛlbama buudi hali bɛdegʋ; ya ma' ye ya bɛlisidim nɛ ka lɛɛ maligim kpɛn'ɛsidim yɛla ni!

english_verse: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a aan wʋʋ man an si'em nwa', mam mɛ naan tun'e pian' tisi ya wʋʋ yanamɛ pian'ad si'em tisidim la.

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ala m ya'a pian', m niŋgbina zabir la kʋ gaadɛ; m ya'a mɛ sinni m nɔɔr li kʋ gaadɛ.

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Ya'a an sida, Wina'am, fʋ kɛ ka m tadignɛ hali, fʋ widigi m yir la wʋsa.

english_verse: my shriveled up skin proves that I am his prisoner.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛ ka m lieb giinla nɛ kɔnba gʋllim, ka li an kasɛt ye man tʋmnɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Wina'am sʋʋnr pɛlig nɛ mam ka o aansidi m zɔra-zɔra. O nyiidim nɛ hali; m dataa la nini mu'oe nɛ mam hali.

english_verse: Everyone is against me; they sneer and slap my face.
translation_verse: Saalib la'adim nɛ ka nɔkimi maali ba bʋnla'adir; ba lɔbidim tampian'as ka maal nɔɔr yinne kisigim.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Wina'am zaŋimi tis nimbɛ'ɛdnam, ka lɔbimi bas pitɔɔg dim nu'ugin.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: M daa bɛ nɛ nimma'asimin ka o kpɛn kʋʋm vuguri; o gban'anɛ m niŋgɔɔnr ka tɛbigimɛ tud sa ka m kɔ' bur-bur. O zaŋim nɛ ka m an wʋʋ sian'arin bʋnkɔnbʋg

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: ka tɔɔndim nɛ piema zin'is wʋsa. O kʋnsim hali paae m sianini ka pʋ zɔt nimbaanliga ka m ziim yii pʋbid teŋin.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: Man sɛn sʋnsa'aŋ fuugʋ libili m niŋgbina, ka zin' teŋin ka m ti'ir kae.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Man kaas nɛ ka m nini mu'oe, m nini la fʋlisi fʋlisnɛ.

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Amaa la'an nɛ wala, m mi' ye m nu'us ka' dian'adɛ, ka m winsɔsʋg an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: Ateŋaa, da dii m ziim, da kɛ ka m fabʋlʋg nwa' lieb zaalim.

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Hali nannankaŋa nwa', m kasɛta sɔb bɛ nɛ arezana ni; ɛɛn, m nu'unwɛ'ɛd la bɛ nɛ saazug.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: M ninta'am litnɛ bɔr-bɔr Wina'am tuon ka m zuanam maannim siaa.

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye m sʋndaan naan bɛɛ nwɛ' Wina'am nu'ugʋ tisim nwɛnɛ nid nɛ o zua nɛ.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: Yʋma fiin nwa' kpɛlim ka mam na dɔl suokanɛ ka' lɛbig na la keŋ.”

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Ka Job yʋ'ʋn yɛl ye, “Man vʋm la naae ya, m dabisa pʋ lɛn lalla, yaʋg ya'anɛ nɔɔri gurim.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Asida sida banɛ la'ad mam la galis nɛ; dinzugɔ m na kpɛn gɔsid banɛ pɛligidi m sʋnf la.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: O m Wina'am, kpɛn'ɛsimi fʋ nu'ugʋ m yɛl nwa' ni ka sɔ' kae na zi'enɛ m nya'aŋa.

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ lusi ba pʋtɛnda ka ba kʋ gban'e si'el-si'el gbinnɛ; alazug, da kɛ ka ba di ya'annɛ.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ yii o zua nya'aŋ ye o di'e yɔɔd, o sɔb biis na ba'as yɔri.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: Wina'am kɛnɛ ka man lieb bʋnla'adiri tis nidib wʋsa, ba tʋbisidnɛ nintɔɔndi matti m nindaa.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: M sʋnsa'aŋ la kɛnɛ ka m nini sɔbid, ka m niŋgbina naae kpɛlim kɔnba ma'aa.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Pʋpielnam ya'a nyɛ nɛ'ɛŋa, li zabidi banɛ; ka banɛ ka' taal sʋʋnr pɛlig nɛ banɛ pʋ zɔt Wina'am.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, pʋpielim dim na kpɛn zi'e ba sida ni, ka banɛ nu'usi an nyain la maligin nyɛ kpi'euŋ.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: M dabisa gaad ya ka m gban'ar wʋsa san'am ala ka m ya'amlɛog pʋn lɛn kae nɛ si'ela.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Nimbama nwa' nɔknɛ yʋ'ʋŋ ka li lieb nintaŋ; ka zaŋ lik ka li lieb nɛɛsim.

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: M ti'ir wʋsa bɛ nɛ kpi'im teŋ, zin'ikanɛ ka m na diginɛ gbis likin.

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: M na buol Ayaʋg ye, ‘M saam’, ka buol bʋnvʋya banɛ diti m niŋgbina la ye, ‘M ma’, bɛɛ ‘M taʋn’.

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: M ti'ir bɛ yaanɛ kimm nɛ? Anɔ'ɔn na gɔsi nyɛ ti'iri tisi ma?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ti'ir na dɔllimi sig yaʋgʋnɛɛ? Li na diginɛ m san'an kpi'im teŋaa?”

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: “Bɔ saŋa ka fʋ ye fʋ bas pian'adɛ? Zuligimi ya'am, ka kɛlis ka ti yʋ'ʋn pian'.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka ya gɔs ka ti nwɛnɛ niigi ya nini ni wʋʋ ti ka' ya'am baa bi'ela?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: Ba kpiis pitɔɔg sɔb fitir; o bugum la kpiisnɛ ka pʋ lɛn ditta.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: O tadig nɛ ka pʋ tun'e yakid nɔbir nɛ kpi'euŋɔ; o mɛŋ bugusim ya'am la dii o.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Baŋ gban'e o nɔbkpansinkpanda ka bɛndig la mɔr o kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
translation_verse: On ken zin'isi'a wʋsa dabiem mɔr o nɛ.

english_verse: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster,
translation_verse: Kɔ'ɔm tadig o; ka san'auŋ gur o ye o li.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Ban'abɛ'ɛdi tiigi o niŋgbina wʋsa, ka kɛ ka o nu'us nɛ o nɔba pun'oe.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Ba yis o, o yir kanɛ ka o bɛ ka daauŋ kae la nii mɔr o keŋ Na'aba Akum san'an.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Bugumpielim ma'aa bɛɛ o dɔɔgin; ka kidibir dinɛ dit bugum gilig o yir la.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: O nya'a kʋdignɛ teŋin, ka o wila la agɔla ziank.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Ba kad o yis nɛɛsimin kpɛn'ɛs likin ka mɛlis o dunia nwa' ni.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Asida, lin niŋid banɛ pʋ zɔt Wina'am si'em la; ala ka banɛ zi' Wina'am la bɛllim aɛn.”

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: “Bʋndaar ka ya na basi m daamʋgɔ? Ya nɔɔr pian'ad kɛ ka m kɔnba kɔɔd bur-bur!

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Nɔɔrim bʋpiiga nwa' ka ya pɔ'ɔgim; ya tʋmim bɛ'ɛd hali, ka nyan kae.

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Di ya'a an sida ye mam yidig nɛ, yanam kɛl ka li paanɛ mam ma'aa.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Ya tɛn'ɛs ye ya sɔn'oe mam nɛ, ka gɔs ka yɛlbanɛ paae mam la pa'al ye m tʋm nɛ taal.

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: Ya zi' ye li anɛ Wina'am tʋm mam nɛ'ɛŋaa? Onɛ nɔk o baŋi bɛndim.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ man kaas ye, ‘O tʋmim dinɛ pʋ nar la,’ m pʋ nyɛ gandigirɛ. La'an nɛ man ye ba sʋŋimim la, sɔ' pʋ tisim bʋʋdɛ.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: O giŋim nɛ ka m kʋ nyaŋi gaadɛ; o kɛ ka m suor wʋsa an lik.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Wina'am sʋnf pɛlig nɛ mam hali; ka o kaalimi paas o dataas.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: O zabzabidib la la'as ye ba zab nɛ m; ba lɔbi giligim zin'is wʋsa.

english_verse: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
translation_verse: Wina'am kɛnɛ ka m mɛŋ yidim basim; m lieb nɛ saanne tis banɛ mi'im.

english_verse: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
translation_verse: Banɛ an saam man yin, nɛ m tʋmtʋm pu'ab, gɔsid mam ka m nwɛnɛ saan nɛ.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: M buoli m yammʋg ka o zan'as siakir; hali m bɛllim o ka o sin.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: M vʋ'ʋsʋm nyuusidnɛ pɔn'ɔsʋgʋ m pu'a nyɔnya ni; ka m ba'abiis pʋ bɔɔd ye ba li'eli ma.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Hali bibibis nini kpɛn' mam nɛ; ka ba mɔrimi la'ad.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: M zuamɛŋa gɔs man nɛ zaalim; banɛ ka m nɔŋ la yʋ'ʋn kisigim nɛ.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: M yʋ'ʋn lieb nɛ kɔnba ma'aa; di kpɛlim bi'ela ka m kpiin.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: Zɔminim nimbaanlig, m zuanama, zɔminim nimbaanlig, bɔzugɔ, Wina'am nwɛ' m nɛ o mɛŋ-mɛŋ nu'ug.

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Wala ka ya namisidim nwɛnɛ Wina'am namisidim si'em la? Yanamɛ namisim si'em la pʋ sia'alɛɛ?

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: M pian'ad nwa' ya'a sɔbidinnɛ digin, ba naan sɔbi niŋin gbauŋ pʋʋgin.

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: M mi' ye m nu'unwɛ'ɛd la vʋe ka na duoe ka zabi m yɛla.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Hali baa m niŋgbauŋ nwa' ya'a pun'oe, la'an nɛ ala m na nyɛ Wina'am nɛ m nini nwa'.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Mam mɛŋ-mɛŋ na nyɛɛ o nɛ m nini nwa' ka ka' sɔ'ɔɔ. M sʋnf lɔnɛ gur saŋa la!

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a yɛl ye, ‘Ti na kpɛn namisid Job bɔzugɔ, yɛla nwa' wʋsa yinɛ o san'an na.’

english_verse: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
translation_verse: “Job, fʋ pian'ad la daamim sʋʋnr ka li an tilas ye m lɛbisif.

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Fʋn pian'am pian'asi'a la wʋsa anɛ tʋ'ʋd, amaa m mi' mam na lɛbisif si'em.

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: ye ninvʋbɛ'ɛd wʋsa sumalisim pʋ ya'asid naarɛ ka banɛ kis Wina'am kʋ nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgʋ yuugɛ.

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Hali baa o dʋ'ʋsi-m-mɛŋ ya'a bɔɔd din duoe paae arezana, ka o wa'am hali ka o zug paae saŋgbana ni,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: o na pun'oe nwɛnɛ o mɛŋ bin nɛ, ka banɛ daa mi' o na bu'osid ye, ‘O bɛ yaanɛ?’

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: O biis na yɔ dinɛ wʋsa an nɔŋ dim bʋn la lɛbis; ka o mɛŋ mɛ lɛbis mɔrim kanɛ wʋsa ka o zaŋ la.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Kpi'euŋ kanɛ ka o da mɔr o dasannimin la na lɛbi dig titanin.

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: Amaa li ya'a paae o pʋʋrin li na lieb tɔɔg; li na tɔi lak-lak nwɛnɛ yabid nɛ.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: O na tin mɔrim kanɛ ka o di la; Wina'am na kɛ ka o tiin li wʋsa yis na.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: O na liel wiigi zɛɛnsim, zɛɛlʋŋ na dum o kʋ.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: O kʋ nyɛ siind nɛ bin'isim linɛ pʋbid wʋʋ ku'osuoya badigid la malisim.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Si'el lɛn kae ka o na dii; dinzug, o mɔrim la kʋ yuugɛ.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Saŋa kan ka o mɔr si'el mɛkama la, saŋkan nɔɔ ka yɛltɔɔd paad o; fara nɛ yɛlmugusa na gban'e o.

english_verse: and God will make them swallow his blazing anger.
translation_verse: O ya'a ti dii pɛ'ɛl o pʋʋr la, saŋkan ka Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn na lii o zug.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Ba na kad o nɛ zan'an ka o zɔɔ yi, ka ba yʋ'ʋn kʋns o nɛ kʋntzɛn'ug kpan.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Kpan la zug na kʋns o sɔɔnri tɔlig o nya'aŋ na. Dabietita'ar na kpɛn' o

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: ka on bɔ si'el wʋsa digil la san'am; bugum dinɛ ka ninsaal pʋ nyu'oe na di on nɛ o yin la'ad wʋsa.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Saazug na nie o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la paalʋ, ka teŋgbauŋ la na duoe zab nɛ o.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn na zii o yiri gaad, nwɛnɛ ku'om pʋbidi dit la'ad si'em la.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Bugusim daan yɔɔdi an si'eli la, lin ka Wina'am maali digili ba.”

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: “Kɛlisimi sʋ'ʋŋa ka m pian' tisi ya; ya ya'a siak, li na bʋgʋli m sʋʋnr.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Dimi suguru ka kɛ ka m pian', ka m ya'a pian' naae ka ya bɔɔd, yanam la'aminim.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: M pʋ nyɔnnɛ tisid ninsaala dinzug m kʋ di suguru.

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Ya ya'a gɔs man an si'em la ma'aa li na lidigi ya ka ya pin' nɔɔri zin' baanlimm.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: M ya'a tɛn'ɛs bʋn linɛ paae mam nwa', di kpɛn'ɛsidim nɛ waad nɛ dabiem.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Di niŋ wala ka nimbɛ'ɛdnam vʋe yuugid hali, ka ba kpi'euŋ paasida?

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Ba nini ni ka ba biis nyɛt zi'esim linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa, ka ba yaas la nɔbigid hali.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Yɛlbɛ'ɛd pʋ kpɛn'ɛdi ba yir pʋʋginɛ, ka dabiem mɛ pʋ mɔri baa; Wina'am mɛ pʋ namisidi baa.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Ba na'araad dʋti ba na'anya'as ka ba du'ad ka pʋ vɛnbisida.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Ba biis ian'adnɛ wʋʋ pɛ'ɛs nɛ, ka wa'ad nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Ba yʋ'ʋmnɛ ka nwɛ'ɛd siyada nɛ kɔna, ka piebid wiisi maan sumalisim.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Ba dit nɛ malisim ba vʋm saŋa wʋsa, hali ka ti kpi nɛ nimma'asim.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala ba yɛt Wina'am ye, ‘Basimi ti baanlimm! Ti ba'a kae nɛ fʋn gban'e ti yɛla si'em.

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Ba tɛn'ɛs ye ba mɛŋ paŋ ka ba paami ba mɔrim la, amaa mam pʋ siak ban tɛn'ɛsid si'em laa.

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala wʋsa, nɔɔr ala ka ya nyɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim bugum kpiisɛ? Nɔɔr ala ka tɔɔg paae ba bɛɛ Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn luu ba zugɔ?

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Nɔɔr ala ka o da'ae ba keŋ wʋʋ sa'ad bɛɛ udug ka sisi'em da'ae keŋɛ?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a ye, ‘Wina'am namisid biisi ba saamnam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug,’ mam na lɛbis ye o ya'a namis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la sɔb mɛŋ, o na baŋ ye o tʋm bɛ'ɛd!

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb nini nyɛɛ o san'auŋ; kɛl ka Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la tɛɛg o tʋbir ka li wʋm o.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: O dabisa dunia nwa' ya'a ti naae, o ba'a lɛn ka' nɛ o yaas yɛlaa.

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Sɔ' bɛɛ na tun'e pa'al Wina'am onɛ kad tuongatib banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ hali saria laa?

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' on di namisʋg hali nɛ o kum, ka pʋ di nyɛlʋg baa daar yinnee.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Amaa nidib ayi' nwa' ya'a kpi ba na mumi ba wʋsa teŋin ka zʋnzʋnya dii ba niŋgbina la.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: M mi' pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka ya tɛn'ɛsidi m yɛla, nɛ gban'abɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka ya gban'e m yɛla la.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Ya na yɛl ye, ‘Nintita'ar la yir bɛ yaanɛ, ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la da bɛ zin'isi'a la bɛ yaanɛ?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Wina'am sʋʋnr ya'a ti duoe ka o ye o namis nidiba, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim ɛɛnti nyɛnɛ yɔlisimm?

english_verse: No one points out their sin or punishes them.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ yɛt tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb ye o tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ? Anɔ'ɔnɛ yɔɔd o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la sammɛ?

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Ba ya'a mum o naae, ba gur o yaʋg la nɛ sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Ka Elifaz onɛ yi Teman la lɛbis ye,

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Ninsaal ya'am ya'a bɔɔd din zem si'em amaa di ka' vɔɔnri tis Wina'am.

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Fʋ zi' ye fʋ bugusim tʋʋma la zu'onɛ galis ka fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ka' bɛnnɛɛ?

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Fʋ faaɛn fʋ ba'abiis banɛ dii fʋ sam fuud ka li pʋ nara, fʋ yɛɛs nidib la'ad ka basi ba sawɛnya.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Fʋ daa pʋ nɔk ku'om tis banɛ ka ku'onuud kʋʋdi baa, ka lɛm mɔŋ banɛ ka ba kɔ'ɔm zabid la diib,

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Fʋ da kad pʋkɔnya ka ba lɛb nu'uzaalis, ka tʋm kpiibis dinɛ pʋ nara.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Linɛ kɛ ka bɛndis giligif zin'is wʋsa, ka dabiem ɛɛn gbirigi gban'af saŋa wʋsa la.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: Linɛ mɛ kɛ ka li an lik biridi ka fʋ pʋ nyɛta, ka ku'om limif zin'is wʋsa la.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: Wina'am pʋ bɛ nɛ saazug saa? Gɔsim o dʋʋ gaad nwadbibis banɛ bɛ agɔlli ian'ad pidʋ-pidʋ la.

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Amaa fʋ yɛl ye, ‘Wina'am mi' bɔ? O na nyaŋi nyɛ likine kad nid sariaa?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: O bɛ nɛ saazug sa gin ka saŋgbantita'ar ligil o, ka o pʋ nyɛti tii.’

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: Fʋ na kpɛn dɔl suokʋdʋg kanɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim dɔl laa?

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Amaa gɔsima, li anɛ Wina'am pɛ'ɛli ba ya' nɛ bʋnsʋma. Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim pʋtɛn'ɛr pʋn bɛ nɛ li kɔn'.

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ‘Asida mɛnɛ, ba san'ami ti dataas la ka bugum dii ba mɔrim la wʋsa.’

english_verse: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
translation_verse: Siakim tis Wina'am ka paam sumbʋgʋsʋm; fʋ ya'a niŋ ala, o na niŋi fʋ zug yɛlsʋm.

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Di'em o pa'alʋg ka zaŋi li niŋi fʋ sʋʋnrin.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a fɛndigi lɛb Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la san'an na, o na lɛn lɛbisi fʋ, fʋ zin'ikʋdigin la. Fʋ ya'a yis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi fʋ yin

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: ka basi fʋ sanlimgbila la, lɔmmi fʋ sanlim sʋma la bas tampinyɔ'ɔdin,

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Fʋ na sɔs o, ka o na kɛlisi fʋ sɔsʋg ka fʋ na nɔki fʋ piini tis o wʋʋ fʋn pʋn zi'el nɔɔr si'em la.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a gban'e si'el wʋsa, li na zi'en ka nɛɛsim na nie fʋ suoya zan' ni.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Yɛla ya'a sigis nidib teŋin ka fʋ yɛl ye, ‘Wina'am, dʋ'ʋsimi ba!’ O sid na tiligi ba wʋsa.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Hali onɛ ka' bʋʋd la, o na faaɛn o bas, ka li anɛ fʋ nu'usi an nyain la yɛla.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Hali zina m nan kpɛn nyɔnnɛ nɛ sʋnpɛɛn; la'an nɛ din wʋmim ka m unsid la, Wina'am nan kpɛm mugusidim nɛ.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: M ya'a baŋin mam na nyɛɛ o zin'isi'a; ka paae o na'am zin'igin la!

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: M naan baŋin on na gandigi m yɛl la si'em, ka kɛlis on na yɛlim si'el.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: O na zaŋ o paŋ tita'ar la zab nɛ mam bɛɛ? Ayei, o na kɛlisi m pian'ad la.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: Amaa m ya'a keŋ ya-nya'aŋ, o ka' anii; m ya'a keŋ ya-tuona, m kʋ nyɛɛ o anii.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: O ya'a bɛ ya-datiuŋʋ tʋmmaa, m kʋ nyɛɛ o; o ya'a fɛndigi lɛb ya-dagɔbʋgɔ, m kʋ baŋ on bɛ si'ela.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Amaa on mi' suokanɛ ka man dɔl la; o ya'a ti makimi naae, m na nyɛɛn wʋʋ sanlim nɛ.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Man dɔl Wina'am suor la tituaa; m dɔl o nɔba ka pʋ bie lɛb gɔbʋg bɛɛ datiuŋɔ.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Nɛ wala wʋsa, on ma'aa an Wina'am ka sɔ' kae na ki'is oo bɛɛ na tun'e kɛ ka o bas on gban'e ye o tʋm si'em la.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: On gban'e ye o tʋm mam si'em la, linɛ bɛ. O mɛ mɔr gban'asieba man zug.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Amaa la'an nɛ wala, lik pʋ nyaŋi kɛ ka m fɔn baanlimm nɛ, hali baa di ya'a bɔɔd lin sɔbigim biridi si'em.”

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: Ka Job lɛn yɛl ye, “Wala ka Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la pʋ gban'e dabisbanɛ ka o na kad saria? Bɔzug ka banɛ dɔl o la zi' dabisbama nwa'?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Bugusim dim la tɔlisidi ba pɔɔd titɔndis, ka zuud kɔnbidi paasidi ba pɛ'ɛsin.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Ba kad kpiibis bʋmisi keŋ sa ka faaɛn pʋkɔɔnr lɔlig on pʋ nyaŋi yɔɔ o sam la zug.

english_verse: The poor are trampled and forced to hide
translation_verse: Ba da'ae nɔŋdimi yis suorin ka kad tadimnam ka ba zɔɔ su'a.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Nɔŋdaannam saadnɛ mɔɔgin ieed diib wʋʋ bʋmis nɛ; ba biis ginnɛ pipirisin ye ba nyɛ si'eli di.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Ba dɔlisidi nidib pɔɔdinɛ ki'ed kɔnbid yaama ka wi'isid zʋʋd pitɔɔg dim pɔɔdinɛ tisidi ba.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Ba dig yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ biel, ba pʋ mɔr dinɛ na pili ba mɛŋ waad saŋaa.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Ba bɛ nɛ zuoya zut ka saa bʋ'ʋdi ba ka ba zɔti ken tampiinsin ye ba labin ka li lusi ba.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Bugusim dim la pɔnsigid bibanɛ ka' saamnam la ba manam bin'isimin; ka faand nɔŋ dim biisi yɔɔd sama.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Fara dim la ginnɛ sawɛnya ban ka' fuud la zug ba bunnɛ kpan'am dim ki, ka lɛɛ ken kɔ'ɔm.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Ba tuod olif biili siligid kpaam ka maan bʋnnuuda ka ken nɛ ku'onuud.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Tempʋbɛda la ni nidib ʋʋnsidnɛ bɔɔd kum ka sieba pu'alim ka kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir amaa ka Wina'am ba'a kae nɛ baa.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Bɛog ya'a ti yɔe nier la, ninkʋʋd la duodnɛ kʋʋd nɔŋ dim nɛ tadimnam; ka yʋ'ʋŋ ka o an na'ayiigi giligid.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Pu'abɔɔd guri ye li sɔb, ka o zaŋ si'eli lus o nindaa ka tɛn'ɛs ye, ‘Sɔ' kʋ nyɛɛ ma.’

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ ka ba labisidi kpɛn'ɛd yaan, ka bɛog nie ka ba yɔɔ ba mɛŋ dɔɔgin; ka pʋ bɔɔd nɛɛsim baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Ba zaŋ lik biridi ka li an nɛɛsim tisi ba, ka lɛɛ zɔt nɛɛsim dabiem.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la nwɛnɛ pusinpuum ka ku'om diti ken sa; Wina'am nɔpɔɔr bɛɛ ba pɔɔd zug, alazug ka sɔ'ɔsɔ pʋ lɛn kennɛ ba pɔɔdin laa.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Nintaŋi nyɛligid sakuga si'em la, ala mɛn ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim na bɔdig dunia zug.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Ba manam pʋn tami ba yɛla nɛ ka zʋnzʋnya diti ba. Sɔ' pʋ lɛn tɛnr tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la yɛlaa, ba nwɛnɛ tiig ka sisi'em kɔ'ɔgi bas nɛ.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Ba mugusidi kʋnduada ka pʋ zɔt pʋkɔnya nimbaanliga.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Wina'am nɔkid o kpi'euŋʋ vɛ'ɛd paŋ dim la basid; la'an nɛ ban tɛn'ɛs ye ba mɔr paŋ la, ba vʋm bɛ nɛ Wina'am nu'ugin.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Wina'am kɛ ka ba bɛ nwɛnɛ yɛlsi'a pʋ paki baa, amaa o nini gɔti ba ken wʋsa.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Ba diti ya'an daba ayi', ka yʋ'ʋn sʋʋg wʋʋ mɔpuum nɛ, ba nwaadi ba nɛ nwɛnɛ ki ka ba bʋn si'em la.

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Paŋ nɛ dabiem wʋsa anɛ Wina'am din; o kɛ ka sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛ saazug.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e kaal o zabzabidib la? Yaanɛ ka Wina'am nɛɛsim la pʋ paae?

english_verse: How can anyone be innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: Ninsaal na niŋ wala an pʋpiel Wina'am tuonnɛ? Ninsaal biig na niŋ wala pʋ mɔr taal Wina'am tuonnɛ?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Nwadig nɛ nwadbibis nɛɛsim ya'a an zaalim o nini ni,

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: ka ninsaal onɛ nwɛnɛ titan bɛɛ zʋnzʋnr Wina'am nifin la na an wala?”

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: “Waii, gɔsim fʋn sʋŋ ninkanɛ ka' sʋŋid si'em! Gɔsim sʋŋ kanɛ ka fʋ sʋŋ tadim nwa'!

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Waii, gɔsim fʋn sa'al ninkanɛ ka' ya'am si'em! Waii, fʋ sid pa'al ye fʋ mɔr ya'am pamm!

english_verse: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn kimm lɛɛ sʋ'ʋŋif ka fʋ pian' anwana? Anɔ'ɔnɛ tisif pʋtɛn'ɛr ka fʋ pian' pian'abama?

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Gɔsim kpi'imnam banɛ bɛ teŋin nɛ ku'om pʋʋgin la, ba wʋsa kiridnɛ nɛ dabietita'ar.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Hali kpi'im teŋ gba pʋ su'ad nɛ Wina'am; li wʋsa nie nɛ nyain o nini ni.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Wina'am yadig saŋgbauŋ la ya-datiuŋ, ka maal teŋgbauŋ la ka li yul ka si'el pʋ mɔri li.

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: Onɛ kɛ ka saŋgbana la pɛ'ɛl nɛ ku'om ka lɛɛ kʋ tɛbigi tansi li naa.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: O tiɛnd o saŋgbana la libin nwadpielig.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: O buoɛn atɛukʋn la ka li mɔr bɛn-bɛn ka li bɛŋ nɛɛsim nɛ lik.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Wina'am ya'a tans, zan'antɔlis banɛ ti'e saŋgbauŋ la dammidnɛ nɛ dabiem.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Wina'am zaŋ nɛ o paŋ tita'ar la nyaŋ Atɛuk; ka zaŋ o ya'am aans bʋnzɔtir linɛ bɛ ku'otita'arinɛ buon Rahab la.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Wina'am vʋ'ʋsʋm kɛ ka agɔl nie nyain; ka o nu'ug kʋns wa'akanɛ ian'ad ka nwɛɛlimɛ o mɛŋ hali la.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Gɔsima, nwa' wʋsa anɛ Wina'am tʋʋma bi'ela la, ban nya'am yɛl ka ti wʋm si'eli nwa'! Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e baŋ o paŋ la an si'em?”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “M pɔya nɛ Wina'am, onɛ mɔŋim bʋʋd la, Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb ka kɛ ka m bɛllim lieb tɔɔg la,

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: M kʋ maligim siak ye yanamɛ yɛt si'el la anɛ sidaa, hali baa kʋnya bɔkinɛ, m kʋ yɛl ye m ka' sida sɔba.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: Wina'am na namisi m dataas nɛ banɛ kisim la nwɛnɛ on namisid nimbɛ'ɛdnam si'em la.

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Ti'ir bɔ ka onɛ pʋ zɔt Wina'am mɔr saŋa kanɛ ka Wina'am di'e o nyɔvʋrɛ?

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Yɛltɔɔd ya'a ti paae o ka o kaasida, Wina'am na wʋm o kukumaa?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: O na nyɛ sumalisim Wina'am san'anɛɛ? O pʋn na sɔs Wina'am ʋʋn?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: M na pa'ali ya Wina'am paŋi zem si'em; m kʋ su'a ya Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la yɛlaa.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Ya wʋsa pʋn nyɛ linɛ naam wʋsa; ka bɔzug ka ya pian'ad pian'ayɛɛd bama?

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: Wina'am gban'e ye o tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb nɛ pitɔɔg dim si'em nwa':

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: hali baa o biis ya'a zu'oe si'em, ba wʋsa ye ba kpinɛ zaba ni; o yaas kʋ maligim di ka li sia'ali baa.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Ban'as na kʋʋ o bibanɛ pɔns zaba ni la hali ka ba pʋkɔnya kʋ kaasi ba kʋʋrɛ.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd daan ya'a bɔɔd on vaae anzurifa su'a si'em, hali ka mɔr fuud ka li galis si'em,

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: pʋpielim sɔb na yɛ fuud la wʋsa; ka onɛ ka' taal mɛ di'e anzurifa la.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Yir kanɛ ka o mɛɛd la nwɛnɛ silinsi'ipaanlʋŋ nɛ, bɛɛ sʋgʋr ka ba ti' gur pɔɔg.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: O dig nɛ kpan'am zug, amaa ka kʋ maligim bɛɛ ala, o nif aŋir ka li pʋn gaad sa.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: O yam na iank wʋʋ ku'om ɛɛn di nid ka li an si'em la; ka sisi'etita'ar zii o yʋ'ʋn gaad.

english_verse: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.
translation_verse: On mɔɔd ye o zɔɔ yi sisi'emin la li na nwɛ' o yutim-yutim ka nimbaanlig kae.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Sisi'em la vuud nɛ paŋ tita'ar hali kpɛn'ɛsid o dabiem ka kad o yis o bɛllim zin'igin la.”

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Ba tuud kʋnti yisid teŋin na, ka nyu'od kuga yisid kʋntzɛn'ug.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Sanlim tuudib mɔri bugum kpɛn'ɛd sanlimbɔkin; ba tuudi paad zin'ibanɛ an lik biridi wʋsa ieed sanlima.

english_verse: They dig tunnels in distant, unknown places, where they dangle by ropes.
translation_verse: Ba ɛɛn gɔsnɛ nidibi kae zin'isi'a la tu vɔndʋg hali ka li zulim ka zaŋ nwiigi lɔɔ dɔlisi sigi bɛɛ anina ba kɔn'ɔkɔn'.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Zʋʋd yitnɛ teŋgbauŋ zugin, ka li teŋir-teŋir sa nwɛnɛ bugum dii kanb nɛ.

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Niiŋ kae mi' zin'ig la, ka silʋg nif mɛ nan zi' nyɛɛ li.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid pʋn pʋ nɔɔdi ba nɔba anii, ka gbigim gba pʋ dɔl ani gata.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Saalib tuudnɛ hali nwa'ad tampinkpi'ema; ba tuudi zuoya hali paadi ba teŋir.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Ba tuudnɛ ka nyaad vɔnya tampiinsin la, ka nyɛt kugvɛnla nɛ linɛ ligidi zu'oe la wʋsa.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Ba ieedi baŋid kɔldaadi pin'il si'el na, ka mɔr dinɛ wʋsa su'a yi nɛɛsimin na.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Ku'otitada nɛ Atɛuk yɛl ye, ‘Ya'am kae tinam san'anɛ.’

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Fʋ kʋ nyaŋi da' ya'am nɛ sanlim vɛnliŋ, bɛɛ zaŋi li mak nɛ anzurifaa.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Fʋ kʋ nyaŋi zaŋ sanlima bɛɛ gɔtiŋvɛnla mak nɛ lii, bɛɛ da' li nɛ sanlima niŋgɔnkɔrisɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Kugpielvɛnla nɛ li buudi mɛ pʋ li'eli lii; bɔzugɔ ya'am gaad si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Kus teŋ kugvɛnla linɛ an dɔnbʋʋlim la kʋ nyaŋi mak nɛ lii; fʋ mɛ kʋ nyaŋi da' li nɛ sanlimaa.

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Li su'anɛ ka bʋnvʋr kae na tun'e nyɛɛ li, hali niis banɛ ian'ad agɔla nan zi' lin bɛ si'ela.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Hali Asan'auŋ nɛ Kpi'im Teŋ yɛl ye; ‘Tinam mɛ kʋdim wʋmnɛ nɛ tʋba.’

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Wina'am ma'aa mi' ya'am suor, ka mɛ mi' lin bɛ zin'isi'a.

english_verse: he alone sees everything beneath the heavens.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, onɛ gɔsidi nyɛt teŋ-magbinnin ka mɛ nyɛt dinɛ niŋid teŋgbauŋ zug wʋsa.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Onɛ da maal pɛbisim nɛ li paŋ wʋsa, ka mak ku'okanɛ bɛ saŋgbana ni la zem si'em,

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: ka tis saa nɔɔr lin na ni si'em ka maal suori tis satansʋg.

english_verse: he also determined the truth and defined wisdom.
translation_verse: O da gɔs ya'am sʋ'ʋŋa ka siak ye li an sʋ'ʋm pamm.

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Ka yɛl saalib ye, ‘Nid ya'a bɔɔd ya'am, on zɔm Wina'am, o ya'a bɔɔd baŋir on zɔm yi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin tɔ'ɔtɔ.’”

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: “Waii, man ya'a nan kpɛn aan wʋʋ man da bɛ si'em saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am da gɔsidim sʋ'ʋŋa la,

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: ka o fitir la nie m zugin lauu ka m kennɛ o nɛɛsimin la!

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: Saŋkan ka man da nan bɛɛ m naŋnaŋin ka Wina'am onɛ aan m zua la gur man nɛ m yidim la.

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: saŋkan la ka m mɔrim galis hali ka kpaam kpa'adi yit tampiinsin na olif kpaam nɛ tisidim.

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnam ya'a da ɛɛnti la'as ka m kena zin'inɛɛ,

english_verse: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
translation_verse: Hali burikinnam da ɛɛn fɔnnɛ baanlimm nwɛnɛ ba sɛɛn ba nɔya nɛ.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, nɔŋ dim ya'a da kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir, m sʋŋidi ba hali nɛ kpiibis banɛ ka' sʋŋida.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka li da wʋmi ba hali ka ba wʋm kum nyuug la da kaanb kaanbsʋŋɔ tisim; m mɛ da sʋŋ pʋkɔnya ka ba sʋnya ma'ae.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: M da yɛ pʋpielim nwɛnɛ fuug nɛ, ka pid sida nwɛnɛ zupibig nɛ.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Manɛ da an zʋnzɔɔs nini nɛ pɔnda nɔba.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Manɛ da an tadimnam saam; ka di'e saam yɛla zi.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: M da kɔ' bugusim dim nu'us ka faaɛn banɛ ka ba gban'e ba la bas.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: M da tɛn'ɛs ye, ‘M na yuug hali pamm, ka nyaan kpii m mɛŋ yin.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: M da nwɛnɛ tikanɛ nya'a bɛ ku'omin saŋa wʋsa ka o vaand pɛ'ɛl nɛ mɛligim.

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: M ya'a da ya'ae nɔɔr ye m sa'al nidib, ba anɛ ki' ka kɛlisid nɛ ya'amlɛog.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Ba da ɛɛn gur nɛ ya'amlɛog ye ba wʋmi m pian'ad wʋʋ kpaadi gur sigsaa si'em la.

english_verse: and the smile on my face renewed everyone's hopes.
translation_verse: M ya'a da lɔdigi m nindaa tisi ba, ba sʋʋnr ɛɛn kpɛ'ɛŋnɛ.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Manɛ da gban'adi ba gban'ar wʋsa tisidi ba ka gaadi ba tuon wʋʋ na'abi gat o zabzabidib tuon si'em la, ka bɛlisidi ba saŋkanɛ ka ba bɛ mugusʋg pʋʋgin wʋsa.”

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: Job da lɛn yɛl ye, “Amaa nannanna nwa' ba la'ad mam nɛ, hali na'akim baanlʋg banɛ an bɛɛga-bɛɛga biis, ka man da pʋ siakid ye ba saamnam dɔlli m baasi gur kɔnbid la.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Ba da tadignɛ hali ka ka' paŋi na tʋmi m tʋʋmaa tisidi ma.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Nɔŋ nɛ kɔ'ɔm da mɔri ba hali ka ba gʋ'ʋŋi ɔnbid tiis nya'a, ka yʋ'ʋŋ ka ba gɔɔndi gin mɔɔgin nɛ pipirisin.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Ba da vɔɔndnɛ tutuud pipirisin ɔnbid hali ka la'am ɔnbid nya'a banɛ pʋ mɔr mimilimm.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Nidib da kadi ba nɛ yis saalibi bɛ zin'isi'a, ka wuunnɛ ba wʋʋ ba anɛ na'ayiis nɛ.

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: Ba da bɛ nɛ mɔɔgin kaasid wʋʋ bʋnkɔnbid nɛ ka la'asi kʋk taaba dig mɔɔgin.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Ba da anɛ banɛ ka' vɔɔnrɛ ka sɔ' mɛ zi' ba yɛlaa, ba da nɔk kpa'asa kadi ba yis teŋin la.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna ba biis gɔs mam nɛ zaalim ka mɔri m yʋ'ʋri yʋ'ʋm; m pʋ lɛm mɔr vɔɔnri tisi baa.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ'ɛsid man nɛ ka pʋ bɔɔd ye ba li'eli ma; ka tʋbisid nintɔɔndi mat man nindaa.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Wina'am kɛ ka m lieb tadim ka ka' sʋŋid la zug, ka nidib mɔrimi niŋid bam bɔɔd si'el.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Ba la'as nɛ m datiuŋ baba gubigim; ba tunɛ bʋmbu'adi m nɔba baba; ka gban'e ye ba zab nɛ m.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Ba vi' m suori lɛbis ka mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm ka sɔ' kae na faaɛn ma.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Dabiem kɛ ka m pabig. M burikinnim la wʋsa gaadi nwɛnɛ sisi'em nɛ, ka m mɔrim la mɛlim wʋʋ saŋgbana nɛ.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: Nannanna nwa' mam vʋm paadi li bɛn; m namisʋg la dabisa ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa m kɔnba nwa'adnɛ hali ka m niŋgbina zabid ka pʋ ma'ada.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Wina'am zaŋ nɛ o paŋ tita'ar la gban'e m niŋgɔɔnri siank wʋʋ fuug niŋgɔɔnri muknɛ.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: O zaŋimnɛ lɔbi bas bian'arin, ka m yʋ'ʋn lieb wʋʋ titan nɛ tampɛligim.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: M Wina'am, man kaasi buolif, ka fʋ pʋ gandigi ma; ka m duoe zi'en ka fʋ gɔsidim ka pʋ yɛl si'ela.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Mam mi' ye fʋ na ba'asi kʋʋm, ka m keŋ saalib wʋsa naad zin'isi'a la.

english_verse: No one refuses help to others, when disaster strikes.
translation_verse: Sɔ' nan zi' namis ninkanɛ bɛ tɔɔg pʋʋgin ka buon ye ba kena faaɛn o basɛ.

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Amaa mam mɛ ya'a ti tɛn'ɛs ye sʋ'ʋm na kena la, bɛ'ɛdi kenna; m ya'a ti tɛn'ɛs ye nɛɛsim na kena la, liki kenna.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: M sʋʋnr san'amnɛ hali ka ka' ma'arɛ; namisʋg bɛɛ m zugin daar wʋsa.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: M gɛnnɛ nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ka onɛ bɛlisidim kae. M duoe zi'en wʋrʋginɛ nwɛ' kuŋ ye ba sʋŋim.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: M yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ zaŋku'ar sizua, ka an viiug bɛllim taa.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: M niŋgbiŋ wʋsa sɔbig nɛ hali ka tʋligi nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: Ka Job da lɛn yɛl ye, “Mam pɔ nɛ ye m kʋ zaŋi m nini gɔs pu'asadir nɛ yamlɛogɔ.

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Li ka'anɛ san'auŋ ma'aa ka o tisid nimbɛ'ɛdnam, ka kɛt ka banɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd ba'asid yɔri?

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: O pʋ nyɛt mam bɛ bɛllim si'aa, hali ka mi' m nɔba yakir kallɛɛ?

english_verse: and I beg God to prove my innocence.
translation_verse: Wina'am on makim tituaa nɛ sida makir ka o na nyɛ ka m ka' gba'arɛ.

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: Wina'am on kɛl ka m pɔɔg zʋʋd san'am, bɛɛ o kɛ ka sieba dii m diib la ka basim.

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: M ya'amlɛog ya'a kpɛn' nɛ sɔ' pu'a bɛɛ m ya'a digin nɛ m yak pu'a,

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: Wina'am on kɛl ka mam mɛŋ pu'a mɔnnɛ tisid dau zʋŋ, ka dap mɔr o digi.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Nid ya'a tʋm tʋʋmfɛn'ɛsa bama buudi, li nar ye ba kʋʋs o daana bɛ'ɛd ka tɛk o tʋbir.

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: Li na nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ diimɛ paae kpi'im teŋ ka na di mam nɛ m mɔrim wʋsa.

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: Wina'am sʋnf ya'a ti duoe nɛ ma, m na niŋ wala? O ya'a ti bu'osim bu'osa m na niŋ wala gandigɛ?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Ka' Wina'am kanɛ maal man la mɛ maali baa? Ɛɛn! Onɛ sid maali ti wʋsa ti manam pʋʋsin.

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: M da diti m kɔn' ka zan'as ye m kʋ sʋŋ kpiibisɛɛ?

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, m na'akinnimin sa, m gɔsi ba wʋʋ m mɛŋ-mɛŋ biis nɛ, m biilimin sa m ba'a bɛnɛ pʋkɔnya yɛla.

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: M nan mi' vɔlis kpiibig mam mɔr suobanɛ na tisim bʋʋd na'ayin la zugɔɔ? Ayei!

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: M ya'a tʋm ala, m biaunk on aam li, ka m nu'ug kɔ'ɔgi li sʋn'urin la.

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Man zɔt ye Wina'am na san'amim la zug m pʋn kʋ siaki tʋm nɛ'ɛŋaa.

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: bɛɛ nwɛ'ɛdin nyɔ'ɔgʋ m mɔrim zug, bɛɛ man tʋm paam si'el zug,

english_verse: worshiped the sun or moon.
translation_verse: ka m ya'am kpɛn' ba ka m pin'ili pʋ'ʋsidi ba,

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: M dataa ya'a daa namisid, m daa pʋ maan sumalisim, bɛɛ o bɛ yɛla ni ka li ma'ae m sʋʋnrɛ,

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: m pʋ pɔ nɔɔri niŋ o ka li kɛ ka m kpɛn' taalinɛ.

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: Mam pʋ su'a m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋʋ sieba niŋid si'em la.

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: Mam pʋ zɔt nidibi na pian' m yɛla si'em. M mɛ pʋ zɔt ye m yidim na diisim nyan ka linzug kɛ ka m fɔn baanlimm ka kʋ yi yiŋa.

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: Asida mɛnɛ, m na zaŋi li buki m biankimpiiung zug. M na pidi li nwɛnɛ na'am zupibig nɛ.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: M na yɛl Wina'am man tʋm si'el wʋsa, ka ʋki m zug agɔla o tuon.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: M ya'a zuun pɔɔg kanɛ ka m kuod la bɛɛ faaɛn li yi o daana nu'ugin, li na kaasi pa'al ye m tʋm taal.

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: M ya'a di pɔɔg la zʋʋd ka kɛ ka banɛ kua kuob la kpiid kɔ'ɔm,

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: Wina'am on kɛl ka m ya'a bʋd ki nɛ mui, mɔɔd nɛ gɔn'ɔs ma'aa on yim.” Job antu'a naarɛ la.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Nidib atan' nwa' da pʋ lɛm pian' Job si'ela bɔzugɔ o da tɛn'ɛs ye o pʋ mɔr gbɛlʋŋɔ.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: O sʋʋnr mɛ da pɛlig nɛ Job zuanama atan' la bɔzugɔ ban da pʋ nyaŋi pa'al o gbɛlʋŋʋ an si'ela, ka li kɛ ka li nwɛnɛ Wina'am ka' bʋʋd la.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Job zuanama atan' la da an kpɛɛmnam ka Elihu an biigi ba sʋʋgin la zug, o da sinnɛ baanlimm ka ba pian'ad.

english_verse: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
translation_verse: Amaa on da nyɛ ka ba fɔn ka pʋ lɛbisid Job ya'as la, o sʋʋnr da pɛlignɛ.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: Ka Elihu onɛ an Barakɛl biig ka yi Buz teŋin na la yɛl ye; “Yanamɛ an kpɛɛmnam ka man an biigi ya sʋʋgin la zug ka m gi'igi ya ka pʋ lɛbisi m nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: M tɛn'ɛs ye, ‘Zuobpielim na pian'ad nɛ ya'am ka ayʋma-zu'oya mɛ an baŋir.’

english_verse: Age is no guarantee of wisdom and understanding.
translation_verse: Li ka' banɛ kʋdig ma'aa mɔr ya'am bɛɛ mi' linɛ an sidaa.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: Alazug ka m yɛl ye, Kɛlisimi mam mɛ mɔr kʋkɔsi'a ye m lɛbis ka mam mɛ na yɛli ya mam mi' si'el.

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: Amaa Job pʋ pian' tisi ma, alazugɔ m kʋ gandig o wʋʋ yanamɛ lɛbis o si'em laa.”

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: Ka Elihu yʋ'ʋn yɛl ye, “Li nyaŋi ba nɛ ka ba zi' ban na lɛn lɛbisif si'ela; ba nɔɔr lɛbnɛ biaunkin.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: Ban sadigim fɔn ka zi' ban na lɛbis o si'em la, m kpɛm mɔdigi sinnaa?

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, pian'ad pamm bɛɛ m sʋʋnrin, ka m zig ye m mɔdigi gʋ'ʋŋ.

english_verse: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst
translation_verse: M sʋʋnr pɛ'ɛli nɛ pian'ad nwɛnɛ daam na pɛ'ɛl yʋʋr hali bɔɔd fudigir si'em la.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: M kʋ pian' baregaŋ pian'ad bɛɛ m pian' dʋ'ʋs sɔ'ɔɔ.

english_verse: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!
translation_verse: M ya'a mi'in baregaŋ pian'ad, Wina'am onɛ maalim la naan san'aminim.”

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Wina'am Siig la maal mam; Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la vʋ'ʋsʋm kɛ ka m vʋe.

english_verse: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a na nyaŋ, fʋn gandigim; ti'ebim sʋ'ʋŋa, ka ti gandis taaba.

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Man nɛ fʋ anɛ yinne Wina'am tuon; ba mɛ nɔk nɛ ya'adi maalim.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
