translation_verse: Da kɛ ka man yɛla kpɛn'ɛsif dabiem, bɛɛ tɛn'ɛs ye m na mugusif halii.

english_verse: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.
translation_verse: ‘M anɛ nyain ka pʋ mɔr tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ; m anɛ nyain ka ka' taalɛ.

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, Wina'am ye m tʋm taal; o zaŋim ka m lieb o dataa.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: O gbarim nɛ bana; ka man ken zin'isi'a wʋsa ka o gɔsidim.’

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: Amaa m yɛtif ye fʋ ka' bʋʋd nɛ'ɛŋa nwa' nii, bɔzugɔ, Wina'am gat saal woo.

english_verse: So why do you challenge God to answer you?
translation_verse: Bɔ kimm ka fʋ nyɔn ye o pʋ gandigid ninsaal bu'osa wʋsa?

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Wina'am ɛɛn pian'anɛ pian'ad kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb, amaa ka saal pʋ gban'adi li gbinnɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes in the night, he uses terrifying dreams
translation_verse: Saalib ya'a ɛɛn gbisid yʋ'ʋŋ la, saŋkan la ka Wina'am nied yɛla pa'annɛ ba zaansʋŋ pʋʋgin.

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: Linɛ na kɛ ka ba bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka gu'usid nɛ ba dʋ'ʋsi-m-mɛŋ wʋsa ni.

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ala ka o na gu' ba ka ba kʋ kpii, bɛɛ ba sig kpi'im teŋa.

english_verse: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
translation_verse: Wina'am mɛ tun'e digil nid nɛ ban'as hali ka li wʋm o sʋ'ʋŋa, ka zabid o hali.

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: Ani ka o yaama yinɛ diib, ka diib ya'a pʋn malis si'em o pʋ bɔɔda.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: Ka o waŋim hali naae, ka kpɛlim kɔnbdaad ma'aa.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: Saŋkan ka o yʋ'ʋn li'el yaʋg, ka o nyɔvʋr bɛ Akum nu'usin.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala maliaknam tusa si'em la ni yinne ya'a zi'en o nɔba zugʋ aan o nu'unwɛ'ɛd, ka yɛl niŋkan sɔb linɛ nar,

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: ka zɔɔ o nimbaanlig ka yɛl ye, ‘Da kɛ ka o ba'as yaʋgʋnɛɛ; bɔzugɔ m yɔɔ o sam.’

english_verse: Our health is restored, we feel young again,
translation_verse: Ala ka o niŋgbina na lɛn kpɛ'ɛŋ; ka o lieb nwɛnɛ on da an dasaŋ la.

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: Ka o ya'a sɔs Wina'am o na zɔɔ o nimbaanlig, o na nyɛ Wina'am nindaa ka maal sumalisim pamm; ka Wina'am lɛbis o zi'el bɛllim sʋŋin.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: Ka o zi'en nidib tuon ka yʋ'ʋm yɛl ye, ‘Man da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka niŋ linɛ pʋ nara, amaa ba daa pʋ tɛki m tʋbir wʋʋ lin nar si'em.

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: O faanm siig ka m pʋ kpii, ka m na bɛ nɛɛsimin vʋe nɛ sumalisim.’

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: Wina'am sid tʋmnɛ anwa saŋa pamm tisid saalib;

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: ka faandi ba yisid kumin ka kɛt ka vʋm nɛɛsim niedi ba san'an.

english_verse: So, Job, pay attention and don't interrupt,
translation_verse: Job, an baanlimm ka wʋm; kɛlisimi m pian'ad la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a mɔr lɛbisʋg, fʋn lɛbisim. Pian'am ka m bɔɔd ye fʋ nyɛnɛ bʋʋd.

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: “Wʋmminɛ m pian'ad, yanam banɛ an ya'am dima; kɛlisimi, yanam banɛ zamis ka mɔr mi'ilim hali la.

english_verse: Think about my words, as you would taste food.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, tʋbiri wɛligid pian'ad wʋʋ zilimi lɛmmid diib si'em la.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ti mɛŋ-mɛŋ kpansi baŋ linɛ an sida; kɛlli ka ti zamisi baŋ linɛ an sʋm.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Job yɛl ye, man ka' taalɛ: ‘Amaa Wina'am pʋ tisim m bʋʋdɛ.

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ man mɔr sida la, o ye m anɛ ziri sɔb; la'an nɛ mam pʋ tʋm taal la, o pu'alimim bɛ'ɛd bɛ'ɛdi.’

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ o yɛt ye, ‘Ninsaal ya'a bɔɔd on ma'am Wina'am sʋnf si'em ka o kʋ dii li nyɔɔdɛ.’

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, kɛlisimi sʋ'ʋŋa yanam banɛ an ya'am dim la. Wina'am kʋ maligin tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la kʋ niŋ linɛ pʋ nara.

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ tis Wina'am suor ka o sʋ'oe teŋgbauŋ la? Bɛɛ anɔ'ɔnɛ da kɛ ka o sʋ'ʋg dunia nwa' wʋsa?

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Wina'am ya'a gban'anɛ o pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye o vaae o siig nɛ o vʋm lɛbis o mɛŋ ni,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: ninsaalib wʋsa naan mɛlimin; ba naan lɛbin tintannin.

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ kis yɛlsida na tun'e an na'aba? Ka fʋ na tun'e zɛrig Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb ka an sida daan nɛ paŋ sɔb laa?

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: O pʋ kpɛn'ɛd kpɛɛmnam zug bɛɛ gɔs ka kpan'am dim gat nɔŋ dima; bɔzugɔ, onɛ maali ba wʋsa.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Ba tun'e kpi yʋ'ʋŋ tisʋʋs nif aŋir pʋʋgin; Wina'am kɛt ka saalib kpiid vuguri, ka yisid kpi'euŋ dimi ba kpi'euŋ zin'igin ka li pʋ tɔiya.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Lik zin'ig bɛɛ su'asir kae ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim na tun'e su'aa.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: Li ka' tilas ye Wina'am dɛŋin gban'e zi'el saŋkanɛ ka o na kad saalib sariaa.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: O ya'amin ka o yisid kpi'euŋ dimi ba zin'isin ka pʋ vɛɛnsida ka kɛ ka sieba di'e ba zin'ig.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: On mi' ba tʋʋma la zug ka o yisidi ba yʋ'ʋŋ vuguri, ka ba yɛla wʋsa naae.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: Saalib nini ni ka o bʋ'ʋdi ba ban tʋm taal la zug.

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Ba namisid nɔŋ dim ka ba kaasid ka li tuak Wina'am sʋnfʋn.

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: ka na gu' ka bugusim sɔb kʋ di na'am ka bɛnd saalibi kpɛn'ɛsi ba mɔɔgɔ.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: Amaa nid ya'a yɛl Wina'am ye, ‘M tʋm taal, m kʋ lɛm pɔ'ɔgi fɔ.

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: M ya'a tʋm taal ka zi', fʋn pa'alimim ka m kʋ lɛm paasɛ.’

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: Fʋn sadigim ki'is Wina'am nɔɔr la, fʋ tɛn'ɛs ka o na tisif fʋn bɔɔd si'elaa? Fʋnɛ na baŋi li, ka ka' manɛ; dinzug, yɛlim fʋn gban'e si'em.

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: Job pian'adnɛ ya'am ka'alʋg pian'ad; o pian'ad la pʋn ka' vɔɔnrɛ.

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a kpans Job pian'ad ka gɔsi li kii, fʋ na baŋ ye li anɛ sida ye o sid anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb.

english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: Li kas-kas anɛ on tʋm bɛ'ɛd ka lɛn ki'is Wina'am nɔɔr la, ka zi'e ti tuonnɛ pian'adi takidi maligim tukid Wina'am sʋnf.”

english_verse: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: “Fʋ tɛn'ɛs ka nɛ'ɛŋa dɔl suorɛɛ? Fʋ yɛt ye, ‘Wina'am na tisim bʋʋd.’

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: Tɔ', m na gandig fʋn nɛ fʋ zuanam nwa' wʋsa.

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Ka fʋ ya'a tʋm pʋpielim, li paasid o bɔ, bɛɛ bɔ ka Wina'am bɔɔdi fʋ san'anɛ?

english_verse: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la namisidnɛ fʋ saal taaba ma'aa, ka fʋ pʋpielim tʋʋma mɛ sʋŋidi ninsaalib gʋllim.

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a mugus saalib, ba kaasidnɛ ka sɔsid yɔlisim banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ la ni.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' pʋ bu'osid ye, ‘M Wina'am onɛ maalim la bɛ yaa? Onɛ tisidim yʋʋma ye m yʋ'ʋm yʋ'ʋŋ la bɛ yaanɛ?

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Saalib ya'a kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir, o pʋ gandigida, ka li anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim nyɛɛsim la zug.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Wina'am pʋ kɛlisidi ba fabilyɛɛd la; Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la ba'a pʋn kae nɛ baa.

english_verse: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.
translation_verse: Fʋ tɛn'ɛs ye Wina'am sʋnf pʋ duodaa, ka lɛn yɛl ye o ba'a kae nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dimi tʋm si'ela.

english_verse: Everything you have said adds up to nonsense.
translation_verse: Alazug ka Job ya'ae o nɔɔrɛ pian'ad pian'ayɛɛd, ka pʋn zi' on yɛt si'ela.”

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: “Ma'ami fʋ mɛŋ bi'ela nwa' ka m naae Wina'am mɔr si'el ye m yɛlif la.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: O pʋ kɛt ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim nyɔvʋr wa'ama, ka lɛɛ tisid banɛ namisid la bʋʋd.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Wina'am pʋ yisid o nif pʋpielim dim nii; o dʋ'ʋsidi ba ka ba zin' nɛ na'anam, ka kɛt ka ba an girima dim saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Amaa ba ya'a ti lɔ saalib nɛ bana, ka ba bɛ namistita'ar pʋʋgin,

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Amaa ba ya'a zan'as ka pʋ kɛlisɛ, ba na kʋʋ ba nɛ zaba sʋ'ʋs, ka ba kpi yɔri-yɔri.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: Banɛ pʋ niŋ Wina'am yadda la mɔri sʋnpɛɛn saŋa wʋsa, hali o ya'a ba'a ba nɛ bana, ba kʋ sɔs o ka o sʋŋi baa.

english_verse: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
translation_verse: Wina'am dɔlisidnɛ namisʋg pʋʋgin faand banɛ bɛ namisʋgʋn la, namisʋg saŋa ka o pa'annɛ ba ya'am.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Wina'am mɔrif nɛ baanlimm yis yɛla ni na, ka mɔri fʋ keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka yɛlpakir kae, ka li anɛ diib nɛ nuub ma'aa.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna fʋ di'e sariakadib linɛ nar nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la, sariakadib linɛ an yɛlsida la na gban'af.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Gu'usim ka da kɛ ka sɔ' pan'asif nɛ o mɔrimm; da kɛ ka ba zaŋ kpan'am kpɛn'ɛsif mɔɔgɔ.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Fʋ tɛn'ɛs ye fʋ mɔrim bɛɛ fʋ mɛŋ-mɛŋ paŋ na nyaŋi yisif yɛla nii?

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Da mɔr ti'ir ye yʋ'ʋŋ sɔb ka fʋ vɛ' nidibi yisi ba, ba yaanɛ.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ lɛb tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin; fʋ namisʋg la anɛ li gu'uf ka fʋ da lɛb tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdinɛ.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Gɔsima, Wina'am paŋ la ka' tiraana. Anɔ'ɔnɛ an pa'annɛ nwɛnɛ on an si'em la?

english_verse: to guide or correct him. Others Have Praised God
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e pa'al o linɛ nara bɛɛ yɛl o ye, ‘Fʋ gbɛlig ya!’

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Tiɛnm ka zun'e o nu'ugʋ tʋm si'el la linɛ ka saalib yʋ'ʋm ka pian'ad saŋa wʋsa la.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa nyɛ Wina'am tʋʋma la; amaa ba nyɛɛ li nɛ lalli sa.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Ya'a an sida, Wina'am galis nɛ hali ka ti kʋ nyaŋi baŋ on zem si'em! O yʋma ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: God gathers moisture into the clouds
translation_verse: Onɛ kɛt ka ku'om yit teŋgbauŋ zugʋ dʋt agɔla kilim saa niid.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e baŋ on niŋ si'em yadigid saŋgbana la, bɛɛ satansʋg la tansidi dammidi yit agɔl zin'ikanɛ ka o bɛ la?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Gɔsim on kɛ ka saa iank agɔl pililili si'em, ka atɛuk pʋʋgin lɛɛ an lik biridi.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: On gur buudi wʋsa si'em nwa'. O kɛt ka saa niid ka zʋʋd maan, ka saalib nyɛt diib bɛdegʋ dit.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Onɛ mɔr sa-ian'asʋg la paŋ ka on bɔɔd ye li kpa' zin'isi'a la, ani ka li ken.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Saa ya'a ti tans, li pa'an ye sisi'etita'ari na dɔl; hali niigi mɛ mi' ye li kenna.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi, kɛlisim on tansid si'em ka wʋm o nɔɔri pian'ad ka li dammid si'em.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: O kɛ ka saa iank agɔla hali ti tiig zin'ig wʋsa.

english_verse: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.
translation_verse: Wina'am tansʋg mɔr nyalima. O tʋm tʋʋm titada ka ti kʋ nyaŋi gban'e li gbinnɛ.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Wina'am vʋ'ʋsʋm kɛtnɛ ka ku'om ga'aŋ nwɛnɛ kugir nɛ hali ka ku'otitada lieb wʋʋ tampiing nɛ.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: O kɛt ka saŋgbana pɛ'ɛl nɛ ku'om, ka kɛt ka saa ian'asid pil-pil saŋgbana la ni.

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: O tun'e tʋm saa na ka li namis saalibi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug, ka mɛ tun'e kɛ ka saa nii maal zʋʋd ka li pa'al on an sʋ'ʋm si'em.

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: Job, kɛlisim nɛ'ɛŋa sʋ'ʋŋa; an baanlimm ka gɔs Wina'am tʋʋmnyalima an si'em.

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Fʋ mi' lin niŋ si'em ka saŋgbana yul agɔlaa, li ka'anɛ Wina'am tʋʋmnyalimaa?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Fʋn kanɛ ka pɛbistʋʋlʋg ya'a ɛɛn naan ya-dagɔbʋg na ka ɔnsir di'e fʋ fuug matti la

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: na tun'e sʋŋ Wina'am yadig saŋgbauŋ, ka kɛ ka li kpi'em ka ian'ad nwɛnɛ gɔtiŋɔɔ?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: Pa'alimi ti tinamɛ na yɛl Wina'am si'el; bɔzugɔ ti nɔɔr kpari ka ti zi' tinamɛ na yɛl o si'ela, ka li anɛ tinamɛ bɛ likin biridi la yɛla.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Man kʋ siak ye m pian' tis Wina'am; bɔ ka m kɛt ka o ti san'amidim yɔri-yɔri?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kae na tun'e gɔs winnig linɛ nie nyain saŋgbauŋin la. Li kas-kas anɛ sisi'em ya'a ti da'ae ka pɛbisim la pie uusʋg la ka li maligim nie nyain.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: O naan ya-datiuŋʋ kenna ka ian'asid pil-pil wʋʋ sanlim nɛ; Wina'am la kenna nɛ o na'am pipilim.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Alazug ka saalib woo na'asid o. O mɛ pʋm pʋ gɔsi nyɛ banɛ ye ba anɛ ya'am dim laa.”

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la naan sisi'etita'arin la lɛbis Job ye,

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: “Fʋ aan anɔ'ɔnɛ bi'esid ya'am pian'ad nɛ pian'ayɛɛd ka mɛ an onɛ zi' si'ela?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Gban'ami fʋ mɛŋ nwɛnɛ bʋraa nɛ ka m bu'osif bu'osa, ka fʋ gandigim.

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: Man da ɛɛnb teŋgbauŋ la, fʋ da bɛ yaanɛ? Fʋ ya'a gban'e li gbin fʋn lɛbisimim!

english_verse: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ maki li yalʋŋʋ zem si'em? Mɛ fʋ pʋn mi'! Anɔ'ɔnɛ zaŋ nwiigi maki li labisim zem si'em?

english_verse: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone,
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ la ɛɛnbir la sʋn'e bɔ zugɔ, bɛɛ anɔ'ɔnɛ ba'a li ɛɛnbir kuga la,

english_verse: while morning stars sang, and angels rejoiced?
translation_verse: saŋkanɛ ka bɛogʋn nwadbibis yʋ'ʋm wʋʋ saalib ka maliaknam tansid nɛ sumalisim la?

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: Manɛ da nɔk saŋgbana pil atɛuk la, ka bɔbigi li nɛ lik linɛ an biridi la.

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: Saŋkan la m da bia' bi'ena ka li gu' li, ka maal kʋlis nɛ kʋnt gama kpɛn'ɛsi ba.

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn yɛl ye, ‘Fʋ tun'e pʋbigi paae kpɛ', amaa da gaadɛ; fʋ ku'opila banɛ dʋt agɔla la bɛnnɛ nwa'.’ Anɔ'ɔnɛ da kɛ ka li wʋsa niŋɛ? Li ka'anɛ manɛɛ?

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: Job, fʋ biilimin sa, fʋ nan mi' kɛ ka bɛog nie, bɛɛ pa'al sɔɔnrim la li bɛllim zin'igaa?

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: Fʋ nan mi' yɛl nɛɛsim ye li tansim tiig dunia la wʋsa ka kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim yii ba suak zin'isin naa?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Nɛɛsim ya'a tans, teŋgbauŋ niednɛ nyain ka zuoya nɛ bɔn'ɔd wʋsa nie nwɛnɛ fuug nɛ.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Li kɛtnɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim kʋ mɔr nɛɛsim, ka kɛt ka ba pʋ lɛn nyaŋidi zabida.

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ba nan mi' pa'alif kum za'anɔɔrɛɛ? Fʋ nan mi' nyɛ kpi'im teŋ kʋlisɛɛ?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Fʋ mi' teŋgbauŋ la yalʋŋʋ paae si'em? Fʋ ya'a mi' nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa, fʋn yɛlimim!

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: Fʋ mi' nɛɛsim la yit si'el naa, bɛɛ fʋ baŋ liki naanid si'eli kenna?

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Fʋ na yɛl ye fʋ mi' wae, mɛ saŋkan sa ka ba pʋn du'a fɔ! Waii, fʋ yuug ya woo!

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: Fʋ nan mi' kpɛn' sakuga dɔɔginɛɛ? Bɛɛ fʋ mi' nyɛ ba suak zin'iga?

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: Manɛ digil sakuga ani gur yɛltɔɔd saŋa, nɛ dabisbanɛ ka zaba nɛ tanp na li la.

english_verse: From where does lightning leap, or the east wind blow?
translation_verse: Suobɔ ka saa ɛɛn dɔlli ianki widig zin'ig wʋsa? Sisi'em ɛɛn niŋ wala yit ya-nya'aŋ na widigi tiig teŋgbauŋ la?

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ maal ku'osuor ka satitada dɔlisid ani niid, ka maal suor ka sisi'etita'ar nɛ satansʋg yit na?

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ dɔn'ɔsid teŋ kanɛ kʋdig bar-bar la ka kɛt ka mɔma'asa yit na?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Saa mɔr saammaa? Ka mɛligim mɔr ba'a?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Sakuga yinɛ pu'a pʋʋgin naa? Anɔ'ɔnɛ du'a mɛligim linɛ yi agɔl na ka ma'ad sim-sim la?

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Ka kɛt ka ku'om ga'aŋi kpɛ'ɛŋ wʋʋ kugir nɛ ka atɛuk zugin ga'aŋi lieb wʋʋ tampiinga?

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: Fʋ na nyaŋi la'as nwadbibis banɛ bɛ saŋgbana teŋsʋk la bɔbigɛɛ, bɛɛ idig nwadbibis banɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Nɔnya'aŋ-nɛ-o-biis la basɛ?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Fʋ na tun'e kɛ ka nwadbibis la yi saŋkanɛ ka fʋ bɔɔd, bɛɛ pa'al nwadbibis banɛ yʋ'ʋri buonnɛ A-kidigim-bu'os la ban na keŋ zin'isi'aa?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Fʋ mi' wada banɛ gɔsid saŋgbana laa, ka fʋ na tun'e kɛ ka wada bama tʋm teŋgbauŋ nwa' zugɔɔ?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: Fʋ na tun'e tansi yɛl saŋgbana, ka saa ni hali ka ku'om la gɛɛli fɔɔ?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ nɔk ya'am tis saal bɛɛ tis nidib pʋtɛn'ɛr ka ba bakid yɛla?

english_verse: Can you count the clouds or pour out their water
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ mɔr ya'am hali na tun'e kaal saŋgbana, bɛɛ gbɛlig yʋya banɛ bɛ saazug la kpa'ae ku'om la bas na?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Agaung biis ya'a ɛɛnti kaasidi buon Wina'am ka ginnɛ ieed diibɔ, anɔ'ɔnɛ bɔɔd diibi tisidi ba?”

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am lɛn yɛl Job ye, “Fʋ mi' saŋkanɛ ka sian'arin bʋʋs du'adaa? Fʋ nif nan mi' nyɛ ka walig du'ad o biisɛɛ?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Ba biis la nɔbigidnɛ ka kpɛ'ɛŋid tɔ'ɔtɔ; ba ya'a kpɛ'ɛŋi naae, ba zɔtnɛ ka basidi ba ma.

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ wʋm tempʋʋgin tʋkpiidʋg bɛɛ kɛlis nidibi tansidi ba bʋmis ka mugusidi ba si'em laa.

english_verse: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.
translation_verse: Ba gɔɔndnɛ zuoya zuti ieed yam, ba ieednɛ yamma'asa zin'ig wʋsa.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: Wɛnaaf na siak ka fʋ lɔɔ o kuaa? O pʋn na siaki kpɛn' fʋ gariki nii?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Fʋ na nyaŋi niŋ o yu'asin ka o vɛ'ɛg kuunrɛɛ? O na siaki nwɛ' fʋ bɔn'ɔgʋ tisi fɔɔ?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Fʋ na yɛl ye on mɔr paŋ la zug, fʋ na pɛsigi fʋ kuobu tis o ka o kuaa?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Fʋ tɛn'ɛs ka o na siaki zii fʋ ki pɔɔgin bɛɛ zi kibielim zieŋin naa?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: Niiŋtita'asi'a bɛ pipirigin sa; o ya'a bɔɔd on nwɛ'ɛm o kpʋkpama si'em, amaa o kʋ nyaŋi mak nɛ silʋg kpʋkpama linɛ ian'ad laa.

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: O nyɛ'ɛd o gɛla digin teŋin ka kɛ ka titanbin'isʋg tʋligidi ba.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: O ba'a kae ye sɔ' na tun'e nɔɔ ba bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbid na tun'e nɔɔ ba nwa'ae.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: O maannɛ o biis nɛ yɔri-yɔri nwɛnɛ ba ka' o biisɛ, o ba'a kae ye o tʋʋma la na an yɔrii.

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Linɛ kɛ la, Wina'am pʋ tis o ya'am, bɛɛ kɛ ka o mi' linɛ an sʋ'ʋm.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a lak o kpʋkpama ye o zɔ kpɛla, wiedban'ad nɛ o wief wʋsa kʋ li'el oo.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ tis wief paŋaa? Bɛɛ kɛ ka o niŋgɔɔnrin gbɛɛnd la sɔbig liŋ-liŋ laa?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ kɛ ka o ian'ad wʋʋ sisɔm ka sin'im ka dabiem gban'ad nidib laa?

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: O dɛɛdnɛ hali ka li mɔr dabiem, ka pa'annɛ o paŋ saŋkanɛ ka o dammid ka ian'ad zaba bɔn'ɔgin la.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: O zi' dabiem an si'ela ka mɛ pʋ zɔt zaba sʋ'ʋgɔ.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Lɔk kanɛ ka ba suud piema la dammid o lʋga ni, hali ka kpana ian'ad fiaʋn-fiaʋn.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Zaba na'atan ya'a ti pieb, o pʋ lɛn tun'e gban'ad o mɛŋa, o zɔtnɛ ki'ed teŋ la parigid-parigid ka uusʋg duod.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Na'atan ya'a ti pieb, o sin'imnɛ, ka pʋn wʋm zaba nyuug lalli sa, hali nɛ zaba tuongatib la kuŋ.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: Silʋgʋ ɛɛnti iank ka yadig o kpʋkpama kpa'ad ya-dagɔbʋg la, fʋ baŋiri ɛɛn tis o ya'am ka o ian'adaa?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Anina ka o ɛɛn gɔs kii ka nyɛti o diib hali lalli sa.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: O biis diib anɛ ziim ma'aa dinzug, bʋnkpiilima bɛ si'el la, o bɛ nɛ anina.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Job ya'as ye,

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: “Fʋn kanɛ nwa'asid nɛ mam Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la na nyaŋi pa'alim man gbɛlig lɔsi'a? Fʋn kanɛ fiied Wina'am la, gandigim!”

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Ka Job lɛbis Zugsɔb la ye,

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: M pʋn pian' nɔɔrin babiga m kʋ lɛm pian' ya'asɛ, m pʋn kʋ lɛn yɛl si'ela.”

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb naam sisi'etita'arin la na pian' tis Job ye,

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: “Gban'ami fʋ mɛŋ kimm wʋʋ dau nɛ ka m bu'osif bu'osa ka fʋ gandigim.

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Fʋ bɔɔdi pa'al ye man ka' sida sɔbaa? Fʋ bɔɔd ye fʋ zɛrig man ka lɛɛ tisi fʋ mɛŋ bʋʋdɛɛ?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Fʋ paŋ paae Wina'am paŋaa? Ka fʋ na tun'e tans ka fʋ kʋkɔr vuud wʋʋ o kʋkɔrɛ?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Alaa, duom zi'en ka pa'ali fʋ girima nɛ fʋ vɛnlim an si'em, pa'alimi fʋ na'am pipilim nɛ fʋ gandaalim.

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ sʋnpɛɛn duoe nɛ nyɛɛsim dim, ka sie ba, ka ba lieb zaalim.

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: La'asimi ba wʋsa pin' teŋin; ka kpari ba bas kpi'im teŋ.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Ala ka m na baŋ ka siak ye fʋ sid na tun'e faaɛn fʋ mɛŋ.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: Gɔsim Bʋnkɔnbid Na'ab la zem si'em; manɛ maal o ka mɛ maalif, amaa ka o ɔnbid mɔɔd wʋʋ naaf nɛ.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: O paŋ bɛ nɛ o sien, ka giinl kpi'ema bɛɛ o pʋʋrin.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: O zʋʋr yibisidnɛ nwɛnɛ na'aziinr nɛ, ka o gbɛgiinla kpɛn' kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: O kɔnba kpi'emnɛ wʋʋ kʋntzɛn'ug nɛ, ka o gbɛya kpi'em wʋʋ kʋnt nɛ.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Onɛ an bʋntita'ar kanɛ ka Wina'am da dɛŋi maal; ka Wina'am ma'aa na tun'e li'el o nɛ zaba sʋ'ʋg.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: On ɔnbid yam sieba bɛ nɛ zuoya ni, zin'ikanɛ ka mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid gɔɔndi giligid la.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: O dignɛ kɔldaugin tiis teŋir, zin'ikanɛ ka kɔlkantima duoe an limm la.

english_verse: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
translation_verse: Kɔldaug nɔɔrin tiis la tisid o ma'asim ka kɔlkantima la gilig o.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Joodan kɔldaug ya'a bɔɔd lin pɛ'ɛlim si'em ka ku'om la kpɛn'ɛd o nɔɔrin nɛ kpi'euŋ si'em, la'an nɛ wala o pʋ zɔt dabiem.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi puns o nini ka gban'e o? Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi zaŋ gu'a kʋns o nyɔnya?”

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛm bu'os Job ye, Fʋ na nyaŋi tɛɛg bandaug nɛ gu'a yis ku'omin bɛɛ lɔɔ o nɔɔr nɛ nwiigaa?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Fʋ na nyaŋi vʋdig o nyɔnya ka kpɛn'ɛs nwiig bɛɛ zaŋ gu'a kʋns o yierɛɛ?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Fʋ na gban'e o mɔri wʋʋ niiŋe fʋ yin bɛɛ maal o wʋʋ di'ema bʋn ka fʋ yampu'ab gɔsidaa?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Ziiŋku'osidib na dii o da'aa? Ba na pʋdig oo tis ziiŋda'adibaa?

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Fʋ na tun'e tɔɔn o nɛ kpana, bɛɛ vʋdig o zug nɛ ziiŋtɔɔndib piema?

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a si'is o nɔɔr yinne, fʋ kʋ lɛn paasɛ.

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: Pʋn da tɛn'ɛs ye fʋ na tun'e niŋ o si'ela, fʋ ya'a pʋn nyɛɛ o nɛ nif, fʋ giinla kɛnsidnɛ.

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Sɔ' kae mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ hali na tun'e dam oo. Li daan bɛ yaa na tun'e zi'en o tuonnɛ?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn lɛɛ na tun'e lud o ka tiligɛ? Dunia nwa' wʋsa, sɔ' kae na mak oo.

english_verse: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
translation_verse: M pʋn pʋ lɛn yɛt o gbɛya nɛ o paŋi galis si'em nɛ on vɛnl si'em.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn lɛɛ na tun'e tɛɛgi fulig o gbauŋɔ? Bɛɛ pʋn nyaŋi li'el o nɛ salibir ye o li'a o?

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e wɛ'ɛg o nɔɔri ya'ae ka nyɛɛ o nyina banɛ kpɛn'ɛsid nidib dabiem la?

english_verse: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
translation_verse: O nya'aŋ gbana la anɛ muula-muula wʋʋ pien ka ba tɔ'ɔŋi sɛn' nɛ.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: Ba tɔ'ɔŋ nɛ taaba kimm, ka li tɔi pamm nɛ sɔ' na nyaŋi wɛligi ba.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: O ya'a tɛnsim li nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ ian'asidi yit na; ka o nini mu'oe wʋʋ nintaŋi tansid bɛogʋn nɛ.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: Bugum pielim yit o nɔɔrin na; li ian'adnɛ pidʋ-pidʋ.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Ka nyɔ'ɔs yiti o nyɔnya ni us-us wʋʋ dʋk ka ba dʋgʋl bugumin ka li kɔt ka walim yitnɛ.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: O ya'a vʋ'ʋs, bugumsaana la'aŋid nɛ bugum, ka bugum yit o nɔɔrin na pidʋ-pidʋ.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: Paŋ ma'aa pɛ'ɛli o niŋgɔɔnr; ka o zin'ig wʋsa mɔr dabiem.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: O niŋgbiŋ gban'anɛ kimm, li kpi'emnɛ kaŋ-kaŋ ka sɔ' kʋ tun'e dammi li.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: O ya'a duoe zi'en, paŋ dim kiridi nɛ dabiem; ba zɔtnɛ lɛbid nya'aŋ hali ka o nam pʋ zab nɛ baa.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Kʋnt nwɛnɛ kikan'a o san'an, ka kʋntzɛn'ug nwɛnɛ dapɔn'ɔnsa tis o.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: Piema kʋ tun'e kad o ka o zɔɔ; ka luobkugir mɛ nwɛnɛ udugu o san'an.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Balaar nwɛnɛ kikan'ari tis o. Ba ya'a nwɛ' o kpan ka li dammid, li kpɛn'ɛsidi o nɛ la'ad.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: O pʋʋr la anɛ pa'ad pa'adi, ka o ya'a vuugi o mɛŋ bian'ar zug li maannɛ bʋmbɔk wʋʋ na'avuk nɛ.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: O kɛt ka ku'ozulima la dammid wʋʋ ku'om bɛ bugumini lɛ'ɛgid nɛ ka kɛt ka mu'a ku'om nwɛnɛ dʋkʋn kpaam nɛ.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: O ya'a lugid, pumpuum fukid nɛ pɛlig wʋʋ zuobpielim nɛ.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: O tiraan kae teŋgbauŋ zugɔ; o anɛ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ pʋ zɔt si'ela.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: O pʋ gɔsi nyɛ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ zem nɛ oo; onɛ an bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa na'ab.

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “M mi' ye fʋ na tun'e maal si'el wʋsa; fʋn gban'e si'el wʋsa sɔ' kae na nyaŋi gu'oe li.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: Fʋ bu'os ya ye, ‘Oŋa aan anɔ'ɔnɛ bi'esid ya'am pian'ad ka mɛ an onɛ zi' si'ela?’ Ya'a an sida, m pian'adi bʋn linɛ ka m pʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ, yɛl nyalima banɛ ka mam mɛŋ pʋn zi'.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: Fʋ yɛl ye, ‘Kɛlisim ka m na pian'; m na bu'osif bu'osa, ka fʋ gandigim.’

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: M tʋba daa wʋmi fʋ yɛla amaa nannanna m nini nyɛɛf.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la n yɛl Job nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa naae la, o yɛl Elifaz onɛ yi Teman na la ye, “M sʋnf duoe fʋn nɛ fʋ zuanama ayi' la, bɔzugɔ ya pʋ pian' m yɛla sida wʋʋ Job n pian' si'em laa.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Alazug, zaŋimi na'araad ayɔpɔi nɛ pɛraad ayɔpɔi keŋ maal nyu'or malʋŋʋ ya mɛŋ zug. M tʋmtʋm Job na sɔsi tisi ya, ka m na siak o sɔsʋg ka kʋ niŋi ya wʋʋ ya zɔlim tʋʋma la narin si'em la. Ya pʋ pian' m yɛla sʋ'ʋm wʋʋ m tʋmtʋm Job n pian' si'em laa.”

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Job da sɔsi tis o zuanam la, Zugsɔb la da lɛbis o mɔrim la tis o ka li gaad on da mɔr si'em la nɔɔr ayi'.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: O ba'abiis wʋsa da kennɛ o yin na ka ba la'am dit, nɛ banɛ wʋsa da mi' o ka yɛltɔɔd naan paae o la. Ba da bʋgʋl o sʋnf ka bɛlis o, Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka yɛla pamm paae o la zug. Ka ba yinne, yinne tis o anzurifa la'af nɛ sanlima baŋ.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: O mɛ da mɔr biribis ayɔpɔi nɛ bipumis atan'.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Pu'a sɔ' da kae teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa zugʋ vɛnl wʋʋ Job pu'ayuos laa. Ba saam da kɛ ka ba la'as nɛ o biribis la ka o pʋdig o faari tisi ba wʋsa.

english_verse: years—long enough to see his great-grandchildren have children of their own—
translation_verse: ) ka nyɛɛ o yaas nɛ o yaayalinya'asi ti paae zʋmaana anaasi.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: O da kʋdignɛ hali paae o bɛn ka nyaan kpi.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ onɛ pʋ di'ed nimbɛ'ɛdnam sa'alʋgɔ bɛɛ dɔl tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dimi dɔl suosieba la, bɛɛ nɔk o mɛŋi la'as nɛ nintʋ'ʋsnama.

english_verse: ) The Way to Happiness
translation_verse: ) Zugsɔb nidib nɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam yɛla

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Amaa o sʋnf bɔɔdim anɛ ye o dɔl Zugsɔb wada la ka zamisidi li yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: O sɔb nwɛnɛ tikanɛ ka ba sɛ kɔlʋg nɔɔrin nɛ, ka li wan saŋa kanɛ nar ye li wal ka li vaand pʋ sʋʋgida. O ya'a maal si'el wʋsa o nyɛti li nyɔɔd.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'ɛdnam la on ka' ala! Ba nwɛnɛ udug linɛ ka sisi'em da'adi ken.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Alazug tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim na paam kʋʋsbɛ'ɛd, ba na baki ba yis ka bas pʋpielim dim la.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la gur pʋpielim dim la, amaa nimbɛ'ɛdnam la kennɛ san'auŋʋn.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Bɔɔ niŋ ka dunia buudi wʋsa su'a gban'ad gban'abɛ'ɛdɛ? Bɔ ka ba san'amid saŋa gban'ad gban'ayaalisɛ?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Dunia kaŋa na'anam duoe zi'e, ka banɛ sʋ'oe tɛɛns la la'as taaba zan'as Zugsɔb la nɛ Onɛ ka o Gaŋ la.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Ba yɛt taaba ye, “Kɛlli ka ti faaɛn ti mɛŋ ka ba da lɛn sʋ'oe ti ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug arezana ni la la'adi banɛ: Zugsɔb la maannɛ banɛ siaa.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Ka o sʋnf duoe nɛ ba ka o tansi ba ka vɔlisi ba o sʋnf duor la pʋʋgin ka ye,

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: “M diisi m Na'ab Zion zuokanɛ an kasi la zug.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: M na yɛl Zugsɔb la zi'ela la yɛla: O yɛlim ye, “Fʋ anɛ mam Biig; zina ka m liebi fʋ Saam.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Sɔsim, ka m na kɛ ka fʋ sʋ'ʋg tɛɛns la ka dunia bɛn wʋsa aan fʋ din.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Fʋ na nyaŋi ba nɛ kʋnt dansaar, ka nwa'asi ba bugus wʋʋ tandʋk nɛ.”

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, na'anama, baŋimi ya'am! Dunia tuongatiba, sa'alimi ya mɛŋ

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: ka dɔlli Zugsɔb la nya'aŋ nɛ na'asi ka maal sumalisim nɛ kikirʋg.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Na'asimini o biig la, ya'a ka' ala o sʋnf na duoe ka o san'ami ya, ya suobɛ'ɛd la pʋʋgin; bɔzugɔ o sʋnf tun'e duoe vuguri. Albareka bɛ nɛ banɛ wʋsa kɛɛn o san'an na su'a la.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, m dataas zu'onɛ! Nidib bɛdegʋ zabid nɛ mam!

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ yɛti m yɛla ye, “Wina'am kʋ faaɛn oo!”

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ an gbanti'edʋgʋ giligim, fʋnɛ tisim girima ka ʋki m zug agɔla.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ka m kaasi buol, ka o naanɛ o zuokanɛ an kasi la zug ka wʋm tisim.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Man digini gbis; ka lɛn duoe nɛ nimma'asim bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la gurim.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Nidib tusa-tusa giligim zin'ig wʋsa amaa m kʋ zɔ ba dabiem baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, duom zi'en! O m Wina'am, faanmim! Zam nɛ m dataas la wʋsa. Lɔmmi ba tampian'as ka kɔ' bugusim dim la nyina.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: M Wina'am onɛ an pʋpielim daana, m ya'a sɔsif, fʋn wʋm tisim. Man daa bɛ yɛla ni la fʋ daa tisim yɔlisim, ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig ka wʋmi m sɔsʋg.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Saaliba, bʋndaar ka ya na bas man yʋ'ʋr san'auŋɔ? Bʋndaar ka ya na bas ziri bada la ka dɔl sida?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ye Zugsɔb la gaans pʋpielim dim la ye ba aan o nidib. M ya'a sɔs Zugsɔb la o na wʋm tisim.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Fʋ sʋnf ya'a duoe fʋn da tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ; fʋ ya'a digi fʋ dɔɔgin yʋ'ʋŋ fʋn tɛn'ɛsim pian'ad nwa' yɛla ka an baanlimm.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔkim maan kanɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa la tis ka niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ bu'osid ye, “Anɔ'ɔnɛ na maal bʋnsʋŋʋ tisi ti?” Zugsɔba, zɔmi ti nimbaanlig.

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Fʋ tisim sumalistita'ar ka li gat ban na bʋn ki bɛdegʋ ka nyɛt daam nɛ kpaam ka maan sumalisim si'em la.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: M na digini gbis nɛ laafi bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔba, fʋn ma'aa kɛt ka m bɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, wʋmmi m sɔsʋg, kɛlisimi m fabʋlʋg ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Wʋm man kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir la, m Na'ab nɛ m Wina'am, bɔzugɔ li anɛ fʋn ka m sɔsid.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ wʋmmi m sɔsʋg bɛogʋn; bɛogʋn ka m mɔri m winsɔsʋgʋ kɛɛn fʋ tuon na ka gur nɛ ti'ir ye fʋ na maal.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Fʋ anɛ Wina'am kanɛ pʋ bɔɔd bɛ'ɛdɛ; tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim kʋ nyaŋi zin'ini fʋ san'anɛ.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Tita'alnam kʋ nyaŋi kɛɛn fʋ san'an naa; banɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd wʋsa fʋ kisi ba nɛ.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Banɛ faad la fʋ san'amidi ba nɛ; nimbanɛ bɔɔd kʋʋb ka an ziri dim la Zugsɔb la kisi ba nɛ.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Amaa li ya'a an mam, fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr la zug, m tun'e kpɛn' fʋ Yin la ka igini kpa' fʋ pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg linɛ an kasi la ka tisif girima nɛ na'asi.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, gaadimi m tuon nɛ fʋ pʋpielim la, sʋŋimim, m dataas la zug. Kɛl ka fʋ suor la an tituaa tisim ka m dɔl.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Pian'ʋk wʋsa linɛ yiti ba nɔɔrin na ka' sidaa. Ba sʋnf gban'e nɛ san'auŋ ma'aa. Ba pʋʋg pʋ paada; ba pian'adnɛ ziri pian'ad ma'aa.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, kʋʋsimi ba bɛ'ɛd! Kɛl ka ba mɛŋ gban'abɛ'ɛd la tuligi dii ba. Kadimi ba yis, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug, bɔzugɔ ba zan'asi fʋ nɔɔr.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Amaa kɛl ka banɛ wʋsa su'a fʋ san'an la paam sumalisim; kɛl ka ba yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim saŋa wʋsa. Kɛl ka fʋ paŋ kanɛ guri ba la lusi ba, ka banɛ nɔŋif la na mɔr sumalisim fʋ san'an.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, li anɛ sida ye fʋ niŋid pʋpielnam la zug bareka; fʋ lusi ba nɛ wʋʋ gbanti'edʋg nɛ.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, da kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf duoe ka fʋ tansim, bɛɛ namisimi fʋ sʋnf duor la pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, zɔmim nimbaanlig, ka m gɛnnɛ; Zugsɔba, tisimim laafi, ka m niŋgbina wʋsa ka' paŋa.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: M giinla wʋsa kɛnsnɛ. Zugsɔba, li na yuugi paae wala?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: O, Zugsɔba, lɛm na sʋŋim; faanmim fʋ nɔŋilim la zug.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kae na kpi ka lɛn tiɛn fʋ yɛlaa; anɔ'ɔnɛ na bɛ kpi'im teŋ ka lɛn nyaŋi zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋrɛ?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Sʋnsa'aŋ yʋ'ʋn kɛnɛ ka m gɛn, yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa m gadʋg ɛɛn anɛ ninta'am ma'aa ka ninta'am kɛ ka m zukʋgʋr wʋ'ʋg matti.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: M dataas la kɛnɛ ka m kaas hali; ka m nini mɔd ka pʋ lɛn nyɛta.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim nwa', isigimini m san'an bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la wʋmi m kukuma.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la wʋm man kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir si'em; Zugsɔb la gandigi m sɔsʋg.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Li na lidigi m dataas la wʋsa ka nyan gban'e ba; ba na zɔ tɔ'ɔtɔ lɛb nya'aŋ nɛ nyan.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: M Zugsɔb Wina'am, fʋ ni ka m su'ad, faanmim ka yisim banɛ ieedim la nu'usin.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' ala ba na aansim zɔra-zɔra wʋʋ gbigimi aansid si'el si'em la, bɛɛ vɛ'ɛgimi keŋ, ka sɔ' kae na faaɛn ma.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: m ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛdi tis onɛ mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ m, bɛɛ faanm dataa si'el zaalim-zaalim,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: fʋn kɛl ka m dataas kadimi nyaŋim, ka nwɛ'ɛmi digil teŋin, ka yʋ'ʋn kʋʋmi pin' teŋin.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: M Zugsɔba, vaam duoe nɛ sʋʋnr, ka san'am ban gban'e si'el ba sʋnpɛɛn zug la, duom zi'en, m Wina'am, ka kɛ ka sida la tʋm.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka dunia nidib kɛɛn fʋ san'an na; zin'inimi fʋ na'am gbauŋ la zug agɔla ka sʋ'ʋgi ba.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka Zugsɔb kad nidib la saria. M Zugsɔba, kadimi m saria ka li dɔlli m pʋpielim zem si'em, ka dɔlli m bʋʋdi zem si'em, fʋnɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Wina'am Onɛ an Pʋpielim Sɔba, fʋnɛ mi' ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛr nɛ o sʋnfʋ gban'e si'em. Kɛl ka nimbɛ'ɛdnam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la gu'oe, ka kɛ ka pʋpielim dim nyɛɛ ba mɛŋ.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la lusidim, onɛ faand banɛ ka ba sʋnf an nyain la.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Wina'am kad saria nɛ pʋpielim, O pa'annɛ o sʋnpɛɛn daar wʋsa.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb ya'a pʋ tiakɛ Wina'am na maligim saas o sʋ'ʋg la ka gʋd o tiraug la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa gban'e tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ yɛla ma'aa pʋʋg, du'adnɛ dama'am.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Onɛ tu bʋmbɔk o sɔb lutnɛ bʋmbɔkanɛ ka o tu la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Yɛlbanɛ ka o ieed la lɛbidnɛ o zugin na; o daamʋg la wʋsa na lɛb o mɛŋ zugin.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: M na pʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la bareka o pʋpielim la zug, ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zun'e o yʋ'ʋr, Zugsɔb la Gaad Si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Naa, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Zugsɔba, fʋ yʋ'ʋr la mɔri kpi'euŋ dunia wʋsa ni, fʋ dʋ'ʋsi fʋ girima agɔl ka li gaad saŋgbana.

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛt ka bibibis nɛ bilies pian'adi fʋ yʋ'ʋr. Fʋ dataas ya'a maan tʋkpiidʋg fʋ na kɛ ka ba gigilim, la'an nɛ banɛ bɔɔd sam yɔɔb la wʋsa.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: M ya'a gɔs agɔla nyɛ fʋ nu'usi maal si'el la, nwadig nɛ nwadbibis banɛ ka fʋ niŋi ba, ba zin'isin si'em la,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: m bu'osidi m mɛŋ ye, “Ninsaal an bɔ, ka fʋ tɛnr o yɛla ala? Bɛɛ ninsaal biig an bɔ, ka fʋ ba'a bɛɛ o ni?”

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Fʋ maal o ka maliaknam gaad o nɛ bi'ela amaa fʋ tis o girima nɛ na'asi.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛ ka o sʋ'oe linɛ ka fʋ maal la, fʋ zaŋ si'el wʋsa niŋ o nu'usin,

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: onɛ sʋ'oe kɔnbid nɛ niigi wʋsa, nɛ mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid la wʋsa,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: nɛ niimis banɛ ian'ad saŋgbauŋin, nɛ zimi banɛ bɛ atɛukʋn nɛ linɛ wʋsa lugidi dɔlisid ku'osuoya atɛukʋn la.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: Naa, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Zugsɔba, fʋ yʋ'ʋr la mɔri kpi'euŋ dunia wʋsa zug!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, m na zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa, m na yɛl nidibi fʋ tʋʋmnyalima la yɛla.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: M sʋnf na ma'ae ka m maal sumalisim fʋ tuon, ka yʋʋm yʋ'ʋma zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr, fʋnɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa!

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: M dataasi zɔti lɛbid nya'aŋ la, ba na tu'ugi luu kpii fʋ tuon.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ fʋ mi' m bʋʋd yɛla ka kpɛn'ɛdi m zug; fʋ zin'inɛ fʋ na'am gbauŋ zug ka kad saria nɛ sida.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Fʋ sa'al tɛɛns la ka kʋ nimbɛ'ɛdnam: fʋ kpiisi ba yʋda ka li kʋ lɛn maligim sɔbɛ.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: San'auŋ linɛ ka' bɛn paae dataas la; fʋ nwa'a ba teŋ la, hali ka sɔ' pʋ lɛn tɛnri ba yɛlaa.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋ'oe na'am, saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, O zi'el o na'am ye o kad saria.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: O na kad dunia nwa' saria nɛ pʋpielim, ka gur tɛɛns wʋsa nɛ sida.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la anɛ suak zin'igi tis banɛ ka ba namisidi ba, yɛla ya'a ti bɛ, o anɛ kpi'euŋ zin'igi tisi ba.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Banɛ mi' fʋ yʋ'ʋr la paŋi an si'em la na niŋif yadda bɔzugɔ fʋn kanɛ an Zugsɔb la nan zi' kad banɛ ieedif la basɛ.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋmmi yʋʋma wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb onɛ an Zion Na'ab la, yɛlimi tɛɛns la wʋsa on maal si'el!

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ o tɛnr banɛ namisid la yɛla. O pʋ tammid banɛ kaasid la yɛlaa, ka yɔɔd banɛ namisidi ba la sam.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: Naa, m Zugsɔba, gɔsimi m dataas la namisidim si'em. Zɔmim nimbaanlig ka yisim kum pʋʋgin.

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: M na zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr Zion teŋ za'anɔɔrin ka maal sumalisim fʋ faangir la yɛla.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns la nidib pʋn lu bʋmbu'abanɛ ka ba tu la pʋʋgin, baans banɛ ka ba su'a bɛnd la lɛm gban'e ba mɛŋ nɔba.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ba baŋid Zugsɔb la yɛla nɛ on an sida sɔb la zug; nimbɛ'ɛdnam la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi gban'adi ba.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'ɛdnam wʋsa lɛbidnɛ kpi'im teŋ, nɛ buudbanɛ wʋsa tam Wina'am yɛla la.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Amaa o kʋ tam tadimnam yɛlaa, bɛɛ kɛ ka banɛ bɛ namisʋgʋn la ti'ir gaadɛ.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, duom zi'en ka da kɛ ka ninsaal di ya'annɛ; kɛl ka ba kad buudi wʋsa saria fʋ tuon.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, kɛl ka dabiem gban'e ba, kɛl ka buudi la baŋ ye ba anɛ ninsaalib ma'aa.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, bɔ ka fʋ zi'e lallisa? Bɔ ka fʋ su'adi fʋ mɛŋ, yɛla saŋa?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Bugusim sɔb la, tita'alim zug ka o namisid tadimnam; o gban'e bɛ'ɛd la na tuligi gban'e o mɛŋ!

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ninvʋbɛ'ɛd nwɛ'ɛdnɛ nyɔ'ɔg nɛ on tʋm linɛ aan o sʋʋnr bɔɔdim la; o kaanbid kaanb sʋŋi tisid dasʋŋ sɔb ka ki'isid Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb la tita'alim zug, o pʋ ieed Wina'am zin'iga; o tɛn'ɛsʋg wʋsa pʋʋgin, fal kae tis Wina'am.

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: O suoya wʋsa ken tuon la zug, o mɔri nyɛɛsim ka fʋ wada lal nɛ o, ka nɛ'ɛsid o dataas wʋsa.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: O yɛt o sʋnfʋn ye, “Si'el kae na daam mam. Saŋa wʋsa m na mɔr sumalisim ka yɛlsi'a kʋ maligim paae ma.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Linɛ yit o nɔɔrin na anɛ nɔpɔɔr nɛ ziri nɛ vɔlisʋg. O zilim pɛ'ɛli nɛ yɛla nɛ bɛ'ɛd ma'aa.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: O su'anɛ teŋkpɛmis la baba, ye o kʋʋd banɛ ka' taal la, ka su'a gu'ud banɛ dɔl anina gat la.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: O dignɛ gur wʋʋ gbigim nɛ, ye o gban'e tadimnam. O gban'adnɛ banɛ ka' kpi'euŋ la, ka niŋidi ba o zulis la pʋʋgin mɔri ken.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: O mugusidnɛ tadimnam ka ba lit teŋin, o mɔr paŋi nyaŋidi ba.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: O yɛt o sʋnfʋn ye, “Wina'am tam ya, o ligil o nindaa ka pʋ lɛn nyɛt si'ela.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, duom zi'en! Wina'am, ʋkimi fʋ nu'ug! Da tam tadimnam la yɛlaa.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Bɔɔ kɛ ka nimbɛ'ɛd la ziemid Wina'am? Bɔɔ kɛ ka o yɛt o sʋnfʋn ye, “O kʋ gi'el man tʋm si'el la yɛllɛ.”

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Amaa sida fʋ nyɛt yɛla nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ kan ka maan, O Wina'am: fʋ gɔsidi li yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa. Onɛ ka ba namisid la nɔk o mɛŋi niŋi fʋ ma'asimin, ka fʋ sʋŋid banɛ an kpiibis la wʋsa.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Kɔ'ɔgim bugusim sɔb nɛ nimbɛ'ɛd kpʋkpauŋ, kɛl ka ba paam namisʋgʋ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug la'an nɛ ban yɛl ye sɔ' kʋ nyɛ li la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la anɛ na'ab saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, teŋ zʋŋ nidib kʋ lɛm bɛɛ o teŋinɛ.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, fʋ wʋm banɛ namisid la bɔɔd si'el; fʋ wʋmmi ba kukuma ka kpɛmisidi ba;

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: ka sʋŋid kpiibis nɛ banɛ bɛ namisʋgʋn; linɛ na kɛ ka ninsaal na bɛ dunia ni ka kʋ lɛn zɔ dabiem ya'asɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la aan m suak zin'ig, dinzug bɔ ka ya yɛtim ye m iankim wʋʋ niiŋe zɔɔ keŋ zuoya ni?

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Gɔsim nimbɛ'ɛdnam la gʋdi ba tiraad si'em! Ba nɔk piema la niŋi ba tiraadin ye ba su'a zibisimin tɔn banɛ sʋnya an nyain nɛ Wina'am la.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Ɛɛnbir la ya'a luu widig pʋpielim dim la ye ba niŋ wala?

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la bɛ nɛ o Pʋ'ʋsim Yir linɛ an kasi la ni, Zugsɔb la bɛ nɛ o na'am gbauŋ zug arezana ni. O kpansid ninsaalib, ka o nini la gɔsid ban tʋm si'em.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kpansid pʋpielim dim, amaa bugusim dim nɛ banɛ bɔɔd zaba la, o kisi ba ka o ya'am pʋ bɔɔdi ba baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: O na kpa'ae bugumsaana nɛ kidibiri niŋ bugusim dim zug, pɛbistʋʋlʋg na da'ae gɛɛli ba.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la anɛ pʋpielim sɔb ka nɔŋ pʋpielim tʋʋma; sida dim nɛ banɛ tʋm sʋm na nyɛɛ o nindaa.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, sʋŋimim, ka banɛ dɔllif lɛn kae, pʋpielnam lɛn ka' nidib sʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa ma'adnɛ tisid o kpi'a, ba nɔŋgban pian'ad anɛ ziri ma'aa.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Zugsɔb, kɛl ka nɔŋgban malisiŋ wʋsa lɛbi fɔn' ka banɛ nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg la zilima niŋ baanlimm.

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: Ba yɛt ye, “Ti na nyaŋ nɛ ti zilima la: tinamɛ sʋ'oe ti nɔŋgbana, anɔ'ɔnɛ aan ti sʋ'ʋda?”

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Ban namisid tadimnam nɛ banɛ ka' si'el la fabʋlʋg zug, m yʋ'ʋn na duoe zi'en,” m na faaɛn ba yis banɛ namisidi ba la nu'usin.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlʋg anɛ nyain wʋʋ anzurifa nɛ; ka nwɛnɛ anzurifa ka ba nyɛligi silig nɔɔr ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, gu'umi ba sʋ'ʋŋa guri ba ka yisi ti nimbama nu'usin, saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'ɛdnam la bɛ nɛ zin'ig wʋsa ka linɛ pʋ nar la lieb girima bʋn nidib la sʋʋgin.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, saŋa wala ka fʋ na tam man yɛla? Fʋ na tam man yɛla fassinɛ? Saŋa wala ka fʋ na fɛndigi fʋ nindaa ka basi ma?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Saŋa wala ka man pʋtɛn'ɛr na kpɛn an yɔɔd-yɔɔdi, ka mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ daar wʋsa? Saŋa wala ka m dataas na nyaŋi ma?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ aan m Zugsɔba, sʋŋim! Kɛlisim ka gandigim. Tisim paŋ ya'as; ya'a ka' ala m na kpi.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka m dataa yɛl ye, “M nyaŋ oo.” Banɛ kisim la ya'a nyɛ ka m lu, ba na maal sumalisim.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Amaa mam mɔr yadda nɛ fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ pʋ naad la. M sʋnf malis nɛ fʋ faangir linɛ ka' bɛn la.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: M na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma tis Zugsɔb la bɔzugɔ o tʋm tʋʋm sʋma tisim.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg yɛt o pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye, “Wina'am kae!” Ba san'amnɛ, ka ba suoya wʋsa an bɛ'ɛd; sɔ' kae tʋm sʋm.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la naan arezana gɔsid saalib ye o na nyɛ ya'am daani ba sʋʋgin nɛ onɛ ieed on Wina'am.

english_verse: But all of them are corrupt; no one does right.
translation_verse: Ayei! Sɔ' wʋsa fɛndignɛ, ba wʋsa yʋ'ʋn kilimnɛ zam dim; sɔ' kae tʋm sʋm, hali baa nid yinne mɛnɛ.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la kʋ zamis ya'am? Ba vɔnnɛ m nidib la wʋʋ saalibi vɔn sa'ab si'em la; ka mɛ pʋn pʋ sɔsid Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Banɛ bɛɛ anina ka dabietita'ar gban'e ba la, Wina'am mɛ bɛ nɛ o nimbanɛ an pʋpielim dim la san'an.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Yanam bugusim dim la san'amid tadimnam yɛla amaa Wina'am aan ba suak zin'ig.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye Israel faangir naan Zion teŋin na! Zugsɔb la ya'a ti lɛbis o nidibi ba zin'igin, Jakob nɛ Israel dim na mɔr sumalisim!

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Zugsɔba anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi kpɛn' fʋ yin la? Anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi bɛɛ fʋ zuokanɛ an kasi la zugɔ?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Li anɛ onɛ ken ka gba'ar kae, ka tʋm linɛ an pʋpielim la, o anɛ onɛ pian'ad sida ka li yit o sʋnfʋn na.

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: O zilim pʋ pian'ad bɛ'ɛdɛ, bɛɛ maannɛ o kpi'a linɛ pʋ nara, ka pʋ kɛɛnd o ninsaal taabaa.

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: O kis nimbɛ'ɛdnam, ka nɔŋ banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la. O zi'e o kaanbʋg zug hali baa li ya'a tɔi si'em tis oo.

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: O pɛ'ɛŋid o ligidi tisid ka pʋ paasid nyɔɔdɛ, ka pʋ kɛt ka ba da'ad o ye o kʋʋs bʋʋd sɔb bɛ'ɛdɛ. Onɛ tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa, si'el kae na daam o.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: O, m Wina'am, gurim sʋ'ʋŋa bɔzugɔ fʋ san'an ka m su'adi m mɛŋ.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: M yɛl Zugsɔb la ye, “Fʋ anɛ m Zugsɔb; ya'a ka' fʋnɛ, m pʋ lɛm mɔr bʋnsʋŋsi'aa.”

english_verse: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb nimbanɛ bɛ teŋ la ni la anɛ girima dim ka m sʋnf malis nɛ ba.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Banɛ zɔti dɔl winsieba la, na maligim paasi ba mɛŋ sʋnsa'aŋ. M kʋ bu'oe ba maan ku'om linɛ an ziim la bɛɛ ya'am m nɔɔri buoli ba yʋdaa.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ tisim linɛ aan m bʋn nɛ linɛ narim, fʋnɛ kɛ ka m zin' ka dabiem kae.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: M di'e zin'ibanɛ vɛnli tisim; sida-sida m mɔr faar linɛ ma'adi m sʋnf.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: M na zun'e Zugsɔb onɛ sa'annim la, la'an nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ m sʋnf pa'annim mam na maal si'em.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ka man zaŋi galisi m tuon daar wʋsa; on bɛɛ m datiuŋ la zug, dabiem pʋ mɔri ma.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Dinzug, man sʋnf ma'anɛ ka m pian'ad nɛ sumalisim, ka m niŋgbina mɛ mɔr laafi ka si'el kʋ daami ma.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ fʋ kʋ basim yaʋgʋnɛ, bɛɛ kɛ ka Onɛ an Kasi tisif la pun'oe.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ kɛ ka m baŋ vʋm suor, fʋ na tisim sumalisim fʋ san'an, ka kɛ ka m mɔr ya'amlɛog linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ fʋ datiuŋ la.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, kɛlisimi m pʋpielim winsɔsʋg, wʋmmi m kukuma. Kɛlisimi m sɔsʋg, li pʋ yit ziri sɔb nɔɔrin naa.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka li anɛ fʋnɛ na tisim bʋʋd. Fʋ nini na nyɛ linɛ an sida.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ fʋn mi' m sʋnf ka kpansidim yʋ'ʋŋ la, la'an nɛ fʋn makidimɛ gɔsid la, fʋ kʋ nyɛ gba'arɛ; m gban'e ye m nɔɔr kʋ pian' bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim ninsaalib tʋʋma, fʋ nɔɔr pian'ad zug man gban'e m mɛŋ ka pʋ dɔl zaba dim suoya.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: M nɔba zi'enɛ fʋ suorin la, m pʋ bie yii li nii.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋn ka m buon, bɔzugɔ m mi' ye fʋ na wʋm tisim. Kɛlisim ka wʋmi m sɔsʋg.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Pa'alimi fʋ nɔŋilim la tʋm nyalima si'em, fʋnɛ nɔki fʋ paŋi faaɛn nidib wʋsa banɛ zɔti kennɛ su'adi fʋ san'an ba dataas yɛla la.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Mɔrim sʋŋa wʋʋ fʋ nif bielif nɛ, nɔkimi su'a fʋ kpʋkpama lɛuŋʋn

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: yi nimbɛ'ɛdnam banɛ mɔɔd ye ba duoe tʋ'ʋsim nɛ zaba la ni, nɛ m dataas banɛ giligim ye ba kʋ la san'an.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Ba yɔɔ ba sʋnya linɛ digilim la, ka pian'adnɛ tita'alim.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ba gban'e man nɛ zi'el ka giligim; ba ieednɛ suoya ye ba lugim teŋin.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Ba nwɛnɛ gbigim ka kɔ'ɔm mɔr o ka o gu'ud ye o gban'e si'el, ka nwɛnɛ gbigim kanɛ su'a mɔɔdin mɔɔd ye o gban'e si'eli ɔnb.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, duom zi'en, tʋ'ʋsimi ba ka sigisi ba teŋin, nɔkimi fʋ zaba sʋ'ʋg la faanmi yis nimbɛ'ɛdnam nu'ugin.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, nɔkimi fʋ paŋi faanmi yis nimbama nu'usin; ban banɛ di'edi ba yɔɔd dunia kaŋa ni ma'aa la. Fʋn nɔŋ sieba la kɔ'ɔm ya'a zabid fʋ tisidi banɛ ka ba tigid ka ba biis mɛ mɔr bɛdegʋ, ba su'a arezak bɛdegʋ digili ba biis.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Ka mam an pʋpiel la zug m na nyɛɛf. M ya'a ti duoe ka nyɛɛ fʋ nindaa, lin ma'aa siakim.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: Man nɔŋ fʋn Zugsɔb onɛ aan m paŋ daan la.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: M Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ aan m tampiing, m suak zin'ikpi'euŋ nɛ m faangid. M Wina'am la anɛ m gbanti'edʋg, o san'an ka m su'ad. Onɛ lusidim ka aan m vʋm la paŋ, nɛ m kpi'euŋ zin'ig.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: M buol Zugsɔb onɛ nar nɛ zʋn'or la, ka paam yɔlisim yii m dataas nu'usin.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Kum lɔbi giligim nwɛnɛ nwiis nɛ, ka kum ku'onwiis libigim yɔɔg-yɔɔg.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: M mugusʋg pʋʋgin m daa buolnɛ Zugsɔb la, m daa kaasi tisim Wina'am la bɔɔd sʋŋir, ka o naanɛ o Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka wʋm tisim, m kukuma la paae o san'an ka kpɛn' o tʋba ni.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ la damnɛ ka mi'im zika-zika, hali ka zuoya la gbina dammid; ba mi'imnɛ o sʋnfʋ duoe la zug.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
