translation_verse: Nyɔ'ɔs daa naanɛ o nyɔnya nii yina; ka bugum linɛ kanbid yii o nɔɔrin na, ka bugumsaana linɛ dit yii li pʋʋgin na.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: O da buak agɔla ka sig na, ka saŋgbansabilig bɛɛ o nɔba teŋir.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: O da ban' Kerub la iank. Ka sisi'em da'ad o ken tɔ'ɔtɔ wʋʋ niiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: O da nɔk liki su'a o mɛŋ, ka kɛ ka saa saŋgbansabilig gilig o.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Saŋgbana nɛ sakuga nɛ sa-ian'asʋg naan nɛɛsim linɛ bɛɛ o san'an la yina.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la tans wʋʋ saa nɛ arezana ni; Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la lɛn vu ya'as.

english_verse: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.
translation_verse: O da tɔɔn o piema la widig o bi'emnam, ka kadi ba nɛ sa-ian'astita'ar.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ tansʋg nɛ pɛbistita'ar kanɛ yii fʋ nyɔnya ni na la kɛ ka Atɛuk ku'osuoya nɛ teŋgbauŋ ɛɛnbir nie paalʋ.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: O naan agɔlli su'uni gban'e m nu'ugʋ yaami yis ku'ozuluŋ pʋʋgin.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: O faanmi yisi m dataas banɛ mɔr paŋ hali la ni, banɛ kisim ka mɔr paŋi gatim la.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Ba daa kena ludimi m dabisbɛ'og daar, amaa ka Zugsɔb la sʋŋim.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: O daa mɔrimi yii keŋ paae zin'ikanɛ an yaliŋa. O daa faanm, on nɔŋim la zug.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la tʋmnɛ tisim wʋʋ man an pʋpiel si'em la. M nu'usi an nyain la zug ka fʋ tisim piini.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Man dɔlis Zugsɔb suoya la wʋsa; m pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi fɛndig ka basi m Wina'am.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: M dɔlisid o wada la wʋsa, m pʋ fɛndig ka bas o zi'ela la.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: O pʋ nyɛ gba'asi'a m san'anɛ, m mɔɔ gban'e m mɛŋ ka pʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: M pʋpielim la zug ka Zugsɔb la niŋi m zug bareka. M nu'usi an nyain la zug ka o tisim piini.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Banɛ an sida dim la, fʋ pa'annɛ ba nɛ ye fʋ anɛ sida sɔb, banɛ ka' gba'ar la, fʋ pa'annɛ ba ye fʋ mɛ ka' gba'arɛ.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Banɛ an nyain la, fʋ pa'annɛ ba ye fʋ anɛ nyain. Amaa banɛ bɛllim pʋ dɔl suor la, fʋ mɛ pa'annɛ ba ye fʋ mi' ba gbin.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Fʋ faand banɛ siedi ba mɛŋ la, ka sigisid nyɛɛsim dim wʋsa.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ kɛt ka m fitir la kpɛn dit, Wina'am la kɛ ka lik lieb nɛɛsim tisim.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Ya'a an sida, Wina'am suoya la an sʋ'ʋŋa. Zugsɔb la pian'ad pʋ mɔr zirii; onɛ lusid banɛ wʋsa su'a o san'an la.

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Li anɛ Wina'am la tisidim paŋ, ka maannɛ m suor sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: O maali m nɔba wʋʋ walig nɔba nɛ, ka dʋ'ʋsimi zi'el zuor zug.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: O pa'alim mam na zab si'em, m nu'us tun'e pɔnd kʋntzɛn'ug tiraug.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Fʋ zaŋ nɛ zaba gbanti'edʋgʋ lusim ka m nyaŋi m dataas, ka fʋ datiuŋ nu'ug gurim. Fʋ sʋŋir kɛ ka m an nintita'ar.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Fʋ yalig suokanɛ bɛɛ m tuon la, ka m nɔba kʋ sadigɛ.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: M kadi m dataas la paae ba, ka pʋ fɛndig nya'aŋa, hali nɛ mam ti san'ami ba wʋsa.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: M nwɛ' ba digil teŋinɛ m nɔba ni ka ba mak duori gʋ'ʋŋ.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Fʋ tisim paŋ kanɛ na zab, ka kɛ ka m dataas igini m tuon.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ kɛ ka m dataas fɛndigi zɔ ka basim, ka m kʋ banɛ kisim la wʋsa.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ka ba kaasi bɔɔd sʋŋir, amaa sɔ' kae na faaɛn ba. Ba kaasi tis Zugsɔb la ka o pʋ gi'e gɔsi ba.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: M bʋ' ba hali ka ba ti nwɛnɛ uusʋg ka pɛbisim ziidi kennɛ; m kpa'ae ba bas pal zug wʋʋ bian'ar nɛ.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Fʋ faanmi yis nimbanɛ kisim la nu'usin, ka kɛ ka m lieb tɛɛns la zugdaan; ka sʋ'oe nimbanɛ ka m zi' ba.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa giinla kɛns nɛ, ka ba kiridi yiti ba kpi'euŋ zin'isin kenna.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sid bɛ! Zun'or anɛ m Tampiing la din! Wina'am onɛ aan m faangid la nar nɛ zʋn'or!

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: O anɛ Wina'am onɛ yɔɔd banɛ tʋmmim bɛ'ɛd la sam, ka nyaŋid tɛɛns banɛ ka m sʋ'oe ba la,

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: o faanmi yisi m dataas nu'usin. Fʋ dʋ'ʋsimi gaadi m dataas, ka faanmi yis banɛ bɔɔd zaba la ni.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Alazug, Zugsɔba, m na na'asif buudi wʋsa sʋʋgin, m na yʋʋm wɔ'ɔgi fʋ yʋ'ʋr la.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Agɔla pa'annɛ Wina'am girima an si'em; saŋgbana la mɛ mɔɔnnɛ o nu'ug tʋʋma yɛla.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Dabisir wʋsa ba pian'adnɛ, yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa ba pa'annɛ o baŋiri an si'em.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Fʋ kʋ wʋm ka ba pian'ad bɛɛ yɛt si'ela amaa la'an nɛ wala, teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa mi' ba yɛla.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: Ba tiig teŋ wʋsa, ka ba labaar paae dunia bɛn la. Wina'am maal zin'ig agɔlli tis winnig la

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: ka li nwɛnɛ pu'apaal sidi naanɛ o dɔɔgin yit na, bɛɛ zɔzɔti zɔɔ nyaŋ ka maan sumalisim ye o lɛn zɔ.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Winnig la yitnɛ nya'aŋi gaadi keŋ lu tuon, si'el kae na su'a ka o tʋʋlʋg kʋ paae lii.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb wada la an sʋm hali, ka tɛndigid ninsaal sʋnf. Zugsɔb la pa'alʋg anɛ sida, ka kɛt ka banɛ zi' si'el la paam baŋir.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sa'alʋg dɔl suor, ka tisid sumalisim. Zugsɔb la zi'ela mɔr nɛɛsim linɛ nied ninsaal nini.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zɔtim anɛ nyain ka na bɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Zugsɔb la zi'el si'el la zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ ka pʋpielim bɛɛ li pʋʋgin hali.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Li an sʋm gat sanlimsʋŋ, li gat sanlimmɛŋir bɛdegʋ. Li malisi gat siind, li gat siind linɛ siligi yi singbana ni na.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Li ni ka m paamid nimmua sa'alʋg; man kanɛ aan fʋ sankpan'as la, m ya'a dɔlli li, li mɔri nyɔɔd bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi baŋ o gbɛlima? Kɛlli m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛsu'ada la taali bas.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: M anɛ fʋ sankpan'as, gurim ka m da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pɔn'ɔsim-pɔn'ɔsim; da kɛ ka li sʋ'ʋgi ma. Ala ka m kʋ mɔr gba'ar linɛ zu'oe halii.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m nɔɔr pian'ad nɛ m sʋnf tɛn'ɛsa paae fʋ ya'am, Zugsɔba, fʋ anɛ m Tampiing nɛ m Faangid.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a ti bɛ yɛla ni, Zugsɔb la na sʋ'ʋŋif; Jakob Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr na gurif.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: O na kɛ ka o sʋŋir naanɛ o pʋ'ʋsim yin la kena, ka kɛ ka fʋ paam sʋŋiri yi Zion teŋin.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: O na tiɛn fʋ piini la yɛla, ka di'e fʋ piini linɛ an nyu'or maan la.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: O na kɛ ka fʋ paami fʋ sʋʋnr bɔɔdim ka kɛ ka fʋ gban'ar wʋsa zi'en.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Ti na dʋ'ʋsi ti kʋkɔya agɔla maal sumalisim fʋ nyaŋir saŋa ka ʋki ti tuutanam agɔla nɛ Wina'am yʋ'ʋr zug. Zugsɔb na kɛ ka fʋ paam linɛ ka fʋ sɔs o la wʋsa.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Nannanna man mi' ye Zugsɔb la faand Na'akanɛ ka o gaŋ la. O naamid o mɛŋ zin'ig linɛ an kasi arezana ni la ka wʋm Na'ab la sɔsʋg, ka nɔk o paŋ tita'ar la sʋŋ o.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Sieba nɔki ba yadda niŋ nɛ zaba tɛrekonam ni ka sieba mɛ ti'e ba widi, amaa tinam niŋnɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr yadda; Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa na tu'ugi li, amaa tinam na duoe zi'en nɛ kpi'euŋ.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, tisim Na'ab la nyaŋir! Ti ya'a sɔs si'el, fʋn wʋm tisi ti.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, Na'ab la mɔr sumalisim fʋ paŋ la zug. O mɔr sumalisim hali nɛ nyaŋir banɛ ka fʋ kɛ ka o nyaŋ la zug!

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛ ka o paam o sʋnfʋ bɔɔd si'el ka pʋ kɛ ka o nɔɔri sɔs si'el la niŋ zaalim.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Fʋ di'e o nɛ bareka pamm ka nɔk sanlimmɛŋir zupibigi pil o zug.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: O sɔsif nyɔvʋr yɛla ka fʋ tis o; fʋ kɛ ka o bɛllim dabisa ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Fʋn kɛ ka o nyaŋ si'em la zug ka o girima zu'oe fʋ nɔk vɛnlim nɛ na'am pipilim tis o.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Sida, fʋ tis o albareka linɛ ka' naarɛ ka kɛ ka o pʋʋg pie nɛ sumalisim fʋn bɛɛ o san'an la zug.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Fʋ na nyaŋi fʋ dataas wʋsa; fʋ na nɔki fʋ paŋ la nyaŋi fʋ bi'emnam.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka fʋ na ti nie paalʋ la fʋ na maali ba wʋʋ bugum linɛ dit hali; Zugsɔb la sʋnduor pʋʋgin o na vɔli ba, ka o bugum la na kanbi ba.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Fʋ na kʋʋ ba yaas la wʋsa dunia zug, ka mɛlisi ba ninsaalib buudi wʋsa sʋʋgin.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ban gban'e gban'abɛ'ɛdi fʋ yɛla ka mɔr bugusim suoya la, ba kʋ nyaŋ hali baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ fʋ na gʋdi fʋ tiraug la kpa' ba ka li na kɛ ka ba fɛndig tɔ'ɔtɔ zɔ.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, di'em zun'ori fʋ paŋ la zug! Ti na yʋ'ʋm ka wɔ'ɔgif fʋ kpi'euŋ la zug.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: M Wina'am, m Wina'am, bɔ ka fʋ basi ma? Bɔɔ kɛ ka fʋ lal hali nɛ fʋn na faaɛn ma; fʋ lal nɛ hali, ka pʋ wʋmi m fabʋlʋgɔ?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: M Wina'am, man fabin nintaŋ, amaa fʋ pʋ wʋmmi tisidi ma, hali la'an nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ mam pʋ sinna.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala fʋnɛ an kasi. Fʋ zin'ini fʋ na'am gbauŋ la zug; fʋn ka Israel dim la wɔ'ɔgid.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Ba da fabili tisif ka paam faangir; fʋn ka ba da niŋ yadda ka pʋ di nyannɛ.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Amaa man yʋ'ʋn anɛ zʋnzʋnr ka ka' ninsaala, ka nidib la'adim ka nɛ'ɛsidim.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Banɛ nyɛɛm wʋsa maannim nɛ siaa; ba tʋ'ʋdimnɛ, ka lɔbidi ba zuti yɛt ye,

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: “O daa ti'enɛ Zugsɔb la, kɛl ka Zugsɔb la faaɛn o kɛl ka o yis o, on sadigim nɔŋ o yɛla la!”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ yisimi m ma pʋʋgin na; hali man da nan mu'adi m ma bin'isim la fʋn ka m da niŋ yadda.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Lin pin'ili m du'am daar la, fʋnɛ gurim; m ma pʋʋgin sa ka fʋ da aan m Wina'am.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Da lal nɛ ma bɔzugɔ yɛla la pʋ lalla ka sɔ' kae na sʋŋi ma.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: M dataas bɛdegʋ n la'asi giligim Ba nwɛnɛ Basan wɛniigi la'asi giligim.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Ba nwɛnɛ gbigima na gban'e bʋnkɔnbidi ɔnbid ka nwa'amid si'em la, ba ya'anɛ ba nɔya ieedim.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Ba kpa'ae mam wʋʋ ku'om nɛ, ka m kɔnba wʋsa pʋ lɛn tɔ'ɔŋ taabaa. M sʋnf nwɛnɛ kpaam linɛ nyɛligid nɛ; li nyɛligi yi ka basim.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: M kʋdignɛ wʋʋ tandʋk nɛ ka m zilim tabin; fʋ kɛ ka m dig teŋin wʋʋ kum nɛ.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'ɛdnam bɛdegʋ la'asi kena giligim nwɛnɛ baas nɛ, ba kʋnsi m nu'us nɛ m nɔba.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Man na nyaŋi kaali m kɔnba wʋsa; nidib la'asi gɔtim ka la'adim.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Ba pʋdigi m fuudi tis taaba ka maal bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm m fuug la yɛla.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Amaa, Zugsɔba, da bɛ lalli; m Paŋsɔba, kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na sʋŋim.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Yisimi m nyɔvʋr zaba sʋ'ʋs la ni, m nyɔvʋsʋŋ la, yisimi li baas la ni.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Faanmimɛ yis gbigima la nɔɔrin ka yisim wɛniigi la iila ni.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: M na yɛli m ba'abiis fʋn tʋm si'eli tisim la, m na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr nidib bɛdegʋ tuon.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la, wɔ'ɔgim o! Yanam banɛ an Jakob yaas la wʋsa, zun'omi nɛ o!

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: O pʋ zan'as onɛ namisid hali la, bɛɛ gɔsid o wʋʋ dian'ad sɔba; o pʋ fɛndig o nindaa ka bas oo, amaa o wʋm on kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir la.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Fʋn tʋm si'el la zug ka m zun'odif fʋ nidib la teŋsʋk, ka na tʋm man daa zi'el nɔɔr si'em la ka nidib la wʋsa nyɛ.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Nɔŋ dim na dii tig; banɛ ieed Zugsɔb la na wɔ'ɔg o, ba na paam bareka saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Dunia bɛn wʋsa na tiɛn ka lɛb Zugsɔb la san'an na, ka sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa nidib na igin o tuon,

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ na'am paŋ wʋsa anɛ Zugsɔb la din onɛ sʋ'oe sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Dunia nwa' kpan'am dim na di ka wɔ'ɔg o yʋ'ʋr; ka banɛ kpiid wʋsa na igin o tuon, la'an nɛ banɛ kʋ nyaŋi gɔsi ba mɛŋ la.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ba biis nɛ ba yaas la na dɔl o; ba na yɛl Zugsɔb la yɛla tis zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ na ti duoe na la.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Ba na yɛl o pʋpielim la yɛla tis nimbanɛ ka ba nam pʋ du'a la, bɔzugɔ onɛ maali li wʋsa.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la aan m gu'ud, si'el-si'el pʋ pansigidi ma.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: O kɛt ka m dig mɔma'asa zin'igin, o mɔrimi ken ku'oma'asig zin'ig,

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: o tɛndigidi m paŋ. O mɔrimi dɔl suosʋŋ zug o yʋ'ʋr zug.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Hali la'an nɛ man ken lik pʋʋgin la, m pʋ zɔt yɛlbɛ'ɛdɛ, bɔzugɔ fʋ bɛɛ m san'an, Zugsɔba, fʋ duor nɛ fʋ dansaar la bʋgʋnnɛ m sʋʋnr.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Fʋ maal diibi tisimi m dataas tuon. Fʋ bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ man zugin; ka man nwam pɛ'ɛli badigid.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Sida bareka nɛ nɔŋilim na dɔllim m nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsa, ka m na zin'in Zugsɔb yin yʋma linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ la anɛ Zugsɔb la din, nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa, dunia la, nɛ onɛ wʋsa bɛɛ li ni;

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Onɛ da ɛɛnbi li atɛukʋn ka kɛ ka li zi'e ku'omin la.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn na dʋ Zugsɔb kʋkʋn la zugɔ, ka anɔ'ɔn na zi'en Zugsɔb zin'ikanɛ an kasi la?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Li anɛ onɛ nu'usi an nyain ka an pʋʋg yinne sɔb la onɛ pʋ maan bɛɛ na'asid badaa bɛɛ pɔɔd linɛ an zirii.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: On sɔb na di'e albareka Zugsɔb la san'an ka Wina'am onɛ aan o faangid la na pa'al ye o anɛ sida sɔb

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ala ka li aan tis zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ ieed o la, ban banɛ ieed fʋn Jakob Wina'am la.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Duomini ya zut, yanam za'anɔya; yɔ'ɔgimi yanam kʋlis banɛ da pʋn bɛ kʋdimin sa la, ka na'anam Na'ab la kpɛn' na.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ an Na'akaŋa, ka o na'am mɔr pipilim la? Li anɛ Zugsɔb kanɛ mɔr paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ la Zugsɔb kanɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ zaba ni la.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Duomini ya zut, yanam za'anɔya, yɔ'ɔgimi, yanam kʋlis banɛ da pʋn bɛ kʋdimin sa la, ka na'anam Na'ab la na bɛ anina.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: M Zugsɔba, fʋ nu'usin ka m nɔki m mɛŋi niŋ;

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: fʋn ka m tis sida ka ti'e, m Wina'am. Da kɛ ka m di nyannɛ, bɛɛ m dataas tʋ'ʋdimi m liig zugɔ!

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, pa'alimi fʋ suoya la, kɛl ka m baŋi fʋ suobibis la.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Nɔkimi dɔlisi fʋ sida suoya la ka pa'alim. Fʋnɛ aan m Wina'am nɛ m Faangid, fʋ san'an ka m ti'ir bɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, tɛnri fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr nɛ fʋ nɔŋilim la, bɔzugɔ li anɛ linɛ da bɛ kʋdimin sa.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Da tɛn'ɛsidi m biilimin tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla nɛ man da zan'asidi fʋ nɔɔr si'em laa; fʋ nɔŋir la zugɔ tɛnri m yɛla, Naa m Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ an sʋm.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an sʋm ka o si'el wʋsa dɔl suor; alazug o pa'an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim, ye ba siak o suoya la.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Banɛ siedi ba mɛŋ la ka o kɛt ka ba dɔl linɛ an sʋm ka pa'annɛ ba o suoya sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la suoya wʋsa anɛ nɔŋilim nɛ linɛ an sida tisid banɛ dɔl o nɔnaar la bɔɔd si'em la.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Fʋ yʋ'ʋr zug, Naa Zugsɔba, kɛlli m taali bas, la'an nɛ lin zu'oe la.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la? Zugsɔb na nɔk suokanɛ ka o gaŋ la pa'al o.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: O sɔb bɛllim wʋsa ni, si'el kʋ pɔ'ɔg oo, ka o yaas na sʋ'ʋg teŋ la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zuanamɛ an banɛ zɔt o la; o kɛt ka ba baŋid o nɔnaar la.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ka m gɔsid saŋa wʋsa, on ma'aa na yisi m nɔba baans banɛ ka ba bɛnd la ni.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Fɛndigimi m san'an na ka zɔɔ m nimbaanlig, ka m anɛ m kɔn'ɔkɔn' ka pʋ mɔr paŋa.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Yɛla banɛ bɛɛ m zugin la maligim paasid nɛ; Faanmimɛ yis sʋnsa'aŋ pʋʋgin.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi m namisʋg nɛ m sʋnsa'aŋ ka yisi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi m bi'emnamɛ yʋ'ʋn zu'oe si'em ka gɔs ban kisim si'em!

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Gurim ka faanm; da kɛ ka m di nyannɛ, ka fʋ san'an ka m su'ad.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: M sʋm nɛ m sida la na faanm, bɔzugɔ m ti'ir bɛ nɛ fʋ ni.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Naa Wina'am, faanmi fʋ nidib Israel dim yisimi ba yɛla la wʋsa pʋʋgin!

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba tisim bʋʋd, ka m bɛllim la pʋ mɔr gba'arɛ; m tisnɛ fʋn sida ka pʋ lɛn gi'ed nya'aŋa.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Makimim ka kpansimi gɔs, kpansimi m sʋʋnr nɛ m pʋtɛn'ɛr.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋir la bɛɛ m san'an saŋa wʋsa, m kennɛ fʋ sida la pʋʋgin saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Mam pʋ dɔl ziri dima, bɛɛ m ba'a bɛ nɛ zam dima;

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: M pie m nu'usi pa'al ye m pʋ tʋm taalɛ ka keŋi fʋ maan bimbimin la.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: M nɔŋ yikanɛ ka fʋ bɛ la, Zugsɔba, fʋ na'am pipilim bɛ zin'isi'a la.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka m kpi nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dima, da la'asim nɛ ninkʋʋdiba,

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Amaa mam bɛllim pʋ mɔr gba'arɛ zɔmim nimbaanlig ka faanm.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: M nɔba zi'enɛ zin'ikanɛ an sassi. Nidibi la'as zin'isi'a bɛdegʋ la, ani ka mam na dʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la aan m nɛɛsim nɛ m faangid; anɔ'ɔn ka m zɔta? Zugsɔb la an onɛ gurimi m bɛllim pʋʋgin; anɔ'ɔn ka m na zɔt dabiem?

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Banɛ aan m dataas nɛ m bi'emnam la ya'a ti duoe ye ba zab nɛ mam ba wʋsa na tu'usidi lit.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Hali dataas ya'a giligim, m ya'am kʋ ian'adaa; la'an nɛ zaba ya'a kɔ' ka ba zabid nɛ m, li wʋsa ni m na paam sʋnkpi'euŋ.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Bʋn yinne ma'aa ka m sɔs Zugsɔb la; man sɔs si'eli nwa': m bɔɔd ye m bɛ Zugsɔb la yin m nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsa, ka nyɛt Zugsɔb la vɛnlim ka ieed o, o Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Yɛla ya'a ti bɛ, o na gurim on bɛ si'el la; o na su'am o Fuug Sʋgʋrin la ka dʋ'ʋsim tampintita'ar zug.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Ala ka m sʋʋnr na ma'ae m dataas banɛ giligim la yɛla; o Fuug Sʋgʋrin la ka m na maal maana ka tansid agɔla nɛ sumalisim. M na yʋ'ʋm tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: M ya'a buol, fʋn wʋmi m, m Zugsɔba, zɔmim nimbaanlig ka wʋmi m buolʋg.

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: M sʋʋnr yɛl mam ye, “Kem na iee o,” ka m daa lɛbis ye, “M na kena, Zugsɔba,

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: da su'a fʋ nindaa nɛ sʋnpɛɛnnɛ, da bidim kʋdugɔ, ka m anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm. Fʋnɛ aan m sʋŋid, da zan'asim bɛɛ fʋ tami m yɛllɛ, O m Wina'am nɛ m Faangida.”

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Baa m saam nɛ m ma ya'a zan'asim Zugsɔb la na di'em.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Pa'alimim fʋ suor la, o Zugsɔba, ka mɔrimi dɔl suokanɛ kpa' sappi, bɔzugɔ m dataas la zu'oe nɛ.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Da zaŋimi niŋi m dataas nu'usin ka ba tʋmim bam bɔɔd si'el la, bɔzugɔ ziri kasɛtib duoe zi'enɛ m yɛla, ka vʋ'ʋsidi kpɛn'ɛsidim dabiem.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: M nan kpɛn mɔr nɛ' ti'ir: m na nyɛ Zugsɔb la tʋʋm sʋma man nam bɛ dunia nwa' la.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Gu'usim Zugsɔb la, zi'enim sʋ'ʋŋa ka kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ sʋnf ka gu'us Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Fʋn ka m buol, O m Zugsɔba; fʋnɛ an m Tampiing, da li' fʋ tʋbaa. Fʋ ya'a sinni fʋ nɔɔr, m na nwɛnɛ banɛ kpi la nɛ.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Wʋm man kaasid ye fʋ zɔɔ m nimbaanlig ka sʋŋim la; ka ʋki m nu'usi kpa' fʋ Kasi Wʋsa Kasi Zin'ig la.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Da vɛ'ɛgimi la'as nɛ bugusim dim la yisɛ, da la'asim nɛ banɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd la, banɛ ma'aa pian'adi ba kpi'es nɛ nɔŋgban malisiŋ ka ba pʋʋgin pɛ'ɛl nɛ pʋkpɛnnim ma'aa la.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Ban sadigim pʋ nan Zugsɔb la tʋm si'el, bɛɛ o nu'usi maal si'el la, o na namisi ba, hali ka san'ami ba nyain.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: M na dʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr bɔzugɔ o wʋmi m kaasig ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la aan m paŋ nɛ m gbanti'edʋg; on ka m tis sida, ka nyɛt sʋŋir. O mɛ sʋŋidim ka m sʋnf malis hali ka m na yʋ'ʋm pʋ'ʋs o bareka.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la aan o nidib la paŋ nɛ ba kpi'euŋ, ka an suak zin'igi tis na'ab onɛ ka o gaŋ la.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Faanmi fʋ nidib la ka niŋi ba albareka; aan ba kɔnbkem ka guri ba saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ bɛ arezana ni, tisimi Zugsɔb la na'asi! Tisimi Zugsɔb na'asi o girima nɛ o paŋ la zug.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Tisimi Zugsɔb la na'asi linɛ nar nɛ o yʋ'ʋr la, zun'omi Zugsɔb onɛ vɛnl ka an kasi la.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la dammid ku'om la zug; Wina'am onɛ an girima sɔb ka mɔr paŋ la tans ya, Zugsɔb la tansid ku'otita'ar zug.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pian'ad mɔr paŋ; Zugsɔb la pian'ad mɔri na'asi.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kɔɔd na'aziinr tiis; hali Lebanon na'aziinr tiis la o kɔɔdi ba bur-bur.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: O kɛt ka Lebanon zuor la ian'asid wʋʋ na'abil nɛ, ka lɛn kɛt ka Hemon zuor ian'asid wʋʋ mɔɔgin na'arapɔl nɛ.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ya'a pian'ad, bugum yit nɛ.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pian'ad ka pipiris teŋ la dammid; Zugsɔb la dam Kades linɛ an pipirig teŋ la.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kɛ ka tibɛda dammid ka sian'arin tiis vaand sʋʋg wʋsa. Ka sɔ' wʋsa tansid o pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ye, “Girima anɛ Zugsɔb la din!”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zin'inɛ o na'am gbauŋ zug ka sʋ'oe dunia ku'om wʋsa; Zugsɔb la na'am pʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la tisid o nidib paŋ; Zugsɔb la kɛt ka o nidib la mɔr bareka nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: M na dʋ'ʋsif, O Zugsɔbaa, fʋn yisim teŋ teŋiri dʋ'ʋsim agɔl, ka pʋ kɛ ka m dataas nyaŋim la.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: M Zugsɔb Wina'am, m buolif ye fʋ sʋŋim ka fʋ tisim laafi.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋm tisi Zugsɔb, yanam banɛ aan o nidib la; zun'omini o yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: O sʋnpɛɛn pʋ yuugida, amaa o nɔŋir bɛ nɛ fʋ nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsa; kaasig na bɛ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ ma'aa, amaa sumalisim na kɛn bɛogʋn na.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: Man daa zi'e sʋ'ʋŋa la, m daa yɛl ye, “Sɔ' kʋ lɛn nyaŋi ma.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔbaa, fʋn daa maalim sʋ'ʋŋa la, fʋ daa kɛ ka m zi'e ka dabiem kae; amaa fʋn daa bidim kʋdig la dabiem daa mɔrim nɛ hali.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Naa Zugsɔbaa, fʋn ka m buol; Zugsɔb la ka m kaasi tis ye o zɔɔm nimbaanlig:

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: “M ya'a kpii keŋ yaʋgʋnɛ, nyɔbɔ ka fʋ na di'e? Titan la na nyaŋi zun'e fɔɔ? Li na mɔɔli fʋ yɛlsida la yɛlaa?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Fʋ tiaki m kaasig ka li lieb wa'a; fʋ yis sʋnsa'aŋ linɛ nwɛnɛ bɔto fuug la m niŋgbiŋin, ka lɛbis sumalisim yɛɛlim

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: ye li kɛ ka m sʋnf ma'ae ka m yʋ'ʋmmi tisidif ka kʋ an baanlimm nɛ. M Zugsɔb Wina'am, m na tisif bareka pʋ'ʋsim saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ san'an ka m su'a; da kɛ ka m di nyannɛ; faanmim nɛ fʋ pʋpielim la.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Wʋmmi m sɔsʋg; kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na faanm; an tampinkanɛ na su'am, ka an onɛ na faanm.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Fʋn sadigim aan m tampiing nɛ m kpi'euŋ zin'ig la; fʋ yʋ'ʋr zugɔ, aan m tuongat ka nwɛdigidim.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Faanmi yis baŋ kanɛ ka ba bɛndim la pʋʋgin, fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: M nɔki m siigi niŋi fʋ nu'usin; faanmim, Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ an sida Wina'am.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: M kis banɛ dɔl bada linɛ ka' gbin la; mam mɛ tis Zugsɔb la sida.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: M na maal sumalisim fʋ nɔŋir la ni, bɔzugɔ fʋ nyɛt man namisid si'em, ka baŋi m sʋnsa'aŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋ nɔkimi tisim dataas laa, amaa ka lɛɛ nɔki m nɔba zi'el zin'isʋŋin.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: Zɔmim nimbaanlig, O Zugsɔba, ka m bɛ nɛ sʋnsa'aŋin. M nini gɛnnɛ nɛ kaasig, ka m niŋgbiŋ nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Sʋnsa'aŋ kɛnɛ ka m gɛn ka m yʋma sied; namisʋg la kɛ ka m paŋ naae, ka m kɔnba ka' paŋ ya'asɛ.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: M dataas nɛ m kpi'es la wʋsa nɛ'ɛsidim nɛ; banɛ mi'im la zɔtim nɛ, ba ya'a nyɛɛm suoraugʋn ba zɔtnɛ.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Ba tami m yɛla ka li nwɛnɛ m kpinɛ nɛ; man yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ yʋkanɛ nwa'ae nɛ.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: M wʋm ka nidib bɛdegʋ nya'amid; dabiem gilig zin'ig wʋsa. Ba gban'ad gban'abɛ'ɛd man yɛla ka mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Amaa m tis fʋn sida, O m Zugsɔba; m yɛl ye, “Fʋnɛ aan m Wina'am.”

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: M bɛ nɛ fʋ nu'usin saŋa wʋsa; faanmim m dataas nɛ banɛ katim la nu'usin.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, da kɛ ka m di nyannɛ, amaa kɛl ka bugusim dim la di nyan ka digin yaʋgʋn baanlimm.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ziri dim la fɔn, bɔzugɔ ba mɔri nyɛɛsim nɛ tita'alim, ka pian'adi nɛ'ɛsid pʋpielim dim.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Fʋ mɔr bʋnsʋma bɛdegʋ, ka su'a li tisid banɛ zɔtif la. Fʋ tisid banɛ su'adi ba mɛŋi fʋ san'an la ka nidib wʋsa nyɛt.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr na nyɛ na'asi, bɔzugɔ man daa nwɛnɛ tempʋkanɛ ka dataas gilig la, o daa pa'al mam o nɔŋilim tita'ar.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: M daa kaasi yɛl ye, “O kadimi yis o san'an!” La'an nɛ wala man kaasi buolif ye fʋ sʋŋim la fʋ wʋmi m kaasig ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Nɔŋimi Zugsɔb la, yanam banɛ tis o sida la! Zugsɔb la gur banɛ an sida dim la, amaa ka yɔɔd tita'alim dim la sam ka li paadi li bɛn.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Zi'enimi sʋ'ʋŋa ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya sʋnf, yanam banɛ wʋsa ti'iri bɛ Zugsɔb san'an la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Wina'am bareka bɛ nɛ onɛ ka ba kɛɛ o taali bas ka lus o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Wina'am bareka bɛɛ tis ninkanɛ ka Zugsɔb la pʋ kaannɛ o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, nɛ onɛ wʋsa ka ziri ka' o san'anɛ.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Man daa pʋ viigi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, li daa kilim ban'asi m kɔnba ni ka m ʋʋnsid dabismum.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa fʋ daa tisim namisʋg, ka m paŋ wʋsa naae wʋʋ ɔnsir saŋa ka ku'om kpiɛnd si'em la.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: M gban'e ye, “M na viigi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi tis Zugsɔb la.” M yʋ'ʋn kaali m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi tisif ka pʋ su'af linɛ ka m pɔ'ɔg laa, ka fʋ daa kɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ ka m tʋm la taali bas.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, kɛl ka banɛ dɔl fʋn Wina'am la sɔsif saŋkan ka fʋ nam bɛ yammin la; Sida yɛlmugusa ya'a ti paae na wʋʋ ku'otita'ari badigidnɛ, li kʋ dii baa.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Fʋ anɛ m suak zin'ig; fʋ na gurim ka yisim yɛla pʋʋgin ka m na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma fʋ faangir la yɛla. Zugsɔb la yɛt ye,

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: “M na tisif nɔɔr ka pa'alif fʋn na ken si'em; M na sa'alif ka gurif.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Da nwɛnɛ wief bɛɛ bʋŋ banɛ pʋ gban'ad si'el gbinnɛ. Ba ya'a pʋ li'a ba nɔɔr ka bʋ'ʋdi ba, ba kʋ dɔl suorɛ.”

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Bugusim sɔb na nyɛ namisʋg bɛdegʋ, amaa onɛ siak Zugsɔb la o nɔŋilim linɛ pʋ naad la na bɛ nɛ o.

english_verse: And so your good people should celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Mɔri sumalisim ka maal sumalisim, yanam pʋpielim dima; yʋ'ʋmmi nɛ sumalisim, yanam banɛ pʋ mɔr gba'ar la.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Yanam pʋpielim dima, yʋ'ʋmmi nɛ sumalisim! Zun'omi Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, ka li nar ye banɛ pʋ mɔr gba'ar la zun'e o.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Nwɛ'ɛm kɔnne zun'e Zugsɔb la; yʋ'ʋmmi yʋʋma ka nwɛ' bʋnnwɛ'ɛda tis o.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋm yʋʋm paalli tis o, nwɛ'ɛm sʋ'ʋŋa ka tans nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pian'ad anɛ sida ka dɔl suor; ka on tʋm si'el wʋsa mɛ an sʋm.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la bɔɔdi pʋpielim nɛ sida; teŋgbauŋ la pɛ'ɛli nɛ o nɔŋilim linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pian'ʋk ka o da maal saŋgbana, o nɔɔr pɛbisim da maal winnig nɛ nwadig nɛ nwadbibis wʋsa.

english_verse: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
translation_verse: O da la'as atɛuk ku'om zin'ig yinne ka yɔ' ku'om la lɛbisi li bɛllim zin'igin.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Kɛl ka teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa zɔ Zugsɔb la; kɛl ka dunia nidib wʋsa na'as o sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: O da pian'anɛ ka li naam; o da tis nɔɔr ka li zi'en sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la widigid buudi wʋsa gban'ar; ka kɛ ka nidibi gban'e si'el la lieb yɔri.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la gban'ar zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ saŋa wʋsa, o sʋnfʋ gban'e si'el la dɔlisidnɛ paad zʋmaana wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ buudkanɛ ka Zugsɔb aan ba Wina'am la, nɛ nimbanɛ ka o gaŋ ka ba aan o nidib la.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la bɛ nɛ arezana ni ka gɔsid teŋinɛ nyɛt nidib wʋsa.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: On bɛ zin'isi'a la ka o gɔsid banɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Onɛ maal nidib wʋsa sʋnya ka mi' ban maan si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Na'ab kae na di ya'an ka li anɛ o soogianamɛ zu'oe la zugɔ; bɛɛ zabzabid kae na nyaŋi pɔns zaba ni nɛ o mɛŋ paŋa.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Zaba wief ti'ir anɛ zaalim; la'an nɛ on mɔr paŋ si'em la, o kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn fɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la nini laki kpa' nɛ banɛ zɔt o la, nɛ banɛ ti'iri bɛɛ o nɔŋilim linɛ ka' bɛn la ni,

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Ti gu'usid ka mɔr ti'ir Zugsɔb la ni; onɛ sʋŋidi ti ka lusidi ti.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: On zug ka ti sʋnya malis, o yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la ka ti tis sida.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ni ma'aa ka mam na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg; kɛl ka banɛ namisid la wʋm ka mɔr sumalisim.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Kem na ka ti la'asi wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb la; kɛl ka ti la'as taaba dʋ'ʋs o yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: M sɔs Zugsɔb la ka o di'e m sɔsʋg; o yisim dabiem wʋsa pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Banɛ gɔsid Zugsɔb la na mɔr sumalisim; ba kʋ di nyan baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Man onɛ an tadim nwa' buol Zugsɔb la ka o wʋm; o faanmi yis yɛla wʋsa pʋʋgin.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la maliak gur banɛ zɔt o la, ka faandi ba saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Li'elim na ka fʋ na baŋ ye Zugsɔb la dɔllim malis; ninkanɛ wʋsa su'a o mɛŋ o san'an mɔr Wina'am bareka.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ an Zugsɔb nidib la, zɔmini o; si'el kʋ pansig banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb laa.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Kɔ'ɔm na wʋm gbigima ka ba tadig, amaa banɛ ti'e Zugsɔb la, bʋnsʋŋ si'a kʋ pɔ'ɔgi baa.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Kemi na, m biisɛ, kɛlisimi; M na pa'ali ya ka ya na zɔt Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ bɛ ya sʋʋgin nɔŋ vʋm ka bɔɔd ye o vʋe yuug ka o bɛllim na malisa?

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: Gban'ami fʋ zilim ka li da pian'ad bɛ'ɛdɛ ka mɛ da kɛ ka fʋ nɔɔr pian'ad an zirii.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Basim bɛ'ɛd tʋʋma ka fɛndigi tʋm linɛ an sʋm; gban'am sumbʋgʋsʋm, nu'us ayi' ka da basɛ.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nindaa kpa'anɛ gɔsid pʋpielim dim ka o tʋba yɔ'ɔgi kɛlisidi ba fabʋlʋg;

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la fɛndig o nindaa bid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim kʋdig, ye o kɛ ka nidib tami ba yɛla dunia nwa' ni.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dim ya'a kaasi buol Zugsɔb la, o na kɛlisi tisi ba, ka na yisi ba yɛla wʋsa pʋʋgin.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pʋ lal nɛ banɛ sʋnya san'am la, ka sʋŋid banɛ ti'iri naae la.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Yɛla bɛdegʋ na tun'e paae pʋpiel, amaa Zugsɔb la na yis o li wʋsa pʋʋgin;

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: o na yis o yɛlbɛ'ɛd wʋsa pʋʋgin, hali o kɔnbir baa yinne kʋ kɔ'ɔgɛ.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Pʋkpɛnnim linɛ ka bugusim dim mɔr la na mɔri ba keŋ; banɛ kis pʋpielim dim la na nyɛ kʋʋsbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na faaɛn o tʋmtʋmnib; banɛ nɔki ba mɛŋi dɛllim o la kʋ nyɛ kʋʋsbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Nɔkimi fʋ kpan nɛ fʋ duori gu' banɛ kati dɔllim la. Yɛlimim ye, “Manɛ an fʋ faangid.”

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm la di nyan ka nyan kpɛn' ba; banɛ ieedi m san'auŋ la, kɛl ka ba ya'am fɛndig ka ba tuligi lɛb.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba na nwɛnɛ udugi bɛ pɛbisim ni, ka Zugsɔb maliak na da'ae ba mɔri gaad;

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: ba suor na lieb lik nɛ sisalig, ka Zugsɔb maliak la kati ba.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Ban sadigim bɛnd mam baans zaalim-zaalim ka tuud bʋmbɔk ye m li la,

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: san'auŋ na gbirigi paae ba, baŋ kanɛ ka ba bɛnd la na gban'e ba mɛŋ, ka ba na li bʋmbɔk kanɛ ka ba tu la ni ka nyɛ san'auŋ.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Ala ka m sʋnf na malis nɛ m Zugsɔb la ka na mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ o nɔŋilim la.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: M na dʋ'ʋsi o yʋ'ʋr ka yɛl ye, “Anɔ'ɔnɛ bɛ nwɛnɛ fʋ, O Zugsɔba? Fʋ faaɛn nɔŋ dim ninkpi'ema nu'usin, fʋ faaɛn nɔŋ dim nɛ fara dim faandib nu'usin.”

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Kasɛtib banɛ pʋ mɔr zi'esim yi tuon na m bu'osidim linɛ ka m zi' yɛla.

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: M maali ba sʋm ka ba lɛbisim bɛ'ɛd, ka m yʋ'ʋn kpɛlimmi m kɔn'ɔkɔn' nɛ pakir.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala ban daa bɛn'ɛd la m daa mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ ka yɛ bɔto fuug, ka sie m mɛŋi lɔ nɔɔr. Amaa winsɔsʋg la daa pʋ di'e la,

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: m daa kumnɛ nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ wʋʋ ba anɛ m zuanam bɛɛ m yidim, ka sʋ'ʋnnɛ m zug nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ wʋʋ m ma yɛla ka m kaasidnɛ.

english_verse: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
translation_verse: Amaa man tu'ug la, ba la'as nɛ maan sumalisim; ba la'asi giligimi bu'osidim linɛ ka m zi' li gbinnɛ. Ba kɛɛndim nɛ ka pʋ basida.

english_verse: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
translation_verse: Ba la'adim nɛ nwɛnɛ banɛ zi' Wina'am nɛ. Ba ga'adi ba nyina man yɛla.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, bɔ ka li yuug ka fʋ pʋ maan si'ela? Faanmi m nyɔvʋri yis banɛ zabid nɛ m la nu'usin, faanmi m nyɔvʋri yis gbigim bama ni.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: M na pʋ'ʋsif bareka nidib la la'asʋg zin'igin. Nidib la wʋsa sʋʋgin, m na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka m dataas banɛ an ziri dim la maal sumalisim man nyaŋir yɛla. Banɛ kisim zaalim-zaalim la, da kɛ ka ba maal sumalisim m sʋnsa'aŋ yɛlaa.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ pian'ad nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm, amaa ba ma'adi ziin nimbanɛ bɛ baanlimm teŋin la.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ba mi'edim ka la'adim ye, “Ha! Haa! Ti nyɛya nɛ ti mɛŋ nini!”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ nyɛ nɛ'ɛŋa; da sin baanlimm nɛ. Da lal nɛ ma, Zugsɔbaa.

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: O m Zugsɔb nɛ m Wina'am fʋn an pʋpiel la zug, tisimim bʋʋd; da kɛ ka ba sʋnf ma'ae man yɛllɛ.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ba la' ye, “Hahaa, tinamɛ bɔɔdin si'eli nwa'!” Bɛɛ ba yɛl ye, “Ti yʋ'ʋn vɔl o naae.”

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ maan sumalisim man yɛla la di nyan ka ba ya'am fɛndig; banɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ ye ba gat mam la na di nyan ka ba zug fak.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Banɛ mɛ bɛɛ m nya'aŋ ye m di bʋʋd la na tansid nɛ sumalisim; ba na yɛt ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ mɔr sumalisim nɛ o tʋmtʋm bɛllim la yʋ'ʋr na paam zʋn'or.”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: M zilim na pian'adi fʋ pʋpielim la yɛla ka wɔ'ɔgif dabisir la wʋsa.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nya'amid nimbɛ'ɛd sɔb tʋba ni. O pʋ zɔt Wina'am ka na gu'usɛ.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: On dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ la zugʋ kɛt ka o pʋ baŋid ye o tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ bɛɛ o ki'is o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: O nɔɔr pian'ad anɛ bɛ'ɛd nɛ ziri; o zan'as nɛ on na iee ya'am ka tʋm linɛ an sʋm.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Hali o dig zin'igin o la'am gban'adi bɛ'ɛd; o zaŋ o pʋtɛnda lɔ nɛ suogɔnlima ka pʋ zan'asid linɛ mɔr gba'arɛ. Zugsɔb la nɔŋilim yɛla

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ nɔŋilim la paae agɔla ka fʋ yɛlsida la paae saŋgbana ni.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋpielim la nwɛnɛ zuotitada nɛ, ka fʋ sida la zulim hali. O Zugsɔbaa, fʋnɛ gur ninsaalib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋilim la zu'onɛ ka ligidi kʋ nyaŋi da' lii, nidib wʋsa su'adi ba mɛŋ nɛ fʋ san'an.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Diib linɛ yiti fʋ yin na la ka ba dit; fʋ maal sʋm tisi ba ka li nwɛnɛ ku'om linɛ pʋbid ka ba nuud.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Fʋ san'an ka vʋm bɛ; Li anɛ fʋ nɛɛsim la zug ka ti nyɛt.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ nɔŋilim la kpɛm bɛ nɛ banɛ mi' la, ka fʋ pʋpielim la mɛ bɛ nɛ banɛ pʋ mɔr gba'ar la.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka nyɛɛsim dim la li'eli m san'an naa, bɛɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam la nyaŋi kadi ma.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Gɔsim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la li si'em ba liya ka kʋ nyaŋi duoe!

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf duoe nɛ banɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd la yɛla bɛɛ fʋ mɔr fufum nɛ bugusim dim la;

english_verse: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.
translation_verse: ba na sʋʋg wʋʋ mɔɔd nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ mɔma'asa kʋdig nɛ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Tisim Zugsɔb la sida ka tʋm linɛ an sʋm; bɛ teŋin la ka nyɛ li malisim.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ ya'amlɛog bɛ Zugsɔb la ni; ka o na tisi fʋ, fʋ ya'am bɔɔd si'el.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Pɛsigimi fʋ mɛŋi tis Zugsɔb la; tisim o sida ka o na tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa:

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: o na kɛ ka fʋ pʋpielim la nie wʋʋ bɛogʋ nied nɛ, ka fʋ yɛlsida la na nwɛnɛ nintaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: An baanlimm Zugsɔb la tuon ka gu'usid o; nidib bɛllim ya'a an sʋm tisi ba, bɛɛ ba ya'a gban'ad gban'abɛ'ɛdɛ, fʋn da kɛ ka li daami fɔ.

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf san'am bɛɛ pɛligɛ; ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dɔlli sumpɛɛn nya'aŋ.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ba na kʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim bɛɛ ba kadi ba yis, amaa banɛ ti'iri bɛ Zugsɔb san'an la na sʋ'ʋg teŋ la.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ an baanlimm la na sʋ'ʋg teŋ la ka na mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Bugusim dim la gban'ad bɛ'ɛd pʋpielim dim yɛla ka ga'ad nyina ba yɛla;

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: amaa Zugsɔb la la'adi ba nɛ, bɔzugɔ o mi' ye ba dabisir kenna.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Bugusim dim la fuoe sʋ'ʋg ka gʋd tiraug ye ba kʋ nɔŋ nɛ fara dim, nɛ banɛ bɛllim dɔl suor la.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Amaa ba zaba sʋ'ʋs la na lɛbi kʋnsi ba mɛŋ susʋnya, ka ba tiraad la na kɔ'.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔbi mɔr si'el bi'ela la an sʋm gat bugusim dimi mɔr si'el bɛdegʋ la;

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ bugusim dim la paŋ na naae, amaa Zugsɔb la na ti'ed pʋpielim dim.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mi' pʋpielim dim dabisa, ka ba na di faar saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Yɛlpakir saŋa ba kʋ nyaŋi baa; ka ba na dii tig kɔ'ɔm saŋa.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Amaa bugusim dim la na kpi. Zugsɔb dataas la vɛnlim nwɛnɛ mɔɔd puum ba na bɔdig wʋʋ nyɔ'ɔs nɛ.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'ɛdnam la ya'a pɛ'ɛŋ ba pʋ yɔɔda, amaa pʋpielim dim la on tisid piini.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka Zugsɔb niŋ bareka la na sʋ'ʋg teŋ la, amaa banɛ ka o pɔ nɔɔri tisi ba la na kpi.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Sɔ' bɛllim ya'a malis Zugsɔb la, o na kɛ ka o ba' nya'a sʋ'ʋŋa;

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: baa o ya'a tu'ug, o kʋ lii, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la na mɔr o nɛ o nu'us.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: M da anɛ dasaŋ ka nannanna m yʋ'ʋn kʋdig nɛ, la'an nɛ wala m nam pʋ nyɛ ka Zugsɔb la bas pʋpielim dim la, bɛɛ ba biis sɔsid diibɔ.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Ba piinid ka pɛmisid nidib saŋa wʋsa; ba biis na paam bareka hali.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Fɛndigim yi bɛ'ɛdin ka tʋm linɛ an sʋm; ka fʋ na bɛ teŋin la saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la nɔŋ sida dim ka kʋ basi ba baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dim na sʋ'ʋg teŋ la ka bɛɛ li ni saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔb pian'ad nɛ ya'am ka pian'akanɛ yit o nɔɔrin na an sida.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: O Wina'am la wada bɛ nɛ o sʋnfʋn; ka o nɔbir mɛ pʋ sadigida.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'ɛdnam la dignɛ gur pʋpielim dimi mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋ ba;

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: amaa Zugsɔb la kʋ tisi ba suorɛ, bɛɛ o kɛ ka ba kʋʋsi ba bɛ'ɛd antu'a zin'iginɛ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Gu'usim Zugsɔb la ka dɔl o suor. O na dʋ'ʋsif ka kɛ ka fʋ sʋ'oe teŋ la; nimbɛ'ɛdnam la na kpii naae ka fʋ nini nyɛ.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: M nini nyɛ nimbɛ'og kanɛ zugʋ kpi'em ka si'el wʋsa an sʋm tis o wʋʋ tikanɛ ka ba sɛ kʋ'ʋlʋm zin'ig,

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Kpansim banɛ ka' gba'ar nɛ pʋpielim dim la kii gɔs; ba mɔr sumalisim bɛog sa.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Amaa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim wʋsa na kpi; nimbɛ'ɛdnam la pʋ mɔr bɛogɔ.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dim faangir yit nɛ Zugsɔb la san'an na; yɛl ya'a ti paae ba on onɛ aan ba kpi'euŋ sɔb la na guri ba.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la guri ba ka faandi ba; o faandi ba nimbɛ'ɛdnam la nu'usin, bɔzugɔ o san'an ka ba zɔti su'ad.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, fʋ sʋnf ya'a ti duoe fʋn da zɛrigim bɛɛ kɛ ka m nyɛ namisʋgɔ.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ fʋ piema la kʋnsim, ka fʋ paŋ nwɛ'ɛmi digil teŋin.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Fʋ sumpɛɛn la zug ka m niŋgbina pʋ mɔr laafii; m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la kɛnɛ ka m kɔnba zabid.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: M fɛn'ɛd la yalig nɛ ka nyuusid ka li anɛ m zɔlim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Ba lɔɔm nɛ digil teŋin; dabisir la wʋsa ka m ken ka kum.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: M nya'aŋ wʋsa tʋlig nɛ zabid; ka laafi ka' m niŋgbina la nii.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: M gɛnnɛ tadig hali; ka m sʋʋnr san'am, ka m niŋgbina zabir kɛ ka m ʋʋnsid.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔbaa, fʋ mi' man bɔɔd si'el wʋsa m kaasig la pʋ su'a fʋ san'anɛ.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: M ya'am ian'ad, ka m paŋ naae; hali m nini pʋ lɛn nyɛta.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: M sapu'ad la zug, m zuanam nɛ m dɔllim taas luakidimnɛ; m kpi'es pʋ lɛn li'ennɛ ma.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Banɛ mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm la bɛndim nɛ baans, ka banɛ pʋ bɔɔdi m yɛla la mɔɔdi m san'auŋ; dabisir la wʋsa ba gban'adi ziri gban'ar.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: M nwɛnɛ tʋbkpida nɛ, ka pʋ wʋmma, ka nwɛnɛ gik nɛ, ka kʋ nyaŋi pian';

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: M yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ ninkanɛ pʋ wʋmma, ka o nɔɔr kʋ nyaŋi ya'ae lɛbis pian'adɛ.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: M gu'usidif nɛ, O Zugsɔbaa; fʋnɛ na lɛbisi tisim, O Zugsɔb onɛ aan m Wina'am.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Man yɛl ye, “Da kɛ ka m dataas sʋnf ma'ae bɛɛ ba dʋ'ʋsi ba mɛŋ man tu'ug la zugɔ.”

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ m bɔɔdi liig, ka m niŋgbina zabir la bɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: M viigi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd; m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la daamidim nɛ.

english_verse: Many deadly and powerful enemies hate me,
translation_verse: M dataas la bɛdegʋ mɔr laafi nɛ paŋ; banɛ kisim zaalim-zaalim la zu'oya.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka m maali ba sʋm la lɛbisidimnɛ bɛ'ɛd, m ya'a tʋm linɛ dɔl suor ba pian'adi m yɛla bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, da basi ma; da lal nɛ ma, O Wina'am.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na sʋŋim O m Zugsɔb nɛ m Faangida.

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: M yɛl ye, “M na gu'usid nɛ m suoya la ka gban'e m zilim ka kʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ; nimbɛ'ɛdnam la ya'a bɛɛ m san'an, m na gban'e m nɔɔr.”

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Amaa man sin ka an baanlimm ka pʋ yɛt si'el linɛ an sʋm la, m sʋnsa'aŋ la maligim paasidnɛ.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: M susʋnf tʋligidnɛ, ka m ya'a tɛn'ɛsid li la'aŋid nɛ bugum; ka m gʋ'ʋŋ ka yɛl ye,

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Fʋ maali m nyɔvʋr ka li anɛ giŋa; m nyɔvʋr bɛllim anɛ zaalim fʋ san'an. Sɔ' wʋsa nyɔvʋr ka' si'el si'eli fʋ san'anɛ.

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Ninsaal nwɛnɛ ma'asim nɛ ken ka tulisid: o zɔtnɛ giilim zaalim-zaalim; o la'asid kpan'am digin ka zi' onɛ na ti dii o faarɛ.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: “Amaa nannanna, Zugsɔbaa, bɔ ka m ieeda? M ti'ir bɛ nɛ fʋ san'an.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Faanmim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pʋʋgin; da kɛ ka zɔn la la' ma.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: M na an baanlimm ka kʋ pian'ada, bɔzugɔ li anɛ fʋnɛ tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa.”

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Da lɛn namisim ya'asɛ; ka m gɛnnɛ fʋ nu'ug nwɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Fʋ zɛrigid ka sa'an nidibi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla; ka san'amid linɛ ka ba mɔr la wʋʋ muak nɛ, ninsaal wʋsa nwɛnɛ pɛbisim nɛ.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: “O Zugsɔba, wʋmmi m sɔsʋg, kɛlisimi m kaasig ka sʋŋim; Da li' fʋ tʋba nɛ m kukuma laa. Bɔzugɔ m bɛ nɛ fʋ san'an wʋʋ saan nɛ, m anɛ suoken wʋʋ m yaanamɛ da an si'em la.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Fɛndigimi fʋ nindaa m san'an, ka kɛ ka m nyɛ sumalisim bi'ela ya'as, ka m kum saŋa nyaan paae ka m gaad ka kʋ lɛm bɛɛ.”

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: M bʋgʋli m sʋʋnri gu'usid Zugsɔb la ka o fɛndig na ka wʋmi m kaasig.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: O vɛ'ɛgimi yis bʋmbɔk bɛ'ɛd la pʋʋgin, zin'ikanɛ an bian'ar ka bu'ad la; o nɔkimi zi'el tampiing zug ka tisim zin'isʋŋ ye m zi'en.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: O pa'alim yʋʋm paal ye m yʋ'ʋm, yʋʋm kanɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ti Wina'am la. Nidib bɛdegʋ na nyɛ ka zɔ dabiem ka tis Zugsɔb la sida.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ nimbanɛ ti'e Zugsɔb la nɛ ba sʋʋnr wʋsa ka pʋ gɔsid banɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ nɛ banɛ fɛndigi pʋ'ʋsid wina banɛ ka' sida la.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: O m Zugsɔb nɛ m Wina'am, nyalima banɛ ka fʋ maal la zu'oya. Fʋn gban'e ti yɛla si'em la sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi kaali pa'alɛ; li ya'a an ye m pian' li yɛla, li zu'onɛ galis ka m kʋ nyaŋi kaalɛ.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋ bɔɔd bʋnkɔnbid nɛ zʋʋd malimaa, amaa fʋ yɔ'ɔgi m tʋba ye m kɛlis. Nyu'or maan nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan ka' linɛ ka fʋ bɔɔda.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Ani ka m yɛl ye, “Manɛ nwa', m kena; li pʋn sɔbi m yɛla gbauŋʋn la.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: O Wina'am, m bɔɔd ye m tʋmi fʋ bɔɔdim; fʋ wada la bɛɛ m sʋʋnrin.”

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: M mɔɔl pʋpielim yɛla fʋ nidib la la'asʋg zin'igin, m pʋ gban'e m nɔɔr wʋʋ fʋn pʋm mi' si'em la, m Zugsɔba.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: M pʋ su'a fʋ pʋpielim la m sʋnfʋnɛ; m pian'adi fʋ sida nɛ fʋ pʋpielim la yɛla. M pʋ su'a fʋ nɔŋilim nɛ fʋ sida la nidib la la'asʋg sʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: Da yisi fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr la m san'anɛ, O m Zugsɔbaa; kɛl ka fʋ nɔŋilim nɛ fʋ sida la gurim. Sʋŋir sɔsʋg (Yʋm

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Yɛla banɛ giligim la pʋ mɔr kallɛ, m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la nyaŋim nɛ ka m pʋ lɛn nyɛta. Ba zu'oe gati m zuobid kal ka m ya'am ianki bɔdig sɔee.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: M Zugsɔba, dim suguru ka faanm; m Zugsɔba, kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na sʋŋim.

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Banɛ ieedim ye ba kʋʋm la, kɛl ka ba ya'am fɛndig ka ba di nyan. Banɛ wʋsa bɔɔdi m san'auŋ la na fɛndigi lɛb nɛ nyan.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka nyan di banɛ la'ad mam ye, “Hahaa, hahaa la!”

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ wʋsa ieedif la sʋnf na malis ka ba na mɔr sumalisim nɛf; kɛl ka banɛ nɔŋi fʋ faangir la yɛt saŋa wʋsa ye, “Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr na nyɛ zʋn'or!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala m anɛ nɔŋdaan ka an fara sɔb; Zugsɔb la na tɛn'ɛsi m yɛla. Fʋnɛ aan m sʋŋid nɛ onɛ faandim; O m Wina'am, da yuugɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
