translation_verse: Wina'am bareka bɛ nɛ onɛ tɛn'ɛsid tadimnam yɛla; o ya'a ti bɛ yɛla ni, Zugsɔb la na yis o.

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na gur o nɛ o nyɔvʋr; o na niŋ o zug bareka teŋ la ni ka kʋ kɛ ka o lii o bi'emnam nu'usin bɛɛ ba maal o ban bɔɔd si'em.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na sʋŋ o, o ban'as saŋa ka na kɛ ka o paam laafi o wiim la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: M yɛl ye, “O Zugsɔba, m tʋm taali pɔ'ɔgif; zɔmim nimbaanlig ka tisim laafi.”

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: M dataas pian'adi m yɛla ye, “Bʋndaar ka o na kpi ka o yʋ'ʋr bɔdigɛ?”

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Ba nid yinne ya'a kena nyɛɛm o nɔɔr pian'adi linɛ ka' sidaa, ka mɛ tɛn'ɛs yɛlbɛ'ɛd o sʋnfʋn, ka yii mɔɔli li tis nidib zin'ig wʋsa.

english_verse: My enemies whisper about me. They think the worst,
translation_verse: M dataas la wʋsa nya'amidi taaba m yɛla; ba makid yɛlbɛ'ɛdi tisidimi yɛt ye,

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: “Ban'abɛ'ɛdi gban'e o; on dig si'em la o kʋ lɛn duoe.”

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Hali m mɛŋ zua, onɛ ka m niŋ o yadda, onɛ ka man nɛ on la'am dit la, yii m nya'aŋi zi'e m yɛla.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn onɛ aan m Zugsɔba, zɔmim nimbaanlig; kɛl ka m duoe ka yɔɔ ba sam.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: M mi' ye fʋ bɔɔdi m yɛla, bɔzugɔ m dataas la pʋ nyaŋi ma.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: M bɛllim an sʋ'ʋŋa la zug fʋ kʋ basi ma ka na kɛ ka m bɛɛ fʋ tuon saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Dʋ'ʋsim Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr, saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Ami! Ami!

english_verse: ) Longing for God
translation_verse: ) Onɛ bɛ teŋ zʋŋ winsɔsʋg

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ waligi yu'osidi bɔɔd ku'om si'em la; ala ka m siig mɛ yu'osidi fʋ yɛla, O Wina'am.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: M sʋʋnr wʋsa bɛ nɛ fʋn Wina'am kanɛ vʋe la ni. Saŋkanɛ ka m na kɛɛn fʋ san'an na?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: M ninta'am aan m diib nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa, ka nidib yʋ'ʋn bu'osidim ye, “Fʋ Wina'am la bɛ yaanɛ?”

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: M ya'a tɛn'ɛs nɛ'ɛnam yɛla li tisidim nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ: man daa ɛɛnti dɔl nidib bɛdegʋ si'em ka gaadi ba tuon ka ti yʋ'ʋmmi kpɛn'ɛd Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim Yin la; ti daa tansid agɔla nɛ sumalisim tisid Wina'am bareka pʋ'ʋsim, malʋŋ tiɛnr saŋa.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Bɔ ka m sʋʋnr aan anwana? Bɔ ka li daamidim wala? Kɛl ka m nɔki m ti'iri niŋi m Wina'am la ni, mam na kpɛn dʋ'ʋsid o yʋ'ʋr; m Zugsɔb

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: nɛ m Wina'am. M sʋʋnr wʋsa san'amnɛ hali; dinzug, m na tɛnri fʋ yɛla lin yi Joodan kɔldaug baba, nɛ Hemon nɛ Mizar zuoya la ni.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: Sʋnsa'aŋ tita'ari paam ka li nwɛnɛ ku'otita'ari naan zuor zugʋ suugid teŋin; ka li paŋ nɛ ku'onwiis la nyaŋim hali.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nɔŋir na bɛɛ m san'an nintaŋ, ka o yʋʋma bɛɛ m nɔɔrin yʋ'ʋŋ; m sɔsidi Wina'am onɛ sʋ'oe m nyɔvʋr la.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: M yɛli m Wina'am onɛ aan m tampiing la ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ tami m yɛla? Bɔ ka fʋ kɛ ka m fabinnɛ m dataasi mugusidim hali la yɛla?”

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: M kɔnba la zabidnɛ hali ka li nwɛnɛ m bɔɔdi kum nɛ, m dataas la tʋ'ʋdimnɛ ka yɛtim saŋa wʋsa ye, “Fʋ Wina'am la bɛ yaanɛ?”

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka m sʋʋnr aan anwana? Bɔ ka li daamidim wala? Man na nɔki m ti'iri niŋi m Wina'am la ni, mam na kpɛn dʋ'ʋsid o yʋ'ʋr; onɛ aan m Faangid nɛ m Wina'am.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Tisimim bʋʋd, O m Wina'am, ka zab nɛ banɛ zan'asi fʋ nɔnaar la sʋŋim; faanmim nimbɛ'ɛd banɛ an ziri dim la nu'usin.

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Fʋ anɛ Wina'am onɛ aan m kpi'euŋ sɔb, bɔ ka fʋ zan'asi ma? Bɔ ka fʋ kɛ ka m kummi gin ka li anɛ m dataasi namisidim la zugɔ?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ nɛɛsim nɛ fʋ sida la kena; kɛl ka ba pa'alimi fʋ suor, ka mɔrimi kɛɛn fʋ zuor kanɛ an kasi la ni na, zin'ikanɛ ka fʋ bɛ la.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Ani ka m na keŋ Wina'am bimbimin la, Wina'am kanɛ aan m sumalisim nɛ m ya'am bʋn la san'an. M na nwɛ' kɔnne dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr, O Wina'am onɛ an m Wina'am.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka m sʋʋnr aan nwana? Bɔ ka li daamidim wala? M na nɔki m ti'iri niŋ Wina'am la ni, mam na kpɛn dʋ'ʋsid; o yʋ'ʋr; onɛ aan m Faangid nɛ m Wina'am.

english_verse: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
translation_verse: Ti Wina'am, ti wʋmi li nɛ ti mɛŋ tʋba; ka ti yaanam mɛ yɛli ti fʋn da tʋm si'em ba saŋa la yʋma banɛ da gaad la sa.

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔki fʋ nu'ugʋ kad buudi bɛdegʋ yis ka zin'ili ti yaanamɛ ba teŋin; fʋ da namis nidib la pamm ka lɛɛ kɛ ka ti yaanam zin'in nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Li ka' ba mɛŋi da zabi faaɛn teŋ la, bɛɛ ba zaba la'ad ka ba da nɔki nyaŋɛ; li da anɛ fʋ nu'ukanɛ mɔr paŋ la, nɛ nɛɛsim kanɛ bɛɛ fʋ nindaan la, fʋn nɔŋi ba la zug.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ aan m na'ab nɛ m Wina'am, onɛ pian' nyaŋir yɛla tis Jakob.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Li anɛ fʋ paŋ zug ka ti nyaŋi ti dataas; fʋ yʋ'ʋr zug ka ti nɔɔdi ti bi'emnam nɛ nɔba.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Mam pʋ ti'e m tiraug la, m zaba sʋ'ʋg la pʋ tisidim nyaŋirɛ;

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: amaa fʋnɛ tisi ti paŋ ka ti nyaŋi ti dataas, fʋ diis banɛ nya'ad nɛ ti la nyan.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Wina'am la yɛla ka ti mɔri nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg saŋa wʋsa, ti nan kpɛn dʋ'ʋsidi fʋ yʋ'ʋr saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna fʋ zan'as ya ka sie ti; fʋ pʋ lɛn yit nɛ ti zabzabidib la ya'asɛ.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛ ka ti fɛndigi zɔ ka basi ti dataas, ka ti bi'emnam la faaɛn ti la'ad.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka ba kɔti ti wʋʋ kɔnbid nɛ ka widigi ti kpɛn'ɛs teŋ zʋna bɛdegʋ ni.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Fʋ kuosi fʋ nidib nɛ yɔn, ka pʋ nyɛ nyɔɔdi fʋ kuosʋg la pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka ti kpi'es nyɛ ti gbin, ka banɛ kpi'e nɛ ti la nɛ'ɛsidi ti ka la'adi ti.

english_verse: Foreigners joke about us and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛ ka ti lieb bʋnla'adir buudi bɛdegʋ sʋʋgin; nidib la gɔsidi ti ka lɔbid zug.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Man diti nyan daar wʋsa, ka pʋ lɛn nyaŋidi duodi m zugɔ

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: banɛ nɛ'ɛsidim ka tʋ'ʋdim la yɛla, nɛ m dataas banɛ bɔɔd ye ba yɔ sam la zug.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa maali ti, la'an nɛ tinamɛ pʋ tami fʋ yɛla la, bɛɛ zan'asi fʋ nɔnaar la.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Ti pʋtɛn'ɛr pʋ yii fʋ san'anɛ; ti nɔba pʋ yii fʋ suorin la.

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋ nyɔrigi ti bas ka ti bɛ nɛ mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid. Fʋ kɛya ka lik ligili ti.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a tammin nɛ Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ ti yadigi ti nu'usi pʋ'ʋsid win zʋna,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: Wina'am naan kʋ baŋinɛɛ? On mi' linɛ bɛ ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛrin la!

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala fʋn zug ka ba kʋʋdi ti saŋa wʋsa; ka maannɛ ti nwɛnɛ pɛ'ɛs ka ba mɔri ken ye ba kɔdig nɛ.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Duom, O Zugsɔba! Bɔ ka fʋ gbisida? Duomi fʋ mɛŋ! Da zan'asi ti baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ su'adi fʋ nindaa ka tami ti namisʋg nɛ banɛ mugusidi ti la yɛla?

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Ti yʋ'ʋn bɛ nɛ teŋin; ka ti niŋgbina dig avanba.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Duom sʋŋi ti; faanmi ti fʋ nɔŋir linɛ pʋ naad la zug!

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Pian'asʋma ma'aa kʋdim pɛ'ɛli m sʋʋnr, saŋa kan ka m pin'il ye m yʋ'ʋm yʋʋm bama tis na'ab la; li nwɛnɛ onɛ mi' sɔb sʋ'ʋŋa sɔbid si'em la, ala ka m zilim la yʋ'ʋm yʋʋm malisiŋ.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Naa, fʋ vɛnli gat dap wʋsa. Wina'am niŋif bareka linɛ pʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ, ka pian'asʋma yiti fʋ nɔɔrin na.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Fʋ na'am la paŋ pʋʋgin, kem tuon nɛ nyaŋir, ka kɛ ka sida, nɛ a-sie-m-mɛŋ nɛ pʋpielim zi'en; kɛl ka fʋ paŋ la tʋm tʋʋmnyalima.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ piema banɛ pʋlim la kʋnsi fʋ dataas la susʋnya; kɛl ka buudi bɛdegʋ lii fʋ nɔba teŋir.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋ na'am la na bɛ saŋa kanɛ ka' bɛnnɛ; fʋ na'am dansaar la na sida dansaari fʋ sʋ'ʋlimin la.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋ pʋpielim ka kis linɛ an bɛ'ɛd. Wina'am, onɛ aan fʋ Wina'am la, dʋ'ʋsi fʋ gaadi fʋ taaba, ka kpa'ae sumalisim kpaam niŋif wʋʋ tudaar nɛ.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Fʋ fuud la wʋsa nyuug anɛ tudaar nɛ bʋnnyubisa nɛ kasiya nyuug ma'aa; fʋ bɛ nɛ na'ayir linɛ ka ba nɔk wabʋg nyina maal ka li vɛnl la ka bʋnnwɛ'ɛda nwɛ'ɛdi ma'adi fʋ sʋnf.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Na'anam pu'ayuos bɛɛ fʋ pu'ab la sʋʋgin; ka na'apu'a zin' fʋ datiuŋʋ pid sanlima baans.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: M pu'ayua, digilimi fʋ tʋbir ka kɛlis sʋ'ʋŋa: tammi fʋ nidib nɛ fʋ saam yidim yɛla.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: Fʋ vɛnlim la kɛ ka na'ab la bɔɔdif; na'asim o ka o anɛ fʋ zugdaan.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Taya dim na mɔr piini na tisif, kpan'am dim na bɔɔd ye fʋ sʋŋi ba.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Pu'apaal onɛ bɛ na'ayin la vɛnl hali; sanlim ka ba nɔki ʋg o fuug la.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: O fukanɛ vɛnl hali la ka o yɛ ka ba dɔl o keŋ na'ab la san'an. O na'abitaaba la dɔl o ka ba kɛɛn fʋ san'an na, Na'aba.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ba dɔl o kena nɛ sumalisim; ba kena kpɛn' na'ayin la.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Na'aba, fʋ biribis na di'e ba yaanam zin'ig; fʋ na kɛ ka ba an kpɛɛmnam teŋ la wʋsa ni.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka zumaana wʋsa tɛnri fʋ yɛla; dinzugɔ nidib wʋsa na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Wina'am bɛ nɛ ti ka aan ti paŋ nɛ ti suak zin'ig, ka na sʋŋi ti mugusʋg saŋa.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ ti pʋ zɔt dabiem, hali baa teŋ la ya'a dammid ka zuoya kɔɔdi lit atɛuk la pʋʋginɛ,

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: hali baa atɛuk la ya'a dammidi dʋ'ʋsid pumpuum ka li dammʋg la kɛ ka zuoya kirida.

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Kɔldaug yinne bɛɛ mɔr sumalisim ken Wina'am tempʋʋgin la na, zin'ikanɛ an kasi ka Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa bɛ la.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Wina'am bɛɛ ani, ka teŋ la kʋ li bɛɛ san'am; Wina'am na sʋŋ teŋ la bɛkɛung wʋsa.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Dabiem na bɛ tɛɛnsin la, ka sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa dammid; o na dʋ'ʋsi o kʋkɔri pian' ka teŋgbauŋ bɔdig.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la bɛ nɛ ti; Jakob Wina'am la an ti suak zin'ig.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Kem na gɔs Zugsɔb la tʋʋma, nyalima linɛ ka o mɔr teŋgbauŋʋn la na.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: O kɛya ka dunia la wʋsa pʋ lɛn mɔr zabaa; o kɔ' tiraad ka widig kpana la, o nyu'oe gbanti'edʋg la nɛ bugum.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: “An baanlimm, ka baŋ ye manɛ an Wina'am; ba na dʋ'ʋsi m yʋ'ʋr buudi wʋsa ni, ka dʋ'ʋsi m yʋ'ʋr dunia zug.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la bɛ nɛ ti; Jakob Wina'am la aan ti suak zin'ig.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Buudi wʋsa pʋ'ʋsim nu'us; yʋ'ʋmmi nɛ sumalisim tis Wina'am.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la anɛ onɛ ka ya na zɔt o, onɛ an Na'atita'ar ka sʋ'oe dunia wʋsa!

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: O nyaŋ buudi wʋsa tisi ti, ka nidib la lɛbi ti nɔba teŋir.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: O gaŋ faari tisi ti, ye li dʋ'ʋs Jakob onɛ ka o nɔŋ la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Wina'am duoe zin' o na'am gbauŋ zug ka ba tansid nɛ sumalisim, ka piebid na'atana.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Wina'am la an dunia wʋsa Na'ab, yʋ'ʋmmi yʋʋma pian' o yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Wina'am sʋ'oe buudi wʋsa na'am, Wina'am zin' o na'am gbauŋ linɛ an kasi la zug.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Buudi wʋsa na'anam la'as ya, ka lieb Abraham Wina'am la nidib, Wina'am sʋ'oe dunia na'anam la wʋsa, ba dʋ'ʋsid o yʋ'ʋr bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la galis ya, ka nar nɛ zʋn'or hali ti Wina'am la tempʋʋgin la, o zuokanɛ an kasi la ni.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Zuor la wa'am nɛ ka vɛnl hali, ka dunia dim wʋsa mɔr sumalisim li yɛla. Li nwɛnɛ Zafon zuor, zin'ikanɛ wa'am hali la, Na'atita'ar la tempʋʋg linɛ an Zion Zuor la.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Wina'am mɛŋ bɛɛ li kpi'euŋ zin'isin la; o pa'al o mɛŋ ye o anɛ ba suak zin'ig.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Na'anam la la'as taaba, ba la'asi ken tuon,

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: ba nyɛɛ o ka li paki ba; ka dabiem mɔri ba ka ba zɔt.

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: Fʋ san'ami ba wʋʋ Tarsis anrintitada ka sisi'em yi ya-nya'aŋ na widigi ba.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ tinamɛ wʋm si'em la, ala ka ti nyɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb tempʋʋgin la, ti Wina'am tempʋʋgin la: Wina'am kɛ ka li an baanlimm saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la pʋʋgin ka ti tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ pʋ mɔr bɛn la yɛla.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Fʋ yʋ'ʋri an si'em la, ala ka fʋ zʋn'or paae dunia la zin'ig wʋsa; fʋ datiuŋ nu'ug la pɛ'ɛl nɛ pʋpielim.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Zion Zuor nidib maan sumalisim, ka Juda teŋkpɛmis la dim sʋnf ma'ae fʋn tu'ad sida la zug.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Kemi Zion Zuorin la, giligimi li, kaalimi li mɛɛb banɛ wa'am la,

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: gɔsimi li zaŋguom kpi'ema la, ka gɔsi ba ya' linɛ mɔr paŋ la, ka ti yɛl zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ na ti duoe na la.

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Wina'am kaŋa anɛ ti Wina'am saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ; onɛ na guri ti hali ti paae li bɛn.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Ya wʋsa wʋmmi; kɛlisimi nɛ', yanam banɛ bɛ dunia nwa' ni la,

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: banɛ an talis nɛ kpi'emnam wʋsa, kpan'am dim nɛ nɔŋ dim zan':

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: M nɔɔr na pian' ya'am pian'ad; pian'ad linɛ yiti m pʋtɛn'ɛrin na la mɔr gbin.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: M na fɛndigi m tʋbiri kɛlis siilima; m na nwɛ' kɔn ka yɛli m bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm la gbin.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka m na zɔt dabiem nɛ dabisbɛ'og kenna yɛla? Nimbɛ'ɛdnam giligim,

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: banɛ niŋi ba kpan'am yadda ka dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ nɛ ba areza'as yɛla la.

english_verse: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
translation_verse: Sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn o tiraan nyɔvʋrɛ bɛɛ o yɔ Wina'am o mɛŋ yɛla.

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Nyɔvʋr yɔɔdi kpi'em si'em la, sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi yɔɔ li yɛla,

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: ye o vʋe saŋa wʋsa ka da kpii.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a gɔs, ya'am dim kpiid; ka zɔn nɛ ya'ampɔɔdim dim mɛ kpiid ka basidi ba kpan'am tisid sieba.

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Ba yaad na kpɛn aan ba ya', ba na bɛɛ li ni saŋa linɛ pʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ, la'an nɛ ban nɔki ba mɛŋ yʋda pʋd tɛɛns la.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Banɛ tisi ba mɛŋ sida la na ba'as si'em nwa', nɛ banɛ dɔlli ba nya'aŋ ka siak ban yɛl si'el la.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Ba na kpi nwɛnɛ pɛ'ɛs nɛ, ka kum dii ba. Pʋpielim dim na sʋ'ʋgʋ ba; ba niŋgbina na pun'oe yaʋgʋn, ka ba na lal nɛ ba ya-vɛnla banɛ ka ba mɛ' la.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am na faaɛn man nyɔvʋr yaʋgʋn; sida o na nɔk mam keŋ o san'an.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a nyɛ kpan'am, fʋn da kɛ ka li paki fɔ, hali baa o yir ya'a ti nɔbigidi ken tuonnɛ;

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ o ya'a ti kpiid o kʋ mɔr si'eli keŋɛ, o kpan'am la kʋ dɔl o keŋɛ.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ on daa vʋe ka tɛn'ɛs ye o mɔri bareka hali ka nidib dʋ'ʋsidif fʋn daa ken tuon zug la,

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: o na keŋ la'as nɛ o yaanam zʋmaʋŋ la, ka kʋ lɛn nyɛ nɛɛsim linɛ bɛ vʋm pʋʋgin la.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Wina'am Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, o anɛ Zugsɔb Wina'am, o pian'ad ka buon dunia wʋsa lin yi winnigi tansid zin'isi'a paae on lit zin'isi'a.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Wina'am pipilim nyɛɛnnɛ yit Zion linɛ an teŋ vɛnliŋ amɛŋa la na.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Ti Wina'am la kenna amaa o pʋ an baanlimm nɛ; bugum gaad o tuonnɛ diti ken ka sisi'etita'ar gilig o.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: O buol agɔl nɛ teŋ ye ba wʋm, ye o na kad o nidib saria, ka ye,

english_verse: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
translation_verse: “La'asimini m mɛŋ nidib la mɔri kɛɛn m san'an na; nimbanɛ daa maal maana maal nɔnaar nɛ man la.”

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Saŋgbana na mɔɔl o pʋpielim la yɛla, bɔzugɔ Wina'am mɛŋ anɛ sariakat.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: “M nidiba, wʋmmi ka m bɔɔd ye m pian'anɛ. Yanam Israel dima, m na di kasɛti pɔ'ɔgi ya; manɛ an Wina'am, onɛ aan ya Wina'am la.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: M pʋ bɔɔd na'araugʋ ya gariki ni bɛɛ bʋʋsi ya bʋlʋʋdinɛ.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Bʋnkɔnbid banɛ bɛ mɔɔgin la wʋsa anɛ man din, nɛ niigi banɛ bɛ zuoya tusa ni la.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: M mi' niis banɛ bɛ zuoya ni la wʋsa, bʋnvʋya banɛ bɛ sian'arin la anɛ m din.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Man kɔ'ɔm ya'a pʋn zabid, m kʋ yɛli yaa, bɔzugɔ dunia la nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa anɛ man din.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Man ɔnbidnɛ na'araad ni'imɛɛ? Bɛɛ m nuudnɛ bʋʋs ziim?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Maalim bareka pʋ'ʋsim maannɛ tis Wina'am, ka kɛ ka fʋn pʋ'ʋlʋm zi'el Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la niŋ amɛŋa.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Buoliminimɛ ya yɛla saŋa; ka m na yisi ya, ka ya na'asim.”

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Amaa nimbɛ'ɛdnam la, Wina'am yɛli ba ye, “Suobɔ ka fʋ mɔr ka na pian'adi m wada la yɛla? Bɛɛ bɔ ka fʋ nɔki m nɔnaar la ka li bɛɛ fʋ nɔɔrinɛ?

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Fʋ kisi m pa'alʋg ka lɔbigi m pian'ad la bas nya'aŋ.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a nyɛ na'ayiig, fʋ ɛɛnti naal nɛ o nɛ; fʋ zaŋi fʋ mɛŋi la'as nɛ banɛ bɔɔd nidib pu'ab nɛ banɛ bɔɔd nidib sidib.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Fʋ mɔri fʋ nɔɔri pian'ad bɛ'ɛd ka pʋ gban'adi fʋ zilim nɛ faadɛ.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Fʋ pian'adi pɔ'ɔgidi fʋ ba'abiig ka pʋ basida ka kɛɛndi fʋ mɛŋ mabiis.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Fʋn maal nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa ka m sin baanlimm la; fʋ tɛn'ɛs ye mam anɛ wʋʋ fʋ nɛ. Amaa m na zɛrigif sʋ'ʋŋa ka bu'osi fʋ, fʋ nini ni.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: Kɛlisim yɛl lina nwa', fʋn kanɛ tam Wina'am yɛla la, ya'a ka' ala m na aansif bɛna-bɛna ka sɔ' kae na faaɛn fɔ.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Onɛ maal bareka pʋ'ʋsim maan wʋsa na'asidi mam, ka maan suori digin ye m ti pa'al o Wina'am faangir.”

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: Zɔmim nimbaanlig, O Wina'am, fʋ nɔŋilim kanɛ pʋ naad la zug; fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔri zu'oe si'em la zug, kɛɛsimi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la bas.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Linɛ wʋsa ka m gɛsig la piemi li wʋsa ka pie m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas ka m lieb nyain.

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: M baŋi m pɔ'ɔgiri an si'em, saŋa wʋsa m mi' m taal la yɛla.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: M tʋm bugusim tʋʋma pɔ'ɔgif, ka tʋm linɛ an bɛ'ɛdi fʋ tuon, alazugɔ, fʋ din dɔl suor ka fʋ pian'ad mɔr sida fʋ sariakadib pʋʋgin.

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Sida m anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb m biilimin sa, m maa tʋki m pʋʋg saŋsi'a la sa ka m tʋm taal.

english_verse: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
translation_verse: Sida, fʋ bɔɔdi linɛ an sida ninsaal bɛllim pʋʋgin; pa'alimim ya'am linɛ na bɛɛ m sʋnfʋn!

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Piemim nɛ sappʋ, ka kɛ ka m an nyain; sʋʋmim ka m pɛligi gaad sakuga.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m wʋm sumalisim labaar; fʋn daa tisim sʋnsa'aŋ hali la, kɛl ka sumalisim lɛb na.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Da gɔsidi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ka yis linɛ wʋsa ka m tʋm ka li an bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Maalimi m sʋnf la bʋmpaal, O Wina'am, ka tɛndigim ka m na bɛ sʋ'ʋŋa tisif.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Da kadimi yisi fʋ san'anɛ bɛɛ yisi fʋ Siig Kasi la ka kɛɛ ma.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Lɛbisim sumalisim linɛ yiti fʋ faangirin la na tisim ka tisim siig kanɛ wʋmmi fʋ nɔɔr la ka ala na sʋŋidim saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Ala ka m na pa'ali fʋ suoya tis banɛ pɔ'ɔgidif la, ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim na fɛndigi lɛbi fʋ san'an na.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Faanmim yis ninkʋʋr pʋʋgin, O Wina'am, fʋn Wina'am onɛ faandim la, m zilim na yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ pʋpielim la yɛla.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, yɔ'ɔgimi m nɔɔr, ka m na zʋn'ʋf.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Maana linɛ ka Wina'am bɔɔd anɛ fʋn na tiaki fʋ sʋnf ka sie fʋ mɛŋ. Fʋ mɛ pʋ zan'asid ninkanɛ sik o mɛŋ ka tiak ka bas o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'am bɔɔdim pʋʋgin kɛl ka Zion zi'esim an sʋ'ʋŋa, mɛɛm Jerusalem zaŋguoma la.

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Ala ka ba na maal pʋpielim maana, nɛ nyu'or maana linɛ na ma'aa fʋ sʋʋnri tisif. Ala ka na'araad maana na maali fʋ bimbim la zug.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ mɔr tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgɔ, kpi'euŋ tita'ar sɔba? Bɔ ka fʋ dʋ'ʋsidi fʋ mɛŋ bɛogʋn sa? La'an nɛ wala Wina'am nɔŋilim sid bɛnɛ saŋa wʋsa!

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Fʋ zilim pian'ad anɛ gban'abɛ'ɛd; li nwɛnɛ sʋ'ʋg kanɛ dit hali nɛ, fʋ gban'e faad nu'us ayi'.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋ bɛ'ɛdi gat sʋm, ka mɛ nɔŋ faadi gat sida.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋ pian'ad linɛ na san'am nid sʋʋnr, Fʋn kanɛ an faad sɔba!

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Sida Wina'am na mɔr san'auŋ linɛ kʋ mɔr naari kɛɛn fʋ san'an na: O na sianki fʋ yisi fʋ sʋgʋrin la bas; o na yisif teŋ kanɛ ka vʋm dim bɛ la ni.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dim na nyɛɛ li, ka dabiem gban'e ba; ba na la'ad o ka yɛt ye,

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: “Dau la nwa' yʋ'ʋs onɛ pʋ nɔk Wina'am ka o aan o kpi'euŋ zin'iga, amaa ka ti'e o kpan'am ka mɔɔd hali san'amid o taaba la!”

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Amaa man nwɛnɛ olif tiig nɛ busid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin; M niŋnɛ Wina'am nɔŋilim linɛ pʋ mɔr bɛn la yadda saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: M na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr saŋa wʋsa fʋn maal si'el la zug; fʋ yʋ'ʋrin ka m mɔr ti'ir, fʋ yʋ'ʋri an sʋm la zug. M na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr fʋ nidib la tuon.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg yɛt o pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye, “Wina'am kae!” Ba san'amnɛ, ka ba suoya wʋsa an bɛ'ɛd; sɔ' kae tʋm sʋm.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Wina'am naan arezana gɔsid saalib ye o na nyɛ ya'am daani ba sʋʋgin nɛ onɛ ieed on Wina'am.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Ayei! Sɔ' wʋsa fɛndignɛ, ba wʋsa yʋ'ʋn san'amnɛ; sɔ' kae tʋm sʋm, hali baa nid yinne mɛnɛ.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la kʋ zamis ya'am? Ba vɔnnɛ m nidib la wʋʋ saalibi vɔn sa'ab si'em la; ka mɛ pʋn pʋ sɔsid Wina'am.

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Amaa dabietita'ar linɛ nan zi' gban'e ba yʋ'ʋn na paae ba hali pamm. Wina'am na widig banɛ zabid nɛ ya la; ya diisi ba nyan, bɔzugɔ Wina'am nɛ'ɛsi banɛ.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye Israel faangir naan Zion teŋin na! Wina'am ya'a ti lɛbis o nidibi ba zin'igin, Jakob nɛ Israel dim na mɔr sumalisim!

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Wina'am, faanmi mɛ fʋ yʋ'ʋr la zug; ka tisim bʋʋd nɛ fʋ paŋ la.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: Wʋmmi m sɔsʋg, O Wina'am; kɛlisimi m pian'ad linɛ yiti m nɔɔrin na.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Teŋ zʋŋ dimi zabid nɛ m; nimbɛ'ɛdnam banɛ ba'a kae nɛ Wina'am la bɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Sida, Wina'am anɛ m sʋŋid; Zugsɔb la kɛ ka m vʋe.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka bɛ'ɛd linɛ ka m dataas gban'ad la lɛbi ba zugin; fʋ yɛlsida zugɔ, kɛl ka ba nyɛ san'auŋ.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: M na maal maan linɛ an ya'amlɛog piini tisif; M na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr, O Zugsɔba, bɔzugɔ li an sʋm.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ o yisim yɛla wʋsa ni, ka m nini nyɛ m dataas la li si'em.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi m sɔsʋg, O Wina'am, da zan'asi m sɔsʋgɔ.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Kɛlisim ka sʋŋim. M tɛn'ɛsa la daa daamim nɛ ka m fabili gɛn.

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: M dataas la tansid agɔla kpɛn'ɛsidim dabiem; ba kɛ ka m nyɛt namisʋg ka katim nɛ sʋnpɛɛn.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: M sʋnf san'amnɛ hali; ka kum dabiem mɔrim.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Dabiem kpɛn'ɛm nɛ ka m kirid; dabiem nyaŋim nɛ hali.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, “M ya'a mɔrin dawan kpʋkpama! M naan ianki lalig ka vʋ'ʋsin.

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: M naan ianki laligi bɛɛn pipirisin.

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: M naan zɔɔ laligi ieen su'asig zin'ig, ka lal nɛ sisi'em linɛ vuud hali la.”

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: Fɛndigim nimbɛ'ɛdnam la ya'am, O Zugsɔbaa, kɛl ka ban gban'e si'el wʋsa lieb zaalim, bɔzugɔ m nyɛ zaba nɛ bugusim ka li pɛ'ɛl tempʋʋg la wʋsa.

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa ba giligid zaŋguoma la ni wʋʋ ba guri teŋ la; kisidim nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ma'aa zu'oe teŋ la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmsa'aŋ dim ma'aa pɛ'ɛl teŋ la pʋʋgin; banɛ kpɛn'ɛsid nidib dabiem nɛ ziri dimi bɛ suoraadin la.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Li ya'a aannɛ m dataa tʋ'ʋdim, m naan mɔdigin; li ya'a aannɛ m bi'em duoe zabid nɛ m, m naan su'an ka bas o.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Amaa li anɛ fʋn, ninkanɛ nwɛnɛ mam nɛ, m zɔɔng, ka aan m zua.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: Fʋn onɛ ka fʋ dɔllim daa malisim ka ti dɔl taaba la'am ken Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim yin.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka kum libigi m dataas la; kɛl ka ba sig kpi'im teŋ vʋt, bɔzugɔ bɛ'ɛd bɛɛ ba san'anɛ giilim.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Amaa m buol Wina'am, ka Zugsɔb la faanm.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Zaam nɛ bɛogʋn nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa m kaasid nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, ka o wʋmmi tisidim.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Zaba giligi m zin'ig wʋsa ka o faanm ka ba pʋ pu'alimi ma, hali baa nɛ nidib bɛdegʋ duoe zabid nɛ m la.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ zin' o na'am gbauŋ zug saŋa wʋsa la, na wʋmi ba yɛla ka namisi ba. Ba anɛ nimbanɛ pʋ tiakidi ba suorɛ, ka mɛ pʋ zɔt Wina'am baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: M dɔllim taa la zabid nɛ o zuanam; o san'am o nɔnaar la.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: O pian'ad anɛ saaliga wʋʋ kpaam nɛ, la'an nɛ wala zaba bɛɛ o sʋnfʋn; o pian'ad bʋgʋsnɛ nwɛnɛ kpaam nɛ, la'an nɛ wala li anɛ linɛ yisid zaba sʋ'ʋs na.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Nɔkimi fʋ ziid wʋsa tis Zugsɔb la ka onɛ na sʋ'ʋŋif; o kʋ kɛ ka pʋpielim sɔb lii.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋ lɛɛ na kɛ ka nimbɛ'ɛdnam la li ba na li bʋmbɔk linɛ an san'auŋ la ni; ninkʋʋdib nɛ ziri dim la na dɛŋ kum ka kʋ paae ba yʋma bɛnnɛ. Amaa ya'a kpɛlim nɛ mam, fʋn ka man ti'e.

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: Zɔmim nimbaanlig, O Wina'am, ka nidibi katim, dabisir la wʋsa ba zabid nɛ mam.

english_verse: Many of them are pursuing and attacking me,
translation_verse: Banɛ ma'ad ziri tisidim la katimnɛ saŋa wʋsa, a-pa'alim-mɛŋ dim zabid nɛ man.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Dabiem ya'a ti mɔrim saŋa si'a wʋsa, mam na ti'enɛ fʋn.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr ka m dʋ'ʋsid, Wina'am la ka m tis sida, ka kʋ zɔt dabiem. Ninsaal na maalim bɔ?

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Saŋa wʋsa ba tia'asidi m pian'ad ka gban'adi m yɛla bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Ba su'anɛ gban'adi m yɛla, ka gɔsidi m nɔba yakir, ka mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug da kɛ ka ba pɔnsɛ; O Wina'am kɛl ka fʋ sʋnf duoe nɛ tɛɛns nwa' ka ba wʋsa li.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Sɔmmi m fabʋlʋg la; nɔkimi m ninta'am niŋi fʋ waa la pʋʋgin; li yɛla pʋ sɔbi fʋ gbana la nii?

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Ala ka m ya'a ti buonnɛ fʋ bɔɔd sʋŋir m dataas la na lɛb nya'aŋ. Ala ka m na baŋ ye Wina'am la bɔɔdi m yɛla.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Wina'am la ka m tis sida, ka kʋ zɔt dabiem; ninsaal na maalim bɔ?

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: M na maal man daa kaanbi zi'el si'el la, O Wina'am, m na tisi fʋ m bareka pʋ'ʋsim piini la.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ yisim kumin ka pʋ kɛ ka m nɔba tu'ugɛ, ye m ken Wina'am tuon vʋm linɛ an nɛɛsim dunia kaŋa ni la.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Zɔmim nimbaanlig, O Wina'am, zɔmim nimbaanlig, bɔzugɔ fʋ ni ka m su'adi m mɛŋ. M na su'a m mɛŋi fʋ kpʋkpama lɛuŋʋn ka yɛlpakir ti gaad.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: O na naan arezana ni tʋm sʋŋiri faanm, ka nyaŋ banɛ kati dɔllim la tisim. Kɛl ka Wina'am pa'al o nɔŋilim nɛ yɛlsida tisim.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: M bɛ nɛ gbigima buugin, m dignɛ nɛ bʋnyuos; nimbanɛ ka ba nyina an wʋʋ kpana nɛ piema nɛ, ka ba zilima nwɛnɛ zaba sʋ'ʋg kanɛ dit hali.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, kɛl ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr la dʋʋ paae saŋgbana; kɛl ka fʋ na'am pipilim la pɛ'ɛl teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Ba yadig asau ye ba gban'e m nɔba; ka m sʋnf san'am hali. Ba tunɛ bʋmbɔki m suorin; amaa ba mɛŋ lɛbi lii ani.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: M sʋnf lɔnɛ viki fʋ yɛla, O Wina'am, m sʋnf sid lɔnɛ yim, m na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zʋn'ʋf.

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: M siiga, duom! Duomi, yanam banɛ nwɛ'ɛd kɔna nɛ duundis la! M na duoe bɛkɛung asuba yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, m na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr tɛɛns la sʋʋgin, ka yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ yɛla nidib buudi wʋsa sʋʋgin.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋilim la zu'onɛ, li wa'ami gaad saŋgbana la; ka fʋ sida la dʋʋ paae agɔla.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, kɛl ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr la dʋʋ paae saŋgbana; ka fʋ na'am pipilim la pɛ'ɛl teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ an na'anama, ya sid pian'adnɛ sidaa? Ya kad nidib saria ka li dɔl suorɛɛ?

english_verse: You are always planning evil, and you are brutal.
translation_verse: Ayei, ya pʋtɛnda ni ya gban'ar wʋsa pʋ dɔl suorɛ, ya nu'us ieed zaba teŋgbauŋ la zug.

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Hali bugusim dim la pʋn bɔdig nɛ ba du'am saŋa; ba du'am saŋa sa ka ba pʋn anɛ ninyaalis nɛ ziri dim.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Ba nɔɔr tɔi nɛ wʋʋ yabid nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ dunduug kanɛ li' o tʋba ka pʋ wʋmma,

english_verse: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
translation_verse: hali tiim sɔb ya'a bɛlisidi ba si'em, ba pʋ wʋm o kʋkɔrɛ.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: Kɔɔmi ba nyina la ba nɔya ni, O Wina'am; vɔɔm gbigima la nyina, O Zugsɔba!

english_verse: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba mɛlim wʋʋ ku'om na pʋbigi gaad si'em la; ba ya'a tɛɛg tiraug, fʋn kɛl ka ba piema la gbi'ilim.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba nwɛnɛ wilisʋŋ ka bian'ar mɔri gaad ka nwɛnɛ bikpiilʋŋ ka ba du'a ka o pʋ nyɛ winniga.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Wina'am na uusi ba kpɛɛmnam nɛ ba biis la tɔ'ɔtɔ wʋʋ ban na dʋgʋl dʋk ka walim yit si'em la.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Ba sam yɔɔb la ya'a ti paae, pʋpielim dim na mɔr sumalisim, daakan ka ba na sig bugusim dim ziimin buugi gaad.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Ani ka nidib na yɛl ye, “Sida, pʋpielim dim la di'e ba yɔɔd; Wina'am onɛ kad teŋgbauŋ saria nɛ sida la sid bɛ.”

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Yisimim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la nu'usin ka faanm ninkʋʋdib la nu'usin.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Gɔsim ban dig si'em gurim! Nimbɛ'ɛdnamɛ gu'udim ka m mɛ pʋ maali ba bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: M pʋ maali ba bugusim, la'an nɛ wala, ba mɔɔd ye ba zab nɛ m. Duom sʋŋim, ka gɔsi maali m yɛl la tisim!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb, ka an Israel Wina'am, duom zi'enɛ fʋ mɛŋ ka namis tɛɛns la; da zɔ bugusnam la nimbaanliga.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Zaam ma'aya, ka ba lɛb na ka nyiigid nyina wʋʋ baas, ka su'adi giligid tempʋʋg la.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Gɔsim yɛlbɛ'ɛd linɛ yiti ba nɔɔrin na, ba nɔɔr pian'ad nwɛnɛ sʋ'ʋsi nwaad nidib, ka ba yɛt ye, “Anɔ'ɔn na wʋmi ti pian'ad la?”

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, fʋ la'adi ba nɛ; fʋ nɛ'ɛs tɛɛns la wʋsa.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ aan m paŋ, fʋn ka m gɔsid; O Wina'am, fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig,

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: nɛ m Wina'am onɛ an nɔŋilim sɔb. Wina'am na gaadi m tuon ka kɛ ka m nyaŋi m dataas.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Amaa da kʋʋ ba, O Zugsɔb onɛ lusidi ti, ya'a ka' ala m nidib la na tam. Fʋ paŋ tita'ar la na kɛ ka ba yirid yɔri-yɔri, ka kɛ ka ba yʋ'ʋn sig teŋin.

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: fʋ sʋnpɛɛn na kanbi ba wʋʋ bugum nɛ, li na dii ba ti naae nyain. Ala ka dunia wʋsa na baŋ ye Wina'am sʋ'oe Jakob yaas la.

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Zaam ma'aya, ka ba lɛb na nyiigid nyina wʋʋ baas nɛ, ka su'adi giligid tempʋʋgin la.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Ba zɔti giligidi ieed diib, ka ba ya'a pʋ tigɛ ban wuunnɛ wʋʋ baas nɛ.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Amaa mam na yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ paŋ la yɛla, bɛog ya'a nie m na yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ nɔŋilim la yɛla; bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig, fʋ san'an ka m su'ad mugusʋg saŋa.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: Fʋn onɛ aan m paŋa, m yʋ'ʋmmi zun'odi fʋ yʋ'ʋr; O Wina'am, fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig, nɛ Wina'am kanɛ nɔŋim saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: Wina'am, fʋ zan'asi ti ka san'ami ti; fʋ sʋnf pɛlig nɛ ti. Kɛl ka ti lɛm paae fʋ ya'am ya'as!

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Fʋ dam teŋ la yɔ'ɔgi li; maalimi li lɛbis, ka li da san'am naae.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka fʋ nidib nyɛ mugusʋg, ka kɛ ka ti gɛrid nwɛnɛ daam ka ti nunɛ.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ zɔtif la, fʋ nɔk tuuta sɛɛ tisi ba ye ba zɔɔ la'as anina zaba saŋa.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Faanmi ti ka sʋŋi ti nɛ fʋ paŋ la, ka ala ka banɛ ka fʋ nɔŋ la na paam yɔlisim.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Wina'am naan o zin'ikanɛ an kasi la nii pian' ye, “M na pʋdig Sekɛm teŋ la nɛ paŋ ka mak Sukot Bɔn'ɔg la.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Gilead teŋgbauŋ la anɛ m din, ka Manase sʋ'ʋlim mɛ aan m din: Efiram anɛ m tanp zupibig, ka Juda aan m na'am dansaar.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab anɛ lakanɛ ka m mɔri piesid, ka Edom aan m ta'ada digilʋg zin'ig; Filistia ka m tansid, man nyaŋi ba la yɛla.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na mɔrimi kpɛn' tempʋkanɛ kpi'em la ni? Anɔ'ɔnɛ na ta'asim Edom teŋinɛ?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Sʋŋimi tii zab nɛ ti dataas la, ka ninsaal sʋŋir ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Nɛ Wina'am paŋa ti na nyaŋ, bɔzugɔ, o na nɔɔ ti dataas la digil teŋin.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Wʋmmi m kaasig, O Wina'am; kɛlisimi m winsɔsʋg.

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: Dunia bɛn wʋsa ni ka m buolif, m buolnɛ hali ka m susʋnya ligid; mɔrimi keŋ tampiing kanɛ wa'ami gat mam la ni.

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig, zin'ikanɛ kpi'em ka gu'udi m dataasi lɛbisid.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: M ya'am bɔɔd ye m bɛɛ fʋ sʋgʋrin la saŋa wʋsa ka su'a m mɛŋi fʋ kpʋkpama lɛuŋʋn.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋn wʋm mam pɔ nɔsi'a zi'el la, ka tisim faar linɛ ka fʋ digil ye fʋ tis banɛ zɔti fʋ yʋ'ʋr la.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Paasim na'ab la yʋma, ka o saŋa na zu'oe zʋmaana bɛdegʋ ni.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: O na zin'in Wina'am na'am gbauŋ zug saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ; nɔkimi fʋ nɔŋilim nɛ fʋ sida la gur o.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Ala ka m na yʋ'ʋm zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr la ka maal linɛ ka m pɔɔ zi'el la dabisir wʋsa.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Mam anɛ baanlimm ka gu'usid Wina'am la; m faangir yit nɛ o san'an na.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: On ma'aa aan m tampiing nɛ m faangid; onɛ aan m suak zin'ig, m kʋ zɔt dabiem.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka ya la'asi gilig nid yinnɛ? Ya wʋsa na la'asi lug o wʋʋ zaŋguom kanɛ dɛlli bɔɔd liig, bɛɛ dɔkpin kanɛ pʋ mɔr paŋa?

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Ba mɔɔd ye ba sigis o zin'isʋŋ kanɛ ka o bɛ la ni; ba ya'amlɛog anɛ faad ma'aa. Ba kaanbidnɛ kaanb sʋŋʋ ba nɔya ni, ka lɛɛ kaanbid kaanbbɛ'ɛdi ba sʋʋnrin.

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ma'aa ka m gu'usid; m ti'ir yit nɛ o san'an na.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: On ma'aa aan m tampiing nɛ m faangid; onɛ aan m suak zin'ig, m kʋ zɔt dabiem.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: M faangir nɛ m na'asi bɛ nɛ Wina'am nu'usin; o anɛ m tampintita'ar, ka aan m suak zin'ig.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Nidibaa, tisimin o sida saŋa wʋsa, pɛligimi ya pʋʋg nyain tis o, ka Wina'am la aan ti suak zin'ig.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Ninsaalib wʋsa nwɛnɛ nidi na vʋ'ʋsi yis na, kpi'emnam nɛ tadimnam wʋsa pʋ mɔr sidaa; ba ya'a la'asi ba maki ba tɛbisim ba anɛ zaalim wʋʋ sɔ' na vʋ'ʋsi yis na.

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: ka fʋn, O Zugsɔba, fʋ anɛ nɔŋilim sɔb. Sida fʋ na yɔ sɔ' wʋsa wʋʋ on tʋm si'em.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋ anɛ m Wina'am, m ieedif nɛ nimmua; fʋ yɛla kɛ ka ku'onuud mɔri m siig ka m niŋgbina bɔɔdif hali zin'ikanɛ ka ku'om kae ka teŋ la kʋdig bar-bar nwa' ni.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: M nyɛɛf fʋ, fʋ pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka nyɛɛ fʋ paŋ nɛ fʋ na'am pipilim an si'em.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋilim la zu'oe gaad vʋm la zug, m nɔɔr na wɔ'ɔgif.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: M vʋm saŋa wʋsa m na zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr, ka fʋ yʋ'ʋrin la ka m na ʋkidi m nu'us.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: M tigi gaad mam na di disʋŋ; m nɔɔr na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zʋn'ʋf.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: M dig zin'igin m tɛnri fʋ yɛla; M tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ yɛla yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Fʋn aan m sʋŋid la zug, ka m su'a m mɛŋi fʋ kpʋkpama lɛuŋʋn.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Fʋn ka m gban'e mɔr kiŋ-kiŋ ka fʋ datiuŋ nu'ugʋ gurim.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Banɛ bɔɔd ye ba yisi m nyɔvʋr la na paam san'auŋ; ba na sig kpi'im teŋ.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Ba na kpi zaba ni ka lieb diibi tis sian'anr bʋnkɔnbid.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Amaa na'ab la na mɔr sumalisim Wina'am san'an; banɛ wʋsa pɔɔd nɛ Wina'am yʋ'ʋr la na wɔ'ɔg o, amaa banɛ an ziri dim la, nɔya na an baanlimm.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: Wʋmmi m fabʋlʋgʋ tisim, O Wina'am; gu'umi m nyɔvʋr ka bi'em daan la da nyaŋi ma.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Su'amim ka bugusnam la gban'abɛ'ɛd la da paae ma, nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim banɛ zu'oe mɔr tʋkpiidʋg la.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Ba saasi ba zilima nɛ wʋʋ sʋ'ʋs nɛ ka pian'adim pian'abɛ'ɛd wʋʋ piema ka ba ɔɔnni tɔɔndim.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Ba kpɛmisidi taaba gban'ad gban'abɛ'ɛd, ka pian'ad ban na su'adi bɛnt baans si'em; ka yɛt ye, “Anɔ'ɔn na nyɛ ti baans nwa'?”

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Ba gban'ad linɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ ka yɛt ye, “Ti gban'e gban'asʋŋ!” Sida ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛr nɛ o sʋnf mɔri ya'ambɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am na tɔɔn ba nɛ piema; o na tɔɔn ba vuguri digil teŋin.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: O na kɛ ka ba mɛŋ pian'ad tuligi dii ba ka kɛ ka san'auŋ paae ba; ka banɛ wʋsa nyɛɛ ba na lɔbid zug ka nɛ'ɛsidi ba.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Nidib wʋsa na zɔt dabiem; ba na mɔɔl Wina'am tʋʋma la yɛla ka tɛn'ɛsid on maal si'el la.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka pʋpielim dim la mɔr sumalisim Zugsɔb la ni ka su'a o san'an; kɛl ka banɛ pʋ mɔr gba'are ba sʋnya ni la zun'e o.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: O Wina'am li nar ye ti zun'odif Zion teŋin; ti na maal tinamɛ pɔɔ zi'el ye ti maal si'el la tisif.

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: Fʋn kanɛ wʋm winsɔsʋg la, nidib wʋsa na kɛɛn fʋ san'an na.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ daa bɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin ka li zu'oe nyaŋi ti la, fʋ di suguru ka kɛɛ ti taali bas.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka fʋ gaŋ la mɔr Wina'am bareka; ban ka fʋ mɔri ba na ye ba bɛɛ fʋ zakin la! Ti nyɛ la'asʋma banɛ bɛɛ fʋ yin la, fʋ pʋ'ʋsim zin'ikanɛ an kasi la.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Fʋ di'e ti winsɔsʋg nɛ fʋ pʋpielim linɛ an tʋʋmnyalima la, O Wina'am onɛ an ti Faangida. Fʋnɛ an sɔ' wʋsa ti'ir dunia nwa' ni nɛ banɛ bɛɛ atɛukʋn lallisa la.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ maal zuoya la nɛ fʋ mɛŋ paŋ, ka li pa'annɛ fʋ kpi'euŋ linɛ galis la,

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: ka kɛ ka atɛuk la ma'ae baanlimm, ka li ku'onwiis mɛ ma'ae baanlimm, ka kɛ ka tʋkpiidʋg linɛ yit tɛɛnsin la na lɛbi fɔn.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Banɛ bɛ teŋ-magbinnin la sa zɔti fʋ tʋʋmnyalima la; winnigi yit si'el hali ti paae on lut si'el la, fʋ kɛya ka nidib nyɛt sumalisim.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Fʋ gɔsid teŋ la ka dɔn'ɔsidi li; ka kɛ ka li mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm. Wina'am kɔldaad la pɛ'ɛl nɛ ku'om ye li kɛ ka nidib nyɛ zʋʋd, bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ maali li ala.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka saa ni ka ku'om pɛ'ɛl vugus hali birigi li wʋsa; fʋ kɛya ka saa nii bʋgʋli li ka kɛ ka li zʋʋd la mɔr bareka.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: Yʋʋm la pʋʋgin fʋ kɛya ka nidib bun zʋʋd bɛdegʋ, ka diib pɛ'ɛli ba niigi tɛrekonam hali badigidi lut suoya ni.

english_verse: Desert pastures blossom, and mountains celebrate.
translation_verse: Mɔma'asa bɛ pipirisin la ka kɔnbid ɔnbid; ka kʋkʋna la mɔr sumalisim.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Bʋnkɔnbid galis nɛ zin'ikanɛ ka yaama bɛ la, ka bɔn'ɔd la mɛ pɛ'ɛl nɛ zʋʋd; ka ba yʋ'ʋm ka tansid nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ wʋsa, tansim nɛ sumalisim tis Wina'am!

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋmmi yʋʋma yɛl o yʋ'ʋr la mɔr vɛnlim si'em; kɛl ka o zʋn'or la dʋʋ agɔla!

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Yɛlim Wina'am ye, “Fʋ tʋʋma la mɔr nyalima! Fʋ paŋ la zu'oya ka fʋ dataas la kiridi kennɛ fʋ tuon na.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Dunia la wʋsa iginidi fʋ tuon; ba yʋ'ʋmnɛ zun'odif, ba yʋ'ʋmnɛ zun'odi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.”

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Kemi na gɔsi Wina'am la tʋm si'el, o tʋm tʋʋmnyalima tis o nidib.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: O kɛ ka atɛuk lieb teŋ kpi'emis, ka ba dɔl teŋ kpi'emis la gaadi dʋ. Alazugɔ, kemi na ka ti maal sumalisim o san'an!

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: O paŋ la zug ka o na'am la ka' naarɛ, ka o nini gɔsid tɛɛns la wʋsa ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi zan'as o nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Zun'omi ti Wina'am la, yanam nidiba, kɛlli ka ba wʋm yanamɛ zun'od o la;

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: o guri ti nyɔvʋya ka kʋ maligin kɛ ka ti sadigɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋ maki ti gɔs; ka siligi ti wʋʋ anzurifa ka ba nyɛlig nɛ.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Fʋ kpɛn'ɛsi ti sanrega ni ka ziili ti ziid.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Fʋ bas suor ka nidib nɔɔdi ti; ka kɛ ka ti dɔl bugum nɛ ku'om pʋʋginɛ gaad; amaa fʋ mɔri ti kɛn zin'ikanɛ ka diib bɛ bɛdegʋ na.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: M na mɔr nyu'or maana kɛɛn fʋ pʋ'ʋsim yin la na, ka maal mam pɔ nɔɔri zi'el ye m na maal si'el la wʋsa.

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: M na nɔk bʋnkɔnbid banɛ nɔbi tisif ka maal maan nɛ pɛraad; M na nɔk na'araad nɛ bʋʋsi maal maan.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ zɔt Wina'am la wʋsa, kemi na kɛlisi; kɛl ka m mɔɔli on tʋm si'em tisim la wʋsa.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Man kaas nɛ tis o; ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zun'e o yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: M sʋnf ya'a nɔŋin tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, Zugsɔb la naan kʋ kɛlisini m pian'adɛ;

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: amaa Wina'am sid kɛlisya ka wʋmi m winsɔsʋg.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Wina'am yʋ'ʋr na paam zʋn'or, on pʋ zan'asi m winsɔsʋg bɛɛ mɔŋim o nɔŋilim la!

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Wina'am na zɔɔ ti nimbaanlig ka niŋi ti bareka ka kɛ ka o nindaa nie ti san'an na.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: Ka li kɛ ka nidib baŋ o suoya la, ka tɛɛns wʋsa na wʋm o faangir la yɛla.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Wina'am, kɛl ka nidib dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr, kɛl ka tɛɛns wʋsa nidib zʋn'ʋf.

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka tɛɛns la na mɔr sumalisim ka yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumpielim, bɔzugɔ fʋ gur nidib la lin nar si'em ka pa'an tɛɛns banɛ bɛ dunia ni la suosʋma.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Wina'am, kɛl ka nidib dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr, kɛl ka nidib wʋsa zʋn'ʋf.

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Ala ka teŋgbauŋ la na du'a zʋʋd bɛdegʋ, ka Wina'am onɛ aan ti Wina'am la na niŋi ti bareka.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Wina'am na niŋi ti bareka, ka dunia nwa' wʋsa nidib na zɔɔ o.

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Wina'am, duom zi'en ka fʋ dataas la widig; fʋ bi'emnam la na zɔɔ widigi fʋ tuon.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ sisi'em da'ad nyɔ'ɔsi ken si'em la fʋ na da'ae ba ka ba gaad; nwɛnɛ bugum nyɛligid singbana si'em la, ala ka ba na bɔdig Wina'am tuon.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Amaa pʋpielim dim la na mɔr sumalisim ka maal sumalisim Wina'am tuon; ba sʋnya sid na malis hali.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋm tis Wina'am, yʋ'ʋm zʋn'or yʋʋma tis o, dʋ'ʋsim Onɛ Ban'ad Saŋgbana la yʋ'ʋr; o yʋ'ʋri buon Zugsɔb, maalimi sumalisim o tuon!

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: O anɛ kpiibis ba', ka an onɛ sʋŋid pʋkɔnya, onɛ an Wina'am kanɛ bɛɛ o Zin'ig Kanɛ An Kasi la ni.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Wina'am tisid banɛ pʋ mɔr si'el-si'el la ya' ka ba kpɛn'ɛd, onɛ yisid banɛ bɛ sanrega ni la ka ba yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim; amaa banɛ zan'as o la na bɛ teŋ kanɛ mɔr nintantʋʋlʋg

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋn da gaad nidib la tuonnɛ mɔri ba dɔl sian'arin la,

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: teŋ la da dam ya, ka saa naan agɔlli ni Sinai Zuor zug fʋn Wina'am, onɛ sid an Israel dim Wina'am la tuon.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: Wina'am, fʋ tis saa bɛdegʋ ye fʋ bʋgʋli fʋ teŋ kanɛ kʋdig la.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da tis o labaar la, ka pu'ab pamm giligi mɔɔli li yɛla yɛt ye,

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: “Na'anam nɛ ba soogianam zɔt tɔ'ɔtɔ ka basi ba la'asʋg la zin'ig, ka nidib pʋdig la'abanɛ ka ba faaɛn la.

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Hali yanam banɛ da gbɛɛnd bʋnkɔnbid dɔɔdin la, ya nyɛt la'ad linɛ nwɛnɛ dawana kɔnbid nɛ ka ba buligi li nɛ anzurifa, ka li kɔnbid nyɛɛnnɛ nwɛnɛ sanlim nɛ.”

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la da widig na'anam teŋin saŋsi'a la, li da nwɛnɛ sakuga lit Zalmon Zuor zug nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Basan zuoya la anɛ zuotitada; Basan zuoya la dʋnɛ hali.

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Yanam zuotitada, bɔ ka ya gɔsid zuokanɛ ka Zugsɔb la gaŋ ye o sʋ'oe ka na bɛɛ ani saŋa wʋsa la nɛ fufummɛ?

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Wina'am zaba tɛrekonam la zu'onɛ, ba anɛ tusa-tusa ka pʋ mɔr kallɛ; Zugsɔb la yi Sinai kɛɛn o pʋ'ʋsim yin la na.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Fʋn da dʋʋ agɔla la, fʋ da mɔri banɛ an yammis bɛdegʋ keŋ, ka di'e piini nidib san'an, hali la'an nɛ banɛ zan'asif la: Zugsɔb Wina'am, fʋ na bɛɛ ani.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Dʋ'ʋsim Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, Wina'am onɛ aan ti Faangid, ka ziidi ti zitɛbisa tisidi ti daar wʋsa la.

english_verse: You always protect us and save us from death.
translation_verse: Ti Wina'am la anɛ faangid Wina'am, Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yisidi ti kumin.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Sida, Wina'am na nwa'ae o dataas la zut, o na nwa'ae banɛ ken nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ma'aa la zut.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “M na mɔri ba yi Basan teŋin na, nɛ atɛuk zulʋŋ la pʋʋgin,

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: ka ya na piesi ya nɔba ya bi'emnam la ziimin, hali ka ya baas mɛ na nyɛɛ ba din.”

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, sɔ' mɛkama nyɛ fʋn ken si'em, Wina'am onɛ an Na'ab la ken si'em kpɛn'ɛd o pʋ'ʋsim yin la.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Banɛ yʋ'ʋm la bɛ tuon ka bʋnnwɛ'ɛda la bɛɛ ba nya'aŋ, ka pu'asada la bɛɛ ba teŋsʋkʋ nwɛ'ɛd siyaaris.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Zun'om Zugsɔb la nidib la'asʋg zin'igin; zun'om Zugsɔb la Israel dim wʋsa bɛ si'el la.

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Benjamin dɔɔg kanɛ an fiin la gaadi ba tuon, ani ka Juda na'ayikpɛm la bɛ, nɛ Zebulun nɛ Naftali kpi'emnam wʋsa.

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: Wina'am, kɛl ka fʋ paŋ la nie paalʋ, pa'alimi li tisi ti wʋʋ fʋn ɛɛnti niŋid si'em la.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋ'ʋsim Yiri bɛ Jerusalem la zug na'anam na mɔr piini na tisif.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Kadim Egipt dim banɛ nwɛnɛ bʋnkɔnbidi bɛ mɔɔgin la, ka tans tɛɛns la nimbanɛ an wʋʋ wɛniigi la. Widigim tɛɛns banɛ bɔɔd zaba la, ka kɛ ka ba sie ba mɛŋ ka mɔr anzurifa na tisif.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Ba na tʋm nidib ka ba yi Egipt teŋin kena, Kus dim mɛ na nɔki ba mɛŋi tis Wina'am.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Dunia na'anama, yʋ'ʋm tisi Wina'am, yʋ'ʋm zun'oni ti Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋm tisi on, Onɛ Ban'ad Saŋgbana la, saŋgbana banɛ da pʋn dɛŋi bɛ agɔla kʋdimin sa tansid nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar la.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Mɔɔlim Wina'am paŋ la yɛla onɛ ka o kpi'euŋ gur Israel, ka o paŋ bɛ saŋgbana ni la.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋn bɛ fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yin si'em la, fʋ tʋʋmnyalima kpɛn'ɛsid nidib dabiem. Israel Wina'am la tisid o nidib kpi'euŋ nɛ paŋ. Na'asi anɛ Wina'am din!

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: Faanmim, O Wina'am, ka ku'om la paae m kʋkɔya.

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: M simnɛ bian'ar la pʋʋgin sa, zin'ikanɛ ka nɔbir zi'elʋg zin'ig kae. M paanɛ ku'ozuluŋin la, ka ku'om la nyaŋim.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: M gɛnnɛ ka bɔɔd sʋŋir; m kʋdig nɛ. M nini sɔbid nɛ, ka m ieedi m Wina'am.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Banɛ kis man ka li ka' gbin la gaad mam mɛŋ zuobid kal; dataas banɛ yaam zaalim-zaalim la zu'oya, ba anɛ banɛ mɔɔd ye ba san'amim. Li anɛ mugusʋgʋ tisim ban yɛtim ye m yɔɔm linɛ ka m pʋ zu la.

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋ mi' m zɔlim yɛla, m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pʋ su'a fʋ san'anɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, ruler of Israel, don't let me embarrass anyone who trusts and worships you.
