translation_verse: Da kɛ ka banɛ mɔr ti'iri fʋ san'an la di nyan man zugɔ, O Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba; da kɛ ka banɛ ieedif la di nyan man yɛlaa, O Israel Wina'am.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Fʋn yɛla ka ba tʋ'ʋdim saŋa wʋsa, ka diisidim nyan daar woo.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Man liebnɛ saanne m ba'abiisin, ka nwɛnɛ teŋ zʋŋ nidi m mɛŋ mabiis la ni;

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: M nini mu'oe nɛ Wina'am Yir yɛla si'em la li nwɛnɛ bugum dit man nɛ nimbanɛ tʋ'ʋdif la tʋ'ʋdnɛ mam.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: M ya'a lɔ nɔɔri sɔsid Wina'am nɛ kukuma, ba la'adim nɛ;

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: M ya'a yɛ bɔto fuug sʋnsa'aŋ zugɔ, ba mɔrim nɛ siilim.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Banɛ zin' za'anɔɔrin la la'adim nɛ, ka danuudib mɔrimi yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Amaa m Zugsɔba, fʋn ka man sɔsid. Wina'am, gandigimim fʋ sʋŋir saŋa nɛ fʋ nɔŋilim tita'ar la, di'emi m sɔsʋg nɛ fʋ yɛlsida faangir la.

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: Yisimim bian'arin la, da kɛ ka m firi li nii; faanmim banɛ kisim la nu'usin. Yisimim ku'ozulima la ni.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ku'om linɛ pʋbid la nyaŋim, bɛɛ linɛ zulim la limi ma, bɛɛ yaʋg linɛ an bʋmbɔk la vɔli ma.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: Di'emi m sɔsʋg, O Zugsɔba, fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ an sʋm la zug; fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr la zugɔ, fɛndigimi m san'an na.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: M anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm, da su'a fʋ nindaa nɛ ma; di'emi m sɔsʋg tɔ'ɔtɔ, ka m bɛ nɛ yɛla ni.

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Li'elim na faanm; faanmim yisi m bi'emnam la nu'usin.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Fʋ mi' ban tʋ'ʋdim ka nɛ'ɛsidim ka kpɛn'ɛsidim nyan si'em; m bi'emnam la wʋsa bɛ nɛ fʋ tuon ka fʋ nyɛti ba.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Tʋ'ʋd la san'ami m sʋʋnr pamm ka kɛ ka m kʋ lɛn nyaŋi maal si'ela; M ieed onɛ na bʋgʋli m sʋnf, ka sɔ' kae; ka bɔɔd onɛ na zɔtim nimbaanligi gʋ'ʋŋ.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Ba daa nɔk yabidi niŋi m diibin ka nɔk bʋmmi'isʋgʋ gɛndigi m bʋnnuuda ni.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Kpa'ami fʋ sumpɛɛn la yɛɛli ba; ka kɛ ka fʋ sumpɛɛn linɛ dit wʋʋ bugum la kanbi ba.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba yir na yɔ danzuunr, ka nidib kʋ lɛm bɛɛ aninaa.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Ba namisidi banɛ ka fʋ pu'alimi ba la ka pian'ad banɛ ka fʋ kɛ ka tɔɔg paae ba la yɛla bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: Sɔmmi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa digil; da kɛ ka ba nyɛ fʋ faangir laa.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Yisimi ba yʋda nyɔvʋr gbauŋʋn la ka da kɛ ka ba yʋda la'as nɛ pʋpielim dim la.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: M sʋʋnri san'am ka m niŋgbina zabid; O Wina'am, kɛl ka fʋ faangir paŋ la gurim.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: M na yʋ'ʋm zun'e Wina'am yʋ'ʋr ka na'as o nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa na ma'ae Zugsɔb la sʋʋnri gaad naaf maan, o bɔɔdi li gaad na'araug kanɛ mɔr iila nɛ tafɛɛd.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Nɔŋ dim na nyɛ ka ba sʋnya ma'ae; yanam banɛ ieed Wina'am la sʋnya sid na malis!

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la wʋm fara dim la kaasig, ka pʋ nɛ'ɛsid o nimbanɛ bɛ mugusʋg pʋʋgin la yɛla.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka agɔl nɛ teŋgbauŋ zun'e o, la'an nɛ atɛuk nɛ linɛ bɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Wina'am na faaɛn Zion ka lɛbis Juda tempʋʋs la mɛ'. Ka nidib na zin'in ani ka sʋ'ʋgi li;

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: o tʋmtʋmnib la biis na dii li faar, ka banɛ nɔŋ o yʋ'ʋr la na bɛɛ ani.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: M Wina'am, kem tɔ' na faanm! O m Zugsɔba, kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na sʋŋim!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Banɛ ieedim ye ba kʋʋm la, kɛl ka ba ya'am fɛndig, ka ba di nyan; Banɛ wʋsa bɔɔdi m san'auŋ la na fɛndigi lɛb nɛ nyan.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka nyan di banɛ la'ad mam ye, “Hahaa, hahaa la!”

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ wʋsa ieedif la sʋnf na malis ka ba na mɔr sumalisim nɛf; kɛl ka banɛ nɔŋi fʋ faangir la yɛt saŋa wʋsa ye, “Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr na nyɛ zʋn'or!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, m anɛ nɔŋdaan ka an fara sɔb kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na, O Wina'am. Fʋnɛ aan m sʋŋid nɛ m faangid; O Zugsɔba, da yuugɛ.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: M Wina'am, kem tɔ' na faanm! O m Zugsɔba, kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na sʋŋim!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Banɛ ieedim ye ba kʋʋm la, kɛl ka ba ya'am fɛndig, ka ba di nyan; Banɛ wʋsa bɔɔdi m san'auŋ la na fɛndigi lɛb nɛ nyan.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka nyan di banɛ la'ad mam ye, “Hahaa, hahaa la!”

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ wʋsa ieedif la sʋnf na malis ka ba na mɔr sumalisim nɛf; kɛl ka banɛ nɔŋi fʋ faangir la yɛt saŋa wʋsa ye, “Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr na nyɛ zʋn'or!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, m anɛ nɔŋdaan ka an fara sɔb kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na, O Wina'am. Fʋnɛ aan m sʋŋid nɛ m faangid; O Zugsɔba, da yuugɛ.

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, fʋ san'an ka m su'adi m mɛŋ; da kɛ ka m di nyannɛ.

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Faanmim ka yisim nɛ fʋ pʋpielim la; Wʋmmi m sɔsʋg ka faanm.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Aan m tampinkanɛ ka m su'adi fʋ ni, ani ka m na ken saŋa wʋsa; tisim nɔɔr ka m nyɛ faangir, bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ aan m tampiing nɛ m kpi'euŋ zin'ig.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: M Wina'am, faanmim nimbɛ'ɛdnam la nu'usin, banɛ an bugusnam ka tʋm bɛ'ɛd la.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ an m ti'ir, O Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, lin yii m biilimin sa hali ti paae nannanna.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Lin yii m du'am saŋa sa fʋn ma'aa ka m ti'e; fʋnɛ yisimi m ma pʋʋgin na. Fʋn ma'aa ka m na zun'od.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: M bɛllim la anɛ zanbinnɛ tis nidib bɛdegʋ, bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ aan m kpi'euŋ nɛ m suak zin'ig.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Fʋ zʋn'or ma'aa bɛɛ m nɔɔrin, m pa'annɛ fʋ pipilim la an si'em daar wʋsa.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: M ya'a kʋdig, fʋn da kadimi basɛ; m paŋ ya'a ti naae, fʋn da tami m yɛllɛ.

english_verse: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
translation_verse: M dataas pian'adi m yɛla bɛ'ɛd banɛ mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm la la'asi gban'e, yɛt ye,

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: “Wina'am tam o yɛla, kʋdim gban'aminɛ o, ka sɔ' kʋ faaɛn o.”

english_verse: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Wina'am, da lal nɛ ma; lɛm tɔ'ɔtɔ na sʋŋim, O m Wina'am.

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Banɛ duoe zi'e m yɛla la na bɔdig ka di nyan; banɛ bɔɔd ye san'auŋ paam la na di nyan.

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Amaa ya'a kpɛlim nɛ mam, m na mɔr ti'ir saŋa wʋsa; m na dʋ'ʋsif ka maligim dʋ'ʋsif.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: M nɔɔr na yɛli fʋ pʋpielim nɛ fʋ faangir la yɛla daar wʋsa, la'an nɛ mam kʋ nyaŋi maki baŋ lin zem si'em la.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: M na kena mɔɔli fʋ tʋʋm kpi'ema la yɛla, O Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔba; m na mɔɔl pʋpielim linɛ an fʋn ma'aa din la yɛla.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, m biilim saŋa ka fʋ pa'alim, hali ti paae zina ka m kpɛn mɔɔnnɛ fʋ nyalima tʋʋma la yɛla.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋ pʋpielim la paae saŋgbana ni, fʋn kanɛ tʋm tʋʋm bɛda la, O Wina'am, anɔ'ɔn nwɛnɛ fɔ?

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ fʋn kɛ ka m nyɛ yɛla bɛdegʋ nɛ tɔɔg la, fʋ na lɛbisi m paŋ la na; hali m ya'a sigi bɛ teŋ teŋir fʋ na mɔrimi dʋ'ʋs na ya'as.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Fʋ paasim na'asi ka bʋgʋli m sʋʋnr ya'as.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: M Wina'am, fʋ sida la zug, m na nwɛ' kɔnne zʋn'ʋf. M na yʋ'ʋm dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr, O Israel Wina'am onɛ an Kasi.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Mam kanɛ ka fʋ faaɛn la, na baamid nɛ sumalisim zun'odi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: M zilim na yɛli fʋ pʋpielim tʋʋma la yɛla daar wʋsa, banɛ bɔɔd ye ba san'amim la, ba ya'am fɛndig ya ka ba di nyan.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: Pa'alim Na'ab la fʋ yɛlsida, O Wina'am, pa'alim na'abiig la fʋ pʋpielim.

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: O na kadi fʋ nidib la saria nɛ pʋpielim, nɛ fʋ nimbanɛ namisid la nɛ yɛlsida.

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka zuoya la mɔr bɛllim linɛ an sʋm na tis nidib la, ka kʋkʋna mɔr pʋpielim na.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: O na zab o nimbanɛ namisid la yɛla ka tis biis banɛ an fara dim la yɔlisim; o na san'am onɛ namisidi ba la paŋ.

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: O na bɛ saŋa wʋsa nwɛnɛ winnig nɛ nwadigi bɛ si'em la, hali nɛ zʋmaana wʋsa.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: O na nwɛnɛ saa niid mɔma'asa zug, ka nwɛnɛ samilimmiugʋ niidi bʋgʋn teŋ la.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: O bɛllim saŋa la pʋpielim na bɛ; si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa paae nwadig la bɛn.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: O na sʋ'oe atɛuk nɔɔrin keŋ paae atɛuk nɔɔrin nɛ Efiritis kɔldaug la nɔɔrin paae teŋ la bɛn.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Buudbanɛ bɛ pipirisin la na igin o tuon ka o dataas lii o tuon tintannin.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Tarsis na'ab nɛ banɛ bɛ lalli la na mɔr piini na tis o; Seeba teŋ nɛ Seba teŋ na'anam mɛ na yɔɔd lampɔɔ tisid o.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Na'anam wʋsa na igin o tuon ka sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa na tʋmmi tisid o.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ onɛ na faaɛn fara dim banɛ kaasidi buon o la, nɛ banɛ namisid ka pʋ mɔr sʋŋid la.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: O na zɔ tadimnam nɛ nɔŋ dim la nimbaanlig ka faaɛn ba kum pʋʋgin.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: O na faaɛn ba zaba nɛ mugusʋg pʋʋgin, ba vʋm yɛla pak o la zug.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: O na vʋe yuug! Ba na tis o sanlima linɛ yit Seeba teŋin na. Nidib na sɔsid Wina'am tisid o ka kaanb sʋm tis o saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka zʋʋd bɛ teŋ la wʋsa ni; hali nɛ kʋkʋna la wʋsa zug. Ka wal wala wʋʋ Lebanon zʋʋdi maan si'em la; ka bul nwɛnɛ mɔɔd banɛ bɛ mɔɔgin la bʋn si'em la.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka na'ab la yʋ'ʋr bɛ saŋa wʋsa; kɛl ka o yʋ'ʋr na yuug wʋʋ winnigi yuugid si'em la. On zug ka sʋ'ʋlim bɛdegʋ na nyɛ bareka, ka ba na buon o ye Wina'am bareka sɔb.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Zun'or anɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la din, on ma'aa tʋm nyalima.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Zun'omin o yʋ'ʋr linɛ an sʋm hali la saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ; teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa pɛ'ɛl nɛ o na'am pipilim. Ami! Ami!

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Jese biig David winsɔsʋg la bɛnnɛ nwa'.

english_verse: ) God Is Good
translation_verse: ) Wina'am tʋmnɛ linɛ nar

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Sida, Zugsɔb la an sʋm tis Israel, nɛ banɛ pʋʋgʋ an nyain la.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, m daa mɔr fufum nɛ nyɛɛsim dim la, man daa nyɛ ka bugusim dim ken tuon la zug.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Si'el-si'el pʋ daamidi baa; ka ba niŋgbina mɔr laafi nɛ paŋ.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, nyɛɛsim aan ba niŋgɔnkɔris ka ba nɔk zaba yɛ wʋʋ fuug nɛ.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Ba sʋnya an bɛ'ɛd la zug ka ba tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd; bɛ'ɛd linɛ ka ba tɛn'ɛsidi ba pʋtɛn'ɛrin la pʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ nan nidiba, ka pian'ad nɛ kisidim ba nyɛɛsim la zug ka ba bɔɔd ye ba namisi ba taaba.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Ba pian'adi nwɛnɛ banɛ sʋ'oe arezana, ka pa'an nyɛɛsim dunia nwa' pʋʋgin.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, ba nidib yʋ'ʋn fɛndigi lɛbidi ba san'an ka siakid ban yɛt si'el wʋsa wʋʋ ku'om ka ba nuud nɛ.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Ba yɛt ye, “Wina'am na niŋ wala baŋɛ? Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la mɔr baŋirɛɛ?”

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Bugusim dimi an si'em la, ba ba'a kae, ba mɔɔdi ban na nyɛ kpan'am paas.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Sida, man pɛligi m pʋʋgʋ bɛ si'em la anɛ zaalim; ka san'ami m ya'a gban'e m mɛŋ nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Dabisa la wʋsa m bɛ nɛ namisʋgʋn; bɛkɛung wʋsa m nyɛti namisʋg.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: M ya'a yɛlin ye m na pian' li yɛla m naan yiinɛ fʋ biis la nya'aŋ.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: Mam daa mak ye m gban'e li gbin la, li daa anɛ linɛ mugusidim pamm,

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: hali ti paae saŋkanɛ ka m kpɛn' Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim Yin la; ani ka m baŋi ba naarɛ na an si'em.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Sida, fʋ nɔki ba niŋ sisalig zin'igin; fʋ da'ae ba bas teŋin ye ba san'am.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Gɔsim ban gbirigi san'am si'em! Dabiem mɔri ba gaad sa nyain!

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Li nwɛnɛ nidi na zaansim ka duoe gbɛɛmin, Oo Zugsɔba, fʋ ya'a ti duoe, fʋ na nɛ'ɛsi ba ban ka' gbin la zug.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: M sʋnfʋ daa san'am saŋa si'a ka ɛndʋg mɔrim hali la,

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: m daa anɛ zɔlʋg ka zi' si'el si'ela ka nwɛnɛ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'ogʋ fʋ tuon.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, m bɛ fʋ san'an saŋa wʋsa ka fʋ gban'e m datiuŋ nu'ug.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Fʋ gurim nɛ fʋ sa'alʋg ka li naar wʋsa fʋ na mɔrimi keŋ na'asi zin'igin.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: M mɔr anɔ'ɔn arezana ni, ka li ya'a ka'anɛ fʋn ma'aanɛ? Si'el kae teŋgbauŋ la zug ka m bɔɔdi lɛm paas fʋn zugɔ.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: M niŋgbina nɛ m sʋnf tun'e tadig, amaa Wina'am an onɛ kpɛmisidi m sʋnf; on ma'aa ka m bɔɔd saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Banɛ basif la na bɔdig; fʋ na san'am banɛ wʋsa pʋ dɔllif nɛ sida la.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Amaa li ya'a kpɛlim nɛ mam, li an sʋm nɛ mam pʋ lal nɛ Wina'am la. M na kɛ ka Zugsɔb la aan m suak zin'ig, ka lɛm mɔɔn o tʋʋm sʋma yɛla saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: Wina'am, bɔ ka fʋ zan'asi ti nyainnɛ? Bɔ ka fʋ sʋnf pɛlig nɛ fʋ nimbanɛ nwɛnɛ fʋ pɛ'ɛs la?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Tɛnri fʋ nimbanɛ ka fʋ gaŋ ka li yʋma zulim la, buudkanɛ aan fʋ faar ka fʋ faaɛn ba la. Tɛnr Zion Zuokanɛ aan fʋ bɛllim zin'ig la.

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Fɛndigimi fʋ nindaa kpa' gɔsi fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la san'am si'em, dataas la san'ami li ka li pʋ lɛm mɔr maalʋgɔ.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Fʋ dataas bɛ zin'ikanɛ ka tinam nɛ fʋ la'asid la ka nwa'ami tansid nyaŋir tansʋg; ba sɛɛ ba tuutanamɛ zi'el ka li an zanbinnɛ pa'an ye ba nyaŋ ya.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Ba niŋidi nwɛnɛ nimbanɛ zanl zɛnna ba nu'usin ye ba nwa' tiis bɛdegʋ lug.

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: Ka zaŋ liemis nɛ zɛnna san'am dabanɛ ka ba kpi'a la.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Ka yɛli ba pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye, “Ti na san'ami ba wʋsa nyain!” Teŋin la wʋsa ba nɔk bugum nyu'oe ka li di zin'ibanɛ wʋsa ka ba daa pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am la.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Ti pʋ lɛn nyɛt zanbina ka li an nyalimaa; nɔdi'esidib la baa yinne pʋ kpɛlim, ka ti sɔ' mɛ zi' nɛ'ɛŋa na yuugi paae si'em bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: O Wina'am, bʋndaar ka fʋ dataas la na basi fʋ la'abɔ? Bi'emnam la na kpɛn san'amidi fʋ yʋ'ʋr ala saŋa wʋsaa?

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋnɛ da aan m na'ab pin'ilʋgʋn sa; fʋnɛ mɔr faangiri kɛn teŋgbauŋ la zug na.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Li anɛ fʋnɛ da buak atɛuk la nɛ fʋ paŋ; fʋnɛ da nwa'ae ku'omin bʋnyua la zut.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Li anɛ fʋnɛ da mɛdig bʋmbɛ'og kanɛ ka ba buon Lɛviatan la zug ka nɔk o niŋgbina tis pipirisin bʋnkɔnbid ka li liebi ba diib.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Li anɛ fʋnɛ da yɔ'ɔg ku'osuoya nɛ zin'ibanɛ ka ku'om tansidi yit na la; ka mɛ kɛ ka kɔldaad banɛ pʋbid saŋa wʋsa la kʋdig.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ sʋ'oe nintaŋ ka lɛn sʋ'oe yʋ'ʋŋ; fʋnɛ da maal winnig nɛ nwadig.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ da mak teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa titɔndis; fʋnɛ maal ʋʋn nɛ sɛɛung wʋsa.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔbaa, tɛn'ɛsim dataas la la'adif si'em, gɔsim nimbanɛ an zɔn la san'amidi fʋ yʋ'ʋr si'em.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Ti nwɛnɛ fʋ dawana nɛ, da nɔki ti tis sian'arin bʋnkɔnbidɛ, da tami fʋ nimbanɛ namisid la yɛla nyainnɛ.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Tɛnri fʋ nɔnaar la yɛla, bɔzugɔ teŋ la zin'ibanɛ an lik la wʋsa pɛ'ɛl nɛ zaba.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka banɛ ka ba mugusidi ba la lɛb nɛ nyannɛ; kɛl ka nɔŋ dim nɛ fara dim la dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, duom zabi sʋŋi fʋ nidib la; tɛn'ɛsim zɔn la san'amidi fʋ yʋ'ʋr la saŋa wʋsa si'em.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ'ʋsif bareka, O Wina'am, ti pʋ'ʋs ya bɔzugɔ, fʋ yʋ'ʋr la bɛ nɛ ti yammin; nidib yɛti fʋ tʋʋmnyalima la yɛla.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ la ya'a ti dam nɛ nimbanɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin la, manɛ gban'adi lii mɔr kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Tita'alnam la ka m yɛt ye, ‘Da dʋ'ʋsi ya mɛŋ ya'asɛ’, ka yɛl bugusnam la ye, ‘Da lɛm pa'ali nɛ ya paŋ la!

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: Da dʋ'ʋsidi ya mɛŋ agɔllɛ; da pian'adi ka duoe ya niŋgɔnya dɔi nɛ.’”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kae ya-nya'aŋ, bɛɛ ya-tuona, bɛɛ yi pipirisin na, na nyaŋi dʋ'ʋs ninsaala.

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Amaa li anɛ Wina'am: onɛ sied nid, onɛ lɛn dʋ'ʋsid nid.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Bʋtiŋ bɛ Zugsɔb la nu'ugin li pɛ'ɛl nɛ daam kanɛ gɛndig bʋnnyubisa o na kpa'ae li bas, ka bugusnam banɛ bɛ teŋin la na nuu li wʋsa naae.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ mam, m na yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa saŋa wʋsa; m na yʋ'ʋm zun'e Jakob Wina'am la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: M na san'am bugusnam la paŋ, amaa pʋpielim dim la, m na kɛ ka ba dʋ'ʋsi ba.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Nidib mi' Wina'am Juda teŋin; o mɔr yʋ'ʋtita'ar Israel teŋin.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: O Fuug Sʋgʋr bɛ Salem tempʋʋgin, ka o bɛllim zin'ig bɛ Zion Zuorin.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Ani ka o kɔ' piema banɛ tɔɔnd la, la'an nɛ gbanti'edʋg nɛ sʋ'ʋraad nɛ zaba la'ad wʋsa.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Ba faaɛn dap banɛ mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ la la'ad wʋsa ka kɛ ka ba digi. Ba gbisya ka kʋ lɛn duoe; zabzabidib la baa yinne kʋ nyaŋi ʋk nu'ug ya'asɛ.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: O Jakob Wina'am, fʋ da tansya, ka widi nɛ zaba tɛrekonam digin baanlimm.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Fʋn ma'aa nar ye ba zɔtif. Fʋ sʋnf ya'a pɛligɛ anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi zi'enɛ fʋ tuonnɛ?

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: Sida fʋ sʋnf ya'a ti pɛlig nɛ nidib li zun'odi fʋ yʋ'ʋr, ka banɛ nyaŋi yii fʋ sʋnpɛɛnnin la na lɛb nya'aŋ.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ yɛl si'eli zi'eli ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la asɛɛ ka ya maali li bʋn; kɛl ka tɛɛns banɛ kpi'e la wʋsa mɔri ba piini na tis onɛ nar ye ba zɔt o la.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: O kɛ ka na'anam banɛ kpi'em hali la nini ma'ae; dunia wʋsa na'anam zɔt o nɛ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: M kaasi tis Wina'am ye o sʋŋim, m kaasi tis Wina'am ye o wʋmi m sɔsʋg.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Man daa bɛ sʋnsa'aŋin la, m daa sɔs Zugsɔb la; yʋ'ʋŋ ya'a sɔb m ʋkidi m nu'us hali ka pʋ gɛɛnda ka m sʋʋnr wʋsa pʋ lɛn siakid bɛlisigɔ.

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: M tɛn'ɛsi fʋ yɛla, O Wina'am, ka unsid; m fabilnɛ hali ka m paŋ ti naae.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka m nini wak; M sʋʋnr san'amnɛ galis ka m gʋ'ʋŋ pian'ad.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: M tɛn'ɛs dabisbanɛ gaad la, nɛ yʋʋm banɛ gaad sa la yɛla;

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb la na kpɛn zan'asidi tii? O sʋnf kʋ lɛm malis nɛ ti ya'asɛɛ?

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: O nɔŋilim linɛ pʋ naad la bɔdignɛ la nyainnɛɛ? O kaanbʋg la pʋ nyaŋidi tʋm saŋa wʋsaa?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Wina'am tam o nimbaanlzɔɔr la yɛla nɛɛ? O sʋnpɛɛn la yɛla ka o pʋ lɛn zɔti ti nimbaanligaa?”

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Ka m tɛn'ɛs ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa zugɔ m na sɔs o: yʋma banɛ ka ti da nyɛt Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa paŋ la lɛn kae.”

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: M na tiɛn Zugsɔb la tʋʋma; sida, m na tɛn'ɛs tʋʋm banɛ ka fʋ da tʋm ka li yuug la.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: M na tɛn'ɛs fʋn tʋm si'em la wʋsa ka tiɛn fʋ tʋʋm titada la.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋ suoya la anɛ kasi. Win kan bɛ yaanɛ zem nɛ ti Wina'am la?

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Fʋ anɛ Wina'am kanɛ tʋm nyalima; fʋ pa'al nidib la fʋ paŋi an si'em.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Fʋ da faaɛn fʋ nidib la nɛ fʋ paŋ tita'ar, banɛ an Jakob nɛ Josef yaas la.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: M Wina'am, ku'om la da nyɛɛf la, ku'om la sid da nyɛɛf la ka dabiem kpɛn' o; ka li ku'ozuluŋ zin'ig la kirid.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Saŋgbana la da pin'ili niid saa, ka maligim mɔr satansʋg; ka fʋ piema la ken tuon nɛ nya'aŋ.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Satansʋg la da naam sisi'epiliŋin la tansid, ka sa-ian'asʋg kɛ ka dunia nie nyain; ka teŋ la dam ka kirid.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Fʋ suobuga da dɔlli atɛukʋn la, ka fʋ suoya dɔl ku'otitada la ni, la'an nɛ fʋ nɔbtan'am pʋ nyɛt la.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Fʋ da mɔri fʋ nidib la ken wʋʋ kɔnbid ka Moses nɛ Aaron guri ba.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: M nidibaa, wʋmminɛ m pa'alʋg, ka kɛlisi m nɔɔr pian'ad.

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: M na ya'ae m nɔɔri siilim siilima, ka pian' yɛlsu'ada, linɛ da bɛ kʋdimin la.

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: Li anɛ tinamɛ zamis ka baŋ si'el, nɛ ti yaanamɛ daa pʋn yɛli ti si'el la.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ti kʋ su'a li ti biisɛ; ti na yɛl zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ duod na la Zugsɔb paŋ nɛ o nyalima tʋʋma linɛ nar zʋn'or nɛ wɔ'ɔgir la yɛla.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: O zi'el zi'ela tis Jakob yaas ka zi'el wada Israel teŋin, linɛ ka o da tisi ti yaanam nɔɔr ye ba pa'ali ba biis la.

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: Ala ka zʋmaana banɛ dɔlli ba nya'aŋ la na baŋ, hali ka bibanɛ ka ba nam pʋ du'a la, mɛ na ti yɛli ba biisi li yɛla.

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: Ala ka ba na tis Wina'am sida ka kʋ tam on tʋm si'el la amaa ka na dɔl o zi'ela la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: They would be different from their ancestors, who were stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful to God.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ nwɛnɛ ba yaanam zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ zuti kpi'em ka ba pʋ siakid o nɔɔr la banɛ sʋnya ka' nyain tis Wina'am, ka ba pʋ dɔl o nɛ sida la.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ Efiram dimi bɔb nɛ tiraad la, tanp nwɛ'ɛb saŋa la ba zɔnɛ.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Ba da pʋ dɔl Wina'am nɔnaar la ka zan'as ka pʋ dɔl o wada la.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Ba da tam on maal si'el la, nɛ nyalima banɛ ka o pa'ali ba la.

english_verse: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: O tʋm nyalima ba yaanam san'an Egipt teŋin, Zoan sʋ'ʋlimin.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: O da pʋdig atɛuk la ka mɔri ba gaad; ka kɛ ka ku'om la zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ wʋʋ zaŋguom nɛ.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka saŋgbauŋ dɔlli ba nintaŋ ka bugum mɛ dɔlli ba yʋ'ʋŋ.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: O da buak tampiins sian'arin la tisi ba ku'om ka li zu'oe nwɛnɛ atɛuk ku'om nɛ;

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: o da kɛ ka ku'om yi tampiins sian'asim na pʋbidi nwɛnɛ kɔldaug nɛ.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Amaa ba da nan kpɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔgid o, ka zan'as Zugsɔb Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la sian'arin la.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Ba da gban'e ba pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye ba mak Wina'am ka fabil ye ba bɔɔd diib.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Ba da pian' pɔ'ɔg Wina'am yɛt ye, “Wina'am sid na nyaŋi tisi ti diib sian'arin nwaa?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: O daa nwɛ' tampiing ka ku'om tans na pʋbid yɔri-yɔri, amaa o na nyaŋi tisi ti diibɔɔ? O na nyaŋi tis tinam banɛ aan o nidib la ni'imɛɛ?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da wʋm la, o sʋnf da pɛlig ya hali, ka o kɛ ka bugum la'aŋ Jakob yaas la, ka o sʋnf duoe nɛ Israel dim,

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: ban pʋ niŋ Wina'am yadda, bɛɛ tis sida ye o na faaɛn ba la zug.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, o tis saŋgbana banɛ bɛɛ agɔla la nɔɔr ka yɔ'ɔg agɔla za'anɔya;

english_verse: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
translation_verse: o kɛ ka manna li na ka nidib la di, o tisi ba arezana ni zʋʋd.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Ka ninsaalib la di maliaknam diib; o da tisi ba diib linɛ na sia'ali ba wʋsa.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: O kɛ ka nya'aŋ sisi'em yi saŋgbana ni na ka kɛ ka o paŋ zi dagɔbʋg sisi'em na.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka ni'im lina wʋʋ titan nɛ, ka niis ian'adi nwɛnɛ atɛuk nɔɔrin titanbin'isi.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka ba ian'a kpɛn' o nidib la'asʋg zin'igin na, giligi ba sʋga la.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Ka nidib la ɔnbi tig hali sʋ'ʋŋaa, bɔzugɔ o da tisi ba, ba ya'amlɛog bɔɔdim.

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: ka Zugsɔb sʋnf duoe nɛ ba; ka o kʋʋ ba ninkpi'ema banɛ bɛɛ ba sʋʋgin la, banɛ an Israel na'akimsʋma la.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala wʋsa, ba da nan kpɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd; hali nɛ o tʋʋmnyalima la wʋsa, ba da nam pʋ niŋ o yadda.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Ala ka o da kɛ ka ba vʋm ba'as yɔri ka kɛ ka dabiem mɔri ba, ba bɛllim pʋʋgin.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Wina'am ya'a da ɛɛnti kɛ ka ba kpiid; ba fɛndig nɛ lɛb o san'an ya'as nɛ nimmua.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Ba da yii tiɛn ye Wina'am aan ba Tampiing, Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la aan ba Faangid.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Amaa li da pʋ yuugida ka ba lɛm pian'ad o nɔŋgban malisim ma'aa, ka mɔri ba zilima la faad o;

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala o da anɛ nimbaanlzɔt; o kɛɛ ba taali bas ka pʋ san'ami ba. Saŋa bɛdegʋ o gu'usid o sʋnpɛɛn ka pʋ kɛ ka o sʋnf pɛligi galisɛ.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: O da tiɛnya ye ba anɛ niŋgbiŋ ma'aa, ba nwɛnɛ pɛbisim na da'ae gaad ka kʋ lɛb si'em na la.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Gɔsim saŋa bɛdegʋ ka ba da zan'as o nɔɔr sian'arin la ka san'am o sʋʋnr si'em!

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba makid Wina'am saŋa wʋsa; ba san'amid Israel Wina'am Onɛ an Kasi la sʋʋnr.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ba da pʋ lɛn tɛnri o paŋ kanɛ ka o da zaŋi faaɛn ba banɛ da mugusidi ba la nu'usin la yɛla,

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: daakanɛ ka o da pa'al o nyalima zanbina Egipt teŋin, nɛ o kilima tʋʋma Zoan sʋ'ʋlimin la.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: O da tiak Egipt dim kɔldaad ka li kilim ziim; ka ba pʋ nyaŋidi nuudi ba kɔldabʋmbu'ad la ku'om.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka dumis yina dumi ba, ka kɛ ka lɔmis san'ami ba teŋ la.

english_verse: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka sisɔma san'ami ba pɔɔd, ka na'azɔmnam san'ami ba zʋʋd.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: O san'ami ba vain tiis nɛ waad ka kɔɔ ba kekama nɛ sakuga.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka sakuga kʋʋ ba niigi, ka kɛ ka satansʋg kʋʋ ba kɔnbid.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: O da kpa'ae o sʋnpɛɛn linɛ la'aŋidi nwɛnɛ bugum la nɛ o sʋnsa'aŋ tita'ar la niŋi ba zug ka kɛ ka o maliaknam banɛ kʋʋd la da yina.

english_verse: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
translation_verse: O da tis o sumpɛɛn la suor; o pʋ kɛ ka ba pɔns nɛ kum amaa ka kɛ ka ban'abɛ'ɛd gban'e ba.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Amaa o da mɔr o nidibi yina wʋʋ kɔnbid nɛ; o da dɔlisi ba yi sian'arin wʋʋ pɛ'ɛs nɛ.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: O da guri ba sʋ'ʋŋa ka dabiem pʋ mɔri ba; amaa ka atɛuk la vɔli ba dataas.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: O da mɔri ba paae teŋ kanɛ an kasi la titɔndigin na, ta'asi ba paae zuoya teŋin na zin'ikanɛ ka o nɔk o paŋi faaɛn tisi ba la.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: O da kad buudbanɛ bɛɛ ba tuon la ka pʋdig teŋ la tisi ba ka li aan ba faar; ka zin'il Israel buudi la ka ba zin' ba yaan.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Amaa ba da lɛm mak Wina'am ka zan'as Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la; ba pʋ di'e o nɔɔr zi'elʋgɔ.

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: Ba da anɛ wʋʋ ba yaanamɛ da an si'em la ka ka' sida dima ka pʋ mɔr yaddaa, ka nwɛnɛ tiraug kanɛ mɔr dɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Ba da duoe o sʋʋnr nɛ ban maan maana zin'isieba la; ka kɛ ka fufum mɔr o nɛ ba bada la zug.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Wina'am da nyɛɛ li la ka o sʋʋnr pɛlig hali; ka o zan'as Israel dim la nyain.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: O da bas o pʋ'ʋsim dɔɔg linɛ bɛ Siilo la, nɛ Fuug Sʋgʋr linɛ ka o ti' li nidib sʋʋgin la.

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka ba dataas faaɛn Nɔnaar Daka linɛ aan o paŋ, nɛ linɛ an zanbinnɛ pa'annɛ o na'am pipilim la.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: O sʋnf da pɛlig nɛ o nimbanɛ aan o faar la galis; ka o kɛ ka ba dataas zabi kʋʋ ba.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Bugum da kanbi ba na'akim la wʋsa, ka ba pu'asada pʋ nyɛ sidibi kulɛ;

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Ba da kʋʋ ba maanmaannib la tanpin ka ba pʋkɔnya gʋ'ʋŋ kukuma.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la duoe wʋʋ ninkanɛ nie gbɛɛmin nɛ, bɛɛ ninkanɛ bug daam ka li yɛɛg o an si'em la.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: O da kad o dataas la lɛbis nya'aŋ; ka diisi ba nyan linɛ pʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Amaa o da zan'as Josef yaas la, o da pʋ gaŋ Efiram dɔɔg la;

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: amaa ka lɛɛ gaŋ Juda dɔɔg la, nɛ Zion Zuokanɛ ka o nɔŋ la.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: O da mɛɛ o Pʋ'ʋsim Yir anina ka li nwɛnɛ agɔl nɛ, ka lɛn nwɛnɛ teŋgbauŋ kan ka o maal ka li bɛ saŋa wʋsa la.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: O da gaŋ David onɛ aan o tʋmtʋm la yis o kɔnbkemmin;

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: zin'ikanɛ ka o da kem kɔnbid la mɔr o na ye o kem o nimbanɛ an Jakob yaas la; Israel dim banɛ aan o faar la.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Ka David da guri ba nɛ pʋʋg yinne; o da mɔri ba nɛ mi'ilim.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: Wina'am, ba san'ami fʋ teŋ kanɛ aan fʋ faar la; ba san'ami fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir linɛ aan fʋ din ka an kasi la, ba kɛ ka Jerusalem lieb tandia'ana.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋmtʋmnib banɛ ka ba kʋ la, ba nɔki ba tis zʋʋnd ka li liebi ba diib, ka zaŋi ba niŋgbina tis bʋnyuos banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋʋn la.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Ba kpa'ae ziim wʋʋ ku'om nɛ gilig Jerusalem wʋsa, ka sɔ' kae na mum kumm.

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Kpa'ami fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la niŋ tɛɛns banɛ ka ba ba'a ka' nɛf la nɛ sʋ'ʋlim banɛ pʋ buonnɛ fʋ yʋ'ʋr la,

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: nɛ banɛ kʋʋ fʋ nimbanɛ an Jakob yaas ka san'ami ba teŋ la.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ti yaanam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dɔlli tii; kɛl ka fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr paae ti san'an tɔ'ɔtɔ na, ka ti pʋ lɛm mɔr ti'irɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: Sʋŋimi ti, O ti Wina'am onɛ an ti Faangidaa, fʋ yʋ'ʋri an yʋ'ʋsʋŋ la zug; faanmi ti ka kɛɛ ti taali bas fʋ girima la zug.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka tɛɛns la nidib yɛt ye, “Ba Wina'am la bɛ yaanɛ?” Pa'alim tɛɛns la nidibi ti nini ni, ye fʋ na yɔ sam ban kʋʋ fʋ tʋmtʋmnib la zug.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ bɛ sanrega ni la ʋʋnsʋg paae fʋ san'an na. Fʋn mɔr paŋ la zugɔ, gɔsim banɛ ka ba kʋʋs ye ba kpi la ka gu' ba nyɔvʋya.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: Ti kpi'es banɛ tʋ'ʋdif la, yɔɔmi li sam nɔɔr ayɔpɔi, O Zugsɔbaa.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Ti anɛ fʋ nidib, ka nwɛnɛ kɔnbbanɛ ka fʋ kem nɛ; ti na zun'odif saŋa wʋsa. Lin yi zʋmaʋŋ yinne ti paae yinne ni, ti na tiɛndi wɔ'ɔgidif saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Fʋn kanɛ an Israel kɔnbkemma, wʋm tisi ti, fʋn kanɛ gur Josef yaas wʋʋ kɔnbid la; fʋn kanɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug Kerubnam teŋsʋk la, niem paalʋ

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: Efiram nɛ Benjamin nɛ Manase dɔɔd dim tuon na. Duom nɛ fʋ paŋ la; kem na faaɛn ti.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Lɛbisimi ti, ti zin'igin, O Wina'am; kɛl ka fʋ nindaa nie ti san'an, ka ti nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋ Sɔba, fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la ye li yuugi paae wala bɛnnɛ? Fʋ kʋ lɛn gandigi fʋ nidib winsɔsʋgɔɔ?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka ba diib an sʋnsa'aŋ, ka nɔk ninta'am pɛ'ɛl laa ye ba nu.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛ ka tinam nɛ ti kpi'es mɔr zaba, ka ti bi'emnam la'adi ti.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Lɛbisimi ti, ti zin'igin, O Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋ Sɔba; kɛl ka fʋ nindaa nie ti san'an, ka ti nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: Fʋ da mɔri fʋ nidibi yi Egipt na ka li nwɛnɛ daam tiig ka fʋ vuoɛn na ka kad buudbanɛ bɛɛ ani la ka sɛɛ li.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Fʋ uus paalʋ tisi li, ka li tɔn nya'a nɔbigi yadig teŋin la.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Ka li ma'asim lus zuoya la wʋsa, ka lus na'aziinr tititada nɛ ba wila wʋsa.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Li tɔɔn li wila paae Atɛukʋn la, ka li nya'a tɔɔn paae Efiritis kɔldaugin.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ nwa'ae li zaŋguoma bas ka onɛ gat wʋsa na nyaŋi pi'isi li wala la?

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Mɔɔgin dɛɛs la nɔɔdi li ka mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid dit ani.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Lɛmmi ti san'an na, O Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋ Sɔba; naanim arezana ni gɔs teŋin na ka nyɛɛ ti! Gur tikaŋa sʋ'ʋŋa,

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: ka fʋnɛ da nɔki fʋ datiuŋ nu'ugʋ sɛɛ li, bikanɛ ka fʋ ugusi tisi fʋ mɛŋ la.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ba nwaae fʋ tiig la, ka bugum dii li; fʋ tansi fʋ nidib la ka ba yʋ'ʋr san'am.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Nɔkimi fʋ nu'ugʋ kuak dau kanɛ bɛɛ fʋ datiuŋ la, ninsaal kanɛ ka fʋ ugus ye o aan fʋ din la.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Ka ala ka ti kʋ lɛn fɛndigi tɔɔmi fʋ san'anɛ; vʋ'ʋgimi ti, ka ti na buoli fʋ yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Lɛbisimi ti, ti zin'igin, O Zugsɔb Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋ Sɔba; kɛl ka fʋ nindaa nie ti san'an, ka ti nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim tisi ti Wina'am onɛ aan ti paŋ la; tansim agɔla gɔla tis Jakob Wina'am la.

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Pin'ilim yʋʋma la, nwɛ'ɛm siya'ar, nwɛ'ɛm bʋnnwɛ'ɛda banɛ malis wʋsa.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Piebim na'atan nwadpaalig daar, nɛ nwadigi na ti pɛlig ti malʋŋ di'ema la daar;

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: nɛ'ɛŋa an zi'elʋgʋ tis Israel dim, nɛ dɔlisʋg linɛ an Jakob Wina'am la din.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: On da yii zab nɛ Egipt teŋ nidib la o da zi'eli li nɛ, ka li an wada tis Josef yaas la. Ti wʋm kʋkɔri pian'ad ka ti wʋm ka pʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ,

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: ka o yɛl ye, “M tʋk ziid la ba zutin; ka ba nu'us nyɛ yɔlisim nɛ pɛog kanɛ ka ba zanl la.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Ya mugusʋg saŋa la, ya da buolim ka m faaɛn ya. M da naam satansʋg saŋgbana ni wʋm tisi ya; ka maki ya Meriba ku'omin la.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: M yɛl ye, ‘M nidibaa, wʋmmi, ka m na sa'ali ya; yanam Israel dima, ya ya'a kɛlisidinim,

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: ya naan kʋ mɔrin teŋ zʋŋ bada ya sʋʋgin, bɛɛ igini zun'e win saaŋa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt teŋin na la. Ya'amini ya nɔɔr ka m diisi ya.’

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: Amaa m nidib la pʋ bɔɔd ye ba kɛlisi ma; Israel dim pʋ siakidi m nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Ala ka m kɛ ka ba ken nɛ ba zukpi'euŋ suoya ka tʋmmi ba mɛŋi gban'e si'em la.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: Amaa m nidib la ya'a kɛlisinim, Israel dim mɛ ya'a dɔllini m suoya,

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: m naan fɛndigin nɛ m paŋi zab nɛ ba bi'emnam la ka nyaŋi ba dataas la tɔ'ɔtɔ!

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Banɛ kis Zugsɔb la naan igin o tuon nɛ dabiem, ka ba namisʋg la kʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Amaa m na diisi ya nɛ disʋma; m na kɛ ka ya di tampiing siindi tig.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Wina'am zin'in o na'am la'astita'ar la zin'igin; onɛ kad “wina” banɛ bɛ wʋsa saria, ka yɛt ye,

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka ya sʋŋid banɛ ka' sida dima ka mɔr baregaŋ nɛ bugusim dim la?

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Sʋŋimi tadimnam nɛ kpiibis; gɔsimi ka nɔŋ dim banɛ nyɛt mugusʋg la di bʋʋd.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Faanmi tadimnam nɛ nɔŋ dim la; yisimi ba bugusim dim la nu'usin.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: Ba zi' si'ela, ka pʋ gban'ad si'el gbinnɛ. Ba kennɛ giilim likin; dunia ɛɛnbir wʋsa dammidnɛ.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: “M yɛli ya ye, ‘Ya anɛ “wina”; ya anɛ Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la biis.’

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: Amaa ya na kpi wʋʋ ninsaalib nɛ; ya na lu wʋʋ tuongatib wʋsa lut si'em la.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Wina'am, duom kad dunia la saria, ka tɛɛns la wʋsa anɛ fʋ faar!

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: O Wina'am, da sinna; da fɔn ki' nɛ, O Wina'am, da zi'e baanlimm nɛ.

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi fʋ dataas la sʋnya duoe ka ba ʋki ba zut si'em.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Ba yɛt ye, “Kemi na ka ti san'ami ba teŋ la, ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn tiɛn Israel yɛla ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Ba gban'e nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne; ba la'as nɛ nɔɔr yinne ye ba zab nɛf.

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Banɛ an: Edom nɛ Isimael dim nɛ Moab nɛ Haga dim,

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Gebal nɛ Ammon nɛ Amalek nidib nɛ Filistia nɛ Taya dim la wʋsa.

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Hali Asiria dim la'as nɛ ba sʋŋid Lot yaas nwa' ye ba mɔr paŋ hali.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Niŋimi ba wʋʋ fʋn da niŋ Midian dim si'em la, ka lɛn niŋ wʋʋ fʋn da niŋ Sisera nɛ Jabin si'em la, saŋkan ka fʋ da zabi nyaŋi ba Kison kɔldaugin la;

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: fʋ da nyaŋi ba Endo teŋin ka ba kpii digi nwɛnɛ sa'ad.

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Niŋimi ba tuongatib wʋʋ fʋn da niŋ Oreb nɛ Zeeb si'em la, ka kɛ ka ba na'anam wʋsa nwɛnɛ Zeba nɛ Zalmunna,

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: banɛ da yɛl ye, “Kɛlli ka ti faaɛn teŋ la ka sʋ'ʋg Wina'am paalʋ la wʋsa.”

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: O m Wina'am, maalimi ba wʋʋ vuoŋ gungum nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ udug ka sisi'em da'adi li.

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, kɛl ka nyan kpɛn' ba ka ala ka nidib na ieedi fʋ zin'ig.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba nyan la bɛ saŋa wʋsa ka li paki ba; kɛl ka ba kpi nɛ nyan.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba baŋ ye fʋn kanɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Zugsɔb la, fʋn ma'aa an Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa ka fʋ sʋ'oe teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: O Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, fʋ bɛllim zin'ig la sid vɛnl hali!

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb zakin la ya'amlɛogʋ kʋʋdim; m sʋnf nɛ m niŋgbina kaasidnɛ bɔɔd Wina'am Kanɛ Vʋe la.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Hali lʋya paam gbɛɛnsa, ka lilaalis mɛ mɛɛ ba mɛŋ dɔɔd, zin'ikanɛ ka ba na wiakidi ba biis; ka li kpi'e nɛ fʋ bimbim la, O Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, fʋ anɛ m Na'ab nɛ m Wina'am.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ banɛ bɛ fʋ yin la; ba wɔ'ɔgidif saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ banɛ paŋi yiti fʋ san'an la, banɛ gban'e nɛ ba sʋʋnr ye ba keŋ Zion Zuorin la.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Ban dɔl Baka bɔn'ɔkpi'eŋ la gaad la, li lieb zin'ikanɛ ka ku'om tansidi yit na; ka sigsaa mɛ kɛ ka li lieb bɛɛnna.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Ba na maligim paam paŋi paas, hali nɛ ba wʋsa na ti paae Wina'am san'an Zion Zuorin.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Wʋmmi m sɔsʋg, Zugsɔb Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋ Sɔbaa; kɛlisim tisim, Jakob Wina'am.

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋnɛ aan ti zaba gbanti'edʋg kɛl ka fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr bɛ nɛ onɛ ka fʋ gaŋ ka bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ o la.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: M ya'a bɛɛ fʋ zakin la daar yinne li malisi gat mam na bɛ zin'isi'a dabisa tusir; M siak mam na an Wina'am yir za'anɔgur gaad mam na bɛ bugusim dim yin.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Wina'am la aan m winnig nɛ m zaba gbanti'edʋg; Zugsɔb la bɔɔdi m yɛla ka na'asidim; o pʋ mɔŋid banɛ pʋ mɔr taal la bʋnsʋŋɔ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋ Sɔbaa, Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ onɛ ti'iri bɛɛ fʋ ni la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, fʋ da zɔɔ fʋ teŋ la nimbaanlig, ka lɛbis Jakob yaas zusʋŋ la na.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛɛ fʋ nidib la taali bas ka lusi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Fʋ basi fʋ sʋnduor la wʋsa nɛ fʋ sʋnpɛɛn linɛ mɔr dabiem la.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: Lɛbisimi tii ti zi'esimin ya'as, O ti Wina'am nɛ ti Faangidaa, ka da kɛ ka fʋ ya'amlɛog yii ti san'anɛ.

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Fʋ kʋ lɛn tɛndigi ti ya'as ka fʋ nidib la maal sumalisim fʋ san'anɛɛ?

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: M na kɛlis Wina'am onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb la na yɛl si'el; o kaanb ye o na tis tinam banɛ aan o mɛŋ nidib la sumbʋgʋsʋm, amaa ti da lɛn lɛbi ti zɔlim tʋʋma la nii.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Sida o faangir la pʋ lal nɛ banɛ zɔt o la, ka o na'am pipilim la na kpɛm bɛ ti teŋin la.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Nɔŋir nɛ sida sia'al taaba; ka pʋpielim nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm pʋ'ʋs taaba sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Yɛlsida tansi yit teŋin na, ka pʋpielim naan arezana ni gɔsid teŋin na.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sid na tisi ti linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa, ka zʋʋd na maali ti teŋin la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim gaad o tuon ka maan suori tisid o nɔba yakir.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, wʋm ka lɛbisi tisim, ka m anɛ tadim ka an nɔŋdaan.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Guri m nyɔvʋr, ka m pɛsigi m mɛŋi tisif. Fʋ anɛ m Wina'am, faanmim, m anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm ka tisidif sida.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Zɔmim nimbaanlig, O Zugsɔba, ka m buonif daar wʋsa.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Tisimim sumalisim, ka m anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm, O Zugsɔba, fʋn ka m nɔki m mɛŋi tis.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔbaa, fʋ anɛ onɛ an sʋm ka kɛt taali basid, ka fʋ nɔŋilim la paad banɛ wʋsa sɔsidif.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: Wʋmmi m sɔsʋg, O Zugsɔba; kɛlisimi m kaasig ka zɔɔ m nimbaanlig.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Yɛla ya'a ti paae m daasi'er, m na buolif, bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ sʋŋidim.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns banɛ ka fʋ maal la wʋsa nidib na kena igini fʋ tuon, O Zugsɔba; ba na kena na'asi fʋ yʋ'ʋr la.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Fʋ zu'onɛ galis ka tʋm nyalima; fʋn ma'aa an Wina'am.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: Pa'alimim fʋ suor la, O Zugsɔba, ka m na dɔllif nɛ sida; da kɛ ka m bi'esidi m pʋtɛn'ɛrinɛ, ala ka m na zɔti fʋ yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: M na zʋn'ʋf nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa, O Zugsɔb Wina'am; m na na'asi fʋ yʋ'ʋr la saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Fʋn nɔŋim si'em la zu'onɛ; fʋ faanmi yis Ayaʋg linɛ zulim la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Tita'alim dim la bɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm, O Zugsɔba; ninkʋʋdib la'asidi bɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm; nimbanɛ ka ba ba'a ka' nɛf la.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn, Zugsɔba, fʋ anɛ Wina'am onɛ mɔr nimbaanlzɔɔr nɛ nyɔɔg; fʋ anɛ baanlimm ka fʋ sʋnf pʋ duod tɔ'ɔtɔ, ka fʋ nɔŋilim nɛ sida ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Fɛndigim na ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig; tisim man kanɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋm la paŋ, ka faanm, ka m anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm pu'ak la biig.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m nyɛ zanbin ka li na pa'al fʋn an sʋm si'em. Kɛl ka m dataas la nyɛɛ li ka nyan dii ba, bɔzugɔ, fʋn onɛ aan m Zugsɔb la sʋŋidim ka bɛlisidim.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: O ɛɛnb o teŋ la zuokanɛ an kasi la ni;

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nɔŋ Zion za'anɔya gat Jakob nidib bɛllim zin'is wʋsa.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb tempʋʋga, ba pian' fʋ yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: “M na kaal Egipt dim nɛ Babilon dimi paas banɛ siakim la pʋʋgin; m mɛ na kaal Filistia nɛ Taya nɛ Kus dim la wʋsa, ka na yɛl ye, ‘Ba da du'a oŋa nɛ Zion teŋin.’”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Sida, ba na yɛl Zion yɛla ye, “Ba da du'a oŋa nɛ oŋa la nɛ Zion teŋin, ka Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la na zi'el teŋ la kiŋ-kiŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na sɔb nidib la yʋda niŋ yʋda gbauŋʋn la ye, “Ba da du'a oŋa nɛ Zion teŋin.”

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Ba wa'ad ka yʋ'ʋmmi yɛt ye, “Zion ni ka ti bʋnsʋma wʋsa yit na.”

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, Wina'am kanɛ faandim nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ la, fʋn ka m kaasi tis.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m winsɔsʋg paae fʋ san'an na; fɛndigimi fʋ tʋbiri kɛlisi m kaasig.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: M sʋʋnr pɛ'ɛli nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ka m nyɔvʋr vurisidi li'en yaʋg.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Ba kaalimi paas banɛ an kpi'imnam la ni; m nwɛnɛ ninkanɛ ka o paŋ wʋsa naae.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka m bɛ yaʋg teŋir, zin'ikanɛ zulim ka lik bɛ la.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Fʋ sumpɛɛn la anɛ ziidi tɛbigi m zugin, ka nyaŋim nwɛnɛ atɛuk ku'onwiis.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka m zuanam zɔ ka basim, ka zan'as ye ba kʋ li'eli ma. Ba yɔɔm nɛ ka m kʋ nyaŋi yii;

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: m sʋnsa'aŋ la kɛ nɛ ka m nini sɔbid. O Zugsɔba, m buonnɛ fʋn daar wʋsa; M ʋki m nu'us agɔla tisif nɛ winsɔsʋg.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔkidi fʋ nyalima la pa'an kpi'imnamaa? Banɛ kpi la na duoe zun'e fɔɔ?

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ba pian'adi fʋ nɔŋilim la yɛla yaʋgʋnɛɛ, bɛɛ fʋ sida la yɛla san'auŋ zin'igaa?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Banɛ bɛ likin la mi' fʋ nyalima la yɛlaa? Bɛɛ fʋ pʋpielim tʋʋma la bɛ kpi'im teŋaa?

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, bɔ ka fʋ zan'asim ka yuki fʋ nindaa ka kɛɛ ma?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: M biilim saŋa sa m nyɛ namisʋg ka pʋ lal nɛ kum; fʋ kpɛn'ɛsim dabiem ka m ti'ir lɛn kae.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Fʋ sumpɛɛn la limimnɛ wʋʋ ku'om; dabiem kanɛ ka fʋ kpɛn'ɛsidim la kɛ ka m nyɛ san'auŋ.

english_verse: that strike each day and from every side.
translation_verse: Daar wʋsa li giligim nɛ wʋʋ ku'om nɛ ka limim nyain.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Fʋ yisi m zuanam nɛ banɛ nɔŋim la m san'an; lik ma'aa liebi m zua kanɛ bɛ nɛ m yammin.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: M na yʋ'ʋm Zugsɔb nɔŋilim tita'ar la yɛla; fʋ sida la an si'em la, m na pian' nɛ m nɔɔr ka zʋmaana wʋsa baŋ.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: M na yɛl nyain ye fʋ nɔŋilim la zi'enɛ sʋ'ʋŋa saŋa wʋsa, ka fʋ yɛlsida la bɛ saŋa wʋsa wʋʋ saŋgbauŋ nɛ.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Fʋ yɛl ye, “M maal nɔnaar nɛ onɛ ka m gaŋ la, m pɔɔ zi'el David onɛ aan m tʋmtʋm la ye,

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, agɔla zun'odif fʋ nyalima tʋʋma la, ka nimbanɛ bɛɛ fʋ kasi la'asʋg zin'igin la mɛ zun'odif fʋ sida la yɛla.

english_verse: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ bɛɛ agɔla na nyaŋi mak nɛ Zugsɔb la? Banɛ bɛ arezana la wʋsa sʋʋgin anɔ'ɔnɛ nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la?

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Banɛ an kasi la la'asʋg zin'igin ba zɔt Wina'am hali; o anɛ onɛ galis hali, ka banɛ gilig o la wʋsa zɔt o dabiem.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, anɔ'ɔnɛ bɛ nwɛnɛ fʋ? Fʋ anɛ Paŋ Sɔb, O Zugsɔba, ka fʋ sida la bɛ si'el wʋsa ni.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Fʋ da san'am Arahab yɔri-yɔri wʋʋ nid ka ba kʋ la; fʋ nɔki fʋ paŋ tita'ar la widigi fʋ dataas.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Agɔla anɛ fʋ din, teŋgbauŋ mɛ anɛ fʋ din; fʋnɛ maal dunia nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ maal ya-datiuŋ nɛ ya-dagɔbʋg; Tabo nɛ Hemon zuoya yʋ'ʋmnɛ nɛ sumalisim fʋ yʋ'ʋrin la.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim nɛ sida aan fʋ na'am la ɛɛnbir nɔŋilim nɛ yɛlsida gaadi fʋ tuon.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Wina'am, bareka bɛ nɛ banɛ zun'odi fʋ yʋ'ʋr la, nɛ banɛ kennɛ fʋ nɛɛsimin la, O Zugsɔba.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Ba maan sumalisim fʋ yʋ'ʋrin la saŋa wʋsa; fʋ pʋpielim la zug ka ba maan sumalisim.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ aan ti paŋ nɛ ti vɛnlim, fʋ nɔŋir zug ka fʋ tisi ti nyaŋir.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Asida, tinam ti'ed anɛ Zugsɔb la, Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la sʋ'oe ti Na'ab la. Wina'am zi'el nɔɔri tis David

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Fʋ da pian' nier pʋʋgin tis banɛ dɔllif nɛ sida la, ka yɛli ba ye, M tis zabzabid la paŋ; M gaŋ dasaŋ nidib la sʋʋginɛ dʋ'ʋs o.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: David onɛ aan m tʋmtʋm la ka m gaŋ; ka nɔk malʋŋ kpaam bu'oe niŋ o zug.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: M kpi'euŋ la na bɛ nɛ o kiŋ-kiŋ; sida, m paŋ la na tis o kpi'euŋ.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Dataa kae na nyaŋ oo; bugusim sɔb kae na mugus oo.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: M sida nɔŋilim la na bɛ nɛ o, ka m yʋ'ʋr pʋʋgin ka o paŋ la na dʋ.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka o sʋ'ʋlim paae atɛuk, ka o paŋ la paae kɔldaad la.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: O na buolim ye, “Fʋnɛ an m Ba', m Wina'am onɛ an m Tampiing nɛ m Faangid la.”

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: M na lɛn gaŋ o ka o aan m bikpɛɛm, onɛ na an na'akanɛ gat na'anam wʋsa teŋgbauŋ la ni.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka m nɔŋilim la kpɛm bɛ nɛ o saŋa wʋsa, ka mam nɛ on nɔnaar la kʋ viigɛ.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka o tuŋ la bɛ saŋa wʋsa, o na'am la na yuug wʋʋ saŋgbana yuugid si'em la.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: “O biis ya'a tami m wada la ka pʋ dɔlli m zi'ela laa,

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: ba ya'a san'ami m gban'ar ka pʋ dɔlli m wada laa,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: m na zaŋ balaari namisi ba, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug, ka fiebi ba nɛ sisanbig ba pɔ'ɔgir la zug.

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: Amaa m kʋ yisi m nɔŋilim la David san'anɛ, bɛɛ kɛ ka man gban'e si'em o yɛla la pʋ niŋa asida.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
