translation_verse: M kʋ san'ami m nɔnaar la bɛɛ tiaki m nɔɔri pian' si'el laa.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: M yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la zugɔ, m pɔ nɛ vuguri, ye m kʋ fa David baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: O tuŋ la na bɛ saŋa wʋsa ka o na'am la mɛ na bɛ saŋa wʋsa wʋʋ winnigi bɛ si'em la.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Amaa, Zugsɔba, fʋ zan'as o, fʋ sʋnf pɛlig nɛ onɛ ka fʋ gaŋ ka bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ o zug la.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Fʋ zan'as nɔnaar linɛ ka fʋ pɔɔ zi'eli fʋ tʋmtʋm la ka vɛn'ɛlim o na'am zupibig la dian'adin.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Fʋ nwa'ae o zaŋguoma wʋsa bas ka kɛ ka o kpi'euŋ zin'is la lieb dabɔɔd.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Banɛ dɔl ani gat la wʋsa zuud o la'ad, ka o yʋ'ʋn lieb bʋnla'adiri tis o kpi'es.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Fʋ tis o bi'emnam la kpi'euŋ; ka kɛ ka o dataas wʋsa maan sumalisim.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛns o giinla zaba ni ka pʋ sʋŋ o tanpinɛ.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka o vɛnlim la naae, ka san'am o na'am paŋ la.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Fʋ nwaae o na'akinnim saŋa ka li niŋ giŋa; ka kɛ ka nyan pil o wʋʋ fuug nɛ.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ su'a fʋ mɛŋ ka li yuugida, O Zugsɔba? Bɔ ka fʋ sʋnf la'aŋ bugum?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Tɛnri m nyɔvʋri naad tɔ'ɔtɔ si'em la. Fʋ maal ninsaalib wʋsa ka ba pʋ mɔr gbinnɛ.

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn lɛɛ na vʋe ka kʋ kpi, bɛɛ faaɛn o mɛŋ nɛ paŋi zɔ ka bas Ayaʋgɔ?

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ da zu'oe hali la bɛɛ yaanɛ, linɛ ka fʋ sida pʋʋgin ka fʋ da pɔɔ zi'el David la?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: M Zugsɔba, tiɛnm ban la'adi fʋ tʋmtʋm la si'em, tiɛnm tɛɛns la tʋ'ʋdim ka li zabidi m sʋʋnr si'em.

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛsʋg la zug ka fʋ dataas la la'ad, Zugsɔba; onɛ ka fʋ gaŋ la nɔbir yakir wʋsa ba la'ad o nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Zun'or anɛ Zugsɔb la din saŋa wʋsa! Ami! Ami!

english_verse: ) God Is Eternal
translation_verse: ) Wina'am nɛ ninsaal yɛla

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ aan ti bɛllim zin'ig zʋmaana wʋsa ni.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka zuoya da nan kae la bɛɛ teŋgbauŋ nɛ dunia da nan kae la, ka fʋ da bɛ, ka na kpɛm bɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Fʋ lɛbisid ninsaalib titanin, ka yɛl ye, “Ninsaaliba, lɛmmi teŋin.”

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Dabisa tusa fʋn san'an nwɛnɛ dabisir yinne na gaad, bɛɛ yʋ'ʋŋʋ na sɔb ka bɛog nie.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Kum linɛ nwɛnɛ gbɛɛm la ni ka fʋ uusid ninsaalibi ken; ba nwɛnɛ mɔbiigʋ na tans bɛkɛung na.

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ lin yi bɛogʋn na an mɔpaala la, zaam ti ma'ae la ka li ʋki kʋdig.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Fʋ sumpɛɛn la san'amidi ti ka kpɛn'ɛsidi ti dabiem.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Fʋ digili ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la fʋ tuon, ka ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ su'a la nie nyain fʋ san'an.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la kɛnɛ ka ti kpiid tɔ'ɔtɔ, ka ti yʋma ya'a ti wae naarin la ti sin'im nɛ ma'aa.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Ti nyɔvʋr wa'alim anɛ yʋma pisyɔpɔi, ka ti ya'a mɔr paŋ, li na paae yʋma pisnii. La'an nɛ wala, li saŋa la anɛ yɛltɔɔd nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ma'aa; ka yʋma la gat tɔ'ɔtɔ, wʋʋ niiŋe ianki gaadnɛ.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ mi' fʋ sumpɛɛn la galis si'em? Fʋ sumpɛɛn la zu'onɛ nwɛnɛ lin nar ye ba zɔtif si'em la.

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Pa'alimi ti ka ti baŋi ti dabisa bɛn, ka ala ka ti na zamis ya'am.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ bɛ bɛkɛung la sia'ali ti, ka ti na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma wɔ'ɔgif ka maal sumalisim daar wʋsa.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ti sumalisim la yuug wʋʋ dabisbanɛ ka fʋ tisi ti namisʋg la, nwɛnɛ yʋma bɛdegʋ banɛ ka ti nyɛ sʋnsa'aŋ la.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Pa'alimi ti fʋ tʋʋma la an si'em ka kɛ ka ti biis nyɛ fʋ vɛnlim.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋn Zugsɔb Wina'am la nimbaanlzɔɔr bɛ nɛ ti; ka kɛ ka ti nu'ug tʋʋma zi'en sʋ'ʋŋa. Ɛɛn, kɛl ka ti nu'ug tʋʋma zi'en!

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Banɛ zɔti ken Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa san'ani su'ad la na nyɛ Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la ma'asim vʋ'ʋs.

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: M na pian' Zugsɔb yɛla ye, “O anɛ m suak nɛ m kpi'euŋ zin'ig, m Wina'am la ka m niŋ o yadda.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Sida, o na sʋ'ʋŋif ka fʋ yi bɛndis pʋʋgin nɛ ban'abɛ'ɛd linɛ kʋʋd nidib hali la pʋʋgin mɛn.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: O na lusi fʋ o kpʋkpama la ni, ka o biaunk lɛuŋʋn ka fʋ na nyɛ suak zin'ig; o yɛlsida la na gurif ka zabi tisif.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Fʋ kʋ zɔt dabiem yʋ'ʋŋ bɛɛ fʋ zɔ piema banɛ ian'ad nintaŋ fiaʋn-fiaʋn la.

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: Fʋ kʋ zɔt ban'abɛ'ɛd linɛ bɛ likin la, bɛɛ wiim linɛ kʋʋd nidib nintaŋ tisʋʋs laa.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Nidib tusa na liti fʋ baba, ka tusa piiga li fʋ datiuŋ, amaa li kʋ li'eli fɔ.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Fʋ nini ma'aa na nyɛ ka baŋ bugusim dim la di'ed namisʋg si'em.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a kɛ ka Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la aan fʋ bɛllim zin'ig; Zugsɔb onɛ an man suak zin'ig la;

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: ala ka yɛlbɛ'ɛd kʋ paae fɔ, bɛɛ tɔɔg li'eli fʋ yinnɛ.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Fʋn zug, o na tis o maliaknam nɔɔr ka ba gurif, fʋn ken zin'isi'a wʋsa;

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: ba na mɔri fʋ ba nu'usin ka fʋ kʋ tu'ugi fʋ nɔbir nɛ kugirɛ.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Fʋ na nɔ gbigim nɛ dunduug; fʋ na nɔ gbigimtita'ar nɛ wa'akpɛuŋ.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “On nɔŋim la zug, m na faaɛn o; M na gur o, on mi' m yʋ'ʋr la zug.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: O na buolim ka m na siak; yɛla ya'a ti paae o, m na bɛ nɛ o, ka na'as o, ka faaɛn o.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka o nyɔvʋr wa'am ka o sʋnf ma'ae ka pa'al o m faangir.”

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Li an sʋm nɛ tinamɛ na zun'e Zugsɔb la, ka an sʋm nɛ bʋnnwɛ'ɛda na nwɛ' zun'e fʋn Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋʋm titada la kɛ ka m sʋnf ma'ae, O Zugsɔba; m yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim yʋʋma fʋn tʋm si'el la yɛla.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋm tʋʋm titada, O Zugsɔba, ka fʋ pʋtɛn'ɛr la zulim nɛ sɔ' na baŋ!

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Ya'am ka'alʋg sɔb la zi', ka zɔn la mɛ pʋ gban'adi li gbin

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: ye bugusnam la na yina nwɛnɛ mɔɔd ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim wʋsa ken tuon, la'an nɛ wala ba na nyɛ san'auŋ linɛ ka' makirɛ.

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔba, fʋn nyɛtnɛ zʋn'or saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Ya'a an sida fʋ dataas la; fʋn Zugsɔb dataas la sid na bɔdig; tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la wʋsa na widig.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Fʋ tisim paŋ ka li nwɛnɛ wɛnaaf paŋ nɛ, ka bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa la niŋi m zug.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: M nini nyɛɛm dataas la lu si'em; ka m tʋba wʋmi m bi'emnam la kaasidi zɔt si'em.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dim la na kpɛn nɔbigid wʋʋ kpʋkparis, bɛɛ Lebanon na'aziinr banɛ wa'am hali

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: ka ba sɛɛ ba Zugsɔb la yin la; ba na nɔbigi ti Wina'am la zakin.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Ba na ti kʋdig ka nan wan wala, ka ma'ae siaa, ka ba vaand sɔbig bir-bir.

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: Ba na mɔɔl ye, “Zugsɔb la ka' gba'arɛ. O anɛ m Tampiing, ka bugusim kae o san'anɛ.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an na'ab; paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ ka o yɛ wʋʋ fuug nɛ. Dunia la zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ li kʋ nyaŋi vurigɛ.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Fʋ na'am la zi'en ka li yuug fʋ bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: Atɛuk la dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ, Zugsɔba, Atɛuk la dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ; o dʋ'ʋs o ku'opila la nwɛ'ɛd taaba.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an na'abi gat si'el wʋsa arezana ni; o paŋ zu'oe gaad Atɛuk ku'om la na dam, o paŋ gat Atɛuk ku'onwiis.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Fʋ wada la zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ, O Zugsɔba; fʋ yir la anɛ kasi ka vɛnl hali ka na bɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, Wina'am kanɛ yɔɔd sammɛ, fʋn Wina'am kanɛ yɔɔd sam la, niem na!

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Duom agɔl, fʋn onɛ an teŋgbauŋ Sariakata; yɔɔm nyɛɛsim dim la lin nar ye ba di'e si'em!

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka li yuugida, O Zugsɔba? Bɔ ka bugusnam la maannɛ ba ya'amin ka li yuugida?

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Ba pian'ad nɛ tita'alim; tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la wʋsa dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Ba kʋʋd pʋkɔnya nɛ saam nɛ kpiibis wʋsa.

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: Ba yɛt ye, “Zugsɔb la pʋ nyɛta; Jakob Wina'am la pʋ kɛlisida.”

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Onɛ maal tʋbir la pʋ wʋmmaa? Onɛ maal nif la pʋ nyɛtaa?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: On kanɛ tɛɛgid tɛɛns tʋba la kʋ namisi yaa? On kanɛ pa'an nidib la na kɔ'ɔŋ ya'am?

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mi' ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛr; o mi' ye ba tɛn'ɛsa anɛ zaalim.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ ka fʋ tɛɛg o tʋbir mɔr Wina'am bareka, Zugsɔba, ninkanɛ ka fʋ pa'annɛ fʋ wada la;

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: tɔɔg saŋa fʋ tisid o yɔlisim, ti paae saŋkanɛ ka ba tu bʋmbɔk ka bugusim sɔb lii li ni.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la kʋ zan'as o nidiba; o kʋ tam banɛ aan o faar la yɛla.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Sida nɛ pʋpielim na lɛm bɛ sariakadib zin'igin, ka banɛ pʋ mɔr gbada la na dɔlli li.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na duoe zab nɛ bugusim dim la tisi ma? Anɔ'ɔnɛ na zi'enɛ m nya'aŋi zab nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ya'a pʋ sʋ'ʋŋi ma, li kʋ yuugɛ ka m dig kum zin'igin baanlimm.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Man daa yɛl ye, “M nɔbir sadigid la,” Zugsɔba, fʋ nɔŋir la daa sʋŋim.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Man daa lɛn zi' man fɛndigidi lɛbid zin'isi'a la, fʋ daa bʋgʋli m sʋʋnr ka kɛ ka m nyɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋn liebi m kpi'euŋ zin'ig, nɛ m Wina'am, onɛ an tampinkanɛ ka m su'ad o san'an.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: O na yɔɔ ba, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla ka san'ami ba, ba bugusim la zug; ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la na san'ami ba.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Kem na ka ti yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim tisi ti Zugsɔb la; kɛl ka ti tans agɔla tisi ti Tampiing onɛ aan ti Faangid la!

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ti kɛɛn o san'an na nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim ka nwɛ' bʋnnwɛ'ɛda ka yʋ'ʋm zun'e o yʋ'ʋr!

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la an Wina'am tita'ar, ka an na'akanɛ gat wina wʋsa.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ la nɛ li zulʋŋ wʋsa bɛ nɛ o nu'ugin ka zuoya la zut mɛ anɛ o din.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Atɛuk la anɛ o din, bɔzugɔ onɛ maali li, ka o nu'us lɛm maal teŋgbauŋ la.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: ka onɛ aan ti Wina'am ka ti aan o nidib, ti nwɛnɛ kɔnbidi bɛɛ o karinyauŋin, ka an kɔnbbanɛ ka o gur. Zina, ya ya'a wʋm o kʋkɔr,

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: yanam da digilimi ya sʋnya zan'as Wina'am wʋʋ yanamɛ da niŋ Meriba mɔɔgin si'em la. Ka mɛ da niŋ wʋʋ yanamɛ da niŋ Masa pipirigin si'em la;

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: zin'ikanɛ ka ya da makim ka kpansim la, la'an nɛ yanamɛ nyɛɛm tʋʋma la.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Yʋma pisnaasi ka m sʋnf da pɛlig nɛ zʋmaʋŋ kan la dim; ka m yɛl ye, “Ba anɛ nimbanɛ ka ba ya'am fɛndig, ka pʋ baŋ man suoya la an si'em.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Ala ka m sʋnf da pɛlig nɛ ba ka m pɔ nɔɔri zi'el ye, “Ba kʋdim kʋ kpɛn' m vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'igin laa.”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋmmi yʋʋm paalli tis Zugsɔb la; teŋgbauŋ wʋsa, yʋ'ʋm tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋm tis Zugsɔb la, zun'om o yʋ'ʋr; mɔɔlim o faangir la dabisir wʋsa pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Yɛlimi tɛɛns la o na'am pipilim la an si'em, mɔɔlim o tʋʋmnyalima la nidib wʋsa sʋʋgin.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la an onɛ galis ka nar nɛ zʋn'or; li sʋm ye ti zɔɔ o gaad wina wʋsa.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ wina banɛ bɛ tɛɛnsin la anɛ bada, amaa Zugsɔb la maal agɔla.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Vɛnlim nɛ kpi'euŋ ma'aa gilig o; paŋ nɛ na'am pipilim pɛ'ɛl o yin la.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yanam nimbanɛ bɛ tɛɛnsin la wʋsa, zun'omi Zugsɔb la! Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, o na'am nɛ o paŋ la zug.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la wʋʋ o yʋ'ʋr la nar si'em; mɔri piini kɛɛn o zakin la na.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la o vɛnlim nɛ on an kasi la zug; teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa kem o tuon na nɛ kikirʋg.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Yɛlimi tɛɛns la wʋsa sʋʋgin ye, “Zugsɔb la an Na'ab!” Dunia la zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ, ka kʋ vurigɛ; o na kad nidib la saria ka baregaŋ kae.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Kɛl ka agɔla nɛ teŋ la maal sumalisim. Kɛl ka Atɛuk nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa maligim tans agɔla.

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Kɛl ka karinyana nɛ pɔɔd la wʋsa maal sumalisim nɛ linɛ bɛɛ ba pʋʋgin wʋsa. Tiis banɛ bɛ sian'arin la yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim;

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: ba na yʋ'ʋm zun'e Zugsɔb la, bɔzugɔ, o na kena kad teŋgbauŋ la saria. O na kad dunia la saria nɛ pʋpielim; o na kad nidib la saria nɛ sida.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an na'ab, kɛl ka teŋgbauŋ la sʋnf ma'ae; kɛl ka tembanɛ bɛ ku'om sʋʋgin lallisa la mɔr sumalisim.

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Saŋgbana nɛ lik tita'ari gilig o; pʋpielim nɛ yɛlsida aan o na'am la ɛɛnbir.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Bugum bɛɛ o tuon ka dit o bi'emnam zin'ig wʋsa.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: O nɛɛsim linɛ nwɛnɛ sa-ian'asʋg la nie dunia la; ka teŋgbauŋ la nyɛ ka kirid.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Zuoya la nyɛligidi nwɛnɛ sinbi'en Zugsɔb la tuon, Zugsɔb onɛ sʋ'oe teŋgbauŋ wʋsa la tuon.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Saŋgbana la mɔɔnnɛ o pʋpielim yɛla, ka nidib la wʋsa nyɛt o na'am la vɛnlim.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Banɛ pʋ'ʋsid bada la di nyan, yanam banɛ nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgi ya bada yɛla nɛ ya wina la wʋsa, zun'omi Zugsɔb la!

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Zion wʋmya ka maal sumalisim ka Juda teŋkpɛmis la mɔr sumalisim fʋn kad saria si'em la zug, O Zugsɔba.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ an Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa teŋgbauŋ la zug; fʋ nyɛt zun'ori gat wina banɛ bɛ wʋsa.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ nɔŋ Zugsɔb la kisig bɛ'ɛd, bɔzugɔ o gu'ud banɛ dɔl o nɛ sida la nyɔvʋr ka yisidi ba bugusim dim la nu'usin.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Nɛɛsim nie tis pʋpielim dim la, ka sumalisim bɛ nɛ banɛ pʋ mɔr gba'ar la.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ an pʋpielim dim la, maalimi sumalisim, ka zun'e o yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋmmi yʋʋm paalli tis Zugsɔb la ka o tʋm tʋʋmnyalima; o paŋ linɛ an kasi la nɛ o datiuŋ nu'ug la tʋm faangir tʋʋma tis o.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pa'al o faangir ka nie o pʋpielim la tis tɛɛns wʋsa.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O tiɛn o nɔŋilim nɛ o sida la nɛ Israel dim; dunia bɛn wʋsa nyɛ ti Wina'am la faangir.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim tisid Zugsɔb la, yʋ'ʋmmi ka nwɛ' bʋnnwɛ'ɛda;

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: nwɛ'ɛm kɔnne tis Zugsɔb la, yʋ'ʋm ka nwɛ' kɔn,

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Piebim na'atana nɛ na'atana; tansim nɛ sumalisim Zugsɔb onɛ an na'ab la tuon.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka Atɛuk la maligim dam, nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa, la'an nɛ dunia nɛ banɛ bɛɛ anina wʋsa.

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka kɔldaad la pʋ'ʋs nu'us, ka kɛ ka zuoya la la'asi yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim;

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: kɛl ka ba yʋ'ʋm Zugsɔb la tuon, ka o kenna ye o kad teŋgbauŋ la saria. O na kad dunia la saria nɛ pʋpielim nɛ nidib la ka baregaŋ kae.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an Na'ab, kɛl ka tɛɛns la nidib kirid o tuon. O zin'inɛ o na'am gbauŋ zug Kerubnam la teŋsʋk, kɛl ka dunia la dammid.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ bɛ Zion tempʋʋgin la galis nɛ; ba zun'od o tɛɛns la wʋsa ni.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋtita'ar linɛ galis ka mɔr zɔtim la. O anɛ onɛ an Kasi.

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Na'ab la anɛ na'atita'ar, o nɔŋ yɛlsida. Zugsɔba, fʋ kɛya ka sida zi'en; Jakob yidimin la ka fʋ maal linɛ an sida ka tʋm linɛ dɔl suor.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Dʋ'ʋsimi ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la ka zun'e o, o nɔba zi'elʋg zin'ig; ka o anɛ Kasi.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Moses nɛ Aaron da paas o maanmaannib la kallin, Samuel da paas banɛ da buon o yʋ'ʋr la kallin; ba da buol Zugsɔb la ka o wʋm tisi ba.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: O da naan saŋgbauŋ linɛ zi'e sappi la ni pian' tisi ba; ba da dɔlisid o wada nɛ zi'ela banɛ ka o tisi ba la.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb Wina'am, fʋ da wʋm tisi ba; fʋ da anɛ Wina'am kanɛ kɛt Israel taali basid, la'an nɛ fʋn da namisi ba, ba pɔ'ɔgir zug la.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Dʋ'ʋsimi ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la ka zun'e o, o zuor linɛ an kasi la ni, ka ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la anɛ kasi.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ wʋsa dʋ'ʋsimi ba kʋkɔya yʋ'ʋm sumalisim yʋʋma tis Zugsɔb la!

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la nɛ sumalisim; yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim kɛɛn o san'an na.

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Baŋim ye Zugsɔb la an Wina'am. Li anɛ onɛ maali ti, ti anɛ o din, ka ka' tinamɛ sʋ'oe ti mɛŋa ti anɛ o mɛŋ nidib, ka nwɛnɛ pɛ'ɛsi bɛɛ o karinyauŋin.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Kpɛn'ɛm o za'anɔya la ni nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim ka kpɛn' o zakin la nɛ zʋn'or; pʋ'ʋsim o bareka ka zun'e o yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an sʋm ka o nɔŋilim bɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ; o sida la dɔlisidi paad zʋmaana wʋsa.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: M na yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ nɔŋir nɛ fʋ sida la yɛla; O Zugsɔba, fʋn ka m na zun'e.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: M na dɔl suosʋŋ la nɛ nimmua ka gba'ar kʋ bɛɛ; saŋkanɛ ka fʋ na kɛɛn m san'an na? M na bɛɛ m yin la ka m sʋnf kʋ mɔr gba'arɛ.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: Zam dim la na lal nɛ mam; mam ba'a kae nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa kɛɛnd o kpi'a m na kɛ ka o sɔba an baanlimm; onɛ mɔr nyɛɛsim ka dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ m kʋ siaki tis o sɔbaa.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: M nini na gɔsid nɛ yɛlsida dim banɛ bɛ teŋin la, ka nimban la na bɛ nɛ m; onɛ an burikin na tʋm tis mam.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa zamisid faad kʋ bɛ man yinne; ziri sɔb kʋ zi'en man tuonnɛ.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛkɛung wʋsa m na kɛ ka nimbɛ'ɛdnam la an baanlimm; m na kad tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb wʋsa yis Zugsɔb tempʋʋgin la.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: Wʋmi m sɔsʋg, Zugsɔbaa, kɛlisimi m kaasig ka sʋŋim!

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: M ya'a bɛ yɛla ni, fʋn da basi ma! Kɛlisimi m buolʋg, ka siak tɔ'ɔtɔ tisim!

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, m dabisa gatnɛ tɔ'ɔtɔ wʋʋ nyɔ'ɔs nɛ; ka m niŋgbina zabidi nwɛnɛ bugum la'aŋ nɛ.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Man ʋʋnsid si'em la kɛnɛ ka m niŋgbina sie kpɛlim kɔnba ma'aa.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: M nwɛnɛ pipirisin viiug, ka nwɛnɛ niimbia kanɛ bɛ dabɔɔdin.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: M dignɛ, amaa gbɛɛm kae, ka yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ niiŋ kanɛ ya'a dɔɔg zug.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: M dataas la tʋ'ʋdim nɛ daar wʋsa; banɛ la'adim la mɔri man yʋ'ʋri pɔɔd nɔɔri tisid nidib.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Tampɛligim aan m diib ka linɛ ka m nuud wʋsa gɛndig nɛ ninta'am.

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: Fʋ sʋnpɛɛn tita'ar la zug, ka fʋ nɔkimi lɔbig kpikpɛŋ sa.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: M yʋma la kennɛ nwɛnɛ zaam ma'asim ka m kʋdigid tɔ'ɔtɔ wʋʋ mɔɔd nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔba, fʋ anɛ na'ab saŋa wʋsa zʋmaana wʋsa na tɛnri fʋ yɛla.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ teŋ la san'am la fʋ tʋmtʋmnib la nɔŋi li tandia'ana; ka lin lieb titani dig si'em la mɔri ba nimbaanlig.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns wʋsa na zɔt Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr ka dunia na'anam na na'asid o na'am paŋ la.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na lɛbisi mɛ' Zion tempʋʋg ka nie pa'al o mɛŋ nɛ o na'am pipilim la.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: O na wʋm banɛ ka' sʋŋir la winsɔsʋg; ka kʋ nɛ'ɛsi ba sɔsʋgɔ.

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: ye o wʋm banɛ bɛ sanrega ni la ʋʋnsʋg ka yis banɛ ka ba kʋʋs ye ba kpi la bas.”

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: saŋkan ka nidib nɛ na'am sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa na ti la'as ye ba pʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kɛnɛ ka m tadig ka nam pʋ kʋdigɛ; ka nwaae m yʋma ka li an giŋa.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Ala ka m yɛl ye, “O m Wina'am, da nɔki m nannanna dabisa banɛ ka m bɛ la sʋʋginɛ; fʋ kʋdim bɛ nɛ ala zʋmaana wʋsa.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Pin'ilʋgʋn ka fʋ da digil teŋgbauŋ la ɛɛnbir, ka fʋ nu'us maal saŋgbana la wʋsa.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Ba na bɔdig amaa ka fʋ nan kpɛm bɛ; ba wʋsa na ti kpii nwɛnɛ fuug nɛ. Ba nwɛnɛ fuud ka fʋ na tiak ka nɔki ba bas.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn anɛ fʋ naŋ-naŋ, ka fʋ yʋma kʋdim kʋ naae.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋmtʋmnib la biis na duoe na paaf; ka ba yaas na duoe na nyɛ zi'esim fʋ nini ni.”

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Wɔ'ɔgim Zugsɔb la, O m siiga; nɛ linɛ bɛɛ m ni wʋsa wɔ'ɔgimi o yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la!

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Wɔ'ɔgim Zugsɔb la, O m siiga, ka da tam o nyɔɔdi an si'em wʋsaa,

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: onɛ kɛti m taali basid ka ti'ebidi m ban'as wʋsa la.

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: O faanmi yis kum pʋʋgin ka pidim nɛ nɔŋilim nɛ nimbaanlzɔɔr wʋʋ zupibig nɛ.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: O kɛt ka m nyɛt bʋnsʋma linɛ ka m ya'amlɛog bɔɔd, ka m paŋ lɛɛ tɛndigid nwɛnɛ silʋg paŋ nɛ.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la tʋmnɛ pʋpielim nɛ sida tisid banɛ bɛ mugusʋg pʋʋgin.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: O da nɔk o suoya pa'al Moses, ka kɛ ka Israel dim baŋ o tʋʋma.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la anɛ nimbaanlzɔt nɛ suguru sɔb, o sʋnf pʋ pɛligid tɔ'ɔtɔɔ, ka o nɔŋilim mɛ zu'oe.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: O pʋ zɛrigidi ti saŋa wʋsa; o mɛ ka' onɛ ka o sʋʋnr duod nɛ ti saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ agɔla lal nɛ teŋgbauŋ si'em la, ala ka o nɔŋilim mɛ zu'oe tis banɛ na'asid o la.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ ya-nya'aŋi lal nɛ ya-tuona si'em la, ala ka o mɛ yisi ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li lal nɛ ti.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ ninsaali nɔŋ o biis si'em la, ala ka Zugsɔb la mɛ bɔɔd banɛ na'asid o la.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: O mi' on da nɔk si'eli maali ti; o tɛnr ye ti anɛ titan ma'aa.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ tinama, ti nwɛnɛ mɔɔdnɛ; ti nɔbigidi nwɛnɛ puum banɛ bɛ mɔɔgin,

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: ka sisi'em da'ae li mɔri gaad, ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn nyɛɛ li ya'asɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ na'asid Zugsɔb la, o nɔŋir pʋ naadi ba san'anɛ, ka o sʋm la paad zʋmaana wʋsa,

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la digil o na'am gbauŋ arezana ni; onɛ an na'anam wʋsa Na'ab.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, yanam banɛ aan o maliaknam la, yanam banɛ mɔr paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ ka siak o nɔzi'elʋg, ka kɛlisid on yɛt si'el la.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, yanam banɛ aan o zabzabidib ka bɛ arezana ni la, yanam banɛ aan o tʋmtʋmnib, ka tʋmm o bɔɔdim la!

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb, yanam banɛ ka o maal la wʋsa nɛ zin'ibanɛ ka o gɔsid la wʋsa. M siiga, zun'om Zugsɔb la!

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Zun'om Zugsɔb la, m siigaa! O m Zugsɔb Wina'am, fʋ anɛ gandaug! Sida nɛ na'am paŋ ma'aa giligif.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: O nɔk nɛɛsim m pil o mɛŋ wʋʋ fuug nɛ ka yadig saŋgbana wʋʋ tapooli nɛ,

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: ka mɛɛ o yiri sʋn'ʋl ku'om linɛ bɛ agɔla la zug. Saŋgbana ka o maal o zaba tɛrekonam ka ban'ad sisi'em ian'adi ken.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: O kɛ ka o maliaknam la an wʋʋ pɛbisim nɛ ka o tʋmmi ba, ka bugum pielim aan o tʋmtʋmnib.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: O da ɛɛnb dunia ɛɛnbir ka li zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ ka kʋ vurig hali baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Fʋ da nɔk ku'ozuluŋʋ pil teŋgbauŋ la wʋʋ fuug nɛ; ka li lim zuoya la wʋsa.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: ku'om la pʋbid zuoya la ni sigid bɔn'ɔdin ken zin'ikanɛ ka fʋ tis nɔɔr ye li keŋ la.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Fʋ digil titɔndig ka li kʋ nyaŋi lɔ'ɔŋɛ; ka mɛ kʋ lɛn nyaŋi pʋbigi di teŋgbauŋ la ya'asɛ.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: O kɛya ka ku'om tansidi yit na zɔti sigid bɔn'ɔdin; li pʋbid zuoya la teŋsʋk.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: Ka sian'arin bʋnkɔnbid paamid ku'om nuud; ani ka sian'arin bʋmis kati ba ku'onuud.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Niis banɛ ian'ad agɔla la tɛɛdi ba tɛɛd ku'om la baba; ka zu'oe tiis wila ni.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: O bɛ nɛ o yin agɔla ka dɔn'ɔsid zuoya la; ka teŋgbauŋ sʋnf ma'ae nɛ o tʋʋma la.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: O kɛ ka yaama yiti tisid niigi, ka zʋʋd bɛ ka ninsaalib kuod ka diib yit teŋin na.

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: Li tisid daam linɛ kɛt ka ninsaal sʋʋnr ma'ad, nɛ kpaam ka o nindaa nyɛɛn, ka diib tɔ'ɔŋid o giinla.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb tiis la nyɛt dɔn'ɔsʋg sʋ'ʋŋa, tibanɛ ka o sɛɛ ba Lebanon zuoya ni la.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Ani ka niis la maannɛ ba tɛɛd; tiliilʋŋ yir bɛ nɛ tiis la zug.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Sian'arin bʋʋs bɛ nɛ zuobanɛ wa'am la ni; ka tampiins la sian'asim an bʋnkɔnbbaanlʋg suak zin'ig.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Nwadig la pa'an ʋʋn nɛ sɛɛung, ka winnig la mɛ mi' o kpɛn'ɛb saŋa.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ mɔr liki kenna, ka li liebid yʋ'ʋŋ, ka sian'arin bʋnkɔnbid yina gɔɔnd.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Gbigima la nwa'amidi bɔɔd si'el ye ba gban'e ka ieed diib Wina'am san'an.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Winnig ya'a ti tans na ka ba zɔɔ lɛb; ba lɛbidi digi ba su'asa zin'ig.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Ka nidib yʋ'ʋn yiti ba tʋʋma ni, tʋmm ala hali ti paae zaam.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋʋma la zu'oya, O Zugsɔba, fʋ ya'am la pʋʋgin ka fʋ maali li wʋsa; dunia la pɛ'ɛl nɛ bʋn linɛ ka fʋ maal la.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Atɛukʋ dig la, li zu'onɛ ka yalim, ka bʋnvʋya banɛ pʋ mɔr kal bɛɛ ani, bʋnvʋbɛda nɛ bʋnvʋbaanlʋg wʋsa bɛɛ ani.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Ani ka anrima dɔlli ken ka lɛbid, ka bʋntita'ar kanɛ ka ba buon Lɛviatan la bɛ ku'omin la, ka maan o ya'amin ani.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Bama wʋsa gɔsidi fʋ ye fʋ tisi ba diib saŋa kanɛ nar.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a ti tisi ba, ba na la'asi li; fʋ ya'a laki fʋ nu'ug, ba tigid bʋnsʋma wʋsa nɛ li buudi.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a fɛndigi fʋ nindaa su'a, dabiem kpɛn'ɛdi ba nɛ; fʋ ya'a yisi ba vʋ'ʋsʋm, ba na kpi ka lɛb titanin.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a tʋmmi fʋ siig la na, o na maali ba, ka tɛndig teŋgbauŋ la ka li an bʋmpaalig.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na'am paŋ na bɛ saŋa wʋsa; Zugsɔb la mɔr sumalisim o tʋʋma ni.

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: Onɛ ɛɛnti gɔs teŋgbauŋ ka li dammid la, ka si'isid zuoya ka nyɔ'ɔs yit la.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: M na yʋ'ʋm tis Zugsɔb la m nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsa; m na yʋ'ʋm zun'e m Wina'am la ti paae m vʋm naar.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka man tɛn'ɛsid si'el tigi fʋ nini, bɔzugɔ, m maannɛ sumalisim fʋn Zugsɔb la ni.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Amaa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la na bɔdig teŋgbauŋ nwa' ni ka bugusnam lɛn kae. O m siiga, zun'om Zugsɔb la. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi Zugsɔb la bareka, buolim o yʋ'ʋr; kɛl ka tɛɛns la wʋsa baŋ on maal si'el.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋm tis o, yʋ'ʋm zun'e o; mɔɔlim o tʋʋmnyalima la wʋsa.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Maalim sumalisim Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋrin; kɛl ka banɛ ieed Zugsɔb la wʋsa maal sumalisim.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi Zugsɔb nɛ o paŋ la; ieminɛ o zin'ig saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb Wina'am; ka o sariakadib bɛ dunia wʋsa ni.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: O tɛnri o nɔnaar la yɛla saŋa wʋsa, nɛ o pian'ʋk linɛ ka o tis zʋmaana tusir nidib la

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: “Fʋn ka m ye m nɔk Keenan teŋ la tis ka li liebi fʋ faar.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: O da yɛl nɛ' nɛ saŋkanɛ ka ba kal da nam pʋ zu'oe la; sida, ba da pɔɔd ka mɛ an saam teŋin la.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Ba da gɔɔndi giligid teŋ-teŋ, yit sʋ'ʋlim yinne ken sʋ'ʋlim yinne ni.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: O da pʋ kɛ ka sɔ' mugusi baa; ba yɛla ka o da zɛrig na'anam, ka yɛli ba ye,

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya si'is onɛ ka m gaŋ la; da niŋi m nɔdi'esidib la si'ela.” Josef yɛla

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka kɔ'ɔm li teŋin la ka san'ami ba diib wʋsa;

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: ka nɔk dau sɔ' onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Josef, ka ba kuos o tis ka o lieb yammʋg.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Ba da ba'a o nɔba nɛ bana, ka kɔl o niŋgɔɔnr nɛ kʋnt,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: hali ti paae saŋkanɛ ka on da yɛl si'el la niŋ amɛŋa, ka Zugsɔb la pian'ad pa'al ye on yɛl si'el la anɛ sida.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka o lieb o yir la wʋsa kpɛɛm, ka sʋ'oe o la'ad la wʋsa,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: ka o mɔr paŋi na sa'al kpɛɛmnam la ka mɔr o ya'am la pa'an na'ayikpɛm la. Moses yɛla

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Israel da bɛ nɛ Egipt teŋin la, Jakob da anɛ saanne bɛ Ham teŋin.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka ba nɔbigi zu'oe; ka kɛ ka ba mɔr paŋi gati ba bi'emnam.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka Egipt dim la tuligi kis o nidib la, ka maannɛ ba bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: O da tʋm Moses onɛ aan o tʋmtʋm la nɛ Aaron onɛ ka o gaŋ la.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Ba da tʋm nyalima ka li aan o zanbina nidib la sʋʋgin, ka tʋm o kilima tʋʋma Ham teŋin.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Ban da pʋ siak o nɔɔr la zug ka o tʋm liki ba teŋin la na.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka ba ku'om kilim ziim, ka li kɛ ka ba zimi kpi.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ba teŋ la da pɛ'ɛl nɛ lɔmis, ka ba kpɛn'ɛdi ba na'anam la dɔɔdin.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: O da pian' ya ka pʋmpɔɔs nɛ dumis wiaki pɛ'ɛl teŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka saa niid sakuga nɛ sa-ian'asʋg teŋ la wʋsa ni;

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: o da san'ami ba daam nɛ kekama tiis ka kɔɔ ba tibanɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa bas.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: O da pian' ya ka na'azɔmnam yina, sisɔma mɛ da yina ka' bɛnnɛ

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: ɔnb linɛ mɔr vaand wʋsa teŋin la, ka ɔnbi ba teŋ la zʋʋd wʋsa.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Ani ka o lɛn kʋ bikpɛɛmnam wʋsa teŋin la, o da kʋ yir wʋsa bikpɛɛm.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Li nya'aŋ ka o da yis Israel dim, ka ba ziid anzurifa nɛ sanlima, ka ba buudi la ni, sɔ' da kae an tadim.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Ban da yi la, Egipt dim sʋnf da ma'ae ya, bɔzugɔ Israel dim la dabiem da kpɛn' ba.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: O da yadig saŋgbana lusi ba, ka kɛ ka bugum bɛ yʋ'ʋŋʋ tisidi ba nɛɛsim.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Ba da sɔs diib ka o tisi ba kɔdis ka ba lɛn di arezana ni diibi tig.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: O da yɔ'ɔg tampiing ka ku'om yina nwɛnɛ kɔldaug nɛ pʋbid sian'arin la.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ o da tiɛn o kaanbʋg linɛ an kasi ka o da tis Abraham la.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: O da mɔr o nidibi yina nɛ sumalisim, banɛ ka o da gaŋ la yina maan sumalisim.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: O da tisi ba buudbanɛ bɛɛ ani la tɛɛns ka ba di faar linɛ ka sieba namisi li yɛla,

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: ye li kɛ ka ba siak o nɔzi'elʋg ka dɔl o wada la wʋsa. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya! Pʋ'ʋsimi Zugsɔb la bareka on an sʋm la zug; o nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi mɔɔl Zugsɔb tʋʋm titada la yɛla bɛɛ pa'al o zun'ori an si'em wʋsa?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Wina'am bareka bɛ nɛ banɛ dɔl sida la, ka tʋm linɛ an sʋm saŋa wʋsa la.

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: Ka m mɛ la'am di bareka nɛ banɛ ka fʋ gaŋ la, ka mɛ di malisim fʋ nidib la san'an ka naal nɛ banɛ an fʋ faar la zʋn'ʋf. Egipt teŋin yɛla

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Ti yaanamɛ da bɛ Egipt la, ba da pʋ tɛn'ɛsi fʋ tʋʋmnyalima la yɛlaa; ba da pʋ tiɛn fʋn maali ba sʋm si'em la amaa ka zan'asi fʋ nɔɔr Atɛuk Zɛn'ugʋn la.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, o da faaɛn ba o yʋ'ʋr zug, ye o kɛ ka ba baŋ o paŋ tita'ar la.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: O da tans Atɛuk Zɛn'ug la ka li kʋdig; ka mɔri ti yaanam la dɔlli gaad ka li nwɛnɛ pipirig nɛ.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: Amaa ku'om da pili ba dataas la; ka ba nid baa yinne pʋ tiligɛ.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Ani ka ba niŋ o kaanbʋg la yadda ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zun'e o. Pipirigin yɛla

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Amaa li da pʋ yuugɛ ka ba tam on maal si'el la ka pʋ lɛn kɛlis o sa'alʋgɔ.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Kʋkɔma'asim da mɔri ba sian'arin la; ka ba mak Wina'am ani.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Ala ka o da tisi ba ban sɔs si'el la, amaa ka kɛ ka ban'abɛ'ɛd gban'e ba.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Ba la'asʋg la zin'igin, ba da bɛn'ɛd fufum nɛ Moses nɛ Aaron onɛ ka Zugsɔb gaŋ la.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Teŋ la da ya'ae li nɔɔrɛ vɔl Datan; ka mum Abiram nidib la wʋsa.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Bugum da li ba nya'andɔlib la sʋʋgin; ka kanb bugusnam la.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Horeb zuorin la ba da maal na'abil ka pʋ'ʋsid ba'ar linɛ ka ba mɛŋ maal.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: Ba tiaki ba Wina'am na'am pipilim la tis na'abil, onɛ ɔnbid mɔɔd la.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Ba tam Wina'am kanɛ faaɛn ba la yɛla, la'an nɛ on da tʋm yɛltitada Egipt teŋgbauŋʋn la,

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: ka tʋm nyalima Ham dim teŋin nɛ yɛlpakir Atɛuk Zɛn'ugʋn la.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Ani ka ba da nɛ'ɛs teŋ sʋŋ la: ba da pʋ niŋ linɛ ka o kaanbi zi'el la yaddaa.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Ba da bɛɛ ba sʋga ni nyɔn, ka pʋ siak Zugsɔb la nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Ala ka o pɔ nɛ o paŋ tita'ar la ye o na kɛ ka ba kpi mɔɔgin la,

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Ba da la'asi dɔl Baal teŋgban linɛ bɛ Peor teŋin la ka di maana diib linɛ ka ba maali tis wina banɛ pʋ vʋeya;

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la da duoe Zugsɔb la sʋʋnr, ka ban'abɛ'ɛd lii ba sʋʋgin.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Amaa Finehas da duoe zi'enɛ nwɛ' nu'ug la zug, ka ban'as la basi ba.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Meriba ku'om zin'igin la ba kɛ ka Zugsɔb la sʋʋnr pɛlig, ka yɛla paae Moses ka li anɛ ban zug;

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ba da kɛ ka o sʋnf pɛlig, ka pian'ayɔɔd yi o nɔɔrin na. Keenan teŋin yɛla

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Ba da pʋ kʋ teŋ la nidib wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em laa,

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: amaa ba da la'asi nɛ tɛɛns nwa' nidib ka di'e ba malima dɔl.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Ba maannɛ ba bada la, ka li an bɛndigʋ bɛndi ba.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Ba da nɔki ba biribis nɛ bipumisi maal maana tis kikiris.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Ba da kʋʋ ba, la'an nɛ ban pʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛd la, ba biribis nɛ bipumis ka ba da kʋ, ba da nɔki ba maal maana tis Keenan bada la, ka ba ziim la kɛ ka teŋ la lieb dian'ad.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Linɛ da kɛ ka Zugsɔb la sʋnf duoe nɛ o nidib la ka o kisig banɛ aan o faar la.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: O da nɔki baa tis teŋ zʋna nidib, ka kɛ ka ba bi'emnam sʋ'oe ba.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Ba dataas da mugusi ba ka ba kɔ'ɔŋ paŋ ka bɛɛ ba nu'usin.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: O yisi ba nɔɔr babiga amaa ka ba zan'as ka nan kpɛn zan'asid o nɔɔr ka ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la san'ami ba. Zugsɔb Wina'am, faanmi ti

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Amaa ban da kaasi tis o la o da kpansi nyɛɛ ba namisʋg;

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Faanmi ti, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am, ka la'asi ti tɛɛnsin la na ka ti na tisi fʋ yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la bareka pʋ'ʋsim ka zun'e fʋ na'am la.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Zun'or anɛ Zugsɔb la din, onɛ an Israel Wina'am la, lin yi nannanna nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Kɛl ka nidib la zan' yɛl ye, Ami! Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: ) The Lord Is Good to His People
translation_verse: ) Pʋ'ʋsimi Wina'am bareka on an sʋm la zug

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi Zugsɔb la bareka on an sʋm la zug; o nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ ka Zugsɔb faaɛn ba la yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa, banɛ ka Zugsɔb faaɛn ba, ba bi'emnam nu'usin la,

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: banɛ ka o la'asi ba yi tɛɛns banɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ nɛ ya-tuona, nɛ banɛ bɛ ya-dagɔbʋg nɛ ya-datiuŋ la. Banɛ giligid mɔɔgin yɛla

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Ba sieba da giligid mɔɔgin, ka pʋ nyɛ suori na keŋ tempʋʋgini zin'inɛ.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Kɔ'ɔm nɛ ku'onuud da mɔri ba, ka ba vʋm ti'ir lɛn kae.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Ani ka ba kaasi tis Zugsɔb ban bɛ yɛla ni la zug, ka o yisi ba namisʋg la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: O da mɔri ba dɔl suokanɛ kpa' sappi keŋ tempʋkanɛ ka ba na zin'in.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba tis Zugsɔb la bareka pʋ'ʋsim o nɔŋilim linɛ ka' naar la yɛla nɛ o tʋʋmnyalima la wʋsa zug.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka ku'onuud mɔri ba la, o tisi ba ku'om ka diis banɛ kɔ'ɔm zabid la disʋma. Banɛ namisid la yɛla

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Sieba da bɛ nɛ lik nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ tita'ar pʋʋgin, namisid sanrega ni ka ba lɔɔ ba nɛ bana,

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: ban zan'as Wina'am pian'ad ka nɛ'ɛs Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa sa'alʋg la zug.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Ala ka o kɛ ka ba tʋm tʋʋm tɔɔg, kennɛ tu'usidi lit, ka sɔ' kae na faaɛn baa.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Ani ka ba kaasi tis Zugsɔb ban bɛ yɛla ni la zug, ka o yisi ba namisʋg la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: O mɔri baa yis lik nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ tita'ar la pʋʋgin ka kɛnsi ba bana la.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba tis Zugsɔb la bareka pʋ'ʋsim o nɔŋilim linɛ ka' naar la yɛla nɛ o tʋʋmnyalima la wʋsa zug.

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: O kɔ' kʋntzɛn'ug gama la ka kɔ'ɔgi li kʋnt daad la.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Sieba da lieb zɔnnɛ ba zan'asʋg suoya la ni, ka namis hali, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Ba da kisig diib wʋsa ka yʋ'ʋn li'el kum za'anɔɔrin.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Ani ka ba kaasi tis Zugsɔb ban bɛ yɛla ni la zug, ka o yisi ba namisʋg la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: O da tʋm o labaar na ka li tisi ba laafi; o da faaɛn ba yis yaʋgʋn.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba tis Zugsɔb la bareka pʋ'ʋsim o nɔŋilim linɛ ka' naar la yɛla nɛ o tʋʋmnyalima la wʋsa zug.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba maal maana tis o bareka pʋ'ʋsim ka mɔɔl o tʋʋma la yɛla nɛ sumalisim yʋʋma. Banɛ tʋm atɛukʋn tʋʋma la yɛla

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Sieba da yii keŋi atɛukʋn nɛ anrima; ba da anɛ banɛ kpiisid ku'otita'arin la.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Ba da nyɛ Zugsɔb la tʋʋma, ka gɔs o tʋʋmnyalima ku'ozuluŋin la.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: O da pian' ya ka atɛuk ku'om gudig ka ʋkid ku'opila agɔla.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Ku'opila la mɔri ba dʋ'ʋsid agɔla ka lɛbisidi sigid ku'ozuluŋin la; lin paki ba la, ka ba ya'am bɔdig.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Ba da tu'usid ka gɛridi nwɛnɛ danuudib nɛ; ka ba ti'ir wʋsa naae.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Ani ka ba kaasi tis Zugsɔb ban bɛ yɛla ni la zug, ka o yisi ba namisʋg la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka ku'opila la fɔn baanlimm; ka ma'ae sisi'em la ka li gu'oe.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Lin da niŋ baanlimm la ba sʋnf da ma'ae ya, ka o mɔri ba keŋi ba ya'am m bɔɔd zin'isi'a.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba tis Zugsɔb la bareka pʋ'ʋsim o nɔŋilim linɛ ka' naar la yɛla nɛ o tʋʋmnyalima la wʋsa zug.

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba dʋ'ʋs o, nidib la la'asʋg sʋʋgin, ka zun'e o, kpɛɛmnamɛ nwɛ'ɛd taaba sɔɔra zin'isi'a la. Tʋbtɛkir nɛ faangir yɛla

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: O kɛ ka kɔldaad lieb pipiris, ka ku'om daa ɛɛnti tansid zin'isi'a la kʋdig bar-bar,

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: ka teŋ kanɛ daa maan zʋʋd la lieb yaarim zin'ig, ka li anɛ banɛ bɛɛ ani la bugusim zug.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: O mɛ tiak pipiris ka li lieb bɛɛnna ka zin'ikanɛ da kʋdigi ga'aŋ la tansid ku'om pʋbid;

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: o da mɔr banɛ kɔ'ɔm zabid la kena ye ba bɛɛ ani ka mɛ' tempʋkanɛ ka ba na bɛ.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Ba da kua pɔɔd ka sɛ tiwanna ka bun zʋʋd bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: O da niŋ o nidib la zug bareka, ka ba nɔbig ka ba kal zu'oe, o mɛ da pʋ kɛ ka ba niigi la kal sie.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Ka mugusʋg nɛ tɔɔg nɛ namisʋg paae ba, ka ba kal sie.

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: Ka o kɛ ka kpi'em banɛ daa namisidi ba la di nyan ka gin mɔɔgin yɔri-yɔri.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Amaa o da yis fara dim namisʋg pʋʋgin ka kɛ ka ba nɔbig wʋʋ bʋnkɔnbid nɛ.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Banɛ bɛllim dɔl suor la nyɛɛ li ka maal sumalisim, amaa ka nimbɛ'ɛdnam on fɔɔn ba nɔɔr baanlimm.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka onɛ wʋsa mɔr ya'am kɛlis nɛ'ɛnam ka tɛn'ɛs Zugsɔb la nɔŋilim zu'oe si'em.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: M ya'am gban'e nɛ kiŋ-kiŋ, O Wina'am; m na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zʋn'ʋf nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa.

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Duomi, yanam banɛ nwɛ'ɛd kɔna nɛ duundis la! M na duoe bɛkɛung asuba yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, m na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr tɛɛns la sʋʋgin; ka yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ yɛla nidib buudi wʋsa sʋʋgin.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋilim la zu'onɛ, li wa'ami gaad saŋgbana la; ka fʋ sida la dʋʋ paae agɔla.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, kɛl ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr la dʋʋ paae saŋgbana; ka fʋ na'am pipilim la pɛ'ɛl teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Faanmi ti ka sʋŋi ti nɛ fʋ paŋ la, ka ala ka banɛ ka fʋ nɔŋ la na paam yɔlisim.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Wina'am naan o zin'ikanɛ an kasi la nii pian' ye, “M na pʋdig Sekɛm teŋ la nɛ paŋ ka mak Sukot Bɔn'ɔg la.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Gilead teŋgbauŋ la anɛ m din, ka Manase sʋ'ʋlim mɛ aan m din: Efiram anɛ m tanp zupibig, ka Juda aan m na'am dansaar.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab anɛ lakanɛ ka m mɔri piesid, ka Edom aan m ta'ada digilʋg zin'ig Filistia ka m tansid, man nyaŋi ba la yɛla.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na mɔrimi kpɛn' tempʋkanɛ kpi'em la ni? Anɔ'ɔnɛ na ta'asim Edom teŋinɛ?

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: Li ka' fʋnɛɛ, O Wina'am? Ka' fʋnɛ zan'asi ti ka pʋ lɛn dɔlli ti soogianamɛ yit tanp laa?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Sʋŋimi tii zab nɛ ti dataas la, ka ninsaal sʋŋir ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Nɛ Wina'am paŋa ti na nyaŋ, bɔzugɔ, o na nɔɔ ti dataas la digil teŋin.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ ka mam zun'oda, da kpɛn an baanlimm

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Ba giligimnɛ ki'isidim pian'ad ma'aa; ba zabidimnɛ zaalim-zaalim.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Man kpɛn'ɛdi ba da' nɛ ligidi ka ba kpɛn'ɛdi m da' nɛ kuga, amaa man anɛ ninkanɛ bɔɔd winsɔsʋg.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: M maali ba sʋm ka ba lɛbis bɛ'ɛd, ka m zuod an kisidim tisi ba.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Ba yɛt ye, “Gaŋim onɛ na pian' o yɛla bɛ'ɛd; kɛl ka dataa la kena zi'enɛ kpi'enɛ o datiuŋ.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba ya'a ti tu'ad o antu'a, on di nyan, ka o winsɔsʋg lieb bɛ'ɛdi tis o.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka o dabisa yuugɛ; kɛl ka sɔ' di'e o tʋʋma tʋm.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Kɛl ka o biis lieb kpiibis ka o pu'a lieb pʋkɔɔnr.

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: O biis la na ginnɛ sɔsid; ka kɛ ka ba ya lieb dabɔɔd ka ba kadi baa yis.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: O samdaan na faaɛn on mɔr si'el wʋsa; on tʋm namisi nyɛ si'el la, saam na faaɛn li.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kʋ maal o sʋm bɛɛ zɔɔ o kpiibis la nimbaanliga.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: O yaas na kpii naae, ka ba yʋ'ʋr kʋ pʋdig zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ na ti kena la nii.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb na kpɛn tɛnri o yaanam bɛ'ɛd la yɛla; ka o ma tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd mɛ kʋ yi ka kɛɛ o.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb na kpɛn tɛnri li yɛla saŋa wʋsa, ka na kɛ ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn tɛnri ba yɛla teŋgbauŋ nwa' nii.

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ o nan zi' tɛn'ɛs ye o tʋm sʋm, amaa o kʋʋd nɔŋ dim nɛ fara dim nɛ banɛ mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: On nɔŋ si'el anɛ nɔpɔɔr li na lɛb o mɛŋ zugin. O pʋ mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ on na niŋ sɔ' albareka; ala ka bareka mɛ na lalig ka kɛɛ o.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: O nɔk nɔpɔɔri yɛɛd wʋʋ dansik nɛ; ka li kpɛn' o niŋgbina ni wʋʋ ku'om, ka kpɛn' o kɔnba ni wʋʋ kpaam nɛ.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka o nɔpɔɔr la vil o niŋgbina wʋʋ fuug, ka nwɛnɛ sɛnbidiŋ nɛ lɔɔ o siaa saŋa wʋsa.”

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Kɛl ka nɛ' anɛ Zugsɔb la yɔɔdi m dataas la sam, nɛ banɛ pian'adi m yɛla bɛ'ɛd la.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, maalim mam sʋ'ʋŋa fʋ yʋ'ʋr zug; fʋ nɔŋilim zu'oe si'em la zugɔ, faanmim.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Man an nɔŋdaan nɛ fara sɔb la zug, ka m sʋʋnr wʋsa san'am.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: M naadi tɔ'ɔtɔ wʋʋ zaam ma'asim nɛ; ba pisigimi bas wʋʋ sisɔm nɛ.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Kɔ'ɔm kɛ ka m duma wʋsa ka' paŋa; ka m niŋgbina naae ka m an gɛr-gɛr.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: M lieb nɛ bʋnla'adiri tis banɛ pian'adi m yɛla bɛ'ɛd la; ba ɛɛnti nyɛɛm ka lɔbidi ba zut.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: M Zugsɔb Wina'am, sʋŋim; faanmim wʋʋ fʋ nɔŋilim zu'oe si'em la.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba baŋ ye li anɛ fʋ paŋ, ka baŋ ye fʋnɛ tʋmmi li, O Zugsɔba.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a bɔɔd ban pɔɔm nɔɔri tisim, amaa fʋn na tisim bareka; ba ya'a duoe zab ba na di nyan, amaa man kanɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋm la na mɔr sumalisim.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Banɛ pian'adi m yɛla bɛ'ɛd la na di nyan tita'ar ka nyan na pili ba wʋʋ fuugnɛ.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: M na dʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la nɛ m nɔɔr pian'ad, ka wɔ'ɔg o, nidib la wʋsa sʋʋgin.

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ o zi'e onɛ an fara sɔb la nya'aŋ ye o faaɛn o yis banɛ kʋʋsid o bɛ'ɛd la nu'usin.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛli m Zugsɔb ye, “Zin'inimi m datiuŋ hali ka m ti kɛ ka fʋ bi'emnam bɛɛ fʋ nɔba teŋir.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka fʋ na'am paŋ yi Zion teŋin na; fʋ na di na'am fʋ dataas sʋʋgin.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Daakanɛ ka fʋ ye fʋ keŋ zaba la, fʋ zabzabidib la na siaki yina. Fʋ na zi'en nɛ na'am paŋ linɛ an kasi la, bɛogʋ ti nied la; na'akim la na kɛɛn fʋ san'an na ka li nwɛnɛ bɛogʋn mɛligim nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pɔya ka kʋ tiak o pʋtɛn'ɛrɛ; o yɛl ye, “Fʋ anɛ maanmaan onɛ tʋʋma ka' naar nwɛnɛ Melkizedek la.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la aan fʋ paŋ; o sʋʋnr ya'a ti duoe o na nyaŋ na'anam wʋsa.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: O na kad tɛɛns la saria, ka la'as banɛ kpi la digil dʋʋr-dʋʋr ka nyaŋ banɛ sʋ'oe dunia sʋ'ʋlim la wʋsa.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: O na nu bulig kanɛ bɛ suor kpikpɛŋ la ku'om; ala ka o na paam paŋ nɛ nyaŋir.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya! M na wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb burikinnam la'asʋg zin'igin nɛ m sʋʋnr wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la tʋm tʋʋm kpi'ema; banɛ nini tigi li la tɛn'ɛsidi li yɛla ka mɔɔd ye ba baŋi li gbin.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: O tʋʋma la mɔr kpi'euŋ nɛ vɛnlim, ka o pʋpielim bɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: O kɛya ka ba tɛnri o nyalima tʋʋma la; Zugsɔb la an sʋm ka an nimbaanlzɔt.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: O tisid banɛ zɔt o la diib; o tɛnri o nɔnaar la yɛla saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: O pa'al o nidib la o paŋi an si'em, ka nɔk buudsieba paalʋ tisi ba.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: O tʋʋma anɛ sida ka dɔl suor; ka o zi'ela la wʋsa mɔr yɛlsida.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: O maal suori tis o nidib ka ba na nyɛ faangir; o zi'el o nɔnaar ka li bɛ saŋa wʋsa; o yʋ'ʋr la anɛ kasi ka mɔr dabiem.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zɔtim an ya'am pin'ilʋg; banɛ wʋsa dɔl o zi'ela la na gban'ad si'elnam gbin, on ma'aa nar nɛ girima saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
