translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya! Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ onɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la nɛ onɛ ya'am bɛɛ o zi'ela la ni.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: O sɔb biis na mɔr kpi'euŋ teŋin la; onɛ an burikin la yaas na mɔr bareka.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Kpan'am nɛ arezak bɛɛ o yin, ka o pʋpielim kpɛm bɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Hali baa likinɛ, nɛɛsim bɛɛ tis burikin nɛ, on an ninsʋŋ, nɛ nimbaanlzɔt, nɛ pʋpielim sɔb la zug.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm na bɛɛ tis onɛ tisid piini ka pɛmisid nidib, nɛ onɛ tʋmm o tʋʋma nɛ yɛlsida.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Sida, daamʋg kʋ bɛɛ o san'anɛ; ba na tɛnr pʋpielim sɔb la yɛla saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: O kʋ zɔt dabiem ye lababɛ'ɛd pa'ati kenaa; o yadda zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ, ka o niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: O ya'am dignɛ baanlimm ka o pʋ zɔt dabiem; li nya'aŋ o na di ya'an ka nyaŋ o bi'emnam.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: O nɔk piini bɛdegʋ tis nɔŋ dim, ka o pʋpielim la na bɛ yʋma linɛ ka' naarɛ; ba tis o na'asi nɛ girima.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Bugusnam la na nyɛɛ o ka ba sʋnf pɛlig nɛ o, ka ba ga'adi ba nyina ka ba'as yɔri. Bugusnam ya'amlɛog na lieb zaalim.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya! Zugsɔb tʋmtʋmniba, zun'omin o, zun'omi Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba zun'e Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr nannanna nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Lin yi winnigi tansid zin'isi'a paae on lit zin'isi'a la, Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋri nar nɛ zʋn'or.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nyɛt dʋ'ʋsʋgʋ gat tɛɛns wʋsa ka o na'am la pipilim wa'ami gat saŋgbana.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ bɛɛ nwɛnɛ ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la? O zin'inɛ o na'am gbauŋ zug arezana ni,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: ka siki gɔsid agɔla nɛ teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: O dʋ'ʋsid tadimnam banɛ bɛ teŋin la ka yis fara dim la tampʋʋrine zi'el.

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: O zin'ili ba nɛ, nɛ nintitada ka tisi ba zin'isa ba teŋ kpɛɛmnam san'an.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: O kɛ ka pu'a kʋndu'ar zin' o yin wʋʋ pu'a kanɛ mɔr biis ka o sʋnf malis. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Israel dimi da yi Egipt na ka bas nimbanɛ pian'ad pian'azʋŋ la,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Wina'am da gaŋ Juda ka o aan o din, ka Israel aan o mɛŋ sʋ'ʋlim.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Atɛuk da gɔsi nyɛ Wina'am ka zɔ, ka Joodan kɔldaug la lɛb tutula;

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: zuoya la da ian'asid wʋʋ pɛraad, ka kʋkʋna la ian'asid wʋʋ pɛbibis nɛ.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Atɛukɔɔ, bɔɔ niŋ ka fʋ zɔta, Joodan kɔldaugɔɔ, bɔɔ niŋ ka fʋ lɛbid tutula?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Zuoyaa, bɔ ka ya ian'asid wʋʋ pɛraadɛ, kʋkʋnaa, bɔ ka ya ian'asid wʋʋ pɛbibisɛ?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋɔ, kirim Zugsɔb la tuon. Kirim onɛ an Jakob Wina'am la tuon.

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: Onɛ kɛ ka tampiing la lieb bɛuŋ, ka ku'om tansidi yit tampinkpi'euŋ la ni na.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Li ka' tinam dinnɛ, Zugsɔba, li ka' tinam dinnɛ; amaa fʋn yʋ'ʋr la na paam na'asi, fʋ nɔŋilim nɛ fʋ sida la zug.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Bɔ ka tɛɛns la nidib yɛt ye, “Ba Wina'am la bɛ ya?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Ti Wina'am la bɛ arezana ni; o tʋmnɛ dinɛ ka o bɔɔd.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Amaa ba bada la anɛ anzurifa nɛ sanlima, ka nidib nu'us maali ba.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Ba mɔr nɔya, amaa ka kʋ nyaŋi pian', ba mɔr nini ka pʋ nyɛtaa;

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: ba mɔr tʋba amaa ka pʋ wʋmma, nɛ nyɔnya, amaa ka pʋ wʋm nyuugɔ;

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Ba mɔr nu'us, ka pʋ tun'e babin na, ka mɔr nɔba ka kʋ nyaŋi keŋi, ba mɛ kʋ tun'e kɛ ka sɔ' wʋmi ba pian'adɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Banɛ maali ba la na nwɛnɛ ba nɛ, ban nɛ banɛ niŋi ba yadda la wʋsa.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Israel dima, niŋimi Zugsɔb la yadda, ka onɛ sʋŋidi ya ka guri ya.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Aaron yidima, niŋimi Zugsɔb la yadda, ka onɛ sʋŋidi ya ka aan ya zaba gbanti'edʋg.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la, niŋimin o yadda ka onɛ sʋŋidi ya ka aan ya zaba gbanti'edʋg.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la tɛnri ti yɛla ka na niŋi ti bareka: o na niŋ Israel dim bareka, o na niŋ Aaron yidim bareka,

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la o niŋidi ba bareka, banɛ an ninvʋbɛda nɛ tadimnam wʋsa.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka ya wiak, yanam nɛ ya biis wʋsa.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ maal arezana nɛ teŋgbauŋ la, na niŋi ya bareka.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Saŋgbana linɛ bɛ agɔla la wʋsa anɛ Zugsɔb la din, amaa o nɔk teŋgbauŋʋ tis ninsaal.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Li ka' kpi'imnam banɛ kpii dig kpi'im teŋ la zun'od Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Li anɛ tinam banɛ nan vʋe la na zun'od Zugsɔb la, nannanna nɛ saŋa kanɛ ka' naarɛ. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, o yɔ'ɔg o tʋbiri tisim, m na buon o saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Kum lɔb nwiisi giligim zin'ig wʋsa, ka nyaŋi gban'am; ka yɛla nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ paae m.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Ani ka m buol Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr ye, “Zugsɔba, faanmim!”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an sʋm ka an pʋpiel; ti Wina'am la nimbaanlzɔɔr zu'oya.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la gur talis; man daa bɔɔd sʋŋir la, o daa faanm.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: M siigaa, lɛn vʋ'ʋs ya'as, ka Zugsɔb la tʋm tʋʋm sʋma tisif.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Zugsɔbaa, li anɛ fʋnɛ faanm nyɔvʋri yis kumin, fʋ duusi m ninta'am ka guri m nɔba ka m pʋ tu'ugɛ,

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: ye m ken fʋn Zugsɔb la tuon teŋ kanɛ ka banɛ nan vʋe bɛ la.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Hali baa man yɛl ye, “M bɛ nɛ namisʋgʋn la”, m niŋ o yadda.

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Lin daa wʋmimi galis la, m ya'am fɛndig ka m yɛl ye, “Ninsaalib wʋsa anɛ ziri dim.”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: M na niŋ wala yɔ Zugsɔb la on maali m sʋm si'em la?

english_verse: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
translation_verse: M na ʋk bʋtiŋ kanɛ pa'an faangir la agɔla ka buol Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: M na maal man zi'el nɔɔr ye m na maal si'eli tis Zugsɔb la ka o nidib la wʋsa nini nyɛ.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb tʋmtʋmnib la yinne ya'a kpi, li zabid Zugsɔb la sʋʋnr nɛ hali.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: Sida, Zugsɔbaa, m anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm; m anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm pu'ak biig. Fʋ faanmi yis yɛla pʋʋgin.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: M na maal bareka pʋ'ʋsim maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la ka buol o yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Yir la zakin ka m na maali li ka li zi'e Jerusalem tempʋʋgin. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns wʋsa nidibaa, pian'ami Zugsɔb la! Buudi wʋsa, zun'omin o!

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ on nɔŋi ti si'em la galis nɛ, Zugsɔb la sida bɛ nɛ saŋa wʋsa. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi Zugsɔb la bareka on an sʋm la zug; o nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka Aaron yidim la yɛl ye, “O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: M sʋnsa'aŋ pʋʋgin m daa kaasi tis Zugsɔb la, ka o wʋm ka tisim yɔlisim.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la bɛɛ m san'an, m kʋ zɔt dabiem. Ninsaal na nyaŋi niŋim bɔ?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la bɛ nɛ m; onɛ aan m sʋŋid. M na nyaŋi m dataas la wʋsa.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a su'a fʋ mɛŋ Zugsɔb la san'an sɔn'oe fʋn na nɔki fʋ ti'iri niŋ ninsaal ni.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns la wʋsa nidib daa la'asi giligim, amaa ka m nyaŋi ba nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba giligim nɛ zin'ig wʋsa, amaa ka m nyaŋi ba nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Ba giligim nɛ wʋʋ siins, amaa ka kpi tɔ'ɔtɔ wʋʋ gɔn'ɔs bugum kpiigid si'em la; m nyaŋi ba nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Ba daa da'am nɛ lɛbis nya'aŋ ka m bɔɔd liig, amaa ka Zugsɔb la sʋŋim.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an mam paŋ, onɛ aan m yʋʋm, onɛ liebi m faangid.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Wʋmmi nyaŋir yʋʋma naan pʋpielim dim sʋga nii yit na si'em; Zugsɔb la mɔr paŋi tʋm tʋʋm titada!

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Ba dʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la paŋ agɔla; Zugsɔb la paŋ tʋm tʋʋm titada!

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: M kʋ kpii, amaa m na vʋe ka mɔɔl Zugsɔb la maal si'eli tisim.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la tɛki m tʋbir hali sʋ'ʋŋa, amaa o pʋ kɛ ka m kpii.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Yɔ'ɔgim pʋpielim dim za'anɔya la tisim, ka m kpɛn' tis Zugsɔb la bareka pʋ'ʋsim.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la za'anɔɔri nwa', ani ka pʋpielim dim na kpɛn'ɛd.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, m na pʋ'ʋsif bareka bɔzugɔ fʋ wʋmi m sɔsʋg ka liebi m faangid.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Tampigkanɛ ka tanmɛɛdib daa nɛ'ɛs la lieb lɔdigin tampigir;

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Nwa' anɛ Zugsɔb la niŋi li, ka ti nyɛ ka li an nyalima ti nini ni.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la maal dabiskaŋa, kɛlli ka ti maal sumalisim li ni.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, faanmi ti; Zugsɔba, kɛl ka ti di ya'an.

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ onɛ kenna nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr zug; ti bɛ nɛ Zugsɔb la Yin ka kaanbid bareka niŋidi ya.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an Wina'am, o kɛ ka o nɛɛsim nie tisi ti. Zanli tiis wila ya nu'usin ka yʋ'ʋm wa'a gilig malʋŋ daka la.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Fʋ anɛ m Wina'am, ka m na tisif bareka pʋ'ʋsim; fʋ anɛ m Wina'am, ka m na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi Zugsɔb la bareka on an sʋm la zug; o nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Wina'am bareka bɛ nɛ banɛ ka' gba'arɛ, ka dɔl Zugsɔb wada sʋ'ʋŋa la.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Wina'am bareka bɛ nɛ banɛ dɔl o nɔzi'ela la ka ieed o nɛ ba sʋʋnr wʋsa la.

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ tʋm linɛ an bɛ'ɛdɛ amaa ka dɔlisid o suoya la.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Fʋ digili fʋ wada ye ti siaki ba wʋsa.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: Man bɔɔdin si'el anɛ m zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ ka nyaŋi dɔl fʋn gban'e si'el la!

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: M ya'a tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ nɔzi'ela la yɛla man kʋ di nyannɛ.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Man zamisi fʋ pʋpielim wada la m na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr nɛ pʋʋg nyain.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Da tami m yɛla nyainnɛ; ka m na siak fʋn gban'e si'el la.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: M ieedif nɛ m sʋʋnr wʋsa; da kɛ ka m yidigi fʋ nɔɔr zi'elʋgɔ.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: M na su'a fʋ pian'ʋk la m sʋnfʋn ka li kɛ ka m da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔgi fɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Zun'or anɛ fʋ din, Zugsɔbaa; pa'alimi fʋ gban'ar la.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: M na ya'a m nɔɔri mɔɔli fʋ wada la yɛla, wada banɛ yii fʋ san'an na la wʋsa.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Li malisim nɛ mam na dɔlli fʋ nɔɔr wʋʋ sɔ' na mɔr kpan'am ka li malis o si'em la.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: M na tɛn'ɛsi fʋ wada la yɛla ka kpansi fʋ suoya la wʋsa.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: M mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ fʋ nɔzi'ela la; ka kʋ tami fʋ pian'ʋk laa.

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Maalimi fʋ tʋmtʋm la sʋ'ʋŋa, ka m na kpɛn vʋe ka siaki fʋ nɔɔr.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Yɔ'ɔgimi m nini ka m nyɛ bʋnnyalima fʋ wada la ni.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: M anɛ saan dunia nwa' ni; da su'ami fʋ nɔzi'ela la.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Fʋ wada la ya'amlɛogʋ kʋʋdim ka m bɔɔd ye m baŋi li saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Fʋ zɛrigid tita'alnam banɛ ka nɔpɔɔr bɛɛ ba zugin la nɛ banɛ fɛndig ka basi fʋ nɔzi'elʋg la.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Yisim nɛ'ɛsʋg nɛ tʋ'ʋdi m san'an, ka m dɔlli fʋ wada la.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ na'anamɛ la'asi zin' san'amidi m yʋ'ʋr la, m anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm ka na tɛn'ɛsid fʋn gban'e si'em la yɛla.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Fʋ wada la ka m ya'am bɔɔd; li anɛ linɛ sa'annim.

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: M tadignɛ dig teŋin; gu'umi m nyɔvʋr wʋʋ fʋn pian' zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: M pie m pʋʋgʋ yɛlif man tʋm si'el wʋsa ka fʋ siaki m sɔsʋg; pa'alimi fʋ gban'ar la.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m baŋi fʋ wada la pa'an si'el; ala ka m na tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ nyalima la yɛla.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: M gɛnnɛ nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ; tɛndigimim wʋʋ fʋ nɔɔr zi'elʋgʋ an si'em la.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Yisimim ziri suoya ni; ka sʋŋim nɛ fʋ wada la.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Man gaŋnɛ yɛlsida suor; ka niŋi fʋ wada la m pʋtɛn'ɛrin.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: M dɔlli fʋ wada la sʋ'ʋŋa, Zugsɔbaa; da kɛ ka m di nyannɛ.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: M zɔtnɛ dɔlli fʋ zi'ela suoya, bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ tisim yɔlisim.

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Pa'alimim, O Zugsɔba, ka m dɔlli fʋ gban'ar la; ala ka m na dɔlisi paae li bɛn.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Sʋŋimim ka m gban'e fʋ wada la gbin ka siaki li nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Pa'alimi fʋ nɔzi'elʋg la suoya, ka ani ka m ya'am kpɛn'.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Fɛndigimi m pʋtɛn'ɛre lɛbisi fʋ wada la ni ka da kɛ ka m tɛn'ɛsidi m mɛŋ yɛla ma'aanɛ.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka m nini gɔsid linɛ ka' gbinnɛ; ka guri m nyɔvʋr wʋʋ fʋn zi'el nɔɔr si'em la.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Fʋn da kaanbi tisi fʋ tʋmtʋm la, kɛl ka li niŋ amɛŋa tisim ka m na zɔtif

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Yisimim nyan linɛ ka m zɔt la pʋʋgin, bɔzugɔ fʋ wada la an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: M nɔŋi fʋ pa'ala la hali! Guri m nyɔvʋr nɛ fʋ pʋpielim la.

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, kɛl ka fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ ka' naar la kɛɛn m san'an na, nɛ fʋ faangir la wʋʋ fʋn kaanb si'em la;

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: ala ka m na nyɛ pian'ʋkʋ lɛbis banɛ tʋ'ʋdim la, bɔzugɔ m tisi fʋ nɔɔr yɛlʋg la sida.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Da yis yɛlsida pian'adi m nɔɔrinɛ, ka m nɔki m ti'iri niŋnɛ fʋ wada la ni.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: M na siakidi fʋ wada la, saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: M na ken nɛ yɔlisim, man ieedi fʋ pa'alʋg la zug.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: M na mɔɔli fʋ wada la tis na'anam ka kʋ zɔ nyannɛ,

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ m ya'amlɛog bɛɛ fʋ zi'ela la ni man nɔŋi ba la zug.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: M ʋki m nu'usi na'asi fʋ zi'ela linɛ ka m nɔŋ la, ka tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ wada la yɛla.

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Tiɛnmi fʋ pian'ʋk linɛ ka fʋ tisim la, bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ tisim ti'ir.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Sumbʋgʋsʋm linɛ ka m mɔri m namisʋg la pʋʋgin anɛ fʋ kaanbʋg linɛ tisidim vʋm la.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Tita'alnam la tʋ'ʋdim nɛ ka pʋ gu'usida, amaa m pʋ fɛndig ka basi fʋ wada la.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, m tɛnri fʋ wada linɛ da bɛ kʋdimin sa la, ka nyɛ ka li bʋgʋnnɛ m sʋʋnr.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: M sʋʋnr ɛɛnti duoe nɛ bugusnam, banɛ zan'asidi fʋ wada la.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Man bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa, fʋ zi'ela la aan m yʋʋma.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, m tɛnri fʋ yʋ'ʋr la yʋ'ʋŋ, ka na dɔlisidi fʋ wada la.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Man ɛɛnti tʋm si'em nwa': m siakidi fʋ wada la.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Fʋn ka m gaŋ, Zugsɔbaa; m yɛl nɔɔrɛ zi'el ye m na siaki fʋ nɔɔr yɛlʋg la.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: M ieedif nɛ m sʋʋnr wʋsa; maalimim sʋ'ʋŋa wʋʋ fʋn kaanb si'em la.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: M tɛn'ɛsi m suoya la an si'em ka fɛndigi lɛbi fʋ wada la ni.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: M na niŋ tɔ'ɔtɔ ka kʋ yuugɛ m siaki fʋ zi'elʋg la.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ bugusnam la lɔɔdim nɛ nwiis la, m kʋ tami fʋ wada laa.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ tisʋʋs ka m duoe pʋ'ʋsif bareka fʋ sida nɛ pʋpielim la zug.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Banɛ zɔtif la wʋsa anɛ man zuanam, nɛ banɛ wʋsa dɔlisidi fʋ pa'alʋg la.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ la pɛ'ɛl nɛ fʋ nɔŋilim, Zugsɔba; pa'alimim fʋ nɔzi'ela la.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, niŋim man onɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋm la sʋ'ʋŋa nwɛnɛ fʋn zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Pa'alimim baŋir nɛ ya'am kanɛ bakid sʋm nɛ bɛ'ɛd, ka m niŋi fʋ zi'elʋg la yadda.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: M daa yidig nɛ ka namisʋg naan paam, amaa nannanna m siaki fʋ nɔɔr.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Fʋ an sʋm, ka fʋ tʋʋma mɛ an sʋm; pa'alimim fʋ gban'ar la.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ tita'alnam la ma' ziri tisim la, m dɔlli fʋ pa'ala la nɛ m sʋʋnr wʋsa.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Ba ba'a kae nɛ lin na wʋm sɔ', amaa man ya'am bɔɔdi fʋ wada la.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Li an sʋm nɛ man daa nyɛ namisʋg la bɔzugɔ li na kɛ ka m zamisi fʋ nɔzi'ela la.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Wada linɛ yiti fʋ nɔɔrin na la anɛ bʋnsʋŋ hali tisim, li gaad sanlima nɛ anzurifa gbila tusa-tusa.

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Fʋ nu'usi ya'abim ka maalim; tisimim ya'am ka m zamisi fʋ nɔzi'elʋg la.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ zɔtif la ya'a nyɛɛm bam mɔr sumalisim, ka fʋ pian'ʋk la ni ka m ti'ir bɛ.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, m mi' ye fʋ wada la anɛ linɛ dɔl suor, fʋ sida zug ka fʋ namisim.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ pʋ naad la bʋgʋli m sʋʋnr, wʋʋ fʋn kaanb si'em tisim la, ka m anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Zɔmim nimbaanlig ka tisim vʋm, ka fʋ wada la ka m ya'am bɔɔd.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka tita'alnam la di nyan ban tʋmim bɛ'ɛd ka li pʋ dɔl suor la zug; amaa mam na tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ nɔzi'ela la yɛla.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ zɔtif ka gban'e fʋ wada la gbin la fɛndigi lɛbi m san'an na.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m dɔlli fʋ zi'ela la nɛ pʋʋg nyain, ka li kɛ ka m da di nyannɛ.

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Fʋ faangir la ya'amlɛogʋ kʋʋdim, amaa m nɔki m ti'iri niŋi fʋ pian'ʋk la ni.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: M wiisi fʋ kaanbʋg la gʋ'ʋŋ, ka yɛl ye, “Bʋndaar ka fʋ na bʋgʋli m sʋʋnrɛ?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ man nwɛnɛ waa ya'ae nyɔ'ɔsin la, m pʋ tam fʋ zi'ela laa.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Fʋ bɔɔd ye m gu'usi paae wala bɛnnɛ? Bʋndaar ka fʋ na namis banɛ namisidim la?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Tita'alnam la tuudi bʋmbu'adi bɔɔd ye m li, ka li pʋ dɔlli fʋ wada laa.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: Fʋ zi'ela la wʋsa anɛ linɛ mɔr sida; sʋŋimim, ka nidib namisidim zaalim-zaalim.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Ba bɔɔdim nɛ kʋʋb, amaa m pʋ tami fʋ pa'alʋg laa.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋilim la zugɔ guri m nyɔvʋr, ka m na siaki fʋ nɔzi'elʋg la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, fʋ labaar la bɛ nɛ saŋa wʋsa; li zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ arezana ni.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Fʋ yɛlsida la dɔlisidi paad zʋmaana wʋsa; fʋ maal teŋ la ka li zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Fʋ wada la bɛ nɛ ala hali ti paae zina, bɔzugɔ si'el wʋsa tʋmnɛ tisidif.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Fʋ wada la ya'a ka'an linɛ ka m bɔɔda, m naan kpiin nɛ namisʋg.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: M kʋ tami fʋ pa'alʋg laa, bɔzugɔ linzug ka fʋ tisidim vʋm.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Faanmim ka m anɛ fʋ din; m siaki fʋ wada la.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Bugusim dim la guri bɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm, amaa m na tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ zi'ela la yɛla.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: M nɔŋi fʋ wada la hali! M tɛn'ɛsidi li yɛla daar wʋsa.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔzi'ela la kɛ ka m mɔr ya'am gati m dataas, bɔzugɔ li bɛɛ m san'an saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: M gban'e li gbinni gaad banɛ pa'annim la, bɔzugɔ m tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ zi'ela la yɛla.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: M gban'e li gbinni gaad kpɛɛmnam la, bɔzugɔ m siaki fʋ pa'alʋg la.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: M gban'am mɛŋ ka pʋ dɔl tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd suor ye li kɛ ka m siaki fʋ pian'ad la.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: M pʋ bie ka basi fʋ wada la, bɔzugɔ fʋ mɛŋi pa'alim.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: Fʋ pa'alʋg la kɛt ka m gban'ad yɛla gbin; dinzug ka m kis suobɛ'ɛd wʋsa.

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Fʋ pian'ʋk la anɛ fitiri tisim nɔba, nɛ nɛɛsim pa'annim suor.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: M digil nɔɔr ka mɛ siak ye, m na dɔlli fʋ pʋpielim zi'elʋg la.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: M namis ya hali, Zugsɔbaa, guri m nyɔvʋr, wʋʋ fʋ pian'ʋkʋ yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, di'emi m bareka pʋ'ʋsim, ka pa'alimi fʋ zi'elʋg la.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ man mɔri m vʋm di'em la, m kʋ tami fʋ wada laa.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Bugusim dim la bɛndim nɛ baans, amaa m pʋ yidigi fʋ zamisʋg laa.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Fʋ wada la aan m faar saŋa wʋsa; li anɛ linɛ tisidim sumalisim.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: M sʋnf gban'anɛ ye m dɔlli fʋ gban'ar wʋsa hali ti paae li bɛn.

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Man kis banɛ mɔr pʋtɛnda ayi' yi la, Amaa m nɔŋi fʋ wada la.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Fʋ anɛ m suak zin'ig nɛ m gbanti'edʋg m nɔki m ti'iri niŋi fʋ pian'ʋk la ni.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Tɔɔmini m san'an, yanam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dima! Ka m dɔlisi m Wina'am zi'ela la.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Kpɛmisimim wʋʋ fʋn kaanb si'em la, ka m na vʋe; da kɛ ka m ti'ir gaadɛ.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Sʋŋimim ka m na nyɛ faangir, ka kɛlisidi fʋ gban'ar la saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Fʋ zan'asid banɛ wʋsa zan'as fʋn gban'e si'el la, bɔzugɔ ba ya'am bɛ'ɛd la naadi zaalim.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Bugusim dim banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ zug la, fʋ vaae ba bas wʋʋ sa'ad; amaa man nɔŋi fʋ wada la.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Man zɔtif la zug ka m niŋgbina kirid, ka fʋ wada la kɛ ka m zi'e nɛ pakir.

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: M tʋm linɛ an pʋpielim nɛ sida; da basimi tis banɛ mugusidim laa.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Gur man kanɛ an fʋ tʋmtʋm la sʋ'ʋŋa; da kɛ ka tita'alnam la mugusi ma.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Man ieenɛ fʋ faangir la nɛ fʋ pʋpielim kaanbʋg la hali ka m nini ti sɔb.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Dɔl man kanɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋm la nɛ nɔŋilim ka pa'alimi fʋ gban'ar la.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, li paae saŋkanɛ ka fʋ na maal si'el; bɔzugɔ nidib san'ami fʋ wada la nɛ.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Man nɔŋi fʋ nɔzi'ela la gaad sanlima, m nɔŋi li hali gaad sanlim sʋŋ.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ man siaki fʋ zamisʋg la ye li an sʋm, m kis suobɛ'ɛd wʋsa.

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Fʋ pa'alʋg la anɛ nyalima; dinzug ka m siakidi li la.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Fʋ niedi fʋ yɛlʋg la pa'an nidib ka li tisidi ba nɛɛsim; li tisid zi'ilim dim la ya'am.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔzi'ela la ku'onuudi mɔri m ka m vʋ'ʋsidi pʋ paada ka ya'ae nɔɔr.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Fɛndigimi m san'an na ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig, wʋʋ fʋn niŋid si'em saŋa wʋsa nɛ banɛ nɔŋi fʋ yʋ'ʋr la.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Guri m nɔba yakir wʋʋ fʋ pian'ad la yɛl si'em la; da kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sʋ'ʋgi ma.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Faanmim nidib mugusʋg pʋʋgin, ka ala ka m na nyaŋi siaki fʋ wada la.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ nindaa nie man kanɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋm la ni ka pa'alim fʋn gban'e si'em la.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Man ninta'am yuodnɛ bɔra-bɔra ka li anɛ banɛ pʋ siaki fʋ wada la zug.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, fʋ anɛ pʋpiel, ka fʋ wada la dɔl suor.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Zi'ela banɛ ka fʋ tis la anɛ pʋpielim suoya ka an sida hali.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: M sʋʋnr pɛlignɛ hali ka li zabidim, bɔzugɔ m dataasi zan'asi fʋ pian'ad la zug.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Ba maki fʋ kaanbʋg la gɔs ka li an sʋ'ʋŋa, lin ka man kanɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋm la nɔŋi li la.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ nidibi gɔsidi pʋ nyɛti ma ka nɛ'ɛsidim la, m pʋ tami fʋ pa'alʋg laa.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋpielim la bɛ nɛ saŋa wʋsa ka fʋ wada la an sida.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Yɛla nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ sigi m zug na, amaa fʋ zi'ela la bʋgʋnnɛ m sʋʋnr.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Fʋ pa'alʋg la dɔl suor saŋa wʋsa; sʋŋim ka m gban'e li gbin ka li na tisim vʋm.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: M buonif nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa Zugsɔbaa, siakim tisim ka m na siaki fʋ zi'ela la.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Fʋn ka m buon; faanmim ka m na dɔlli fʋ wada la.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: M duod ka bɛog nam pʋ nie kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir; m nɔki m ti'iri niŋnɛ fʋ pian'ad la ni.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa m pʋ gbisidaa m tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ kaanbʋg la yɛla.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋilim an si'em la zug, wʋmmi m sɔsʋg; guri m nyɔvʋr, o m Zugsɔba, wʋʋ fʋ wada la an si'em la.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Banɛ gban'ad suobɛ'ɛdnam la bɛ yammin, amaa ba lal nɛ fʋ wada la dɔllim.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ala fʋ bɛ yammin, Zugsɔba, ka fʋ nɔzi'ela la wʋsa mɛ an sida.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: M zamisi fʋ pa'alʋg la ka li yuug, fʋ maali li nɛ ye li bɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi m namisʋg la ka faanm, ka m pʋ tami fʋ wada laa.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Kpɛn'ɛmi m zug ka faanm; ka guri m nyɔvʋr wʋʋ fʋn kaanb si'em la.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Bugusim dim la lal nɛ faangir, ban pʋ ieedi fʋ nɔzi'ela la zug.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr galis ya; guri m nyɔvʋr wʋʋ fʋ wada la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Bi'emnam nɛ banɛ namisidim zu'oya, amaa m pʋ fɛndig ka basi fʋ zi'ela laa.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Man ɛɛnti gɔsi nyɛ banɛ pʋ niŋif yadda la, li duodi m sʋʋnr ban pʋ siakidi fʋ pian'ad la zug.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Gɔsim man nɔŋi fʋ pa'alʋg la si'em; guri m nyɔvʋr, Zugsɔba, wʋʋ fʋ nɔŋilim an si'em la.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Fʋ pian'ad wʋsa anɛ sida; fʋ pʋpielim zi'ela la wʋsa pʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ la namisidim nɛ zaalim-zaalim amaa mam sʋnfʋn dabiem mɔrim nɛ fʋ pian'ad la.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: M mɔr sumalisim nɛ fʋ kaanbʋg la yɛla wʋʋ sɔ' na nyaŋi faaɛn la'ad zaba ni lɛb.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: M kis linɛ an ziri ka pʋ bɔɔdi lii, amaa m nɔŋi fʋ wada la.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Daar wʋsa m zun'odif nɛ nɔɔr ayɔpɔi fʋ pʋpielim wada la zug.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Banɛ nɔŋi fʋ wada la mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm ka li zu'oe, ka si'el kae na kɛ ka ba tu'ugi lii.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, m gu'usidi fʋ faangir la, ka dɔlli fʋ zi'ela la.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: M siakidi fʋ zi'ela la, man nɔŋi li bɛdegʋ la zug.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: M siakidi fʋ pa'alʋg nɛ fʋn tis nɔɔr si'em la, bɔzugɔ fʋ mi' m suoya wʋsa.

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: O m Zugsɔba, kɛl ka m kaasig paae fʋ san'an na; ka kɛ ka m gban'adi fʋ pian'ad la gbin.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m winsɔsʋg paae fʋ san'an; faanmim wʋʋ fʋn kaanb si'em la.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m nɔɔr na pɛ'ɛl nɛ fʋ zʋn'or ma'aa, fʋn pa'animi fʋ wada la zug.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m zilim na yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ pian'ad la yɛla, bɔzugɔ fʋ zi'ela la wʋsa anɛ linɛ nar.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ nu'ug tiel na sʋŋim, man gaŋi fʋ pa'alʋg la zug.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ faangir la ya'amlɛogʋ kʋʋdi m, ka m ya'am kpɛn' fʋ wada la hali.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m vʋe ka dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr, ka kɛ ka fʋ wada la kpɛmisimim.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: M bɛllim la nwɛnɛ pɛ'og kanɛ bɔdignɛ, ieem man kanɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋm la ka m pʋ tami fʋ nɔzi'ela laa.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: M daa buol Zugsɔb la m sʋnsa'aŋ saŋa, ka o wʋm tisim.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: M daa yɛl ye, “O Zugsɔba, kem na faanmi yis faad nɛ ziri dim la nu'usin.”

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Ziri dim nwa', Wina'am na tʋmi ya tʋʋma o na namisi ya hali ka ya baŋ.

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: O na zaŋ zabzabidib piema namisi ya, ka vʋʋnli ya nɛ bugumsaan tʋʋlʋg.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Tɔɔg paadim nɛ mam bɛ Mesek teŋin, nɛ Kedar dim sʋga ni la!

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: M bɛ nɛ banɛ kis sumbʋgʋsʋm la ka li yuug hali.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Man anɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm sɔb amaa m ya'a pian' li anɛ zaba ma'aa.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: M ʋki m nindaa gɔs zuoya zug. Ya ka m sʋŋir na yina?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: M sʋŋir yitnɛ Zugsɔb la san'an na, onɛ maal arezana nɛ dunia la.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: O kʋ kɛ ka fʋ nɔbir sadigɛ, onɛ gurif la kʋ zɔɔnsim.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Asida onɛ gur Israel la kʋ zɔɔnsim bɛɛ gbisɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la gurif, Zugsɔb la aan fʋ datiuŋ nu'ug ma'asim.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Nintaŋ kʋ daamif dabisir pʋʋginɛ, bɛɛ nwadpielig daamif yʋ'ʋŋɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na yisif yɛlbɛ'ɛd pʋʋgin, o na guri fʋ nyɔvʋr;

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na guri fʋ yiib nɛ fʋ kpɛn'ɛb nannanna nɛ saŋa kanɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: M mɔr sumalisim nɛ banɛ yɛlim ye, “Kɛl ka ti keŋ Zugsɔb yin la.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Nannanna ti paae na! Jerusalem, ti zi'enɛ fʋ za'anɔɔrin la.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Jerusalem nwɛnɛ tempʋʋg kanɛ vɛnl ka kpɛn' sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Anina ka Israel dɔɔd la ken, banɛ an Zugsɔb buudi la, ba kennɛ dʋ'ʋsid Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr nwɛnɛ lin zi'el Israel dim yɛla si'em la.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Ani ka David na'am gbauŋ la bɛ, ani ka ba zin' kad saria.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Sɔsim ye sumbʋgʋsʋm na bɛ Jerusalem: “Banɛ nɔŋif la na bɛ ka dabiem kae.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Sumbʋgʋsʋm na bɛɛ fʋ teŋ la pʋʋgin ka dabiem kʋ bɛɛ fʋ kpi'euŋ zin'isin la.”

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: M ba'abiis nɛ m zuanam zugɔɔ, m na yɛl ye, “Sumalisim na bɛ nɛf.”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb Wina'am Yir la zugɔɔ, m na sɔsi ya sʋm yɛla.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Wina'am, fʋn ka man kʋdim gɔsid, fʋn kanɛ ka fʋ na'am gbauŋ bɛ arezana la.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Zɔmi ti nimbaanlig, O Zugsɔbaa, zɔmi ti nimbaanlig, ka ti yʋ'ʋn gɛn nɛ'ɛsʋg nɛ.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Ti gɛn banɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ la la'ad, tita'alnam la nɛ'ɛsʋg zu'oe nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb la ya'a ka'anɛ ti san'anɛ,” kɛl ka Israel dim yɛl ye,

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb la ya'a ka'anɛ ti san'anɛ, nidib la daa zabid nɛ ti la,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: ba sʋnfʋ daa duoe nɛ ti la, ba daa naan vɔlini ti vʋt.

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: Ba sumpɛɛn linɛ nwɛnɛ ku'om la naan limini ti ka ku'onwiis la mɔri ti keŋ.

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: Ku'om linɛ pʋbid nɛ sʋnpɛɛn la naan mɔrini ti keŋ.”

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Ti pʋ'ʋsid Zugsɔb la bareka on pʋ kɛ ka ba aansi ti bɛnnim la.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Ti sʋŋir bɛ nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋrin onɛ maal arezana nɛ teŋgbauŋ la.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Banɛ tis Zugsɔb sida la nwɛnɛ Zion zuor, linɛ pʋ vurigida ka kpɛm bɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ zuoya gilig Jerusalem si'em la, ala ka Zugsɔb la mɛ gilig o nidib la nannanna nɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Bugusim dim kʋ lɛn sʋ'oe teŋ la, teŋ kanɛ an pʋpielim dim faar la, ka li zug ti kɛ ka pʋpielim dim la nu'us tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Zugsɔbaa, tʋm sʋm tis banɛ an ninsʋma la, nɛ banɛ siakidi fʋ nɔɔr la!

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ fɛndigi dɔl suobɛ'ɛdnam la Zugsɔb la na kadi ba la'an nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la yis. Sumalisim na bɛ Israel zugin.

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la daa mɔri ti lɛb Zion na la, ti daa nyɛ ka li nwɛnɛ nidibi na zaansim nɛ.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: La'ad ma'aa daa pɛ'ɛli ti nɔɔrin, ka ti yʋ'ʋm sumalisim yʋʋma. Ka tembanɛ daa giligi ti la yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la tʋm tʋʋm titada tisi ba.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sid tʋm tʋʋm titada tisi ti, ka ti mɔr sumalisim.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, lɛn lɛbisi ti bareka la na ya'as wʋʋ Negef teŋ pipirisin ku'osuoya pʋbidi lɛbid si'em la.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Banɛ bʋt nɛ ninta'am la na bʋn ka yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Onɛ yit ka kum, ka ziid kibʋʋda ye o bʋd la, o sɔb na lɛbid ka yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim, ka ziid ki bɔba bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ya'a pʋ mɛ yirɛ, tanmɛɛdib la namisidnɛ zaalim. Zugsɔb la ya'a pʋ gur teŋa, banɛ gur la namisidnɛ zaalim.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Fʋ dɛŋid duor bɛkɛung asuba tʋm diib yɛla hali ka winnig ti li, amaa fʋ namisʋg la wʋsa anɛ zaalim, bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb la kɛt ka banɛ ka o nɔŋ la gbisid.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Biis anɛ piini yit Zugsɔb la ni, biis anɛ o piini.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Biis banɛ ka fʋ du'a ba fʋ na'akinnim bɛɛ fʋ pu'asatim saŋa la nwɛnɛ piema banɛ bɛ zabzabid nu'usin.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ onɛ ka piema nwa' pɛ'ɛl o lɔkin. On nɛ o dataa ya'a paam nɔŋgbannwa'ar o kʋ di nyannɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb ka dɔl o suoya la.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Fʋ na dii fʋ tʋʋma la nyɔɔd, fʋ na mɔr albareka ka si'el wʋsa an sʋ'ʋŋa tisif.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Fʋ yipu'a na nwɛnɛ tikanɛ wan wala nɛ fʋ yin la; fʋ biis na nwɛnɛ olif tibaanlʋg nɛ giligi fʋ diib zin'ig.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ zɔt Zugsɔb ka siakid o nɔɔr la na nyɛ bareka kaŋa buudi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na naan Zion Zuor zugʋ niŋif bareka fʋ nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsa ni; fʋ na nyɛ bareka linɛ na kɛn Jerusalem na,

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: ka na vʋe hali ti nyɛɛ fʋ yaas. Sumalisim na bɛ Israel zugin.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Israel dima yɛlimi ye, “Ba mugusim hali m dasannim saŋa ti paae zina.”

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Ba mugusim hali, m dasannim saŋa, amaa ba pʋ nyaŋi ma.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Nidib fiebim ka m nya'aŋ bɔɔnri bɔɔnr nwɛnɛ vugus ka ba nwɛ' nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la anɛ pʋpielim sɔb; o kɛns bugusnam la nwiis la ka faanmi bas.”

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Banɛ kis Zion la wʋsa na fɛndigi lɛb nɛ nyan.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba na nwɛnɛ mɔbanɛ yi dɔɔg zug, ka pʋ nɔbigɛ ka ʋki kpi.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa dɔl ani gat kʋ pʋ'ʋsi ba ye, “Tʋʋma-tʋʋma”, bɛɛ yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la bareka na bɛ nɛ ya; ti niŋi ya bareka Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr zugɔ.”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: M sʋnsa'aŋ pʋʋgin ka m kaasi tisif, O Zugsɔba,

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, wʋmmi m kukuma. Digilimi fʋ tʋbiri kɛlis sʋ'ʋŋa ka wʋmi m kaasig ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Zugsɔbaa, fʋ ya'a ye fʋ sɔbid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi digin na, anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi zi'enɛ, Zugsɔba?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn anɛ onɛ kɛt nidib taali basid; alazugʋ kɛ ka ba zɔtif la.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: M gu'usidi Zugsɔb la, m sʋnf gu'usid o nɛ, o pian'ad la ni ka m ti'ir bɛ.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: M sʋnf gu'usid Zugsɔb la gaad banɛ gur yiri gu'usid bɛog nier si'em, m sid gu'usidif hali gaad banɛ gur yiri gu'usid bɛog nier si'em la.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Niŋimi Zugsɔb la yadda, yanam Israel dima, ka Zugsɔb la san'an ka nɔŋilim linɛ ka' naar la bɛ; o san'an mɛn ka faangir bɛ sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: On mɛŋ na faaɛn Israel ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa pʋʋgin.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, mam pʋ dʋ'ʋsidi m mɛŋa, m mɛ ka' nimpʋnanna; M pʋ kpɛn'ɛsidi m mɛŋ yɛlbɛda nii bɛɛ yɛlbanɛ kpi'emi gati ma.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Amaa m gban'e m mɛŋi an baanlimm; wʋʋ bikanɛ ka ba tuk o bin'isire dig o ma tuon si'em la, m sʋnf anɛ baanlimm wʋʋ biig nɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Israel dima, nɔkimi ya ti'iri niŋ Zugsɔb la san'an nannanna nɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, tiɛnm David yɛla nɛ mugusʋg linɛ wʋsa paae o la.

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: O zi'el nɔɔri tis Zugsɔb la ka pɔɔ zi'el onɛ an Jakob Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la ye,

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “M kʋ kpɛn' m yin bɛɛ digini m sɔŋinɛ.

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: hali nɛ mam na ti nyɛ zin'igi tis Zugsɔb la; zin'ikanɛ an Jakob Paŋtita'ar Sɔb din la.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Ti wʋmi li yɛla Efirata teŋin, ka nyɛɛ li Jaar sʋ'ʋlimin, ka yɛl ye,

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: “Kɛlli ka ti keŋ o bɛllim zin'igin la; ka paae o na'am gbauŋ la tuonnɛ zun'e o.

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: Duom, O Zugsɔba, kemi fʋ vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'igin la na, fʋn nɛ fʋ Nɔnaar Daka linɛ aan fʋ paŋ zanbin la.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ maanmaannib la yɛ pʋpielim wʋʋ fuugnɛ; ka fʋ tʋmtʋmnib la yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim.”

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pɔɔ zi'el David ka kʋ yii o nɔpɔɔr la nya'aŋa. O yɛl ye, “Fʋ mɛŋ yaas la yinne ka m na zin'ili fʋ na'am gbauŋ la zug.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Fʋ biis la ya'a dɔlisidi m nɔnaar la nɛ zi'ela banɛ ka m pa'ali ba la, ba biis na zin'inɛ fʋ na'am gbauŋ la zug saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la gaŋ Zion Zuor la, o bɔɔd ye li an o bɛllim zin'ig, ka yɛl ye,

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: “M vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'igi nwa' saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ; kpɛla ka m na zin' m na'am gbauŋ zug, bɔzugɔ mam mɛŋi bɔɔdi li.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: M na tis teŋ la bareka ka li na mɔr la'ad bɛdegʋ. M na kɛ ka nɔŋ dim la dii tig.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka o maanmaannib la yɛ faangir wʋʋ fuug nɛ, ka o tʋmtʋmnib la na yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Kpɛla ka m na kɛ ka na'atita'ar yi David gbinnin na, ka kɛ ka man gaŋ sɔ' la nie wʋʋ bugum nɛ.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka nyan dii o dataas, ka o na'am la na bɛ saŋa wʋsa.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Ba'abiis ya'a la'as taaba bɛ nɛ nɔɔr yinne li anɛ sʋm ka malisi galis!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Li nwɛnɛ malʋŋ kpaam linɛ ka ba bu'oe niŋ Aaron zugin, ka li buoɛndi sigid o tieŋin, hali paae o fuug niŋgɔɔnrin.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Li nwɛnɛ Hemon zuorin mɛligim lit Zion Zuorin si'em la. Ani ka Zugsɔb tisid albareka, hali nɛ vʋm linɛ bɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi Zugsɔb la bareka, yanam banɛ an Zugsɔb tʋmtʋmnib la wʋsa, yanam banɛ tʋm Zugsɔb la Yin yʋ'ʋŋ la.

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Ʋkimi ya nu'us Zugsɔb pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka pʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la bareka.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ maal arezana nɛ dunia la na naam Zion Zuorin la tisi ya bareka.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya! Zun'omi Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr; zun'omi nɛ o, yanam banɛ an Zugsɔb tʋmtʋmnib la.

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ tʋm Zugsɔb pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, yanam banɛ tʋmi ti Wina'am Yir zakin la.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, ka Zugsɔb la an sʋm; yʋ'ʋm zun'e nɛ o yʋ'ʋr la, ka linɛ malis.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la gaŋ Jakob ka o an o mɛŋ din, Israel dimi an o nyɔɔrin kɔnbʋg.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: M mi' ye Zugsɔb la zu'oya, ti Wina'am la zu'oe gat wina wʋsa.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la maannɛ linɛ wʋsa malis o, agɔla nɛ teŋin, atɛukʋn nɛ zin'ibanɛ zulim la wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: O kɛt ka saŋgbana yit teŋiri dʋtna; onɛ tisid saa nɛ sa-ian'asʋg ka yisid sisi'em la o suak zin'igin na.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Onɛ da kʋ Egipt bikpɛɛmnam, nɛ ba bʋnkɔnbid bikpɛɛmnam la wʋsa.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: O da tʋm o zanbina nɛ nyalima Egipt teŋin, zabid Na'ab Faaro nɛ o tʋmtʋmnib la wʋsa.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: O san'am tɛɛns bɛdegʋ ka kʋ na'atitada.

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: O kʋ Sihon onɛ an Amor dim na'ab la, nɛ Og onɛ an Basan na'ab nɛ Keenan na'anam la wʋsa.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ yʋ'ʋr la bɛ nɛ saŋa wʋsa, O Zugsɔba, fʋ anɛ yʋ'ʋr daan zʋmaana wʋsa ni.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na tis o nidib la bʋʋd ka zɔɔ o tʋmtʋmnib la nimbaanlig.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Teŋ sieba bada anɛ anzurifa nɛ sanlima, ka nidib maali ba nɛ ba nu'us.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Ba mɔr nɔya, amaa ka kʋ nyaŋi pian', ba mɔr nini ka pʋ nyɛta;

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: ba mɔr tʋba amaa ka pʋ wʋmma, ka vʋ'ʋsʋm kae ba nɔɔrinɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Banɛ maali ba la na nwɛnɛ ba nɛ, ban nɛ banɛ niŋi ba yadda la wʋsa.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Israel dima, zun'omi Zugsɔb la; Aaron yidima, zun'omi Zugsɔb la;

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Levi yidima, zun'omi Zugsɔb la; yanam banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la, zun'omin o.

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Zun'or yitnɛ Zion Zuorin la na tisid Zugsɔb la, li tisid on kanɛ bɛ Jerusalem la. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi Zugsɔb la bareka on an sʋm la zug. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi Zugsɔb onɛ an wina wʋsa Wina'am la. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi zugsɔbnam Zugsɔb la. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: On ma'aa tʋm tʋʋmnyalima. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onɛ zaŋ ya'am maal saŋgbana. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onɛ da yadig teŋgbauŋʋ pa'al ku'om zug. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onɛ maal bugum titada la. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ka kɛ ka winnig sʋ'oe nintaŋ, O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ka nwadig nɛ nwadbibis la sʋ'oe yʋ'ʋŋ; O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onɛ da kʋ Egipt dim bikpɛɛmnam. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ka yis Israel dim la ba sʋʋgin na. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onɛ da yisi ba nɛ o nu'ug kanɛ kpi'em ka mɔr paŋ la. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onɛ da pʋdig Atɛuk Zɛn'ug. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ka mɔr Israel dim la dɔlli li sʋʋgin yina, O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Amaa ka kɛ ka Atɛuk Zɛn'ug ku'om di Faaro nɛ o zabzabidib. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onɛ da mɔr o nidibi dɔlisi yi sian'arin na la. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onɛ da kʋ na'atitada O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ka kʋ na'akpi'ema O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O da kʋ Sihon onɛ an Amor dim na'ab la. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nɛ Og onɛ an Basan na'ab la. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Li anɛ faari tis o nidib Israel dim la. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: On kanɛ da tɛn'ɛsi ti yɛlaa, saŋkan ka ti da an tadimnam la. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ka faaɛn ti, ti dataas nu'usin ka tisi ti yɔlisim. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onɛ tisid bʋnvʋya wʋsa diib. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi arezana Wina'am la bareka. O nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ tɛn'ɛs Zion yɛla la ti zin'in Babilon kɔldaad la nɔɔrin kaas.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Ani ka ti nɔki ti kɔna la ya'al tiis zug.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Ani ka banɛ gban'e ti la yɛl ye ti yʋ'ʋm, banɛ daa namisidi ti la yɛl ye ti yʋ'ʋm sumalisim yʋʋma; ba yɛl ye, “Yʋ'ʋmmi Zion yʋʋma la yinne!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Ti na niŋ wala bɛ teŋ zʋŋ ka yʋ'ʋm Zugsɔb la yʋʋma?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Jerusalem, m ya'a tam fʋ yɛla m mɛ na tami m nu'ug tʋʋm.

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: M ya'a tami fʋ yɛla bɛɛ m pʋ gɔs ka Jerusalem gaad si'el wʋsa, fʋn kɛl ka m zilim tabinɛ m nɔɔrin sa.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: O Zugsɔbaa, tiɛnm Edom dim la daa maal si'el daakanɛ ka ti bi'emnam daa nyaŋ Jerusalem la. Ba daa kaas kuŋ ye, “Nwa'ami li, nwa'ami, nwa'ami li paae teŋin!”

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: San'auŋ na paaf, Babilon! Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ onɛ na maalif nwɛnɛ fʋn daa san'ami ti teŋ si'em la.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Ala ka ba na nɔki fʋ bibibisi fanb nɛ tampiins la wʋʋ fʋn daa niŋi ti si'em la.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, m na zʋn'ʋf nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa; m na yʋ'ʋm zʋn'ʋf “wina” la tuon.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: M na sʋ'ʋnnɛ kpa' fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kanɛ an Kasi la ka zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr fʋ nɔŋilim nɛ fʋ sida la zug, bɔzugɔ, fʋ kɛya ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr nɛ fʋ pian'ʋk la gaad si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Man buol la, fʋ siaki tisim; fʋ tisim sʋnkpi'euŋ ka kpɛmisimim.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, dunia na'anam ya'a wʋm fʋ nɔɔr pian'ad ba wʋsa na zʋn'ʋf hali.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Ba na yʋ'ʋm Zugsɔb la an si'em la yɛla, bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb la na'am pipilim sid zu'oya.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ Zugsɔb la bɛɛ agɔla lalli la, o gɔsid tadimnam, amaa banɛ mɔr nyɛɛsim la o bɛ nɛ lalli ka kpansidi ba.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ man ken yɛla pʋʋgin la, fʋ guri m nyɔvʋr; fʋ tiɛn fʋ nu'ugʋ gu' m bi'emnam banɛ sʋnya pɛlig la lɛbis, fʋ paŋ tita'ar la ka fʋ nɔki faanm.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na maal on zi'el si'em tisim la; O m Zugsɔba, fʋ nɔŋilim la bɛ nɛ saŋa wʋsa, da bas tinam banɛ ka fʋ maal la.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, fʋ kpansimi gɔs ka baŋim sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Fʋ mi' m zin'ig nɛ m duor saŋa; la'an nɛ fʋn bɛ lalli la fʋ mi' m pʋtɛnda wʋsa.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Fʋ mi' m yiib saŋa nɛ diginʋg saŋa; fʋ mi' m suoya la wʋsa.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, pian'ʋkʋ ti bɛɛ m nɔɔrin saŋsi'a la ka fʋ pʋn baŋi li.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Fʋ bɛɛ m tuon nɛ m nya'aŋ wʋsa; ka kɛ ka fʋ paŋ la bɛ nɛ m.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Baŋir kaŋa buudi anɛ nyalima tisim, li zu'onɛ galis ka m kʋ nyaŋi gban'e li gbinnɛ.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: M na niŋ wala keŋ ka fʋ siig la pʋ bɛɛ m san'anɛ? M na niŋ wala zɔ ka basi fɔ?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: M ya'a dʋ saŋgbana ni fʋ bɛɛ anina; M ya'a maali m dig zin'ig kpi'im teŋ fʋ bɛɛ ani.

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: M ya'a mɔrin kpʋkpama na nyaŋi iank wʋʋ bɛogʋ nied si'em la, bɛɛ m zin'inɛ atɛuk nɔɔrin lallisa,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: hali la'an nɛ ani, fʋ paŋ la nan kpɛn gurim, fʋ datiuŋ nu'ug kanɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ la na kpɛn zanlim.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: M ya'a yɛl ye, “Sida, lik la na su'am ka nɛɛsim lieb yʋ'ʋŋʋ giligim,”

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: hali lik la kʋ an zibisʋgʋ fʋ san'anɛ; li na nie nwɛnɛ nintaŋ, bɔzugɔ lik la nwɛnɛ nintaŋi fʋ san'an.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ maali m sʋnf; ka ya'abi mɛ niŋi m ma pʋʋgin.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: M zun'odif bɔzugɔ, fʋ maalim nɛ ka m an bʋnnyalʋŋ nɛ bʋnzɔtir. M mi' fʋ tʋʋmnyalima la yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Man da an si'em la pʋ su'a fʋ san'anɛ; man da su'a m ma pʋʋgin nɔbigid la, nɛ m niŋgbina la da tɔ'ɔŋid taaba teŋ teŋir la,

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: fʋ nini da nyɛɛm ka ba nam pʋ du'a ma. Dabisa banɛ aan m din la wʋsa pʋn sɔbi digili fʋ gbauŋʋn la ka ba wʋsa naan kɛn yinne-yinne na.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: O Wina'am, fʋn tɛn'ɛsidi m yɛla si'em la anɛ sʋm galis! Ba kal zu'onɛ hali!

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
