translation_verse: M ya'a ye m kaali ba, ba na zu'oe gaad titanbin'isi. M ya'a gbisi duoe m nan kpɛm bɛ nɛ fʋ san'an.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: O Wina'am, m bɔɔdi fʋn na kʋ bugusnam la wʋsa! Tɔɔmini m san'an, yanam banɛ an ninkʋʋdib la!

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Ba pian'adi fʋ yɛla nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd; fʋ bi'emnam la san'amidi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, man kis banɛ kisif la ka nɛ'ɛsid banɛ zan'asi fʋ nɔɔr la.

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: M kisi ba nɛ amɛŋa mɛŋa, ka kaali ba paasi m dataasin.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Kpansimim ka baŋi m pʋtɛn'ɛr; Makimim ka gɔsi m sʋnfʋ an si'em.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Gɔsim ye bɛ'ɛd bɛɛ m san'anɛɛ, ka mɔrimi dɔlis suokanɛ pʋ mɔr bɛn la ni.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: Faanmim nimbɛ'ɛdnam la nu'usin, O Zugsɔba; gurim ka banɛ bɔɔd zaba la da nyɛɛ ma,

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: Ba gban'adnɛ pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛdi ba sʋnya ni ka kɔɔd zaba daar wʋsa.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Ba zilima ditnɛ nwɛnɛ wa'abɛ'og zilim nɛ; ka dunduug yabid bɛɛ ba nɔŋgbana ni.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: Gurim, O Zugsɔba, ka da kɛ ka m li bugusim dim nu'usinɛ ka gu' banɛ an zabzabidib ka gban'adi m yɛla bɛ'ɛd la.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Tita'alnam la bɛndim nɛ baans; ba ʋgnɛ zulisi digili gilig zin'ig wʋsa ka bɛnd baansi dɔlisi m suor.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, m yɛlif ye, “Fʋnɛ aan m Wina'am.” Wʋmi m kaasig, ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig.

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, fʋnɛ an kpi'euŋ sɔb ka faandim ka lusidi m zug zabbɔn'ɔgin.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka m bi'emnam la nyɛ ban bɔɔd si'ela; da kɛ ka ba gban'ar zi'enɛ, ka ya'a ka' ala, ba nyɛɛsim la na zu'oe galis.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Banɛ giligim la wʋsa, kɛl ka ba mɛŋ nɔɔr pian'ad zi yɛla na gɛɛli ba.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka bugumsaana linɛ mu'oe wii lii ba zugin; kɛl ka ba da'ae ba bas bʋmbɔk kanɛ ka bian'ar bɛ ka ba kʋ lɛn nyaŋi dʋ naa.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, m mi' ye fʋ tisid nɔŋ dim la bʋʋd ka sʋŋid fara dim.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Sida, pʋpielim dim na zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr ka banɛ pʋ mɔr gba'ar la na bɛ fʋ tuon.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, m buonif, kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na. M ya'a buol, fʋn wʋmmi m.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m winsɔsʋg paae fʋ san'an na wʋʋ bʋnnyubisa nɛ; ka kɛ ka m ya'a ʋki m nu'us ka li nwɛnɛ zaamnɔɔr maannɛ.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: Sʋŋimim ka m guri m nɔɔr, O Zugsɔba; ka gu'usidi m nɔŋgban ya'ar.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka m pʋtɛn'ɛr lɛb linɛ an bɛ'ɛdin ka m tʋm linɛ an bugusim tʋʋma nɛ nimbanɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la; da kɛ ka m la'as nɛ ba dii ba diib la.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka pʋpiel sa'alim, ka nwɛ'ɛm ka li an sʋ'ʋŋa; kɛl ka o tansim, ka li nwɛnɛ kpaam ka o suoɛn m zug, ka m kʋ zan'asi lii. Man sɔsnɛ Wina'am ye o gu'omi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Ba na naan tampiins zugʋ lɔbi ba tuongatib la bas na, din ka bugusim dim la na baŋ ye, m pian'ad la anɛ sida.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Ba na yɛl ye, “Nwɛnɛ sɔ' na kuod ka bʋ'ʋsid tandia'ana si'em la, ala ka ti kɔnba mɛ widig yaʋg nɔɔrin.”

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Amaa, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, m nindaa kpa'anɛ gɔsidif; fʋ san'an ka m su'a, da kɛ ka m kpii.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka bugusim dim la lii ba mɛŋi bɛnd si'el la ni, ka man luaki gaadnɛ laafi.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: M kaas agɔla tis Zugsɔb la; m dʋ'ʋsi m kʋkɔri buol Zugsɔb ye o zɔɔm nimbaanlig.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: O tuon ka m zaŋi m fabʋlʋgʋ digil; o tuon ka m zaŋi m yɛla yɛl o.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: M sʋʋnr ya'a ti san'am, fʋnɛ mi' linɛ bɛɛ m pʋtɛn'ɛrin. Suokanɛ ka m dɔl la, nidib su'a bɛndim baans ani.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: M gɔsi m datiuŋʋ nyɛ, ka sɔ' ba'a ka' nɛ ma. M pʋ mɔr suak zin'iga; sɔ' ba'a ka' nɛ m vʋm yɛla.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Fʋn ka m kaasidi tisid, O m Zugsɔba; m yɛl ye, “Fʋnɛ an m suak zin'ig, nɛ m mɔrim, zin'ikanɛ ka vʋm dim bɛ la.”

english_verse: Help! They are chasing me, and they are too strong.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi m kaasig, ka m bɛ nɛ yɛlpakir pʋʋgin; faanmim banɛ katim la nu'usin, ka ba paŋ gatim.

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Tisimim yɔlisim yɛlmugusa la pʋʋgin, ka m nyaŋi zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr. Ala ka pʋpielim dim na la'asi m san'an na, fʋn maalim sʋm si'em la zug.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Wʋmi m winsɔsʋg, O m Zugsɔba, kɛlisimi m kaasig ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig; fʋ sida nɛ fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr la zug, kem na tisim vʋ'ʋsʋm.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: M anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm, da kadi m sariaa, ka sɔ' pʋn kae an pʋpieli fʋ tuonnɛ.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Dataa la katim nɛ, ka nwɛ'ɛmi bas teŋin; o kɛnɛ ka m bɛ likin ka nwɛnɛ banɛ kpi ka li yuug la.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Ala ka m sʋʋnr san'am; ka m ti'ir wʋsa naae.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: M tɛnr dabisa banɛ gaad ka li yuug la yɛla; m tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ tʋʋma la wʋsa yɛla ka tiɛn fʋ nu'usi da tʋm si'el la.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: M ʋki m nu'usi tisif ka sɔsidif; m siig bɔɔdif nwɛnɛ pipirigi bɔɔd ku'om si'em la.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Di'emi m sɔsʋg tɔ'ɔtɔ, O Zugsɔba; ka m ti'ir naanɛ. Da su'a fʋ nindaa ka kɛɛ ma; ya'a ka' ala m na nwɛnɛ banɛ kpii dig yaʋgʋn la.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m nyɛti fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ ka' naar la bɛkɛung wʋsa, ka fʋn ka m tis sida. Pa'alimim suor kanɛ ka m na dɔl, ka fʋ san'an ka m mɔri m winsɔsʋgʋ kenna.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, faanmim m dataas la nu'usin, ka fʋ san'an ka m su'a m mɛŋ.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Pa'alimim ka m tʋmmi fʋ bɔɔdim, ka fʋnɛ aan m Wina'am; kɛl ka fʋ Siig Sʋŋ la mɔrimi dɔlis suosʋŋin.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Zugsɔbaa, fʋ yʋ'ʋr zug, guri m nyɔvʋr; fʋ pʋpielim la zugɔ, yisimim yɛla pʋʋgin.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋilim zu'oe m san'an si'em la zug, san'ami m bi'emnam la, ka m anɛ fʋ sankpan'as.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb onɛ an m Tampiing la, onɛ pa'annɛ m nu'us tanp nwɛ'ɛb, ka pa'annɛ m nu'ubibis zaba.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Onɛ aan m Wina'am kanɛ nɔŋim, nɛ m kpi'euŋ zin'ig, onɛ aan m kpi'euŋ sɔb nɛ m faangid, onɛ aan m gbanti'edʋg, ka m su'adim mɛŋ o san'an, ka o nyaŋ tɛɛns banɛ bɛɛ m san'an la ka kɛ ka m sʋ'ʋgi ba.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, ninsaal an bɔ ka fʋ ba'a bɛ nɛ o? Ninvʋsaalib an bɔ ka fʋ tɛn'ɛsidi ba yɛla?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Ninsaal nwɛnɛ pɛbisim na yi nyɔnya ni na; o dabisa nwɛnɛ ma'asim tuligid tɔ'ɔtɔ si'em la.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, aansimi fʋ saŋgbana la, ka sig na; si'isim zuoya la, ka kɛ ka nyɔ'ɔs yina.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka saa tansi widigi fʋ dataas la; tɔɔnmi fʋ piema la ka ba zɔɔ widig.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Naanim agɔla tiɛn fʋ nu'ug teŋin na faanmi bas; ka yaam ku'otita'ar la pʋʋgin ka yisim teŋ zʋŋ dim la nu'usin,

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: banɛ nɔya pɛ'ɛl nɛ faad ma'aa, ka ba nan zi' pian' sida baa bi'ela la.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: M na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋm paalli tisif, O Wina'am; M na nwɛ' kɔnne yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma tisif

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: fʋn Onɛ tisid na'anam nyaŋir, ka sʋŋid David onɛ aan fʋ sankpan'asi, yisid o zaba linɛ ziid kum la na pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Faanmim ka yisim teŋ zʋŋ dim la nu'usin banɛ nɔya pɛ'ɛl nɛ faad ma'aa, ka nan zi' pian' sida baa bi'ela la.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Ala ka ti biribis na nwɛnɛ tibanɛ ka ba gu'uli ba sʋ'ʋŋa ba na'akinnim saŋa nɛ, ka ti bipumis na nwɛnɛ zan'antɔlis banɛ ka ba kpi'e ba maal na'ayir ye li vɛnl.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Ti bʋya na pɛ'ɛl sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ zʋʋd buudi wʋsa. Ti pɛ'ɛs na wiak tusa piig-piig ban kemmi ba zin'isi'a la;

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: ka ti niigi na mɔr paŋi ziid zitɛbisa. Ba kʋ lɛn da'ae ti teŋ la zaŋguoma basɛ, ba mɛ kʋ gban'e ti keŋ teŋ zʋŋɔ, kaasig bɛɛ sʋnsa'aŋ kʋ lɛm bɛɛ ti suoraadinɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ banɛ ka li sid na niŋ ala tisi ba, nimbanɛ ka Zugsɔb aan ba Wina'am la.

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: M na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr, m Wina'am onɛ an Na'aba; m na zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: M na zʋn'ʋf daar wʋsa ka na'asif saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la galis nɛ ka nar nɛ zʋn'or; sɔ' kae na nyaŋi maki baŋ on galis si'em la.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Zʋmaaŋ yinne na pa'ali fʋ yɛla tis zʋmaʋŋ yinne; ba na yɛli fʋ tʋʋm titada la an si'em.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Ba na pian' fʋ na'am pipilim nɛ fʋ vɛnlim la yɛla, ka mam mɛ na tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ tʋʋmnyalima la an si'em.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Ba na yɛli fʋ tʋʋm kpi'ema nɛ fʋ zɔtim la yɛla, ka mam na mɔɔli fʋ tʋʋm titada an si'em.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Ba na maal sumalisim di'ema fʋn an sʋm ka zu'oe si'em la zug, ka yʋʋm nɛ sumalisim fʋ pʋpielim la yɛla.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an sʋm ka an nimbaanlzɔt, o nɔŋilim zu'oya, ka o sʋnf pʋ duod tɔ'ɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an sʋm tis sɔ' wʋsa; on maal si'el la wʋsa, o zɔti li nimbaanlig.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋn maal si'el la wʋsa na zʋn'ʋf ka fʋ nidib la wʋsa pʋ'ʋsif bareka.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Ba na yɛli fʋ na'am la vɛnlim ka pian' fʋ kpi'euŋ la yɛla.

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: Ala ka nidib na baŋi fʋ tʋʋma an si'em nɛ fʋ na'am la mɔr pipilim ka vɛnl si'em.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Fʋ sʋ'ʋlim la na yuug ka kʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ, ka zʋmaana wʋsa na nyɛɛ fʋ na'am la. Zugsɔb la dɔlisid on kaanb si'em la nɛ sida ka nɔŋ on maal si'el la wʋsa.

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ti'ed banɛ bɔɔd liig la ka duosid banɛ dig teŋinɛ zi'el agɔla.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Nidib wʋsa kpa' gɔsidi fʋ, ka fʋ tisidi ba diib saŋa kanɛ nar.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Fʋ laki fʋ nu'us ka tisid bʋnvʋr wʋsa o bɔɔdim.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mɔr pʋpielim o suoya wʋsa ni, ka nɔŋ on maal si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la li'ennɛ banɛ wʋsa buol o, o li'en banɛ wʋsa buol o nɛ sida la.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Banɛ zɔt o la, o tisidi ba, ba bɔɔdim; o wʋmi ba kaasig ka faandi ba.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la gur banɛ nɔŋ o la wʋsa, amaa o na san'am bugusim dim la wʋsa.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: M nɔɔr na pian' zun'e Zugsɔb la. Kɛl ka bʋnvʋr wʋsa zun'e o yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya! M siigaa zun'om Zugsɔb la!

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: M na zun'e Zugsɔb la m nyɔvʋr bɛllim saŋa; M na yʋ'ʋm zʋn'or yʋʋma tisim Wina'am la saŋa kanɛ ka m vʋe wʋsa.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Da nɔki fʋ ti'iri niŋ tuongatib banɛ an saalib la nii; ninsaal kae na nyaŋi faaɛn fɔ.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a kpi, ba lɛbidnɛ titanin; daakan la ya'a ti paae, ba gban'ar wʋsa liebidnɛ zaalim.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ onɛ sʋŋiri yit Jakob Wina'am san'an na, ka o ti'ir bɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan o Wina'am la ni.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Onɛ maal arezana nɛ teŋgbauŋ, ka maal atɛuk nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin la wʋsa, onɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ an sida sɔb, saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: O tu'adi tisid banɛ ka ba mugusidi ba la ka tisid banɛ ka kɔ'ɔm mɔri ba la diib. Zugsɔb la tisid banɛ bɛ sanrega ni la yɔlisim,

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la lakid zʋnzɔɔs nini; Zugsɔb la duosid banɛ li teŋin la, Zugsɔb la nɔŋ pʋpielim dim.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la gur saam ka sʋŋid kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya, amaa ka vi'id bugusim dim suoya.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an Na'ab saŋa wʋsa, Zion nidiba, ya Wina'am la na bɛɛ tis zʋmaana wʋsa. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya! Li an sʋm hali nɛ tinamɛ na yʋ'ʋm zun'e ti Wina'am la, li malis ka nar hali ye ti zun'e Zugsɔb la!

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la maligim mɛɛd Jerusalem; ka la'asid Israel dim banɛ widigi bɛ teŋ zʋna la lɛbisid na.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: O bʋgʋn banɛ sʋnya san'am la ka ti'ebidi ba sapu'ad.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: O mɛŋ pʋtɛn'ɛre gban'ad on bɔɔd ye nwadbibis la zem si'em ka buonnɛ ba yʋda yinne-yinne.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋŋid banɛ siedi ba mɛŋ la amaa ka kɛt ka bugusim dim la lit teŋin.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋmmi bareka pʋ'ʋsim yʋʋma tis Zugsɔb la; nwɛ'ɛmi kɔna tisi ti Wina'am la.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Onɛ pil agɔla nɛ saŋgbana; ka kɛ ka saa niidi basid teŋgbauŋ zug ka kɛ ka mɔɔd yi zuoya ni.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Onɛ tisid niigi diib ka diisid agaung biis ban bɔɔd diib saŋsi'a.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: O ya'amlɛog pʋ bɛ widi banɛ mɔr paŋ la nii, bɛɛ o mɔr nyɛlʋg nɛ ninsaalib nɔba kpi'em si'em;

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ya'amlɛog bɛ nɛ nimbanɛ zɔt o, nɛ banɛ nɔki ba ti'iri niŋ o nɔŋilim linɛ ka' bɛn la ni.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Zun'omi ya Zugsɔb la, O Jerusalem dima; Zun'omi ya Wina'am la, O Zion nidibaa,

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: ka li anɛ onɛ kɛ ka ya za'anɔya la kpi'em ka tisidi ya nidib la bareka.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: O kɛ ka sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛɛ ya titɔndisin ka kɛ ka ya nyɛt diib linɛ an sʋm diti tigid.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Onɛ tisid teŋgbauŋ la nɔɔr; ka o pian'ad la zɔt tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: O yadigid sakuga wʋʋ gungum nɛ, ka widigid mɛligim teŋin wʋʋ sisi'em da'ad uusʋg si'em la.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: O kɛ ka sakuga lit wʋʋ kugbaanlʋg nɛ. Anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi zi'en waad kanɛ ka o kpa'ae bas na la ni?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: O ɛɛn pian'anɛ tis ka li buoe; ka kɛ ka sisi'em da'ae ka ku'om la pʋbig.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: O nie o pian'adi tis Jakob yaas, o wada nɛ o gban'ar ka o tis Israel dim.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: O nan zi' maal nɛ'ɛŋa tis teŋ si'a; ba zi' o wada la. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya! Zun'omi Zugsɔb la saŋgbana ni, Zun'omi Zugsɔb la saazug.

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Zun'omin o, yanam banɛ aan o maliaknam la, Zun'omin o, yanam banɛ bɛɛ o san'an arezana ni la.

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Winnig nɛ nwadiga, zun'omin o, yanam banɛ an nwadbibis la wʋsa, zun'omin o.

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Zun'omin o, yanam saŋgbana banɛ bɛɛ agɔla nɛ ku'om linɛ bɛ saŋgbana zugin la.

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ba zun'e Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, ka onɛ da pian' ka ba naam.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: O zi'eli ba, ba bɛllim zin'ig ka ba bɛ saŋa wʋsa; onɛ tis on gban'e si'el la ka li kʋdim kʋ gaadɛ.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la teŋgbauŋʋn la, yanam bʋnvʋtitada banɛ bɛɛ atɛukʋn nɛ ku'ozulima ni la wʋsa;

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: sa-ian'asʋg nɛ sakuga, ku'om linɛ ga'aŋ nɛ saŋgbana, nɛ sisi'etita'ar siakid o nɔɔr.

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: Yanam zuoya nɛ kʋkʋna zun'omin o, tiis banɛ wan wala nɛ na'aziinr tiis;

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid nɛ niigi, bʋnvʋbaanlʋg nɛ niis banɛ ian'ad.

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: Na'anam banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ la zug nɛ tɛɛns la wʋsa,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: na'akim nɛ pu'asada, bʋnkʋd nɛ biis wʋsa zun'omin o.

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba zun'e Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, ka o yʋ'ʋr la ma'aa gaad si'el wʋsa; o vɛnlim la gat agɔla nɛ teŋin.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: O tis o nidib la paŋ, ka o nidib la zun'od o; o mɔr o nimbanɛ an Israel dim la nyɔɔg hali. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya! Yʋ'ʋmmi yʋʋm paalli tis Zugsɔb la, zun'omin o, o nidib la sʋʋgin.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka Israel dim mɔr sumalisim nɛ onɛ maali ba la; kɛl ka Zion nidib mɔr sumalisim nɛ ba Na'ab la.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba zun'e o yʋ'ʋr nɛ wa'a, ka nwɛ' kɔna nɛ siyada.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋnf malis nɛ o nidib la; o tisid banɛ siedi ba mɛŋ la faangir.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka o nidib la maal sumalisim ba nyaŋir la zug ka yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim ba dig zin'igin.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Wina'am zʋn'or na bɛɛ ba nɔya ni ka zaba sʋ'ʋs banɛ dit tuon nɛ nya'aŋ na bɛɛ ba nu'usin,

english_verse: Take revenge and punish the nations.
translation_verse: ye ba yɔ tɛɛns la sam ka namis buudi wʋsa nidib.

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Ba na lɔɔ ba na'anam nɛ bana, ka mɛ lɔɔ ba tuongatib la nɛ kʋnt baans,

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: tɛki ba tʋba wʋʋ ban kʋʋsi ba bɛ'ɛd si'em ka li pʋn sɔbi dig la. Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ yʋ'ʋri tis o nidib la. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya! Zun'omi Wina'am la o Pʋ'ʋsim Yir pʋʋgin; zun'omi Zugsɔb la o arezana tita'ar la ni.

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Zun'omi Zugsɔb la on tʋm nɛ paŋ si'em la zug; zun'omin o on zu'oe gaad si'el wʋsa la zug.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Piebimi na'atana zun'e o, nwɛ'ɛmi kɔna nɛ googinamɛ zun'e o.

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Zun'omin o nɛ siyada nwɛ'ɛb nɛ wa'a. Zun'omin o nɛ kɔna nɛ wiis,

english_verse: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
translation_verse: Nwɛ'ɛmi galana zun'e o, maligim nwɛ' galana sʋ'ʋŋa zun'e o.

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Kɛl ka bʋnvʋr wʋsa zun'e Zugsɔb la. Zun'omi Zugsɔb la, haleluya!

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Solomon onɛ da an David biig, ka an Israel na'ab la siilima nwa':

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Siilima nwa' ye li pa'al nɛ nidib ya'am ka sa'ali ba, ka kɛ ka ba gban'e ya'am pian'ad gbin.

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Li na sʋŋ nidib ka ba di'e sa'alʋg ka keŋ tuonnɛ tʋm linɛ nar ka dɔl suor;

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: Siilim bama na kɛ ka Azi'iyɛ'og baŋ ya'am, ka pa'al dasam nɛ pu'asada ka ba baŋ ya'am suoya, nɛ linɛ mɔr sʋŋir.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ya'am dim kɛlis ka paam baŋiri paas. Li na sʋŋ banɛ gban'e li gbin la ba tʋʋma ni.

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: Li na kɛ ka nidib baŋ siilima nɛ sɔlima, ka baŋ ya'am dim pian'ad nɛ bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm gbin.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zɔtim an baŋir pin'ilʋg amaa zɔn nɛ'ɛsidnɛ ya'am nɛ sa'alʋg. Sa'alʋg linɛ na tisif ya'amlɛog ka fʋ bɔ ya'am

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: M biiga, wʋmmi fʋ ba' sa'alʋg, ka da zan'asi fʋ maa na pa'alif si'el la.

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: Ka li na an vɛnlim bɛɛ fʋ zugin, ka an zɔnti fʋ niŋgɔɔnrin.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: M biiga, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim ya'a pan'asidif, fʋn da kɛlisi ba pian'adɛ.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Ba ya'a yɛl ye, “Kem na dɔlli ti; kɛl ka ti su'a kʋ sɔ', kɛl ka ti su'a suor kpikpɛŋi kʋ nid zaalim-zaalim;

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: kɛlli ka ti vɔli ba vʋt wʋʋ yaʋg nɛ, ka vɔli ba mummi wʋʋ banɛ sig bʋmbɔkin nɛ;

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: ka ti na nyɛ la'asʋma nɛ li buudi ka fan' la'adi pɛ'ɛli ti ya';

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: kem na la'as nɛ ti ka ti pʋdig tinamɛ faaɛn si'el la.”

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: M biiga, ba ya'a yɛtif ala fʋn da dɔlli ba keŋɛ, da nɔki fʋ nɔbiri dɔlli ba suor la;

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ba nɔba zɔti ken bɛ'ɛd zin'ig, ba zɔti tɔ'ɔtɔ mɔɔd ye ba kʋ nid.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Li pʋ dɔl suor nɛ fʋn na ya'ae sʋlʋg la nɔɔr ka niis la wʋsa gɔsida!

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Nimbama su'anɛ gur ye ba kʋʋ ba mɛŋ; ba mɛŋ nyɔvʋr ka ba na yis!

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Ala ka li aɛn tis onɛ wʋsa kʋʋd ye o paam mɔrim; o ba'asʋg anɛ kum. Ya'am buon nidib

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Ya'am nwɛnɛ pu'a kanɛ bɛ suoraugʋn buon, o dʋ'ʋs o kʋkɔri buon nidibi bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa;

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: nidibi galis zin'isi'a wʋsa maan tʋkpiidʋg, o bɛɛ ani, ka kaasidi buon tempʋʋg la za'anɔya ni ka yɛt ye,

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “Yanam banɛ an Azi'iyɛ'og dima, bɔ ka ya nan kpɛm bɛ zi'iliminɛ? Bɔ ka nintʋ'ʋsnam nan kpɛn nɔŋ nintʋ'ʋsim, ka zɔn la mɛ kis baŋirɛ?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a siakini m sa'alʋg, m naan pɛligini m pʋʋgi tisi ya ka kɛ ka ya baŋim tɛn'ɛsa.

english_verse: You completely ignored me and refused to listen;
translation_verse: Yanamɛ sadigim zan'asi m buolʋg, ka m tiɛn m nu'ug ka sɔ' pʋ kɛligɛ,

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: yanamɛ zan'asi m sa'alʋg ka m tansi ya ka ya pʋ wʋm la,

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: Li ya'a ti paae ya wʋʋ sisi'em nɛ; tɔɔg ya'a ti mɔri ya keŋ wʋʋ sisi'epiliŋ nɛ ka yɛla nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ paae ya, m ba'a kae.

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: Ani ka ba na buonim amaa m kʋ siakɛ; ba na ieedim, amaa ba kʋ nyɛɛ ma.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Ban kis baŋir ka pʋ gaŋ Zugsɔb zɔtim la zug,

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: ban zan'asi m sa'alʋg ka m tansi ba ka ba pʋ wʋm la,

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: ala ka ban bʋd si'el la ka ba na bʋn ban gban'e si'el la li na bi'igi ba.

english_verse: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
translation_verse: Azi'iyɛ'og dim kalinka'alim la na kʋʋ ba zɔn ya'a ti ye nɛ' ka' yɛllɛ, linɛ na san'ami ba;

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: amaa onɛ wʋsa kɛlis mam pian'ad na bɛ nɛ laafi ka kʋ zɔt dabiem nɛ yɛlbɛ'ɛdɛ.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: M biiga, fʋ ya'a na di'e m pian'ad nɛ m pa'ala ka kɛ ka m nɔzi'elʋg la bɛ fʋ ni,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: ka yɔ'ɔgi fʋ tʋba kɛlis ya'am ka kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf gban'e li gbin,

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: fʋ ya'a kaasidi buon baŋir ka dʋ'ʋs kʋkɔri kaasid ye fʋ gban'e si'el gbin,

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: fʋ ya'a iee li wʋʋ anzurifa ka ieedi li wʋʋ kpan'am linɛ su'a,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: ala ka fʋ na baŋ Zugsɔb la zɔtim gbin ka nyɛ Wina'am baŋir.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la tisid ya'am, o nɔɔrin ka baŋir bɛ nɛ linɛ gban'ad yɛla gbin.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: O tisid pʋpielim dim nyaŋir, ka an gbanti'edʋgʋ tis banɛ bɛllim dɔl suor la.

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: Onɛ gɔsid banɛ an sida dim ka gur nimbanɛ bɛllim dɔl suor la.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Ala ka fʋ na gban'e pʋpielim nɛ sida gbin nɛ linɛ an sʋm nɛ suosʋŋ wʋsa.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: Ya'am na kpɛn' fʋ sʋnfʋn, ka baŋir malisi tisif.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Pʋtɛn'ɛsʋŋ na gu'udif ka fʋn tun'e bakid yɛla gbin la na gurif.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Ya'am na faaɛn fʋ yis nimbɛ'ɛdnam suoya ni, nɛ banɛ pian'adi ka' kibar la.

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: Ban banɛ bas sida suor ka dɔl linɛ bɛ likin la.

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: Ba suoya anɛ suogɔnlima ka ba tʋm biriku'an tʋʋma.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Li na yisif pu'asan'auŋ pʋʋgin, nɛ pu'agɔɔndir onɛ mɔr pian'amalisa bɛlisid nidib la.

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: O bas o pu'asatim saŋa sid ka tam nɔnaar kanɛ ka o maal nɛ Wina'am la.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: O yisuor la kennɛ sigid kum zin'igin ka o suoya wʋsa ken kpi'im teŋ tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Sɔ' pʋ kpɛn'ɛd o san'an ka lɛn yit na bɛɛ o lɛn nyɛ nyɔvʋr suorɛ.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Lin an si'em la, dɔl ninsʋma suor ka dɔl pʋpielim dim suor.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Yɛlsida dim na kpɛm bɛ teŋin la, ka banɛ pʋ mɔr gba'ar la kpɛlim ani;

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: amaa bugusim dim la tuŋ kʋ tiɛn, ba na vuoɛn banɛ ka' sida dim la yis teŋin la nyain.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: M biiga, da tami m pa'ala la, amaa kɛl ka m nɔzi'elʋg la bɛɛ fʋ sʋnfʋn.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka nɔŋilim nɛ sida bɛllim pɔ'ɔgi fʋ san'anɛ; lɔɔmi baa kɔri fʋ niŋgɔɔnrin, sɔmmi baa fʋ sʋʋnrin.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Ala ka Wina'am nɛ nidib sʋʋgin fʋ na mɔr yʋ'ʋsʋŋ ka ba na bɔɔdi fʋ yɛla.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Niŋim Zugsɔb la yadda nɛ fʋ sʋnf wʋsa ka da ti'e fʋ mɛŋ mi'ilim;

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: fʋ suoya wʋsa ni, tiɛnm Zugsɔb la yɛla, ka onɛ na pa'alif suokanɛ an sappi.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Da ma' fʋ mɛŋ ka tɛn'ɛs ye fʋ mɔr ya'am halii; zɔm Wina'am ka da tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa na tisi fʋ niŋgbina laafi ka kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ kɔnba.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Na'asim Zugsɔb la nɛ fʋ ligidi, nɛ zʋʋd linɛ ka fʋ bun yiiga la wʋsa;

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: ka linɛ na kɛ ka fʋ bʋya pɛ'ɛli badigid, ka fʋ gan'a na pɛ'ɛl nɛ danpaalig.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: M biiga, da nɛ'ɛs Zugsɔb la tʋbtɛɛgirɛ; o ya'a zɛrigif fʋn da kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf pɛligɛ,

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la tɛɛgidnɛ banɛ ka o nɔŋ la tʋba, nwɛnɛ saamme tɛɛgid bikanɛ ka o ya'am kpɛn' tʋbir si'em la.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Wina'am albareka bɛ nɛ dau kanɛ paam ya'am, nɛ dau kanɛ gban'ad si'el gbin,

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ya'am mɔr nyɔɔdi gat anzurifa, on yisid si'el na la gat sanlima.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Li anɛ bʋnsʋŋ hali gat si'el wʋsa; linɛ aan fʋ bɔɔdim wʋsa kʋ mak nɛ lii.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Nyɔvʋwɔk bɛ nɛ ya'am sɔb datiuŋ ka o dagɔbʋg mɔr kpan'am nɛ na'asi.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: O suoya anɛ suosʋma, ka o suobuga la mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: O anɛ vʋm tiigi tis banɛ wʋsa di'e o la; banɛ gban'e o nu'us ayi' la na nyɛ zusʋŋ.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Li anɛ ya'am ka Zugsɔb la da nɔki ɛɛnb dunia la, ka zaŋ o mi'ilim kɛ ka saŋgbana bɛɛ li zin'igin.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: O baŋir zug ka o da pʋdig ku'ozulima la, ka kɛ ka mɛligim yit saŋgbana ni lit teŋin na.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: M biiga, kpɛm mɔri fʋ ya'am la, nɛ gban'asʋma banɛ na sʋ'ʋŋif, da kɛ ka li yi ka basi fɔ.

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: Li na an vʋm tisif, ka an niŋgɔnkɔrigi fʋ niŋgɔɔnrinɛ pɛ'ɛs vɛnlim.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: Ala ka fʋ suor pʋʋgin, yɛl kʋ paae fɔ; ka fʋ nɔbir kʋ tu'ugɛ.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a digi fʋ kʋ zɔt dabiem; fʋ ya'a diginɛ gbis fʋ gbɛɛm na malis.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Da zɔt dabiem ye yɛltɔɔgʋ na ti paaf wʋʋ san'auŋʋ ɛɛnti gbirigi paae bugusim dim si'em laa.

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ka fʋ na ti'e ka o na gu' fʋ nɔba ka bɛndis kʋ gban'e fɔ.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a mɔr paŋ, fʋn da mɔŋ sɔ' bʋnsʋŋ linɛ nar ye o di'e.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ yɛli fʋ kpi'a ye “Kem ka lɛb na; ka bɛogɔ m saa na tisif,” ka pʋn mɔri li bʋnnɛ.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ gban'e gban'abɛ'ɛdi fʋ kpi'a onɛ an sida sɔb ka kpi'e nɛf la.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ ma'aa tabili fʋ kpi'a zaalim-zaalim ka o pʋ maalif bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Da mɔr fufum nɛ onɛ zabid yɔri-yɔri bɛɛ fʋ gaŋ o suoya la sieba dɔlla.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kis onɛ bɛllim pʋ dɔl suorɛ; amaa banɛ bɛllim an sʋm la on nɛ ban anɛ yinne.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nɔpɔɔr bɛ bugusim sɔb yin, amaa o niŋid pʋpielim dim yir bareka.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Banɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ nɛ nyɛɛsim la'adi ba taaba la Zugsɔb la mɛ na la'adi ba, ka lɛɛ tisid banɛ sie ba mɛŋ la yɔlisim.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Ya'am dim na di na'asi faar, amaa banɛ an zɔn la ditnɛ nyan.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, kɛlisimi ya ba' sa'alʋg; kɛlisimi sʋ'ʋŋa ka gban'e li gbin.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: M tisi ya pa'alsʋŋ, alazugɔ da tami m pa'ala la.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Man da nan an dasaŋ ka bɛɛ m saam yin la; man da nam pɔɔd ka aan m ma biyimmir la,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: m saam da pa'alim ka yɛl ye, “Gban'ami m pian'ad la nɛ fʋ sʋnf wʋsa; kɛl ka m nɔzi'elʋg la bɛɛ fʋ ni ka lin ka fʋ na vʋe.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Ieem ya'am, ka linɛ gban'ad pian'ad gbin; da tami m pian'ad la bɛɛ fʋ bie ka basi lii.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Da bas ya'am, ka onɛ na gu'udif; nɔŋim o ka o na gurif.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Ya'am gat si'el wʋsa; dinzugɔ ieem ya'am. Hali baa li ya'a na tɔi si'em wʋsa n tisi fɔ, fʋn mɔɔm ka bɔ baŋiri paas.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Na'asim o ka o na dʋ'ʋsif; kuakim o ka o na tisif girima.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: O na maal linɛ ligin zugʋ ligili fʋ zug ka nɔk na'am zupibig linɛ vɛnli pidif.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Kɛlisim, m biiga, siakim man yɛtif si'el la, ka fʋ yʋma na zu'oe.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: M mɔri fʋ dɔlisid nɛ ya'am suor ka kɛ ka fʋ dɔl suoya banɛ kpa' sappi.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a ken, si'el kʋ vi' fʋ suorɛ; fʋ ya'a zɔt, fʋ nɔbir kʋ tu'ugɛ.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Di'em sa'al sʋma ka da bas ka li gaadɛ; guri li sʋ'ʋŋa ka li anɛ fʋ nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Da nɔki fʋ nɔbiri keŋ bugusnam zin'iginɛ bɛɛ fʋ ken nɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnama.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Luakim ka da dɔl anii; fɛndigim dɔlli fʋ suori gaad.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ ba ya'a pʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ ba kʋ nyaŋi gbisɛ, ba ya'a pʋ kɛ ka sɔ' lii ba pʋ nyaŋidi gbisida.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Ba diib anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka zaba aan ba daam ka ba nuud.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dim suor nwɛnɛ bɛogʋ na nied nyain nɛ, ka maligim nied hali ti paae nintaŋ tisʋʋs.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Amaa bugusim dim la suor nwɛnɛ liktita'ar; ba kennɛ tu'usid ka zi' linɛ kɛ ka ba tu'usida.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: M biiga, kɛlisim man yɛtif si'el la; kɛlisimi m pian'ad la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka li yii fʋ san'anɛ, kɛl ka li bɛɛ fʋ sʋnfʋn;

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ li anɛ vʋm tis banɛ nyɛɛ li la ka an laafi tis ninsaal niŋgbina wʋsa.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Linɛ gaadi li wʋsa anɛ ye, fʋ gɔsimi fʋ sʋnf sʋ'ʋŋa ka linɛ an vʋm bulig.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Yisim pian'ayaalisi fʋ nɔɔrin; da kɛ ka ziri pian'ad li'eli fʋ nɔŋgban nɛ.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ nini kpa' fʋ tuon ka fʋ mi' fʋn ken si'el.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Maalimi fʋ suor ka li an sassi ka gban'ad suoya banɛ zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Da bie lɛb datiuŋ bɛɛ dagɔbʋga; da kɛ ka fʋ nɔba ken bɛ'ɛd zin'iga.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: M biiga, kɛlisimi m pian'ad ka wʋm linɛ tisid ya'am la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ li na kɛ ka fʋ baŋ fʋn na mɔri fʋ mɛŋ si'em, ka fʋ pian'ad na pa'al ye fʋ mɔr baŋir.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Pu'agɔɔndir nɔɔr tun'e malis wʋʋ siind nɛ, bɛɛ bʋki gat kpaam,

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: amaa li naarin o yɛla tɔi gat kʋk, o na gaad ka basif nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ tɔɔg.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: O ziidif nɛ wa'ae kumin; on dɔl suosi'a la kennɛ kpi'im teŋin.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: O pʋ dɔl suokanɛ na tis o vʋm la, o yirid nɛ giligid ka zi' linɛ maanna.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: Nannanna, m biisɛ, kɛlisimi man yɛti ya si'el la, kɛlisimi sʋ'ʋŋa ka da tamm.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ li'el pu'a kan buudi, pʋn da lɛb o yir za'anɔɔr babaa!

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a niŋ ala, fʋ na zaŋi fʋ kpi'euŋʋ tis sieba, ka fʋ nyɔvʋr bɛlim wʋsa na bɛ ninyɔɔd nu'usin.

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: Ɛɛn, saam na nɔki fʋ arezak la wʋsa! Ka fʋn ieen ɔnsiri paam si'el la na lieb sɔ' din.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a ti digi bɔɔd kum fʋ na fabil hali, bɔzugɔ fʋ niŋgbiŋ nɛ fʋ giinla wʋsa gɛnnɛ

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: San'auŋ yʋ'ʋn bɔɔdi paam, man ti ye m baŋ la ka nyan diim nidib sʋʋgin.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: Numi fʋ mɛŋ bulig ku'om, ku'okanɛ bunɛ fʋ mɛŋ buligin la.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Da nwɛnɛ bulkanɛ pʋbid yɔɔg-yɔɔg ka li ku'om yadigid suoraadinɛ.

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ bulig ku'om anɛ fʋn ma'aa din; mid ka fʋ kɛ ka saam nuudi sʋŋidif.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Wina'am na niŋi fʋ bulig la albareka. Mɔr sumalisim nɛ pu'a kanɛ ka fʋ di fʋ dasannimin la.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: O vɛnlim nwɛnɛ mɔlif bɛɛ walnya'aŋ nɛ, kɛl ka o bin'isa nɛ o niŋgbiŋ la mɔrif nyɛlʋg saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: M biiga, bɔ ka fʋ basi fʋ mɛŋ ka pu'agɔɔndir nyaŋi fɔ? Bɔ ka fʋ ya'amlɛog lɛɛ kpɛn' onɛ ka' fʋ pu'a?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Wina'am nyɛt fʋn maan si'el la wʋsa, fʋn ken zin'isi'a wʋsa nied paalʋ o san'an.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Bugusim sɔb tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd anɛ bɛndigi lɛn tis o mɛŋ. Ba mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi gban'adi ba ya'as.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Ban pʋ mɔr a-gban'a-m-mɛŋ la zug ka ba kpiid. Ba mɛŋ yalimisi kʋʋdi ba.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: M biiga, fʋ ya'a nam mi' kaanbnɛ ye fʋ di'e sɔ' samme yɔ, ka tik nu'ugʋ tis saan;

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: bɛɛ nam mi' pian'anɛ pian'ad ka li diif ka kaanbi zi'el ka li gɛɛlif,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: ala m biiga, baŋim ye fʋ bɛ nɛ o sɔb nu'usin, amaa fʋn na niŋ si'em yii li pʋʋginɛ nwa': zɔm keŋ o san'an tɔ'ɔtɔ sie fʋ mɛŋ ka nwɛ' o nu'ug.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Niŋim tɔ'ɔtɔ ka da maan galim bɛɛ bɔɔd ye fʋ vʋ'ʋs bɛɛ zɔɔnsim ka nyaan tʋmm.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Zɔm yi bɛndig la pʋʋgin wʋʋ walig bɛɛ niiŋe na nyɛ sʋlʋg ka ianki yi si'em la.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Yanam gbanya'anama, zamisimi ya'am yi salinsa'asin, gɔsimi ban tʋm si'el la ka gban'e li gbin.

english_verse: but they store up food during harvest season.
translation_verse: Amaa ba la'asid diib tigir saŋa ka su'ad zʋʋdi gur kɔ'ɔm saŋa.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Gbanyan'a la ye o gbis daba ala? Ka bʋndaar ka o na nie gbɛɛminɛ?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: On yɛt si'el anɛ ye, “Kɛl ka m gbis bi'ela, ka zɔɔnsim bi'ela ka kpɛn'ɛsi m nu'us gɛɛgʋni vʋ'ʋs.”

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: Amaa on bɛ gbɛɛmin la, nɔŋ na kena wʋʋ na'ayiig nɛ ka fara kpɛn' o nwɛnɛ faandibi kena faaɛn o nɛ.

english_verse: winking and giving signals to deceive others.
translation_verse: Ba amisidi ba nini, ka sɔɔndi ba nɔba, ka tiesid nu'us,

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: ka gban'ad gban'abɛ'ɛdi ba sʋnfʋn, ka ieed yɛla tugun nidib zin'ig wʋsa.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa zug tɔɔg na di'igi ba, ka ba paam sapu'ad bɛ'ɛd bɛ'ɛdi ka onɛ na ti'ebi ba kae.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Bʋnama ayɔpɔi bɛ ka Zugsɔb la kis hali ka pʋ bɔɔd ye o nyɛ ka ninsaal niŋi li.

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba pian'ad la bɛɛ fʋ ni saŋa wʋsa, lɔɔmi li kɔlli fʋ niŋgɔɔnrin wʋʋ niŋgɔnkɔrig nɛ.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Ba pa'ala la na sʋ'ʋŋif zin'ig wʋsa, ka gurif yʋ'ʋŋ, ka mɛ sa'alif nintaŋ.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Ba pa'ala la anɛ nɛɛsim kanɛ nie, ba sa'alʋg la na pa'alif fʋn na bɛ si'em, ka li anɛ nyɔvʋr suori tisif.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Li na sʋ'ʋŋif ka fʋ yi pu'agɔɔnda nu'usin, nɛ banɛ an nidib pu'ab ka mɔr nɔmalisim ye ba yuomif la.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka fʋ ya'am kpɛn' pu'a la vɛnlim zugɔ, da kɛ ka o nindaa vɛnlim tiaki fʋ ya'am.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Pu'agɔɔndir yɔɔd pʋ gat bodobodo gbil ligidii, amaa sɔ' pu'a na san'ami fʋ nyɔvʋr wʋsa.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Fʋ na kpa'ae bugumsaana niŋi fʋ nɔba zug ka li kʋ la'aŋi fʋ fuugɔɔ?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Fʋ na nɔ bugum nɛ nɔba ka li kʋ vʋnligi fɔɔ?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka li aaɛn tis onɛ wʋsa dig nɛ sɔ' pu'a. Onɛ wʋsa si'is pu'a nwa' kʋ yi namisʋgʋnɛ.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Na'ayiig ya'a zu ka li anɛ o pʋʋr yɛla, nidib na kɛɛs o bas linzugɔɔ?

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a gban'e o, o na yɔ on zu si'el la lɛbis nɔɔr ayɔpɔi; o na nɔk on mɔr si'el la wʋsa yɔ.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Amaa dau kanɛ san'am pu'a ka' ya'am, o kʋdim san'amid nɛ o mɛŋ.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ, fufum na kɛ ka dau sʋʋnr duoe ka o ya'a ti ye o zab, o kʋ zɔt nimbaanliga.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Si'el kae ka fʋ na nɔki yɔɔ o ka o di'e, si'el kae ka fʋ na tis o ka o sʋnf ma'ae.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: M biiga, tɛnr man yɛlif si'el la, ka da tam man zi'elif ye fʋ tʋm si'em la.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Maalim man pa'al si'el la, ka fʋ na vʋe. Gu'usim sʋ'ʋŋa ka dɔlli m pa'ala la, wʋʋ fʋn gu'usid nɛ fʋ nif bielif yɛla si'em la.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka m pa'ala la bɛɛ fʋ ni saŋa wʋsa; lɔɔmi li tabili fʋ nu'ubibis, ka sɔbi li digili fʋ sʋnfʋn.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Yɛlim ya'am ye, “Fʋ anɛ m taʋn,” ka buol baŋir ye fʋ sizua.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Ba na sʋŋif ka fʋ luak pu'agɔɔnda, nɛ pu'a banɛ dɔl dapi pian'ad zufa'asim pian'ad la. Pu'agɔɔndir la yɛla

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Daar yinne ka m daa vɛɛsi m takoro ni gɔsid yiŋ ye m nyɛ linɛ bɛ.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Ka pu'a la sia'al o, ka maal o mɛŋ wʋʋ pu'agɔɔndir nɛ, ka pin'ili bɛlisid o.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: O daa anɛ pu'a kanɛ zugʋ kpi'em ka pʋ zɔt nyannɛ, ka bɛ pal la zugʋ ken saŋa wʋsa,

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: ka zi'e lɔdigin, bɛɛ suoraug la zug, bɛɛ da'an la gur.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: O daa kuak dasaŋ la, ka muak o, ka gɔs o nindaa kii, ka ye,

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “M maali m maan zina, ka maan la ni'im bɛ.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m yina ieedif; m ieef nɛ hali ka yʋ'ʋn nyɛɛf nwa'!

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: M da'anɛ gadʋ pien sʋma Egipt teŋin nɔki ligili m gadʋg la.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: M nɔknɛ tudaar sʋma puusi li ka li anɛ bʋnnyubisa buudi wʋsa.

english_verse: “Let's go there and make love all night.
translation_verse: Kpɛn'ɛm na digin nɛ mam yʋ'ʋŋa ka bɛog ti nie, ka ti wʋsa na di malisim.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: M sid ka' yinnɛ, o duoe nɛ suori keŋ lallisa.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: On nɔk ligidsi'a la pʋ pɔɔda, o na paae bakuai ayi'.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Pu'a la daa pan'as o nɛ nɔŋgban malisiŋ, ka zaŋ antu'a malisiŋi gban'e o.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Ka o kpɛn yuk tɔ'ɔtɔ dɔl pu'a la nya'aŋ wʋʋ naaf ka ba mɔri wa'ae kʋʋb, bɛɛ waligi ianki sig baŋin

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: ka ba kʋns o sʋnf nɛ piim si'em la. O daa nwɛnɛ niiŋe na ian'adi ken bɛndigin ka zi' ye o nyɔvʋr bɛnnɛ la.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, m biisɛ, kɛlisimi man yɛt si'el la sʋ'ʋŋa ka yɔ'ɔgi ya tʋbaa wʋm nɛ nimmua.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya kɛ ka ya ya'amlɛog kpɛn' pu'a bannam buudii, pʋn da bie lɛbi ba san'an baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: O nyaŋi san'am dap bɛdegʋ. Ya'a kpɛlim banɛ kpi la, fʋ kʋ nyaŋi kaali baa.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a keŋ o yin, fʋn baŋim ye fʋ bɛ nɛ suori ken kpi'im teŋ. Li anɛ suogiŋ kanɛ ziidi fʋ ken kumin.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi! Aya'am buon la. Abaŋir yis o mɛŋ paalʋ na.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: O nwɛnɛ pu'a zi'e suor kanɛ bɛ kʋkʋn zug nɛ suokita ni.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: O zi'enɛ suokanɛ dɔlli kpɛn'ɛd tempʋʋgin la, ani ka o zi'e buon nidib la ye,

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “Gɔsimi, m pian'adi tisidi ya wʋsa; m buonnɛ yanam banɛ wʋsa bɛ dunia ni!

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Yanam ya'am pɔɔdim dima, bɔɔmi ya'am. Yanam banɛ an zɔnnɛ, mɔɔmi ka gban'e pian'ad gbin.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi ka m mɔri yɛlsʋm sieba ye m yɛl; man yɛt si'el la wʋsa dɔlli suor.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Man nɔɔr tu'asidnɛ sida; man kisnɛ ziri pian'ad.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Linɛ yiti m nɔɔrin na wʋsa mɔri sʋŋir; ziri baa yinne kae, ka li mɛ kʋ kɛ ka sɔ' kpɛn' mɔɔgɔ.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Li nienɛ nyain tis banɛ gban'ad si'el gbin; ka an tituaa tis banɛ mɔr mi'ilim sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Gaŋimi man pa'ala la, ka bas anzurifa, ieemi baŋir ka kɛ sanlima.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Man anɛ Aya'am, m gat bʋnsʋma wʋsa; fʋn mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ si'el wʋsa kʋ nyaŋi nɔki mak nɛ mam.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Man anɛ Aya'am, m gban'ad si'el gbin; man mɔr baŋir nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛsʋma.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zɔtim anɛ fʋn na kis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. Man kis nyɛɛsim nɛ tita'alim, nɛ suobɛ'ɛd nɛ ziri pian'ad wʋsa.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: M ya'a gban'e si'el m tʋmnɛ ala kimm. Man gban'ad si'el gbin, ka mɛ mɔr paŋ.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Man sʋŋid na'anam ka ba gɔsidi ba teŋ ka pa'an tuongatib ka ba gban'ad wadsʋma.

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Manɛ sʋŋid tuongatib wʋsa dunia nwa' pʋʋgin la'an nɛ kpi'emnam nɛ ninsʋma wʋsa.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Man nɔŋnɛ banɛ nɔŋim la; onɛ wʋsa ieed mam sid na nyɛɛm.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Arezak nɛ na'asi bɛ nɛ man san'an, kpan'am nɛ mɔrim linɛ pʋ naad bɛ nɛ man ni.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Linɛ ka fʋ na paam man san'an la gat sanlima, ka tisid bʋnsʋma ka li kʋ nyaŋi mak nɛ anzurifa sʋŋɔ.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Mam bɛ nɛ pʋpielim bɛllim; ka dɔl sida suor tituaa,

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: ka tisid banɛ nɔŋim la kpan'am, ka kɛt ka arezak pɛ'ɛnnɛ ba yir.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: Man ka Zugsɔb la da dɛŋin maal yiiga; on da nam pʋ maal si'el-si'el la ka mam pʋm bɛ.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Pin'ilʋgʋn sa ka o maal mam, manɛ an yiiga ka dunia nyaan pin'il.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Ba da du'a man yiiga ka atɛuk nyaan maal, saŋa kanɛ ka ku'om nam pʋ bun la.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Zuoya nɛ kʋkʋna da nan kae la, ka mam pʋm bɛ.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Saŋa kan ka Wina'am nam pʋ maal dunia nɛ teŋgbauŋ nɛ titanbin'isi.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: On da zi'el saŋgbauŋʋ li zin'igin la, m da bɛɛ ani, saŋa kanɛ ka o da buoɛn ku'om nɛ teŋ bɛn la.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: O da kɛ ka saŋgbauŋ zi'en ki', ka kɛ ka atɛuk pin'ili bun nɛ paŋ,

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: ka zi'el nɔɔri tis atɛuk ku'om ye li da pɛ'ɛli gaad on pa'al si'em la; onɛ mɛ da pin'il dunia ɛɛnbir la.

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: Saŋkan ka man da bɛɛ o san'an wʋʋ onɛ mi' mɛɛb yɛla nɛ. Daar wʋsa manɛ da kɛt ka o mɔr sumalisim, ka m mɛŋ da maan sumalisim o san'an saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: M sʋnf da malis nɛ dunia la wʋsa ka m nini tig nɛ ninsaal buudi.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, nannanna kɛlisimini m pian'ad nwa'; albareka bɛ nɛ banɛ dɔl man yɛl si'el la.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimini m pa'ala la ka paam ya'am, mid ka ya nɛ'ɛsi lii bas.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Albareka bɛ nɛ onɛ wʋsa wʋmi m pian'ad ka bɛɛ m san'an daar wʋsa, ka zi'e m za'anɔɔrini gur.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Banɛ ieemi nyɛ la mɔr nyɔvʋr, ka Zugsɔb la sʋnf mɛ na ma'ae nɛ ba.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Banɛ pʋ nyɛ mam la na san'ami ba mɛŋ; onɛ wʋsa pʋ bɔɔd mam bɔɔd nɛ kum.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Aya'am mɛɛ o yir, ka ba' zan'antɔlis ayɔpɔi ka li zi'e sappi.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: O dʋg ni'im sʋ'ʋŋa ka maal damalisiŋ ka li kpɛlim nidib la na kena di.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: O tʋm o tʋmtʋm pu'ab tempʋʋgin ye ba buol nidib na ka ba di. O zi'e teŋ la zin'ikanɛ dʋ la nii kaasid agɔla yɛt ye,

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: “Yanam banɛ ya'am nam pʋ bi' la, kemi na!” Ka yɛl banɛ an zɔn la ye,

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Kemi na dii m diib la ka nu dankanɛ ka m digil la.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Basim ya'amka'alʋg tʋʋma ka fʋ na vʋe; ka dɔl baŋir suor sʋ'ʋŋa.”

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a sa'al nintʋ'ʋsim sɔb fʋ di'edi tʋ'ʋd; fʋ ya'a sa'al nimbɛ'og o na zɛrigif.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Da sa'al nintʋ'ʋsa ka o na kisigif; amaa fʋ ya'a sa'al ya'am sɔb o na nɔŋif.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a yɛl ya'am dim si'el li maligim paasidi ba nɛ ya'am. Fʋ ya'a yɛl pʋpielnam si'el li paasidi ba nɛ baŋir.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb zɔtim an ya'am pin'ilʋg, fʋ ya'a mi' Onɛ an Kasi la li anɛ baŋir.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Ya'am paasidnɛ fʋ vʋm yʋma ka fʋ na yuug dunia nwa' ni.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a mɔr ya'am, fʋn nɔɔ na dii li malisim; fʋ mɛ ya'a ka' ya'am, fʋn nɔɔ na di fara.

english_verse: Stupidity is reckless, senseless, and foolish.
translation_verse: Pu'ayaliŋ maannɛ vuud, o zi' si'ela ka mɛ pʋ zɔt nyannɛ.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: O zi'inɛ o yir za'anɔɔrin, bɛɛ digil o kʋk tempʋʋginɛ zin',

english_verse: She shouts to everyone who passes by,
translation_verse: ka buon banɛ gat ka ba nini mu'oe nɛ ba tʋʋma la ye,

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: “Yanam nimbanɛ ka' ya'am la, kpɛn'ɛmi na!” Ka yɛt zɔn la ye,

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Fʋ ya'a zu ku'om nu li malis nɛ. Fʋ mɛ ya'a zu diibi su'a di, li malis nɛ hali.”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka o buon la zi' ye nimbanɛ kpɛn'ɛd o yin la kpiidnɛ, ba kʋ tun'e baŋ ye banɛ pʋn kpɛn' la bɛ yaʋgʋn kʋdim-kʋdim saa.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ Solomon siilima: Bikanɛ mɔr ya'am ziankid o saam zug; ka zɔn diisidi ba manam nyan.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a dɔl zam suori paam kpan'am li kʋ sʋŋi fɔɔ, amaa pʋpielim yisidif nɛ kumin.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kʋ kɛ ka pʋpiel ken nɛ kɔ'ɔm, ka mɛ kʋ kɛ ka nimbɛ'og nyɛ on bɔɔd si'ela.

english_verse: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb la'asid o ki nɛ bunib saŋa, sieba mɛ ya'a ti bɛ bunibin ka fʋn bɛ gbɛɛmin, li anɛ nyan.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Pʋpielnam na paam albareka pamm. Nimbɛ'og pian'ad ziidi zabaa kenna.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a tiɛn burikin yɛla li mɔri bareka kenna, amaa nimbɛ'og yʋ'ʋr na pun'oe.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Banɛ mɔr ya'am di'ednɛ sa'al sʋŋ, amaa banɛ pian'ad nɛ zɔlimis la na ba'as yɔri.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Sida dim kennɛ tuon ka dabiem kae, amaa bugusim dim la ba na sɛnbigi ba.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Onɛ amisid o nifʋ pa'an yɛlsu'ada ziidi yɛla kenna, ka onɛ pian'ad pian'ayɛɛd na ba'as bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel pian'ad ziidnɛ vʋm kenna, wʋʋ bulig ku'om bun si'em la; amaa nimbɛ'og pian'ad ziidnɛ zaba kenna.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Kisidim mɔri yɛla kenna, amaa nɔŋilim kɛtnɛ taab taali basid.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Onɛ mi' yɛla bakid pian'ad nɛ ya'am, amaa zi'ilim daan nya'aŋ tigid nɛ balaar.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb paamidi baŋir kanɛ wʋsa ka o bɔɔd, amaa zɔlʋg pian'ayɛɛd ziidnɛ san'auŋʋ kenna.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Arezak sʋŋidi bʋndaan wʋʋ zaŋguom kpi'ema sʋŋid tempʋʋg si'em la, amaa nɔŋ kɛtnɛ ka nɔŋdaan ba'asid yɔri.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Tʋʋm sʋma sɔb yɔɔd anɛ vʋm, amaa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɔɔd anɛ tʋbtɛɛgir.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Banɛ wʋm sa'alʋg na vʋe, amaa banɛ yidig ka pʋ siak ye ba pa'ali ba la na zii ba taaba kpɛn' mɔɔg.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Onɛ su'a mɔr kisidim o sʋʋnrin anɛ dama'am sɔb, onɛ ginnɛ yɛɛsid anɛ zɔlʋg.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a pian'adi galis fʋ kʋ luak tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, amaa onɛ gban'ad o zilim anɛ ya'am sɔb.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel pian'ad nwɛnɛ anzurifa sʋŋ nɛ, nimbɛ'og pʋtɛn'ɛr anɛ zaalim.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dim pian'ad sʋŋid nidib bɛdegʋ, amaa zɔn kpiidnɛ ba ya'amka'alʋg zug.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la albareka kɛt ka nid liebid arezak sɔb, ka li pʋ ziid yɛla kennaa.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nwɛnɛ di'ema tis zɔlʋg, amaa nimbanɛ mɔr baŋir bɔɔdi ya'am.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Bugusnamɛ zɔt si'el dabiem la nyaŋidi ba nɛ, amaa pʋpielnam on na nyɛ ban bɔɔd si'el.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Sisi'em ya'a da'ae li na mɔr nimbɛ'ɛdnam la gaad, amaa pʋpielnam la zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ danmi'isʋgʋ mi'is nɔɔrin, ka nyɔ'ɔs kpand nini si'em la, ala ka gbanya'a aan tis onɛ tʋm o.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zɔtim na kɛ ka fʋ vʋe yuug. Nimbɛ'ɛdnam la kpiidnɛ ka ba daar pʋ paae.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Ninsʋma ti'ir ziidi sumalisim kenna, amaa nimbɛ'ɛdnam pʋ mɔr ti'ir si'a bɛogɔ.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la guri banɛ dɔl suosʋma la, ka lɛɛ san'amid banɛ tʋm linɛ pʋ nara.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Pʋpielnam na zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ saŋa wʋsa, amaa nimbɛ'ɛdnam kʋ kpɛm bɛ teŋ la zugɔ.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Pʋpielnam pian'adi ya'am, amaa nɔɔr kanɛ pian'ad pian'abɛ'ɛd la na nyɛ san'auŋ.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kis zam makir, amaa o ya'am bɔɔd linɛ ka li makir dɔl sida.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Adʋ'ʋsi-m-mɛŋ ya'a gaad tuon, nyannɛ dɔl, amaa a-sie-m-mɛŋ mɔri ya'am kenna.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: Ninsʋma sida la guri ba, amaa banɛ ka' sida dim la, ba zam tʋʋma la na san'ami ba.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Sʋnpɛɛn daar ya'a paae, kpan'am anɛ zaalim, amaa pʋpielim yisid nid kumin.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dimi ka' gba'ar la, zugʋ kɛ ka ba suor an sappi, amaa bugusim dim la ka' alaa, ba bugusim tʋʋma la vɛ'ɛgidi baa sigisid teŋin.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dim bɛllim sʋŋ la yisidi ba amaa banɛ ka' sida la ya'amlɛogʋ gban'adi ba.
