english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Wina'am yisid pʋpiel yɛla ni, ka lɛɛ kɛ ka li keŋ bugusim sɔb la san'an.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Onɛ zi' Wina'am la mɔr o nɔɔr pian'adi san'amid o kpi'a, amaa baŋir na kɛ ka pʋpielim sɔb yii li pʋʋgin.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔb nu'ug ya'a mɔr, teŋ la mɔr sumalisim; bugus ya'a kpi, nidib maannɛ sumalisim tansid agɔla.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Albareka linɛ yit sida dim san'an na la zug ka teŋ la yʋ'ʋr na dʋ, amaa bugus nɔɔri san'amidi li.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ nɛ'ɛsid o kpi'a la ka' ya'am, amaa sida sɔb gban'ad o nɔɔr baanlimm.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Bayɛʋg sɔb viigidnɛ nidib yɛlsu'ada, amaa onɛ ka ba niŋ o yadda su'adi yɛla.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Teŋ kanɛ pʋ mɔr banɛ sa'an la lit nɛ; amaa banɛ sa'an ya'a bɛ, bi'esʋg kae ye ba kʋ nyaŋi.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Onɛ kaanb ye o na di'e saan samme yɔ na nyɛ namisʋg, onɛ wʋsa yis o nu'ugʋ li pʋʋgin mɔr yɔlisim.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Pu'a kanɛ sʋnfʋ bʋgʋs la nyɛt na'asi, amaa dap banɛ maannɛ ba ya'amin la na nyɛ nɛ kpan'am ma'aa.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel sʋŋid o mɛŋ, amaa zaba sɔb ieedi yɛla tisid o mɛŋ.

english_verse: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
translation_verse: Dau bugus di'edi ziri yɔɔd, amaa onɛ bʋt pʋpielim di'edi yɛlsida yɔɔd.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔb amɛŋa nyɛt nyɔvʋr, amaa onɛ kati dɔl bɛ'ɛd gbin la wa'anɛ kumin.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kis banɛ an pʋkpɛnnim dim, amaa o ya'am bɔɔd banɛ pʋ mɔr gbadaa.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Li anɛ sida ye bugusim dim la kʋ nyɛ bʋʋd ka yi namisʋgʋ nɛ, amaa pʋpielim dim la na nyɛ yɔlisim.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Pu'a kanɛ vɛnl ka pʋ mɔr ya'am la nwɛnɛ sanlima baŋi na tʋ kukur nyɔnya ni.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel ya'am bɔɔdim naad nɛ sʋm, amaa bugus ti'ir naad nɛ sʋnpɛɛn.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Onɛ piinid la na maligim nyɛ, onɛ diisid o taaba la mɛ na nyɛɛ di.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Nidib tʋ'ʋdnɛ onɛ vaad diibi su'ad ye o ti kuosi nyɛ nyɔɔd, amaa onɛ siaki kuosid la, albareka bɛɛ o zugin bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Onɛ ieed linɛ an sʋm na nyɛ yɛlsʋm, amaa banɛ ieed bɛ'ɛd la, bɛ'ɛd na kɛɛn ba zugin na.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Onɛ nɔk o ti'iri niŋ o kpan'amin la na li, amaa pʋpiel na nwɛnɛ vanma'asir nɛ.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Onɛ ieed yɛla tisid o mɛŋ yidim la, pɛbisʋg ma'aa na aan o faar; ka zɔlʋg mɛ na an ya'am sɔb sankpan'as.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel tʋʋma anɛ vʋm tiig, ka onɛ mɔr o taaba ken na ka ba dɔl Wina'am anɛ ya'am sɔb.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel ya'a di'e linɛ nar o dunia nwa' ni, ka banɛ zi' Wina'am nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim on kʋ di'e linɛ nari baa?

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋʋnr malis nɛ ninsʋma, amaa o kʋʋs ya'ambɛ'ɛd sɔb la bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Nid kʋ dɔl bugusim suori nyɛ zi'esim, amaa pʋpiel kʋ lii.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Pu'a kanɛ mɔr zusʋŋ anɛ na'am zupibigi tis o sid, amaa pu'a kanɛ diisid o sid nyan nwɛnɛ ban'as o sid kɔnba ni.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔb gban'ar anɛ sida, bugusim sɔb sa'alʋg mɛ anɛ dama'am.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Bugus pian'ad anɛ ninkʋʋr, amaa pʋpielnam pian'adi faandi ba.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a kad bugusim sɔbi yis, o kʋ lɛb na ya'asɛ; amaa pʋpielim sɔb yir zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Ba zun'od ninsaal nɛ o ya'am zug, amaa ka nɛ'ɛsid banɛ pʋ tɛn'ɛsidi paad la.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Li an sʋm nɛ nidi na an tadim ka tʋmmi diisid o mɛŋ, sɔn'oe onɛ dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ ka diib kae.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔb tɛnr o bʋnkɔnbid yɛla, amaa hali bugus nimbaanlzɔɔr anɛ zam.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Onɛ kuod na paam diib bɛdegʋ, amaa onɛ yaannɛ gin zaalim-zaalim pʋ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛrɛ.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Bugus bɔɔdi la'abanɛ ka bugusim dim faand la, amaa pʋpiel ba'a nya'a ka wan walsʋma.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'og mɛŋ pian'abɛ'ɛdi gban'ad o, amaa pʋpiel yiti yɛla ni.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Ninsaal nɔɔr pian'adi tisid o bʋnsʋŋ wʋʋ o nu'ug tʋʋma tisid o nyɔɔd si'em la.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋgʋ tɛn'ɛsid ye o suoya la an sʋm tis o, amaa ya'am sɔb kɛlisidi sa'alʋg.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg sʋnf pʋ ya'asid pɛligirɛ, amaa pʋtɛn'ɛsʋma sɔb pʋ nɔkid tʋ'ʋd ka li an si'ela.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Sida sɔb ditnɛ kasɛta linɛ mɔr sida, amaa ziri kasɛt sɔb pian'ad anɛ faad.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Onɛ pʋ gu'usid la pian'ad kunsidi nwɛnɛ sʋ'ʋg nɛ amaa ya'am sɔb pian'ad mɔri laafi kenna.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Sida sɔb pian'ad zi'enɛ saŋa wʋsa, amaa ziri sɔb pian'ad pʋ yuugida.

english_verse: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
translation_verse: Banɛ gban'e bɛ'ɛd la, ziri ma'aa bɛɛ ba sʋnya ni, amaa banɛ pa'an yɔlisim yɛla la mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Yɛlbɛ'ɛd pʋ paad pʋpiela, amaa bugus bɛ nɛ yɛla ni ma'aa.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kis faad dim, amaa o ya'am bɔɔdnɛ sida dim.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb mɔr o baŋir o san'an baanlimm, amaa zɔlʋg pian'ad o ya'amka'alʋg pian'ad paalʋ ni.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Fʋ nu'us ya'a bɔɔd tʋʋma, li na kɛ ka fʋ lieb na'ab, amaa gbanya'am na kɛ ka fʋ lieb yammʋg.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Sʋnsa'aŋ tadigidnɛ nid, amaa pian'asʋŋ bʋgʋn o sʋʋnr.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel pa'an o zua suosʋma, amaa bugus suor kpɛn'ɛsid o nɛ mɔɔg.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Gbanya'a kʋ nyɛ wɛog ni'imi sɛn'ɛɛ, amaa onɛ tʋm hali nɛ nimmua na paam mɔrim pamm.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim suor mɔr vʋm; ka fʋ ya'a dɔlli li, fʋ kʋ kpii.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Bikanɛ mɔr ya'am di'esid o ba' sa'alʋg, amaa onɛ la'ad nidib pʋ wʋm tansʋgɔ.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Ninsaal nɔɔr pian'adi tisid o bʋnsʋŋ, amaa banɛ ka' sida dim la ieedi zaba ma'aa.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Onɛ gban'ad o nɔɔr gu'ud o nyɔvʋr, amaa onɛ pian'ad yɔri-yɔri la na ba'as yɔri.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Gbanya'a ya'am bɔɔd si'el nɛ ya'amlɛog la, o kʋ nyɛɛ, amaa onɛ bɔɔd tʋʋma hali la na nyɛ ka li sia'al o.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔb kisi linɛ an ziri, amaa bugus diisid o mɛŋ nyan.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim gur yɛlsida sɔb, amaa bugusim lugidi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Dau yinne niŋ o mɛŋ wʋʋ bʋmmɔr, amaa ka lɛɛ ka' si'ela; ka yinne mɛ niŋ o mɛŋ wʋʋ nɔŋdaan, ka lɛɛ mɔr bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Kpan'am sɔb na nɔk o kpan'am la faaɛn o nyɔvʋr, amaa sɔ' kʋ vɔlis nɔŋdaana.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔb nɛɛsim nied nɛ nyain, amaa bugusim sɔb fitir kpiisidnɛ tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Nyɛɛsim sɔb ziidi zaba kenna, amaa banɛ siakid sa'alʋg la mɔr ya'am.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Zam ligidi pʋ ya'asid naarɛ; amaa onɛ la'asid o ligidi bi'el-bi'el, li na nɔbig.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a mɔr ti'ir ka ti kɔ'ɔŋ, li tisidi susʋnya ban'as; amaa fʋ ya'a ti nyɛ fʋ ya'amlɛog bʋn, li sumalisim nwɛnɛ tikanɛ busid nɛ vʋm.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Onɛ ka ba san'an o ka o gbiakid la na nyɛɛ li bɛ'ɛd, amaa onɛ siakid sa'alʋg la na dii li nyɔɔd.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb pa'alʋg anɛ nyɔvʋr bulig ka yisid ninsaal kum bɛndis pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Onɛ gban'ad si'el gbin tɔ'ɔtɔ la nyɛt na'asi, amaa ziri sɔb suor kennɛ san'auŋ zin'igin.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Onɛ an ya'am sɔb wʋsa tɛn'ɛsidnɛ ka nyaan maan si'el, amaa zɔlʋg tʋʋma pa'annɛ o zɔlim paalʋ ni.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a tʋm nimbɛ'ɛd, o na kpɛn'ɛs o mɛŋ yɛla ni, amaa tʋmtʋm onɛ an sida sɔb la mɔri laafi kenna.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Onɛ pʋ siakid zamisʋg la na lieb nɔŋdaan ka di nyan, amaa onɛ siakid pa'alʋg la nyɛti na'asi.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'am ya'a bɔɔd si'el ka fʋ ti nyɛɛ li, li ma'adnɛ sʋʋnr, amaa zɔn la zan'as ye ba kʋ fɛndig ka bas linɛ an bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Onɛ gɔɔnd nɛ ya'am dim la mɛ na mɔr ya'am, amaa onɛ zuanamɛ an zɔn na paam yɛltɔɔg.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Yɛlbɛ'ɛd dɔlli tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb gbin, amaa yɛlsʋm anɛ pʋpielim sɔb din.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Ninsʋŋ yaas na dii o faar, amaa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim kpan'am la su'anɛ gur pʋpielim dim.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Nɔŋ daan pɔɔg na nyaŋi maal zʋʋd sʋ'ʋŋa, amaa teŋ kanɛ ka nidib pʋ dɔl sida la, ba na zii li gaad.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Onɛ zɔt sisanbig nyɔɔg kis o biig nɛ, amaa onɛ nɔŋ o biig na sa'al o sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dim la diti ba ya'am bɔɔd si'el, amaa bugusnam la kennɛ ka kɔ'ɔm kʋʋdi ba.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Pu'a kanɛ an ya'am sɔb la mɛɛd o yir, amaa pu'a kanɛ ka' ya'am la nwa'ad o din.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ dɔl suor linɛ an sʋm ka nar zɔt Wina'am dabiem amaa onɛ dɔl zam suoya la nɛ'ɛsid o nɛ.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg pian'adi kɛt ka o di'ed balaar o nya'aŋ; amaa ya'am sɔb pian'ad gu'ud o nɛ yisid yɛla ni.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Niigi kae zin'isi'a la, gariki la dignɛ zaalim amaa niigi paŋi kɛt ka ti nyɛt zʋʋd bɛdegʋ bun.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Kasɛta sɔb onɛ pian'ad sida la pʋ ma'ada amaa ziri kasɛta la faad.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Ninla'as la ieedi ya'am ka pʋ nyɛta, amaa onɛ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr la nyɛti baŋir na'ana.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Zɔm ka bas zɔlʋg, ka fʋ kʋ nyɛ ya'am o san'anɛ.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb ya'am kɛt ka o mi' linɛ nar amaa zɔltita'ar la ma'ad o mɛŋ.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Zɔn la'adnɛ onɛ sɔsid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd suguru, amaa ninsʋma mɔri Wina'am yɛlsʋm.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Onɛ sʋnfʋ pɛligi mi' lin zabid o si'em, ka sɔ' mɛ kae na nyaŋi pʋdig o sumalisim.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'og yir na san'am, amaa ninsʋŋ din na nɔbigid.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Suosi'a bɛnɛ nwɛnɛ li anɛ sʋ'ʋŋa tis ninsaal, amaa li naar la mɔr o nɛ ken kum zin'igin.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Nid tun'e la'ad ka o sʋʋnr lɛɛ zabid, sumalisim na tun'e naae nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Onɛ ya'am pɔɔd la niŋidi si'el wʋsa yadda, amaa onɛ mɔr ya'am la gu'usidi nɛ o nɔbir yakir.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb zɔti Zugsɔb la dabiem ka luakid bɛ'ɛd, amaa zɔlʋg on nɔkidnɛ o zugʋ kpa' ken.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Sʋnpɛɛn sɔb tʋmnɛ tʋʋmyɔɔd, ka sɔ' wʋsa kis pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd sɔb.

english_verse: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
translation_verse: Onɛ ya'am pɔɔd la ditnɛ zɔlim faar, amaa ya'am sɔb di'ednɛ baŋir wʋʋ na'am zupibig nɛ.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'ɛdnam la na igin ninsʋma tuon, ka bugusim dim la bɛ pʋpielim dim za'anɔya nii sɔsid.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Onɛ an nɔŋdaan la, hali o kpi'es la'am luakid o nɛ, amaa onɛ an kpan'a la zuanam anɛ bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Onɛ nɛ'ɛs o kpi'a tʋm taal amaa onɛ maan fara dim sʋ'ʋŋa la mɔr zusʋŋ.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Banɛ gban'ad gban'abɛ'ɛd la bɔdigid nɛ. Amaa banɛ gban'ad linɛ an sʋm la mɔr nɔŋilim nɛ sida.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Tʋʋm kpi'euŋ wʋsa mɔri nyɔɔdi kenna, amaa azin'i-sɔnsid ziidi nɔŋ na.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Ya'am dim kpan'am anɛ na'am zupibig, amaa zɔltitada la din anɛ zɔlim ma'aa.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Kasɛta sɔb onɛ pian'ad sida la ziid vʋm kenna, amaa ziri kasɛta anɛ faad ma'aa.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Onɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la mɔr suak zin'ig linɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ, ka li mɛ na an suak zin'igi tis o biis.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zɔtim anɛ nyɔvʋr bulig ka yisid ninsaal kum bɛndis pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ dʋ'ʋsid na'am, amaa nidib ya'a kae, san'auŋ na kpɛn' na'abiig.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Suguru sɔb gban'ad si'el gbin, amaa sʋnpɛɛn sɔb pa'annɛ zɔlimis.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Fʋ sʋnf ya'a mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm linɛ tisid niŋgbiŋ laafi, amaa fufum sɔb kɔnba na ba'asi pun'oe.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Onɛ mugusid nɔŋ dim tʋ'ʋdi Onɛ Maali ba la, amaa onɛ maan fara dim sʋ'ʋŋa la na'asid Wina'am.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Bɛ'ɛd ya'a ti lɛb bugusim dim la zugin ba liig paae ya, amaa hali baa kum zin'igin pʋpielim dim na nyɛ suak.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Ya'am bɛ nɛ banɛ mɔr baŋiri ba sʋnfʋn, amaa zɔn pʋn zi' linɛ buon ya'am.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dʋ'ʋsid teŋ yʋ'ʋr, ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd diisid nidib wʋsa nyan.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Na'ab bɔɔdi kpɛɛm kanɛ mɔr ya'am, amaa o ya'a tʋm nyan tʋʋma li duodi na'ab sʋnf.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Lɛbisʋg linɛ an baanlimm yisidnɛ sʋnpɛɛn, amaa ɛndʋg pian'ad duodi sʋnf.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb zilim pian'adnɛ baŋir yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa, amaa gɛdʋg nɔɔr pɛ'ɛl nɛ zɔlim ma'aa.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nini bɛ nɛ zin'ig wʋsa, gɔsid bugusim dim nɛ banɛ tʋm sʋm wʋsa.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Nɔɔr kanɛ pian'adi mɔr laafi na nwɛnɛ tiig linɛ wala an vʋm, amaa nɔɔr kanɛ pian'ad ziri la tisidi sʋnsa'aŋ.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋgʋ nɛ'ɛsid o ba' sa'alʋg, amaa onɛ siakid sa'alʋg anɛ ya'am sɔb.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔb yin mɔri kpan'am bɛdegʋ; amaa bugusim sɔbi nyɛt si'el la ziidi yɛla na.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb pian'adnɛ baŋir pian'ad, amaa li ka' ala nɛ zɔnnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kis bugusim sɔb maan, amaa onɛ bɛllim an sʋm la pʋ'ʋsim ma'ad o sʋʋnr.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kis bugusim dim suoya amaa o nɔŋ banɛ dɔl pʋpielim dim suor.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Namisʋg digi gur onɛ bas suor dɔllim; onɛ kis sa'alʋg na kpi.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Kpi'im teŋ nɛ aba'as-yɔri dignɛ Zugsɔb la tuon ka ninsaalib sʋnf na nyaŋi su'a o san'anɛɛ?

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Onɛ la'ad nidib kis ban na yɛl o gbɛlʋŋ; o pʋ nwɛ'ɛd ya'am sɔb sɔɔraa.

english_verse: Happiness makes you smile; sorrow can crush you.
translation_verse: Onɛ sʋnfʋ malis la lɔdigid o nindaa, amaa sʋnzabir mɔri sʋnsa'aŋʋ kenna.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr la ieed baŋir amaa banɛ an zɔn la zɔlim tʋʋma aan ba diib.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Onɛ bɛ mugusʋg pʋʋgin la dabisa wʋsa anɛ tɔɔg, amaa onɛ mɔr sumalisim la ditnɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a mɔr bi'ela ka zɔt Zugsɔb dabiem li sɔn'oe onɛ mɔr bɛdegʋ ka bɛ yɛla ni.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Li an sʋm nɛ fʋn na ɔnb vaand ma'aa gat fʋn na ɔnbid na'akanɛ mɔr kpaam ni'im ka kisidim bɛ.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Sʋnpɛɛn sɔb ziidi nɔŋgbannwa'ari kenna, amaa suguru sɔb kpiisidi nɔŋgbannwa'ar.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Gbanya'a suor pɛ'ɛl nɛ gɔn'ɔs, amaa onɛ bɛllim an sʋm la suor anɛ suoraug.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Bikanɛ mɔr ya'am ma'ad o ba' sʋʋnr, amaa zɔlʋg nɛ'ɛsid o ma.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg ya'am ka'alʋg ma'ad o mɛŋ sʋnf, amaa ninkanɛ gban'ad si'el gbin la tʋmnɛ linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Onɛ sa'an ya'a kae lin ka yɛla san'amid, amaa sa'ansa'annib ya'a zu'oe ba na nyaŋi maal yɛla.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a lɛbis bu'osʋg sʋ'ʋŋa li ma'ad o sʋʋnr, ka pian'ʋk mɛ ya'a pian' saŋa kanɛ nar, li anɛ sʋ'ʋŋa!

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Mi'ilim sɔb suori tisid o nyɔvʋr ka gur o ka o da sig kpi'im teŋa.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la san'amid nyɛɛsim sɔb yir, amaa ka gur pʋkɔɔnr titɔndis sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kis bugusim sɔb tɛn'ɛsa, amaa o sʋnf lɛɛ malisi nɛ pʋpielim sɔb.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Kpian'asʋg sɔb ziidi yɛla kpɛn'ɛsid o yin, amaa onɛ kʋ siak ye ba da' o la na vʋe yuug.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔb ɛɛnti tɛn'ɛs nɛ sʋ'ʋŋa ka nyaan gandig bu'osʋg, amaa bugus nɔɔr yisidi bɛ'ɛd yɔri-yɔri.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la lal nɛ bugusim sɔb amaa o wʋm pʋpiel winsɔsʋg.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Onɛ pʋ lɔɔd nindaa li tisid o sʋnf malisim, ka labasʋŋ mɛ tisid niŋgbiŋ wʋsa laafi.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Onɛ kɛlisid sa'alʋg linɛ tisid vʋm la, ba na kaal o paas ya'am dim san'an.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa nɛ'ɛs zamisʋg nɛ'ɛs nɛ o mɛŋ amaa onɛ wʋsa siakid o gbɛlʋŋ maligim gban'ad si'el gbin.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zɔtim pa'an ninsaal ya'am, a-sie-m-mɛŋi gat tuon ka na'asi nyaan dɔl.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Ninsaal sʋnfʋ gban'ad gban'ar, amaa Zugsɔb la sʋ'oe maalʋg yɛla.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Ninsaal suoya wʋsa anɛ sʋ'ʋŋa o mɛŋ nini ni, amaa Zugsɔb la kpansid o sʋnfʋ an si'em.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Zaŋim fʋn maan si'el wʋsa tis Zugsɔb la, ka fʋ gban'ar wʋsa na maal sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la maal si'el wʋsa mɔri li naar; hali bugusim sɔb naar anɛ san'auŋ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kis banɛ wʋsa mɔr nyɛɛsim. Baŋimi ye ba kʋ yi namisʋgʋnɛɛ.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Nɔŋir nɛ sida kɛt ka Wina'am na kɛ taali bas; Zugsɔb la zɔtim kɛt ka ninsaal na nyaŋi bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Ninsaal suoya ya'a malis Zugsɔb la, hali o na kɛ ka on nɛ o bi'emnam na la'am bɛ nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Li an sʋm nɛ fʋn na mɔr bi'ela ka li an pʋpielim bunnɛ gaad fʋn na nyɛ bɛdegʋ ka li an zam bʋn.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Ninsaal gban'ad o sʋnfʋn on na keŋ si'em, amaa Zugsɔb la pa'annɛ o nɔba yakid si'em.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Makir linɛ an sʋm ka tu'al yitnɛ Zugsɔb ni na; linɛ ka ba mɔri makid tɛbisim la o ba'a bɛ nɛ li wʋsa.

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Na'anam kis linɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ, bɔzugɔ pʋpielim kɛt ka na'am la zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Na'ab sʋnpɛɛn anɛ linɛ ziid kum na, amaa onɛ mɔr ya'am la na ma'ae li.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Na'ab ya'a ti yidig o nindaa, li mɔri vʋm kenna; o sʋŋir nwɛnɛ saa na kʋ sigir saŋa kenna la.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a paam ya'am li gat fʋn na paam sanlim! Fʋ ya'a bɔ baŋir, li sɔn'oe fʋn na gaŋ anzurifa!

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Banɛ bɛllim an sʋ'ʋŋa la dɔlnɛ suoraug ka bɛ'ɛd kae; onɛ gu'usid nɛ o ken pʋʋgin gu'ud o nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a sie fʋ mɛŋ ka ba kaali fʋ pɛ'ɛs nɔŋdimin, li sɔn'oe fʋn na la'as nɛ banɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ ka ya fan' la'adi pʋdig.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Banɛ kɛlisid ka siakid pa'ala kennɛ tuon, ka albareka mɛ bɛ nɛ onɛ niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Ba buon onɛ mɔr ya'am ye baŋir sɔb; pian'ad linɛ malis la sʋŋid ka pa'alʋg ken tuon.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Banɛ mɔr ya'am gban'ad si'el gbin tɔ'ɔtɔ la, li nwɛnɛ buligi bunnɛ tisidi ba nyɔvʋr, amaa zɔlimis mɔri namisʋgʋ ken zɔn ni na.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb gu'usid nɛ o nɔɔr pian'ad, ka li kɛt ka nidib di'ed o pa'alʋg.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Pian'asʋma malisnɛ nwɛnɛ siind, li malisi tisi fʋ nɔɔr ka tisidi fʋ niŋgbiŋ wʋsa laafi.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Suosi'a bɛɛ nwɛnɛ li anɛ sʋ'ʋŋaa tis ninsaal, amaa li naar mɔr o kennɛ kum zin'igin.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Ya'amlɛogʋ kɛt ka tʋmtʋm nyidigid ka kɔ'ɔm zabir kpɛmisid o ka o tʋm.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'og gban'adnɛ gban'abɛ'ɛd ka o pian'ad dit nwɛnɛ bugum pielim nɛ.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ ieed yɛla tuginnɛ nidib, bayɛʋg mɛ san'amidi zuod.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Zaba sɔb bɛlisid o kpi'a kpɛn'ɛsid o suobɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Onɛ amisid la gban'adi gban'abɛ'ɛd; onɛ mi'ed nidib la tɛn'ɛsidi bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Zupielim anɛ na'am zupibig kanɛ vɛnl, pʋpielim dim ma'aa nyɛti li.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Sumbʋgʋsʋm sɔb sɔn'oe zabzabid onɛ kpi'em, ka onɛ nyaŋi gban'ad o mɛŋ gat onɛ nyaŋ teŋ mum.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm dim bʋgʋlʋm ye ba gban'e gban'ar, amaa gban'ar wʋsa yitnɛ Zugsɔb la san'an na.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a di zɔ'ɔm ka mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm li sɔn'oe yir kanɛ ka fʋ dii tig ka nɔŋgbannwa'ar bɛ.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Sankpan'as kanɛ mɔr ya'am na sʋ'oe yibiig kanɛ diisid o yidim nyan, o na la'asi di faar wʋʋ o anɛ yibiig nɛ.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Bugum ka ba mɔri nyɛligid anzurifa nɛ sanlima siligid, amaa Zugsɔb la kpansid ninsaal sʋnf.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Bugus kɛlisidi pian'ad linɛ an bɛ'ɛd ka faad sɔb mɛ kɛlisid ziri kikɛung.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Onɛ la' nɔŋ dim tʋ'ʋdi Onɛ Maali ba la; onɛ ka yɛla paae sɔ' ka o sʋnf ma'ae la na nyɛ namisʋg.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Yaas anɛ na'am zupibigi tis bʋnkʋdʋg, ka biis mɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋi ba du'adib zug.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Ya'am pian'ad pʋ nar nɛ zɔlʋgɔ; ka li bɛ'ɛd wʋsa anɛ na'akanɛ faad!

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Onɛ da'ad kpi'emnam nɛ ligidi la tɛn'ɛs ye linɛ fɛndigid nidib ya'am; ka on fɛndig zin'isi'a wʋsa o na di ya'an.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa lusid taal kɛt ka nɔŋilim bɛ, amaa onɛ wʋsa tɛɛnsid yɛla san'amidi zuod.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a zɛrig ya'am sɔb vugiri li na tiak o gat zɔlʋgʋ na di'e kpa'asa kɔbiga.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Ninvʋbɛ'ɛd anɛ onɛ zan'asid yɛlsida; ka ba mɛ na tʋm onɛ pʋ zɔt nimbaanlig o san'an ka o vɛɛns o.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a tʋ'ʋs bʋnyua kanɛ ka ba faaɛn o biis sɔn'oe fʋn na tʋ'ʋs zɔlʋg ka o tʋmm o zɔlim tʋʋma.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a maalif sʋ'ʋŋa ka fʋ lɛbis o bɛ'ɛd, bɛ'ɛd kʋ naae fʋ yir pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Onɛ pin'il nɔŋgbannwa'ar li tɔɔg nwɛnɛ fʋn na bi'ed mu'ar; alazug dɛŋim bas yɛl la ka li da lieb zabaa.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Azɛrig bʋʋd sɔb ka tis bugus bʋʋd la anɛ linɛ ka Zugsɔb la kisi li wʋsa.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg ya'a pʋ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye o ie ya'am, o ligidi tʋʋm an bɔ?

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Zua anɛ onɛ nɔŋif saŋa wʋsa, ka ba'abiig mɛ an onɛ sʋŋid yɛlpakir saŋa.

english_verse: It's stupid to guarantee someone else's loan.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ ka' ya'am nɔkid o la'adi zi'en kasɛt ye o kpi'a pɛ'ɛŋ.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Onɛ nɔŋ nɔŋgbannwa'ar la nɔŋnɛ bɛ'ɛd onɛ niŋid ala ieedi yɛla tisid o mɛŋ.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ an zam sɔb la pʋ ken tuonnɛ; ka ziri sɔb mɛ kpɛn'ɛd yɛla ni.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a du'a zɔlʋg li anɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, zɔlʋg saam sʋʋnr ka' ma'arɛ.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Onɛ sʋʋnri malis, li tisid o nɛ laafi amaa sʋnsa'aŋ kpɛn'ɛsidi ban'as nid kɔnba ni.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ an bugus la su'adi di'esid ligidi ye o san'am yɛlsida dim la suor.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Onɛ pʋtɛn'ɛri vʋe la mɔr ya'am, amaa zɔlʋg gi'esidnɛ yɔri-yɔri.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Bikanɛ an zɔlʋg tisid o ba' sʋnsa'aŋ ka kɛ ka onɛ du'a o la sʋʋnr zabid.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Li ka' sʋm nɛ fʋn na namis sɔ' zaalim-zaalim, bɛɛ fʋ bʋ' ninsʋŋ o yɛlsida zugɔ.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ mɔr baŋir pian'adi ka gu'usid ka onɛ gban'ad yɛl gbin sʋnf pʋ pɛligid tɔ'ɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ ka' zua la mɔɔdnɛ o mɛŋ yɛla ma'aa ka zan'asid linɛ an sa'al sʋŋ wʋsa.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg pʋ mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ ya'am zamisʋgɔ, amaa o mɔɔdi ye o pa'al o mɛŋ pʋtɛn'ɛri gban'e si'el la ma'aa.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Ninsaal pian'ad nwɛnɛ ku'ozuluŋ nɛ amaa ya'am nwɛnɛ ku'okanɛ bun buligin.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Li ka' sʋm nɛ fʋn na tis bugusim sɔb bʋʋd ka lɛɛ mɔŋ sida sɔba.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg pian'ad mɔri zaba kennɛ o san'an na, ka o nɔɔr ieed bʋ'ʋdi tisid o.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg nɔɔri san'amid o, ka an baŋi gban'ad o mɛŋ.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Bayɛʋg sɔb pian'ad malis nɛ nwɛnɛ sa'anwɛdir nɛ; li sigid nɛ bɔlimm-bɔlimm paad pʋʋgin sa.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Gbanya'am sɔb nɛ la'asan'auŋ sɔb anɛ ba'abiis.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr anɛ suak zin'ig; Pʋpielnam la zɔti kpɛn'ɛdi su'adi ani ka paam faangir.

english_verse: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a ti dʋ'ʋsid o mɛŋ, o liigi dɔl, amaa A-sie-m-mɛŋ ya'a kena, na'asi dɔl.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Onɛ lɛbis pian'ad ka pʋ kɛlisɛ, li anɛ gɛtim nɛ nyannɛ tis o.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Ninsaal siigi tisid o kpi'euŋ o ban'as saŋa, amaa anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi kpɛmis onɛ siigi tadigɛ?

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɔr ya'am ieednɛ baŋiri paasid; ka o sɔb tʋba yɔ'ɔgi ieedi li zin'ig.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Piini yɔ'ɔgidi suori tit Onɛ piinid la ka vɛ'ɛgid o la'asid nɛ nintitada.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Onɛ dɛŋ tuonnɛ tu'as o pian'ad la li nwɛnɛ on sɔba mɔr bʋʋd, asɛɛ ka o tiraan la ti kena bu'os o bu'osa ka li nie.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Pɔnsʋgʋ pansigid zaba ka widigid paŋ dim banɛ zabid nɛ taaba la.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Ninsaal nɔɔr pian'adi tisid o diib ka o pʋʋr pɛ'ɛn ka o nɔŋgbannɛ tisid o si'el linɛ sia'al o.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Zilimi mɔr kum nɛ vʋm paŋ, ka banɛ nɔŋi li na dii li wala.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Onɛ di pu'a sʋŋ nyɛ bʋnsʋŋ ka na nyɛ sʋŋir Zugsɔb la san'an.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Nɔŋ daan sɔsidi ye ba zɔɔ o nimbaanlig, amaa bʋmmɔr on lɛbisidi nɛ nyinyiug.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Sɔ' na tun'e mɔr zuanam bɛdegʋ ka ba pʋ nyaŋi sʋŋ o, amaa ka zua si'a bɛɛ gati fʋ mabiig.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Onɛ an nɔŋdaan ka ken nɛ burikinnim sɔn'oe zɔlʋg kanɛ ka o nɔɔr pian'ad an ziri.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Li ka' sʋm nɛ fʋn na mɔr nyɛlʋg ka baŋir kae bɛɛ kir tɔ'ɔtɔ keŋ yidig suorɛ.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Ninsaal mɛŋ zɔlimisi san'amid o, la'an nɛ wala ka o sʋʋnr duod nɛ Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Kpan'am mɔri zuanam bɛdegʋ kenna, amaa nɔŋdaan zuanam widigidnɛ ka kɛt o.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ la'asid onɛ an tuongat san'ani bɔɔd sʋŋir, ka sɔ' wʋsa zua an onɛ tisid piini.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Nɔŋ daan sizuop ya'a nɛ'ɛs o, di na niŋ wala ka o zuanam wʋsa kʋ luak o! La'an nɛ on bɛlimmi dɔlli ba la, o ieedi ba ka pʋ nyɛtaa.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Onɛ ieed ya'am la nɔŋ o mɛŋ; ka onɛ mɛ gban'ad si'el gbin la kennɛ tuon.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Li pʋ nar ye zɔlʋg bɛ zin'isʋŋinɛ, ka li bɛ'ɛd mɛ anɛ sankpan'asi na sʋ'oe na'abiis!

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Ninsaal ya'am kɛt ka o an suguru sɔb; on pʋ zaŋid sɔ' taal la zugʋ kɛt ka o nyɛt girima.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Na'ab sʋnf ya'a pɛlig o nwa'amnɛ wʋʋ gbigim, amaa o nimbaanlzɔɔr nwɛnɛ mɛligim na lit mɔɔg zug.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Bizɔlʋg kɛtnɛ ka o saam ba'as yɔri, ka pu'a kanɛ nɔŋ zaba nwɛnɛ ku'om na nyun tuak-tuak nɛ.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ya' nɛ kpan'am anɛ faar linɛ yit du'adibin na, amaa Zugsɔb la tisid pu'a kanɛ mɔr ya'am.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Gbanya'a gbisidi tigid, ka onɛ pʋ siakid ye o nɔbir yaki keŋ tʋʋma ni la, on sɔb na dig nɛ kɔ'ɔm.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Onɛ di'ed zi'ela na vʋe yuug, amaa onɛ nɛ'ɛsi li na kpi.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Onɛ sʋŋid tadimnam pɛ'ɛŋidnɛ tisid Zugsɔb la, ka o na yɔɔ o on maal si'el la zug.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Tɛɛgimi fʋ biig tʋbir saŋa kanɛ ka ti'ir nam bɛ la, ka da bas o ka li kɛ ka o kpi tɔ'ɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Sʋnpɛɛn galisʋg sɔb na nyɛɛ li yɔɔd; fʋ ya'a sʋŋi yis o yɛla ni, o na lɛn kpɛn' ka fʋ lɛn yis o ya'as.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Kɛlisim sa'alʋg ka di'e pa'alʋg, ka li naarin la fʋ na an ya'am sɔb.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛr gban'adi yɛla bɛdegʋ, amaa Zugsɔb la bɔɔdim na zi'en.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Ninsaali bɔɔd si'el anɛ nɔŋilim linɛ pʋ naada; fʋ ya'a an nɔŋdaan li sɔn'oe fʋn na an faad sɔb.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb zɔtim mɔri vʋm kenna: ala ka fʋ na nyɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm ka yɛla kʋ paae fɔ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Gbanya'a na nɔk o nu'ugʋ tʋm laan; amaa ka kʋ nyaŋi nɔki niŋ nɔɔrinɛ!

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Nwɛ'ɛm nintʋ'ʋs ka banɛ nan ka' ya'am la na zamis ya'am; sa'alim onɛ gban'ad pian'ad gbin ka o na paam baŋiri pɛ'ɛs.

english_verse: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
translation_verse: Onɛ faaɛn o saam la'ad ka kad o maa yis la, o sɔb mɔri nyan nɛ zuziigi kenna.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: M biiga, fʋ ya'a pʋ lɛn kɛlisid sa'alʋgɔ, fʋ na yidig ka kʋ baŋ ya'am pian'adɛ.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Onɛ tisid zam kasɛt tʋ'ʋdi yɛlsida, ka bugusnam la vɔn tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋʋ li anɛ diib.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Namisʋg bɛɛ gur nintʋ'ʋsnam, ka bʋ'ʋd mɛ digi gur banɛ an zɔn la.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Daam anɛ ninla'ad ka dankpi'euŋ ziid zabbɔɔsim na onɛ bas o mɛŋ ka daam kpɛn'ɛs o mɔɔg ka' ya'am sɔba.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Na'ab sʋnpɛɛn nwɛnɛ gbigimi na nwa'am; onɛ kɛ ka o sʋnf pɛlig na kɔ'ɔŋ o nyɔvʋr

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Onɛ gban'e o mɛŋ nɛ zaba mɔr girima, amaa zɔlʋg on ieedi zaba tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Gbanya'a pʋ kuod kuob saŋaa; ala ka bunib saŋa ka o gɔsid o pɔɔg ka si'el kae.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛr nwɛnɛ ku'ozuluŋ nɛ amaa baŋir sɔb na gban'e li gbin.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ yɛti ye ba mɔr nɔŋir, amaa anɔ'ɔn na nyɛ onɛ an yɛlsida sɔba?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim sɔb bɛllim pʋ mɔr gba'arɛ; o biis na nyɛ albareka bɛog sa.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi yɛl ye, “Mam pʋʋg anɛ yinne; man anɛ nyain ka pʋ mɔr tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ?”

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Nidib ya'a mak la'ad ka zam taaba kuosimin, li anɛ linɛ ka Zugsɔb la kis hali.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Hali biig gba' tʋʋma ni ka nidib baŋid ye o pʋʋg anɛ yinne ka dɔl suor.

english_verse: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
translation_verse: Tʋba banɛ wʋm nɛ nini banɛ nyɛt la, Li anɛ Zugsɔb la maali ba wʋsa.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Da nɔŋ gbɛɛm ka fʋ na kilim nɔŋdaan; duom tʋm, ka fʋ na nyɛ diibi di ka li kpɛlim.

english_verse: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
translation_verse: Sanlima bɛnɛ ka kugvɛnla mɛ bɛ, amaa ya'am pian'adi gati ba wʋsa.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Nɔkim onɛ kaanb ye o na yɔ saan sam la fuug; o ya'a niŋ ala tis teŋ zʋŋ nid yanam faanmi li!

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a zu diibi di, li malis nɛ o nɔɔrin, amaa li nya'aŋ, o nɔɔr na pɛ'ɛl nɛ zigi.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a gban'e ye fʋ tʋm si'el, fʋn ieem sa'alʋg; da keŋ zaba ka pʋ gban'e fʋn na zab si'em.

english_verse: Stay away from gossips— they tell everything.
translation_verse: Onɛ ginnɛ yɛɛsid viigidi nidib pian'asu'ada paalʋ; alazugɔ luakim pian'agalisʋg sɔb.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a pɔ nɔɔrɛ tis o ba' bɛɛ o ma, o bugum na kpiis lik amɛŋa ni.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Kpan'am linɛ ka fʋ pʋ namis ka paam la kʋ naae nɛ yɛlsʋmmɛ.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Da yɛl ye, “Bɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka fʋ maalim la m na yɔ sammɛ!” Gu'usim ka Zugsɔb la na yɔɔ li sʋ'ʋŋa lɛbisif.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kis nidibi na zam taaba kuosim pʋʋgin, zam makir anɛ linɛ pʋ malis o.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋ'oe ti nɔbir yakir yɛla, ka sɔ' na niŋ wala baŋ linɛ na niŋ o bɛllim pʋʋginɛ?

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la fitiri ieed ninsaal siig, o mɔri gɔsid o sʋʋnrin yɛla wʋsa.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Nɔŋir nɛ yɛlsida na sʋŋ na'ab, ka kɛ ka o zin'inɛ o na'am gbauŋ zugʋ yuug.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Na'akim paŋi aan ba girima, zuobpielim an bʋnkʋd vɛnlim.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Bʋ'ʋkanɛ tisid dɛŋ la yisid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka nwɛ'ɛd mɛ tiakid ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛr.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Na'ab la ya'am bɛ nɛ Zugsɔb la nu'ugin wʋʋ ku'osuor nɛ; onɛ kɛ ka li ku'om pʋbidi ken on bɔɔd si'el.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ninsaal suoya wʋsa anɛ sʋm o mɛŋ nini ni, amaa Zugsɔb la gban'adi li gbin wʋsa.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Sida nɛ fʋn na tʋm linɛ dɔl suor la ma'ad Zugsɔb la sʋʋnri gat maana.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Nimpʋnannim nɛ dʋ'ʋsi-m-mɛŋ ma'aa an nɛɛsim linɛ bɛɛ tisid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Nimmua daan ya'a mɔdig o mɛŋi gban'e gban'asʋma li mɔri nyɔɔdi kenna ka kikirʋg mɛ mɔr nɔŋi kenna.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a dɔlis filim-filim suori paam kpan'am li na naae tɔ'ɔtɔ nwɛnɛ walim nɛ kum bɛndig nɛ.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Bugusnam banɛ nɔŋ zaba la linɛ na mɔri ba keŋ, ban zan'as ye ba kʋ tʋm linɛ dɔl suor la zug.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Onɛ tʋm taal suor anɛ suogɔnlima, amaa banɛ pʋ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd la tʋʋma dɔlli suor.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a gbɛɛnd gɔnnin li sɔn'oe fʋn na gbɛɛnd nɛ pu'a kanɛ nɔŋ zaba.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Bugus ieedi bɛ'ɛd daar wʋsa; o pʋ zɔt o kpi'a nimbaanliga.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Nintʋ'ʋs ya'a ti nyɛ namisʋg, banɛ nan ka' ya'am na zamis ya'am; ba ya'a pa'al ya'am sɔb, o paamidi mi'ilim.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ an pʋpiel la mi' bugusim sɔbi maan si'el o yin, ka na kɛ ka san'auŋ paae o.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a li' o tʋba pʋ bɔɔd ye o wʋm nɔŋdaan kaasiga, on mɛ na ti kaasid ka sɔ' kʋ kɛlisɛ.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a tu'as yɛlsida, li bʋgʋnnɛ pʋpielim sɔb sʋʋnr amaa ka kɛt ka dabiem mɔr tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ bie ka bas ya'am linɛ gban'ad si'el gbin la suorin o na gaadi sig kpi'im teŋ.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Onɛ di'emid ka maannɛ o ya'amin la na lieb nɔŋdaan. Onɛ wʋsa nɔŋ daam nɛ dikpama kʋ tun'e nyɛ kpan'am.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Bugusnam la na di'e pʋpielim dim namisʋg, ka ziri dim la na paam burikinnam namisʋg.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a bɛ pipirigini fʋ kɔn'ɔkɔn', li sɔn'oe fʋn na bɛ nɛ pu'a kanɛ nɔŋ zaba ka mɔr sʋnpɛɛn.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Ya'am dim yin ka arezak nɛ disʋma bɛ ka ba su'a, amaa zɔn yin la ba diti si'el wʋsa naae.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Onɛ ieed nɔŋilim nɛ pʋpielim tʋʋma na paam nyɔvʋwɔk, nɛ pʋpielim, nɛ na'asi.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb zabidi nyaŋid zabzabidib teŋ, ka san'ami ba kpi'euŋ zin'ig linɛ ka ba ti'e la.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa gu'usid o zilim nɛ o nɔɔr yisidi o mɛŋ yɛla ni.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Onɛ an nyɛɛsim sɔb nɛ tita'al, ba buon o sɔb yʋ'ʋr ye, “Nintʋ'ʋs”; o tʋmnɛ si'el wʋsa, nɛ nyɛɛsim ma'aa.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Ya'amlɛog ma'aa na kʋ gbanya'a, bɔzugɔ o ye o nu'ug kʋ tʋm si'ela.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kis bugusnam la maana; ka li kas-kas anɛ on na maal nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Onɛ di ziri kasɛt la na paam san'auŋ, ka onɛ wʋsa kɛlisid o na nyɛ san'auŋ linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ an bugus ma'anɛ lɔdigid o nindaa, amaa onɛ an burikin tɛn'ɛsidi o yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Ya'am si'a kae, mi'ilim si'a kae, gban'asi'a mɛ kae na nyaŋi gaad Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Ba bɔb Wiefʋ gur zaba dabisir, amaa Zugsɔb la sʋ'oe nyaŋir.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Pa'alim biig on na bɛ si'em, ka o ya'a ti nɔbig o kʋ tiak ka basi lii.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Bʋndaane sʋ'oe nɔŋdaan, ka onɛ pɛ'ɛŋ mɛ an on pɛ'ɛŋ sɔ' san'an la sankpan'as.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Onɛ bʋd bɛ'ɛd na bun yɛltɔɔg, ka kʋ lɛm mɔr kpi'euŋʋ na mugus nidiba.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Onɛ tisid piini la mɛ na nyɛ bareka, on pʋdigid o diib nɛ nɔŋ dim la zug.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Kadim nintʋ'ʋs la yis ka sʋnpɛɛn gaad, ka nɔŋgbannwa'ar nɛ zaba na naae.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Onɛ an burikin ka o pian'ad mɛ tisid sumbʋgʋsʋm, on sɔb na an na'ab zua.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kpa'anɛ o nini gɔsid baŋir dim, amaa o lɛɛ kati banɛ kae sida la pian'adi basid.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Gbanya'a pʋ bɔɔd tʋʋma ka ma' ye, “Gbigim bɛ samannin, m pa'a ti yii keŋ ka o kʋʋm!”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Pu'agɔɔndir nɔɔr zulimnɛ nwɛnɛ bʋmbɔk; onɛ ka Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn bɛɛ o zugin la na lii li pʋʋgin.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Biig ya'a tʋm zɔlim tʋʋma sisanbig na sa'al o ka o tiak ka basi li.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Onɛ mugusid nɔŋ dim ye o nyɛ kpan'am paas nɛ onɛ mɔr o la'adi tisid kpan'am dim, babayi' la wʋsa na lieb nɔŋ dim. Ya'am dim pian'ad

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: An baanlimm ka kɛlis ya'am dim pian'ad; kɛl ka fʋ ya'am gban'e man pa'anif si'el la,

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ fʋ ya'a nɔki li niŋi fʋ pʋtɛn'ɛrin ka mɔri li wʋsa fʋ nɔɔrin ala ka li na niŋif malisim.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Mam pa'anif nɛ'ɛŋa nɛ zina ye li kɛ ka fʋ tis Zugsɔb la sida. Ɛɛn, fʋn ka m yɛt!

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: M pa'alif linɛ an sida ka pʋ mɔr viigirɛ, ala ka fʋ na baŋ fʋn na gandig banɛ tʋmif la si'em.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Da faaɛn nɔŋdaan si'el on an tadim la zugɔ ka mɛ da mɔŋ fara sɔb bʋʋd kɔɔtʋ nii,

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la na zabi tisi ba ka na fan' banɛ faaɛn ba la'ad la.

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Da dɔl sʋnpɛɛn galisʋg sɔb zuodɛ, mɛ da la'asi fʋ mɛŋ nɛ onɛ sʋnfʋ pʋ ya'asid pɛligirɛ,

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: ya'a ka' alaa fʋ na zamis o suoya la ka ti kpɛn'ɛsi fʋ mɛŋ bɛndigin.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: fʋ ya'a ti kɔ'ɔŋ yɔɔb, hali fʋ gadʋg linɛ ka fʋ mɔri dig la, ba na faaɛn li.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Da tɔlisi fʋ kpi'a titɔndig kugir kanɛ ka ba da digil kʋdimin sa laa.

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Fʋ nyɛ ninkanɛ mi' tʋʋma sʋ'ʋŋa laa? O na tʋm na'anam yin; o kʋ tʋm tis tadimnama.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Da di dasuŋ sɔb diibɔ, da kɛ ka fʋ ya'am kpɛn' lii;

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a zin'in nɛ na'ab ye fʋ di, gban'ami fʋ mɛŋ ka baŋ banɛ nɔk diibi tisif la an sɔ'.

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a an dindiis, fʋn gu'usimi fʋ mɛŋ.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka kʋkɔma'asim mɔrif nɛ o diib la malis si'em la zugɔ, ka daasi'erɛɛ o bɔɔdi makif nɛ gɔs.

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ o anɛ ninkanɛ buudi tɛn'ɛsid o diib la samme an si'em; o na yɛl ye, “Dim, dim, ka nuu fʋ bɔɔdim bɛn!” Amaa ka o sʋnf lɛɛ kpɛnnɛf.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Da bɔɔdi fʋ tʋm kʋʋ fʋ mɛŋi paam kpan'am; mɔr ya'am ka gu'usid.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a nɔki fʋ nifi kpa' kpan'am, li na gaad wʋʋ li busnɛ kpʋkpama ianknɛ, li na ianki dʋʋ agɔla wʋʋ silʋg nɛ.

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Fʋ na tin linɛ ka fʋ di bi'ela la, ka fʋn faas o si'em la lieb zaalim.

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Da pian'ad nɛ zɔlʋgɔ, bɔzugɔ o na gɔsi ziemi fʋ ya'am pian'ad la.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Da tɔlis kʋdimin sa titɔndig kugirɛ bɛɛ fʋ kuaa kpɛn' kpiibig pɔɔginɛ,

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: M biiga, kɛlisim ka baŋ ya'am, ka kɛ ka fʋ ya'am gban'e linɛ dɔl suor.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Da la'asi fʋ mɛŋ nɛ banɛ gban'e daam nu'us ayi' la bɛɛ banɛ an dindiisnam laa;

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: ka danuudib nɛ dindiisnam na lieb nɔŋ dim, ka gbɛɛm sɔb na yɛɛd kparikɛɛnd ma'aa.

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi fʋ ba' onɛ du'af la pian'ad, ka fʋ ma ya'a kʋdig fʋn da nɛ'ɛs oo.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Da'am sida ka da kuosi lii; ieem ya'am, nɛ zamisʋg, nɛ pian'ad gbin gban'ar.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Bikanɛ an pʋpielim sɔb, o saam mɔri sumalisim; ka onɛ biigi mɔr ya'am o nif tigid o nɛ.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: M biiga, pɛligimi fʋ pʋʋgʋ tisim ka yɔ'ɔgi fʋ nini gɔsi m suoya la;

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: ka pu'a pu'agɔɔndir anɛ bʋmbɔk zulʋŋ ka pu'a bɛ'ɛd mɛ nwɛnɛ bulig kanɛ nɔɔri pʋ yalimma.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: O dig nɛ gu'ud wʋʋ banɛ faand, ka gban'e dau kaŋa lɔ'ɔŋ dau kaŋa ka kɛt ka banɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd la zu'oe pɛ'ɛs.

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ mɔr tɔɔgɔ? Anɔ'ɔnɛ mɔr sʋnsa'aŋa? Anɔ'ɔnɛ bɔɔd zaba? Anɔ'ɔnɛ fabin na? Anɔ'ɔn ka o niŋgbina fieb zaalim-zaalim? Anɔ'ɔn ka o nini mu'oe wii nɛ?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka daam kʋʋli ba, ka ba gɛndigid dankpi'ema kɔn'ɔb, kɔn'ɔbi nuud la.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Da gɔsid daam mu'oe wii si'em laa, bɛɛ lin zi'e nɛ nwammi fuud ka fʋ nuud ka li malis ka sigid bɔlimm-bɔlimm sʋ'ʋŋa la!

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: Li naarin la, li na dumif nwɛnɛ waaf, ka li zɛɛnsim nwɛnɛ dunduug zɛɛnsim nɛ.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Fʋ nini na nyɛt bʋnsaamis ka fʋ pʋtɛn'ɛr pian'ad yɔri-yɔri tisidif.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Fʋ na nwɛnɛ ninkanɛ gbisid atɛukʋn ka dig nwiis banɛ ka ba lɔ anrʋŋ la zug.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Fʋ na yɛl ye, “Ba nwɛ'ɛm,” amaa m pʋ pu'alim! Ba bʋ'ʋm amaa li pʋ zabidima! Bʋndaar ka m na tun'e duoe ka lɛm paam daam nu?

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf zabid nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la bɛɛ fʋ bɛn'ɛd fufum nɛ bugusnam la zugɔ,

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Da mɔr fufum nɛ bugusnama, da bɔɔd ye fʋ la'as nɛ baa;

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ba sʋnf gban'e nɛ zaba, ka ba nɔɔr pian'ad la ieed yɛla.

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb pʋ mɔr bɛogɔ, ka bugusnam la bugum na kpiis.

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Ya'am mɛɛd yir, ka agban'ad si'el gbin kɛt ka li zi'e.

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: Baŋiri kɛt ka yir la dɔɔd la pɛ'ɛn nɛ la'asʋma nɛ kpan'am wʋsa.

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: M biiga, zɔm Zugsɔb la ka mɛ zɔ na'ab la, ka da la'asi fʋ mɛŋ nɛ banɛ pʋ siakid bama nɔɔrɛ,

english_verse: Wisdom brings strength, and knowledge gives power.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ mɔr ya'am mɔr paŋ, ka ninkanɛ mɔr baŋir paŋ mɛ paasid.

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a wa'ae zaba ni ieemi li suoya, ka nyaŋir anɛ fʋn na mɔr banɛ sa'an bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: ka bama ayi' la na kɛ ka san'auŋ paae ba, ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na baŋ yɛltita'ar kanɛ yiti ba san'an na? Ya'am dim pian'ad linɛ pɛ'ɛs

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Ya'am zu'oe galis nɛ zɔlʋgʋ na mɔri li; bɔzugɔ o pʋ ya'ad o nɔɔr nidib sʋʋgin bɛɛ kɔɔtʋ nii.

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Ya'am dim pian'ad linɛ pɛ'ɛsi nwa': Da kad saria nɛ baregaŋa, ka li ka' sʋm.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Onɛ tɛn'ɛsid bɛ'ɛd ba na buon o ye, pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd sɔb.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg gban'ar anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka nidib wʋsa kis nintʋ'ʋs.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa yɛl taal sɔb ye, “Fʋ mɔr bʋʋd,” nidib na pɔ nɔɔri tis o ka tɛɛns wʋsa zan'as o.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a tadig yɛla saŋa, fʋ sid na tadig amɛŋa!

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Amaa si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tis banɛ tu'asid sida la, ba na nyɛ albareka tita'ar.

english_verse: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Faanm banɛ wa'ae kum zin'igin la; ka gban'e banɛ ka ba kʋʋsi ba bɛ'ɛd ye asɛɛ ka ba kpi la.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a yɛl ye, “Amaa tinam zi' nɛ' yɛlaa,” onɛ mi' linɛ bɛ ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛrin la kʋ baŋi lii? Onɛ guri fʋ nyɔvʋr la kʋ baŋi lii? O kʋ yɔ sɔ' wʋsa on tʋm si'el laa?

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a pian' sida li nwɛnɛ on na ʋk o fʋ zi.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: M biiga, dim siind ka li an sʋm siind linɛ an singbana la na malisi fʋ nɔɔrin.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Baŋim ye ya'am mɛ an sʋm tisi fʋ siig; fʋ ya'a nyɛɛ li, fʋ mɔr ti'ir bɛog sa, ka fʋ ti'ir la kʋ naae.

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Kuomi fʋ saman yiiga naae ka naan lɔ'ɔŋ pɔɔg; lin nya'aŋ ka fʋ nyaan mɛɛ fʋ yir.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Da su'a digi gur ye fʋ keŋ san'am pʋpielim sɔb yir wʋʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔbi tʋm si'em la, da keŋ o yinnɛ faaɛn o la'adɛ;

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ pʋpiel ya'a li nɔɔr ayɔpɔi, o na lɛn duoe, amaa zam sɔb tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd na dii o.

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Da di ziri kasɛti zɛrigi fʋ kpi'a zaalim-zaalim bɛɛ fʋ ya'ae fʋ nɔɔri faa tis oo.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Fʋ dataa ya'a li da kɛ ka li ma'ae fʋ sʋnf ka fʋ dii tigɛ; o ya'a tu'ug, fʋn da maal sumalisim.

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: Ka ya'a ka' ala Zugsɔb la na nyɛ ka li pʋ malis oo ka o yis o sʋnpɛɛnni fʋ dataa la san'an.

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: M dɔl gbanya'a la pɔɔgin gaad, ka dɔl zɔlʋg onɛ zi' gban'ar la tiis pɔɔgin;

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: ka nyɛ ka gɔn'ɔs yi zin'ig wʋsa, mɔɔd ma'aa di'e pɔɔg la zan', ka li kuga zaŋguom la lii digi.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: M tɛn'ɛs man nyɛ si'el la ka zamis ya'am li pʋʋgin, ye,

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Onɛ yɛt ye, “Kɛl ka m gbis bi'ela, ka zɔɔnsim bi'ela ka kpɛn'ɛsi m nu'us gɛɛgʋni vʋ'ʋs la.”

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Solomon siilima sieba nwa', ka Hezekia onɛ an Juda na'ab la kpɛɛmnam da la'asi li sɔbi digil:

english_verse: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.
translation_verse: Wina'am nyɛt na'asi nɛ on su'a yɛla la zug; na'anam mɛ nyɛt na'asi nɛ ban vɛɛnsidi baŋid pian'ad gbin la zug.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ agɔla lal ka teŋ zulim si'em la, ala ka fʋ kʋ baŋ linɛ bɛ na'anam pʋtɛnda nii.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Nyɛligim anzurifa yis dian'ad linɛ bɛɛ ani la, ka onɛ tʋm nɛ anzurifa la nɔki li maal la'asʋŋ.

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Yisim nimbɛ'ɛdnam la na'ab san'an, ka o na'am la na ba'a zi'en nɛ pʋpielim.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Da dʋ'ʋsi fʋ mɛŋ na'ab tuonnɛ, mɛ da dɛŋi gaŋ kpɛɛmnam zin'isiga;

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: li an sʋm nɛ on na yɛl ye, “Dʋm kpɛla na zin'in,” n gaad on na diisif nyan burikinnam la sʋʋgin. Fʋ nini nyɛ si'el la

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: da mɔɔd ye fʋ mɔri li tɔ'ɔtɔ keŋ kɔɔtʋ nii, li nya'aŋ la fʋ kpi'a la ya'a ti diisif nyannɛ fʋ na niŋ wala?

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Fʋn nɛ fʋ kpi'a ya'a mɔr nɔŋgbannwa'ar, da viigi fʋ kpi'a la gbin ka kɛ ka li yi yiŋa.

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' ala nidib na wʋmi li ka yʋ'ʋbɛ'ɛd kanɛ bɛɛ fʋ san'an la kʋ yi na'anaa.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Pian'ad linɛ mɔr gbin la, nwɛnɛ sanlima na gɛndig nɛ anzurifa nɛ.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb sa'alʋg nwɛnɛ sanlim tʋblɛm bɛɛ sanlimsʋŋ baŋi tis onɛ kɛlisid nɛ.

english_verse: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.
translation_verse: Bisʋŋ titʋmis ma'ad banɛ tʋm o la sʋʋnr nwɛnɛ zʋʋd bunib saŋa ku'oma'asig nɛ; o bʋgʋnnɛ o zugdaannam sʋʋnr.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Onɛ dʋ'ʋsid o mɛŋ ye o na tis sɔ' piini ka pʋ tis o nwɛnɛ saa na kʋʋ fuk ka pʋ nii.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Suguru sɔb bɛlisidi tuongat, ka onɛ kʋkɔri bʋgʋs nyaŋid yɛl.

english_verse: Eating too much honey can make you sick.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a nyɛ siind fʋn dim zemis; fʋ ya'a dii galis fʋ na tiin li bas.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Da kennɛ fʋ kpi'a yiri pɛndigida, ka o yaama na yiif ka o kisigif.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Onɛ di ziri kasɛti tis o kpi'a li nwɛnɛ balaar bɛɛ zaba sʋ'ʋg bɛɛ piim yabid ka o pu'alim o.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Yɛla ya'a paaf ka fʋ bɔɔd sʋŋir onɛ ka' sida sɔb san'an, li nwɛnɛ fʋ nyina na pun'oe ka fʋ ye fʋ ɔnb si'el bɛɛ fʋ keŋ nɛ nɔbir kanɛ pɔn'ɔlim nɛ.

english_verse: Singing to someone in deep sorrow is like pouring vinegar in an open cut.
translation_verse: Onɛ yʋ'ʋmmi tisid sʋnsa'aŋ sɔb nwɛnɛ ban na kpa'ae bʋmmi'isʋgʋ gɛndig nɛ zɛɛm, bɛɛ sɔ' na yɛɛg o fuug waad daar.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Fʋ dataa kɔ'ɔm ya'a zabid, fʋn tisim o diib ka o di, ka ku'onuud ya'a mɔr o, fʋn tisim o ku'om ka o nu.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a niŋ ala, li nwɛnɛ fʋn na vaae bugumsaana linɛ diti pa'al o sɔb zugin, Zugsɔb la mɛ na yɔɔ fʋ li yɛla.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Sisi'em mɔr saa kenna si'em la, ala mɛn ka kikɛung mɔr sʋnpɛɛnni kenna.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Samannin bɛllim sɔn'oe fʋn na la'as dɔɔgin nɛ pu'a kanɛ bɔɔd zaba.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a wʋm labasʋŋ ka li yi lalli na, li nwɛnɛ ku'onuudi na wʋmif ka fʋ nyɛ ku'oma'asig.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel ya'a ti siak nimbɛ'og sa'alʋg, li nwɛnɛ bulig ku'om na gɛndig nɛ yabid.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ pʋ gban'ad o mɛŋ nwɛnɛ tempʋʋg kanɛ pʋ mɔr zaŋguoma.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ saa pʋ nar ye li niid bunib saŋa bɛɛ sakuga lit dɔnwalig saŋa si'em la, ala ka zɔlʋg pʋ nar nɛ na'asii.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Nɔpɔɔr linɛ ka' gbin la na bus kpʋkpama iank wʋʋ lʋʋr bɛɛ lilaaliŋ.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Wief din anɛ sisanbig, bʋŋ din anɛ ba li'e o, ka zɔlʋg din mɛ an bʋ'ʋd!

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
