translation_verse: Zɔlʋg ya'a bu'osif zɔlim bu'osʋg, fʋn da gandig o zɔlim gandigirɛ, ya'a ka' alaa, fʋn nɛ on na nwɛn taaba.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Lɛbisim zɔlʋg wʋʋ on bu'os si'em la ya'a ka' ala o na tɛn'ɛs ye o mɔri ya'am.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a tʋm zɔlʋg li nwɛnɛ fʋn na ki'e fʋ nɔbir nɛ lieŋe bas, bɛɛ nu yabid.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ pɔn'ɔr nɔbiri zaanlim si'em la, ala ka zɔlʋg siiliŋ mɛ aɛn.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a na'as zɔlʋg, li nwɛnɛ fʋn na niŋ kugir luobigini vɛnlig.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg ya'a siilim siiliŋ, li nwɛnɛ danuudi na yɛl ye o yis gun'a o nu'ugin nɛ.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Onɛ buol zɔlʋg bɛɛ ningɔɔndir ye o kena tʋm baadi tʋʋma nwɛnɛ onɛ tɔɔnd piema yɔri-yɔri pu'alim nidib.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Baa tiind ka lɛbidi dit si'em la, ala ka zɔlʋg mɛ tʋmm o zɔlim tʋʋma takid.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Fʋ nyɛ ninkanɛ tɛn'ɛs ye on mɔr ya'am hali laa? Zɔlʋg sɔn'oe ninkan la.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Gbanya'a pʋ bɔɔd tʋʋma ka ma'aa ye, “Gbigim bɛ suorin, gbigim bɛɛ ani ka li mɔr dabiem hali!”

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ kʋlʋŋi yuulimi li tabidisin si'em la, ala ka gbanya'a digi liebid ka dɔɔn o gadʋg zug.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Gbanya'a na nɔk o nu'ugʋ tʋm laan; amaa ka ʋkim niŋ nɔɔrin la an yɛl!

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Gbanya'a tɛn'ɛs ye on mɔr ya'am gaad nidiba ayɔpɔi banɛ na tun'e gandig bu'osa nɛ ya'am la.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Onɛ zɔti kpɛn'ɛd yɛlbanɛ pʋ paae o la nwɛnɛ ninkanɛ sia'al baa suorin ka gban'e o tʋba.

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Daad ya'a kae, bugum na kpiis; bayɛʋg mɛ ya'a kae, zaba naae ya.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Bayɛʋg sɔb pian'ad malis nɛ nwɛnɛ sa'anwɛdir nɛ; li sigid nɛ bɔlimm-bɔlimm paad pʋʋgin sa.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Biriku'an sɔb pian'ad nwɛnɛ sɔ' na ya'ab yʋʋr, ka nyɛlig kɔlibire bʋligi li ka li vɛnl.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'og pian'ad anɛ linɛ malis, amaa ka bugum zɔɔnd pʋʋgin.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a tu bʋmbɔk, o mɛŋ na lii anina; ninkanɛ mɛ bilig kugir, li na lɛbi diinl o.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Ziri sɔb kis nimbanɛ ka o ma'adi tisidi ba la ka onɛ pan'asidi ba mɛ mɔɔdi ba san'auŋ.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Da dʋ'ʋsidi fʋ mɛŋ bɛog yɛllɛ, ka fʋ zi' bɛogʋ saa na an si'em.

english_verse: Don't brag about yourself— let others praise you.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka sɔ' dʋ'ʋsif ka da dʋ'ʋsidi fʋ mɛŋa.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Kugir tɛbis ka titan mɛ an zitɛbisʋg, amaa zɔlʋg daamʋg gat bama ayi' la wʋsa.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Sʋnpɛɛn nɛ ɛndʋg anɛ bɛ'ɛd ka na nyaŋi zi san'auŋ na, amaa anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi zi'en fufum sɔb tuonnɛ?

english_verse: A truly good friend will openly correct you.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a pian' nyain sa'al nid li sɔn'oe fʋn na su'a nɔŋ o.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Fʋ zua ya'a pu'alimif, li sɔn'oe fʋ dataa na nɔk o nu'ugʋ kuaki fʋ niŋgɔɔnr.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Onɛ dii tig la pʋ bɔɔd siindɛ, amaa nid kɔ'ɔm ya'a zabid, hali bʋntɔɔg gba malis o nɔɔrin.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a yidig o yisuor li nwɛnɛ niiŋe na yidig o tɛog nɛ.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Tudaar nɛ bʋnnyubisa ma'ad sʋʋnr, ka sɔ' sumbʋgʋsʋm yit nɛ on nyɛɛ o zua sa'alʋg si'em.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Da tami fʋ zuanam nɛ fʋ ba' zuanam yɛlaa mɛ da kennɛ fʋ ba'abiisin saŋa kanɛ ka yɛla paaf ma'anɛ; fʋ ya'a mɔr kpi'a onɛ an sʋm sɔn'oe fʋn na mɔr ba'abiig kanɛ bɛ lalli sa.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: M biiga, mɔr ya'am, ka kɛ ka m sʋnf malis; ala ka sɔ' ya'a nɛ'ɛsim, m mi' mam na lɛbis o si'em.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Pʋtɛn'ɛr sɔb dɛŋidnɛ nyɛt yɛltɔɔg ka luakid, amaa zɔlʋg on na gaad tuonnɛ nyɛ namisʋg.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Nɔkim onɛ kaanb ye o na yɔ saan sam la fuug; o ya'a niŋ ala tis pu'agɔɔndir fʋn mɔr fuug la ka li zi'e sam la zi'esim!

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a tansi pʋ'ʋsi fʋ zua bɛkɛung asuba, o na nɔki li ka li nwɛnɛ nɔpɔɔr ka fʋ tis o nɛ.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Pu'a kanɛ nɔŋ zaba nwɛnɛ saa na niid ka ku'om yun ka pʋ gu'oda.

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a ye fʋ gu' o, li nwɛnɛ fʋn na mɔɔd ye fʋ gu' sisi'em bɛɛ fʋn na mak ye fʋ gban'e kpaam nu'ugin nɛ.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Kunti saasid kʋnt si'em la, ala ka nidib mɛ zamisidi yiti ba taaba san'an.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Onɛ sɛ tiig onɛ na dii li nyɔɔd, onɛ tʋmmi tisid o zugdaan na mɔr na'asi.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Ninsaali gɔsid ku'omin ka nyɛt o nindaa si'em la, ala mɛn ka sɔ' wʋsa mɛŋ sʋnf niedi pa'an on an sɔ'.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Kum nɛ yaʋgʋ vɔn ka pʋ tigid si'em la, ala ka ninsaal nini mɛ gɔsid ka pʋ tigida.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Bugum ka ba mɔri nyɛligid anzurifa nɛ sanlima siligid ka li yit nyain, amaa ba makid ninsaal nɛ on nyɛt na'asi si'em.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a bɔɔd fʋn tuom zɔlʋg tuodirin, bɛɛ nɛɛm o wʋʋ zɔ'ɔm nɛ, fʋ kʋ nyaŋi yis zɔlimis linɛ bɛɛ o pʋʋgin laa.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Baŋimi fʋ kɔnbid la bɛllim an si'em, ka guri fʋ niigi la sʋ'ʋŋa;

english_verse: because wealth and honor don't last forever.
translation_verse: ka kpan'am pʋ bɛ saŋa wʋsa, bɛɛ na'am zi'e sʋ'ʋŋa zʋmaana wʋsa nii.

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a kie yaama ka mɔpaalig yina, ka la'as mɔbanɛ bɛ kʋkʋna ni na,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: pɛ'ɛs la kɔnbid na tisif gum ka fʋ ʋg fuud ka kuos bʋʋs la da' pɔɔg.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Fʋ na mɔr bʋʋs bin'isim bɛdegʋ ka fʋn nɛ fʋ yidim nuud ka ugusi fʋ sankpan'asnam banɛ an bipumis la.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Onɛ an bugus la zɔti ka sɔ' pʋ kad oo, amaa pʋpielim sɔb la na mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ wʋʋ gbigim nɛ.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Zaba ya'a ti kɔ' teŋin, banɛ sʋ'oe teŋ la anɛ bɛdegʋ, amaa ninkanɛ mɔr ya'am nɛ baŋir la na kɛ ka si'el wʋsa ken sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Nɔŋ daan onɛ mugusid o taaba la nwɛnɛ saa na niidi da'ad nɛ paŋi san'amid zʋʋd.

english_verse: Lawbreakers praise criminals, but law-abiding citizens always oppose them.
translation_verse: Banɛ pʋ dɔl wada la faasid bugusnam, amaa banɛ dɔl wada la pʋ siakidi li'ennɛ baa.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'ɛdnam pʋ gban'ad sida gbinnɛ, amaa banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la gban'adi li gbin sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a an nɔŋdaan ka an burikin sɔn'oe fʋn na mɔr kpan'am ka fʋ bɛllim pʋ dɔl suorɛ.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Onɛ dɔl wada la anɛ bikanɛ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr, amaa onɛ dɔl dindiisnam la diisid o ba' nyan.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Onɛ di'esid nyɔɔd bɛdegʋ maan kpan'am digin la, o sɔb la'asidnɛ diginɛ tisid onɛ na zɔt nɔŋ dim nimbaanlig.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Onɛ li' o tʋba ka pʋ dɔl wada la, hali o winsɔsʋg anɛ linɛ ka Zugsɔb la kis.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Onɛ nɔk pʋpieli dɔlisid suobɛ'ɛd, o sɔb na lii o mɛŋ baŋin; amaa banɛ pʋ mɔr gba'ar la na di faar linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Bʋmmɔr na tɛn'ɛs ye o mɔri ya'am, amaa nɔŋdaan onɛ an ya'am sɔb la mi' o gbin.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel ya'a ti paam paŋ, nidib maannɛ sumalisim; amaa nimbɛ'og ya'a sʋ'oe teŋ, nidib zɔti su'ad.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Onɛ su'ad o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kʋ keŋ tuonnɛ, amaa onɛ viig o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi tu'as ka zan'asi li na nyɛ nimbaanlzɔɔr.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Albareka bɛ nɛ onɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la; amaa onɛ digilim o sʋnf la na kpɛn' yɛla ni.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ sʋ'oe nidib ka an bugus la nwɛnɛ gbigimi na nwa'am bɛɛ mɔɔgin bʋnyua.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Onɛ sʋ'oe teŋ ka pʋ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛsʋma la mugusidi nidib, amaa onɛ kis zam la nyɔvʋr na wa'am.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Da mɔɔd ye fʋ sʋŋ ninkanɛ kʋ nida; kɛl ka o kennɛ o kɔn'ɔkɔn' ti paae o kum daar.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Onɛ ken ka pʋ mɔr gba'ar la na bɛ nɛ laafi, amaa onɛ bɛllim pʋ dɔl suor la na nyɛ kʋʋsbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Onɛ kuod na paam diib bɛdegʋ, amaa onɛ yaannɛ gin zaalim-zaalim nɔŋ na kʋʋ o.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ an sida sɔb na nyɛ bareka, amaa onɛ mɔɔd ye o nyɛ kpan'am tɔ'ɔtɔ kʋ keŋ zaalim ka da di'e namisʋgɔ.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a maan baregaŋ li ka' sʋm; la'an nɛ wala diib bi'ela yɛla ma'aa zug sɔ' na maal bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ tɛn'ɛsid o mɛŋ yɛla ma'aa ka mɔɔd on na niŋ si'em nyɛ kpan'am, on sɔb zi' ye nɔŋ bɛ suori gur oo.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ zuu o ba' nɛ o ma ka yɛl ye, “Li ka' bɛ'ɛdɛ”; on nɛ na'ayiig anɛ yinne.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Dindiis anɛ onɛ ieed yɛla, amaa onɛ tis Zugsɔb la sida na ken tuon.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Onɛ ti'e o mɛŋ paŋ la anɛ zɔlʋg, amaa onɛ mɔr ya'am ken la, daamʋg kʋ paae oo.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Onɛ tisid tadimnam piini, si'el kʋ pɔ'ɔg o; amaa onɛ fɛndig o nindaa bidi ba la, ba na pɔɔ o nɔɔr.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'og ya'a ti sʋ'ʋg teŋ, nidib zɔtnɛ su'ad; amaa bugusnam la ya'a ti paam san'auŋ pʋpielnam la kpɛn kennɛ tuon.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ zugʋ kpi'em hali ka ba sa'ali gʋ'ʋŋ la; o sɔb na gbirigi paam san'auŋ ka li maalʋg kae.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel ya'a ken tuon, li malis nɛ nidib sʋnya; nimbɛ'og ya'a di na'am, nidib la na unsidi nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ mɔr ya'am la ma'ad o ba' sʋʋnr, amaa onɛ dɔl pu'agɔɔnda la na dii o arezaki naae.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Na'akanɛ tu'asid sida la, o sʋ'ʋlim la zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ, amaa onɛ an fufum sɔb ka di'esid ligidi la na san'am teŋ la.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'og tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi gban'ad o, amaa onɛ an pʋpiel la na yʋ'ʋm ka mɔr sumalisim.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Onɛ an pʋpiel tisid nɔŋ dim bʋʋd, amaa bugusim sɔb on ba'a ka' nɛ ba.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Ninla'asnam la tugunnɛ teŋ nidib, amaa ya'am dim la ma'adnɛ nidib sʋnya.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb ya'a mɔr zɔlʋgʋ keŋ kɔɔtʋ ni, zɔlʋg la na pian'ad pian'ayɛɛd ka maan tʋkpiidʋg ka sumbʋgʋsʋm kae.

english_verse: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.
translation_verse: Ninkʋʋdib kis onɛ an sida sɔb ka mɔɔd ye ba kʋ burikinnam.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg pa'annɛ o sʋnpɛɛn nyain, amaa ya'am sɔb gban'ad o mɛŋ.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Na'ab ya'a kɛlisid ziri, o na'ayikpɛm wʋsa mɛ na an nimbɛ'ɛdnam.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Bʋn yinne bɛ ka nɔŋdaan nɛ onɛ mugusid o taab an yinne; Zugsɔb la niedi ba wʋsa nini.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Na'ab ya'a kad nɔŋdaan saria nɛ sida, o na'am la na zi'en kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Sisanbig nɛ sa'alʋgʋ pa'an biig ka tisid o ya'am, fʋ ya'a bas o ka o tʋm o bɔɔdim o na diis o ma nyan.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Bugusnam ya'a ken tuon, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd mɛ nɔbigidnɛ, amaa pʋpielnam na nyɛɛ ba liig.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Sa'alimi fʋ biig, ka o na kɛ ka fʋ nyɛt sumbʋgʋsʋm; ka lɛn kɛ ka fʋ ya'amlɛog bɛɛ o san'an.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Zin'ikanɛ ka Wina'am nied si'elnamɛ pa'an na nidib la bɛllim an yɔri-yɔri; amaa sumalisim bɛ nɛ onɛ dɔlisid wada la.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Sankpan'as pʋ sʋm ka fʋ san'an o nɛ nɔɔr pian'ad ma'anɛ, daasi'erɛ o na gban'e li gbin, ka lɛɛ kʋ tʋm wʋʋ lin nar si'em.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Fʋ nyɛ ninkanɛ pian'ad ka pʋ gu'usid laa? Zɔlʋg mɔr ti'iri sɔn'oe ninkan la.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a pɔn'ɔli fʋ sankpan'as o biilimin, li naarin la o na san'ami fʋ sʋʋnr.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ an sʋnpɛɛn sɔb la ziid nɔŋgbannwa'ar na, sʋnpɛɛn galisʋg sɔb kpɛn'ɛdi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: Too much pride brings disgrace; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Tita'alim lugid ninsaal, amaa onɛ sied o mɛŋ ka an baanlimm la nyɛt na'asi.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ sʋŋid na'ayiig la anɛ o mɛŋ dataa; ba na kɛ ka o pɔ amaa ka kʋ tun'e dii li sida kasɛta.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a zɔt ninsaal, fʋ bɛnd nɛ fʋ mɛŋ baans, amaa onɛ tis Zugsɔb la sida na bɛ ka daamʋg kae.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ bɔɔd ye na'ab kɛlisi ba pian'ad, amaa li anɛ Zugsɔb la tisid ninsaal sida.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Jake biig Agur nimmua pian'akanɛ ka o pian' tis Itiel la nwa'. O pian'anɛ tis Itiel nɛ Ukal ye, “Wina'am, m gɛnnɛ; Wina'am, m gɛnnɛ ka ligid.

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: Man anɛ zi'ilim sɔb ninsaalib wʋsa sʋʋgin; M pʋ mɔr ya'am kanɛ ka ninsaalib mɔr laa.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: M pʋ zamis ya'am, bɛɛ mɔr baŋir Onɛ an Kasi la yɛlaa.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ dʋ arezana ni ka sig na? Anɔ'ɔnɛ nam mi' gban'e pɛbisim nɛ o nu'ugɔ? Anɔ'ɔnɛ nam mi' pɔnbil ku'om nɛ fuugɔ? Anɔ'ɔnɛ digil teŋgbauŋ la bɛn wʋsa ɛɛnbirɛ? O yʋ'ʋrɛ? Ka o biig la yʋ'ʋrɛ? Fʋ ya'a mi' fʋn yɛlimim!

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: Wina'am pian'ad wʋsa anɛ sida nyain; o anɛ gbanti'edʋg banɛ ieed suak zin'ig o san'an la.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Da paas si'el o pian'ad la zugɔ, ya'a ka' ala o na tansif ka li pa'al ye fʋ anɛ ziri sɔb.

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: Bʋnama ayi' ka m sɔsidif, O Zugsɔba; tʋmmi li tisim man nan vʋe la.

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka faad nɛ dama'am lal nɛ m ka da kɛ ka li bɛɛ m san'anɛ. Mɛ da kɛ ka m an nɔŋdaan tapigif bɛɛ m mɔri galisɛ, amaa tisimim linɛ na sia'alim dabisir wʋsa.

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' ala m na mɔr bɛdegʋ ka tami fʋ yɛla ka yɛl ye, ‘Zugsɔb la aan anɔ'ɔnɛ?’ Bɛɛ m an nɔŋdaan ka zu, ka li san'ami m Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: Da zɛrig tʋmtʋmi tis o zugdaana, ka o na pɔ nɔɔri tisif, ka fʋ nyɛ li namisʋg.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: Ninsieba bɛɛ pɔɔd nɔya tisidi ba saamnam ka pʋ kaanbid sʋ'ʋm tisidi ba manama.

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Nimban gɔsi ba mɛŋ ka ba anɛ kasi ka zi' ye ba lɛɛ anɛ dian'ad dima.

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: Ba anɛ nimpʋnannib ka pʋ gɔsid nidibi nyɛta.

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: Adanyɔb mɔri bipumis ayi' ka ba kaasidi yɛt ye, ‘Tisim! Tisim!’ Ka pʋ tigida. Ala ka bʋnam atan' bɛɛ nan zi' tigɛ, ka bʋnam anaasi nan zi' yɛl ye, ‘Li sia'al yaa!’

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Bama anɛ: yaʋg nɛ kʋndu'ar nɛ teŋ kanɛ zi' tig ku'om. Bugum mɛ nan zi' yɛl ye, ‘M dii sia'alɛ!’

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ nɔk o ba' maal bʋnla'adir ka nɛ'ɛsid o ma ka pʋ di'ed o nɔɔr la, agaand na yi bɔn'ɔgin na nwɛ' ba gaad wʋʋ silʋg nɛ, ka zʋʋnd dii ba.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Bʋnama atan' bɛɛ an nyalima tisim, anaasi ka m pʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ.

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Bama anɛ: silʋg suor saŋgbana ni, waaf suor tampiing zug, anrʋŋ tita'ar suor atɛukʋn, nɛ dau nɛ pu'asadir nɔŋir suoya.

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Bʋnam atan' ka teŋgbauŋ la nyɛt ka kirid, bʋnam anaasi ka o kʋ nyaŋi ba.

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Bama anɛ: Sankpan'asi na di na'am, nɛ zɔlʋgʋ na di diibi tig,

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: pu'a kanɛ ka nidib pʋ bɔɔd o la na kul sid, nɛ pu'a-ɛliŋi na kad yipu'a ka lɛdig.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Bʋnam anaasi bɛ teŋgbauŋ la zugʋ pɔɔd, amaa ka ba paŋ lɛɛ galis nɛ. Bama anɛ:

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: salinsa'as banɛ ka ba paŋ pɔɔd la'an nɛ wala ka ba su'adi ba diibi paad dɔnwalig;

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: bʋnvʋbaanlʋg banɛ ka ba paŋ pɔɔd, la'an nɛ wala ka ba maali ba gbɛɛnb zin'ig tampiins sian'asimin;

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: na'azɔmnam pʋ mɔr na'aba, la'an nɛ wala ba kennɛ salililili;

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: fʋ na nyaŋi gban'e akɔn'ɔs nɛ nu'ug, la'an nɛ wala ba bɛ na'ayin.

english_verse: Three or four creatures really strut around:
translation_verse: Bʋnama atan' bɛ ka fʋ nanɛ ba ken, bʋnama anaasi kennɛ ba ya'amin.

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: nɔraug kanɛ ken nɛ nyɛɛsim, nɛ bʋraug nɛ na'ab kanɛ ka o soogianam gilig o.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a an zɔlʋg ka dʋ'ʋsi fʋ mɛŋ, bɛɛ fʋ gban'anɛ gban'abɛ'ɛd, nɔkimi fʋ nu'usi pin' fʋ nɔɔr.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, nwɛnɛ bin'isgbisidim yisid bin'iskpaam, ka nyɔnya nwɛ'ɛb yisid ziim si'em la, ala mɛn fʋ ya'a kɛ ka sʋnpɛɛn duoe li ziidnɛ zaba na.”

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Na'ab Lemuel maa pa'al o pian'asieba nwa':

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: “M biiga, m mɛŋ pʋʋgin biiga, M nɔɔr kaanbʋg biiga,

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: da mɔri fʋ paŋi san'amid nɛ pu'aba, da mɔri fʋ daulim ken banɛ san'amid na'anam la san'anɛ.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: M biig Lemuel, li ka' na'anam tʋʋma la, li ka' sʋm ye na'ab nuud daam, bɛɛ banɛ sʋ'oe tɛɛns la bɔɔd dankpi'ema;

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Nɔkim dankpi'ema tis banɛ bɔɔd kum la ka ba nu, sʋnsa'aŋ dimi bɔɔd daam;

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: kɛl ka ba nu ka tami ba nɔŋ la yɛla ka mɛ da lɛn tiɛnri ba fara la yɛla ya'asɛ.

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: Pian'am sʋŋ banɛ kʋ nyaŋi pian' ba mɛŋ yɛla la, ka sʋŋ banɛ mɔr bʋʋd ka pʋ mɔr sʋŋir la.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Pian'am ka kad saria ka li dɔl suor; ka zabi sʋŋ nɔŋ nɛ fara dim.” Pu'a kanɛ kik ka mi' o mɛŋ mɔrim

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn kimm lɛɛ na nyaŋi paam pu'a kanɛ an pu'amɛŋa? O gaad fʋn na mɔr sanlim.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: O sid ti'ir wʋsa bɛ nɛ o san'an ka linɛ an bʋnsʋŋ wʋsa pʋ kɔ'ɔŋid o san'anɛ.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: O vʋm pʋʋgin wʋsa, o maannɛ o sid sʋ'ʋŋa ka gbɛlʋŋ kae.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: O kpɛ'ɛŋid o mɛŋi gaansid gum sʋŋʋ nwiid ka ʋgʋd piena.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: O nwɛnɛ anrʋŋ kanɛ ka ba mɔri kpiisid, o ziidi diibi yit lalli sa kenna.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: O na dɛŋi duoe ka bɛog nam pʋ nie maal diibi tis o yidim ka pa'al o yir tʋmtʋm bipumis la sɔ' wʋsa nɛ o tʋʋma.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: O ɛɛnti gɔs nɛ paalʋ kanɛ an sʋm ka da' li: on tʋm nyɛ si'el la ka o nɔki kuo pɔɔg.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: O mi' ye o kpikpiŋ an sʋm ka li tisid o nyɔɔd; o na tʋm ka yʋ'ʋŋ ti kena sɔb.

english_verse: She spins her own cloth,
translation_verse: Onɛ kaad o mɛŋ gum, ka ʋgid o mɛŋ fuud.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: O sʋŋidi nɔŋ dim ka mɛ pʋ mɔŋid fara dima.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Waadi bɛ daasi'ɛr hali la, dabiem pʋ mɔr o, o yidim yɛlaa; bɔzugɔ ba wʋsa mɔr waad fuud.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: O mɛŋi maan fubanɛ na yadig gadʋg; ka sɔɔnd fuud banɛ pɔnri vɛnl.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Ba na'asid o sid wʋrʋg sʋʋgin, zin'ikanɛ ka o zin' nɛ teŋ la kpɛɛmnam la.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: O sɛɛnd fuudi kuosid, ka banɛ kpiisid la kennɛ o san'an na da'ad sɛnbidis.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: O mɔr paŋ nɛ girima; ka bɛog sa o saa na zin' ka dit ka maan sumalisim.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: O pian'adi nɛ ya'am ka on pa'an si'el wʋsa an sida.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: O gɔsid o yir sʋ'ʋŋa ka pʋ mɔr gbanya'am ka na kɔ'ɔŋ diibɔ.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: O biis na duoe na ka kaanb, kaanb sʋŋʋ tis o; ka o sid mɛ na faas o ka ye,

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: “Pu'ab bɛdegʋ tʋm tʋʋm sʋma, amaa fʋ gaadi ba wʋsa.”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a bɔbi fʋ mɛŋ nɛ fusʋma, li bɛligidnɛ nidib ka vɛnlim wʋsa mɛ na gaad; amaa pu'a kanɛ na'asid Zugsɔb la nar ye ba zun'e o.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Tisim o yɔɔd linɛ nar ye o di'e la, ka kɛ ka o tʋʋma la tis o girima nidib la'asʋg zin'igin.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Labakaŋa yinɛ Pa'an onɛ an David biig ka da di na'am Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la na.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: Pa'an la yɛl ye, “Li ka' gbinnɛ! Li ka' gbinnɛ Asida si'el wʋsa ka' gbinnɛ!

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Ninsaal na nyɛ nyɔbɔ yit tʋʋm kanɛ ka o tʋm dunia nwa' pʋʋginɛ?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Zʋmaana kena ka gaad, amaa dunia la on kpɛm bɛ nɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Winnig tansid ka lɛm kpɛn'ɛd, ka lɛbid on yi zin'isi'a la na tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Pɛbisʋg la da'adnɛ ken ya-tuona ka lɛbid ya-nya'aŋi giligid on yi zin'isi'a na.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Ka kɔldaad wʋsa pʋbidi sigid Atɛukʋn, amaa Atɛuk la pʋ pɛ'ɛnna. Kɔldaad la yi zin'isi'a na la, ani ka ba na lɛb.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Si'el wʋsa mɔri gɛɛnlis, li tʋʋg ninsaal pian'ad bɛn; sɔ' nini nan zi' gɔsi tigɛ, bɛɛ sɔ' tʋbir wʋm tigɛ.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before; nothing is new, nothing under the sun.
translation_verse: Dinɛ pʋn kena la na lɛn kena, ka dinɛ pʋn tʋm la na lɛn tʋm. Si'el kae an bʋmpaal dunia kaŋa nii.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Sɔ' pʋ lɛn tɛn'ɛsid zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ gaad la nidib yɛla ya'asɛ; hali ka banɛ na dɔl banɛ na ti kenna la nya'aŋ kʋ tiɛn ba yɛlaa.” Baŋir ka' gbinnɛ

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Mam kanɛ an Pa'an la da anɛ Israel na'ab Jerusalem tempʋʋgin.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: Ka kpɛ'ɛŋi m mɛŋi zamis ye m baŋ ya'am an si'em, nɛ baŋiri zaŋi ken dunia nwa' pʋʋgin yɛla wʋsa. Abɔnam yɛla nwa' ka Wina'am zaŋi ziil ninsaaliba!

english_verse: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: M da gɔsi nyɛ linɛ maal dunia nwa' ni, ka li wʋsa anɛ zaalim wʋʋ fʋn na kad pɛbisʋg ye fʋ gban'e nɛ.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Dinɛ pɔnd la kʋ nyaŋi tiɛn sappii. Ka linɛ kae la kʋ nyaŋi kaalɛ.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: M tɛn'ɛsi m sʋʋnrin sa ye, “Gɔsima, m nɔbig ya ka mɔr ya'am hali gaad na'abanɛ wʋsa nam mi' sʋ'oe Jerusalem. M paam ya'am nɛ baŋir bɛdegʋ.”

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn nɔki m mɛŋi mak nɛ ya'am nɛ baŋir, ka lɛn vɛɛnsi mak gɛɛmis nɛ zɔn yɛla, ka yʋ'ʋn baŋ ye li wʋsa anɛ zaalim wʋʋ fʋn na kad pɛbisʋg ye fʋ gban'e nɛ.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Ya'am galisʋg lɛn anɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, ka fʋ ya'a mɔr baŋiri galis li anɛ namisʋg.

english_verse: I said to myself, “Have fun and enjoy yourself!” But this didn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ka m tɛn'ɛsi m sʋnfʋn sa ye, “Tɔ', kɛl ka m tʋmim ya'amlɛog bɔɔdim ka gɔs ye bɔɔ na niŋɛ.” Amaa din wʋsa mɛ anɛ zaalim.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: Man nyɛ ka di'emyaalis anɛ zɔlimis, ka nyɔbɔɔ yit ya'amlɛog tʋʋma ni?

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛlim mɛŋ ye, m na bʋgʋli m sʋnf nɛ daam hali ka maali m mɛŋ wʋʋ zɔlʋg nɛ, amaa ka m ya'am nam kpɛn vʋe. M da bɔɔd ye m kpansi gɔs ye bɔɔ nar ye ninsaal tʋm saŋa bi'ela kanɛ ka o mɔr dunia nwa' ni.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: Ka m tʋm tʋʋm kpi'ema ka mɛ' yaa tisim mɛŋ ka kua pɔɔd bɛdegʋ,

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: ka maal lɔmbɔn'ɔdi sɛ tiwanna buudi wʋsa li pʋʋgin,

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: ka ga mu'a mɔri dɔn'ɔsidi m tiis la.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: M mɛ da lɛn da' yamdaad nɛ yampu'abi pɛ'ɛs, ka ba sieba la'an du'a m yin. Ka m mɛ mɔr niigi nɛ kɔnbidi gat nimbanɛ wʋsa da bɛ Jerusalem ka man nan kae.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: M da paam anzurifa nɛ sanlima bɛdegʋ ka di'es areza'as tɛɛns bɛdegʋ na'anam san'an tisim mɛŋ; ka mɛ la'as dap nɛ pu'a banɛ yʋ'ʋmmi tisidim, nɛ pu'ab bɛdegʋ banɛ na ma'ae dau sʋnf.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: Ka m kpi'euŋ yʋ'ʋn da gat na'abanɛ wʋsa dɛŋi m tuon Jerusalem tempʋʋgin; ka la'an nɛ lin wʋsa m ya'am da nam kpɛn vʋe.

english_verse: I got whatever I wanted and did whatever made me happy. But most of all, I enjoyed my work.
translation_verse: Linɛ wʋsa ka m nif da nyɛ ka bɔɔd la, m da paamidi li, ka pʋ zan'asi m ya'am bɔɔdim. M sʋnf da ma'ae nɛ m tʋʋma wʋsa, ka nwa' da aan m tʋʋma la wʋsa nyɔɔd.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala wʋsa man da gɔsi m nu'ug tʋʋma ka nyɛ man namisi paam si'el wʋsa la, m nyɛ ka li wʋsa ka' gbinnɛ, wʋʋ fʋn na kad pɛbisim ye fʋ gban'e nɛ. Si'el kae mɔr nyɔɔd dunia nwa' nii. Ya'am nɛ zɔlimis wʋsa anɛ yɔri

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Ka m yʋ'ʋn pin'ili tɛn'ɛsid, ya'am nɛ gɛɛmis nɛ zɔlimis yɛla. Na'apaal na tʋm bɔ ka li ka'anɛ linɛ pʋn tʋm sa?

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ ka ya'am mɔr nyɔɔdi gat yalimis, nwɛnɛ nɛɛsim mɔr nyɔɔdi gat lik si'em la.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb mɔr nini nyɛt, ka zɔlʋg on ken lik. Amaa m kpansi baŋ ye bʋn yinne paadi ba wʋsa.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Tɔ', ka m lɛn tɛn'ɛsi m sʋʋnrin sa ye yɛl linɛ paad zɔlʋg mɛ paad mam. Dinzugɔ, nyɔbɔ ka man nyɛ m ya'am la pʋʋginɛ? Ka m yɛli m sʋʋnrin sa ye, “Nɛ' mɛ ka' gbinnɛ.”

english_verse: This made me hate life. Everything we do is painful; it's just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Alazug ka m kisig dunia nwa' bɛllim bɔzugɔ li anɛ namisʋg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋi tisim. Ka li wʋsa ka' gbinnɛ, wʋʋ fʋn na kad pɛbisim nɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Ka m kisig bʋn linɛ wʋsa ka m tʋm nyɛ dunia nwa' ni bɔzugɔ, m na basi li tis onɛ na dɔllim nya'aŋ na.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na baŋ ye o sɔb na an ya'am sɔb bɛɛ zɔlʋgɔ? La'an nɛ wala o na sʋ'oe bʋn dinɛ wʋsa ka m zaŋi m ya'am tʋm namis ka nyɛ dunia nwa' ni la. Nɛ' mɛ ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: Ala ka m sʋnf pin'ili san'am m dunia namisʋg nwa' zug.

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: Nid na nɔk o ya'am nɛ baŋir nɛ mi'ilim tʋm o tʋʋma, ka di an tilas ye o bas on paam si'el wʋsa la tis ninkanɛ pʋ namisi di yɛlaa. Nɛ' mɛ ka' gbinnɛ ka mɛ an zutɔɔg.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Bɔ nyɔɔd ka ninsaal nyɛti yi o dunia nwa' fara nɛ namisʋg pʋʋginɛ?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Daar wʋsa o tʋʋma anɛ namisʋg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, la'an nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa o ya'am pʋ dig ya. Nɛ' mɛ ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Nid kʋ tʋm bʋnsʋŋ si'a gaad on na di ka nu ka nyɛ sumalisim o tʋʋma nii. M mɛ nyɛ ka lina wʋsa yinɛ Wina'am san'an na

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ, ya'a ka' onɛ, anɔ'ɔnɛ na di bɛɛ nyɛ malisim?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Dau kanɛ ma'ae Wina'am sʋnf la ka o tisid o ya'am nɛ mi'ilim nɛ sumalisim. Amaa o kɛtnɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb namisid ka la'as areza'asi digili tis onɛ ma'ae Wina'am sʋnf la. Ka li wʋsa ka' gbin wʋʋ fʋn na ye fʋ kad pɛbisim gban'e nɛ.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Si'el wʋsa mɔri li saŋa. Tʋʋma wʋsa mɔri li saŋa dunia nwa' ni.

english_verse: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping,
translation_verse: Du'am saŋa bɛ nɛ, ka kum saŋa bɛ; sɛɛb saŋa bɛ nɛ, ka vɔɔnb saŋa bɛ;

english_verse: There is a time for finding and losing, keeping and giving,
translation_verse: Ieeb saŋa bɛ nɛ, ka bɔdigir saŋa bɛ; mɔrim saŋa bɛ nɛ, ka basib saŋa bɛ.

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: nɔŋilim saŋa bɛ nɛ, ka kisigir saŋa bɛ; zaba saŋa bɛ nɛ, ka sumbʋgʋsʋm saŋa bɛ.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka tʋmtʋm nyɛti yii o namisʋg pʋʋginɛ?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: M nyɛ namiskanɛ ka Wina'am nɔki ziil ninsaalib la.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: O maal si'el wʋsa ka li vɛnli li saŋa, ka mɛ kɛ ka saalib tɛn'ɛsid saŋa linɛ gaad nɛ linɛ kenna la yɛla wʋsa. Amaa nɛ wala wʋsa ba kʋ tun'e baŋ on maal si'el la wʋsa lin yi pin'ilʋgʋn ken paae li naarin la gbinnɛ.

english_verse: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life,
translation_verse: Mam mi' ye bʋnsʋŋ si'a kae gat ninsaali na mɔr sumalisim ka mɛ tʋm sʋ'ʋm o vʋm saŋaa.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: Linɛ paas anɛ ye sɔ' wʋsa na tun'e di ka nu ka mɔr sumalisim ka li yinɛ o tʋʋma ni na. Nɛ' anɛ Wina'am piini.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: M mi' ye bʋn linɛ ka Wina'am maal pʋ naada. Si'el kʋ tun'e paasɛ, ka si'el mɛ kʋ yii di pʋʋginɛ. Wina'am maal ala ye nidib tis o girima bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Bʋn kanɛ da pʋn tʋm nɛ bʋnkanɛ na tʋm wʋsa anɛ linɛ pʋn tʋm sa. Ka Wina'am na kɛ ka bʋn linɛ gaad la wʋsa lɛm maal ya'as.

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn tɛn'ɛs m sʋnfʋn ye Wina'am na kad ninsʋma nɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam wʋsa saria. Bɔzugɔ tʋʋm wʋsa mɔri li saŋa nɛ li maalʋg suor.

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn tɛn'ɛs ye Wina'am kɛtnɛ ka ninsaalib baŋid ye ba anɛ wʋʋ bʋnkɔnbid nɛ.

english_verse: Like animals we breathe and die, and we are no better off than they are. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Dinɛ na niŋ ninsaal la, dinɛ mɛ na niŋ bʋnkɔnbid. Saalib na kpi wʋʋ bʋnkɔnbidi kpiid si'em la, ba wʋsa mɔri vʋm yinne. Ninsaal pʋ mɔri nyɔsi'a gat bʋnkɔnbʋgɔ. Nɛ' mɛn wʋsa ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa kennɛ zin'ig yinne. Ba wʋsa yinɛ tannin na ka tannin ka ba na lɛb.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi baŋ ye ninsaal siig dʋt nɛ agɔl ka bʋnkɔnbʋg siig sigid teŋinɛ?

english_verse: We were meant to enjoy our work, and that's the best thing we can do. We can never know the future.
translation_verse: Ala ka m baŋ ye bʋnsʋŋ kae tis ninsaali gat on naanɛ di malisim o tʋʋma pʋʋginɛ, bɔzugɔ linɛ aan o nyɔɔd. Anɔ'ɔnɛ na ti mɔr o lɛb na ka o nyɛ linɛ na tʋm o kum nya'aŋa?

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn gɔs ya'as ka nyɛ mugusʋg buudi wʋsa dinɛ bɛ dunia nwa' ni. M nyɛ bam mugusid sieba la ninta'am ka sɔ' ka' bɛlisidi baa. Paŋ bɛ nɛ banɛ mugusidi ba la nu'usin, dinzug ka sɔ' ka' bɛlisidi baa.

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl nyain ye banɛ pʋn kpi sa la mɔr sumalisim gat banɛ vʋe la.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ sɔn'oe wʋsa anɛ onɛ ka ba nam pʋ du'a. On sɔb nam pʋ nyɛ bɛ'ɛd kanɛ namisid nidib dunia ni laa.

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn nyɛ ka baŋ ye fufum nɛ ti taaba zugʋ kɛ ka saalib pamm tʋm hali. Nɛ' mɛ ka' gbinnɛ. Li anɛ wʋʋ fʋn na kad pɛbisim nɛ.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg kaknɛ o nu'us ka kʋ siaki tʋmm hali ka kɔ'ɔm kʋʋd o.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a mɔr bi'ela ka mɔr sumalisim sɔn'oe onɛ tʋm paam ka namisid ka di an wʋʋ o katnɛ pɛbisim ye o gban'e nɛ.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: M lɛn nyɛ si'el ya'as ka li ka' gbin dunia nwa' nii:

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Dau da bɛ aan o kɔn', ka ka' ba'abiig bɛɛ o mɛŋ biiga. O tʋʋma da ka' bɛnnɛ. Nɛ wala o nini daa pʋ tig o arezak la. Ka o bu'os o mɛŋ ye, “Man tʋmmi tisid anɔ'ɔnɛ? Bɔ ka m mɔŋi m mɛŋ sumalisim?” Nɛ' mɛ anɛ namis zaalig ka ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Nidib ayi' ya'a la'am bɛ sɔn'oe nid yinne bɔzugɔ ba na tun'e tʋm paam nyɔɔd bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Ayinne ya'a lu, o tiraan na nyaŋi sʋŋ o ka o duoe. Amaa nid ya'a lu ka sɔ' kae na sʋŋ o ka o duoe, o bɛ nɛ yɛla ni.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Nidib ayi' ya'a la'asi digi li anɛ wamm. Amaa nid ya'a dig o kɔn'ɔkɔn', li na niŋ wala an wamm nɛ?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Nid yinne nyaŋir pʋ tɔya, Amaa nidib ayi' na tun'e sʋŋ taaba yi yɛla ni. Hali nwiig kanɛ pan'am atan' pʋ kɛnsigid na'anaa.

english_verse: You may be poor and young, but if you are wise, you are better off than a foolish old king who won't listen to advice.
translation_verse: Dasaŋ onɛ an nɔŋdaan ka mɔr ya'am gat bʋnkʋdʋg onɛ an na'ab ka an zɔlʋg ka mɛ pʋ lɛn di'ed nimmua sa'alʋgɔ.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: Li tun'e anɛ ye dasaŋ nwa' yinɛ sanrega ni na di na'am la, bɛɛ ba mɛ tun'e du'a o nɛ nɔŋin.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ ka banɛ wʋsa vʋe ka bɛ dunia nwa' ni la dɔl na'apaal la.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ dɔl o la ka' bɛnnɛ. Amaa ka zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ yuolim la kʋ mɔr sumalisim nɛ na'ab nwaa. Nɛ' mɛ ka' gbinnɛ. Li anɛ wʋʋ fʋn na kad pɛbisim ye fʋ gban'e nɛ.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a keŋ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin fʋn gu'usimi fʋ mɛŋ. Kem ka kɛlis sʋ'ʋŋa, gaad fʋn na maan maana wʋʋ zɔn banɛ zi' ye ba tʋm bɛ'ɛd la maan si'em la.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka fʋ nɔɔr pian'ad tɔ'ɔtɔ pa'an linɛ bɛɛ fʋ sʋnfʋn ka gbirigi kaanbi zi'el Wina'am tuonnɛ. Wina'am bɛ nɛ agɔl ka fʋn mɛ bɛ teŋin. Alazug kɛl ka fʋ pian'ad an fiin.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ yɛl babigi na bɛ sɔ' sʋnfʋn ka li kɛ ka o zaansim si'em la, ala ka li na an nɛ zɔlʋgʋ na pian'ad pian'ayɛɛd.

english_verse: God doesn't like fools. So don't be slow to keep your promises to God.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a kaanbi zi'el Wina'am tuon fʋn da yuug nɛ yɔɔbɔ. Baŋim ye o ba'a kae nɛ zɔnnɛ; mɔɔm ka yɔ fʋn kaanb si'el la.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a pʋ kaanbɛ li sɔn'oe fʋn na kaanb ka pʋ yɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka fʋ nɔɔr kɛ ka fʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Mɛ da yɛl Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋm la ye fʋn daa kaanb la fʋ daa yidig nɛ. Bɔ ka fʋ na kɛ ka Wina'am sʋnf duoe nɛf ka o san'ami fʋ nu'ug tʋʋma?

english_verse: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.
translation_verse: Zaansima bɛdegʋ nɛ pian'abɛdʋg anɛ zaalim. Gu'usim fʋn dɔl Wina'am si'em. Zam arezak ka' nyɔɔdɛ

english_verse: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a nyɛ ka ba namisid nɔŋdaan teŋ si'a ni ka mɔŋ o bʋʋd, fʋn da kɛ ka li lidigi fɔ. Bɔzugɔ kpɛɛm wʋsa mɔr onɛ sʋ'oe o, ka on mɛ mɔr sʋ'ʋd.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Zʋʋd linɛ yit teŋin la na ka ba dit. Na'ab gba nyɔɔd yit nɛ pɔɔgin na.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Onɛ nɔŋ ligidi pʋ nyɛt ligidi ka li siakida. Onɛ bɔɔd areza'as o nini pʋ tigid on mɔr si'ela. Nɛ' mɛ ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Diibi paasid si'em la, ditib mɛ paasid nɛ ala. Ka nyɔbɔɔ bɛ tis o sɔba gat o nini na gɔsidi li?

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Tʋmtʋm ya'a di fiin bɛɛ bɛdegʋ, o gbisidnɛ o ya'amin. Amaa arezak daan pʋ gbisid baa bi'elaa o mɔrim la yɛla.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: M lɛn nyɛ tʋʋm kanɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd hali dunia nwa' ni. Arezak sɔb la'asid kpan'am su'ad ka li lieb yɛla tis o hali,

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: ka o zutɔɔg kɛ ka li widig ka bas o. Ka o ya'a mɔr biig, faar kae ka o na basi tis oo.

english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: Ba du'ad nid nɛ biel. On kɛn si'em na la, ala ka o mɛ lɛbid. O kʋ nɔk on tʋm nyɛ si'el la keŋɛ.

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Nɛ' mɛ anɛ yɛlpakir: Nidi kɛn si'em na la, ala ka o mɛ lɛbid. O namsisʋg la wʋsa nwɛnɛ onɛ tʋm tʋʋmzaal nɛ, o kʋ tun'e paam si'eli yii li nii.

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: O dii o dabisa wʋsa dunia nwa' ni nɛ namisʋg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, ka nyɛt yɛltɔɔd nɛ sʋnpɛɛn gʋllim.

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Tɔ', ka m vʋʋg ye li an sʋm ka nar ye ninsaal dit ka nuud ka paam sumalisim o namisʋg tʋʋma la pʋʋgin dabisa bi'ela banɛ ka Wina'am tis o ka o vʋe la. Bɔzugɔ, lina aan o nyɔɔd.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Linɛ paas, Wina'am ya'a nɔk arezak nɛ mɔrim tis sɔ', ka lɛn tis o suor ye o nyɛɛ o tʋʋma la malisim ka dii li nyɔɔd wʋsa, li anɛ Wina'am piini.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Wina'am kɛnɛ ka on sɔb mɔr sumalisim daar wʋsa ka kʋ lɛn fabin o bɛllim yɛlaa.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn nyɛ yɛlbɛ'ɛsi'a linɛ tɛbis ka paad nidib dunia nwa' ni.

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Li anɛ ye Wina'am tis nid arezak nɛ mɔrim nɛ na'asi ka kɛ ka o pʋ kɔ'ɔŋid o ya'am bɔɔdim. Amaa Wina'am pʋ kɛ ka o dii li malisim, ka saan lɛɛ kena di li malisim. Nɛ' ka' gbinnɛ, ka an sʋnsa'aŋ pamm.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Nid na tun'e mɔr biis kɔbiga ka o yʋma zu'oe. Ka la'an nɛ on yuug si'em la, o ya'a kʋ dii o areza'as la malisim o vʋm saŋa ka kpi ka pʋ nyɛ kʋʋrɛ, bikpi'iŋ sɔn'oe o.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: la'an nɛ on pʋ nyɛ nɛɛsim bɛɛ baŋ vʋm an si'el la. O mɔr yɔlisim sɔn'oe ninkaŋa sɔb

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: baa o ya'a vʋe yʋʋm tusir bɛɛ tusa ayi' ka pʋ dii o mɔrim malisim. Ba wʋsa pʋ wa'anɛ zin'ig yinnee?

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Ninsaal mɔɔr wʋsa anɛ m di la yɛla. Amaa nɛ wala wʋsa o diib pʋ siakid oo.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Bɔ ni ka ya'am sɔb sɔn'oe zɔlʋgɔ? Nyɔbɔ ka nɔŋdaan na nyɛ o ya'a mi' o mɛŋ mɔrim nidibinɛ?

english_verse: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋ nif tig nɛ fʋn mɔr si'eli, gaad linɛ ka fʋ nan tɛn'ɛsidi li yɛla. Nɛ' mɛ anɛ zaalim wʋʋ fʋn na kad pɛbisʋg ye fʋ gban'e nɛ.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Bʋn kanɛ bɛ la, ba pʋm pʋd o li yʋ'ʋr sa. Ka ninsaali an si'em la, ba pʋm baŋ. Nid kae na tun'e nwa'as nɔŋgbannwa'ari nyaŋ onɛ paŋi gaad o.

english_verse: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?
translation_verse: Pian'ad ya'a zu'oe, li gbin anɛ fiin ka li nyɔɔd an bɔ tis sɔ'?

english_verse: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?
translation_verse: Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ mi' linɛ an sʋm tis nid o vʋm saŋa. O dabisa banɛ an fiin ka ka' gbin la na gaad. Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na yɛl o linɛ na tʋm dunia nwa' ni o kum nya'aŋa?

english_verse: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋsʋŋ an sʋm gaad tudaar, ka fʋ kum daar sɔn'oe fʋ du'am daar.

english_verse: It's better to go to a funeral than to attend a feast; funerals remind us that we all must die.
translation_verse: Li an sʋm ka fʋ keŋ kʋyinnɛ gat yikanɛ ka ba maan sumalisim. Bɔzugɔ kum an sɔ' mɛkama ba'asʋg zin'ig. Banɛ vʋe wʋsa tɛn'ɛsim nɛ'.

english_verse: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.
translation_verse: Sʋnsa'aŋ an sʋm gat la'ad bɔzugɔ sʋnsa'aŋ an sʋm tisi fʋ sʋnr.

english_verse: A sensible person mourns, but fools always laugh.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb sʋnf bɛ nɛ kʋyin. Amaa zɔn sʋnya bɛ nɛ sumalisim zin'ig.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a di'e ya'am sɔb tansʋg li sɔn'oe fʋn na kɛlisid zɔn yʋʋma.

english_verse: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ gɔn'ɔsi dit bugumini tansid si'em la, ala mɛnɛ an zɔlʋg la'ad. Nɛ' mɛ ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: Corruption makes fools of sensible people, and bribes can ruin you.
translation_verse: Filiŋʋ kɛt ka ya'am sɔb liebid zɔlʋg ka zam san'amid nid sʋnf.

english_verse: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.
translation_verse: Si'el mɛkama wʋsa naar an sʋm gati li pin'ilʋg. Ka mɔdigir mɛ an sʋm gat nyɛɛsim.

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Da kɛt ka fʋ sʋnf duod tɔ'ɔtɔ ka sʋnduor anɛ zɔn din.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: Mid ka fʋ yɛl ye, “Bɔɔ lɛɛ kɛ ka kʋdimin la da an sʋm gat nannanna?” Bɔzugɔ, bu'os kan ka' ya'am bu'osʋgɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you just like money; knowledge with good sense will lead you to life.
translation_verse: Ya'am anɛ linɛ lusidif wʋʋ ligidi lusid si'em la, Amaa mi'ilim an sʋm si'em nwa': li faandi onɛ mɔr ya'am la nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsim gɔs Wina'am maal si'el. Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi tiɛn on pɔnd si'ela?

english_verse: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next. Some of Life's Questions
translation_verse: Saŋa ya'a ti an sʋm, fʋn mɔr sumalisim. Saŋa ya'a mɛ ti an bɛ'ɛd fʋn baŋim ye li anɛ Wina'am maali li wʋsa. Alazugɔ ninsaal kʋ nyaŋi baŋ o bɛogɔ.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: Mam bɛllim dinɛ ka' gbin nwa' ni, m nyɛ nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa: ninsʋŋ kpiidi tɔ'ɔtɔ o pʋpielimin ka bugis mɛ vʋe yuug nɛ o bugusim.

english_verse: So don't destroy yourself by being too good or acting too smart!
translation_verse: Da an sʋm galisɛ, bɛɛ mɔr ya'am galisɛ: bɔ ka fʋ san'amidi fʋ mɛŋa?

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Da mɔr pʋtɔɔgʋ galisɛ, mɛ da an zɔlʋgɔ: bɔ ka fʋ kpiid ka fʋ daar pʋ paae?

english_verse: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.
translation_verse: Li an sʋm ka fʋ gban'e yinne ka mɛ da bas ka yinne la gaadɛ. Ninkanɛ zɔt Wina'am mɔr ayi' la wʋsa ka kʋ maali baa tʋʋgɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Ya'am kɛt nɛ ka li sɔb mɔr paŋi gaad na'anam piiga.

english_verse: No one in this world always does right.
translation_verse: Ninsʋŋ kae dunia nwa' nii tʋm sʋm ka bɛ'ɛd ka' o nii.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Da kɛlisid dinɛ wʋsa ka nidib yɛta, ka daasi'erɛɛ fʋ na ti wʋm ka fʋ yammʋg tʋ'ʋdif.

english_verse: Haven't you cursed many others?
translation_verse: Ka fʋ mi' ye saŋa bɛdegʋ fʋn mɛ tʋ'ʋd sieba.

english_verse: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.
translation_verse: Man nɔki m ya'am kpans nɛ' wʋsa ka mɔɔd ye m lieb ya'am sɔb, amaa nɛ' gaad man nɛ.

english_verse: The truth is beyond us. It's far too deep.
translation_verse: Ya'am ya'a an si'em wʋsa, li zulim nɛ hali ka ninsaal kae na iee nyɛɛ li.

english_verse: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛm mɔ ye m tiaki m pʋtɛn'ɛri vɛɛnsi baŋ ya'am ka gban'e si'elnam gbin. M mɔ ye m pa'al ye pitɔɔlim anɛ zɔlimis ka gɛɛmis mɛ an yalimis.

english_verse: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.
translation_verse: M nyɛ tɔɔg kanɛ gaad kum. Linɛ an pu'a kanɛ an bɛndig, ka o sʋnf nɛ o nu'us nwɛnɛ baŋ ka ba bɛnd. Ninkanɛ ma'ad Wina'am sʋnf la ma'aa na pɔns, amaa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb la, o na bɛndi gban'e o.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I have tried to find out how everything fits together,
translation_verse: Gɔsima! Pa'an la yɛt ye, “Nɛ' anɛ linɛ ka m nyɛ: m daa dɔlisnɛ suoya kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb ye m baŋ yɛla wʋsa gbin.

english_verse: but so far I have not been able to. I do know there is one good man in a thousand, but never have I found a good woman.
translation_verse: Ka man daa nan ieed ka nam pʋ nyɛ la, m daa nyɛnɛ dau sʋŋ yinne tusir pʋʋgin, ka lɛɛ pʋ nyɛ pu'a sʋŋ yinne hali tusir pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.
translation_verse: Nɛ' ma'aa ka man nyɛ: Wina'am maal ninsaal nɛ sʋ'ʋŋa, amaa sɔ' mɛkama ieed o mɛŋ pitɔya'am.”

english_verse: Who is smart enough to explain everything? Wisdom makes you cheerful and gives you a smile. Obey the King
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn nwɛnɛ ya'am sɔba? Anɔ'ɔn baŋid yɛla gbinnɛ? Ya'am nied nɛ ninsaal nini ka tiakid o ka o kʋ lɛn lɔɔd nindaa. Siakim na'ab nɔɔr

english_verse: If you promised God that you would be loyal to the king, I advise you to keep that promise.
translation_verse: Siakim na'ab wʋʋ fʋn kaanbi zi'el Wina'am tuon si'em la.

english_verse: Don't quickly oppose the king or argue when he has already made up his mind.
translation_verse: Da gɛn' ka duoe na'ab tuonnɛ. Mɛ da nwa'asid nɛ na'aba bɔzugɔ, o na tun'e tʋm on bɔɔd si'el.

english_verse: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, “Why are you doing this?”
translation_verse: Na'ab pian'ʋk mɔri paŋ, ka sɔ' kʋ tun'e bu'os o ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ maan nɛ'ɛŋa?”

english_verse: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.
translation_verse: On mɛkama siak o, kʋ nyɛ dɛŋŋa. Ya'am sɔb mi' o pʋtɛn'ɛrin saŋa kanɛ nar ka dɔl suor.

english_verse: Life is hard, but there is a time and a place for everything,
translation_verse: Si'el wʋsa mɔri li saŋa nɛ li suor, la'an nɛ ninsaal bɛllim an tɔɔg si'em la.

english_verse: We cannot control the wind or determine the day of our death. There is no escape in time of war, and no one can hide behind evil.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ka' sisi'em paŋ ka na tun'e gu'oe li, ala mɛn ka sɔ' ka' paŋ o kum daarɛ. Nwɛnɛ zabzabidi ka' suori na zɔ ka bas zaba si'em la, ala mɛn ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kʋ bas banɛ tʋmmi li la suorɛ.

english_verse: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another? Who Can Understand the Ways of God?
translation_verse: Nɛ' wʋsa ka m nyɛ saŋkan ka m nɔki m ya'am ye m baŋ dunia nwa' gbin la. Saŋa bɛ nɛ ka nid sʋ'oe o taaba tʋmmi ba pitɔɔg, ka li mɛ an mugusʋgʋ tis o mɛŋ.

english_verse: I saw the wicked buried with honor, but God's people had to leave the holy city and were forgotten. None of this makes sense.
translation_verse: M lɛn nyɛ ka ba mum bugisnam nɛ girima. Ka banɛ mi' ba bugusim yɛla wɔ'ɔgidi ba ban daa bɛ teŋ si'a la. Nɛ' mɛn ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: When we see criminals commit crime after crime without being punished, it makes us want to start a life of crime.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb ya'a pʋ nyɛt tʋbtɛkir tɔ'ɔtɔ, li kɛtnɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yaligid.

english_verse: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper,
translation_verse: La'an nɛ bugisnamɛ tʋm bugisim bɛdegʋ ka mɔr nyɔvʋr wɔk la, li na an sʋm gat ala tis Wina'am nimbanɛ zɔt o.

english_verse: but no one who sins and rejects God will prosper or live very long.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ bugisnam la pʋ zɔt Wina'am la, li kʋ an sʋm tisi ba, ka ba dabisa kʋ wa'am nwɛnɛ winnigi ɛɛnti bik ka fʋ siig wa'am laa.

english_verse: There is something else that doesn't make sense to me. Good citizens are treated as criminals, while criminals are honored as though they were good citizens.
translation_verse: Si'el lɛm bɛ dunia nwa' ni ya'as ka ka' gbinnɛ. Ninsʋma di'esid bugisnam yɔɔd. Ka bugisnam mɛ di'esid ninsʋma yɔɔd. Nɛ' mɛn ka m yɛl ye li ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: So I think we should get as much out of life as we possibly can. There is nothing better than to enjoy our food and drink and have a good time. Then we can make it through this troublesome life that God has given us here on earth.
translation_verse: Alazug dim sumalisim ya vʋm saŋa bɔzugɔ si'el kae an sʋm tis nidi gat on na di ka nu ka mɔr sumalisim. Ka sumalisim na bɛ nɛ o, o tʋʋma zin'igin, dabisban ka Wina'am tis o dunia nwa' pʋʋgin la.

english_verse: Day and night I went without sleep, trying to understand what goes on in this world.
translation_verse: Man daa mɔɔd ye m baŋ linɛ maan dunia nwa' wʋsa ni ka nyɛ ka ninsaal namisid hali nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa ka pʋ gbisida.

english_verse: I saw everything God does, and I realized no one can really understand what happens. We may be very wise, but no matter how much we try or how much we claim to know, we cannot understand it all.
translation_verse: Ani ka m nyɛ linɛ wʋsa ka Wina'am maal. Sɔ' kae na nyaŋi gban'e linɛ tʋm dunia nwa' ni la gbinnɛ. La'an nɛ paŋ kanɛ ka o mɔɔd la wʋsa o kʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ. Baa ya'am sɔb ya'a ma' ye o mi', o kʋ nyaŋi gban'e li gbinnɛ.

english_verse: I thought about these things. Then I understood that God has power over everyone, even those who are wise and live right. Anything can happen to any one of us, and so we never know if life will be good or bad.
translation_verse: Ka m tiɛn gɔs nɛ' wʋsa yɛla ka kʋ'ʋg giŋa ye ninsʋŋ nɛ ya'am sɔb nɛ ba tʋʋma wʋsa bɛ nɛ Wina'am nu'usin. Alazugɔ sɔ' zi' ye nɔŋilim bɛɛ kisidim gur oo.

english_verse: But exactly the same thing will finally happen to all of us, whether we live right and respect God or sin and don't respect God. Yes, the same thing will happen if we offer sacrifices to God or if we don't, if we keep our promises or are afraid to make them.
translation_verse: Bama wʋsa na naae zin'ig yinne: pʋpiel nɛ bugis, ninsʋŋ nɛ nimbɛ'og, banɛ an nyain nɛ banɛ ka' nyainnɛ, banɛ maan maana nɛ banɛ pʋ maana. Lin an si'em tis ninsʋŋ la, ala mɛn ka li na aaɛn tis nimbɛ'og. Lin an si'em tis banɛ kaanbi zi'el la mɛ anɛ ala tis banɛ zɔt kaanbʋg la.

english_verse: It's terribly unfair for the same thing to happen to each of us. We are mean and foolish while we live, and then we die.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa an bʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ tʋm dunia nwa' ni: Saal wʋsa gan'al si'em la linɛ diti ba. Ba sʋnya pɛ'ɛli nɛ bɛ'ɛd ka ba tʋm gɛɛntʋʋma ba vʋm saŋa wʋsa, ka li nya'aŋ ka ba kpi.

english_verse: As long as we are alive, we still have hope, just as a live dog is better off than a dead lion.
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ wʋsa vʋe lɛm mɔr ti'ir; hali bavʋt sɔn'oe gbigim kpiiluŋ.

english_verse: We know we will die, but the dead don't know a thing. Nothing good will happen to them—they are gone and forgotten.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ banɛ vʋe la mi' ye ba na kpi, amaa banɛ kpi zi' si'ela. Ba pʋ lɛm mɔr yɔɔdɛ, li kʋ yuugɛ ka nidib tami ba yɛla.

english_verse: Their loves, their hates, and their jealous feelings have all disappeared with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens on this earth.
translation_verse: Ka ba nɔŋilim nɛ ba kisidim nɛ ba ya'amlɛog gaad, ka ba pʋ lɛm mɔr zin'isi'a dunia nwa' nii.

english_verse: So be happy and enjoy eating and drinking! God decided long ago that this is what you should do.
translation_verse: Kem dii fʋ diib nɛ sumalisim ka nu ka kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf ma'ae. Ka Wina'am nini pʋn tig fʋn tʋm si'el la.

english_verse: Dress up, comb your hair, and look your best.
translation_verse: Yɛɛm fupielig saŋa wʋsa, ka mɛ bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋi fʋ zug saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Life is short, and you love your wife, so enjoy being with her. This is what you are supposed to do as you struggle through life on this earth.
translation_verse: Dim malisim nɛ fʋ pu'a kanɛ ka fʋ nɔŋ la fʋ vʋm saŋa linɛ ka' gbinnɛ ka Wina'am tisif dunia nwa' ni la. Dim dabisbanɛ ka' gbin la wʋsa nɛ o, bɔzugɔ linɛ an namiskanɛ ka fʋ nyɛ dunia nwa' ni.

english_verse: Work hard at whatever you do. You will soon go to the world of the dead, where no one works or thinks or reasons or even knows anything.
translation_verse: Fʋ nu'ugʋ gban'e tʋʋm si'a wʋsa, fʋn tʋmmi li nɛ fʋ paŋ wʋsa, bɔzugɔ tʋʋma bɛɛ gban'ar bɛɛ mi'ilim bɛɛ ya'am kae yaʋgʋn, zin'ikan ka fʋ wa'ae la.

english_verse: Here is something else I have learned: The fastest runners and the greatest heroes don't always win races and battles. Wisdom, intelligence, and skill don't always make you healthy, rich, or popular. We each have our own share of misfortune.
translation_verse: M lɛn nyɛ si'el ya'as dunia nwa' ni: Li ka'anɛ onɛ mi' zɔɔgʋ dit ya'an zɔɔginɛ, bɛɛ onɛ mɔr paŋi nyaŋid zaba nii. Li ka'anɛ ya'am sɔbi paamid diib bɛdegʋʋ, bɛɛ onɛ mɔr baŋiri paamid arezaka. Li ka'anɛ onɛ zamis hali paamid on bɔɔd si'ela: ayei, li anɛ sia'alsʋŋ bɛɛ sia'albɛ'ɛdi tisidi ba wʋsa.

english_verse: None of us know when we might fall victim to a sudden disaster and find ourselves like fish in a net or birds in a trap. Better To Be Wise than Foolish
translation_verse: Sɔ' mɛ zi' saŋa kanɛ ka o na kpii. Asau gban'ad zimi si'em, bɛɛ bɛndisi gban'ad niis si'em la, ala ka ba bɛnd nidib ka li gban'adi ba tɔ'ɔtɔ ka ba zi' li yɛla baa bi'elaa. Ya'am nɛ yalimis yɛla

english_verse: Once I saw what people really think of wisdom, and it made an impression on me.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn nyɛ dunia nwa' ni ya'am si'a buudi ka li an sʋm tisim.

english_verse: It happened when a powerful ruler surrounded and attacked a small city where only a few people lived. The enemy army was getting ready to break through the city walls.
translation_verse: Tembil si'a da bɛ ka li nidib pʋ zu'oe, ka na'atita'ar kena ye o gilig ka zab nɛ li nɛ o paŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: But the city was saved by the wisdom of a poor person who was soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Ka dau bɛ tembil nwa' nii an nɔŋdaan ka lɛɛ mɔr ya'am, o da nɔk o ya'am faaɛn teŋ nwa'. Amaa sɔ' da pʋ lɛn tiɛn dau kaŋa yɛlaa.

english_verse: So I decided that wisdom is better than strength. Yet if you are poor, no one pays any attention to you, no matter how smart you are.
translation_verse: Alazug ka m yɛl ye la'an nɛ ya'am an sʋm gat paŋ la, ba ziem nɔŋdaan ya'am la ka pʋ kɛlis o yɛlaa.

english_verse: Words of wisdom spoken softly make much more sense than the shouts of a ruler to a crowd of fools.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb ya'a pian' bʋgʋsiga ka fʋ di'e, li sɔn'oe na'abi na pian'adi tansidi tisid zɔn.

english_verse: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons, yet one mistake can destroy all the good you have done.
translation_verse: Ya'am an sʋm gat zaba la'ad, amaa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb yinne san'amid bʋnsʋma bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: A few dead flies in perfume make all of it stink, and a little foolishness outweighs a lot of wisdom.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ pʋmpɔɔsi na kpi tudaari pʋʋgin ka li nyuug san'am si'em la, ala mɛn ka zɔlim ɛɛn paas ya'amin ka girima lɛn kae.

english_verse: Sensible thoughts lead you to do right; foolish thoughts lead you to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb sʋnf gban'adi bʋnsʋŋ. Amaa zɔlʋg sʋnf gban'adi bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Fools show their stupidity by the way they live; it's easy to see they have no sense.
translation_verse: Hali zɔlʋg ya'a dɔl pal zug, o ya'am kae, ka on niŋid si'em la kɛtnɛ ka ba baŋ o gɛtim la yɛla.

english_verse: Don't give up your job when your boss gets angry. If you stay calm, you'll be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na'ab sʋnf ya'a duoe nɛ na'ayikpɛɛm, on da bas o kpɛuŋɔ. An baanlimm ka o sʋnpɛɛn la na ba'asi li ka o tami fʋ bɛ'ɛd la.

english_verse: They honor fools, but dishonor the rich;
translation_verse: Ba nɔk zɔn ka ba gaad tuon, ka mɛ lɛbis ya'am dim nya'aŋ.

english_verse: they let slaves ride on horses, but force slave owners to walk.
translation_verse: Man nyɛ yammis ka ba ban'ad widi ka tuongatib ken nɔbteŋ.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you might fall in; if you break down a wall, a snake might bite you.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɛkama tu bʋmbɔk zulʋŋ na luu li pʋʋgin. Onɛ nwa'ae guomi kpɛn' na, waaf na dum o.

english_verse: You could even get hurt by chiseling a stone or chopping a log.
translation_verse: Onɛ nwa'ae kuga na nyɛ kuga sapu'ad. Onɛ wia'arid daad na nyɛ li dɛŋ.

english_verse: If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do.
translation_verse: Zɛnnir ya'a pʋ ditta ka fʋ pʋ saasɛ asɛɛ ka fʋ wiak nɛ paŋ, amaa mi'ilim na kɛ ka fʋ wiaki li na'ana.

english_verse: The power to charm a snake does you no good if it bites you anyway.
translation_verse: Waaf ya'a dumif ka tiimdaan kae yamminɛ o tiim la nyɔɔd kae.

english_verse: If you talk sensibly, you will have friends; if you talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Ya'am sɔb pian'adi kɛt ka nidib na'asid o, amaa zɔlʋg nɔɔri dit o.

english_verse: Fools begin with nonsense, and their stupid chatter ends with disaster.
translation_verse: Pin'ilʋgʋn la o pian'ad anɛ zɔlim pian'ad, ka naarin la ka li an bugisim nɛ gɛɛŋ pian'ad.

english_verse: They never tire of talking, but none of us really know what the future will bring.
translation_verse: Ka zɔlʋg kpɛm pian'adi ken tuon, amaa sɔ' zi' dinɛ kennaa. Anɔ'ɔnɛ mi' on na gaad ka dinɛ na lɛdigi tʋm?

english_verse: Fools wear themselves out— they don't know enough to find their way home.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg tʋʋma gɛɛnsid o nɛ, ka la'an nɛ wala o zi' suokanɛ wa'ae tempʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: A country is in for trouble when its ruler is childish, and its leaders party all day long.
translation_verse: Yɛltɔɔg bɛɛ tis teŋ kanɛ na'abi an sankpan'as, ka ba tuongatib nuud ka maan sumalisim bɛogʋn.

english_verse: But a nation will prosper when its ruler is mature, and its leaders don't party too much.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛɛ tis teŋ kanɛ na'ab ka ba du'a o nɛ na'am. Ka li tuongatib dit saŋa dinɛ nar ye ba nyɛ paŋ ka ka' ye ba nuu bugɛ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to fix a leaky roof— then the house collapses.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a an gbanya'a o yu'ada pun'odnɛ tɔ'ɔtɔ; o nu'us ya'a pʋ bɔɔd tʋʋmaa, o yir nyunnɛ.

english_verse: Eating and drinking make you feel happy, and money can buy everything you need.
translation_verse: Di'ema ziid sumalisim na. Ka daam ma'ae sʋnf. Amaa ligidi wɛligid yɛla wʋsa.

english_verse: Don't let yourself think about cursing the king; don't curse the rich, not even in secret. A little bird might hear and tell everything.
translation_verse: Da tɛn'ɛs na'ab yɛla bɛ'ɛdi fʋ sʋnfʋnɛ bɛɛ zɛrig arezak sɔbi fʋ dɔɔginɛ, ka niiŋ tun'e mɔri fʋ pian'ad la yi, bʋn-ian'adir kanɛ bɛ ani na mɔɔli fʋ yɛla tis.

english_verse: Be generous, and someday you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Nɔkimi fʋ diibi lɔs ku'omin ka dabisa bɛdegʋ nya'aŋ fʋ na lɛn di'e li.

english_verse: Share what you have with seven or eight others, because you never know when disaster may strike.
translation_verse: Pʋdigim tis nidib ayɔpɔi bɛɛ anii, bɔzugɔ fʋ zi' yɛlbɛ'ɛd kanɛ na ti lu teŋ la zugɔ.

english_verse: Rain clouds always bring rain; trees always stay wherever they fall.
translation_verse: Saŋgbana ya'a pɛ'ɛl nɛ ku'om, li niidnɛ saa basid teŋ zug. Tiig ya'a lu dagɔbʋg bɛɛ datiuŋ, ani ka li digi.

english_verse: If you worry about the weather and don't plant seeds, you won't harvest a crop.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɛkama kpansid sisi'em kʋ bʋdɛ. Onɛ gɔsid saŋgbana mɛ kʋ bunɛ.

english_verse: No one can explain how a baby breathes before it is born. So how can anyone explain what God does? After all, God created everything.
translation_verse: Fʋn zi' sisi'em suori an si'em la, bɛɛ biigi kilimid o ma pʋʋgin si'em la, ala mɛn ka fʋ kʋ baŋ Wina'am onɛ maal si'el wʋsa la tʋʋmaa.

english_verse: Plant your seeds early in the morning and keep working in the field until dark. Who knows? Your work might pay off, and your seeds might produce. Youth and Old Age
