translation_verse: Bʋdimi fʋ bʋmbʋʋda bɛogʋn, ka mɛ da bas zaam bʋdiga, ka fʋ zi' tʋʋm kanɛ na maal sʋ'ʋŋa li tun'e an bɛogʋn bɛɛ zaam din la, bɛɛ ayi' la wʋsa. Tɛnr onɛ maalif la fʋ dasannim saŋa

english_verse: Nothing on earth is more beautiful than the morning sun.
translation_verse: Nɛɛsim malis, li an sʋm nɛ fʋn na vʋe ka fʋ nini na nyɛt winnig.

english_verse: Even if you have a very long life, you should try to enjoy each day, because darkness will come and will last a long time. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Baa nid ya'a vʋe yʋma bɛdegʋ, on kɛl ka li malis o. Amaa o tiɛnm dabisbanɛ na ti an lik la bɔzugɔ dabisban la na ti zu'oe. Bʋn kanɛ kenna wʋsa ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: Be cheerful and enjoy life while you are young! Do what you want and find pleasure in what you see. But don't forget that God will judge you for everything you do.
translation_verse: Dasaŋa, mɔr sumalisim fʋn nam mɔr paŋ la, ka kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf malisi fʋ dasannim saŋa. Dɔlli fʋ sʋnf bɔɔdim nɛ fʋ nini nyɛ si'el ka bɔɔd. Amaa tɛnr ye dabisir kenna ka Wina'am na kadi fʋ saria.

english_verse: Rid yourself of all worry and pain, because the wonderful moments of youth quickly disappear.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ basimi fʋ sʋntɔɔg nɛ fʋ pʋtɛn'ɛyaalis la, ka da kɛ ka fʋ niŋgbiŋ yɛla daami fɔ, ka dasannim nɛ li paŋ wʋsa ka' gbinnɛ.

english_verse: The noisy grinding of grain and the voices of singers will be shut out by your deaf ears, but even the song of a bird will keep you awake.
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋba na kpid ka fʋ kʋ wʋm suoraadin vuudɛ. Fʋ mɛ kʋ lɛn wʋm nɛɛr bɛɛ yʋʋma vuudɛ; amaa niimis kaasig na nief gbɛɛmin.

english_verse: You will be afraid to climb up a hill or walk down a road. Your hair will turn as white as almond blossoms. You will feel lifeless and drag along like an old grasshopper. We each go to our eternal home, and the streets here are filled with those who mourn.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka fʋ ya'a bɛɛ agɔl fʋ na zɔt dabiem, ka mɛ zɔt dabiem nɛ suorin sapu'ad yɛla. Saŋkanɛ ka fʋ zuobid pɛlig farr wʋʋ gum nɛ ka fʋ gɛɛn kennɛ ku'usid bi'el-bi'el ka kʋ lɛm mɔr si'el yamlɛogɔ. Ka fʋ yʋ'ʋn na kuli fʋ yin ka kʋ lɛn lɛb naa, ka kʋkaasidib dɔl suoya kaasid.

english_verse: The silver cord snaps, the golden bowl breaks; the water pitcher is smashed, and the pulley at the well is shattered.
translation_verse: Tiɛnmi Wina'am yɛla ka anzurifa zɔnt la nam pʋ kɛnsigɛ bɛɛ sanlima laa la nwa'ae. Ka ku'om yʋʋr la mɛ nam pʋ nwa'ae buliginɛ, bɛɛ lɔbidiŋ nwiig la kɛnsigɛ.

english_verse: So our bodies return to the earth, and the life-giving breath returns to God.
translation_verse: Ka tan la na lɛb tannin, ka siig mɛ na lɛb Wina'am kanɛ maal o la ni.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense. Respect and Obey God
translation_verse: Pa'an la yɛl ye, “Li gbin kae! Li gbin kae! Si'el wʋsa ka' gbinnɛ.” Naar yɛla

english_verse: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.
translation_verse: Pa'an la da ka'anɛ ya'am sɔb ma'aanɛ; amaa o mɛ da pa'an nidib ka ba paamid baŋir, ka la'as siilima bɛdegʋ digil.

english_verse: Then I tried to explain these things in the best and most accurate way.
translation_verse: O da ieednɛ ye o nyɛ pian'akanɛ an viki nɛ sida.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are like the stick a farmer uses to make animals move. These sayings come from a shepherd, and they are like nails that fasten things together.
translation_verse: Ya'am dim pian'ad nwɛnɛ kɔnbkem duor nɛ. Ka ba siilima nwɛnɛ kuusa banɛ kpa' gban'e sʋ'ʋŋa. Wina'am onɛ aan ti kɔnbkem la tis nɛ' wʋsa.

english_verse: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.
translation_verse: M biiga, gu'usim ka da di'e pa'alsieba ka li ya'a ka' nɛ'. Gbana bɛdegʋ sɔbir ka' bɛnnɛ, ka zamistɔɔg mɛ an gɛɛnlis.

english_verse: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.
translation_verse: Nannanna ti wʋmi li wʋsa, yɛl la kʋʋsʋgʋ nwa': zɔm Wina'am ka di'e o zi'ela la, ka linɛ nar ye ninvʋsaal tʋm.

english_verse: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Wina'am na kad si'el wʋsa saria, la'an nɛ linɛ su'a wʋsa, li ya'a an sʋm bɛɛ bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Kiss me tenderly! Your love is better than wine,
translation_verse: Muakimim nɛ fʋ nɔɔr ka fʋ nɔŋir la gaad damalisiŋ.

english_verse: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *
translation_verse: Fʋ yʋ'ʋr la nwɛnɛ tudaar kanɛ nyuugʋ malis ka ba kpa'ae ka li nyuug tiig zin'ig wʋsa nɛ. Bi'esʋg kae nɛ pu'asada nɔŋif la!

english_verse: Hurry, my king! Let's hurry. Take me to your home. The Young Women Speak: We are happy for you! And we praise your love even more than wine. She Speaks: Young women of Jerusalem, it is only right that you should adore him.
translation_verse: Mɔrim ka ti yi! Kɛl ka ti keŋ tɔ'ɔtɔ! Kɛl ka m na'ab la mɔrimi keŋ o dɔɔgin. Pu'asadir la zuanam yɛt dau la ye, Ti bɔɔdi fʋ yɛla ka mɔr sumalisim fʋ yɛla; ti na zun'e fʋ nɔŋilim gaad damalisiŋ. Pu'asadir la mɛŋ: Asida, li nar ye ba zʋn'ʋf!

english_verse: My skin is dark and beautiful, like a tent in the desert or like Solomon's curtains.
translation_verse: Mam anɛ sabilig, la'an nɛ wala m vɛnl hali. Yanam Jerusalem pu'asada sɔbig nɛ nwɛnɛ Kedar teŋ dim sʋga nɛ, amaa ka nwɛnɛ Solomon dɔɔg fuvɛnla la.

english_verse: Don't stare at me just because the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me work in the vineyard, and so I neglected my complexion.
translation_verse: Da gɔsidim kii, man an sabilig la zugɔ, nintaŋi nwɛ'ɛm la zug ka m sɔbig. M tanp la wʋsa sʋnf daa pɛlig nɛ mam ka ba kɛ ka m guri ba vain pɔɔd, dinzug ka m basim mɛŋ vain pɔɔg la.

english_verse: My darling, I love you! Where do you feed your sheep and let them rest at noon? Don't let the other shepherds think badly of me. I'm not one of those women who shamelessly follow after shepherds. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Fʋn kanɛ ka m nɔŋ la, yɛlimim fʋn kemmi fʋ kɔnbid la zin'isi'a, nɛ winnigi ɛɛnti bul ka kɔnbid la vʋ'ʋsid zin'isi'a? Bɔ ka m na nwɛnɛ pu'a kanɛ ka ba lus o nindaa ka o su'a dɔlli ya'adi fʋ zuanam kɔnbidɛ. O zuanam la yɛt, ye,

english_verse: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.
translation_verse: Oi! Pu'a vɛnliŋa, fʋ ya'a zi', asɛɛ fʋ kadi m kɔnbid la buga, ka mɔri fʋ bʋbibis la keŋ ka ba ɔnb yam kɔnbkemnib la sʋgaa bɛ si'el la.

english_verse: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.
translation_verse: M ya'am bʋnnɛ, m nɔki fɔ maki nɛ wiednya'as banɛ gat Na'ab Faaro zaba tɛrekonam tuon la.

english_verse: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.
translation_verse: Fʋ kpɛnda la vɛnli nɛ tʋblɛma hali, ka sanlima niŋgɔnkɔris pɛ'ɛli fʋ niŋgɔɔnr. Pu'asadir la zuanam ye,

english_verse: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Ti na maal sanlima tʋblɛma, nɛ anzurifa baansi tisif. Pu'asadir la:

english_verse: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.
translation_verse: Na'ab la daa zin'in ye o di la, ka m tudaari la nyuug duoe.

english_verse: My darling, you are perfume between my breasts;
translation_verse: M ya'ambʋn la nwɛnɛ kpaam kanɛ nyuugʋ malis hali ka li pa'ae m bin'isa zug.

english_verse: you are flower blossoms from the gardens of En-Gedi. He Speaks:
translation_verse: M nɔŋir la nwɛnɛ puum linɛ widigi vɛnl ka bɛ Engedi vain pɔɔgin la. Sabua, dau la:

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove. She Speaks:
translation_verse: M ya'am bʋnnɛ, fʋ vɛnl woo! Fʋ sid vɛnl hali! Ka fʋ nini la nwɛnɛ dawan nini. Pu'asadir la:

english_verse: My love, you are handsome, truly handsome— the fresh green grass will be our wedding bed
translation_verse: Fʋ vɛnl hali, m nɔŋirɛ, ka m nini sid tigif! Mɔma'asa la na aan ti digisig zin'ig.

english_verse: in the shade of cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Na'aziinr tiis la na aan ti dɔɔg la datitada; ka dɔɔns la na aan li yu'ada.

english_verse: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley. He Speaks:
translation_verse: M nwɛnɛ mɔɔd puum linɛ mu'oe ka vɛnl hali bɛ bɔn'ɔgin la. Dau la:

english_verse: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ puum kanɛ vɛnl ka bɛ gɔn'ɔs sʋʋgin si'em la ala ka m ya'am bʋn bɛ pu'asada sʋʋgin. Pu'asadir la:

english_verse: And you, my love, are an apple tree among trees of the forest. Your shade brought me pleasure; your fruit was sweet.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ apʋl tiigi bɛ mɔɔgin tiis sʋʋgin si'em la ala ka onɛ aan m ya'am bʋn la mɛ bɛ na'akim sʋʋgin. M ya'am bɔɔdnɛ hali ye m zin' o ma'asim, ka o wala mɛ malisi m nɔɔrin hali.

english_verse: You led me to your banquet room and showered me with love.
translation_verse: O mɔrimi keŋ diib zin'igin, ka pa'alim o nɔŋilim kanɛ nwɛnɛ fuugʋ lusim la.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: O nɔk o dagɔbʋg nu'ug la kʋki m zug, ka o datiuŋ nu'ug la kuakim.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles never to awaken love before it is ready. Winter Is Past She Speaks:
translation_verse: Yanam Jerusalem pu'asada, pɔɔmi nɛ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ ka ya pɔɔd la ye, ti nɔŋir la kʋ san'am. Da tiɛnd nɔŋir yɛla ka li saŋa nam pʋ paae.

english_verse: I hear the voice of the one I love, as he comes leaping over mountains and hills
translation_verse: Kɛlisima! M ya'am bʋnnɛ! Gɔsima, onɛ ka m nɔŋ la kenna, o yi zuoya la nii kenna, o ian'asid kʋkʋna nii kenna.

english_verse: like a deer or a gazelle. Now he stands outside our wall, looking through the window
translation_verse: Onɛ ka m nɔŋ la nwɛnɛ walig bɛɛ mɔlif nɛ. Gɔsima! Onɛ zi'e ti yampʋn la. O gbɛlisidi gɔsid takoro la ni na, ka gɔsid vɔnya la ni.

english_verse: and speaking to me. He Speaks: My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Onɛ ka m nɔŋ la yɛlim ye, Dau la: Duoma, m ya'am bʋnnɛ, m sʋnf bʋnnɛ, kem na dɔllim.

english_verse: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;
translation_verse: Gɔsima! Sɛɛung gaad ya saa pʋ lɛn niida.

english_verse: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.
translation_verse: Puum yit teŋin la; yʋʋma saŋa paae ya, ka dawana kaasidi ti teŋ la zug.

english_verse: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Kekama tiis pin'ili wan waldɛɛnna; ka vain tiis la puum nyuug pɛ'ɛl zin'ig wʋsa. Duom, kem na, m nɔŋirɛ; m ya'ambʋnnɛɛ, kem na ye!

english_verse: You are my dove hiding among the rocks on the side of a cliff. Let me see how lovely you are! Let me hear the sound of your melodious voice.
translation_verse: Fʋ anɛ m dawan, onɛ bɛ tampiins lɛuŋʋn ka kpɛn' suak zin'igin zuoya la ni. Kɛl ka m nyɛ fʋ nindaa; ka kɛ ka m wʋmi fʋ kʋkɔr ka fʋ kʋkɔr malis nɛ hali, ka fʋ nindaa vɛnl amɛŋa.

english_verse: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Gban'am zaŋsiris la tisi ti, gban'am zaŋsirbibis banɛ san'am vain tiis pɔɔg saŋkanɛ ka tiis la puud la. Pu'asadir la:

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you are mine, as you feed your sheep among the lilies.
translation_verse: Man anɛ m nɔŋir la din ka on mɛ aan m din; ka mɔr o pɛ'ɛs la bɛ na'apu'a-kʋ-si'is-ku'om pʋʋgin ka ba ɔnbidi giligid.

english_verse: Pretend to be a young deer dancing on mountain slopes until daylight comes and shadows fade away.
translation_verse: Sɛɛ bɛog ti nie ka zibisʋg gaad; fɛndigim na, m ya'am bʋnnɛ, nwɛnɛ mɔlif bɛɛ walig kanɛ bɛ kʋkʋna la ni.

english_verse: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: M diginnɛ m kɔn'ɔkɔn' gadʋg zug yʋ'ʋŋ la wʋsa ka bɔɔd onɛ ka m ya'am nɔŋ hali la; M iee o zin'ig hali ka pʋ nyɛ o.

english_verse: So I searched through the town for the one I love. I looked on every street, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: M na duoe nannanna gilig tempʋʋg la, m na gilig suoraad la nɛ lɔdis la wʋsa; mam na iee onɛ ka m nɔŋ nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa la. M sid iee o hali ka pʋ nyɛ o.

english_verse: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, “Have you seen the one I love so much?”
translation_verse: Dap banɛ gur tempʋʋg nyɛ mam, ban daa kaadi giligid la, ka m bu'osi ba ye, “Ya nyɛ onɛ ka m nɔŋ hali laa?”

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles, never to awaken love before it is ready. The Groom and the Wedding Party Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Yanam Jerusalem pu'asada, pɔɔmi nɛ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ ka ya pɔɔd la ye, ti nɔŋir la kʋ san'am. Da tiɛnd nɔŋir yɛla ka li saŋa nam pʋ paae.

english_verse: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ nwa' yi pipirigini kenna nwɛnɛ nyɔ'ɔsi duoda? O nɔk tudaari nɛ bʋnnyubisa banɛ bɛ wʋsa, linɛ ka banɛ kuosid la'ad mɔr la, mis o mɛŋ.

english_verse: It is King Solomon carried on a throne, surrounded by sixty of Israel's best soldiers.
translation_verse: Gɔsima! Li anɛ Solomon ka ba ziid ka zabzabidib banɛ kpi'em ban pisyuobʋ dɔl o, ba anɛ Israel zaba tuongatib kpɛɛmnam.

english_verse: Each of them wears a sword. They are experts at fighting, even in the dark.
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa mɔr zaba sʋ'ʋs, ba wʋsa mɛ mi' zaba sʋ'ʋŋa. Sɔ' wʋsa mɔr o sʋ'ʋg ka li bɛɛ o sakpidirin gur zabaa na ti kɔ' yʋ'ʋŋ.

english_verse: Its posts are silver, the back is gold, and the seat is covered with purple cloth. You women of Jerusalem have taken great care to furnish the inside.
translation_verse: Li daad la buligi nɛ anzurifa, li gbinnin la ba bulig nɛ sanlima. Fupipɛlʋg ka ba nɔki maali li zin'isa la. Li anɛ Jerusalem pu'asada la ʋgi li nɛ nɔŋilim.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: M ya'ambʋnnɛɛ, fʋ vɛnl hali! Fʋ sid vɛnl, oo! Fʋ nini banɛ ka fʋ ligil la vɛnli nwɛnɛ dawan nini. Fʋ zuobid la sɔbigi nwɛnɛ bʋʋsi naan Gilead zuorin la wa'adi sigid na.

english_verse: Your lips are crimson cords, your mouth is shapely; behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋgban la mu'oenɛ vɛnl wʋʋ pien gum, ka fʋ pian'ad la mɔr nɔŋilim. Fʋ gbɛ'og la nie bɔbigin la naa vɛnl ka gbilisi nwɛnɛ taba kiig.

english_verse: Your neck is more graceful than the tower of David, decorated with thousands of warriors' shields.
translation_verse: Fʋ niŋgɔɔnr la nwɛnɛ David girimbisa linɛ ka ba mɛɛ li ka li vɛnl; ka fʋ kɔr niŋgɔnkɔris wʋʋ ban ya'an zaba la'ad za'antɔligin si'em la.

english_verse: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.
translation_verse: Fʋ bin'isa ayi' la zi'enɛ sappi, li nwɛnɛ walbibis banɛ an liiba banɛ bɛ na'apu'a-kʋ-si'is-ku'om teŋsʋkʋ ɔnbid yam.

english_verse: I will hasten to those hills sprinkled with sweet perfume and stay there till sunrise.
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' bɛog ti nie ka zibisim la gaadɛ, m na bɛ zuoya la zin'ikanɛ ka bʋnnyubisa linɛ an frankinsens nɛ mir bɛ la ni.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely in every way.
translation_verse: M ya'ambʋnnɛɛ, fʋ vɛnlim la bɛ nɛ zin'ig wʋsa; fʋ pʋ mɔr gba'arɛ.

english_verse: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.
translation_verse: Dɔllim ka ti yi Lebanon teŋin, ɛɛn, m pu'apaalaa, dɔllim ka ti yi Lebanon na. Kɛl ka ti la'am naan Amana zuorin la sig na, ka naan Senir nɛ Hemon zuoya la zugɔ sig na. Yim gbigima buugin la nɛ zuoya linɛ an wɛbaas gbɛɛnsir la ni.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.
translation_verse: Fʋ fɛndigi m ya'am, m taʋn nɛ m pu'apaala; fʋ fɛndigi m ya'am. Fʋ gɔsig yimmʋ, nɛ fʋ niŋgɔnkɔris la fɛndigi m ya'am.

english_verse: Your love is sweeter than wine; the smell of your perfume is more fragrant than spices.
translation_verse: M taʋn nɛ m pu'apaala, fʋ nɔŋir la mɔr ya'amlɛog! Fʋ nɔŋir la malisi gaad damalisiŋ, ka fʋ tudaari la nyuug malisi gaad bʋnnyubisa wʋsa!

english_verse: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: M pu'apaala, fʋ nɔɔr malisi nwɛnɛ sinkpaam tu'asid nɛ; bin'isim nɛ siind bɛɛ fʋ zilimin la. Fʋ fuug la nyuug nwɛnɛ bʋnnyubisa nɛ li buudi wʋsa banɛ bɛ Lebanon teŋin nɛ.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.
translation_verse: M pu'apaal nɛ m taʋn, fʋ nwɛnɛ lɔmbɔn'ɔg ka ba yɔɔ lɛbis; fʋ anɛ bulkanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin, bulkanɛ ka ba taasi li nɔɔr.

english_verse: Your arms are vines, covered with delicious fruits and all sorts of spices— henna, nard,
translation_verse: Fʋ tiis pɔɔg la anɛ pomanganɛt linɛ vɛnl. Li wan walsʋma ka mɔr nyuug linɛ malis.

english_verse: saffron, calamus, cinnamon, frankincense, myrrh, and aloes —all the finest spices.
translation_verse: Bʋnnyubisa tiis buudi wʋsa bɛɛ ani, la'an nɛ frankinsens nɛ mir nɛ bʋnnyubisa banɛ bɛ wʋsa.

english_verse: You are a spring in the garden, a fountain of pure water, and a refreshing stream from Mount Lebanon. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Fʋ anɛ lɔmbɔn'ɔgin bulkanɛ ka ku'om bʋnnɛ naanid Lebanon zuoya zugʋ pʋbidi sigid na. Pu'asadir la:

english_verse: Let the north wind blow, the south wind too! Let them spread the aroma of my garden, so the one I love may enter and taste its delicious fruits.
translation_verse: Pɛbisʋg kanɛ yit ya-datiuŋ naa, duom! Pɛbiskanɛ yit ya-dagɔbʋgɔ, kem na! Lɔmmi pɛbisim gɛɛlini m lɔmbɔn'ɔg la, ka li nyuug la widigi gilig zin'ig wʋsa. M ya'am bʋnnɛ, kemi m lɔmbɔn'ɔgin la na lɛmim tiis la walmalisa linɛ bɛɛ ani la.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:
translation_verse: M kpɛn' m lɔmbɔn'ɔgin la, m taʋn nɛ m pu'apaala. M la'asi m bʋnnyubisa la. M di m sinkpaam nɛ li mantigan'ama la; ka nuu m daam nɛ m bin'isim la. Dau la zuanam la pian' tisi ba: Dimmi, yanam banɛ aan m zuanama, dimi ka nu; dim tigi yanamɛ bɔɔd si'em, m ya'ambʋnama. Pu'asadir la:

english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”
translation_verse: M gbis ya ka m pʋtɛn'ɛr lɛɛ nɛi. Kɛlisima! Onɛ ka m nɔŋ la nwɛ'ɛd dɔɔg za'anɔɔr la ye, Dau la: “Yɔ'ɔgim tisim, m taʋn nɛ m ya'ambʋnnɛ, fʋ anɛ m dawan, ka paae m ya'am. M zug la wʋsa yʋdignɛ nɛ mɛligim, ka m zuobid ma'ae yʋ'ʋŋ la wʋsa.” Pu'asadir la:

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: Mam pʋn yɛɛgi m fuug sa, m na lɛn yɛɛ li ya'asɛɛ? Mam pie m nɔba sa, m na lɛn yɛɛ m la'ad ka kɛ ka li miligɛɛ?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: M ya'ambʋn tiɛn o nu'ug dɔɔg za'anɔɔrin, ka m ya'am pin'ili tuod o yɛla.

english_verse: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.
translation_verse: M duonɛ ye m yɔ'ɔg ka o kpɛn' na ka mir linɛ nyuusid hali la taae m nu'us. Man gban'e kʋlʋŋ la linɛ yɔ'ɔgid la.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: M yɔ'ɔg za'anɔɔri tisim ya'ambʋn la, amaa ka o pʋn gaad sa. On gaad la ka m sʋʋnr san'am, ka m gɔs ka tɛn'ɛs ye m na nyɛɛ o amaa ka pʋ nyɛɛ o. M buol o amaa o pʋ siakɛ.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Banɛ gur teŋ la duoe kaadi giligid la, ba daa nyɛɛm, ka bʋ'ʋm hali fiebi fieb; ka faanm fuugʋ mɔri keŋ, ba anɛ banɛ gur zaŋguoma la! Pu'asadir la tu'asidi tisid o taaba la:

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Jerusalem pu'asada, m bɛlimnɛ ya ya'a nyɛɛm ya'ambʋn la, ya na yɛl o ye bɔ? Yɛlimin o ye, nɔŋir ma'aa kɛ ka m nwi'e. O taaba la lɛbisid ye,

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel? She Speaks:
translation_verse: Fʋ sabua la vɛnli gat pu'ab wʋsaa, fʋ ya'ambʋn la gat banɛ bɛ la wala? Fʋ ya'ambʋn la gat ban la wala-wala, ka fʋ bɛlimmi tii ala? Pu'asadir la:

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.
translation_verse: M ya'ambʋn la vɛnli nya'am-nya'am ka mɔr paŋ, o bɛ nɛ o kɔn', tusa piiga la sʋʋgin.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: O zug la anɛ sanlim sʋŋ; o zuobid la nwɛnɛ ba pan'ami li nɛ ka sɔbigi nwɛnɛ agaung.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: O nini vɛnli nwɛnɛ dawan nɛ bɛ kɔldaug nɔɔrin. O nini pɛligi nwɛnɛ bin'isim ka o nɔki sʋʋd nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ niŋgɔnkɔris ka o kɔr.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: O kpɛnda nwɛnɛ vugus ka ba sɛ bʋnnyubisa tiis O nɔŋgban nwɛnɛ na'apu'a-kʋ-si'is-ku'om nɛ, ka mir linɛ nyuugʋ malis hali la tu'asidi yiti lit.

english_verse: His arms are branches of gold covered with jewels; his body is ivory decorated with sapphires.
translation_verse: O kpʋkpama la nwɛnɛ sanlim daad ka ba nɔki li bulig gɔtiŋin. O niŋgbina nwɛnɛ wabʋg nyina ka ba saalimi li ka maali li nɛ kugvɛnla.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.
translation_verse: O nɔba nwɛnɛ kugpiela zan'antɔlis ka ba ba'a li nɛ sanlima zi'esa Fʋ ya'a nyɛ o, o nwɛnɛ Lebanon zuoya ka nwɛnɛ na'aziinr wila yaadim si'em la.

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.
translation_verse: O nɔɔr muakir malis nɛ; ka o si'el wʋsa mɔr ya'amlɛog. Jerusalem pu'abaa, m ya'ambʋn la an si'em nwa'.

english_verse: What if I could have sixty queens, eighty wives, and thousands of others!
translation_verse: Na'apu'ab la bɛɛ paae pisyuobʋ, ka pu'abibis an pisnii, ka pu'asada zu'oe ka' kallɛ.

translation_verse: Amaa la'an nɛ wala m dawan la bɛ nɛ o kɔn', on ma'aa aan o ma bipuŋ, onɛ ka o du'a o ka nɔŋ o hali la. Pu'asada la wʋsa nyɛ o ka yɛl ye o anɛ zusʋŋ sɔb; na'apu'ab nɛ pu'abibis la wʋsa zun'od o. Pu'asadir la taaba:

translation_verse: Na'ab pu'ayua, fʋ nɔba vɛnl nɛ ta'ada hali, fʋn na'ab pu'ayua biiga! Fʋ gbɛya ayi' saalimnɛ vɛnli nwɛnɛ niŋgɔnkɔris, ka nwɛnɛ onɛ mi' kpi'eb hali kpi'a li nɛ nu'us.

english_verse: Your neck is like ivory, and your eyes sparkle like the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath-Rabbim. Your nose is beautiful like Mount Lebanon above the city of Damascus.
translation_verse: Fʋ niŋgɔɔnr la nwɛnɛ zan'antɔlig ka ba nɔk wabʋg nyina maali li. Fʋ nini ian'adi pil-pil wʋʋ Hesbon teŋ bɛuŋ linɛ kpi'e Bafirabim za'anɔɔr la. Fʋ Nyɔnya la vɛnli nwɛnɛ Lebanon girimbisa linɛ zi'e kpa' Damaskus tempʋʋg la.

english_verse: You are tall and slender like a palm tree, and your breasts are full.

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you desire me.

english_verse: Let's stroll through the fields and sleep in the villages.

english_verse: At dawn let's slip out and see if grapevines and fruit trees are covered with blossoms. When we are there, I will give you my love.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ti isigi keŋ vain tiis pʋʋgin la ka gɔs ye tiis la bus ya, bɛɛ? Ka pomanganɛt la ya'a puud, ani ka m na pa'ali fʋ m nɔŋir.

english_verse: Perfume from the magic flower fills the air, my darling. Right at our doorstep I have stored up for you all kinds of tasty fruits.
translation_verse: Tipuum banɛ nyuugʋ malis hali la tiig nɛ zin'ig wʋsa ka bɛɛ ti dɔɔg za'anɔɔrin la. Bʋnkʋda nɛ bʋmpaala wʋsa bɛ, ka m la'asi ba wʋsa digili gurif, m ya'am bʋnnɛ.

english_verse: If you were my brother, I could kiss you whenever we happen to meet, and no one would say I did wrong.
translation_verse: M naan bɔɔdin ye fʋ aannɛ m taʋn kanɛ mu'a m ma bin'isir! Li ya'a aan na la ka m nyɛɛ nɛf zin'isi'a, m naan muakinɛ fʋ nɔɔr, ka sɔ' kʋ nɛ'ɛsi ma.

english_verse: I could take you to the home of my mother, who taught me all I know. I would give you delicious wine and fruit juice as well.
translation_verse: M naan gaadini fʋ tuon ka dɔlli fʋ kuli m ma yin. M ma kanɛ pa'alim la san'an. M naan tisi nɛf daam kanɛ nyuugʋ malis ka fʋ nu, danmalisʋŋ kanɛ ka m nwiaki yisi m mɛŋ pomanganɛt tiis wala ni la.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: O nɔk o dagɔbʋg nu'ug la kʋki m zug, ka o datiuŋ nu'ug la kuakim.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me never to awaken love before it is ready. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Yanam Jerusalem pu'asada, pɔɔmi ye ya kʋ kɛ ti taab bɔɔb kʋkɔr duoe ka li saŋa nam pʋ paae. Pu'asadir la taaba:

english_verse: Who is this young woman coming in from the desert and leaning on the shoulder of the one she loves? She Speaks: I stirred up your passions under the apple tree where you were born.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ nwa' yi pipirisin kenna ka nɔk o mɛŋi dɛllim o ya'ambʋn la? Pu'asadir la: Apʋl walsʋma tiig la gbinnin ka m duof; ani ka fʋ ma da tʋki fʋ pʋʋg, ani ka o da lɛn sa'ae du'af.

english_verse: Always keep me in your heart and wear this bracelet to remember me by. The passion of love bursting into flame is more powerful than death, stronger than the grave.
translation_verse: Fɛndigimi fʋ pʋtɛn'ɛr sɔ' wʋsa ni ka kɛ ka fʋ ya'am bɛ man ni ma'aa, da lɛm gban'e sɔ' nu'ugɔ sɛɛ mam ma'aa; ka nɔŋir kpi'emi nwɛnɛ kum nɛ, li ya'amlɛog mɛ mɔr paŋ wʋʋ kpi'im teŋ. Li la'aŋid nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ, ka diti nwɛnɛ bugum pielim dit nɛ paŋ si'em la.

english_verse: We have a little sister whose breasts are not yet formed. If someone asks to marry her, what should we do?
translation_verse: Ti mɔri ti taʋn bil, ka o bin'isa nam pʋ nɔbigɛ. Ti na niŋi ti taʋn la yɛla wala daakanɛ ka dau kena ye o bɔɔd o?

english_verse: She isn't a wall that we can defend behind a silver shield. Neither is she a room that we can protect behind a wooden door. She Speaks:
translation_verse: O ya'a aan zaŋguom, ti naan nɔkin anzurifa mɛɛ gilig o. O ya'a lɛn aan nɛ kʋlʋŋ, ti naan nɔkin na'aziinr dalamma maali lus o lɛbis. Pu'asadir la:

english_verse: I am a wall around a city, my breasts are towers, and just looking at me brings him great pleasure.
translation_verse: Mam anɛ zaŋguom, ka m bin'isa la zi'e sappi wʋʋ dɔbanɛ wa'am nɛ. O nini gɔsidim nɛ ka pʋ tigida ka li nwɛnɛ ninkanɛ kɛ ka o ya'am digin.

english_verse: My vineyard is mine alone! Solomon can keep his silver and the others can keep their share of the profits. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Amaa mam mɛŋ vain pɔɔg anɛ m mɛŋ din; kɛl ka Solomon mɔr o anzurifa tusir-tusir la, ka banɛ gur la mɛ mɔri ba kɔbisyi' yi la. Dau la:

english_verse: You are in the garden with friends all around. Let me hear your voice! She Speaks:
translation_verse: Fʋn kanɛ bɛ lɔmbɔn'ɔgin ka fʋ zuanam nɛ fʋ tʋmtʋmnib bɛɛ fʋ san'an la, kɛl ka m wʋmi fʋ kʋkɔr! Pu'asadir la:

english_verse: Hurry to me, my darling! Run faster than a deer to mountains of spices.
translation_verse: M sabua onɛ ka m nɔŋ hali, kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na nwɛnɛ mɔlif, bɛɛ waldaug kanɛ an bʋmpɔlli bɛ zuoya ni, zin'ikanɛ ka bʋnnyubisa bɛ la.

english_verse: I am Isaiah, the son of Amoz. And this is the message that I was given about Judah and Jerusalem when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah: A Guilty Nation
translation_verse: Juda nɛ Jerusalem yɛla da nie pa'al Azaya onɛ da an Amoz biig la ka o nyɛ, saŋkanɛ ka Uzia nɛ Jotam nɛ Ahaz nɛ Hezekia da di Juda teŋ na'am tuunl taaba la. Zugsɔb la sa'al o nidib la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord has said, “Listen, heaven and earth! The children I raised have turned against me.
translation_verse: Azaya da yɛl Zugsɔb la labaar ye, “Arezana, wʋmma! Teŋgbauŋɔ, fʋn mɛ kɛlisim! M ugus biis ka ba duoe na amaa ka zan'asi m nɔɔr.

english_verse: Oxen and donkeys know who owns and feeds them, but my people won't ever learn.”
translation_verse: Na'araug mi' o daan, ka bʋŋ mɛ mi' o yam daka zin'ig, amaa Israel dim zi'; man nidib la pʋ mɔr gbin gban'arɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, you are a sinful nation loaded down with guilt. You are wicked and corrupt and have turned from the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ya anɛ buudkanɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim, ka an nimbanɛ tʋʋma pʋ dɔl suorɛ, ka wiakid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka an bibanɛ bɔɔd bugusim, ka zan'as Zugsɔb la. Ya nɛ'ɛs Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la, ka fɛndigi lɛb nya'aŋ ka bid o kudug.

english_verse: Why be punished more? Why not give up your sin? Your head is badly bruised, and you are weak all over.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka ya lɛm bɔɔd bʋ'ʋd ya'asɛ? Bɔ ka ya nan kpɛn zan'as ka aandi yita? Ya zut wʋsa pu'alim nɛ, ka ya ya'am wʋsa fɛndig.

english_verse: From your head to your toes there isn't a healthy spot. Bruises, cuts, and open sores go without care or oil to ease the pain. A Country in Ruins
translation_verse: Din yii ya nɔba ni keŋ dʋʋ ya zugin laafi kae, li anɛ sapu'ad nɛ fɛn'ɛd ma'aa. Ba pʋ pie li bɛɛ viligi li piennɛ bɛɛ ba ma' li nɛ kpaam.

english_verse: Your country lies in ruins; your towns are in ashes. Foreigners and strangers take and destroy your land while you watch.
translation_verse: Nidib widig ya ka basi ya teŋ la. Bugum dii ya tempʋʋd la. Saam kena buni ya pɔɔd la ya nini ni, ka basi ya zaalim nɛ namisʋg.

english_verse: Zion would have disappeared like Sodom and Gomorrah, if the Lord All-Powerful had not let a few of its people survive. Justice, Not Sacrifices
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la kɛ ka ti sieba vʋ'ʋgɛ, ti teŋ la wʋsa naan nwɛnɛ Sodom teŋ nɛ, ti naan nwɛnɛ Gomora dim nɛ. Ba Wina'am pʋ'ʋsʋg pʋ dɔl suorɛ

english_verse: You are no better than the leaders and people of Sodom and Gomorrah! So listen to the Lord God:
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ an wʋʋ Sodom na'anamaa, kɛlisimi Zugsɔb la labaar! Wʋmmi ti Wina'am wada la, yanam Gomora dima!

english_verse: “Your sacrifices mean nothing to me. I am sick of your offerings of rams and choice cattle; I don't like the blood of bulls or lambs or goats.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Ya maana banɛ an bɛdegʋ la an bɔɔ tis mam?” Mam di'esi ya pɛraad nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ nɔb ka ya mɔri maan nyu'or maana la tig. Mam pʋ mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ na'araad nɛ pɛribis nɛ bʋʋs ziim.

english_verse: “Who asked you to bring all this when you come to worship me? Stay out of my temple!
translation_verse: Yanamɛ ɛɛnti kɛɛn m san'an na la, anɔ'ɔnɛ yɛti ya ye ya mɔr nɛ'ɛnam na? Bɔ ka ya giilimi m Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zakin la?

english_verse: Your sacrifices are worthless, and your incense disgusting. I can't stand the evil you do on your New Moon Festivals or on your Sabbaths and other times of worship.
translation_verse: Da lɛm mɔri malima linɛ ka' gbin la kennɛ m san'an naa. M kis maan banɛ ka ya nyu'od la. Ya nwadpaalig nɛ ya Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar malima la ka' gbinnɛ; m yaama yi nɛ ya la'as banɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la'asʋg la.

english_verse: I hate your New Moon Festivals and all others as well. They are a heavy burden I am tired of carrying.
translation_verse: Mam kisnɛ ya nwadpaalig malima nɛ malima banɛ ka ya zi'el la. Li daamidim nɛ, ka lieb ziidi tisim, ka m zii li gɛn.

english_verse: Wash yourselves clean! I hate your filthy deeds. Stop doing wrong
translation_verse: Pieminɛ ya mɛŋ ka maali ya mɛŋ nyain. Mɔri nɛ ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la tɔɔmi m san'an. Basimi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd;

english_verse: and learn to live right. See that justice is done. Defend widows and orphans and help the oppressed.” An Invitation from the Lord
translation_verse: zamisimi tʋmi linɛ an sʋm, ka iee zin'ikanɛ ka ba kad saria nɛ sida. Sʋŋim banɛ ka ba mugusidi ba la, ka sa'al banɛ wɛbidi ba la. Sʋŋim banɛ an kpiibis la mɛn, ka tu'as pʋkɔnya antu'a nɛ yɛlmɛŋir.

english_verse: I, the Lord, invite you to come and talk it over. Your sins are scarlet red, but they will be whiter than snow or wool.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Kemi na ka ti la'asi tɛn'ɛs ka pian' li yɛla. La'an nɛ ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la miligi mu'oe si'em la, ya na lɛm pɛligi nwɛnɛ sakuga nɛ, la'an nɛ lin kɛ ka ya miligi si' la, ya na lɛm pɛligi nwɛnɛ gungum nɛ.

english_verse: If you willingly obey me, the best crops in the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a siaki m nɔɔr sʋ'ʋŋa, ya na nyɛ disʋma teŋ la nii di.

english_verse: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a zan'asim, ba na kʋʋ ya nɛ sʋ'ʋg zaba ni.” Zugsɔb la nɔɔri pian' si'em la. Jerusalem dim tʋbpʋwʋmnim yɛla

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.
translation_verse: Gɔsim teŋ sʋŋ la yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ pu'agɔɔndir nɛ. O da anɛ sida nɛ pʋpielim sɔb, amaa ka yʋ'ʋn lieb ninkʋʋd.

english_verse: Your silver is fake, and your wine is watered down.
translation_verse: Ya anzurifanam la liebnɛ zaalim; daam kanɛ ka ya nɔŋ la, ba yaligi li nɛ ku'om.

english_verse: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.
translation_verse: Ya tuongatib la zan'asi m nɔɔr, ka ba zuanam an na'ayiis. Ba wʋsa nɔŋ nɛ nidib la na da' ba, ka zɔti dɔl nidibi bɔɔd ye ba di'es piini. Ba pʋ pian'adi sʋŋid kpiibisɛ, ka mɛ pʋ kɛlisid pʋkɔnya pian'adɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, Paŋ Sɔb onɛ sʋ'oe Israel la, pian' ya nyain ye; “Alazugɔ, m na nyɛ yɔlisim m dataas san'an ka yɔɔ m bi'emnam la sam.

english_verse: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: M na zan'asi ya, ka siligi ya wʋʋ kpaam nɛ, ka yis dian'ad linɛ bɛɛ ya san'an la.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be “Justice and Faithfulness.” The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ya sariakatib maligim bɛ nwɛnɛ kʋdimin la, ka banɛ san'anɛ ya la bɛ wʋʋ pin'ilʋgʋnɛ da an si'em la. Lin nya'aŋ la ba na buonnɛ ya ye, ‘Pʋpielim Teŋ dim’, ka ya teŋ yʋ'ʋr na an Tempʋʋg kanɛ an Sida.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb na faaɛn Zion teŋ nɛ sida, banɛ siak ka lɛb na la na nyɛ faangir pʋpielim.

english_verse: But those rebellious sinners who turn against me, the Lord, will all disappear.
translation_verse: Amaa o na san'am banɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim nɛ banɛ zan'as o la, ka banɛ pʋ siak o la na bɔdig.

english_verse: You will be made ashamed of those groves of trees where you worshiped idols.
translation_verse: Nyan na dii ya, yanamɛ mɔr ya'amlɛog ye ya pʋ'ʋsid tiis la zug. Ba na faki ya zut yanamɛ gaŋ lɔmbɔn'ɔd sieba wɔ'ɔgid la zug.

english_verse: You will be like a grove of trees dying in a drought.
translation_verse: Ya na nwɛnɛ tikanɛ ka li vaand kʋdig ka sʋʋgid nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ lɔmbɔn'ɔg kanɛ ka' ku'om.

english_verse: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.
translation_verse: Nintitada la na nwɛnɛ sa'ad, ka bugum na diti ba tʋʋma linɛ an bɛ'ɛd la ka sɔ' kae na kpiisɛ.

english_verse: This is the message I was given about Judah and Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Amoz biig Azaya da nyɛ si'eli zaŋi keŋ Juda teŋgbauŋ nɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋg yɛla la nwa':

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills; every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: “Naar saŋa la, zuokanɛ ka Zugsɔb Yir zi'e li zug la na zi'en kiŋ-kiŋ. Li na wa'am hali gaad kʋkʋna la wʋsa. Ka tɛɛns wʋsa nidib na la'as anina pʋ'ʋs.

english_verse: Many people will come and say, “Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ na la'as taaba yɛl ye, ‘Kemi na ka ti keŋ Zugsɔb zuorin la, kem na ka ti keŋ Jakob Wina'am Yin la. O na pa'ali ti o suori an si'em ka ti na dɔlli li sʋ'ʋŋa.’ Wina'am wada na yit Zion zuorin, ka Zugsɔb la nɔzi'elʋg na naan Jerusalem teŋin na ka ti siaki li.

english_verse: He will settle arguments between nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: O na an tɛɛns wʋsa sariakat ka na maal buudi wʋsa pian'adi tisi ba. Ba na zan' ba zaba sʋ'ʋsi maal kʋnya, ka nɔki ba kpana la maal gɔn'ɔd. Ba kʋ lɛn tʋ'ʋsid tanp bɛɛ ba zamisid zaba ya'asɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord. Following Sinful Customs
translation_verse: Jakob yidima, kemi na! Kɛlli ka ti keŋ Zugsɔb nɛɛsim la ni.” Zugsɔb dabisir la yɛla

english_verse: Our Lord, you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.
translation_verse: Nɔdi'es Azaya n da lɛn yɛl si'eli nwa': “Zugsɔba, fʋ basi fʋ nimbanɛ an Jakob yidim la. Ba dɔlnɛ ya-nya'aŋ dim buudi malima la wʋsa, ba bʋgʋdnɛ wʋʋ Filistia dimi bʋgʋd si'em la, ka maan zuod nɛ nimbanɛ zi' fʋn Wina'am.

english_verse: They have endless treasures of silver and gold; they have countless horses and war chariots.
translation_verse: Anzurifa nɛ sanlima pɛ'ɛli ba teŋin la; ba kpan'am la pʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ. Ba teŋ la pɛ'ɛli nɛ widi ka ba tɛrekonam pʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them! A Day of Judgment
translation_verse: Alazug sigisimi ba wʋsa teŋin ka kɛ ka ba di nyan. Da kɛɛ ba taali basɛ.

english_verse: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
translation_verse: Kem kpɛn' tampinlɛma ni ka tu bʋmbu'ad teŋinɛ su'a ya mɛŋ Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn la nɛ o na'am paŋ la zug.

english_verse: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.
translation_verse: Dau kanɛ an tita'alim sɔb la nini na ma'ae, ka saalib nyɛɛsim na sie, Zugsɔb la ma'aa ka ba na dʋ'ʋs o daakan la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la zi'el dabisiri gur banɛ mɔr nyɛɛsim ka dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ la. Ninkanɛ wʋsa nwɛ'ɛd o nyɔ'ɔg la na sig teŋin.

english_verse: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan,
translation_verse: O na san'am Lebanon na'aziinr tibanɛ wa'am la nɛ tititada banɛ bɛ Basan ka dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ la,

english_verse: all high mountains and hills,
translation_verse: nɛ zuotitada wʋsa nɛ kʋkʋna banɛ wa'am la,

english_verse: all the seagoing ships, and every beautiful boat.
translation_verse: nɛ anrima banɛ ka ba mɔri ken lallisa kpiisid, nɛ anrinvɛnla la wʋsa.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.
translation_verse: Dau kanɛ an tita'alim sɔb la nini na ma'ae, ka saalib nyɛɛsim na sie. Zugsɔb la ma'aa ka ba na dʋ'ʋs o daakan la,

english_verse: Idols will be gone for good.
translation_verse: ka bada la wʋsa na bɔdig nyain.

english_verse: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.
translation_verse: Nidib na zɔɔ keŋ kpɛn' tampinlɛma ni ka tu bʋmbu'ad teŋinɛ su'a ba mɛŋ, Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn la nɛ o na'am paŋ la zug, saŋkan ka o na duoe dam teŋgbauŋ la.

english_verse: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
translation_verse: Daakan la, nidib na nɔki ba anzurifa bada nɛ ba sanlima wina banɛ ka ba maali pʋ'ʋsid la lɔbi tis dayuud nɛ zinzana la.

english_verse: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
translation_verse: Ba na zɔɔ kpɛn' tampinlɛma ni nɛ tampinyɔ'ɔdin ye ba su'a ba mɛŋ, Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn la nɛ o na'am paŋ la zug, saŋkan ka o na duoe dam teŋgbauŋ la.

english_verse: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
translation_verse: Da lɛn nɔki fʋ ti'iri niŋ ninsaal onɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm pʋ lal ka bɛɛ o nyɔnya ni la. O ka' vɔɔnr hali baa bi'elaa.”

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful is going to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything you need— your bread and water, *
translation_verse: Gɔsima, nannanna, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la bɔɔd ye o faaɛnnɛ sʋŋir kanɛ bɛɛ tis Jerusalem nɛ Juda la; linɛ an diib bɛɛ ku'om wʋsa,

english_verse: soldiers and heroes, judges and prophets, leaders and army officers,
translation_verse: nɛ banɛ an gandaad nɛ zabzabidib la, nɛ sariakatib nɛ nɔdi'esidib, nɛ ba'akɔn dim nɛ kpɛɛmnam,

english_verse: He will let children and babies become your rulers.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka na'akimbibis aan ba kpɛɛmnam, ka bilies sʋ'oe ba.

english_verse: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
translation_verse: Nidib na mugusid taaba. Dau na zabid nɛ o tiraan ka nid nɛ o kpi'a na zabid nɛ taaba. Biis na duoe ziem ninkʋda, ka tadimnam mɛ zan'as banɛ aan ba kpɛɛmnam nɔɔr.

english_verse: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
translation_verse: Saŋa kenna ka nid na gban'e o ba'abiig o saam yin ka yɛl o ye, “Fʋn mɔr fuug, alazug fʋnɛ na sʋ'oe ti, ka maal dabɔɔg nwa' yɛla tisi ti!”

english_verse: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
translation_verse: Amaa o na tans agɔla ka lɛbis ye, “Mam pɔya mɛnɛ, m pʋ mɔr paŋ kanɛ na nyaŋi sʋŋɛ! Mam pʋ mɔr diib bɛɛ fuudi m yinnɛ; Da nɔk mam ye m sʋ'oe nidib la!”

english_verse: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Jerusalem yidig nɛ, ka Juda bɔɔd liig. Bɔzugɔ, ba pian'ad nɛ ba tʋʋma ka' sʋm tis Zugsɔb la, ka ba mɛ ki'is Zugsɔb na'am girima la.

english_verse: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves. The Wrong Kind of Leaders
translation_verse: Ban gɔsid si'em la pa'al ye ba tʋm taal. Ba tʋmmi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd paalʋ ni wʋʋ Sodom dim nɛ. Yɛl bɛɛ ba zugin, ba mɛŋ tʋʋma kɛt ka ba paam tʋbtɛɛgir.

english_verse: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Yɛlim pʋpielim dim la ye, si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ba bɔzugɔ, ba na dii ba tʋʋm sʋma la nyɔɔd.

english_verse: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
translation_verse: Yɛl bɛ bugusnam la zugin, yɛltɔɔg na paae ba. Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka ba tʋm la, lin ka ba na lɛbisi yɔɔ ba.

english_verse: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
translation_verse: Biisi mugusidi m nidib la ka pu'ab sʋ'oe ba. M nidiba, banɛ guri ya la na bɔdisi ya, ka fɛndigi ya yis suorin la.

english_verse: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zin'inɛ o zin'isigin kɔɔtʋ ni. O duoe zi'en ye o kad o nidib la saria.

english_verse: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kad kpɛɛmnam nɛ tuongatib la saria ka kʋʋsi ba wʋsa bɛ'ɛd ye, “Ya di sɔ' wʋsa pɔɔg zʋʋd, ka tadimnam la'abanɛ ka ya faaɛn la bɛɛ ya yaan.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ya gban'e ye bɔ ka san'amidi m nidib la? Bɛɛ bɔ ka ya nɛɛmidi ba wʋʋ zɔ'ɔm?” Zugsɔb Wina'am Paŋtita'ar Sɔb pian'ʋkʋ la. Jerusalem pu'ab yɛla

english_verse: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛl ye, “Zion pu'ab la anɛ nyɛɛsim dim; ba ken ka dʋ'ʋsidi ba ningɔnya ka ba gɔsig pa'an ye ba anɛ pu'agɔɔnda. Ba ken ka zia'asidi ba niŋgbina bɔɔd ye nidib gɔs, ka ba nɔba baans kum saiin-saiin.”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka Zion pu'ab la zut mɔr fɛn'ɛd. O na kɛ ka ba zut la kɔn.

english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Ka li nyuugi naan malisin la, li na nyuusid pɔn'ɔsʋg; ka ban naan lɔɔdin pien sʋma la, ba na lɔɔd nwiis banɛ gbinigbin. Ban naan mɔrin zuobidi maan ka li vɛnl la, ba zut na an kɔɔndkɔɔndi, ka ban naan yɛɛdin fusʋma la, ba na yɛɛd bɔto fuud. Ba vɛnlim la na lieb nyan.

english_verse: The fighting men of Jerusalem will be killed in battle.
translation_verse: Ba na nwɛ' tanpi kʋʋ ya dap, ka ya zabzabidib na kpi zaba ni.

english_verse: The city will mourn and sit in the dirt, emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Zion za'anɔya ni nidib na kaasidi ba yɛla, ka tempʋʋg la na an zaalim wʋʋ pu'a na zin' sanwɛɛr nɛ.

english_verse: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
translation_verse: Dabisban ya'a ti paae, pu'aba ayɔpɔi na la'asi gban'e dau yinne ka yɛl o ye, “Ti na tʋm diisi ti mɛŋ, ka da'adi ti mɛŋ fuudi yɛɛd. Tinamɛ bɔɔd si'el anɛ fʋ siak ka ti buonif ye ti sid ka li yisi ti nyan pʋʋgin ka nidib da yɛl ye, ti kɔ'ɔŋ sidibi kulɛ.” Zugsɔb la na maligim sʋŋi ba

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
translation_verse: “Saŋkan la Zugsɔb na kɛ ka ya tiis la nɔbig ka vɛnl hali, ka zʋʋd na maal teŋ la zug bɛdegʋ ka Israel dim banɛ kpɛlim la na nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg ka mɔr si'ire li zug.

english_verse: after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na pie dian'ad linɛ ka Zion pu'ab tʋm la, ka kad saria ka vaae ziim linɛ kpa'ae Jerusalem pɔɔgin la, ka o siig la na kadi li saria ka pie li nɛ bugum.

english_verse: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka saŋgbauŋ linɛ nwɛnɛ nyɔ'ɔs la lus banɛ la'as Zion zuorin la nintaŋ, ka an bugum nie tisi ba yʋ'ʋŋ. Ka Wina'am na'am pipilim la na nwɛnɛ sʋk nɛ lusi ba.

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: Li na mɔr ma'asim tisi ba nintaŋ, ka an suak zin'igi tisi ba saa nɛ sisi'em saŋa.”

english_verse: I will sing a song about my friend's vineyard that was on the side of a fertile hill.
translation_verse: “M na yʋ'ʋm tis onɛ ka m nɔŋ la; o vain tiis pɔɔg la yɛla ka m na yʋ'ʋm ye, ‘Onɛ ka m nɔŋ la mɔr tiis pɔɔg ka li bɛ zuokanɛ mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm la zug.

english_verse: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
translation_verse: O tuu li ka uusi yis kuga la wʋsa, ka gaŋ tisʋma sɛ. O mɛ' dɔwɔk kanɛ ka ba zin' gur, ka tu zin'ikanɛ ka ba na nwi'asid wain la, ka bɔ tibanɛ wan walsʋma, amaa ka ba lɛɛ wan walbɛ'ɛdnam.

english_verse: Listen, people of Jerusalem and of Judah! You be the judge of me and my vineyard.
translation_verse: Nannanna, yanam banɛ bɛ Jerusalem nɛ Juda, kadimi mam nɛ m vain tiis pɔɔg la saria.

english_verse: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka m naan maalinɛ m tiis pɔɔgin la gat mam maal si'el la? Man daa tɛn'ɛs ye li na wal walsʋma la, li niŋ wala wan walbɛ'ɛdnam ma'aanɛ?

english_verse: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
translation_verse: Nannanna, m na yɛli ya mam na niŋi m pɔɔg la si'em; m na yis linɛ ka m maali gu' li lɛbis la ka kɛ ka li san'am. M na nwa'ae li zaŋguom la ka bʋnkɔnbid kpɛn' nɔɔ li.

english_verse: It will turn into a desert, neither pruned nor hoed; it will be covered with thorns and briars. I will command the clouds not to send rain.
translation_verse: M na bas ka mɔɔg yi li pʋʋgin. M kʋ pɛsi li maal sʋ'ʋŋa bɛɛ m kua pɔɔg la, ka na kɛ ka tutubɛ'ɛd nɛ gɔn'ɔs tiis yii ani. M mɛ na yɛl saŋgbana la ye ba da kɛ ka saa ni anina.’

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! Israel is the vineyard, and Judah is the garden I tended with care. I had hoped for honesty and for justice, but dishonesty and cries for mercy were all I found. Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pɔɔg anɛ Israel, ka Juda dim nwɛnɛ o lɔmbɔn'ɔg nɛ. O bɔɔdi sida amaa on nyɛt si'el anɛ ninkʋʋr ma'aa, O ieedi pʋpielim nɛ sumalisim amaa o lɛɛ wʋmnɛ banɛ namisid la kaasig nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ma'aa.” Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sa'alʋg

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Tɔɔg bɛ yanam banɛ ɛɛnti mɛ' yir ka lɛn tɔlisi mɛ' yisi'a, ka ɛɛnti kua pɔɔg ka lɛn tɔlisi kua pɔsi'a, ka teŋ la wʋsa liebi ya sʋ'ʋlim ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn nyɛ paalʋʋ mɛ' bɛɛ kua la, ka ya yʋ'ʋn bɛɛ ya kɔn'ɔkɔn' teŋ la zugin.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' ya ka m wʋm. O yɛl ye, “Sida, ya' titada la na lieb dabɔɔd ka ya' vɛnla la na zi'e ka sɔ' kʋ kpɛn' li pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Ba sɔ'ɔsɔ pʋ gɛn bɛɛ tu'ugɛ, ka sɔ' pʋ zɔɔnsim bɛɛ gbisɛ. Ba sɔ' sɛnbidiŋ pʋ yu'as o sien bɛɛ sɔ' ta'ada nwiis kɛnsigɛ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Tɔɔg na paae yanam banɛ mɔr dama'am ka vɛ'ɛd tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ bugusim mɔri kenna, nwɛnɛ tɛreko ka ba vɛ'ɛd nɛ nwiis la.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
translation_verse: Tɔɔg na paae banɛ ɛɛnti isig bɛkɛungʋ zɔti ieed daam zin'ig la, nɛ banɛ ɛɛnti zin'in daamin ka yʋ'ʋŋ ti sɔbi sʋdig ka ba nuu kʋʋl ka ba niŋgbina wʋsa lieb daam la.

english_verse: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
translation_verse: Ba ya'a la'as ye ba di, ba kɛti ka googinam nɛ siyada nwɛ'ɛd, ka wiis piebid, ka galana nɛ piris nwɛ'ɛd ka daam zi'e. Amaa ka ba ba'a kae nɛ Zugsɔbi tʋm si'el la, ka mɛ pʋ na'asid Zugsɔb la maal si'el la.

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m na kɛ ka ba gban'e m nidib la keŋ teŋ zʋŋ ka ba an sankpan'asnam, ban pʋ gban'ad yɛla gbin la zug. Kɔ'ɔm na kʋʋ ba kpɛɛmnam la, ka ku'onuud kʋʋ ba tadimnam la wʋsa.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: Alazug, Ayaʋg mɔri ya ya'amlɛog hali bɔɔd ye o vɔli ya, ka ya'ae o nɔɔri gur. Ani ka ya kpi'emnam la nɛ tadimnam la wʋsa na sig la'an nɛ nimbanɛ maan tʋkpiidʋg ka aan m ba'akae dim la.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Ba na ti kɛ ka ninsaalib sig teŋin, ba na sie saalib la wʋsa; ba na diis tita'alim sɔb nyan.

english_verse: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
translation_verse: Din saŋa, pɛ'ɛs na ɔnbid yaama anina nwɛnɛ ba yam ɔnbsir zin'ig nɛ, ka pɛbibis mɛ na ɔnbid yaama dabɔɔdin la.

english_verse: And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Banɛ yɛt ye, “Wina'am, niŋim tɔ'ɔtɔ! O gbirigim tʋm o tʋʋma ka ti nini nyɛ! O kɛl ka li li'el na! Israel Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la kɛl ka on gban'e si'em la nie ka ti baŋ!”

english_verse: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
translation_verse: Banɛ di'esid ligidi ka kɛt ka onɛ tʋm taal keŋ zaalim, ka lɛɛ mɔŋid sida sɔb bʋʋd la.

english_verse: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, nwɛnɛ bugum dit kikan'a si'em la bɛɛ lin lɛligid mɔɔd si'em la, ala ka ba na an wʋʋ tiis ka ba nya'a pun'oe nɛ, ka ba mɔpuum sʋʋg nwɛnɛ uusʋg ka sisi'em da'adi ken nɛ. Bɔzugɔ ban ki'is Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la zi'elʋg ka zan'as Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi pian'ad la zug.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Alazug ka Zugsɔb la sʋnf la'aŋ wʋʋ bugum nɛ, o nidib la yɛla, ka o zaŋ o mɛŋ-mɛŋ nu'ugʋ nwɛ' baa digil. O kɛ ka zuoya dammid, ka nidib kpii yadig suoya ni nwɛnɛ sa'ad nɛ. La'an nɛ wala, o sʋnpɛɛn la kʋ tɔɔm ka basi baa, li nan kpɛm bɛ nɛ ba zugin.

english_verse: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
translation_verse: O na ʋk tuuta ye tɛɛns banɛ bɛ lalli la kena, ka vʋʋli buol banɛ bɛ dunia kpikpɛmis la. Banɛ nwa' zɔt tɔ'ɔtɔ kenna!

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Ba piema la pʋlimnɛ ka ba tiraad la gʋdi gur tɔɔnb. Ba widi tafɛɛd la kpi'emnɛ nwɛnɛ sataŋ nɛ, ka ba zaba tɛrekonam la zɔti nwɛnɛ sisi'epiliŋ nɛ.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a kaas li nwɛnɛ gbigim nɛ, ba ya'a nwa'am li nwɛnɛ gbigimbibis nɛ. Ba nyuunnɛ wʋʋ bʋnyua na gban'e bʋnkɔnbʋgʋ mɔri wa'ae ka sɔ' kae na faaɛn o basɛ.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_verse: Daakan la ya'a ti paae, ba na kaasi bas Israel zug ka li vuudi nwɛnɛ atɛuk ku'opila vuud si'em la. Ka nid ya'a gɔs teŋgbauŋʋn la, o nyɛti lik nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, hali ka saŋgbana la na vɔl nɛɛsim ka li lieb zibisʋg.

english_verse: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
translation_verse: Na'ab Uzia da kpi yʋʋm si'a la, m da nyɛ Zugsɔb la ka o zin' o na'am gbauŋ zug ka bɛɛ agɔl, ka o fuug la yidigi pɛ'ɛl Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la wʋsa.

english_verse: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying,
translation_verse: Ka Serafnam zi'e gilig o, ka yinne wʋsa mɔr kpʋkpama ayuobʋ; ka nɔk kpʋkpama ayi' lus o nindaa, ka nɔk ayi' lus o nɔba, ka mɔr kpʋkpama ayi' mɛ ian'ad.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord All-Powerful! The earth is filled with your glory.”
translation_verse: Ka ba buon taaba yɛt ye, “Kasi, kasi, kasi! Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la anɛ kasi: dunia la wʋsa pɛ'ɛli nɛ o na'am paŋ nɛ girima!”

english_verse: As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
translation_verse: Ka ba kʋkɔya la vuud kɛ ka dɔɔg la dalamma la nɛ kugbanɛ gban'e li la dam, ka Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la pɛ'ɛl nɛ nyɔ'ɔs.

english_verse: Then I cried out, “I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Ka m kaas kuŋʋ yɛl ye, “Yɛl paae mam, m pʋn san'am naae! Bɔzugɔ, mam pian'ad anɛ bɛ'ɛd ka m mɛ la'am bɛ nɛ nimbanɛ pian'adi an bɛ'ɛd, ka m nini nyɛ Na'ab onɛ an Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la!”

english_verse: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.
translation_verse: Ka Serafnam la yinne nɔk ma'adiŋe mak bugumsaan kanɛ dit maan daka la zug, ka ianki kɛɛn m san'an na,

english_verse: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
translation_verse: ka nɔki li si'isi m nɔɔr ka yɛl ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa si'isi fʋ nɔɔr si'em la, taal kanɛ bɛɛ fʋ zugin la yi ya; ba yɔɔ fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa sam.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?” “I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm Zugsɔb la bu'osid ye, “Anɔ'ɔn ka m na tʋm? Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na keŋ tisi ti?” Ka m yɛl ye, “Naa, manɛ nwa': tʋmmim.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
translation_verse: Ka o yɛl ye, “Kem yɛl nimbama ye, “Ya na wʋm ka lɛn wʋm ka kʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ. Ya na gɔs ka lɛn gɔs ka kʋ nyɛ si'ela.”

english_verse: Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?” The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty,
translation_verse: Ka m bu'os o ye, “M Zugsɔba, li na yuugi paae wala?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Asɛɛ tempʋʋd la ti lieb dabɔɔd, ka nidib lɛn kae, ka ya' la zi'e zaalim, ka pɔɔd la san'am yɔɔg-yɔɔg.

english_verse: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ Zugsɔb la ti kad nidibi naae ka ba lalig ka bas teŋ la nyain.

english_verse: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_verse: Baa nidib piiga pʋʋgin yinne ya'a kpɛlim teŋin la, bugum na di teŋ la san'ami li. Amaa nwɛnɛ tiig ka ba ɛɛnti nwaae ka li gbi'ir kpɛlim si'em la, ala mɛn ka bielim banɛ an kasi la na kpɛlim teŋin wʋʋ gbi'ir nɛ.”

english_verse: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Ba da yɛl David yidim banɛ an na'am tuŋ dim la ye, “Aram dim la la'as nɛ Efiram dimi naal nɔɔr”; ka Ahaz nɛ o nidib la wʋsa ya'am iank, ka ba susʋnya dammid wʋʋ sisi'em na da'ad tiis vaand ka li dammid si'em la.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Azaya ye, “Fʋn nɛ fʋ biig Sear-Jasuob yim keŋ tʋ'ʋs Na'ab Ahaz, ka o bɛ ku'osuokanɛ ka ku'om naanid bɛuŋ kanɛ bɛ zugin la pʋbidi dɔl la naarin. Suokanɛ ka banɛ piesid piena tʋm la.

english_verse: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear
translation_verse: Kem yɛl o ye, Gu'usim, ka an baanlimm ka da zɔt dabiem. Da kɛ ka fʋ ya'am ian'ad Na'ab Rezin nɛ Aram dim nɛ Na'ab Remalaya sʋnfʋ duoe nɛ ya la zugɔ. Ba nwɛnɛ nyɔ'ɔsi na yit bugum dagbida ayi' ni na nɛ

english_verse: to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.
translation_verse: ‘Kɛl ka ti keŋ zab nɛ Juda, kpɛn'ɛs nidib la dabiem ka faaɛn teŋ la sʋ'oe, ka diis Tabeel biig la na'am ka o gur zin'ig la tisi ti.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen.
translation_verse: Amaa la'an nɛ wala, Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Ayei! Li kʋ zi'enɛ, li kʋ nyaŋi maalɛ.

english_verse: Damascus is just the capital of Syria, and King Rezin rules only in Damascus. Samaria is just the capital of Israel, and King Pekah rules only in Samaria. But in less than
translation_verse: Samaria tempʋʋgʋ mɛ sʋ'oe Efiram teŋ la sʋ'ʋlim, ka Remalaya biig Na'ab Peka mɛ sʋ'oe Samaria. Ya ya'a pʋ zi'en sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ yadda, ya kʋdim kʋ nyaŋi zi'en kiŋ-kiŋ nɛ.”

english_verse: Once again the Lord God spoke to King Ahaz. This time he said,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛm pian' tis Ahaz ye,

english_verse: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
translation_verse: “Sɔsimi fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am la ka o tisif zanbin kanɛ na maal teŋ teŋir sa bɛɛ agɔla gɔla.”

english_verse: “No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
translation_verse: Amaa ka Ahaz lɛbis ye, “M kʋ sɔsɛ. M kʋ maki m Zugsɔba.”

english_verse: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
translation_verse: Ka Azaya lɛbis ye, Yanam David yidima, kɛlisimi. Yanamɛ mak saalib summɔtir la li pʋ siakɛɛ, ka ya yʋ'ʋn bɔɔd ye ya maki m Wina'am la summɔtirɛɛ?

english_verse: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb la mɛŋ na pa'ali ya zanbin kaŋa: Pu'asadir na tʋk pʋʋgʋ du'a biribiŋ ka ba na pʋd o, o yʋ'ʋr ye Immanuel.

english_verse: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Amaa saŋkanɛ ka biig la ti mɔr ya'am na bak sʋm nɛ bɛ'ɛd la, li saŋa ka na'anama ayi' banɛ ka fʋ zɔt la tɛɛns na lieb dabɔɔd.

english_verse: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka dabisbɛ'og lu fʋn nɛ fʋ nidib nɛ fʋ saam yidim la zugin. Yɛlbanɛ nan zi' paae ya lin yi saŋkanɛ ka Efiram da aaɛn yi Juda sʋ'ʋlimin la hali ti paae zina. O na kɛ ka Asiria na'ab la kena zab nɛ ya.

english_verse: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees.
translation_verse: Dabiskan daar ya'a ti paae, Zugsɔb la na vʋʋli buol pʋmpɔɔs Egipt kɔldaadin la sa ka ba yina, ka siins mɛ yi Asiria na.

english_verse: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
translation_verse: Ba na kena pɛ'ɛl bɔn'ɔzulima la, nɛ tampinlɛma la ni, ka na tabin gɔn'ɔs tiis ka pɛ'ɛl kɔlis la wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
translation_verse: Daakan la Zugsɔb la na nɔk barig Efiritis kɔldaug la lɔ'ɔm, ka li anɛ Asiria na'ab la. O na pʋni ya zut ka pʋni ya nɔba kɔnbilʋg ka mɛ kɔɔnsi ya tiemis.

english_verse: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep,
translation_verse: Saŋkan la, dau sɔ' ya'a nan kpɛm mɔr na'asa'a yinne nɛ kɔnbid ayi' li anɛ zusʋŋ.

english_verse: will have enough milk to make yogurt. In fact, everyone left in the land will eat yogurt and honey.
translation_verse: Ba bin'isim na zu'oe hali ka o na mɔr bin'iskpaam dit. Banɛ kpɛlim teŋin la wʋsa na dit bin'iskpaam nɛ siind.

english_verse: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.
translation_verse: Banɛ ken ani wʋsa na mɔr tiraad nɛ piema ken bɔzugɔ, zin'ig la na anɛ tutuud nɛ gɔn'ɔs ma'aa.

english_verse: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ kʋkʋna banɛ ka ba da kuod nɛ kʋnya la, ya kʋ lɛn li'eli ani ya'asɛ bɔzugɔ ya na zɔt dabiem tutuud nɛ gɔn'ɔsi galis la zug. Niigi nɛ kɔnbid ma'aa na bɛɛ ani.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Isaiah, get something to write on. Then write in big clear letters the name, MAHER-SHALAL-HASH-BAZ.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Nɔkim si'eli sɔb lina niŋ ani ye, Mahesialalhasbaz.

english_verse: I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.”
translation_verse: Ka m da buol Uria onɛ da an maanmaan la, nɛ Jeberekaya biig Zakaria banɛ an sida dim la ye ba dii m kasɛt.”

english_verse: Sometime later, my wife and I had a son, and the Lord said, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
translation_verse: Ka m da digin nɛ m pu'a onɛ an nɔdi'es la ka o tʋk pʋʋg ka du'a biribiŋ, ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Pʋdim biig la yʋ'ʋr ye Mahesialalhasbaz.

english_verse: Because before he can say ‘Mommy’ or ‘Daddy,’ the king of Assyria will attack and take everything of value from Damascus and Samaria.”
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka biig la nam pʋ siak on na nyaŋi buol ye, ‘M ba',’ bɛɛ ‘M ma,’ la, ka Asiria na'ab pʋn kena faaɛn Damaskus teŋ nɛ Samaria la'ad la wʋsa zii lɛb o teŋin.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛlim ye;

english_verse: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.
translation_verse: “Nimbama zan'as Siiloa ku'okanɛ pʋbid bi'el-bi'el la ka lɛɛ maan sumalisim nɛ Rezin nɛ Remalaya biig la zug,

english_verse: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka Asiria na'ab kɛɛn ba san'an na ka on nɛ o zabzabidib la zab nɛ ba. Ba na kena nwɛnɛ Efiritis kɔldaug linɛ pɛ'ɛli pʋbid nɛ paŋ ka badigi li' ku'osuoya wʋsa si'em la.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.
translation_verse: Li na yadig hali pil Juda teŋ la ka di saalib nɛ linɛ bɛɛ anina wʋsa keŋ. Li na yadigi nwɛnɛ kpʋkpama nɛ tiig Immanuel teŋ la wʋsa.”

english_verse: Get together and make plans, but you will fail because God is with us.
translation_verse: Gban'ami gban'e paala, amaa li na ba'as yɔri, Niŋimi yanamɛ gban'e si'em la, amaa li na anɛ zaalim. Bɔzugɔ, Wina'am bɛ nɛ ti. Zɔmi Wina'am

english_verse: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pian' tisim, ka o paŋ tita'ar la bɛɛ m san'an, o sa'alim nɛ nimmua ye m da niŋid nwɛnɛ nimbama niŋid si'em la. O yɛl ye,

english_verse: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.
translation_verse: “Linɛ ka nimbama buon gban'abɛ'ɛd la, fʋn da buonnɛ li ye gban'abɛ'ɛdɛ, mɛ da zɔt ban zɔt si'el la ka kɛ ka li kpɛn'ɛsif dabiem.

english_verse: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la ma'aa ka fʋ na gɔs o ka o an kasi. On ka fʋ na zɔt, on ma'aa ka fʋ na zɔt dabiem.

english_verse: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.
translation_verse: Lɔɔmi kasɛta gbauŋ la, ka maali m wada la pɔnbil ka kɛ ka m pa'ala la bɛɛ m nya'andɔlib la san'an.

english_verse: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.
translation_verse: Mam na mɔdigi gu'us Wina'am, la'an nɛ on su'ad o mɛŋ Jakob yidimin la. On ka mam na ti'e.

english_verse: My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Manɛ nwa' bɛ nɛ biis banɛ ka Zugsɔb tisim la. Ti anɛ zanbina tis Israel dim la yi Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la san'an na, Zugsɔb onɛ bɛ Zion zuor zug la.

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Ba ya'a ti yɛli ya ye ya kem bu'osi kikiris sɔb, bɛɛ ba'abʋgʋdib bɛɛ banɛ gɔsidi nyɛt kpi'imnam ka yɛt, yanam da siakɛ. Ya na niŋ wala bu'osid banɛ kpi la banɛ vʋe yɛla? Li nar ye nidib keŋ bu'osi ba Wina'am.

english_verse: what it should do.” None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day!
translation_verse: Nɔkimi wada la nɛ kasɛta yɛla pʋʋginɛ zamis nimbama yɛt si'em la, ka ba ya'a pʋ pian' wʋʋ lin nar si'em, li pa'an ye bɛog nam pʋ nie ba san'anɛ.

english_verse: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
translation_verse: Ba na gɔɔnd teŋin la nɛ kɔ'ɔm nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, kɔ'ɔm ya'a ti wʋmi ba, ba sʋʋnr na duoe hali ka ba gɔ'ɔni gɔs agɔla, ka pɔɔd nɔɔri tisidi ba na'ab nɛ ba Wina'am.

english_verse: and on earth, they will find only trouble and darkness, terrible trouble and deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Ba mɛ na su'uni gɔs teŋin ka nyɛ sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ lik nɛ dabiem ma'aa, ka ba na nɔki ba lɔbi bas lik tita'arin.

english_verse: But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected. War Is Over
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, banɛ zɔt dabiem ka ba sʋnya da san'am la kʋ mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ ya'asɛ. Yʋma banɛ da gaad la o da sie Zebulun nɛ Naftali tɛɛns, amaa saŋa kenna ka o na na'as Galile linɛ an teŋ zʋŋ dim sʋ'ʋlim din zaŋ Atɛuk Suoraug la baba nɛ Joodan gbɛogʋ mɔri ken la.

english_verse: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ ken likin la, yʋ'ʋn nyɛ nɛɛsim tita'ar. Nɛɛsim la nie tis nimbanɛ bɛ teŋ kanɛ an lik ka nwɛnɛ kum teŋ la ni.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.
translation_verse: Fʋ yaligi ba teŋ la ka pɛ'ɛsi ba sumalisim, ka ba maan sumalisim fʋ tuon wʋʋ nidibi na bun ki ka maan sumalisim si'em bɛɛ nidibi na zabi fan' la'adi pʋdigid ka maan sumalisim si'em la.

english_verse: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.
translation_verse: Li nwɛnɛ dabiskanɛ ka Wina'am da nyaŋ Midian dimi tisi ya la. O san'am yu'asin dakanɛ ka ba ziili ya la, ka kɔ'ɔg dakanɛ ka ba nɔki bʋ'ʋdi ya la nɛ kpa'asa banɛ ka ba da mɔri fiebidi ya la.

english_verse: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
translation_verse: Ta'ada banɛ ka zabzabidib pidi keŋ zaba ni la nɛ fubanɛ ka ba zaŋi bilim ziimin la, ba na nyu'oe li nɛ bugum.

english_verse: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
translation_verse: Ba du'a biigi tisi ti, ba tisi ti biribiŋ, onɛ na sʋ'oe ti na'am sʋ'ʋlim. Ba na buon o ye, Onɛ Sa'an Nɛ Nyalima, Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋ Sɔb, Ti Ba' onɛ Bɛ Saŋa Wʋsa, Sumalisim na'abiig.

english_verse: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done. God Will Punish Israel
translation_verse: O na'am la na nɔbigid nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm si'em la kʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ. O na zin'in Na'ab David na'am gbauŋ la zug, ka zi'el na'am la sʋ'ʋŋa ka kɛ ka li mɔr paŋ. O na tʋm nɛ sida nɛ pʋpielim, lin yi saŋkan la nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na tʋm lina wʋsa nɛ nimmua. Wina'am na tɛɛg Israel dim la tʋbir

english_verse: The Lord had warned the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la tis labaar linɛ pɔ'ɔg Jakob yaas la, li na lu nɛ Israel dim zugin!

english_verse: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
translation_verse: Nidib wʋsa na baŋi li yɛla. Amaa Efiram nɛ Samaria dim pian'adi dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ ka mɔr nyɛɛsim ba sʋnya ni. Ba yɛt ye,

english_verse: “Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.”
translation_verse: “Tampiga mɛɛb la li ya, amaa ti na lɛbisi mɛ' nɛ kuga, ba pilig kekaŋ daad yu'ada la amaa ti na lɛbis na'aziinri yu'a.”

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Aram dim la bɛ nɛ ya-nya'aŋ ka Filistia dim mɛ bɛ ya-tuona. Ba ya'ae nɔɔri bɔɔd ye ba vɔl Israel dim. La'an nɛ wala, o sʋnpɛɛn la kʋ tɔɔm ka basi yaa, li nan kpɛm bɛ nɛ ya zugin.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Amaa nidib la pʋ lɛb onɛ namisi ba la san'an na, bɛɛ ba iee Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la kɛɛn o san'an naa.

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: Alazug Zugsɔb la na tɛk Israel kpɛɛmnam nɛ ba tadimnam la wʋsa tʋba, ka na fi'ig Israel zug nɛ zʋʋr wʋsa daar yinne.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: Ba kpɛɛmnam nɛ ninkpi'ema la an zut la ka nɔdi'esidib banɛ pa'an linɛ ka' sida la an zʋya la.

english_verse: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
translation_verse: Banɛ pa'an nimbama la mɔri ba nɛ kpɛn'ɛd mɔɔg, ka ban pa'an sieba la bɔdig wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Dinzug, Zugsɔb la kʋ zɔɔ ba na'akim, bɛɛ ba kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya la nimbaanliga. Bɔzugɔ, sɔ' wʋsa zan'as nɛ ka mɔr bugusim, ka ba nɔɔr pian'ad anɛ bɛ'ɛd. La'an nɛ wala, o sʋnpɛɛn la kʋ tɔɔm ka basi yaa, li nan kpɛm bɛɛ ya zugin.

english_verse: Evil had spread like a raging forest fire sending thornbushes up in smoke.
translation_verse: Sida, bugusim ditnɛ nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ, ka dit gɛnda nɛ gauŋ wʋsa. Li la'aŋ nɛ sian'atita'ari dit, ka nyɔ'ɔs la gbilimme dʋt agɔla.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la sʋnpɛɛn duonɛ ka o na kɛ ka teŋ kanb ka nidib wʋsa la'aŋ bugum, saŋkan la, sɔ' kʋ siaki faaɛn o bier bɛɛ o pitʋ.

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: Ba na dit diib gɔbʋg nɛ diiug wʋsa amaa ka kʋ tigɛ; ka kɔ'ɔm kpɛn mɔri ba la zug, ba na kʋʋ ba mɛŋ biisi ɔnb.

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: Manase nɛ Efiram dim na zabid nɛ taaba, ka yʋ'ʋn la'asi zab nɛ Juda dim la. La'an nɛ wala, o sʋnpɛɛn la kʋ tɔɔm ka basi yaa, li nan kpɛm bɛɛ ya zugin.

english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Tɔɔg na paae banɛ zi'en wada linɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ, nɛ banɛ tisid nɔzi'elʋg linɛ mugusid nidib,

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Ya na ti niŋ wala sam yɔɔb daarɛ, ka yɛltɔɔd ya'a ti yi lalli paae ya na, ya na keŋ anɔ'ɔn san'an ka o faaɛn ya? Ya na nɔki ya kpan'am la niŋ yaanɛ?

english_verse: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
translation_verse: Ya kʋ nyɛ su'ab zin'iga amaa ya na zɔɔ la'as nɛ banɛ ka ba gban'e ba la hali ka ba kʋʋ ya paas banɛ kpi la zug. La'an nɛ wala, o sʋnpɛɛn la kʋ tɔɔm ka basi yaa, li na kpɛm bɛɛ ya zugin. Wina'am na kad Asiria saria si'em

english_verse: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
translation_verse: “Tɔɔg na paae Asiria! Mam daa nɔk o ye o an wʋʋ m balaar, linɛ ka m na mɔri bʋ'ʋdi ya m sʋnpɛɛn zug la. O nu'ugin ka m sʋnpɛɛn duor la bɛ!

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
