translation_verse: M da tʋm o ye o keŋ zab nɛ m nimbanɛ zi' Wina'am la. M da kɛ ka o keŋ zab nɛ m nimbanɛ pɛligidi m sʋnf la, ye o gban'e ba ka faaɛn ba la'ad, ka nɔɔ ba wʋʋ bian'ar ka ba nɔɔd suorin si'em la.

english_verse: He has even bigger plans in mind, because he wants to destroy many nations.
translation_verse: Amaa on pʋ gban'e ala o pʋtɛn'ɛrinɛ, o gban'e nɛ ye o san'am ka li' buudi bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus.
translation_verse: M mɛ san'am Hamat nɛ Apad tɛɛns la wʋsa, hali la'am pɛ'ɛs nɛ Samaria nɛ Damaskus tɛɛns la.

english_verse: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
translation_verse: m kʋ san'am Jerusalem dim nɛ ba bada la wʋʋ man da niŋ Samaria dim nɛ ba bada si'em laa?’”

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “M ya'a ti naae man tʋm si'el Zion nɛ Jerusalem la, m na namis Asiria na'ab la o dʋ'ʋsim mɛŋ nɛ o nyɛɛsim la yɛla.

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: O yɛl ye, ‘Mam mɛŋ paŋ ka m tʋmi li nɛ m nu'ug nɛ m mɛŋ ya'am, bɔzugɔ m gban'ad si'el wʋsa gbin. M yis sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa titɔndis ka faaɛn ba areza'as. Man an gandaug la zug m nyaŋi ba wʋsa.

english_verse: I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.
translation_verse: M nu'ug faaɛn buudi bɛdegʋ kpan'am, nwɛnɛ nidi ba'aŋi yak niis tɛɛd ka vaae gɛla bɛdegʋ nɛ. Ala ka m la'as tɛɛns la wʋsa, ka sɔ' pʋ nyaŋi dam o kpʋkpauŋ bɛɛ ya'ae o nɔɔri yɛl si'ela.’

english_verse: King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it?
translation_verse: Abaa! Lieŋ na nyaŋi ʋki li mɛŋi gaad onɛ ʋki li laa? Bɛɛ sʋ'ʋg dʋ'ʋsi li mɛŋi gaad onɛ mɔri li tʋmid laa? Dau ʋkid duor ka duor pʋ ʋkid dau!

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Dinzug, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na nwɛ' Asiria na'ab la, ka kɛ ka wiim kpɛn' o zabzabkpi'ema la niŋgbina ni, ka bugum pielim na dit o na'am girima la'ad la wʋsa.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Mam Wina'am onɛ an Israel nɛɛsim la na lieb bugum, mam onɛ an kasi la na lieb bugum pielim ka di si'el wʋsa la'am kanb o gɛnda nɛ gauŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Tiis banɛ na kpɛlim o sian'arin la na pɔɔd hali ka biig na nyaŋi kaali ba ka sɔb.” Israel dim banɛ kpɛlim la yɛla

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ya'a ti paae, Israel dim banɛ kpɛlim la, Jakob yidim banɛ nan vʋe la kʋ lɛn nɔki ba ti'iri niŋ onɛ bʋ'ʋdi ba la nii, amaa ba na ti'enɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ Israel dimi zu'oe wʋʋ titanbin'isʋg linɛ dig atɛuk nɔɔrin la, ba bi'ela ma'aa na lɛb na. O gban'e ba san'auŋ yɛla, o na san'ami ba wʋsa wʋʋ lin nar si'em.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na kɛ ka gban'ar linɛ an san'auŋ la yɛla lu teŋ la wʋsa zug.

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “M nimbanɛ bɛ Zion teŋinɛ, da zɔti Asiria dim dabiem, hali nɛ ban mɔr duoya nɛ balaya bʋ'ʋdi ya wʋʋ Egipt dimi da niŋidi ya si'em la.

english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: Li kʋ yuugɛ ka m sʋnpɛɛn la naae ani ka fɛndigi lɛb banɛ bɔɔdi ya san'auŋ la san'an.”

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na fiebi ba nɛ sisanbig wʋʋ on da fieb Midia dim Oreb Tampiingin si'em la, ka na ʋk o dansaari kpa' Atɛuk ku'om la wʋʋ on da niŋ Egipt si'em la.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ba na yis ziid la ya zugin, ka yisi ba yu'asindaug la ya ningɔnya ni, yanamɛ na nɔb la zug, yu'asindaug la na kɔ'. Asiria dim Kenna ye ba zab

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: Asiria dim kpɛn' Ayaf teŋin gaadi keŋ Migron, ka su'a ba la'ad Mikmas teŋin.

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: Ba dɔl za'anɔɔrin la gaad ka yɛl ye, “Ti na la'as Geba teŋin yʋ'ʋŋa.” Ka dabiem kpɛn' Rama dim ka ba kirid, ka Gibea linɛ an Saul teŋ la dim zɔt.

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: Gallim dima, ya tansim agɔla! Laisa dima, kɛlisimi! Lɛbisimi, Anatof dima!

english_verse: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.
translation_verse: Madmena dim bɛ nɛ zɔɔgin, ka Gebim dim ieed suak zin'ig.

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Asiria dim na zi'en Nob teŋin zina, Zion Zuorin la ba na nwɛ'ɛd nu'usi pisid, hali nɛ Jerusalem kʋkʋnin la.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.
translation_verse: Gɔsim Zugsɔb la, Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, o na nwaae wila la bas nɛ o paŋ tita'ar la. Ba na nwa' tibɛda la wʋsa bas, banɛ wa'am hali la na li teŋin na.

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: O na nwaae tititada banɛ bɛ sian'arin la nɛ lieŋ, Lebanon tiis na li Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la tuon.

english_verse: Like a branch that sprouts from a stump, someone from David's family will someday be king.
translation_verse: Wil paal na bus Jese tiig la gbinnin na; o nya'a la ni ka wil na buli wal wala.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Siig na bɛɛ o ni, ka kɛ ka o na mɔr ya'am ka mi' si'el wʋsa gbin, ka mɔr paŋ nɛ sa'al sʋŋ siig, ka na baŋ yɛla gbin, ka mɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: O na mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ Zugsɔb la zɔtim. O kʋ kad saria nɛ o nini nyɛ si'el bɛɛ tu'as antu'a o tʋba wʋm si'el ma'aanɛ;

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: amaa o na kad nɔŋ dim saria nɛ pʋpielim, ka maan tadimnam banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋʋn nwa' la yɛla nɛ sida. O na nwɛ' teŋgbauŋ la nɛ balaar kanɛ bɛɛ o nɔɔrin la, ka o nɔŋgban pɛbisim na kʋ bugusim dim.

english_verse: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim na aan o sɛnbidiŋ, ka sida pien na lɔɔ o siaa.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la zaŋku'ar nɛ pɛbibis na la'am bɛ nɛ taaba, ka wɛbaa na la'asi digi nɛ bʋʋg. Na'abil nɛ gbigimbibis na la'asi ɔnbid yaama, ka bibil na kemmi ba.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Na'anya'aŋ nɛ gbigim na la'asidi dit ka ba biis na la'asi digi, ka gbigim na ɔnbid mɔɔd wʋʋ naaf nɛ.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Bilia na di'emid dunduug vɔndʋg nɔɔrin, ka bibil na nɔk o nu'ugʋ pa'al teŋkʋdʋgingbi'ug buugin.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Ba na bɛ zuokanɛ aan m mɛŋ din ka an kasi la ni, ka kʋ pu'alim taaba bɛɛ san'am taaba baa bi'elaa. Teŋgbauŋ wʋsa na pɛ'ɛl nɛ nimbanɛ mi' Zugsɔb la wʋʋ ku'om pɛ'ɛl atɛuk si'em la.

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Dabiskan la, nya'ar kanɛ yi Jese gbinnin na la, na zi'e wʋʋ tuuta nɛ tis nidib la. Buudi bɛdegʋ na la'asi dɔl o, ka o vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'ig na mɔr girima.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Dabiskan la ya'a ti paae, Zugsɔb la na lɛm ba'aŋ o nu'ugʋ mɔr o nimbanɛ kpɛlim Asiria nɛ Egipt Teŋir nɛ banɛ bɛ Egipt Zugin la lɛbis na, nɛ banɛ bɛ Patros nɛ Kus, nɛ Elam nɛ Sinar, nɛ banɛ bɛ Hamat nɛ tɛɛns banɛ ka atɛuk giligi ba la.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: O na ʋk tuuta pa'al tɛɛns la nidib ka la'as Israel nimbanɛ ka ba gban'e ba mɔri keŋ la. O na la'as Juda nimbanɛ widig la wʋsa, nɛ o nimbanɛ bɛ dunia lʋga anaasi la.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Efiram fufum na bɔdig, ka Juda dataadʋg kʋ lɛm bɛɛ. Efiram kʋ lɛm mɔr fufum nɛ Juda ka Juda mɛ kʋ lɛn zabid nɛ Efiram ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Ba na sigi zab nɛ Filistia dim ya-tuona la baba. Ka lɛn la'as taaba nyaŋ tɛɛns banɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ la, ka faaɛn ba la'adi mɔri lɛb na. Ba na nyaŋ Edom nɛ Moab dim wʋsa ka Ammon dim na siaki ba nɔɔr.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka atɛuk kanɛ bɛ Egipt nɔɔrin la kʋdig wʋsa ka na ʋk o nu'ugʋ kɛ ka pɛbistʋʋlʋg kpɛn' Efiritis kɔldaug la. O na buaki li ka li lieb kɔldabibis ayɔpɔi ka nidib na nyaŋi pid ta'ada lɔ'ɔŋ.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Suoraug na bɛ tis o nimbanɛ kpɛlim Asiria la, nwɛnɛ Israel dim la da yi Egipt saŋsi'a la.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Dabiskan la fʋ na yɛl ye, “M Zugsɔba, m na pʋ'ʋsif bareka! Fʋ sʋnf daa pɛlig nɛ mam amaa nannanna fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la gaadya, ka fʋ bʋgʋli m sʋʋnr.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Sida, Zugsɔb la aan m faangid, m na niŋ o yadda ka kʋ zɔ dabiem; Zugsɔb la an mam paŋ, o zug ka m yʋ'ʋmid yʋʋm nwa', onɛ lieb mam faangid.

english_verse: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
translation_verse: Ya na wik ku'om faangir bulisin la nɛ sumalisim.”

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Dabiskan la ya na yɛl ye, “Tisimi Zugsɔb la bareka pʋ'ʋsim, ka buol o yʋ'ʋr sʋ'ʋŋa. Kɛl ka buudi wʋsa wʋm o tʋʋma yɛla; mɔɔlim ye ba dʋ'ʋsim o yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋm na'as Zugsɔb la, bɔzugɔ o tʋm tʋʋm titada. Kɛl ka dunia wʋsa baŋi li yɛla.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Zion dima, dʋ'ʋsimi ya kʋkɔya yʋ'ʋmmi nɛ sumalisim, bɔzugɔ Israel Wina'am la galis nɛ, ka an kasi ka mɛ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin.”

english_verse: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
translation_verse: Babilon labaar linɛ ka Wina'am da kɛ ka Amoz biig Azaya nyɛ la nwa':

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: Kʋkʋn zug zin'ikanɛ ka tiis nɛ mɔɔd kae la, anina ka ba mɔɔn zaba labaar. Ya kaasim agɔla tisi ba ka ʋki ya nu'usi tiesi pa'ali ba ka ba dɔl kpɛɛmnam za'anɔya la kpɛn' tempʋʋgin la.

english_verse: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
translation_verse: Mam mɛŋ tis nimbanɛ ka m gaans la nɔɔr, m la'asi m nidib la, ba anɛ banɛ mi' zaba sʋ'ʋŋa: ba na zab nɛ banɛ kɛ ka m sʋnf duoe la.

english_verse: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
translation_verse: Kɛlisim tʋkpiidʋg kanɛ yit zuoya la zut na, li nwɛnɛ nidibi la'as bɛdegʋ nɛ! Kɛlisim tɛɛns la tʋkpiidʋg, buudi la la'asid taaba! Zugsɔb la la'asid o zabzabidib ye ba nwɛ' tanp.

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: Ba yinɛ teŋ kanɛ lal, zin'ikanɛ an dunia la bɛn la. Zugsɔb la nɛ o nimbanɛ an wʋʋ o zaba la'ad la na san'am dunia la wʋsa.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Kaasimi, ka Zugsɔb dabisir la li'el ya, li na kena nwɛnɛ san'auŋ linɛ yit Paŋtita'ar Sɔb san'an na.

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa zug, sɔ' wʋsa nu'us kʋ lɛm mɔr paŋa ka ba ya'am na bɔdig.

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: Dabiem na kpɛn' ba, ka tɔɔg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ tita'ar na paae ba, ka li zabir na nwɛnɛ pu'a na sa'ae nɛ, ka ba nini mu'oe wii ka ba yirid.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, Zugsɔb dabisir kenna. Li anɛ dabisbɛ'og, ka anɛ o sʋnpɛɛn linɛ mɔr dabiem la dabisir. Li na kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim san'am ka teŋ la lieb dabɔɔd.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Nwadbibis banɛ bɛ saŋgbauŋin la wʋsa kʋ lɛn nie. Winnig na lieb lik, ka nwadig mɛ kʋ lɛn tans na ya'asɛ.

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: M na namis dunia nidibi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla, nɛ banɛ an bugusim dim la ba bugusim la yɛla. M na gu'oe nyɛɛsim dim nɛ ba nyɔ'ɔg nwɛ'ɛb la, ka sie banɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ ka ziemi ba taaba la.

english_verse: Survivors will be harder to find than the purest gold.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka nidib kpɛlim bi'ela ka kar hali gaad sanlim vɛnla, hali ba na kari gaad Ofir sanlima.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Man Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la sʋnf ya'a ti pɛlig, saŋgbana na dammid, ka teŋ na mi'im lin bɛ zin'isi'a la, daa kanɛ ka m sʋnf la'aŋi nwɛnɛ bugum la.

english_verse: Everyone will run to their homelands, just as hunted deer run, and sheep scatter when they have no shepherd.
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa na zɔɔ lɛb o nidibin, ka widigi kuli ba mɛŋ teŋin. Ba na nwɛnɛ walis ka tɔn'ɔsnam budigi ba, bɛɛ pɛbanɛ pʋ mɔr kɔnbkemma.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa ka ba gban'e o ba na kʋns o, ka na nɔki ba zaba sʋ'ʋsi kʋʋ ba wʋsa.

english_verse: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.
translation_verse: Ba na fanbi ba bilies teŋin kʋʋ ba, ba nini ni; ka kpɛn' ba yaanɛ fan' la'ad ka bibi ba pu'ab.

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, m na kɛ ka Media dim kena ka ba sʋʋnr duoe ka ba zab nɛ ba. Ba ba'a ka' nɛ anzurifaa, ka ba ya'amlɛog mɛ pʋ bɛ nɛ sanlimaa.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: Ba tiraad la na tɔn na'akim; ba kʋ zɔt bilies nimbaanliga bɛɛ ba gɔs biis ka nimbaanlig mɔri ba.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Babilon sʋ'ʋlim la da vɛnli gaad sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa, lin ka ba mɔri dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ la. Nɛ nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa, Wina'am na san'ami li ka li na an wʋʋ on da san'am Sodom nɛ Gomora si'em la.

english_verse: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.
translation_verse: Nid kʋ lɛn zin'in anina zʋmaʋŋ kaŋa hali nɛ zʋmaana banɛ dɔl nya'aŋ na la wʋsa. Arab dim la kʋ lɛn ti' ba sʋga anina, ka sɔ' mɛ kʋ lɛn kem kɔnbid anina.

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: Pipirisin bʋnkɔnbid na dig anina, ka zunna na pɛ'ɛli ba yaan la. Viid na maali ba tɛɛd anina ka sian'arin bʋʋs na ian'ad anina di'em.

english_verse: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
translation_verse: Zaŋku'a na kaasidi ba kpi'euŋ zin'ig la, ka wɛbaas na digi ba vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'isin la. Babilon saŋa paae ya, o dabisa pʋ lɛn lal la.

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na zɔ Jakob yidim nimbaanlig; o na lɛn gaŋ Israel ya'as ka na zin'ili ba, ba mɛŋ teŋin. Saam na la'as nɛ ba, ka naali ba mɛŋ nɛ Jakob yidim.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Tɛɛns nidib na mɔri ba lɛbisi ba mɛŋ zin'igin na. Ka Israel dim na sʋ'oe tɛɛns la nidib ka ba dap nɛ pu'ab na an sankpan'asnam Zugsɔb la teŋin. Ba na gban'e banɛ da gban'e ba la, ka tuligi sʋ'oe banɛ daa sʋ'oe ba la. Zugsɔb la pian' Babilon na'ab yɛla

english_verse: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
translation_verse: Daakanɛ ka Zugsɔb la ti tisi ya yɔlisim ya namisʋg nɛ tɔɔg nɛ mugusʋg nɛ tʋʋm kpi'ema ni la,

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: ya na maal Babilon na'ab la siaa ye, Mugusʋg sɔb la yɛla naae ya, ka zaba kʋ lɛn duoe ya'asɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kɔ'ɔg bugusim sɔb la balaar, ka buak o na'am dansaar la,

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns wʋsa yʋ'ʋn dig nɛ baanlimm ka sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛ, sɔ' wʋsa yʋ'ʋmmi nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Hali Lebanon tiis wʋsa maannɛ sumalisim fʋ yɛla yɛt ye, “Fʋn lɛn kae la, sɔ' kʋ lɛn nwaae ti ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa na la'asi yɛlif ye, “Fʋ mɛ yʋ'ʋn lieb tadim, fʋ yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ tinam nɛ!”

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: Fʋ na'am nɛ li paŋ la wʋsa sig yaʋgʋn, nɛ bʋnnwɛ'ɛda banɛ da na'asidif la. Bugula zug ka fʋ digi ka zʋnzʋnya pilif.

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: Fʋ niŋ wala naan agɔlli luna, fʋn kanɛ an nwaddar ka an nɛɛsim sɔb la! Ba da'ae fʋ bas dunia ni na, fʋn onɛ da gɔs tɛɛns ka ba an zaalim la!

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: Fʋ da yɛli fʋ pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye, “M na dʋ arezana ni, m na dʋ'ʋsi m na'am paŋ ka li gaad Wina'am nwadbibis! M na zin'in na'am zin'ig, zin'ikanɛ ka ba la'asid zuor zug la, zuokanɛ an kasi ka wa'am hali la.”

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Amaa ba nɔki fʋ sigis yaʋgʋn na, niŋif bʋmbɔk zulʋŋin la.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: Banɛ nyɛɛf la gɔsidif nɛ kii, ka bi'esid, ye, “Oŋa da dam dunia ka kɛ ka tɛɛns nidib kirid laa?

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: Dau kaŋa da kɛ ka dunia lieb dabɔɔd ka zab nɛ tempʋʋsi san'ami ba ka pʋ siak ka banɛ ka o gban'e la lɛbi kul laa?”

english_verse: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns la na'anam la dignɛ ba ya-vɛnla ni, sɔ' wʋsa vʋ'ʋsidnɛ o yaʋgʋn.

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: Amaa ba lɔbigifnɛ yisi fʋ yaʋgʋn, nwɛnɛ wilkanɛ ka ba pʋ bɔɔda; banɛ ka ba kʋʋ ba la ligilif, banɛ ka ba kʋʋ ba nɛ sʋ'ʋg, ka sigisi ba kuga bʋmbɔkin, bɛɛ nwɛnɛ kum kanɛ ka ba nɔ nɛ nɔba.

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ la'asi fʋ mum nɛ na'anam la, fʋn san'ami fʋ teŋ ka kʋʋ fʋ nidib la zug. Ba kʋ lɛn tɛnri fʋ yɛla bɛɛ kɛ ka fʋ na'am tuŋ yʋ'ʋr duoe.

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Maalimi kʋʋb zin'ig ka kʋʋ o biribis la, ba yaanam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla ka ba na kɔdigi ba; ye ba da duoe na di teŋ la faar ka sʋ'ʋg teŋ la, ka nɔbigi pɛ'ɛl teŋ la nɛ tempʋʋs la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “M na duoe zab nɛ ya,” m na kɛnsig Babilon yʋ'ʋr nɛ banɛ kpɛlim la. Ba biis nɛ ba yaas wʋsa m kʋ kɛ ka ba yʋ'ʋr pʋdigɛ. Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “M na kɛ ka Babilon lieb ku'om zin'ig nɛ zin'ikanɛ ka wɛog bʋnkɔnbid nɛ niis bɛ; m na san'ami ba wʋsa wʋʋ saug ka ba piis sa'adi bas nɛ.” Zugsɔb la pian' Asiria yɛla

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl nɔɔr ye, “Sida, man gban'e si'em la, linɛ na zi'en, man tɛn'ɛs si'em la kʋ viigɛ.

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: M na san'am Asiria dim la m teŋin; m zuoya la ni ka m na nɔɔ ba digil. M na yisi ba mugusʋg linɛ nwɛnɛ yu'asindaug ka ba pa'al nidib niŋgɔnya ni la, nɛ zitɛbisa linɛ ka ba mugusi ba ye ba ziid la.”

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ gban'ar linɛ tis dunia la wʋsa; nu'ukaŋa na tiɛn paae tɛɛns wʋsa.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have made these plans. No one can stop me now! The Philistines Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la gban'e ye o tʋmi li, anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi vi' o? O tiɛn o nu'ug nɛ paŋ, anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi lɛbisi li? Zugsɔb la pian' Filistia dim yɛla

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Na'ab Ahaz kum yʋʋm la ka labakaŋa kena:

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: Filistia dima, da maannɛ sumalisim ye balaar kanɛ nwɛ' ya la kɔ'ɔg yaa. Bɔzugɔ wa'akan la gbinnin ka dunduug na yina, o biis na anɛ wa'abanɛ ian'ad ka ba yabid mɔr zɛɛnsim hali pamm.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Hali nɔŋdaan tapiif na paam diib, ka banɛ an tadimnam la na dig nɛ sumalisim. Amaa kɔ'ɔm na kʋʋ fʋ gbin la nɛ fʋ nimbanɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa.

english_verse: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
translation_verse: Kaasim agɔla gɔla ya teŋ za'anɔya ni, ka nwɛ' kuŋ nɛ paŋi ya tempʋʋgin la! Zabzabidib yi ya-datiuŋ baba kenna wʋʋ nyɔ'ɔs tita'ar, dabiem sɔb ka' ba sʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Ti lɛbis teŋ la tʋmtʋmnib ye bɔ? Ti na yɛli ba ye, “Zugsɔb la lɛbis Zion n zi'el, ka o nidib la yʋ'ʋn nyɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm.”

english_verse: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
translation_verse: Labakaŋa anɛ Moab yɛla: Ar tempʋʋg linɛ bɛ Moab sʋ'ʋlimin la lieb dabɔɔg. Yʋ'ʋŋ yinne ka li san'am! Kir tempʋʋg linɛ bɛ Moab sʋ'ʋlimin la lieb dabɔɔg. Yʋ'ʋŋ yinne ka li san'am!

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Dibon dim keŋi ba pʋ'ʋsim zin'igin; ba keŋi ba zuoya la ni kum; Moab dim la kaasid Nebo nɛ Medeba tɛɛns yɛla. Ba wʋsa pʋni ba zut ka kɔɔnsi ba tiemis ba sʋnsa'aŋ zug ka li tɔi hali.

english_verse: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka ba yɛ bɔto fuudi bɛ suoraadin, ka sieba dʋ dɔɔd zugʋ kaasid, ka sieba vanb nidibi la'asid zin'isi'a wʋsa kaasid.

english_verse: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
translation_verse: Hesbon nɛ Eleale tɛɛns dim kaasid nɛ, ka ba kaasig la keŋ paae Jahaz teŋin. Dinzug ka Moab zabzabidib la nwɛ' kuŋ ka ba niŋgbina kpi.

english_verse: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
translation_verse: M kaasidi m sʋnfʋn Moab yɛla, nidib la zɔ hali ti paae Zoar teŋin, ka gaadi paae Eglaf Sielisiya. Ba sieba dɔl suor la dʋ paae Luhif teŋin, ba kennɛ ka kaasid, ban dɔl suori wa'ae Horonam la, ka kum, san'auŋ kanɛ paae ba la yɛla.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Nimirim kɔlis la kpiɛn ya, ka mɔɔd kʋdig, tiis nɛ mɔɔd la wʋsa zɛndig ya, ka fʋ kʋ lɛn nyɛ mɔma'asa, hali baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Kpan'am linɛ ka ba nyɛ ka su'a li la, ba kpilimi li wʋsa zii lɔ'ɔŋ kɔldabʋmbɔk la gaad.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Ba kaasig la paae Moab titɔndis bɛn, ba kaasig la lalig nɛ hali ti paae Eglam tempʋʋgin, ba kukuma la laligi paae Beer Elim.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Dimon kɔlis la wʋsa pɛ'ɛli nɛ ziim, amaa bɛ'ɛd na lɛn ken Dimon teŋin na gaad ala, gbigim na gban'e banɛ zɔɔ yit Moab teŋin la nɛ banɛ kpɛlim bɛ teŋin la wʋsa.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: “Mɔri pɛ'ɛsi keŋ tis onɛ sʋ'oe teŋ la ka li aan ya piini, lin yi Sela lɔ'ɔŋ pipiris teŋ la hali ti paae Zion zuorin la na.

english_verse: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ niis ka ba ɛɛnti budigi ba tɛɛgʋn ka ba ian'ad si'em la, Moab pu'ab la mɛ anɛ ala, ka yi Aanon kɔldaugin la widig saiin, ka yɛt ye,

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: ‘Sa'alimi ti ka ti baŋ tinamɛ na gban'e si'em. Kɛl ka fʋ ma'asim lusi ti nintaŋ saŋa. Su'am banɛ zɔɔ pɔns la, da pa'al banɛ zɔɔ widig la zin'iga.

english_verse: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka Moab dim banɛ su'a zɔ la bɛɛ fʋ san'an, lusimi ba ka onɛ bɔɔd ye o san'am la da nyɛɛ ba.’ Onɛ mugusidi ya la saŋa na gaad, ka san'auŋ la gu'oe, ka onɛ bɔɔd zaba la bɔdig teŋ la zug.

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: Saŋkan la sɔ' na zin'in na'am gbauŋ la zug ka mɔr nɔŋilim nɛ yɛlsida. Onɛ na zin'in na'am gbauŋ zug la na anɛ David yaaŋ: o na tu'adnɛ sida, ka kɛ ka pʋpielim zi'en.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka Moab dim la kaasid; ba la'as taaba kaasid Moab teŋ la yɛla. Ba sʋnsa'aŋ pɔɔgin, ba fabin ka kaasid ka maal sʋnsa'aŋ Kir Harosef teŋ dimalisa la yɛla.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Hesbon pɔɔd la kʋdig ya, Sibma tiwanna pɔɔd la mɛ kʋdig nɛ. Tɛɛns wʋsa na'anam da nu tiis la wala daam kʋʋl. Tiban la wila daa ɛɛnti tiɛn paae Jaza tempʋʋg gaadi paae pipiris teŋin la, ka li bula la tansidi yit ka tiɛndi paad atɛukʋn.

english_verse: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
translation_verse: Ala ka m kaas wʋʋ Jaza dimi kaasid si'em la ka li anɛ Sibma tiwanna la yɛla. Oi, Hesbon nɛ Eleale, m kaas ya ka m ninta'am sʋʋ ya! Fʋ wala ɛɛnti bi'ig ka ba pɔn'ɔd, ya pɔɔd bunib saŋa, sumalisim tansʋg nɛ yʋʋma lɛn kae.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Sumalisim lɛn kae tiisin la, sɔ' pʋ lɛn yʋ'ʋm bɛɛ maan tʋkpiidʋg tiwanna pɔɔdin la, sɔ' pʋ lɛn nwi'asid tiwala la ye o yis daam, sumalisim tansʋg agɔla, gɔla la gu'oe ya.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: M kaasid Moab yɛla nwɛnɛ kɔnne nwɛ'ɛd nɛ, ka m sʋnf san'am Kir Harosef yɛla.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Moab dimi yii keŋi ba zuoya zug winsɔsʋgin, ba sɔsidnɛ gɛɛnd zaalim; ban keŋi ba teŋgbana pʋ'ʋsʋg zin'igin la, si'el-si'el pʋ maalɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da dɛŋi pian' Moab yɛla si'em nwa'.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Yʋma atan' sʋʋgin, na an wʋʋ sɔ' na kpɛn' tʋʋma ka kaannɛ o dabisa si'em la, Moab vɛnlim nɛ o nidib la zu'oe si'em la ba na nɛ'ɛsi ba, nimbanɛ kpɛlim la na anɛ fiin ka mɛ kʋ mɔr paŋ bɛɛ yʋ'ʋrɛ.”

english_verse: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb pian' labakaŋa Damaskus yɛla ye, “Gɔsima! Damaskus kʋ lɛn an tempʋʋg ya'asɛ, amaa li na lieb nɛ dabɔɔd.

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Ba na bas Aroa tempʋʋs la, sɔ' kʋ lɛm kpɛn' ani ya'asɛ. Ba na bas ka bʋnkɔnbid ma'aa dig ani, ka sɔ' kae na kadi baa.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Paŋ kanɛ ka Efiram tɛɛns mɔr la kʋ lɛm bɛɛ, ka Damaskus na'am paŋ mɛ kʋ lɛm bɛɛ, ka Aram dim banɛ kpɛlim la na kɔ'ɔŋ girima nwɛnɛ Israel dimi kɔ'ɔŋ si'em la”, Zugsɔb la yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa.

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Saŋa kenna ka Jakob yidim paŋ la na sie ka ba kpan'am la gaad.

english_verse: Israel will be like wheat fields in Rephaim Valley picked clean of grain.
translation_verse: Li na nwɛnɛ ki na zi'e ka ba kie ka buni naae, ka nwɛnɛ ki linɛ bɛ Refa Dim Bɔn'ɔgin ka ba wi'isi li wʋsa.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, o nidib la bi'ela na kpɛlim, ka lɛn nwɛnɛ olif tiis wala ka ba pɔn' ka ayi' bɛɛ atan' kpɛlim saazug sa, ka anaasi bɛɛ anu kpɛlim wil banɛ bɛ teŋir la.” Israel Wina'am la yɛl.

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la, nidib na gɔs onɛ maali ba la, ka fɛndigi lɛb Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la san'an na.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ gɔs maan bimbima banɛ ka ba mɛŋ nu'us maal la, ka mɛ kʋ tis Asera daad la girima nɛ bimbima banɛ ka ba maali nyu'od bʋnnyubisa li zug la.

english_verse: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
translation_verse: Asida mɛnɛ, li saŋa ya'a ti paae, ba tempʋbanɛ kpi'em hali la na nwɛnɛ Ammon dim din la nɛ. Tɛɛns banɛ ka ba bas Israel dim yɛla, ka li lieb sian'anr nɛ tutuud wʋsa la, nid kʋ lɛm bɛɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, ya tam Wina'am onɛ aan ya Faangid la yɛla, ya pʋ lɛn tiɛn tampiing onɛ aan ya kpi'euŋ sɔb la yɛllɛ. Ya tun'e sɛ teŋ zʋŋ tisʋma,

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: hali ka ba nɔbig ka pu puum daakanɛ ka ya sɛɛ ba la, amaa ya kʋ pun'oe wal baa yinne ba nii. Yanamɛ na bun si'el anɛ sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ tɔɔg linɛ pʋ naada.

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ nidib la maan tʋkpiidʋgʋ nwɛnɛ ku'om aaɛn pʋbidi ken la, Wina'am ya'a tansi ba, ba na zɔɔ lalig, ba na zɔ nwɛnɛ udug ka pɛbisʋg ʋki li kʋkʋna ni, ka nwɛnɛ sa'ad ka sisi'epiliŋ da'ae li.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: Zaam ya'a ma'ae dabietita'ar na bɛ! Bɛogʋ ti nied la ka ba gaad! Banɛ faaɛn ti, ka vaae ti la'ad la, ban na di'e si'eli la.

english_verse: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
translation_verse: Teŋgban si'a bɛ Kus kɔldaug nɔɔrin la, anina ka ba nwɛ'ɛdi ba kpʋkpama ka maan tʋkpiidʋg. Tɔɔg na paae teŋgbauŋ nwa'!

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: Ba tʋm nidib ka ba kpɛn' anrima kenna, ba dɔl ku'omin kenna. Ayei, lɛmmi, yanam banɛ ka ba tʋmi ya ka ya tun'e zɔɔg hali la, kemi ya nimbanɛ wa'am ka ba niŋgbina saalim la ni, bam banɛ ka nimbanɛ bɛ lalli nɛ yammin zɔti ba la. Teŋ kanɛ dimi mɔr paŋ ka nɔŋ zaba ka kɔldaad bɛɛsi ba teŋ la.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Yanam nimbanɛ bɛ dunia nwa' ni, yanam banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ zug la, ba ya'a ti ʋk tanp tuuta zuoya la ni, ya na nyɛ, ba ya'a ti pieb zaba na'atan ya na wʋm.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim si'eli nwa': “M na an baanlimm m bɛllim zin'ig ka gɔsid dinɛ na niŋ; wʋʋ nintaŋi na dʋt na nɛ tʋʋlʋg, bɛɛ mɛligim na li bunib saŋa.”

english_verse: Before the blossoms can turn into grapes, God will cut off the sprouts and hack off the branches.
translation_verse: Bunib saŋa ya'a nam pʋ paae, ka puum la sʋʋgi naae, ka wala la yʋ'ʋn bi'ig, o na nwaae wila la nɛ sʋ'ʋg, o ya'a nwaae naae o na pɛs wilbibis la.

english_verse: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.
translation_verse: Li wʋsa na kpɛn dig ka niis banɛ bɛ zuoya ni la nɛ wɛog bʋnkɔnbid na dit: niis na dii li ɔnsir saŋa ka wɛog bʋnkɔnbid mɛ na diti li waad saŋa.

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la nimbanɛ wa'am ka ba niŋgbina saalim ka ba mɔr paŋ ka nɔŋ zaba ka kɔldaad bɛɛsi ba teŋ, ka nimbanɛ li'eli ba nɛ banɛ bɛ lalli zɔti ba la, na mɔr piini na tis Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la. Ba na mɔr piini la kɛn Zion Zuorin zin'ikanɛ ka Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yʋ'ʋr bɛ la.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pian' labakaŋa Egipt yɛla: “Gɔsima, Zugsɔb la ban'adnɛ saŋgbana ka li zɔt tɔ'ɔtɔ ken Egipt na. Egipt bada la kirid o tuon ka Egipt dim ya'am bɔdig.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Dabiem na kpɛn' Egipt dim, ka m kɛ ka ba gban'ar wʋsa lieb zaalim. Ba na bu'osi ba bada la nɛ kpi'imnam nɛ kikiris sɔb ban na niŋ si'em.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: M na nɔk Egipt dim la wʋsa niŋ onɛ mɔr paŋi gati ba la nu'usin. O anɛ bugusim sɔb hali: na'akanɛ ka nidib zɔt dabiem la na sʋ'oe ba,” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Kɔldaug la ku'om na kpiɛn, kɔldaug la pʋʋgin na ga'aŋi kʋdig.

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: Ku'om la dɔl suosieba zɔt la na pun'oe nyuusid, Egipt kɔldabibis la ku'om na sie hali. Li na ba'asi kʋdig, ka kɔlkɛɛna nɛ dindɛgɛɛns na kʋdigi kpi,

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Banɛ tʋm gum tʋʋma wʋsa la'an nɛ banɛ ʋgʋd gum la ti'ir naae ya.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: Banɛ tʋm fuud tʋʋma la na mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ, ka banɛ tʋm ka ba yɔɔdi ba dabisir wʋsa la sʋnf na san'am.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Zoan teŋ tuongatib la anɛ nɛɛm-nɛɛm; ba anɛ zɔn; banɛ ye ba mɔri ya'am ka sa'an Faaro la, ba wʋsa tisid o nɛ ya'amka'alʋg sa'alʋg. Ya na niŋ wala yɛl Na'ab Faaro ye, “Tinam anɛ ya'am dim ka mɛ an kʋdimin na'anam la nya'andɔliba?”

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Na'ab Faaro, fʋ ya'am dim la bɛ yaanɛ? Kɛl ka ba pa'alif ka fʋ baŋ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la gban'e Egipt yɛla si'em la.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Zoan tuongatib la lieb nɛ zɔn, Memfis na'ayikpɛm la mɛ kɛlisid dama'am dim; ban nɛ nimbanɛ mɔr teŋ la paŋ la kpɛn'ɛs Egipt dim mɔɔg.

english_verse: No one in Egypt can do a thing, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Egipt dim kʋ nyaŋi maal si'ela, sɔ' ka' ani an nɔŋdaan bɛɛ kpan'am sɔb ka na nyaŋi sʋŋi baa.

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Egipt dim na ti nwɛnɛ pu'ab nɛ, dabiem na ti kpɛn' ba hali, saŋkanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na ti duoe ye o namisi ba la.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Juda dim na kpɛn'ɛs Egipt dim la dabiem, ka onɛ wʋsa ka ba pʋdig Juda dim yʋ'ʋr o san'an la, o ya'am na iank, Zugsɔb la gban'adi ba yɛla si'em la zug.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Egipt tempʋʋs anu na pian'ad Keenan teŋ pian'ad, ka pɔɔd nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yʋ'ʋr, ba na buon tɛɛns nwa' yinne ye Winnig Tempʋʋg.

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ba na maal Zugsɔb maan daka Egipt teŋ la teŋsʋk, ka ba'a kugir kanɛ tiɛnd Zugsɔb la yɛla teŋ la titɔndigin.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Li na anɛ zanbin ka an kasɛti tis Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, bɔzugɔ ba ya'a ti nyɛ mugusʋg ka kaasi tis Zugsɔb la, o na tisi ba faangid nɛ onɛ na zabi ba yɛla, ka o na faaɛn ba.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: Ala ka Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka Egipt dim baŋ o, saŋkan la ka ba na tiɛn Zugsɔb la yɛla. Ba na zun'od o ka maan maana nɛ zʋʋd piini, ba na zi'el nɔɔri tis Zugsɔb la ka dɔlisi li.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka Egipt dim nyɛ mugusʋg, o na mugusi ba ka lɛn tisi ba yɔlisim. Ba na lɛb o san'an na ka o wʋmi ba sɔsʋg ka tisi ba yɔlisim.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ya'a ti paae, suoratita'ar na yi Egipt kennɛ Asiria. Asiria dim na ken Egipt ka Egipt dim mɛ na ken Asiria. Egipt dim nɛ Asiria dim na la'asi zun'od Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ya'a ti paae, Israel na paas Egipt nɛ Asiria. Tɛɛns atan' nwa' na kɛ ka dunia la nyɛ albareka.

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na niŋi ba bareka ka yɛl ye, “Albareka bɛ nɛ Egipt dim banɛ an m nidib la, nɛ Asiria dim banɛ ka m nu'ug maali ba la, nɛ Israel dim banɛ an m mɛŋ faar la.”

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Yʋʋm kanɛ ka Asiria na'ab Sargon da kɛ ka o soogia kpɛɛm keŋ zab nɛ Asdod n nyaŋi li la,

english_verse: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
translation_verse: saŋkan ka Zugsɔb da pian' tis Azaya ka yɛl o ye, “Yɛɛgim bɔto fuug la ka pidigi fʋ ta'ada la.” Ka o niŋ ala, ka ken biel nɛ nɔbteŋ.

english_verse: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Nwɛnɛ m sankpan'as Azaya ken biel nɛ nɔbteŋ yʋma atan' ye li an zanbinnɛ tis Egipt nɛ Kus dim si'em la,

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: ala ka Asiria na'ab la na zabi gban'e Egipt nɛ Kus teŋ dim na'akim nɛ ba pu'asada nɛ ba bʋnkʋd nɛ ba pu'anya'as wʋsa ka ba ken biel nɛ nɔbteŋ. O na kɛ ka ba ken gbinfuma, ka li an nyannɛ tis Egipt dim la.

english_verse: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
translation_verse: Ka Filistia dim banɛ nɔki ba ti'iri niŋ Kus dimin ka nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg Egipt dim yɛla la, dabiem na kpɛn' ba ka ba di nyan.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ya'a ti paae, nimbanɛ bɛ atɛuk nɔɔrin la na yɛl ye, ‘Gɔsim nimbanɛ ka ti daa nɔki ti ti'iri niŋi ba san'an la, banɛ ka ti daa zɔɔ keŋi ba san'an Asiria na'ab yɛla, ye ba faaɛn ti ka tisi ti yɔlisim la! Ti na niŋ wala yi ya'asɛ?’”

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Labakaŋa anɛ pipiris teŋ linɛ bɛ atɛuk nɔɔrin ka li yʋ'ʋr buon Babilon la yɛla. Nwɛnɛ sisi'epiliŋi na yi ya-dagɔbʋg baba piisid teŋ si'em ken la, ala ka nidib na yi pipiris teŋ kanɛ ka nidib zɔti li la kena.

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: M nyɛ nier si'a ka li mɔr dabiem. Teŋgbi'idim sɔb la gbi'i ya, ka faaung sɔb la faaɛn ya. Elam dima, duom zabi! Media dima, duomi keŋ giligi tempʋʋg la! M na kɛ ka on namisid nidib ka ba kaasidi fabin si'em la wʋsa naae.

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa ni ka m nyɛ, ka dabiem kpɛn'ɛm pʋʋgin ka m niŋgbina pin'ili zabid, ka li zabir la nwɛnɛ pu'a na sa'ae nɛ. Ka m kennɛ gɛrid man wʋm si'el la yɛla, ka m ya'am fɛndig man nyɛ si'el la zug.

english_verse: My head spins; I'm horrified! Early evening, my favorite time, has become a nightmare.
translation_verse: M ya'am iank nɛ ka dabiem kɛ ka m kirid, ya'amlɛog kanɛ ka m pa'a mɔr ye zaam ma'ae la liebnɛ dabiem tisim.

english_verse: In Babylon the high officials were having a feast. They were eating and drinking, when someone shouted, “Officers, take your places! Grab your shields.”
translation_verse: Ba maal diibi zi'el, ba yadig sɔna, ka ba di, ka nu! Zaba tuongatiba, duomi, ka ti'ebi nɛ ya zaba la'ad la!

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Send guards to find out what's going on.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim si'eli nwa'; “Kem bɔ sɔ' ka o gur teŋ la, ka kɛ ka o yɛl on nyɛ si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
translation_verse: O ya'a nyɛ zaba tɛrekonam ka ba kenna nɛ widi, bɛɛ ba ban'ad bʋmis bɛɛ yʋgʋma ka ba ban'adi kenna, asɛɛ ka o ti'eb amɛŋa mɛŋa. Ɛɛn, o ti'ebim sʋ'ʋŋa.”

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: Gɔsima, dau sɔ' nwana kenna nɛ zaba tɛreko, ka dɔl nidib ka ba ban'ad widi!” Onɛ gur la lɛbisi yɛl ye, “Babilon teŋ la luya, li lu ya! Ka ba lugi ba bada banɛ ka ba ya'ab la ka li widigi yaam-yaam dig teŋin”

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: M nidiba, ba bʋ' ya zieŋin wʋʋ ki nɛ, ka yɛligi ya; man wʋm si'el Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb ka an Israel Wina'am la san'an la ka m mɔɔli tisi ya. Zugsɔb la pian' Edom yɛla

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Labakaŋa anɛ Duma yɛla. Sɔ' buon Seir teŋin yɛt ye, “Fʋn teŋ gura, yʋ'ʋŋ la na gaad saŋkanɛ? Teŋ guraa, yʋ'ʋŋ la na gaad saŋkanɛ?”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Onɛ gur la na lɛbis ye, “Bɛog na nie, amaa yʋ'ʋŋ na lɛn sɔb. Fʋ ya'a bɔɔd ye fʋ bu'os ya'as, fʋn lɛm na bu'os.” Zugsɔb la pian' Arabia yɛla

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Labakaŋa anɛ Arabia yɛla. Yanam suokennib banɛ yi Dedan teŋin la, yanam banɛ la'asi bɛ Arabia mɔɔgin la,

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: mɔri ku'om yina tis banɛ ka ku'onuud mɔri ba la. Yanam banɛ bɛ Tema sʋ'ʋlimin la, mɔri diib na tis banɛ an zɔɔma la.

english_verse: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.
translation_verse: Ba zɔnɛ zaba sʋ'ʋs la yɛla, ba zɔnɛ sʋ'ʋg kanɛ ka ba fuoe la yɛla, nɛ tiraug kanɛ ka ba gɔnd la yɛla, nɛ zaba la muk si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim si'eli nwa': “Yʋʋm yinne pɔɔgin, nwɛnɛ onɛ kpɛn' tʋʋma na kaan dabisa si'em la, Kedar dim yʋ'ʋri dʋt si'em la mɛ na naae.

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: Banɛ tɔnd tiraad ka an zabzabidibi bɛ Kedar teŋin la kpii naae, ba bi'ela ma'aa kpɛlim.”

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Labakaŋa anɛ Nier Bɔn'ɔg la yɛla. Bɔɔ daamidi ya nannanna ka ya dʋʋ bɛ dɔɔd zugɔ?

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: Tempʋʋg la pɛ'ɛli nɛ tʋkpiidʋg. Tempʋʋg la anɛ di'ema nɛ kuŋ. Ya nimbanɛ kpi la, ba da pʋ zabnɛ kʋʋ ba bɛɛ ba mɛŋi keŋ tanp nwɛ'ɛbi kpii ani.

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: Ya tuongatib la wʋsa la'asi zɔ. Ba dataas gban'e ba, hali ka pʋ tɔn piim yinne. Yanam banɛ ka ba gban'e ya la liebnɛ yammis, la'an nɛ yanamɛ dɛŋi zɔ ka ya dataas nam bɛ lalli la.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m yɛl ye, “Tɔɔmi m san'an; kɛl ka m kaasi tig. Da bɔɔd ye ya bɛlis mam m nimbanɛ kpi la zugɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la mɔr dabisir, ka li an tʋkpiidʋg nɛ kikirʋg nɛ dabiem ka li bɛ Nier Bɔn'ɔgin la, dabisir kanɛ ka ba na kaas ka fabin zuoya la ni.

english_verse: The people of Elam and Kir attacked with chariots and carried shields.
translation_verse: Elam teŋ dim la pianki ba lu'ad ka yina nɛ widi nɛ zaba tɛrekonam. Kir dim mɛ ti'eb ya nɛ zaba gbanti'edis.

english_verse: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Ya bɔn'ɔsʋma la pɛ'ɛl nɛ zaba tɛrekonam, ka ba zi'el wiedban'adib tempʋʋg la za'anɔya ni.

english_verse: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
translation_verse: Juda dim sʋŋir wʋsa naae ya. Daakan la ka ya yʋ'ʋn pin'ili gɔsidi ya zaba la'ad linɛ ka ba su'a Lebanon Tiis Yin la.

english_verse: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
translation_verse: Ya nyɛya ka David tempʋʋg zaŋguoma la mɔr wɛn bɛdegʋ, ka ya' pɛ'ɛl Teŋir Bɛuŋ la nɛ ku'om.

english_verse: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
translation_verse: Ya kaal Jerusalem dɔɔd nɛ ya' la wʋsa baŋi li kal, ka nwa'ae sieba yis kuga la ye ya maal zaŋguoma la ka li mɔr paŋ.

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: Ya tu zin'ikanɛ ka ku'om na digi zaŋguoma ayi' la teŋsʋk, ye Bɛuŋ Kʋdig la ku'om pʋbigi sig anina. Amaa ya pʋ gɔsi nyɛ Wina'am onɛ maali li wʋsa kʋdimin sa la, bɛɛ Zugsɔb onɛ gban'e li yɛla ka li yʋma zulim la.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la da buoli ya daakan la ye ya kaasim ka kum, ka pʋni ya zut, ka yɛ bɔto fuud, ka li anɛ sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ nyan zug.

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: Gɔsimiya, ya maan sumalisim tʋkpiidʋg, kɔtid niigi ka kʋʋd pɛ'ɛs, ɔnbid ni'im ka nuud daam! Ya yɛt ye, “Kɛlli ka ti di ka nu, ka bɛog anwa ka ti kpinɛ!”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la nie nɛ'ɛŋa pa'alim ka kɛ ka m wʋm “Ya'a ka' ya kum saŋa, ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la taal ka' basibɔ.” Zugsɔb la pian', Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl. Zugsɔb pian' Siebna nɛ Eliakim yɛla

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, Kem yɛl tʋmtʋm kaŋa, Siebna onɛ gɔsid na'ayir la ye,

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋm bɔ kpɛla? Anɔ'ɔn tisif suor ye fʋ tuu fʋ mɛŋ yaʋg kpɛla? Wala ka fʋ tuudi fʋ yaʋg kʋkʋn zug ka kpi'ed tampiing ye fʋ maali fʋ vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'iga?

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: Baŋim ka Zugsɔb la bɔɔd ye o zaŋi fʋ lɔbig, la'an nɛ fʋn an nintita'ar la.

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: O na gbilimif wʋʋ piennɛ lɔbigi bas teŋ kanɛ ka si'el-si'el kae ka fʋ kpii ani ka basi fʋ widi tɛreko sʋma la; fʋn onɛ diisidi fʋ zugdaan yir la nyan la!

english_verse: The Lord is going to take away your job!
translation_verse: M na yisi fʋ, fʋ tʋʋma ni, ka fʋ kʋ lɛm bɛɛ fʋ zin'igin la.

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: M na nɔki fʋ fuug la yɛɛl o, ka nɔki fʋ sɛnbidiŋ la lɔɔ o siaa, ka nɔki fʋ kpi'euŋ la tis o. O na an saamme tis banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la nɛ Juda yidim wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: M na nɔk Na'ab David yir saafinam la niŋ o nu'usin. On yɔ'ɔg si'el, sɔ' kae na nyaŋi yɔɔ; ka on yɔ' si'el, sɔ' kae na nyaŋi yɔ'ɔgɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: M na zi'el o kiŋ-kiŋ wʋʋ kpa'ar nɛ, ka o zi'esim la na mɔr na'asi kɛɛn o saam yin na.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: Yin la kpi'euŋ nɛ ba biis nɛ ba yaas wʋsa yɛla na ziil nɛ on, nwɛnɛ la'abibis nɛ la'abɛda ya'ae ba'a zug si'em la.

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb yɛl ya ye, “Saŋkan la ya'a ti paae, ba'akanɛ ka ba ba' zi'el kiŋ-kiŋ la na vuoɛn, ba na dam viki li, ka ziid linɛ ya'ae li zugin la na sʋʋgi li teŋin.” Zugsɔb la pian' li.

english_verse: This is a message from distant islands about the city of Tyre: Cry, you seagoing ships! Tyre and its houses lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Labakaŋa anɛ Taya yɛla. Tarsis dima, kaasimi! Yanam banɛ mɔr anrima ka ba bɛ ku'omin la ken lallisa kpiisid la. Kaasimi Taya san'auŋ la zug ka yir bɛɛ anrʋŋ zi'elʋg zin'ig lɛn kae. Labaar la yinɛ Saipuros teŋin na yɛli ba.

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Aaɛn baanlimm, yanam banɛ bɛɛ Atɛuk nɔɔrin la, nɛ yanam Sidon kpikpinkpinnib, ka banɛ kpiisid atɛukʋn la kɛ ka ya paam kpan'am la.

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: Siihor zʋʋd naan ku'otita'ar la suoya linɛ ka ba bʋn Nail kɔldaugin la yit na. Li wʋsa anɛ ya kuosim, ka ya lieb tɛɛns bɛdegʋ da'.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: Sidon teŋa, kɛl ka nyan kpɛn'ɛf, nɛ fʋn kanɛ aan atɛuk kpi'euŋ zin'ig la! Atɛuk la pian'adi tisidif ye, “Man nan zi' sa'ae bɛɛ du'aa. M nan zi' ugus biribis bɛɛ bipumisɛ.”

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: Lɔ'ɔŋim keŋ paae Tarsis, kaasimi, yanam banɛ bɛ ku'om nɔɔrin la.

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: Tempʋkanɛ da mɔr sumalisim la nwaa? Tempʋkanɛ da pin'il kʋdimin sa ka o nidib ken teŋ lalli mɛɛd ya' ka zin' ani la nwaa?

english_verse: its merchants were kings honored all over the world. Who planned to destroy Tyre?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ gban'e Taya yɛla anwa? Taya onɛ di'esid na'anam na'am la, ka o kpikpinkpinnib an na'abiis, ka o nimbanɛ kpiisid mɔr yʋ'ʋri gat dunia dim wʋsa la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la gban'e li, ye o sigis banɛ mɔr nyɛɛsim dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ la, nɛ banɛ kɛt ka ba mɔr yʋ'ʋri gat dunia dim wʋsa la.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Tarsis teŋ pu'aba, kuomini ya pɔɔd wʋʋ Egipt dimi kuod linɛ bɛ Nail kɔldaug nɔɔrin si'em la, bɔzugɔ ya kʋ lɛm mɔr zin'ikanɛ ka anrima na zi'enɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la tiɛn o nu'ugʋ kpa' atɛuk la, ka kɛ ka na'anam kirid. O tis nɔɔr Fonisia yɛla, ye ba san'am o kpi'euŋ zin'is la wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: O yɛl ye, “Sidon teŋa, fʋ sumalisim la naae ya! Fʋ yʋ'ʋn nyɛ mugusʋg! Duom lɔ'ɔŋ Atɛukʋ keŋ paae Saipuros teŋin, hali baa anina fʋ kʋ nyɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm”

english_verse: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Gɔsim Babilon teŋ dim la, ba lɛn ka' vɔɔnrɛ! Li anɛ Asiria dim la tʋmmi li, ka kɛ ka wɛog bʋnkɔnbid di'e zin'ig la. Ba da giligi li, ka maal datti dʋ zaŋguoma la san'ami ba kpi'euŋ zin'is la ka kɛ ka li lieb dabɔɔd.

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: Kaasimi, yanam Tarsis dim banɛ tʋm anrima tʋʋma la; ya kpɛn'ɛb zin'ig la san'am ya!

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: Fʋn onɛ an pu'agɔɔndir ka ba tami fʋ yɛllɛ, nɔkimi fʋ kɔn ka gilig tempʋʋg la wʋsa. Nwɛ'ɛm kɔn la sʋ'ʋŋa, ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma bɛdegʋ, ka ala ka ba na tiɛn fʋ yɛla.

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, nyɔɔd nɛ ligidi linɛ wʋsa ka o nyɛt la na anɛ Zugsɔb la din. O kʋ nɔki li su'a, ba na mɔr nyɔɔd na tis banɛ bɛ Zugsɔb tʋʋma ni la, ka diib nɛ fuud na bɛ bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Gɔsima, Zugsɔb la na san'am teŋgbauŋ la ka kɛ ka li dig zaalim. O na aansi li wʋsa ka nimbanɛ bɛ li pɔɔgin widig.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ la na san'am nyain ka li wʋsa lieb dabɔɔg, wʋʋ tanpi na kena nwɛ' gaad. Zugsɔb la pian' labakaŋa ka li sid na maal.

english_verse: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
translation_verse: Dunia nidib zan'as wada la nɛ, ba zan'as zi'ela la ka san'ami li, ka kɛ ka teŋ la an dian'ad. Ba san'am nɔnaar kanɛ maal ye li bɛ saŋa wʋsa la.

english_verse: The earth is under a curse; its people are dying out because of their sins.
translation_verse: Dinzug, Wina'am nɔpɔɔr na kanb teŋgbauŋ la, taal na bɛɛ li nidib la zugin. Dinzug, nimbanɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ la pɔɔgin kanb ya ka kpɛlim bi'ela.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Tiwanna la na kʋdig ka daam pɔ'ɔg, ka banɛ maan sumalisim la wʋsa na nyɔn.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Siyanwɛ'ɛdib la anɛ baanlimm, ka banɛ wa'adi maan tʋkpiidʋg la gu'oe; googi kanɛ maan sumalisim la fɔnnɛ ki'.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ lɛn nuud daam ka yʋ'ʋma, daam lieb nɛ tɔɔgʋ tis banɛ nuud la.

english_verse: Towns are crushed and in chaos; houses are locked tight.
translation_verse: Tempʋkanɛ san'am la kpɛlim nɛ dabɔɔd ka nidib kae, ka ba nɔk daadi kpa' puug yir wʋsa za'anɔɔr.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Suoraad la ni ba kaasidnɛ daam yɛla, di'ema la lieb nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, sumalisim bɔdig teŋgbauŋ la zugin.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Tempʋʋg la san'amnɛ ka dig zaalim, ba nwɛ' li za'anɔya la nwa'asi nwa'as.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba dʋ'ʋsidi ba kʋkɔya tansid nɛ sumalisim, ka banɛ bɛ ya-tuona la pian'ad Zugsɔb la paŋi an si'em.

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, yanam banɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ la zun'omi Zugsɔb la, dʋ'ʋsimi Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr, yanam banɛ bɛ tɛɛns banɛ ka atɛuk gilig la ni la.

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Dunia kpikpɛmis wʋsa na ti wʋm ka ba yʋ'ʋm ye, “Na'asi anɛ Pʋpielim Sɔb la din.” Amaa mam mɛ yɛl ye, “Yɛla paam, yɛla paam! Tɔɔg paam! Ziri sɔb la gbi'idim teŋgbi'idim ka teŋgbi'idim sɔb la gbi'id!”

english_verse: Terror, traps, and pits are waiting for everyone.
translation_verse: Bɛndig nɛ bʋmbɔk nɛ baŋ digi gur yanam banɛ bɛ dunia ni la!

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa nyɛ bɛndig la ka zɔ, o sɔb na keŋ li bʋmbɔkin la; onɛ wʋsa mɛ yi bʋmbɔkin la na, baŋ na gban'e o. Ku'osuoya linɛ bɛ agɔl la yɔ'ɔs ya, ka dunia ɛɛnbir dam.

english_verse: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
translation_verse: Teŋ la nwa'ae nɛ, teŋ la buak nɛ pʋdig, teŋ la wʋsa dammidnɛ.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ gɛridnɛ nwɛnɛ danuud, ka gbɛlisid wʋʋ laŋir ka sisi'em da'ad nɛ. On pʋ siakid la zug ka taal bɛɛ o zugin, ka li kɛ ka o na li ka kʋ lɛn duoe.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: Daakan la Zugsɔb la na namis paŋ dim banɛ bɛ agɔla saŋgbana ni, nɛ na'anam banɛ bɛ dunia zug la.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Ba na la'asi ba wʋʋ banɛ bɛ bʋlʋʋgin, ka ba kpɛn'ɛsi ba bʋmbɔkin nɛ, ba na yɔɔ ba sanrega ni ka tɛɛgi ba tʋba ka li yuug hali.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Nwadig la na su'ad o mɛŋ ka winnig la na zɔt nyan ka kʋ nie. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na di na'am zin' Zion zuorin nɛ Jerusalem pɔɔgin, ka kpɛɛmnam la na nyɛ ka baŋ o na'am paŋi an si'em.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ anɛ m Wina'am; m na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr ka wɔ'ɔgif. Fʋ maal linɛ dɔl suor nɛ yɛlmɛŋir, linɛ ka fʋ da pʋn dɛŋi gban'e li yɛla la, fʋ tʋmi li ka li an tʋʋmnyalima.

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka tempʋʋs nwa'ae ka li tampiga la dig kuda-kuda, tɛɛns banɛ an kpi'euŋ zin'is la lieb dabɔɔd. Tempʋkanɛ an saam kpi'euŋ zin'ig la lɛn kae, ba kʋ lɛm mɛɛ li ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Now strong and cruel nations will fear and honor you.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, nimbanɛ kpi'em la na na'asif, tempʋbanɛ nidibi an bugusnam la na tisif girima.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Fʋ anɛ nɔŋ dim la suak zin'ig, ka banɛ an fara dim kpɛn'ɛdi fʋ ma'asimin la. Yɛla ya'a ti paae ba, fʋ anɛ kpi'euŋ dɔkanɛ na lusi ba ka sisi'em kʋ paae baa, bɛɛ walʋsʋg daami baa. Bugusnam la mugusʋg nwɛnɛ sisi'etita'ari na da'adi nwɛ'ɛd zaŋguom nɛ,

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: bɛɛ nwɛnɛ pipirisin tʋʋlʋgʋ an si'em la. Fʋ kɛya ka saam banɛ maan tʋkpiidʋg la lɛbi fɔn. Wʋʋ saŋgbana na lus nintaŋ si'em la, bugusnam la yʋ'ʋma la ma'ae nɛ sillimm.

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Zuokaŋa ni ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na maal diib, dikanɛ an sʋm hali tis nidib wʋsa; ni'im nɛ daam kanɛ malis hali.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: O na vɔl Akum san'am o paŋ ka kum kʋ lɛm bɛɛ. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋ Sɔb la na duus ninta'am sɔ' wʋsa nindaan, o na yis o nidib wʋsa nyan pɔɔgin, dunia ni wʋsa. Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: At that time, people will say, “The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.”
translation_verse: Daakan la ba na yɛl ye, “Sida ti Wina'am la nwa'; ti gur o ka o faaɛn ti. Zugsɔb kaŋa ka ti niŋ o yadda, kɛlli ka ti maal sumalisim o faangir la zug.”

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la paŋ na bɛ zuokaŋa zug; amaa ba na nɔ Moab dim la lɛbis teŋin wʋʋ sa'ad ka ba nɔɔdi kpɛn'ɛsid bugulimin si'em la.

english_verse: They will struggle to get out, but God will humiliate them no matter how hard they try.
translation_verse: Moab dim la na yadigi ba nu'us wʋʋ onɛ lugid ku'om yadigid o nu'us si'em la. Wina'am na sigisi ba nyɛɛsim la teŋin la'an nɛ ban mɔɔd nɛ nimmua si'em la.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: O na nwa'ae ya zaŋguom kpi'ema la, o na sigisi li wʋsa digil teŋin ka li lieb titan.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: Daakan la ba na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋm kaŋa Juda teŋin: Ti mɔr tempʋkanɛ kpi'em! Wina'am maal faangiri tisi ti wʋʋ zaŋguoma linɛ mɔr paŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Yɔ'ɔgim za'anɔɔri tis buudkanɛ an pʋpielim dim la ka ba kpɛn', buudbanɛ an yadda dim la.

english_verse: The Lord gives perfect peace to those whose faith is firm.
translation_verse: Fʋ na kɛ ka sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛ nɛ onɛ yadda niŋiri zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ la bɔzugɔ, on niŋif yadda sʋ'ʋŋa la zug.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Niŋim Zugsɔb la yadda saŋa wʋsa, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la an tampiing kanɛ bɛ saŋa kanɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
translation_verse: O sigis banɛ dʋ'ʋsi ba mɛŋ la, ka nwɛ' tempʋkanɛ zi'e agɔla la sigis teŋin; o da'ae li bas ka li naalim nɛ titan.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Ba nɔɔ li nɛ nɔba digil teŋin. Banɛ ka ba daa mugusidi ba la nɔɔ li, nɔŋ dim la nɔɔ li nɛ ba nɔba.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim dim la suor anɛ sassi; Fʋn kanɛ an burikin la kɛya ka pʋpielim dim suor an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Ɛɛn, Zugsɔba, ti dɔlli fʋ wada la suor ka gu'usidif, fʋ yʋ'ʋr la an sʋm hali, ka ti ya'am bɔɔd.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa m ya'amlɛog bɛ nɛ fʋ san'an, ka m siig ieedi fʋ zin'ig bɛkɛung wʋsa. Fʋ sida pian'adi nie dunia ni la, dunia nidib baŋi fʋ pʋpielim an si'em.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ fʋn maal suguru tis bugusnam la ba pʋ zamis pʋpielim ya'am. Hali la'an nɛ yɛlsida dim teŋin, ba nan kpɛn tʋmnɛ bɛ'ɛd ka ba ba'a ka' nɛ Zugsɔb la paŋi an si'em la.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ paŋ la zu'oya amaa ba pʋ nyɛti li. Kɛl ka ba nyɛ fʋn bɔɔdi fʋ nidib la yɛla si'em ka nyan dii ba; kɛl ka bugum kanɛ ka fʋ maali guri fʋ bi'emnam la dii ba.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ kɛya ka ti zin' nɛ sumalisim, ka tinamɛ maal si'el la wʋsa, fʋnɛ tʋmi li tisi ti.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am, winsieba da sʋ'oe ti, amaa fʋ ma'aa ka tinam na'asid.

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: Ba kpiya, ba pʋ lɛn vʋe yaa, banɛ kpii gaad la kʋ lɛn duoe ya'asɛ. Fʋ namisi ba ka kɛ ka ba paam san'auŋ, fʋ uusi ba ka sɔ' pʋ lɛn tɛnri ba yɛla ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ yalig buudi la, ɛɛn, fʋ sid yalig buudi la. Fʋ yalig teŋ la titɔndis ka dinzug ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr paam girima.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋn namisi fʋ nidib la, ba kɛɛn fʋ san'an na nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, ka nya'am nɛ winsɔsʋg.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, nwɛnɛ pu'a na sa'ae bɔɔd du'ab ka li zabid ka o nwɛɛn ka kaasid si'em la, ala ka ti daa bɛɛ fʋ tuon.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Ti daa mɔri pʋʋg, ka li zabid ka ti nwɛɛn, amaa ti du'anɛ zaalim. Ti pʋ tis dunia la faangirɛ; ti pʋ nyaŋi du'a biisi tis dunia la.

english_verse: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
translation_verse: Amaa ya nimbanɛ kpi la na vʋ'ʋg; ba niŋgbina la na vʋ'ʋgi yi kumin. Yanam banɛ dig yaʋgʋn la, duom tansi ka yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim, bɔzugɔ ya yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ bɛogʋn mɛligim nɛ, teŋ la na duos banɛ kpii bɛɛ o ni la wʋsa.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: M nidiba kpɛn'ɛminɛ ya dɔɔdin ka yɔ' dalamma la lɛbis; Su'amini ya mɛŋ bi'ela, hali ka o sʋnpɛɛn la ti gaad.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, Zugsɔb la yii o bɛllim zin'igi kenna ye o namis dunia nidib, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug. Teŋ la na yis banɛ ka ba kʋʋ ba dʋ'ʋs na, o kʋ lɛn su'a banɛ ka ba kʋʋ ba la.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
