translation_verse: Daakan la Zugsɔb la na zaŋi o zaba sʋ'ʋg kanɛ san'amid nidib la; linɛ zu'oe hali ka kʋʋd nidib ka dabiem bɛ la. O na namis wa'akanɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Lɛviatan, ka o ian'ad ka nwɛɛlim o mɛŋ hali la, Zugsɔb la na kʋʋ atɛukʋn bʋnyua la.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Daakan la, yʋ'ʋmmi tiwanna pɔɔg linɛ wan sʋ'ʋŋa la yɛla.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: Mam kanɛ an Zugsɔb la guri li, ka dɔn'ɔsidi li saŋa wʋsa. M guri li yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi daami lii.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: M sʋnf pʋ pɛligɛ, baa gauŋ nɛ gɔn'ɔs ya'a daamidim, m na zabi vɔɔn li ka li kpi, ka nyu'oe li wʋsa bugum.

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' ala kɛl ka ba kɛɛn m san'an na su'a. Kɛl ka ba mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ mam, sida kɛl ka ba mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ mam.

english_verse: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
translation_verse: Dabisa kenna ka Jakob na ba'a nya'a, Israel na tɔn wila ka pu puum ka kɛ ka dunia la pɛ'ɛl nɛ li wala.

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nwɛ' o wʋʋ on nwɛ' banɛ daa nwɛ' o laa? O kʋʋ o wʋʋ banɛ daa kʋʋ o ka o kʋʋ ba si'em laa?

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka ba na kɛ Jakob yidim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas, ka ban na niŋ si'em nwa' ka di pa'al ye ba yisi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas: ba na yis kuga banɛ bɛ bimbima la ni nwa'ae ba ka nɛɛmi li bugusi bugus; ka Asera teŋgban daad kʋ lɛm bɛɛ, nɛ bimbim banɛ ka ba nyu'od bʋnnyubisa li zugʋ tisid wina la.

english_verse: Fortress cities are left like a desert where no one lives. Cattle walk through the ruins, stripping the trees bare.
translation_verse: Tempʋkanɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ la lieb dabɔɔg, zin'ikanɛ ka nidib daa zin' la yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ sian'anr nɛ. Ani ka niigi ɔnbid ka digi; ka fanrisi li vaand la wʋsa.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Wil banɛ mɔr vanmɛna la ya'a kʋdig, li na kɔ'ɔgi li ka pu'ab kena pi'isi nyu'oe bugum. Nimbama pʋ gban'ad pian'ad gbinnɛ; alazug, onɛ maali ba la pʋ zɔti ba nimbaanlig bɛɛ o mɔri ba nyɔɔgɔ.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Li saŋa ya'a ti paae, lin yi Efiritis kɔldaugʋ pʋbidi yit zin'isi'a la ti paae kɔlbil linɛ bɛ Egipt teŋ titɔndigin la, Zugsɔb la na wɛlig o nidibi yis wʋʋ ki ka ba bʋ'ʋdi yɛligid si'em la, amaa yanam Israel dima, Zugsɔb la na la'asi ya yinne-yinne.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Li daar ya'a paae, ba na pieb na'atantita'ar, ka banɛ bɛ Asiria bɔɔd bɔdigir la, nɛ banɛ da zɔɔ keŋ Egipt la, na lɛb na zun'e Zugsɔb la Jerusalem zuokanɛ an kasi la ni.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Tɔɔg na paae Efiram dim banɛ nuud daam kʋʋn ka mɔr nyɛɛsim hali la! Ba puum vɛnl hali ka bɛ bɔn'ɔg kanɛ mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm la ni, amaa li ziankid nɛ ka li vɛnlim bɔdigid. Tempʋʋg kan la ni banɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ la, daam lɛbisi ba teŋin!

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, Zugsɔb la na tʋm onɛ mɔr paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ na. O nwɛnɛ sakuga nɛ sisi'etita'ar kanɛ san'am la'ad nɛ. O nwɛnɛ satita'ari na ni ka ku'om kpɛn' kɔlisi badig ka pʋbid teŋin nɛ paŋ si'em la.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: La'avɛnla linɛ ka Efiram danuudib mɔri nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg la, ba na nɔɔ ba nɛ nɔba.

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: Teŋ la bɛ nɛ bɔn'ɔg kanɛ mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm la ni, amaa li vɛnlim la na bɔdig wʋʋ puum nɛ. Ba na zii li tɔ'ɔtɔ gaad nwɛnɛ kekandeenna na bi'ig ka ba pun'oe li tɔ'ɔtɔ di si'em la.

english_verse: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
translation_verse: Li daar ya'a paae Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na an na'atita'ar, ka nwɛnɛ na'am zupibig dinɛ vɛnl hali tis o nimbanɛ kpɛlim la.

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: O na kɛ ka o siig bɛ sariakatib la ni ka ba pian'ad linɛ an sida, ka tis banɛ gur za'anɔɔr la kpi'euŋ ka ba nyaŋ banɛ ye ba kpɛn' zab nɛ ba la.

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: Ka ban dit si'el zug la wʋsa pɛ'ɛl nɛ tiind, zin'isi'a pʋ kpɛlim an nyain ka dian'ad kae.

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: O yɛti ti ye, ‘Niŋimi nɛ anwa ka niŋ anwa, dɔlli zi'elkaŋa ka dɔl zi'elkaŋa, niŋim dina bi'ela ka niŋ kpɛ' bi'ela.’”

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Alazug, Wina'am na zaŋ nimbanɛ an saam nɛ banɛ pian'ad pian'azʋna la, kɛ ka ba pian' tis nimbama.

english_verse: Now his message to you will be senseless sound after senseless sound. Then you will fall backwards, injured and trapped. False Security Is Fatal
translation_verse: Dinzug, Zugsɔb labaar la na lieb nɛ zaalim tisi ba: Wʋʋ ban yɛt si'em ye, “Niŋimi nɛ anwa ka niŋ anwa, dɔlli zi'elkaŋa ka dɔl zi'elkaŋa, niŋim dina bi'ela ka niŋ kpɛ' bi'ela.” Ala ka ba na lɛb nya'aŋi lii pu'alim, ka baŋ kanɛ bɛnd la gban'e ba.

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, kɛlisimi Zugsɔb labaar, yanam banɛ an ninla'asnam la, yanam banɛ sʋ'oe nimbanɛ bɛ Jerusalem la.

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Ya dʋ'ʋsidi ya mɛŋ ka yɛt ye, “Tinam maal nɔɔr yinne nɛ kum, ka naal nɔɔr nɛ yaʋg. Ban'as nɛ yɛltɔɔd ya'a kena li kʋ niŋi ti si'ela, bɔzugɔ tinam nɔknɛ faadi su'a ti mɛŋ, hali dama'am aan ti suak zin'ig.”

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: Alazug ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Gɔsima, m digil kugir Zion teŋin, kugir kanɛ ka ba maki li ka li an bʋnsʋŋ hali, linɛ na ɛɛnb ɛɛnbir kanɛ mɔr paŋ: onɛ niŋ yadda kʋ di nyannɛ.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will be the measuring lines that help me build.” Hailstones and floods will destroy and wash away your shelter of lies.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka yɛlsida an wʋʋ nwiig dinɛ ka m mɔri makid la, ka pʋpielim an wʋʋ nwiig dinɛ ka tanmɛɛdib mɔri makidi mɛɛd la; saa nɛ sakuga na udigi ya suak linɛ an faad la keŋ, ku'om na gɛɛl zin'ikanɛ ka ya su'ad la.

english_verse: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
translation_verse: M na san'am nɔnaar kanɛ ka ya maal nɛ kum la, yanamɛ naal nɔɔr nɛ yaʋg si'em la, li kʋ nyaŋi zi'enɛ, ban'as nɛ tɔɔg ya'a ti gɛɛli ya, li na mɔri ya keŋ.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: Lin kɛn saŋsi'a wʋsa na, li na mɔri ya keŋ, li ya'a anɛ bɛogʋn bɛɛ nintaŋ bɛɛ yʋ'ʋŋɔ, li na mɔri ya keŋ.” Ya ya'a gban'e labakaŋa gbin, asida li na kpɛn'ɛsi ya dabiem pamm.

english_verse: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na duoe wʋʋ on da duoe Perazim Zuorin si'em la, ka bʋʋgi ba wʋʋ on da bʋʋg o bi'emnam Gibeon Bɔn'ɔgin si'em la. O na tʋm tʋʋm kanɛ an tʋʋm saaŋ la, o na tʋm linɛ na lidigi ba.

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: Basimini ya ninla'asim la, ya'a ka' alaa baans banɛ lɔɔ ya la na muki ya gaad ala. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛlim ka m baŋ on gban'e ye o san'am teŋ la wʋsa si'em.

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi ka wʋmi m, kɛlisim man yɛt si'el la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: O ya'a ti bug o pɔɔg la ka maali bʋ'ʋsi naae, ka' nyiri ka o na bʋd ka li'is sɔ'ɔdɛ? Ka o ya'a ti naae, o kʋ bʋd ki li kɔn' ka bʋd mui li kɔn'ɔɔ?

english_verse: They learn this from their God.
translation_verse: Wina'am pa'an kpaad la ka zamisid o linɛ dɔl suor.

english_verse: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ bʋ'ʋd nyiri nɛ balayaa, ba pɔn'ɔnɛ ka li pun'oe ka ba pie; ba mɛ pʋ bʋ'ʋd sɔ'ɔd nɛ balayaa, ba kpa'asidnɛ.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Ba nɛ'ɛm zʋʋd la nɛ maan diib, ka ba pʋ bʋ'ʋd ka li ti lieb zɔ'ɔm. Hali baa o ya'a nɔk bʋŋ nɛ tɛreko nɔɔ li si'em, li kʋ maligin kilim zɔ'ɔm.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Nɛ' wʋsa yinɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la ni na, li anɛ sa'al kanɛ an nyalima nɛ ya'am kanɛ an sʋm hali.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Woo, tɔɔg na paae fʋn Ariel, linɛ an teŋ kanɛ ka David da zin' la! Kpɛn ken tuonnɛ paasid malima nɛ di'ema banɛ ka fʋ maan yʋʋm-yʋʋm la!

english_verse: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka sʋnsan'aŋ sig Ariel teŋin na ka o kaasid ka fabin. O sid na lieb nwɛnɛ bam buon o ye malʋŋ bimbim kanɛ ka ba nyu'od maannɛ li zug la.

english_verse: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.
translation_verse: Fʋ na lu teŋin, ka digi pian'adi bɛbin, ka yit teŋin na wʋʋ silinsiiug nɛ; fʋ na dig teŋin ka pian'adi nya'am.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na kena nɛ satansʋg, ka teŋ na mi'im ka tʋkpiidʋg bɛ, nɛ sisi'etita'ar. O na kena nɛ sʋnpɛɛn nɛ bugum kanɛ dit ka pʋ basid si'el baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.
translation_verse: Ani ka bi'emnam banɛ yi tɛɛns nɛ buudi wʋsa na zabid nɛ Ariel linɛ an Jerusalem la na la'asi giligi ba kpi'euŋ zin'ig la, amaa ba na gaad tɔ'ɔtɔ nwɛnɛ nidi na zaansim yʋ'ʋŋ si'em la.

english_verse: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
translation_verse: Li na lidigi ya ka paki ya, ya na nwɛnɛ zu'om ka pʋ nyɛtaa. Ya kʋʋli ken ka pʋ nu daam, kennɛ tu'usid ka li ka'anɛ daam yɛllɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kɛ ka gbɛɛm lii ya zugin. O ligil nɔdi'esidib la nini, ka lus banɛ nyɛti tu'asid Wina'am yɛla la zut.

english_verse: Now his message is like a sealed letter to you. Some of you say, “We can't read it, because it's sealed.”
translation_verse: Nier linɛ tisid nɔdi'esidib la na nwɛnɛ gbauŋ kanɛ ka ba kpilim ka tabili li, ka fʋ ya'a nɔki tis onɛ mi' karʋŋ ye, “Di'em karim,” o na lɛbis ye, “M kʋ nyaŋɛ bɔzugɔ, ba tabili li nɛ.”

english_verse: Others say, “We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.”
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a lɛn nɔk gbauŋ la tis onɛ zi' karʋŋɔ, ka yɛl o ye, “Di'em karim,” o na lɛbis ye, “Ayei! Man zi' karʋŋɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Nimbama kennɛ m san'an na nɛ ba nɔɔr pian'ad ka na'asidim nɛ ba nɔŋgbana, amaa ka ba sʋnya lal nɛ mam hali. Ban zun'od mam si'em la pʋ yii ba sʋʋnrin naa, li anɛ zi'ela linɛ ka nidib pa'ali ba gʋllim.

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m na kɛ ka yɛl nyalima paadi ya ka yɛlpakir na paadi ya yinne-yinne; ya'am dim la ya'am na bɔdig, ka mi'ilim dim mi'ilim mɛlim.”

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Tɔɔg na paae banɛ sig bʋmbu'azulima ni ye ba su'a ka Zugsɔb da baŋ ban gban'e si'ela, nɛ banɛ tʋm likin ka tɛn'ɛsid ye, “Anɔ'ɔnɛ nyɛ? Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ baŋɛ?”

english_verse: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
translation_verse: Ya tulis si'elnam tutula, ka tɛn'ɛsid ye onɛ ya'abid la nwɛnɛ ya'adɛ! Sɔ' nan mi' maal si'el ka li bʋn yɛl onɛ maali li la ye, “Ka' fʋnɛ maali ma”? Dʋk na yɛl onɛ ya'ab o la ye, “O zi' si'elaa”?

english_verse: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
translation_verse: Li kʋ yuugɛ, Lebanon kʋ lɛm mɔr tititada ka li na anɛ wʋʋ lɔmbɔn'ɔg; ka zin'ikanɛ daa an lɔmbɔn'ɔd la na an tisʋma zin'ig wʋsa.

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Li daar ya'a ti paae, tʋbkpida na wʋm ka ba karim gbauŋʋ tisi ba, ka zʋnzɔɔs banɛ bɛ likin biridi la na nyɛt.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Tadimnam la na lɛm mɔr sumalisim Zugsɔb la tuon, banɛ an nɔŋ dim la na maal sumalisim ka li anɛ Israel Dim Wina'am Onɛ an Kasi la zug.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Banɛ mugusidi ba taaba la na bɔdig, ka banɛ an ninla'asnam la mɛlim, ka nimbanɛ ka ba ya'am kpɛn' nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la kʋ lɛm bɛɛ.

english_verse: together with everyone who tells lies in court and keeps innocent people from getting a fair trial.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ banɛ pian'adi kɛt ka nidib kɔ'ɔŋid bʋʋd, ka bɛnt banɛ tu'ad sida kɔɔtʋ ni la baans, ka dit ziri kasɛti mɔŋ banɛ mɔr sida la bʋʋd la; ba wʋsa na ba'as bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka Zugsɔb, onɛ da faaɛn Abraham la, yɛl Jakob yidim ye, “Nyan kʋ lɛm gban'e ya ka kɛ ka ya lɔɔdi ya nindaasɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
translation_verse: Banɛ an kalinka'ad siigin la yʋ'ʋn na gban'e li gbin, ka banɛ nyɔn hali la mɛ siak sa'alʋg.”

english_verse: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Tɔɔg na paae m nimbanɛ pʋ tiakid la, banɛ gban'adi ba mɛŋ gban'ar ka li ka' man din la, ka maan nɔɔr yinne nɛ ninsieba amaa ka li pʋ dɔlnɛ m siig bɔɔdim la. Ala ka ba tʋmid bɛ'ɛdi paasid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug la.

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Ba ken Egipt ka pʋ bɔɔdi m nɔɔr yɛlʋgɔ, ba zɔti ken Na'ab Faaro san'an ye o guri ba, ka yɛt ye ba na kpɛn' Egipt dim ma'asimin.

english_verse: “You will be disappointed, completely disgraced for trusting Egypt.
translation_verse: Amaa Faaro san'an suak la na anɛ nyannɛ tisi ba, Egipt dim ma'asim la na diisi ba nyan.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ba tuongatibi bɛ Zoan teŋin ka banɛ zi'e ba teŋ yɛla paae Hanes teŋin la,

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Labakaŋa anɛ Negef bʋnkɔnbid la yɛla. “Ba mɔri bʋmis nɛ yʋgʋma ziidi ba kpan'am dɔl suokanɛ dɔllim tɔi; ka gbigima buudi wʋsa zu'oe ani ka wa'abɛ'ɛdnam banɛ ian'ad agɔla galis ani.

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Ba keŋ paad Egipt n bɔɔd sʋŋir zin'ikanɛ ka sʋŋir kae. Dinzug ka m buon Egipt ye, ‘Rahab, Bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og onɛ ka' tʋmmirɛ.’”

english_verse: The Lord told me to write down his message for his people, so that it would be there forever.
translation_verse: Kem sɔb bʋn bama dalammirin tisi ba, sɔm niŋ gbauŋʋn ka ba na nɔki li zi'eli tis bɛog sa dim la ka li na an kasɛt saŋa wʋsa tisi ba.

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Bama anɛ banɛ tʋba pʋ wʋmma, bibanɛ an ziri dim, bibanɛ pʋ siakid ye ba kɛlis Zugsɔb la nɔɔr yɛlʋgɔ.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: Ba yɛt banɛ nyɛt bɛog sa yɛla la ye, “Da lɛn nyɛti nier linɛ an bɛog yɛllɛ!” Ka yɛt nɔdi'esidib ye, “Da lɛn yɛli ti linɛ dɔl suorɛ! Yɛlimi ti linɛ na malisi ti, yɛlimi ti ya mɛŋ pʋtɛn'ɛr.

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Basimi suokaŋa, tɔɔmi suokan ni, da lɛn tu'asidi ti Israel Dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la yɛlaa.”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Israel Dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la yɛl ye, “Yanamɛ sadigim zan'as labakaŋa ka dɔl linɛ an mugusʋg nɛ ziri la,

english_verse: This sin is like a crack that makes a high wall quickly crumble
translation_verse: li bɛ'ɛd nwɛnɛ zaŋguom kanɛ wa'am ka mugilim tansi paae teŋin, ka li na kpɛn lu vuguri.

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Li na nwa'ae nwɛnɛ dʋk bɛɛ yʋʋr nɛ; li na nwa'ae yaam-yaam, ka ba kʋ nyaŋi nyɛ li yaama baa yinne ka li siak ban na nɔki li mu'oe bugum, bɛɛ ba nɔki li kabig ku'om buliginɛ.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb ka an Israel Dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la yɛl ye, “Viigimini ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka nyɛ faangir ka vʋ'ʋs, ya ya'a an baanlimm ka niŋ yadda linɛ na aan ya paŋ, amaa ka ya zan'as ka pʋ siak ye ya tʋmmi lii.

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Ba nid yinne na kad nidib tusir, ka nidiba anu kadi ya wʋsa, hali ka ya ti kpɛlim bi'ela nwɛnɛ tuuta bɛ li kɔn' zuor zug, bɛɛ pien ka ba lɔɔ li kʋkʋn zug.”

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala Zugsɔb la bɔɔd ye o pa'ali ya pʋpielim, o gban'e ya ye o pa'ali ya o nimbaanlzɔɔr. Zugsɔb la anɛ yɛlsida sɔb. Banɛ wʋsa gu'usid Zugsɔb la tuon na paam albareka!

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: Zion nidibaa, yanam banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la, ya kʋ lɛn kum ya'asɛ. Ya ya'a ti kaasi bɔɔd suor, o anɛ pʋpielim sɔb ka na sʋŋi ya. O ya'a ti wʋm ka ya kaasi buol o, o na siak.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ Zugsɔb la na mɔri ya dɔlis tɔɔg nɛ mugusʋg pɔɔgin la, ya pa'annib la kʋ lɛn su'adi ba mɛŋ ya'asɛ, ya na nyɛ ba nɛ ya nini.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: Ya ya'a fɛndig datiuŋ bɛɛ dagɔbʋg, ya tʋba na wʋm ka li pian'adi ya nya'aŋi yɛti ya ye, “Suori nwa', dɔlli li!”

english_verse: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.
translation_verse: Ya na san'ami ya bada banɛ ka ya buligi li nɛ anzurifa nɛ sanlima, ka nɔki li lɔbi bas nwɛnɛ pu'a pier kparikɛɛung nɛ, ka yɛl ye kem sa!

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ bʋd si'el teŋin la wʋsa o na kɛ ka saa nii li zug, ka dikanɛ na yi teŋin la na zu'oe ka mɔr tɛbisim. Saŋkan la ya bʋnkɔnbid na nyɛ yam sʋma ɔnb.

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: Hali niigi nɛ bʋmis banɛ ka ya mɔri ba tʋm la na ɔnb yamkpi'emis ka mu'a dʋʋsa nɛ bisi.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Daakanɛ ka ya na ti nyaŋi ya bi'emnam ka kʋʋ ba la, ba zin'ikpi'ema na li, ka ku'om na pʋbid zuotitada nɛ kʋkʋna zugʋ sigid na.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Nwadig la na nie nwɛnɛ winnig nɛ, ka winnig la nie gaad ala nɔɔr ayɔpɔi, li na nwɛnɛ daba ayɔpɔi nɛɛsim ka ba la'asi li dabisir yinne. Saŋkan la, Zugsɔb la na vil fɛn'ɛd linɛ bɛɛ o nidib niŋgbiŋin la nɛ piena, ka ma'ae sapu'ad linɛ ka o kɛ ka ba paam la.

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Gɔsima! Zugsɔb la naanɛ lalli kenna, ka o sʋnf pɛlig nwɛnɛ bugum dit nɛ, ka nyɔ'ɔs duoe gilig o. O nɔɔr pian'ad pɛ'ɛl nɛ sʋnpɛɛn ka diti nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: O ya'a vʋ'ʋs, li nwɛnɛ ku'om linɛ pɛ'ɛl kɔlʋg ka paad nidib kʋkɔya bɛn. O mɔr gu'odiŋ linɛ an san'auŋ la gu'osid tɛɛns wʋsa, ka nɔk salibiri li'a nidib nɔya mɔri ba ken san'auŋ zin'ig.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Ya na yʋ'ʋm nwɛnɛ yʋ'ʋŋ kanɛ ka ya maan di'ema tiɛnd Wina'am malʋŋ la yɛla la, ka ya sʋnya na malis nwɛnɛ nidibi na piebid na'akpa'as ka ken ye ba maal sumalisim Zugsɔb zuor zug, Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Tampiingin la.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka nidib wʋm o pian'ad linɛ mɔr paŋ la, ka ba nyɛɛ o nu'ug ka li sigid na nwɛnɛ bugum ka dit nɛ sʋnpɛɛn kanbidi kenna, ka saŋgbana tansid nɛ sisi'em nɛ satansʋg nɛ sakuga.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na widig Asiria dim; o na bʋ' ba nɛ o balaar la.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ya'a bʋ' ba nɛ balaar, o nidib na yʋ'ʋmmi nwɛ'ɛd siyada nɛ kɔna, ka o zabid nɛ ba zabbɔn'ɔgin ka nwɛ'ɛdi ba nɛ kpisinkpila nɛ o mɛŋ nu'ug.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Ba pʋn ti'eb Tofet nɛ gur, ba ti'ebi li nɛ gur na'ab la. Li bugum bʋmbɔk la zulimnɛ ka yalim, ka bugum nɛ daad dinɛ bɛɛ ani la zu'oe; Zugsɔb la vʋ'ʋsʋm, dinɛ nwɛnɛ kidibir bugum la, na nyu'oe li.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Tɔɔg na paae banɛ ken Egipt n bɔɔd sʋŋir, ka ti'e ba widi la ban zu'oe la zug, ka niŋ yadda nɛ ba zaba tɛrekonam nɛ ba wiedban'adib la ban mɔr paŋ la zug, amaa ka lɛɛ pʋ gɔsid Israel Dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi, bɛɛ bɔɔd sʋŋir Zugsɔb la san'anɛ.

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala o ya'am zu'oya ka o na nyaŋi mɔr namisʋg na, o ya'a pian' si'el o pʋ lɛbid nya'aŋa. O na duoe zab nɛ banɛ an bugusnam la, nɛ banɛ sʋŋid bugusim dim la.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Amaa Egipt dim la anɛ saalib ka ba ka' Wina'am; ba widi la anɛ niŋgbina ma'aa ka ba ka' siisɛ. Zugsɔb la ya'a ti tiɛn o nu'ug, onɛ sʋŋid la na tu'ug, ka onɛ ka ba sʋŋid la mɛ li, babayi' la na la'asi bɔdig.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim si'eli nwa': “Nwɛnɛ gbigimi nwa'am si'em la, gbigimtita'ar ya'a gban'e bʋnkɔnbʋg ye o ɔnb, kɔnbkemnib ya'a kaas kuŋʋ la'asi gilig o si'em li kʋ kɛ ka dabiem kpɛn' gbigim la bɛɛ tʋkpiidʋg la daam o. Ala ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na sig na zi'en Zion zuor kʋkʋn la zuginɛ zab.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ bʋn-ian'ada ɛɛnti yadig kpʋkpama laan agɔl si'em la, ala ka Zugsɔb la na an gbanti'edʋgʋ tis Jerusalem. O na guri li sʋ'ʋŋa, ka sʋŋi li ka faaɛn li.”

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel dima, ya pɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb la ka zan'as o, amaa lɛmmini o san'an.

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Dabiskan la daar ya'a ti paae, ya yinne-yinne na zan'as anzurifa nɛ sanlima bada banɛ ka ya nɔki ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nu'usi maal la.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: “Asiria dim na kpi zaba ni, amaa li ka'anɛ ninsaali na kʋʋ ba. San'auŋ na paae ba zaba ni ka li ka' ninsaalib paŋa. Zaba la na kɛ ka ba zɔɔ widig ka ba na'akim na tʋm yammis tʋʋma.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Dabiem na kɛ ka ba zin'ikpi'ema la li, dabiem mɛ na kpɛn' ba zaba tuongatib la zabbɔn'ɔgin.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la, on onɛ ka o bugum bɛ Zion teŋin, ka li nyu'or zin'ig bɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa na nwɛnɛ dɔɔg linɛ lus sisi'em lɛbis ka nwɛnɛ zin'ikanɛ ka nid na su'a ka pɛbisʋg kʋ paae o. Ba na nwɛnɛ ku'osuor linɛ pʋbidi ken pipiris zin'ig, ka nwɛnɛ tampintita'akanɛ bɛ zin'ikanɛ ka ku'om kae.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Ala ka banɛ nini nyɛt la na ken ka kʋ umi ba nini, ka banɛ tʋba wʋm la na kɛlis sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Banɛ tʋm nɛ kikirʋg la na lieb banɛ gban'ad yɛla gbin, ka gik bɛɛ bidʋg zilim na lak ka o pian'ad nyain-nyain.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ lɛm buon zɔlʋg ye burikin, bɛɛ ba buol ninyaalig ye na'asi sɔba.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋg na pian'ad o zɔlim pian'ad paalʋ, o pʋtɛn'ɛri pɛ'ɛl nɛ bɛ'ɛd la zug. O tʋʋma anɛ linɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suorɛ, ka o pian'ad pian'abɛ'ɛdi yadigid Zugsɔb la yɛla. O pʋ sʋŋid kɔ'ɔm dima, ka mɔŋ banɛ ka ku'onuud mɔri ba la ku'om.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Yalim la suoya anɛ bugusim suoya, ka o gban'ar wʋsa an bɛ'ɛd. O mɔɔd ye o san'am nɔŋ dim nɛ ziri pian'ad, hali baa nɔŋdaan ya'a mɔr sidaa.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amaa burikin gban'ar anɛ burikinnim, ka o zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ o tʋʋm sʋma yɛla. Jerusalem pu'ab

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Lin yi nannanna ken li kʋ paae yʋʋmmɛ ka yanam banɛ tɛn'ɛs ye si'el pʋ daamidi ya la na kirid, ya bʋnwanna la kʋ walɛ, ya kʋ nyɛ wala la pɔn'ɔɔ.

english_verse: Shake and shudder, you women without a care! Strip off your clothes— put on sackcloth.
translation_verse: Kirimi nɛ dabiem, yanam pu'a banɛ zin' ka li malisi ya la. Sɔn'ɔsimini ya fuud ka sɔɔn'e bɔto fuud!

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Bibigimi ya nyɔ'ɔg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, pɔɔd banɛ mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm nɛ bʋnwanna pɔɔd la yɛla,

english_verse: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ m nidib la bɛ zin'isi'a la liebnɛ gauŋ nɛ gɔn'ɔs. Kummi ya' banɛ ka ya daa mɔr sumalisim nɛ tempʋkanɛ ka ya daa nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg la yɛla.

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Ba na zɔ ka basi ba ya' sʋma la; tempʋkanɛ ka nidib daa pɛ'ɛl la, sɔ' kʋ lɛm bɛɛ li nii. Tempʋkpi'ema la nɛ dɔwɔk linɛ ka ba daa bɛɛ ani gur teŋ la, nidib kʋ lɛm bɛɛ ani. Sian'arin bʋmis na bɛ ani maan sumalisim, ka li na anɛ yam sʋma zin'igi tis kɔnbid.

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: Li na anɛ ala ti paae Wina'am na ti kpa'ae o siig la sigis na. Ani ka pipiris la na lieb kʋ'ʋlʋm zin'ig, ka zin'ikanɛ mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm la lieb sian'anr linɛ mɔr tiis.

english_verse: Honesty and justice will prosper there,
translation_verse: Yɛlsida na zin'in pipirisin ka pʋpielim na bɛ zin'ibanɛ mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm la.

english_verse: and justice will produce lasting peace and security.
translation_verse: Pʋpielim nyɔɔd anɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm, ka mɛ kɛt ka ti bɛ baanlimm ka mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: even if hailstones flatten forests and cities.
translation_verse: Hali baa sakuga ya'a lii san'am sian'anr la wʋsa, ka tempʋʋg la lieb dabɔɔg,

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: la'an nɛ wala, albareka na bɛnɛ ya; ya na bʋti ya bʋmbʋta kɔlis nɔɔrin, ka ya niigi nɛ bʋmis na gɔɔndi ba ya'amin.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Tɔɔg na paae fʋn kanɛ an san'auŋ sɔb la, hali baa bam pʋ san'amif la! Tɔɔg na paae fʋn kanɛ an zam sɔb la hali baa bam pʋ zammif la! Fʋ ya'a bas san'auŋ, ba na san'amif; fʋ ya'a bas zammʋg, ba na zammif.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, zɔmi ti nimbaanlig, ti ti'ir bɛ nɛ fʋ ni. Fʋnɛ tisidi ti paŋ daar wʋsa, yɛla ya'a ti paae ti, fʋn faanmi ti.

english_verse: Nations scatter when you roar and show your greatness.
translation_verse: Nidib ya'a wʋmi fʋ tansʋg, ba zɔtnɛ; fʋ ya'a duoe, buudi wʋsa widigidnɛ.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye, Ya la'abanɛ ka ya fan' la, nidib na dii li nwɛnɛ na'azɔm baanlʋgʋ fanrisid vaand si'em la, nwɛnɛ na'azɔmnam bɛdegʋ na ian'adi ba zugin nɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: Ba na dʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, on bɛɛ agɔla la zug. O kɛ ka sida nɛ pʋpielim pɛ'ɛl Zion tempʋʋg la.

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: Onɛ na aan ya ɛɛnbir saŋa wʋsa, nɛ ya faangir tita'ar nɛ ya'am nɛ baŋir. Zugsɔb la zɔtim na kɛ ka ya paam lina wʋsa.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi, ba nimbanɛ an sʋnkpi'euŋ dim la bɛ suoraadinɛ zi'e kaasid agɔla gɔla: Banɛ ka ba tʋm ye ba maal nɔnaar la ba kumnɛ hali ban gʋ'ʋŋ la zug.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Nidib bas suoraad la wʋsa, sɔ' pʋ lɛn dɔl suoya la. Nɔnaar la san'am ya, ba nɛ'ɛs banɛ di kasɛt la nɛ, ba pʋ lɛn na'asid sɔ'ɔɔ.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Pɔɔd la kʋdignɛ ka bʋmbʋta sʋʋgid; Lebanon dinɛ nyan ka o tititada la ziank. Saron kʋ'ʋlʋm zin'is yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ Araba pipirig la nɛ, ka Basan nɛ Kaamel tivɛnla vaand la sʋʋg.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Nannanna m na duoe zi'en, ba yʋ'ʋn na zun'om ka dʋ'ʋsi m yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Pɔkanɛ ka fʋ mɔr la nwɛnɛ udug nɛ, ka fʋn na du'a si'el la nwɛnɛ kikan'agbita nɛ, fʋ ya'a vʋ'ʋs li na anɛ bugum diti fʋ mɛŋ.

english_verse: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.
translation_verse: Nidib la na kanbi lieb tampɛligim, ka nwɛnɛ gɔn'ɔs ka ba nwaae nyu'oe bugum.

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ bɛ lalli la, kɛlisimi man maal si'el la. Yanam banɛ mɛ bɛ yammin la, baŋimi man mɔr paŋ si'em!”

english_verse: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, “How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning?”
translation_verse: Dabiem kpɛn' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim banɛ bɛ Zion teŋin la, banɛ zi' Wina'am la kiridnɛ, ka yɛt ye, “Anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi zi'en nɛ bugum kanɛ dit nwa'? Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na kpɛm bɛ nɛ bugum linɛ dit ka pʋ kpiigid la?”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Ayei! Li anɛ onɛ ken nɛ pʋpielim la, nɛ onɛ pian'ad linɛ an sida la. Ba zan'asi ye ba kʋ muk nidibi di'e ligidi, ka pʋ tiennɛ ba nu'ugʋ di'ed ligidi linɛ ka sɔ' na da' ba. Ba li' ba tʋba ka pʋ kɛlisid banɛ gban'ad ninkʋʋr yɛla la, ka umi ba nini ka pʋ siakidi gɔsid bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: Nimbama na zin'in ya' banɛ ka na'am bɛ, ba na kpɛn' kpi'euŋ zin'ig linɛ bɛ zuor zug la su'a li pʋʋgin. Ani ka ba na mɔr diib saŋa wʋsa, ka ku'om mɛ kʋ pansigi baa.

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Ya nini na nyɛ Na'ab la nɛ o na'am vɛnlim, ka ya gɔs teŋ kanɛ yalim hali la.

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: Ya na kpɛn tɛɛnsid dabiem linɛ da bɛ kʋdimin sa la yɛla ye, “Tuongatib kpɛɛm la bɛ yaanɛ? Onɛ di'esid lampɔ la bɛ yaanɛ? Kpɛɛm kanɛ di'esid zaŋguoma nɛ za'anɔya lampɔ la o sɔb mɛ bɛ yaanɛ?”

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Ya kʋ nyɛ nimbanɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ la ya'asɛ, nimbanɛ pian'adi pʋ mɔr gbin gban'arɛ nɛ teŋ zʋŋ pian'ad linɛ ka' gbin la.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi Zion zuor zug, tempʋkanɛ an ya malʋŋ tiɛnr zin'ig la. Ya nini na nyɛ Jerusalem, ka li na an zin'ikanɛ bɛllim mɔr sumalisim. Li na nwɛnɛ sʋgʋr kanɛ ka ba kʋ viigi li, ba kʋ vuoɛn li dazi'eda la, bɛɛ kɛnsi li nwiis la.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: Anina ka Zugsɔb la na aan ti Paŋtita'ar Sɔb. Li na nwɛnɛ teŋ kanɛ bɛ kɔldabɛda nɛ mu'a ni, amaa ka anrʋŋ buudi wʋsa kae na nyaŋi lɔ'ɔŋi paae anina.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la aan ti sariakat, Zugsɔb la an onɛ tisidi ti wada, Zugsɔb la aan ti na'ab, li anɛ onɛ na faaɛn ti.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: Ya nwiis banɛ lɔɔ ya anrʋŋ la yidig ya, ka li daug linɛ zi'e sappi la pʋ ba'a sʋ'ʋŋaa ka li fukanɛ ka pɛbisʋg da'ad la aans. Ba na pʋdig ban fan' la'asieba la ka li zu'oe, hali banɛ an waba na di'e la'ad la bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Banɛ wʋsa bɛ Zion teŋin la sɔ' kʋ yɛl ye, “Mam bɛn'ɛda”; ka banɛ bɛ ani ka tʋm bɛ'ɛd la, ba na kɛɛ ba taali bas.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation, the entire earth, and all its creatures, come here and listen!
translation_verse: Buudii, li'elimi na ka kɛlisi; nidibaa, kɛlisimi sʋ'ʋŋa! Kɛl ka teŋgbauŋ la nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pɔɔgin wʋsa wʋm, nɛ dunia la nɛ linɛ yiti li pʋʋgin na la!

english_verse: The Lord is terribly angry with the nations; he has condemned them to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋnf pɛlig nɛ buudi wʋsa; nɛ ba zabzabidib la wʋsa. O na san'ami ba wʋsa, ka nɔki ba tis ka ba kʋʋ ba.

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: Ba na kʋʋ ba lɔbi bas, ka ba niŋgbina nyuug duoe, ka zuoya la wʋsa pɛ'ɛl nɛ ba ziim.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Nwadbibis banɛ bɛ saŋgbana ni la na bu'oe ka saŋgbauŋ la na kpilim wʋʋ gbauŋ nɛ. Nwadbibis nɛ linɛ bɛ saŋgbana ni la na lit teŋin wʋʋ tiis vaandi kʋdigi sʋʋgid nɛ.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: M sʋ'ʋraug la ti'eb arezana ni naae; gɔsima, li na sig Edom na kad saria, nimbanɛ ka m pɛsigi ba ye ba san'am nyain la.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb sʋ'ʋg la wʋsa anɛ ziim, kpaam buligi li, pɛ'ɛs nɛ bʋʋs ziim nɛ kpaam linɛ bɛ pɛ'ɛs sianini ni la. Zugsɔb la na maal maan kaŋa Bozra teŋin, o na kʋʋ li bɛdegʋ Edom teŋin.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Mɔɔgin niigi la na la'am kpi nɛ ba, nɛ na'arabibis nɛ na'aratitada la. Ba teŋ la na madig nɛ ziim, ka zin'ig wʋsa wʋ'ʋg nɛ kpaam.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mɔr dabiskanɛ an sam yɔɔb, li anɛ yʋʋm kanɛ ka o na yɔ Zion bi'emnam la samme tis Zion dim.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Edom kɔldaad la na lieb kotaal, ba teŋ la na nyɛligid wʋʋ kidibiri la'aŋ bugum, ka nwɛnɛ kotaal ka bugum la'aŋi dit!

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa li kʋ kpiigɛ, nyɔ'ɔs na duod saŋa wʋsa. Li na yi zʋmaʋŋ yinne paae zʋmaʋŋ ya'as ka teŋ la na kpɛn dig zaalim; sɔ' kʋ lɛn dɔl ani gaad ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Viid nɛ agaand na sʋ'oe zin'ig la, ba na maali ba tɛɛd anina. Wina'am na mak Edom teŋ la nɛ o makir nwiig ka kɛ ka li kpɛlim zaalim ka dig yɔɔg-yɔɔg.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Ba ninsʋma la kʋ mɔr linɛ nar ye ba buon ye sʋ'ʋlim, ba tuongatib la wʋsa na bɔdig.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Gɔn'ɔs na di'e ba tempʋʋs la wʋsa, gɔn'ɔs nɛ tiyɔɔd na yii ba kpi'euŋ zin'isin, li na lieb wɛbaas nɛ viid gbɛɛnsa.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Mɔɔgin bʋnyuos nɛ zaŋku'a na la'asid ani, ka sian'arin bʋʋs na kaasidi buon taaba, ani ka yʋ'ʋŋ bʋnyuos na nyɛ ba vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'ig.

english_verse: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
translation_verse: Viiug na tɛ tɛog anina nyɛ' gɛla, o na wiak anina ka gur o biis la o kpʋkpama ni, wibid mɛ na la'asid ani ayi', yi'.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Gɔsim Zugsɔb gbauŋʋn la ka karim gɔs lin yɛl si'el: Bama wʋsa na bɛ ani, baa yinne kʋ bɛ ani aan o kɔn'ɔkɔn'. Li anɛ Wina'am nɔɔri pian' zi'el, ka o siig na la'asi ba na.

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: O pʋdig sɔ' wʋsa o din, o nu'ugʋ maki tɔndi ba. Ba na sʋ'oe li saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ ka ba zʋmaana bɛdegʋ na zin'inɛ anina.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Pipirig nɛ teŋ kpi'emis la na mɔr sumalisim, tiis na yina pu puum ka maal sumalisim.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Li na maal puum tɔ'ɔtɔ, ka na maal sumalisim bɛdegʋ ka nwɛ'ɛd sumalisim kuŋ. Li na mɔr Lebanon vɛnlim la buudi, li vɛnlim na nwɛnɛ Kaamel zuor nɛ Saron teŋgbauŋ; ba na nyɛɛ ti Zugsɔb la na'am pipilim nɛ ti Wina'am la vɛnlim.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Kpɛmisim banɛ nu'usi buk la, ka kpɛ'ɛŋ banɛ duma gɛn la.

english_verse: “Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.”
translation_verse: Yɛlim banɛ zɔt dabiem la ye, “Kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya sʋnya ka da zɔt dabiem, ya Wina'am la na kena, o na kena yɔ sam. Wina'am mɛŋ na yɔ sam nɛ o siig paŋ, o na kena faaɛn ya, ya bi'emnam nu'usin.”

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: Banɛ nini zu'om la na lak, ka tʋbkpida tʋba yɔ'ɔg.

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: Waba na ian'ad wʋʋ walis nɛ, ka gigis tansid agɔla gɔla nɛ sumalisim. Ku'om na tansidi yit sian'arin na ka pʋbidi yit pipirisin.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Zin'ikanɛ ka nintaŋ tʋʋlʋg kanbid titanbin'isi la na lieb bɛuŋ, ka ku'om tansidi yit zin'ikanɛ kʋdig la wʋsa. Zin'ikanɛ an zin'ibɛ'ɛd ka wɛbaas bɛɛ anina la, kɔlkantima nɛ ku'omin mɔɔd na bus.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Suoraug na bɛɛ anina; ba na buonnɛ li ye, Wina'am Suor. Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim kʋ nyaŋi dɔlli lii. Li na anɛ banɛ dɔl suokan la din, ka banɛ an zɔn nɛ bugusim dim la kʋ nyaŋi dɔl suokaŋaa.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ lɛn nyɛ gbigim aninaa, ka bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og mɛ kʋ duoe anii. Ba taaba wʋsa lɛn kae. Amaa banɛ nyɛ faangir la ma'aa na kenna ani.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka Zugsɔb yɔɔ ba yɛla la na lɛb na, ba na yʋ'ʋmmi kpɛn'ɛd Zion tempʋʋg, ka sumalisim linɛ ka' naar la na bɛ nɛ ba. Sumpielim nɛ sumalisim na pɛ'ɛli ba, ka sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ mugusʋg na zɔ ka basi ba.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Mid ka ya kɛlisid Hezekia yɛti ya ye, “Zugsɔb la na faaɛn ti la.” Teŋgban si'a nam mi' faaɛn o teŋ man Asiria Na'ab nu'uginɛɛ?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Ka duoe zi'en ka tansi buol nɛ Hibiru pian'ad ye, “Kɛlisimi labaar kanɛ yi Na'atita'ar onɛ aan Asiria Na'ab la san'an na!

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Hamat nɛ Apad tɛɛns la bɛ yaanɛ? Sefaavam teŋ la bɛ yaanɛ? Ba da nyaŋi faaɛn Samaria yisi m nu'uginɛ?

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Ka Hilkia biig Eliakim onɛ an na'ayikpɛɛm nɛ Siebna gbansɔbid la, nɛ Joa onɛ saamme an Asaf onɛ sɔbid yɛla digin la da yii tʋ'ʋsi ba.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Asiria na'ayikpɛm la da yɛli ba ye, “Yɛlimi Hezekia ye Asiria Na'atita'ar la yɛl si'eli nwa': Fʋ ti'e bɔ ka mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ kaŋa?

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Fʋ ye fʋ mɔr suoya nɛ soogianam paŋ, amaa fʋ pian'adnɛ pian'azaal. Anɔ'ɔn ka fʋ ti'e ka ki'isid man nɔɔrɛ?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, nannanna fʋ ti'enɛ Egipt kanɛ nwɛnɛ balaari ɛɛn buak bɛɛ tuoɛn ka sɔ' ya'a zanl ka dɛllimi li ka li kʋns o nu'ugʋ pu'alim si'em la. Ala ka Egipt Na'ab Faaro aan tis onɛ wʋsa dɛllim o.”

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Ka fʋ ya'a yɛl mam ye, “Tinam ti'enɛ ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la, ka' o maan zin'is nɛ bimbima ka Hezekia san'am, ka yɛt Juda nɛ Jerusalem dim ye, asɛɛ ka ya pʋ'ʋs bimbim kaŋa tuon, Jerusalem teŋin laa?”

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people! He will give you
translation_verse: Kem na! Kɛl ka fʋn nɛ m zugdaan Asiria Na'ab la di da'. M na tisif widi tusa ayi', fʋ ya'a na nyɛ banɛ na ban' ba!

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: La'an nɛ fʋn ti'e Egipt zaba widi tɛrekonam nɛ wiedban'adib la, fʋ ye fʋ niŋ wala nyaŋ man kpɛɛmnam la yinne; hali baa onɛ an biigi ba san'an la?

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Linɛ lɛm paas, mam na kena zab nɛ ya ka pʋ di'e nɔɔri yi Zugsɔb la san'anɛɛ? Zugsɔb la mɛŋi yɛlim ye m kem na zab nɛ teŋ kaŋa san'ami li.

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Ka Hilkia biig Eliakim nɛ Siebna nɛ Joa da lɛbis o ye, “Naa, pian'am tisi ti nɛ Aram buudi pian'ad ka ti wʋm, ka da pian'adi ti nɛ Hibiru dim pian'adɛ, ka nimbanɛ bɛ zaŋguom la zug la na wʋm.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Amaa kpɛɛm la da lɛbis ye, “Ya tɛn'ɛs ye li daa anɛ yanam nɛ ya zugdaan la yɛla ma'aa ka m zugdaan daa tʋmim ka m kena yɛl pian'ad la ka ka' dap banɛ zin' zaŋguom zug laa? Ban nɛ yanam wʋsa na dii ya mɛŋ bin ka nuu ya mɛŋ dʋ'ʋnim!”

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Da siaki ka Hezekia bɛlisi ya ye ya niŋim Zugsɔb la yaddaa! On yɛti ya ye, “Zugsɔb la sid na nyaŋi faaɛn ti ka Asiria Na'ab kʋ nyaŋi zabi faaɛn tempʋkaŋa la.”

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah. Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: Da kɛlisidi Hezekia pian'adɛ!’ Asiria Na'ab la yɛl si'eli nwa': ‘Mɔri sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ mam ka yisi ya mɛŋi kɛn mam san'an na. Din ka sɔ' wʋsa na dii o mɛŋ tiis wala ka nuu o mɛŋ buligin ku'om.

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: Hali nɛ mam na ti kena nɔki ya keŋ teŋ kanɛ nwɛnɛ ya din la, teŋ kanɛ ka ki bɛ, ka bodobodo bɛ, nɛ tiwanna pɔɔd.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Tembama teŋgbana la wʋsa sʋʋgin, teŋgban kanɛ nyaŋi faaɛn o teŋi yi man nu'uginɛ? Zugsɔb la ye o niŋ wala faaɛn Jerusalem yi man nu'uginɛ?’”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Ka Hilkia biig Eliakim onɛ an na'ayikpɛɛm, nɛ Siebna onɛ an gbauŋ sɔbid nɛ Joa onɛ saamme an Asaf onɛ sɔbid yɛla digin la, yɛ fu-aanlima keŋ Hezekia san'an ka yɛl o Asiria na'ayikpɛm la yɛl si'em.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na'ab Hezekia da wʋm la, o da aans o fuud ka yɛ bɔtkɛɛnd ka kpɛn' Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Hamat Na'ab la bɛɛ Apad Na'ab, bɛɛ na'ab onɛ an Sefaavam tempʋʋg Na'ab la, bɛɛ banɛ an Hena, bɛɛ Iva Na'anam la bɛ yaanɛ?’” Hezekia winsɔsʋg

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Ba da yɛl o ye, “Na'ab Hezekia yɛl si'eli nwa': zina anɛ tɔɔg nɛ zɛligir nɛ nyan dabisir, nwɛnɛ pu'a na sa'ae ka biig zug tʋm na ka paŋ lɛn kae unsid ka o yit na la.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Daasi'erɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan fʋ Wina'am la wʋm Asiria na'ayikpɛɛm onɛ ka o zugdaan Asiria Na'ab tʋm ye o kena tʋ' ka la' Wina'am Kanɛ Vʋe la; ka na zɛrig o zaŋi keŋ pian'akanɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ aan fʋ Wina'am wʋm la. Alazugɔ sɔsim tis banɛ kpɛlim bi'ela ka nan vʋe la!”

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Na'ab Hezekia kpi'emnam la da paae Azaya san'an na la,

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Azaya da yɛli ba ye, “Yɛlimi ya zugdaan la ye, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': ‘Da zɔti dabiem nɛ yanamɛ wʋm pian'abanɛ ka Asiria Na'ab na'ayikpɛɛm kena pian' nɛ'ɛs mam la.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi! M na fɛndig o ya'am ka o ya'a wʋm labasi'a o na lɛb o mɛŋ teŋin, ani ka m na kɛ ka ba kie o nɛ sʋ'ʋgʋ kʋ.’”

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Asiria kpɛɛm la da wʋm ye Asiria Na'ab yi Lakis la, o da yii keŋ nyɛnɛ Na'ab la zabid nɛ Libna teŋ dim.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Senakɛrib da wʋm labaar ye Tirhaka onɛ an Kus Na'ab la yit ye o zab nɛ o la, o da lɛn tɔlim labaari yɛl Hezekia ye,

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Hezekia onɛ an Juda Na'ab la ye, ‘Da kɛ ka teŋgban kanɛ ka fʋ dɛl la ma'af ye, “Ba kʋ nyaŋi di'e Jerusalem tis Asiria Na'ab laa.”

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Fʋ mɛŋ wʋm Asiria Na'abi tʋm si'el tembama la ni san'ami ba nyain-nyain. Ka fʋn tɛn'ɛs ka fʋ na paam faangirɛɛ?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: M yaanamɛ da san'am Gozan, nɛ Haran nɛ Rezef teŋgbana la nɛ Eden nimbanɛ da bɛ Telasa la, ba teŋgbana da nyaŋi faaɛn baa?

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Hezekia da di'e gbauŋ la ban tʋm sieba o san'an na la nu'ugin karim. Ka duoe keŋ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yinnɛ fuoe gbauŋ la digil Zugsɔb la tuon,

english_verse: Then he prayed:
translation_verse: ka pian' tis Zugsɔb la ye,

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “M Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am, fʋnɛ zin' Kerubnam teŋsʋk. Fʋn ma'aa an Wina'am sʋ'oe sʋ'ʋlim banɛ bɛ dunia wʋsa. Fʋnɛ maal agɔl nɛ teŋ.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, li anɛ sida ye Asiria na'anam san'am teŋgbana nɛ li nidib la wʋsa.

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: On dɔl suosi'a kena la o na dɔl ani lɛb, o kʋ kpɛn' teŋ kaŋa pʋʋginɛ.” Zugsɔb la yɛl ala.

english_verse: I went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, you prayed to me about King Sennacherib of Assyria. Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: Pian'akanɛ ka Zugsɔb la pian' zɛrig o nwa': “Zion Pu'asadir onɛ nan zi' dau nɛ'ɛsidif ka la'adif. Jerusalem pu'ayua lɔbid o zugʋ fʋ zɔɔg la yɛla.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋmi fʋ kpɛɛmnam ka ba kenna tʋ' Zugsɔb la bɛ'ɛd bɛ'ɛdi. Ka yɛl ye, ‘Mam mɔr zaba tɛrekonam bɛdegʋ la zug ka m nyaŋi dʋ zuor zug, zin'ikanɛ dʋʋ gaad zin'is wʋsa Lebanon teŋin. Mam nwa' na'aziinr tiwa'a la wʋsa digil teŋin nɛ tibanɛ ka li daad vɛnl la. Man dʋʋ paae li zugin sa, ka keŋ paae sian'anr la bɛn.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Man tu bulis teŋ zʋna ni ka nuu li ku'om, ka mam mɛŋ nɔbpansimpana ka m nɔki kɛ ka Egipt ku'osuoya kpiɛn.’

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋ wʋm ye kʋdimin sa ka m gban'e lii? Ɛɛn, yʋʋm pʋkʋdʋg la sa ka mam da pʋn gban'e li yɛla! Nannanna ka m yʋ'ʋn kɛ ka li maal. Ka fʋ nɔk tɛɛns banɛ da mɔr kpi'euŋ la ka kɛ ka li lieb zin'ikanɛ ka kuga dig kuda-kuda.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: Ba nimbanɛ paŋi naae la lidig nɛ ka di nyan. Ba nwɛnɛ bʋmbʋta linɛ nam bun pɔɔgin, ka nwɛnɛ mɔbiili linɛ nan tansid, ka lɛn nwɛnɛ mɔɔdi naanɛ tansid mɔpil zug ka nintaŋ tʋʋlʋg nyaŋi ba ka ba pʋ nyaŋi nɔbigɛ.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: Amaa mam mi' fʋn bɛ zin'isi'a, nɛ fʋn ken ka lɛbid suosi'a; nɛ fʋn kis mam si'em la.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Fʋn kisim si'em la, nɛ fʋ tʋ'ʋd la kpɛn' m tʋba ni, m na nɔk m gu'a la ga' fʋ Nyɔnya, ka li'a fʋ nɔɔr nɛ salibir, ka kɛ ka fʋ lɛb wʋʋ fʋn kɛn si'em na la.

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Na'ab Hezekia, nɛ' na an zanbinnɛ tisif: dʋnna ya ye ya dinɛ ki linɛ yi ka sɔ' pʋ bʋdɛ. Ka yʋʋm kanɛ pɛ'ɛs ayi' la ya na di linɛ yii li mɛŋ. Amaa yʋʋm kanɛ paasida atan' la, bʋdim ka bun. Bʋdim tiis pɔɔd ka dii li wala.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Linɛ lɛm paas, nidib na kpɛlim Juda dɔɔgin la ba'a nya'a teŋin yina wal wala agɔl.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Jerusalem pʋʋgin nidib bi'ela na kpɛlim ka Zion zuor zug banɛ kpɛlim ka pʋ kpi la na la'as ani ka yina. Zugsɔb la nyɛlʋgʋ na kɛ ka nɛ' maal.

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “Ala zugɔɔ Zugsɔb la yɛt si'eli nwa' zaŋi ken Asiria Na'ab la yɛla ye: “O kʋ kpɛn' teŋ kaŋa pʋʋga, bɛɛ tɔn piim kpɛla. O kʋ nyaŋi kpɛn' ani ka zanl gbanti'edʋg bɛɛ nyaŋi mɛ' gu'ub zaŋguommi giŋi li.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Dinzug Na'ab Senakɛrib da basi ba gu'ub zin'ig la ka duoe tɔɔm ka lɛb Ninive tempʋʋgin zin'inɛ ani.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Daar yinne ka o bɛ teŋ kanɛ buon Nisirok la dɔɔgin maan malʋŋ ka o biis Adiramelek nɛ Siareza ki'e o nɛ sʋ'ʋgʋ kʋ ka zɔɔ keŋ Ararat teŋin. Ka Esaraddon onɛ aan o biig la di na'am.

english_verse: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
translation_verse: Hezekia da fɛndig o nindaa kpa' dɔkpinni sɔsid Zugsɔb la yɛt ye,

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na faanm! Kɛl ka ti nwɛ' kɔna yʋ'ʋm dʋ'ʋs o yʋ'ʋr. O Pʋ'ʋsim Yin ka ti na bɛ, ti nyɔvʋr bɛllim wʋsa ni.”

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Na'ab Hezekia da lu ban'a ka li bɔɔd o kʋʋb. Nɔdi'es Azaya onɛ an Amoz biig la da keŋ o san'an yɛl o ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', ‘Maalimi fʋ yir la sʋ'ʋŋa bɔzugɔ fʋ na kpi, fʋ kʋ duoe.’”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, ‘M kʋ lɛn nyɛ Zugsɔb la nɛ banɛ vʋe la ya'asɛ; man kʋ lɛn nyɛ ninsaaliba, bɛɛ banɛ nam bɛ dunia kaŋa ni la.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: “M Zugsɔba, tiɛnm man dɔllif nɛ sida si'em nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa la. M pɛsigi m mɛŋ ka tʋm si'el wʋsa ka li an sʋ'ʋŋa fʋ nini ni!” Ka Na'ab Hezekia kaas nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ.

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: “Lɛm yɛl Hezekia ye, ‘Zugsɔb onɛ aan fʋ yaab David Wina'am la yɛl ye, m wʋmi fʋ sɔsʋg ka mɛ nyɛɛ fʋ ninta'am la. M na paasif yʋʋm pii nɛ anu.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Amaa m ye m yɛl ye bɔ? O pian' tisim, o mɛŋ mɛŋi tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa. M na anɛ baanlimm m vʋm wʋsa pɔɔgin sʋnsa'aŋ kanɛ paam la zug.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: M mɛ na faaɛn fʋn nɛ teŋ kaŋa yis Asiria Na'ab la nu'ugin.

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: Nɛ' na an Zugsɔb la zanbinnɛ pa'annif ye Zugsɔb na maal on kaanb si'el la wʋsa:

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: m na kɛ ka winnig la ma'asim la lɛb nya'aŋi dʋ nɔba yakir piiga wʋʋ lin sig si'em, Ahaz ma'asim makir zin'igin la.’” Ka winnig la sid lɛb nya'aŋ nɔba yakir piiga wʋʋ lin da pʋn sig si'em la. Na'ab Hezekia yʋʋm

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Juda na'ab Hezekia n tilig o ban'as la ni la, ka sɔb nɛ'ɛŋa:

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: “Ka m yɛl ye, ‘M nyɔvʋr bɛllim saŋa, saŋkan ka m nam mɔr paŋ la, li nar ye m dɔl kum za'anɔɔrɛɛ? Li sʋm ye m kɔ'ɔŋi m nyɔvʋr m bɛllim wʋsa nii?’

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Man yir nwɛnɛ kɔnbkemnib Fuug Sʋgʋr ka ba da'ae li bas ka yisi li m san'an. M nyɔvʋr nwɛnɛ pien kanɛ ka ba ʋgʋd ka kpilimi li, ka ba yʋ'ʋn nwaae li yis sʋlʋg daadin la. Nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa fʋ kɛya ka man yɛla naae.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Ka m gu'usid nɛ suguru ka bɛog ti nie, amaa ka o nwɛnɛ gbigim nɛ, kɔɔ m kɔnba wʋsa; Nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa fʋ kɛya ka man yɛla naae.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: Ka m kaas wʋʋ lilaaliŋ nɛ, ka kum nwɛnɛ dawan nɛ. Ka m gɔs agɔla ka m nini sɔbid. Zugsɔba, kem na sʋŋim, ka m bɛ nɛ yɛla ni!’

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, nɛ'ɛŋa kɛ ka nidib vʋe, ka m siig mɛ nyɛt vʋm li ni. Fʋ kɛya ka m nyɛ laafi, ka vʋe.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Asida sida li anɛ man sʋ'ʋm zugʋ kɛ ka m paam sʋnsa'aŋ kaŋa. Fʋ nɔŋilim la zug ka fʋ su'am ka yisim bʋmbɔk kanɛ an san'auŋ la pɔɔgin. Fʋ yisi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa m bas.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Yaʋg kʋ nyaŋi zun'e fɔ, kum mɛ kʋ nyaŋi yʋʋm dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋrɛ; banɛ sig yaadin la pʋ mɔr ti'ir nɛ fʋ sida la ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Banɛ vʋe la dʋ'ʋsid ka zun'odi fʋ yʋ'ʋr, nwɛnɛ man an si'em zina la; saamnam yɛti ba biisi fʋ sida la yɛla.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Ka Azaya da yɛl ye, “Yisim kekama kpaam suoɛn o natiŋkpi'eŋ la ka o na paam laafi.”

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Na'ab Hezekia da pʋn bu'os ye, “Zanbin bɔɔ na pa'alim ye Zugsɔb la na tisim laafi ka m keŋ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la?”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Hezekia sʋnf da ma'ae ka o di'e saam la ka pa'ali ba linɛ wʋsa bɛɛ o la'ad dɔɔgin la. La'abama da anɛ, anzurifa nɛ sanlima nɛ tudaari nɛ kpasʋma. O mɛ da pa'ali ba zaba la'ad zin'ig nɛ la'abanɛ wʋsa bɛ la'ad suak dɔɔgin la. Si'el da pʋ kpɛlim na'ayin la bɛɛ o sʋ'ʋlim la ni ka o pʋ pa'ali baa.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Merodak-Baladan onɛ saamme an Babilon Na'ab ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Baladan la da tɔlim gbana nɛ piini ye ba tis Hezekia bɔzugɔ o da wʋm o ban'as la yɛla.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Azaya onɛ da an nɔdi'es la da keŋ Na'ab Hezekia san'an bu'os o ye, “Nimbanɛ kena la yɛl ye bɔ, ka ba yi yaanɛ na?” Ka Hezekia lɛbis ye, “Ba yinɛ lallisa, hali Babilon teŋin na.”

english_verse: “What did you show them?” I asked. Hezekiah answered, “I showed them everything in my kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ka nɔdi'es la bu'os o ye, “Ba nyɛ bɔɔ fʋ yin la?” Ka Hezekia lɛbis ye, “Ba nyɛ si'el wʋsa. Si'el pʋ kpɛlim suak dɔɔgin la ka m pʋ pa'ali baa.”

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ka Azaya yɛl Hezekia ye, “Tɔ'! Kɛlisim Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'el,

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: ‘Saŋa kenna ka la'abanɛ bɛ na'ayin nwa' wʋsa nɛ fʋ yaanamɛ da su'a la'asieba ba saŋa ti paae zina la wʋsa, ba na vaae li wʋsa lɛb Babilon teŋin ka si'el-si'el kʋ kpɛlim!’ Zugsɔb la yɛl ala.”

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: O lɛn yɛl ye, “Ba na gban'e fʋ yaas banɛ aan fʋ mɛŋ ziim la sieba mɔri keŋ zan' ba ka ba lieb Babilon Na'ayitʋmtʋmnib.”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Ka Hezekia lɛbis ye, “Zugsɔb pian'akanɛ ka fʋ pian' la an sʋm!” Bɔzugɔ o tɛn'ɛs o sʋʋnrin ye, “Sumbʋgʋsʋm ya'a sadigim bɛ man nyɔvʋr bɛllim saŋa la, li ka' yɛllɛ.”

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: Ya Wina'am la yɛl ya ye, “Bʋgʋlimi m nidib la sʋʋnr, bʋgʋlimi m nidib la sʋʋnr!”

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Pian'am bʋgʋsiga tis Jerusalem, ka mɔɔli tis o ye, o tʋʋm kpi'ema la wʋsa gaad ya; ye, o taal kanɛ ka o daa tʋm la, ba yɔɔ li yɛla; ye, o di'e namisʋg abʋyi' Zugsɔb la san'anɛ o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa zug.

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Sɔ' bɛ mɔɔgini mɔɔn ye, “Maalimi suori tis Zugsɔb la; maalim suoraug sappi mɔɔgin la tisi ti Wina'am la.

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Wina'am pipilim la na nie, ka ninsaalib wʋsa na nyɛɛ li. Zugsɔb la mɛŋi pian'.”

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: M wʋm ka sɔ' yɛlim ye, “Kaasima agɔla.” Ka m bu'os ye, “M kaasim yɛl ye bɔ?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Yɛlim ye, ‘Ninsaalib wʋsa nwɛnɛ mɔɔd nɛ, ka ba vɛnlim nwɛnɛ mɔpuum banɛ bɛ mɔɔgin nɛ.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: Mɔɔd la ziankid ka li puum la sʋʋgid, Zugsɔb la vʋ'ʋsidi niŋidi ba la zug. Sida ninsaalib anɛ mɔɔd.

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Mɔɔd la ziankid ka puum la sʋʋgid, amaa Zugsɔb pian'ad la kpɛm bɛ nɛ saŋa wʋsa.’”

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ mɔr labasʋŋʋ kɛn Zion na la, dʋmmi zuokanɛ wa'am hali la zug. Yanam banɛ mɔr labasʋŋʋ kɛn Jerusalem na la dʋ'ʋsimi ya kʋkɔya tans agɔla gɔla. Dʋ'ʋsimi, da zɔti dabiem; yɛlim Juda tempʋʋs la ye, “Ya Wina'am la nwa'!”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la kenna nɛ paŋ ye o sʋ'ʋg teŋ la, o paŋ la na bɛ saŋa wʋsa. Gɔsima, o mɔri yɔɔd kanɛ ka o na yɔɔ o nidib.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: O gur o kɔnbid la wʋʋ kɔnbkem nɛ: O la'asid pɛbibis la ka ʋkidi ba nɛ o nu'usi piankid o nyɔ'ɔgin; ka kad pɛnya'as la bi'el-bi'el.

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Sɔ' bɛɛ na nyaŋi mak atɛuk ku'om la nɛ o nu'ug bɛɛ mak saŋgbauŋ la nɛ o nu'ug labisim? Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi vaae dunia uusʋg la wʋsa niŋ pɛogʋnɛ, bɛɛ mak zuoya la ka mak kʋkʋna baŋi ba tɛbisim?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ mi' Zugsɔb la pʋtɛn'ɛrɛ, bɛɛ na nyaŋi pa'al o bɛɛ sa'al o?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn ka Zugsɔb la keŋ o san'an bɔɔd ye o nie o ya'am? Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ pa'an o linɛ dɔl suorɛ? Anɔ'ɔnɛ da pa'al o baŋir bɛɛ yɛl o linɛ nar ye o tʋm?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Dunia la tɛɛns wʋsa nwɛnɛ ku'om na tuaki li buati ni nɛ; ba fa'as nɛ nwɛnɛ uusʋg nɛ; o makid tembanɛ ka ku'om gilig la wʋʋ titanbʋʋlʋg nɛ.

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Lebanon tiis la wʋsa pʋ siak maan bimbim la zug bugum nyu'orɛ, bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ bɛɛ ani la siak maana maalʋgɔ.

english_verse: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
translation_verse: Buudi wʋsa ka' si'el o tuonnɛ; ba anɛ zaalim o nini ni. O gɔsi ba ka ba ka' vɔɔnrɛ.

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Ya'a anɛ ba'arɛ, banɛ kpi'ed la maali li, ka banɛ kʋnt sanlima la buligi li nɛ sanlima ka maal anzurifa zɔnti niŋi li.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Dau kanɛ an nɔŋdaan ka pʋ mɔr sanlima bɛɛ anzurifa la, gaŋidi daug kanɛ ka sibig kʋ nyaŋɛ dii, ka bɔ onɛ mi' kpi'eb sʋ'ʋŋa ka o maal ba'akanɛ na zi'en sʋ'ʋŋa ka kʋ lii.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Ya zi'ii? Ya nam pʋ wʋmm? Ba pʋ yɛli ya pin'ilʋgʋn saa? Ya pʋ gban'e li gbin dunia pin'ilʋg saŋa la saa?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: O zin'inɛ o na'am gbauŋ zug dunia nwa' ni, ka nimbanɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ la zug nwɛnɛ sisɔma nɛ. O tiɛn saŋgbana la wʋʋ fuug nɛ, ka yadigi ba wʋʋ sʋgʋr ka ba ti' ye ba kpɛn' nɛ.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: O kɛ ka kpi'emnam lieb zaalim, ka sie dunia na'anam paŋ ka li lieb zaalim.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Ban sɛɛ ba naae bɛɛ bʋdi ba, ka ba bɔɔd nya'a ba'ab la, ka o kpɛn da'ae pɛbisim gɛɛli ba ka ba kʋdig, ka sisi'epiliŋ piisi ba ka ba mɛlim wʋʋ udug nɛ.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: “Anɔ'ɔn ka ya na nɔki mak nɛ mam bɛɛ anɔ'ɔn zem nɛ mam?” Onɛ an Kasi la yɛl ala.

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
