translation_verse: Gɔ'ɔnim gɔs saŋgbana la: anɔ'ɔnɛ maal nɛ' wʋsa? Onɛ maal nwadbibis la wʋsa ka buonnɛ ba wʋsa yʋda yinne-yinne. On mɔr kpi'euŋ nɛ paŋ tita'ar la zug, baa yinne pʋ bɔdigida.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka ya nyɔnna, Israel? Israel, bɔ ka fʋ fabin ye, “Zugsɔb la zi' m tɔɔg la yɛllɛ bɛɛ o ba'a kae nɛ ban na mɔŋim bʋʋdɛ?”

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Fʋ nam pʋ baŋɛɛ? Fʋ nam pʋ wʋmm? Zugsɔb la anɛ Wina'am onɛ bɛ saŋa wʋsa, onɛ maal dunia la wʋsa. O pʋ gɛɛnda, o mɛ pʋ tadigida; ka on gban'ad si'el gbin si'em la, sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi baŋi lii.

english_verse: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
translation_verse: O tisid banɛ tadig la paŋ ka paasid banɛ an tadimnam la kpi'euŋ.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Hali na'akim nɛ pu'asada tadigid ka dasam tu'usidi lit;

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: amaa banɛ mɔr ti'ir nɛ Zugsɔb la na paam paŋ paal. Ba na bus kpʋkpama wʋʋ silʋg nɛ; ba na zɔ ka kʋ tadigɛ, ba na keŋ hali ka kʋ nwi'e.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: “Aaɛn baanlimm man tuon, yanam banɛ ka ku'om giligi ya tɛɛns la! Kɛl ka buudi wʋsa nidib tɛndigi ba paŋ! Kɛl ka ba yi paalʋ na tu'as; kɛlli ka ti la'as taaba sariakadib zin'igin.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: O kati ba nɛ dɔl suokanɛ ka o nan zi' dɔl laa, ka lɛɛ pʋ pu'alimi o mɛŋa.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn maal nɛ'ɛŋa ka nyaŋi tʋmi li? Anɔ'ɔnɛ sʋ'oe zʋmaana wʋsa yɛla, hali dunia pin'ilʋgʋnɛ? Man Zugsɔb, onɛ an pin'ilʋg ka an naar la, maannɛ ala.”

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Tembanɛ ka ku'om gilig la nyɛɛ li la, dabiem gban'e ba nɛ, hali tembanɛ bɛ teŋ-magbinnin la kiridnɛ; Ba la'as nɛ kennɛ m san'an na.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa sʋŋid o tiraan ka yɛt o ba'abiis ye, “Kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya mɛŋ!”

english_verse: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
translation_verse: Onɛ kpi'ed la kpɛmisid onɛ kʋnt sanlima la, ka onɛ mɔr sanlima bʋligid la mɛ kpɛmisid onɛ mɔr zan'ari kʋnt la. Ka yɛt onɛ nyɛligidi tabin la ye, “Li an sʋ'ʋŋa.” O nɔk kpa'asi kpa' ba'ar la tabil sʋ'ʋŋa ka li kʋ lii.

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: “Amaa Israel nidiba, yanamɛ aan m tʋmtʋmnib. Jakob nidiba, yanam ka m gaŋ, yanam bama aan m zua Abraham yaas.

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: M mɔri ya yinɛ teŋ-magbinnin na, ka buoli ya yi zin'ibanɛ lal na ka yɛl ye, ‘Ya anɛ m tʋmtʋmnib.’ Mam mɛŋi gaŋi ya ka pʋ zan'asi ya.

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Dinzug da zɔtnɛ dabiem, ka m bɛ nɛ ya, da kɛ ka li paki ya, ka manɛ aan ya Wina'am. M na kpɛmisi ya ka sʋŋi ya; M na mɔri ya nɛ m nu'ukpi'euŋ la ka faaɛn ya.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: Banɛ duoe zi'e ya yɛla la sid na di nyan tita'ar banɛ zan'asi ya la na bɔdig, ba na nwɛnɛ zaalim nɛ.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Ya na ti ieedi ya dataas la zin'ig, ka kʋ nyɛɛ baa. Banɛ duoe zi'e bɔɔd ye ba zab nɛ ya la na mɛlim.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am; m zanli ya nɛ m datiuŋ nu'ugin ka yɛti ya ye ya da zɔt dabiem; ka m na sʋŋi ya.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Jakob yaas banɛ an tadimbʋʋsɛ, da zɔti dabiem, Israel buudbanɛ pɔɔda, da zɔti ya; mam na sʋŋi ya.” Zugsɔb la pian' li, onɛ an ya Faangid, ka an Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: “Gɔsima, m na maali ya nwɛnɛ dakanɛ bʋ'ʋd ki, ka ya an bʋmpaal linɛ pʋlim ka mɔr tɛbisim bɛdegʋ. Ya na nwa'ae zuoya la bugus, ka kɛ ka kʋkʋna lieb wʋʋ udug nɛ.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: Ya na yɛligi ba, ka pɛbisim ʋki ba, ka sisi'etita'ar da'ae ba mɔri keŋ. Amaa ya na maal sumalisim Zugsɔb la san'an, ka dʋ'ʋs man Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: Nɔŋ nɛ fara dim ieed ku'om, ka pʋ paam baa si'el si'ela; ka ku'onuud mɔri ba, ka ba zilima kʋdig. Man Zugsɔb na gandigi ba sɔsʋg; mam onɛ an Israel Wina'am la kʋ tami ba yɛllɛ.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka kɔldaad pʋbidi dɔl kʋkʋna linɛ an pipiris la zug, ka kɛ ka ku'om tansid bɔn'ɔdin la. Ku'om na bun zin'ikanɛ an dindak la yitna.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka na'aziinr nɛ gɔn'ɔs nɛ olif bɛ pipirisin la, ka tiis yi zin'ikanɛ ka mɔɔg gba pʋ yit la, tiwa'a banɛ mɔr mɛɛb dasʋma la na yii ani mɛn.”

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: Ala ka nidib na nyɛ ka baŋ, ba na tɛn'ɛs ka gban'e li gbin, ye Zugsɔb la paŋi tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa, ye Israel Wina'am Onɛ an Kasi la maali li.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Yɛlimi dinɛ paki ya,” Jakob na'ab la yɛl ye, “Yisiminɛ ya nɔɔr pian'ʋkʋ an si'el.”

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ka ye, “Mɔrini ya bada la na ka ba yɛli ti linɛ na niŋ saŋa kanɛ kenna. Yɛlimi ti kʋdimin yɛla la da an si'em, ka ti tɛn'ɛsi li yɛla gɔs ka baŋi li naarɛ na an si'em. Bɛɛ ya nie pa'ali ti linɛ na ti niŋ.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ti linɛ na niŋ bɛog, ka ti baŋ ye ya sid anɛ wina. Maalimi bʋn linɛ an sʋm bɛɛ bɛ'ɛd, ka li na paki ti ka kpɛn'ɛsi ti dabiem.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Badaa, ya ka' vɔɔnrɛ, ya tʋʋma wʋsa anɛ zaalim; ka banɛ kaanbidi ya la mɛ ka' vɔɔnrɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: M gaŋ sɔ' ka o yi ya-datiuŋʋ kenna o yinɛ winnigi tansid zin'isi'a la ka na'asid man yʋ'ʋr. O nɔɔd na'anam wʋʋ tan nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ onɛ ya'abid ya'adi nɔn ya'ad si'em la.

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ yɛl nɛ' yɛla pin'ilʋgʋn ka ti na baŋɛ, bɛɛ dɛŋi maal ka ti na yɛl ye, ‘On yɛl si'el la anɛ sida’? Ayei, sɔ' pʋ nie nɛ' yɛllɛ, sɔ' mɛ pʋ dɛŋi yɛli li yɛllɛ, sɔ' pʋ wʋm pian'asi'a ya san'anɛ.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Manɛ dɛŋ yiiga yɛl Zion ye, ‘Gɔsima, banɛ nwana!’ M tʋm sɔ' Jerusalem ye o yɛli ba labasʋŋ la.

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, ba wʋsa anɛ ziri dim! Ba tʋʋma la wʋsa la'asi anɛ zaalim, bada la wʋsa nwɛnɛ sisi'em da'ad.”

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: “Gɔsima, oŋa aan m tʋmtʋm onɛ ka m tis o kpi'euŋ, on ka m gaŋ ka m sʋnf malis o yɛla. M na kɛ ka m siig la pɛ'ɛl o, ka o na mɔr yɛlsida kɛn buudi wʋsa ni na.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: O kʋ tansid agɔla gɔla, bɛɛ dʋ'ʋsid o kʋkɔri pian'ad suoraadinɛ.

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: Mɔkanɛ bɔɔd kɔ'ɔgir la, o kʋ kɔ'ɔgi li naae. Lauŋʋ kanɛ pʋ dit sʋ'ʋŋa, o kʋ kpiisi lii. O pʋpielim la zug, o na kɛ ka sida zi'en.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: O giinla kʋ siɛn ka o tadig ka basɛ, hali nɛ on na ti kɛ ka yɛlsida la tiig dunia wʋsa. Ala ka buudi wʋsa na mɔr ti'ir o yʋ'ʋrin.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa an linɛ ka Zugsɔb Wina'am la yɛt; on kanɛ maal saŋgbauŋ ka yadigi li wʋʋ sɔŋ la. Onɛ yadig teŋgbauŋ la nɛ bʋn dinɛ yiti li zugin la, onɛ tisid o nidib pɛbisim ka ba vʋ'ʋsid, ka tisid banɛ bɛ dunia wʋsa nyɔvʋr; o yɛt ye,

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: “Mam onɛ an Zugsɔb la buolif nɛ, nɛ pʋpielim; M na gban'e fʋ nu'ug, m na maali fʋ zi'el sappi ka kɛ ka fʋ an nɔnaari tis nidib la ka an nɛɛsim tis banɛ ka' Juda dim la.

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: Fʋ na lak banɛ zu'om la nini, ka yɔ'ɔg banɛ bɛ sanrega ni la ka ba nyɛ yɔlisim ka yis banɛ bɛ likin la na.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: Manɛ an Zugsɔb la; m yʋ'ʋri la! M kʋ nɔki m girima pʋdig nɛ sɔ' bɛɛ nɔk linɛ an m yʋ'ʋr zʋn'or la tis ba'arɛ.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Gɔsima, bʋnkʋda la gaad ya, ka m mɔr bʋmpaala na; saŋkanɛ ka ba nam pʋ yina la ka m mɔɔnnɛ tisidi ya.” Zugsɔb la zʋn'or yʋʋma

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋmmi yʋʋm paalli tis Zugsɔb la teŋgbauŋ wʋsa zun'om o, yanam banɛ bɛɛ atɛukʋn la nɛ linɛ bɛɛ ani wʋsa; yanam banɛ ka ku'om giligi ya tɛɛns la nɛ linɛ bɛɛ ani wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na yina wʋʋ zabzabkpi'euŋ nɛ, ka ti'ebid nɛ nimmua tansid agɔla gɔla nwɛ'ɛd zaba kuŋ ka na nyaŋ o dataas la wʋsa.

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Ka ye, “Li yuug ya hali ka m an baanlimm, m anɛ baanlimm ka gban'e m mɛŋi lɛb nya'aŋ. Amaa nannanna, m nwɛnɛ pu'a kanɛ bɔɔd biig du'ab, m kaasid agɔla kirid ka vʋ'ʋsidi pʋ paada.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: M na san'am zuoya nɛ kʋkʋna la wʋsa ka kɛ ka ba tiis nɛ mɔɔd wʋsa kʋdig; M na kɛ ka kɔldaad la lieb pipiris ka kɛ ka bɛɛnna la kʋdig.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: M na mɔr zʋnzɔɔs la dɔlis suokanɛ ka ba zi', suobanɛ ka ba pʋ miilim la m na dɔlisi ba; M na kɛ ka lik linɛ bɛɛ ba tuon la lieb nɛɛsim ka kɛ ka suobanɛ ka' sʋm la lieb sassi. Nɛ'ɛnam ka m ye m tʋm; M kʋ tami ba yɛlaa.

english_verse: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ niŋ bada yadda, ka nɔk linɛ ka ba maal la yɛl ye, ‘Ya anɛ ti wina la,’ ba na di nyan tita'ar.” Israel dim anɛ tʋbkpida nɛ zʋnzɔɔs

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: “Wʋmmi, yanam banɛ an tʋbkpida la; Gɔsimi, yanam banɛ an zʋnzɔɔs la, ka nyɛ!

english_verse: who sees and hears so much, but pays no attention.
translation_verse: Fʋ nyɛ si'elnam bɛdegʋ amaa fʋ pʋ kɛligɛ; fʋ tʋba yɔ'ɔg ya, amaa fʋ pʋ wʋm si'ela.”

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Li malis Zugsɔb la o pʋpielim la zug o na kɛ ka o wada la kpi'em ka mɔr girima.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Amaa nidib nwa' anɛ banɛ ka ba fan' ka zuu ba, ba ludi ba wʋsa nɛ bʋmbu'adin bɛɛ kpɛn'ɛsi ba sanrega ni ka sɔ' kae na faaɛn baa; sɔ' mɛ kae na yɛl ye, “Lɛbisimini baa.”

english_verse: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ nɔk Jakob n tis ka ba faand o, ka kɛ ka Israel an onɛ ka ba faanda? Li ka'anɛ Zugsɔb onɛ ka ti tʋm o taal laa? Ban pʋ dɔlisid o suoya ka pʋ siak o wada la zug.

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Ala ka o kpa'ae o sʋnpɛɛn linɛ an zabbɛ'og la yɛɛli ba, ka li diti ba wʋʋ bugum pielim nɛ, la'an nɛ wala ba pʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ. Li kanbidi ba, amaa ka ba la'am pʋ su'unida.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', O Jakob yaas banɛ ka m maalɛ, O Israel dim banɛ ka m ya'abɛ: “Da zɔti dabiem ka manɛ faaɛn ya; m buonnɛ ya nɛ ya yʋda yinne-yinne; ya anɛ man din.

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ken ku'omin m na bɛ nɛ ya, ya ya'a lɔ'ɔŋid kɔldaad, ku'om la kʋ dii ya, ya ya'a ken bugumin, bugum la kʋ dii ya; bugum pielim la kʋ la'aŋi yaa.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb, Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la, ka manɛ aan ya Faangid; M nɔk Egipt n tiaki ya yɔlisim yɛla ka nɔk Kus dinɛ bɛ Nail kɔldaug zugin la pɛ'ɛs Seba teŋ la zi'eli ya yɛla.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ an sʋm ka mɔr girima nɛ na'asi m tuon la zug, nɛ mam mɛ nɔŋi ya la zug, m na nɔk saalibi tiaki zi'eli ya yɛla, ka nɔk nidibi tiaki ya nyɔvʋya zug.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: Da zɔti dabiem, ka m bɛ nɛ ya; M na mɔri ya biis banɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ la na ka la'as banɛ bɛ ya-tuona la na.

english_verse: I will say to the north and to the south, “Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.
translation_verse: M na yɛl banɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ la ye, ‘Basimini ba!’ Ka yɛl banɛ bɛ ya-dagɔbʋg la ye, ‘Da vi'ini ba.’ Mɔrini m biribis banɛ bɛ lalli la na nɛ m bipumis banɛ bɛ teŋ-magbinnin la na.

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: Banɛ an man mɛŋ nidib, ka m maali ba ye m yʋ'ʋr nyɛ na'asi ka ya'abi ba nɛ m mɛŋ-mɛŋ nu'ug.”

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Gaadimi tuon ka banɛ mɔr nini ka pʋ nyɛt la, nɛ banɛ mɔr tʋba ka pʋ wʋm la, dɔlli ya.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns la wʋsa la'as nɛ taaba ka buudi wʋsa mɛ la'as. Ba teŋgbana la na tun'e yɛl linɛ na niŋ bɛogɔ? Bɛɛ ba nyaŋi nie linɛ maan nannanna la pa'alɛ? Kɛl ka ba mɔri ba kasɛtib na ka ba di kasɛt ye ba din dɔl suor, ka banɛ kpɛlim la wʋm ka yɛl ye, “Li anɛ sida.”

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Ya anɛ m kasɛtib nɛ m tʋmtʋm banɛ ka m gaŋ, ala ka ya na baŋ ka niŋim yadda ka baŋ ye li anɛ manɛ la. Win si'a kae da bɛ ka man nan kae bɛɛ na ti bɛ man tuonnɛ.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: Mam ma'aa an Zugsɔb la; li ya'a ka' manɛ, faangid lɛn kae.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Manɛ nie pa'al linɛ na niŋ ka lɛn faaɛn ya; li anɛ man ka ka' win si'a bɛɛ ya sʋʋginɛ tʋmmi lii. Ya anɛ m kasɛtib.” Zugsɔb la pian' li, ka yɛl ye, “M anɛ Wina'am.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: Ɛɛn, manɛ la, kʋdimin sa m da pʋn bɛ nɛ. Sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ya m nu'uginɛ. M ya'a duoe zi'enɛ, anɔ'ɔn na vi' m suorɛ?” Wina'am nimbaanlzɔɔr nɛ Israel sida ka'alim

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Faangid, Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la, yɛl si'eli nwa': “Yanam zug, m na tʋm Babilon n gban'e teŋ la nidib wʋsa niŋi ba anrimbanɛ ka ba mɔri nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg la ni.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Manɛ an Zugsɔb, onɛ an Kasi tisi ya la, Manɛ maal Israel, ka mɛ aan ya na'ab.”

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa'; on onɛ maal suor atɛukʋn ka maal suobugiri dɔl ku'otitada banɛ pʋbid nɛ paŋ la pɔɔgin la.

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: Onɛ da mɔr zabzabidib nɛ ba widi tɛrekonam la keŋ san'ami ba nyain ka ba digi ka kʋ nyaŋi duoe ya'asɛ. Ba nwɛnɛ fitir laŋʋ ka ba kpiisi li bugum ka li kʋ lɛn nyaŋi la'aŋɛ.

english_verse: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
translation_verse: Tammi yɛlkʋda la; da dɔl kʋdimin sa yɛlaa ka saŋkan gaadya nɛ li waad!

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, m maannɛ bʋmpaal! Nannanna li yit na, fʋ pʋ nyɛɛ lii? M maannɛ suor sian'arin ka kɛ ka ku'om pʋbid pipirisin.

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Sian'arin bʋnkɔnbid na'asid mam, la'an nɛ kunduna nɛ viid wʋsa; bɔzugɔ manɛ kɛ ka ku'om tansi yi pipirigin na ye nimbanɛ ka m gaŋ la nyɛ ku'om nu.

english_verse: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
translation_verse: Nimban la ka m maal ye ba pian'am m yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: “La'an nɛ wala Jakob, fʋ pʋ sɔsidi ma, Israel, man yɛla pʋ mu'oe fʋ nifɔ.

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋ mɔr pɛ'ɛs na maal nyu'or maannɛ tisi ma, bɛɛ na'asi m nɛ maana. M pʋ mugusif ye fʋ maal zʋʋd maana, ka mɛ pʋ kɛ ka fʋ gɛn nɛ bʋnnyubisa nyu'orɛ.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋ da' bʋnnyubisa linɛ nyu'od la tisi ma, bɛɛ fʋ piinim kɔnbbanɛ ka fʋ maan maana la kpaam. Amaa fʋ kɛ ka m gɛn nɛ fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka mɛ kɛ ka li wʋmim nɛ fʋn pʋ di'edi m nɔɔr la zug.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala m mɛŋi mɔr suguru piedi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la mam mɛŋ zug, ka kʋ lɛn tiɛndi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛlaa.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: Tiɛnm linɛ gaad la yɛla, kɛl ka ti la'asi zin'ini tu'asi li yɛla; ka ya pa'alimi ya buudi zem si'em.

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Ya yiiga yaanam la da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd; ka ya tuongatib la zan'asi m nɔɔr.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: M na diisi ya pʋ'ʋsim dɔɔg tuongatib la nyan, ka kɛ ka Jakob nyɛ san'auŋ, ka kɛ ka Israel yʋ'ʋr san'am.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb la yɛl ye; “Jakob yaasɛ, kɛlisimi, ya anɛ man tʋmtʋmnib, manɛ gaŋ Israel.

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ maalif ka ya'abi fʋ niŋi fʋ ma pʋʋgin, ka an onɛ na sʋ'ʋŋif. M tʋmtʋm Jakob, da zɔt dabiem, fʋnɛ an onɛ ka m gaŋ.

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: M na kpa'ae ku'om niŋ teŋ la zin'ikanɛ ka ku'om kae, ka kɛ ka ku'om pʋbid zin'ikanɛ ka teŋ la an kpi'emis; M na kpa'ae m Siig n niŋi ya biis zug, ka m albareka na bɛɛ tisi ya yaas la.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Ba na nɔbigid tɔ'ɔtɔ wʋʋ mɔɔd nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ tibanɛ bɛ kɔldaug nɔɔrin nɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa'; Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, onɛ an Israel na'ab nɛ ba Faangid. Manɛ an pin'ilʋg ka an naar; li ya'a ka' manɛ, Wina'am lɛn kae.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ nwɛnɛ mam? Li sɔb yim paalʋ na yɛl nyain. Kɛl ka o nie linɛ da niŋ kʋdimin sa nyain pa'alim man da pin'ili maal nidib la, nɛ linɛ na ti niŋ. Ɛɛn, kɛl ka o yɛl linɛ na ti kena.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Da kirida, mɛ da zɔt dabiem. M pʋ mɔɔl nɛ' yɛla ka pian' li yɛla ka li yuugɛɛ? Ya anɛ m kasɛtib. Wina'am si'a lɛm bɛɛ paas man zugɔɔ? Ayei, tampiing lɛn kae, baa yinnee.”

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Banɛ maan bada la wʋsa anɛ zaalim, ka linɛ ka ba gɔs ka li an nyɔɔdi tisi ba la ka' gbinnɛ. Banɛ pian'adi ba yɛla la anɛ zʋnzɔɔs; nyan kanɛ bɛɛ ba zugin la ba zi'.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ kpi'a win ka maal ba'ar linɛ kʋ nyaŋi sʋŋ o?

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: On nɛ o buudi la wʋsa na di nyan; banɛ kpi'ed la ka' si'ela, ba anɛ ninsaalib. Kɛl ka ba wʋsa la'asi yɛli ba zi'esim; dabiem nɛ yʋ'ʋsan'auŋ na paae ba.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Onɛ kʋnt la mɔri tʋʋma laukʋ tʋm, o mɔri lii tʋm nɛ bugumsaana; o mɔri zan'ari kʋnti li, o nu'ug paŋ ka o mɔri tʋm. O kɔ'ɔm ɛɛnti zabid ka o paŋ naae; ku'onuud ya'a nyaŋ o, o na tadig.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Kampinta la mɔr nwiigi makid ka mɔr linɛ makidi zanbinnɛ li bɛn; ka kpi'edi li nɛ lieŋ ka nɔk linɛ makidi pa'annɛ li zemisʋg la makid. O maannɛ li ka li nwɛnɛ nid nɛ, ka o vɛnlim wʋsa nwɛnɛ nid, ka kpɛn'ɛs o teŋgban dɔɔgin.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: O na nwaae na'aziinr, bɛɛ tikanɛ daadi mɔr paŋ. O paamid tiis la nɛ mɔɔgin, bɛɛ o sɛ ka saa ni ka ba nɔbig.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Daad anɛ linɛ ka ninsaal na nɔki nyu'oe bugum; o nɔkid sieba nyu'od bugum ʋʋsid, ka nɔkid sieba nyu'oe bugum sɛn'ɛd bodobodo. Amaa ka lɛn nɔki li maal win ka wɔ'ɔgidi li; o nɔkidi li maan ba'ar ka igini li tuon.

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Linɛ kpɛlim la o na nɔki maal o win bɛɛ ba'ar; ka igini li tuonnɛ na'asi li. O na sɔsi li ka yɛl ye, “Faanmim ka fʋnɛ aan m win!”

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ maan bada nwa' pʋ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr bɛɛ baŋir bɛɛ gban'ad si'el gbin ka na yɛl ye, “M nɔk daug la pʋsʋkʋ nyu'oe bugum; hali ka sɛn' bodobodo li bugumsaana la zug, ka mɛ sɛn' ni'imi anina ɔnbɛ. Wala ka m na lɛn nɔk linɛ kpɛlim la maal ba'arɛ? Li pʋ nar ye m igin daug tuonnɛ pʋ'ʋsɛ.”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ dit tampɛligim gba sɔn o. O pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd la ma'ad o nɛ kpɛn'ɛsid mɔɔg; o kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn o mɛŋ bɛɛ siaki yɛl ye, “Linɛ bɛɛ m datiuŋ nu'ugin nwa' kʋ tun'e an Wina'am.”

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: “Israel nidiba, tɛn'ɛsimi nɛ'ɛnam yɛla, bɔzugɔ ya anɛ man tʋmtʋmnib; m kʋ tami ya yɛlaa.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: M uusi fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋʋ saŋgbana nɛ, fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ nwɛnɛ bɛogʋn mɛligim la. Lɛmmi m san'an na, ka manɛ faanf.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Saŋgbana, yʋ'ʋmmi nɛ sumalisim, Zugsɔb la maal nɛ' la zug; tansiminɛ agɔla yanam banɛ bɛ teŋ teŋir la. Zuoya, yʋ'ʋmmi nɛ sumalisim, nɛ tiis banɛ bɛ sian'arin la wʋsa, Zugsɔb la faaɛn Jakob, o nɔk o na'am la tis Israel. Israel na paam zin'ig

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan fʋ Faangid, ka maali fʋ niŋi fʋ ma pʋʋgin la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ maal si'el wʋsa la, ka tiɛn saŋgbana la yadig, manɛ tɛk teŋgbauŋ la yadigi li m mɛŋ.

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Manɛ kɛt ka ba'abʋgʋdibi yɛt si'el la lieb zaalim ka kɛ ka banɛ ye ba nyɛt bɛog sa yɛla la lieb zɔn, ka yis banɛ zamis hali la ya'am ka kɛ ka li lieb yalimis.

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: Manɛ yɛt ku'okanɛ zulim la ye li kpiɛnm, ka kɛt ka li ku'osuoya kʋdigid.

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: Manɛ yɛl Sarus yɛla ye, ‘O anɛ m kɔnbkem ka na maal linɛ wʋsa an sʋm tisim. O na yɛl Jerusalem yɛla ye, “Kɛl ka li lɛn lɛbi mɛ'!” Ka yɛl Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la ye, “Kɛl ka li ɛɛnbir la ɛɛnb.”’”

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', “M gaŋ Sarus onɛ ka m bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ o zug la, ka gban'e o datiuŋ nu'ugʋ zanl, ye o nyaŋ buudbanɛ bɛɛ o tuon la ka yis na'anamɛ ba na'am gbana zug, ka yɔ'ɔs kʋlʋŋ banɛ bɛɛ o tuon ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi yɔɔ.

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: M na gaadi fʋ tuon ka birig zuoya la; m na kɔ' kʋnt gama nɛ li kʋnt daad la.

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: M na tisif kpan'am wʋsa linɛ su'a likin nɛ zin'ibanɛ an zin'isu'ada la, ala ka fʋ na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la buonif.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: Jakob onɛ aan m tʋmtʋm la zug, Israel onɛ ka m gaŋ la yɛla, ka m buolif ka tisif na'asi la'an nɛ fʋ ba'a kae nɛ man la.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: Manɛ an Zugsɔb la, sɔ' lɛn kae; ya'a ka' mam, Wina'am lɛn kae. M na kpɛmisif, la'an nɛ fʋ ba'a kae nɛ man la,

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: ala ka lin yi winnigi tansid si'eli keŋ paae o liib zin'ig nidib na baŋ ye sɔ' lɛn kae zem nɛ mam. Manɛ an Wina'am ka sɔ' lɛn kae.

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: Manɛ maal nɛɛsim ka maal lik, manɛ maal sumalisim saŋa nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ saŋa; man Zugsɔb la tʋm nɛ' wʋsa.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yanam saŋgbana banɛ bɛ agɔllɛ, niimi pʋpielim wʋʋ saa nɛ; kɛl ka saŋgbana la nii li bas na. Kɛl ka teŋ la yɔ'ɔg yalʋŋʋ, ka faangir yina, ka kɛ ka pʋpielim nɔbig nɛ li.” Man Zugsɔb la maali li.

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Tɔɔg na paae onɛ nwa'asid nɛ onɛ maal o la, o nwɛnɛ ya'ad ka ba ya'abid. Ya'ad na nyaŋi bu'os onɛ ya'abid o la ye, “Fʋ ya'abid bɔɔ?” Fʋn ya'abid si'el la na yɛl ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ pʋ maali m nu'usɛ”?

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Tɔɔg na paae onɛ yɛl o ba' ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ du'am ka m aan nwa',” bɛɛ o yɛl o ma ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ du'adi ma?”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ maal Israel ka aan o Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la yɛl si'eli nwa' dinɛ na ti kena la yɛla: “Fʋ aan anɔ'ɔnɛ bu'osid mam m biis yɛla? Bɛɛ pa'annim dinɛ nar ye m maalɛ?

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Manɛ maal teŋgbauŋ la ka maal ninsaali niŋi li zug. Mam mɛŋ nu'us ka m yadig saŋgbana la; nɛ nwadbibis banɛ bɛɛ li ni la.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: M na dʋ'ʋs Sarus nɛ m pʋpielim la: M na kɛ ka o suoya wʋsa an sappi. O na lɛbisi mɛɛ m tempʋʋg la ka tisim nimbanɛ ka ba gban'e ba la yɔlisim, amaa li ka' ye ba yɔ o ligidi bɛɛ tis o si'ela, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl.”

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Egipt la'ad nɛ Kus dim banɛ kpiisid la nɛ Sabɛa dim banɛ wa'am la, ba na kɛɛn ya san'an na ka na aan ya din. Ba na dɔlli ya nya'aŋi ken bi'el-bi'el baans banɛ lɔɔ ba la zug. Ba na igini ya tuon ka sɔsid suguru yɛt ye, ‘Sida Wina'am sid bɛ nɛ ya; win lɛn kae zin'isi'a.’”

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Sida fʋ anɛ Wina'am kanɛ su'a fʋ mɛŋ, fʋn Wina'am onɛ an Israel dim Faangid la.

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Banɛ maan bada la wʋsa na di nyan; ba na la'asi keŋ nɛ nyan.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la na faaɛn Israel dim ka li anɛ faangir linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ; ya kʋ maligin di nyan saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', on kanɛ maal agɔl la onɛ an Wina'am. Onɛ maal teŋgbauŋ, ka li zi'e sʋ'ʋŋa; o pʋ maali li ka li an zaalim, amaa ka maali li ka nidib bɛɛ li ni. O yɛl ye, “Manɛ an Zugsɔb la, ka sɔ' lɛn kae.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: M pʋ su'a pian' li zin'ikanɛ an lika; M pʋ yɛl Jakob yaas la ye, ‘Ya na ieem ka kʋ nyɛɛ ma.’ Man Zugsɔb la pian'ad nɛ asida; linɛ dɔl suor la ka m yɛt nyain.

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: La'asimi taaba kena; la'asimi, yanam banɛ zɔɔ widigi kpɛn' teŋ sieba la. Zi'ilim dim la ken ka ziid bada banɛ ka ba zaŋ daadi maal, ka pʋ'ʋsid wina banɛ kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn baa.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Li'elimi na tu'asini ya antu'a la, kɛl ka ba la'asi nwɛ' taaba sɔɔra. Anɔ'ɔnɛ dɛŋi yɛl nɛ' yɛla, anɔ'ɔnɛ dɛŋi yɛl ka li saŋa yuugɛ? Li ka'anɛ man Zugsɔb laa? Wina'am si'a lɛn kae ya'a ka' mam, Wina'am kanɛ an pʋpiel ka an Faangid la; sɔ' lɛn kae asɛɛ mam ma'aa.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: Lɛmmini m san'an na ka paam faangir, yanam banɛ bɛ teŋ-magbinnin sa la; manɛ an Wina'am ka sɔ' lɛn kae.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: M mɛŋ nɔɔr ka m pɔɔ zi'el nɛ kpi'euŋ, li anɛ pian'ʋk linɛ kʋ lɛb nya'aŋa: Nidib wʋsa na igin man tuon; ka zilima wʋsa di kasɛti m yɛla.

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: Ba na yɛlim yɛla ye, ‘Zugsɔb la ni ma'aa ka pʋpielim nɛ paŋ bɛ.’” Banɛ wʋsa duoe zi'e o yɛla la na kɛɛn o san'an na ka o diisi ba nyan.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la na tis Israel yaas la bʋʋd ka kɛ ka ba nyɛ pʋpielim ka dʋ'ʋs o yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: Bel nɛ Nebo banɛ an Babilon bada banɛ ka bʋnkɔnbid ziidi ba la na vanbin teŋin. Li anɛ gɛɛnlisi tis bʋnkɔnbid banɛ ziidi ba nɛ banɛ maannɛ ba la.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Bada nwa' wʋsa na igin teŋin, ba kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ba mɛŋa, amaa ba na zii ba keŋ sankpan'asimin.

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi, Jakob yidima, yanam banɛ kpɛlim Israel yin la wʋsa, yanam banɛ ka m guri ya sʋ'ʋŋa saŋkanɛ ka ba da nan kpɛn'ɛdi ya pʋʋg ka mɔri ya lin yii ya du'am saŋa sa la.

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: Manɛ aan ya Wina'am ka na guri ya ka ya ti kʋdig ka ya zut pɛlig. Manɛ la, manɛ na nyaŋi sʋŋi ya. Manɛ maali ya ka na gɔsidi ya; M na guri ya ka faaɛn ya.

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Sieba kpa'ae sanlima ligidi yisi ba kɔlʋgin na ka nɔk anzurifa maki li tɛbisim; ka yɔ banɛ tʋm sanlima tʋʋma la ye ba nɔki maal ba'ari tisi ba, ka iginid teŋin zun'odi li.

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Ba bukidnɛ ba'ar la ba biankimpiiung zug; ka mɔri keŋ ba'a li zi'eli li zi'esigin, ka li zi'e ani. Li zi'egi la, li kʋ nyaŋi vurigɛ. Baa sɔ' ya'a buonnɛ li, li kʋ siakɛ; li kʋ nyaŋi yis o yɛla pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: Tɛnri dina, yanam banɛ an ki'isʋg dim nwa', niŋimini li ya sʋʋnrin.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsimi bʋn linɛ da niŋ saŋa kanɛ gaad la yɛla; Manɛ an Wina'am, sɔ' lɛn kae; Manɛ an Wina'am ka sɔ' lɛn kae nwɛnɛ mam.

english_verse: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
translation_verse: Pin'ilʋgʋn sa, ka m pa'ali ya naari na ti an si'em. Kʋdimin sa ka m pa'al linɛ na ti kena. M yɛl ye, ‘Mam bɔɔdim na zi'en, ka m na maal linɛ malisim.’

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: M buol dau sɔ' ka o na yi ya-nya'aŋ na; o na kena nwɛnɛ silʋg nɛ tʋm mam bɔɔd si'el. Man yɛl si'el la, dinɛ na niŋ; man gban'e si'el la, dinɛ na tʋm.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi, yanam tʋbzian'asim dim banɛ lal nɛ pʋpielim la.

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: M mɔri m pʋpielim la li'el na, li pʋ lalla; ka m faangir la kʋ lɛn yuugɛ. M na tis Zion faangir, ka Israel mɛ na nyɛ m vɛnlim.”

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: “Babilon pu'ayua, sigim teŋin, zin'inim uusʋgin, zin'inim teŋin, fʋ kʋ nyɛ na'am gbauŋʋ zin'inɛ. Ba kʋ lɛm buonif ye girima sɔb bɛɛ onɛ vɛnla.

english_verse: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
translation_verse: Nɔkim nɛɛri nɛɛm zɔ'ɔm; yisimi fʋ bɔbig la. Dʋ'ʋsimi fʋ fuug la ka kɛɛ fʋ nɔba la zaalim lɔ'ɔŋ kɔlis la.

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Ba na nyɛɛ fʋ sanwɛɛr ka fʋ nyan yi paalʋ. M na yɔ sam; ka kʋ bas baa nid yinnee.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Onɛ aan ti Faangid nɛ ti Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, o yʋ'ʋri an Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: “Babilon dim pu'ayua, zin'inim likin baanlimm, ba kʋ lɛm buonif ye, tɛɛns pu'ana'aba.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: M sʋnf da pɛlig nɛ m nidib la ka m niŋi ba wʋʋ ba ka' m dinnɛ; m nɔki ba niŋi fʋ nu'usin, ka fʋ pʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanliga. Hali la'an nɛ banɛ kʋdig la, ya nɔk zitɛbisa ziili ba.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: Fʋ tɛn'ɛsi fʋ pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye, ‘M na kpɛn an pu'ana'ab saŋa wʋsa!’ Amaa fʋ pʋ tɛn'ɛs nɛ'ɛnam yɛla bɛɛ linɛ na ti niŋɛ.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Nannanna kɛlisim sʋ'ʋŋa, fʋn kanɛ tʋmmi fʋ ya'amlɛog bɔɔdim, ka tɛn'ɛs ye si'el-si'el kʋ niŋi fɔ, ka yɛt ye, ‘Manɛ bɛ ka sɔ' lɛn kae paae mam. Mam kʋdim kʋ lieb pʋkɔɔnr bɛɛ m biis kpi ka kɛɛ ma.’

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: Fʋ ti'enɛ bugusim tʋʋma ma'aa, ka yɛl ye, ‘Sɔ' pʋ nyɛti ma.’ Fʋ ya'am nɛ fʋ baŋir la bɔdisif nɛ. Lin ka fʋ yɛti fʋ mɛŋ ye, ‘Manɛ bɛ ka sɔ' lɛn ka' paam la.’

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: Kem tuon, nɛ fʋn nyalimid nidib si'em nɛ fʋ sɔnpʋt nɛ fʋ ba'akɔlʋg tʋʋma linɛ ka fʋ mɔri tʋmmi fʋ biilimin sa la. Daasi'erɛ fʋ na nyaŋi nɔki li kpɛn'ɛs nidib dabiem.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Sa'al banɛ ka ba tisif la wʋsa gɛɛnsif nɛ! Kɛl ka fʋ nimbanɛ zamis nwadbibis yɛla la yi tuon na. Ban banɛ yɛt linɛ saa na maal bɛog sa la. Fʋ nimbanɛ gɔsid nwadbibis ka yɛtif linɛ na maal bɛog sa nwadig-nwadig wʋsa la, kɛl ka ba faaɛn fʋ yis bʋn linɛ kennɛ fʋ zugin na la.

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Sida ba nwɛnɛ kikan'a nɛ ka bugum dii ba. Hali ba kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ba mɛŋ bugum tita'ar la pʋʋginɛ. Li ka' bugumsaana ka sɔ' na ʋʋs, bɛɛ zin'inɛ kpi'enɛ.

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋm nɛ nimbama nwa', ka ba bɛ nɛf hali fʋ biilimin sa amaa ba kʋ nyaŋi sʋŋi fɔ. Ba wʋsa na keŋi ba ken zin'ig; ka baa yinne kʋ kpɛlim faaɛn fɔ.”

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi nɛ', Jakob yidima, yanam banɛ ka ba mɔr Israel yʋ'ʋri buonnɛ ya ka ya yi Juda gbinnin na la, yanam banɛ pɔɔd nɛ Zugsɔb yʋ'ʋr, ka ye ya dɔlnɛ Israel Wina'am amaa ka li ka' sida la.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ buoli ya mɛŋ ye ya anɛ tempʋkanɛ an kasi nidib ka ti'e Israel Wina'am la. Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la aan o yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: “M dɛŋi yɛl linɛ an kʋdimin yɛla ka li yuug, m nɔɔr mɔɔli li ka pa'ali li nyain; m tʋmi li vuguri, ka kɛ ka li maal.

english_verse: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, “The idols we worship did this.”
translation_verse: Alazug ka m yɛli ya nɛ'ɛnam kʋdimin sa la; m mɔɔli li yɛla tisi ya ka li nam pʋ maalɛ; ala ka ya kʋ yɛl ye, ‘Ti bada la maali ba,’ bɛɛ ‘Ti daad nɛ ti kʋnt wina la niŋi li.’

english_verse: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
translation_verse: Ya wʋm nɛ'ɛnam yɛla; yʋ'ʋn gɔsimini ba. Ya kʋ siakɛɛ? Lin yi nannanna wa'ae sa m na yɛli ya yɛlpaala banɛ su'a ka ya pʋ baŋ la.

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: Yanam pʋ wʋm bɛɛ gban'e li gbinnɛ; hali kʋdimin sa ya tʋba nam pʋ yɔ'ɔgɛ. M mi' ya sʋ'ʋŋa ye ya anɛ banɛ ka ya pʋʋg pʋ paada; ya biilimin sa ya anɛ banɛ pʋ siakida.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: Mam pʋ bɔɔd ye m yʋ'ʋr san'am la zug ka m gu'usid nɛ m sʋnpɛɛn la; m mɛŋ yʋ'ʋsʋŋ zug, m kʋ kɛ ka li kɛɛn ya san'an na, san'ami ya.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, m maki ya nɛ namisʋg linɛ nwɛnɛ bugum, ka nwɛnɛ anzurifa ka ba nyɛligidi siligid si'em la.

english_verse: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
translation_verse: Mam mɛŋ zug, ka m niŋ nɛ'. M na niŋ wala kɛ ka m mɛŋ yʋ'ʋr nyɛ zɛrigirɛ? M kʋ nɔki m na'asi la tis sɔ'ɔɔ.” Israel nyɛ yɔlisim

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: “Kɛlisima, O Jakob Israel onɛ ka m buol la: Manɛ la, manɛ an pin'ilʋg ka an naar.

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Mam mɛŋ nu'ug ka m ɛɛnb dunia la, ka m datiuŋ nu'ug yadig saŋgbana la; m ya'a buoli ba, ba wʋsa la'asid nɛ duoe zi'en.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: Ya wʋsa la'asim taaba na ka kɛlis. Ba'akanɛ san'anɛ dɛŋi yɛli ya nɛ'ɛnam yɛla? Zugsɔb la gaŋ sɔ' la na niŋ nwɛnɛ on gban'e ye o niŋ Babilon dim si'em la. O nu'ukanɛ mɔr paŋ la na zab nɛ Babilon.

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Mam mɛŋ mɛŋi pian'; ɛɛn, manɛ buol o. M na mɔr o na, ka o na nyaŋi tʋm o tʋʋma sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: “Li'elimi m san'an na, ka kɛlis nɛ'ɛŋa: “M yiiga mɔɔlʋg la, m pʋ su'a pian'; ka lin maal saŋsi'a la, m bɛɛ ani mɛn.” Ka nannanna Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, tʋmim nɛ o Siig la.

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel dim Faangid ka an Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi la yɛl si'em nwa': “Manɛ an fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ pa'anif linɛ an sʋm, ka pa'anif suokanɛ ka fʋ na ken.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a kɛlisini m nɔzi'ela la, fʋ sumbʋgʋsʋm na pʋbid nwɛnɛ kɔldaug ku'om nɛ, ka fʋ pʋpielim nwɛnɛ atɛuk ku'opila nɛ.

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: Fʋ yaas la na zu'oe wʋʋ titanbin'isʋg nɛ, ka fʋ biis na nwɛnɛ tanbin'isbʋʋlʋg nɛ; ba yʋ'ʋr ka' linɛ na bɔdigɛ bɛɛ li san'am mam san'anɛ.”

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Basim Babilon, zɔm yi Babilon dim san'an! Mɔɔlim agɔla gɔla nɛ sumalisim ka yɛli li yɛla. Kɛl ka labaar la paae teŋ-magbinnin; yɛlim ye, “Zugsɔb la faaɛn o tʋmtʋm Jakob.”

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: On da mɔri ba ken sian'arin la, ku'onuud da pʋ gban'e baa. O da kɛ ka ku'om yi tampiingin na ka ba nu; o da buak tampiing la, ka ku'om yina.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Bugusim dim kʋ maligin nyɛ sumalisim.”

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi yanam banɛ ka ku'om giligi ya tɛɛns la; wʋmmi nɛ'ɛŋa, yanam tɛɛns banɛ bɛ lalli la: Zugsɔb la da buolim ka ba nam pʋ du'a ma; m du'am saŋa ka o pʋd o m yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: O kɛ ka m nɔɔr pian'ad dit nwɛnɛ zaba sʋ'ʋg nɛ, ka zaŋimi su'a o nu'ug pʋʋgin. O maalim ka m pʋlim nwɛnɛ piim nɛ; ka nɔkimi suu o lɔkin.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: O yɛlim ye, “Israel, fʋ anɛ m tʋmtʋm, di na yinɛ fʋ ni ka nidib dʋ'ʋsi m yʋ'ʋr.”

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Amaa ka m yɛl ye, “Man gɛɛnlis la ka' gbinnɛ; M san'ami m paŋ zaalim ka si'el-si'el kae. Nɛ wala, linɛ nar nɛ man la bɛ nɛ Zugsɔb la nu'ugin, ka m yɔɔd bɛɛ m Wina'am san'an.”

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Nannanna Zugsɔb la pian' tisim; o anɛ onɛ maalimi niŋi m ma pʋʋgin ye m aan o tʋmtʋm, ka mɔr Jakob n lɛb o san'an na, ka la'as Israel dim banɛ widig la o mɛŋ san'an. Zugsɔb la tisim na'asi m Wina'am la aan m paŋ.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: O yɛlim ye, “Fʋ kʋ aan m tʋmtʋm ma'aanɛ, ye fʋ kɛ ka Jakob buudi la ma'aa lɛbi m san'an na ka mɔr Israel dim banɛ kpɛlim la lɛbis na, amaa m mɛ na kɛ ka fʋ an nɛɛsim tis banɛ ka' Israel dim buudi la, ka kɛ ka ba baŋ Wina'am yɛla nyain. Ala ka fʋ na mɔri m faangir la paae dunia bɛn wʋsa.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Faangid ka an Kasi tis Israel la yɛt onɛ ka buudi wʋsa da nɛ'ɛs ka kis o la, on onɛ an tʋmtʋmi tis na'anam la; yɛl si'eli nwa' ye: “Na'anam na nyɛɛf ka duoe zi'en, ka kpi'emnam mɛ nyɛɛf ka igin teŋin, ka li anɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an sida sɔb la zug onɛ an Kasi tis Israel kanɛ ka o gaŋ la.” Israel dim na lɛbi ba zin'igin

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Saŋkanɛ ka m na zɔɔ ya nyɔɔg la ya'a ti paae, m na di'e ya winsɔsʋg, ka na sʋŋi ya m faangir daar la; m na guri ya ka maali ya ka li na yinɛ ya san'an na ka m na maal nɔnaar nɛ nidib wʋsa, ka kɛ ka teŋ la lɛbi digin wʋʋ lin daa an si'em la, ka nidib lɛbi zin'inɛ ba teŋ kanɛ daa lieb dabɔɔd la.

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: Ka yɛl banɛ ka ba gban'e ba ka ba an yammis la ye, ‘Yimi na,’ ka yɛl banɛ bɛ likin la ye, ‘Yimi nɛɛsimin na!’ Ba na nwɛnɛ kɔnbidi ɔnbid suoya nɔɔrin. Hali baa pipirisi nɛ, ba na nyɛ diibi di.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Kɔ'ɔm bɛɛ ku'onuud kʋ gban'e ba, ka nintaŋ tʋʋlʋg kʋ wʋmi baa. Onɛ zɔti ba nimbaanlig la na guri ba, ka na dɔlli ba keŋ ku'om bun zin'isi'a.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka m zuoya la wʋsa lieb suoya, ka na dʋ'ʋsi m suoraad la.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Gɔsima, ba na yi lalli kena; sieba na yi datiuŋ na ka sieba yi ya-tuona na, ka sieba yi Ason sʋ'ʋlimin na.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Saŋgbana, tansimi nɛ sumalisim; teŋgbauŋɔ, maalim sumalisim; zuoya, yʋ'ʋmmi nɛ sumalisim! Zugsɔb la bʋgʋnnɛ o nidib sʋnya ka na zɔt banɛ namisid la nimbaanlig.”

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Amaa Zion teŋ la yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la bas mam nɛ, Zugsɔb la tam mam yɛla nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛbis ye, “Pu'a na tam o bikanɛ nam mu'ad yɛllɛɛ? O kʋ zɔɔ o bikanɛ ka o du'a la nimbaanligaa? Hali o ya'a na tam, man lɛɛ kʋ tami fʋ yɛllɛ!

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Gɔsima, Jerusalem, m sɔbi fʋ yʋ'ʋri niŋi m nu'usin; m kʋ tami fʋ yɛla baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: Fʋ biis na lɛbi fʋ san'an tɔ'ɔtɔ na, ka banɛ san'amif la zɔ ka basif.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Ʋkimi fʋ nindaa gɔsi gilig; fʋ biis la wʋsa la'asidi fʋ san'an na.” Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Sida-sida, fʋ na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg nɛ fʋ nidib la yɛla; ba na nwɛnɛ pu'apaali na yɛ fuvɛnla nɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ teŋ la lieb dabɔɔd ka nid baa yinne kae ka teŋ la dig zaalim la, nannanna li na pɔɔdi tisi fʋ nidib la, ka fʋ bi'emnam banɛ san'ami li la na lalig sa ka basif.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Bibanɛ ka fʋ daa du'a fʋ sʋnsa'aŋ saŋa la na yɛli fʋ tʋba ni ye, ‘Zin'ikaŋa pɔɔdi tisi ti; tisimi ti paalʋ linɛ zu'oe ka ti bɛɛ ani.’

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Ka fʋ na yɛli fʋ sʋnfʋn ye, ‘Anɔ'ɔnɛ du'a bama tisi ma? M daa mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ ka pʋ lɛm mɔr biiga; ba daa mɔrimi lɔ'ɔŋ teŋ ka zan'asim. Anɔ'ɔnɛ ugusi ba? M daa kpɛlim nɛ m kɔn'ɔkɔn', amaa gɔsima, bibama wʋsa yi yaanɛ na?’”

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Gɔsima, m na buol banɛ ka' Israel dim la, ka yɛl dunia nidib wʋsa ye ba mɔri fʋ biribis la ba nu'usin na ka buki fʋ pu'ayuos la mɔr na.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Na'anamɛ na liebi fʋ saamnam, ka ba pu'ab mu'asidi fʋ biis. Ba na igini fʋ tuon ka tisif girima; ba na sigisi ba mɛŋi fʋ tuon ka na'asif. Ala ka fʋ na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la; banɛ nɔki ba ti'iri niŋi m ni la kʋ di nyannɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Ɛɛn, ba na faaɛn banɛ ka ba gban'e ba la zabzabidib la nu'usin, ka di'e la'abanɛ ka zabzabidib la faaɛn la. M na zab nɛ banɛ zabid nɛf la ka fʋ biis na nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka banɛ mugusidif la ɔnbi ba mɛŋ niŋgbiŋ; ba na nuu ba mɛŋ ziim, wʋʋ daam nɛ. Ala ka nidib na baŋ ye, man Zugsɔb la anɛ Faangid, ya Faangid la anɛ Paŋtita'ar Sɔbi tis Jakob.”

english_verse: I came and called out, but you didn't answer. Have I lost my power to rescue and save? At my command oceans and rivers turn into deserts; fish rot and stink for lack of water.
translation_verse: Man kɛɛn na la, bɔ ka sɔ'ɔsɔ ka'anɛ? Ka man buol la, bɔ ka sɔ' pʋ siakɛ? Anɛ m nu'ugʋ gim hali galis nɛ mam na nyaŋi faaɛn yaa? Bɛɛ m paŋi pɔɔd nɛ mam na yisi ya? M pian'ʋk bi'ela da kɛ ka atɛuk kpiɛn kʋdig, ka m kɛ ka kɔldaad lieb pipiris; ka zimi la kpi nɛ ku'onuud ka pun'oe.

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Mam pil saŋgbana la nɛ lik, wʋʋ sʋnsa'aŋ dimi yɛ fusabila si'em la.”

english_verse: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la tisim baŋir ka m na nyaŋi pian', ka pian'ad linɛ na kpɛ'ɛŋ banɛ tadig la. O niedim bɛkɛung wʋsa, o yɔ'ɔgidi m tʋba ka m kɛlisid wʋʋ onɛ ka ba pa'an.

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɔ'ɔgi m tʋba ka m pʋ zan'asɛ; M pʋ bid o kudigɔ.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: M basim nya'aŋi tis banɛ bʋ'ʋdim la, ka basim tieŋgu'ori tis banɛ vɔɔndim tieŋ la; m pʋ su'a m nindaa nɛ banɛ la'adim ka tʋbisid nintɔɔndi niŋidim la.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la sʋŋidim la zug, m kʋ di nyannɛ. Alazug ka m mɔdigid, ka mi' ye nyan kʋ dii ma.

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la sʋŋid mam la, anɔ'ɔnɛ na kʋʋs man yɛla bɛ'ɛdɛ? Ba wʋsa na aans nwɛnɛ fuud ka muak mu'a ba.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin zɔt Zugsɔb la ka siakid o tʋmtʋm nɔɔr pian'adɛ? Onɛ ken likin ka pʋ mɔr nɛɛsim la, kɛl ka o niŋ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr yadda ka nɔk o ti'iri niŋ o Wina'am la san'an.

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna, yanam banɛ mɔ'ɔsid bugum ka nyɔ'ɔdi ya mɛŋ bugum la, kemini ya mɛŋ nɛɛsimin la, amaa baŋimi ye yanamɛ na di'e si'eli nwa': ya na dig nɛ namisʋg.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
translation_verse: “Kɛlisimi, yanam banɛ bɔɔd pʋpielim ka ieed Zugsɔb la. Tɛn'ɛsimi tampinkanɛ ni ka ba kpi'e ya yis na la nɛ kugkanɛ ka ba ki'e yisi ya la.

english_verse: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsimi Abraham onɛ aan ya yaab la nɛ Sara onɛ du'a ya la yɛla. Man da buol Abraham la ka o anɛ o kɔn'ɔkɔn', ka m niŋ o albareka ka kɛ ka o nɔbig.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na bʋgʋl Zion sʋnf ka zɔɔ o nimbaanlig san'auŋ linɛ paae o la zug; o na maal o pipiris zin'ig la ka li nwɛnɛ Eden teŋ vɛnliŋ la nɛ. O na nɔk o zin'ikanɛ pʋ maan si'el-si'el la ka kɛ ka li lieb wʋʋ Zugsɔb lɔmbɔn'ɔg la nɛ. Sumalisim na bɛɛ o san'an, li na an bareka pʋ'ʋsim nɛ yʋ'ʋma ma'aa.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: M nidiba, kɛlisimi; yanam banɛ aan m buudi la, wʋmmi! M na nɔki m wada la tis tɛɛns la wʋsa; ka m sida la na lieb nɛɛsim tisi ba.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: M pʋpielim la li'en tɔ'ɔtɔ na, ka m faangir la bɛ suor. M paŋ la na mɔr yɛlsida kɛn buudi wʋsa ni na. Tɛɛns banɛ ka ku'om gilig la na gɔsid mam ka mɔr ti'ir ye m paŋ la na faaɛn ba.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Gɔdigim gɔs agɔla ka su'uni gɔs teŋin. Saŋgbana la na mɛlim nwɛnɛ nyɔ'ɔs nɛ, ka teŋgbauŋ la aaɛn wʋʋ kparikɛɛnd nɛ ka nidib la kpi nwɛnɛ pʋmpɔɔs nɛ. Amaa m faangir la na bɛ saŋa wʋsa, ka m pʋpielim la kʋ gʋ'ʋŋɛ.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: Wʋmmi, yanam banɛ mi' linɛ dɔl suor la, yanam banɛ mɔri m wada la ya sʋnya ni la: Da kɛ ka nidib zɛrigir paki yaa bɛɛ zɔti ba tʋ'ʋd la.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Muak na mu'a ba wʋʋ fuug nɛ; zʋnzʋnya na dii ba wʋsa. Amaa m pʋpielim la na bɛ saŋa wʋsa, m faangir na paae zʋmaana wʋsa.”

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: Duom, duom! Zi'enim nɛ paŋ! Zugsɔba, pa'alimi fʋ paŋ! Duom, nwɛnɛ dabisbanɛ gaad la, nwɛnɛ zʋmaʋŋ kʋdig saŋa la. Ka' fʋnɛ da kie Rahab n zɔri zɔr ka kʋns bʋnzɔtir linɛ bɛ ku'otita'arin la tɔligɛɛ?

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: Ka' fʋnɛ da kɛ ka atɛuk la ku'om kpiɛn ka ku'ozulima kʋdigɛɛ? Ka maal suor atɛuk zulʋŋ pɔɔgin ye banɛ ka fʋ faaɛn la dɔlli gaadɛɛ?

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Nannanna banɛ ka Zugsɔb faaɛn ba la na lɛb na. Ba na yʋʋm kpɛn' Zion tempʋʋgin; ba na mɔr sumalisim linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Ba sumalisim na tʋʋgi li bɛn, sʋnsa'aŋ na gaad ka basi ba.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: “Mam mɛŋi bʋgʋnnɛ ya sʋnya. Bɔzug ka ya zɔt ninsaalib banɛ nwɛnɛ mɔɔd ka pʋ yuugid la?

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: Bɔzug ka ya tam Zugsɔb onɛ maali ya ka tiɛn saŋgbana ka ɛɛnb dunia ɛɛnbir la? Bɔzug ka ya zɔt banɛ mugusidi ya la dabiem daar wʋsa, ban banɛ ti'eb ye ba san'ami ya yɛla la? Ba sʋnpɛɛn la kʋ nyaŋi niŋi ya si'el si'ela.

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Li kʋ yuugɛ ka banɛ bɛ sanrega ni la paam yɔlisim. Ba kʋ kpi bʋmbɔkin la, bɛɛ ba kɔ'ɔŋ diibɔ.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ gudigid atɛuk ka li ku'opila duosid agɔla. M yʋ'ʋri an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: M niŋi m pian'adi ya nɔɔrin ka nɔki m nu'ug ma'asim lusi ya. Manɛ an onɛ zi'el saŋgbana la ba zi'esigin, ka an onɛ ɛɛnb dunia la ɛɛnbir, ka an onɛ yɛl Zion dim ye, ‘Ya anɛ m nidib.’” Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn bʋtiŋ

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Duom, duom! O Jerusalem, duom, Zugsɔb la sʋnf daa duoe nɛf; fʋ namisʋg daa nwɛnɛ daam dinɛ bɛ bʋtiŋin nɛ. Zugsɔb la daa kɛ ka fʋ nu dankan la; fʋ daa nu daam la wʋsa hali bugi gɛnnim.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Jerusalem da mɔr nidib bɛdegʋ, amaa tuongat da kae na gaad o tuonnɛ. Nimbanɛ da duoe ani la wʋsa, sɔ' da kae na gɔs oo.

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: Fʋ biis la nwi'enɛ ba dignɛ suor wʋsa ni, nwɛnɛ walig ka baŋ gban'e o nɛ. Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn bɛɛ ba zug ka ba Wina'am la zɛrigi ba hali.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ fʋn kanɛ namisida, kɛlisim sʋ'ʋŋa, fʋ kʋʋlnɛ ka lɛɛ pʋ nu daam.

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Fʋ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', fʋ Wina'am kanɛ zabidi sʋŋid o nidib la: “Gɔsima, m di'e bʋtiŋ la fʋ nu'ugin, bʋtiŋ kanɛ kɛ ka fʋ kennɛ gɛnnim la; bʋtiŋ linɛ an tɔɔg ka an m sʋnpɛɛn la, fʋ kʋ lɛn nuu li ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: M na nɔki li niŋ banɛ namisidif la nu'usin, banɛ kɛ ka fʋ digin suor zug ka ba nɔɔdif wʋʋ titan la.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Zion, duom ka zi'en nɛ paŋ! Jerusalem, tempʋkanɛ an kasi la, yɛɛmi fʋ fubanɛ vɛnl la! Banɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ ka an dian'ad dim la kʋ lɛn kpɛn' fʋ san'an na ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: Jerusalem, kpa'asim titan la bas; duom keŋ zin'in na'am gbauŋ la zug. Zion pu'ayua onɛ bɛ namisʋg pʋʋginɛ, yidigim baans banɛ ka ba lɔɔ fʋ niŋgɔɔnr la ka nyɛ yɔlisim.

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Ba daa kuosif nɛ zaalim ka pʋ di'e ligidii, fʋ mɛ na nyɛ faangir zaalim ka kʋ yɔ ligidii.”

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “M nidib da dɛŋi keŋ Egipt ye ba zin' ani; li nya'aŋ ka Asiria dim mugusi ba.”

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Gɔsima, nannanna nɛ'ɛŋa an bɔ? Ba mɔri m nidib la keŋ zaalim-zaalim, ka banɛ sʋ'oe ba la la'adi ba, ka pian'ad bɛ'ɛdi san'amidi m yʋ'ʋr saŋa wʋsa.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: “Dinzug ka m nidib la na baŋi m yʋ'ʋr; di zug ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ da dɛŋi yɛli zi'el. Ɛɛn, li anɛ mam.”

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Banɛ mɔr labasʋŋʋ yit zuoya ni na la, ba ken malisi ti sʋnf pamm! Ban banɛ mɔɔn sumbʋgʋsʋm yɛla, ka mɔr labasʋŋʋ kenna, ka mɔɔn faangir yɛla, ka yɛt Zion ye, “Fʋ Wina'am la anɛ na'ab la!”

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi! Nimbanɛ gur teŋ la dʋ'ʋsi ba kʋkɔya; ba la'asi tansid agɔla nɛ sumalisim. Zugsɔb la ya'a ti lɛb Zion na, ba na nyɛɛ o nɛ ba mɛŋ nini.

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Jerusalem dinɛ an dabɔɔdɛ, la'asim yʋ'ʋmmi nɛ sumalisim, ka Zugsɔb la bʋgʋl o nidib sʋnya; o faaɛn Jerusalem dim.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na pa'al o paŋ kanɛ an nyain la buudi wʋsa tuon, ka banɛ bɛ teŋ-magbinnin sa na nyɛɛ ti Wina'am la faangir.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Yimi, yimi anina na! Da si'isi bʋn linɛ an dian'adɛ! Yim anina na ka maali ya mɛŋ nyain, yanam banɛ ziid Zugsɔb la'ad la.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Amaa ya kʋ yinɛ tʋkpiidʋg nwɛnɛ ba mugusidi ya nɛ bɛɛ ya zɔt wʋʋ banɛ ka ba kata; Zugsɔb la na gaadi ya tuon, Israel Wina'am la na bɛɛ ya nya'aŋi guri ya mɛn. Tʋmtʋm la namisʋg nɛ na'am kanɛ ka o na nyɛ la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛt ye, “Gɔsima, m tʋmtʋm la na tʋm nɛ ya'am. Ba na dʋ'ʋs o agɔla ka na'as o.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ nidib bɛdegʋ daa nyɛɛ o ka li paki ba si'em, ka o nindaa tiak hali ka o pʋ lɛn nwɛnɛ ninsaala, ka o niŋgbina wʋsa san'am ka sɔ' pʋ lɛm baŋ ye li anɛ on la,

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: ala ka o na kɛ ka tɛɛns pamm lidig ka na'anam mak pian'adi gʋ'ʋŋ ka gigilim o yɛla. Ban da yɛli ba si'el o yɛla la, ba na nyɛɛ li, ka ban nam pʋ wʋm si'el yɛla la, ba na gban'e li gbin.”

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn niŋi ti labaar la yadda ka anɔ'ɔn san'an ka Zugsɔb la nie o paŋi pa'alɛ?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb tʋmtʋm la nɔbig o san'an wʋʋ tikanɛ nam bun paalim ka nwɛnɛ nya'ar kanɛ bɛ teŋ kpi'emis zin'igin nɛ. O daa pʋ mɔr vɛnlim bɛɛ kpi'euŋ si'a na kɛ ka ti ya'am bɔɔd o. On an si'em la pʋ tisi ti nyɛlʋg ka ti na kɛɛn o san'an naa.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Nidib daa nɛ'ɛs o ka zan'as o. O daa anɛ ninkanɛ miilim pu'alʋŋ, nɛ tɔɔg nɛ namisʋg. Sɔ' daa pʋn pʋ bɔɔd ye o gɔs oo; ba daa nɛ'ɛs o ka tinam mɛ gɔs o zaalim.

english_verse: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
translation_verse: Li ya'a an sida, onɛ di'e ti niŋgbina tɔɔg ka yisi ti ban'as wʋsa. La'an nɛ wala ti tɛn'ɛs ye li anɛ Wina'am kɛ ka yɛltɔɔd nɛ namisʋg nɛ mugusʋg paae o.

english_verse: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
translation_verse: Amaa ba daa pu'alim o nɛ ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla, tinam taal zug ka ba namis o; ba daa namis o ka li kɛ ka ti nyɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm; o pu'alʋŋ la zugʋ kɛ ka ti paam laafi.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Ti wʋsa nwɛnɛ pɛ'ɛs nɛ yirid kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb, ti wʋsa yinne-yinne fɛndig nɛ ti ya'am bɔɔdim; ka Zugsɔb la nɔki ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa ziil o.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Ba daa mugus o ka namis o, la'an nɛ wala o pʋ ya'ae o nɔɔrɛ. Ba daa mɔr o ken wʋʋ pɛribig ka ba mɔri kennɛ o kɔdigir zin'igin si'em la, ka nwɛnɛ pɛ'og ka ba ye ba kiesi o kɔnbid nɛ ka o an baanlimm ka pʋ ya'ae o nɔɔrɛ

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Ba daa mugus o ka kad o saria ka mɔr o keŋ. Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi pʋn tiɛn on kpi ka pʋ bas nya'aŋ la yɛllɛ? Ba daa mugus o ka kʋʋ o man nidib la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug.

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala linɛ niŋ o la daa anɛ Zugsɔb la bɔɔdim ka Wina'am kɛ ka o nyɛ mugusʋg ka namis, hali ka nɔk o nyɔvʋri maal maan. Nɛ wala o na nyɛɛ o yaas ka o dabisa yuug, ka Zugsɔb bɔɔdim na maal o bɛllimin.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: O namisʋg nya'aŋ o na lɛn nyɛ sumalisim ka o pʋʋg pie; o baŋ ye o namisʋg la ka' zaalim. “M tʋmtʋm sʋŋ onɛ ka m nɔŋ la na di'e namisʋg nidib pamm zug, ka o yɛla ka m na kɛɛ ba taali bas.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Alazug m na tis o girima nintitada nɛ kpi'emnam sʋʋgin. Bɔzugɔ o nɔk o nyɔvʋri tis ka kɛ ka ba kaal o paas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dimin ka kʋʋ oo. O zi nidib bɛdegʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka sɔs Wina'am tisi ba ye o kɛɛ ba taali bas.”

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Jerusalem, yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim, fʋn kanɛ nwɛnɛ pu'a kanɛ nan zi' du'a la; yʋ'ʋm ka tansid nɛ sumalisim, fʋn kanɛ nan zi' sa'ae la; bɔzugɔ pu'a kanɛ ka' sid la biis na zu'oe gaad pu'a kanɛ mɔr sid la.” Zugsɔb la yɛl ala.
