english_verse: Make your tents larger! Spread out the tent pegs; fasten them firmly.
translation_verse: Yaligimi fʋ Fuug Sʋgʋr la, vɛ'ɛgim fubanɛ bɛŋ la tɔlis ka da basɛ; yaligimi fʋ za'as, ka maali fʋ kpada la ka li kpi'em.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Fʋ na yaligi keŋ datiuŋ nɛ dagɔbʋg; fʋ yaas na kad buudi bɛdegʋ yis ka zin'in tempʋbanɛ ka ba yi ka bas la.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Da zɔt dabiem ka fʋ kʋ di nyannɛ. Da kɛ ka dabiem mɔri fɔ ka ba kʋ diisif nyannɛ. Fʋ na tami fʋ pu'asatimin nyan la, ka kʋ lɛn tiɛn fʋ pʋkɔntim saŋa sʋnsa'aŋ la yɛlaa.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Onɛ maalif la aan fʋ sid; o yʋ'ʋri an Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la. Israel Wina'am onɛ an Kasi la aan fʋ Faangid; o yʋ'ʋri buon Teŋgbauŋ Wʋsa Wina'am.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na lɛn di'ef ya'as wʋʋ pu'a kanɛ ka ba bas o ka o sʋʋnr san'am. Fʋ Wina'am la yɛl ye, “Fʋ nwɛnɛ pu'asadir kanɛ kul sid ka o sid zan'as o.

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: M daa basif ka li pʋ yuugɛ amaa m nimbaanlzɔɔri galis la zug ka m di'ef ya'as.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: M sʋnpɛɛnni daa zu'oe galis la zug ka m basif saŋa bi'ela amaa m pʋpielim linɛ ka' naar la zug, m na zɔɔ fʋ nimbaanlig.” Zugsɔb onɛ an fʋ Faangid la yɛl ala.

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: “Mam san'anɛ, nɛ'ɛŋa nwɛnɛ Noa saŋa; ka m da pɔ nɔɔr ye, Noa saŋa ku'om la kʋ lɛn san'am teŋgbauŋ ya'asɛ. Ala ka m pɔ nɔɔr ye m sʋnf kʋ lɛm pɛlig nɛf ya'asɛ, m mɛ kʋ lɛn tansif ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Hali baa zuoya ya'a mi'im ka kʋkʋna birid, La'an nɛ wala, man nɔŋif si'em la, bɛɛ m sumbʋgʋsʋm nɔnaar la kʋ naae.” Zugsɔb onɛ zɔtif nimbaanlig la yɛti li.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: “O Jerusalem teŋa, fʋn kanɛ ka namisʋg paaf ka onɛ bɛlisidif kae, m na mɛɛf nɛ kugbanɛ ligidi kpi'em ka nɔk kugvɛnla ɛɛnbi fʋ ɛɛnbir.

english_verse: Your fortresses will be built of rubies, your gates of jewels, and your walls of gems.
translation_verse: M na mɛɛ ya zaŋguoma la ka li an sʋ'ʋŋa ka ya za'anɔya vɛnl nwɛnɛ sanlima nɛ, ka ya zaŋguoma la na an kuga banɛ ligidi kpi'em.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na pa'annɛ ya biis la ka ba na mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Fʋ na zin' nɛ pʋpielim: fʋ bi'emnam na lal nɛf ka fʋ kʋ zɔt si'el-si'el dabiem. Dabiem na yi nyain; li kʋ li'eli fʋ babaa.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a duoe ye o zab nɛf, li kʋ an ye manɛ tis o suorɛ; onɛ zab nɛf, fʋ na nyaŋ o.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, li anɛ manɛ maal onɛ kʋnt la nɛ onɛ zugid ka bugumsaana la'aŋid la ka kʋnt zaba la'abanɛ wʋsa nar nɛ zaba tʋʋma. Manɛ lɛm maal la'asan'auŋ sɔb ka o san'amid la'ad.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Zaba lauk kae ka ba maal ka ba na nyaŋi nɔki zab nɛ fɔ, nɔkanɛ pian' pian'abɛ'ɛd wʋsa, li kʋ dɔlli fɔ. Nɛ'ɛŋa an Zugsɔb tʋmtʋmnib la faar, ka mɛ an nɔzi'elʋg linɛ yi man san'an na.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Kemi na, yanam banɛ ka ku'onuud mɔri ya la, kemi ku'om zin'igin na! Yanam banɛ ka' ligidi la, kemi na da' diie! Kemi na da' daam nɛ bin'isim ka da yɔ ligidii, li mɛ ka' sammɛ.

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka ya san'amid ligidi nɛ linɛ ka' diibɔ, ka gɛɛnd nɛ linɛ pʋ mɔr sʋŋirɛ? Kɛlisimini m pian'ad, ka di linɛ an sʋm, ka dikanɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa ka na malisi tisi ya.

english_verse: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.
translation_verse: Yɔ'ɔgimi ya tʋba ka kɛɛn m san'an na; kɛlisimini m pian'ad, ka ya siig na paam vʋm. M na maal nɔnaar linɛ ka' naar nɛ ya, ka li anɛ m sida nɔŋilim linɛ ka m da kaanbi tis Na'ab David la.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, m da kɛ ka o an kasɛti tis nidib la, ka an tɛɛns dim la tuongat nɛ ba kpɛɛm.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: M yɛl o ye, ‘Sida fʋ na buol buudbanɛ ka fʋ zi' la la'as, ka buudbanɛ zi'if la na zɔ tɔ'ɔtɔ kɛɛn fʋ san'an na, ka li na anɛ fʋ Zugsɔb Wina'am la zug, onɛ an Kasi tis Israel la, bɔzugɔ onɛ kɛ ka fʋ an girima sɔb.’”

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Dɛŋim iee Zugsɔb la saŋkanɛ ka ya na nyɛɛ o; buolimin o on nam bɛ yammin la.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka bugusim sɔb bas o bugusim suoya ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb kɛɛ o pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd la. Kɛl ka o lɛb Zugsɔb la san'an na ka o na zɔɔ o nimbaanlig, ka lɛbi ti Wina'am la san'an na ka o na kɛɛ o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Mam pʋtɛn'ɛr ka' ya pʋtɛndaa, ka ya suoya mɛ ka' man suoya.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ agɔla lal nɛ teŋ si'em la, ala ka m suoya lalli gati ya suoya ka m pʋtɛnda mɛ gati ya pʋtɛnda.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: Saa nɛ sakuga yit agɔla lit na ka kʋ lɛb zaalim ka pʋ madig teŋgbauŋ la, ka kɛt ka bʋmbʋta yitna ka maan puum, nɛ zʋʋdi tisid onɛ bʋd la nɛ diibi tisid onɛ dit la,

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: ala mɛn nɔɔ ka m pian'ad la kʋ yii m nɔɔrinɛ keŋ ka lɛn lɛbi m san'an na zaalim, amaa asɛɛ li maal mam bɔɔd si'el, ka maal mam tʋmmi li si'el yɛla la.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: Ya na yinɛ sumalisim ka lɛb nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm; zuoya nɛ kʋkʋna na yʋ'ʋmmi ya tuon, ka tiis banɛ zi'e la wʋsa na nwɛ'ɛdi ba nu'us pʋra-pʋra!

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kpʋkparig tiis na yi gɔn'ɔsi daa bɛ zin'isi'a la ka tivɛnla yi zin'ikanɛ daa an sian'anr la. Lina na an zanbin linɛ na bɛ saŋa wʋsa ka na tiɛn ya man Zugsɔb la tʋm si'el.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Tʋmmi linɛ an sida ka niŋi linɛ dɔl suor, ka m faangir la pʋ lal la; m pʋpielim la kʋ yuugɛ ka nie.

english_verse: I will bless everyone who respects the Sabbath and refuses to do wrong.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ dau kanɛ gban'e li sʋ'ʋŋa ka dɔlisid Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la ka pʋ san'ami li, ka yis o nu'ug bɛ'ɛd pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka saan onɛ kɛn Zugsɔb la san'an na yɛl ye, ‘Zugsɔb la kʋ paas mam o nidib la kallinɛ.’ Da kɛ ka onɛ ka ba zan' o la nyɔn ye, ‘Mam kʋdim nwɛnɛ tikanɛ kʋdigɛ.’”

english_verse: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', “Yanam banɛ ka ba zan' ya la ya'a dɔlisidi m Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la, ka tʋm linɛ malisim ka gban'e m nɔnaar la yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa,

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: ba na tɛnri ya yʋda m Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la gat yanamɛ naan mɔrin biribis nɛ bipumis; ka ya yʋda la kʋ kpiis bɛɛ bɔdigɛ.”

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Saam banɛ nɔki ba mɛŋi tabil nɛ Zugsɔb la ka tʋmmi tisid o, ka nɔŋ o yʋ'ʋr ka pʋ'ʋsid o, ka dɔlisid Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la ka pʋ san'ami lii, ka mɛ gban'e o nɔnaar la yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa la,

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: bama ka m na mɔri kɛɛn m zuokanɛ an kasi la ni na ka tisi ba sumalisim m winsɔsʋg yin la. Ba nyu'or maana nɛ maana banɛ ka ba maan bimbimin la, m na di'e li. Bɔzugɔ ba na buonnɛ m yir la ye buudi wʋsa winsɔsʋg yir.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb ka la'asid Israel dim banɛ zɔɔ widig la yɛl ye, “Banɛ ka m pʋn dɛŋi la'as la, m na lɛn la'as sieba na m paasi ba.” Wina'am zɛrig banɛ an bugusim dim la

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Yanam mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid nɛ banɛ bɛ sian'arin nɛ, kemi na vɔli ba!

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Banɛ gur Israel dim la wʋsa zu'om nɛ, ba wʋsa ka' ya'am; ba wʋsa anɛ bagigis, ba kʋ nyaŋi wɛsɛ; ba la'as nɛ digi zaansim, ba nɔŋnɛ gbɛɛm ma'aa.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Ba anɛ baas banɛ ka ba nɔya malis hali; si'el nan zi' sia'ali baa. Ba anɛ kɔnbkemnib banɛ pʋ gban'ad si'el gbinnɛ; ba wʋsa fɛndigi dɔlli ba mɛŋ suor, sɔ' wʋsa ieed o mɛŋ din.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa yinne-yinne kaasidi buon ye, “Kɛlli ka m iee daam na! Kemmi na ka ti nu daam tig! Ka bɛog na nwɛnɛ zina, bɛɛ li na gaad ala.”

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Banɛ bɛllim an sʋ'ʋŋa la na zin'in nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm; ba ya'a kpi ba na nyɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: “Amaa yanam banɛ an ba'abʋgʋdib biisɛ, kemi kpɛla na! Ya saamnam anɛ dap banɛ san'amid pu'ab ka ya manam mɛ an pu'agɔɔnda.

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn ka ya la'ada? Anɔ'ɔn ka ya man siaa ka mi'ed nɔɔrɛ? Ya ka'anɛ banɛ ki'isid nɛ banɛ an faad dim la biisɛ?

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: Ya bɛ nɛ tʋtʋga nɛ tibɛda gbina ni maannɛ ya teŋgbana la ka ya pʋtɛnda wʋsa bɛ pu'abɔɔsimin. Ya mɔri ya biisi maan maana bɔn'ɔfalisin nɛ tampinlɛma ni.

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Ya nɔk kugbanɛ bɛ bɔn'ɔgin saalim la ka ba aan ya wina; ka ya maannɛ ba, ka tisidi ba bʋnnuuda nɛ zʋʋd maana. Fʋn nyɛ nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa la, M na nyaŋi mɔdig ka nan kpɛm mɔr suguruu?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Ya maali ya digisa zuotitada zug; ka dʋt ani maannɛ ya maana ka tʋm tʋʋmyaalis.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Ya nɔki ya bada la su'a ya dalamma nya'aŋ. Ya tam mam yɛla, ka pʋ'ʋsidi ba. Li nwɛnɛ pu'asan'auŋ tʋʋma nɛ. Ya dɔl bada la ka li nwɛnɛ nidi na dig nɛ pu'agɔɔndir nɛ.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Ya suoɛn olif kpaam ka niŋ tudaari keŋ maan maannɛ tis Molek. Ya tʋm nidib lalli ye ba iee bada, hali la'an nɛ kpi'im teŋ!

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: Ya suoya la wʋsa kɛ ka ya gɛn, amaa ya pʋ siak ye, ‘Li ka' gbinnɛ.’ Ya nyɛ paŋ paalig, linɛ kɛ ka ya pʋ vibɛ.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn ka ya zɔt ka ya ya'am ian'ad ka ya ma'adi ma? Ya pʋ tiɛn m yɛla bɛɛ tɛn'ɛsi m yɛla ya sʋʋnrinɛ. Li ka'anɛ man sin baanlimm ka li yuug la zug ka ya pʋ lɛn zɔti maa?

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Ya ya'a ti kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir, yanam kɛl ka ya bada banɛ ka ya la'as la faaɛnnɛ ya! Ayei, sisi'em na zii ba gaad, pɛbisʋg bi'ela ma'aa na mɔri ba keŋ. Amaa ninkanɛ su'a o mɛŋ man san'an na sʋ'oe teŋ la ka na pʋ'ʋs mam m Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la.” Wina'am na bʋgʋl banɛ sʋnya san'am la

english_verse: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
translation_verse: Ka ba na yɛl ye, “Maalimi suor la uusi sʋ'ʋŋa! Yisimi linɛ vi'idi m nidib la suor.”

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Onɛ bɛ agɔla, ka gaad si'el wʋsa la yɛl si'eli nwa', on kanɛ bɛ saŋa wʋsa, ka o yʋ'ʋr an kasi la: “M bɛ nɛ zin'ikanɛ bɛɛ agɔla ka an kasi la, amaa m mɛ bɛ nɛ onɛ sied o mɛŋ ka siakid tiakir. M kɛ ka banɛ ka' ti'ir la paam ti'ir ka kɛ ka banɛ sʋnya san'am la nyɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: M kʋ zɛrigi m nidib la bɛɛ m sʋʋnr pɛlig nɛ ba saŋa wʋsaa. M ya'a niŋ ala, ninsaal vʋ'ʋsʋm dinɛ ka m maal la na yi ka o kpi, ka o siig lɛbi m san'an na.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: M sʋnfʋ daa duoe nɛ o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, m daa namis o ka keŋ ka bas o nɛ sʋnpɛɛn, la'an nɛ wala, o nan kpɛn dɔl nɛ o ya'amlɛog bɔɔdim.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: M nyɛɛ o suoya la, amaa m na tis o laafi; M na gur o ka bʋgʋl o sʋʋnr,

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: ka kɛ ka banɛ kaasid Israel teŋin la yʋ'ʋm zʋn'or yʋʋma. Sumbʋgʋsʋm sid bɛɛ tis banɛ bɛ lalli nɛ banɛ bɛ yammin.” Ala ka Zugsɔb la yɛl. Ka mɛ lɛn ye, “M na tisi ba laafi.”

english_verse: The wicked are a restless sea tossing up mud.
translation_verse: Amaa bugusim dim la nwɛnɛ atɛuk ku'opila linɛ kʋ nyaŋi an baanlimm nɛ, ka gudigid dian'ad nɛ bian'ar.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: M Wina'am la yɛl ye, “Bugusim dim kʋ maligin nyɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.”

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Tansim agɔla, ka da sinna! Dʋ'ʋsimi fʋ kʋkɔr wʋʋ na'atannɛ. Yɛlimi m nidib la ban ki'isi m nɔɔr la yɛla ka yɛl Jakob yidimi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla.

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Daar wʋsa ba ieedim nɛ; ka niŋid wʋʋ ba mui nɛ nif ye ba baŋi m pa'ala la; ba niŋidnɛ nwɛnɛ ba anɛ buudbanɛ tʋm linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa ka pʋ basi ba Wina'am nɔɔr zi'elʋgɔ. Ba yɛtim ye ba bɔɔd gban'ar linɛ an sida ka nwɛnɛ ba bɔɔd nɛ ba sʋnf wʋsa ye Wina'am li'eli ba nɛ.

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: Ba yɛti ye, ‘Bɔ ka ti lɔɔd nɔɔr ka fʋ pʋ nyɛta? Bɔ ka ti sie ti mɛŋ ka fʋ ba'a mɛ kae?’ Nɛ wala, daakanɛ ka ya lɔ nɔɔr la, ya maannɛ linɛ malisi ya, ka mugusidi ya tʋmtʋmnib.

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Nɔlɔkaŋa taaba ka mam bɔɔdaa? Li anɛ nidi na sie o mɛŋ daar yinne ma'aa la zugɔɔ? Li anɛ nidi na sʋ'ʋnnɛ o zug wʋʋ mɔɔg nɛ ka dig bɔto fuudin nɛ tampɛligiminɛɛ? Lin la ka ya buon nɔlɔrɛɛ? Ya tɛn'ɛs ye m sʋnf na malis nɛ nɔlɔkaŋa buudii?

english_verse: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
translation_verse: Ayei, li ka' nɔlɔkaŋa buudi ka mam bɔɔda. Amaa lɛɛ yisimi bana nwiis linɛ an ziri la ka tʋk zitɛbisa nidib zugin, ka kɔ'ɔg yu'asindaug linɛ an zitɛbisa la, ka tis banɛ ka ba mugusidi ba la yɔlisim.

english_verse: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
translation_verse: Li pʋ nar ye ya pʋdigi ya diib nɛ banɛ kɔ'ɔm zabid la ka tis nɔŋ dim banɛ ka' gbɛɛnsa la gbɛɛnb zin'igaa? Ya ya'a nyɛ sɔ' ka o ken biel yanam yɛɛlim o fuug, ka da zan'asi ya nidib sʋŋirɛ.

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: Ala ka ya nɛɛsim na nie nwɛnɛ bɛogʋ nie nɛ, ka ya laafi nyɛɛb na kɛn tɔ'ɔtɔ na; ka ya pʋpielim la na kɛ ka ya keŋ tuon, ka Zugsɔb na'am paŋ la na guri ya.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Ya na buoli ya Zugsɔb la ka o siak; ya na kaasi bɔɔd sʋŋir, ka o na yɛl ye, ‘Manɛ nwa'!’ Ya ya'a yis mugusʋg linɛ nwɛnɛ yu'asindaug la, ka bas nu'ubibis tiesʋg nɛ pian'abɛ'ɛd,

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: ka tis banɛ ka kɔ'ɔm mɔri ba la diib ka tis banɛ bɛ mugusʋg pʋʋgin yɔlisim, ala ka ya nɛɛsim na nie likin, ka ya yʋ'ʋŋ na nwɛnɛ nintaŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na guri ya saŋa wʋsa; o na tisi ya yanamɛ bɔɔd si'el teŋ kanɛ ka nintaŋ tʋʋlʋg bɛ hali la ka tɛndigi ya paŋ. Ya na nwɛnɛ lɔmbɔn'ɔg kanɛ ka ba dɔn'ɔsid saŋa wʋsa, ka nwɛnɛ bulkanɛ ku'om bun ka pʋ naada.

english_verse: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.
translation_verse: Ya nidib la na lɛbisi mɛ' dabɔɔd banɛ da bɛ kʋdimin sa la ka na dʋ'ʋs ɛɛnb kʋda la; ba na buonnɛ ya ye, ‘Banɛ Mɛɛd Zaŋguom nwa'alima’, nɛ ‘Banɛ Lɛbisid Suoraad’, nɛ ‘Banɛ Maan Zin'ikanɛ ka Nidib Bɛ la’.

english_verse: But first, you must start respecting the Sabbath as a joyful day of worship. You must stop doing and saying whatever you please on this special day.
translation_verse: Dɔlisimi Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la sʋ'ʋŋa ka da tʋm ya ya'amin dabiskanɛ an kasi la daarɛ. Mɔri sumalisim Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la yɛla ka na'asi Zugsɔb dabiskanɛ an kasi la. Na'asimini li ka da tʋmmi ya mɛŋ bɔɔdim bɛɛ pian'ad yɔɔg-yɔɔg dabiskan la.

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Ya ya'a niŋ ala, ya na nyɛ sumalisim Zugsɔb la san'an ka m na kɛ ka ya mɔr na'asi teŋgbauŋ la ni. M na kɛ ka ya dii ya yaab Jakob faar la.” Man Zugsɔb mɛŋi yɛli li.

english_verse: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.
translation_verse: Sida, Zugsɔb la nu'ug pʋ gimme galis nɛ on na faaɛn ya, bɛɛ o tʋba li' ka o kʋ wʋmm.

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: Amaa ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wɛligi ya, ya Wina'am la san'an; ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la kɛ ka o fɛndig ka basi ya, ka pʋ wʋmi ya sɔsʋgɔ.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ ya anɛ ninkʋʋdib, ka mɔri ya nu'usi tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. Ya nɔŋgbana pian'ad anɛ ziri, ka ya zilima nyɔn ka pian'ad bugusim pian'ad.

english_verse: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
translation_verse: Baa nid yinne pʋ dɔl sida suorɛ; sɔ' pʋ tu'ad o antu'a ka li mɔr sidaa. Ba ti'enɛ nɔŋgbannwa'ar nɛ faad; ba gban'e nɛ yɛla pʋʋg ka du'a tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
translation_verse: Ba wiakid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋʋ wa'abɛ'og gɛla nɛ, onɛ wʋsa ɔnbi ba gɛla na kpi, ka fʋ ya'a nwa'ae gɛl yinne, wa'abɛ'ogʋ yit na. Ba faad nwɛnɛ silinsin'ugʋ ʋgidi o paanlʋŋ si'em la.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ba nɔba kennɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zin'igin tɔ'ɔtɔ; ba zɔti tɔ'ɔtɔ ken ye ba kʋ nimbanɛ pʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ. Ba mɔri bugusim pʋtɛnda; ba suor wʋsa anɛ san'auŋ nɛ widigir.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Ba zi' sumbʋgʋsʋm suorɛ; sida ka' ba san'anɛ. Ba fɛndigi lɛb nɛ zam tʋʋma ni; sɔ' kae dɔlli ba ka mi' sumbʋgʋsʋm.

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: Ala ka sida lal nɛ ti, ka pʋpielim pʋ paadi tii. Ti ieednɛ nɛɛsim, amaa si'el wʋsa anɛ zibisʋg; ti bɔɔdnɛ lin na nie nyain, amaa ti kennɛ likin.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: Ti nwɛnɛ zʋnzɔɔs ka babinnɛ dɔlisid dɔkpin, ti babinnɛ ken wʋʋ nimbanɛ ka' ninii. Nintansʋʋs ti tu'usidi lit wʋʋ li anɛ sisɔbir nɛ; baa banɛ mɔr paŋ la sʋʋgin, tinam nwɛnɛ ninkpiilima nɛ.

english_verse: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
translation_verse: Ti wʋsa bʋʋnnɛ wʋʋ bʋnyua nɛ; ka ʋʋnsid wʋʋ dawana. Ti ieedi sida, amaa ka pʋ nyɛɛ; ti bɔɔd faangir, amaa ka li lalli ti.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: Linɛ kɛ ka ti pɔ'ɔgir zu'oe fʋ tuon ka ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dii ti la. Ti pɔ'ɔgir la bɛnɛ ti san'an saŋa wʋsa, ka ti siak ye ti tʋm bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: Ti pian'ad ka' sida, ka ti zan'as Zugsɔb la nɔɔr ka bidi ti Wina'am la kʋdig, ti pian'adi ziri ka mugusidi ti taaba ka pʋ siakid sida, ti pʋtɛnda gban'e nɛ dama'am ma'aa.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: Linzug sida lɛb nɛ nya'aŋ ka pʋpielim zi'e lallisa; yɛlsida tu'ugi li suorin, ka ba da'ae burikinnamɛ bas kpikpɛŋ sa.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Sɔ' lɛn zi' sida zin'iga, ka onɛ wʋsa zan'as linɛ an bɛ'ɛd la liebi ba dataa. Zugsɔb la gɔsi li ka li pʋ malis oo sida ka'alim la zug.

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: O gɔsi nyɛ ka sɔ' kae ka o sʋnf san'amnɛ sɔ' kae na sʋŋ la zug; ala ka o mɛŋ nu'ug tʋʋma tis o faangir, ka o mɛŋ pʋpielim la tis o paŋ.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: O dataasi tʋm si'em la, ala ka o na yɔ sʋnpɛɛnni lɛbisi ba. O na tɔndi paae o bi'emnam wʋsa, ka yɔ tembanɛ ka ku'om gilig la linɛ nari ba.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Nidib banɛ bɛ ya-tuona la na zɔt Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, ka banɛ bɛ winnigi tansid zin'isi'a la na tis o na'am la girima. O na kennɛ nwɛnɛ ku'om pʋbid nɛ paŋ, ka li anɛ Zugsɔb la vʋ'ʋsʋm da'ae li mɔri keŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Faangid la na kɛn Zion na, o na faaɛn Jakob yidim banɛ viigi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka tiak la.” Ala ka Zugsɔb la yɛl.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Ya'a an mam, m nɔnaari nwa': m siig kanɛ bɛɛ fʋ ni la nɛ m pian'ad linɛ ka m niŋi fʋ nɔɔrin la kʋ yi fʋn bɛɛ fʋ biis bɛɛ fʋ yaas nɔɔrinɛ, lin yi nannanna mɔri ken sa.” Man Zugsɔb la yɛl.

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Jerusalem, duom ka nie nyain ka fʋ nɛɛsim kena, ka Zugsɔb girima la nie fʋ ni.

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, dunia la anɛ lik ka saalib wʋsa mɛ bɛ likin biridi, amaa Zugsɔb la nɛɛsim na nie fʋ ni ka o girima mɛ nie fʋ nidib wʋsa san'an.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tɛɛns na kɛɛn fʋ nɛɛsimin la na ka na'anam mɛ kena ye ba nyɛ girimkanɛ tansidi fʋ ni ka li nie wʋʋ bɛogʋn sɔɔnrim la.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: Ʋkimi fʋ nindaa gɔsi gilig ka fʋ na nyɛ bʋn dinɛ niŋid: Fʋ nidib la la'asid nɛ taaba kunna; fʋ biribis la naam lalli kunna, ba na zii fʋ bipumis la na.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Fʋ na gɔsi nyɛ ka fʋ sumpielim galis, fʋ sʋnf na ma'ae hali ka fʋ zig ye fʋ gban'e fʋ mɛŋi gʋ'ʋŋ. Ba na zi tembanɛ bɛɛ atɛuk lɔ'ɔm la la'adi mɔr na tisif, ka mɔr tɛɛns la kpan'am wʋsa kɛɛn fʋ san'an na.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Yʋgʋma bɛdegʋ na yi Midian nɛ Efa tɛɛnsini kena pɛ'ɛli ya teŋ la. Banɛ bɛ Seeba teŋin wʋsa na kena ka ziid sanlima nɛ bʋnnyubisa na. Ba na dʋ'ʋsid Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr ka pʋ'ʋsid o bareka.

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Ba na mɔr Kedar nɛ Nebaiof pɛ'ɛs la wʋsa kɛɛn fʋ san'an na maal malʋŋʋ tisif; ba na di'e ba niŋi m malʋŋ daka la zug, ka m na kɛ ka m Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la pɛ'ɛl nɛ girima.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: Ka anɔ'ɔnamɛ nwa' ukid ililili wʋʋ saŋgbana, ka nwɛnɛ dawana ian'adi kpɛn'ɛdi ba tɛɛdinɛ?

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ya'a an sida, tembanɛ ka ku'om lɔbi gilig la tɛn'ɛsidnɛ mam yɛla; Tarsi teŋ anrima la gaad tuonnɛ mɔri fʋ biribis la yi lalli kunna, ba mɔri anzurifa nɛ sanlima ye ba kena na'as Zugsɔb onɛ aan fʋ Wina'am la, On kanɛ an Kasi Tis Israel la, bɔzugɔ, o kɛ ka dunia wʋsa na'asidif.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Saam na maali fʋ zaŋguoma la mɛ', ka ba na'anam tʋmmi tisidif. La'an nɛ m sʋʋnri daa duoe ka m nwɛ' fɔ bas la, m na zɔɔ fʋ nimbaanlig ka li anɛ m mɛŋ ya'amlɛog zug.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa fʋ za'anɔya na yɔ'ɔg, ba kʋdim kʋ yɔɔ baa. Ala ka na'anam na gaadi ba nidib tuonnɛ mɔri ba kpan'am na tisif.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Teŋ bɛɛ sʋ'ʋlim kanɛ pʋ siak ye li tʋmm tisi fɔ li teŋ na san'am yɔri-yɔri.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: Ba na mɔr tisʋma nɛ tivɛnla wʋsa daad na, Dasʋma nwa' yinɛ Lebanon sian'arin na. Ba na mɔri ba na maali mɛ' m Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la; ala ka m nɔba zi'esim na an girima zin'ig.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Banɛ mugusidif la biis na kena igini fʋ tuon; banɛ gɔs ka fʋ an zaalim la na igini fʋ nɔba ni ka buolif ye, ‘Zugsɔb la Teŋ’, Zion linɛ ka Israel dim Wina'am Onɛ An Kasi sʋ'oe li la.

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ban pʋn kisigif hali ka yaaf ka nid baa yinne pʋ dɔlli gati fʋ baba la, m na maalif ka fʋ lieb teŋ kanɛ ka sɔ' wʋsa nif na tig ka zʋmaana wʋsa na mɔr sumalisim fʋ zug.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns nɛ ba na'anam na gɔsidi ya sʋ'ʋŋa wʋʋ bimaa mu'asid o biig si'em la. Ala ka ya na baŋ ye man Zugsɔb la aan ya Faangid nɛ ya Sʋŋid Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: Man naan tisini ya kʋntzɛn'ug la, m lɛɛ na tisi ya sanlima, man naan tisini ya kʋnt la, m lɛɛ na tisi ya anzurifa. Man naan tisini ya daad la, m lɛɛ na tisi ya kʋntzɛn'ug. Man naan tisini ya kuga la, m lɛɛ na tisi ya kʋnt. Banɛ sʋ'oe ya kʋ lɛn namisidi yaa, M na kɛ ka ba gɔsidi ya nɛ sida nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Ya kʋ lɛn wʋm zaba nyuugʋ ya teŋgbauŋʋn la, bɛɛ san'auŋ bɛɛ sapu'adi ya teŋ la babaa. M na guri ya wʋʋ zaŋguom kpi'euŋ nɛ Ka ya pian' m yʋ'ʋr man faaɛn ya la zug.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: Winnig kʋ lɛn an nɛɛsim tisi ya nintaŋa, bɛɛ nwadig an nɛɛsim tisi ya yʋ'ʋŋɔ, bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb la na an nɛɛsim linɛ pʋ kpiigidi tisi ya, ya Wina'am la girima na bɛ nɛ ya.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Ya sʋnsa'aŋ dabisa la na gaad. Man onɛ aan ya Zugsɔb la na aan ya nɛɛsim linɛ pʋ kpiisida Ka na bɛɛ yuugi gaad winnig nɛ nwadig.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: Ala ka fʋ nidib la na lieb pʋpielim dim ka na sʋ'ʋg teŋ la saŋa kanɛ ka' naarɛ. Ba anɛ tiig ka m sɛ, ka an banɛ ka m maal ye ba pa'alim paŋ la zem si'em.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Yir kanɛ pɔɔd hali la na nɔbigi paae tusir, ka banɛ ka ba ziem la nɔbigi kilim teŋ. Man Zugsɔb la yɛl, ka li saŋa ya'a ti paae li na niŋ tɔ'ɔtɔ.”

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la Siig bɛɛ m ni, bɔzugɔ o gaŋim ye m mɔɔl labasʋŋ la tis nɔŋ dim. O tʋmim ye m bʋgʋl banɛ sʋnya san'am la, ka mɔɔl yɔlisim yɛla tis banɛ an yammis la, ka yis banɛ bɛ sanrega la likin.

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: Ka mɔɔl yʋʋm kanɛ ka Zugsɔb na zɔ nidib nimbaanlig ka di'e ba nɛ daakanɛ aan ti Wina'am la sam yɔɔb la. O na bɛlis banɛ kum la,

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: ka tis banɛ bɛ Zion ka mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ la na'am zupibig linɛ vɛnl ka pa'an sumalisim ka ka' sʋnsa'aŋa, ka tis linɛ na bʋgʋli ba sʋʋnr wʋʋ kpaam ka ka' kʋkumaa, ka yɛɛli ba fuug linɛ na dʋ'ʋsi ba ka ka' sʋntɔɔgɔ. Ba na buonnɛ ba ye pʋpielim tiis, linɛ ka Zugsɔb la sɛ ye li pa'al o vɛnlim.

english_verse: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
translation_verse: Teŋ zʋŋ dim na kemi ya kɔnbidi tisi ya; saam mɛ na tʋmmi ya pɔɔdin nɛ tiwala lɔmbɔn'ɔdin.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Ba na buonnɛ ya Zugsɔb la maanmaannib, ka pʋd o ya yʋ'ʋr ye ti Wina'am la tʋmtʋmnib. Tɛɛns na mɔri ba kpan'am na tisi ya ka ya na nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg lin aan ya din la zug.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: Man Zugsɔb la nɔŋ sida la zug; m kis faaung nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. M na yɔɔ ba nɛ m sida ka maal nɔnaar linɛ ka' bɛn nɛ ba.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Tɛɛns la wʋsa na baŋi ba biis ka nidib wʋsa baŋi ba yaas. Banɛ wʋsa nyɛ ba na baŋ ye ba anɛ nimbanɛ ka Zugsɔb la niŋi ba bareka.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: M ya'amlɛog bɔɔd Zugsɔb la; ka m siig mɔr sumalisim m Wina'am la yɛla. Bɔzugɔ o yɛɛlim fukanɛ an faangir ka bɔbim nɛ pʋpielim fuug wʋʋ pu'apaal sidi na bɔbig o zug wʋʋ maanmaan nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ pu'apaali maal o mɛŋ nɛ niŋgɔnkɔris.

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ tintanni kɛt ka bʋmbʋta yit si'em ka lɔmbɔn'ɔg mɛ kɛt ka ban bʋd si'el nɔbigid si'em la, ala ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la mɛ na kɛ ka pʋpielim nɔbigi bɛ tɛɛns wʋsa sʋʋgin.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: Zion zugɔɔ m kʋ sinni m nɔɔrɛ; Jerusalem yɛla m kʋ an baanlim nɛ, hali nɛ o pʋpielim na ti nie nwɛnɛ bɛogʋ nied si'em la ka o nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' naar la nie wʋʋ bugum nɛ.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns la wʋsa na nyɛɛ fʋ pʋpielim, ka na'anam wʋsa nyɛɛ fʋ girima; ba na buonif nɛ yʋ'ʋpaal linɛ ka Zugsɔb la mɛŋ na pʋdif la.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Fʋ na an wʋʋ sanlima zupibig Zugsɔb la nu'usin nɛ na'am laukʋ fʋ Wina'am la nu'usin.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Wʋʋ dasaŋi dit pu'asadir si'em la, ala mɛn ka onɛ maalif la na diif; pu'apaal sid sʋnfʋ ma'ae nɛ o pu'a yɛla si'em la, ala mɛn ka ya Wina'am la sʋnf na malis nɛ ya.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Jerusalem dima, m zi'el banɛ gur teŋ la ya zaŋguoma la nya'aŋ; yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa ba yɛtnɛ linɛ maan ka kʋ sinni ba nɔɔrɛ. Yanam banɛ buon Zugsɔb la bɔɔd sʋŋir la, mid ka ya gɛn ka bas,

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: ka mɛ da basin o sɔsʋg baa bi'elaa, nɛ on na ti kɛ ka Jerusalem zi'en, ka an teŋ kanɛ ka dunia wʋsa na na'asid.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kaanbi zi'el Ka na nɔk o paŋ la kɛ ka li sid tʋm ye, “M kʋ lɛn kɛ ka ya dataas la faaɛn ya ki, ka teŋ sieba dim mɛ kʋ lɛn nuu ya danpaalig linɛ ka ya namisi paam la;

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: Amaa yanam banɛ bun la na dii li ka zun'e Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, ka banɛ ku'on daam tiwala la na nuu li daam la man Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la za'as pʋʋgin”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Dɔlli gaad, dɔl yaŋirin la gaad! Maalimi suori tis nidib la. Wɛdigim, wɛdigim suoraug la! Yisimi kuga suor la zug. Maalimi tuuta zi'el ka dunia wʋsa nyɛ.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mɔɔli tis dunia bɛn wʋsa: “Yɛlim Zion dim ye, ‘Gɔsimi, ya faangid la kenna! Gɔsimi, o yɔɔd la bɛɛ o san'an, ka o na yɔ sɔ' wʋsa samme lɛbis.’”

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Ba na buonnɛ ba ye nimbanɛ an kasi, banɛ ka Zugsɔb la faaɛn; ka na buonif ye teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la nɔŋ, nɛ tempʋkanɛ ka Zugsɔb la pʋ tammi li yɛlaa.

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ nwa' yi Edom teŋgbauŋʋn kenna, anɔ'ɔnɛ mɛ yi Bozira tempʋʋgin kenna ka o fuud si' mu'oe wala? Anɔ'ɔnɛ nwa' yɛ fuvɛnla, bɛ tuonnɛ nɔɔd vugur vuguri ken nɛ paŋ wala? “Li anɛ mam, m pian'ad nɛ pʋpielim, ka mɔr paŋi na nyaŋi faaɛn ya.”

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ fuud mu'oe nwɛnɛ onɛ nɔɔd tiis wala maan daam?

english_verse: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
translation_verse: “Mam ma'aa bɛ zin'ikanɛ ka ba nwi'asid tiis wala la; buudi la wʋsa ni, sɔ' daa pʋ sʋŋi ma. Ka dinzug ka m nɔɔ ba nɛ sʋnpɛɛn ka nɔɔ ba teŋin nɛ ɛndʋg; ka ba ziim tɔn'ɔsi madi m fuud, ka m fuud la wʋsa si'.

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: Saŋa paae ya ka m na yɔɔ m dataas la sam, ka faanm nidib la bas.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: M gɔsi gilig ka sɔ' kae na sʋŋi ma, ka li pakim nɛ sɔ' kae na sʋŋim la; ala ka m mɛŋ paŋ tʋm tisim faangir, ka m mɛŋ sʋnpɛɛn tisim kpi'euŋ ka m ken tuon.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: M nɔ tɛɛns la nɛ m sʋnpɛɛn; m sʋʋnri duoe ka m kɛ ka li wʋmi ba ka ba ziim kpa'ae teŋin.” Zun'or nɛ winsɔsʋg

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: M na yɛl Zugsɔb la pʋpielim an si'em on maal si'el ka li nar ye ba wɔ'ɔg o la, ka li dɔl wʋʋ Zugsɔb la maal si'eli tisi ti la. Asida, o maal yɛlsʋma bɛdegʋ tis Israel yidim, ka li anɛ o nimbaanlzɔɔr nɛ o pʋpielim piini la zug.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: O yɛl ye, “Asida ba anɛ m nidib, ba anɛ m bibanɛ kʋ faa ma,” dinzug ka o liebi ba Faangid.

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Ba sʋnsa'aŋ wʋsa pɔɔgin, o mɛ daa mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ, ka o tʋm maliak kanɛ bɛɛ o san'an la ka o faaɛn ba O nɔŋilim nɛ o nimbaanlzɔɔr la zug ka o faaɛn ba; ka ʋki ba agɔlaa zi, yʋʋmpʋkʋda la saŋa sa.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala ba zan'as o ka san'am o Siig Kasi la sʋʋnr. Ala ka o liebi ba dataa, ka o mɛŋ zab nɛ ba.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Ani ka o nidib la tiɛn Moses zʋmaana la yɛla ka bu'os ye, “Onɛ da nɔk o paŋtita'ari mɔri ba yina la bɛ ya? Onɛ mɛ dɔlli ba atɛukʋn kena nɛ o kɔnbkemnib la bɛ ya? On kanɛ da nɔk o Siig Kasi niŋi ba sʋʋgin la bɛ ya?

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Onɛ da nɔk o paŋtita'ari dɔlis Moses ni buak atɛuk dinɛ da bɛɛ ba tuon ka li kɛ ka ba dʋ'ʋs o yʋ'ʋr saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: He led his people across like horses running wild without stumbling.
translation_verse: Onɛ da dɔlli ba yi zin'izulima zin'igin ka ba nwɛnɛ wiedbanɛ zɔt paalʋ ni, ka pʋ tu'ugida.

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Ba nwɛnɛ niigi sigid bɔn'ɔgin nɛ, ka Zugsɔb la Siig tisi ba vʋ'ʋsʋm. Fʋn daa guri fʋ nidib la si'em nwa' ye fʋ da' yʋ'ʋtita'are tisi fʋ mɛŋ”.

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Naanim arezana ni gɔs na fʋ na'am zin'ig linɛ an kasi ka vɛnl hali la. Fʋ paŋ nɛ fʋ kpi'euŋ la wʋsa kpɛlim yaanɛ? Fʋ pʋ lɛn zɔti ti nimbaanlig bɛɛ mɔri ti nyɔɔgɔ.

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋnɛ aan ti ba' la'an nɛ Abraham zi' ti la, ka Israel mɛ zan'asi ti la; Oo Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ aan ti ba', ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr buon Faangid kʋdimin sa.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: Oo Zugsɔba, bɔ ka fʋ kɛ ka ti yidigi fʋ suoya la ka digilimi ti sʋnya ka pʋ lɛn na'asidi fɔ? Tinam banɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋmnib nɛ buudkanɛ aan fʋ din la zugɔɔ, lɛm na.

english_verse: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
translation_verse: Ti anɛ fʋ din kʋdimin sa; amaa fʋ pʋ sʋ'ʋg nimbanɛ, ba pʋ mɔri fʋ yʋ'ʋri buonnɛ baa.

english_verse: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, aansim saŋgbana la ka sig na ka zuoya mi'imi fʋ tuon!

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ bugum ɛɛn la'aŋ daad si'em ka kɛ ka ku'om lɛ'ɛg la, ala mɛn, sigim na ka kɛ ka fʋ dataas baŋi fʋ paŋi zem si'em ka buudi wʋsa kiridi fʋ tuon nɛ dabiem!

english_verse: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
translation_verse: Fʋ daa tʋm tʋʋm nyalim sieba ka li lidigi ti. Fʋ daa sig na ka zuoya mi'imi fʋ tuon.

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Fʋ kena sʋŋid banɛ ka tʋʋm sʋma yɛla malisi ba ka ba tɛnri fʋ suoya la. Amaa tinamɛ daa nan kpɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔgi fʋ zi'ela la, fʋ sʋnf daa pɛlig nɛ ti. Ti na niŋ wala nyɛ faangirɛ?

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Ti wʋsa yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ onɛ an dian'ad sɔb nɛ, ka ti pʋpielim tʋʋma la wʋsa nwɛnɛ kparikɛnmilisa; ti wʋsa gɔbilim nɛ nwɛnɛ vankpi'emis, ka ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la mɔri ti ken wʋʋ sisi'em.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: Sɔ' pʋ buonnɛ fʋ yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ mɔɔd ye o li'eli fɔ; bɔzugɔ fʋ bidi ti kʋdig ka kɛ ka ti gɛɛn ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, m Zugsɔba, fʋ anɛ ti ba'. Tinam anɛ ya'ad ka fʋ an onɛ ya'abid; fʋ nu'ugʋ maali ti wʋsa.

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf duoe galisɛ; da tiɛndi ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla baa bi'elaa. Wʋmmi ti sɔsʋg, ka ti anɛ fʋ biis.

english_verse: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Fʋ tempʋbanɛ an kasi la lieb nɛ pipiris; hali Zion lieb nɛ pipirig, ka Jerusalem kilim dabɔɔd.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Ba nyu'oe ti Pʋ'ʋsim Yir linɛ an fʋ din ka vɛnl hali ka ti yaanam da zun'odif anina la, ka la'asʋma banɛ ka ti su'a anina la wʋsa san'am.

english_verse: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔba, yɛlbama wʋsa paae ti nwa', fʋ na sin ka namisi ti ka li tʋʋgi li bɛnnɛɛ?

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: “M nie m mɛŋi pa'al banɛ pʋ bu'osidi m yɛla la; ka banɛ pʋ ieedim la nyɛɛm. Teŋ kanɛ pʋ buolim la, m yɛli ba ye, ‘Manɛ nwa', manɛ nwa'!’

english_verse: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.
translation_verse: Daar wʋsa, m tiɛn m nu'us ye m di'e nimbanɛ tʋba zian'as ka ba dɔlli ba mɛŋ bɔɔdim nɛ ba mɛŋ pʋtɛn'ɛr la.

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: Nidib nwa' kennɛ m san'an na saŋa wʋsa duodi m sʋʋnr. Ba maan maana lɔmbɔn'ɔdin, ka nyu'od bʋnnyubisa tisid teŋgbana bimbim banɛ ka ba nwɛ' tampiga mɛ' la zug.

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: Ba zin'inɛ yaadin yʋ'ʋŋ-yʋ'ʋŋ n gu'usidi bɔɔd sʋŋir kpi'imnam san'an. Ba ɔnbid kukur ni'im, ka ba dʋgid pɛ'ɛl nɛ biim linɛ ka' nyainnɛ.

english_verse: And then they say to others, “Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God.” Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.
translation_verse: Ba yɛti ba taaba ye, ‘Tɔɔmi; da li'eli ma, ka man anɛ kasi ka fʋ kʋ nyaŋi li'eli ma!’ Nimban la nwɛnɛ nyɔ'ɔsi na kpandi m nindaa, ka nwɛnɛ bugum na dit dabismum ka pʋ kpiisɛ.

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, li sɔbi zi'e m tuon. M kʋ sinna, m na lɛbisi yɔ ka li paae li bɛn; M na yɔɔ ba din nar si'em,

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
translation_verse: ban nɛ ba saamnam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la.” Zugsɔb la yɛl ala. “Ban nyu'od maana zuoya ni ka diisi m nyan kʋkʋna zug la, ka m na namisi ba wʋʋ lin nar si'em.”

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Nwɛnɛ tiis wala na bi'igi tʋʋg ka ba ye ba na nɔki li bas ka nidib yɛt ye, ‘Da san'ami li ka li nan an sʋm si'em la,’ ala ka m mɛ na niŋi m tʋmtʋmnib la; m kʋ san'ami ba wʋsaa.

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: M na mɔr Jakob yaas na, nɛ Juda dim banɛ na kena sʋ'oe m zuoya la; m nimbanɛ ka m gaŋ la na dii li faar, ani ka m tʋmtʋmnib la na bɛ.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: M nimbanɛ ieedim la, Saron na kilim yaama zin'igi tisi ba kɔnbid ka Akor bɔn'ɔg la an zin'ikanɛ ka ba niigi vʋ'ʋsid.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: Amaa yanam banɛ bas Zugsɔb la ka tami m zuokanɛ an kasi la ka ieed zusʋŋ tiim Gad onɛ an ba'ar san'an ka pɛ'ɛl nwama nɛ daam kaanbid Meni la,

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: m na kɛ ka ba kʋʋ ya nɛ sʋ'ʋraug, ka ya wʋsa na igini tis onɛ kʋʋdi ya la. Bɔzugɔ, m buol ya, ka ya pʋ siakɛ, m pian' ya amaa ya pʋ kɛlisɛ. Ya tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi m san'an ka maan linɛ pʋ malisi ma.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “M tʋmtʋmnib la na di, amaa yanam na ken nɛ kɔ'ɔm; m tʋmtʋmnib la na nu, amaa yanam na ken nɛ ku'onuud; m tʋmtʋmnib la na maan sumalisim, amaa ba na diis yanam nyan.

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: Man tʋmtʋmnib la na yʋ'ʋm ka li anɛ sumalisim linɛ bɛ ba sʋnya ni la zug, amaa yanam na kaasid ka li anɛ ya sʋnsa'aŋ zug, ya na kaas buki nɛ tɔɔg.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Ya yʋ'ʋr na anɛ nɔpɔɔri tis banɛ ka m gaŋ la. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na kʋʋ ya, amaa o na tis o tʋmtʋmnib la yʋ'ʋpaala.

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa bɛ teŋ la zug ka sɔs bareka, o na niŋ ala nɛ Wina'am Kanɛ an Sida Sɔb la yʋ'ʋr zug. Onɛ wʋsa yɛl nɔɔri zi'el teŋ la zug na pɔ nɛ Wina'am Kanɛ an Sida Sɔb la yʋ'ʋr zug. Yɛlmugusa banɛ gaad la m na tami ba yɛla ka kʋ lɛn tiɛn ba, baa bi'elaa.” Arezana paal nɛ dunia paal

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: “Gɔsima, m na maal arezana paal nɛ dunia paal. Ba na tam yɛlkʋda la yɛla, sɔ' kʋ lɛn tɛn'ɛsi ba yɛllɛ.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: M na mɔr sumalisim nɛ Jerusalem yɛla ka mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ m nidib la; sɔ' kʋ lɛn wʋm kaasig nɛ kukuma ani ya'asɛ.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Bilies kʋdim kʋ lɛn kpi teŋin la bɛɛ dau bɛ ka kʋ kʋdigi paae o bɛnnɛ; onɛ kpi wʋʋ yʋma kɔbiga ba na yɛl ye o kpinɛ kansir bɛɛ o anɛ na'akin; onɛ pʋ paae yʋʋm kɔbiga ka kpi, ba na yɛl ye nɔpɔɔri ya'a bɛɛ o zugin.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Ba na mɛɛ ba ya' ka kpɛn'; ba na sɛ tiwanna ba pɔɔdin ka dii li wala.

english_verse: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ lɛm mɛ' ya' ka sieba faaɛn kpɛn', bɛɛ ba sɛ tiis ka sieba faaɛn li dii. Bɔzugɔ, tiig dabisa zu'oe si'em la, ala ka m nidib la dabisa mɛ na zu'oe; m nidib la na dii ba nu'us tʋʋma nyɔɔd.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ namis zaalim bɛɛ ba du'a biis ye ba nyɛ zutɔɔgʋ; bɔzugɔ, ba na anɛ nimbanɛ ka Zugsɔb la niŋi ba zug bareka, ban nɛ ba yaas wʋsa.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Zaŋku'ar nɛ pɛbil na la'asi dit, ka gbigim na ɔnbid mɔɔd wʋʋ naaf nɛ, amaa tintanni nɛ na an waaf diib. Ba kʋ pu'alim bɛɛ san'am taaba m zuokanɛ aan m mɛŋ din kasi la nii.” Zugsɔb la pian' li.

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Arezana anɛ m na'am gbauŋ, ka dunia la aan m nɔba zi'esim zin'ig. Yir bɔ buudi ka ya na mɛɛ tis mam? Ka m vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'ig na bɛ yaanɛ?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Li ka'anɛ man nu'ugʋ maal bama wʋsa, ka ba bɛ laa?” Zugsɔb la yɛl ala. “Banɛ ka m sʋnf malisi ba yɛla nwa': onɛ sied o mɛŋ ka siak tiakir, ka zɔtim ka di'edi m pian'ad.

english_verse: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ wʋsa nɔk na'araugʋ kʋʋ maal maan nwɛnɛ onɛ kʋ nid nɛ, ka onɛ wʋsa kʋ pɛbil, nwɛnɛ onɛ kɔ'ɔg baa niŋgɔɔnr nɛ. Onɛ wʋsa nɔk zʋʋdi maal maan nwɛnɛ onɛ nɔk kukur ziim maal maan nɛ, onɛ wʋsa nyu'oe tiɛnr bʋnnyubisa nwɛnɛ onɛ maan ba'ar nɛ. Ba gaŋi ba mɛŋ suoya, ka ba sʋnya malis nɛ yɛlkisa banɛ ka ba maan la.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ala ka m mɛ na gaŋ tɔɔgʋ tisi ba ka mɔr ban zɔt si'el la kɛɛn ba zugin na. Bɔzugɔ man buol la, sɔ' pʋ siakɛ, man pian' la, sɔ' pʋ kɛlisɛ. Ba tʋm bɛ'ɛdi m san'an ka gaŋ linɛ pʋ malisi ma.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Wʋmmi Zugsɔb la pian'ad, yanam banɛ nɔŋ o labaar la; “Ya ba'abiis banɛ kisi ya ka yisi ya kallin man yʋ'ʋr zug la, yɛl ye, ‘Kɛl ka ya Zugsɔb la nyɛ na'asi, ka ti gɔsi ya sumalisim la!’ La'an nɛ wala ba na di nyan.

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: Wʋm tʋkpiidʋg kanɛ bɛ tempʋʋgin la, Wʋm tʋkpiidʋg kanɛ bɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la! Li anɛ Zugsɔb la vuudi yɔɔd o bi'emnam linɛ wʋsa nar nɛ ba.

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: M tempʋkanɛ an kasi la nwɛnɛ pu'apʋʋg nɛ, on ti ye o sa'ae saŋsi'a la ka o pʋn du'a; on ti ye o baŋ zabir saŋsi'a la, ka o pʋn du'a biribiŋ.

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn nan mi' wʋm yɛlbama? Anɔ'ɔn nan mi' nyɛ nɛ'? Teŋ nan nyaŋi kpɛm pin'ili bɛ daar yinnee, bɛɛ buudi kpɛn gbirigi bɛɛ? La'an nɛ wala Zion sa'ae nɛ ka li pʋ yuugɛ ka o du'a biis.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ya sa'ae ka lɛɛ kʋ kɛ ka ya du'aa?” Zugsɔb la yɛl ala. Ya Wina'am la yɛl ye, “Man na kɛ ka fʋ sa'ae ka m lɛn giŋi fʋ du'am?

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: Maalim sumalisim nɛ Jerusalem, ka mɔr sumpielim yanam banɛ wʋsa nɔŋ o la, maalimi sumalisim bɛdegʋ nɛ o, yanam banɛ wʋsa kum o yɛla la.

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Ya na mu'a o bin'isim la tig ka ya sʋnya ma'ae. Ya na nuu li sʋ'ʋŋa ka ya ya'amlɛog bɛ teŋ la kpan'am zu'oe si'em la ni.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “M na tis o sumbʋgʋsʋm ka li pʋbidi gɛɛn o nwɛnɛ kɔldaug nɛ, ka tɛɛns bɛdegʋ kpan'am na pʋbidi ken o san'an. O na yuoli ya o nu'usin nwɛnɛ biig nɛ ka ya wa'ad o duma zug.

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a nyɛ nɛ'ɛŋa, ya sʋnya na malis ka ya na nɔbigi ma'ae siaa wʋʋ mɔɔd nɛ; Zugsɔb la paŋ na nie tis o tʋmtʋmnib, amaa o dataas na nyɛɛ o sʋnpɛɛn.

english_verse: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, Zugsɔb la kenna nɛ bugum, ka o zaba tɛrekonam la nwɛnɛ sisi'epiliŋ; o na sig na nɛ o sʋnpɛɛn wʋʋ bugum nɛ, ka o tansʋg nwɛnɛ bugum pielim.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Bugum nɛ zaba sʋ'ʋg ka Zugsɔb la na zaŋi kad nidib wʋsa saria, ka na kʋ nidib bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: “Nimbama nwa' maali ba mɛŋ nyain ye ba keŋi maali ba bada linɛ bɛɛ ba lɔmbɔn'ɔdin la. Ba dɔlli taaba kpɛn'ɛdi ba lɔmbɔn'ɔdin la ɔnbid kukur nɛ dayuus ni'im nɛ ba kisbʋn wʋsa. Amaa m na san'ami ba wʋsa saŋa yinne,” Zugsɔb la yɛl ala.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: “Ka ban tʋm si'el nɛ ban tɛn'ɛsidi makid si'em la zug, ka m bɔɔd ye m kena la'as nidib buudi nɛ pian'ad buudi wʋsa, ka ba na kena nyɛɛm na'am paŋ.

english_verse: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
translation_verse: “M na maal zanbina ba sʋʋgin, ka tʋm banɛ nan vʋe la Tarsis nɛ Libiya nɛ Tubal nɛ Lud dim banɛ mi' tɔɔnb hali la, nɛ Put nɛ Girik dim tɛɛns la, nɛ tɛɛns banɛ lal ka ku'om gilig ka ba nam pʋ wʋmi m yɛla bɛɛ m na'am paŋ la. Ba na mɔɔli m na'am paŋ la yɛla tɛɛnsin la.

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: Ka ba na mɔri ya ba'abiis banɛ bɛ tɛɛns bɛdegʋ sʋʋgin la lɛb zuokanɛ an kasi bɛ Jerusalem la ni na, ka li na an wʋʋ maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la nɛ. Ba na ban'ad widi nɛ zaba tɛrekonam nɛ bʋmis nɛ yʋgʋma.” Zugsɔb la yɛl ala. “Ba na mɔri ba na wʋʋ Israel dimi mɔr zʋʋd maana nɛ maana la'abanɛ an nyain ken Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin na si'em la.

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: M na gaŋi ba sieba ka ba an Levi dim nɛ maanmaannib.” Zugsɔb la yɛl ala.

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Nwɛnɛ arezana paal nɛ dunia paal linɛ ka m maal la na bɛɛ m san'anɛ yuug si'em la, ala ka ya yʋ'ʋr nɛ ya yaas mɛ na bɛɛ yuug.

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nwadpaalig malʋŋ daar nɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar wʋsa, ninsaalib wʋsa na kɛɛn m san'an na igini m tuon.” Zugsɔb la yɛl ala.

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: “Ba na yi yiŋi gɔs banɛ daa zan'asi m nɔɔr la kpii dig si'em; zunzunbanɛ diti ba la kʋ kpii, bɛɛ bugum kanɛ diti ba la kpiisɛ, ka nidib kʋ bɔɔd ye ba li'el anii.”

english_verse: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.
translation_verse: Pian'abama yinɛ Jeremia ni na. O saam da anɛ Hilkia onɛ yi Anatof teŋin na ka an maanmaan Benjamin sʋ'ʋlimin la.

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la labaar da kɛɛn o san'an na saŋa kanɛ ka Juda sʋ'ʋlim Na'ab Josia onɛ an Ammon biig la da dii o na'am la, li yʋʋm pii nɛ atan' saŋa.

english_verse: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
translation_verse: O da nan kpɛn tu'asid Zugsɔb labaar la Na'ab Jehoyakim onɛ an Josia biig na'am saŋa la, mɔr ala ti paae Zedekaya onɛ an Josia biig la na'am yʋʋm pii nɛ yinne, li nwadis anu saŋa. Saŋkan la ka ba da gban'e Jerusalem dimi lɔ'ɔŋ teŋ la. Jeremia n da yɛl si'el la wʋsa bɛ gbauŋ kaŋa pʋʋgin. Zugsɔb la da buol Jeremia si'em nwa'

english_verse: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
translation_verse: “Man da nam pʋ maali fʋ, fʋ ma pʋʋgin la ka m pʋn mi'if, ban da nam pʋ du'af la, ka m gaŋif ka kɛ ka fʋ bɛɛ fʋ kɔn'; M gaŋif ye fʋ an nɔdi'esi tis buudi bɛdegʋ.”

english_verse: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, “Aa, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, man zi' pian'adɛ; m nan anɛ biig.”

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la da yɛlim ye, “Da yɛl ye fʋ anɛ biiga, onɛ wʋsa ni ka m tʋmif asɛɛ ka fʋ keŋ ka yɛl nɔzi'elʋg kanɛ ka m tisif la.

english_verse: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Da zɔti ba dabiem, ka mam na bɛ nɛf ka gurif.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la tiɛn o nu'ugʋ si'isi m nɔɔr ka yɛlim ye, “Nannanna m nɔki m pian'ad la niŋi fʋ nɔɔrin.

english_verse: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
translation_verse: Gɔsima, zina m gaŋif ye fʋ sʋ'oe tɛɛns nɛ sʋ'ʋlimnam. Fʋ na vɔn' ka aans, ka da'ae bas ka san'am ka nyaŋ, ka lɛbisi mɛ' ka sɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb labaar lɛn kɛɛn m san'an na bu'osim ye, “Jeremia, fʋ nyɛ bɔ?” Ka m lɛbis ye, “M gɔsi nyɛ tiig wil.”

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Fʋ sid nyɛɛ li sʋ'ʋŋa, bɔzugɔ m na gɔs ka m pian'ad la tʋm wʋʋ man yɛl si'em la.”

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb labaar lɛn kɛɛn m san'an na ye, “Fʋ nyɛ bɔ?” Ka m lɛbis ye, “M nyɛ dʋk ka li lɛ'ɛd ka gbɛligi lɛbid ya-datiuŋ baba la bɔɔd kpa'ar.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Tɔɔg na yi ya-datiuŋ na kpa'ae yɛɛl banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ la zug wʋsa.”

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: O da lɛn yɛl ye, “M bɔɔd ye m buol nidib nɛ sʋ'ʋlim banɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ la wʋsa la'as na. Ba na'anam na kɛn Jerusalem tempʋʋgin na ka zin'ini ba na'am gbana la zug za'anɔya ni; ba na kena zab nɛ zaŋguoma banɛ giligi li la nɛ Juda tempʋʋs la wʋsa.

english_verse: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
translation_verse: M na kadi m nidib la saria, ban gban'e bugusim ka tam man yɛla, ka nyu'od bʋnnyubisa tisid winsieba ka pʋ'ʋsid linɛ ka ba mɛŋ maal nɛ ba nu'us la.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb lɛn yɛlim ye, “Ti'ebim sʋ'ʋŋa! Duom zi'en ka yɛli ba man yɛlif ye fʋ yɛli ba si'el la wʋsa. Da zɔɔ ba dabiem, ya'a ka' ala m na kpɛn'ɛsif dabiem hali ba tuon.

english_verse: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
translation_verse: Juda na'anam nɛ ba kpɛɛmnam nɛ ba maanmaannib nɛ teŋ la tadimnam wʋsa na duoe zan'asif. Amaa zina m maalif nɛ ka fʋ nwɛnɛ tempʋkanɛ mɔr paŋ hali, nɛ kʋnt zan'antɔlig bɛɛ kʋntzɛn'ug zaŋguom.

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: Ba na zab nɛf, amaa ba kʋ nyaŋɛ, bɔzugɔ mam na bɛ nɛf ka faanf.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord told me
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb labaar kɛɛn m san'an na ye,

english_verse: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
translation_verse: “Kem mɔɔl ka Jerusalem dim tʋba wʋm ye, “‘M tɛnr fʋn da an na'akin ka pɛsigi fʋ mɛŋ si'em ka dɔllim sian'arin teŋ kanɛ ka ba daa nan zi' bʋd la.

english_verse: You belonged to me alone, like the first part of the harvest, and I severely punished those who mistreated you.
translation_verse: Israel da anɛ kasi tis Zugsɔb la, ka nwɛnɛ waldɛɛnna o bunib saŋa; m da zaŋid banɛ wʋsa daami m nidib la taal, ka kɛ ka tɔɔg lii ba zugin.’” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye: “Ya yaanam nyɛ gbɛlʋŋ bɔ man san'an ka li kɛ ka ya basim ka yirida? Ba da dɔlli ba'ayaalis ka lieb ninyaalis.

english_verse: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.
translation_verse: M da mɔri ya na kpɛn'ɛs teŋ kanɛ mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm ye ya dii li zʋʋd linɛ maan sʋ'ʋŋa la. Amaa ya kena kɛ ka teŋ la lieb dian'ad ka kɛ ka m faar lieb bʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la pʋ bu'os ye, ‘Zugsɔb la bɛ yaanɛ?’ Banɛ tʋmmi m wada tʋʋma la zi' ma, ka tuongatib la zan'asi m nɔɔr. Nɔdi'esidib la pian'adi Baal yɛla, ka dɔl ba'ayaalis.

english_verse: I will take you to court and accuse you and your descendants *
translation_verse: Dinzug, m na lɛn zaŋi ya taal ya'as; hali ka zaŋi ya biis nɛ ya yaas taal mɛn.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.
translation_verse: “Lɔ'ɔŋiminɛ atɛukʋ keŋ Kitim teŋgbauŋʋn la gɔsi. Kemi Kedar nɛ tɛɛns banɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ la gɔsi kii ye lina taaba nam mi' niŋɛɛ?

english_verse: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Buudsi'a nam mi' tiaki ba Wina'am? Amaa man nidib la nɔki man na'am pipilim la tiaki li dɔl ba'ayaalis.

english_verse: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
translation_verse: “M nidib la tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zin'is ayi': Ba zan'asimnɛ ba zan'as man kanɛ an nyɔvʋr ku'om bulig la, ka tuu ba mɛŋ bulis, bulis banɛ li' ka ku'om pʋ bunna.

english_verse: People of Israel, you weren't born slaves; you were captured in war.
translation_verse: Israel anɛ sankpan'as bɛɛ ba du'a o nɛ yammidi nɛ? Ka bɔɔ niŋ ka o nwɛnɛ onɛ ka ba zabi gban'e o?

english_verse: Enemies roared like lions and destroyed your land; towns lie burned and empty.
translation_verse: Gbigima nwa'am ya, ka maan tʋkpiidʋg o san'an. Ba san'am o teŋ la bas: ba nyu'oe o tempʋʋs la ka sɔ' pʋ lɛm bɛɛ ani.

english_verse: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
translation_verse: Memfis nɛ Tapenɛs nidib mɛ kena nwɛ' ya zuti nwa'asi nwa'as.

english_verse: It's all your own fault! You stopped following me, the Lord your God,
translation_verse: Li ka' ya mɛŋi mɔri li ya zugin naa? Ya zan'asi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ mɔri ya yina la dɔllim.

english_verse: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ya bugusim la zug ya na di'e li namisʋg; ya nya'aŋ lɛbig la na kɛ ka ya nyɛ namisʋg. Tɛn'ɛsimi ka baŋi li bɛ'ɛd nɛ lin na tɔi si'em tisi ya, ya bas man kanɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la ka pʋ lɛn zɔti ma.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ nwa'.

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: “Ya kɔ'ɔg yu'asindaug la ka kɛns baans linɛ lɔɔ ya la ka li yuug. Ya yɛl ye, ‘Ti kʋ lɛn tʋm tisi fɔ!’ Sida, ya bɛ nɛ zuotitada zug nɛ tititada wʋsa gbina nii pʋ'ʋsid winsieba, wʋʋ ya anɛ pu'agɔɔnda nɛ.

english_verse: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine. Israel Is Stained with Guilt
translation_verse: M da gaŋif nɛ sɛ, ka fʋ nwɛnɛ tisʋŋ ka til la mɛ an sʋm. Ka li niŋ wala ka fʋ zan'asim ka lieb mɔɔgin tibɛ'ɛdɛ?

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ fʋn pie fʋ mɛŋ nɛ zɛɛm nɛ ki'ibʋ bɛdegʋ la, fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ kɛ ka fʋ si' la nam pʋ yii, li nan kpɛm bɛɛ fʋ niŋgbiŋin.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋ tita'ar sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ nwa'.

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
translation_verse: “Fʋ na niŋ wala yɛl ye, ‘Man ka' dian'ad sɔba; mam pʋ zɔɔ yii dɔl Baalnama’? Gɔsim fʋn tʋm si'em bɔn'ɔgin la, tɛn'ɛsim fʋn tʋm si'el la. Fʋ nwɛnɛ yʋgʋm nya'aŋ kanɛ ɛɛnti zɔɔ lɛb kpɛ' ka zɔɔ lɛb kpɛ' nɛ.

english_verse: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
translation_verse: Da zɔ ka ta'ada kɛns ka fʋ nɔba kpɛlim biel, bɛɛ kɛ ka fʋ kʋkɔr kʋdigɛ. Amaa fʋ yɛl ye, ‘Li ka' gbinnɛ. Win zʋna la ka mam bɔɔd, asɛɛ m dɔlli ba.’

english_verse: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
translation_verse: Ba ɛɛnti yɛl tiig ye, ‘Fʋnɛ aan m ba',’ ka yɛl kugir ye, ‘Fʋnɛ du'am.’ Ba fɛndigi ba nindaas ka bidi m kʋdig; amaa ba ya'a ti bɛ yɛla ni ba buonim nɛ ye, ‘Kem na faaɛn ti!’

english_verse: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
translation_verse: Wina banɛ ka ya mɛŋ maal la bɛ yaanɛ? Ba ya'a na nyaŋi faaɛn ya, alaa ya ya'a bɛ yɛla ni yanam on buoliminɛ ba! Bɔzugɔ Juda mɔr wina bɛdegʋ ka ba zu'oe nwɛnɛ ba tempʋʋs la zu'oe si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka ya yɛl ye manɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ? Ya wʋsa zan'asim.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.
translation_verse: “M namisi ya nidib la nɛ zaalim, ba pʋ di'ed sa'alʋgɔ; ya zabi kʋʋ ya nɔdi'esidib wʋʋ gbigim kanɛ ka kɔ'ɔm mɔr o.
