english_verse: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
translation_verse: Yanam zʋmaʋŋ kaŋa dima, tɛn'ɛsimi man Zugsɔb labaar la yɛla: M anɛ teŋ kanɛ an pipirigi tisi ya bɛɛ teŋ kanɛ an lika? Bɔ ka m nidib la yɛl ye, ‘Ti mɔr yɔlisim na gɔɔn ti ya'aminɛ; ti kʋ lɛn kɛɛn fʋ san'an na ya'asɛ’?

english_verse: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.
translation_verse: Pu'asadir na tam o niŋgɔnkɔris yɛlaa, bɛɛ pu'apaal tam o duorim la'ad yɛla? La'an nɛ wala, man nidib la tami m yɛla, ka li dabisa yuug.

english_verse: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.
translation_verse: Ya sid mi' yanamɛ na maal si'em nyɛ sabuos! Hali banɛ an pu'agɔɔnda amɛŋa la na zamisi ya suoya la.

english_verse: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
translation_verse: Tadimnam ziim bɛɛ ya fuudin la ka li pa'an ye ya kʋʋ ba. Hali yanamɛ pʋ gban'e ba ka ba kɔɔ kpɛn'ɛd la, la'an nɛ wala

english_verse: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.
translation_verse: fʋ yɛl ye, ‘Man zi' ti'irɛ; o sʋnf pʋ pɛlig nɛ mam.’ Amaa m na kadif saria bɔzugɔ fʋ yɛl ye, ‘Mam pʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ.’

english_verse: When Assyria let you down, you quickly ran to Egypt, but you'll find no help there,
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ zɔti giligidi tia'asidi fʋ suoya? Egipt na lugif wʋʋ Asiria da maalif si'em la.

english_verse: and you will leave in great sadness. I won't let you find help from those you trust.
translation_verse: Fʋ mɛ na yii anina ka nɔki fʋ nu'usi kʋk zug bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb la zan'as banɛ ka fʋ nɔki fʋ ti'iri niŋ la: ba kʋ sʋŋif baa bi'elaa.”

english_verse: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Dau ya'a bas o pu'a ka pu'a la tɔɔm kul dau sɔ', dau la na nyaŋi lɛb pu'a la nii? Ala kʋ kɛ ka teŋ la mɔr dian'adɛɛ? Amaa gɔsima, ya niŋ wala maali ya mɛŋ wʋʋ pu'agɔɔnda? Banɛ ka ya nɔŋ ka dɔl la anɛ bɛdegʋ, ya yʋ'ʋn na niŋ wala lɛb man san'an na?” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.
translation_verse: “Gɔsim gilig zuoya la zin'is wʋsa ye zin'isi'a bɛ ka ba pʋ digin nɛ yaa? Ya zin' suor kpikpɛŋi guri ya sabuos. Ya su'a zin' nwɛnɛ Arab dim faandib banɛ bɛ pipirisin la. Ya kɛ ka teŋ la lieb dian'ad ya pu'agɔɔnda tʋʋma nɛ ya bugusim tʋʋma la zug.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m kɛ ka saa pʋ lɛn niida, ka sadɛɛŋ mɛ lɛn kae. La'an nɛ wala ya maali ya mɛŋ wʋʋ pu'agɔɔnda; ka nan zan'as ka pʋ zɔti li nyannɛ.

english_verse: You call me your father or your long-lost friend;
translation_verse: Nannanna ka ya yʋ'ʋn buolim ka yɛl ye, ‘M ba', fʋ anɛ man zua m biilimin sa.

english_verse: you beg me to stop being angry, but you won't stop sinning. The Lord Asks Israel To Come Back to Him
translation_verse: Fʋ sʋnf na pɛligid alaa? Fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la na kpɛn aan ala saŋa wʋsaa?’ Yanamɛ pian'ad si'em nwa', amaa ka sin ka tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd buudi wʋsa linɛ ka ya na nyaŋi tʋm.” Israel dimi ka' sida dim la yɛla

english_verse: When Josiah was king, the Lord said: Jeremiah, the kingdom of Israel was like an unfaithful wife who became a prostitute on the hilltops and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Na'ab Josia na'am saŋa la ka Zugsɔb la da yɛlim ye, “Fʋ nyɛ Israel dim la pʋ mɔr sida si'em? Israel dʋt kʋkʋn tita'ar wʋsa zug ka ken tititada wʋsa gbinnin tʋm linɛ nwɛnɛ pu'agɔɔndir tʋʋma anina.

english_verse: I knew that the kingdom of Israel had been unfaithful and committed many sins, yet I still hoped she might come back to me. But she didn't, so I divorced her and sent her away. Her sister, the kingdom of Judah, saw what happened, but she wasn't worried in the least, and I watched her become unfaithful like her sister.
translation_verse: M tis Israel onɛ ka' sida sɔb la pu'abasib kasɛta gbauŋ ka kad o yis o dausan'auŋ la zug. La'an nɛ wala, o pitʋ Juda pʋ zɔ dabiem, ka mɛ yii keŋ san'am dap.

english_verse: The kingdom of Judah wasn't sorry for being a prostitute, and she didn't care that she had made both herself and the land unclean by worshiping idols of stone and wood.
translation_verse: Israel dimi pʋ gɔs ka dian'ad tʋʋma an bɛ'ɛd la zug, ba dɔlli kuga nɛ tiisi tʋm wʋʋ pu'agɔɔnda nɛ, ka kɛ ka teŋ la wʋsa lieb dian'ad.

english_verse: Even the people of Israel were honest enough not to pretend.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye Israel onɛ ka' sida sɔb la lɛɛ an pʋpielim sɔbi gaad Juda onɛ ka' sida la.

english_verse: Jeremiah, shout toward the north: Israel, I am your Lord— come back to me! You were unfaithful and made me furious, but I am merciful, and so I will forgive you.
translation_verse: Ka lɛn yɛlim ye m fɛndigim kpa' ya-datiuŋ baba mɔɔl ye, “Lɛm na, Israel onɛ ka' sida sɔbaa!” “M kʋ lɛn lɔɔm nindaa nɛ fʋn ya'asɛ, bɔzugɔ, m anɛ nimbaanlzɔt.” “M sʋnpɛɛn la kʋ kpɛm bɛ saŋa wʋsaa. Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: You are unfaithful children, but you belong to me. Come home! I'll take one or two of you from each town and clan and bring you to Zion.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Lɛmmi na, nimbanɛ ka' sida dima, manɛ aan ya sid. M na gaŋi ya nid yinne-yinne tempʋʋg wʋsa ni, ka gaŋ nidib ayi' tuŋ wʋsa ni, mɔri ya kɛn Zion na.

english_verse: Then I'll appoint wise rulers who will obey me, and they will care for you like shepherds.
translation_verse: Ala ka m na tisi ya kɔnbkem sʋma banɛ paae m ya'am ka ba na gaadi ya tuon nɛ baŋir ka an banɛ gban'ad pian'ad gbin sʋ'ʋŋa.”

english_verse: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ba na buol Jerusalem ye, ‘Zugsɔb Na'am Zin'ig’, ka buudi wʋsa na la'as Jerusalem na na'as Zugsɔb la. Ba kʋ lɛm mɔr zukpi'euŋ nɛ ba sʋnya digilim si'em la.

english_verse: Then, in countries to the north, you people of Judah and Israel will be reunited, and you will return to the land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Dabisban la ya'a ti paae, Juda dim na la'as nɛ Israel dim ka ba naan ya-datiuŋ na keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka m tisi ya yaanam ye li aan ba faar la.”

english_verse: I have always wanted to treat you as my children and give you the best land, the most beautiful on earth. I wanted you to call me “Father” and not turn from me.
translation_verse: Mam mɛŋ yɛl ye, “Li na malisim ka m na mɔri ya wʋʋ m biis ka na tisi ya teŋ kanɛ mɔr ya'amlɛog faar kanɛ vɛnl hali gat buudbanɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa tɛɛns la. M bɔɔdin ye ya na buolim ye, ‘Ti Ba',’ ka kʋ lɛn fɛndig ka basim dɔllim.

english_verse: I will tell them, “Come back, and I will cure you of your unfaithfulness.” They will answer, “We will come back, because you are the Lord our God.

english_verse: On hilltops, we worshiped idols and made loud noises, but it was all for nothing— only you can save us.

english_verse: Then I told the people of Israel, “Put on sackcloth! Mourn and cry out, ‘The Lord is still angry with us.’ ”
translation_verse: Alazug, yɛɛmi bɔto fuudi pa'ali ya sʋnsa'aŋ, fabilimi ka kumi, Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn tita'ar linɛ mɔr dabiem la nam pʋ yii ti san'an la zug.

english_verse: The Lord said, “When all this happens, the king and his officials, the prophets and the priests will be shocked and terrified.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛli ya nyain ye, “Daakan la, na'ab la nɛ kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa ya'am na bɔdig, maanmaannib sʋnya na san'am, ka li na pak nɔdi'esidib la.”

english_verse: I said, “You are the Lord God. So why have you fooled everyone, especially the people of Jerusalem? Why did you promise peace, when a knife is at our throats?” The Coming Disaster
translation_verse: Ani ka m da yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb Wina'am, gɔsim fʋn ma' nimbama nɛ Jerusalem dim si'em, fʋ yɛli ba ye, ‘Ya na mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm,’ hali ka zaba bɛɛ ti zugin.”

translation_verse: ‘Fʋ mɛŋ itʋŋ nɛ fʋ tʋʋma la zi nɛ'ɛŋa kɛɛn fʋ zugin na. Nɛ'ɛŋa aan fʋ namisʋg. Li na tɔi tisif! Li na zabi kpɛn' fʋ sʋnfʋn!’”

english_verse: I can't stand the pain! My heart pounds, as I twist and turn in agony. I hear the signal trumpet and the battle cry of the enemy, and I cannot be silent.
translation_verse: Oo, man sʋnsa'aŋʋ nwaa, man sʋnsa'aŋʋ nwaa! Li zabidimnɛ ka m liebid. Oo, m sʋʋnr san'amya! Li zabidnɛ kpɛn'ɛdi m sʋnfʋn, m ya'am wʋsa tuodnɛ ka m kʋ nyaŋi mɔdigɛ. Man wʋm na'atan piebʋg ka wʋm ka ba nwɛ'ɛd tanp kuŋ la zug.

english_verse: I see the enemy defeating us time after time, leaving everything in ruins. Even my own home is destroyed in a moment.
translation_verse: Yɛl tɔɔg yinne gaad ka yinne dɔl; ka teŋ la wʋsa lieb dabɔɔd. M sʋgʋr la gbirigi san'am, li pʋ yuugɛ ka m gbɛɛnsir zin'ig san'am.

translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛbisi yɛl ye, “Man nidib la anɛ zɔn; ba zi' ma. Ba anɛ biis banɛ ya'am pɔɔd; ba pʋ gban'ad si'el gbinnɛ. Ba zan'aŋ nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd tʋʋma hali; ka zi' linɛ an sʋm maalʋgɔ.”

english_verse: Enemy cavalry and archers shout their battle cry. People run for their lives and try to find safety among trees and rocks. Every town is empty.
translation_verse: Banɛ ban'ad widi nɛ banɛ tɔɔnd piema la dammir kɛ ka tempʋʋs wʋsa nidib zɔ. Sieba kpɛn' nɛ gɔn'ɔsin; ka sieba dʋ tampiins zug. Ba zɔnɛ ka bas tempʋʋs la wʋsa; sɔ' pʋ lɛm bɛɛ ani ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your land has been wiped out. But you act like a prostitute and try to win back your lovers, who now hate you. You can put on a red dress, gold jewelry, and eye shadow, but it's no use— your lovers are out to kill you!
translation_verse: Fʋn teŋ kanɛ lɛn ka' vɔɔnr nwa', bɔ ka fʋ yɛɛd fuvɛnla ka kɔr sanlima niŋgɔnkɔrisɛ? Bɔ ka fʋ mɔ'ɔsidi fʋ nindaa? Fʋ maannɛ fʋ mɛŋ nɛ zaalim. Banɛ daa nɔŋif la nɛ'ɛsif nɛ; ka mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋf.

translation_verse: Dinzug duomi, ka ti keŋ yʋ'ʋŋʋ zab nɛ o ka san'am o kpi'euŋ zin'is la wʋsa!’”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye: “Nwaamɛ tiis la ka maal datti gilig Jerusalem zaŋguoma. Asɛɛ tempʋkaŋa nyɛ namisʋg; li pɛ'ɛli nɛ mugusʋg.

english_verse: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
translation_verse: Bulig ku'om bun si'em la, ala ka o bugusim la mɛ yit na. Zaba nɛ san'auŋ pʋtɛn'ɛr ma'aa bɛɛ o ni; o ban'as nɛ o sapu'ad la bɛ nɛ m tuon saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Listen to me, you people of Jerusalem and Judah. I will abandon you, and your land will become an empty desert.
translation_verse: Di'em nimmua sa'alʋg, O Jerusalem, ya'a ka' ala, m na fɛndig ka basif, ka kɛ ka fʋ teŋ la kpɛlim zaalim ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn nyaŋi bɛ teŋ la pʋʋginɛ.”

english_verse: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah's Anger
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye: “Kɛl ka ba wi'is Israel dim banɛ kpɛlim la sʋ'ʋŋa wʋʋ vain tiis wala ka ba wi'isid si'em la: nɔkim nu'ugʋ tʋm wila la ni ya'as, wʋʋ sɔ' na pɔn'ɔd wala banɛ ka ba yaa bas si'em la.”

english_verse: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away The Lord answered: Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn pɛ'ɛli m san'an, ka m kʋ nyaŋi mɔri lii. “Alaa, ka kpa'ami li niŋ biis banɛ bɛ suoraadin la, nɛ na'akim banɛ la'as taaba la! Li na paae dap nɛ ba pu'ab wʋsa, la'an nɛ bʋnkʋd nɛ pu'anya'as wʋsa.

english_verse: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: M sʋnf ya'a ti pɛlig ka m ʋki m nu'ugʋ kpa' banɛ bɛ teŋin la, ba na faaɛn ba ya' la tis sieba, la'an nɛ ba pɔɔd nɛ ba pu'ab” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: “Lin yii ba tadimnamin ti paae ba kpi'emnam la, ba wʋsa anɛ fufum dim ka mɔɔdi ba mɛŋ yɛla ma'aa; nɔdi'esidib nɛ maanmaannib la mɛ anɛ ala, ba wʋsa anɛ ziri dim.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Ba piesidi m nidib la sapu'ad la nɛ m ba'a kae piesʋg ka ma' yɛt ye sumbʋgʋsʋm, sumbʋgʋsʋm, ka sumbʋgʋsʋm mɛ kae.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Ba ya'a zɔt nyan nɛ ba tʋʋmyaalis la yɛla? Ayei, ba zi' nyan baa bi'elaa; hali ba zug pʋ ziida. Alazugɔ, ba na kpii paas banɛ kpi la zug; m ya'a ti namisi ba, ba na sie ba teŋin.” Zugsɔb la yɛl.

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye: “Zi'enimi suokita la ni ka gɔs; bu'osim yʋʋmpʋkʋda suokʋda la yɛla, bu'osim suosʋŋ la bɛ zin'isi'a ka dɔlli li, ka ya siis na paam yɔlisim.” Amaa ya yɛl ye, “Tinam kʋ dɔlli li zugɔ.”

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: “M gaŋ sieba ye ba guri ya ka yɛl ye, ‘Kɛlisim na'atan la piebʋg!’ Amaa ya yɛl ye, ‘Tinam kʋ kɛlisɛ.’

english_verse: So I tell all nations on earth, “Watch what I will do!
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, buudi woo kɛlisimi; kasɛtiba, kpansimi ka gɔs linɛ na niŋi ba.

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋɔ, wʋmma! M mɔri tɔɔgʋ ken nimbama zugin na, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɔɔdi la. Bɔzugɔ, ba pʋ kɛlisi m pian'adɛ ka zan'asi m wada la.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: Bɔ ka Seeba teŋ bʋnnyubisa la yɛla paki ma bɛɛ bʋnnyubisa banɛ yi teŋ lalli la? Man kʋ di'e ya nyu'or maana la; ya maana la wʋsa pʋ ma'adi m sʋʋnrɛ.”

english_verse: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
translation_verse: Dinzug, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “M na bɔ si'elnamɛ digil nimbama tuon. Ka ba saamnam nɛ ba biis wʋsa na tu'usidi lit; ka ba kpi'es nɛ ba zuanam wʋsa na kpi.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye: “Gɔsima, tanp kenna, ba yinɛ ya-datiuŋʋ kenna; teŋ tita'ar nidib sʋnf duoe nɛ ya ka ba yi teŋgbauŋ la kpikpɛŋi kenna.

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: Ba bɔbnɛ nɛ tiraad nɛ kpana; ba anɛ bugusim dim ka pʋ zɔt nimbaanliga. Ba ban'adi ba widi la, ba vuudi nwɛnɛ atɛuk ku'om kenna nwɛnɛ banɛ yi tanp nwɛ'ɛb nɛ ye ba zab nɛ yanam Zion dim.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: Ti wʋmi ba yɛla ka ti nu'us kpi. Ti sʋnya san'am ya, ka li zabidi ti nwɛnɛ pu'a na sa'ae bɔɔd du'am.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Da yi paalʋ bɛɛ ya dɔl suoyaa, ka dataa la mɔr zaba sʋ'ʋg, ka dabiem gilig zin'ig wʋsa.

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: Oi! M nidibaa, yɛɛmi bɔto fuud ka bilim tampɛligimin sʋnsa'aŋ zug; kaasimi nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ tɔɔg wʋʋ sɔ' biribiŋ yimmiri na kpi nɛ. Ka san'auŋ sɔb la na gbirigi kɛɛn ti san'an na.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa anɛ banɛ tʋba pʋ wʋmma, ba giligidi san'amid nidib yʋda. Ba nwɛnɛ kʋnt zɛn'ug nɛ kʋnt kanɛ kpi'em; ba wʋsa anɛ ziri dim.

english_verse: Silver can be purified in a fiery furnace, but my people are too wicked to be made pure, and so I have rejected them.
translation_verse: Ba na buonnɛ ba ye anzurifa kanɛ ka ba zan'as, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la zan'asi ba.”

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amaa ba pʋ wʋmi m pian'ad bɛɛ kɛlisɛ. Ba anɛ zukpi'euŋ dim ka tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi gaadi ba yaanam.”

english_verse: Stop taking advantage of foreigners, orphans, and widows. Don't kill innocent people. And stop worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: ka pʋ mugusid saam nɛ kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya, ka mɛ pʋ kʋʋd nidib zaalim-zaalim zin'ikaŋa, ka mɛ pʋ dɔl winsieba san'ami ya mɛŋa,

english_verse: The Lord told me to stand by the gate of the temple and tell the people who were going in that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: Pay attention, people of Judah! Change your ways and start living right, then I will let you keep on living in your own country.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb ka an Israel Wina'am la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye: Tiakimi ya suoya nɛ ya itʋŋ, ka m na kɛ ka ya bɛ kpɛla.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.
translation_verse: Da niŋi pian'ad linɛ an ziri la yadda ka ye, “Zugsɔb la Yiri nwa', Zugsɔb la Yiri nwa', Zugsɔb la Yiri nwa'!”

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a sid tiaki ya suoya nɛ ya itʋŋ ka dɔl taaba nɛ sida,

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: ala ka m na kɛ ka ya bɛ teŋ kanɛ ka m da nɔki tisi ya yaanam ye li aan ba din saŋa wʋsa la ni.

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: Amaa gɔsima, ya tis ziri pian'ad linɛ ka' gbin la sida.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: “Ya na zuud ka kʋʋd ka dap nɛ pu'ab san'amid taaba, ka pɔɔd nɛ wina banɛ ka' sida la, ka nyu'od bʋnnyubisa nɛ maana tisid Baal ka dɔl wina banɛ ka ya da zi',

english_verse: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
translation_verse: ka lɛn kena zi'en man tuon yikaŋa linɛ ka man yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ li ni la yɛt ye, ‘Ti nyɛ yɔlisim.’ Ya nyɛɛ ya mɛŋ nɛ ye ya tʋm yɛlkisa banɛ ka ya tʋm laa? Ala dɔl suorɛɛ?

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: Yikanɛ ka man yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ li ni la liebnɛ faandib suak yiri tisi yaa? Amaa man nan gɔsidi ya nɛ kii.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: Ka lɛn yɛl ye, “Kem Siilo zin'ikanɛ ka m da dɛŋi kɛ ka m yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ anina la, ka gɔs mam maali li si'em m nidib Israel dim bugusim la zug.

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ daa maan nwa' la wʋsa m daa pian' tisi ya taki tak amaa ka ya pʋ kɛlisɛ; m buoli ya ka ya pʋ siakɛ.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: “Dinzug, man daa niŋ Siilo si'em la, nannanna m mɛ na niŋ yikanɛ ka m yʋ'ʋr bɛ la nɛ zin'ikanɛ ka ya ti'ir bɛ ka m tisi ya nɛ ya yaanam la ala mɛn.

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋ nyɛ ban tʋm si'el Juda tempʋʋsin nɛ Jerusalem suoraadin laa?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Biis la la'asid daad ka ba saamnam la nyu'od bugum ka pu'ab la nɔn zɔ'ɔm maan bodobodo tisid win kanɛ ka ba buon ‘Arezana Pu'ana'ab’ la, ka lɛm mɔr daam tisid winsieba ka li pɛligidi m sʋnf.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Li anɛ man sʋʋnr ka ba duodaa? Li ka'anɛ ba mɛŋ ka ba maan bɛ'ɛd, ka diisidi ba mɛŋ nyannɛɛ?” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye: “M sʋnpɛɛn la wʋsa na bu'oe niŋ zin'ikaŋa. M na niŋi li ninsaalib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid nɛ tiis nɛ bʋnwanna linɛ bɛ teŋin la, ka li na dit wʋʋ bugum ka pʋ kpiisida.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, but I won't accept sacrifices from you. So don't even bother bringing them to me. You might as well just cook the meat for yourselves.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa an linɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb ka an Israel Wina'am la yɛl ye, “Kemi tuon nɛ ya nyu'or maana, nɛ maana banɛ bɛ la wʋsa, ka ɔnbi li ni'im!

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Man da mɔri ya yaanamɛ yi Egipt na ka pian' tisi ba la, m da pʋ tisi ba nɔɔr ye ba da maal nyu'or maana, nɛ maana banɛ bɛ, ma'aanɛ;

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: amaa m da tisi ba nɛ nɔkaŋa ye, ‘Siakimini m nɔɔr ka m aan ya Wina'am, ka yanam na aan m nidib. Dɔlli suobanɛ ka m tisi ya la, ka si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa tisi ya.’

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Amaa ba da pʋ wʋmi m pian'ad bɛɛ kɛligɛ. Ba lɛɛ da dɔlli ba zukpi'euŋ nɛ ba pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd la. Ba da lɛbidi nya'aŋ ka pʋ ken tuonnɛ.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Lin yi saŋa kanɛ ka ya yaanam da yi Egipt la ti paae nannanna, m tʋmmi m nɔdi'esidib dabisir wʋsa nɛ saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Dinzug yɛlimi ba ye, ‘Buudkaŋa zan'as Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɔɔr ka mɛ pʋ siak sa'alʋgɔ. Sida bɔdig ya; li naae ba nɔŋgbana ni.

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: Kiesimi ya zuobid la lɔbi bas; ka kaasidi dɔl zuoya nɛ pipirisin la ken, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la zan'as zʋmaʋŋ kaŋa ka basi ba, ban kɛ ka o sʋnf duoe la zug.’” Ninkʋʋr bɔn'ɔg

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Juda dim la tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd man tuon. Ba zi'eli ba bada banɛ an bʋnkisa la Yikanɛ ka man yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ ani la kɛ ka li lieb dian'ad. Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: Ba mɛɛ ba maana malʋŋ zin'is linɛ buon Tofet ka bɛ Ben Hinnom Biis Bɔn'ɔgin la, ye ba nyu'oe ba biribis nɛ ba bipumis la maal maana linɛ ka mam pʋ tisi ba nɔɔr bɛɛ li bɛ m pʋtɛn'ɛrinɛ.”

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la. “Baŋimi ka dabisa kenna, ka nidib kʋ lɛm buonnɛ li ye Tofet bɛɛ Ben Hinnom Biis Bɔn'ɔgɔ, amaa ba na buon ye, kʋʋb Bɔn'ɔg bɔzugɔ, ba na mum nimbanɛ ka ba kʋ la anina hali ka paalʋ ti naae nyain.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ kpi nwa niŋgbiŋ na lieb diibi tis niis banɛ ian'ad agɔla la nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ bɛ mɔɔgin la, ka sɔ' kae na kadi ba ka ba keŋɛ.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka sumalisim tʋkpiidʋg linɛ ka ba maan la naae, ka ba kʋ lɛn wʋm dau nɛ o pu'apaal kʋkɔya Juda tempʋʋsin nɛ Jerusalem suoraadin la, teŋ la na ti lieb zaalim la zug.”

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Saŋa kan ya'a ti paae, ba na lɛɛg Juda na'anam nɛ ba kpɛɛmnam kɔnba, nɛ maanmaannib nɛ nɔdi'esidib nɛ Jerusalem nidib wʋsa kɔnba yii ba yaadin.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: Ba na yisi ba kɔnba dɛlig paalʋ tis winnig nɛ nwadig nɛ nwadbibis banɛ bɛɛ agɔla la, bɔzugɔ bʋmbama ka ba nɔŋ ka tʋmmi tisidi ba, ka mɛ dɔl ka pʋ'ʋsidi ba. Ba kʋ la'asi ba kɔnba la gumm bɛɛ mumi ba, amaa ba na dig teŋin wʋʋ sa'ad nɛ.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka m kadi ba yis, banɛ kpɛlim la na bɔɔd ye ba ya'a kpiin an sʋm gat ban vʋe la.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ nwa. Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ namisʋg

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, m yɛlimi ba ye Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa: “Nidib ya'a li, ba pʋ lɛn duodaa? Sɔ' ya'a yidig suorɛ, o pʋ lɛn lɛbidaa?

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Ka bɔ ka nimbama fɛndigɛ? Bɔ ka Jerusalem fɛndigid saŋa wʋsa? Ba nɔknɛ faadi lusi ba mɛŋ ka zan'as lɛbig na.

english_verse: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.
translation_verse: M kɛlis sʋ'ʋŋa, amaa ba pʋ pian' linɛ dɔl suorɛ. Sɔ' pʋ tiaki yii o bugusim la nii, ka yɛt ye, ‘M maal bɔ?’ Sɔ' wʋsa mɔɔdnɛ o mɔɔr wʋʋ tanp widi nini na mu'oe zaba ni si'em la.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Hali adaalʋŋ kanɛ ian'ad agɔla la mi' o ken saŋa, ka dawana nɛ niis buudi wʋsa kpansi mi' saŋa kanɛ ka ba na ianki tɔɔm zin'ig. Amaa man nidib la zi' si'ela ka pʋ baŋ man Zugsɔb la bɔɔdim.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Ya na niŋ wala yɛl ye, ‘Tinam mɔr ya'am, bɔzugɔ tinam mɔr Zugsɔb la wada,’ ka ya pa'annib banɛ pa'an wada la pʋ sɔbi li nɛ sida tisi ya?

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Ya'am dim la na di nyan; li na libigi ba ka gban'e ba wʋʋ baŋ nɛ. Ban sadigim zan'as Zugsɔb pian'ad la, ya'am bɔ ka ba mɔra?

english_verse: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m na nɔki ba pu'ab la tis dap sieba ka nɔki ba pɔɔd la tis ninsieba ka ba sʋ'ʋgi li. Lin yii ba tadimnamin ti paae ba kpi'emnam la wʋsa mɔri fufum ka mɔɔd ye ba paam; maanmaannib nɛ nɔdi'esidib la wʋsa anɛ ziri dim.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Ba piesidnɛ m nidib la sapu'ad wʋʋ li pʋ zabida. Ba yɛt ye, ‘Sumbʋgʋsʋm, sumbʋgʋsʋm!’ Ka sumbʋgʋsʋm lɛɛ kae.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ zɔti ba itʋŋ bɛ'ɛd la nyannɛɛ? Ayei, ba zi' nyan baa bi'elaa; ba pʋn zi' linɛ yʋ'ʋri buon nyannɛ. Alazug ba na kpii paas banɛ kpi la zug; ba ya'a ti nyɛ namisʋg ba na sie.” Zugsɔb la yɛl.

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: “M na faaɛn ba zʋʋd. Ba vain tiis la kʋ lɛn walɛ. Wala kʋ lɛm bɛ tiig zugɔ, ka li vaand na sʋʋg. Man tisi ba si'el la ba na faaɛn ka kɛɛ ba.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
translation_verse: Nidib la bu'os ye, “Bɔ ka ti zin' kpɛla? La'asimi taaba! Kɛlli ka ti zɔɔ keŋ kpɛn' tempʋkpi'ema la ni lɛɛ kpii ani! Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la pʋn kʋʋsi ti bɛ'ɛd ye ti kpi ka tisi ti yabid ku'om ye ti nu, tinamɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔg o la zug.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Ti mɔr ti'ir ye sumbʋgʋsʋm na bɛ amaa bʋnsʋŋ pʋ yi naa. Ti tɛn'ɛsid ye li na anɛ laafi saŋa amaa li anɛ tɔɔg ma'aa.

english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: Dataas la widi nɔɔd nɛ paŋ ka ti wʋmi ba dammir hali Dan teŋin sa; ba anɛ wiedbɛda ken nɛ kpi'euŋ ka teŋ la wʋsa dammid. Ba kena ye ba san'am teŋ la nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa, ba na san'am tempʋʋg la nɛ nimbanɛ bɛɛ ani la wʋsa.”

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: “Gɔsima, m na tʋm wa'abɛ'ɛdnamɛ ya sʋʋgin, wa'abanɛ ka ya tima dim kʋ nyaŋi ba, ka ba na dumi ya.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, “Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ bʋgʋnnɛ m sʋʋnr, m sʋnf wʋsa san'amnɛ.

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: M nidib la bɛ nɛ teŋ lallisa kaasid; kɛlisim ban kaasid si'em ye, ‘Zugsɔb la lɛn ka' Zion teŋinɛɛ? Zion Na'ab lɛn ka' anii?’” Ka Zugsɔb la lɛbis ye, “Bɔ ka ba duodi m sʋnf nɛ linɛ ka ba ya'ab, nɛ teŋ zʋna bada linɛ ka' gbin la?”

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: Ba yɛt ye, “Bunib saŋa gaad ya, sapal gaad ya, ka ti nam pʋ nyɛ yɔlisim.”

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Ka Jeremia ye, “M nidib la bɛ namisʋg pʋʋgin la mam mɛ bɛ nɛ namisʋg pʋʋgin. M kummi nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ka li zabidim.

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Kpaam linɛ ma'ad zabir ka' Gilead teŋinɛɛ? Du'ata ka' anii? Bɔ ka m nidib banɛ pu'alim la pʋ nyɛ laafi?”

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: M da lɛn yɛl ye, “Oi, m zug ya'a bunnin ku'om ka m nini yit ninta'am ka pʋ gu'oda! M naan kumin nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa m nimbanɛ ka ba kʋ la yɛla.

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: O, m ya'a mɔrin suokennib sʋgʋr ka li bɛ pipirisin la, ka m na kpɛn' ani; m naan basini m nidib la ka tɔɔm ka basi ba; ba wʋsa anɛ banɛ an dapgɔɔnda nɛ pu'agɔɔnda, ba anɛ nimbanɛ zu'oe ka ka' sida dima.”

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb yɛl ye, “Ba gʋdi ba zilima wʋʋ tiraug nɛ, bɔɔd ye ba fa faad. Ba kpi'euŋ kanɛ ka ba mɔr teŋ la zug la yinɛ dama'amin na. Ba tʋmnɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yinne lɔ'ɔŋid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yinne; ba pʋ tɛn'ɛsidi m yɛllɛ.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Jeremiah, all your friends and relatives tell lies about you, so don't trust them.
translation_verse: “Baŋimi fʋ zuanam la yɛla; da tisi fʋ ba'abiis la sidaa. Ba'abiig wʋsa anɛ dama'am sɔb, ka zua wʋsa an yʋ'ʋsan'auŋ sɔb.

english_verse: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.
translation_verse: Zua ma'adi zua, ka sɔ' kae pian'ad sidaa. Ba pa'ali ba zilima la faad; ka tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd hali ka li galis.

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Fʋ bɛ nɛ ziri dim sʋʋgin; ba sida ka'alim la zug ka ba pʋ bɔɔdi m yɛla,” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye: “Gɔsima, m na nyɛligi ba wʋʋ sanlima nɛ maki ba gɔs. Ya'a ka' ala, m nidib la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi zu'oe si'em la m ye m niŋ wala ya'asɛ?

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: Ba zilim nwɛnɛ piim yabid nɛ; ka ba pian'ad nɛ ziri; sɔ' wʋsa pian'ad o kpi'a wʋʋ ba mɔri nɔɔr yinne, amaa o sʋʋnrin la ka o bɛnt o baans.

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, Li pʋ nar ye m namisi ba nɛ'ɛŋa yɛlaa?” “Buudkaŋa an si'em nwa' la, li pʋ sʋm ye m yɔ samme m mɛŋaa?”

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, “M na kum ka kaas zuoya la yɛla ka maal sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ yaama linɛ bɛ pipirisin la yɛla. Ba kʋdig nɛ nwɛnɛ bugum kanb, ka sɔ' pʋ lɛn dɔl ani, sɔ' mɛ pʋ lɛn wʋm niigi bʋʋlʋgɔ. Niis banɛ ian'ad agɔla la ianki lalig ka bʋnkɔnbid la mɛ gaad.”

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛbis ye, “M na kɛ ka Jerusalem wʋsa lieb dabɔɔd, ka wɛbaas na gbɛɛnd ani. M na san'am Juda sʋ'ʋlim tempʋʋs wʋsa ka sɔ' kʋ lɛm kpɛlim ani.”

english_verse: I said to the Lord, “None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why?”
translation_verse: M bu'os ye, “Ninkan bɛ ya ka o ya'am sia'al ka o na gban'e nɛ' gbinnɛ? Anɔ'ɔn ka Zugsɔb la zamis o ka o na pa'ali li gbinnɛ? Bɔ ka teŋ la san'am ka dig wʋʋ pipirig nɛ ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi dɔlli gaadɛ?”

english_verse: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛbis ye, “Li anɛ ban zan'as man wada kanɛ ka m tisi ba la zug; ba pʋ siaki m nɔɔr bɛɛ dɔlli m wada la.

english_verse: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, onɛ an Israel dim Wina'am la, yɛl si'eli nwa ye: “Gɔsima, m na kɛ ka nimbama di ditɔɔg ka nu yabid ku'om.

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: M na widigi ba kpɛn'ɛs buudsieba ni, banɛ ka ban, bɛɛ ba yaanam pʋn zi', ka na nɔk zaba sʋ'ʋraugʋ kadi ba hali nɛ man na ti san'ami ba wʋsa naae.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye, “Tɛn'ɛsimi nannanna! Buolim pu'ab banɛ tʋʋmmi an kʋʋr kaasig la ka ba kena; la'asimi banɛ mi' baamʋg hali la na.”

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Ka nidib la lɛbisi yɛl ye, “Kɛl ka ba kɛn tɔ'ɔtɔ na kaasi tisi ti! Ka ti nini wʋsa ti yit ninta'am ka ti nimbielim wʋsa pʋbid ku'om.

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: Ti wʋm kaasig Zion teŋin, ye, ‘San'auŋ paae ti! Ti nyan la zu'oe nɛ! Asɛɛ ka ti basi ti teŋ la bɔzugɔ ti ya' la liebnɛ dabɔɔd.’”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, Nannanna, pu'abaa, wʋmmi Zugsɔb la pian'ad; yɔ'ɔgimi ya tʋba kɛlis o nɔɔr pian'ad. Pa'alimi ya bipumis la ban na kaas kʋʋr si'em; pa'alimi taaba sʋnsa'aŋ yʋʋma, ka ba yʋ'ʋm ye,

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Akum dʋʋ ti takoronamin kpɛn' na ka kpɛn' ti kpi'euŋ zin'isin na; o naae ti biis suoraadin nɛ ti na'akim la nidib la'asʋg zin'isin.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Yɛlim ye, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la ye, “Ninkpiilima la na dig ala wʋʋ sa'ad ka ba vaae bas paalʋ, ka nwɛnɛ kikan'a ka ba bun ka bas nya'aŋ, ka sɔ' kae na la'asi baa.

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Amaa kɛl ka onɛ bɔɔd ye o nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg on nwɛ'ɛm nyɔ'ɔg nɛ' yɛla: ye o gban'e li gbin ka baŋ man, ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la, ka tʋm linɛ an sʋm ka tʋm sida nɛ pʋpielim teŋgbauŋ nwa zug: nɛ'ɛnam ka m bɔɔd.’ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.”

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: Banɛ an: Egipt nɛ Juda nɛ Edom nɛ Ammon nɛ Moab dim, nɛ banɛ bɛ pipirisin lalli la wʋsa, sʋnf ka' nyain nɛ wʋʋ banɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ nɛ, hali nɛ Israel dim wʋsa sʋnya ka' nyainnɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye: “Da zamisidi suoya banɛ ka buudsieba dɔl la, bɛɛ dabiem mɔri ya nɛ zanbina banɛ bɛ saŋgbauŋin la, la'an nɛ buudsieba ɛɛnti nyɛɛ li ka zɔt dabiem la.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Nidib la malima ka' gbinnɛ; ba ɛɛnti keŋ nɛ sian'arin nwaae tiigi mɔri kena, ka onɛ mi' kpi'eb kpi'e li nɛ o lieŋ.

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: Ka ba nɔk anzurifa nɛ sanlima bʋligi li ka li vɛnl; ka nɔk hamma kpa' li nɛ kpa'asi tabil ka li kʋ lii.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Li nwɛnɛ daug ka ba nɔki sɛ ka ya'al fuug ye li kad niis pɔɔgin. Ba bada la kʋ nyaŋi pian'; asɛɛ ka ba zii ba bɔzugɔ ba kʋ nyaŋi keŋɛ. Da zɔti baa; ba kʋ nyaŋi tʋmif bɛ'ɛd bɛɛ ba tʋm sʋ'ʋm tisi fɔ.”

english_verse: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ kʋ na'asi fɔ, fʋn kanɛ an buudi wʋsa Na'aba? Fʋnɛ nar nɛ na'asi. Ya'am dim banɛ bɛ buudi ni la wʋsa nɛ ba sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa, sɔ' lɛn kae nwɛnɛ fʋ.

english_verse: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa ka' ya'am ka an zɔn; bada banɛ an daad ka ka' gban'ar la pa'annɛ ba.

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: Anzurifa linɛ ka ba kʋnt la yinɛ Tarsis teŋin na ka sanlima yi Yufas teŋin na. Banɛ kpi'ed nɛ banɛ kʋnt sanlima maali ba, ka ba nɔk nɛ pien kanɛ an bʋlʋ nɛ fuzɛn'ugʋ yɛɛli li, banɛ mi' tʋʋma la maali ba wʋsa.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la an sida Wina'am, o anɛ Wina'am kanɛ vʋe, ka an Na'akanɛ bɛ saŋa wʋsa. O sʋnf ya'a pɛlig, teŋgbauŋ la dammidnɛ; o sʋʋnr ya'a duoe, buudi kae na nyaŋi zi'enɛ.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye, “Wina nwa pʋ maal agɔla nɛ teŋgbauŋ la, alazug, ba na mɛlim teŋgbauŋ nwa zug nɛ teŋ teŋir sa.”

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: O ya'a tans, ku'om linɛ bɛɛ agɔl la gudigidnɛ; o maal saŋgbana ka li pin'il teŋgbauŋ la bɛnnɛ dʋ. Onɛ kɛ ka saa nɛ sa-ian'asʋg bɛ ka yisid sisi'em o la'ad dɔɔdin na.

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa anɛ zɔlʋg ka mɛ pʋ mɔr baŋirɛ; banɛ kʋnt sanlima la wʋsa di nyannɛ ba bada la zug. Bada dimi maan si'el la anɛ ziri; ba mɛŋ pʋ mɔr vʋ'ʋsʋm.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ba ka' vɔɔnrɛ, ba anɛ linɛ mɔr la'adi tis nidib. Ba sariakadib saŋa ya'a ti paae, ba na bɔdig.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Onɛ an Jakob yaas Wina'am la pʋ nwɛnɛ bama. Onɛ maal si'el wʋsa, la'an nɛ Israel wʋsa, buudbanɛ an o faar la, o yʋ'ʋri buon Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la. San'auŋ kenna

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: La'asimi ya la'ad wʋsa yi teŋin la, yanam banɛ ka ya dataas lɔbi giligidi ya la.

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa: “Saŋa kaŋa m na nɔk banɛ bɛ teŋ kaŋa ni la lɔbi ba bas. M na kɛ ka ba paam sʋnsa'aŋ hali, ka ba dataas gban'e ba.”

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Tɔɔg paam, m sapu'ad la zug! M pu'alʋŋ la kʋ bɔdigɛ! La'an nɛ wala m yɛli m mɛŋ ye, “Nɛ' anɛ m ban'as, asɛɛ ka m mɔdig nɛ li.”

english_verse: Our homes are destroyed; our children are dead. No one is left to help us find shelter.”
translation_verse: M Fuug Sʋgʋr san'am ya; li nwiis la wʋsa kɛns ya, m biis wʋsa kpiya, ka lɛn kae; sɔ' lɛn kae na ti' m Fuug Sʋgʋr la tisi ma, bɛɛ maali m gbɛɛnsirɛ.

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: Kɔnbkemnib la pʋ mɔr ya'am, ka mɛ pʋ sɔsid Zugsɔb la; alazug ka ba pʋ nyɛt si'ela ka ba kɔnbid wʋsa widig.

english_verse: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
translation_verse: Kɛlisim! Labaar la kenna, daamʋg tita'ar yi ya-datiuŋʋ kenna! Li na kɛ ka Juda tempʋʋs la kpɛlim zaalim, ka lieb wɛog bʋnkɔnbid zin'ig. Jeremia winsɔsʋg

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, m mi' ye, ninsaal nyɔvʋr ka' o mɛŋ dinnɛ; ninsaal kʋ nyaŋi baŋ o mɛŋ nɔbir yakiri zi'en si'em.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, pa'alimi m gbɛlʋŋ, amaa kɛl ka li dɔl sida ka ka' fʋ sʋnpɛɛn saŋa, ya'a ka' ala fʋ na kɛ ka m lieb zaalim.

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Kpa'ami fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la yɛɛl buudi la, kpan'am yɛɛl banɛ ba'a ka' nɛf la, nɛ banɛ pʋ buonnɛ fʋ yʋ'ʋr la. Ba kʋ Jakob nidib la naae ba li' ba nɛ nyain ka san'ami ba teŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: Pian'abanɛ ka m da pian' tisi ya yaanam man da mɔri ba yi Egipt teŋin na, zin'ikanɛ nwɛnɛ bugum tita'ar kanɛ ka ba nyɛligid kʋnt la.’ M yɛli ba ye, ‘Siakimini m nɔɔr ka siak man yɛli ya si'el la, ka aan m nidib, ka m na aan ya Wina'am.

english_verse: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
translation_verse: Ala ka m na maal man da pɔ nɔsi'a tisi ya yaanam la, m da zi'el nɔɔr ye m na tisi ba teŋ kanɛ ka bin'isim nɛ siind pʋbid, teŋ kanɛ ka ya bɛ zina la.’” Ka m siak ye, “Ami, Zugsɔba.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛlim ye, “Mɔɔlim pian'abama tis Juda tempʋʋs la nɛ Jerusalem suoraadin la ye, ‘Kɛlisimi nɔnakaŋa pian'ad la ka dɔlisi li.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Lin yi saŋa kanɛ ka m yisi ya yaanam Egipt teŋin la ti paae zina, m sa'ali ba ka lɛn sa'ali ba ya'as, ye, “Siakimini m nɔɔr.”

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Amaa ba pʋ wʋm bɛɛ kɛlisɛ; ka lɛɛ dɔlli ba zukpi'euŋ tʋʋma linɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bɛɛ ba sʋnya ni la. M yɛli ba ye ba dɔlli m wada la, amaa ka ba zan'as ka pʋ dɔlisɛ. Ala ka m mɔr nɔpɔɔr linɛ bɛ m wada la ni wʋsa kɛɛn ba zugin na.’”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Juda nidib nɛ banɛ bɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la gban'e nɛ man yɛla bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Ba fɛndignɛ lɛbi tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd banɛ ka ba yaanam da ki'isi m nɔɔr ka tʋm la. Ba pʋ'ʋsidi winsieba. Israel dim nɛ Juda dim wʋsa san'am nɔnaar kanɛ ka m da maal nɛ ba yaanam la.”

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: Dinzug, man Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', “M na mɔr yɛltɔɔgʋ ba zugin na ka ba kʋ yii. Ba ya'a la'an kaasi tisim, m kʋ kɛlisi baa.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Yanam Juda dima, ya mɔr wina ka ba zu'oe gaadi ya tempʋʋs, ka bimbima banɛ ka ya mɛ' ka nyu'od maana tisid Baal, win kanɛ mɔr nyan la, zu'oe gaad Jerusalem suoraad.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: Da sɔs winsɔsʋgʋ tis nimbama, bɛɛ sɔs suguru ba yɛlaa, bɔzugɔ ba ya'a ti bɛ sʋnsa'aŋ pʋʋgin ka buon, m kʋ kɛlisɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Juda dim la ye, “Onɛ ka m nɔŋ la tʋm bɔɔ m pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka la'as nɛ nidib bɛdegʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ? Maana banɛ ka ya maan la na yisi ya namisʋg pʋʋginɛɛ? Ya ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛd ya maannɛ sumalisim.”

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la buonif nɛ ye, olif tiig kanɛ nɔbigid hali ka fʋ wala vɛnl sʋ'ʋŋa. Amaa sisi'etita'ar ya'a da'ae o na kɛ ka li wila la wʋsa kɔ', ka nyu'oe li nɛ bugum.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: Man Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb, ka sɛɛf wʋʋ tiig la, zi'el nɔɔr ye tɔɔg kɛɛn fʋ zugin na, bɔzugɔ Israel nɛ Juda dim tʋm bɛ'ɛd hali, ka duodi m sʋʋnr ban nyu'od maana tisid Baal la zug. Ban gban'e bɛ'ɛd Jeremia yɛla la

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nie ban gban'e si'em tisim la zug, ka m baŋi li, bɔzugɔ saŋa kan la o pa'alim ban daa bɛɛ ani niŋid si'el.

english_verse: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
translation_verse: M nwɛnɛ pɛbil kanɛ an baanlimm ka ba mɔr o keŋ kɔdigir zin'igin; man zi' ye ba gban'e m yɛla bɛ'ɛdi yɛt ye, “Kɛlli ka ti san'am tiig la nɛ li wala la wʋsa; kɛlli ka ti yis o teŋ kanɛ ka vʋm bɛ la ni nyain, ka o yʋ'ʋr kʋ lɛm pʋdig ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: Amaa, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, fʋn kanɛ kad saria nɛ sida, ka kpansid ninsaal ya'am nɛ o pʋtɛn'ɛr la, yɔɔmi ba sam ka m nyɛ, bɔzugɔ, fʋ ni ka m nɔki m ti'iri niŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa zaŋi keŋ Anatof dim banɛ ieedi fʋ nyɔvʋr ka yɛt ye, “Da pian'ad nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋrɛ, ya'a ka' ala ti na kʋʋf.”

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye, “M na namisi ba. Ba na'akim na kpi zaba ni, ka kɔ'ɔm na kʋʋ ba biribis nɛ ba bipumis.

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: Ba nid baa yinne kʋ kpɛlim, bɔzugɔ, m na mɔr yɛltɔɔg na ziil Anatof teŋ dim yʋʋm kanɛ ka ba na ti nyɛ namisʋg la.”

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: M Zugsɔba, saŋa kanɛ wʋsa ka m mɔri m pian'adi kɛɛn fʋ san'an na fʋ anɛ pʋpielim sɔb. La'an nɛ wala m na pian' nɛ fʋ, fʋ sida la yɛla: tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la niŋ wala ka ba si'el wʋsa ken sʋ'ʋŋa? Bɔ ka banɛ pʋ niŋ yadda la bɛ ka li malisi ba?

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Fʋ sɛɛ ba wʋʋ tiis ka ba ba' nya'a; ka ba nɔbig ka wal wala. Fʋ yʋ'ʋr bɛ nɛ ba nɔɔrin, amaa ka lɛɛ ka' ba sʋnya nii.

english_verse: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala fʋ mi'im Zugsɔba; fʋ nyɛɛm ka kpansi m pʋtɛn'ɛr man tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ yɛla si'em. Vuugimi ba wʋʋ pɛ'ɛs ka ba mɔrimi wa'ae ye ba kɔdig! Yisimi ba zi'eli ba kɔn' guri ba kʋʋb daar!

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Bʋndaar ka teŋ la na kʋdig ka mɔɔd linɛ bɛ pɔɔdin la wʋsa kʋdigɛ? Bʋnkɔnbid nɛ niis la wʋsa mɛlim ya bɔzugɔ, nimbanɛ bɛɛ ani la anɛ bugusim dim. Nidib la mɛ lɛn yɛt ye, “O kʋ nyɛ linɛ maannɛ tii.” Wina'am lɛbis si'em

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: “Fʋ ya'a zɔti yigin nɛ nidib ka ba kɛ ka fʋ gɛn, fʋ na niŋ wala zɔti yigin nɛ widi? Fʋ ya'a ken paalʋ ka tu'usida, fʋ na niŋ wala keŋ Joodan kɔldaug gɔn'ɔsin la?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Fʋ mɛŋ ba'abiis nɛ fʋ mɛŋ yidimi gbi'idif. Ba duonɛ zi'e fʋ yɛla. Da niŋi ba yadda, la'an nɛ ban pian'adi fʋ yɛla sʋm la.

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: M na tami m yir yɛla, ka basim faar; M na nɔk onɛ ka m nɔŋ la tis o dataas.

english_verse: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
translation_verse: M faar la yʋ'ʋn anɛ wʋʋ gbigimi bɛ sian'arin. Dinzug ka m kis o, ka yaa o.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: M faar la lieb wʋʋ silʋg bɛɛ viiug ka o bʋn-ian'ada taaba kena gilig o zabid. Kem la'as wɛog bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa na; mɔri ba na ka ba vɔli ba.

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Kɔnbkemnib bɛdegʋ na san'ami m tiwanna pɔɔg la ka ban nɛ pɛ'ɛs la nɔɔ m pɔɔg la vɛnnim; ba na kɛ ka pɔkanɛ ka m ya'am kpɛn' hali la lieb pipirig ka nidib kae.

english_verse: Every field I see lies barren, and no one cares.
translation_verse: Li sid na lieb pipirig, teŋ la na san'am ka lieb zaalim bɔzugɔ sɔ'ɔsɔ ba'a kʋ bɛɛ li nii.

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Zuoya tɛɛns banɛ bɛ sian'arin la wʋsa, banɛ san'amid na yina giligi li. Zugsɔb zabzabidib na yina kʋ nidib; lin naan teŋ la kpikpɛŋ yinne ti paae kpikpɛŋ yinne; sɔ' wʋsa na kpi.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Ba na bʋd ki, amaa ka bun gɔn'ɔs; ba na tʋm gɛn, amaa ka kʋ nyɛ si'ela. Ala ka ba na di nyan kanɛ ka ba bun la, man Zugsɔb la sumpɛɛn zug.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye, “Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ Israel kpi'es banɛ an bugusim dim, ka faaɛn faar linɛ ka m tisim nidib Israel la, m na duoe ba yisi ba, ba mɛŋ teŋin la, ka duoe Juda dim la yisi ba sʋʋgin.

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: Amaa m ya'a ti duoe ba naae, li nya'aŋ m na lɛn zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig, ka mɔr sɔ' wʋsa lɛb o faar zin'ig nɛ o mɛŋ teŋin.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Ka ba ya'a baŋ ya'am ka zamisi m nidib la san'an, ka pɔ nɛ man yʋ'ʋr ye, ‘Asida sida Zugsɔb la bɛ’ wʋʋ ban daa ma' m nidib ka ba pɔ nɛ Baal yʋ'ʋr si'em la m na kɛ ka ba zin'in nɛ m nidib la.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Amaa buudkanɛ pʋ kɛlisɛ, m na duoe ba ka san'ami ba nyain.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim si'eli nwa ye, “Kem da' pien sɛnbidiŋi lɔɔ fʋ siaa, amaa da kɛ ka li si'is ku'om.”

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Ka m sid da' sɛnbidiŋ la wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛlim si'em la, lɔɔ li m sien.

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Nɔkim sɛnbidiŋ kanɛ ka fʋ da' lɔɔdi fʋ siaa la mɔri keŋ Para su'a li tampiins sian'asimin.”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.”
translation_verse: Dabisa bɛdegʋ nya'aŋ ka Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛlim ye, “Nannanna, kem Para nɔk sɛnbidiŋ la ka m daa yɛlif ye fʋ kem su'a la.”

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Ka m keŋ Para tuu yis sɛnbidiŋ la man daa su'a li zin'isi'a la, amaa li daa san'amnɛ ka lɛn ka' tʋʋmmɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb labaar kɛɛn m san'an na ye

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye, “Ala mɛn ka m na san'am Juda dim nɛ Jerusalem dim nyɛɛsim linɛ zu'oe hali la.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Nimbama anɛ bugusim dim, ka zan'as ye ba kʋ kɛlisi m pian'adɛ, ba sʋnya digilimnɛ, ka ba tʋmmi ba ya'am bɔɔd si'el, ka zɔti dɔl winsieba tʋmmi tisidi ba ka zun'odi ba. Alazug ba na nwɛnɛ sɛnbidiŋ nwa ka kʋ lɛm mɔr tʋʋmmɛ!

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ sɛnbidiŋi lɔɔd siaa si'em la, ala ka m da nɔk Israel dim nɛ Juda dimi lɔɔm mɛŋ,” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la, “ye ba aan m nidib ka ba yʋ'ʋr dʋ ka nyɛ na'asi. Amaa ba pʋ kɛligida.” Daam gan'a yɛla

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: “Yɛlimi ba ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la yɛl si'eli nwa ye, ba pɛ'ɛlim daam gan'ar wʋsa nɛ daam. Ka ba ya'a yɛlif ye, ‘Tinam mɛŋ zi' ye daam gan'ar wʋsa pɛ'ɛnnɛ nɛ daam?’

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Fʋn yɛlimi ba ye, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye: ‘M ye m kɛnɛ ka banɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa lieb danuudib, la'an nɛ na'anam banɛ zin' David na'am gbauŋ zug la, nɛ maanmaannib nɛ nɔdi'esidib la'an nɛ banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la wʋsa.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: M na nɔki ba zuti nwɛ' nɛ taaba, du'adib nɛ ba biis na tʋ'ʋs taaba.’ Zugsɔb la yɛli li. ‘M kʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanliga. M na san'ami ba wʋsa.’” Ba na gban'e ba maal yammis

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: M da yɛl nidib la ye, Kɛlisimi ka wʋm, da an nyɛɛsim dima ka Zugsɔb la pian' ya.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Tisimi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la girima ka o da kɛ ka lik paae ya ka ya nɔba da tu'usid kʋkʋna lin an lik la zugɔ. Ya mɔri nɛɛsim ti'ir amaa o na kɛ ka li an lik ka tiaki li ka li lieb lik biridi.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a pʋ kɛlisɛ, m na su'a kum ya nyɛɛsim la zug; m na kum ka m nini mɔd, m nini na yuod nɛ ninta'am, bɔzugɔ, ba na gban'e Zugsɔb pɛ'ɛs la mɔri keŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Yɛlim na'ab la nɛ o ma la ye, “Duomi ya na'am gbana la zug, ya na'am zupibis la, ba na pidigi li ya zutin.”

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: Ba na yɔ tempʋbanɛ bɛ Negef la, ka sɔ' kae na yɔ'ɔgi baa. Ba na gban'e Juda dim wʋsa mɔri keŋ teŋ zʋŋ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: Jerusalem, ʋkimi fʋ nindaa gɔs banɛ yi ya-datiuŋʋ kenna la. Kɔnbid banɛ ka ba nɔki tisif la bɛ yaanɛ? Pɛ'ɛs banɛ yɛla ka fʋ dʋ'ʋsidi fʋ mɛŋ la lɛn kae?

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la ya'a kɛ ka banɛ aan fʋ zuanam la sʋ'ʋgʋf, fʋ na yɛl ye bɔ? Li kʋ zabif hali wʋʋ pu'a na sa'ae?

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ ya'a bu'osi fʋ mɛŋ ye, “Bɔ ka yɛl kaŋa paae mam?” Li anɛ fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi zu'oe la zugʋ kɛ ka fʋ fuug aaɛn ka fʋ di nyan.

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Etiopia nid na nyaŋi tiak o niŋgbinaa? Bɛɛ wɛbaa tiak o pʋpɔnrim la? Yanam banɛ miilim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la kʋ nyaŋi tiaki tʋm tʋʋm sʋŋɔ.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: “M na widigi ya wʋʋ udug ka pɛbisʋg yi pipirisin na da'adi li ken.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Fʋ dinnɛ nwa, Jerusalem, mam gban'e ka pʋdig si'em digili fʋ la. Li anɛ fʋn tam man yɛla ka niŋ winsieba banɛ ka' sida yadda la zug.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: “M na pidigi fʋ fuug la ka kɛ ka ba nyɛɛ fʋ nyan,

english_verse: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
translation_verse: fʋ dausan'auŋ nɛ pu'asan'auŋ ya'amlɛog linɛ an bɛ'ɛd la, fʋ anɛ pu'agɔɔndir ka pʋ zɔt nyannɛ! M nyɛ yɛlkisa banɛ ka fʋ tʋm zuoya zug nɛ pɔɔdin la wʋsa. Woo! Tɔɔg na paaf, Jerusalem! Bʋndaar ka fʋ na yii fʋ dian'ad tʋʋma la ni?”

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb labakaŋa daa kɛn man Jeremia san'an na ka li anɛ sawak yɛla:

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Kpi'emnam la tʋmi ba sankpan'asnam ye ba iee ku'om na tisi ba; amaa ba keŋ bulisin la, ka pʋ paam ku'om. Ka tuligi lɛb ka pʋ nyɛ ku'om pɛ'ɛli ba yʋya la; ka li paki ba ka ba pʋ lɛm mɔr ti'irɛ, ka lusi ba zut.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Teŋ la kʋdig nɛ tans bɔzugɔ saa pʋ niid teŋin la; li pak kpaadib la nɛ ka ba nɔk nu'usi bibigi ba zut.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Hali walig kanɛ bɛ mɔɔgin la bas o bilia kanɛ ka o du'a la bɔzugɔ, yaama kae ka ba na ɔnbɛ.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Sian'arin bʋmis bɛ kʋkʋna ni vʋ'ʋsidi ligid wʋʋ wɛbaas nɛ; ka ba nini sɔbid yaama ka' la zug.

english_verse: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi di kasɛti ti yɛla la, O Zugsɔba, maalim si'eli fʋ yʋ'ʋr zug. Ti nya'aŋ lɛbig la yʋ'ʋn zu'onɛ galis; ti tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔgif.

english_verse: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
translation_verse: Fʋn onɛ an Israel Ti'ir, ka aan o Faangid sʋnsa'aŋ saŋa la, bɔ ka fʋ nwɛnɛ saan teŋ la zugɔ, ka nwɛnɛ suoken kanɛ gbɛn yʋ'ʋŋ yinne ma'aanɛ?

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ nwɛnɛ dau kanɛ ka ba libig o ka nwɛnɛ zabzabid ka ba nyaŋ o ka o kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn o mɛŋa? Fʋ bɛɛ ti sʋʋgin, Zugsɔba, fʋ yʋ'ʋr ka ba mɔri buonnɛ ti; da basi tii!”

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl nimbama yɛla si'em nwa: “Ba nɔŋnɛ ban na gɔɔndi giligid yɔɔg-yɔɔg; ba pʋ gu'usid nɛ ba nɔba la ken zin'isi'a. Ala ka Zugsɔb la zan'asi ba; o na tiɛn ba pɔ'ɔgir la yɛla ka namisi ba, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Da sɔsid nimbama nwa sʋm yɛllɛ.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ban lɔɔd nɔɔr la, m kʋ kɛlisi ba kaasiga; la'an nɛ ban maan nyu'or maana nɛ zuud maana la, m kʋ di'e lii. M lɛɛ na san'ami ba nɛ zaba nɛ kɔ'ɔm nɛ ban'abɛ'ɛd.”

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Amaa ka m yɛl ye, “Aa! Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, nɔdi'esidib la yɛti ba saŋa wʋsa ye, ‘Ya kʋ nyɛ zaba bɛɛ kɔ'ɔm. Sida, sumbʋgʋsʋm na bɛ kpɛla yuug.’”

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, Nɔdi'esidib la mɔri man yʋ'ʋri pian'ad ziri. M pʋ tʋmi ba bɛɛ gaŋi ba bɛɛ pian' tisi baa. Ba pian'adnɛ ziri pian' linɛ ka ba pʋ wʋmm, li anɛ sɔnpʋt nɛ ba'abʋgʋsim tʋʋma nɛ bada linɛ ka' gbinnɛ, nɛ ba mɛŋ pʋtɛnda gban'e si'em.

english_verse: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, man Zugsɔb la yɛl nɔdi'esidib banɛ mɔri m yʋ'ʋri pian'ad la yɛla si'em nwa ye m pʋ tʋmi baa, ka ba lɛɛ yɛt ye, “Zaba bɛɛ kɔ'ɔm kʋ paae teŋ kaŋa naa.” Nɔdi'es ban nɔɔ ka zaba nɛ kɔ'ɔm na kʋʋ ba.

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Ka ban pian'adi tisid ninsieba la, ba na lɔbi ba yis Jerusalem suoraadin la kɔ'ɔm nɛ zaba zug. Sɔ' kae na mum ban nɛ ba pu'ab bɛɛ ba biribis nɛ ba bipumis la. M na kpa'ae tɔɔg kanɛ nar nɛ ba la niŋi ba zugin.

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba pian' kaŋa ye, “Kɛl ka m nini pɛ'ɛl nɛ ninta'am yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ ka pʋ gu'oda, bɔzugɔ m nidib la namis ya hali nɛ sapu'ad bɛdegʋ ban nwɛ' ba la zug.

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: M ya'a yi teŋ la yiŋ, m na nyɛ nimbanɛ kpi zaba ni; m ya'a lɛn keŋ tempʋʋgin la, m na nyɛ nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ kpi kɔ'ɔm. Nɔdi'esidib nɛ maanmaannib la wʋsa keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka ba zi'.”

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Fʋ zan'as Juda nɛ nyainnɛɛ? Fʋ nɛ'ɛs Zion dimaa? Bɔ ka fʋ tisi ti tɔɔg ka li kʋ nyaŋi bɔdigɛ? Ti mɔr ti'ir ye sumbʋgʋsʋm na bɛ amaa bʋnsʋŋ pʋ yi naa. Ti tɛn'ɛsid ye li na anɛ laafi saŋa amaa li anɛ dabiem ma'aa.

english_verse: We and our ancestors are guilty of rebelling against you.
translation_verse: Ti baŋi ti pɔ'ɔgir nɛ ti yaanam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la; ti sid tʋm taal ka pɔ'ɔgif.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Fʋ yʋ'ʋr zugɔ, da nɛ'ɛsi tii; da kɛ ka fʋ na'am gbauŋ la di nyannɛ. Tɛnri fʋ nɔnaar linɛ ka fʋ naal nɛ ti la, ka da san'ami lii.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ba'ayɔɔd banɛ ka buudi bɛdegʋ maan la na nyaŋi tis saa naa? Saŋgbana la mɛŋ na nyaŋi kɛ ka saa nii? Ayei! Li anɛ fʋn, ti Zugsɔb Wina'am. Dinzugɔ ti ti'ir bɛ nɛ fʋ san'an, bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ maal nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Hali Moses nɛ Samuel ya'a zi'eni m tuon m ya'am kʋ keŋ nimbama nii. Mɔri ba tɔɔmi m san'an! Kɛl ka ba keŋ!

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Ka ba ya'a bu'osif ye, ‘Ti na keŋ yaanɛ?’ Fʋn yɛlimi ba ye Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye: “Banɛ ka li an ye ba kpi la na kpi; ka banɛ na kpi zaba ni la na kpi zaba ni; banɛ ka kɔ'ɔm na kʋʋ ba la, na kpi kɔ'ɔm; banɛ ka ba mɛ na gban'e ba la, ba na gban'e ba.”

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mɛŋ yɛl ye, “M na kɛ ka san'auŋ zin'is anaasi kena:” ba na kpi zaba ni, ka baas na vuu ba mɔri keŋ, ka niis banɛ ian'ad agɔla la dii ba, ka bʋnyuos banɛ bɛ teŋin la na ɔnbi ba san'ami ba.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Manase onɛ an Hezekia biig ka da an Juda na'ab la tʋm si'el Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la zug, m na kɛ ka buudbanɛ bɛ dunia ni wʋsa kisigi ba.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ na zɔɔf nimbaanliga, O Jerusalem? Anɔ'ɔnɛ na kumi fʋ yɛla? Anɔ'ɔnɛ na bu'osif ye fʋ niŋgbina an wala?

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ya ye, “Fʋ zan'as mam,” “fʋ lɛbidi nya'aŋ saŋa wʋsa. Alazug m na nɔki m nu'usi pa'ali fʋ zug, ka san'amif; m zɔɔf nimbaanligi gɛn.

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: M na nɔk nwammi yɛligi ya wʋʋ ki tempʋʋg la za'anɔɔrin. M na kɛ ka kum nɛ san'auŋ kɛɛn m nidibin la na, ban pʋ tiaki ba suoya la zug.

english_verse: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ba pʋkɔnya zu'oe gaad atɛuk nɔɔrin titanbin'isi. M na kɛ ka san'auŋ sigi ba sʋʋgin nintaŋ tisʋʋs na ka ba biis na kpi ka kɛɛ ba manam. M na kɛ ka li gbirigi lii ba zugin na ka sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ dabiem na bɛ.

english_verse: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
translation_verse: Pu'a kanɛ du'a biis ayɔpɔi na lig ka vʋ'ʋsid ka li pʋ sigida. Li na an nintaŋ, amaa ka yʋ'ʋŋ pʋn sɔb on san'an; Jerusalem na paam nɛ'ɛsʋg ka di nyan. Banɛ kpɛlim la, m na kɛ ka ba keŋ zaba ni ka ba bi'emnam kʋʋ ba.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: Oi, m maa, fʋn du'a man la li anɛ tɔɔg, m anɛ ninkanɛ ka teŋ la wʋsa kisig ka mɔɔdi m yɛla! M pʋ pɛ'ɛŋ sɔ' si'el bɛɛ m pɛ'ɛŋ si'eli tis sɔ'ɔɔ, la'an nɛ wala sɔ' wʋsa pɔɔdi nɔɔri tisidim.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Sida, m na yisif yɛla ni; yɛltɔɔg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ya'a ti kena, m na kɛ ka fʋ dataas la nwɛ'ɛf nu'ug.

english_verse: People of Judah, just as you can't break iron mixed with bronze, you can't defeat the enemies that will attack from the north.
translation_verse: Ninsaal na nyaŋi kɔ'ɔg kuntɛɛ? Ba na kɔ'ɔg kuntkpi'euŋ linɛ yi ya-datiuŋ la na, bɛɛ kʋntzɛn'ugɔ?

english_verse: I will give them everything you own, because you have sinned everywhere in your country.
translation_verse: M na nɔki fʋ kpan'am nɛ fʋ arezak la wʋsa tis banɛ an faandib ka ba kʋ yɔɔ li sammɛ, fʋn kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yadig teŋgbauŋʋn la zug.

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka fʋ liebi fʋ bi'emnam yammʋg ka ba na mɔri fʋ keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ zi'. M sʋnpɛɛn la na nwɛnɛ bugum ka na la'aŋi fʋ diif.”

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: Fʋ gban'e li gbin, O Zugsɔba; tɛnri m yɛla ka sʋŋim, ka yɔ m bi'emnam banɛ mugusidim la sam. Fʋ summɔtir galis nɛ, alazug, da kɛ ka m kpii; tɛn'ɛsim ban namisidim ka tʋ'ʋdimi fʋ yɛla si'em.

english_verse: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Fʋ pian'ad la daa kɛɛn m san'an na la, m di'e li; m ya'am bɔɔd si'eli la, ka li tisim sumalisim. Ba nɔki fʋ yʋ'ʋr la pʋdim, O m Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba.
