english_verse: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
translation_verse: Man nam pʋ la'as nɛ banɛ la'asidi dit ka wa'ad la, m nan zi' la'as nɛ ba maal sumalisim. M zin'inɛ m kɔn'ɔkɔn' fʋ paŋ la daa bɛɛ m san'an la zug ka fʋ kɛ ka ɛndʋg mɔrim.

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Bɔ ka man niŋgbiŋ la zabir pʋ naada ka m sapu'atita'ar la pʋ bɔdigida? Fʋ bɔɔdi nwɛnɛ kuozɔtir kanɛ kʋdig sɛɛung winnɛɛ? Ka nwɛnɛ zin'ikanɛ ka ku'om tansidi yit ka pʋ ya'asid kpiɛnrɛɛ?

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa, “Fʋ ya'a tiak, m na lɛn kɛ ka fʋ lɛbi fʋ tʋʋma ni ka na tʋmmi tisidim. Fʋ ya'a pian'ad sʋ'ʋŋa, ka bas pian'ayaalis, m na kɛ ka fʋ di'esidi m pian'ad. Kɛl ka nimbama lɛbi fʋ san'an na, amaa fʋn da lɛbi ba san'anɛ.

english_verse: because I am making you strong, like a bronze wall. They are evil and violent, but when they attack,
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka fʋ nwɛnɛ zaŋguommi tis nimbama, kʋntzɛn'ug zaŋguom kanɛ mɔr paŋ. Ba na zab nɛf, amaa ba kʋ nyaŋɛ, bɔzugɔ m na bɛ nɛf ka sʋŋif ka faanf.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “M na yisif bugusim dim la nu'ugin pitɔɔg dim la ya'a ti ye ba gban'af, m na faanf.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la labaar lɛn kɛɛn m san'an na ye,

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: “Mid ka fʋ di pu'a du'a biribis nɛ bipumis kpɛla.”

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: “Ban'abɛ'ɛd na gban'e ba ka ba kpi. Ba kʋ mumi ba bɛɛ kaasi ba kʋʋrɛ, amaa ba na nwɛnɛ sa'ad nɛ dig teŋin. Zaba nɛ kɔ'ɔm na kʋʋ baa naae, ka ba niŋgbiŋ la na kilim diibi tis bʋn-ian'ada nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ la zug.”

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye, “Da kpɛn' yikanɛ ka ba maal kʋʋr diibɔ; da keŋ ye fʋ kaas kʋʋr bɛɛ fʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanliga; bɔzugɔ m yisi m albareka nɛ m nɔŋir nɛ m nimbaanlzɔɔr nimbama san'an.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: “Kpi'emnam nɛ tadimnam wʋsa na kpi teŋ kaŋa ni. Ba kʋ mumi ba bɛɛ kaasi ba kʋʋrɛ, ka sɔ' mɛ kʋ pʋn o zug bɛɛ maal si'eli ba yɛllɛ.

english_verse: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kʋ tis banɛ kaasid kʋʋr la diibɔ, hali baa li ya'a anɛ ba saam bɛɛ ba ma; sɔ' pʋn kʋ bʋgʋli ba sʋʋnr ka tisi ba si'el ye ba nuu.”

english_verse: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
translation_verse: “Da kpɛn' yikanɛ ka ba la'asi dit la zin'in ye fʋ di ka nu nɛ baa.”

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a yɛl nimbama nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa ka ba bu'os ye, “Bɔ ka Zugsɔb la gban'e tɔɔg kaŋa tinam yɛla? Ti maal bɔ ka li an bɛ'ɛdɛ? Taal bɔ ka ti tʋm pɔ'ɔgi ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la?”

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Fʋn yɛlimi ba ye, “Li anɛ ya yaanamɛ da zan'as man ka dɔl winsieba tʋmmi tisidi ba ka wɔ'ɔgidi ba la zug. Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la, Ba zan'asim ka pʋ dɔlli m wada la.

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: Amaa yanam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd gaadi ya yaanam la. Gɔsimi ya wʋsa gban'e zukpi'euŋ ka dɔlli ya sʋnfʋ bɔɔd si'el ka zan'as ka pʋ dɔlli m nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: Alazug m na lɔbigi ya yis teŋ kaŋa yiŋ, ka ya tɔɔm keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka yanam nɛ ya yaanam zi', ani ka ya na tʋmmi tisid winsieba nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa, ka m kʋ gi'e gɔsi yaa.”

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “La'an nɛ wala sa, dabisa kenna, ka nidib kʋ lɛm pɔ nɛ Zugsɔb la ye, Ti pɔya nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ yis Israel dim Egipt teŋin na la.”

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Amaa ba na yɛl ye, Ti pɔya nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ mɔr Israel dim banɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ nɛ tɛɛns banɛ ka o widigi kpɛn'ɛs la. Bɔzugɔ m na lɛbisi ba teŋ kanɛ ka ba da tisi ba yaanam la.

english_verse: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
translation_verse: “Amaa m na tʋm buol ziiŋgban'adib bɛdegʋ,” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la, “ka ba na gban'e ba. Lin nya'aŋ, m na tʋm tɔn'ɔsnam bɛdegʋ ka ba na tɔn'ɔsi kadi ba zuoya nɛ kʋkʋna nɛ tampinyɔ'ɔdin wʋsa.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: M nini nyɛti ba suoya la wʋsa; ba kʋ nyaŋi su'a man san'an, bɛɛ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la su'a ka m nini kʋ nyɛɛ.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: M na lɛbisi yɔɔ ba abʋyi' ba bugusim nɛ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug, bɔzugɔ ba kɛ ka m teŋ la lieb dian'ad, nɛ bada banɛ pʋ vʋeya, ka linɛ aan m faar la pɛ'ɛl nɛ si'elnam banɛ an ba'akpiilima.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: M Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ aan m paŋ nɛ m kpi'euŋ, fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig mugusʋg saŋa. Fʋ san'an ka buudi bɛdegʋ na kena, ba na yi dunia kpikpɛmis wʋsa na yɛl ye, “Ti yaanam da pʋ mɔr si'el si'ela asɛɛ wina banɛ pʋ mɔr sidaa ka an ba'ayaalis banɛ pʋ tʋm bʋnsʋŋʋ tisidi baa.

english_verse: worthless idols made by human hands.”
translation_verse: Ninsaalib maannɛ ba mɛŋ winaa? Ɛɛn, amaa ba ka' Wina'am!”

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Dinzugɔ, m na pa'ali ba, nannanna m na pa'ali ba m paŋ nɛ m kpi'euŋʋ an si'em. Ani ka ba na baŋ ye m yʋ'ʋri an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛli ba ye, “Juda tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la nwɛnɛ linɛ ka ba sɔbi digil. Ba nɔknɛ kʋnt kanɛ pʋlʋmmi gʋlis, bɛɛ kugir kanɛ kpi'em hali ka ba sɔbi tabili ba sʋnya ni nɛ ba maan bimbima zug.

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: Hali ba biis nan tɛnri ba maan bimbima nɛ ba Asera teŋgban buos linɛ bɛ titita'ar wʋsa gbinnin nɛ kʋkʋna banɛ ka ba kennɛ zun'odi ba la.

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Ya mɛŋ pɔ'ɔgir zug ka ya na kɔ'ɔŋi ya faar kanɛ ka m da tisi ya la. M na kɛ ka ya lieb yammisi ya dataas nu'usin teŋ kanɛ ka ya zi'isigɛ, yanamɛ kɛ ka m sʋnf la'aŋ bugum, ka na dit saŋa wʋsa la zug.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛl si'eli nwa', “Onɛ nɔk o ti'iri niŋ ninsaal san'an, nɔpɔɔr bɛɛ o zugin, nɛ onɛ wʋsa ti'e ninsaal paŋ, ka bid Zugsɔb la kudug.

english_verse: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Bareka bɛ nɛ onɛ wʋsa nɔk o ti'iri niŋ Zugsɔb la ni, ka ti'enɛ on ma'aa.

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: O na nwɛnɛ tikanɛ ka ba sɛɛ li kpi'el kɔlʋg nɔɔrin, ka o nya'a tɔɔndi sigid ku'omin la. Tʋʋlʋg ya'a kenna o pʋ zɔt dabiem; ka o vaand sɔbig saŋa wʋsa. Saa ya'a wak yʋʋm si'a li pʋ pakid o ka o pʋ gʋ'ʋŋid walibɔ.”

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, “Ninsaal susʋnf la dama'am gaad si'el wʋsa, anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi baŋi li?”

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛbis ye, “Man Zugsɔb la vɛɛnsid sʋnf ka kpansid pʋtɛn'ɛr wʋsa ka yɔɔd ninsaal wʋsa nɛ o itʋŋʋ an si'em, nɛ on nar ye o di'e si'em.”

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ nyɛ kpan'am ka li pʋ dɔlli li suorɛ, o nwɛnɛ kɔdiŋ kanɛ pʋ nyɛ' gɛlaa ka lɛɛ zu o tiraan gɛla um ka li wiak. O ya'a ti kʋdig bi'ela li na zɔ ka kɛɛ o, ka li naarin la o na pa'al ye o anɛ zɔlʋg.

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ'ʋsim zin'ig anɛ na'am zin'ig kanɛ vɛnl ka nyɛt dʋ'ʋsʋg ka bɛ pin'ilʋgʋn sa.

english_verse: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ an Israel ti'ir, banɛ zan'asif la wʋsa na di nyan. Banɛ fɛndig ka basif la nwɛnɛ banɛ yʋda ka ba sɔb titanin, bɔzugɔ ban bas Zugsɔb onɛ an ku'osʋŋ bulig linɛ tisid vʋm la.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: O Zugsɔba, ti'ebimim, ka m paam laafi; faanmim ka m nyɛ faangir, bɔzugɔ fʋn ma'aa ka m dʋ'ʋsid.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Ba yɛtim saŋa wʋsa ye, “Zugsɔb labaar la kpɛlim yaanɛ? Kɛl ka li maal nannanna!”

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: M pʋ zɔ ka bas kɔnbkem tʋʋma linɛ ka fʋ tisim ye m tʋm la; fʋ mi' ye m pʋ mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ fʋ nidib la san'auŋ yɛlaa. Fʋ mi' ye linɛ wʋsa yit man nɔɔrin la anɛ nyain fʋ tuon.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Da kpɛn'ɛsidim dabiem; ka fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig yɛltɔɔg daar.

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ namisidim la di nyan, amaa yisim mam nyan pʋʋgin. Kɛl ka ba ya'am iank, amaa yisim mam dabiem pʋʋgin. Kɛl ka dabisbɛ'og kɛɛn ba san'an na; kɛl ka san'auŋ kɛɛn ba san'an na ta'ali ta'al. Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir dɔlisʋg yɛla

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye, ‘Wʋmmi Zugsɔb la labaar, yanam Juda na'anam nɛ Juda nidib wʋsa nɛ banɛ wʋsa bɛ Jerusalem ka dɔl za'anɔbama ni yit la.

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, Ya ya'a gu'usid ka siaki m nɔɔr, ka pʋ mɔr ziidi kpɛn'ɛd tempʋkaŋa ni Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daarɛ, ka kɛ ka Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la an kasi ka pʋ tʋm si'eli li daarɛ,

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: na'anam banɛ zin' Na'ab David na'am gbauŋ zug la na dɔl tempʋkaŋa za'anɔya la ni nɛ ba na'ayikpɛm. Ban nɛ ba na'ayikpɛm la na ban'a ba tɛrekonam bɛɛ ba widi kpɛn'ɛd, ka Juda dim na bieli ba nɛ banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la, ka tempʋkaŋa na mɔr nidib saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Nidib na yi Juda na nɛ teŋkpɛmis banɛ gilig Jerusalem la, ba na yi Benjamin sʋ'ʋlim nɛ Sefela nɛ zuoya nɛ Negef tɛɛnsin la na, m mɔr nyu'or maana nɛ zʋʋd maana nɛ bʋnnyubisa nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim piini ken Zugsɔb pʋ'ʋsim Yin na.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a pʋ siaki m nɔɔr ka kɛ ka Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la an kasii, ka ziid ziidi kpɛn'ɛd Jerusalem za'anɔya la ni Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar, m na kɛ ka bugum kanɛ pʋ kpiisid la'aŋ Jerusalem za'anɔya la ka dii ba kpi'euŋ zin'is la wʋsa.’”

english_verse: “Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
translation_verse: “Kem onɛ ya'abid la yin ka m na tisi fʋ m labaar anina.”

english_verse: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
translation_verse: Alazug m daa keŋ onɛ ya'abid la yin, ka nyɛ ka o nwɛ'ɛd o ya'ad.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Amaa yʋʋr kanɛ daa bɛɛ o nu'usin ka o ya'abid la daa ka' sʋm; ka onɛ ya'abid la tiaki ya'ab yʋsi'a ya'as wʋʋ on bɔɔd ye li an si'em.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb labaar kɛɛn m san'an na ye,

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: ka ba tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka pʋ siaki m nɔɔrɛ, asɛɛ ka m maligim tɛn'ɛs bʋnsʋŋ kanɛ ka m gban'e ye m maali tisi ba la yɛla.

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: Nannanna, yɛlim Juda nidib nɛ banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la ye, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa: Gɔsima! M ti'ebidi ye m kɛ ka tɔɔg paae ya ka gban'adi ya yɛla bɛ'ɛd. Alazugɔ, fɛndigimi ka basi ya suobɛ'ɛdnam la, ya wʋsa yinne-yinne tiakimi ya suoya nɛ tʋʋmbanɛ ka ya tʋm la.

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: Amaa ba mɛ na lɛbis ye, Li ka' gbinnɛ, ti na kpɛn ken tuon nɛ ti mɛŋi gban'e si'em la; ti wʋsa yinne-yinne na kpɛn tʋmmi ti zukpi'euŋ tʋʋma.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye, “Bu'osim buudi wʋsa sʋʋgin ye, ‘Anɔ'ɔnamɛ mi' wʋm si'el ka li nwɛnɛ nɛ'?’ Israel onɛ nwɛnɛ pu'a kanɛ nan zi' dau la tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd tita'ar.

english_verse: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.
translation_verse: Ku'om linɛ ga'aŋ wʋʋ sakuga la na buoe Lebanon zuoya zugɔɔ? Bɛɛ li ku'oma'asig linɛ pʋbid lalli sigid na la nam mi' gu'oe ka pʋ pʋbida?

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala man nidib la tam man yɛla nɛ; ka nyɔ'ɔd bʋnnyubisa tisid ba'ayaalis, ka li kɛ ka ba tu'usidi ba suoya la ni nɛ yʋʋmpʋkʋda suoya la pʋʋgin. Bada la kɛya ka ba luaki dɔl suobuga nɛ suobanɛ pʋ maalɛ.

english_verse: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Ba teŋ la na san'am, li na anɛ bʋnla'adir saŋa wʋsa; li na niŋ pakiri tis banɛ gat ani wʋsa ka ba na lɔbidi ba zut.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: M na widigi m nidibi ba bi'emnam la tuon, wʋʋ ya-nya'aŋ sisi'em da'ad sa'ad nɛ; Ba dabisbɛ'og la daar ba na nyɛnɛ m nya'aŋ ka ka' m nindaa.” Jeremia dataas la yɛla

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Ba da yɛl ye, “Kemi na ka ti gban'e Jeremia yɛla; ka wada linɛ ka maanmaannib pa'an la bɛɛ ya'am dim sa'alʋg nɛ nɔdi'esidib pian'ad la kʋ bɔdigɛ. Alazug kemi na ka ti nwa'as nɔŋgbannwa'ar nɛ Jeremia ka da kɛlis on yɛt si'el la wʋsaa.”

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, “Kɛlisim, O Zugsɔba; wʋm banɛ pian'adi m yɛla bɛ'ɛd la yɛt si'em!

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a maal sʋm, ba na lɛbis bɛ'ɛdi yɔɔ o sɔbaa? Amaa nɛ wala, ba tu bʋmbɔk man yɛla. Tiɛnm ye m daa zi'enɛ ba nɔba zugʋ pian' ba yɛla fʋ tuon ye fʋ da kɛ ka fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la paae ba.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Alazug kɛl ka kɔ'ɔm kpɛn'ɛ ba biis; ka kɛ ka ba dataas zabi nyaŋi ba. Kɛl ka ba pu'ab lieb pʋkɔnya ka kɔ'ɔŋi ba biis; ka ba bi'emnam kʋʋ ba dap la ka ba na'akim kpi zaba ni.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka nidib wʋm kaasigi ba yaan, fʋ ya'a ti kɛ ka ba bi'emnam gbirigi kpɛn' ba san'an la, bɔzugɔ ba tu bʋmbɔk ye ba ludimi gban'e ka su'a bɛnd baans ye ba gban'am.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye, “Kem onɛ ya'abid san'anɛ da' yʋʋr. Ka dɔl nidib la kpɛɛmnam nɛ maanmaannib la sieba keŋ

english_verse: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
translation_verse: sig Ben Hinnom bɔn'ɔgin zin'ikanɛ kpi'e nɛ Sɛwies Za'anɔɔr la. Ani ka fʋ na mɔɔl labakanɛ ka m yɛlif la,

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: ka yɛl ye, Wʋmmi Zugsɔb la pian'ad, yanam Juda na'anam nɛ Jerusalem nidiba: nɛ'ɛŋa an linɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl: Kɛlisimi! M na mɔr tɔɔgʋ kɛn zin'ikaŋa na, ka onɛ wʋsa tʋbiri wʋm li na pak o.

english_verse: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
translation_verse: Ba mɛ' Baal teŋgban maalʋg zin'ig ye ba nyu'odi ba biisi ani maan maana tisid Baal linɛ ka m pʋ tisi ba nɔɔr ye ba niŋ bɛɛ pʋdigi li yɛllɛ, bɛɛ li bɛɛ m pʋtɛn'ɛrinɛ.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, baŋimi ka dabisa kenna, ka ba kʋ lɛm buon zin'ikaŋa ye, ‘Tofet’ bɛɛ ‘Ben Hinnom Biis Bɔn'ɔgɔ, amaa Ninkʋʋr Bɔn'ɔg.’” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: “Zin'ikaŋa nwa ka m na san'am Juda nɛ Jerusalem gban'ar. M na nɔki ba niŋi ba bi'emnam banɛ ieedi ba nyɔvʋr la nu'usin ka ba zabi kʋʋ ba nɛ sʋ'ʋraug, ka nɔki ba niŋgbina la tis bʋn-ian'ada nɛ bʋnkɔnbid.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: M na san'am tempʋkaŋa ka kɛ ka li an linɛ ka ba na la'adi li. Li na pak banɛ wʋsa nyɛɛ li ka ba pian'adi nɛ'ɛsidi li, lin san'am si'em la zug.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ba dataas banɛ bɔɔd ye ba kʋʋ ba la kena giligi ba, ka kɔ'ɔm na kɛ ka ba na ɔnbi ba biribis nɛ ba bipumis, ba mɛ na ɔnbi ba taaba ni'im.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: “Nwa'am yʋʋr la banɛ dɔlli fʋ keŋ la nini ni,

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, ‘M na san'am buudkaŋa ka nwa'ae tempʋkaŋa wʋʋ yʋkaŋa nwa'ae si'em ka ba kʋ nyaŋi lɛn sɛɛn li la. Ba na mum kum Tofet teŋin la ka paalʋ ti naae.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Ya' banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la nɛ Juda na'anam la ya' na lieb dian'ad wʋʋ Tofet zin'ikaŋa nɛ, ban nyu'od bʋnnyubisa dɔɔd zugʋ tisid nwadbibis banɛ bɛɛ agɔla la, ka kpa'asid bʋnnuuda tisid winsieba la zug.”

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Jeremia da yi Tofet bɔn'ɔgin lɛb zin'ikanɛ ka Zugsɔb da tʋm o ye o keŋ tis o labaar la, ka zi'en Zugsɔb Yir zakin la yɛl nidib la wʋsa ye,

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa, onɛ an Israel Wina'am la yɛl ye, ‘Kɛlisimi! M na kɛ ka tɔɔg kanɛ ka m dɛŋi pian' ye li na kena la paae tempʋkaŋa nɛ teŋkpɛmis banɛ giligi li la, bɔzugɔ ba anɛ zukpi'euŋ dim ka pʋ kɛlisidi m pian'adɛ.’”

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Maanmaan Pasur onɛ an Imer biig, ka lɛn an kpɛɛm Zugsɔb pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, wʋm ka Jeremia pian' pian'abama la,

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: ka o kɛ ka ba bʋ' Wina'am nɔdi'es Jeremia ka ba'a o nɛ ba'annɛ digil dɔɔg kanɛ bɛ Zugsɔb la Yin Benjamin Za'anɔɔr Kanɛ Bɛ Zugin baba la.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: Bɛogʋ da nie ka Pasur kɛ ka ba yis ba'an la o san'an la, ka Jeremia yɛl o ye, “Yʋ'ʋr kanɛ ka Zugsɔb tisif la ka' Pasur ya'asɛ, amaa li anɛ Magor-Misabib.”

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye: “M na kɛ ka dabiem kpɛn' fʋ mɛŋ nɛ fʋ zuanam wʋsa; fʋ mɛŋ nini na nyɛ ka ba bi'emnam kʋʋ ba zaba ni. M na nɔk Juda nidib wʋsa tis Babilon na'ab, ka o na zii ba keŋ Babilon teŋin bɛɛ o kʋʋ ba.

english_verse: He will clean out the royal treasury and take everything else of value from Jerusalem.
translation_verse: M na nɔk tempʋkaŋa kpan'am nɛ li la'asʋma nɛ Juda na'ab arezak la wʋsa tisi ba bi'emnam. Ba na faaɛn li mɔri keŋ Babilon teŋin.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Ka fʋn Pasur, nɛ banɛ bɛɛ fʋ yin la wʋsa, ba na gban'e ya mɔri keŋ Babilon teŋin. Ani ka ba na mumif, fʋn nɛ fʋ zuanam banɛ wʋsa ka fʋ ma' ziri nɔdi'esʋgʋ tisi ba la.” Jeremia fabili tis Zugsɔb la

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ ma'am nɛ, ka m niŋ dama'am la yadda: fʋ paŋi gaadim ka fʋ nyaŋim. Ba la'adim nɛ daar wʋsa ka sɔ' wʋsa tʋ'ʋdim.

english_verse: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
translation_verse: M pian'ad wʋsa anɛ kaasig, nɛ zaba nɛ san'auŋ. Ala ka Zugsɔb labaar kennɛ m san'an na ka li kɛt ka m nyɛt tʋ'ʋd nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ma'aa daar wʋsa.

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Amaa m ya'a yɛl ye, “M kʋ lɛm pʋdig o yɛllɛ,” bɛɛ “m kʋ lɛm pian' o yʋ'ʋrɛ,” o pian'ad la nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ bɛɛ m sʋnfʋn, ka bɛɛ m kɔnba ni wʋsa. M gɛnnɛ ka kʋ nyaŋi mɔri li. Sida, m kʋ nyaŋɛ.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: M wʋm ka nidib bɛdegʋ nya'ami m yɛla, “Dabiem gilignɛ zin'ig wʋsa! Kem yɛl o yɛla! Kɛlli ka ti keŋ pɔɔtim o!” M zuanam wʋsa guri ye m yidig ka yɛt ye, “Daasi'erɛ ba na ma'aa o; ka ti nyaŋ o ka yɔɔ ti sam.”

english_verse: But you, Lord, are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la bɛnɛ m san'an wʋʋ zabzabid kanɛ kpi'em hali; ala ka banɛ duoe zi'e m yɛla la kʋ nyaŋɛ. Ba na mɔɔ gʋ'ʋŋ ka di nyan tita'ar, nidib na nyɛ ba gbin ka sɔ' kʋ tami li yɛllɛ.

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, fʋn kanɛ kpansid pʋpielim dim ka mi' ninsaal sʋnf nɛ o pʋtɛn'ɛr la, kɛl ka m nini nyɛ fʋn na yɔɔ ba sam si'em, bɔzugɔ, fʋn ka m zaŋi m yɛla niŋi fʋ nu'usin.

english_verse: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋm tis Zugsɔb la Zun'omi Zugsɔb la! O faaɛn fara dim la nyɔvʋr ka yisi ba bugusim dim la nu'usin.

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: Nɔpɔɔr bɛ dabiskanɛ ka ba da du'am la zug! Dabiskanɛ ka m ma da du'am la kʋ nyɛ barekaa!

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Nɔpɔɔr bɛ onɛ kena yɛli m saam labaar la, onɛ kɛ ka o sʋnf ma'ae ka yɛl o ye, “Ba du'a biribiŋi tisif la!”

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Ninkan la na nwɛnɛ tembanɛ ka Zugsɔb la san'am ka pʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig la. O na wʋm zabir fabʋlʋg bɛogʋn, ka wʋm tanp kuŋ kaasig nintaŋ tisʋʋs.

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: O da naan kʋʋnɛ mɛ m ma pʋʋgin, lin na kɛ ka m ma niŋgbina liebi m yaʋg, ka o mɔr pʋʋg saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
translation_verse: Bɔɔ kɛ ka m yii m ma pʋʋgin na? Ka m nyɛt daamʋg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ka m bɛllim wʋsa ti naae nɛ nyannɛ?

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Labaar da yi Zugsɔb la san'anɛ kɛn Jeremia ni na saŋa kanɛ ka Na'ab Zedekaya da tʋm Pasur onɛ an Malkija biig la, nɛ maanmaan Zefanaya onɛ an Maaseya biig la, ye ba kem o san'an na la. Ba da yɛl o ye,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Bu'osim Zugsɔb la tisi ti bɔzugɔ Nebukadnɛza onɛ an Babilon na'ab la bɔɔd ye o zab nɛ ti. Daasi'erɛ Zugsɔb la na tʋm nyalima tisi ti wʋʋ on da tʋm kʋdimin si'em la, ka Nebukadnɛza lɛb ka basi ti.”

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Lɛn yɛl nidib la ye Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye: “Gɔsima, m ye m digil nɛ vʋm nɛ kum suoya ya tuon.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa kpɛlim tempʋkaŋa ni ba na kʋʋ o. Amaa onɛ wʋsa yii nɔk o mɛŋi tis Babilon dim banɛ giligi ya la na vʋe; o na faaɛn o mɛŋ.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: M gban'e ye tempʋkaŋa kʋ nyɛ sʋ'ʋm amaa bɛ'ɛd. Babilon na'ab na faaɛn li, ka nyu'oe li nɛ bugum.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Pay attention, you that belong to the royal family.
translation_verse: Linɛ lɛm paas, yɛlim Juda na'ayidim la ye, “Kɛlisimi Zugsɔb la labaar,

english_verse: Each new day, make sure that justice is done, and rescue those who are being robbed. Or else my anger will flame up like a fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: yanam Na'ab David yidima, Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Tʋmmi nɛ sida ya antu'a zin'igin daar wʋsa; faanmi banɛ ka ba faandi ba, ka yisi ba banɛ mugusidi ba la nu'ugin. Ya'a ka' ala, m sʋnpɛɛn la na la'aŋi nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ, bɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka ya tʋm la zug; li na la'aŋ ka sɔ' kae na kpiisi lii.

english_verse: Jerusalem, from your mountaintop you look out over the valleys and think you are safe. But I, the Lord, am angry,
translation_verse: Jerusalem dima m sʋnf pɛlig nɛ ya, yanam banɛ zin' zuokaŋa zugin ka bɔn'ɔd la gilig la, yanam banɛ yɛl ye, anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi kena zab nɛ ti? Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi kpɛn' ti suak zin'igin na?

english_verse: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
translation_verse: M na namisi ya wʋʋ lin nar si'em, M na nyu'oe ya tiis la nɛ bugum ka linɛ giligi ya la wʋsa kanb.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ka ba na lɛbis ye, Ban zan'asi ba Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔnaar la ka pʋ'ʋsid winsieba la zug.” Na'ab Josia biig Jehoahas yɛla

english_verse: King Josiah is dead, so don't mourn for him. Instead, mourn for his son King Jehoahaz, dragged off to another country, never to return.
translation_verse: Da kum Na'ab Josia onɛ kpi la yɛlaa; amaa lɛɛ kum o biig Jehoahas yɛla, ban gban'e o lɔ'ɔŋ teŋ la, bɔzugɔ, on kʋ lɛb na bɛɛ o nyɛɛ o mɛŋ teŋ ya'asɛ.

english_verse: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *
translation_verse: O yɛl ye, “M na mɛ na'ayitita'ari tisim mɛŋ ka dɔɔd banɛ bɛɛ li zugin la yalim.” Ala ka o maal takorbɛda kpɛn'ɛsi li, ka kuaki li nɛ na'aziinr dalamma ka taae li nɛ galʋʋrʋ wiiug.

english_verse: More cedar in your palace doesn't make you a better king than your father Josiah. He always did right— he gave justice to the poor and was honest.
translation_verse: “Fʋ ya'a mɔr na'aziinr bɛdegʋ, li na nyaŋi kɛ ka fʋ sid an na'aba? Fʋ saam da pʋ mɔr diib nɛ bʋnnuudaa? O da tʋm linɛ an sʋm nɛ linɛ an sida ala ka si'el wʋsa da an sʋ'ʋŋa tis o.

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: O da kpɛn'ɛd nɔŋ dim nɛ fara dim zug, ka si'el wʋsa ken sʋ'ʋŋa. Li ka' ala pa'an onɛ nɔŋi maa?” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: “Amaa fʋ nini nɛ fʋ sʋnf wʋsa gban'anɛ ye fʋ filim paam la'ad, ka kʋʋd nimbanɛ pʋ maal si'ela; fʋ mugusid nidib ka fɛndigi ba ya'am.” Na'ab Josia biig Jehoyakim yɛla

english_verse: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, “Why did our great king have to die?”
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa Juda na'ab Jehoyakim onɛ an Na'ab Josia biig la ye, “On na ti kpi saŋa si'a la ba kʋ kaas o kʋʋr ye, ‘Abaa, m bierɛ! Abaa, m taʋn!’ Ba mɛ kʋ kaas o kʋʋr ye, ‘Abaa, m Zugraana! Abaa, Na'aba!’

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: Zɔm keŋ dʋ Lebanon zuoya zugʋ kaas kuŋ, kɛl ka Basan dim wʋmi fʋ kaasig Abarim teŋin, ka fʋ taaba la wʋsa kpiya.

english_verse: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
translation_verse: M daa sa'alif saŋa kanɛ ka fʋ daa tɛn'ɛs ye si'el wʋsa an sʋ'ʋŋa tisif la; amaa fʋ daa yɛl ye, ‘M kʋ kɛlisɛ!’ Fʋ tʋʋmmi la lin yii fʋ na'akinnimin sa ti paae zina; fʋ pʋ siaki m nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Sisi'em na da'ae fʋ kɔnbkemnib la wʋsa mɔri keŋ ka mɔri fʋ taaba la keŋ teŋ zʋŋ. Ka fʋ yʋ'ʋn di nyan ka ba nyɛɛ fʋ gbin fʋ bugusim kanɛ ka fʋ mɔr la zug.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la ye, “Asida sida ka m yɛtif ye, fʋn Jehoyakin onɛ an Juda na'ab ka an Jehoyakim biig la ya'a pʋn aannɛ baŋ kanɛ pidi m datiuŋ nu'ugin pa'annɛ m paŋ la, m naan fuoe nɛ fʋ basin.

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: M na nɔki fʋ tis banɛ ieedif ye ba kʋʋf ka fʋ zɔti ba la, m na nɔki fʋ tis Babilon na'ab Nebukadnɛza nɛ Babilon dim wʋsa.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: M na lɔb fʋn nɛ fʋ ma kanɛ du'af la teŋgban si'a ni, zin'ikanɛ ka ba pʋ du'a ya sɔ'ɔsɔ la, ani ka ya wʋsa na kpi.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ka m bu'os ye, Dau kanɛ ka ba buon Jehoyakin la, ba sid nɛ'ɛs o nɛ wʋʋ yʋkanɛ nwa'ae? O anɛ lauk kanɛ ka sɔ' pʋ bɔɔdi li yɛllɛɛ? Bɔ ka ba na nɔk on nɛ o biisi lɔb yiŋ, teŋ kanɛ ka ba zi'?

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: O teŋgbauŋɔ, teŋgbauŋɔ, teŋgbauŋɔ, wʋm Zugsɔb la pian'ad!

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa: “Sɔm dau kaŋa yɛla digil, nwɛnɛ onɛ ka' biiga, o kʋ mɔr vɔɔnr o bɛllim saŋaa, o bisɔ' kʋ zin'in David na'am gbauŋ la zug bɛɛ di na'am Juda teŋinɛ.”

english_verse: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.
translation_verse: “Tɔɔg na paae kɔnbkemnib banɛ widigid ka san'amidi m pɛ'ɛs banɛ bɛɛ ba nu'usin la!” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ Zugsɔb, onɛ an Israel Wina'am la, yɛl kɔnbkemnib banɛ gɔsid o kɔnbid la ye, “Yanamɛ sadigim widigi m kɔnbid la ka kati ba ka pʋ guri ba la, m na namisi ya bɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka ya tʋm la zug.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: “Mam mɛŋ na la'asi m kɔnbbanɛ kpɛlim ka m widigi ba kpɛn'ɛs tɛɛns wʋsa mɔri ba lɛbi ba bɛllim zin'igin na, ani ka ba na nɔbig ka ba kal zu'oe.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: M na bɔ kɔnbkemnibi tisi ba ka ba na guri ba, ka ba kʋ lɛn zɔt dabiem bɛɛ dabiem kpɛn' ba, ka ba yinne kʋ bɔdigɛ.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Dabisban ni ka Juda na paam yɔlisim ka Israel na bɛ nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.” Ba na ti buon o yʋ'ʋr ye: Zugsɔb la Aan Ti Pʋpielim Sɔb.

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: “La'an nɛ wala sa, dabisa kenna, ka nidib kʋ lɛm pɔ ye, ‘Ti pɔya nɛ Zugsɔb Onɛ mɔri ti yi Egipt teŋin la yʋ'ʋrɛ!’ Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la,

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: amaa ba na yɛl ye, ‘Zugsɔb onɛ mɔr Israel dimi yi teŋ kanɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ la na, nɛ tɛɛns banɛ ka o widigi ba kpɛn'ɛs la.’ M na mɔri ba lɛbis teŋ kanɛ ka m da tisi ba yaanam la ni na.” Ziri nɔdi'esidib la yɛla

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: Nɔdi'esidib la yɛla: ka m sʋʋnr san'am; m kɔnba wʋsa dammidnɛ. M nwɛnɛ danuud nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ onɛ ka daam nyaŋ o, bɔzugɔ li anɛ Zugsɔb la nɛ o pian'abanɛ an kasi la zug.

english_verse: Those unfaithful prophets misuse their power all over the country. So God turned the pasturelands into scorching deserts. The Lord Will Punish Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Teŋ la pɛ'ɛli nɛ pu'agɔɔnda tʋʋma; bɔzugɔ nɔpɔɔr la kɛnɛ ka teŋ la kʋdig ka mɔɔd banɛ bɛ sian'arin la kʋdig. Nɔdi'esidib la dɔlli ziri suoya ka pʋ mɔri ba paŋ la tʋm nɛ sidaa.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: “Nɔdi'esidib nɛ maanmaannib la wʋsa pʋ dɔl Wina'am; hali m pʋ'ʋsim Yin la m nyɛ ba bɛ'ɛd la an si'em,” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Now I will punish you with disaster, and you will slip and fall in the darkness. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Dinzugɔ, ba suor la na lieb sisalig; ba na kadi ba kpɛn'ɛs likin ani ka ba na li. Yʋʋm kanɛ ka ba na nyɛ namisʋg la m na mɔr yɛltɔɔgʋ ba zugin na,” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.
translation_verse: “Samaria nɔdi'esidib la sʋʋgin m nyɛ linɛ pʋ malisi ma: ba di'edi Baal nɔɔr pian'ad ka kpɛn'ɛsidi m nidib Israel dim la mɔɔg.

english_verse: And you prophets in Jerusalem are even worse. You're unfaithful in marriage and never tell the truth. You even lead others to sin instead of helping them turn back to me. You and the people of Jerusalem are evil like Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: M nyɛ ka nɔdi'esidib banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la tʋm tʋʋmfɛn'ɛsa si'em: ba anɛ pu'asan'auŋ nɛ dausan'auŋ nɛ ziri dim. Ba kpɛmisid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim, alazugʋ kɛ ka sɔ' pʋ fɛndigid ka basid o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Man san'an ba nwɛnɛ Sodom nɛ Gomora dim nɛ.”

english_verse: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord, promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink. The Lord Gives a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye: “M na kɛ ka ba di diib linɛ an tɔɔg ka nu ku'om linɛ an yabid, bɔzugɔ Jerusalem nɔdi'esidib la kɛ ka ba Wina'am zi'ilim la yadigi paae zin'ig wʋsa.”

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, Da kɛlisidi nɔdi'esidib la yɛti ya si'el la; ba tisidi ya nɛ ti'ir linɛ ka' asida. Ba pian'adi linɛ yii ba mɛŋ pʋtɛn'ɛrin na, ka ka' linɛ yi Zugsɔb la nɔɔrinɛ.

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Ba yɛt banɛ pʋ bɔɔdi m yɛla la ye, Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Ya na mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm.” Nɛ banɛ wʋsa ka ba sʋnya digilim la ba yɛt ye, “Bɛ'ɛd kʋdim kʋ kɛɛn ya san'an naa.”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Amaa ba sʋʋgin la anɔ'ɔnɛ mi' zi'en Zugsɔb la la'asʋg zin'igin ye o gɔs bɛɛ o wʋm o pian'adɛ? Anɔ'ɔnɛ kɛlis bɛɛ baŋ o pian'adɛ?

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn na da'ae na nwɛnɛ sisi'em nɛ, li na nwɛnɛ sisi'epiliŋi da'adi bʋʋn pʋkpɛnnim dim wʋsa zugin.

english_verse: I won't calm down, until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday you will understand exactly what I mean.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn linɛ mɔr dabiem la kʋ lɛbɛ asɛɛ li ti tʋm o sʋnfʋ gban'e si'el la naae. Dabisa kenna ka ya na gban'e li gbin sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: Mam pʋ tʋm nɔdi'es bamaa, la'an nɛ wala ba zɔti ken nɛ ba labaya. Mam pʋ pian' tisi baa, la'an nɛ wala ba pian'adi tisid nidib la.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Amaa ba ya'a bɛɛn nɛ m la'asʋg la zin'igin, ba naan di'edi nɛ m pian'adi tisidi m nidib la, ka fɛndigi ba yiti ba suobɛ'ɛdnam nɛ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: in heaven and on earth. There are no secret places where you can hide from me.
translation_verse: Sɔ' na nyaŋi nyɛ suak zin'igi su'a ka man kʋ nyɛɛ o?” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la. “Mam pʋ pɛ'ɛl agɔl nɛ teŋin wʋsaa?” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: “M wʋm nɔdi'esidib la yɛt si'em, banɛ pian'ad ziri nɛ m yʋ'ʋr la. Ba yɛt ye, M zaansim nɛ! M zaansim nɛ! Wina'am nie pa'alim!

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Bʋndaar ka nɔdi'esidib banɛ pian'adi ba mɛŋ pʋtɛnda gban'e si'el la na basɛ?

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: Ba tɛn'ɛs ye zaansima banɛ ka ba yɛt taaba la na kɛ ka m nidib la tam man yʋ'ʋr, nwɛnɛ ba yaanamɛ da kpɛlim Baal pʋ'ʋsʋg ka tam man yɛla si'em la.

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka nɔdi'es kanɛ zaansim la yɛl o zaansʋŋ la, amaa kɛl ka onɛ mɔr mam pian'ad la pian' li nɛ sida. “Kikan'ar ka' li kɔn' nɛ kibielim?” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: “Mam pian'ad la pʋ nwɛnɛ bugum?” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la, “Ka lɛn nwɛnɛ zan'ar bɛɛ hamma nwɛ'ɛd tampiinsi buaridaa?”

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Asida, m zan'as banɛ pian'ad ziri zaansima la. Ba pian'adi li yɛla tisidi m nidib la, ka ma'adi ba n kpɛn'ɛsid mɔɔg nɛ ba ziri la, la'an nɛ mam pʋ tʋmmi ba bɛɛ gaŋi ba la. Ba pʋ kɛ ka nimbama nyɛ nyɔɔd baa bi'ela.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la. Ziri pian'ad nɛ ziri nɔdi'esidib la yɛla

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: “Nimbama bɛɛ nɔdi'es bɛɛ maanmaan ya'a ti bu'osif ye lababɔ ka Zugsɔb la nɔki tisi fɔ? Fʋn lɛbisim ye, ‘Ya anɛ ziidi tis Zugsɔb la, o na tʋki yaa bas.’” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: Nɔdi'es bɛɛ maanmaan bɛɛ onɛ wʋsa yɛl ye labakaŋa anɛ Zugsɔb la din la, m na namis dau kan la nɛ o yidim wʋsa.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Nɛ' ka ya wʋsa yinne-yinne yɛt o zua bɛɛ o sizua ye, “Zugsɔb la lɛbisʋg an bɔ? bɛɛ Zugsɔb la pian' ye bɔ?”

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Amaa da lɛm pʋdigi Zugsɔb la labaar yɛla ya'asɛ, bɔzugɔ sɔ' wʋsa mɔr o mɛŋ labaari tisid, ka nɔki li ka li an Zugsɔb la din, ka tia'asid Wina'am Onɛ Vʋe la pian'ad, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, onɛ aan ti Wina'am.

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Ya bu'osid nɔdi'esib la ye, Zugsɔb la lɛbis ye bɔɔ tisi fɔ? bɛɛ Zugsɔb la pian' ye bɔ?

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m na tami ya yɛla ka kadi ya yisi m san'an, nɛ tempʋkanɛ ka m tis yanam nɛ ya yaanam la wʋsa.

english_verse: You will never be free from your shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka nyan dii ya, hali ka nyan kan buudi ka' linɛ ka ba na tam.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Jehoyakin onɛ an Jehoyakim biig ka an Juda na'ab la, nɛ o na'ayikpɛm nɛ Juda nimbanɛ mi' tʋʋma sʋ'ʋŋa la, Babilon na'ab Nebukadnɛza da gban'e ba Jerusalem teŋin mɔri keŋ Babilon teŋin. Lin nya'aŋ ka Zugsɔb la nie pa'alim, ka m nyɛ kekama pɛɛd ayi', ka li zi'e Zugsɔb Yir za'anɔɔrin.

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Pɛog yinne da mɔri kekamsʋma, nwɛnɛ wala banɛ dɛŋ bi'igir; ka yinne la an bʋmpɔn'ɔsa linɛ san'am hali ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi dii li.

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la bu'osim ye, “Jeremia, fʋ nyɛ bɔ?” Ka m lɛbis ye, “Kekama. Bʋnsʋma la an sʋm hali, amaa bʋmbɛ'ɛdnam la san'amnɛ hali ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi dii.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb labaar kɛɛn m san'an na ye,

english_verse: People of Judah, the good figs stand for those of you I sent away as exiles to Babylonia,
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la yɛl si'eli nwa ye, M gɔs kekamsʋma nwa ka ba anɛ nimbanɛ ka m kɛ ka ba gban'e ba mɔri keŋ Babilon teŋin la an sʋ'ʋm si'em.

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: M na guri ba, ka na ti mɔri ba lɛbis teŋ kaŋa ni na. M na maali mɛɛ ba sʋ'ʋŋa ka kʋ nwa'ae ba ya'asɛ. M na sɛɛ ba ka kʋ lɛn vuoɛn ba ya'asɛ.

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: M na pɛligi m pʋʋgʋ tisi ba, ka ba baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la. Ba na aan m nidib, ka mam mɛ na aan ba Wina'am, bɔzugɔ, ba na lɛbi m san'an na nɛ ba sʋnf wʋsa.”

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛl ye, “Nwɛnɛ kekama banɛ san'am ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi di si'em la, ala ka m na niŋ Juda na'ab Zedekaya nɛ o na'ayikpɛm nɛ banɛ kpɛlim la, ba ya'a bɛ nɛ Jerusalem la bɛɛ Egipt teŋin wʋsa.

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka sʋ'ʋlim banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ la zug wʋsa yaa ba ka kisigi ba, ka siilimi ba. Ba na la'adi ba ka tʋ'ʋdi ba, ka pɔɔdi ba nɔya man kadi ba kpɛn'ɛs zin'isi'a wʋsa.

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka zaba, nɛ kɔ'ɔm, nɛ ban'as paae ba, hali ka ba ti kpii naae teŋ kanɛ ka m tisi ba nɛ ba yaanam la.”

english_verse: The Lord has sent prophets to you time after time, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb la la'an tʋm o tʋmtʋmnib banɛ aan o nɔdi'esidibi ya san'an na saŋa wʋsa la, ya pʋ kɛlisɛ ka zan'asi ba pian'ad la.

english_verse: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ba yɛli ya ye, Ya wʋsa yinne-yinne fɛndigimi ya suobɛ'ɛdnamin la nannanna, nɛ bɛ'ɛd linɛ ka ya maan la, ka ya na kpɛm bɛ teŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la tis yanam nɛ ya yaanam la ni saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.
translation_verse: Da dɔlli winsieba maannɛ ba ka zun'odi baa; da kɛ ka m sʋʋnr pɛlig nɛ linɛ ka ya maal nɛ ya mɛŋ nu'us la. Lin ka m kʋ san'ami yaa.”

english_verse: But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord, say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did.
translation_verse: “Amaa ya pʋ kɛlis man yɛl si'el la.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la, Ya kɛya ka m sʋnf duoe nɛ linɛ ka ya nɔki ya nu'usi maal la, ka mɔr san'auŋʋ kɛɛn ya mɛŋ san'an na.

english_verse: and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: m na buol nimbanɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ la nɛ m tʋmtʋm Nebukadnɛza onɛ an Babilon na'ab la na. M na mɔri ba na ka ba zab nɛ teŋ kaŋa nɛ nimbanɛ bɛɛ li ni la, nɛ buudbanɛ gilig la wʋsa. M na san'ami ba nyain ka kɛ ka ba lieb bʋnla'ada ka ba san'auŋ la kʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ,” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.
translation_verse: M na yis sumalisim vuudi ba san'an, sumalisim linɛ ka pu'apaal nɛ pu'apaal sidib maan la, ba kʋ lɛn wʋm ka sɔ' nɛ'ɛm zɔ'ɔm bɛɛ ba nyu'oe fitirɛ.

english_verse: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for
translation_verse: Teŋ tita'ar kaŋa na lieb zaalim, ka buudbanɛ bɛ kpɛla la na tʋmmi tisid Babilon teŋ dim yʋma pisyɔpɔi.

english_verse: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.
translation_verse: “Amaa yʋma pisyɔpɔi la ya'a ti gaad, m na namis Babilon na'ab nɛ o teŋ la, nɛ Babilon nidib la wʋsa ba bɛ'ɛd la yɛla. M na kɛ ka teŋ la kpɛlim zaalim saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ,” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: “Mam pian' si'el teŋ kaŋa yɛla la m na mɔri li na, nɛ linɛ wʋsa sɔb gbauŋ kaŋa ni ka Jeremia pian' zɛrig buudi wʋsa la.

english_verse: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves. The Cup Full of God's Anger
translation_verse: Ba mɛŋ na zɔɔ kpɛn' sankpan'asim tɛɛns bɛdegʋ pʋʋgin nɛ na'atitada nu'usin. M na lɛbisi yɔɔ ba ban tʋm si'el, nɛ ban nɔki ba nu'usi maal si'el la.” Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn bʋtiŋ

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la yɛlim si'eli nwa ye: “Nɔkim bʋtiŋ kanɛ pɛ'ɛl nɛ daam linɛ pa'annɛ m sʋnpɛɛn la ka kɛ ka buudbanɛ ka m tʋmmi fʋ ba san'an la nuu li.

english_verse: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
translation_verse: Ba ya'a nuu li, ba na gɛɛm ka kennɛ gɛrid, zaba bɛɛ tanp linɛ ka m na kɛ ka li nwɛ' ba sʋʋgin la zug.”

english_verse: I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.
translation_verse: Ka m di'e bʋtiŋ la Zugsɔb la nu'ugin ka kɛ ka on da tʋmim buudsieba san'an la nuu li.

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: Banɛ an Jerusalem nɛ tempʋbanɛ bɛ Juda nɛ li na'anam nɛ ba kpɛɛmnam la, ka li kɛ ka nidib yaae ba, ka pɔɔd nɔɔri tisidi ba, ka kɛ ka ba lieb bʋnla'ada, nwɛnɛ din an si'em zina la.

english_verse: The second place I went was Egypt, where everyone had to drink from the cup, including the king and his officials, the other government workers, the rest of the Egyptians,
translation_verse: Egipt na'ab Faaro nɛ o tʋmtʋmnib nɛ o na'ayikpɛm nɛ o nidib la wʋsa na ti nuu li

english_verse: Then I went to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon,
translation_verse: Edom nɛ Moab nɛ Ammon

english_verse: and to the kings of Tyre, Sidon, and their colonies across the sea.
translation_verse: nɛ Taya nɛ Sidon na'anam; na'anam banɛ bɛɛ atɛuk nɔɔrin nɛ banɛ lɔ'ɔŋ atɛuk la.

english_verse: After this, I went to the kings of Dedan, Tema, Buz, the tribes of the Arabian Desert,
translation_verse: Arabia na'anam wʋsa nɛ nimbanɛ an teŋ zʋŋ na'anam ka bɛ pipirisin la;

english_verse: and the countries in the north, both near and far. I went to all the countries on earth, one after another, and finally to Babylonia.
translation_verse: nɛ na'anam banɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ nɛ banɛ bɛ yammin nɛ banɛ bɛ lalli nɛ sʋ'ʋlim banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ la zug wʋsa na nu sʋnpɛɛn daam la. Ka lin nya'aŋ Siasiak na'ab mɛ na nuu li.

english_verse: The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye m yɛlimi ba ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb, onɛ an Israel Wina'am la, yɛl ye, numini m sʋnduor la kʋʋli ka tin ka lii digi ka da lɛn duoe ya'asɛ, bɔzugɔ, m na kɛ ka zaba paae ya na.

english_verse: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.
translation_verse: Amaa ba ya'a zan'as ka pʋ di'e bʋtiŋ la fʋ nu'usinɛ nuu, yɛlimi ba ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Asɛɛ ya nuu li!

english_verse: My voice will be heard everywhere on earth, accusing nations of their crimes and sentencing the guilty to death. Disaster Is Coming
translation_verse: O tansʋg la na maligim paae dunia kpikpɛmis, Zugsɔb la na pian' buudi wʋsa pɔ'ɔgir yɛla. O na kad nidib wʋsa saria ka kʋ bugusim dim la.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye: “Gɔsima! Tɔɔg yadigidi kenna, li na paae buudi wʋsa yinne-yinne; sisi'etita'ar yi dunia kpikpɛmisi kenna.”

english_verse: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn. The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Saŋa kan la ya'a ti paae ka banɛ ka Zugsɔb kʋ la na bɛ zin'ig wʋsa, li na yi dunia kpikpɛŋ yinne paae kpikpɛŋ yinne. Ba kʋ kaasi ba kʋʋr bɛɛ ba la'asi ba bɛɛ mumi baa, amaa ba na nwɛnɛ sa'ad nɛ dig teŋin.

english_verse: The Lord's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ an kɔnbkemniba, kummi ka kaasi; yanam banɛ bɛ pɛ'ɛs la tuonnɛ, bilimmi titanin; bɔzugɔ ya kʋʋb saŋa paae ya; ya na lii yaam-yaam wʋʋ yʋʋri nwa'anɛ.

english_verse: You have nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. *
translation_verse: Kɔnbkemnib la kʋ mɔr zin'ikanɛ ka ba na zɔɔ keŋɛ, kɔnbid la tuongatib kʋ nyɛ suori zɔɔ pɔnsɛ.

english_verse: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na kɛn mɔma'asa linɛ malisi tis bʋnkɔnbid la zin'ig na ka kɛ ka li lieb pipiris zin'ig Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn linɛ mɔr dabiem la zug.

english_verse: Like a lion leaving its den, the Lord has abandoned his people to the destruction of war.
translation_verse: O na bas o buug la wʋʋ gbigim nɛ, ka sɔ' kʋ lɛm bɛ teŋin la bɔzugɔ, mugusʋg sɔb la na kʋʋ ya ka li anɛ Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn linɛ mɔr dabiem la zug.

english_verse: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said,
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la nɛ nɔdi'esidib nɛ nidib la wʋsa da wʋm ka Jeremia pian' pian'abama Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zakin la.

english_verse: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ baŋimi ye, ya ya'a kʋ man, li na an tuku ti yanam nɛ tempʋkaŋa nɛ nimbanɛ bɛɛ li ni la wʋsa, yanamɛ kʋ onɛ pʋ tʋm taal la zug, bɔzugɔ li anɛ sida, Zugsɔb la tʋmim ye m pian' nɛ' wʋsa ka ya wʋm.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye, “Zi'enim Zugsɔb Yir la zakin pian' tis Juda tempʋʋs la nimbanɛ wʋsa kɛn Zugsɔb la Yin na ye ba pʋ'ʋs la. Yɛlimi ba man ye fʋ yɛli ba si'el la wʋsa; da bas pian'ʋk baa yinnɛɛ.

english_verse: Maybe the people will listen this time. And if they stop doing wrong, I will change my mind and not punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Daasi'erɛɛ ba na kɛlis ka ba yinne-yinne tiaki ba suobɛ'ɛdnam la. Ka m na tiaki m pʋtɛn'ɛr ka kʋ lɛn kɛ ka tɔɔg kanɛ ka m gban'e la kena, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka ba tʋm la zugɔ.”

english_verse: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa ye: ‘Ya ya'a pʋ kɛlis ka dɔl wada linɛ ka m nɔki digili ya tuon la,

english_verse: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once,
translation_verse: ka mɛ pʋ kɛlis nɔdi'esidib banɛ aan m tʋmtʋmnib la pian'adɛ, banɛ ka m tʋmi ba ya san'an ka lɛn tʋmi ba ya san'an na la ,

english_verse: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name “Jerusalem” as a curse word. Jeremiah on Trial
translation_verse: alazug m na kɛ ka yikaŋa nwɛnɛ Siilo teŋ ka m da san'am si'em la, ka nɔpɔɔr na bɛ tempʋkaŋa zug buudbanɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa sʋʋgin.’”

english_verse: and as soon as I finished, they all crowded around me and started shouting, “Why did you preach that the Lord will destroy this temple, just as he destroyed Shiloh? Why did you say that Jerusalem will be empty and lie in ruins? You ought to be put to death for saying such things in the Lord's name!” Then they had me arrested.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ yɛt nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr ye Yikaŋa na nwɛnɛ Siilo ka tempʋkaŋa na kpɛlimmi li kɔn'ɔkɔn' ka sɔ' kʋ bɛɛ li ni?” Ka nidib la wʋsa la'asi gilig Jeremia, Zugsɔb Yin la.

english_verse: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.
translation_verse: Na'ayikpɛm la wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la, ka duoe na'ayin la keŋ Zugsɔb la Yin Za'anɔpaallin la zin'inɛ ba zin'isa ni.

english_verse: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, “All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.”
translation_verse: Ani ka maanmaannib nɛ nɔdi'esidib la yɛl na'ayikpɛm la nɛ nidib la wʋsa ye, “Kʋʋsimi ye dau kaŋa nar nɛ kʋʋb bɔzugɔ o pian' bɛ'ɛdi tis tempʋkaŋa. Ya mɛŋ tʋba wʋm ya!”

english_verse: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord, he will change his mind.
translation_verse: Nannanna tiakimini ya suoya nɛ ya tʋʋma ka siak Zugsɔb la nɔɔr. Ala ka o na tiak o pʋtɛn'ɛr ka kɛ ka tɔɔg kanɛ ka o yɛl ye li na kena la kʋ lɛn kɛɛn ya zugin naa.

english_verse: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ mam, m bɛɛ ya nu'usin; maalimi linɛ ka ya tɛn'ɛs ye li an sʋm ka dɔl suor.

english_verse: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, “Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.”
translation_verse: Ani ka na'ayikpɛm la nɛ nidib la wʋsa nɛ maanmaannib nɛ nɔdi'esidib la ye, “Dau kaŋa pʋ nar nɛ ban na kʋʋs o yɛla ye o kpii! Bɔzugɔ o pian' tisi ti nɛ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr zug.”

english_verse: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnam la sieba da duoe yi tuon na ka yɛl nimbanɛ la'as la wʋsa ye,

english_verse: years ago when Hezekiah was king of Judah, a prophet named Micah from the town of Moresheth had said: “I, the Lord All-Powerful, say Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.”
translation_verse: Hezekia da an na'ab Juda teŋin saŋsi'a la, Maika onɛ yi Moreset la da di'esid Zugsɔb pian'adi tisid nidib la. O da yɛl Juda dim wʋsa ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa: “Zion na lieb pɔɔg ka ba kua, ka Jerusalem lieb tandia'ana dʋʋr, ka Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zuor la lieb sian'anr.”

english_verse: Then the leaders continued: No one put Micah to death for saying that. Instead, King Hezekiah prayed to the Lord with fear and trembling and asked him to have mercy. Then the Lord decided not to destroy Jerusalem, even though he had already said he would. People of Judah, if Jeremiah is killed, we will bring a terrible disaster on ourselves.
translation_verse: Juda na'ab Hezekia bɛɛ sɔ' da duoe Juda teŋin la kʋʋ o? Hezekia da pʋ zɔ dabiem ka sɔs Zugsɔb la suguruu? Zugsɔb la da pʋ tiak o pʋtɛn'ɛr on yɛl ye o na mɔr tɔɔgʋ kɛɛn ba san'an na laa? Nannanna ti bɔɔdi bɔnɛ yɛltɔɔgʋ tisi ti mɛŋ!

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me: Jeremiah, make a wooden yoke with leather straps, and place it on your neck.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim si'eli nwa ye, Maalim yu'asindaug ka biɛn gbana lɔɔ li kɔlli fʋ niŋgɔɔnrin.

english_verse: Then send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon. Some officials from these countries are in Jerusalem, meeting with Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Ka tɔlim labaari tis kpɛɛmnam banɛ yi Edom nɛ Moab nɛ Ammon nɛ Taya nɛ Sidon tɛɛnsini kɛn Juda na'ab Zedekaya san'an na la,

english_verse: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: ye ba yɛli ba zugdaannam la ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb ka an Israel Wina'am la yɛl ye, Yɛlimi ya zugdaannam la nɛ'ɛŋa:

english_verse: and with my power I created the earth, its people, and all animals. I decide who will rule the earth,
translation_verse: M mɛŋ paŋ nɛ m nu'ug kanɛ paad zin'ig wʋsa la ka m maal teŋgbauŋ nɛ nidib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ bɛɛ li ni la, ka nɔkidi li tisid onɛ wʋsa ka m bɔɔd.

english_verse: and I have chosen my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to rule all nations, including yours. I will even let him rule the wild animals. All nations will be slaves of Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson. Then many nations will join together, and their kings will make slaves of the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Buudi wʋsa na tʋm tis on nɛ o biig nɛ o yaaŋ hali ti paae li bɛn; ani ka buudi bɛdegʋ nɛ na'atitada yʋ'ʋn na la'as taaba zabi nyaŋ o.

english_verse: This yoke stands for the power of King Nebuchadnezzar, and I will destroy any nation that refuses to obey him. Nebuchadnezzar will attack, and many will die in battle or from hunger and disease.
translation_verse: Ka buudsi'a bɛɛ sʋ'ʋlim si'a ya'a pʋ tʋm tis Babilon na'ab Nebukadnɛza bɛɛ igini na'as oo, m na namis buudkan la, Tanp nɛ kɔ'ɔm nɛ ban'abɛ'ɛd na kʋʋ ba, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la, asɛɛ ka m san'ami ba wʋsa naae.

english_verse: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Alazug, da kɛlisidi ya nɔdi'esidib nɛ banɛ gɔsid ku'omin nɛ banɛ ye ba mi' zaansima gbinni yɛt la, ya sɔnpʋttib nɛ ba'akɔn dim banɛ yɛti ya ye, “Ya kʋ tʋm tis Babilon na'ab la.”

english_verse: If you listen to such lies, I will have you dragged far from your country and killed.
translation_verse: Ba yɛti ya nɛ ziri linɛ na kɛ ka ba mɔri ya lalig ka basi ya teŋ la; m na kadi ya yis ka ya bɔdig.

english_verse: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.
translation_verse: Amaa buudkanɛ igin ka siak Babilon na'ab yu'asindaug la ka tʋm tis o, m na kɛ ka buudkan la kpɛlimmi ba mɛŋ teŋin, ka kuod ka bɛɛ ani, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Labakan la mɛn ka m da tis Juda na'ab Zedekaya. M da yɛl o ye, “Iginim ka siak Babilon na'ab yu'asindaug la; ka tʋm tis on nɛ o nidib, ka fʋ na vʋe.

english_verse: But if you refuse, then you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease, just as the Lord has warned.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ bɔɔdi kɛ ka fʋn nɛ fʋ nidib kpi zaba ni nɛ kɔ'ɔm nɛ ban'abɛ'ɛd linɛ ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, buudkanɛ pʋ siaki tʋm tis Babilon na'aba o na kɛ ka li paae ba la?

english_verse: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.
translation_verse: Da kɛlisid nɔdi'esidib banɛ ma'adif ye fʋ kʋ tʋm tis Babilon na'ab laa.

english_verse: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord, but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Mam pʋ tʋmi baa,” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la. Ba ma'adnɛ ziri nɛ man yʋ'ʋr. Dinzugɔ m na kadi ya yis, yanam nɛ nɔdi'esidib banɛ pian'adi tisidi ya la wʋsa, ka ya na kpi.

english_verse: When I finished talking to the king, I told the priests and everyone else that the Lord had said: Don't listen to the prophets when they say that very soon the Babylonians will return the things they took from my temple. Those prophets are lying!
translation_verse: Ani ka m yɛl maanmaannib la nɛ nimbama wʋsa ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa, Da kɛlisid nɔdi'esidib banɛ yɛt ye, Li kʋ yuugɛ, Zugsɔb Yir la'ad linɛ bɛ Babilon la ba na mɔri ba lɛbis na la.” Ba ma'adnɛ, li anɛ ziri nɔdi'esʋg.

english_verse: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.
translation_verse: Da kɛlisidi baa. Tʋm tis Babilon Na'ab la ka ya na vʋe. Bɔ ka tempʋkaŋa na lieb dabɔɔgɔ?

english_verse: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a sid anɛ nɔdi'esidib ka mɔr Zugsɔb la pian'ad, kɛl ka ba sɔs Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, ka la'ad linɛ nam bɛ Zugsɔb Yin nɛ Juda na'ab yin la kpɛm bɛɛ ala, nɛ linɛ bɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la, ka ba da mɔri li keŋ Babilon teŋinɛ.

english_verse: will be taken to Babylonia, where they will remain until I decide to bring them back to Jerusalem. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Ba na mɔri ba keŋ Babilon ka ba na bɛɛ ani paae daakanɛ ka m na lɛb na nɔki ba mɔri lɛbis kpɛla na la.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening,
translation_verse: Zedekaya da dii o na'am la li yʋma anaasi saŋa, nwadis anu la ni, nɔdi'es Hanania onɛ an Azur biig ka yi Gibeon teŋin la na da pian' tisim Zugsɔb Yin la, ka maanmaannib nɛ nidib la wʋsa bɛ, ka o yɛl ye,

english_verse: he told me that the Lord had said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I will smash the yoke that Nebuchadnezzar put on the necks of the nations to make them his slaves.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb, ka an Israel Wina'am la yɛl ye, M na kɔ'ɔg Babilon na'ab yu'asindaug la.

english_verse: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Yʋma ayi' saŋa m na mɔr Zugsɔb Yir la'ad la wʋsa lɛbis kpɛla na, la'abanɛ ka Babilon na'ab da yis kpɛla mɔri keŋ Babilon la.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!
translation_verse: M na mɔr Juda na'ab Jehoyakin onɛ an Jehoyakim biig la lɛbis kpɛla na, nɛ banɛ wʋsa ka ba da gban'e ba Juda mɔri keŋ Babilon la, bɔzugɔ m na kɔ'ɔg Babilon na'ab yu'asindaug la.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The priests and the others were still standing there, so I said:
translation_verse: Jeremia da lɛbis nɔdi'es Hanania, maanmaannib la tuon, nɛ nimbanɛ bɛ Zugsɔb Yin la si'em nwa.

english_verse: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.
translation_verse: O da yɛl ye, “Ami! Zugsɔb la kɛl ka li lieb amɛŋa, ka di'e fʋ nɔɔr ka pian'abanɛ ka fʋ yɛl la niŋ amɛŋa, ka Zugsɔb Yir la'ad nɛ nimbanɛ ka ba gban'e ba mɔri keŋ Babilon la sid lɛb kpɛla na!

english_verse: that long before we were born, prophets were saying powerful kingdoms would be struck by war, disaster, and disease.
translation_verse: Nɔdi'esidib banɛ da gaad saŋa kanɛ ka man nɛ fʋ nan kae la da pian'anɛ zi'el ye zaba nɛ tɔɔg nɛ ban'abɛ'ɛd na paae tɛɛns bɛdegʋ nɛ sʋ'ʋlim banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ la.

english_verse: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Amaa nɔdi'es kanɛ yɛl ye sumbʋgʋsʋm na bɛ la, lin na niŋ si'em ka ba baŋ ye Zugsɔb la sid tʋm o na anɛ o pian'ad la ya'a niŋ amɛŋa.”

english_verse: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.
translation_verse: Ani ka nɔdi'es Hanania yis yu'asindaug la Jeremia niŋgɔɔnrinɛ kɔ'ɔgi li,

english_verse: Then he said, “The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years.” I left the temple,
translation_verse: ka yɛl nidib la wʋsa tuon ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em nwa ye, Ala ka m na kɔ'ɔg Babilon na'ab Nebukadnɛza yu'asindaug la buudi wʋsa niŋgɔnya ni yʋma ayi' saŋa.” Nɛ'ɛŋa da kɛ ka nɔdi'es Jeremia gban'e o suori keŋ.

english_verse: to go back and say to Hananiah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You smashed a wooden yoke, but I will replace it with one made of iron. I will put iron yokes on all the nations, and they will have to do what King Nebuchadnezzar commands. I will even let him rule the wild animals.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb ka an Israel Wina'am la yɛl si'eli nwa, “M na nɔk kʋnt yu'asin nɛ gɛɛl buudbama niŋgɔnya, ka kɛ ka ba tʋmmi tisid Babilon na'ab Nebukadnɛza, hali m na kɛ ka o sʋ'oe sian'anr bʋnkɔnbid.”

english_verse: Hananiah, I have never sent you to speak for me. And yet you have talked my people into believing your lies and rebelling against me. So now I will send you—I'll send you right off the face of the earth! You will die before this year is over.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa, ‘M na yisif dunia kaŋa pʋʋgin. Yʋʋm kaŋa fʋ na kpi, bɔzugɔ fʋ kɛ ka nidib la zan'as Zugsɔb la nɔɔr.’”

english_verse: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote
translation_verse: O da nɔk gbauŋ la tis Elasa onɛ an Safan biig la, nɛ Gemaraya onɛ an Hilkia biig la, bama ka Juda na'ab Zedekaya da tʋm Na'ab Nebukadnɛza san'an Babilon teŋin. Li da sɔb gbauŋ la pʋʋgin ye,

english_verse: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb, ka an Israel Wina'am la yɛl si'eli nwa tis banɛ ka o da kɛ ka ba gban'e ba Jerusalem mɔri keŋ Babilon la:

english_verse: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.
translation_verse: ‘Mɛɛmi yaa kpɛn', maalimi lɔmbɔn'ɔd ka di linɛ wʋsa ka ya bʋdi li pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Get married and have children, then help your sons find wives and help your daughters find husbands, so they can have children as well. I want your numbers to grow, not to get smaller.
translation_verse: Dimi pu'ab ka kul sidibi du'a biribis nɛ bipumis; bɔɔmi pu'abi tisi ya biribis ka tisi ya bipumis la sidib, ka ban mɛ na du'a biribis nɛ bipumis. Wiakimi ka nɔbigi ka da sie.

english_verse: Pray for peace in Babylonia and work hard to make it prosperous. The more successful that nation is, the better off you will be.
translation_verse: Ieminɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ tempʋkanɛ ka ya bɛ la sʋ'ʋm, zin'ikanɛ ka m mɛŋ mɔri ya keŋ la. Sɔsimi man Zugsɔb la li yɛla, bɔzugɔ teŋ la ya'a mɔr malisim, ala ka yanam mɛ na di malisim teŋin la.’
