english_verse: My people, I am on your side, and I will take revenge on Babylon. I will cut off its water supply, and its stream will dry up.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Gɔsima, m na zabi ya yɛla ka yɔ samme tisi ya. M na kɛ ka Babilon mu'ar la kpiɛn ka o bulis la kʋdig.

english_verse: Babylon will be a pile of rubble where only jackals live, and everyone will be afraid to walk among the ruins.
translation_verse: Babilon na anɛ dabɔɔd, zin'ikanɛ ka wɛbaas na bɛ; li na anɛ pakiri tis nidib ka an bʋnla'adir, ka an zin'ikanɛ ka nidib kʋ bɛɛ.

english_verse: The Babylonians roar and growl like young lions.
translation_verse: O nidib la wʋsa nwa'am wʋʋ gbigimpaalis, ka kaasid wʋʋ gbigimbibis.

english_verse: And since they are hungry, I will give them a banquet. They will celebrate, get drunk, then fall asleep, never to wake up!
translation_verse: Ba ya'a ti daamid hali, m na tisi ba daam ka kɛ ka ba nuu kʋʋl, ala ka ba na la'ad agɔla gɔla, ba'asi gbis ka kʋ lɛn duoe.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: I will lead them away to die, like sheep, lambs, and goats being led to the butcher.
translation_verse: “M na mɔri ba na ka ba nwɛnɛ pɛbibis nɛ pɛraad nɛ bʋʋs banɛ ka ba mɔri wa'ae kʋʋb zin'ig.

english_verse: All nations now praise Babylon, but when it is captured, those same nations will be horrified.
translation_verse: Ba na nyaŋ Siesiak onɛ da dʋ'ʋsidi o mɛŋ teŋgbauŋ wʋsa sʋʋgin la! Babilon yɛla na pak tɛɛns wʋsa!

english_verse: Babylon's enemies will rise like ocean waves and flood the city.
translation_verse: Babilon dataas na duoe nwɛnɛ atɛuk ku'om; ka ku'opila la pil o.

english_verse: Horrible destruction will strike the nearby towns. The land will become a barren desert, where no one can live or even travel.
translation_verse: Babilon tempʋʋs la na kpɛlim dabɔɔd, li na anɛ pipiris nɛ titanbin'isi teŋ, teŋ kanɛ ka sɔ' pʋ bɛɛ li ni, ka sɔ' mɛ pʋ dɔl ani gata.

english_verse: I will punish Marduk, the god of Babylon, and make him vomit out everything he gobbled up. Then nations will no longer bring him gifts, and Babylon's walls will crumble. The Lord Offers Hope to His People
translation_verse: M na namis Bel onɛ an Babilon win la, ka kɛ ka o tin on vɔl si'el la lɛbis na. Tɛɛns kʋ lɛn la'asidi kennɛ o san'an ya'asɛ. Babilon zaŋguom la na li.

english_verse: Get out of Babylon, my people, and run for your lives, before I strike the city in my anger!
translation_verse: M nidibaa, zɔm yii Babilon! Zɔm faaɛn ya nyɔvʋr! Zɔm yi Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn linɛ mɔr dabiem la ni.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or lose hope, though year after year there are rumors of leaders fighting for control in the city of Babylon.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ya giinla siɛn bɛɛ dabiem kpɛn' ya ba ya'a ti wʋm labaar teŋin la; labaar yinne na bɛ dʋnna ka yinne mɛ bɛ yʋʋm kanɛ kenna la, li na anɛ zaba labaar ka na'ab na duoe zabid nɛ o na'atiraan.

english_verse: The time will come when I will punish Babylon's false gods. Everyone there will die, and the whole nation will be disgraced,
translation_verse: Sida, saŋa kenna ka m na namis Babilon bada la; teŋ la wʋsa na di nyan ka nimbanɛ kpi la digi li pʋʋgin vɛnrʋ.

english_verse: when an army attacks from the north and brings destruction. Then the earth and the heavens and everything in them will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ani ka agɔla nɛ teŋgbauŋ nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li ni wʋsa na maan sumalisim Babilon yɛla, dataas na yi ya-datiuŋ baba na zab nɛ o san'am o nyain.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Babylon must be overthrown, because it slaughtered the people of Israel and of many other nations.
translation_verse: “Babilon na li Israel nimbanɛ kpi la yɛla, wʋʋ teŋ sieba nidibi kpi si'em Babilon yɛla la.

english_verse: My people, you escaped death when Jerusalem fell. Now you live far from home, but you should trust me and think about Jerusalem. Leave Babylon! Don't stay!
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ pɔns ka pʋ kpi la, yimi ka da giilimi ya! Yanamɛ bɛ teŋ lalli la, tiɛnmi Zugsɔb la yɛla, ka mɛ tɛn'ɛs Jerusalem yɛla.”

english_verse: You feel ashamed and disgraced, because foreigners have entered my sacred temple.
translation_verse: “Ti di nyan, bɔzugɔ ba tʋ' ti ka nyan lusi ti nindaas, bɔzugɔ teŋ zʋŋ nidib kena kpɛn' Zugsɔb Yir Zin'ibanɛ an kasi la.”

english_verse: Soon I will send a war to punish Babylon's idols and leave its wounded people moaning everywhere.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Dabisa kenna, ka m na namis o bada la, teŋ la wʋsa pʋʋgin ka banɛ pu'alim la na ʋʋnsid.

english_verse: Although Babylon's walls reach to the sky, the army I send will destroy that city. I, the Lord, have spoken. Babylon Will Be Destroyed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Hali Babilon ya'a paae saŋgbana la ni, ka maligim mɛɛd o kpi'euŋ zin'ig linɛ wa'am la, La'an nɛ lin wʋsa m na kɛ ka dataas kɛɛn o san'an na san'am o.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Listen to the cries for help coming from Babylon. Everywhere in the country the sounds of destruction can be heard.
translation_verse: “Kaasig yi Babilon kenna, vuud la anɛ san'auŋ tita'ar nɛ kaasig n yit Babilon teŋin na.

translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na san'am Babilon; o na kɛ ka o bas tʋkpiidʋg ka niŋ baanlimm. Dataas la vuudnɛ nwɛnɛ ku'otita'ar ba kʋkɔya la na maligim tansid agɔla gɔla.

english_verse: An enemy will attack and destroy Babylon. Its soldiers will be captured and their weapons broken, because I am a God who takes revenge against nations for what they do.
translation_verse: Dataas na kena zab nɛ Babilon n san'ami li; ba na gban'e zabzabidib la ka kɔɔ ba tiraad. Zugsɔb la an onɛ yɔɔd sam la zug, o na yɔ ka li paae li bɛn.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the true King, promise that the officials and advisors, the governors and leaders, and the soldiers of Babylon will get drunk, fall asleep, and never wake up.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka Babilon kpɛɛmnam la nɛ ba ya'am dim nɛ gɔmenanam nɛ ba tuongatib la kʋʋl; ba na gbis ka kʋ lɛn duoe.” Na'ab onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl.

english_verse: The thick walls of that city will be torn down, and its huge gates burned. Everything that nation worked so hard to gain will go up in smoke. Jeremiah Gives Seraiah a Scroll
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, Babilon dim zaŋguom tita'ar la na digin teŋin ka bugum dii o za'anɔya banɛ wa'am la. Nidib la na gɛn zaalim; linɛ ka tɛɛns la tʋm gɛn la, bugum na dii li wʋsa.

english_verse: Zedekiah's sons and the officials of Judah were killed while he watched,
translation_verse: Dibila teŋin ka Babilon na'ab la da kʋ Zedekaya biis o nini ni, ka kʋ Juda kpɛɛmnam.

english_verse: Jerusalem was captured during Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king of Babylonia. About a month later, Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guards arrived in Jerusalem. His name was Nebuzaradan,
translation_verse: Nebukadnɛza onɛ an Babilon Na'ab la da di na'am la yʋma pii nɛ awai saŋa nwadig kanɛ paas anu la o dabpiiga daar la, Nebuzaradan onɛ an soogianam kpɛɛm ka an na'ayikpɛɛm Babilon na'ayin la da kɛn Jerusalem na.

english_verse: and he burned down the Lord's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses.
translation_verse: O da nyu'oe Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la nɛ bugum, nɛ na'ayir la, nɛ Jerusalem ya' la wʋsa. Mɛɛb banɛ an mɛsʋma la wʋsa o da nyu'oe li nɛ.

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: O soogianam la da la'asi da'ae Jerusalem zaŋguoma la wʋsa bas.

english_verse: He led away the people left in the city, including everyone who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar, the rest of the skilled workers, and even some of the poor people of Judah.
translation_verse: Nebuzaradan onɛ an soogianam tuongat la da zi nimbanɛ kpɛlim tempʋʋgin la ka mi' tʋʋma sʋ'ʋŋa la mɔri ba keŋ kpɛn'ɛs sankpan'asim, la'an nɛ teŋkpɛmisin nidib la wʋsa, nɛ banɛ pʋn dɛŋi keŋ Babilon Na'ab san'an la wʋsa.

english_verse: Only the very poorest were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.
translation_verse: Amaa Nebuzaradan da bas banɛ an nɔŋ dim amɛŋa la ka ba kpɛlim teŋin tʋm vain tiis pɔɔd nɛ pɔɔdin la.

english_verse: from Jerusalem. In his twenty-third year as king, his officer Nebuzaradan took
translation_verse: ) ka o da gban'e Jerusalem.

translation_verse: ). Ba bas na'ab Jehoyakin la yɛla

english_verse: Evil Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: O da pian' sʋ'ʋŋa tis o, ka tis o na'asi zin'ig hali ka li gaad na'anam banɛ kpɛlim ka on nɛ ban ɛɛnti la'am bɛ Babilon la.

english_verse: Jehoiachin was allowed to wear regular clothes instead of a prison uniform, and he even ate at the king's table every day.
translation_verse: Jehoyakin da yɛɛs o sanrega fuud la digil. Ka on nɛ Na'ab la la'am dit hali ti paae o nyɔvʋr bɛn.

english_verse: As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Dabisir wʋsa pʋʋgin Na'ab la da tisid Jehoyakin diib ligidi hali ti paae o vʋm bɛn.

english_verse: Jerusalem, once so crowded, lies deserted and lonely. This city that was known all over the world is now like a widow. This queen of the nations has been made a slave.
translation_verse: Jerusalem kanɛ ka nidib da pɛ'ɛl la yʋ'ʋn kpɛlimnɛ nɛɛm. Onɛ ka dunia wʋsa da tisid na'asi la yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ pʋkɔɔnr nɛ. Tempʋkanɛ da sʋ'oe sʋ'ʋlim bɛdegʋ la yʋ'ʋn lieb yammis teŋ.

english_verse: Each night, bitter tears flood her cheeks. None of her former lovers are there to offer comfort; her friends have betrayed her and are now her enemies.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa ka o kaasid ka o ninta'am yuod bɔr-bɔr. Banɛ da nɔŋ o la wʋsa sʋʋgin sɔ' kae na lɛn bɛlis o ka kpɛ'ɛŋ o sʋnfɔ. O kpi'es la wʋsa gbi'id o nɛ ka yit o nya'aŋ ka lieb o dataas.

english_verse: The people of Judah are slaves, suffering in a foreign land, with no rest from sorrow. Their enemies captured them and were terribly cruel.
translation_verse: Juda nidib anɛ yammis ka pʋ mɔr sʋŋirɛ ba kadi ba yisi ba yaan nɛ ba mɛŋ teŋin. Ban bɛ teŋ si'a la ba kʋ nyaŋi yɛl ye ba mɛŋ teŋa, ka ba dataas giligi ba zin'ig wʋsa ka ba kʋ nyaŋi yii.

english_verse: The roads to Zion mourn because no one travels there to celebrate the festivals. The city gates are deserted; priests are weeping. Young women are raped; Zion is in sorrow!
translation_verse: Sɔ' pʋ lɛn ken Pʋ'ʋsim Yin laa, ba pʋ kenna ye ba pʋ'ʋs ka di'em malima saŋaa. Pu'asada banɛ daa yʋ'ʋm la namisidnɛ ka maanmaannib la nyɔn nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ. Tempʋʋg la za'anɔya anɛ zaalim ka Zion namisʋg la san'ami ba sʋnya.

english_verse: Enemies now rule the city and live as they please. The Lord has punished Jerusalem because of her awful sins; he has let her people be dragged away.
translation_verse: Ba dataas zabi nyaŋi ba ka sʋ'oe ba ka mɔri ba nɛ kpi'euŋ. Zugsɔb la kɛnɛ ka ba namis ka li yinɛ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin na. Ba biis la bɛ nɛ teŋ zʋŋ, ba gban'e ba wʋsa mɔri keŋ.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared. Her leaders are like deer that cannot find pasture; they are hunted down till their strength is gone.
translation_verse: Jerusalem vɛnlim la wʋsa lɛn kae. Li wʋmi ba tuongatib la hali ka ba nwɛnɛ walis ka kɔ'ɔm mɔri ba ka ba gin ka pʋ nyɛ diibɔ. Tɔn'ɔsnam la kati ba ka ba zɔ ka paŋ wʋsa naae.

english_verse: Her people recall the good life that once was theirs; now they suffer and are scattered. No one was there to protect them from their enemies who sneered when their city was taken.
translation_verse: Jerusalem yʋ'ʋn kpɛlimnɛ dabɔɔd ka tɛn'ɛsid o kpan'am da an si'em la yɛla. Teŋ la da luu o dataas nu'usin la, sɔ' da kae na nyaŋi sʋŋ o ka o dataas la yʋ'ʋn gɔsid o ka la'ad o, o liig la yɛla.

english_verse: Jerusalem's horrible sins have made the city a joke. Those who once admired her now hate her instead— she has been disgraced; she groans and turns away.
translation_verse: Jerusalem tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bɛdegʋ dinzug ka o lɛn ka' nyain nɛ. Banɛ da na'asid o la wʋsa yʋ'ʋn gɔsid o nɛ yɔri, bɔzugɔ ba nyɛɛ o gbin. O mɛŋ ʋʋnsidnɛ ka fɛndigi lɛb nya'aŋ sa.

english_verse: Her sins had made her filthy, but she wasn't worried about what could happen. And when Jerusalem fell, it was so tragic. No one gave her comfort when she cried out, “Help! I'm in trouble, Lord! The enemy has won.”
translation_verse: O tʋʋmfɛn'ɛsa la da nienɛ paalʋ nyain, amaa ka o ba'a kae nɛ on na ba'as si'em. On da san'am si'em la da anɛ yɛlpakir, ka sɔ' mɛ lɛn kae bɛlisid oo. “O m Zugsɔba, gɔsimi m namisʋg la; m dataas la nyaŋim nɛ!”

english_verse: Zion's treasures were stolen. Jerusalem saw foreigners enter her place of worship, though the Lord had forbidden them to belong to his people.
translation_verse: O dataas la faaɛn o la'asʋma la wʋsa; O nyɛ tembanɛ an ba'amaannib la kpɛn'ɛd o Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, banɛ ka fʋ kisigi ba ye ba da kpɛn' fʋ nidib la'asʋg zin'igin la.

english_verse: Everyone in the city groans while searching for food; they trade their valuables for barely enough scraps to stay alive. Jerusalem Speaks: Jerusalem shouts to the Lord, “Please look and see how miserable I am!”
translation_verse: Nidib la fabinnɛ ieed ban na paam si'eli di, ka nɔki ba areza'asi tiak diib ye ba dit ka vʋe. Tempʋʋg la dim kaasid ye “Ti zugsɔba! Gɔsim ban ziemi ti si'em!”

english_verse: No passerby even cares. Why doesn't someone notice my terrible sufferings? You were fiercely angry, Lord, and you punished me worst of all.
translation_verse: “Li na pʋ pak yanam banɛ gat la? Gɔsim giligi ka ya na nyɛ. Sɔ' lɛm bɛɛ nyɛt tɔɔg wʋʋ namisʋg kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la mɔri kɛɛn m zugin na o sʋnpɛɛn dabisir la?”

english_verse: From heaven you sent a fire that burned in my bones; you set a trap for my feet and made me turn back. All day long you leave me in shock from constant pain.
translation_verse: O kɛnɛ ka bugum yii agɔl na dit mam kɔnba. O bɛndim nɛ baŋi gban'e m ka vɛ'ɛgimi lɛbis na. O basim nɛ tɔɔg pʋʋgin ka m namisʋg la pʋ naada.

english_verse: You have tied my sins around my neck, and they weigh so heavily that my strength is gone. You have put me in the power of enemies too strong for me.
translation_verse: O vɛɛnsi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa ka lɔɔ ba la'as taaba ka nɔki ba kɔlli m niŋgɔɔnrin ka li tɛbisim la kɛ ka m gɛn. Zugsɔb la nɔkimi tisim dataas ka m kʋ nyaŋi zab nɛ ba.

english_verse: You, Lord, have turned back my warriors and crushed my young heroes. Judah was a woman untouched, but you let her be trampled like grapes in a wine pit.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zan'as zabzabidib banɛ bɛɛ m san'an la o la'as soogianam ye ba zab nɛ m ka kʋʋ m dasam la wʋsa. Zugsɔb la nɔɔ m nidib la bugusi bugus, wʋʋ ban nɔɔd daam tiwala nwi'asid si'em la.

english_verse: Because of this, I mourn, and tears flood my eyes. No one is here to comfort or to encourage me; we have lost the war— my people are suffering. The Prophet Speaks:
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa kɛ ka m kum ka m nini wʋsa an ninta'am, ka sɔ' kae na bɛlisim bɛɛ kpɛmisi ma, M nidib la wʋsa ka'asigɛ ka li anɛ m dataas la zabi nyaŋim la zug.

english_verse: Zion reaches out her hands, but no one offers comfort. The Lord has turned the neighboring nations against Jacob's descendants. Jerusalem is merely a filthy rag to her neighbors. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Teŋ la nwɛnɛ pu'a na tiɛnd o nu'ug amaa sɔ' kae na bɛlis o, ka o yɛt ye “Zugsɔb la zi'el nɔɔri tis Jakob ye o kpi'es na lieb o dataas; Jerusalem yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ dian'ad sɔb nɛ ba sʋʋgin.”

english_verse: The Lord was right, but I refused to obey him. Now I ask all of you to look at my sufferings— even my young people have been dragged away.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la anɛ pʋpielim sɔb amaa ka man lɛɛ ki'is o zi'elʋg. Sɔ' wʋsa kɛlisim! Gɔsimini m tɔɔg nɛ m namisʋg la an si'em! Ba gban'e m na'akim nɛ m pu'asada la ka ba wʋsa lieb yammisi bɛ teŋ zʋŋ.

english_verse: I called out to my lovers, but they betrayed me. My priests and my leaders died while searching the city for scraps of food.
translation_verse: M daa buoli m zuanam ye ba kena sʋŋim, amaa ka ba pan'asim ka zan'as. M maanmaannib nɛ m kpɛɛmnam la dɔl suoraadi giligidi ieed diib tempʋʋgin la ye ba di ka vʋe amaa ka pʋ nyɛɛ ka vibi kpi kɔ'ɔm.

english_verse: Won't you look and see how upset I am, our Lord? My stomach is in knots, and my heart is broken because I betrayed you. In the streets and at home, my people are slaughtered.
translation_verse: M Zugsɔba, gɔsimi m sʋʋnri san'am yɔri-yɔri si'em! M pʋʋg lɛɛrim nɛ, ka m sʋnf san'am ka tɔɔg mɔrim hali ka li anɛ m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ m tʋbzian'asim la yɛla. Ninkʋʋdibi bɛ suoya la ni, ka kum bɛ za'asin nɛ dɔɔdin wʋsa.

english_verse: Everyone heard my groaning, but no one offered comfort. My enemies know of the trouble that you have brought on me, and it makes them glad. Hurry and punish them, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Nidib wʋmi m kaasig, amaa sɔ' kae na bɛlisi ma. M dataas la wʋsa wʋmi m sʋnsa'aŋ la yɛla; ba maannɛ sumalisim fʋn kɛ ka tɔɔg paam la zug. Kɛl ka namisʋg dabiskanɛ ka fʋ da kaanbi zi'el la lii ba zugin ala ka ba mɛ na nwɛnɛ mam nɛ.

english_verse: Don't let their evil deeds escape your sight. Punish them as much as you have punished me because of my sins. I never stop groaning— I've lost all hope!
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, namisimi ba, ba bugusim la zug. Tɛɛgimi ba tʋbir wʋʋ fʋn tɛɛg mam tʋbir si'em m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug la. M sʋnsa'aŋ la zu'oe nɛ hali ka m bɛn'ɛd susʋnya ban'as.

english_verse: The Lord was angry! So he disgraced Zion though it was Israel's pride and his own place of rest. In his anger he threw Zion down from heaven to earth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋnf duonɛ hali ka o kɛ ka Zion wʋsa an lik. O nɔk Israel vɛnlim la wʋsa bas ka li naan arezana nii li teŋin. O pʋ lɛn tɛnr o Pʋ'ʋsim yir linɛ aan o nɔba zi'elʋg zin'ig la o sʋnpɛɛn la daarɛ.

english_verse: The Lord had no mercy! He destroyed the homes of Jacob's descendants. In his anger he tore down every walled city in Judah; he toppled the nation together with its leaders, leaving them in shame.
translation_verse: O san'am Juda sʋ'ʋlim teŋkpɛmis la wʋsa ka pʋ zɔ nimbaanliga. O san'am zaŋguoma banɛ gu'ud teŋ la nɛ Zion tempʋʋg kpi'euŋ zin'is wʋsa. O kɛ ka nyan kpɛn' teŋ la hali ka tuongatib la wʋsa lɛn ka' na'asi.

english_verse: The Lord was so furiously angry that he wiped out the whole army of Israel by not supporting them when the enemy attacked. He was like a raging fire that swallowed up the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: O sʋʋnr duoe nɛ Israel dim la hali ka o kɛnsi ba giinla. Ba dataasi da li'en na la, ka o lɛb nya'aŋ ka zan'as ye o kʋ sʋŋi baa. O sʋʋnr pɛlig nɛ Jakob wʋʋ bugum diti san'amid la'ad si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord was like an enemy! He left Israel in ruins with its palaces and fortresses destroyed, and with everyone in Judah moaning and weeping.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb san'am Israel wʋʋ o dataa nɛ, ka kɛ ka na'ayir la wʋsa lieb dabɔɔd ka san'ami ba kpi'euŋ zin'is la. O tis Juda dim sʋnsa'aŋ bɛdegʋ ka ba kum ka fabin.

english_verse: He shattered his temple like a hut in a garden; he completely wiped out his meeting place, and did away with festivals and Sabbaths in the city of Zion. In his fierce anger he rejected our king and priests.
translation_verse: O da nwa'ae o Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la bas ka san'ami ba la'asʋg zin'ig la bugusi bugus. Zugsɔb la kɛya ka ba tami ba malima nɛ ba Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisa; o sʋnpɛɛn la taas na'anam nɛ maanmaannib la, ka o zan'asi ba wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord abandoned his altar and his temple; he let Zion's enemies capture her fortresses. Noisy shouts were heard from the temple, as if it were a time of celebration.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb bas o mɛŋ maan daka la nɛ, nɛ o Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la. O zaŋi li tis dataas la ka ba faaɛn na'ayir la nɛ ba ya-vɛnla la. Ba maan tʋkpiidʋg Zugsɔb Yir la pʋʋgin nwɛnɛ malʋŋ dabisa ka ba maan si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord had decided to tear down the walls of Zion stone by stone. So he started destroying and did not stop until walls and fortresses mourned and trembled.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la gban'e ye o nwa'ae o na'am zaŋguoma banɛ gilig Zion la. O nɔk linɛ makid la maki li ka pʋ basi li san'auŋɔ. O kɛ ka zaŋguoma wʋsa kaasid; ka kɛ ka ba san'ami li wʋsa.

english_verse: Zion's gates have fallen facedown on the ground; the bars that locked the gates are smashed to pieces. Her king and royal family are prisoners in foreign lands. Her priests don't teach, and her prophets don't have a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Za'anɔya la wʋsa vɔnrigi sig teŋin ka li kʋlis nɛ kʋntnam wʋsa kɔ' gima-gima. Ba na'anam nɛ burikinnam wʋsa lieb yammis. Wada la lɛn kae baa bi'elaa, ka nɔdi'esidib la mɛ pʋ lɛn wʋm si'el bɛɛ nyɛt si'el ka li yit Zugsɔb san'an na ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Zion's leaders are silent. They just sit on the ground, tossing dirt on their heads and wearing sackcloth. Her young women can do nothing but stare at the ground.
translation_verse: Jerusalem bʋnkʋd la yʋ'ʋn zin'inɛ teŋin ka fɔn ki' an baanlimm. Ba wʋsa bugi ba zut nɛ titan ka yɛ bɔto fuudi pa'annɛ ba sʋnsa'aŋ. Pu'asada banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la wʋsa nyan mɔri ba nɛ ka ba nɔki ba zuti ba' teŋin.

english_verse: My eyes are red from crying, my stomach is in knots, and I feel sick all over. My people are being wiped out, and children lie helpless in the streets of the city.
translation_verse: M kaas nɛ hali ka m nini pʋ lɛn nyɛta ka m zi' man bɛ si'ela. M sʋnf san'amnɛ m nidib la san'auŋ yɛla li wʋmim nɛ ka m lɛn ka' paŋa. Biis nɛ bilies la nwi'e tempʋʋg la suoya ni.

english_verse: A child begs its mother for food and drink, then blacks out like a wounded soldier lying in the street. The child slowly dies in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Ba kaasidnɛ tisidi ba manamɛ bɔɔd diib nɛ bʋnnuuda. Ba lu tempʋʋg la suoya ni nwi'e wʋʋ ba pu'alimi ba nɛ. Ka tita'am kpii ba manam la nu'usin.

english_verse: Zion, how can I comfort you? How great is your pain? Lovely city of Jerusalem, how can I heal your wounds, gaping as wide as the sea?
translation_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem kanɛ ka m nɔŋa, m ye m yɛl ye bɔ? M ye m nɔk bɔɔ maki fɔ? Bɛɛ m na yɛli fʋ yɛla ye bɔ? Namiskan ka fʋ namis la sɔ' nan namis namiskan buudii? Fʋ namisʋg la zu'onɛ wʋʋ atɛuk nɛ ka onɛ na bɛlisif lɛn kae.

english_verse: Your prophets deceived you with false visions and lying messages— they should have warned you to leave your sins and be saved from disaster.
translation_verse: Nɔdi'esidib la da pʋ pian'ad sida tisidi fɔ asɛɛ faad nɛ dama'am ma'aa. Ba da pʋ mɔɔli nie ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi an si'em, ka ya gu'us ka ba da gban'e ya keŋ teŋ zʋŋɔ. Ban yɛti ya si'el wʋsa la anɛ dama'am ma'aa ka kpɛn'ɛsidi ya mɔɔg.

english_verse: Those who pass by shake their heads and sneer as they make fun and shout, “What a lovely city you were, the happiest on earth, but look at you now!”
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ gat tempʋʋgin la wʋsa la'adi ya nɛ, ka nwɛ'ɛdi ba nu'us ka lɔbid zut ka la'ad Jerusalem san'auŋ la yɛla. Ba bu'osid taaba ye, “Tempʋmalisiŋ la nwana? Zin'ikanɛ an Dunia wʋsa malisim zin'ig la nwana?”

english_verse: Zion, your enemies curse you and snarl like wild animals, while shouting, “This is the day we've waited for! At last, we've got you!”
translation_verse: Ya dataas la wʋsa lɔbidi ya nɛ nɔya ba wʋsa kpɛn'ɛsidi ya nɛ ɛndʋg ka ga'ad nyina. Ba yɛt ye, “Ehɛɛn! Ti san'ami ba! Dabiskanɛ ka ti daa gu'usid la paae ya ka ti nini nyɛ li!”

english_verse: Zion, deep in your heart you cried out to the Lord. Now let your tears overflow your walls day and night. Don't ever lose hope or let your tears stop.
translation_verse: O Jerusalem, kɛlli ka ya zaŋguoma la kaas ka li wʋsa nwɛ' kuŋi tis Zugsɔb la. Kɛlli ka ya ninta'am yit wʋʋ ku'om bun nɛ ka pʋbid yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ. Kaasimi ka kɛ ka ya sʋnya san'am. Da vʋ'ʋs bɛɛ bas kaasig baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: Get up and pray for help all through the night. Pour out your feelings to the Lord, as you would pour water out of a jug. Beg him to save your people, who are starving to death at every street crossing. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa duom ka kaasi tis Zugsɔb la, kaasim zaamnɔɔr hali ti paae yʋ'ʋŋ tisʋʋs. Nɔkimi ya sʋnya kpa'ae wʋʋ ku'om nɛ sɔsid Zugsɔb la. Ʋkimini ya nu'us agɔl ka sɔs o ka o zɔɔ ya biis la nimbaanlig; bibanɛ ka kɔ'ɔm kʋʋd suoya wʋsa ni la.

english_verse: Think about it, Lord! Have you ever been this cruel to anyone before? Is it right for mothers to eat their children, or for priests and prophets to be killed in your temple?
translation_verse: Wala ka fʋ namisidi ba ala, Zugsɔba? Sɔ' kae nam mi' nyɛ namisʋg ka li nwɛnɛ nɛ'ɛɛ. Gɔsima! Li nar ye pu'ab ɔnbi ba biisɛ? Bibanɛ ka ba mɛŋ du'a ka gɔsi ba la? Ka li nar ye ba kʋʋdi fʋ maanmaannib nɛ nɔdi'esidib banɛ tʋmmi fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la?

english_verse: My people, both young and old, lie dead in the streets. Because you were angry, my young men and women were brutally slaughtered.
translation_verse: Ba biis nɛ ba kpɛɛmnam la'am kpii dig teŋin suoya la ni. Dataas la kʋʋ ba dasam nɛ pu'asada la; ba kʋʋ ba wʋsa tanpin. Fʋ sʋʋnri duoe la zug ka fʋ kɛ ka ba kpi ka pʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanliga.

english_verse: When you were angry, Lord, you invited my enemies like guests for a party. No one survived that day; enemies killed my children, my own little ones.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋn la'asid nidib ye ba di ka maal sumalisim si'em la, ala ka fʋ kɛ ka dataas kpɛn'ɛsidim dabiem zin'ig wʋsa. Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn daar la sɔ' kae na nyaŋi zɔɔ pɔns bɛɛ tiligɛ. Bi'emnam la kena kʋʋ m biis banɛ ka m gʋ'ʋl ka nɔŋ la.

english_verse: He chased me into a dark place, where no light could enter.
translation_verse: O mɔrimi keŋ kpɛn'ɛs zin'ikanɛ an lik ka nɛɛsim kae.

english_verse: I am the only one he punishes over and over again, without ever stopping.
translation_verse: Ka bʋ'ʋm hali sʋ'ʋŋa pɛndigi pɛndig ka pʋ basida.

english_verse: God caused my skin and flesh to waste away, and he crushed my bones.
translation_verse: O basi m niŋgbiŋ la ka li kʋdig, ka kɔɔ m kɔnba.

english_verse: He attacked and surrounded me with hardships and trouble;
translation_verse: O da yɔɔm nɛ sanrega ni ka kɛ ka namisʋg nɛ tɔɔg giligim.

english_verse: he forced me to sit in the dark like someone long dead.
translation_verse: O kɛ ka m bɛ likin ka nwɛnɛ banɛ kpii dig yaʋgʋn nɛ.

english_verse: God built a fence around me that I cannot climb over, and he chained me down.
translation_verse: O lɔɔm nu'us nɛ baans ka m ka' yiib ti'irɛ.

english_verse: Even when I shouted and prayed for help, he refused to listen.
translation_verse: M kaas kuŋ ka tansi bɔɔd sʋŋir, ka Wina'am zan'as ye o kʋ wʋmi m sɔsʋgɔ.

english_verse: God put big rocks in my way and made me follow a crooked path.
translation_verse: M ya'a ye m keŋ wʋsa o mɛɛd kuga guoma gu'udim.

english_verse: God was like a bear or a lion waiting in ambush for me;
translation_verse: O nwɛnɛ wɛbaa su'a gu'udim ka nwɛnɛ gbigim kanɛ su'a digi pigidim.

english_verse: he dragged me from the road, then tore me to shreds.
translation_verse: O vuugimi yi suor la zug na tɔɔnsi tɔɔnsim ka basim, ka sʋŋir kae.

english_verse: I am a joke to everyone— no one ever stops making fun of me.
translation_verse: Nidib la'adim daar wʋsa, ka mɔrimi di'em, ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma nɛ'ɛsidim.

english_verse: God has turned my life sour.
translation_verse: Namisʋgʋ liebi m diib nɛ m ku'om li tɔɔg nwɛnɛ yabid nɛ.

english_verse: He made me eat gravel and rubbed me in the dirt.
translation_verse: O nɔk zigi nɛ kuga kɔɔ m nyina; ka nɔɔmi digil titanin.

english_verse: I tell myself, “I am finished! I can't count on the Lord to do anything for me.”
translation_verse: Ala ka m yɛl ye, “Man vɛnlim naae ya, ka m ti'ir linɛ ka m mɔr Zugsɔb san'an la gaad.”

english_verse: Just thinking of my troubles and my lonely wandering makes me miserable.
translation_verse: M ya'a tɛn'ɛsi m namisʋg nɛ man giilim si'em la yɛla li anɛ tɔɔg wʋʋ yabid nɛ tisim.

english_verse: That's all I ever think about, and I am depressed.
translation_verse: M tɛn'ɛsidi li yɛla hali ka m sʋʋnr san'ami li zug.

english_verse: Then I remember something that fills me with hope.
translation_verse: Amaa m tɛn'ɛs yɛl yinne ka linzug ka m mɔr ti'ir ya'as:

english_verse: The Lord's kindness never fails! If he had not been merciful, we would have been destroyed.
translation_verse: ye, Zugsɔb nɔŋilim nɛ o nimbaanlzɔɔr linɛ ka' bɛn la, kɛ ka ti nan kpɛm bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord can always be trusted to show mercy each morning.
translation_verse: Bɛogʋn wʋsa o nɔŋilim la anɛ bʋmpaal; ka o yɛlsida zu'oe hali.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I say, “The Lord is all I need; I can depend on him!”
translation_verse: M yɛli m sʋʋnrin ye, “Zugsɔb la aan m mɔrim nɛ m faar, ka m nɔki m ti'ir wʋsa niŋ o ni.”

english_verse: The Lord is kind to everyone who trusts and obeys him.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la an sʋ'ʋm tis banɛ ti'iri bɛɛ o ni nɛ banɛ ieed o nɛ ba sʋʋnr wʋsa la.

english_verse: It is good to wait patiently for the Lord to save us.
translation_verse: Li an sʋ'ʋm nɛ nidi na ma'ae o mɛŋ baanlimm gur Zugsɔb la faangir la.

english_verse: When we are young, it is good to struggle hard
translation_verse: Li nar ye o mɔr suguru kaŋa mɔdig tʋʋm kpi'ema ni saŋkan ka o nam bɛɛ o dasannimin la.

english_verse: and to sit silently alone, if this is what the Lord intends.
translation_verse: O ya'a namisid, on zin'inim baanlimm nɛ suguru ka li anɛ Zugsɔb la kɛ ka li paae o.

english_verse: Being rubbed in the dirt can teach us a lesson;
translation_verse: O siem o mɛŋi digin teŋin ka daasi'erɛ ti'ir na bɛɛ tis o.

english_verse: we can also learn from insults and hard knocks.
translation_verse: Baa li ya'a anɛ tʋ'ʋd nɛ bʋ'ʋd wʋsa on siakimi li ka bɛ baanlimm.

english_verse: The Lord won't always reject us!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zɔt nimbaanlig ka kʋ bas ninsaal nyainnɛ.

english_verse: He causes a lot of suffering, but he also has pity because of his great love.
translation_verse: O na mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ na amaa o na pa'al o nimbaanlzɔɔr o nɔŋilim linɛ ka' naar la zug.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't enjoy sending grief or pain.
translation_verse: Li ka' o bɔɔdim ka o namisid nidiba; ba sʋʋnr ya'a san'am li pʋ malis oo.

english_verse: Don't trample prisoners under your feet
translation_verse: Ba mugus banɛ bɛ sanrega ni ka namisi ba hali.

english_verse: or cheat anyone out of what is rightfully theirs. God Most High sees everything,
translation_verse: Ba mɔŋ nidib bʋʋd Zugsɔb Onɛ Gaad Si'el Wʋsa la tuon,

english_verse: and he knows when you refuse to give someone a fair trial.
translation_verse: ka kɛ ka sida kae sariakadib zin'iginɛ; Zugsɔb la nyɛt ka mi' linɛ tʋm wʋsa.

english_verse: Good and bad each happen at the command of God Most High.
translation_verse: Li ka'anɛ Zugsɔb Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la san'an ka bʋnsʋŋ nɛ bʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa yitnaa?

english_verse: We're still alive! We shouldn't complain when we are being punished for our sins.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ maal ka ninsaal ya'a tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka tɔɔg paae o ka o fabin ka nyɔnnɛ li yɛla?

english_verse: Instead, we should think about the way we are living, and turn back to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ti vɛɛnsi ti suoya gɔs ka fɛndigi lɛb Zugsɔb san'an.

english_verse: When we lift our hands in prayer to God in heaven, we should offer him our hearts and say,
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ti yɔ'ɔgi ti sʋnya tis Wina'am onɛ bɛ Arezana la ka ʋki ti nu'usi pʋ'ʋs o, ka yɛl o ye,

english_verse: “We've sinned! We've rebelled against you, and you haven't forgiven us!
translation_verse: “Ti tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka zan'asi fʋ nɔɔr, ka fʋn Zugsɔb la nam pʋ kɛɛ ti taali basɛ.

english_verse: Anger is written all over you, as you pursue and slaughter us without showing pity.
translation_verse: Fʋ pili fʋ mɛŋ nɛ sʋnpɛɛn wʋʋ fuugnɛ kati ti ka kʋʋdi ti ka pʋ zɔt nimbaanliga.

english_verse: You are behind a wall of clouds that blocks out our prayers.
translation_verse: Fʋ pili fʋ mɛŋ nɛ saŋgbana ka li kɛ ka ti sɔsʋg pʋ paadi fɔ.

english_verse: You allowed nations to treat us like garbage;
translation_verse: Fʋ kɛya ka ti nwɛnɛ tampʋʋr ka nwɛnɛ sa'adi tis dunia nidib wʋsa.

english_verse: We are terrified and trapped, caught and crushed.”
translation_verse: Ti nyɛt tɔɔg nɛ dabiem nɛ vɔlisʋg ka dit namisʋg nɛ fara bɛdegʋ.”

english_verse: My people are destroyed! Tears flood my eyes,
translation_verse: M nini wʋsa anɛ ninta'am ka li anɛ m nidib la paam san'auŋ la zug.

english_verse: until the Lord looks down from heaven and helps.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka Zugsɔb naam arezana ni sʋ'ʋnnɛ gɔs na ka nyɛɛti.

english_verse: I am horrified when I see what enemies have done to the young women of our city.
translation_verse: M ya'a nyɛ ban maan pu'abi m tempʋʋgin la si'em la kɛnɛ ka m sʋʋnr san'amid.

english_verse: No one had reason to hate me, but I was hunted down like a bird.
translation_verse: M dataas gban'am nɛ baŋ wʋʋ niiŋ nɛ ka m pʋ maali ba si'el si'ela.

english_verse: Then they tried to kill me by tossing me into a pit and throwing stones at me.
translation_verse: Ba nɔkim nɛ bas bʋmbɔk zulʋŋin ka nɔk kuga lɔbid ye ba kʋʋm.

english_verse: Water covered my head— I thought I was gone.
translation_verse: Ku'om la limi m zug ka m tɛn'ɛs ye m kum paae.

english_verse: From the bottom of the pit, I prayed to you, Lord.
translation_verse: M Zugsɔba, m daa bɛnɛ bʋmbɔk la pʋʋgin ka nwɛ' kuŋi buoli fʋ yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: I begged you to listen. “Help!” I shouted. “Save me!” You answered my prayer
translation_verse: Fʋ wʋmmi m sɔsʋg, “Da li' fʋ tʋba nɛ man fabinnɛ tisidif ye fʋ tisim yɔlisim la!”

english_verse: and came when I was in need. You told me, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Man buolif la fʋ li'eli m san'an na ka yɛlim ye, “Da zɔt dabiem!”

english_verse: You rescued me and saved my life.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ kena sʋŋim ka faanm ka kɛ ka m nan vʋe.

english_verse: You saw them abuse me, Lord, so make things right.
translation_verse: Fʋ nyɛ ban kisim ka mɔŋi m bʋʋd si'em. Kadim saria ka tisim bʋʋd.

english_verse: You know every plot they have made against me.
translation_verse: Fʋ nyɛ ban yɛt ye ba na yɔ sam ka namisim si'em; ba gban'ad gban'abɛ'ɛd m yɛla.

english_verse: Yes, you know their insults and their evil plans.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋ wʋm ban tʋ'ʋdim si'em ka gban'ad bɛ'ɛd ye ba mugusim.

english_verse: All day long they attack with words and whispers.
translation_verse: Daar wʋsa ba pian'ad nɛ mam yɛla ka su'adi gban'ad pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛdi m yɛla.

english_verse: No matter what they are doing, they keep on mocking me.
translation_verse: Lin yi bɛogʋn keŋ paae zaam man ka ba la'ad, hali ba yʋ'ʋmmi ziemid man.

english_verse: Put your curse on them and make them suffer.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba tʋba ziank, ka kɛ ka fʋ nɔpɔɔr dɔlli ba.

english_verse: Get angry and go after them until not a trace is left under the heavens.
translation_verse: Kadimi ba yis nɛ sʋnpɛɛn yisimi ba dunia kanɛ ka Zugsɔb maal la ni.

english_verse: The purest gold is ruined and has lost its shine; jewels from the temple lie scattered in the streets.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, ti sanlim banɛ daa nyɛɛn la vɛnlim san'am ya! Ba nɔk Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kugvɛnla la wʋsa widigi bas suoya ni.

english_verse: These are Zion's people, worth more than purest gold; yet they are counted worthless like dishes of clay.
translation_verse: Zion dasam banɛ da nwɛnɛ sanlima ligidkpi'ema la, nannanna ba maannɛ ba wʋʋ tan dʋgid ka banɛ ya'abid maal.

english_verse: Even jackals nurse their young, but my people are like ostriches that abandon their own.
translation_verse: Hali wɛbaas mu'asidi ba biis bin'isim amaa mam nidib la anɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam hali, ba nwɛnɛ sian'arin niiŋ titada banɛ pʋ kɛlisidi ba biis kaasiga.

english_verse: Babies are so thirsty that their tongues are stuck to the roof of the mouth. Children go begging for food, but no one gives them any.
translation_verse: Ku'onuudi mɔr bilies la zug ka ba zilima tabinɛ ba nɔnya ni; biis la sɔsid diib, amaa sɔ' pʋ tisi ba diibɔ.

english_verse: All who ate expensive foods lie starving in the streets; those who grew up in luxury now sit on trash heaps.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ daa dit disʋma la yʋ'ʋn gɔɔnd pala ni ka kpiid kɔ'ɔm. Banɛ daa dit na'am ka yɛɛd fuvɛnla la yʋ'ʋn bɛ nɛ tampʋya ni pi'isid diib.

english_verse: My nation was punished worse than the people of Sodom, whose city was destroyed in a flash without the help of human hands.
translation_verse: M nidib la nyɛ mugusʋg si'em la gaad Sodom dimi da namis si'em la, la'an nɛ Wina'am da gbirigi san'ami ba la sɔ' da pʋ siak ye o sʋŋi ba.

english_verse: The leaders of Jerusalem were purer than snow and whiter than milk; their bodies were healthy and glowed like jewels.
translation_verse: Ti na'abiis la daa pɛligi gaad sakuga ka pɛligi gaad bin'isim, ba niŋgbina anɛ nyain ka vɛnli nwɛnɛ kugbanɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Safira la.

english_verse: Now they are blacker than tar, and no one recognizes them; their skin clings to their bones and is drier than firewood.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna ba sɔbigi gaad vugulim ka sɔ' kʋ lɛm baŋi ba nindaa. Ba waŋim nɛ kpɛlim kɔnba ma'aa, ka kʋdigi nwɛnɛ dakpi'emis nɛ.

english_verse: Being killed with a sword is better than slowly starving to death.
translation_verse: Banɛ da kpi zabbɔn'ɔgin la sɔn'oe banɛ ka kɔ'ɔm kʋʋ ba la; ba namis nɛ kɔ'ɔm hali diibi kae pɔɔdin la zug.

english_verse: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ ka man nidib la daa bɛ mugusʋgin la, pu'a banɛ zɔt nimbaanlig daa dʋgidi ba mɛŋ-mɛŋ biis ka li liebi ba diib.

english_verse: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋnfʋ pɛlig la o pʋ gu'us baa bi'elaa, ka nyu'oe Zion tempʋʋg nɛ bugum ka li di nɛ li ɛɛnbir la wʋsa.

english_verse: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋ la na'anam pʋ niŋ labaar la yadda. Hali dunia nidib la wʋsa sɔ' pʋ niŋ yadda ye bi'emnam nɛ dataas na nyaŋi kpɛn' Jerusalem teŋ za'anɔya la nii.

english_verse: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
translation_verse: Amaa li tʋm ya ka li anɛ ba nɔdi'esidib la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug nɛ ba maanmaannib la maal taal. Ban kʋʋd nidib tempʋʋgin la zug, hali banɛ pʋ tʋm taal la kpii ba nu'usin.

english_verse: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.
translation_verse: Ba tuongatib la yiridnɛ suorin wʋʋ zʋnzɔɔs nɛ. Ba liebnɛ tuk dim ziim kanɛ ka ba yis la zug ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi si'isi ba ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Instead, everyone shouted, “Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people!” So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, “You can't stay here!”
translation_verse: Ka nidib la yɛti ba ye, “Zɔmi! Ka ya anɛ tuk dim, da si'isi tii! Kemi sa!” Ka ba tɔɔm giligid tɛɛns wʋsa ka teŋ ban dim la yɛti ba ye, “Da di'e ba ka ba kʋ lɛm kpɛlim kpɛla ya'asɛ!”

english_verse: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mɛŋi widigi ba o pʋ lɛn guri ba ya'asɛ. Maanmaannib pʋ lɛn nyɛt na'asii ka kpɛɛmnam kɔ'ɔŋ girima.

english_verse: Our eyes became weary, hopelessly looking for help from a nation that could not save us.
translation_verse: Ti da tɛn'ɛsid ye sʋŋir na kena ka li pʋ kenaa, ka ti ti'ir naae. Ti da dʋ dɔwa'ama zugʋ gu'usid teŋ kanɛ kʋ nyaŋi sʋŋi tii.

english_verse: Enemies hunted us down on every public street. Our time was up; our doom was near.
translation_verse: Ti dataas la pigidi dɔlli ti wʋʋ tɔn'ɔsnam nɛ ka ti pʋ lɛn nyaŋidi ken suoya la nii. Ti ba'asʋg dabisir li'el ya ka ti naar saŋa paae.

english_verse: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
translation_verse: Banɛ da kati ti bugir la ken tɔ'ɔtɔ gaad silʋgʋ ian'ad agɔlli ken si'em la; banɛ dɔlli ti ye ba gban'e la gaadi ti tuon zuoya la ni ka su'a pipirigin ye ba libigi ti.

english_verse: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
translation_verse: Ba da bɛnd baansi gban'e ti Na'ab onɛ ka ti Zugsɔb gaŋ la, ka li nwɛnɛ ba di'e ti nyɔvʋr wʋsa nɛ. On ka ti niŋ yadda ye ti na su'a o ma'asimin, ka o na gu' ka yisi ti, ti dataas nu'usin.

english_verse: You people of Edom can celebrate now! But your time will come to suffer and stagger around naked.
translation_verse: Yanam Edom dim banɛ bɛ Uz teŋ la, kɛlli ka ya sʋnya ma'ae ka ya maal sumalisim! Amaa yanam namisʋg mɛ kenna, ya na paami li. Ya na nuu li bug ka ken biel nɛ nyan.

english_verse: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.
translation_verse: Yanam Zion dima, ya tʋbtɛɛgir naae ya, Zugsɔb kʋ lɛn kɛ ka ya an yammis teŋ zʋŋʋ yuugɛ. Amaa yanam Edom dima, Zugsɔb na tɛɛgi ya tʋba. O na nie ya bugusim la paalʋ ka nidib nyɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, tɛn'ɛsim dinɛ maali ti la; gɔsim tinamɛ di nyan si'em.

english_verse: Foreigners and strangers have taken our land and our homes.
translation_verse: Ti areza'as wʋsa lieb nɛ saam din ka teŋ zʋŋ dim kpɛn'ɛdi ti yaan.

english_verse: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka ti da' ku'om ka naan nu; ti mɛŋ daad ka ba kuosidi tisidi ti.

english_verse: We are terribly mistreated; we are worn out and can find no rest.
translation_verse: Banɛ kati ti la bɛ nɛ ti nya'aŋ yammin ka ti gɛn ka ba mɛ kʋ basi ti ka ti vʋ'ʋsɛ.

english_verse: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
translation_verse: Dikanɛ ka ti dit ka vʋe kae asɛɛ ti keŋ Egipt bɛɛ Asiria sɔs diib.

english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Ti yaanamɛ da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ka kpi linzug ka tinam yʋ'ʋn bɛ namisʋg pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ sʋ'oe ti la anɛ yammis ka sɔ' mɛ kae na faaɛn ti yisi ba nu'usinɛ.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: Ti ɛɛn kuosnɛ ti nyɔɔr ka naan nyɛ diibi di bɔzugɔ banɛ ye ba kʋʋ ti bɛ sian'arin la.

english_verse: Our skin is scorched from fever and hunger.
translation_verse: Kɔ'ɔm kɛ ka ti niŋgbina tʋlig wʋʋ bugum nɛ.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: Ba bibi ti pu'ab Zion zuorin ka dig nɛ ti pu'asada Juda teŋkpɛmisin wʋsa.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: Ba mɔri ti tuongatib la keŋ yuli ba nɛ nwiis ka pʋ tisidi ti bʋnkʋd la na'asii.

english_verse: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
translation_verse: Ba mugusidi ti na'akim la ka kɛ ka ba nɛ'ɛm ki wʋʋ yammis nɛ, ka ti biribis la zi daadi gɛn.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnam la pʋ lɛn zin' teŋ la za'anɔya nii, ka dasam la mɛ pʋ lɛn nwɛ'ɛd yʋʋma ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
translation_verse: Malisim gaad ya, ka sʋnsa'aŋ di'e zin'ig wʋsa. Ti wa'a tiaknɛ lieb fabʋlʋg nɛ kaasig.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ daa nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ si'el la wʋsa lɛn kae. Gɔsima! Ti tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka bɛ yɛla ni.

english_verse: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka ti sʋnya san'am ka ti nini pʋ lɛn nyɛt sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: our city is in ruins, overrun by wild dogs.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zion zuor la kpɛlim nɛ zaalim ka Akɔranam giligid teŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ an Na'ab saŋa wʋsa ka na'am la bɛ nɛ zʋmaana wʋsa saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Why have you forgotten us for so long?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka fʋ tammidi ti yɛla saŋa wʋsa? Bɔ ka fʋ basi ti ka li yuugɛ?

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ fʋ zan'asi ti nɛ nyainnɛ? Fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la ka' bɛnnɛ?

english_verse: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,
translation_verse: Ka m gɔsi nyɛ ka sisi'etita'ar yi ya-datiuŋ baba kenna nɛ saŋgbantita'ar, ka saa ian'adi tansid panr-panr ka bugum nie nyain giligi li nyɛɛn. Ka si'el bɛ bugum la teŋsʋkʋ nyɛɛn pil-pil,

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
translation_verse: ka si'elnam bɛ bugum la pʋʋgin nwɛnɛ bʋnvʋya anaasi. Ba da nwɛnɛ ninsaal nɛ,

english_verse: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
translation_verse: amaa ba yinne wʋsa da mɔri nindaas nɛ kpʋkpama anaas naas.

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
translation_verse: Ba nɔba da tiɛnnɛ sappi, ka ba nɔbpansimpana nwɛnɛ na'abil tafɛɛd nɛ, ka nyɛɛn wʋʋ kʋntzɛn'ug ka ba maali duus nɛ.

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: Bʋnvʋya la wʋsa kpʋkpama da si'isidnɛ taaba, ka ba yinne wʋsa ya'a ye o keŋ ba la'asidnɛ ken vuguri ka pʋ fɛndigidi ba niŋgbinaa.

english_verse: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
translation_verse: Ba nindaas la da nwɛn si'em nwa': bʋnvʋr wʋsa da mɔri nindaas anaasi; ninsaal nindaa linɛ bɛ tuon, nɛ gbigim nindaa linɛ bɛ datiuŋ, nɛ na'araug nindaa linɛ bɛ dagɔbʋg nɛ abaar nindaa linɛ bɛ nya'aŋ;

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: ba nindaasi da an si'em la. Ba da yadignɛ ba kpʋkpama dʋ'ʋs agɔla; ka bʋnvʋr wʋsa mɔr kpʋkpama ayi', ka kpʋkpauŋ wʋsa tiɛn si'isid bʋnvʋr kanɛ kpi'e nɛ o la kpʋkpauŋ, ka kpʋkpama ayi' banɛ kpɛlim la lusidi ba niŋgbina.

english_verse: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
translation_verse: Yinne wʋsa da kpɛn kpa'ad o tuonnɛ ken. Siig la ken zin'isi'a wʋsa ba na keŋ ka pʋ fɛndigi ba mɛŋa.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Bʋnvʋya la da nwɛnɛ bugumsaana bɛɛ kʋtir bugum nɛ, ka li nyɛɛn hali giligid saŋa wʋsa. Bugum la da nienɛ ka tɔɔndi ian'ad bʋnvʋya la teŋsʋk wʋʋ saa nɛ.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Bʋnvʋya la da zɔti tɔ'ɔtɔ ken tuon ka lɛbid nya'aŋ wʋʋ saa ian'ad si'em la.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Man da gɔt bʋnvʋya anaasi la, m da nyɛ fiilnama anaasi ka li si'isid teŋi kpi'e ba yinne wʋsa.

english_verse: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Fiilnam la da an si'em nwa': anaasi la wʋsa da zemnɛ taaba, ka nyɛɛn nwɛnɛ gɔtiŋ nɛ. Fiilnam la da maal si'em la da nwɛnɛ ba nɔknɛ yinne nyaae li tiraan pʋʋgin nɛ,

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Li fiilnam la da wa'am nɛ mɔr dabiem, ka li wʋsa mɔr nini.

english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Alazug saŋa kanɛ wʋsa ka bʋnvʋya la ken bɛɛ zi'e bɛɛ ian'ad, fiilnam la mɛ maannɛ ala nɔɔ, bɔzugɔ bʋnvʋya la siig bɛnɛ fiilnamin la.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Bʋnvʋya la da ian'ad la, m da wʋm ka ba kpʋkpama la dammid wʋʋ atɛuk ku'om, bɛɛ Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la tansʋg vuud, ka lɛn nwɛnɛ zabzabidib bɛdegʋ na kenna. Ba ya'a da zi'en baanlimm ba sigisidnɛ ba kpʋkpama la teŋin.

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka ba da zi'en ka sigisi ba kpʋkpama la m da wʋm kʋkɔri yi bʋnlammir linɛ bɛɛ ba zugin la.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Bʋnlammir linɛ bɛɛ ba zugin la, si'el da bɛɛ ani nwɛnɛ na'am kʋk linɛ ka ba nɔk gɔtiŋi maal, ka si'el zin' na'am kʋk la zugʋ nwɛnɛ ninsaal nɛ.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: M da nyɛ lin naanɛ o siaa baba dʋt la ka li nyɛɛn nwɛnɛ ba zugudnɛ kʋnt bugumin. Ka lin yii ani sigid la nwɛnɛ bugum ka nɛɛsim tita'ar giligi li.

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: Li da nwɛnɛ saa na kʋ ka dindɛog buoɛn saŋgbana ni si'em la. Vɛnlim kaŋa da gilig o. Ala ka li da nie nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb na'am pipilim girima nɛ. Man da nyɛ nɛ'ɛŋa la ka luu avanba, ka wʋm ka li pian'ad.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, duom zi'en ka m pian' tisif.”

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: On pian' naae la, ka Siig la kpɛn'ɛm ka duomi zi'el, ka m wʋm ka o pian'adi tisidim.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: O yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, m tʋmif nɛ Israel dim san'an. Ba anɛ banɛ pʋ siakida ka ki'isidi m nɔɔr. Ban nɛ ba yaanam ki'isi m nɔɔr hali ti paae zina.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ ka m tʋmmi fʋ ba san'an la anɛ banɛ zuti kpi'em ka ba pʋ tiakid na'anaa. Yɛlimi ba ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa'.

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a siak bɛɛ pʋ siakɛ, fʋn yɛlimi ba, ka ba pʋn anɛ nimbanɛ ki'isid. La'an nɛ ala, ba na baŋ ye Wina'am nɔdi'es sid mi' naanɛ ba sʋʋgin.

english_verse: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ fʋ yɛli ba man yɛlif si'el la, ba ya'a kɛlis bɛɛ zan'asɛɛ, ba pʋn anɛ banɛ ki'isid.

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn, Ninsaal biiga, kɛlisim man yɛlif si'el la. Da ki'isim wʋʋ nimbama. Ya'ami fʋ nɔɔr ka di'e man tisidif si'el la ɔnb.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Ani ka m gɔsi nyɛ nu'ugʋ tieli m san'an na ka gbauŋ kpilim bɛ nu'ug la pʋʋg.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: Ka o idigi li m tuon, ka li tuon nɛ li nya'aŋ wʋsa sɔb fabʋlʋg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ tɔɔg yɛla.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, ɔm gbauŋ kanɛ ka m tisidif la pɛ'ɛli fʋ pʋʋr.” Ka m ɔnbi li ka li malis hali wʋʋ siind nɛ m nɔɔrin.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, kem Israel nidibin la nannanna tu'asi m yɛla tisi ba.

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: M pʋ tʋmif nɛ nimbanɛ zu'oe ka ba pian'ad tɔi ka ba buudi kpi'em ka ba pian'ad ka fʋ kʋ gban'e li gbin la san'anɛ. Sida, hali baa m ya'a tʋmi nɛf nimban buudi san'an ba naan wʋm tisi nɛf.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Amaa Israel dim la kʋ wʋm tisi fɔ, bɔzugɔ ba pʋ bɔɔd ye ba kɛlis mam mɛŋa. Ba wʋsa anɛ zukpi'euŋ dim ka pʋ nanna.

english_verse: Listen carefully to everything I say and then think about it.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛn yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, kɛlisim sʋ'ʋŋa ka tɛnr man yɛlif si'el la wʋsa ka zaŋi niŋi fʋ pʋtɛn'ɛrin.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: Kemi fʋ teŋ nimbanɛ ka ba gban'e ba keŋ teŋ zʋŋ la ni, tu'asi tisi ba. Yɛlimi ba ye, ‘Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛlim ye m yɛli ya si'eli nwa',’ ba ya'a siak bɛɛ ba ya'a pʋ siakɛ fʋn yɛlimi ba.”

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Ka Siig la ʋkim agɔla, ka m wʋm ka kʋkɔtita'ar vuudi m nya'aŋi yɛt ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ bɛ arezana la na paam wɔ'ɔgir o bɛllim zin'igin la!”

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm ka bʋnvʋya kpʋkpama nwɛ'ɛd agɔla si'isid taaba ka tɛreko fiilnam dammid nwa'am-nwa'am nwɛnɛ teŋi mi'im nɛ.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Ka Siig la ʋkim agɔla mɔri keŋ sa. Ka m keŋ nɛ ɛndʋg hali nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ka Zugsɔb la paŋ bɛɛ m san'an.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: M da paae m taab banɛ da bɛ Tel Abib teŋin linɛ kpi'e nɛ Keba kɔldaug la ka li pakim hali ka m zin'in ani daba ayɔpɔi. Israel dim sa'alʋg (Ezi

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Daba ayɔpɔi la naar daar la, ka Wina'am pian' tisim ye,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, mam maalif nɛ yigur ka fʋ na gur Israel nidib la. Wʋm man yɛtif si'el la nɛ nimmua ka tu'asi kpa'asi ba tisim.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: M ya'a yɛl tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb ye o na kpi, ka fʋ pʋ yɛl o ka o bas o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ka nyɛ faangirɛ, ninkan sɔb na kpii o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin, amaa o ziim na bɛɛ fʋ zugin.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋ ya'a yɛl tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb ye o basim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ka o pʋ siakɛ, o na kpii o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin la, amaa fʋn na faaɛn fʋ mɛŋ.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: “Pʋpielim sɔb ya'a bas tʋʋm sʋma ka pin'ili tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka fʋ pʋ yɛl o, m na kɛ ka yɛlbɛ'og gban'e o ka o tu'ugi lii kpi. Li ya'a niŋ ala, m kʋ tɛnr tʋʋm sʋma banɛ ka o tʋm la, ka o ziim mɛ na bɛɛ fʋ zug.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: Amaa fʋ ya'a yɛl pʋpielim sɔb ye o da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ ka o siak, o na vʋe on wʋm nɛ nimmua tisif la zug, ka fʋn mɛ na faaɛn fʋ mɛŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la paŋ da bɛɛ m san'an zin'ikan la, ka o yɛlim ye, “Duom keŋ paalʋ kanɛ an sassi la ni, ka m na pian' tisif.”

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Ka man paae zin'ikan la, m nyɛ ka Zugsɔb la girima nie nyain wʋʋ man da nyɛɛ li si'em Keba kɔldaug baba la. Ka m luu avanba.

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Ka Siig la kɛɛn m san'an na ʋkim agɔla zi'el ka pian' tisim ye, “Kem yɔɔ fʋ mɛŋi fʋ yin.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka fʋ zilim tabin ka fʋ kʋ nyaŋi pian' tis nimbanɛ zugʋ kpi'em la.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Amaa m ya'a lɛm pian' tisif, m na kɛ ka fʋ zilim lak ka fʋ yɛli ba mam Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛlif si'el. Banɛ na siak ban siak, banɛ zan'as ban on zan'as, ka m pʋn mi' ba zukpi'euŋ la yɛla.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am da lɛn yɛl mam Ezikil ye, Ninsaal biiga, nɔkim birikiisi digili fʋ tuon ka buoɛn li zugini pa'al Jerusalem tempʋʋgʋ an si'em.

english_verse: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka nɔk kʋnt gammi zi'el nwɛnɛ zaŋguom nɛ fʋn nɛ birikiisi la teŋsʋk, ka fɛndigi fʋ nindaa kpa' li ka li na bɛ sʋʋgin wʋʋ zabzabidibi lɔbi gilig nɛ ka fʋn na nwɛnɛ banɛ lɔbi giligi li la. Nɛ'ɛŋa na an zanbinnɛ tis Israel dim la.

english_verse: After that, lie down on your left side and stay there for
translation_verse: M na nɔk yʋʋm banɛ ka ba nɔki tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa tiaki li ka li lieb dabisa. Alazug dabisa kɔbistan' nɛ piswai (

english_verse: days you are lying down.
translation_verse: ) saŋa kanɛ ka fʋ dig la.

english_verse: more days. That will be a sign of Judah's punishment—one day for each year of its suffering.
translation_verse: ) tisif. Dabisir wʋsa pa'an ye li anɛ yʋʋm yinne.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: Fɛndigimi fʋ nindaa kpa' Jerusalem kanɛ ka fʋ buoɛn digil la, ka zian'am nu'ugʋ di'e m nɔɔr pian'ad linɛ ka m zɛrigi li la tisi li.

english_verse: I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.
translation_verse: Man na lɔɔf nɛ nwiis ka fʋ kʋ nyaŋi biki lɛb zin'isi'aa, hali nɛ dabisa la bɛnnɛ na ti naae.

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
translation_verse: “Nɔkim mui nɛ bɛŋa nɛ ki niŋ dʋkʋn ka nɔki li maal diib ka dii li dabisa kɔbistan' nɛ piswai (

english_verse: Eat only a small loaf of bread each day
translation_verse: Makim diibi dit daar wʋsa si'em nɛ saŋa kanɛ ka fʋ gban'e ye fʋ dit.

english_verse: and drink only two large cups of water.
translation_verse: Ka mɛ mak ku'om bʋtiis ayi' nuud saŋa kan nɔɔ.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: Dim diib la wʋʋ ma'asa ka fʋ ɔnbid nɛ; li anɛ tilas ye fʋ maal ma'asa la zin'ikanɛ ka nidib na nyɛt, ka nɔk ninsaal binkpi'emisi nyu'oe bugum maali li.”

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa na pa'al Israel dimi na di dian'ad si'em, teŋ kanɛ wʋsa ka m ye m mɔri ba keŋ la.”

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, “Ayei, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba! Man nan zi' di linɛ kis ka an dian'adɛ. M biilimin sa man nan zi' di bʋnkpiilʋŋ bɛɛ linɛ ka wɛog bʋn gban'e. Bʋnkpiilʋŋ ni'im nan zi' kpɛn' man nɔɔrinɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “Tɔ', li ka' yɛllɛ, m na kɛ ka fʋ nɔk na'ambinnɛ nyu'oe maal ka ka' ninsaal binnɛ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.
translation_verse: Ka o yʋ'ʋn yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, m na gu'oe ka kʋ lɛn tis Jerusalem dim diibɔ. Nidib la na di diib linɛ an fiin nɛ nyɛlʋg, ka nu ku'okanɛ an fiin nɛ dabiem,

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ diib nɛ ku'om na kar. Ba na lidigi gɔsid taaba ka waŋim kpii ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: Wina'am da lɛn yɛl mam Ezikil ye, Ninsaal biiga, nannanna nɔkim sʋ'ʋkanɛ dit nwɛnɛ barigi pʋni fʋ zuobid nɛ fʋ tieŋ. Ka nɔk linɛ makid tɛbisim mak, ka pʋdig zuobid la zin'is atan'.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Dabisa banɛ ka fʋ dig la bɛn ya'a paae, fʋn nɔk zuobid la pʋdigir yinne nyu'oe tempʋʋg la pʋʋgin, ka nɔk yinne fuoe sʋ'ʋgʋ fi'idi li giligid teŋ la. Ka nɔk yinne la yɛlig pɛbisʋgin. Ka m na fuoe m sʋ'ʋgʋ kati ba.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Amaa nɔkim zuobid la fiin lɔɔ fʋ fuug nɔɔr,

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: ka yisi li bi'ela nɔki lɔs bugumin ka li kanb. Bugum na naan ani tiigi paae Israel dim wʋsa.

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, Jerusalem kaŋa ka man ye m nɔki zi'el dunia teŋsʋk ka tɛɛns bɛdegʋ gilig o.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: O bugusim la zug ka o zan'asi m wada nɛ m zi'ela la gaad tembanɛ gilig o la. O zan'asnɛ ka pʋ dɔlli m wada nɛ m zi'ela la.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa': Ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd gat tembanɛ giligi ya la ka ya pʋ dɔlli m zi'ela bɛɛ m wada la. Hali ya dɔlnɛ tembanɛ giligi ya la zi'ela.

english_verse: Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you
translation_verse: Dinzug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': Mam mɛŋ kis yanam Jerusalem dim nɛ, ka na kɛ ka namisʋg paae ya ka dunia wʋsa nyɛ.

english_verse: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
translation_verse: Ya bada banɛ ka m kis ka ya sin ka maan la zug, m na maali ya bʋn linɛ ka m nan zi' maalɛ ka mɛ kʋ lɛm maali li buudii.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Alazug ya tempʋʋgin la, saamnam na ɔnbi ba biis, ka biis ɔnbi ba saamnam. M na kɛ ka tɔɔg paae ya, ka banɛ pʋ kpi la m na widigi ba gilig dunia wʋsa.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: Alazug man Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pɔya ye yanamɛ dian'a mam Pʋ'ʋsim Yir, nɛ ya bada banɛ ka ya ya'ab ka m kis la, m kʋ lɛn sʋŋi ya. M mɛ kʋ lɛn zɔɔ ya nimbaanlig bɛɛ bas ka ya pɔnsɛ.

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Ya nidib la pʋdigir zin'is atan' yinne na kpi nɛ tɔɔg bɛɛ kɔ'ɔm. Ba mɛ na kʋ pʋdigir yinne nɛ sʋ'ʋg teŋ la yiŋ, ka m fuoe m sʋ'ʋgʋ kad banɛ kpɛlim la ka ba widigi keŋ dunia wʋsa.

english_verse: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
translation_verse: Linɛ na kɛ ka ɛndʋg nɛ sʋnpɛɛn linɛ ka m gban'e ba yɛla la niŋ lamm. Ala ka ba na baŋ ye man Zugsɔb sid pian'anɛ nɛ sʋntɔɔg.

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: Ba na pɔ'ɔgi ya ka maali ya siaa. M ya'a kɛ ka tɔɔg nɛ mugusʋg paae ya, li na an nimmua sa'alʋgʋ tis tembanɛ giligi ya la. Man onɛ an Zugsɔb la yɛl ala.

english_verse: I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: M ya'a ti tɔɔn ya nɛ kɔ'ɔm wʋʋ piim kanɛ mɔr yabid nɛ, li na kʋʋ ya. M na kɛ ka kɔ'ɔm tɔllʋ kena ka ya kʋ nyɛ diibɔ.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka kɔ'ɔm nɛ wɛog bʋnkɔnbid tʋ'ʋsi ya naae ya biis wʋsa. Tɔɔg nɛ zaba na gɛɛli ya, ka m kɛ ka ba zab nɛ ya. Man onɛ an Zugsɔb la yɛl ala.

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛlim ye;

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, ʋkimi fʋ nindaa kpa' Israel zuoya la; ka zɛrigi ba tisim.

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye, Israel zuoya, wʋmmi Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la labaar. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' tisid zuoya nɛ kʋkʋna la nɛ bɔn'ɔd la wʋsa: M bɔɔd ye m zab nɛ ya, ka san'am san'ami ya teŋgbana la wʋsa.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Bimbim banɛ ka ya maan maana ka nyɔ'ɔd bʋnnyubisa la wʋsa m na nwa'a ba, ka kʋʋ ya nidib la ya bada la tuon.

english_verse: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.
translation_verse: M na dɛlig Israel nidib la niŋgbina ba bada la tuon, ka widigi ya kɔnba la giligi ya bimbima la.

english_verse: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa tɛɛns la na lieb zaalim ka ya teŋgbana la san'am, ka ya bimbima la san'am lieb zaalim, ka ba na nwa'a ya bada la bas, la'an nɛ ya bʋnnyubisa bimbima la; ka yanamɛ maal si'el wʋsa na bɔdig.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Ba na kʋʋ ya nidib la ya teŋsʋk, ka li kɛ ka ya baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: “Amaa m na tiligi ya sieba, bɔzugɔ ya sieba na nyaŋi zɔɔ pɔns, ka widigi keŋ buudi nɛ tɛɛns bɛdegʋ ni.

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: Ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la, ka man da ye yɛla na kena la, m da pʋ vɔlisidnɛ nɛ nɔɔr pian'ad ma'aanɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa', ye, “La'asimi fʋ nu'us ayi' bibig zug ka kimis nɔba ka ki'e kuŋ, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka Israel dim tʋm la zug. Linɛ na kʋʋ ba anɛ zaba nɛ kɔ'ɔm nɛ tɔɔg.

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Onɛ lal la, tɔɔg la na kʋʋ o; ka onɛ bɛ yammin, zaba la na kʋʋ o; ka onɛ pɔns ka pʋ kpii, kɔ'ɔm la na kʋʋ o. Ala ka m sʋnpɛɛn la na luu ba zug.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ an Wina'am, ba ya'a nyɛ ka ba kʋʋ ba nidib la ka ba digi tɛri giligi ba maan bimbima nɛ ba bada zin'isin la nɛ teŋgban wʋsa ni nɛ zuor wʋsa zug nɛ titita'ar wʋsa gbinnin, zin'ibanɛ ka ba nyɔ'ɔd maana nɛ bʋnnyubisa tisidi ba bada la.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ba teŋ la lieb zaalim, lin pin'il pipirigin la ti paae Dibila teŋin nɛ ban bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa. Ka ba baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛt si'eli nwa' tisid Israel teŋ la ye, ‘Li bɛn paae ya! Li bɛn paae tis teŋgbauŋ la lʋga anaasi la wʋsa.

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: M kʋ zɔɔf nimbaanlig bɛɛ basi fɔ; m sid na yɔɔ fʋ zʋgbɛ'ɛd nɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka fʋ tʋm la lɛbis. Ala ka fʋ na baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.’”

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Li bɛn paae ya! Li bɛn sid paae ya! Li duoe li mɛŋi gɛɛli ya. Li kena!

english_verse: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.
translation_verse: San'auŋ kɛɛn ya zugin na, yanam banɛ bɛ teŋin la. Saŋa la paae ya, dabisir la li'el ya, dabiem na bɛ zuoya la zug, ka li kʋ lɛn an sumalisim.

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Li kʋ yuugɛ, m na kpa'ae m sʋnpɛɛn la niŋi ya zugin; m na kadi ya saria ka li dɔlli ya tʋʋma an si'em, ka lɛbisi yɔɔ ya tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka ya tʋmmi ya sʋʋgin la.

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: M kʋ zɔɔ ya nimbaanlig bɛɛ basi yaa. M na lɛbisi yɔɔ ya, ka li dɔlnɛ ya bɛllim nɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka ya tʋm la. Ala ka ya na baŋ ye man onɛ an Zugsɔb la tʋmi li.

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: Nɔŋgbannwa'ar yʋ'ʋn nɔbignɛ kilim balaar ye li bʋ' bugusnamɛ namisi ba; nidib la baa yinne kʋ pɔnsɛ; banɛ la'asi maan tʋkpiidʋg la nɛ ba areza'as nɛ ba la'asʋma wʋsa kʋ pɔnsɛ.

english_verse: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
translation_verse: Onɛ kuosid la kʋ lɛm paam paalʋ kanɛ ka o kuos la ba wʋsa vʋm saŋaa, bɔzugɔ nier linɛ pa'an nidib yɛla la kʋ tiakɛ. Ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug, ba nid baa yinne kʋ tiligɛ.

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Zaba la bɛ nɛ yiŋ, ka wiim nɛ kɔ'ɔm bɛ teŋ la pʋʋgin; banɛ bɛ teŋ la yiŋ la na kpi zaba ni, ka kɔ'ɔm nɛ wiim mɛ kʋ banɛ bɛ teŋ la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Banɛ nyaŋi zɔɔ pɔns la na bɛ zuoya la ni kaasid wʋʋ sian'anr dawana, ba wʋsa na kaasidi ba mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Nu'us wʋsa na kpi zɛba, ka duma wʋsa nyɔsid ka bʋk wʋʋ gungum nɛ.

english_verse: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.
translation_verse: Ba na yɛ bɔto fuud sʋnsa'aŋ zug ka dabiem gban'e ba. Nyan na kpɛn' ba ka ba pʋni ba zut.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Ba na nɔki ba anzurifa lɔbi bas suoraadin, ka sanlima lieb wʋʋ sa'ad nɛ. Daakanɛ ka Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn na luna la, ba anzurifa nɛ ba sanlima la kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ba. Li kʋ tun'e ma'ae ba kɔ'ɔm bɛɛ pɛ'ɛli ba pʋʋrɛ, bɔzugɔ li anɛ linɛ kɛ ka ba tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Ba da dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ nɛ ba niŋgɔnkɔris nɛ ba bʋnvɛnla la wʋsa zug, ka nɔki li kud bada nɛ wina banɛ ka man kis. Alazug mam na tiaki li ka li lieb dian'ad bunnɛ tisi ba.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: M na fɛndigi m nindaa ka kʋ lɛn gɔsi baa, ka kɛ ka ba nɔk man zin'ig linɛ an kasi la maal yalis yalisi. Na'ayiis na kpɛn' ani maal linɛ ka' suorɛ.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: “Ieemi baans, bɔzugɔ teŋ la pɛ'ɛli nɛ ninkʋʋr ka tempʋʋg la pɛ'ɛl nɛ taawai.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka teŋ kanɛ mɔr bugusim gat sɔ' wʋsa la kena sʋ'ʋgi ba ya'. Ya nimbɛda la nyɛɛsim na naae, ka ba na san'ami ba pʋ'ʋsim dɔɔd la.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Mugusʋg ya'a ti kena kpɛn'ɛsi ba dabiem, ba na bɔɔd sumbʋgʋsʋm amaa ka kʋ nyɛɛ.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Yɛla nɛ lababɛ'ɛd na ta'a-ta'a taaba kena. Ba na bɔɔd ye nɔdi'esidib la yɛli ba linɛ na maal bɛog sa, amaa ba na mɔɔ gɛn; Zugsɔb wada linɛ ka maanmaannib la pa'an la kʋ lɛm bɛɛ, ka kpɛɛmnam sa'alʋg la mɛ kʋ lɛm bɛɛ.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Na'ab la na kaas kʋʋr, ka na'abiis la sʋnf san'am, ka teŋ la nidib wʋsa nu'us na kirid. Man na tɛɛgi ba tʋbir ka li dɔlli ba tʋʋma an si'em. Ba mɛŋ zi'esim an si'em la, ala ka m ye m dɔlisi kadi ba saria. Ala ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ ka ti da an yammisi bɛ teŋ zʋŋ la, yʋma ayuobʋ la ni, li nwadis ayuobʋ la dabisa anu daar la, ka man nɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam zin' m yin, ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la paŋ kɛɛn m san'an na.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: M da nyɛ si'el ka li zi'e nwɛnɛ nid. Ka lin yii o siaa baba sig la nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ, ka o siaa la baba dʋt la nyɛɛn wʋʋ kʋnt nɛ.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: O da tiɛn si'el ka li nwɛnɛ nu'ug nɛ gban'e m zuobid. Ka Siig la ʋkim agɔla mɔrimi keŋ Jerusalem zak linɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la za'anɔɔr linɛ lɛbid ya-dagɔbʋg baba la. Ani ka ba'ar linɛ duod Wina'am sʋʋnr la da zi'e.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Ani ka m nyɛ Israel Wina'am girima la, wʋʋ man da nyɛɛ li si'em Keba kɔldaug paalʋ ni la.
