english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, gɔsim kpa' ya-dagɔbʋg baba!” Ka m gɔsi nyɛ maan daka linɛ bɛ ya-dagɔbʋg za'anɔɔrin la, ka ba'ar linɛ duod Zugsɔb sʋnf la zi'e ani.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, fʋ nyɛ ban maan si'elaa? Li anɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka Israel dim tʋm kpɛla, bʋmbanɛ na kɛ ka man lal nɛ m Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la. Hali fʋ na nyɛ yɛlkisa linɛ gaad ala.”

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: Ka o yʋ'ʋn mɔrimi kɛn Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la za'ambɛŋ za'anɔɔrin na, ka m gɔs ka zaŋguom la mɔr vɔɔnr.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, nannanna tuum vɔɔnr zaŋguom la ni.” Ka m sid tu ka nyɛ za'anɔɔr ka li bɛɛ ani.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Kpɛn'ɛm gɔs bugusim nɛ tʋʋmkisa linɛ ka ba tʋm kpɛla.”

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Ka m sid kpɛn' nyɛ ka ba gʋli gʋl bʋnkɔnbid banɛ vuud nɛ bʋnkɔnbkisa nɛ Israel dim bada la wʋsa tabil zaŋguom la.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Israel kpɛɛmnam pisyɔpɔi da zi'e ani, ka Jaazanaya onɛ an Safan biig la mɛ la'am zi'e nɛ ba. Sɔ' wʋsa da zanli linɛ ka ba nyu'od bʋnnyubisa ani la ba nu'usin, ka nyɔ'ɔs zɔɔnd.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Wina'am da bu'osim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, fʋ nyɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam la tʋm si'el likinɛɛ? Sɔ' wʋsa zi'enɛ o ba'ar tuon. Bɔzugɔ ba gban'e ba pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye, ‘Zugsɔb la pʋ nyɛti tii; o tam teŋ la yɛla nɛ.’”

english_verse: But I will show you something even worse than this.”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛn yɛlim ye, “Fʋ na nyɛ ka ba tʋm si'elnam ka li an bɛ'ɛdi gat nɛ'ɛnam.”

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: O da mɔrimi keŋ za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ baba Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, ka m nyɛ pu'ab ka ba zi'e ani kaasid Tamuz onɛ an ba'ar la kʋʋr.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: Ka o bu'osim ye, “Fʋ nyɛ nɛ'ɛŋaa? M na pa'alif tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ gaad fʋn nyɛt si'el la.”

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: O da bu'osim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, fʋ nyɛ nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsaa? Li pʋ pak Juda dim nɛ ban tʋm tʋʋmfɛn'ɛsa laa? Hali ba lɛn ieed zaba ken nidib la sʋʋgin na ka li kɛ ka m sʋnf duoe nɛ ba. Gɔsim ban tʋ'ʋdim nɛ tʋ'ʋtita'ar si'em!

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_verse: Alazug mam na pa'ali ba ye m sʋnf duonɛ; m kʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig bɛɛ basi baa. La'an nɛ ban kpiidi m tʋba nii bɛllim la, m kʋ wʋm tisi baa.”

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: M da wʋm ka Wina'am tans nɛ kʋkɔtita'ari yɛl ye, “La'asimi banɛ gur tempʋʋg la kpɛla na, ka kɛ ka sɔ' wʋsa mɔr o zaba la'ad o nu'ugin!”

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ dapa ayuobʋ ka ba yi ya-datiuŋ baba za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ zugin la kenna, ka mɔr zaba la'abɛda ba nu'usin. Sɔ' da paasi dɔlli ba yɛ fupiel ka zanl si'el linɛ ka o na nyaŋi sɔbi li zug ka li lab o sakpidir. Ba da kpɛn' na zi'enɛ kpi'en nɛ kʋntzɛn'ug maan daka la.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Ka Israel Wina'am la na'am pipilim da naan Kerubnam la zugin, lin da pʋn dɛŋi bɛ zin'isi'a la, dʋʋ agɔla ka keŋ ban dɔl zin'isi'a kpɛn'ɛd Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la. Ka Zugsɔb buol onɛ yɛ fupiel ka zanl linɛ sɔbid ka li lab o sakpidirin la

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: ka yɛl o ye, “Kem kaae gilig Jerusalem tempʋʋg la wʋsa ka zanbil banɛ wʋsa sid kum ka fabin tʋʋmkisa banɛ wʋsa tʋm teŋ la pʋʋgin la gbɛ'ɛlaas.”

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Kʋʋmi bʋnkʋd nɛ dasam nɛ pu'asada nɛ pu'ab nɛ biis, amaa da si'isi onɛ wʋsa mɔr zanbinnɛ o gbɛ'ogʋnɛ. Pin'ilimi Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la pʋʋgin.” Ba sid da pin'il nɛ kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la tuon la.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wina'am da yɛli ba ye, “Miligimi Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la ka li da lɛn an kasii, ka kʋ nidibi pɛ'ɛl za'as la. Kemi!” Ka ba sid yi ka pin'il kʋʋb teŋ la wʋsa pʋʋgin.

english_verse: I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
translation_verse: Ban da pin'ili kʋʋd la ka man kpɛlimmi m kɔn' ani, ka m luu avanba ka kaas kuŋ ye, “Aa, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba! Anwa ka fʋ ye fʋ mɔr tɔɔg linɛ ka fʋ lɔbi bas Jerusalem teŋ zug la san'am Israel nimbanɛ kpɛlim la wʋsaa?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbisi yɛlim ye, “Israel nɛ Juda nidib la tʋmnɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛtita'ar hali. Teŋgbauŋ la pɛ'ɛli nɛ ziim ka sida lɛn kae tempʋʋgin laa. Ba yɛt ye, ‘Zugsɔb la tam teŋ la yɛla nɛ: Zugsɔb la pʋ nyɛtaa.’

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Alazug man kʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig bɛɛ kɛ ka sɔ' pɔnsɛ, amaa ban maal si'el la wʋsa, m na kɛ ka li lɛbi ba zugin na.”

english_verse: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_verse: Ka dau kanɛ yɛ fupiel ka zanl linɛ sɔbid o sakpidirin la lɛb na yɛt ye, “Man tʋm wʋʋ fʋn yɛlim si'em la naae.”

english_verse: I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne.
translation_verse: M da gɔsi nyɛ bʋnsi'a linɛ nwɛnɛ na'am kʋk ka li nyɛɛnnɛ nwɛnɛ gɔtiŋ nɛ bɛ linɛ an lammiri ka bɛ Kerubnam la zugin la.

english_verse: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl onɛ yɛ fupiel la ye, “Kem kpɛn' fiil banɛ bɛ Kerubnam la lɛuŋʋn la teŋsʋk ka gbin'e bugumsaana linɛ bɛ Kerubnam la teŋsʋk la pɛ'ɛli fʋ nu'us ka widigi li kpɛn'ɛs tempʋʋgin la.” Ka man nan gɔsid la ka o keŋ kpɛn' ani.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka dau la kpɛn' la, Kerubnam la da zi'enɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la lɛbisid ya-dagɔbʋg baba, ka Zugsɔb girima la pɛ'ɛl zak la.

english_verse: and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb girima la da yi Kerubnam la zugin keŋ paae Dɔɔg la za'ambɛŋin la, ka zin'ig la pɛ'ɛl nɛ Zugsɔb girima la vɛnlim.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Kerubnam la kpʋkpama da vuud Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la za'ambɛŋin la ka li wʋm paalʋ wʋʋ Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la ɛɛn pian' ka li an si'em la.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Ka Kerub yinne tiɛn o nu'ugʋ paae bugum kanɛ bɛɛ ba teŋsʋk la. O da gbin'e bugum la niŋ dau la nu'ugin, ka o mɔri lii yi yiŋ.

english_verse: and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite.
translation_verse: M da gɔsi nyɛ fiilnam anaasi kpi'e Kerubnam la, ka yinne wʋsa kpi'e bʋnvʋr yinne, nyɛɛn hali wʋʋ gɔtiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim ban nwɛn si'em yɛla, ba wʋsa da nwɛnɛ taaba, yinne wʋsa da nwɛnɛ ba nɔknɛ yinne nyaae li tiraan pʋʋgin nɛ.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved.
translation_verse: Ka Kerubnam la ya'a ken dunia lʋga anaasi la wʋsa zin'isi'a fiilnam la dɔlnɛ ka li ka' ye ba fɛndigɛ, Kerubnam la ya'a ken zin'ikanɛ ka ba zug kpa' wʋsa, ba kennɛ ka pʋ fɛndigida.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Ba niŋgbina la wʋsa la'an nɛ ba nya'aŋ nɛ ba nu'us nɛ kpʋkpama wʋsa da anɛ nini ma'aa, la'an nɛ fiilnam anaasi la wʋsa.

english_verse: And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
translation_verse: Man da wʋm ka ba buon fiilnam la ye, “Fiilzɔta.”

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Kerubnam la wʋsa da mɔri nindaas anaas naas. Nindaa yinne da nwɛnɛ Kerub nindaa, ka linɛ paas ayi' la nwɛnɛ ninsaal nindaa, ka linɛ paas atan' la nwɛnɛ gbigim nindaa, ka linɛ paas anaasi la nwɛnɛ abaar nindaa.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: Kerubnam la ya'a ti zi'en baanlimm, li mɛ zi'enid nɛ, ka ba ya'a duoe ka li mɛ duoe, bɔzugɔ bʋnvʋya la siig da bɛ fiilnamin la.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb girima la da yi za'ambɛŋin la keŋ zi'en Kerubnam la zugin.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: Man da nan gɔt la, ka Kerubnam la yadigi ba kpʋkpama ye ba iank teŋin dʋʋ agɔla, ka ban iank la ka fiilnam la mɛ ianki dɔlli ba. Ba da keŋ zi'en Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔɔr linɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ baba la, ka Israel Wina'am la girima bɛɛ ba zugin.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Bʋnvʋbama ka man da nyɛ Israel Wina'am la san'an Keba kɔldaug la baba la, ka m baŋ ye ba anɛ Kerubnam.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: Ba nindaas la da nwɛnɛ banɛ ka man nyɛ Keba kɔldaug baba la. Ba wʋsa da kpɛn kennɛ kpa'adi ba nindaa kpa' si'em la ken.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl yammis la Zugsɔb la pa'alim si'el la wʋsa.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛlim ye, Ninsaal biiga, nimbama gban'adnɛ gban'abɛ'ɛd, ka sa'an nidib la bugusim sa'alʋg tempʋʋg kaŋa ni.

english_verse: They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’
translation_verse: Ba ye, Li pʋ kpɛlim bi'ela ka ti pin'il ya' mɛɛbɔ? Tempʋkaŋa anɛ dʋk kanɛ ka ba mɔri dʋgid, ka tinam an ni'im la.

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb Siig la kɛɛn m san'an na, ka Zugsɔb la ye m yɛlim ye, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, Yanamɛ yɛt si'em nwa', Israel nidiba, amaa man mi' linɛ bɛɛ ya pʋtɛn'ɛrin.

english_verse: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!
translation_verse: Ya kʋ nidib bɛdegʋ tempʋkaŋa ni, ka suoraad la pɛ'ɛl nɛ kum.

english_verse: This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem,
translation_verse: “Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, ‘Kum banɛ ka ya kʋʋ lɔbi digil la an ni'im la, ka tempʋʋg la an dʋk la, amaa m na kadi ya yisi li ni.’

english_verse: Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies.
translation_verse: M na kadi ya yis teŋ la ni, ka nɔki ya tis teŋ zʋŋ nidib ka ba namisi ya.

english_verse: You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Sʋ'ʋg la ye li kʋʋ ya, ka m kadi ya saria ka kɛ ka tɔɔg paae ya Israel teŋ titɔndigin; ka ya baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Tempʋkaŋa kʋ an dʋkʋ tisi ya bɛɛ yanam an ni'imi li nii. Man na kadi ya saria ka namisi ya, Israel teŋ la titɔndis baba.

english_verse: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
translation_verse: Ka ya baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la, bɔzugɔ ya pʋ siaki m zi'ela bɛɛ m wada la, amaa ya lɛɛ niŋidi wʋʋ sʋ'ʋlim banɛ giligi ya la niŋid si'em la nɔɔ.”

english_verse: Before I finished speaking, Pelatiah dropped dead. I bowed down and cried out, “Please, Lord God, don't kill everyone left in Israel.” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Tɔ', ka man da nan yɛt on ye m yɛlim si'el la, Pelataya onɛ an Benaya biig la da kpiya. Ka m luu avanba ka kaas kuŋ ye, “Aa! Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba! Fʋ na kʋ Israel nimbanɛ kpɛlim la wʋsaa?” Israel lɛbig la yɛla

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga, fʋ ba'abiis la, ɛɛn fʋ ba'abibanɛ ka fʋn nɛ ban an ziim yinne la, nɛ Israel dim la wʋsa anɛ banɛ ka Jerusalem dim la yɛt ye ya lalli nɛ Zugsɔb la. Ka ye, ‘Tinam ka ba tis teŋ kaŋa ye ti sʋ'oe li.’”

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb da lɛn yɛlim ye, Alazugɔ yɛlimi ba ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, La'an nɛ man mɔri ba keŋ lalli widigi ba kpɛn'ɛs sʋ'ʋlimnamin nɛ tɛɛnsin la, m bɛ nɛ ba zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka ba keŋ.

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: Ba na lɛbi li ni ka vɔn' bada nɛ wina banɛ ka man kis la.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: M na tisi ba pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne linɛ ka ba kʋ bi'es mam, ka nɔk sipaaligi kpɛn'ɛsi ba pʋʋgin. M na yisi ba sʋnya linɛ kpi'em wʋʋ kugir la, ka tisi ba sʋnya linɛ bʋgʋs.

english_verse: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Ala ka ba na nyaŋi dɔlli m gban'ar ka gu'us ka dɔlli m wada la. Ba na aan m nidib, ka mam na aan ba Wina'am.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ nɔki ba sʋnya pɛsigi tisi ba wina nɛ bada banɛ ka man kis la, ban tʋm si'el wʋsa m na kɛ ka li lɛbi ba zugin na. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Ka Kerubnam banɛ mɔr fiilnam la yadigi ba kpʋkpama, ka Israel Wina'am la girima bɛɛ ba zugin.

english_verse: left Jerusalem and stopped at a hill east of the city.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb girima la da yi teŋ la zugʋ keŋ zi'en zuor linɛ zi'e tempʋʋg ya-nya'aŋ baba la zug.

english_verse: Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away,
translation_verse: Siig la da ʋkimi mɔri keŋ yammis banɛ bɛ Babilon teŋin la, ka li anɛ Wina'am Siigi nie pa'alim si'em la. Ka man nyɛ bʋnsi'a la yii m san'an.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga, fʋ bɛ nɛ nimbanɛ tʋbaa ziank ka pʋ siakid sʋʋgin. Ba mɔr nini ka li nar ye ba nyɛt amaa ba pʋ nyɛta, ka mɔr tʋba ka li nar ye ba wʋm, amaa ba pʋ wʋmma, bɔzugɔ ba anɛ nimbanɛ ki'isid.

english_verse: So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are.
translation_verse: “Alazug, Ninsaal biiga, la'asimi fʋ la'ad nintaŋ wʋʋ fʋ zɔtnɛ lɔ'ɔŋid teŋ zʋŋ ka ba nyɛtif, ka naan fʋn bɛ zin'isi'a la tɔɔm keŋ zin'isi'a. Ka daasi'erɛɛ ba na gban'e li gbin, la'an nɛ ban an nimbanɛ pʋ siakid la.

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Ban nan gɔsid la, kibigim vɔɔnr zaŋguomin la ka zii fʋ la'ad la dɔl ani yi.

english_verse: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɔkim la'ad la pa'ali fʋ biankimpiiung zug ban nan gɔt la, ka fʋ zii lii yi sisɔbir win. Lusimi fʋ nindaa, linɛ na kɛ ka fʋ kʋ nyɛt teŋ laa, bɔzugɔ m ye m nɔknɛ fʋn ka fʋ an zanbinnɛ tis Israel nidib la.”

english_verse: I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
translation_verse: Alazug m da niŋ wʋʋ on tisim nɔɔr si'em la. Bɛog da nie ya ka m yisi m la'abanɛ ka m lɔ ye m keŋ teŋ zʋŋʋ an yammʋg la. Ka zaam ma'ae ka m nɔki m nu'usi kibig vɔɔnr zaŋguomin la.

english_verse: The next morning, the Lord
translation_verse: Bɛog da nie ya ka Zugsɔb la pian' tisim ye,

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, Israel nimbanɛ an ki'isʋg dim la pʋ bu'osif ye, “Bɔɔ la ka fʋ maana?”

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Labakaŋa anɛ na'abiig kanɛ bɛ Jerusalem la nɛ Israel nimbanɛ bɛɛ ani la din.”

english_verse: I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye, “Man anɛ zanbinnɛ tisi ya.” Man maal si'el la, lin nɔɔ ye li niŋi ba. Ba na keŋ teŋ zʋŋʋ lieb yammis.

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Na'abiig kanɛ bɛ nɛ ba la na vaae o la'adi zii o biankimpiiung zug ka yii gaad, li ya'a ti an sɔb-sɔb la; ka ba na kibig zaŋguom la ka o dɔl ani gaad. O na ligil o nindaa linɛ na kɛ ka o kʋ nyɛt teŋ la.

english_verse: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.
translation_verse: M na yadigi m zulis la gban'e o, ka mɔr o keŋ Babilon linɛ an Kaldea dim teŋ la, amaa o kʋ nyɛɛ li, ani ka o na kpi.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Banɛ aan o tʋmtʋmnib nɛ o zabzabidib la wʋsa mam na widigi ba ka dɔlisi kʋʋ ba.

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: Man ya'a ti widigi ba dunia wʋsa nɛ tɛɛns wʋsa ni la, ba na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: Amaa m na basi ba sieba ka kʋ kʋʋ ba, kɔ'ɔm nɛ tɔɔg la mɛ kʋ nyaŋi ba, ka linɛ na kɛ ka ban keŋ zin'isi'a wʋsa ba na tiɛn ba tʋʋmkisa la yɛla. Ka na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga, dimmi fʋ diib la nɛ dabiem, ka fʋ ya'a nuudi fʋ ku'om la fʋn on kirim gba-gba-gba.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: Yɛlim teŋ la nidib ye, ‘Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' zaŋi ken banɛ bɛ Jerusalem nɛ Israel teŋin la: Ba na dii ba diib la nɛ dabiem ka nuu ba ku'om la nɛ kikirʋg, bɔzugɔ ba teŋ la na kpɛlim zaalim ka li anɛ sɔ' wʋsa onɛ bɛ teŋ la zugʋ pʋ tʋm linɛ nar la zug.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Tɛɛns banɛ ka nidib pɛ'ɛl la na san'am, ka sʋ'ʋlimnam na kilim sian'anr. Lin ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.’”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga, bɔ siiliŋʋ la ka ba mɔri siilim Israel teŋin la ye, ‘Dabisa la gat ka linɛ ka ba ye li na niŋ la wʋsa nam pʋ niŋɛ’?

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye, ‘Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Man ye m kɛnɛ ka siiliŋ kaŋa kpi, ka ba kʋ lɛn siilimi li ya'as Israel teŋinɛ.” Yɛlimi ba ye, “Saŋa la paae ya ka linɛ ka ba da yɛl ye li na niŋ la wʋsa sid na niŋ.

english_verse: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, banɛ ma'ad ye ba nyɛt la nɛ ziri nɔdi'esidib la kʋ lɛm bɛ Israel nidib la san'an ya'asɛ.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Amaa man onɛ an Zugsɔb la na pian' linɛ ka m bɔɔd ye m maal, ka li sid na niŋ ka kʋ yuugɛ. Yanam banɛ ki'isidim la ya zʋmaʋŋ nwa' ni ka m na kɛ ka man yɛl si'el la wʋsa niŋ.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ala.’”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, Israel nidib la yɛt ye man nie si'eli pa'alif la anɛ yʋma bɛdegʋ sa labaar, ka fʋ pian'adnɛ bɛog sa yɛla ma'aa.

english_verse: So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Alazug yɛlimi ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Man pian' si'el la wʋsa kʋ lɛn yuugɛ ka tʋm, man yɛl si'el la wʋsa na tʋm. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, di'emi m nɔɔr pian'ad linɛ ka m zɛrig Israel nɔdi'esidib banɛ pian'ad linɛ na maal bɛog sa la tisi ba. Pian'am tis banɛ pian'adi ba mɛŋi tɛn'ɛs si'el la ye, Kɛlisimi Zugsɔb la pian'ad!

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, Tɔɔg na paae nɔdi'esidib banɛ an zɔn ka dɔlisidi ba mɛŋi tɛn'ɛsid si'el ka sid pʋ nyɛ si'el la!

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: Israel dima, ya nɔdi'esidib la nwɛnɛ wɛbaas banɛ bɛ dabɔɔdin nɛ.

english_verse: They don't warn the people about coming trouble or tell them how dangerous it is to sin against me.
translation_verse: Ya pʋ mɛ' zaŋguoma la zin'ibanɛ mɔr wɛn la lɛbis ka Zugsɔb zaba dabisir la daar ya'a ti paae li na zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.
translation_verse: Ban pian'ad si'el la anɛ ziri ka ban gɔsidi nyɛt si'el ka yɛt la an faad. Ba yɛt ye, “Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la!” Amaa mam pʋ tʋmi ba. Nɛ lin wʋsa ba yɛt ye ba pian'ad la na niŋ asida.

english_verse: They say they're preaching my messages, but they are full of lies—I did not speak to them!
translation_verse: Yanamɛ pian'ad si'el nɛ yanamɛ gɔsidi nyɛt si'el ka yɛt ye, “Zugsɔb pian'ʋkʋ la, ka li ka' ala la, li ka'anɛ zirii?”

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Ya ziri pian'ad nɛ yanamɛ pʋ nyɛta ka faad la zug ka m zɛrigi ya.” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: M na zan'as nɔdi'esidib banɛ pian'ad ziri ka faad linɛ saa na maal bɛog sa yɛla la. Ba kʋ la'as nɛ m nidib la bɛɛ ba yʋda sɔbi paas Israel dim la ni, bɛɛ ba kpɛn' Israel teŋinɛ. Ala ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la.

english_verse: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.
translation_verse: Ba kpɛn'ɛsidi m nidib la mɔɔg, ka yɛt ye, “Sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛ” ka sumbʋgʋsʋm lɛɛ kae. Ba ya'a mɛ' zaŋguom ka li pʋ mɔr paŋa, ba nɔkid gɔɔrpielli bʋligidi li.

english_verse: But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, yɛlim banɛ bʋligi li nɛ gɔɔrpiel la ye li na li. Saa na ni ka sisi'em nɛ sakuga da'ae li bas teŋin.

english_verse: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
translation_verse: Zaŋguom la ya'a ti li, nidib kʋ bu'osi ya li yɛlaa? Ba sid na bu'os ye, “Gɔɔrpiel la ka ya daa buligi li la bɛ yaanɛ?”

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, M sʋʋnr ya'a ti duoe, m na kɛ ka sisi'etita'ar kena, ka m sʋnpɛɛn saŋa, m kɛ ka sakʋdʋg ni ka sakuga luna san'ami li wʋsa.

english_verse: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
translation_verse: Man na nwa'ae zaŋguom kanɛ ka ya nɔk gɔɔrpielli bʋlig la nyain ti paae li ɛɛnbir la; ka ɛɛnbir la mɛŋ nie paalʋ, ka li liig la pʋʋgin yanam mɛ na kpi, ka ba baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead,
translation_verse: Linzug zaŋguom la na nyɛ tɔɔg la'an nɛ banɛ nɔk gɔɔrpielli buligi li la. M na yɛli ya ye, “Zaŋguom la gaad ya, la'an nɛ banɛ buligi li la,

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:
translation_verse: nɔdi'esidib banɛ bɛ Israel ka yɛt Jerusalem dim ye si'el wʋsa an nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm ka li mɛ ka' sumbʋgʋsʋm la.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, now condemn the women of Israel who preach messages that come from their own imagination.
translation_verse: Nannanna, Ninsaal biiga, fɛndigimi fʋ nindaa kpa' pu'a banɛ pian'ad nɔdi'esʋg pian'ad nɛ ba mɛŋ ya'am la, ka di'e m nɔɔr pian'ad linɛ ka m zɛrigi ba la

english_verse: Tell them they're doomed! They wear magic charms on their wrists and scarves on their heads, then trick others into believing they can predict the future. They won't get away with telling those lies.
translation_verse: tisi ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Tɔɔg bɛ pu'a banɛ nɔk sɔɔng nɛ tima nɛ piena linɛ wa'alim pʋ zem taabaa ligili ba zut ye ba bɛlis nidibi nyaŋi ba la. Ya na san'am man nidib la nyɔvʋr ka yanam din lɛɛ bɛɛ?

english_verse: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
translation_verse: Diib bi'ela zug ka ya san'am man yʋ'ʋr nidib la san'an. Ya ma'ad ziri tisid nimbanɛ kɛlisid ziri pian'ad la, ya kʋ banɛ pʋ nar ye ba kpii, ka bas banɛ pʋ narin ye ba vʋe la.”

english_verse: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.
translation_verse: Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “M sʋnf pʋ malis nɛ ya yuomʋg tiim linɛ ka ya mɔri yuomid nidib ka li nwɛnɛ niimis ka ba gban'e ba kpɛn'ɛs tiita dɔɔgin la. M na aansi ba yisi ya kpʋkpama la ni, ka tis nimbanɛ ka ya yuomi ba la yɔlisim wʋʋ niimis nɛ.

english_verse: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: M na aansi ya piena la ka faanm nidib la yisi ya nu'usin, ka ya paŋ la kʋ lɛn nyaŋi ba. Ala ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ man da pʋ kɛ ka sʋnsa'aŋ kena la, ya ma'ad pʋpielnam la nɛ ya ziri pian'ad, ka kpɛmisid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim ye ba da bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka faaɛn ba nyɔvʋrɛ.

english_verse: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Alazug ka ya kʋ lɛn nyɛt ka yɛt linɛ an ziri, bɛɛ bʋgʋdi yɛt linɛ ka' sidaa. M na faanm nidib la yisi ya nu'usin. Ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: One day, some of Israel's leaders came to me and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel kpɛɛmnam la sieba da kɛɛn m san'an naa zin'inɛ m tuon.

english_verse: While they were there, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb labaar la kɛɛn m san'an na ye,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these men have started worshiping idols, though they know it will cause them to sin even more. So I refuse to give them a message!
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, nimbama nɔknɛ ba sʋnya tis bada, ka nɔk bugusim pʋtɛn'ɛr ka li vi' ba suor. Li nar ye m kɛ ka bama baŋ linɛ na yii m san'an na bɛɛ?

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that if they sin by worshiping idols and then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will give them the answer their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Alazug pian'am tisi ba ka yɛli ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', “Israel nid sɔ' ya'a nɔk o sʋnfʋ tis bada, ka nɔk pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd ka li vi' o suor, ka keŋ nɔdi'es san'an bɔɔd ye o baŋ si'el, mam mɛŋ na yɛl o ka li dɔl wʋʋ o bada la bɔɔdim nar si'em la.

english_verse: When they hear my message, maybe they will see that they need to turn back to me and stop worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: M na niŋ ala ka li sʋŋ ka m nyaŋi maligim paam nimbanɛ wʋsa bɛ Israel ka bas mam ka dɔl bada la.”

english_verse: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.
translation_verse: Dinzug yɛlim Israel nidib la ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa', “Tiakimi! Basimini ya bada la nɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ wʋsa ka ya tʋm la!

english_verse: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer
translation_verse: “Israel nid sɔ', bɛɛ saan kanɛ bɛ nɛ ya, ya'a yis o mɛŋ man san'an ka nɔk o sʋnfʋ dɔl bada ka nɔk pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd ka li vi' o suor ka keŋ nɔdi'es san'an ye o baŋ o yɛl gbin, man mɛŋ na lɛbis o pian'ʋk.

english_verse: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: M sʋnf na duoe nɛ ninkaŋa sɔb hali ka li na an sa'alʋgʋ tis sieba. M na yis o m nidib la san'an. Ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people,
translation_verse: “Ka o ya'a nyaŋi bɛlis nɔdi'es la ka o yɛl o si'el, li anɛ manɛ pan'as nɔdi'es kan la, ka m na yis nɔdi'es kan la m nimbanɛ an Israel dim la sʋʋgin.

english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: Ba na zii ba mɛŋ taal ka li kpanb nɔdi'es la nɛ onɛ kɛɛn o san'an na la.

english_verse: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise. Judgment on a Sinful Nation
translation_verse: Ka li kɛ ka Israel nidib la kʋ lɛm bas mam, bɛɛ budimi ba mɛŋ nɛ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsaa. Ba na aan m nidib ka mam na aan ba Wina'am.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Tɔɔg linɛ ka sɔ' kʋ pɔnsɛ

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da pian' tisim ye,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga, teŋ si'a dim ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛdi san'ami m sʋnf ka li anɛ ye ba ka'anɛ sida dima, ka m gban'e ye m namisi ba ka ba kʋ nyɛ diibɔ, ka kɛ ka kɔ'ɔm lu teŋ la zugʋ kʋʋ ba nidib nɛ ba bʋnkɔnbid,

english_verse: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living in that nation, their faithfulness would not save anyone but themselves.
translation_verse: hali baa Noa nɛ Daniel nɛ Job ya'a pʋn bɛ teŋ kan la ni, ba na nyaŋi faaɛn ba mɛŋ ka li anɛ ba pʋpielim la zug.” Man Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Or suppose I punish a nation by sending wild animals to eat people and scare away every passerby, so that the land becomes a barren desert.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ m ya'a kɛ ka wɛog bʋnkɔnbid kpɛn' teŋ kan ni kʋ sɔ' wʋsa ka li kpɛlim zaalim, ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi dɔl ani gaadɛ, ka li anɛ bʋnkɔnbid la yɛla,

english_verse: As surely as I live, I promise that even if these three men lived in that nation, their own children would not be spared. The three men would live, but the land would be an empty desert.
translation_verse: man Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛt ye asida sida, hali baa nidiba atan' nwa' ya'a bɛ teŋ kan la ni, ba kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ba mɛŋ biribis nɛ bipumisɛ. Bam mɛŋ ma'aa na paam faangir amaa teŋ la na kpɛlim zaalim.

english_verse: Or suppose I send an enemy to attack a sinful nation and kill its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ m ya'a kɛ ka zaba lu teŋ kan ni ka yɛl ye, Li tiigim teŋ la wʋsa, ka kʋ nidib nɛ ba bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa,

english_verse: If these three men were in that nation when I punished it, not even their children would be spared. Only the three men would live.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛt ye asida sida, hali baa nimbama atan' nwa' ya'a bɛ teŋ kan ni, ba kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ba mɛŋ biribis nɛ bipumisɛ. Bam mɛŋ ma'aa na paam faangir.

english_verse: And suppose I am so angry that I send a deadly disease to wipe out the people and livestock of a sinful nation.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ m sʋnf ya'a pɛlig ka m kɛ ka ban'abɛ'ɛd lu teŋ la zugʋ kʋʋd dap nɛ bʋnkɔnbid,

english_verse: Again, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, I, the Lord, promise that the children of these faithful men would also die. Only the three of them would be spared.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛt ye, asida sida, hali baa Noa nɛ Daniel nɛ Job ya'a bɛɛn teŋ kan la ni, ba kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ba mɛŋ biribis nɛ bipumisɛ. Ba na faaɛnnɛ ba mɛŋ ma'aa ba pʋpielim la zug.

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I promise to punish Jerusalem severely. I will send war, starvation, wild animals, and deadly disease to slaughter its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “M ya'a ti tʋm na'amistitada anaasi banɛ an zaba nɛ kɔ'ɔm nɛ wɛog bʋnyuos nɛ ban'abɛ'ɛd Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la na ka li kʋ nidib nɛ ba bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa, li na tɔi gaad ala.

english_verse: And those who survive will be taken from their country and led here to Babylonia. Ezekiel, when you see how sinful they are, you will know why I did all these things to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala sieba na tilig; biribis nɛ bipumis na yii li pʋʋgin na. Ba na kɛɛn ya san'an na, ka ya ya'a nyɛɛ ba bɛllim nɛ ba tʋʋma, li na bʋgʋli ya sʋnya zaŋi ken san'auŋ kanɛ ka m kɛ ka li paae Jerusalem la.

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛlim ye,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, what happens to the wood of a grapevine after the grapes have been picked? It isn't like other trees in the forest,
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, li niŋ wala ka vain tiig wil na an sʋm gat tikanɛ wʋsa bɛ sian'arinɛ?

english_verse: because the wood of a grapevine can't be used to make anything, not even a small peg to hang things on.
translation_verse: Ba nam mi' nwaae li willi maal si'el sʋ'ʋŋaa? Ba mɔri li maan kpadaa kpa'adi ya'an la'adɛ?

english_verse: It can only be used as firewood. But after its ends are burnt and its middle is charred, it can't be used for anything.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a nɔki li nyu'oe bugum ka li nɔya ayi' la wʋsa di ka li teŋsʋk la lieb saanna, li tʋʋm lɛn an bɔ?

english_verse: The wood is useless before it is burned, and afterwards, it is completely worthless.
translation_verse: Bʋn la ya'a an bʋmmum ka ka' tʋʋmmɛ, bugum dii li la ka li na mɔr tʋʋmmɛɛ?

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise that just as the wood of a grapevine is burned as firewood,
translation_verse: “Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, Man kɛ ka ba vuoɛn tuŋ la niŋ bugumin si'em la, ala mɛn ka m na niŋ nɛ m nimbanɛ bɛ Jerusalem la.

english_verse: I will punish the people of Jerusalem with fire. Some of them have escaped one destruction, but soon they will be completely burned. And when that happens, you, Ezekiel, will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mam na tɛɛgi ba tʋba, la'an nɛ ban nyaŋi yi bugumin la, bugum la na ba'asi dii ba. Ka m ya'a tɛɛgi ba tʋba ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: I will make their country an empty wasteland, because they have not been loyal to me. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka teŋ la kpɛlim dabɔɔd, bɔzugɔ ba ka' sida dima.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, remind the people of Jerusalem of their disgusting sins
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, yɛlim Jerusalem dimi ba tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka ba tʋm la yɛla

english_verse: and tell them that I, the Lord God, am saying: Jerusalem, you were born in the country where Canaanites lived. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛt Jerusalem si'em nwa': Ba da du'a fʋ yaanam nɛ Keenan teŋin; fʋ saam da anɛ Ammon nid ka fʋ ma an Hitti buudi.

english_verse: When you were born, no one cut you loose from your mother or washed your body. No one rubbed your skin with salt and olive oil, and wrapped you in warm blankets.

translation_verse: Ka m gat ka nyɛ fʋn digi fʋ ziimin la bilim, ka fʋn digi ani la ka m yɛlif ye, “Vʋe!”

translation_verse: Manɛ kɛ ka fʋ nɔbig wʋʋ tiig nɛ, fʋ nɔbignɛ hali vɛnl ka fʋ bin'isa lu ka fʋ zuobid nɔbig, amaa fʋ da nan kpɛn anɛ biel ka dig zaalim.

translation_verse: “Lin nya'aŋ ka m lɛn gat ya'as ka nyɛ ka fʋ yʋ'ʋn nɔbigi siak li'ab la, ka m nɔki m fuug nɔɔri ligili fʋ nyan. Ka kaanbi zi'el, ka mɛ naal nɔnaar nɛf ka fʋ lieb man din. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: I washed the blood off you and rubbed your skin with olive oil.
translation_verse: M da sʋʋf nɛ ku'om ka pie fʋ ziim la ka nɔk kpaam suonf.

translation_verse: M nɔk pien fuvɛnliŋi yɛɛlif, ka nɔk gbauŋ ta'ada pidif, ka nɔk fusʋŋi pilif, ka ligilif nɛ fubanɛ ligidi kpi'em.

english_verse: I gave you bracelets, a necklace,
translation_verse: Manɛ duorif nɛ baans nɛ niŋgɔnkɔris,
