translation_verse: ka nɔk baŋi ga'ali fʋ nyɔɔr, ka ga'alif tʋblɛma ka nɔk zupibvɛnliŋi pili fʋ zug.

english_verse: Your jewelry was gold and silver, and your clothes were made of only the finest material and embroidered linen. Your bread was baked from fine flour, and you ate honey and olive oil. You were as beautiful as a queen,
translation_verse: Alazug m da nɔknɛ sanlima nɛ anzurifa bɔbif. Fʋ fuud la da anɛ fusʋma nɛ banɛ ligidii kpi'em nɛ fubanɛ yalim. Fʋ diib da anɛ zɔ'ɔm sʋŋ nɛ siind nɛ olif kpaam. Fʋ yʋ'ʋn vɛnlnɛ hali ka lieb pu'ana'ab.

english_verse: and everyone on earth knew it. I, the Lord God, had helped you become a lovely young woman.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr tiig dunia wʋsa fʋ vɛnlim la zug, ka li anɛ la'abanɛ ka m tisif la kɛ ka fʋ nyɛ vɛnlim kan buudi.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: You learned that you were attractive enough to have any man you wanted, so you offered yourself to every passerby.
translation_verse: “Amaa fʋ ti'enɛ fʋ vɛnlim la, ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr la kɛ ka fʋ lieb pu'agɔɔndir. Fʋ nɔki fʋ ya'amlɛogʋ niŋ onɛ wʋsa gati fʋ san'an, ka fʋ vɛnlim la an on sɔba din.

english_verse: You made shrines for yourself and decorated them with some of your clothes. That's where you took your visitors to have sex with them. These things should never have happened!
translation_verse: Fʋ yɛɛsi fʋ fuud la sieba bɔbi fʋ teŋgbana nɛ ba'ar maalʋg zin'is la ka li vɛnl, ka fʋ maannɛ fʋ pu'agɔɔndir tʋʋma ani. Tʋʋm bannam pʋ sʋ'ʋm ye li tʋmma, bɛɛ lɛn tʋm ya'asɛ.

english_verse: You made idols out of the gold and silver jewelry I gave you, then you sinned by worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: Fʋ mɛ nɔk baŋ sʋma banɛ ka man nɔki m sanlim nɛ anzurifa sʋma maal la kud bada banɛ an dap, ka fʋn nɛ ban san'amid taaba.

english_verse: You dressed them in the clothes you got from me, and you offered them the olive oil and incense I gave you.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ nɔki fʋ fuyalʋŋ la pili ba, ka nɔki m kpaam la nɛ bʋnnyubisa la nyu'oe tisi ba.

english_verse: I supplied you with fine flour, olive oil, and honey, but you sacrificed it all as offerings to please those idols. I, the Lord God, watched this happen.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn, zɔ'ɔm sʋŋ nɛ olif kpaam nɛ siind linɛ ka m tisif ye fʋ di la, fʋ nɔknɛ tisi ba ka li an bʋnnyubisa maannɛ ba tuon. Ala nɔɔ ka li da maal.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: You slaughtered my children, so you could offer them as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Fʋ kʋʋdi m biis la maan maannɛ tisid bada.

english_verse: You were so busy sinning and being a prostitute that you refused to think about the days when you were young and were rolling around naked in your own blood.
translation_verse: Fʋ tʋʋmkisa nɛ pu'agɔɔndir tʋʋm kanɛ ka fʋ tʋm la, fʋ pʋ tiɛn fʋ pu'asatimin yɛlaa, fʋn da an biel nɛ sawɛɛnri digi fʋ ziim la pʋʋgini bilim la.

english_verse: where you disgraced yourself by having sex with anyone who walked by. And you did that more and more every day!
translation_verse: Tempʋʋg la suoya wʋsa zug fʋ mɛɛ fʋ teŋgbana ka li san'ami fʋ vɛnlim, ka nɔki fʋ niŋgbina la maan dian'ad tʋʋma amɛŋa tisid onɛ wʋsa gat.

english_verse: To make me angry, you even offered yourself to Egyptians, who were always ready to sleep with you.
translation_verse: Fʋ san'am Egipt dap, banɛ aan fʋ kpi'es banɛ ka fʋ mɔr kʋkɔma'asim nɛ ba ka li kɛ ka m sʋnf duoe nɛ fʋ dian'ad linɛ ka fʋ tʋm ka nan kpɛn ken tuonnɛ tʋm la.

english_verse: So I punished you by letting those greedy Philistine enemies take over some of your territory. But even they were offended by your repulsive behavior.
translation_verse: Alazug m tiɛn m nu'ug ye m tisif tɔɔg ka bu'oe fʋ titɔndis la. M nɔki fʋ tisi fʋ dataas banɛ an Filistia dim pu'ayuos banɛ ka li da paki ba nɛ ban da nyɛ dian'ad tʋʋma linɛ ka fʋ da tʋm la.

english_verse: You couldn't get enough sex, so you chased after Assyrians and slept with them. You still weren't satisfied,
translation_verse: Fʋ da dig nɛ Asiria dim la mɛn, bɔzugɔ fʋ da pʋ tigid si'el si'ela, la'an nɛ wala lin nya'aŋ la li da pʋ siaki fɔ.

english_verse: so you went after Babylonians. But those merchants could not satisfy you either.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ maligim paasi fʋ pu'agɔɔndir tʋʋma la hali ti paae Babilon dim banɛ an kpikpinkpinnib la, hali la'an nɛ wala li da pʋ tigi fɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say that you were so disgusting that you would have done anything to get what you wanted.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ka fʋ kʋ tun'e mɔri fʋ mɛŋa?” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Ka fʋ niŋid nɛ'ɛŋanam wʋsa wʋʋ pu'agɔɔndir onɛ pʋ zɔt nyannɛ!

english_verse: You had sex on every street corner, and when you finished, you refused to accept money. That's worse than being a prostitute!
translation_verse: Fʋ mɛɛ fʋ maana zin'is la zin'ig wʋsa tempʋʋg la suoya ni, ka maali fʋ dig zin'ig la paalʋ zin'ig wʋsa tempʋʋgin la, amaa fʋ da pʋ lɛn nwɛnɛ pu'agɔɔndirɛ, bɔzugɔ fʋ da pʋ di'esid yɔɔdɛ.

english_verse: You are nothing but an unfaithful wife who would rather have sex with strangers than with your own husband.
translation_verse: Fʋn kanɛ an pu'agɔɔndirɛ, fʋ nɔŋnɛ dap banɛ an saamme gati fʋ mɛŋ sid!

english_verse: Prostitutes accept money for having sex, but you bribe men from everywhere to have sex with you.
translation_verse: Pu'agɔɔndir wʋsa di'esid yɔɔd, amaa fʋn lɛɛ tisid banɛ dig nɛf la piini, ka da'adi ba zin'ig wʋsa ye ba kena digin nɛf.

english_verse: You're not like other prostitutes. Men don't ask you for sex—you offer to pay them! Jerusalem Must Be Punished The Lord said:
translation_verse: Pu'agɔɔnda la sʋʋgin fʋ bɛ nɛ fʋ kɔn' nɛ fʋ taaba; sɔ' pʋ zɔti dɔllif ye o nɔk o mɛŋi la'as nɛ fɔ. Fʋ bɛ nɛ fʋ kɔn', fʋnɛ lɛɛ yɔɔd ka sɔ' pʋ yɔɔdi tisidi fɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you prostitute, listen to me.
translation_verse: Alazug pu'agɔɔndirɛɛ, wʋm Zugsɔb la labaar!

english_verse: You chased after lovers, then took off your clothes and had sex. You even worshiped disgusting idols and sacrificed your own children as offerings to them.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, Fʋ yisi fʋ arezak ka yisi fʋ nyan paalʋ fʋ dian'ad tʋʋma nɛ banɛ dɔllif la ni, nɛ fʋ wina banɛ ka man kisi ba la, nɛ fʋn nɔki fʋ biis ziim tisi ba la zug,

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will gather every one of your lovers, those you liked and those you hated. They will stand around you, and I will rip off your clothes and let all of those lovers stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: m ye m la'as nɛ banɛ wʋsa ka fʋ nɔŋ ka dit malisim nɛ ba la nɛ banɛ ka fʋ kis la. M na la'asi ba wʋsa na ka ba kisigif, ka yɛɛsi fʋ la'adi ba tuon ka ba na nyɛɛ fʋ nyan.

english_verse: I will find you guilty of being an unfaithful wife and a murderer, and in my fierce anger I will sentence you to a violent death!
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka fʋ nyɛ namisʋg wʋʋ pu'a banɛ san'am dap nɛ banɛ kʋʋd nidib namisʋgʋ an si'em la. M na kɛ ka ninkʋʋr tɔɔg nɛ m sʋnf duor namisʋg la sigi fʋ zugin na,

english_verse: Then I will hand you over to your lovers, who will tear down the places where you had sex. They will take your clothes and jewelry, leaving you naked and empty-handed.
translation_verse: ka m yʋ'ʋn nɔki fʋ tis banɛ dig nɛf la ka ba na san'ami fʋ bada nɛ fʋ teŋgbana la. Ba na yɛɛsi fʋ fuud la ka yisi fʋ baans nɛ niŋgɔnkɔrsʋma la ka basif biel.

english_verse: Your lovers and an angry mob will stone you to death; they will cut your dead body into pieces
translation_verse: Ba na la'as nidib na ka ba zab nɛf, ba na lɔbif nɛ kuga ka nɔki ba sʋ'ʋsi ki'e fʋ bɛnnim-bɛnnim.

english_verse: and burn down your houses. Other women will watch these terrible things happen to you. I promise to stop you from being a prostitute and paying your lovers for sex.
translation_verse: Ba na nyɔ'ɔ fʋ ya' la, ka kɛ ka fʋ nyɛ tɔɔg pu'ab bɛdegʋ tuon. M na kɛ ka fʋ bas pu'agɔɔndir tʋʋma, ka fʋ mɛ kʋ lɛn yɔ banɛ dig nɛf la.

english_verse: You made me furious by doing all these disgusting things and by forgetting how I took care of you when you were young. Then you made things worse by acting like a prostitute. You must be punished! I, the Lord God, have spoken. Jerusalem's Two Sisters The Lord said:
translation_verse: Fʋn pʋ tiɛn man tʋm si'eli tisi fʋ, fʋ pu'asatim saŋa, amaa ka duodi m sʋʋnr nɛ yɛlbama la, m na ba'asi kɛ ka fʋn tʋm si'el la lɛbi fʋ mɛŋ zugin na. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Fʋ pʋ zaŋ nyamisi paas tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka fʋ pʋn tʋm la zugɔɔ?

english_verse: People will use this saying about you, Jerusalem: “If the mother is bad, so is her daughter.”
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa siilim siilima na siilim siiliŋ kaŋa fʋ yɛla ye, “O maa an si'em la, bipuŋ la mɛ anɛ ala.”

english_verse: You are just like your mother, who hated her husband and her own children. You are also like your sisters, who hated their husbands and children. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
translation_verse: Fʋ sid anɛ fʋ ma bipuŋ amɛŋa, onɛ nɛ'ɛs o sid nɛ o biis; fʋ bier nɛ fʋ pitʋ la sid anɛ fʋ mabiis; bam mɛ nɛ'ɛsi ba sidib nɛ ba biis. Fʋ ma da anɛ Hitti buudi ka fʋ saam an Ammon buudi.

english_verse: Your older sister was Samaria, that city to your north with her nearby villages. Your younger sister was Sodom, that city to your south with her nearby villages.
translation_verse: Fʋ bieri da an Samaria onɛ da zin' kpi'e nɛf ya-datiuŋ baba la, ka fʋ pitʋ mɛ an Sodom onɛ bɛ ya-dagɔbʋg baba nɛ o bipumis la.

english_verse: You followed their way of life and their wicked customs, and soon you were more repulsive than they were.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋ dɔlli ba suoya ka tu'asidi ba tʋʋmyaalis la ma'aanɛ, amaa fʋ si'el wʋsa pʋʋgin fʋ yʋ'ʋn tʋm tʋʋmyɔɔdi gati ba.

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, the people of Sodom and its nearby villages were never as sinful as you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', Asida sida ka m yɛt ye fʋ pitʋ Sodom nɛ o pu'ayuos la pʋ tʋm wʋʋ fʋn nɛ fʋ bipumisi tʋm si'em la.

english_verse: They were arrogant and spoiled; they had everything they needed and still refused to help the poor and needy.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd banɛ ka fʋ pitʋ Sodom nɛ o pu'ayuos la da tʋm anɛ tita'alim ka an dindiisnam nɛ haya dim. Ba da pʋ sʋŋid tadimnam nɛ nɔŋ dim la.

english_verse: They thought they were better than everyone else, and they did things I hate. And so I destroyed them.
translation_verse: Ba da anɛ nyɛɛsim dim ka tʋm tʋʋmkisa man tuon. Alazug ka m san'ami ba wʋʋ fʋn nyɛ si'em la.

english_verse: You people of Jerusalem have sinned twice as much as the people of Samaria. In fact, your evil ways have made both Sodom and Samaria look innocent.
translation_verse: Samaria da pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka fʋ tʋm la pʋsʋkɔ, fʋ tʋm tʋʋmfɛn'ɛsa gaadi ba, ka kɛ ka fʋ bier nɛ fʋ pitʋ la an wʋʋ ba anɛ pʋpielim dim ka li anɛ fʋn tʋm tʋʋm sieba la zug.

english_verse: Someday I will bless Sodom and Samaria and their nearby villages. I will also bless you, Jerusalem.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala m na lɛn kɛ ka Sodom nɛ Samaria dim lɛm paami ba zusʋŋ la ya'as, ka fʋ zusʋŋ la mɛ na dɔlli ba.

english_verse: Then you will be ashamed of how you've acted, and Sodom and Samaria will be relieved that they weren't as sinful as you.
translation_verse: Ka li kɛ ka fʋ zii fʋ nyan la ka nyan gban'af, nɛ bʋmbanɛ wʋsa ka fʋ maal ye li malisi ba la.

english_verse: When that day comes, you and Sodom and Samaria will once again be well-off, and all nearby villages will be restored.
translation_verse: Ka Sodom nɛ Samaria dim na lɛbi an ban da an si'em la, ka fʋn nɛ fʋ nidib mɛ na lɛbi an wʋʋ yanamɛ da an si'em la.

english_verse: But now everyone has learned how wicked you really are. The countries of Syria and Philistia, as well as your other neighbors, hate you and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la da nam pʋ yi paalʋ na la, fʋ da pʋ siakid ye fʋ pʋdig Sodom yʋ'ʋrɛ, dabiskanɛ ka fʋ da mɔr nyɛɛsim la. Nannanna Edom nidib yʋ'ʋn la'adif nɛ ba kpi'es wʋsa nɛ Filistia dim wʋsa, nɛ banɛ wʋsa giligif la nɛ'ɛsidif nɛ.

english_verse: You must pay for all the vulgar and disgusting things you have done. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Makes a Promise to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Fʋn pʋ dɔl wadaa ka tʋm tʋʋmkisa la, li na lɛbi fʋ mɛŋ zugin na. Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you deserve to be punished, because you broke your promises and ignored our agreement.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “M na tʋmif wʋʋ lin nar si'em, bɔzugɔ mam nɛ fʋ maal nɔnaar si'a la fʋ san'ami li bas.

english_verse: But I remember the agreement I made with you when you were young, and so I will make you a promise that will last forever.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala m na tiɛn nɔnaar kanɛ ka m da naal nɛf fʋ pu'asatim saŋa la, ka na kɛ ka nɔnaar la zi'en saŋa kanɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: When you think about how you acted, you will be ashamed, especially when I return your sisters to you as daughters, even though this was not part of our agreement.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a ti di'e fʋ mabiis la, fʋ na tiɛn fʋ suoya la yɛla ka nyan gban'af. Fʋ sid na di'e ba, banɛ kpɛmmif nɛ banɛ pʋ kpɛmmif la wʋsa. M na nɔki ba tisif ka ba nwɛnɛ fʋ bipumis nɛ, ka lin lɛɛ pʋ dɔl nɛ nɔnaar kanɛ ka m naal nɛf laa.

english_verse: I will keep this solemn promise, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Alazug man nɛ fʋn nɔnaar la na zi'en ka fʋ baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: I will forgive you, but you will think about your sins and be too ashamed to say a word. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ka m ya'a maal suguru ka bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛbanɛ wʋsa ka fʋ tʋm la, fʋ na tiɛn ka nyan gban'af, ka fʋ kʋ lɛn ya'ae nɔɔr ya'asɛ ka li anɛ nyan zug.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel the following story,
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, bɔɔm siiliŋʋ siilim tis Israel dim la.

english_verse: so they will understand what I am saying to them: A large eagle with strong wings and beautiful feathers once flew to Lebanon. It broke the top branch off a cedar tree,
translation_verse: Yɛlimi ba ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, Abaar tita'ari da bɛ, ka o kpʋkpama kpi'em ka o kɔnbid wa'am ka zu'oe ka pɔnri vɛnl hali. O da keŋ Lebanon teŋin na gban'e na'aziinr tiig wilkanɛ bɛɛ agɔla la,

english_verse: then carried it to a nation of merchants and left it in one of their cities.
translation_verse: ka kɔ'ɔgi li mɔri keŋ banɛ kpiisid teŋin la sɛ kpikpinkpinnib la paalʋ ni.

english_verse: The eagle also took a seed from Israel and planted it in a fertile field with plenty of water, like a willow tree beside a stream.
translation_verse: Ka nɔki ya teŋ la bʋmbʋʋda sieba keŋ bʋd kʋ'ʋlʋm zin'ig. O da sɛɛ li wʋʋ gʋʋŋ nɛ kpi'el zin'ikanɛ ka ku'om zu'oe,

english_verse: The seed sprouted and grew into a grapevine that spread over the ground. It had lots of leaves and strong, deep roots, and its branches grew upward toward the eagle.
translation_verse: ka li busi tɔn wila, ka lieb tikanɛ wan ka yaarim-yaarim. Ka li wila la tɔɔn lɛbidi abaar la san'an, ka li nya'a la lɛɛ kpɛlimmi li gbinnin. Alazug, li da tɔn wila sʋ'ʋŋa ka mɔr vaand bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: There was another eagle with strong wings and thick feathers. The roots and branches of the grapevine soon turned toward this eagle, hoping it would bring water for the soil.
translation_verse: Amaa abaar tita'asi'a mɛ da bɛ mɔr kpʋkpankpi'ema ka o kɔnbid zu'oe. Ka tiig la naan ban sɛɛ o zin'isi'a la tɔn nya'a lɛbid o baba, ka tɔɔn o wila lɛbisid o baba bɔɔd ku'om.

english_verse: But the vine was already growing in fertile soil, where there was plenty of water to produce healthy leaves and large grapes.
translation_verse: Ba da sɛɛ o nɛ kʋ'ʋlʋm zin'igi kpi'el zin'ikanɛ ka ku'om zu'oe, linɛ na kɛ ka o tɔn wila ka wal wala ka lieb titita'ar linɛ vɛnl hali.

english_verse: Now tell me, Ezekiel, do you think this grapevine will live? Or will the first eagle pull it up by its roots and pluck off the grapes and let its new leaves die? The eagle could easily kill it without the help of a large and powerful army.
translation_verse: “Yɛlimi ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la bu'osi ba ye, ‘O na vʋ'ʋgɛɛ? Ba kʋ vuoɛn ka fanr o wala la ka o kʋdigɛɛ? Ba sid na vuoɛn! O wilpɔla banɛ tɔn la wʋsa na kʋdig, li ka' paŋ sɔb bɛɛ nidib bɛdegʋ na vuoɛn o nɛ o nya'a la wʋsa.

english_verse: The grapevine is strong and healthy, but as soon as the scorching desert wind blows, it will quickly wither. The Lord Explains the Story
translation_verse: Ba ya'a lɛn sɛ o, o na vʋ'ʋgɛɛ? Saŋkan la nya'aŋ pɛbisʋg ya'a da'ae gɛɛl o, o kʋ kʋdig nyainnɛɛ? O kʋ kʋdig ban sɛ o ka o nɔbig zin'isi'a laa?’”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛlim ye,

english_verse: Ezekiel, ask the rebellious people of Israel if they know what this story means. Tell them that the king of Babylonia came to Jerusalem, then he captured the king of Judah and his officials, and took them back to Babylon as prisoners.
translation_verse: Bu'osim nimbanɛ ki'isidim la ye, Ya pʋ baŋ bʋmbama gbinnɛɛ? Yɛlimi ba ye, Babilon na'ab da keŋ Jerusalem gban'e Na'ab la nɛ o kpɛɛmnamɛ mɔri ba lɛb Babilon na.

english_verse: He chose someone from the family of Judah's king and signed a treaty with him, then made him swear to be loyal. He also led away other important citizens,
translation_verse: Ka o gaŋ nid yinne onɛ yi na'adɔɔgin la na naal nɔɔr nɛ o ka kɛ ka o pɔ. O da lɛm gban'e teŋ la tuongatibi keŋ,

english_verse: so that the rest of the people of Judah would obey only him and never gain control of their own country again.
translation_verse: linɛ na kɛ ka sʋ'ʋlim la na lu ka kʋ lɛn zi'en ya'asɛ, ka gban'e ye nɔnaar la na kpɛn zi'e.

english_verse: But this new king of Judah later rebelled against Babylonia and sent officials to Egypt to get horses and troops. Will this king be successful in breaking the treaty with Babylonia? Or will he be punished for what he's done?
translation_verse: Amaa Na'ab la da zan'as o ka tʋm o nidib Egipt ye ba da' widi ka mɔr zabzabidib bɛdegʋ na. O ya'a na nyaŋɛ? Onɛ tʋm tʋʋm kaŋa la na pɔnsɛɛ? O na zan'as nɔnaar la ka pɔnsɛɛ?

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I swear that the king of Judah will die in Babylon, because he broke the treaty with the king of Babylonia, who appointed him king.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pɔya ye, O na kpi Babilon na'akanɛ diis o na'am la teŋin, on pɔ nɔɔr ka zan'as ka gban'e nɔnaar ka san'ami li la.

english_verse: Even the king of Egypt and his powerful army will be useless to Judah when the Babylonians attack and build towers and dirt ramps to destroy the cities of Judah and its people.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Babilon dim ya'a kena gilig o tempʋʋg la ye ba zabi kʋ nidib bɛdegʋ, na'ab Faaro nɛ o zabzabidib bɛdegʋ la, kʋ nyaŋi sʋŋ o zaba la nii.

english_verse: The king of Judah broke his own promises and ignored the treaty with Babylonia. And so he will be punished!
translation_verse: O da nɛ'ɛs nɔpɔɔr la nɛ ka san'am nɔnaar la. Ka on sadigim siak kaanbʋg la, ka lɛn sin ka tʋm nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa la o kʋ pɔnsɛ.

english_verse: He made a promise in my name and swore to honor the treaty. And now that he has broken that promise, my name is disgraced. He must pay for what he's done.
translation_verse: Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la ye, Asida sida m nɔpɔɔr kanɛ ka o zan'as la nɛ nɔnaar linɛ ka o san'am la, m na kɛ ka li luu o mɛŋ zugin na.

english_verse: I will spread out a net to trap him. Then I will drag him to Babylon and see that he is punished for his unfaithfulness to me.
translation_verse: M na yadigi m bɛndig la ka li gban'e o, m na mɔr o kɛn Babilon na ka kad o saria ani, on ka' sida sɔbi tis mam la zug.

english_verse: His best troops will be killed in battle, and the survivors will be scattered in every direction. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: O zabzabidib banɛ zɔt la wʋsa na kpi, ka banɛ kpɛlim la na widig zin'ig wʋsa. Ka ya na baŋ ye man kanɛ an Zugsɔb la pian' ya.

english_verse: Someday, I, the Lord, will cut a tender twig from the top of a cedar tree, then plant it on the peak of Israel's tallest mountain,
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la ye, Mam mɛŋ na kɔ'ɔg na'aziinr tiig la willi sɛɛ li. M na kɔ'ɔg wilpɔl kanɛ bɛ zugin-zugin la sɛɛ li zuokanɛ dʋ ka mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm la zug.

english_verse: where it will grow strong branches and produce large fruit. All kinds of birds will find shelter under the tree, and they will rest in the shade of its branches.
translation_verse: Israel zuor la zug ka m ye m sɛɛ li, li na tɔn wila ka wal wala ka kilim titita'ar. Niimis nɛ ba buudi wʋsa na tɛ tɛɛdi li zug, ka paam ma'asim li wila la ni.

english_verse: Every tree in the forest will know that I, the Lord, can bring down tall trees and help short ones grow. I dry up green trees and make dry ones green. I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will keep my word.
translation_verse: Tibanɛ bɛ teŋ la zug wʋsa na baŋ ye man onɛ an Zugsɔb la kɛt ka tikanɛ wa'am liebid giŋa ka tikanɛ gim liebid tiwɔk. Manɛ kɛt ka tima'asir kʋdigid ka tikpi'euŋ liebid tima'asir.” “Man kanɛ an Zugsɔb la pian', ka sid na maal ala.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, I hear the people of Israel using the old saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: “Bɔzug ka ya siilim siiliŋ kaŋa Israel teŋ la yɛla ye, “‘Ba'anam ɔnb li'ema, ka biis nyina gbi'ida?’”

english_verse: Now tell them that I am the Lord God, and as surely as I live, that saying will no longer be used in Israel.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la ye, Asida, sida ka m yɛt ye, ya kʋ lɛn siilim siiliŋ kaŋa Israel teŋinɛ.

english_verse: The lives of all people belong to me—parents as well as children. However, only those who sin will be put to death.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ onɛ vʋe wʋsa anɛ man din, saamnam nɛ ba biis wʋsa anɛ man din. Onɛ wʋsa tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, o sɔbi na kpi.

english_verse: Suppose there is a truly good man who always does what is fair and right.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ pʋpielim sɔb ya'a bɛ ka tʋm linɛ an sʋm ka dɔl suor,

english_verse: He refuses to eat meat sacrificed to foreign gods at local shrines or to worship Israel's idols. He doesn't have sex with someone else's wife or with a woman having her monthly period.
translation_verse: ka pʋ dit diib banɛ ka ba maannɛ tisid teŋgbana banɛ bɛ zuoya zug la bɛɛ ti'e bada banɛ ka Israel dim dɔl la, ka pʋ san'amid o kpi'a pu'a bɛɛ dig nɛ pu'a saŋa kanɛ ka o lu nu'ugɔ,

english_verse: He never cheats or robs anyone and always returns anything taken as security for a loan; he gives food and clothes to the poor
translation_verse: ka pʋ mugusid sɔ'ɔsɔ amaa o lɛbisid linɛ wʋsa ka sɔ' kena digil ka pɛ'ɛŋ si'el o san'an la. O pʋ faand nidiba amaa o mɔr o diibi tisid banɛ kɔ'ɔm zabid ka banɛ ken biel ka o tisidi ba fuud.

english_verse: and doesn't charge interest when lending money. He refuses to do anything evil; he is fair to everyone
translation_verse: O pʋ pɛmisid ligidi nyɔɔd yɛlaa bɛɛ pa'an nyɔɔdi li zugini galisida. O gban'ad o mɛŋ ka pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, ka nidib ayi' ya'a mɔr yɛl, o kati li saria nɛ sida.

english_verse: and faithfully obeys my laws and teachings. This man is good, and I promise he will live.
translation_verse: O siakidi m wada ka dɔlli m zi'ela nɛ sida. Ninkan sɔb anɛ pʋpiel, o sid na vʋe. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: But suppose this good man has an evil son who is violent and commits sins
translation_verse: Li ya'a nwɛnɛ o mɔri bikanɛ tʋm gɛɛntʋʋma, ka kʋʋd nidib, bɛɛ tʋm tʋʋm banɛ ka m kaal la tis o ba'abiig

english_verse: his father never did. He eats meat at local shrines, has sex with someone else's wife,
translation_verse: ka niŋid bʋmbanɛ wʋsa ka o saam pʋ niŋida, ka dit teŋgban banɛ bɛ zuoya ni la diib, ka dig nɛ o kpi'es pu'ab,

english_verse: cheats the poor, and robs people. He keeps what is given to him as security for a loan. He worships idols, does disgusting things,
translation_verse: ka mugusid nɔŋ dim nɛ tadimnam, ka faand nidib, ka pʋ lɛbisid linɛ ka sɔ' mɔr na digil ka pɛ'ɛŋ si'el o san'anɛ, ka dɔl bada, ka tʋm tʋʋmkisa,

english_verse: and charges high interest when lending money. An evil man like that will certainly not live. He is the one who has done these horrible sins, so it's his own fault that he will be put to death.
translation_verse: ka pɛ'ɛmisid nidib nyɔɔd yɛla ka pa'an nyɔɔd ka li gat lin nar si'em, ninkan sɔb nar ye o vʋyaa? Ayei o pʋ nara! Bɔzugɔ on tʋm tʋʋmkisbama la, li anɛ tilas ye ba kʋʋ o, ka o ziim na bɛɛ o mɛŋ zugin.

english_verse: But suppose this evil man has a son who sees his father do these things and refuses to act like him.
translation_verse: Amaa li ya'a nwɛnɛ bikaŋa mɛ mɔr o mɛŋ biig, ka o nyɛɛ o saamme tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛsi'a la wʋsa, ka pʋ tu'asi tʋmmi lii:

english_verse: He doesn't eat meat at local shrines or worship Israel's idols, and he doesn't have sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: O pʋ dit diib linɛ ka ba maan teŋgbana la nii bɛɛ dɔl teŋgbana banɛ ka Israel dim dɔl la. O pʋ dig nɛ o kpi'es pu'aba.

english_verse: He never cheats or robs anyone and doesn't even demand security for a loan. He gives food and clothes to the poor
translation_verse: O pʋ mukid sɔ'ɔsɔ bɛɛ digil lauk ka nyaan pɛ'ɛŋ si'eli tis o kpi'esɛ. O pʋ faand nidiba amaa o nɔkid o diibi tisid banɛ kɔ'ɔm zabid ka tisid banɛ ken biel la fuud.

english_verse: and refuses to do anything evil or to charge interest. And he obeys all my laws and teachings. Such a man will live. His own father sinned, but this good man will not be put to death for the sins of his father.
translation_verse: O gban'ad o mɛŋ ka pʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ ka mɛ pʋ pɛmisid ka pa'an nyɔɔd bɛdegʋʋ. O dɔlli m wada nɛ m zi'ela la. On sɔb kʋ nyaŋi kpii o saam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛlaa, o na ba'asi vʋe.

english_verse: It is his father who will die for cheating and robbing and doing evil.
translation_verse: Amaa o saam na kpii o mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla, bɔzugɔ o pɔnrimnɛ ka faand o ba'abiis ka tʋm linɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ o nidib la san'an.

english_verse: You may wonder why a son isn't punished for the sins of his father. It is because the son does what is right and obeys my laws.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala ya bu'osid ye, “Wala ka biig la pʋ namis o saam la taal zugɔ?” O biig la sadigim tʋm linɛ nar ka dɔl suor, ka gu'usid ka dɔlli m wada la, o sid na vʋe.

english_verse: Only those who sin will be put to death. Children won't suffer for the sins of their parents, and parents won't suffer for the sins of their children. Good people will be rewarded for what they do, and evil people will be punished for what they do.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, onɛ na kpi, biig saam yɛla kʋ dɔl oo, biig mɛ yɛla kʋ dɔl o saama. Pʋpielim sɔb tʋʋm sʋma na dɔl o, ka bugusim sɔb tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd mɛ na dɔl o.

english_verse: Suppose wicked people stop sinning and start obeying my laws and doing right. They won't be put to death.
translation_verse: Amaa nimbɛ'ɛd ya'a bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd banɛ ka o tʋm la wʋsa ka dɔlli m wada la, ka tʋm linɛ an sida ka dɔl suor, o sid na vʋe; o kʋ kpii.

english_verse: All their sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they did right.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd banɛ ka o tʋm la wʋsa kʋ lɛn dɔl oo. Pʋpielim tʋʋma banɛ ka o tʋm la zug, o na vʋe.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, don't like to see wicked people die. I had much rather see them turn back from their sins and live.
translation_verse: “Li malis nɛ tis mam nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔbi na kpi bɛɛ?” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Ayei! Li lɛɛ malisim nɛ ban na bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka vʋe.

english_verse: But when good people start sinning and doing disgusting things, will they live? No! All their good deeds will be forgotten, and they will be put to death because of their sins.
translation_verse: Amaa pʋpielim sɔb ya'a bas pʋpielim tʋʋma ka tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, nɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka bugusnam tʋm la, o na vʋe bɛɛ? Ayei! Sɔ' kʋ lɛn tiɛn o tʋʋm sʋma banɛ ka o tʋm la. On ka' sida sɔba, nɛ on tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sieba la zug, o na kpi.

english_verse: You people of Israel accuse me of being unfair! But listen—I'm not unfair; you are!
translation_verse: Amaa ya yɛt ye, “Zugsɔb la maan si'el la ka' sidaa.” Tɔ'! Israel nidiba kɛlisimi, man maan si'em la, sida kae anii? Ka' yanam tʋʋma la ka sida lɛɛ kae?

english_verse: If good people start doing evil, they must be put to death, because they have sinned.
translation_verse: Pʋpiel ya'a bas pʋpielim tʋʋma ka pin'ili tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka o tʋm la zug o na kpi.

english_verse: And if wicked people start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.
translation_verse: Amaa bugusim sɔb ya'a bas bugusim tʋʋma, ka tʋm linɛ nar ka dɔl suor, o na faaɛn o nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: They will think about what they've done and stop sinning, and so they won't be put to death.
translation_verse: On sadigim baŋ ye tʋʋm banɛ ka o tʋm la ka' sʋ'ʋm, ka o tiaki yii li ni la, o kʋ kpii, o na vʋe.

english_verse: But you still say that I am unfair. You are the ones who have done wrong and are unfair!
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala Israel dim yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la tʋʋma ka' sʋ'ʋm.” Israel nidiba, man suoya sid ka' sʋ'ʋm? Li lɛɛ ka'anɛ yanam suoya ka' sʋ'ʋm?

english_verse: I will judge each of you for what you've done. So stop sinning, or else you will certainly be punished.
translation_verse: Alazug, Israel nidiba, mam na kad sɔ' wʋsa saria ka li dɔlnɛ o tʋʋma. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Tiakimi! Basimi ya tʋʋmkisa la wʋsa; ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd da kɛ ka ya luu.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and start thinking pure thoughts. And be faithful to me! Do you really want to be put to death for your sins?
translation_verse: Basimi tʋʋm banɛ wʋsa ka ya tʋm ka li ka' sʋ'ʋm la ka paami sʋnf paal nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛpaal. Aa! Israel nidiba, bɔɔ kɛ ka ya ye ya kpi?

english_verse: I, the Lord God, don't want to see that happen to anyone. So stop sinning and live!
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a kpi li pʋ malis mam. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Tiakimi ka vʋe!

english_verse: Ezekiel, sing a funeral song for two of Israel's leaders:
translation_verse: “Kaasim kʋʋr Israel tuongatib yɛla

english_verse: Your mother was a brave lioness who raised her cubs among lions.
translation_verse: ka yɛl ye, “‘Ya ma da anɛ gbigimnya'aŋ kanɛ kpi'em gbigima la sʋʋgin! O da la'am digi nɛ gbigimbibis la ka ugusidi ba.

english_verse: She taught one of them to hunt, and he learned to eat people.
translation_verse: O da gʋ'ʋl o biig yinne, ka o lieb gbigimtita'ari mɔr paŋ. Ka o zamis si'elnam gban'ab ka gban'ad nidibi ɔnbid.

english_verse: When the nations heard of him, they trapped him in a pit, then they used hooks to drag him to Egypt.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns la dim da wʋm o yɛla, ka gban'e o niŋ bʋmbɔkin. Ba da nɔk gu'osi gban'e o tɛɛg o mɔri keŋ Egipt teŋin.

english_verse: His mother waited for him to return. But soon she lost all hope and raised another cub, who also became fierce.
translation_verse: Gbigimnya'aŋ la nyɛ ka o ti'ir la kʋ tʋm la, ka on tɛn'ɛs ye o na nyɛ si'el la kae la, ka o nɔk o bʋmbil yinne ya'asɛ ugus ka o ti lieb gbigimtita'ari mɔr paŋ.

english_verse: Nations plotted to kill him, and people came from all over to spread out a net and catch him in a trap.
translation_verse: Ka tɛɛns la duoe tʋ'ʋs o, tembibis banɛ gilig o la wʋsa. Ba da ya'ae ba zulis ka gur o, ka o kena luu ba bɛndigin.

english_verse: They put him in a cage and took him to Babylonia. The lion was locked away, so that his mighty roar would never again be heard on Israel's hills.
translation_verse: Ba da nɔk gu'osi gban'e o tɛɛgi kpɛn'ɛs kʋnt kʋsɔkin ka mɔr o keŋ tis Babilon na'ab. Ba da nɔk o kpɛn'ɛs sanrega dɔɔgin, ka ba pʋ lɛn wʋm o nwa'amʋg la ya'as Israel zuoya la zugɔ.

english_verse: Your mother was a vine like you, growing near a stream. There was plenty of water, so she was filled with branches and with lots of fruit.
translation_verse: Fʋ ma da lɛn nwɛnɛ tikanɛ wan walsʋma nɛ bɛɛ fʋ vain tiis pɔɔgin la ka ba sɛɛ li kpi'el nɛ ku'om. Li da wan ka mɔr wila bɛdegʋ, ku'om pʋ pansig o la zug.

english_verse: Her strong branches became symbols of authority, and she was taller than all other trees— everyone could see how strong and healthy she was.
translation_verse: Li wila la da kpi'emnɛ ka nar nɛ ban na nɔki li maal na'am dansaar. Li da wa'am nɛ dʋʋ agɔla gat sian'arin tiis la vaand wʋsa, ka nyɛt zin'ig wʋsa li wa'alim la zug nɛ lin mɔr wila bɛdegʋ la zug.

english_verse: But in anger, I pulled her up by the roots and threw her to the ground, where the scorching desert wind dried out her fruit. Her strong branches wilted and burned up.
translation_verse: Amaa ka ba vuoɛn li nɛ sʋnpɛɛnni lɔbi li bas teŋin. Ya-nya'aŋ sisi'em da kɛ ka li kʋdigi gɔbilim ka fanri li wala la; ka li wilkpi'ema la kʋdig ka bugum dii li.

english_verse: Then she was planted in a hot, dry desert,
translation_verse: Nannanna li yʋ'ʋn sɛnɛ pipirigin, zin'ikanɛ kʋdig ka ku'om kae.

english_verse: where her stem caught fire, and flames burned her branches and fruit. Not one strong branch is left; she is stripped bare. This funeral song must be sung with sorrow.
translation_verse: Bugum da naanɛ li wilbɛda la yinne ni yina dii li wala la. Wilkpi'euŋ pʋ lɛn kpɛlimmi li zug ka na'ab na nyaŋi nwaae maal na'am dansaarɛ. Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ sʋnsa'aŋ yɛla ka li nar ye ba yʋ'ʋm sʋnsa'aŋ saŋa ma'aa.’”

english_verse: Seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, some of Israel's leaders came to me on the tenth day of the fifth month. They sat down and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ da an yammisi bɛ teŋ zʋŋ saŋa si'a la, li yʋma ayɔpɔi la, li nwadis anu la ni dabisa piiga la daar, ka Israel kpɛɛmnam la sieba da kɛɛn m san'an na ye ba bu'os Zugsɔb la baŋ linɛ bɛ, ka da zin'ini m tuon.

english_verse: Just then, the Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la labaar kɛɛn m san'an na ye,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these leaders have come to find out what I want them to do. As surely as I live, I will not give them an answer of any kind.
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, pian'am tis Israel kpɛɛmnam la ka yɛli ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Ya kena ye ya bu'os mam baŋɛɛ? Asida sida ka m yɛti ya ye, m kʋ kɛ ka ya bu'osim si'el yɛllɛ” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Are you willing to warn them, Ezekiel? Then remind them of the disgusting sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Fʋ na kadi ba sariaa? Ninsaal biiga, fʋ na kadi ba sariaa? Alazug yɛlimi ba tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka ba yaanam da tʋm la yɛla,

english_verse: Tell them that long ago I, the Lord God, chose Israel to be my own. I appeared to their ancestors in Egypt and made a solemn promise that I would be their God and the God of their descendants.
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Daakanɛ ka m da gaŋ Israel la, m da ʋki m nu'ug ka pɔɔ tis Jakob yaas, ka nie m mɛŋi pa'ali ba Egipt teŋin. M da ʋki m nu'ug ka yɛli ba ye, ‘Manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la.’

english_verse: I swore that I would rescue them from Egypt and lead them to a land I had already chosen. This land was rich with milk and honey and was the most splendid land of all.
translation_verse: Daakan la m da pɔɔ tisi ba ye m na yisi ba Egipt teŋin, mɔri ba keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka man mɛŋ iee ye m tisi ba la, teŋ kanɛ ka bin'isim nɛ siind pʋbid, ka li vɛnli gat tɛɛns wʋsa la.

english_verse: I told them to get rid of their disgusting idols and not to sin by worshiping the gods of Egypt. I reminded them that I was the Lord their God,
translation_verse: M da lɛn yɛli ba ye ba wʋsa yinne-yinne basim bʋmbanɛ ka ba ya'ab ka ti'e ka li ka' sʋŋir la, ka mɛ da san'ami ba mɛŋ nɛ Egipt dim bada laa, Manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la.”

english_verse: but they still rebelled against me. They refused to listen and kept on worshiping their idols and foreign gods. In my anger, I decided to punish the Israelites in Egypt.
translation_verse: Amaa ba da zan'asim ka pʋ kɛlis man yɛt si'el laa; ba da pʋ yis ba'abanɛ kʋ nyaŋi sʋŋi ba laa, bɛɛ kɛɛs Israel dim bada la basɛ. Alazug ka m ye m na kɛ ka tɔɔg luu ba zugin, ka m sʋnf duoe nɛ ba Egipt teŋin.

english_verse: But that would have made me look like a liar, because I had already promised in front of everyone that I would lead them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Amaa m yʋ'ʋr la zug, m da pʋ bɔɔd ye m kɛ ka ba nɛ'ɛsi m yʋ'ʋr la sʋ'ʋlimnam la nii, banɛ nini ni ka m nie m mɛŋi pa'al Israel dim ka yisi ba Egipt teŋin la.

english_verse: So I brought them out and led them into the desert.
translation_verse: Alazug m da yisi ba Egipt teŋin mɔri ba kɛn sian'arin la na.

english_verse: I gave them my laws and teachings, so they would know how to live right.
translation_verse: M da tisi ba m zi'ela, ka kɛ ka ba baŋi m wada la, bɔzugɔ ninkanɛ siaki li la, li na sʋŋ o ka o vʋe.

english_verse: And I commanded them to respect the Sabbath as a way of showing that they were holy and belonged to me.
translation_verse: M mɛ da tisi ba m Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir la ka li an zanbinnɛ ti teŋsʋk, ka ba baŋ ye man kanɛ an Zugsɔb la kɛ ka ba an kasi.

english_verse: But the Israelites rebelled against me in the desert. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath like any other day. Then in my anger, I decided to destroy the Israelites in the desert once and for all.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala ka Israel nidib la ki'isim sian'arin la. Ba da pʋ dɔlli m zi'ela la ka zan'asi m wada la, la'an nɛ onɛ siaki li na paam vʋm la. Ba da san'ami m Vʋ'ʋsʋm Dabisa la. Linzug ka m yɛl ye m sʋnpɛɛn na luu ba zug ka m kʋʋ ba sian'arin la.

english_verse: But that would have disgraced me, because many other nations had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Amaa m yʋ'ʋr la zug, m da mɔ mam na niŋ si'em ka kʋ paam yʋ'ʋbɛ'ɛd tɛɛns banɛ da nyɛ ka m yisi ba la nii.

english_verse: I said this because they had not only ignored my laws and teachings, but had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped idols.
translation_verse: Ka li anɛ ban da zan'asi m wada ka pʋ dɔlli m zi'ela la ka pʋ tis Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la girima la zug. Bɔzugɔ ba da pɛsigi ba sʋnf wʋsa tisi ba bada la.

english_verse: Yet, I felt sorry for them and could not let them die in the desert.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, m da gɔsi ba ka zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig, ka pʋ kʋʋ ba bɛɛ li' ba mɔɔgin la.

english_verse: So I warned the children not to act like their parents or follow their evil ways or worship their idols.
translation_verse: M da yɛli ba biis la sian'arin la ye, Da dɔlli ya saamnam nɔba bɛɛ dɔlli ba wada la, bɛɛ san'ami ya mɛŋ nɛ ba bada laa.

english_verse: I reminded them that I was the Lord their God and that they should obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am; dɔllini m zi'ela la ka siaki m wada la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: I told them to respect my Sabbath to show that they were my people and that I was the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka m Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la an kasi, ka li na an zanbin man nɛ yanam teŋsʋk. Ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ an kasi la.

english_verse: But the children also rebelled against me. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath as any other day. I became angry and decided to punish them in the desert.
translation_verse: “Amaa biis la da zan'as mam. Ba da pʋ dɔlli m zi'ela la, ka mɛ pʋ gu'us ka dɔlli m wada la; la'an nɛ onɛ siaki li na vʋe la. Ba mɛ da san'ami m Vʋ'ʋsʋm Dabisa la. Ka m yɛl ye m na kɛ ka tɔɔg luu ba zug, ka m sʋnf pɛlig nɛ ba sian'arin la.

english_verse: But I did not. That would have disgraced me in front of the nations that had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Amaa m da gban'e m mɛŋ, m yʋ'ʋr la zug, ka mɔ mam na niŋ si'em ka da paam yʋ'ʋbɛ'ɛd tembanɛ ni ka ba da bɛ ka m yisi ba la.

english_verse: So I solemnly swore that I would scatter the people of Israel across the nations,
translation_verse: M da lɛn ʋki m nu'ug ka pɔ tisi ba mɔɔgin la ye, m na widigi ba kpɛn'ɛs sʋ'ʋlimnam nɛ tɛɛns la sʋʋgin,

english_verse: because they had disobeyed my laws and ignored my teachings; they had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped the idols their ancestors had made.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ba pʋ siaki m zi'ela nɛ m wada la ka pʋ maali m Vʋ'ʋsʋm Dabisa la kasii, ka ba kʋkɔma'asim kpɛn' ba yaanam bada la.

english_verse: I gave them laws that bring punishment instead of life,
translation_verse: M mɛ da basi ba ka ba dɔl wada banɛ ka' sʋ'ʋm nɛ zi'ela banɛ kʋ tisi ba vʋm.

english_verse: and I let them offer me unacceptable sacrifices, including their first-born sons. I did this to horrify them and to let them know that I, the Lord, was punishing them.
translation_verse: M da dɔlisnɛ ba mɛŋ piini la nii kɛ ka ba tʋm bɛ'ɛd ka mɔri ba mɛŋ bikpɛma na maal maana. Ye m kɛ ka li paki ba hali ka ba baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: by offering sacrifices, incense, and wine to gods on every hill and under every large tree. I was very angry, because they did these things in the land I had given them!
translation_verse: Man da mɔri ba paae teŋ kanɛ ka m pɔ ye m tisi ba la, ka ba nyɛ zuoya nɛ tibɛda la, ani ka ba da maali ba maana linɛ kɛ ka m sʋnf duoe hali, nɛ ban nyɔ'ɔd bʋnnyubisa nɛ bʋnnuuda linɛ ka ba mɔri kenna maan maana la.’

english_verse: I asked them where they went to worship those gods, and they answered, “At the local shrines.” And those places of worship are still called shrines.
translation_verse: Ka m bu'osi ba ye, ‘Kʋkʋna zut banɛ ka ya ken la an bɔ?’” Tʋbtɛɛgir nɛ sʋŋir

english_verse: by worshiping idols and by sacrificing their own children as offerings. They commit these sins and still think they can ask me for a message. As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will give them no answer.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ mɔri ya biribisi nyɔ'ɔdi maan maana tisidi ya bada la, ya nan maligim paasidi ya mɛŋ nɛ dian'ad, hali ti paae zina. Yanam Israel dima, mam na siak ka ya bu'osimi baŋ linɛ bɛɛ?” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la, Asida sida ka m yɛt ye, m kʋ kɛ ka ya bu'osimi baŋ linɛ bɛɛ.

english_verse: They may think they can be like other nations and get away with worshiping idols made of wood and stone. But that will never happen! The Lord Promises To Restore Israel The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Ya yɛt ye, “Ti bɔɔd ye ti nwɛnɛ tembama la, ka nwɛnɛ dunia nidib banɛ wɔ'ɔgid tiis nɛ kuga la.” Amaa linɛ bɛɛ ya pʋtɛn'ɛrin la kʋ maligin tʋmm.

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will rule over you with my powerful arm. You will feel my fierce anger
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ya ye asida, sida ka m yɛti ya ye, “M na tiɛn m nu'ug kpi'euŋ nɛ nu'ug kanɛ mɔr paŋ hali la, nɛ ɛndʋgʋ zanli ya.

english_verse: and lead you into a desert surrounded by nations. I will meet you there face to face. Then I will pass judgment on you
translation_verse: M na mɔri ya yi tɛɛns la pipirisin la na, ka ti kpa' taaba ka m kadi ya saria lugi ya.

english_verse: and punish you, just as I punished your ancestors in the desert near Egypt.
translation_verse: Man da maali ya yaanam si'em Egipt teŋ sian'arin la, ala nɔɔ ka m mɛ ye m kadi ya saria.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: I will force each of you to obey the regulations of our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: “Ya ya'a gati m tuon, m na kpansi ya, ka kaali ya wʋʋ pɛ'ɛs nɛ ka kɛ ka ya siaki m nɔnaar la.

english_verse: I will separate the sinful rebels from the rest of you, and even though I will bring them from the nations where they live in exile, they won't be allowed to return to Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: M na yis banɛ ki'isid ka tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ya san'an. La'an nɛ mam na yisi ba ban bɛ teŋ si'a ni la, ba kʋ kpɛn' Israel dim teŋin la. Ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: Go ahead and worship your idols for now, you Israelites, because soon I will no longer let you dishonor me by offering gifts to them. You will have no choice but to obey me!
translation_verse: “Israel dima, ya'a kpɛlim yanam, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛli ya ye, ‘Sɔ' wʋsa, kem pʋ'ʋs o ba'ar! Amaa lin nya'aŋ la li anɛ tilas ye ya di'e mam nɔɔr ka kʋ lɛn san'ami m yʋ'ʋsʋŋ la ya'as nɛ ya piini nɛ bada laa.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone in Israel will worship me on Mount Zion, my holy mountain in Jerusalem. I will once again call you my own, and I will accept your sacred offerings and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ man zuor linɛ an kasi ka an Israel zuokanɛ wa'am la ni ka Israel nidib la wʋsa na pʋ'ʋs mam, ka m na di'e ba. Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Ani ka m na kɛ ka ya mɔri ya maana nɛ ya ya'amlɛog piini nɛ ya bʋndɛɛnna piini la na, la'an nɛ ya maana linɛ an kasi la.

english_verse: When I bring you home from the places where you are now scattered, I will be pleased with you, just as I am pleased with the smell of the smoke from your sacrifices. Every nation on earth will see that I am holy,
translation_verse: M ya'a ti la'asi ya yi sʋ'ʋlimnam nɛ tɛɛns la ni, m na di'e ya maan linɛ nyuusid sʋ'ʋŋa la ka pa'al ye man anɛ kasi ka sʋ'ʋlim banɛ bɛ la wʋsa nyɛ.

english_verse: and you will know that I, the Lord, am the one who brought you back to Israel, the land I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: M ya'a mɔri ya kɛn Israel teŋin na, teŋ kanɛ ka m da ʋki m nu'ug ka pɔ ye m na nɔki tisi ya yaanam la, ya sid na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Then you will remember your wicked sins, and you will hate yourselves for doing such horrible things. They have made you unacceptable to me,
translation_verse: Ani ka ya na tiɛn ya tʋʋma an si'em, nɛ ya bɛllim linɛ kɛ ka ya lieb dian'ad dim man tuon la, ka li na kɛ ka ya kisigi ya mɛŋ, bɛ'ɛd kanɛ wʋsa ka ya tʋm la yɛla.

english_verse: so you deserve to be punished. But I will treat you in a way that will bring honor to my name, and you will know that I am the Lord God. Fire from the South
translation_verse: M ya'a ti tʋm linɛ na kɛ ka m yʋ'ʋr da san'am ka pʋ dɔl wʋʋ yanamɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd si'em la bɛɛ ya filʋŋ tʋʋma la, ya na baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.’”

english_verse: that I, the Lord God, will start a fire that will burn up every tree, whether green or dry. Nothing will be able to put out the blaze of that fire as it spreads to the north and burns everything in its path.
translation_verse: Yɛlim ya-dagɔbʋg baba sian'anr la ye, Wʋmmi Zugsɔb labaar. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “M ti'ebidnɛ ye m nyu'oe ya bugum, ka li kanbi ya tibanɛ ma'as nɛ banɛ kʋdig la wʋsa. Bugumpielig la kʋ kpiisɛ, ka tʋʋlʋg la na paae si'el wʋsa lin yi ya-dagɔbʋgʋ keŋ paae ya-datiuŋ.

english_verse: Everyone will know that I started it, and that it cannot be stopped.”
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa na nyɛ ka baŋ ye manɛ nyu'oe li, ka li kʋ nyaŋi kpiisɛ.”

english_verse: But I complained, “Lord God, I don't want to do that! People already say I confuse them with my messages.”
translation_verse: Ka m lɛbis ye, “Aa! Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba! Ba pian'adi m yɛla ye, ‘Ayei, li ka'anɛ sɔlima ka o sɔlimaa?’”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the places in Jerusalem where people worship. Warn everyone in Israel
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga, nɔkimi fʋ nindaa kpa' Jerusalem tempʋʋgin ka pian' zɛrig Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la. Di'emi m nɔɔr pian'ad linɛ ka m zɛrig Israel teŋ la wʋsa tisi li

english_verse: that I am about to punish them. I will pull out my sword and have it ready to kill everyone, whether good or evil.
translation_verse: ka yɛl ye, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli tis Israel dim la nwa' ye, M kisi ya nɛ. M na fuoe m sʋ'ʋg la li tɛɛnginɛ kɛnsig yanam banɛ an ninsʋma nɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam la wʋsa yisi m san'an.

english_verse: Ezekiel, groan in sorrow and despair so that everyone can hear you.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Ninsaal biiga, kummi ba tuon nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ tita'ar nɛ ɛndʋg!

english_verse: When they ask why you are groaning, tell them you have terrifying news that will make them faint and tremble in fear and lose all courage. These things will happen soon. I, the Lord God, make this promise! A Sword Is Ready To Attack Israel
translation_verse: Ka ba ya'a bu'osif ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ kumma?” Fʋn on lɛbis ye, Labaar linɛ kenna la zug. Dabiem na gban'e sɔ' wʋsa ka o nu'us kpi; o sʋnkpi'euŋ wʋsa na yi ka kɛ o, ka o duma kirid ka bʋk wʋʋ gungum nɛ. Li kenna! Li sid na niŋ! Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Jerusalem: I have sharpened my sword to slaughter you; it is shiny and will flash like lightning! Don't celebrate— punishment is coming, because everyone has ignored my warnings.
translation_verse: li saasi gur ye li kʋ, ka duus ye li nyɛɛn wʋʋ saa iank nɛ! “Ti na maal sumalisim m biig Juda na'am dansaar la yɛlaa? Sʋ'ʋg la nɛ'ɛsid daban wʋsa nɛ.

english_verse: Groan in sorrow, Ezekiel; the sword is drawn against my people and their leaders. They will die! So give up all hope.
translation_verse: Kaasim bɛdegʋ ka ki'e kuŋ, Ninsaal biiga, bɔzugɔ li ye li zabnɛ nɛ m nidib la; li ye li zabnɛ nɛ Israel tuongatib la wʋsa. Ba ye ba kʋʋ ba nɛ, la'an nɛ m nidib la, alazug bibigimi ya nyɔ'ɔg dabiem zug.

english_verse: I am testing my people, and they can do nothing to stop me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Makir na ba'asi kena. Ka li na niŋ wala Juda na'am dansaar kanɛ ka sʋ'ʋg la nɛ'ɛs la ya'a pʋ keŋ tuonnɛ? Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Ezekiel, warn my people, then celebrate my victory by clapping your hands. My vicious sword will attack again and again, killing my people with every stroke.
translation_verse: “Alazug, Ninsaal biiga, di'emi m nɔɔr pian'adi pian' ka pisigi fʋ nu'us. Kɛl ka sʋ'ʋg la ki'e nɔɔr ayi', hali kɛl ka li paae nɔɔr atan' ya'as. Li anɛ sʋ'ʋg kanɛ nar ye li li'id, li anɛ sʋ'ʋg kanɛ kʋʋd bɛdegʋ, ka giligi ba lʋga wʋsa.

english_verse: They will lose all courage and stumble with fear. My slaughtering sword is waiting at every gate, flashing and ready to kill.
translation_verse: Ka li kɛ ka dabiem bɛ ka nidib bɛdegʋ na kpi. M zi'el sʋ'ʋg la ba za'anɔya wʋsa ni ye li kʋʋ ba bɛdegʋ. Aa! Li na ian'ad wʋʋ saa nɛ ba gban'e li ye ba kʋ.

english_verse: It will slash right and left, wherever the blade is pointed.
translation_verse: Sʋ'ʋgɔ, ki'em lɛb datiuŋ ka lɛb dagɔbʋg, fʋ nɔɔri fɛndigidi lɛbid zin'isi'a wʋsa.

english_verse: Then I will stop being angry, and I will clap my hands in victory. I, the Lord, have spoken. The King of Babylonia and His Sword
translation_verse: Man mɛ na pʋ'ʋsi m nu'us ka m sʋnpɛɛn la ma'ae. Man kanɛ an Zugsɔb la pian'.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, mark two roads for the king of Babylonia to follow when he comes with his sword. The roads will begin at the same place, but be sure to put up a signpost where the two roads separate and go in different directions.
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga, maalim suoya ayi' ka Babilon na'ab sʋ'ʋg la dɔl, ka li wʋsa pin'ili yit teŋ yinne ni. Maalim zanbin si'a digil zin'ikanɛ ka suoya ayi' la bakidi kpa'ad tɛɛns ayi' la.

english_verse: Clearly mark where the two roads lead. One goes to Rabbah, the capital of Ammon, and the other goes to Jerusalem, the fortified capital of Judah.
translation_verse: Maalim suor yinne ka sʋ'ʋg la dɔlli keŋ zab nɛ Rabba linɛ an Ammon dim teŋ la, ka yinne mɛ dɔlli keŋ zab nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalem linɛ aan ba kpi'euŋ zin'ig la.

english_verse: When the Babylonian king stands at that signpost, he will decide which way to go by shaking his arrows, by asking his idols, and by carefully looking at the liver of a sacrificed animal.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Babilon na'ab la na zi'en zanbin la baba, suoya ayi' la kidigid zin'isi'a la iee zanbin la. O na nɔk piema maal bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm, ka lɛn nɔk naaf sɔɔnri kpansi gɔs.

english_verse: His right hand will pull out the arrow marked “Jerusalem.” Then he will immediately give the signal to shout the battle cry, to build dirt ramps up to the top of the city walls, to break down its walls and gates with large wooden poles, and to kill the people.
translation_verse: O datiuŋ nu'ugin ka Jerusalem zanbin na kena, zin'ikanɛ ka o na keŋ digil tanni maal zaba dʋʋsa, ka bas suor ka ba kʋʋ ba, ka ki'e zaba kuŋ, ka digil tanni maal zaba dʋʋsa giŋ za'anɔya la, ka la'as gulungun'ud, ka maali gu' gilig teŋ la suoya.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem had promised to be loyal to Babylonia, and so none of them will believe that this could happen to them. But Babylonia's king will remind them of their sinful ways and warn them of their coming captivity.
translation_verse: Li na nwɛnɛ li ka' sida tis Jerusalem dim banɛ maal nɔnaar nɛ o la, amaa o na tiɛn ba, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla ka gban'e ba.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, tell the people of Jerusalem and their ruler that I, the Lord God, am saying: Everything you do is wicked and shows how sinful you are. You are guilty and will be taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Ya ki'isʋg la tiɛn ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la tis nidib, ka ya zan'asʋg la zug ka ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yi paalʋ. Ka yanamɛ maal nɛ'ɛŋa la zug ba na gban'e ya keŋ.

english_verse: And now, you evil and wicked ruler of Israel, your day of final punishment is almost here.
translation_verse: “Israel tuongat onɛ an dian'ad sɔb nɛ, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔba, fʋ bɛog nie ya, ka fʋ tʋbtɛɛgir saŋa paae.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, command you to take off your royal turban and your crown, because everything will be different. Those who had no power will be put in charge, and those who now rule will become nobodies.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Yisim o na'am papafu la, ka pidig o na'am zupibig la. Li kʋ nwɛnɛ lin da an si'em la. Tadimnam la na dʋ, ka banɛ dʋ la na sig.

english_verse: I will leave Jerusalem in complete ruins like no one has ever seen until my chosen one comes to punish this city. Judgment against Ammon
translation_verse: San'auŋ ye! San'auŋ ye! M na kɛ ka li san'am! Li kʋ nyaŋi zi'enɛ asɛɛ ka onɛ sʋ'oe li amɛŋa ti paae na. Onɛ nar ye o di'e li la on sɔb ka m na nɔki li tis.’”

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, the Ammonites have insulted Israel, so condemn them and tell them I am saying: A sword is drawn, ready to slaughter; it is polished and prepared to kill as fast as lightning.
translation_verse: Ka fʋn Ninsaal biiga, di'emi m nɔɔr pian'ad ka yɛli ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', zaŋi ken Ammon dim la nɛ ba tʋ'ʋd la yɛla: “Zaba sʋ'ʋg ye! Zaba sʋ'ʋg ye! Li fuoe ya ye li kʋ nidib bɛdegʋ. Ba saasi li nɛ ye li san'am ka li ian'ad wʋʋ saa nɛ!

translation_verse: La'an nɛ ban ye ba nyɛti fʋ yɛla ka li ka' sida, ka bʋgʋdi fʋ yɛla ka li ka' sida la, sʋ'ʋg la na bɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam banɛ ka ba ye ba kʋ la wʋsa niŋgɔnya ni. Ba dabisa paae ya ka ba tʋbtɛɛgir saŋa paae li bɛn.

english_verse: Your days to punish others are over, so put your swords away. You will be punished in the land of your birth.
translation_verse: Tɔ'! Lɛbisim sʋ'ʋg la li tɛɛngʋn. Zin'ikanɛ ka ba da maalif la, fʋ yaanam teŋin la, ani ka m na kadi fʋ saria.

english_verse: My furious anger will scorch you like fire, and I will hand you over to cruel men who are experts in killing.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka m ɛndʋg la luu fʋ zugin na ka kɛ ka m sʋntɔɔg la yina gɛɛlif; M na nɔki fʋ tis nimbɛ'ɛdnam, dap banɛ mi' san'auŋ suoya.

translation_verse: Fʋ na lieb daug ka bugum dit, fʋ ziim la na yii fʋ mɛŋ teŋin. Ba kʋ lɛn tiɛn fʋ yɛla ya'asɛ bɔzugɔ man kanɛ an Zugsɔb la pian'.”

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb labaar da kɛɛn m san'an na ye,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, are you ready to condemn Jerusalem? That city is filled with murderers, so remind the people of their sins
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga,” fʋ na kad o sariaa? Fʋ na kad tempʋkanɛ kʋʋd nidib nwa' saria? Alaa kem yɛl o tʋʋmkisa banɛ wʋsa ka o tʋm la yɛla

translation_verse: ka yɛl o ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, Tempʋʋga! Fʋn kanɛ mɔr tɔɔgʋ kennɛ fʋ zugin na ka li anɛ ban kʋʋd nidibi fʋ ni ka maan bada san'ami ba mɛŋ la,

english_verse: Those crimes have made you guilty, and the idols have made you unacceptable to me. So your final punishment is near. Other nations will laugh at you and make insulting remarks,
translation_verse: fʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li anɛ fʋn kʋʋd nidib ka maan bada san'amidi fʋ mɛŋ la zug. Fʋ kʋ'ʋgi fʋ dabisa la giŋa ka fʋ yʋma bɛn paae. Alazug m na kɛ ka sʋ'ʋlimnam la wʋsa nɛ'ɛsif ka fʋ lieb bʋnla'adiri tis tɛɛns la.

translation_verse: “Gɔsim Israel kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛɛ fʋ pʋʋgin la mɔri ba kpi'euŋ la kʋʋd nidib si'em.

translation_verse: Fʋ nɛ'ɛsi m la'abanɛ an kasi la nɛ ka pʋ tisim Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la girimaa.

translation_verse: Fʋ ni ka zam dim bɛɛ mukidi ba mɛŋ hali ninkʋʋr yɛla; fʋ ni ka banɛ dit ba'abanɛ bɛ zuor zug diib la bɛ, ka tʋm nyamis tʋʋma.

english_verse: Men have sex with their father's wife or with women who are having their monthly period
translation_verse: Fʋ san'an ka banɛ dignɛ ba saamnam pu'ab la bɛ, fʋ ni ka banɛ pʋ tuunsid pu'a na lu nu'ug la bɛ.

english_verse: or with someone else's wife. Some men even sleep with their own daughter-in-law or half sister.
translation_verse: Fʋ ni ka dau tʋm tʋʋmkisa nɛ o tiraan pu'a, ka sɔ' mɛ tʋm nyan tʋʋma san'am o bipu'a, ka sɔ' san'am o taʋn onɛ aan o mɛŋ saam bipuŋ.

english_verse: Others of you accept money to murder someone. Your own people charge high interest when making a loan to other Israelites, and they get rich by cheating. Worst of all, you have forgotten me, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Fʋ ni ka nidib siakid ye ba da' ba ka ba kʋ nid; ba pa'an nyɔɔd linɛ pʋ nara, ka filimmi ba taaba paamid arezak, ka tam man yɛla.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: When I'm finished with you, your courage will disappear, and you will be so weak that you won't be able to lift your hands. I, the Lord, have spoken and will not change my mind.
translation_verse: Fʋ sʋnkpi'euŋ la na kpɛm bɛ, bɛɛ fʋ na kpɛm mɔr paŋ daakanɛ ka man ye m sɛnbigif la? Man kanɛ an Zugsɔb la pian', ka sid na tʋmi li.

english_verse: I will scatter you throughout every nation on earth and put a stop to your sinful ways.
translation_verse: M na widigi ya kpɛn'ɛs sʋ'ʋlim nɛ tɛɛns la ni; ka kɛ ka ya tʋʋmkisa la gu'oe.

english_verse: You will be humiliated in the eyes of other nations. Then you will know that I, the Lord God, have done these things. Jerusalem Must Be Purified
translation_verse: Fʋ na di nyan paalʋ sʋ'ʋlimnam la tuon, lin ka fʋ na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I consider the people of Israel as worthless as the leftover metal in a furnace after silver has been purified.
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga, Israel nidib la lɛn ka' tʋmmiri tis mam, ba wʋsa nwɛnɛ kʋntzɛn'ug nɛ kʋntnam buudi wʋsa linɛ kpɛm bɛ onɛ kʋnt la bugum teŋir. Ba nwɛnɛ fʋn na nyɛlig kʋnti yis bʋnsʋŋ la ka bas.

english_verse: I will be like a metalworker who collects that metal from the furnace and melts it down. I will collect the Israelites and blow on them with my fiery anger. They will melt inside the city of Jerusalem
translation_verse: M na la'asi ya ka kɛ ka m sʋnpɛɛn luu ya zug wʋʋ bugum tʋʋlʋg nɛ, ka ya nyɛlig teŋ la ni.

english_verse: like silver in a furnace. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have punished them in my anger. Everyone in Jerusalem Is Guilty
translation_verse: Wʋʋ anzurifa ɛɛn nyɛlig bugumin si'em la, ala mɛn ka ya na nyɛlig ka baŋ ye man kanɛ an Zugsɔb la kpa'ae m sʋnpɛɛn la gɛɛli ya.’”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that their country is full of sin, and that I, the Lord, am furious!
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga,” yɛlim teŋ la ye, Fʋ anɛ teŋ kanɛ pʋ nyɛ saa bɛɛ mɛligim tɔɔg dabisa la saŋaa.

english_verse: Their leaders are like roaring lions, tearing apart their victims. They put people to death, then steal everything of value. Husbands are killed, and many women are left as widows.
translation_verse: Tuongatib la bɛ tempʋʋgin la mɔr gban'asu'ada. Ba nwɛnɛ gbigimi na gban'e si'el ka nwa'am ka aansidi li nɛ; ba gban'ad nidibi kʋʋd, ka faand areza'as nɛ la'asʋma ka kɛt ka pʋkɔnya bɛdegʋ bɛ teŋin la.

english_verse: The priests of Israel ignore my Law! Not only do they refuse to respect any of my sacred things, but they don't even teach the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary or between what is clean and what is unclean. They treat my Sabbath like any other day, and so my own people no longer honor me.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la san'amidi m wada, ka miligidi m la'abanɛ an kasi la; ba pʋ bakid linɛ an kasi nɛ linɛ ka' kasii. Ba pa'an ye linɛ an kasi nɛ linɛ ka' kasi la wʋsa anɛ yinne; ka zan'as ye ba kʋ dɔlli m Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir wada la, ka li yɛla kɛ ka m yʋ'ʋr san'ami ba san'an.

english_verse: Israel's officials are like ferocious wolves, ripping their victims apart. They make a dishonest living by injuring and killing people.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛɛ ani la nwɛnɛ zanku'a na gban'e si'eli ɔnbid nɛ, ba yisid ziim ka kʋʋd nidibi paamid nyɔɔd linɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ.

english_verse: And then the prophets in Israel cover up these sins by giving false visions. I have never spoken to them, but they lie and say they have a message from me.
translation_verse: Nɔdi'esidib la yɛtnɛ nier linɛ ka' sida nɛ bɛog yɛla linɛ an ziri lusid nidib la bɛ'ɛd la tisidi ba. Ba yɛt ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa'. Ka Zugsɔb la mɛ pʋ pian' si'ela.

english_verse: The people themselves cheat and rob; they abuse the poor and take advantage of foreigners.
translation_verse: Teŋ la nidib filimnɛ ka faand, ba mukid nɔŋ nɛ fara dim, ka maan saam linɛ pʋ nara, ka kad saria mɔŋidi ba bʋʋd.

english_verse: I looked for someone to defend the city and to protect it from my anger, as well as to stop me from destroying it. But I found no one.
translation_verse: “Ka m ieed dau kanɛ na an nu'unwɛ'ɛd ka na mɛ' zaŋguommi zi'el ka li zi'en man nɛ teŋ la naalʋŋ yɛla, linɛ na kɛ ka m kʋ san'ami lii, amaa m pʋ nyɛ sɔ'ɔɔ.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish the Israelites for what they have done, and they will know that I am furious. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Alazug m na kpa'ae m sʋnpɛɛn la gɛɛli ba, ka kanbisi ba nɛ sʋnpɛɛn linɛ an bugum la, ka kɛ ka ban tʋm si'el la lɛn lɛbi ba mɛŋ zugin.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, listen to this story about two sisters.
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga,” pu'aba ayi' da bɛ, ka an pu'a yinne biis.

english_verse: The older one was named Oholah, which stands for Samaria; the younger one was Oholibah, which stands for Jerusalem. They became my wives and gave birth to my children.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛm la yʋ'ʋri da buon Ohola ka pit la yʋ'ʋr buon Oholiba. Manɛ da sʋ'oe ba ka ba du'a biribis nɛ bipumis. Ohola zi'enɛ Samaria yɛla ka Oholiba mɛ zi'e Jerusalem yɛla.

english_verse: Even though Oholah was my wife, she continued to be a prostitute and chased after Assyrian lovers.
translation_verse: Ohola da nan kpɛn an man din la o da pin'il o pu'agɔɔnd tʋʋma la, ka mɔr kʋkɔma'asim nɛ banɛ li'ad o la. Ba da anɛ Asiria teŋ zabzabidib

english_verse: She offered herself to soldiers in purple uniforms: handsome, high-ranking officers and cavalry troops.
translation_verse: ka yɛ soogianam fuvɛnla, ka an gɔmenanam nɛ zaba tuongatib. Ba wʋsa da anɛ dasam banɛ vɛnl, ka ban'ad widi.

english_verse: She had sex with all the important Assyrian officials and even worshiped their disgusting idols.
translation_verse: O da nɔk o mɛŋi tis Asiria ninsʋma la wʋsa wʋʋ pu'agɔɔndir nɛ, ka san'am o mɛŋ nɛ ba'abanɛ wʋsa ka o ya'am kpɛn'.

english_verse: Once she started doing these things in Egypt, she never stopped. Men slept with her, and she was always ready for sex.
translation_verse: O da pʋ bas pu'agɔɔnd tʋʋma linɛ ka o pin'il Egipt teŋin o pu'asatim saŋa ka dap da gbɛɛnd nɛ o la, ba da niŋid o wʋʋ o anɛ pu'agɔɔndir ka dig nɛ o.

english_verse: So I gave Oholah to the Assyrian lovers she wanted so badly.
translation_verse: Alazug ka m bas o tis banɛ li'ad o la, banɛ an Asiria dim la, bɔzugɔ ban ka o ya'amlɛog kpɛn' hali.

english_verse: They ripped off her clothes, then captured her children and killed her. Women everywhere talked about what had happened to Oholah.
translation_verse: Ba da yɛɛs o ka kɛɛ o biel, ka gban'e o biribis nɛ o bipumis la mɔri keŋ, ka nɔk sʋ'ʋgʋ kʋʋ o. Pu'ab da mɔr o siilim ka li an yɛlpakir, ka namisʋg bɛdegʋ paae o.

english_verse: Oholibah saw all this, but she was more sinful and wanted sex more than her sister Oholah ever did.
translation_verse: O pitʋ Oholiba da nyɛ nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa, amaa la'an nɛ wala o kʋkɔma'asim nɛ o dapbɔɔsim tʋʋma la da san'am o gaad o bier la.

english_verse: Just like her sister, she did vulgar things.
translation_verse: M da nyɛ ka on mɛ san'am o mɛŋ: babayi' la wʋsa da dɔlnɛ suor yinne.

english_verse: But Oholibah behaved worse than her sister. Oholibah saw images of Babylonian men carved into walls and painted red.
translation_verse: Amaa o da nan kpɛn ken tuon nɛ o dapbɔɔsim la. O da nyɛ dap ka ba gʋli baa tabil dɔkpin,

translation_verse: ka sɛnbidis lɔɔ ba sies, ka bantabis bɛɛ ba zutin, ba wʋsa da nwɛnɛ Babilon zaba tɛreko dɔribanam nɛ, banɛ an Kaldea teŋ dim.

translation_verse: On da nyɛɛ ba la, ka o ya'am kpɛm kpɛn' ba, ka o tʋm nidibi ba san'an Kaldea teŋin.

english_verse: Men from Babylonia came and had sex with her so many times that she got disgusted with them.
translation_verse: Ka Babilon dim la kɛɛn o san'an na digin nɛ o, san'am o. Ka ban san'am o naae la, ka o ya'am yii ba ka o fɛndig ka basi ba.

english_verse: She let everyone see her naked body and didn't care if they knew she was a prostitute. That's why I turned my back on her, just as I had done with her older sister.
translation_verse: On da tʋmm o pu'agɔɔnd tʋʋma la paalʋ ka kɛt ka sɔ' wʋsa nyɛt o sawɛɛnr la, li da kɛ ka m kisig o ka fɛndig ka bas o, nwɛnɛ man da fɛndig ka bas o bier la si'em la.

english_verse: Oholibah didn't stop there, but became even more immoral and acted as she had back in Egypt.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala ka o maligim ken tuon nɛ o dapbɔɔsim la, saŋkanɛ wʋsa ka o tiɛn o pu'asatim saŋa, on da tʋmmi li Egipt teŋin si'em la.

english_verse: She eagerly wanted to go to bed with Egyptian men, who were famous for their sexual powers.
translation_verse: Ani ka o ya'amlɛog da lɛm kpɛn' banɛ li'ad o la, banɛ ka ba daulim zu'oe nwɛnɛ bʋmis nɛ widi daulim an si'em la.

english_verse: And she longed for the days when she was a young prostitute, when men enjoyed caressing her body. The Lord Will Punish Oholibah
translation_verse: Alazug fʋ ya'am da nan kpɛm bɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka fʋ da mɔr fʋn da nan an pu'asadir la, fʋn da bɛ Egipt teŋin la ka ba da babin nɛf ka tɛn'ɛbidi fʋ bin'isa si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Oholibah, though you no longer want to be around your lovers, they will surround you like enemies, when I turn them against you.
translation_verse: “Dinzugɔ, Oholiba, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, M na kɛ ka banɛ li'adif la lɛn tuligi kisigif, banɛ ka kisidim da kpɛn' ya sʋʋgin ka fʋ fɛndig ka basi ba la, m na kɛ ka ba liebi fʋ dataasi yi zin'ig wʋsa na zab nɛf.

english_verse: I will gather all the handsome young officials and the high-ranking cavalry officers from Babylonia and Assyria, as well as from the Chaldean tribes of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa.
translation_verse: Babilon dim nɛ Kaldea dim la wʋsa, nɛ dap banɛ yi Pekod nɛ Soa nɛ Koa tɛɛnsin, la'an nɛ Asiria dim la wʋsa, dasam vɛnla nɛ gɔmenanam nɛ zaba tuongatib nɛ zaba tɛreko dɔribanam nɛ wiedban'adib.

english_verse: Their large armies will come from the north with chariots and wagons carrying weapons. They will wear shields and helmets and will surround you, and I will let them judge and sentence you according to their own laws.
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa na tuligi tʋ'ʋsif nɛ zaba la'ad nɛ zaba tɛrekonam nɛ linɛ ka ba mɔri ziid zaba la'ad la, nɛ nidib bɛdegʋ; ba na zi'en zin'ig wʋsa nɛ kʋnt gbanti'edis bʋmbibis nɛ bʋntitada nɛ kʋnt zupibis. M na nɔki fʋ tisi ba ka ba kadi fʋ saria ka li dɔlli ba wada suori an si'em.

english_verse: I am angry with you, so I will let them be very cruel. They will cut off your nose and ears; they will kill your children and burn alive anyone in your family who survives.
translation_verse: M na nɔki m sʋnpɛɛn la ziilif, m na kɛ ka li tʋligif. Ba na fi'igi fʋ nyɔnya nɛ fʋ tʋba, ka yanam banɛ kpɛlim la ba na kʋʋ ya nɛ sʋ'ʋg. Ka gban'e fʋ biribis nɛ bipumis, ka nyu'oe banɛ kpɛlim la nɛ bugum.

english_verse: Your clothes and jewelry will be torn off.
translation_verse: Ba mɛ na yɛɛsi fʋ la'ad la ka yisi fʋ niŋgɔnkɔris nɛ baŋ vɛnla la.

english_verse: I will stop your wickedness and the prostitution you started back in Egypt. You will never want to think about those days again.
translation_verse: Ka m na kɛ ka fʋ bas tʋʋmkisa nɛ dapbɔɔsim linɛ ka fʋ da pin'il Egipt teŋin la. Fʋ kʋ lɛm bɔɔd bɛɛ tiɛn Egipt yɛla ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, am ready to hand you over to those hateful enemies that you find so disgusting.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “M bɔɔd ye m nɔkif nɛ tis nimbanɛ ka fʋ ya'am yi, ka fʋ fɛndig ka basi ba la.

english_verse: They will cruelly take away everything you have worked for and strip you naked. Then everyone will see you for the prostitute you really are. Your own vulgar sins
translation_verse: Ba na maalif ka fʋ nyɛ ka baŋ ye ba kisif ka nɔk linɛ wʋsa ka fʋ tʋm nyɛ la mɔri keŋ ka kɛɛf ka fʋ an sawɛɛnr nɛ nu'uzaalis ka di nyan ka fʋ pu'agɔɔnd tʋʋma la yi paalʋ. Fʋ tʋʋmkisa nɛ fʋ tʋʋmyaalis la wʋsa

english_verse: have led to this. You were the one determined to have sex with men from other nations and to worship their idols.
translation_verse: zi nɛ'ɛŋa kɛɛn fʋ zugin na, bɔzugɔ fʋ kʋkɔma'asim da kpɛn' sʋ'ʋlimnam la, ka fʋ nɔki ba bada la san'ami fʋ mɛŋ.

english_verse: You have turned out no better than your older sister, and now you must drink from the cup filled with my anger.
translation_verse: Fʋ dɔlnɛ fʋ bier la nɔba; linzug m na nɔk o bʋtiŋi niŋi fʋ nu'ugin ka li kɛ ka fʋ nyɛɛ o namisʋg la buudi.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, gave your sister a large, deep cup filled with my anger. And when you drink from that cup, you will be mocked and insulted.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Fʋ na nuu fʋ bier bʋtiŋ la pʋʋgin, bʋtiŋ kanɛ yalim ka zulim ka an namisʋg buudi la; li na zi la'ad nɛ nɛ'ɛsʋg na, bɔzugɔ bʋtiŋ la pɛ'ɛlnɛ.

english_verse: You will end up drunk and devastated, because that cup is filled with horror and ruin.
translation_verse: Fʋ ye fʋ bugnɛ ka nyɛ sʋnsa'aŋ bɛdegʋ. Li anɛ bʋtiŋ linɛ ziid san'auŋ nɛ widigir na, li anɛ fʋ bier Samaria bʋtiŋ.

english_verse: But you must drink every drop! Then smash the cup and chew on its broken pieces. Use them to cut your breasts in sorrow. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Fʋ na nuu li naae nyain ka lɛɛli li ka li kʋdig; fʋ na nwa'asi-nwa'asi li sɔɔm-sɔɔm ka aansi fʋ bin'isa la.” Manɛ yɛl. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: You have completely rejected me, and so I promise that you will be punished for the disgusting things you did as a prostitute. The Two Sisters Are Condemned
translation_verse: Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Fʋn sadigim tami m yɛla ka bidim kʋdig la, fʋ na namisi fʋ tʋʋmkisa nɛ fʋ pu'agɔɔnd tʋʋma la wʋsa yɛla.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, it's time for you to tell Oholah and Oholibah that they are guilty. Remind them of their evil ways!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, fʋ na kad Ohola nɛ Oholiba sariaa? Alaa kem yɛli ba tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka ba tʋm la yɛla,

english_verse: They have been unfaithful by worshiping idols, and they have committed murder by sacrificing my own children as offerings to idols.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ ba san'amnɛ dap ka kʋ nidib. Ba maalnɛ pu'agɔɔnd tʋʋma nɛ ba bada la, hali ba nɔki ba biis banɛ ka ba du'a tis man la maal maana, ka ba an diibi tis bada la.

english_verse: They came into my temple that same day, and that made it unfit as a place to worship me. They have even stopped respecting the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Daakanɛ ka ba da nɔki ba biisi maal maannɛ tis bada la, daakan nɔɔ ba da kpɛn' san'ami m Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la. Ban da tʋm si'em m Yin la nwa'.

english_verse: They sent messengers to attract men from far away. When those men arrived, the two sisters bathed themselves and put on eye shadow and jewelry.
translation_verse: “Ba da tʋm nidib ka ba keŋ lalli buol dap na. Ka ban paae na la, fʋ maali sʋʋ fʋ mɛŋ nyain ye fʋ nɔki fʋ mɛŋi tisi ba, ka kir kirʋ ka nɔki fʋ niŋgɔnkɔrisi kɔr.

english_verse: They sat on a fancy couch, and in front of them was a table for the olive oil and incense that had belonged to me.
translation_verse: Ka zin'in kʋk tita'ar kanɛ vɛnl zug, ka ba maal teebuli zi'el, ka nɔk kpaam nɛ bʋnnyubisa linɛ an man din la sʋn'ʋl.

english_verse: Their room was always filled with a noisy crowd of drunkards brought in from the desert. These men gave the women bracelets and beautiful crowns,
translation_verse: “Nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ an haya dim da la'asi gilig o maan tʋkpiidʋg, ba da mɔr Sabɛa nidibi yi sian'arin la na, ka ba nɔk nu'ubaansi pid pu'ab la nu'us ka nɔk girima zupibisi pidi ba zut.

english_verse: and I noticed that the men were eager to have sex with these women, though they were exhausted from being prostitutes.
translation_verse: Ka m pian' onɛ tʋm pu'a pu'agɔɔndir tʋʋma hali gɛn la ye, ‘Nannanna kɛl ka ba maal o wʋʋ pu'agɔɔndir, bɔzugɔ on pʋn an si'em la.’

english_verse: In fact, the men had sex over and over with Oholah and Oholibah, the two sinful sisters.
translation_verse: Ka ba sid digin nɛ o. Wʋʋ dapi dig nɛ pu'agɔɔndir si'em la, ala ka ba gbɛɛnd nɛ pu'a banɛ tʋm tʋʋmkisa la, Ohola nɛ Oholiba.

english_verse: But honest judges will someday accuse those two of murder and of being unfaithful, because they are certainly guilty.
translation_verse: Amaa dap banɛ an pʋpielim dim na tɛɛgi ba tʋbir wʋʋ pu'a banɛ san'amid dap ka kʋʋd nidib la, bɔzugɔ ba tʋʋma anɛ ala.”

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, now say to these sisters: I will call together an angry mob that will abuse and rob you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “La'asim nidib na ka ba zab nɛ o, ka kpɛn'ɛsi ba dabiem ka faaɛn ba la'ad.

english_verse: They will stone you to death and cut you to pieces; they will kill your children and burn down your houses.
translation_verse: Nidib la na lɔbi ba nɛ kuga, ka kʋʋ ba nɛ sʋ'ʋs, ba na kʋʋ ba biribis nɛ bipumis ka nyɔ'ɔ ba ya' nɛ bugum.

english_verse: I will get rid of sinful prostitution in this country, so that women everywhere will be warned not to act as you have.
translation_verse: “Linɛ na kɛ ka m gu'oe tʋʋmkisa nɛ li buudi wʋsa teŋ la zug, ka pu'a wʋsa na zamis ya'am nɛ nimmua yii li ni ka kʋ tʋm pu'agɔɔnda tʋʋma.

english_verse: You will be punished for becoming prostitutes and for worshiping idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ya na namisi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla ka namis ya bada maalʋg la yɛla. Ani ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la.”

english_verse: Nine years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the tenth day of the tenth month. He said:
translation_verse: Tinamɛ da an yammisi bɛ teŋ zʋŋ la yʋma awai saŋa li nwadis piiga la ni, dabpiiga daar ka Zugsɔb labaar kɛɛn m san'an na ye,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, write down today's date, because the king of Babylonia has just begun attacking the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga,” sɔm dabiskaŋa digil, dabiskaŋa nɔɔ, bɔzugɔ dabiskaŋa daar ka Babilon na'ab nɛ o nidib la kena diginɛ gu' gilig teŋ la.

english_verse: Then tell my rebellious people: “Pour water in a cooking pot and set it over a fire. *
translation_verse: Yɛlim nimbanɛ ki'isid la siiliŋ kaŋa ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Nɔkim dʋk la sʋn'ʋl bugum zug ka gbin'e ku'om niŋi li pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Throw in the legs and shoulders of your finest sheep and put in the juicy bones.
translation_verse: Gaansim ni'im sʋma banɛ an gbɛya nɛ ban'ad la wʋsa; la'asimi lii niŋ dʋkʋn la. Pɛ'ɛlimi li nɛ kɔnba linɛ an sʋm;

english_verse: Pile wood underneath the pot, and let the meat and bones boil until they are done.”
translation_verse: gaansim kɔnbsʋma la ni'im. Kpan'alim dʋk la gbin nɛ daad ka niŋ bugum ka li lɛ'ɛg ka dʋg kɔnba banɛ bɛɛ ani la.”

english_verse: These words mean that Jerusalem is doomed! The city is filled with murderers and is like an old, rusty pot. The meat is taken out piece by piece, and no one cares what happens to it.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Tɔɔg bɛ tempʋkanɛ kʋʋd nidib la zug, li nwɛnɛ dʋk kanɛ kanb, ka linɛ kanbi si' la kʋ yii! Yaasimi li yinne-yinne hali ka yinne da kpɛlim.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem murdered innocent people in the city and didn't even try to cover up the blood that flowed out on the hard ground.
translation_verse: Ziim kanɛ ka o yis la bɛɛ o san'an; o kpa'ae li nɛ pa'al tampiing zug; o pʋ kpa'ae li bas teŋ zin'ikanɛ ka tan na nyaŋi pin' lii.

english_verse: But I have seen that blood, and it cries out for me to take revenge.
translation_verse: Man kpa' o ziim la nɛ pa'al tampiing zug, linɛ na kɛ ka li kʋ pin', ye li kɛ ka sʋnpɛɛn nɛ sam yɔɔb bɛ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will punish that city of violence! I will make a huge pile of firewood,
translation_verse: Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an kasi la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Yɛl bɛ tempʋkanɛ kʋʋd nidib la zug! Man mɛ na la'as daad la kʋgis bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: so bring more wood and light it. Cook the meat and boil away the broth to let the bones scorch.
translation_verse: Dinzug la'asim daad la digil ka niŋ bugum ka li la'aŋ. Dʋgim ni'im la sʋ'ʋŋa, ka gɛndig zɛɛndnam la; ka kɛ ka kɔnba la bi'igi kanb.

english_verse: Then set the empty pot over the hot coals until it is red-hot. That will clean the pot and burn off the rust.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn kpa'ae li wʋsa bas ka lɛn nɔk dʋk la sʋn'ʋl bugumsaana la zug hali ka li ti tʋligi mu'oe nyɛɛn, ka li kɛ ka dian'ad la wʋsa nyɛlig ka linɛ si' la wʋsa kanbi yi.

english_verse: I've tried everything else. Now the rust must be burned away.
translation_verse: Li kɛ ka fʋ mɔɔr wʋsa lieb zaalim; linɛ kanb la wʋsa pʋ nyaŋi yii, hali bugum gba pʋ nyaŋi yisi lii.

english_verse: Jerusalem is so full of sin and evil that I can't get it clean, even though I have tried. It will stay filthy until I let loose my fierce anger against it.
translation_verse: “Linɛ kɛ ka ya dian'a la anɛ ya tʋʋmkisa la. M mɔ ye m maali ya kasi amaa ya pʋ siak ye ya yii ya dian'ad la ni ka lieb kasii, alazug ka ya mɛ kʋ lɛm maligim an kasi ya'asɛ, asɛɛ ka tɔɔg kanɛ bɛɛ ya zugin la ti yɔlis.”

english_verse: That time will certainly come! And when it does, I won't show the people of Jerusalem any pity or change my mind. They must be punished for the evil they have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Ezekiel's Wife Dies
translation_verse: Man kanɛ an Zugsɔb la pian'. Saŋa paae ya ye m tʋm. M kʋ zan'as tʋʋmaa; m kʋ zɔ nimbaanlig, bɛɛ lɛb nya'aŋa. Ya na paam sariakadib ka li dɔlli ya bɛllim nɛ ya tʋʋma. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Ezikil pu'a kpi la yɛla
