translation_verse: “Fʋn mɔr kʋdimin sa dataadʋg ka kʋ Israel dim saŋa kanɛ ka tɔɔg da paae ba la, saŋa kanɛ ka ba namisʋg la da tʋʋgi li bɛn la,

english_verse: And so, as surely as I am the living Lord God, you are guilty of murder and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Alazug,” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ nwa' ye, “Asida sida ka m yɛti ya ye, m na nɔki ya niŋ ninkʋʋdib nu'usin, ka ninkʋʋdib na kati dɔlli ya. Yanamɛ sadigim pʋ zɔt ninkʋʋr la, li sid na dɔlli ya.

english_verse: I will destroy your nation and kill anyone who travels through it.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka Seir zuor la lieb zaalim, ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn dɔl ani gaadɛ.

english_verse: and your land will lie in ruins forever. No one will live in your towns ever again. You will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka fʋ lieb dabɔɔd hali saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, sɔ' kʋ lɛm bɛɛ fʋ tɛɛnsin la. Ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: You thought the nations of Judah and Israel belonged to you, and that you could take over their territory. But I am their God,
translation_verse: “Yanam yɛl ye, ‘Tɛɛns ayi' nwa' nɛ ba sʋ'ʋlim la wʋsa na aan ti din ka ti sʋ'ʋgi li,’ la'an nɛ man kanɛ an Zugsɔb la da bɛɛ ani la,

english_verse: and as surely as I live, I will punish you for treating my people with anger and hatred. Then they will know that I, the Lord, am punishing you!
translation_verse: alazug,” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la, “asida sida ka m yɛti ya ye, m na maali ya wʋʋ fufum nɛ ɛndʋg nɛ kisidim kanɛ ka ya da maali ba la, ka tɛɛgi ya tʋbir. Ala ka m na kɛ ka ba baŋ man an sɔ'.

english_verse: And you will finally realize that I heard you laugh at their destruction and say their land was yours to take.
translation_verse: Ka ya na baŋ ye man onɛ an Zugsɔb la wʋm pian'ayaalis banɛ ka ya pian'adi zɛrigid Israel zuoya la. Ya yɛl ye, ‘Ba dignɛ zaalim, ka ba nɔki tisi ti ye ti di.’

english_verse: You even insulted me, but I heard it all.
translation_verse: Ya nwɛ'ɛdi ya nyɔ'ɔg ka pian'adi zɛrigid mam ka pʋ zɔt dabiem, ka m wʋmmi li.”

english_verse: just as you celebrated when Israel was destroyed. Your nation of Edom will be nothing but a wasteland. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel dim teŋ linɛ aan ba faar la da kilim zaalim ka ya maan sumalisim la, alazug m mɛ ye m maali ya nɛ, yanamɛ da maali ba si'em la. Seir zuorɛ, fʋ na lieb zaalim, fʋn nɛ Edom wʋsa. Ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the mountains of Israel
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, di'emi m nɔɔr pian'ad linɛ ka m zɛrig Israel zuoya la tisi ba ye, Yanam Israel zuoya, kɛlisimi Zugsɔb la pian'ad.

english_verse: that I, the Lord God, am saying: Your enemies sneered and said that you mountains belonged to them.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Dataa la yɛli ya yɛla ye, ‘Ha haa! Kʋkʋn kʋda la yʋ'ʋn anɛ ti bʋn.’”

english_verse: So all you mountains and hills, streams and valleys, listen to what I will do. Your towns may now lie in ruins, and nations may laugh and insult you.
translation_verse: Alazug, Israel zuoya, wʋmmi Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ad. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la mɔr yɛlsi'a tisid zuoya nɛ kʋkʋna la nɛ ku'osuoya nɛ bɔn'ɔd nɛ dabɔɔd banɛ ka nidib kae, nɛ tempʋbanɛ ka dataas faaɛn ka ba zɔ ka bas, ka tɛɛns banɛ giligi ba la wʋsa la'adi ba la.

english_verse: But in my fierce anger, I will turn against those nations, and especially the Edomites, because they laughed at you the loudest and took over your pasturelands.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, ‘M sʋnfʋ la'aŋ bugum la zug ka m pian' tɛɛns nwa' yɛla, la'an nɛ Edom dim wʋsa, ba sʋnfʋ ma'ae ka ba kisigi ya, ka nɔki m teŋ la maali ba din ka faaɛn teŋ la zin'ibanɛ mɔr yaama sʋ'ʋŋa la zug.’”

english_verse: so I will now insult and disgrace them. That is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, ‘M pɔya, tɛɛns banɛ giligi ya la na namis nɛ tʋ'ʋd mɛn.’

english_verse: Trees will grow on you mountains of Israel and produce fruit for my people, because they will soon come home.
translation_verse: “Amaa yanam banɛ an Israel zuoya la, ya na tɔn wila ka wal wala tisim nimbanɛ an Israel dim la, bɔzugɔ li kʋ yuugɛ ka ba kul yin na.

english_verse: I will take care of you by plowing your soil and planting crops on your fertile slopes.
translation_verse: M ba' bɛɛ ya san'an, ka m na sʋŋi ya ka ya na kua ka bʋd ya'as,

english_verse: The people of Israel will return and rebuild your ruined towns and live in them.
translation_verse: ka na kɛ ka ya nidib kal zu'oe teŋin la, hali li na anɛ Israel dim mummi. Tempʋʋs la na mɔr nidib ka ba na lɛbisi mɛ dabɔɔd la.

english_verse: Children will be born, and animals will give birth to their young. You will no longer be deserted as you are now, but you will be covered with people and treated better than ever. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ya nidib nɛ ya bʋnkɔnbid la zu'oe, ba na wiak ka ba kal zu'oe. M na kɛ ka nidib zin'in teŋin la wʋʋ saŋa kanɛ da gaad la da an si'em la, ka si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa gaad lin da an si'em la. Ala ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: I will bring my people Israel home, and they will live on you mountains, because you belong to them, and your fertile slopes will never again let them starve.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka m nimbanɛ an Israel dim la nɔɔdi ya zugʋ ken. Ba na sʋ'ʋgi ya, ka ya na liebi ba faar; ya kʋ lɛn faaɛn ba biis ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: It's true that you have been accused of not producing enough food and of letting your people starve.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la lɛn yɛl Israel teŋ zuoya nɛ kʋkʋna la si'eli nwa' ye, “Nidib yɛti ya ye, ‘Ya kʋʋd nidib ka kɛ ka ya nidib la kɔ'ɔŋi ba biis.’

english_verse: But I, the Lord, promise that you won't hear other nations laugh and sneer at you ever again. From now on, you will always produce plenty of food for your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord Will Be Honored
translation_verse: “M kʋ lɛn kɛ ka ya wʋm ka tɛɛns nɛ'ɛsidi yaa, ya mɛ kʋ lɛn wʋm ka nidib la'adi ya bɛɛ kɛ ka teŋ la nidib kɔ'ɔŋi ba biisɛ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own country, they made the land unclean by the way they behaved, just as a woman's monthly period makes her unclean.
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, Israel dim la da bɛɛ ba mɛŋ teŋin la, ba tʋʋma nɛ ba itʋŋ pʋʋgin da kɛ ka teŋ la an dian'ad. Ba dian'ad la da an si'em man san'an nwɛnɛ nwadig-nwadig ka pu'a nyɛt pier ka li an si'em la.

english_verse: They committed murders and worshiped idols, which made the land even worse. So in my anger, I punished my people
translation_verse: M da kpa'ae m sʋnpɛɛn la yɛɛli ba bɔzugɔ ba da kɛ ka teŋ la pɛ'ɛl nɛ ziim, nɛ ban nɔki ba bada la miligi li la zug.

english_verse: Wherever they went, my name was disgraced, because foreigners insulted my people by saying I had forced them out of their own land.
translation_verse: Ban keŋ zin'isi'a wʋsa kpɛn' tɛɛnsin la, nidib san'amidi m yʋ'ʋri yɛt ye, “Bama anɛ Zugsɔb la nidib, la'an nɛ wala ka o kɛ ka ba yi ka bas o teŋ la.”

english_verse: so tell the Israelites that I am saying: You have disgraced my holy name among the nations where you now live. So you don't deserve what I'm going to do for you. I will lead you home to bring honor to my name
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ yɛlim Israel dim ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, Israel dima, li ka' yanam yɛla ka m ye m niŋ nɛ'ɛnama, amaa li anɛ m yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la zug, linɛ ka ya san'ami li tɛɛns banɛ wʋsa ka ya kpɛn' ba ni la.

english_verse: I will gather you from the foreign nations and bring you home.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ m na yisi ya tɛɛns la sʋʋgin, ka la'asi ya tɛɛnsin la, mɔri ya lɛbi ya mɛŋ teŋin na.

english_verse: I will sprinkle you with clean water, and you will be clean and acceptable to me. I will wash away everything that makes you unclean, and I will remove your disgusting idols.
translation_verse: M na nɔk ku'okanɛ an nyain zu'asi ya, ka ya na an nyain. M na pie ya dian'ad la wʋsa yis ka la'am yisi ya bada la.

english_verse: I will take away your stubborn heart and give you a new heart and a desire to be faithful. You will have only pure thoughts,
translation_verse: M na yisi ya sʋnya la ka lɛbis bʋmpaala kpɛn'ɛs, m na nɔk sipaaligi kpɛn'ɛsi ya pʋʋgin, ka yisi ya sʋnya linɛ kpi'em wʋʋ kugir la ka tisi ya sʋnya linɛ bʋgʋs.

english_verse: because I will put my Spirit in you and make you eager to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: M na kpɛn'ɛsi m siig la ya sʋnfʋn, ka kɛ ka ya dɔlli m gban'ar la ka ya na gu'usid ka dɔlisidi m wada la.

english_verse: You will once again live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Ya na bɛ teŋ kanɛ ka m da tisi ya yaanam la ni. Ya na aan m nidib, ka mam mɛ na aan ya Wina'am.

english_verse: I will protect you from anything that makes you unclean. Your fields will overflow with grain, and no one will starve.
translation_verse: M na faaɛn ya yisi ya dian'ad wʋsa pʋʋgin. M na kɛ ka zʋʋd bɛ bɛdegʋ ka kɔ'ɔm kʋ lɛn lii ya san'anɛ.

english_verse: Your trees will be filled with fruit, and crops will grow in your fields, so that you will never again feel ashamed for not having enough food.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ya tiis la wal bɛdegʋ ka ya pɔɔd la du'a zʋʋd pamm, ala ka ya kʋ lɛn dit nyan tɛɛns la sʋʋgin ka li anɛ kɔ'ɔm yɛlaa.

english_verse: People of Israel, I'm not doing these things for your sake. You sinned against me, and you must suffer shame and disgrace for what you have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye ya baŋ ye, li ka' yanam yɛla ka m niŋid nɛ'ɛŋaa. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. “Israel dima, kɛlli ka nyan mɔri ya ka ya zut ziidi ya itʋŋ la yɛla!”

english_verse: After I have made you clean, I will let you rebuild your ruined towns and let you live in them.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, Daakanɛ ka m pie ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa bas la, m na maali ya zin'ili ya, ya tempʋʋsin la ka kɛ ka ya lɛbi mɛ dabɔɔd la.

english_verse: Your land will be plowed again, and nobody will be able to see that it was once barren.
translation_verse: Zin'ikanɛ ka ba bas ka sɔ' kae la, ba na kua li, ka li kʋ lɛn dig zaalim ka nidib dɔlli ani gat ka gɔsidaa.

english_verse: Instead, they will say that it looks as beautiful as the garden of Eden. They won't see towns lying in ruins, but they will see your strong cities filled with people.
translation_verse: Ba na yɛl ye, “Zin'ikaŋa nwaa da dig zaalim la, li yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ Eden lɔmbɔn'ɔg nɛ; tempʋbanɛ da san'am-san'am an dabɔɔdi digi ka sɔ' ka' anina la yʋ'ʋn mɔr kpi'euŋ ka nidib bɛɛ li pʋʋgin.”

english_verse: Then the nearby nations that survive will know that I am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and replanted the barren fields. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Ala ka tɛɛns banɛ kpɛlim giligi ya la na baŋ ye man Zugsɔb la lɛbisi mɛ' linɛ da san'am la, ka lɛbis zin'ikanɛ ka nidib da ka' anina la li zin'igin. Man Zugsɔb la pian' ka na tʋmi li.

english_verse: I will once again answer your prayers, and I will let your nation grow until you are like a large flock of sheep.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, M na lɛn wʋm Israel dim fabʋlʋg la ya'as ka tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa tisi ba: m na kɛ ka ba biis zu'oe nwɛnɛ pɛ'ɛs nɛ,

english_verse: The towns that now lie in ruins will be filled with people, just as Jerusalem was once filled with sheep to be offered as sacrifices during a festival. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: ba na zu'oe nwɛnɛ malʋŋ saŋa pɛ'ɛs banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la. Ala ka dabɔɔd la na lɛm pɛ'ɛl nɛ nidib. Ala ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.”

english_verse: Some time later, I felt the Lord's power take control of me, and his Spirit carried me to a valley full of bones.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la paŋ daa bɛɛ m san'an, ka o yisim nɛ o Siig la paŋi zi'elim bɔn'ɔg sʋʋgin; ka kɔnba ma'aa da pɛ'ɛl anina.

english_verse: The Lord showed me all around, and everywhere I looked I saw bones that were dried out.
translation_verse: Ka o mɔrimi gilig bɔn'ɔg la wʋsa, ka m nyɛ kɔnba bɛdegʋ ka li dig bɔn'ɔgin la. Kɔnba la da kʋdignɛ hali.

english_verse: He said, “Ezekiel, son of man, can these bones come back to life?” I replied, “Lord God, only you can answer that.”
translation_verse: Ka o bu'osim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, kɔnbbama na lɛn nyaŋi vʋ'ʋgɛɛ?” Ka m lɛbisi yɛl o ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, fʋn ma'aa mi'.”

english_verse: He then told me to say: Dry bones, listen to what the Lord is saying to you,
translation_verse: Ani ka o yɛlim ye, “Di'emi m nɔɔr pian'adi tis kɔnba nwa' ka yɛli ba ye, ‘Yanam kɔnba banɛ kʋdigɛ, kɛlisimi Zugsɔb la pian'ad!

english_verse: “I, the Lord God, will put breath in you, and once again you will live.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛt kɔnbbama si'em nwa': M na kɛ ka vʋ'ʋsʋm kpɛn' ya ni, ka ya na vʋ'ʋg.

english_verse: I will wrap you with muscles and skin and breathe life into you. Then you will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ya giinla lɛb na, ka kɛ ka ya niŋgbina lɛb na, ka kɛ ka niŋgbina la gbauŋ lɛb na. M na niŋ vʋ'ʋsʋm ya ni, ka ya na vʋ'ʋg. Ala ka ya na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.’”

english_verse: I did what the Lord said, but before I finished speaking, I heard a rattling noise. The bones were coming together!
translation_verse: Ala ka m sid di'e o nɔɔr pian'adi tisi ba wʋʋ on yɛlim si'em la. Ka mam bɛɛ ani pian'ad la ka m wʋm ka li dammid nwɔnr-nwɔnr, ka kɔnba la la'as taaba ka kɔnbir wʋsa tɔ'ɔŋ nɛ o tiraan.

english_verse: I saw muscles and skin cover the bones, but they had no life in them.
translation_verse: Ka m gɔsi nyɛ giinla nɛ niŋgbina nɛ niŋgbiŋ gbauŋ ka li lusi ba, amaa ka vʋ'ʋsʋm lɛɛ ka' ba pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, now say to the wind, “The Lord God commands you to blow from every direction and to breathe life into these dead bodies, so they can live again.”
translation_verse: Ani ka o yɛlim ye, “Di'emi m nɔɔr pian'adi tis vʋ'ʋsʋm la; pian'am, Ninsaal biiga, ka yɛl ye, ‘Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, Vʋ'ʋsʋm! Yim dunia lʋga anaasi la na vʋ'ʋsi niŋ banɛ kpii dig nwa', ka ba nyɛ vʋm.’”

english_verse: As soon as I said this, the wind blew among the bodies, and they came back to life! They all stood up, and there were enough to make a large army.
translation_verse: Ka m sid di'e o nɔɔr pian'adi tisi ba wʋʋ on yɛlim si'em la, ka vʋm kpɛn' ba ni; ka ba vʋ'ʋg ka duoe zi'en. Ba da anɛ dap banɛ zu'oe zemis zaba ken.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are like dead bones. They complain that they are dried up and that they have no hope for the future.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, Ninsaal biiga, kɔnbbama anɛ Israel dim. Ba yɛl ye, Ti kɔnba kʋdig ya ka ti pʋ lɛm mɔr ti'irɛ; tinam yɛla naae ya.

english_verse: So tell them, “I, the Lord God, promise to open your graves and set you free. I will bring you back to Israel,
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, di'emi m nɔɔr pian'adi yɛli ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “M nidiba, m ye m yɔ'ɔsnɛ ya yaad ka yisi ya na. M na mɔri ya lɛb Israel teŋin na.

english_verse: and when that happens, you will realize that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Lin ka m nidib la na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la, m ya'a ti yɔ'ɔs yaad la ka yisi ya na.

english_verse: My Spirit will give you breath, and you will live again. I will bring you home, and you will know that I have kept my promise. I, the Lord, have spoken.” Judah and Israel Together Again
translation_verse: M na nɔki m Siig la niŋi ya pʋʋgin ka ya na vʋe, ka m na zin'ili ya, ya mɛŋ teŋin. Lin ka ya na baŋ ye man Zugsɔb la sid pian' li ka tʋmi li.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Juda nɛ Israel na an sʋ'ʋlim yinne

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Judah.” Then get another stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, nɔkim duori sɔb ka li an Juda dim sʋ'ʋlim din. Nɔkim duor yinne ya'asi sɔb ka li an Israel dim sʋ'ʋlim din.

english_verse: Hold these two sticks end to end, so they look like one stick.
translation_verse: Nɔkimi ba tɔ'ɔŋ taaba ka li lieb yinne fʋ nu'ugin.

english_verse: And when your people ask you what this means,
translation_verse: Fʋ teŋ la dim ya'a ti bu'osif ye, Fʋ kʋ yɛli ti nɛ'ɛŋa gbinnɛɛ?

english_verse: tell them that I, the Lord, will join together the stick of Israel and the stick of Judah. I will hold them in my hand, and they will become one.
translation_verse: Fʋn yɛlimi ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “M ye m nɔknɛ duor kanɛ zi'e Israel yɛla la la'as nɛ duor kanɛ zi'e Juda yɛla la. M na la'asi babayi' la ka li an duor yinne m nu'ugin.”

english_verse: Hold these two sticks where they can be seen by everyone
translation_verse: Mɔr duobanɛ ka fʋ sɔbi niŋi ba zug la na ka ba nini nyɛ

english_verse: and then say: I, the Lord God, will gather the people of Israel and bring them home from the foreign nations where they now live.
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba ye, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, M na yis Israel dim tɛɛns banɛ ka ba bɛ la ni. M na la'asi ba zin'ibanɛ gilig la wʋsa mɔri ba na lɛbisi ba mɛŋ teŋin.

english_verse: I will make them into one nation and let them once again live in the land of Israel. Only one king will rule them, and they will never again be divided into two nations.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ba lieb buudi yinne bɛ teŋgbauŋʋn la, Israel zuoya la ni. Ba wʋsa na mɔr na'ab yinne, ka ba kʋ pʋdigi an tɛɛns ayi' bɛɛ sʋ'ʋlimnam ayi' ya'asɛ.

english_verse: They will no longer worship idols and do things that make them unacceptable to me. I will wash away their sin and make them clean, and I will protect them from everything that makes them unclean. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ lɛn dian'a ba mɛŋ nɛ ba bada la, nɛ linɛ ka ba ya'ab bɛɛ kpi'a la, bɛɛ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd banɛ ka ba tʋm la. Bɔzugɔ m na faaɛn baa ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ kɛ ka ba lɛbid nya'aŋ la ni ka pie ba. Ka ba na aan m nidib, ka mam na aan ba Wina'am.

english_verse: Their king will always come from the family of my servant King David and will care for them like a shepherd. The people of Israel will faithfully obey my laws. They and their descendants will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Ba na bɛ teŋ kanɛ ka m da tisim tʋmtʋm Jakob, ka ya yaanam da bɛ la. Ban nɛ ba biis nɛ ba yaas na bɛɛ ani saŋa wʋsa, ka David onɛ aan m tʋmtʋm la na aan ba na'ab saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: I solemnly promise to bless the people of Israel with unending peace. I will protect them and let them become a powerful nation. My temple will stand in Israel for all time,
translation_verse: M na maal sumbʋgʋsʋm nɔnaar nɛ ba; li na anɛ nɔnaar linɛ bɛ saŋa wʋsa. M na zin'ili ba ka kɛ ka ba kal zu'oe, ka na zi'eli m Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la ba sʋʋgin saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: and I will live among my people and be their God.
translation_verse: M bɛllim zin'ig na bɛɛ ba san'an. M na aan ba Wina'am, ka ba mɛ na aan m nidib.

english_verse: Every nation on earth will know that my temple is in Israel and that I have chosen the Israelites to be my people.
translation_verse: Lin ka tɛɛns la na baŋ ye man Zugsɔb la maal Israel ka ba an kasi, m Pʋ'ʋsim Zin'ig la ya'a bɛɛ ba san'an saŋa wʋsa.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog, that wicked ruler of the kingdoms of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog. Tell him:
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, ʋkimi fʋ nindaa kpa' Gog onɛ bɛ Magog teŋin la, ka o anɛ na'atita'ar kanɛ sʋ'oe Mesek nɛ Tubal tɛɛns la. Di'emi m nɔɔr pian'ad linɛ ka m zɛrig o la tis o

english_verse: and I will make you powerless! I will put a hook in your jaw and drag away both you and your large army. You command cavalry troops that wear heavy armor and carry shields and swords.
translation_verse: M na fɛndigif, ka nɔk gu'osi gban'e fʋ yieri mɔri fʋ yis na, fʋn nɛ fʋ zabzabidib la wʋsa, banɛ an widi nɛ wiedban'adib banɛ ti'eb zaba sʋ'ʋŋa la, nɛ zabzabidib banɛ zu'oe ka yɛ zaba fuud ka mɔr gbanti'edis linɛ an bʋmbɛda nɛ bʋmbibis la, ka ba wʋsa ti'eb nɛ ba zaba sʋ'ʋs.

english_verse: as well as from Gomer and Beth-Togarmah in the north. Your army is enormous!
translation_verse: Goma dim nɛ ba zabzabidib wʋsa na bɛ, nɛ Bet Togama dim banɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ baba lalli la nɛ ba zabzabidib wʋsa; tɛɛns bɛdegʋ bɛɛ fʋ san'an.

english_verse: So keep your troops prepared to fight,
translation_verse: “Ti'ebim, fʋn nɛ nimbanɛ la'asi giligif la, ka tisi ba nɔɔr.

english_verse: because in a few years, I will command you to invade Israel, a country that was ruined by war. It was deserted for a long time, but its people have returned from the foreign nations where they once lived. The Israelites now live in peace in the mountains of their own land.
translation_verse: Yʋma bɛdegʋ nya'aŋ, ba na buoli ya ye ya yim zaba na. Yʋma banɛ na ti kena la, fʋ na kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka ba da zabi nyaŋi ba ka ba yʋ'ʋn paam yɔlisim la. Ba da bas teŋ kaŋa ka li yuug, ka nidib yʋ'ʋn la'as tɛɛns bɛdegʋ nii lɛb Israel zuoya la ni na. Ba mɔri ba yis tɛɛnsin la na, ka ba yʋ'ʋn bɛ nɛ sumalisim nannanna.

english_verse: But you and your army will attack them like a fierce thunderstorm and surround them like a cloud.
translation_verse: Fʋn nɛ fʋ zabzabidib la wʋsa, nɛ tɛɛns bɛdegʋ banɛ la'as nɛf la, na keŋ ani kpɛn'ɛd tɔ'ɔtɔ wʋʋ sisi'em nɛ, ka ya na nwɛnɛ saŋgbana lusi ba teŋ la.”

english_verse: When that day comes, I know that you will have an evil plan
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Daakan la ya'a paae, pʋtɛn'ɛsi'a na kɛɛn fʋ san'an na, ka fʋ na gban'e gban'abɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: to take advantage of Israel, that weak and peaceful country where people live safely inside towns that have no walls or gates or locks.
translation_verse: Fʋ na yɛl ye, ‘M na zab nɛ teŋkpɛmis nɛ tembibis banɛ pʋ mɔr zaŋguoma la. M na zab nɛ teŋ kanɛ zin' baanlimm nɛ sumalisim, nɛ nimbanɛ pʋ mɔr ti'ir si'a ka ba tɛɛns la pʋ mɔr zaŋguoma nɛ za'anɔya kparid la.

english_verse: You will rob the people in towns that were once a pile of rubble. These people lived as prisoners in foreign nations, but they have returned to Israel, the most important place in the world, and they own livestock and property.
translation_verse: M na faaɛn ka vaae la'ad ka zab nɛ banɛ lɛbi zin'in dabɔɔdin la, nɛ banɛ ka ba la'asi ba yi tɛɛnsin la lɛbis na la, ka ba mɔr bʋnkɔnbid nɛ la'ad ka zin' teŋ la teŋsʋk la.’

english_verse: The people of Sheba and Dedan, along with merchants from villages in southern Spain, will be your allies. They will want some of the silver and gold, as well as the livestock and property that your army takes from Israel.
translation_verse: Seeba teŋ dim nɛ Dedan teŋ dim nɛ Tarsis dim banɛ kpiisid la nɛ ba tembibis la na bu'osif ye, ‘Fʋ kena ye fʋ zu ka faan? Fʋ la'asi fʋ nidib la ye ya zu ka vaae anzurifa nɛ sanlima, ka kad bʋnkɔnbid ka fan' ka vaae la'ad bɛdegʋʋ?’”

english_verse: you will lead your powerful cavalry from your kingdom in the north.
translation_verse: Fʋn nɛ tɛɛns bɛdegʋ na yi ya-datiuŋ baba kena. Nidib la na zu'oe ka an zabzabidib banɛ kpi'em, ka ba wʋsa ban'ad widi.

english_verse: You will attack my people like a storm-cloud that covers their land. I will let you invade my country Israel, so that every nation on earth will know that I, the Lord, am holy. Judgment on Gog
translation_verse: Ya na zabid nɛ m nidib Israel dim la, ka ya na nwɛnɛ saa nɛ saŋgbana na pil teŋgbauŋ la nɛ. Gog, saŋa kenna ka m na kɛ ka fʋ zab nɛ m teŋ la ka tɛɛns la baŋim, m ya'a ti pa'al ye m anɛ kasi ka li yinɛ fʋn san'an na ka ba nini nyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Gog: Long ago, I ordered my prophets to warn the people of Israel that someday I would send an enemy to attack them. You, Gog, are that enemy, and that day is coming.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, Ka' fʋn ka m da dɛŋi pian' tisim nɔdi'esidib banɛ bɛ Israel ka ba pian' fʋ yɛla laa? Ba da pian' ye saŋa kenna ka m na kɛ ka fʋ zab nɛ ba.

english_verse: and in my anger I will send a terrible earthquake to shake Israel.
translation_verse: M nini ya'a ti mu'oe ka m sʋnf duoe, Israel teŋ la na dam hali.

english_verse: Every living thing on earth will tremble in fear of me—every fish and bird, every wild animal and reptile, and every human. Mountains will crumble, cliffs will fall, and cities will collapse.
translation_verse: Zimi banɛ bɛ atɛukʋn la, nɛ niis banɛ ian'ad agɔla, nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ ken teŋin la, nɛ bʋnvuuda banɛ vuud teŋin la nɛ nimbanɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ la zug la wʋsa na kiridi m tuon. Zuoya la na tʋlig, ka zuobanɛ an gbɛʋʋ la kɔɔ li na, ka zaŋguoma wʋsa lii paae teŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the mountains of Israel turn against you. Your troops will be so terrified that they will attack each other.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ba zab nɛ Gog m zuoya la ni wʋsa. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Ka sɔ' wʋsa na zabid nɛ o ba'abiig.

english_verse: I will strike you with diseases and punish you with death. You and your army will be pounded with rainstorms, hailstones, and burning sulfur.
translation_verse: M na namis o ka kɛ ka ban'as nɛ kum paae o; m na kpa'ae saa nɛ sisi'em nɛ sakuga nɛ kidibir linɛ nyɛligid la niŋ on nɛ o zabzabidib la zugin nɛ tɛɛns bɛdegʋ banɛ kpɛn'ɛd o zug la.

english_verse: I will do these things to show the world that I, the Lord, am holy.
translation_verse: Ala ka m na pa'alim kpi'euŋ nɛ man an kasi si'em, ka kɛ ka tɛɛns bɛdegʋ baŋim. Lin ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog and tell him: You are the ruler of Meshech and Tubal, but I, the Lord, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Ninsaal biiga, di'emi m nɔɔr pian'ad linɛ ka m zɛrig Gog la tis o ka yɛl o ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, ‘Fʋn Gog onɛ an Mesek nɛ Tubal na'atita'ar la, fʋ anɛ m dataa.

english_verse: I will turn you around and drag you from the north until you reach the mountains of Israel.
translation_verse: M na fɛndigif ka vuugi fʋ keŋ. M na mɔri fʋ yi ya-datiuŋ linɛ bɛ lalli la mɔri fʋ keŋ kpan'al nɛ Israel zuoya la.

english_verse: I will knock the bow out of your left hand and the arrows out of your right hand,
translation_verse: Ani ka m na nwɛ' fʋ tiraug linɛ bɛɛ fʋ dagɔbʋg nu'ugin la, ka piema la naanɛ fʋ datiuŋ nu'ugin li.

english_verse: and you and your army will die on those mountains. Then birds and wild animals will eat the flesh
translation_verse: Fʋn nɛ zabzabidib nɛ tɛɛns banɛ sʋŋidif la na kpi Israel zuoya la ni. M na kɛ ka ya niŋgbina lieb diibi tis niis nɛ sian'arin bʋnkɔnbid.

english_verse: of your dead bodies left lying in open fields. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ya na kpi paalʋ ni.’ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: I will set fire to the land of Magog and to those nations along the seacoast that think they are so secure, and they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: ‘M na kɛ ka bugum la'aŋ Magog teŋ la nɛ banɛ bɛɛ atɛuk nɔɔrin ka yɛlsi'a pʋ daamidi ba la, ala ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: My people Israel will know me, and they will no longer disgrace my holy name. Everyone on earth will know that I am the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: “‘M na kɛ ka Israel dim baŋi m yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la. M kʋ lɛn kɛ ka ba san'ami m yʋ'ʋrɛ, ala ka tɛɛns la na baŋ ye manɛ an Israel Zugsɔb onɛ an Kasi la.

english_verse: The day is coming when these things will happen, just as I have promised.
translation_verse: Li kenna; li sid na maal.’ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. ‘Dabiskaŋa yɛla la ka m pian' la.

english_verse: When that day comes, the people in the towns of Israel will collect the weapons of their dead enemies. They will use these shields, bows and arrows, spears, and clubs as firewood, and there will be enough to last for seven years.
translation_verse: Ala ka banɛ bɛ Israel tempʋʋsin la na vaae Gog nɛ o nidib la zaba la'ad la na ka li lieb bʋntuguda, ka nyu'oe gbanti'edis banɛ an bʋmbɛda nɛ bʋmbibis la. Ba na nyu'oe tiraad nɛ piema nɛ balaya nɛ kpana. Ba na nyɔ'ɔdi li yʋma ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: They will burn these weapons instead of gathering sticks or chopping down trees. That's how the Israelites will take revenge on those who robbed and abused them. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Burial of Gog The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ba kʋ keŋ pi'is daad bɛɛ ba keŋ sian'arin nwa' daadɛ, bɔzugɔ ba na zaŋ zaba la'ad la tugul bugum. Banɛ vaae ba la'ad la, ba mɛ na vaae ba la'ad, ka banɛ faaɛn ba la'ad, ba na faaɛn ba mɛn.’ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: After Gog has been destroyed, I will bury him and his army in Israel, in Travelers' Valley, east of the Dead Sea. That graveyard will be so large that it will block the way of anyone who tries to walk through the valley, which will then be known as “The Valley of Gog's Army.”
translation_verse: “Daakan la ya'a ti paae, m na mum Gog Israel teŋin, Suokennib Bɔn'ɔg linɛ bɛ atɛuk nya'aŋ la. Li na vi' suokennib suor bɔzugɔ, ba na mum Gog nɛ o nidib la wʋsa anina. ‘Alazugɔ ba na buonnɛ li ye Hamon Gog Bɔn'ɔg la.’

english_verse: The Israelites will spend seven months burying dead bodies and cleaning up their land.
translation_verse: “Nwadis ayɔpɔi ka Israel dim na nɔki mumi ba, ye li sʋŋ ka teŋ la an nyain.

english_verse: Everyone will help with the burial, and they will be honored for this on the day the brightness of my glory is seen.
translation_verse: Nidib banɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa na mumi ba, ka daakanɛ ka m na nyɛ zʋn'or la na an dabistita'are tisi ba. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: After those seven months, the people will appoint a group of men to look for any dead bodies left unburied. This must be done for seven months to make sure that the land is no longer unclean.
translation_verse: “Nwadis ayɔpɔi la nya'aŋ, ba na bɔ dap ka ba maal teŋ la nyain, ba na kɛ ka dap sieba mɛ giligidi pi'isid banɛ kpii wɛɛl la mum.

english_verse: Whenever they find a human bone, they will set up a marker next to it. Then the gravediggers will bury it in “The Valley of Gog's Army”
translation_verse: Ban giligid teŋin la, onɛ wʋsa nyɛ ninsaal kɔnbir na sɛ si'eli maal zanbin ka bayaas la ti paae na nɔki mum Hamon Gog Bɔn'ɔgin la.

english_verse: near the town of “Gog's Army.” After that, the land will be pure again.
translation_verse: Ka ba mɛ na maal teŋ kan la nyain.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to hold a feast on Israel's mountains and offer sacrifices there. So invite all the birds and wild animals to come from every direction and eat the meat of sacrifices and drink the blood. The birds and animals
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Ninsaal biiga, buolim niimis buudi wʋsa nɛ sian'anr bʋnkɔnbid la wʋsa, ye, ‘La'asimi na zi'enɛ gilig maan linɛ ka m ti'ebid ye m tisi ya, Israel zuoya la ni la. Ani ka ya na ɔnb ni'im ka nu ziim.

english_verse: will feast on the bodies of warriors and foreign rulers that I will sacrifice like sheep, goats, and bulls.
translation_verse: Ya na ɔnb nintitada ni'im ka nu teŋin la na'abiis ziim, ka li nwɛnɛ ba anɛ Basan pɛraad nɛ pɛbibis, nɛ bʋʋs nɛ na'araad banɛ nɔb la.

english_verse: I want the birds and animals to eat until they are full and drink until they are drunk.
translation_verse: Maan linɛ ka m ti'ebid ye m tisi ya la, ya na ɔnb ni'im linɛ mɔr kpaam ka ya pʋya pid, ka nu ziim kʋʋl.

english_verse: They will come to my table and stuff themselves with the flesh of horses and warriors of every kind. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Israel Will Be Restored The Lord said:
translation_verse: M diib zin'igin la, ya na ɔnb widi nɛ banɛ ban'adi ba la, nɛ nintitada nɛ soogianam nɛ ba buudi wʋsa.’ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.”

english_verse: The people of Israel will know from then on that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Lin yi daakanɛ ken la, Israel dim na baŋ ye manɛ aan ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la.

english_verse: Foreign nations will realize that the Israelites were forced to leave their own land because they sinned against me. I turned my back on my people and let enemies attack and kill them.
translation_verse: Ka tɛɛns la na baŋ ye Israel dim la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi kɛ ka ba lɔ'ɔŋ teŋ zʋŋ, ban da pʋ dɔllim nɛ sida la zug, ka m fɛndig ka basi ba, ka nɔki ba niŋi ba dataas nu'usin, ka ba kʋʋ ba wʋsa.

english_verse: Their lives were wicked and corrupt, and they deserved to be punished.
translation_verse: M maali ba nɛ wʋʋ ba dian'ad nɛ ba pɔ'ɔgiri an si'em la, lin ka m fɛndig ka basi ba.”

english_verse: Now I will show mercy to the people of Israel and bring them back from the nations where they are living. They are Jacob's descendants, so I will bless them and show that I am holy.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “M yʋ'ʋn na mɔr Jakob nidib la lɛbis na, ka zɔ Israel dim la wʋsa nimbaanlig, ka na mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ m yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la.

english_verse: They will live safely in their own land, but will be ashamed when they remember their evil ways and how they disgraced me.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a ti lɛbi zin'inɛ ba teŋin la ka sɔ' kae na kpɛn'ɛsi ba dabiem. Ba na tami ba nyan la yɛla, nɛ ban da pʋ tisidi m sida si'em la.

english_verse: Foreign nations will watch as I take the Israelites from enemy lands and bring them back home, and those nations will see that I am holy.
translation_verse: M ya'a ti mɔri ba yi tɛɛnsin la lɛb na ka la'asi ba yi zin'ibanɛ ka ba widigi kpɛn' ba dataas san'an la, m na dɔlisi baa pa'alim mɛŋ ye m anɛ kasi tɛɛns la sʋʋgin.

english_verse: My people will realize that I, the Lord their God, sent them away as prisoners and now will bring them back to their own land.
translation_verse: Lin ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ aan ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la, la'an nɛ man da kadi ba kpɛn'ɛs sankpan'asim tɛɛns la sʋʋgin la, M na la'asi ba, ba mɛŋ teŋin, ka kʋ bas baa yinnee.

english_verse: Never again will I turn my back on the people of Israel, and my Spirit will live in them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: M kʋ lɛn fɛndig ka kɛɛ baa, bɔzugɔ m na kpa'ae m Siig la niŋ Israel dimin.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Twenty-five years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, and
translation_verse: Wina'am la nier pʋʋgin, o da nɔkimi keŋ Israel teŋinɛ zi'elim zuor kanɛ wa'am hali zugin, ka li bɛ ya-datiuŋ baba la ka m nyɛ mɛɛb ka li zi'e nwɛnɛ tempʋʋg.

english_verse: He measured the entrance room at the far end of the passageway, and it was ten meters wide.
translation_verse: Ka o maki gilig dɔbanɛ ka ba dɔlli kpɛn'ɛd la ti paae za'ambɛŋ la bɛn, ka li an nɔba makir piswai.

english_verse: In my vision the Lord took me closer, and I saw a man who was sparkling like polished bronze. He was standing near one of the gates and was holding a tape measure in one hand and a measuring stick in the other.
translation_verse: On mɔrimi paae ani la, ka m nyɛ dau ka o nyɛɛn nwɛnɛ kʋntzɛn'ug; ka o zi'e za'anɔɔrin la m mɔr nwiig kanɛ makid ka zanl daug kanɛ makid o nu'ugin.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay close attention to everything I'm going to show you—that's why you've been brought here. Listen carefully, because you must tell the people of Israel what you see.” The East Gate
translation_verse: Ka dau la yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, gɔsim nɛ fʋ nini ka wʋm nɛ fʋ tʋba ka kɛlis linɛ wʋsa ka m ye m pa'alif la, ka lin yɛla ka ba mɔrif kpɛla na. Yɛlim Israel dim la linɛ ka fʋ nyɛ wʋsa.” Za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋi kpɛn'ɛd zakin la yɛla

english_verse: Then he went to the east gate, where he walked up steps that led to a long passageway. On each side of this passageway were three guardrooms, which were three meters square, and they were separated by walls two and a half meters thick. The man measured the distance between the opening of the gate and the first guardroom, and it was three meters, the thickness of the outer wall. At the far end of this passageway, I saw an entrance room that faced the courtyard of the temple itself. There was also a distance of three meters between the last guardroom and the entrance room
translation_verse: Banɛ gur la dɔɔd la da bɛ za'anɔɔrin la, ka za'anɔya la yalʋŋ an makir daug yinne ka li wa'alim an daug la makir yinne. Ka dɔkpina banɛ bɛ dɔɔd la teŋsʋk la labisim an nɔbir makir anii. Ka mɛɛb linɛ bɛ zanɔɔr la tuonnɛ kpa' Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la zulʋŋ an makir daug la yinne.

english_verse: at the end of the passageway. The man measured this room: It was four meters from the doorway to the opposite wall, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one meter.
translation_verse: ka li mugulim an makir daug la yinne, ka li labisim an nɔbir makir anaasi. Ka za'ambɛŋ la kpa' Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la.

english_verse: The three guardrooms on each side of the passageway were the same size, and the walls that separated them were the same thickness.
translation_verse: Za'anɔɔr linɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ la pʋʋgin da mɔr banɛ gur la dɔɔd atan' tan' dagɔbʋg nɛ datiuŋ wʋsa; dɔɔd la wʋsa makir anɛ yinne, ka dɔkpina banɛ baki ba la tɛbisim zem taaba.

english_verse: Next, the man measured the width of the passageway, and it was six and a half meters, but the two doors of the gate were only five meters wide.
translation_verse: Ka o maki li yalʋŋʋ paae za'anɔɔrin la; ka li an pii nɛ anu ka li wa'alim an pisi nɛ yinne.

english_verse: The man measured the distance from the back wall of one of these rooms to the same spot in the room directly across the passageway, and it was twelve and a half meters.
translation_verse: Ka o mak dɔɔd ayi' banɛ kpa' taaba za'anɔɔrin la ka li wa'alim makir an nɔba makir pistan' nɛ ayɔpɔi nɛ pʋsʋk.

english_verse: Finally, he measured the total length of the passageway, from the outer wall to the entrance room, and it was
translation_verse: Lin yi za'anɔɔrin la keŋ paae za'ambɛŋ la makir bɛn la anɛ nɔba makir pisyɔpɔi nɛ anu.

english_verse: The three walls in the guardrooms had small windows in them, just like the ones in the entrance room. The walls along the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. The Outer Courtyard
translation_verse: Dɔɔd la dɔkpina banɛ bɛ pʋʋgin nɛ yiŋ la da mɔr takorobibisi gilig, ka za'ambɛŋ la mɛ da aan ala, ka takoronam la wʋsa kpa' pʋʋgin. Ka ba gʋl si'el ka li nwɛnɛ kpʋkparis vaandi tabili li dɔkpina la ni. Zak kanɛ bɛ yiŋ la

english_verse: The man then led me through the passageway and into the outer courtyard of the temple, where I saw
translation_verse: Ka o mɔrimi kpɛn' zak kanɛ bɛ yiŋ la ni. Ani ka m nyɛ dɔɔd ka ba maal suorinɛ gilig zak la; dɔɔd pistan' da dɔlis suor la gilig.

english_verse: I saw the gates that led to the inner courtyard of the temple and noticed that they were higher than those leading to the outer courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gates, and it was
translation_verse: Ka o maki li pʋʋgin paae za'anɔɔr linɛ bɛ teŋir la keŋ yi zak kanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la yiŋ, ka li ya-nya'aŋ la an nɔba makir kɔbiga nɛ pisnu wʋʋ li ya-datiuŋʋ an si'em la. Ya-datiuŋ za'anɔɔr

english_verse: Next, the man measured the north gate that led to the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Ka o mak za'anɔɔr kanɛ dɔlli yit zak kanɛ bɛ yiŋi kpa' ya-datiuŋ la wa'alim nɛ li yalʋŋ.

english_verse: This gate also had three guardrooms on each side of a passageway. The measurements of these rooms, the walls between them, and the entrance room at the far end of the passageway were exactly the same as those of the east gate. The north gate was also
translation_verse: Za'anɔkaŋa da mɔr banɛ gur la dɔɔd atan' tan' li lʋga ayi' wʋsa ni. Li dɔkpina la nɛ li za'ambɛŋ la da zem nɛ taaba wʋʋ za'anɔkanɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ la. Li wa'alim anɛ nɔba makir pisyɔpɔi nɛ anu ka li yalʋŋ an pistan' nɛ ayɔpɔi nɛ pʋsʋk.

english_verse: and the windows, the entrance room, and the carvings of palm trees were just like those in the east gate. The entrance room also faced the courtyard of the temple and had seven steps leading up to it.
translation_verse: Li takoronam nɛ li zaŋguoma nɛ kpʋkparis vaand banɛ ka ba gʋli tabili li dɔkpina la makir anɛ yinne wʋʋ za'anɔɔr kanɛ kpa' ya-nya'aŋ la. Li dʋʋsa la anɛ ayɔpɔi ka li za'ambɛŋ la kpa' li.

english_verse: Directly across the outer courtyard was a gate that led to the inner courtyard, just as there was for the east gate. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was
translation_verse: Za'anɔɔr da bɛɛ kpɛn'ɛd zak kanɛ bɛ pʋʋginɛ kpa' ya-datiuŋ la wʋʋ ya-nya'aŋ din la mɔr si'em la. Ka o mak za'anɔya banɛ kpa' taaba la lal nɛ taaba si'em; ka li an nɔba makir kɔbiga nɛ pisnu.

english_verse: The man then took me to the south gate. He measured the walls and the entrance room of this gate, and the measurements were exactly the same as those of the other two gates.
translation_verse: Ka o dɔllimi lɛb ya-dagɔbʋg baba ka m nyɛ za'anɔɔr kanɛ kpa' zin'ikan la. Ka o maki li dɔkpina banɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la nɛ li za'ambɛŋ la, ka li zem nɛ za'anɔbama la.

english_verse: Seven steps led up to the gate; the entrance room was at the far end of the passageway and faced the courtyard of the temple. Carvings of palm trees decorated the walls along the passageway.
translation_verse: Dʋʋsa ayɔpɔi ka fʋ na dʋʋ paae li, ka li za'ambɛŋ la kpa' zak la. Ka ba gʋl kpʋkparis vaandi tabili li dɔkpina la lʋga ayi' la wʋsa.

english_verse: And directly across the outer courtyard was a gate on the south side of the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was also
translation_verse: Zak kanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la mɛ mɔr za'anɔɔr ka li kpa' ya-dagɔbʋg baba, ka o mak za'anɔkaŋa keŋ paae za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ yiŋ ya-dagɔbʋg baba la, ka li an nɔba makir kɔbiga nɛ pisnu. Za'anɔbanɛ kpɛn'ɛd zak kanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la

english_verse: We then went into the inner courtyard, through the gate on the south side of the temple. The man measured the gate, and it was the same size as the gates in the outer wall.
translation_verse: Ka o mɔrimi dɔl za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ ya-dagɔbʋgʋ kpɛn' zak kanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la, ka mak za'anɔkan la ka li an yinne nɛ za'anɔbama la.

english_verse: The entrance room of this gate faced the outer courtyard, and carvings of palm trees decorated the walls of the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Li za'ambɛŋ la kpa' nɛ zak kanɛ bɛ yiŋ la; ka ba gʋl kpʋkparis vaandi tabili li dɔkpina la, ka li mɔr dʋʋsa anii dʋti li ni.

english_verse: Next, we went through the east gate to the inner courtyard. The man measured this gate, and it was the same size as the others.
translation_verse: Ka o mɔrimi kpɛn' zak kanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin ya-nya'aŋ baba la, ka maki li za'anɔɔr la; ka li makir an yinne nɛ bama la.

english_verse: The guardrooms, the walls separating them, and its entrance room had the same measurements as the other gates. The guardrooms and the entrance room had windows, and the gate was
translation_verse: Banɛ gur la dɔɔd nɛ li dɔkpina nɛ li za'ambɛŋ la makir zem nɛ taaba wʋʋ bama la. Za'anɔɔr la nɛ li za'ambɛŋ la mɔr takoronamɛ gilig. Ka li wa'alim an nɔba makir pisyɔpɔi nɛ anu ka li yalʋŋ an pistan' nɛ ayɔpɔi nɛ pʋsʋk.

english_verse: The entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and the walls in the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Banɛ gur la dɔɔd da kpa' nɛ zak kanɛ bɛ yiŋ la; ka ba gʋl kpʋkparis vaandi tabili li dɔkpina la, ka dʋʋsa anii dʋti li ni.

english_verse: Then the man took me to the north gate. He measured it, and it was the same size as the others,
translation_verse: Ka o mɔrimi lɛb za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ la ka maki li. Ka li makir an yinne nɛ bama la,

english_verse: including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, and the entrance room. There were also windows in this gate. It was
translation_verse: nwɛnɛ banɛ gur dɔbama la an si'em la, nɛ li dɔkpina nɛ li za'ambɛŋ la, ka li mɔr takoronamɛ gilig. Li wa'alim anɛ nɔba makir pisyɔpɔi nɛ anu ka li yalʋŋ an pistan' nɛ ayɔpɔi nɛ pʋsʋk.

english_verse: and like the other inner gates, its entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and its walls were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate. The Rooms for Sacrificing Animals
translation_verse: Li za'ambɛŋ la da kpa' nɛ zak kanɛ bɛ yiŋ la; ka ba gʋl kpʋkparis vaandi tabili li dɔkpina la li lʋga ayi' wʋsa, ka ba maal dʋʋsa anii paae za'anɔɔr la bɛn. Dɔbanɛ ka ba ti'ebid maana la'adi li pʋʋgin la

english_verse: Four more tables were in the outer courtyard, two on each side of the steps leading into the entrance room.
translation_verse: Za'ambɛmis la yiŋ, zin'ikanɛ kpi'e nɛ dʋʋsa linɛ dʋti kpɛn'ɛd ya-datiuŋ za'anɔɔr la, teebulnam ayi' da bɛɛ ani ka ayi' mɛ bɛ dʋʋsa la zin'ikanɛ kpɛlim la.

english_verse: So there was a total of eight tables, four inside and four outside, where the animals were killed,
translation_verse: Alazug za'anɔɔr la zin'ig yinne mɔri teebulnam anaasi ka zin'ig yinne mɛ mɔri anaasi. Maana kɔnbid la ka ba kɔtid teebul sieba zug la la'as nɛ teebulnam anii.

english_verse: and where the meat was placed until it was sacrificed on the altar. Next to the tables in the entrance room were four stone tables
translation_verse: Ka ba kpa' kʋnt gɔna tabil dɔkpin la gilig ka li labisim zem wʋʋ nu'ug nɛ ka li mɔr nɔya ayi', yi'. Ba da mɔri maan la ni'imi pa'an teebulnam la zug. Maanmaannib dɔɔd

english_verse: The man then took me to the inner courtyard, where I saw two buildings, one beside the inner gate on the north and the other beside the inner gate on the south.
translation_verse: Za'anɔɔr kanɛ da bɛ pʋʋgin zak la pʋʋgin la, dɔɔd ayi' da bɛɛ ani; dɔɔd ayi' da bɛ pʋʋgin la ka yinne tabi ya-datiuŋ za'anɔɔri kpa' ya-dagɔbʋg ka yinne mɛ tabi ya-dagɔbʋg za'anɔɔri kpa' ya-datiuŋ.

english_verse: He said, “The building beside the north gate belongs to the priests who serve in the temple,
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Dɔkanɛ kpa' ya-dagɔbʋg la anɛ maanmaannib banɛ gɔsid Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la dɔɔg,

english_verse: and the building beside the south gate belongs to those who serve at the altar. All of them are descendants of Zadok and are the only Levites allowed to serve as the Lord's priests.” The Inner Courtyard and the Temple
translation_verse: ka dɔkanɛ kpa' ya-datiuŋ la anɛ maanmaannib banɛ gɔsid bimbim la din. Bama anɛ Levi dim banɛ an Zadok yaas ka li nar ka ba li'en Zugsɔb la tʋmmi tisid o.”

english_verse: We walked to the porch of the temple, and the man measured the doorway of the porch: It was seven meters long, two and a half meters wide, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one and a half meters.
translation_verse: Ka o mɔrimi keŋ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg za'ambɛŋin la, maki li zaŋguoma la; ka li an nɔbir makir ayɔpɔi nɛ pʋsʋk zin'ig wʋsa. Za'anɔɔr la yalʋŋ anɛ nɔbir makir pisi nɛ yinne ka li zaŋguoma linɛ bɛŋ la an makir anaasi nɛ pʋsʋk li zin'ig wʋsa.

english_verse: The porch itself was ten meters by six meters, with steps leading up to it. There was a column on each side of these steps.
translation_verse: Za'ambɛŋ la yalʋŋ anɛ nɔba makir pistan' ka lin yii li tuonnɛ paae li nya'aŋ la an nɔba makir pii nɛ anu. Li mɔr dʋʋsa ka fʋ na dɔlli kpɛn', ka buos bɛ zanɔɔr la kpikpɛŋ, ka zin'ig wʋsa mɔr bua yinne.

english_verse: Next we went into the main room of the temple. The man measured the doorway of this room: It was
translation_verse: Dau la yʋ'ʋn da mɔrimi kpɛn' dɔkanɛ bɛ sʋʋgin ka ba buonnɛ li ye Zin'isʋŋ Linɛ an Kasi la, ka maki li zanɔɔr ka li zaŋguom la mugulim an nɔba makir awai.

english_verse: Then the man walked to the far end of the temple's main room and said, “Beyond this doorway is the most holy place.” He first measured the doorway: It was one meter wide,
translation_verse: Ka o mak pʋʋgin dɔkanɛ an Kasi Wʋsa Kasi la; ka li wa'alim an nɔba makir pistan', ka li yalʋŋ mɔri ala paae Zin'ig Sʋŋ la, ka li an pistan'. Ka o yɛlim ye, “Kasi Wʋsa Kasi dɔɔg la nwa'.”

english_verse: The walls of the temple were thicker at the bottom than at the top, which meant that the storage rooms on the top level were wider than those on the bottom level. Steps led from the bottom level, through the middle level, and into the top level.
translation_verse: Dɔbanɛ bɛ kpikpɛmisi gilig la da paas nɛ yalʋŋ sʋn'ʋlʋg wʋsa ni. Linɛ mɛɛ gilig Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la tɔ'ɔŋ nɛ taaba zugin ka dɔɔd la yaligidi dʋt wʋʋ ban tɔ'ɔŋ si'em la. Ba da maal dʋʋsa dɔbanɛ bɛ teŋir la ni ka li dʋti dɔl dɔbanɛ bɛ sʋʋgin la keŋ paae banɛ bɛ zugin la.

english_verse: The temple rested on a stone base three meters high, which also served as the foundation for the storage rooms.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ ka bimbim mɛɛ gilig Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la, naal nɛ dɔbanɛ bɛ kpikpɛmis la ɛɛnbir. Ka li tɛbisim an makir daug la yinne.

english_verse: The outside walls of the storage rooms were two and a half meters thick; there was nothing between these walls
translation_verse: Dɔbanɛ bɛ yiŋ la dɔkpin tɛbisim da anɛ nɔba makir ayɔpɔi nɛ pʋsʋk. Ka paalʋ bɛ dɔbanɛ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg kpikpɛŋ la

english_verse: One door led into the storage rooms on the north side of the temple, and another door led to those on the south side. The stone base extended two and a half meters beyond the outside wall of the storage rooms. The West Building and the Measurements of the Temple
translation_verse: Za'anɔya da bɛ zin'ikanɛ an paalʋ la ni kpɛn'ɛd dɔɔdin la, ka za'anɔɔr yinne bɛ ya-datiuŋ ka yinne bɛ ya-dagɔbʋg: ka paalʋ kanɛ bɛ li sʋʋgin gilig la yalʋŋ an nɔba makir ayɔpɔi nɛ pʋsʋk.

english_verse: The distance across the front of the temple, including the open space on either side, was also
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la zak linɛ lɛb ya-nya'aŋ la yalʋŋ, nɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la tuon wʋsa, da anɛ nɔba makir kɔbiga nɛ pisnu.

english_verse: Finally, the man measured the length of the west building, including the side rooms on each end, and it was also
translation_verse: Ka o mak dɔɔg linɛ kpa' zak la Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la nya'aŋ, la'an nɛ li dɔbibis la zin'ig wʋsa; ka li wa'alim an nɔba makir kɔbiga nɛ pisnu. Zin'ig Sʋŋ la, nɛ Kasi Wʋsa Kasi zin'ig, nɛ za'ambɛŋ kanɛ kpa' zak la,

english_verse: were paneled with wood all the way from the floor to the windows, while the doorways, the small windows, and the three side rooms were trimmed in wood.
translation_verse: la'an nɛ li zanɔɔr nɛ takorbibis la nɛ linɛ ka ba mɛɛ gilig dɔɔd atan' la nɛ si'el wʋsa la'an nɛ zanɔɔr la wʋsa ba da nɔknɛ daadi tabili taasi gilig. Lin yii li teŋin nɛ dɔkpinnin la paae takoronam la bɛn; hali takoronam la wʋsa mɛ tabil nɛ daad.

english_verse: The paneling stopped just above the doorway. These walls were decorated
translation_verse: Kasi Wʋsa Kasi zin'ig za'anɔɔr la zugin la nɛ dɔɔd ayi' la wʋsa dɔkpina banɛ gilig la wʋsa

english_verse: The doorframe to the temple's main room was in the shape of a rectangle. The Wooden Altar In front of the doorway to the most holy place was something that looked like
translation_verse: Zin'ikanɛ an Kasi la yiŋ za'anɔɔr la kʋlʋŋ la dazi'eda da anɛ mauk, ka linɛ bɛ Kasi Wʋsa Kasi zin'ig la tuon la mɛ nwɛnɛ ala.

english_verse: a wooden altar. It was one and a half meters high and one meter square, and its corners, its base, and its sides were made of wood. The man said, “This is a reminder that the Lord is constantly watching over his temple.” The Doors in the Temple
translation_verse: Daad malʋŋ teebul da bɛɛ ani ka li zugin wa'alim an nɔba makir anaasi nɛ pʋsʋk, li zin'ig wʋsa da anɛ daad. Ka dau la yɛlim ye, “Teebul kanɛ bɛ Zugsɔb tuon la nwa'.”

english_verse: Both the doorway to the main room of the temple and the doorway to the most holy place had two doors,
translation_verse: Zin'ikanɛ an Kasi la yiŋ nɛ Kasi Wʋsa Kasi pʋʋgin la da mɔri dalamma ayi', yi'.

english_verse: and each door had two sections that could fold open.
translation_verse: Kʋlʋŋ wʋsa da mɔr yɔ'ɔgir ayi' ka ba kpa' ba tabil taaba nɛ tabidis.

english_verse: The doors to the main room were decorated with carvings of winged creatures and palm trees just like those on the walls, and there was a wooden covering over the porch just outside these doors.
translation_verse: Kʋlis banɛ bɛ Kasi Zin'igin la ba da kpi'enɛ Kerubnam nɛ kpʋkparis vaand, wʋʋ dɔkpina la an si'em la, ka maal daadi tabili lus zaŋguoma la tuon.

english_verse: The walls on each side of this porch had small windows and were also decorated with carvings of palm trees.
translation_verse: Dɔkpina banɛ bɛ za'ambɛŋ kpikpɛmis la, takorbibis da bɛ ani ka ba kpi'e kpʋkparis vaandi tabili li zin'ig wʋsa. Dɔbanɛ bɛ kpikpɛmis la wʋsa da mɔr daad banɛ ya'ali lusi li.

english_verse: After the man and I left the temple and walked back to the outer courtyard, he showed me a set of rooms on the north side of the west building. This set of rooms was
translation_verse: Dɔkanɛ ka li za'anɔɔr kpa' ya-datiuŋ la wa'alim da anɛ nɔba makir kɔbiga nɛ pisnu ka li yalʋŋ an nɔba makir pisyɔpɔi nɛ anu.

english_verse: and at the east end of this wall was the door leading from the courtyard to these rooms. There was also a set of rooms on the south side of the west building.
translation_verse: Dɔɔd da bɛ ya-dagɔbʋg linɛ lɛbisid nya'aŋ baba la, dɔlis zaŋguom kanɛ bɛ zak kanɛ bɛ yiŋ la, tɔ'ɔŋ nɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg zak la, ka mɛ kpa' zaŋguom kanɛ bɛ yiŋ la,

english_verse: with doors that opened toward the north, and in front of them was a walkway five meters wide and
translation_verse: Dɔɔd la tuon da mɔr za'anɔɔr linɛ bɛ pʋʋgin ka li yalʋŋ an nɔba makir pii nɛ anu ka li wa'alim an nɔba makir kɔbiga nɛ pisnu, ka dɔbibis la za'anɔya kpa' ya-datiuŋ.

english_verse: The rooms on the top level were narrower than those on the middle level, and the rooms on the middle level were narrower than those on the bottom level.
translation_verse: Dɔbanɛ bɛ zugin la da yubilnɛ ka pʋ yalimma, bɔzugɔ ban da mɛ' ka maali gʋl si'elnam si'em la da kɛ ka li di paalʋ la ka dɔbanɛ bɛ zugin la pʋ yalimme paae dɔbanɛ bɛ teŋin nɛ teŋsʋk la.

english_verse: The rooms on the bottom level supported those on the two upper levels, and so these rooms did not have columns like other buildings in the courtyard.
translation_verse: Dɔbanɛ bɛ zugini sʋn'e atan' ni la da pʋ mɔr zan'antɔlis wʋʋ zakin la an si'em la; alazug ka ba pɔɔd ka pʋ yalim wʋʋ dɔbanɛ bɛ teŋin nɛ teŋsʋk laa.

english_verse: The man then said to me: These rooms on the north and south sides of the temple are the sacred rooms where the Lord's priests will eat the most holy offerings. These offerings include the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices for sin, and the sacrifices to make things right.
translation_verse: Ani ka o yɛlim ye, “Dɔbanɛ bɛ datiuŋ nɛ dagɔbʋgʋ kpa' Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg zak la anɛ maanmaannib la dɔɔd, zin'ikan la ka maanmaannib banɛ kpɛn'ɛd Zugsɔb san'an la na dit maan diib linɛ an kasi la. Ani ka ba na digin maan linɛ an kasi amɛŋa la. Linɛ an: zʋʋd maan, nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, nɛ taal maan la wʋsa, bɔzugɔ zin'ikan la anɛ kasi.

english_verse: When the priests are ready to leave the temple, they must go through these rooms before they return to the outer courtyard. They must leave their sacred clothes in these rooms and put on regular clothes before going anywhere near other people. The Size of the Temple Area
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la ya'a kpɛn' Zin'isʋŋin la ka ti bɔɔd ye ba yii keŋ zak kanɛ bɛ yiŋ la ni, asɛɛ ka ba yɛɛg fubanɛ ka ba yɛɛ kpɛn' anina tʋm la, bɔzugɔ fuud nwa' anɛ kasi. Asɛɛ ba yɛ fubanɛ an yiŋ fuud la ka naan yi nidibi bɛ zin'isi'a la.”

english_verse: After the man had finished measuring the buildings inside the temple area, he took me back through the east gate and measured the wall around this area.
translation_verse: Ka on mak linɛ bɛ pʋʋginɛ naae la, o dɔllimi yi za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ la, ka mak paalʋ la wʋsa gilig.

english_verse: He used his measuring stick to measure the east side of this wall; it was
translation_verse: O nɔk makir daugʋ mak ya-nya'aŋ baba la; ka li an nɔba makir kɔbisyɔpɔi nɛ pisnu.

english_verse: Then he measured the north side, the south side, and the west side of the wall, and they were each
translation_verse: Ani ka o lɛn fɛndig ya-tuona baba mak nɛ makir daug la; ka li an nɔba makir kɔbisyɔpɔi ni pisnu.

english_verse: The man took me back to the east gate of the temple,
translation_verse: Ka dau la mɔrimi lɛb za'anɔɔr kanɛ kpa' ya-nya'aŋ la,

english_verse: meters high, was the place where sacrifices were burned, and the four corners of the top section looked like the horns of a bull. The steps leading up to the altar were on the east side. The Dedication of the Altar
translation_verse: ka m nyɛ Israel Wina'am la na'am pipilim ka li yi ya-nya'aŋi kenna. Ka o kʋkɔr vuudi nwɛnɛ ku'om linɛ bɛ susuudin nɛ, ka teŋ la nie nɛ o pipilim.

english_verse: This vision was like the one I had seen when God came to destroy Jerusalem and like the one I had seen near the Chebar River. I immediately bowed with my face to the ground,
translation_verse: Linɛ nie ka m nyɛ la nwɛnɛ nier kanɛ ka m da nyɛ on da kena ye o san'am tempʋʋg la, ka lɛn nwɛnɛ nier kanɛ ka m da nyɛ Keba kɔldaug baba la. Ka m sʋ'ʋnnɛ m zugʋ kpa' teŋin.

english_verse: and the Lord's glory came through the east gate and into the temple.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb na'am pipilim la dɔl za'anɔɔr kanɛ kpa' ya-nya'aŋ la kpɛn' Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la.

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit lifted me to my feet and carried me to the inner courtyard, where I saw that the Lord's glory had filled the temple.
translation_verse: Ani ka Siig la ʋkim agɔla mɔrimi kpɛn' pʋʋgin zakin la, ka Zugsɔb na'am pipilim pɛ'ɛl Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la.

english_verse: But if the people and their kings stop worshiping other gods and tear down those memorials, I will live among them forever.
translation_verse: Nannanna kɛl ka ba basi ba bada banɛ ka ba dɔl wʋʋ ba anɛ pu'agɔɔnda la, nɛ ba na'anam bada banɛ pʋ mɔr gbin la, ka m na bɛɛ ba sʋʋgin saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: The people of Israel must suffer shame for sinning against me, so tell them about my holy temple. Let them think about it,
translation_verse: “Ninsaal biiga, pa'alim Israel dim la Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la an si'em, ka li na kɛ ka nyan kpɛn' ba, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug. Kɛl ka ba tɛn'ɛs Yir la mɛɛb yɛla,

english_verse: then if they are truly sorry, describe for them the design and shape of the temple, the gates, the measurements, and how the buildings are arranged. Explain the regulations about worshiping there, then write down these things, so they can study and obey them.
translation_verse: ka nyan ya'a mɔri ba nɛ ban maal si'el la wʋsa, fʋn kɛl ka ba baŋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la zi'esim an si'em, nɛ li yiib nɛ li kpɛn'ɛb zin'is. Pa'alimi ba Yir la gban'ari an si'em, li zi'esim nɛ li wada an si'em. Sɔmmi li wʋsa tisi ba ka ba na dɔlisidi li sʋ'ʋŋa zaŋi kennɛ li zi'esim nɛ li zi'ela la.

english_verse: The temple area on my holy mountain must be kept sacred! This is the most important law about the temple. The Altar
translation_verse: “Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la wada nwana: zin'ikanɛ gilig zuor la zug wʋsa na anɛ zin'ikanɛ an kasi la. Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la wada an si'em la.” Maan bimbim la yɛla

english_verse: According to the official standards, the altar in the temple had the following measurements: Around the bottom of the altar was a gutter
translation_verse: “Maan bimbim la makiri an si'em nwa', li ku'osuoya la zulʋŋ anɛ nɔba makir yinne nɛ pʋsʋk ka li yalʋŋ an nɔba makir yinne nɛ pʋsʋkʋ giligi li nɔɔr la, ka li nɔɔr la an nu'ug makir yinne nɛ pʋsʋk. Daka la wa'alim nwa':

english_verse: Each day for the next seven days, you must offer a goat and a bull and a ram as sacrifices for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: “‘Daba ayɔpɔi pʋʋgin, dabisir wʋsa, ya na tisid bʋribig ka ba maan maannɛ sɔs suguru tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla paae daba ayɔpɔi; ya na lɛn tis na'arapɔl nɛ pɛ'ɛraugʋ ya bʋnkɔnbid la sʋʋgin banɛ pʋ mɔr dɛŋŋa.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, after the altar is built, it must be dedicated by offering sacrifices on it and by splattering it with blood. Here is what you must do:
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, ‘Maan bimbim la ya'a ti mɛɛ naae, bama na an zi'ela banɛ bɛ maan la maalʋg saŋa linɛ an nyu'or maan nɛ ziim misib.

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe from the family of Zadok the priest are the only ones who may serve in my temple—this is my law. So give them a young bull to slaughter as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ya na nɔk na'arapɔlli tis maanmaannib banɛ an Levi dim ka yi Zadok tuŋʋn na ka tʋmmi m san'an la. Ya na tisi ba ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan.’ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Take some of the animal's blood and smear it on the four corners of the altar, some on the corners of the middle section, and some more on the rim around its edge. That will purify the altar and make it fit for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: ‘Ya na nɔk ziim la niŋ zin'isa anaasi banɛ ka ba mɛɛ dʋ'ʋsi li zugin ka li nwɛnɛ iila la, nɛ li lɔdis anaasi la giligi li nɔɔr la, ka li an maan kanɛ na sɔs suguru pie maan daka la ka kɛ ka li an kasi.

english_verse: Then take the body of the bull outside the temple area and burn it at the special place.
translation_verse: Ya na nɔk na'araug kanɛ na maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la nyu'oe li Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la yiŋ zin'ikanɛ nar ye ba nyu'oe li la.

english_verse: The next day, a goat that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice for sin. Purify the altar with its blood, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: “‘Dabisir kanɛ paas ayi' la, ya na nɔk bʋribig kanɛ pʋ mɔr dɛŋi maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, ka maal bimbim la ka li an kasi wʋʋ na'araug la ka ba nɔki maali li kasi si'em la.

english_verse: Then choose a young bull and a young ram that have nothing wrong with them,
translation_verse: Ya ya'a maali li kasi naae, ya na nɔk na'arapɔl nɛ pɛ'ɛrabanɛ ka ya na gaŋi ba ya bʋnkɔnbid la sʋʋgin ka babayi' la pʋ mɔr dɛŋ la maal maan.

english_verse: and bring them to my temple. The priests will sprinkle salt on them and offer them as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Ya na mɔri ba kɛn Zugsɔb la tuon na, ka maanmaan la na nɔk yaarim zu'asi ba ka nɔki ba maal nyu'or maannɛ tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: The priests will purify the altar during those days, so that it will be acceptable to me and ready to use.
translation_verse: Daba ayɔpɔi ka ya na maan maana linɛ na kɛ ka daka la an kasi, ka na pɛsigi li.

english_verse: From then on, the priests will use this altar to offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices to ask my blessing. Then I will be pleased with the people of Israel. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Dabisbama ya'a ti gaad, lin yi daba anii la daar, maanmaan la na maal nyu'or maan nɛ taaba la'asʋg maan daka la zug. Ala ka m na di'e ya maana la.’”

english_verse: The man took me back to the outer courtyard, near the east gate of the temple area. I saw that the doors to this gate were closed.
translation_verse: Dau la da lɛn mɔrimi lɛb za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir yiŋ la ni na la, ka za'anɔɔr kanɛ kpa' ya-nya'aŋ la yɔ'.

english_verse: The Lord said: I, the Lord God of Israel, came through this gate, so it must remain closed forever! No one must ever use it.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Za'anɔkaŋa na kpɛn yɔnɛ ala zi'e. Sɔ' kʋ yɔ'ɔgi lii; sɔ' da dɔl ani kpɛn'ɛɛ. Li na kpɛn anɛ ala bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la dɔl ani kpɛn'.

english_verse: The ruler of Israel may come here to eat a sacrificial meal that has been offered to me, but he must use only the entrance room of this gate. People Who Are Not Allowed in the Temple
translation_verse: Na'ab la mɛŋ ma'aa na zin'ini li pʋʋgin zin'ikanɛ an za'anɔɔrin la di diib Zugsɔb la tuon. O na dɔlli za'ambɛŋ la ni kpɛn' ka lɛn dɔlli ani yi.”

english_verse: Then the man took me through the north gate to the front of the temple. I saw that the brightness of the Lord's glory had filled the temple, and I immediately bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Dau la da mɔrimi lɛbɛ dɔl za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ la kpɛn' zi'en Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la tuon. Ka m gɔsi nyɛ Zugsɔb na'am pipilim ka li pɛ'ɛl Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la, ka sʋ'ʋnnɛ m nindaa teŋin.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to give you the laws for my temple. So pay attention and listen carefully to what kind of people are allowed to come in the temple, and what kind are not.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, Ninsaal biiga, gɔsim ka kɛlis sʋ'ʋŋa, ka tɛn'ɛs sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ linɛ wʋsa ka m yɛti fʋ zaŋi ken zi'ela banɛ bɛ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la yɛla la. Kɛl ka ya pʋtɛn'ɛr bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la za'anɔɔr yɛla ni, nɛ li yiib zin'is la.

english_verse: Tell those rebellious people of Israel: I, the Lord God, command you to stop your evil ways!
translation_verse: Yɛlim Israel dim banɛ zan'asidi m nɔɔr la ye, Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Israel dima, yɛlkisa banɛ ka ya tʋm la sia'al ala!

english_verse: My temple has been disgraced, because you have let godless, stubborn foreigners come here when sacrifices are being offered to me. You have sinned and have broken our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka ya tʋm la wʋsa, ya lɛm mɔr saam banɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ nɛ banɛ pʋ siakidi m nɔɔr la kpɛn' m Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na, san'amidi m yʋ'ʋr, saŋkanɛ ka ya maan maana linɛ an kpaam nɛ ziim tisidim la, ala ka ya san'ami m nɔnaar la.

english_verse: Instead of following the proper ways to worship me, you have put foreigners in charge of worship at my temple.
translation_verse: Ya pʋ tʋmmi m tʋʋma la nɛ la'abanɛ an kasi la ya mɛŋa, ya lɛɛ nɔknɛ ninsieba ye ba sʋ'oe m Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la tʋʋma.”

english_verse: And so I, the Lord God, say that no godless foreigner who disobeys me will be allowed in my temple. This includes any foreigner living in Israel. The Levites Are Punished The Lord said:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, Saan kanɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ nɛ banɛ pʋ siakidi m nɔɔr la kʋ kpɛn' m Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la naa, hali la'an nɛ saam banɛ bɛ nɛ Israel dim la.

english_verse: Some of the Levites turned their backs on me and joined the other people of Israel in worshiping idols. So these Levites must be punished!
translation_verse: “Asɛɛ ka Levi dim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la taal dɔlli ba, bɔzugɔ ba da basim ka lalig, saŋkanɛ ka Israel dim da basim ka yuki dɔlli ba bada la.

english_verse: They will still be allowed to serve me as temple workers by guarding the gates and by killing the animals to be sacrificed and by helping the worshipers.
translation_verse: Ba na tʋmmi m Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, ka sʋ'oe Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la za'anɔya la nɛ Yin la tʋʋma; ba da kʋʋd nyu'or malima bʋnkɔnbid la nɛ maana tisid nidib la, ka zi'e ba tuonnɛ tʋmmi tisidi ba.

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe who are descendants of Zadok the priest were faithful to me, even when the rest of the Israelites turned away. And so, these priests will continue to serve as my priests and to offer the fat and the blood of sacrifices.
translation_verse: “Amaa maanmaannib banɛ an Levi dim ka an Zadok yaas da tʋmmi ba tʋʋma sʋ'ʋŋa m Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, saŋkanɛ ka Israel dim da fɛndig ka basim la. Dinzug, banɛ na kena tʋm tisim; ba na zi'enɛ m tuonnɛ maal maana linɛ an kpaam nɛ ziim la.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: They will come into my temple, where they will offer sacrifices at my altar and lead others in worship.
translation_verse: “Ban ma'aa na kpɛn' m Dɔɔgin la; ban ma'aa na li'eli m teebul linɛ bɛɛ m tuon la ka tʋmi m tʋʋma la.

english_verse: When they come to the inner courtyard, they must wear their linen priestly clothes. My priests must never wear anything made of wool when they are on duty in this courtyard or in the temple.
translation_verse: “Ba ya'a kpɛn' za'anɔya linɛ bɛ zak kanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la, asɛɛ ba yɛ maanmaan fuud; ba da yɛ fukanɛ ka ba maal nɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg kɔnbidi bɛ pʋʋgin zak za'anɔya la tʋʋma ni, bɛɛ yɛɛ li kpɛn' Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: Even their turbans and underwear must be made of linen to keep my priests from sweating when they work.
translation_verse: Ba na nɔk zupibpieligi pid ka sɔn kurigimis ka li wʋsa an gum fuud. Li pʋ sʋm ye ba yɛ fukanɛ na kɛ ka ɔnsir yiti baa.

english_verse: And before they leave to join the other people in the outer courtyard, they must take off their priestly clothes, then place them in the sacred rooms and put on their regular clothes. That way, no one will touch their sacred clothes and be harmed.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a yi yiŋ zak la paalʋ zin'ikanɛ ka nidib bɛ, asɛɛ ka ba yɛɛg fubanɛ ka ba yɛɛ bɛ pɔɔginɛ tʋm la digil dɔbanɛ an kasi la ni ka tɔɔm fuudi yɛ, ala ka nidib la kʋ si'isi ba fuud la ka li an bɛ'ɛdi tisi ba, lin an kasi la zug.

english_verse: Priests must never shave their heads when they are mourning. But they must keep their hair properly trimmed and not let it grow too long.
translation_verse: “Ba da pʋni ba zut bɛɛ kɛ ka ba zuobid la nɔbigi wa'ami galisɛ, amaa asɛɛ ba kiesidi ba zuobidi maannɛ li ka li an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: They must not drink wine before going to the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Maanmaan da nu daam ka kpɛn' zak linɛ bɛ pʋʋgin laa.

english_verse: A priest must not marry a divorced woman; he can marry only a virgin from Israel or the widow of another priest.
translation_verse: Li pʋ sʋm ye ba di pʋkɔnya bɛɛ pu'a kanɛ bas o sida; pu'asadir kanɛ an Israel nid ma'aa ka ba na di, bɛɛ maanmaan pʋkɔɔnr.

english_verse: Priests must teach my people the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary, and between what is clean and what is unclean.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ba pa'alim nidib la ka ba baŋ linɛ an kasi nɛ linɛ ka' kasi la m bɛ kɔn'ɔkɔn' si'em, ka pa'ali ba linɛ an nyain nɛ linɛ ka' nyainnɛ.

english_verse: They will make decisions in difficult legal cases, according to my own laws. They must also observe the religious festivals my Law requires and must always respect the Sabbath.
translation_verse: “Antu'a bɛɛ yɛlsi'a wʋsa ya'a bɛ, maanmaannib la na an sariakatib ka kad saria la wʋʋ m wada la zi'el si'em la. Asɛɛ ka ba dɔlisi m wada nɛ m zi'ela nɛ malima banɛ ka m zi'el la, ka kɛ ka Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la an kasi.

english_verse: Touching a dead body will make a person unclean. So a priest must not go near a dead body, unless it is one of his parents or children, or his brother or unmarried sister.
translation_verse: “Maanmaan da li'el kum ka lieb dian'ad sɔba, amaa li ya'a nwɛnɛ onɛ kpi la anɛ o ba' bɛɛ o ma, li ya'a anɛ o bipuŋ bɛɛ o biribiŋ bɛɛ li anɛ o bier nɛ o pitʋ, bɛɛ o taʋn kanɛ nam pʋ kul sida, o na nyaŋi si'is.

english_verse: If a priest touches a dead body, he is unclean and must go through a ceremony to make himself clean. Then seven days later,
translation_verse: O ya'a ti maal o mɛŋ nyain naae, asɛɛ ka o gu'us daba ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: he must go to the inner courtyard of the temple and offer a sacrifice for sin. After that, he may once again serve as my priest. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Daakanɛ ka o ti kpɛn' Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zak kanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la ye o tʋm la, asɛɛ ka o maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan o mɛŋ yɛla.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: I myself will provide for my priests, and so they won't receive any land of their own.
translation_verse: “Man ma'aa na an maanmaannib la faar. Ba kʋ di'e faar Israel sʋ'ʋlim la nii, manɛ na aan ba din.

english_verse: Instead, they will receive part of the grain sacrifices, as well as part of the sacrifices for sin and sacrifices to make things right. They will also be given everything in Israel that has been completely dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ba na dit zʋʋd maana la nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maana nɛ taal maana la diib, nɛ linɛ wʋsa ka Israel dim mɔri kena tis Zugsɔb la na anɛ ba din.

english_verse: The first part of every harvest will belong to the priests. They will also receive part of all special gifts and offerings the Israelites bring to me. translation_verse: Li kas-kas anɛ zʋʋd linɛ an bʋndɛɛnna nɛ piini banɛ ka ya mɔri kenna; lin anɛ maanmaannib la din. Ya na tisi ba ya zʋʋd linɛ an bʋmpaala ka ya ye ya di la yiiga, ala ka bareka na bɛ yanam nɛ ya yidim wʋsa zugin.

english_verse: Priests must not eat any bird or animal that dies a natural death or that has been killed by a wild animal.
translation_verse: Maanmaan la da di si'el linɛ an niiŋ bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg kanɛ kpii digi, bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbsi'a na kʋʋ o tiraana.”

english_verse: The Lord God said: You leaders of Israel have cheated and abused my people long enough! I want you to stop sinning and start doing what is right and fair. You must never again force my people off their own land. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Israel Na'anama, ya tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li yuugi galis! Basimi zaba nɛ nidib mugusʋg ka tʋm linɛ dɔl suor. Basimi yanamɛ faandi m nidib si'em la.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: The ephah will be the standard dry measure, and the bath will be the standard liquid measure. Their size will be based on the homer, which will equal ten ephahs or ten baths.
translation_verse: “Li sʋm ye yanamɛ mɔr kuriba si'a makid bʋnkpi'emis la zem nɛ linɛ ka ya mɔri makid bʋn linɛ an ku'om la. Kuriba piiga an taslaa. Li sʋm ye sɔ' mɛkama mɔr taslaa makid si'elnam wʋsa.

english_verse: The same ceremony must also be done on the seventh day of the month, so that anyone who sins accidentally or without knowing it will be forgiven, and so that my temple will remain holy.
translation_verse: Nwadig la daba ayɔpɔi daar asɛɛ ya niŋ ala tis onɛ wʋsa tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka pʋ tʋmi li pɔn'ɔsim, ala ka ya na maali sɔs suguru tis Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la ka li an kasi.

english_verse: Leaders of Israel, the people must bring you one sixtieth of their grain harvests as offerings to me.
translation_verse: “Nɛ' anɛ piinkanɛ bɛɛ li kɔn' ka ya na tis: yanamɛ bʋn si'el wʋsa, ya na kaal zin'is pisyuobʋ yis yinne mɔri kena tis ka li an piini.

translation_verse: Yanamɛ na makid kpaam si'em nwa' tisid piini: ya na yis kpalaa yinne kpalaas piiga pʋʋgin tis.

english_verse: Each day of the festival he is to bring seven bulls and seven rams as sacrifices to please me, and he must bring a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.

english_verse: The Lord God said: On the first day of the first month, a young bull that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to purify the temple.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Nwadig la pin'ilʋg linɛ an dabisir yinne daar la, ya na nɔk na'arapɔl onɛ pʋ mɔr dɛŋi maal maan Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, ka li kɛ ka li an kasi.

english_verse: The priest will take some blood from this sacrifice and smear it on the doorposts of the temple, as well as on the four corners of the altar and on the doorposts of the gates that lead into the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Maan kanɛ ka ba maal ka li an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan la, maanmaan la na nɔki li ziim la niŋ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la za'anɔya ni, ka niŋ maan daka la lɔdis anaasi la zugin ka mɛ niŋ za'anɔɔr kanɛ kpɛn'ɛd pʋʋgin zakin la.

english_verse: Beginning on the fourteenth day of the first month, and continuing for seven days, everyone will celebrate Passover and eat bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Nwadig kanɛ an yiiga la dabpiiga nɛ anaasi daar, asɛɛ ya tiɛn Kum Maliak Gaadʋg la yɛla, malʋŋ la na yuugi paae daba ayɔpɔi. Dabisbama ni ya na ɔnbid bodobodo linɛ pʋ gɛndig dabinnɛ.

english_verse: On the first day, the ruler will bring a bull to offer as a sacrifice for his sins and for the sins of the people.
