translation_verse: Ba da tis o kpi'euŋ nɛ girima nɛ paŋ tita'ar, ka nidib wʋsa nɛ sʋ'ʋlim nɛ buudi wʋsa wɔ'ɔg o. O kpi'euŋ la na bɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, ka o sʋ'ʋlim la ka' san'auŋɔ.” Zaansʋŋ la gbin

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was terrified by these visions, and I didn't know what to think.
translation_verse: Daniel da lɛn yɛl ye, “Man zaansim nyɛ si'el la daamim bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: But God Most High will give his kingdom to his chosen ones, and it will be theirs forever and ever.”
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el Wʋsa la nidib na di'e sʋ'ʋlim la ka sʋ'ʋgi li saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ; ɛɛn, saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.”

english_verse: I wanted to know more about the fourth beast, because it was so different and much more terrifying than the others. What was the meaning of its iron teeth and bronze claws and of its feet that smashed what the teeth and claws had not ground and crushed?
translation_verse: M da bɔɔd ye m baŋ bʋnkɔnbʋg kanɛ paas anaasi la pa'an si'el, bɔzugɔ, on da bɛɛ o kɔn' nɛ bama la ka lɛn an bʋnzɔtir ka mɔr kʋnt nyina nɛ anzurifa nɔb-ɛɛns ka an bʋnkɔnbʋg kanɛ san'amid ka kʋʋdi o dataas ka nɔɔd banɛ kpɛlim la nɛ nɔba.

english_verse: I also wanted to know more about all ten of those horns on its head. I especially wanted to know more about the one that took the place of three of the others—the horn that had eyes and spoke with arrogance and seemed greater than the others.
translation_verse: M mɛ da bu'os ye m baŋ iila piiga banɛ bɛɛ o zugin la pa'an si'el, nɛ iil kanɛ kpɛlim nya'aŋi yina ka kɛ ka iila atan' vɔn' ka bas o la gbin. Li anɛ iil kan la da gat o taaba la ka mɔr nini nɛ nɔɔri pian'adi dʋ'ʋsid o mɛŋ la.

english_verse: While I was looking, this horn attacked God's chosen ones and was winning the battle.
translation_verse: Man da nan gɔsid la, ka iil la zabid nɛ Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el Wʋsa la nidib la nyaŋidi ba.

english_verse: Then God Most High, the Eternal God, came and judged in favor of his chosen ones, because the time had arrived for them to be given the kingdom.
translation_verse: Hali ka onɛ da pʋn bɛ yʋʋmpʋkʋda saŋa la ti kena kad saria sʋŋ o nidib ka ba nyaŋi di'e sʋ'ʋlim la sʋ'ʋgi li.

english_verse: Then I was told by the one standing there: “The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom to appear on earth. It will be different from all the others— it will trample the earth and crush it to pieces.
translation_verse: On da pa'alimi li gbin si'em nwa': “Bʋnkɔnbʋg kanɛ paas anaasi la pa'annɛ sʋ'ʋlim kanɛ na kɛn dunia na. Li na bɛɛ li kɔn' nɛ sʋ'ʋlim banɛ bɛ la wʋsa, ka na nɔ dunia wʋsa teŋin nɛ nɔbaa san'ami li.

english_verse: All ten of those horns are kings who will come from this kingdom, and one more will follow. This horn will be different from the others, and it will conquer three other kings.
translation_verse: Iila piiga la pa'annɛ na'anam piiga banɛ na yi sʋ'ʋlim kaŋa ni na. Ban ya'a gaadi naae, na'ab yinne na kenaa bɛɛ o kɔn' nɛ banɛ dɛŋ tuon la; o na nyaŋ na'anama atan' yisi ba na'amin la.

english_verse: “This king will speak evil of God Most High, and he will be cruel to God's chosen ones. He will try to change God's Law and the sacred seasons. And he will be able to do this for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: O na pian' zɛrig Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el Wʋsa la ka namisi o nidib la, ka mɔ ye o tiaki ba malima dabisa nɛ ba wada la. O na namis siakidib la yʋma atan' nɛ pʋsʋk.

english_verse: But he will finally be judged, and his kingdom completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Amaa ba na zin'in sariakadib zin'igin la ka faaɛn o paŋ la yii o san'an ka san'am o sʋ'ʋlim la nyain.

english_verse: “Then the greatest kingdom of all will be given to the chosen ones of God Most High. His kingdom will be eternal, and all others will serve and obey him.”
translation_verse: Ka sʋ'ʋlim la na'am nɛ paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ linɛ bɛ dunia ni la wʋsa, ba na nɔki tis siakidib banɛ an Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el Wʋsa la nidib. Ba sʋ'ʋlim la na an sʋ'ʋlim linɛ bɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ ka na'anam na na'as o ka siak o nɔɔr.”

english_verse: That was what I saw and heard. I turned pale with fear and kept it all to myself.
translation_verse: “Tɔ', labaar la bɛnnɛ nwa'. Li daa daam man Daniel hali, ka m pʋtɛn'ɛr wʋsa widig, ka m nindaa san'am, amaa m daa kɛ ka labaar la kpɛlimmi m san'an ka m pʋ yɛl sɔ'.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the third year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had a second vision
translation_verse: Na'ab Beliseaza n da di na'am la li yʋma atan' saŋa ka mam Daniel lɛn zaansim ya'as.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw a ram standing there with two horns on its head—both of them were long, but the second one was longer than the first.
translation_verse: M da nyɛ pɛraug ka o zi'e kpi'e kɔldaug la ka mɔr iila ayi'. Ka iil yinne wa'am gat yinne amaa ka yuolim nɔbig.

english_verse: The ram went charging toward the west, the north, and the south. No other animals were strong enough to oppose him, and nothing could save them from his power. So he did as he pleased and became even more powerful.
translation_verse: M da gɔt ka pɛ'og la zugudi ken ya-tuona nɛ ya-datiuŋ nɛ ya-dagɔbʋg. Bʋnkɔnbʋg da kae na nyaŋi zab nɛ o bɛɛ mɔr paŋi gat o. O da maannɛ o ya'amin ka lieb kpi'em.

english_verse: I kept on watching and saw a goat come from the west and charge across the entire earth, without even touching the ground. Between his eyes was a powerful horn,
translation_verse: Man nan tɛn'ɛsidi li yɛla la, li pʋ yuugɛ ka m nyɛ bʋʋg ka o mɔr iil tita'ar ka li bɛɛ o nini ayi' la teŋsʋk, ka o naan ya-tuona puugid dunia la gat ka lɛɛ pʋ si'isid teŋa.

english_verse: and with tremendous anger the goat started toward the ram that I had seen beside the river.
translation_verse: Bʋʋg la da kennɛ kpa'ad pɛrakanɛ mɔr iila ayi' ka zi'e kpi'e kɔldaug la tʋ'ʋsid o nɛ sʋnpɛɛn.

english_verse: The goat was so fierce that its attack broke both horns of the ram, leaving him powerless. Then the goat trampled on the ram, and no one could do anything to help.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ ka o zabid nɛ pɛ'og la nwɛ'ɛdi kɔɔd o iila ayi' la. Pɛraug la da pʋ mɔr paŋ kanɛ na nyaŋi zab nɛ bʋʋg laa. Bʋʋg la da nwɛ' o bas teŋin ka nɔɔ o nɛ nɔba ka sɔ' kae na nyaŋi faaɛn pɛraug la basɛ.

english_verse: After this, the goat became even more powerful. But at the peak of his power, his mighty horn was broken, and four other mighty horns took its place—one pointing to the north and one to the east, one to the south and one to the west.
translation_verse: Bʋʋg la da paam paŋ hali, amaa o kpi'euŋ la ti zu'oe la ka iil kanɛ kpi'em la kɔ'ɔgi li, ka iil bɛda anaasi lɛm bus zin'ikanɛ ka iil kaŋa la kɔ'ɔg la, tiesi kpa' dunia lʋga anaasi la wʋsa.

english_verse: A little horn came from one of these, and its power reached to the south, the east, and even to the holy land.
translation_verse: Iil ban teŋsʋk la yinne da lɛn yina an fiin, amaa ka nɔbigi lieb kpi'em kpa'ad ya-dagɔbʋg nɛ ya-nya'aŋ nɛ Teŋ vɛnliŋ la baba.

english_verse: It became so strong that it attacked the stars in the sky, which were heaven's army. Then it threw some of them down to the earth and trampled on them.
translation_verse: O da nɔbig hali ti paae agɔla ka zab nɛ arezana zabzabidib la ka sieba li teŋin na ka o nɔɔ ba nɛ nɔba.

english_verse: It humiliated heaven's army and dishonored its leader by keeping him from offering the daily sacrifices. In fact, it was so terrible that it even disgraced the temple and wiped out true worship. It also did everything else it wanted to do.
translation_verse: Nɔɔr zan'asʋg zug, ba da nɔk zabzabidib la nɛ daar wʋsa maana yɛla tis o. Ka o nyaŋ si'el wʋsa ni, ka sida lɛn kae.

english_verse: Then one of the holy angels asked another, “When will the daily sacrifices be offered again? What about this horrible rebellion? When will the temple and heaven's army no longer be trampled in the dust?”
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm ka onɛ an kasi la pian', ka sɔ' mɛ an kasi ka bu'os o ye, “Li na yuugi paae wala ka man nyɛ si'el la tʋm? Zaansʋŋ linɛ pa'an daar wʋsa maan la yɛla nɛ yɛlkisʋg linɛ na zi san'auŋʋ kena nɛ banɛ na nɔk Pʋ'ʋsim Yir nɛ zabzabidib la tis ka ba nɔɔ-nɔɔ li nɛ nɔba la na yuugi paae wala ka maalɛ?”

english_verse: evenings and mornings before the temple is dedicated and in use again.” Gabriel Interprets the Vision
translation_verse: ), bɛogʋn nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa, ka ba nyaan lɛm maligim maal Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la ya'as.” Zaansʋŋ la gbin

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was trying to figure out the meaning of the vision, when someone suddenly appeared there beside me.
translation_verse: Mam Daniel n nan gɔsid man nyɛ si'el la ka mɔɔd ye m gban'e li gbin la, m nyɛ ka sɔ' zi'e m tuonnɛ nwɛnɛ ninsaal.

english_verse: And from beside the Ulai River, a voice like that of a human said, “Gabriel, help him understand the vision.”
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm ka dau naan Ulaae kɔlʋgin la buon ye, “Gabirel, yɛlim dau kaŋa on nyɛ si'el la gbin.”

english_verse: Gabriel came over, and I fell to the ground in fear. Then he said, “You are merely a human, but you need to understand that this vision is about the end of time.”
translation_verse: On da li'el man zi'e si'el la, ka dabiem gban'am ka m lu avanba, ka o yɛl ye, “Ninsaal biiga, baŋim ye fʋn nyɛ si'el la pa'annɛ naar saŋa yɛla.”

english_verse: While he was speaking, I fell facedown in a deep sleep. But he lifted me to my feet
translation_verse: On nan pian'adi tisidim la ka m gbisid ka m nindaa kpa' teŋ, ka o duomi zi'eli m nɔba zug.

english_verse: and said: Listen, and I will tell you what will happen at the end of time, when God has chosen to show his anger.
translation_verse: O da ye, “M na yɛlif tɔɔg linɛ na kɛn naar saŋa na, bɔzugɔ fʋn nyɛ si'el la pa'annɛ linɛ na maal naar saŋa la.

english_verse: The two horns of the ram are the kings of Media and Persia,
translation_verse: Pɛraug kanɛ mɔr iila ayi' ka fʋ nyɛ la pa'annɛ Media nɛ Pesia dim na'anam yɛla.

english_verse: the goat is the kingdom of Greece, and the powerful horn between his eyes is the first of its kings.
translation_verse: Bʋʋg la pa'annɛ Girik dim sʋ'ʋlim yɛla, ka iil tita'ar kanɛ bɛ nini la teŋsʋk la pa'annɛ ba yiiga na'ab la yɛla.

english_verse: After this horn is broken, four other kingdoms will appear, but they won't be as strong.
translation_verse: Iila anaasi banɛ lɛdig iil kanɛ kɔ'ɔg la zin'ig la pa'annɛ sʋ'ʋlim anaasi banɛ na duoe sʋ'ʋlim la ni, amaa ka ba paŋ kʋ an wʋʋ yiiga din la.

english_verse: When these rulers have become as evil as possible, their power will end, and then a king who is dangerous and cannot be trusted will appear.
translation_verse: “Ba na'am la ya'a ti bɔɔd naar, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd na zu'oe, ka na'ab si'a na kena, ka o sʋnf kpi'em hali, ka sɔ' wʋsa zɔt o, ka o an dama'am sɔb.

english_verse: He will gain strength, but not on his own, and he will cause terrible destruction. He will wipe out powerful leaders and God's people as well.
translation_verse: O na kpi'em hali, amaa li ka' o mɛŋ paŋ zugɔ. O na zi san'auŋ tita'ar na ka nyaŋi maal on ye o maan si'el wʋsa. O na nyaŋi kʋ ninkpi'ema nɛ Wina'am nidib la.

english_verse: His deceitful lies will make him so successful, that he will think he is really great. Suddenly he will kill many people, and he will even attack God, the Supreme Ruler. But God will crush him!
translation_verse: O ziri la zug o na kilim bʋmmɔr, ka gɔs o mɛŋ ka o tiraan kae. Ka ba ya'a ti tɛn'ɛs ye yɛl kae, o na kʋ nidib bɛdegʋ ka duoe zi'enɛ ki'is na'anam wʋsa Na'ab la. La'an nɛ wala, o na san'am, ka li lɛɛ ka' nɛ ninsaal paŋa.

english_verse: This vision about the evenings and mornings is true, but these things won't happen for a long time, so don't tell it to others.
translation_verse: “Zaansʋŋ kanɛ ka fʋ zaansim zaŋi keŋ zaam nɛ bɛkɛung yɛla la anɛ sida. Amaa da kɛ ka sɔ' baŋɛ, bɔzugɔ li pa'annɛ bɛog yɛla linɛ nan lal hali.”

english_verse: After this, I was so worn out and weak that it was several days before I could get out of bed and go about my duties for the king. I was disturbed by this vision that made no sense to me.
translation_verse: Mam Daniel da gɛnnɛ ka li ban'a dabisa bɛdegʋ, ka nyaan nyaŋi lɛbi tʋm tʋʋm banɛ ka Na'ab tisim la. Zaansʋŋ la da pakim ka kpɛn'ɛsim dabiem bɔzugɔ m da pʋ nyaŋi gban'e li gbinnɛ.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: Some years later, Darius the Mede, who was the son of Xerxes, had become king of Babylonia. And during his first year as king, I found out from studying the writings of the prophets that the Lord had said to Jeremiah, “Jerusalem will lie in ruins for
translation_verse: Yʋʋm kanɛ ka o da di na'am la ka man Daniel karim Wina'am gbana la ka gban'e li gbin, ka baŋ labaar kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la da yɛl Jeremia onɛ an nɔdi'es la ye, Jerusalem na bɛ yammid pʋʋgin yʋma pisyɔpɔi.

english_verse: Then, to show my sorrow, I went without eating and dressed in sackcloth and sat in ashes. I confessed my sins and earnestly prayed to the Lord my God: Our Lord, you are a great and fearsome God, and you faithfully keep your agreement with those who love and obey you.
translation_verse: M da sɔs Zugsɔb onɛ aan m Wina'am la ka pɛligi m pʋʋg tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ ka ti tʋm la wʋsa yɛla ye, “Naa, m Zugsɔb Wina'am Tita'arɛ, fʋ san'an ka paŋ nɛ yɛl nyalima bɛ, ka fʋ tʋm wʋʋ fʋn maal nɔnaar si'em nɛ banɛ nɔŋif ka siaki fʋ zi'ela la.

english_verse: But we have sinned terribly by rebelling against you and rejecting your laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ti tʋm bɛ'ɛd ka maal linɛ ka' sʋ'ʋm. Ti anɛ bugusim dim ka kisif. Ti zan'asi fʋ nɔɔr nɛ fʋ wada la.

english_verse: We have ignored the message your servants the prophets spoke to our kings, our leaders, our ancestors, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ siak ka di'e fʋ tʋmtʋmnib banɛ an nɔdi'esidib la nɔɔrɛ, banɛ da pian' fʋ yɛla tisi ti na'anam nɛ na'ayikpɛm, nɛ ti yaanam, nɛ nimbanɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa.

english_verse: Lord God, you are merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against you
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la anɛ nimbaanlzɔt, ka kɛti ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd taali basid, la'an nɛ tinamɛ ki'isid o la.

english_verse: and rejected your teachings that came to us from your servants the prophets.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ di'e ti Zugsɔb Wina'am nɔɔr bɛɛ siak o zi'ela banɛ ka o dɔlis o tʋmtʋmnib banɛ an nɔdi'esidib la san'anɛ yɛli ti la.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel has stubbornly refused to obey your laws, and so those curses written by your servant Moses have fallen upon us.
translation_verse: Israel dim wʋsa zan'asi fʋ zi'ela ka fɛndig ka pʋ siaki fʋ nɔɔrɛ. Alazug nɔpɔɔr nɛ tʋbtɛɛgir linɛ da sɔb Moses onɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋm la gbana ni la luu ti zugin, tinamɛ tʋm taal la zug.

english_verse: You warned us and our leaders that Jerusalem would suffer the worst disaster in human history, and you did exactly as you had threatened.
translation_verse: Fʋn da pian' zɛrigi ti nɛ ti na'anam la, ka yɛla paae ti wʋʋ fʋn da yɛl si'em la. Dunia la wʋsa pʋʋgin, yɛl nan paae sɔ' wʋʋ yɛlkanɛ paae Jerusalem dim laa?

english_verse: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ lin sɔb Moses wada gbauŋʋn si'em la, tɔɔg kaŋa wʋsa lii ti zugin na, la'an nɛ wala ti pʋ lɛb fʋn Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la san'anɛ bɔ sʋŋir, bɛɛ basi ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa ka siaki fʋ sida la.

english_verse: And when you finally punished us with this horrible disaster, that was also the right thing to do, because we deserved it so much.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da pʋ kɛ ka li yuugɛ ka tɔɔg paae ti, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am la anɛ sida sɔb o tʋʋma wʋsa pʋʋgin. La'an nɛ wala ti pʋ siak o nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord God, with your own mighty arm you rescued us from Egypt and made yourself famous to this very day, but we have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Naa, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Wina'am, nannanna fʋnɛ yisi fʋ nidib Egipt teŋin nɛ fʋ paŋ tita'ar, ka da' yʋ'ʋri tisi fʋ mɛŋ hali ti paae zina, ti tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ti tʋm linɛ ka' sʋ'ʋm.

english_verse: In the past, you treated us with such kindness, that we now beg you to stop being so terribly angry with Jerusalem. After all, it is your chosen city built on your holy mountain, even though it has suffered public disgrace because of our sins and those of our ancestors.
translation_verse: Naa, Zugsɔba, fʋ maannɛ si'el wʋsa nɛ sida, yisimi fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la Jerusalem zug, ka li anɛ fʋ teŋ nɛ fʋ zuor linɛ an kasi la. Tinam nɛ ti yaanam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi kɛ ka nimbanɛ gilig la wʋsa la'ad Jerusalem dim.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Nannanna, ti Wina'am, wʋmmi fʋ sankpan'asnam sɔsʋg. Fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr la yɛla, zɔmi ti nimbaanlig, tinam nɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kanɛ san'am la zug.

english_verse: Please show mercy to your chosen city, not because we deserve it, but because of your great kindness.
translation_verse: Wina'am, yɔ'ɔgimi fʋ tʋbir ka wʋm, lakimi fʋ nini gɔs teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr bɛɛ ani la san'am si'em. Tinamɛ sɔsidif la, li ka' ye ti anɛ kasii, amaa fʋ pʋpielim la zug.

english_verse: Forgive us! Hurry and do something, not only for your city and your chosen people, but to bring honor to yourself. The Seventy Weeks Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Naa, Zugsɔba, kɛlisim! Zugsɔba, kɛlli ti taali bas. Fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr la zug da yuugɛ, bɔzugɔ fʋ teŋ la nɛ fʋ nidib la buonnɛ fʋ yʋ'ʋr.” Pisyɔpɔi nam zin'is ayɔpɔi

english_verse: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain,
translation_verse: M da nan kpɛn sɔsid o suguru man nɛ m nimbanɛ an Israel dim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla la, ka lɛm bɛllimi m Zugsɔb Wina'am o zuor kanɛ an kasi la yɛla.

english_verse: when Gabriel suddenly came flying in at the time of the evening sacrifice. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my vision,
translation_verse: Ka man da nan bɛɛ ani sɔsid la, ka Gabirel, onɛ ka m da dɛŋi nyɛ zaansʋŋ pʋʋgin la, dɔl sisi'epiliŋi kɛɛn m san'an na winkɔɔr saŋa, ban maan maana saŋsi'a la.

english_verse: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.
translation_verse: O da pa'alim ka ye, “M yʋ'ʋn kena ye m pa'alif ka fʋ gban'e si'el wʋsa gbin.

english_verse: God thinks highly of you, and at the very moment you started praying, I was sent to give you the answer.
translation_verse: Fʋn daa pin'ili sɔsʋg saŋsi'a la, ka fʋ winsɔsʋg la pʋn gandig, lin ka m kena ye m yɛlif. Fʋ anɛ onɛ mɔr girima hali, alazug kɛlisim pian'ad nwa' ka gban'e zaansʋŋ la gbin.

english_verse: For one week this foreigner will make a firm agreement with many people, and halfway through this week, he will end all sacrifices and offerings. Then the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction will be put there. And it will stay there until the time God has decided to destroy this one who destroys.
translation_verse: O na kɛ ka nɔnaar kanɛ ka o gban'e nɛ nidib bɛdegʋ la niŋ amɛŋa, ka li na bɛ bakuai yinne. Bakuai la pʋsʋk o na kɛ ka maana wʋsa nɛ piini maana wʋsa gu'oe. O na ya'ab si'eli zi'el Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la lʋgir yinne ni linɛ na an bʋnkisʋg linɛ san'amid si'el mɛkama, hali ka ban gban'e san'auŋ si'a la nyaan lii o zugin.

english_verse: In the third year of Cyrus the king of Persia, a message came to Daniel from God, and it was explained in a vision. The message was about a dreadful war, and it was true.
translation_verse: Na'ab Sarus n da di Pesia na'am la li yʋma atan' saŋa, si'el da nie pa'al Daniel onɛ yʋ'ʋri lɛm buon ye Belteseaza la. Labaar la da anɛ sida ka an zabtita'asi'a yɛla. Li da nie labaar la gbinnɛ pa'al o nier pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: For three weeks I was in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ka Daniel yɛl ye, “Saŋkan la man daa mɔri sʋnsa'aŋ bakuai muma atan'.

english_verse: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.
translation_verse: M daa pʋ di disʋŋ, bɛɛ ɔnb ni'im bɛɛ nɔk daam si'isi m nɔɔrɛ; m mɛ pʋ suoɛn kpaam bakuai atan' nwa' sʋʋginɛ.”

english_verse: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River,
translation_verse: Yiiga nwadig la li dabisa pisi nɛ anaasi daar la, man daa zi'e kɔldatita'ar kanɛ ka ba buon Tigiris la gbɛog la.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.
translation_verse: M daa ʋki m nindaa nyɛ dau ka o yɛ fupielig ka nɔk sanlimvɛnliŋ sialɔɔdiŋe lɔɔ o siaa.

english_verse: His body was like a precious stone, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming fires, his arms and legs like polished bronze, and his voice like the roar of a crowd.
translation_verse: O niŋgbiŋ daa nyɛɛnnɛ wʋʋ gɔtiŋ nɛ, ka o nindaa ian'ad wʋʋ saa ian'asʋg nɛ, ka o kpʋkpama nɛ o nɔba nyɛɛn wʋʋ kʋntzɛn'ug linɛ ka ba saas nɛ, ka o vuud wʋʋ nimbabigi na pian'ad ka ba kʋkɔya vuud si'em la.

english_verse: Although the people who were with me did not see the vision, they became so frightened that they scattered and hid.
translation_verse: Man Daniel ma'aa daa nyɛ linɛ nie la; nimbanɛ daa bɛɛ m san'an la daa pʋ nyɛɛ lii, amaa dabiem daa gban'e ba nɛ hali ka ba zɔɔ su'a.

english_verse: and at the sound of his voice, I fell facedown in a deep sleep.
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm ka o pian'ad, ka man kɛlisid o la, ka gbɛɛm zɛɛgim ka m vanbini gbisid ka m nindaa kpa' teŋin.

english_verse: He raised me to my hands and knees
translation_verse: Nu'ug daa si'isim ka duomi igini m nu'us nɛ m duma zug ka m pin'ili kirid.

english_verse: and then said, “Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention.” I stood trembling, while the angel said:
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Daniel, Wina'am nɔŋif hali; kɛlisim man ye m yɛlif pian'asi'a la sʋ'ʋŋa ka duoe zi'en agɔla, bɔzugɔ nannanna ka ba tʋmim fʋ san'an na.” Ka on yɛlim nɛ'ɛŋa naae la ka m duoe zi'en ka kirid.

english_verse: Daniel, don't be afraid! God has listened to your prayers since the first day you humbly asked for understanding, and he has sent me here.
translation_verse: Ka o keŋ tuonnɛ yɛlim ye, “Daniel, da zɔt dabiem. Lin pin'il daakanɛ ka fʋ daa pin'ili sie fʋ mɛŋ Wina'am tuon ka bɔɔd ye fʋ baŋ linɛ bɛ la, o daa wʋmi fʋ sɔsʋg, linzug ka m kena ye m gandigi fʋ sɔsʋg la wʋsa.

english_verse: I will tell you what is written in The Book of Truth. But first, you must realize that no one except Michael, the guardian angel of Israel, is on my side.
translation_verse: amaa m na yɛlif linɛ sɔb Sida Gbauŋʋn la. Sɔ' pʋ sʋŋidim ka m zabida, ya'a ka' Maikel onɛ sʋ'oe yanam yɛla laa.

english_verse: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.
translation_verse: Nannanna m kena ye m yɛlif linɛ na maali fʋ nidib bɛog daar, ka fʋn na ti nyɛ si'el la anɛ bɛog sa yɛla.”

english_verse: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.
translation_verse: On da nan pian'ad anwa tisidim la, ka m gigilim ka sʋnr, ka m nindaa kpa' teŋin.

english_verse: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, “Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.
translation_verse: Onɛ ka m daa nyɛɛ o ka o nwɛnɛ dau la daa si'isi m nɔŋgban, ka m ya'ae m nɔɔri pin'ili pian'ad. M daa yɛl onɛ zi'e m tuon la ye, “Man nyɛ si'el la kɛnɛ ka dabiem gban'am, ka m zi' man niŋidi m mɛŋ si'ela.

english_verse: I am merely your servant. How can I possibly speak with someone so powerful, when I am almost too weak to get my breath?”
translation_verse: Mam anɛ fʋ sankpan'as: m ye m niŋ walaa pian' nɛ fʋ, m Zugsɔba? M paŋ wʋsa naa ya, ka m pʋ lɛn tun'e vʋ'ʋsid sʋ'ʋŋaa.”

english_verse: The angel touched me a second time and said, “Don't be frightened! God thinks highly of you, and he intends this for your good, so be brave and strong.” At this, I regained my strength and replied, “Please speak! You have already made me feel much better.”
translation_verse: O daa yɛlim ye, “Da zɔt dabiem, fʋn kanɛ ka Wina'am zɔti fʋ nimbaanlig la! Mɔr sumalisim, ka kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ mɛŋ, kpɛ'ɛŋimi fʋ mɛŋ!” On daa pian' tisim la, li daa kpɛmisim ka m yɛl o ye, “M Zugsɔba pian'am, ka fʋ tisim kpi'euŋ.”

english_verse: Then the angel said: Now do you understand why I have come? Soon I must leave to fight against the guardian angel of Persia. Then after I have defeated him, the guardian angel of Greece will attack me.
translation_verse: Ka o bu'osim ye, “Fʋ mi' linɛ zugʋ kɛ ka m kɛɛn fʋ san'an naa? Li kʋ yuugɛ m na lɛbi zab nɛ Sʋntaana tʋmtʋm onɛ sʋ'oe Pesia yɛla la, ka m ya'a lɛb, onɛ sʋ'oe Grees yɛla la na kena;

english_verse: You also need to know that I protected and helped Darius the Mede in his first year as king. The Angel's Message to Daniel Part One: The Four Kings and Their Successors
translation_verse: “Yʋʋm kanɛ ka Darius onɛ an Media nid la da di na'am la, m da zi'enɛ m nɔba zug ye m sʋŋ o ka ti'el o.” Ya-dagɔbʋg nɛ ya-datiuŋ na'anam la yɛla

english_verse: What I am going to tell you is certain to happen. Four kings will rule Persia, one after the other, but the fourth one will become much richer than the others. In fact, his wealth will make him so powerful that he will turn everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
translation_verse: Man ye m yɛlif si'el nannanna la anɛ sida. Na'anama atan' na duoe Pesia teŋin na, ka yinne na lɛn duoe na paas anaasi ka on na mɔr arezaki gaad bama la wʋsa. O ya'a ti nɔk o arezak la paam paŋ, o na nɔk sɔ' wʋsa tugul nɛ Grees sʋ'ʋlim la.

english_verse: Then a mighty king will come to power and will be able to do whatever he pleases.
translation_verse: Na'atita'ar sɔ' na duoe na ka o na'am la mɔr paŋ ka li kɛ ka o tʋm o ya'am bɔɔd si'em.

english_verse: But suddenly his kingdom will be crushed and scattered to the four corners of the earth, where four more kingdoms will rise. But these won't be ruled by his descendants or be as powerful as his kingdom.
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a zin'ini naae, o sʋ'ʋlim la na widigi keŋ dunia lʋga anaasi la wʋsa. Li kʋ lɛb o yaas nu'uginɛ, bɛɛ ba paam paŋ kanɛ ka o mɔr la buudii, bɔzugɔ ba na faaɛn o sʋ'ʋlim la tis sieba.

english_verse: The king of the south will grow powerful. Then one of his generals will rebel and will rule an even larger kingdom.
translation_verse: “Ya-dagɔbʋg Na'ab la na mɔr kpi'euŋ hali, amaa o kpɛɛmnam la yinne na mɔr kpi'euŋʋ gat o, ka na zanl sʋ'ʋlim la nɛ kpi'euŋ.

english_verse: Years later the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom will make a treaty, and the daughter of the king of the south will marry the king of the north. But she will lose her power. Then she, her husband, their child, and the servants who came with her will all be killed. After this,
translation_verse: Yʋma bi'ela nya'aŋ ba na naal nɔɔr nɛ taaba. Ya-dagɔbʋg Na'ab la pu'ayua na keŋ kul Ya-datiuŋ Na'ab la, ye ba naal nɔɔr nɛ taaba, amaa pu'a la kʋ nyaŋi kɛ ka nɔnaalʋg la keŋ tuonnɛ, ka Na'ab la nɛ o biis mɛ kʋ yuugɛ. Dabisban la ni, ba na gban'e pu'a la nɛ o nya'andɔlib la nɛ o saam nɛ onɛ sʋŋid o la wʋsaa tis.”

english_verse: one of her relatives will become the ruler of the southern kingdom. He will attack the army of the northern kingdom and capture its fortresses.
translation_verse: “Sɔ' na yi tuŋ kan la ni na lɛdig pu'a la zin'ig. O na zab nɛ Ya-datiuŋ Na'ab zabzabidib la ka kpɛn' ba kpi'euŋ zin'igin la; o na zab nɛ ba hali ti nyaŋi ba.

english_verse: Then he will carry their idols to Egypt, together with their precious treasures of silver and gold, but it will be a long time before he attacks the northern kingdom again. Some years later
translation_verse: O mɛ na faaɛn ba bada la nɛ ba kʋnt wina la, nɛ ba la'asʋma linɛ an anzurifa nɛ sanlima la, zii li keŋ Egipt teŋgbauŋʋn. Yʋma bi'ela ya'a gaad o kʋ lɛn daam Ya-datiuŋ Na'ab la ya'asɛ.

english_verse: the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom, but he will be forced back to his own country.
translation_verse: Ya-datiuŋ Na'ab la yʋ'ʋn na kpɛn' Ya-dagɔbʋg Na'ab la sʋ'ʋlim ni ye o zab, amaa o na zɔɔ lɛb o mɛŋ teŋin.

english_verse: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.
translation_verse: O biis la na ti'eb zaba ti'ebʋg ka la'as zabzabidib bɛdegʋ: ba na gɛɛl wʋʋ ku'om ɛɛnti pɛ'ɛli badig si'em la, ka li tiigi paae o dataa la kpi'euŋ zin'igin.”

english_verse: But this will make the king of the south angry, and he will defeat this large army from the north.
translation_verse: “Li na kɛ ka Ya-dagɔbʋg Na'ab la sʋnf duoe ka o zab nɛ Ya-datiuŋ Na'ab la, o na la'as zabzabidib bɛdegʋ amaa ba na la'am nyaŋ o.

english_verse: The king of the south will feel proud because of the many thousands he has killed. But his victories won't last long,
translation_verse: Ba ya'a gban'e zabzabidib la gaad, Ya-dagɔbʋg Na'ab la na duoe nɛ nyɛɛsim ka kʋ nidib tusa-tusa, la'an nɛ wala o kʋ kpɛn an nyaŋir sɔba,

english_verse: because the king of the north will gather a larger and more powerful army than ever before. Then in a few years, he will start invading other countries.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ Ya-datiuŋ Na'ab la na lɛn la'as zabzabidib bɛdegʋ, ka ba gat banɛ ka o daa dɛŋi la'as la; ka li ya'a paas yʋma bi'ela o na la'as zabzabidib bɛdegʋ banɛ na ti'eb sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ zaba la'adi keŋ zab.”

english_verse: At this time many of your own people will try to make this vision come true by rebelling against the king of the south, but their rebellion will fail.
translation_verse: “Dabisban la nidib bɛdegʋ na la'asi zan'as Ya-dagɔbʋg Na'ab la nɔɔr. Nimbanɛ an zabbɔɔdibi fʋ nidib la teŋsʋk la na maal taawai ka li niŋ amɛŋa wʋʋ nier la ka fʋ nyɛ si'em la, amaa ba kʋ nyaŋɛ.

english_verse: Then the army from the north will surround and capture a fortress in the south, and not even the most experienced troops of the southern kingdom will be able to make them retreat.
translation_verse: Ya-datiuŋ Na'ab la na kena gu' gilig teŋ la ka na nyaŋ tempʋkpi'euŋ la. Zabzabidib banɛ yi ya-dagɔbʋg na la kʋ nyaŋi tʋ'ʋsi baa, hali baa ba zabzabsʋma la kʋ nyaŋi zi'enɛ zab nɛ ba.

english_verse: The king who invaded from the north will do as he pleases, and he will even capture and destroy the holy land.
translation_verse: Onɛ nyaŋ la na maal on bɔɔd si'el, sɔ' kae na nyaŋi zab nɛ oo. O na ba' nya'a Teŋ Vɛnliŋin la ka na mɔr paŋ kanɛ na nyaŋi san'ami li.

english_verse: In fact, he will decide to invade the south with his entire army. Then he will attempt to make peace by giving the king of the south a bride from the northern kingdom, but this won't be successful.
translation_verse: O na gban'e ye o yina nɛ kpi'euŋ linɛ bɛɛ o sʋ'ʋlimin la wʋsa ka maal nɔnaar nɛ Na'ab kanɛ yi Ya-dagɔbʋg la na. Ka na nɔk o pu'ayua tis o, ye li kɛ ka o nyaŋ sʋ'ʋlim la, amaa o gban'ar la kʋ nyaŋi zi'en bɛɛ sʋŋ oo.

english_verse: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.
translation_verse: Ka o na fɛndig o pʋtɛn'ɛri lɛbis tɛɛns banɛ kpi'e atɛuk la, ka na gban'e ba bɛdegʋ, amaa teŋ zʋŋ zabzabidib tuongat na kɛ ka o nyɛɛsim la paae li bɛn, ka kɛ ka o nyɛɛsim la lɛb o mɛŋ zugin.

english_verse: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.
translation_verse: Lin nya'aŋ la, o na lɛbid o mɛŋ teŋin, o kpi'euŋ zin'isin la, amaa ba na nyaŋ o ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn nyɛɛ o ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: The next king of the north will try to collect taxes for the glory of his kingdom. However, he will come to a sudden end in some mysterious way, instead of in battle or because of someone's anger. Part Two: The Evil King from the North
translation_verse: “Onɛ na dɔl o nya'aŋ la na tʋm lampɔdi'esidib ka ba keŋ maligim maal la'abanɛ san'am na'ayin la ka li lɛm mɔr girima. Yʋma bi'ela nya'aŋ o na kpi ka li kʋ anɛ sʋnpɛɛn zug bɛɛ zaba nii.”

english_verse: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.
translation_verse: “Onɛ ye o dɔl on nya'aŋ la na an ninyɔɔg onɛ pʋ nara, bɔzugɔ o pʋ yi na'adɔɔginɛ. O na nyaŋ teŋ la saŋa kanɛ ka nidib la tɛn'ɛs ye ba vʋ'ʋs ya la, ka o na nɔk teŋgbi'idim nyaŋ teŋ la.

english_verse: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.
translation_verse: O ya'a ti naal nɔɔr nɛ o, ka ma'aa niŋid wʋʋ o anɛ ninsʋŋ la, o na nɔk nidib bi'ela paam paŋ.

english_verse: Without warning, he will successfully invade a wealthy province, which is something his ancestors never did. Then he will divide among his followers all of its treasures and property. But none of this will last very long.
translation_verse: Tembanɛ mɔr areza'as hali la ya'a ti tɛn'ɛs ye ban vʋ'ʋs ya, o na keŋ gban'e ba ka nyaŋi tʋm linɛ ka o saamnam bɛɛ o yaanam nan zi' tʋmm. O na pʋdig on zabi vaae si'el bɛɛ on fan' si'el nɛ arezak linɛ ka o paam la wʋsa tɔdi tis o nya'andɔlib. O na gban'e on na niŋ si'em faaɛn kpi'euŋ zin'is, amaa o saŋa la kʋ yuugɛ.”

english_verse: He will gather a large and powerful army, and with great courage he will attack the king of the south. The king of the south will meet him with a much stronger army, but he will lose the battle, because he will be betrayed
translation_verse: “O na nɔk zabzabidib bɛdegʋ tʋ'ʋs Ya-dagɔbʋg Na'ab la pa'al o paŋ nɛ o sʋnfʋ kpi'em si'em. Na'ab la na nɔk zabzabidib banɛ zu'oe ka mɔr paŋ la zab nɛ o, amaa o kʋ nyaŋɛ, ban gban'e gban'asieba o yɛla la zug.

english_verse: by members of the royal court. He will be ruined, and most of his army will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ la'am dit nɛ Na'ab la o diib zin'igin la na mɔ ye ba kʋ o; ba na kad o zabzabidib la ka nidib bɛdegʋ na kpi zaba ni.

english_verse: The two kings will meet around a table and tell evil lies to each other. But their plans will fail, because God has already decided what will happen.
translation_verse: Na'anama ayi' nwa' banɛ sʋnya pʋn gban'e bɛ'ɛd nɛ taaba la na la'asi zin'in zin'ig yinne ka ma'aa tis taaba, amaa li kʋ sʋŋi baa, bɔzugɔ saŋa la ya'a paae li na naae.

english_verse: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.
translation_verse: Ya-datiuŋ Na'ab la na lɛbi kul o mɛŋ teŋin nɛ arezak bɛdegʋ, amaa o sʋnf kʋ bɔɔd nɔnaar kanɛ an kasi la. O na dɛŋi maal taawai li yɛla ka lɛb o mɛŋ teŋin.”

english_verse: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.
translation_verse: “Saŋa la ya'a ti paae o na lɛn nyaŋ Ya-dagɔbʋg Na'ab la ya'as, amaa saŋa kaŋa kʋ nwɛnɛ yiiga laa.

english_verse: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Ya-tuona baba atɛuk gbɛog dim na mɔr anrima kena tʋ'ʋs o, ka o giinla na kɛns. Li na kɛ ka o lɛb na nɛ sʋnpɛɛn ka zan'as nɔnaar linɛ an kasi suor la. O na lɛn lɛb na sʋŋ banɛ zan'as nɔnaar linɛ an kasi suor la.

english_verse: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction.
translation_verse: “O zabzabidib la na gban'e ye ba tʋm linɛ kis Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kpi'euŋ zin'igin la, ka mɔ ye ba kad daar wʋsa maana la bas. Ba na maal bʋnkisʋg linɛ san'amid si'el mɛkama la zi'el.

english_verse: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.
translation_verse: O na nɔk dama'am tiak banɛ zan'as nɔnaar la ya'am, amaa nimbanɛ mi' ba Wina'am sʋ'ʋŋa la na zan'as o amɛŋa mɛŋa.

english_verse: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.
translation_verse: “Banɛ mɔr ya'am la na sa'al nidib bɛdegʋ, la'an nɛ ban na kʋʋ ba sieba zaba ni ka nyu'oe ba sieba nɛ bugum ka gban'e sieba ka fan' sieba areza'as la.

english_verse: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a kpi ba na nyɛ sʋŋir bi'ela, amaa nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ ka' sida dim la na nɔki ba mɛŋi la'as nɛ ba.

english_verse: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.
translation_verse: Banɛ mɔr ya'am la sieba na tu'usi li, amaa nɛ lin wʋsa ba na pie ba ka ba maligim lieb kasi ka gba'ar ka' ba san'anɛ hali ka saŋa la bɛn ti paae. Li sid na kɛn lin nar saŋsi'a na.” Na'akanɛ dʋ'ʋsid o mɛŋ la yɛla

english_verse: This king will do as he pleases. He will proudly claim to be greater than any god and will insult the only true God. Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people.
translation_verse: “Na'ab la na tʋmm o ya'am bɔɔd si'el. O na dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ ka maal o mɛŋ bʋntita'ari gaad wina wʋsa, ka na pian' pian'abanɛ ka sɔ' na wʋm ka zɛrig Wina'am kanɛ an wina wʋsa Wina'am la. O na nyaŋ hali ka sʋnpɛɛn saŋa la ti gaad, bɔzugɔ asɛɛ linɛ daa gban'e la wʋsa maali naae.

english_verse: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods
translation_verse: O mɛ kʋ na'as o yaanam wina la, bɛɛ win kanɛ ka pu'ab la nɔŋ la, bɛɛ gɔsi nyɛ win si'aa, amaa o na dʋ'ʋsi o mɛŋi gaad bama wʋsa.

english_verse: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.
translation_verse: O na zan'as bama wʋsa ka lɛɛ na na'asid win kanɛ gur kpi'euŋ zin'is la, win kanɛ ka o yaanam da zi' la, O na wɔ'ɔg o nɛ sanlima nɛ anzurifa nɛ kugvɛnla nɛ piini linɛ ligidi kpi'em.

english_verse: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land. Part Three: The Time of the End
translation_verse: O na zab nɛ teŋ kpi'ema ka li na yinɛ teŋ zʋŋ wina sʋŋir zug, ka o na nyaŋi li, ka na dʋ'ʋs nimbanɛ na'asid o la yʋda. O na kɛ ka ba gaad nidib bɛdegʋ tuon, ka pʋdig tɛɛns la tis ka di'e ligidi.

english_verse: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another,
translation_verse: “Saŋa la bɛn ya'a ti bɔɔd paar, Ya-dagɔbʋg Na'ab la na duoe zab nɛ o, ka Ya-datiuŋ Na'ab la na tʋ'ʋs o nɛ zaba widi, nɛ tɛrekonam, nɛ anrimbɛda bɛdegʋ. O na nyaŋ tɛɛns bɛdegʋ ka pili ba nwɛnɛ ku'om ɛɛnti pɛ'ɛli gɛɛl si'em la.

english_verse: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
translation_verse: O mɛ na nyaŋ Teŋ vɛnliŋ la. Tɛɛns bɛdegʋ na san'am, amaa Edom nɛ Moab dim nɛ Ammon tuongatib la na yii o nu'usin.

english_verse: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt,
translation_verse: O paŋ la na tiigi paae tɛɛns bɛdegʋ; hali Egipt gba kʋ pɔnsɛ.

english_verse: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: O na nyaŋi sʋ'ʋg sanlima nɛ anzurifa linɛ bɛ Egipt suak dɔɔdin la, nɛ li arezak wʋsa. Ka Libiya dim nɛ Kus dim na nɔki ba mɛŋi tis o.

english_verse: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.
translation_verse: Amaa labaya banɛ ka o na wʋm yit ya-datiuŋ nɛ ya-nya'aŋ la na kpɛn'ɛs o dabiem, ka o na yit nɛ ɛndʋg ka zabidi kʋʋd nidib ka san'am sieba nyain.

english_verse: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
translation_verse: O na ti' o na'am Fuug Sʋgʋr la atɛuk la baba zuor kanɛ vɛnl ka an kasi la ni. La'an nɛ wala o bɛn na paae ka sɔ' kʋ sʋŋ oo.”

english_verse: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ kpi la na vʋ'ʋg kumin. Sieba na vʋ'ʋgi paam nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarɛ, ka sieba mɛ na vʋ'ʋgi di nyan nɛ ziemis linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
translation_verse: Banɛ mɔr ya'am la na nyɛɛn wʋʋ arezana nɛɛsim nɛ, ka banɛ nyaŋi sʋŋi ba taaba ka ba tiaki lieb pʋpielim dim la na nwɛnɛ nwadbibis nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it. The End of Time
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn, Daniel, su'am pian'akanɛ bɛ gbauŋʋn la ka saŋa la bɛn ti paae. Nidib bɛdegʋ na zɔti giligidi ieed baŋir.’

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side.
translation_verse: “Ka man Daniel, ʋki m nindaa nyɛ nidib ayi' ka ba zi'e m san'an, ka yinne zi'e kɔldaug la gbɛog ka yinne la mɛ zi'e gbɛkaŋa la sa.

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
translation_verse: Ba nid yinne daa yɛl onɛ yɛ fupielig ka zi'e agɔla ka ku'om la bɛ teŋir la ye, ‘Li ye li nɔk saŋa wala ka yɛlnyalima bama naan maalɛ?’

english_verse: The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
translation_verse: “Dau kanɛ daa yɛ fupieligi zi'e ku'om la zug la daa ʋk o datiuŋ nɛ o dagɔbʋg nu'usi dʋ'ʋs agɔla kpa' arezana, ka m wʋm ka o pɔ nɛ Onɛ vʋe saŋa linɛ ka' bɛn la yɛt ye, ‘Li na an yʋma atan' nɛ pʋsʋk. Wina'am nidib la namisʋg la bɛn ya'a ti gaad, si'el wʋsa bɛn na paae.’

english_verse: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?” The angel in my vision then replied:
translation_verse: “M daa wʋm ka lɛɛ pʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ. Alazug m daa bu'os ye, ‘M zugdaana, nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa ye li ti niŋ wala-wala?’

english_verse: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.
translation_verse: “O daa lɛbisim ye, ‘Daniel, kemi fʋ ken, bɔzugɔ pian'ad la su'anɛ gur saŋa la bɛnnɛ na ti paae.

english_verse: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ na maali ba mɛŋ kasi vɛnl, ka gba'ar si'a lɛn kae. Amaa nimbɛ'ɛdnam la na kpɛn an nimbɛ'ɛdnam. Nimbɛ'ɛdnam la baa yinne kʋ gban'e si'el gbinnɛ, amaa banɛ mɔr ya'am la na gban'e li gbin.

english_verse: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_verse: “‘Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ fʋ, kemi fʋ ken hali ka li bɛn ti paae. Fʋ na kpi, ka dabisa la bɛn ya'a ti paae fʋ na vʋ'ʋgi di'e yɔɔd linɛ aan fʋ din la.’”

english_verse: I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me. Hosea's Family
translation_verse: Labaar kanɛ da yi Zugsɔb la san'an na tis Hosea onɛ an Beeri biig la nwa', saŋkanɛ ka Uzia nɛ Jotam nɛ Ahaz nɛ Hezekia da di Juda sʋ'ʋlim na'am tisid taaba la ka Jeroboam onɛ an Joas biig la da zin' Israel sʋ'ʋlim na'am gbauŋ zug la. Hosea pu'a nɛ o biis yɛla

english_verse: The Lord said, “Hosea, Israel has betrayed me like an unfaithful wife. Marry such a woman and have children by her.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da dɛŋim pian' tis Hosea la, o da yɛl o ye, “Kem nɔk pu'agɔɔndir ka o aan fʋ pu'a, ka o du'a bitampiinb, bɔzugɔ teŋ la tʋm taal ka li nwɛnɛ pu'asan'auŋ nɛ, ban zan'as man Zugsɔb la zug.”

english_verse: So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
translation_verse: Ala ka Hosea da di Goma onɛ an Dibilam pu'ayua la, ka o nɔk pʋʋgʋ du'a biribiŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Hosea ye, “Pʋdimi o yʋ'ʋr ye, ‘Jezireel’, bɔzugɔ li kpɛlim bi'ela ka m namis Israel Na'ab Jehu na'am tuŋ la, ban da kʋ nidib bɛdegʋ Jezireel teŋin la zug. Ka m na kɛ ka Israel na'am sʋ'ʋlim la naae.

english_verse: and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
translation_verse: Daakan la mam na kɔ'ɔg Israel tiraad Jezireel Bɔn'ɔgin la.”

english_verse: Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel.
translation_verse: Goma da lɛm gban'e pʋʋg ya'asi du'a bipuŋ, ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Hosea ye, “Pʋdim biig la yʋ'ʋr ye Loruhama, bɔzugɔ m kʋ lɛm pa'al Israel dimi m nɔŋilim bɛɛ kɛɛ ba taali basɛ.

english_verse: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
translation_verse: Amaa mam Zugsɔb Wina'am na pa'alim nɔŋilim an si'em nɛ Juda nidib. M na faaɛn ba, ba dataas nu'usin, ka ba nyɛ yɔlisim, hali ka li ka'anɛ ye ba nɔk zaba la'ad bɛɛ widi nɛ tanp tɛrekonamɛ zabɛ, amaa li anɛ mam Zugsɔb Wina'am yʋ'ʋr la zug.”

english_verse: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.
translation_verse: Goma biig la da tuk bin'isir la, o da lɛm gban'e pɔɔgʋ du'a biribiŋ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.” Hope for Israel
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “pʋdim o yʋ'ʋr ye Loammi, bɔzugɔ Israel dim lɛn ka' m nidiba, ka mam mɛ ka' ba Wina'am.” Israel dim na lɛn lɛbi ba zi'esimin na

english_verse: Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called “Not My People,” but in the future they will be called “Children of the Living God.”
translation_verse: Amaa saŋa kenna ka Israel dim na zu'oe nwɛnɛ atɛuk titan linɛ ka ba kʋ nyaŋi mak bɛɛ kaalɛ. Ka zin'ikanɛ ka ba yɛli ba ye, ya ka' m nidib la, ba na buoli ya anina ye, “Wina'am onɛ vʋe la biis.”

english_verse: Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.
translation_verse: Ka Juda nidib nɛ Israel dim na naal nɔɔr yinne, ka mɔr tuongat yinne ka na dɔl taaba lɛbi ba teŋin na. Li na an dabistita'are tis Jezireel.

english_verse: So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.” The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Yɛlimi fʋ ba'abiis la ye, “M nidiba.” Ka yɛli fʋ tanp la ye, “Banɛ ka m zɔti ba Nimbaanliga.” Pu'a kanɛ dɔl dap la yɛla

english_verse: Accuse! Accuse your mother! She is no longer my wife, and now I, the Lord, am not her husband. Beg her to give up prostitution and stop being unfaithful,
translation_verse: M biisɛ, sa'aliminɛ ya ma, sa'aliminɛ o nɛ nimmua ka o lɛn ka' mam pu'a ka mam mɛ lɛn ka' o sida. Sa'aliminɛ o ye o basim pu'agɔɔndir tʋʋma la nɛ on mɔr o niŋgbina tisid dap yɔɔg-yɔɔg la.

english_verse: or I will strip her naked like the day she was born. I will make her barren like a desert, and she will die of thirst.
translation_verse: Ya'a ka' ala mam na yɛɛg o fuud ka kɛ ka o ken sanwɛɛr nwɛnɛ on da yii o ma pʋʋgin na si'em la. M na kɛ ka o kpi ku'onuud nwɛnɛ pipirigi ɛɛn dig ka ku'om kae si'em la.

english_verse: You children are the result of her unfaithfulness, and I'll show you no pity.
translation_verse: M kʋ zɔɔ o biis la nimbaanliga ban an pu'agɔɔndir biis la zug.

english_verse: Your mother was unfaithful. She was disgraceful and said, “I'll run after my lovers. Everything comes from them— my food and drink, my linen and wool, my olive oil and wine.”
translation_verse: Ba ma san'amnɛ dapi du'a biis la nɛ nyan. O yɛl ye, “Mam na keŋ dɔlli m sabuos banɛ tisidim diib nɛ ku'om nɛ fuud nɛ kpaam nɛ daam la.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, will build a fence of thorns to block her path.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, m na zaŋ gɔn'ɔsi vi' o suor la, ka mɛ' zaŋguommi giŋ o, lin ka o kʋ nyɛ suori yii.

english_verse: She will run after her lovers, but not catch them; she will search, but not find them. Then she will say, “I'll return to my first husband. Life was better then.”
translation_verse: O na zɔti dɔl o sabuos la amaa ka kʋ paae baa. O na iee ba zin'igi gɛn ka kʋ nyɛɛ baa. O na yɛl ye, “Kɛl ka m lɛbi m sid san'an ka man daa bɛ nɛ o si'em la daa an sʋm gaad lin yʋ'ʋn an si'em nwa' la.”

english_verse: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: O nam pʋ baŋ ye manɛ tis o diib la nɛ bʋnnuuda nɛ kpaam la wʋsa. Hali ka tis o sanlima nɛ anzurifa linɛ ka o mɔri tisid Baal ba'ar ka li aan o piini la.

english_verse: So I'll hold back the harvest of grain and grapes. I'll take back my wool and my linen that cover her body.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, m na faanm ki la li bi'igir saŋa, ka faanm daam la li maalʋg saŋa. M na faanm fuud nɛ m piena linɛ ka m daa tis o ye o lus o mɛŋ la.

english_verse: Then I'll strip her naked in the sight of her lovers. No one can rescue her.
translation_verse: M na yɛɛg o fuud ka o lieb biel o sabuos la tuon, ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn o m nu'usinɛ.

english_verse: I'll stop Israel's celebrations— no more New Moon Festivals, Sabbaths, or other feasts.
translation_verse: M na gu'oe o malima la wʋsa o yʋʋm-yʋʋm malima, nɛ o nwadig-nwadig malima, nɛ o bakuai-bakuai Vʋ'ʋsʋm Dabisa la.

english_verse: She said, “My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex.” Now I, the Lord, will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: M na san'am o vain tiis nɛ kekama tiis banɛ ka o ye li anɛ o yɔɔd ka o sabuos daa yɔɔ o la. M na kɛ ka o pɔɔd la lieb gɔn'ɔs ka mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid san'ami ba.

english_verse: I'll punish her for the days she worshiped Baal and burned incense to him. I'll punish her for the times she forgot about me and wore jewelry and rings to attract her lovers. I, the Lord, have spoken! The Lord Will Help Israel
translation_verse: M na namis o, on daa tami m yɛla saŋsi'a la zug, nɛ on da nyɔ'ɔd bʋnnyubisa nɛ maana tisid Baalnam nɛ o sabuos banɛ wʋsa ka o daa dɔl la zug. Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, will lure you into the desert and speak gently to you.
translation_verse: “Amaa m na maligim mɔr o lɛb na. M na lɛm mɔr o keŋ pipirigin, ani m na pian' pian'amalisa tis o.

english_verse: I will return your vineyards, and then Trouble Valley will become Hopeful Valley. You will say “Yes” to me as you did in your youth, when leaving Egypt.
translation_verse: M na nɔk o vain tiis pɔɔdi lɛbisi tis o ka maal Akor bɔn'ɔg ka li lieb ti'ir za'anɔɔr. O na siaki tisim nwɛnɛ on da nan an biig ka niŋid si'em, saŋkanɛ ka m da yis o Egipt teŋin na la.

english_verse: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye daakan la, fʋ na lɛm buolim ye, ‘M sid’; ka kʋ lɛm buolim ye, ‘M Baal.’

english_verse: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
translation_verse: M kʋ lɛn kɛ ka o pian' Baal bada la yɛla ya'asɛ. O pʋn kʋ lɛm pʋdigi ba yʋda ya'asɛ.

english_verse: And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la m na maal nɔnaar nɛ bʋnkɔnbid la ka ba kʋ lɛn san'ami m nidib la, banɛ an sian'arin bʋnkɔnbid nɛ niis nɛ bʋnvuuda la wʋsa. M na yis tiraad nɛ zaba sʋ'ʋs nɛ zaba wʋsa teŋgbauŋʋn la ka m nidib na nyaŋi bɛ baanlimm nɛ laafi.

english_verse: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness,
translation_verse: Israel, m na kɛ ka fʋ aan m pu'a. M na mɔrif nɛ pʋpielim nɛ sida, ka pa'ali fʋ m nɔŋilim nɛ m nimbaanlzɔɔr.

english_verse: and faithfulness. Then you will truly know who I am.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ na aan m pu'a-ɛliŋ nɛ yɛlmɛŋir saŋa wʋsa ka baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.
translation_verse: ka teŋgbauŋ la mɛ siaki maal ki, nɛ kpaam, nɛ daam bɛdegʋ. Li wʋsa na siaki tis Jezireel.

english_verse: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka m nidib ba' nya'a teŋgbauŋʋn la. M na pa'alim m nɔŋilim nɛ onɛ ka m buon ye, ‘M nɔŋilim kae la.’ M na yɛl banɛ ka ba buon ye, ‘Ba ka' m nidib la’ ye, ‘Ya anɛ Nidib’, ka ba mɛ na gandig ye, ‘Fʋ anɛ ti Wina'am.’”

english_verse: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛlim ye, “Kem li'a fʋ pu'a kanɛ dɔl sabuos ka san'am dap la. Nɔŋim o nwɛnɛ man nɔŋ Israel nidib si'em la la'an nɛ ban fɛndigi lɛb ba'asieba ni ka nɔŋi li diib la.”

english_verse: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
translation_verse: Ani ka m yɛl o ye, “Asɛɛ ka fʋ bɛ nɛ mam ma'aa saŋa wʋsa ka da lɛn an pu'agɔɔndiri ginnɛ san'am dapa; ala ka mam mɛ na bɛ nɛf ka gurif.”

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
translation_verse: Anwana ka Israel na bɛɛ yuug ka kʋ mɔr na'ab bɛɛ tuongatiba, ka kʋ maal maan bɛɛ mɔr teŋkʋga bɛɛ linɛ wʋsa ka ba mɔri maan maanaa.

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: Amaa dabisir kenna ka Israel dim na lɛbi ba Wina'am nɛ ba Na'ab David san'an. Ba na kirid nɛ dabiem ken Zugsɔb la san'an na ka di'e o bareka la.

english_verse: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.
translation_verse: Israel dima, wʋmmi Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em, bɔzugɔ o mɔr yɛl nɛ ya, ka na zɛrig yanam banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋʋn la. “Yɛlsida bɛɛ nɔŋilim ka' teŋgbauŋʋn laa, ka nidib la pʋ baŋi ba Wina'am.

english_verse: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
translation_verse: Alazug teŋgbauŋ na fabinnɛ, ka linɛ wʋsa bɛɛ ani na mɛlim. Bʋnkɔnbid nɛ niis nɛ zimi na kpi.”

english_verse: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Da kɛ ka sɔ' zɛrig o tiraan bɛɛ nyɛɛ o gba'arɛ, yanam maanmaannib la ka m zɛrigid.

english_verse: You and the prophets will stumble day and night; I'll silence your mothers.
translation_verse: Ya tu'usidnɛ ken nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ ka nɔdi'esidib la mɛ la'am tu'usidi dɔlli ya. M na kʋʋ ya ma la.

english_verse: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.
translation_verse: M nidib la ba'asidnɛ yɔri ba zi'ilim la zug. Maanmaannib la ba'a ka' m pa'alʋg la nii, ala ka man ba'a mɛ ka' ba nii; ba zan'asi m nɔzi'elʋg la, lin ka m zan'as ye ba biis la kʋ an maanmaanniba.

english_verse: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
translation_verse: Maanmaannib la kal ya'a nɔbigid, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd mɛ paasidnɛ, alazug m na kɛ ka ya girima lieb nyannɛ tisi ya.

english_verse: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
translation_verse: M nidib la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin ka maanmaannib la paamid diib dinzug ka nidib la ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛd, ka ba mɔr sumalisim la.

english_verse: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
translation_verse: Nidib la an si'em la, ala ka maanmaannib la mɛ aaɛn. Dinzug, m na namis maanmaannib la nɛ nidib la wʋsa ba na di'e ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɔɔd.

english_verse: Their food won't satisfy, and having sex at pagan shrines won't produce children. My people have rebelled
translation_verse: Ba na dit ka kɔ'ɔm nan kpɛm mɔri ba, ba na dɔl winsieba wʋʋ dap nɛ pu'abi san'amid taaba si'em la ka kʋ nyɛ biisɛ, bɔzugɔ ba bas Wina'am dɔllim ka dɔl winsieba.

english_verse: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
translation_verse: Ba sɔsidnɛ ba'akanɛ ka ba zaŋ daugʋ maal ye li yɛlim ba ban na tʋm si'el. Ba ginnɛ ieed bada nwɛnɛ pu'agɔɔnda, ka li kpɛn'ɛsidi ba mɔɔg. Ba bɛ nɛ pu'asan'auŋ pʋʋgin ka dɔl winsieba ka zan'asi ba Wina'am.

english_verse: You offer sacrifices on mountaintops and hills, under oak trees, and wherever good shade is found. Your own daughters and daughters-in-law sell themselves for sex.
translation_verse: Ba kennɛ zuoya zuti maan bada, ba bɛ nɛ tibanɛ wa'am ka mɔr ma'asim gbina ni nyɔ'ɔd maana tisidi ba. Lin ka ya bipumis kpɛn' pu'agɔɔnda tʋʋma ka ya bipu'ab mɛ san'amid dap la.

english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: M kʋ namisi ya pu'asada banɛ kpɛn' pu'agɔɔnda tʋʋma la bɛɛ ya bipu'ab banɛ san'am dap la, bɔzugɔ, yanamɛ tʋm pa'ali ba. Ya san'am pu'abi ya wina dɔɔdin ka la'as nɛ ba maan bada. Yalimnama! Ya na paam san'auŋ, yanamɛ pʋ siak ye ya gban'e li gbin la yɛla.

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: Hali la'an nɛ Israel n tʋm wʋʋ pu'agɔɔndir la, Juda gu'usim ka da tʋm taalɛ. Juda, da keŋ Gilgal teŋin nɛ baa, mɛ da keŋ Betaven tɛɛnsin laa. Da la'as nɛ baa, ka ba pʋ'ʋsim la anɛ ziri; hali la'an nɛ banɛ ɛɛnti pʋ'ʋlʋm zi'el nɛ Zugsɔb yʋ'ʋr la.

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Israel tʋbzian'asim nwɛnɛ na'asa'a tʋbzian'asim nɛ. Alazugɔ, Zugsɔb la na niŋ wala mɔr o keŋ yaama zin'igin nwɛnɛ pɛbil kanɛ bɛ paalʋ ɔnbid yaama?

english_verse: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
translation_verse: Efiram nidib zaŋi ba mɛŋi la'as nɛ bada; kɛlli ba ka ba keŋ!

english_verse: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
translation_verse: Ka Israel dim ya'a nuu ba daam naae la, ba gɔɔndnɛ bɔɔd pu'agɔɔnda; ba nɔŋ nyan tʋʋma gaad linɛ an girima.

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: Sisi'epiliŋ na kena zii ba keŋ; ka ba na kpi nyan kum, ban maan bada la zug.”

english_verse: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
translation_verse: Maanmaanniba wʋmmiya! Kɛlisimi sʋ'ʋŋa Israel nidiba! Wʋmmi sʋ'ʋŋa yanam banɛ an Na'ayidima! Sariakadib kaŋa ye li lu nɛ ya zug, bɔzugɔ ya bɛndi ya mɛŋ Misipa teŋin, ka aaɛn asau yadig Tabo Zuor zug.

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: Ala ka ya tu bʋmbɔk zulʋŋ Akesia teŋin. Amaa m na tɛɛgi ba wʋsa tʋba.

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: Ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi gu'udi ba ka ba kʋ nyaŋi lɛbi ba Wina'am san'anɛ, ba anɛ pu'agɔɔnda amɛŋa mɛŋa ba pʋ tiɛnd Zugsɔb la yɛlaa.

english_verse: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.
translation_verse: Israel dim tita'alim la nie paalʋ, Israel dim la nɛ Efiram dim la tu'usidnɛ luti ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin. Juda nidib mɛ na tu'usidi dɔlli ba.

english_verse: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
translation_verse: Ba mɔri ba niigi nɛ ba bʋnkɔnbid na ye ba maal maana tis Zugsɔb, amaa ba kʋ lɛn nyɛɛ o bɔzugɔ o lɛb nɛ nya'aŋ ka basi ba.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ba pʋ dɔl Zugsɔb la nɛ yɛlmɛŋirɛ, ka du'ad bitampiinb. Li kʋ yuugɛ ka ba Nwadpaalig malima la na san'ami ba hali nɛ ba pɔɔd nɛ ba zʋʋd wʋsa.

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: “Piebimi na'atan la Gibea teŋin ka pieb wiis Rama tempʋʋgin mɛn! Ka kaas tanp kuŋ la Betaven ni ye Benjamin dim lum tuon!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Namisʋg daar la ya'a paae, Efiram teŋ la wʋsa na lieb dabɔɔd; Nwa' ka m mɔɔnnɛ tisid Israel dim; li anɛ asida ye li sid na niŋ.

english_verse: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
translation_verse: Juda teŋ tuongatib la tʋʋma nwɛnɛ nidi na tɔlis o kpi'a pɔɔg titɔndig kugir nɛ. M na kpa'ae m sʋnpɛɛnni ba zug ka li nwɛnɛ ku'om na pɛ'ɛl kɔligi badig nɛ.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Ba kad Efiram nidib la saria ka kʋʋsi ba bɛ'ɛd ka yʋ'ʋn mugusidi ba, bɔzugɔ ba gban'anɛ ye ba na dɔlli ba bada la.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: M na san'am Israel nidib nwɛnɛ na'anuguli na ɔnb fuudi san'amnɛ. M na sigis Juda paŋ nwɛnɛ muaki na mu'a daug nɛ.

english_verse: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
translation_verse: Efiram dimi baŋ ye ba bɛn'ɛdnɛ, ka Juda nidib mɛ nyɛɛ ba sapu'ad la zabid si'em la, ka Efiram dim lɛb Asiria san'an ka sɔsid Asiria Na'atita'ar la ye o sʋŋi ba. Amaa ka o pʋ nyaŋi sʋŋi ba, bɛɛ ti'ebi ba sapu'ad la.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: M na aans Israel nɛ Juda dim nwɛnɛ gbigimɛ gban'e si'eli aansidnɛ, M na gban'e ba mɔri ken ka aansid ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ba.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: M na lɛbi m zin'igin hali nɛ ban na ti siaki ba taal ka lɛbi m san'an na sɔs sʋŋir. Ala ka ba na fabili buolim, saŋkanɛ ka ba bɛ fara pʋʋgin la.”

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: Kemi na ka ti lɛbi ti Zugsɔb la san'an. Onɛ aansi ti zɔra-zɔra amaa o na nyaŋi ti'ebi ti ya'as; onɛ pu'alimi ti, ka mɛ na nɔk piena lɔɔ ti sapu'ad la.

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Li ya'a niŋ daba ayi', o na kpɛmisi ti ka daba atan' daar la ka o maali ti zi'el tituaa ka ti na tun'e bɛɛ o san'an.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Baŋimi Zugsɔb la an sɔ', kɛlli ka ti kpɛ'ɛŋi ti mɛŋi baŋ o sʋ'ʋŋa. Winnigi tansid daar wʋsa ka bi'esʋg kae la, ala ka bi'esʋg kae ye Zugsɔb la na nie o mɛŋi tisi ti. Sɛɛungʋ mɔr saŋa ken si'em na la bɛɛ sigiri ɛɛnti paad ka saa niid si'em la, ala ka o na kɛɛn ti san'an na.

english_verse: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Yanam Efiram dima, m ye m niŋi ya wala? Juda dima m na maali ya wala-wala? Ya nɔŋilim la nwɛnɛ bɛogʋn mɛligim nɛ, li nwɛnɛ mɛligim linɛ pʋ ya'asid kʋdigir si'em la.

english_verse: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m kɛ ka m nɔdi'esidib nwaae ya zɔra-zɔra la. M kʋʋ ya nɛ m nɔɔr pian'ʋk. M sariakadib na luu ya zug nwɛnɛ sa-ian'asʋg nɛ.

english_verse: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mam bɔɔd si'el anɛ nimbaanlzɔɔr ka ka' ya maanaa. M bɔɔd nɛ yanamɛ na baŋ man Wina'am sʋ'ʋŋa gaadi ya nyu'or maana la.

english_verse: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
translation_verse: Amaa ba san'am mam nɔnaar la nwɛnɛ Adam da niŋ si'em, ka ki'is mam ka pʋ bɛ sida bɛllim tisim la.

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Gilead sʋ'ʋlim anɛ teŋ kanɛ ka nidib la tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka ninkʋʋr ziim pɛ'ɛli ba teŋ la

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: nwɛnɛ faandibi su'a dig mɔɔgin gur nidib si'em la. Ala ka maanmaannib la aaɛn; ba gu'unɛ suoraad banɛ ken Sekɛm la kʋʋd nidib, nyan nɛ bugusim tʋʋma ma'aa ka ba tʋm.

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Asida, m nyɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi galis Israel si'em. Ani ka Efiram nɔk o mɛŋi lieb pu'agɔɔndir, ani ka Israel san'am o mɛŋ nɛ bada.

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: Juda dima, namisʋg digi guri ya, la'an nɛ m gban'e ye m lɛbisi m nidib la zusʋŋ la.”

english_verse: and to heal its wounds. But then I see the crimes in Israel and Samaria. Everyone is deceitful; robbers roam the streets.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka m gban'e ye m ti'eb Israel la, li saŋa ka m nyɛt Efiram dimi tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd si'em, ka baŋ Samaria nidib bugusim yɛla. Ba tɛɛns la pɛ'ɛl nɛ ziri pian'ad, ka na'ayiis kpɛn'ɛd nidib yaanɛ zuud, ka faandib bɛɛ ba suoya zug.

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: Ba tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka na'ab la sʋnf ma'ae, ka ba dama'am la kɛ ka na'ayikpɛm la mɔr sumalisim.

english_verse: Everyone burns with desire— they are like coals in an oven, ready to burst into flames.
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa anɛ pu'asan'auŋ dim ma'aa, ka ba niŋgbina bɔɔdim diti ba nwɛnɛ bugum tʋligid bodobodo dɔɔgi bi'igidi li ka bodobodo maan la pʋn pʋ limisid la.

english_verse: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
translation_verse: Daakanɛ an na'am malima daar la na'ab nɛ na'ayikpɛm la nunɛ daam kʋʋl ka naal nɛ banɛ an ninla'asnam.

english_verse: Their anger is a fire that smolders all night, then flares up at dawn.
translation_verse: Ba sʋnya la'aŋnɛ bugum. Yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa ba sʋnya duodnɛ hali ka bɛog nie ka li dit wʋʋ bugum pielim nɛ.

english_verse: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
translation_verse: Ba nwɛnɛ bugum linɛ kanbid ka diti ba tuongatib la yinne-yinne; ba na'anam wʋsa kpiidnɛ yɔri-yɔri ka sɔ' pʋ kaasi tisim ka m sʋŋi baa.

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: “M nimbanɛ an Efiram dim la nɔki ba mɛŋi la'as nɛ saam, ba nwɛnɛ ma'asir ka ba maal ka pʋ lɛbigɛ.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Teŋ zʋŋ dim fɔɔnsi ba paŋ la wʋsa, amaa ka ba lɛɛ pʋ baŋɛ. Ba zuobid gɛndignɛ nɛ zuobpielim amaa ka ba pʋ baŋ ye ba kʋdignɛ ka paŋ lɛn kae.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel dim tita'alim la mɛ pʋn anɛ kasɛta gɛɛnsi ba, la'an nɛ wala ba pʋ siak ye ba lɛbi ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la san'anɛ hali ba zan'asnɛ ka pʋ ieed o zin'iga.

english_verse: Israel is a senseless bird, fluttering back and forth between Egypt and Assyria.
translation_verse: Efiram nidib la nwɛnɛ dawana nɛ ba anɛ ya'am-ka'alim dim. Ba buol Egipt dim ye ba sʋŋi ba ka fɛndigi zɔɔ keŋi Asiria teŋin.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a keŋ anina m na nɔki m sau lɔbi gban'e ba ka tɛɛgi ba sigis teŋin wʋʋ niis banɛ ian'ad agɔla ka ba gban'ad si'em la. M ya'a wʋm ka ba la'asid taaba, m na gban'e ba wʋsa tɛɛgi ba tʋbir.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: Woo, tɔɔgʋ bɛ nimbanɛ bas mam la zug. Ba na san'am yɔri-yɔri ban ki'is mam nɔɔr la zug! Mam bɔɔd ye m faaɛn ba, amaa ba ma'ad ziri tisid man.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ kaasidi buonim nɛ ba sʋnya wʋsa, ba dignɛ ba gat zuti kaasid. Ba nwaadi ba mɛŋi sɔsid bada ye ba bɔɔd ki nɛ danpaal ka lɛɛ fɛndig ka bas mam.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: M zamisi ba ka kpɛmisi ba sʋ'ʋŋa ka ba lɛɛ gban'ad mam yɛla bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: Ba pʋ lɛb na dɔl man Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la. Ba nwɛnɛ tiraug kanɛ gɔnlig ka kʋ nyaŋi maalɛ. Ba bi'emnam na kʋʋ ba kpɛɛmnam la ba pian'ayɔɔd la yɛla, alazugɔ Egipt nidib na la' ba.”

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Piebimi na'atana maali tʋkpiidʋg! Dataa la sigid mam Zugsɔb nidibin la na nwɛnɛ silʋg nɛ, ban san'ami m nɔnaar ka ki'isi m wada la zug.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Israel dim kaasi buolim ye, ‘Sʋŋimi ti, ka fʋnɛ aan ti Wina'am!’

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: Amaa Israel nidib la pʋn zan'as bʋn linɛ an sʋm, alazug, ba dataas yʋ'ʋn na kati ba.

english_verse: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
translation_verse: Nidib la diis na'anam ka gaans kpɛɛmnam ka man zi' li ti'irɛ. Ba nɔki ba anzurifa nɛ sanlima maal bada ka li mɔr san'auŋ na tisidi ba.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Samaria dima, lɔmmi na'abil kanɛ ka ya maal ka di aan ya ba'ar la basi! M sʋnf duonɛ nɛ ya. Bɔ saŋa ka ya na yi taal pʋʋginɛ?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Israel dim banɛ mi' tʋʋma la banɛ maal na'abil la nɛ ba nu'us. Li ka' Wina'am, dinzugɔ, ba na san'am Samaria na'abil la bas.

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: Ba bʋd pɛbisʋg ka bʋn sisi'em. Ba ki la kʋdignɛ ka pʋ du'a. Li ya'a pʋn du'a, saam na dii li.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Ba vɔl Israel nidibi naae ka kɛ ka ba digi buudi wʋsa sʋʋgin nwɛnɛ dʋk kanɛ ka' tʋʋmmɛ.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Ba keŋ Asiria teŋin gɔɔnd yɔɔg-yɔɔg nwɛnɛ wɛogʋn bʋŋ kanɛ gɔɔnd o kɔn'ɔkɔn'. Israel dim yɔɔd ligidi tisid nidib ye ba sʋŋi ba wʋʋ dapi yɔɔd ligidi si'em tisid pu'agɔɔnda la.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Baa ban ken tɛɛns bɛdegʋ ieed sʋŋir la m na lɛn la'asi ba na ya'as. M na lɛn kɛ ka ba nyɛ namisʋg hali Asiria na'atita'ar la nu'usin.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: Israel dim mɛɛdnɛ bimbima bɛdegʋ ye ba maal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maana, amaa bimbim bama liebnɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zin'is.

english_verse: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ man tisi ba m wada bɛdegʋ la, ba niŋidnɛ wʋʋ li anɛ bʋnsaaŋi tisi ba.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Israel nidib maan maana bɛdegʋ ye ba nyɛ ni'imi ɔnb, amaa li pʋ malis Zugsɔb la sʋnfɔ. Nannanna o na tiɛn ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ka namisi ba li yɛla. Ba na lɛb Egipt teŋgbauŋʋn ya'as.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: Israel dim mɛɛd ya-vɛnla ka lɛɛ tam onɛ maali ba la yɛla. Juda dim mɛɛdi ba tempʋbanɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ; amaa m na kɛ ka bugum dii ba tempʋbɛda la.”

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Yanam Israel dima, da maannɛ sumalisim, da maannɛ sumalisim wʋʋ buudbama la niŋid si'em laa. Bɔzugɔ, ya pʋ dɔlli ya Wina'am la nɛ sidaa. Ya ginnɛ ziemis wʋsa nii pʋ'ʋsid wina, nwɛnɛ pu'agɔɔndiri bas o sid ka ginnɛ ieed dap ligidi yɛla siem la,

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ kpɛlim zin'ikanɛ an Zugsɔb teŋ la nii. Efiram na lɛb Egipt teŋin ka na dit Asiria dim diib linɛ ka ban tɛn'ɛs ye li anɛ dian'ad la.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ nyaŋi nɔk daam maal maannɛ tis Zugsɔb laa, ba maana mɛ kʋ ma'ae Zugsɔb sʋʋnrɛ. Maan bama wʋsa diib na nwɛnɛ kʋyin diib nɛ, ka onɛ dii li wʋsa na lieb dian'ad sɔb. Dikaŋa na anɛ ba mɛŋ ma'aa diib; ba kʋ mɔri li kɛn Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin naa.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ya na niŋ wala dabisbanɛ an Zugsɔb malʋŋ di'ema la daarɛ?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Hali baa ba ya'a zɔɔ widigi yi san'auŋʋn Egipt dim na la'asi baa, ba san'an na ka Memfis tempʋʋg la mumi ba. Mɔɔg na di'e zin'ikanɛ ka ba kpan'am linɛ an anzurifa bɛ la, ka gɔn'ɔs yii pɛ'ɛli ba sʋga la.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Tʋbtɛɛgir dabisa kenna, ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɔɔd dabisa li'el ya, kɛl ka Israel dim baŋ nɛ'ɛŋa. Bɔzugɔ ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la galis nɛ, ka ya kisidim zu'oe. Ya gban'e ye Wina'am nɔdi'es la anɛ zɔlʋg, ka yɛt ye onɛ ka Wina'am Siig bɛɛ o san'an la zug fɛndignɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Nɔdi'es la nɛ o Wina'am gur Efiram. La'an nɛ wala on ken suosi'a ni wʋsa ba bɛnd o nɛ baans; hali ka pitɔtʋʋma bɛɛ o Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir pʋʋgin la.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Ba kpɛn' filʋŋ pʋʋgin hali nwɛnɛ Gibea saŋa da an si'em la. Wina'am na tɛnri ba bugusim la yɛla ka namisi baa ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug.

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Man da nyɛ Israel saŋa si'a la ba da nwɛnɛ tikanɛ zi'e mɔɔgin wan wala nɛ. Saŋkanɛ ka m da nyɛɛ ya yaanam la, ba da nwɛnɛ kekaŋ dɛɛŋi na bi'ig nɛ. Amaa ban da paae Baal Peor la, ba da nɔki ba mɛŋi la'as nɛ ba'ar kanɛ mɔr nyan la, ka yʋ'ʋn nwɛnɛ o, ban nɔŋ o la zug.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Efiram pipilim la na iank wʋʋ niiŋ nɛ gaad: ba kʋ lɛn du'a biis bɛɛ mɔr pu'a pʋʋsɛ. Hali ba kʋ lɛn tʋk pʋʋga.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Baa ba ya'a du'a biis, m na kʋʋ ba wʋsa. M ya'a bidi m kudug ka basi ba, tɔɔg na paae ba.

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: M da nyɛ Efiram ka o nwɛnɛ Taya nɛ ka bɛ zin'isʋŋin. Amaa li nan kpɛn anɛ tilas ye Efiram dim yisi ba bibanɛ ka ba du'a la wʋsa na ka ba dataas kʋʋ ba.”

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Tisimi ba, O Zugsɔba, fʋ na tisi ba bɔ? Kɛl ka ba ya'a nɔk pʋʋs ban kpa'ae, ka ba bin'isa mɛ da mɔr bin'isim.
