english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Ba bugusim linɛ ka ba da tʋm Gilgal teŋin la li yɛla ka m kisigi ba. Ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug m na kadi ba yisi m yin, m kʋ lɛn nɔŋi ba ya'asɛ, ban nɛ ba tuongatib la wʋsa zan'asi m nɔɔr.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Efiram luya, ba nya'a kʋdig ya, ba kʋ du'a biisɛ. Baa ba ya'a du'a biis m na kʋʋ ba biis banɛ ka ba nɔŋ hali la.”

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: M Wina'am la na zan'asi ba bɔzugɔ ba zan'as o nɔɔr, ba na zɔti kpɛn'ɛd buudbanɛ wʋsa bɛ tɛɛnsin la.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Israel da nwɛnɛ tikanɛ tɔɔnd wila yadigid, ka wal wala tis o mɛŋ. Wala la zu'od si'em la, ala ka o mɛɛd maana bimbima paasid. Teŋ la zʋʋdi paasid si'em la, ala ka o maligim na'asid kugbanɛ ka o ba'a zi'eli pʋ'ʋsid la.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Ba sʋnyaa pɛ'ɛl nɛ dama'am la zug, ba na di'e ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɔɔd. Zugsɔb la na nwa'ae ba bimbima la ka san'ami ba kugbanɛ ka ba pʋ'ʋsid la.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Ba na yɛl ye, “Tinamɛ pʋ na'asid Zugsɔb la zug ka ti ka' na'aba. Amaa ti ya'a pʋn mɔr na'aba, o ye o maal bɔɔ tisi ti?”

english_verse: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
translation_verse: Na'anam la kaanbid nɔya bɛdegʋ zi'en ka maan nɔnaar linɛ ka' sidaa. Alazug, pɔnrʋŋ sariakadib yʋ'ʋn yadigid nɛ nwɛnɛ nwauŋʋ na yi yɔɔg-yɔɔg pɔɔgin nɛ.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ bɛ Samaria tempʋʋgin la, zɔmi dabiem ka fabin na'arazɔl ba'ar kanɛ bɛ Betaven teŋin la yɛla. Nidib banɛ maan ba'ar nwa' wʋsa na kummi li yɛla. Ba daa maan sumalisim li vɛnlim yɛla amaa ka ba bi'emnam nɔki li mɔri keŋ teŋ zʋŋ.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Ba na zii o keŋ Asiria tis Na'atita'ar la. Ba na diis Efiram nyan, ka Israel di nyannɛ o daad bada la yɛla.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Samaria dim nɛ ba na'ab la wʋsa na gaad wʋʋ dapauk ka ku'om zii li gaadnɛ.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Betaven teŋgbana banɛ bɛ kʋkʋna zug la na san'am, bɔzugɔ li anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi tis Israel dim. Gɔn'ɔs nɛ mɔɔd na yii gubili ba bimbima la. Ani ka dabiem na gban'e ba ka ba na yɛt zuoya ye, “Lusimini ti!” Ka yɛl zuobibis la ye, “Lim diinlini ti!”

english_verse: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
translation_verse: Israel dima, ya tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, lin yi Gibea saŋa sa, ka nan kpɛm bɛɛ ani. Ka' zaba ni ka ba da nyaŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim banɛ bɛ Gibea teŋin la wʋsaa?

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Li ya'a ti kɛɛn m pʋtɛn'ɛrin na, m na namisi ba, buudi bɛdegʋ na la'asi zabi gban'e ba, ban tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi ta'an la zug.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: Efiram anɛ na'akanɛ ka ba zamis o naae ka o nɔŋ ki bʋ'ʋb tʋʋma; amaa m na pa'al yu'asindaug o niŋgɔɔnrin, ka kad o ka o tʋm tʋʋm kanda. Juda na kuod hali ka Jakob liebid pɔɔg la.

english_verse: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
translation_verse: Bʋdimi pʋpielim tisi ya mɛŋ, ka bʋn nɔŋilim kanɛ pʋ naada. Bugumi teŋ la zin'ikanɛ nam pʋ kua la, bɔzugɔ li paae saŋkanɛ ka ya na iee Zugsɔb la hali nɛ on na ti lɛb na ka kpa'ae o pʋpielim niŋi ya zug.

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: Amaa ya bʋd bugusim bʋmbʋʋda ka yʋ'ʋn bun bʋmbɛ'ɛd ka dit dama'am wala. Yanamɛ ti'e ya mɛŋ paŋ nɛ ya zabzabidibi zu'oe si'em la zug,

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: zaba na kɔɔ gɛɛli ya nidib, ka ya kpi'euŋ zin'is la wʋsa san'am, nwɛnɛ Saliman da san'am Betaribɛl teŋ si'em tanp nwɛ'ɛb daar ka ba nɔk teŋ la pu'ab nɛ ba biisi fanb teŋin ka ba kpiid si'em la,

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: ba na niŋ ala tis yanam Betel dim. Bɔzugɔ, ya bugusim la zu'oya. Dabiskan la ya'a ti paae, ba na kʋ Israel na'ab la ka san'am o nyain-nyain.

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Israel da an biig la, m da nɔŋ o, ka buoli m biribiŋi yi Egipt teŋin na.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Amaa mam buon Israel dim si'em la, ala ka ba mɛ tɔlisid ka basidim. Ba maan maana tisid Baal ka nyu'od maana tisid bada wʋsa.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Manɛ da pa'al Efiram dim ken, ka gban'e ba nu'usi taasidi ba. Amaa ba lɛn zi' ye manɛ da ti'ebi ba

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: ka zɔɔ ba nyɔɔg ka mɔri ba yina nɛ nɔŋilim linɛ ka' naarɛ; ba mɛ zi' ye manɛ yis yu'asindaug la ba niŋgɔnya ni, ka ku'un teŋin diisi ba diibɔ.

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: Ayei! Asɛɛ ba maligim lɛb Egipt teŋin, ka Asiria dim sʋ'ʋgi ba ban zan'asi m nɔɔr la zug.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: M nidib la mɔɔd ye ba fɛndig ka basim. Ba ya'a bɔɔd bam buolim Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el Wʋsa la ka o kʋ wʋm ka dʋ'ʋsi baa.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: Efiram dima, m na niŋ wala tami ya yɛla? M na niŋ wala nɔk yanam Israel dimi tisɛ? Ka m na niŋ wala maali ya wʋʋ Adma teŋ dima? M na niŋ wala maali ya wʋʋ Zeboim dima? M pʋtɛn'ɛr yʋ'ʋn tiakid ka m nimbaanlzɔɔr lɛb na.

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: M kʋ yisi m sʋnpɛɛn linɛ mɔr dabiem la naa, bɛɛ m tuligi san'am Efiram; bɔzugɔ, m anɛ Wina'am ka m ka' ninsaala, m anɛ Onɛ An Kasi bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin. M kʋ kena nɛ sʋnpɛɛnnɛ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na nwa'am wʋʋ gbigim nɛ ka ba na dɔl o nya'aŋi yina. O ya'a ti nwa'am, o biis na yi ya-tuona kiridi kennɛ o san'an na.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: “Ba na yi Egipt n ken tɔ'ɔtɔ na ka kirid wʋʋ niis nɛ ka nwɛnɛ dawana yi Asiria kenna nɛ, ka m na lɛbisi ba zin'ili ba yaan.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la. Israel tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla

english_verse: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
translation_verse: Efiram nidib la giligim nɛ faad, ka Israel nidib la mɛ an dama'am dim. Juda dim zan'asi ba Wina'am, hali la'an nɛ Wina'am Onɛ an Kasi ka an sida sɔb la.

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: Efiram dim nwɛnɛ banɛ dit pɛbisʋg, ka gɔɔnd mɔɔgin kad sisi'em daar wʋsa. Ba ziri nɛ ba sʋnya duod tɔ'ɔtɔ si'em la pɛ'ɛsidnɛ. Ba naal nɔnaar nɛ Asiria dim, ka mɔr olif kpaam kennɛ tisid Egipt dim la.

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nɛ Juda dim mɔr antu'a; o na namis Jakob yaas ban tʋm si'em la zug, ka yɔɔ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sam wʋʋ din nar si'em.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Jakob n da bɛɛ o ma pʋʋgin la o da gban'e o bier nɔbir; o da anɛ ninsaal amaa ka mɔ nɛ Wina'am.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: O da mɔ nɛ maliak ka nyaŋ o, ka yʋ'ʋn kpɛn' kukuma ka bɛllim o ye o kaanbim kaanb sʋŋʋ tis o. O da nyɛ Zugsɔb la Betel teŋin ka pian' tis o,

english_verse: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, Zugsɔb la aan o yʋ'ʋr ka nar nɛ zʋn'or.

english_verse: So return to your God. Patiently trust him, and show love and justice.
translation_verse: Amaa, asɛɛ ka ya lɛbi ya Wina'am la san'an; kɛl ka nɔŋilim nɛ sida kpɛm bɛ ala, ka gu'usidi ya Wina'am la saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Israel, you enjoy cheating and taking advantage of others.
translation_verse: Kpikpinkpinnib nɔŋ nɛ filʋŋ buudi wʋsa, ba mɔri kuriba banɛ pʋ zu'oe makid kuosim kuosid.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Efiram dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋi yɛt ye, “M mɔr kpan'am, ka lieb bʋmmɔr. La'an nɛ m mɔrim la wʋsa, ba kʋ nyɛ taal bɛɛ bɛ'ɛdi m bɛllim pʋʋginɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt teŋin na la. M na lɛn kɛ ka ya gbɛɛnd sʋga ni, nwɛnɛ Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ saŋa ka ya bɛ sʋga ni si'em la.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: M pian' tis nɔdi'esidib la, ka nie si'elnam bɛdegʋ tisi ba ka lɛn kɛ ka ba siilim siilima.”

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Gilead dim la anɛ bugusnamaa? Ba nidib la ka' vɔɔnrɛ! Ba mɔr na'araadi maan maana Gilgal teŋinɛɛ? Ba maana bimbima la na nwɛnɛ kuga ka ba yis pɔɔginɛ la'asi digil kpikpɛŋ kuob saŋa.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da nɔknɛ o nɔdi'es ka kɛ ka o yis Israel dim Egipt teŋin na, ka kɛ ka o nɔdi'es la guri ba.

english_verse: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
translation_verse: Efiram dim ya'a da pian', nidib kiridnɛ, ba da nyɛt na'asi Israel dim sʋʋgin. Amaa ban tʋm bɛ'ɛd ka pʋ'ʋsid Baal la zug ba na kpi.

english_verse: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
translation_verse: Ba nan kpɛn tʋmnɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi paasid ka nɔkid anzurifa maan bada pʋ'ʋsid. Nimbanɛ mi' nu'ug tʋʋma sʋ'ʋŋa zaŋ ya'am maal bada la nɛ ba mɛŋ nu'us. Ba yɛl nimbama nwa' yɛla ye, “Ba mɔr saalibi maan maana tisid na'arazɔl bada la ka pʋ'ʋsidi ba.”

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: Dinzug, ba na nwɛnɛ bɛogʋn kpaandʋg nɛ ka nwɛnɛ bɛogʋn mɛligim ɛɛnti mɛlim si'em la, ka lɛn nwɛnɛ udug ka sisi'em ʋki li zieŋini mɔri ken nɛ, ba mɛ lɛn nwɛnɛ nyɔ'ɔsi na yi takoro ni gaad.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Manɛ an ya Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt teŋin na. Da dɔlli winsieba lɛm paas mam ya'asɛ, faangid kae zin'isi'a asɛɛ mam ma'aa.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: M da guri ya pipirisin la, zin'ikanɛ ka teŋ la tʋl hali la.

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: Man da diisi ba la ba da tig ya, amaa ban da dii tig la ka mɔr nyɛɛsim, ka tam man yɛla.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: Alazug, m na gban'e ba nwɛnɛ gbigimɛ gban'ad bʋnkɔnbid si'em la, m na digin suorinɛ guri ba wʋʋ wɛbaa nɛ,

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: M na aansi ba ka ɔnbi ba nwɛnɛ bʋnyua ka ba gban'e o biis nɛ. M na ɔnbi ba wʋʋ gbigim nɛ; m na aansi ba zɔra-zɔra wʋʋ wɛog bʋnkɔnbʋg nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: Israel dima, ya na san'am, yanamɛ zabid nɛ man la zug, ya zabid nɛ man kanɛ sʋŋidi ya la.

english_verse: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
translation_verse: Ya na'ab kanɛ na faaɛn ya la bɛ ya? Ya tuongatib banɛ bɛ tempʋʋsin la bɛ ya? Banɛ ka ya yɛl ye, ‘Tisimi ti na'ab nɛ kpɛɛmnam la’?

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Alazug m sʋʋnr da duoe ya ka m tisi ya na'ab, ka m sʋnpɛɛn zug ka m da yis o.

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: M sɔb Efiram dim taal la digil, m nɔki ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la su'a.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: M na yisi ba yaʋgʋn, m na faaɛn ba kum zin'igin. Akum, fʋ paŋ la bɛ yaanɛ? Ayaʋgɔ, fʋ paŋ kanɛ san'amid la bɛ yaanɛ? M kʋ siaki zɔɔ ba nimbaanliga.

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ on kpɛ'ɛŋid ye o gaad o ba'abiis la, Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka nya'aŋ sisi'em da'ae na; li na da'ae yi pipirisin la na, ka kɛ ka ku'om linɛ tansid teŋin yit na la gu'oe, ka o bulis la wʋsa kʋdig. Ba na faaɛn o la'ad o la'ad suak zin'igin la wʋsa ka mɔr o areza'as banɛ zu'oe la keŋ.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: Samaria dim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd na kpɛlimmi ba zugin, bɔzugɔ ba zan'asi ba Wina'am la nɔɔr. Ba na kʋʋ ba zaba ni, ba na faaɛn ba biisi fanbi ba teŋin, ka lati ba pu'apʋʋs.”

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Tiakimi, ka lɛbi Zugsɔb Wina'am sa'an na, yanam Israel dima. Ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la kɛ ka ya tu'usidi lit!

english_verse: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
translation_verse: Di'emi pian'akaŋa ka lɛbi Zugsɔb la san'an na. Yɛlimin o ye, “Kɛlli ti taali bas ka di'e ti nɛ pʋpielim ka ti na wɔ'ɔgif nɛ ti nɔya wʋʋ tinamɛ zi'el nɔɔr si'em la.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Asiria dim kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn tii; ti kʋ ban' zaba widi ya'asɛ. Ti nu'usi maal si'el la, ti kʋ lɛn yɛli ba ye, ‘Ti Winaa nwa'.’ Li anɛ fʋn san'an ka kpiibis nyɛt nimbaanlzɔɔr.”

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “M na kɛ ka ba basi ba bɛllim linɛ pʋ nar la ka mɔri ba lɛb na ka nɔŋi ba nɛ m sʋʋnr wʋsa, m sʋnpɛɛnni yii ba san'an la zug.

english_verse: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
translation_verse: M na nwɛnɛ mɛligim nɛ tis Israel dim, ba na vɛnli nwɛnɛ mɔɔd puum nɛ, ka wa'am nwɛnɛ Lebanon teŋ tititada nɛ, ka ba nya'a na ba'a sig teŋin.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Ba bibibis la na nɔbig, ka ba vɛnlim na nwɛnɛ olif tiig nɛ ba nyuug na malisi nwɛnɛ Lebanon na'aziinr tiis nɛ.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Nidib na lɛm bɛɛ ba ma'asim, ba na nɔbigi nwɛnɛ ki linɛ bɛ pɔɔgin nɛ. Ba nwɛnɛ daam tiig puum, ka na mɔr yʋ'ʋri nwɛnɛ daam linɛ yi Lebanon teŋin na.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Efiram dima, m ba'a bɔɔ bɛ nɛ bada? M na wʋmi ya sɔsʋg ka guri ya. M nwɛnɛ kpʋkparig vaand linɛ pʋ sʋʋgida; ya sʋ'ʋm wʋsa yitnɛ man san'an na.”

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ an ya'am sɔba? On sɔbi na baŋ nɛ'ɛŋa. Anɔ'ɔnɛ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛrɛ? On sɔbi na gban'e li gbin. Zugsɔb la suoya anɛ linɛ dɔl suor, ka pʋpielim dim la dɔlli li; amaa banɛ zan'as Zugsɔb la kennɛ tu'usid.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: Zugsɔb labaar linɛ yi Petuel biig Joel san'an na la nwa'. Na'azɔmnamɛ na yi si'em na yɛla

english_verse: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?
translation_verse: Kpɛɛmnama, kɛlisimi; yanam banɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa kɛlisimi. Ya saŋa la, nɛ' buudi nam mi' maal bɛɛ li mi' maali ya yaanam saŋa la?

english_verse: Tell our children! Let it be told to our grandchildren and their children too.
translation_verse: Yɛlimini ya biis, ka kɛ ka ya biis la mɛ yɛli ba biis, ka ban biis mɛ yɛl zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ dɔlli ba nya'aŋ la.

english_verse: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
translation_verse: Danuudiba, duomi ka kaasi! Kaasimi, yanam banɛ nuud daam la; kaasimi danpaalig la yɛla, bɔzugɔ ba faaɛn li ya nɔɔrin.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Teŋ si'a zabzabidib kpɛn' san'ami m teŋ, ba mɔr paŋ hali, ka zu'oe pʋ mɔr kallɛ; ba nyina nwɛnɛ gbigim nyina nɛ, ba pʋlimmi nwɛnɛ gbigimnya'aŋ nyina.

english_verse: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.
translation_verse: Ba san'ami m tiis pɔɔg ka kʋʋ m kekama tiis. Ba pigisi ba pa'ad la lɔbi bas, ka kɛ ka wila la an piela-piela.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Kaasim wʋʋ pu'a-ɛliŋ ka ba nɔk o tis dau ye o kul ka o sid la pʋ yuugɛ ka kpi.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Zʋʋd nɛ bʋnnuuda maana lɛn ka' Zugsɔb Yin la ya'asɛ. Maanmaannib banɛ tʋm Zugsɔb Yin la bɛ nɛ kukuma ni.

english_verse: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.
translation_verse: Teŋ la kʋdignɛ, ka pɔɔd la san'am; zʋʋd san'am ya, ka danpaal naae, ka kpaam lɛn kae.

english_verse: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
translation_verse: Kpaadiba, maalimi sʋnsa'aŋ; kaasimi, yanam banɛ mɔr vain tiis la. Maalimi sʋnsa'aŋ ki nɛ mui kae la yɛla, bɔzugɔ pɔɔd banɛ ka ya na bʋn la san'am ya.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Vain tiis la kʋdigya, ka kekama la sʋʋg; pomanganɛt nɛ kpʋkpara nɛ tibanɛ kpɛlim la sʋʋgya, tibanɛ bɛ pɔɔgin la wʋsa sʋʋg ya. Sida linɛ an ninsaal sumalisim la wʋsa naae ya. Sʋnya tiakir yɛla

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Maanmaanniba, kaasimi ka yɛ bɔto fuud ya sʋnsa'aŋ la zug; kaasimi, yanam banɛ tʋm maana bimbim tʋʋma la. Kemi na ka yɛɛi bɔto fuud yʋ'ʋŋ la wʋsa, yanam banɛ tʋmmi tisidi m Wina'am la bɔzugɔ zʋʋd maana nɛ bʋnnuuda maana la lɛn kae ya Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Gban'ami nɔlɔɔr linɛ bɛɛ li kɔn; kɛl ka nidib la la'as la'asʋg linɛ an kasi. La'asimi kpɛɛmnam la nɛ nimbanɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa ye ba kemi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la Pʋ'ʋsim Yin na, ka kaasi tisi Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
translation_verse: Dabisir la paae ya! Zugsɔb dabisir la li'el ya; li na yi Wina'am Onɛ Galis la san'anɛ kena nɛ san'auŋ.

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Diib la pʋ naae ti nini nii? Hali sumalisim lɛn kae ti Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la.

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Bʋmbʋʋda la daa kʋdignɛ teŋin, teŋ la pʋʋgin anɛ kpi'emis. Diib kae na su bʋya la nii ka bʋya la lii san'am bɔzugɔ li wʋsa kʋdignɛ.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Wʋmmi niigi la bʋʋn si'em! Ba giligidnɛ yɔɔg-yɔɔg bɔzugɔ yaama kae ka ba na ɔnbɛ. Hali pɛ'ɛs la mɛ namisidnɛ.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: Fʋn ka m buon, Zugsɔba, bɔzugɔ bugum kanb yaama banɛ bɛ paalʋ la ka lɛn di tiis banɛ bɛ karinyauŋin la.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Hali wɛog bʋnkɔnbid yu'osidi ieedif, ku'om linɛ pʋbid kɔldabibisin la kpiɛnnɛ ka bugum di yaama banɛ bɛ sian'arin la wʋsa.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Piebimi na'atana la Zion teŋin; kɛl ka ba wʋmi li m zuokanɛ an kasi la ni! Kɛl ka banɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa kirid, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la dabisir kenna. Li li'el ya, li bɛ nɛ yammin,

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: dabisir la na anɛ lik, dabisir la na anɛ saŋgbana nɛ zibisʋg. Li na nwɛnɛ bɛogʋ na bɔɔd nier ka nied zuoya ni ka zabzabidib banɛ zu'oe la kenna nɛ kpi'euŋ. Li buudi nan zi' maalɛ ka mɛ kʋ lɛm maal saŋa linɛ kenna la wʋsa.

english_verse: Fiery flames surround them; no one escapes. Before they invaded, the land was like Eden; now only a desert remains.
translation_verse: Bugum na bɛ tuonnɛ dit, ka bugum pielim bɛ nya'aŋi kanbid. Teŋ la na nwɛnɛ Eden lɔmbɔn'ɔgʋ ba tuon, ka ba nya'aŋ la na nwɛnɛ pipirig, ka si'el kae na pɔnsɛ.

english_verse: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.
translation_verse: Ba na nwɛnɛ widi nɛ; ka zɔti nwɛnɛ zaba widi nɛ.

english_verse: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
translation_verse: Ba na zɔt zuoya la zugʋ vuud nwɛnɛ zaba tɛrekonam. Li na panridi nwɛnɛ bugum dit mɔɔg, ka nwɛnɛ zabzabidib ka ba la'asi ba wa'ae zaba.

english_verse: The very sight of them is frightening.
translation_verse: Ban bɛ zin'isi'a la, buudi wʋsa na mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ; ka sɔ' wʋsa nwɛɛgid.

english_verse: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
translation_verse: Ba nini na mu'oe nwɛnɛ zabzabidib; ka ian'adi dʋt zaŋguoma nwɛnɛ soogianam nɛ. Ba na tʋn taaba kpa' ken, ka kʋ fɛndig bɛɛ ba kɛdigɛ.

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: Ba yinne kʋ di'e o tiraan suorɛ; ba wʋsa zugʋ kpa' zin'isi'a la ka ba na ken. Ba kʋ buŋidi kpa'ad zabzabidib ka bie ka bas suorɛ.

english_verse: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
translation_verse: Ba zɔɔ keŋ tempʋʋgin la ka zɔɔ dɔlis zaŋguom la. Ba ianki kpɛn' nidib la dɔɔd pʋʋgin, ka kpɛn' takoronam la ni wʋʋ ba anɛ na'ayiis.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: Teŋ la dammi ba tuon, ka saŋgbana la mi'im, winnig nɛ nwadig la liebnɛ lik, ka nwadbibis pʋ lɛn nieda.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la bɛɛ o soogianam la tuon ka pian'ad nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar. O zabzabidib banɛ siak o nɔɔr la zu'oya ka kpi'em hali. Zugsɔb dabisir la anɛ dabistita'ar, ka mɔr dabiem ka tɔi hali. Dabiskan la daarɛ anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi zi'enɛ? Kɛl ka ya sʋnya san'am amɛŋa

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ya ye, “Lɛmmini m san'an na nɛ ya sʋnf wʋsa, lɔɔmi nɔɔri kaasid ka kum.”

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Da aansidi ya fuud ye ya pa'ali ya sʋnsan'aŋa amaa pa'alimi ya sʋnyaa sid san'am si'em. Lɛmmi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la san'an, ka o anɛ nimbaanlzɔt hali. O sʋnf pʋ duod tɔ'ɔtɔ, ka o nɔŋir mɛ pʋ naada, o na kɛɛ ya taali bas ka kʋ kɛ ka yɛlbɛ'ɛd kenaa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Daasi'erɛɛ ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la tun'e zɔɔ ya nimbaanlig ka tisi ya albareka ka ya nyɛ zʋʋd bɛdegʋ ka ya na mɔri maan zʋʋd nɛ bʋnnuuda maana tisid o.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Piebimi na'atan Zion Zuorin la, Gban'ami nɔlɔɔr linɛ bɛɛ li kɔn', ka la'asi la'asʋg linɛ an kasi.

english_verse: Make sure that everyone is fit to worship me. Bring adults, children, babies, and even bring newlyweds from their festivities.
translation_verse: La'asimi nidib la, ka maali ba kasi; la'asim kpɛɛmnam la na, la'asim biis la, la'an nɛ banɛ nam mu'ad la. Kɛl ka pu'apaal la nɛ o sid basi ba dɔɔg ka yina.

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Maanmaannib banɛ tʋmmi tisid Zugsɔb ka zi'e Pʋ'ʋsim Yir bimbim nɛ za'ambɛŋ la za'anɔɔr teŋsʋk la kaasim ka nwɛ' kuŋ. Kɛl ka ba yɛl ye, “Zugsɔba, zɔmi fʋ nidib la nimbaanlig. Da kɛ ka ba nɛ'ɛs tinam banɛ aan fʋ faar la ka nɔki ti maal bʋnla'ada nidib la sʋʋginɛ. Bɔ ka ba na bu'osid nidib la sʋʋgin ye, ‘Ba Wina'am la bɛ yaanɛ?’” Zugsɔb la lɛbis si'em

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la na kpɛn'ɛs o nu'ug ka zɔɔ o nidib la nimbaanlig.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la lɛbisi ba ye, “M na tisi ya zʋʋd nɛ danpaal nɛ kpaam ka li na zu'oe ka siaki ya; m kʋ lɛn kɛ ka ya an bʋnla'ada tis buudbanɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa.

english_verse: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate
translation_verse: Teŋgbauŋɔ, da zɔt dabiem; lɛɛ mɔr sumalisim. Ya'a an sida, Zugsɔb la tʋm tʋʋm kpi'ema.

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Wɛog bʋnkɔnbidɛ, da zɔti dabiem; ka yaama la maligim sɔbigidnɛ. Tiis la wannɛ ba wala; kekama nɛ vain tiis la wal sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: Yanam Zion dima, mɔri sumalisim, maalimi sumalisim Zugsɔb la maal si'eli tisi ya la zug, bɔzugɔ o tisidi ya saa, saŋa kanɛ nar; o tisidi ya saa ka li pa'an on an sʋm si'em. O tisi ya ku'om bɛdegʋ; sadɛɛŋ nɛ sayɔɔŋ wʋʋ on ɛɛnti niŋid si'em la.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Zʋʋd na pɛ'ɛl ziemis la ka ban nwiakid daam ka siligid kpaam zin'isieba la mɛ na pɛ'ɛli badig.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: M na lɛbisi yɔɔ ya zʋʋd banɛ ka na'azɔmnam da ɔnb yʋʋm banɛ gaad la sam: na'azɔmnam banɛ an bʋntitada nɛ banɛ an bʋmbaanlʋg la, na'azɔm titada nɛ na'azɔm baanlʋg nɛ na'azɔmnam banɛ dɔl nya'aŋ la wʋsa. Banɛ an zabzabkpi'ema ka m da tʋm la na.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Ya na mɔr diib bɛdegʋ dit, hali ka li sia'ali ya, ka ya na dʋ'ʋsi ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr, ka wɔ'ɔg onɛ tʋm nyalima tisi ya la. Ya kʋ lɛn di nyan ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ani ka ya na baŋ ye m bɛ Israel teŋin, ya na baŋ ye manɛ aan ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la, ka sɔ' lɛn kae paas mam zugɔ. Ya kʋ lɛn di nyan ya'asɛ. Zugsɔb la dabisir kenna yɛla

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: Lin nya'aŋ la, m na kpa'ae m Siig la niŋ ninsaalib buudi wʋsa zug. Ya biribis nɛ ya bipumis na di'e Wina'am pian'adi tis nidib. Ya ninkʋda na zaansim zaansima, ka ya bibibis nyɛ nier pa'alʋg.

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: Hali m na kpa'ae m siig la niŋi, m tʋmtʋm dap nɛ tʋmtʋm pu'ab dabisban la ni.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: M na maal bʋnnyalima agɔl ka maal zanbina dunia zug. Ziim nɛ bugum nɛ nyɔ'ɔs na duod zin'ig wʋsa.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
translation_verse: Winnig na ti lieb lik ka nwadig mu'oe nwɛnɛ ziim nɛ, ka Zugsɔb dabistita'ar linɛ mɔr dabiem la naan paae.

english_verse: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ wʋsa buol Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, o na nyɛ faangir; bɔzugɔ faangir na bɛ Zion Zuorin la nɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin, nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb la pʋn yɛl si'em la, faangir la na bɛ banɛ kpɛlim la sʋʋgin, banɛ ka Zugsɔb buol la.”

english_verse: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Dabisban la nɛ saŋkan la, m ya'a ti lɛbis Juda nɛ Jerusalem zusʋŋ la na,

english_verse: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
translation_verse: m na la'as buudi wʋsa mɔri ba sig Jehosafat bɔn'ɔgin la. Ani ka m na zin'inɛ kadi ba saria Israel dim banɛ aan m faar la yɛla, bɔzugɔ ba widigi m nidibi kpɛn'ɛs tɛɛnsin la ka pʋdigi m teŋ la.

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: Ba maali m nidib bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm ka kuosi ba biribis la yɔ pu'agɔɔnda; ka mɛ kuosi ba bipumis la tis ka di'e daam nu.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ka ya duoe zabid nɛ ma, yanam Taya nɛ Sidon dim, nɛ yanam banɛ bɛ Filistia sʋ'ʋlimin la? M maali ya nɛ si'el ka ya ye ya yɔɔmi li sam bɛɛ? M ya'a maalnɛ si'el ka ya yɔɔdim sam, m na fɛndig yanamɛ maal si'el la tɔ'ɔtɔ lɛbisi ziili ya zugin.

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: Ya vaae m anzurifa nɛ sanlima ka zii m la'asʋma la mɔri keŋ kpɛn'ɛsi ya pʋ'ʋsim dɔɔdin.

english_verse: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
translation_verse: Ya kuos Juda nɛ Jerusalem dimi tis Girik dim, ye ya kɛ ka ba lalig ka basi ba mɛŋ teŋ.

english_verse: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
translation_verse: “Gɔsima, m na yisi ba yanamɛ kadi ba kpɛn'ɛs zin'isieba la nii mɔri lɛbis na, ka kɛ ka yanamɛ maali ba si'el la lɛbi ya zugin.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: M na kuosi ya biribis nɛ ya bipumis la tis Juda dim, ka ban mɛ na kuosi ba tis Arabia dim banɛ bɛ teŋ lalli la.” Zugsɔb la pian'.

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Mɔɔlim nɛ'ɛŋa tis buudi wʋsa ye, Ti'ebimi zaba! Buolimi soogianam la na! Kɛl ka zabzabidib la wʋsa li'eli zab!

english_verse: Make swords out of plows and spears out of garden tools. Strengthen every weakling.”
translation_verse: Zan'aminɛ ya kʋnya la maal zaba sʋ'ʋs ka nɔki ya gɔn'ɔd la maal kpana. Kɛl ka onɛ tadig yɛl ye, “Mam mɔr paŋ!”

english_verse: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
translation_verse: Kemi tɔ'ɔtɔ na, yanam buudbanɛ gilig la wʋsa, La'asimini anina. Zugsɔba, mɔri fʋ zabzabidibi sig na!

english_verse: You must come now to Judgment Valley, where the Lord will judge the surrounding nations.
translation_verse: “Kɛl ka buudi wʋsa la'as na; kɛl ka ba keŋ Jehosafat bɔn'ɔgin la tɔ'ɔtɔ, ka ani ka m na zin'ini kad buudi la wʋsa saria, m saria zin'igin.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: Saasim gɔn'ɔg la ka bunib saŋa paae ya. Kem na nɔ daam tiwala la, ka daam bɔk la pɛ'ɛl ya ka siins la mɛ pɛ'ɛli badigid nwɛnɛ ti dataas la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pɛ'ɛli badigid si'em la.”

english_verse: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
translation_verse: Nidib la anɛ tusa-tusa bɛ sariakadib bɔn'ɔgin la! Zugsɔb dabisir la li'el sariakadib bɔn'ɔgin la.

english_verse: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
translation_verse: Winnig nɛ nwadig la na lieb lik, ka nwadbibis la kʋ lɛn nie ya'asɛ.

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: Zugsɔb na naan Zion Zuorini nwa'am agɔla gɔla ka tans Jerusalem wʋʋ satansʋg nɛ; ka teŋ nɛ saŋgbana na dammid. Amaa Zugsɔb la na aan o nidib suak zin'ig, o na anɛ kpi'euŋ zin'igi tis Israel dim! Wina'am nidib na nyɛ albareka

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb da lɛn yɛl ye, “Ani ka ya sid na baŋ sida ye man Zugsɔb Wina'am la bɛ Zion, m zuokanɛ an kasi la ni. Jerusalem na an kasi; saam kʋ lɛn faaɛn teŋ la ya'asɛ.

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: Daakan la ya'a ti paae, daam na bun zuoya la ni, ka kʋkʋna la na pʋbid bin'isim, ka ku'om na pʋbid Juda teŋ ku'osuoya la wʋsa ni. Ku'om na pʋbidi yit Zugsɔb Yin la na li na dɔn'ɔs Gɔn'ɔs bɔn'ɔg la ka li ma'ae siaa.

english_verse: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
translation_verse: Amaa Egipt teŋgbauŋ na anɛ pipirig ka Edom na san'am digi, ban da zab nɛ Juda dim nɛ pitɔɔg ka kʋ nidib teŋin la zaalim-zaalim la zug.

english_verse: but Judah and Jerusalem will always have people.
translation_verse: Juda na lɛbi mɔr nidib saŋa wʋsa ka Jerusalem mɛ na mɔr nidib zʋmaana wʋsa ni.

english_verse: I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion. I will punish the guilty and defend the innocent.
translation_verse: Ba ninkʋʋr linɛ ka m nam pʋ kɛɛ ba taali bas la, m na kɛɛ li bas.”

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: Labakaŋa yinɛ Amos onɛ da gʋ'ʋn kɔnbid ka yi Tekoa tempʋʋg linɛ bɛ Juda sʋ'ʋlimin la ni na. Li pa'annɛ on da nyɛ si'el Israel yɛla la, li yʋma ayi' nya'aŋ ka teŋ nyaan dam la, saŋkan ka Uzia da an Juda na'ab ka Jeroboam onɛ saamme da an Jehoas ka o an Israel Na'ab la. Wina'am da nie yɛlbama Israel yɛla tis Amos.

english_verse: and I said: When the Lord roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown. Judgment on Syria
translation_verse: Ka Amos yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la nwa'am Zion zuorin, ka o kʋkɔr yi Jerusalem tempʋʋgin na. Yaama bɛ zin'isi'a ka kɔnbkemnib kemmi ba kɔnbid la kʋdignɛ, ka mɔɔd banɛ bɛ Kaamel Zuor zug la kanb. Wina'am na kad Israel kpi'es saria

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Damaskus teŋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li paae zin'is atan', hali li paae anaasi, m kʋ lɛn nyaŋi mɔdig nɛ m sʋnpɛɛn laa. Bɔzugɔ, ba da mɔr kʋnt kanɛ mɔr nyina m bʋ'ʋd Gilead nidib wʋʋ ban bʋ'ʋd ki si'em la.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka bugum di Na'ab Hazael yir nɛ Na'ab Ben-Hadad kpi'euŋ zin'is la, ka san'ami li wʋsa.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: M na nwa'ae Damaskus za'anɔya la; ka san'am nimbanɛ bɛ Aven Bɔn'ɔgin la nɛ onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ la zug la. Ka lɛn kʋ onɛ an na'ab Beteden teŋin la. Aram nidib la na lɔ'ɔŋ Kir teŋinɛ kpɛn' sankpan'asim.’ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Gaza teŋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li paae zin'is atan', hali li paae anaasi m kʋ lɛn nyaŋi mɔdig nɛ m sʋnpɛɛn laa. Bɔzugɔ ba gban'e tɛɛns la nidibi kuosi tis Edom teŋ dim.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka bugum kanb Gaza zaŋguoma la; li na kanbi dii ba kpi'euŋ zin'is la wʋsa san'am.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: M na san'am Asdod na'ab, nɛ onɛ mɔr na'am kpi'euŋʋ bɛ Askɛlon la. M mɛ na zab nɛ Ekron teŋ, hali ka Filistia dim la wʋsa ti kpii naae.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Taya dim tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li paae zin'is atan'; hali li paae anaasi ka m kʋ lɛn nyaŋi mɔdig nɛ m sʋnpɛɛn la. Bɔzugɔ, ba gban'e tɛɛns la nidibi kuosi tis Edom teŋ dim, ka ba ba'a kae nɛ nɔnaar linɛ kɛ ka ba an ba'abiis la.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka bugum kanb Taya teŋ zaŋguoma la; li na kanbi ba kpi'euŋ zin'is la wʋsa.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Edom dim tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li paae zin'is atan', hali li paae anaasi m kʋ lɛn nyaŋi mɔdig nɛ m sʋnpɛɛn la. Bɔzugɔ ba kadi ba ba'abiis Israel dim la nɛ zaba sʋ'ʋg, ka pʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanliga ba sʋnya pɛligi galis ka dit wʋʋ bugum pielim ka pʋ ma'ad la zug.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: M na tud bugum Teman teŋin ka li na kanb Bozira kpi'euŋ zin'is la.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Ammon dim tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li paae zin'is atan', hali li paae anaasi m kʋ lɛn nyaŋi mɔdig nɛ m sʋnpɛɛn laa. Bɔzugɔ ban da bɔɔd ye ba yaligi ba teŋ titɔndis la, ba da zab nɛ Gilead teŋ la ka lati ba pu'apʋʋs.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: M na nyu'oe Rabba teŋ zaŋguoma la bugum ka li na kanbi ba kpi'euŋ zin'is la; saŋkan la ba na nyɛ yɛltɔɔg tanp nwɛ'ɛb daar, ka zaba la daar la na nwɛnɛ sisi'etita'ari da'adnɛ.

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na'ab nɛ o na'ayikpɛm wʋsa na lɔ'ɔŋ teŋ zʋŋʋ kilim yammis.” Mam Zugsɔb la yɛl.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Moab dim tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li paae zin'is atan', hali li paae anaasi, m kʋ lɛn nyaŋi mɔdig nɛ m sʋnpɛɛn laa. Bɔzugɔ ba nyu'oe Edom na'ab kɔnba, ka li dii kilim tampɛligim ka ba mɔri gɛndigid bʋmbɔni taad.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: M na tud bugum Moab teŋin la ka li kanb teŋ la ka san'am linɛ wʋsa bɛ Keriof kpi'euŋ zin'isin la. Ba na san'am Moab dim zabtita'arin, saŋkanɛ ka ba ki'ed zaba kuŋ ka piebid na'atana la.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: M na san'am Moab na'ab la ka kʋʋ o na'ayikpɛm la wʋsa.” Zugsɔb la yɛl.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Juda dim tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zin'is atan', hali li paae anaasi ka m kʋ lɛn nyaŋi mɔdig nɛ m sʋnpɛɛn laa. Bɔzugɔ ba zan'as Zugsɔb la wada ka pʋ dɔl o zi'ela la. Li anɛ ziri wina nɛ bada banɛ ka ba yaanam da dɔl la mɔri ba kpɛn'ɛs mɔɔg la zug.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: M na tud bugum Juda teŋin na, ka li na kanb Jerusalem kpi'euŋ zin'is la.” Israel sariakadib yɛla

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Israel dim tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li paae zin'is atan', hali li paae anaasi ka m kʋ lɛn nyaŋi mɔdig nɛ m sʋnpɛɛn laa. Ba nɔkid pʋpielim dimi kuosidi di'esid anzurifa, ka kuosid nɔŋ dim la di'esid ta'ada.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Ba nɔɔd nɔŋ dim la zug wʋʋ titan linɛ bɛ teŋin nɛ ka mɔŋ banɛ ka ba namisid la bʋʋd. Dau nɛ o biig la'asi bɔ bipuŋ yinne ala ka ba san'amidi m yʋ'ʋr kanɛ an kasi la.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Ba mɔr fubanɛ ka ba di'esidi ba samdaannam san'an la bɔbigi digi ba maana bimbima la baba. Ba nuud daam kanɛ ka ba di'e ba samdaannam san'anɛ ba wina bɛ yisi'a la ni.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: M da san'am Ammon dim banɛ bɛɛ ba tuon la, la'an nɛ ban wa'am wʋʋ na'aziinr ka kpi'emi nwɛnɛ kʋk daad la. M san'ami ba wala linɛ bɛɛ agɔla la nɛ ba nya'a linɛ bɛ teŋin la.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Manɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt teŋin na, ka gaadi ya tuon mɔɔgin la yʋma pisnaasi ka faaɛn Amor dim la teŋi tisi ya.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: M gaansi ya biribis la sieba ka ba an nɔdi'esidib ka sieba an Naazirnam banɛ pʋ nuud daam. Nwa' ka' sidaa, Israel dima?” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: Amaa ya kɛ ka Naazirnam la nu daam ka muk nɔdi'esidib la ye ba da di'es Zugsɔb pian'ad ya'asɛ.

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: “M na muki ya ka ya kɔ' wʋʋ tɛreko na zi la'ad bɛdegʋ ka kɔ' si'em la.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ mi' zɔɔg hali la kʋ pɔnsɛ, ka ya paŋ dim la paŋ na naae, ka zabzabidib la kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ba mɛŋa.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Banɛ mi' tiraug tɔɔnb la kʋ tun'e zi'en kiŋ-kiŋ zabɛ, ka soogianam banɛ ken nɔba la kʋ pɔnsɛ, ka banɛ ban'ad widi zabid la kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ba nyɔvʋrɛ.

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Zabzabidib banɛ mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ hali la na zɔt biel daakan la.” Man Zugsɔb la yɛl.

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: Amos da lɛn yɛl ye, “Kɛlisimi labakanɛ ka Zugsɔb la pian' pɔ'ɔg, yanam Israel dim wʋsa banɛ ka o yis Egipt na la ye,

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: “Buudbanɛ bɛ dunia ni wʋsa sʋʋgin, yanam ma'aa ka m gaŋ. Dinzugɔ m na tɛɛgi ya tʋbiri ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa zug.”

english_verse: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
translation_verse: Nidib ayi' na nyaŋi la'asi ken, ka pʋ dɛŋi siak ye ba na dɔl taabaa?

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Gbigim na nwa'am o gbɛɛnsigin ka li ka' o nyɛnɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg ye o kʋʋ? O na nyuun o buugin ka pʋ gban'e si'elaa?

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Bɛndig na nyaŋi gban'e niiŋ teŋin zin'ikanɛ ka ba pʋ bɛndɛɛ? Ka baŋ na nyaŋi kpirig teŋin ka si'el pʋ nɔɔ lii?

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Tanp na'atan na pieb tempʋʋgin, ka dabiem kʋ kpɛn' nidib laa? San'auŋ na li tempʋʋgin na ka li ka' nɛ Zugsɔb la maalɛɛ?

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Sida Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pʋ maan si'el, ka pʋ dɛŋi nie on gban'e si'el la tis o nɔdi'esidiba.

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Tɔ'! Gbigim nwa'am ya ka anɔ'ɔnɛ kʋ zɔ dabiem? Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' ya anɔ'ɔnɛ kʋ mɔɔl o labaar la?

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Mɔɔlim tis banɛ bɛ Asdod dim kpi'euŋ zin'is nɛ Egipt teŋgbauŋ kpi'euŋ zin'isin la ye, “La'asimi taaba Samaria zuoya la nii gɔsi taawai kanɛ duoe anina dammid teŋ la nɛ mugusʋg kanɛ paae teŋ la nidib.”

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛl ye, “Nidib la zi' tʋʋm sʋŋɔ, ba nɔk la'abanɛ ka ba fan' nidib san'an nɛ paŋ la su'a ba mɛŋ kpi'euŋ zin'isin la.”

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Dataas na kena gilig teŋ la; ba na san'ami ya kpi'euŋ zin'is ka faaɛn dinɛ bɛɛ anina wʋsa.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', “Nwɛnɛ kɔnbkemi na faaɛn o kɔnbʋg gbɛya ayi' bɛɛ o tʋbir gbigim nɔɔrin si'em la, ala mɛn ka m na faaɛn Israel dim banɛ bɛ Samaria nɛ Damaskus n digi ba gadsʋma ka zin' ba kʋgis zug la.”

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: “Wʋmmi nɛ' ka di kasɛt Jakob buudi la yɛla.” Zugsɔb Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: “Daakanɛ ka m na tɛɛg Israel dim tʋbiri ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla la, m na san'am Betel teŋ malʋŋ bimbima la ka iila banɛ bɛ bimbima la zug la kɔɔ li teŋin wʋsa.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: M na nwa'ae dɔbanɛ ka ya gbɛɛnd waad saŋa nɛ dɔbanɛ ka ya gbɛɛnd walʋsʋg saŋa la; ya' banɛ ka ya nɔk wabʋg nyina maal ye li vɛnl la nɛ ya' banɛ an ya' bɛda la wʋsa na san'am.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
translation_verse: Amos da lɛn yɛl ye, Wʋmmi nwa', yanam pu'a banɛ bɛ Samaria Zuorin la, ya nwɛnɛ na'anya'as banɛ bɛ Basan sʋ'ʋlimin nɛ. Ya faand nɔŋ dim ka mugusid banɛ an fara dim ka yɛti ya sidib ye, “Tisimini ti daam ka ti nu!”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pɔya nɛ on an Kasi la ye, “Saŋa na kena, bi'esʋg kae, ka ba sid na lɔɔ ya nɛ nwiisi mɔri keŋ, yanam banɛ kpɛlim la ba na gban'e ya wʋʋ zimi nɛ.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ba na tɛɛgi ya yi tempʋʋg la yiŋi dɔl wɛn banɛ bɛ zaŋguoma la ni, ka basi ya ka ya dɔl suokanɛ kpa' Hamon la.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Come to Bethel and Gilgal. Sin all you want! Offer sacrifices the next morning and bring a tenth of your crops on the third day.
translation_verse: “Ɛɛn, ya'an kemi Betel teŋinɛ tʋmmini ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la; ka gaad Gilgal teŋinɛ maligim tʋm bɛ'ɛd ka li gaad ala. Mɔri ya maana bɛogʋn wʋsa kena, ka mɔri ya pʋʋr piiga yʋma atan' wʋsa kena.

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Mɔri bodobodo linɛ ka' danbin na nyu'oe maali bareka pʋ'ʋsim maan, ka mɔr linɛ an ya'amlɛog piini la na maal maan li ka' yanam Israel dimi nɔŋ si'eli laa?” Zugsɔb Wina'am la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: “M da kɛ ka ya kɔ'ɔŋ diib tempʋʋs la ni wʋsa ka diib mɛ kae teŋkpɛmis la nii, la'an nɛ wala ya pʋ lɛb man san'an naa.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: “Manɛ da lɛn gu'oe saa saŋkan ka bunib nan kpɛlim nwadis atan' la. M da kɛ ka saa ni teŋ yinne ni amaa ka pʋ ni teŋ yinne nii. Saa da ni pɔɔg yinne ni ka pʋ ni yinne nii ka li kʋdig.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ku'onuud da wʋm nidib ka ba gɛrid tempʋʋsini ieed ku'om amaa ka pʋ nyɛɛ nu ka li sia'ali baa, la'an nɛ wala ba pʋ lɛb man san'an naa.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Saŋa bɛdegʋ ka m da kɛ ka wauŋ kpɛn' ya lɔmbɔn'ɔd nɛ ya tiis pɔɔd la ka li zɛndig, ka kɛ ka wiim gban'e ba. Na'azɔmnam ɔnbi ya kekama nɛ ya olif tiis la, la'an nɛ wala, ya pʋ lɛbi m san'an naa.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Manɛ da kɛ ka ban'abɛ'ɛd lii ya sʋʋgin wʋʋ man da niŋ Egipt teŋin si'em la. M da kʋʋ ya na'akim zaba ni, nɛ ya widi banɛ ka ba faaɛn la. Manɛ da kɛ ka ya ninkpiilima nyuug kpɛn' ya nyɔnya ni, la'an nɛ wala ya pʋ lɛbi m san'an naa.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Manɛ da san'ami ya sieba wʋʋ man da san'am Sodom nɛ Gomora dim si'em la. Ya da nwɛnɛ daug kanɛ ka bugum dit ka ba yaae li bugumin la yis na, la'an nɛ wala ya pʋ lɛbi m san'an naa.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
translation_verse: “Dinzugɔ, mam na maali ya si'em nwa', yanam Israel dima. Man ye m niŋi ya anwa la zugɔ, ti'ebimi ka tʋ'ʋsi ya Wina'am la.”

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ maal zuoya la, onɛ mɛ maal sisi'em, o nie o pʋtɛn'ɛri pa'al ninsaal. On kanɛ kɛ ka nɛɛsim lieb lik, ka ken dunia zuoya zug la: o yʋ'ʋri buon Zugsɔb Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la.

english_verse: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
translation_verse: Amos da lɛn yɛl, ye, Kɛlisimi labakaŋa, Israel dima, nɛ'ɛŋa ka m fabinnɛ ya yɛla:

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: “Israel kanɛ nwɛnɛ pu'asadir la luya, ka kʋ lɛn duoe ya'asɛ. Ba da'ae o bas o mɛŋ teŋin ka sɔ' kae na duo oo.”

english_verse: The Lord God has warned, “From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Tempʋkanɛ yi nɛ soogianam tusir Israel teŋin keŋ zaba ni na mɔr nidib kɔbiga ma'aa lɛb na; ka tempʋkanɛ mɛ yi nɛ soogianam kɔbiga keŋ nidib piiga ma'aa na lɛb na.”

english_verse: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl Israel dim si'em nwa' ye, “Ieemi mam ka lin ka ya na vʋe.

english_verse: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
translation_verse: Da ieedi kennɛ Betel ye ya pʋ'ʋsi ba winaa, mɛ da kennɛ Gilgal bɛɛ Beerseba teŋinɛɛ. Bɔzugɔ, bi'esʋg kae ye ba na mɔr Gilgal dimi lɔ'ɔŋ teŋ zʋŋɔ, ka Betel mɛ na lieb zaalim.”

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: Ieemi Zugsɔb la, kemin o san'an na ka ya na vʋe, ka ya'a ka' ala o na piis Josef yaas sʋ'ʋlimin la wʋʋ bugum di nɛ, li na dii kanb ka sɔ' kʋ bɛ Betel teŋin na kpiisɛ.

english_verse: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
translation_verse: Ya nɔk sida ka li lieb tɔɔg, ka nwɛ' pʋpielim bas teŋin.

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: (Wina'am maal nwadbibis, Nɔnya'aŋ-nɛ-o-biis nɛ A-kidigim-bu'os nam wʋsa. On kanɛ tiakid lik ka kɛt ka bɛog nied, ka kɛt ka nintaŋ liebid yʋ'ʋŋ; on kanɛ buon na atɛuk ku'om la'asid ka kɛt ka li liebid saa niid teŋgbauŋ zug la: o yʋ'ʋri buon Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: O ian'asid wʋʋ saa nɛ san'am kpi'euŋ zin'ig la ka kɛ ka tempʋkanɛ ka ba mɛ' zaŋguoma gur la lieb dabɔɔg.)

english_verse: You people hate judges and honest witnesses;
translation_verse: Ya kis onɛ kad saria nɛ sida kɔɔtʋ ni ka nɛ'ɛsid onɛ pian'ad yɛlmɛŋir.

english_verse: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
translation_verse: Ya nɔɔd nɔŋ dim la ka mugusidi ba di'esidi ba zʋʋd. Dinzugɔ, la'an nɛ yanamɛ mɛɛ ya ya-bɛda nɛ kuga la, ya kʋ gbɛɛn li nii; la'an nɛ yanamɛ sɛ tiis pɔɔdin la, ya kʋ nuu li daam.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
translation_verse: M mi' ya pɔ'ɔgiri an si'em wʋsa nɛ ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi zu'oe si'em. Ya mugusid pʋpielim dim ka di'esid ligidi ka mɔŋ nɔŋ dim la sida kɔɔtʋ ni.

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, saŋkan la buudi, ya'am sɔb la anɛ baanlimm bɔzugɔ li anɛ bɛ'ɛd saŋa.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Ieemi linɛ an sʋm, da bɔɔd bɛ'ɛdɛ, ka ala ka ya na vʋe. Ka Zugsɔb Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na bɛ nɛ ya wʋʋ yanamɛ yɛl ye o sid bɛ nɛ ya si'em la.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Kisigimi bɛ'ɛd, ka nɔŋ linɛ an sʋm. Kɛl ka yɛlsida bɛ sariakadib zin'igin, ka daasi'erɛ Zugsɔb Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na zɔ Josef yaas banɛ kpɛlim la nimbaanlig.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ Zugsɔb la, Zugsɔb Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Nidib na bɛ suoraad la wʋsa ni kaasid ka na kaasid nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ nidibi bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa. Ba na buol kpaadib ye ba kena kum ka buol banɛ kum kʋya ni la ye ba kena kaas.

english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: Nidib na kaasid vain tiis pɔɔd la wʋsa ni bɔzugɔ m na gaadi ya sʋʋgin ka tɛɛgi ya tʋbir.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la. Zugsɔb Dabisir la

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Tɔɔg bɛ yanam banɛ bɔɔd ye Zugsɔb la dabisir kɛn tɔ'ɔtɔ na la zug! Bɔ ka ya ieed Zugsɔb dabisir la? Daakan la na anɛ lik; nɛɛsim kʋ bɛɛ.

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Li na nwɛnɛ sɔ' na nyɛ gbigim ka zɔɔ keŋ tʋ'ʋs wɛbaa, bɛɛ o kpɛn' nɛ o yinnɛ nɔk o nu'ugʋ tik dɔkpin ka waaf dum o.

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: Zugsɔb dabisir la pʋ ye li anɛ lik ma'aa, ka nɛɛsim kʋ bɛɛ? Li pʋ ye li anɛ lik biridi, ka nɛɛsim kae?

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛl, ye, “M pʋ bɔɔdi ya di'ema malima la baa bi'elaa. M ba'a mɛ kae nɛ yanamɛ la'asidi ya malima zin'igin la.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Isigimi nɛ tʋkpiidʋg linɛ ka ya maan ka ye yʋʋma la! M kʋ kɛlis yanamɛ nwɛ'ɛd kɔna si'em la.

english_verse: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Amaa kɛlli ka yɛlsida pʋbid wʋʋ kɔldaug ku'om nɛ, ka pʋpielim nwɛnɛ bulig kanɛ ka li ku'om pʋ kpiɛnda!

english_verse: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Israel dima, yʋma pisnaasi pʋʋgin linɛ ka ya da bɛ sian'arin la, ya da mɔr maana nɛ piini na tisi maa?

english_verse: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
translation_verse: Ya da ziidi ya teŋgban kanɛ ka ya buon ye, ‘Na'ab’ la, nɛ ya bada banɛ ka ya ziidi ken nɔba, nɛ win kanɛ an nwadbil linɛ ka ya mɛŋ maal la.

english_verse: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m na kɛ ka ba gban'e ya mɔri keŋ teŋ zʋŋ, ka ya lalig hali tʋʋg Damaskus tempʋʋgin.” Zugsɔb onɛ ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Wina'am Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl nwa'.

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: Amos da lɛn yɛl ye, Tɔɔg na paae yanam banɛ bɛ Zion tempʋʋgin ka tɛn'ɛs ye si'el wʋsa anɛ na'ana la, nɛ banɛ bɛ Samaria zuoya ni ka tɛn'ɛs ye si'el kʋ daami ba la. Yanam banɛ an tuongat-kpi'ema bɛ teŋ tita'arin nwa' la, li anɛ yanam san'an ka Israel dim kennɛ bɔɔd sʋŋir.

english_verse: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?
translation_verse: Kem gɔsi Kalnɛ teŋ la; ka naan ani keŋ gɔs Hamat teŋ la, ka yʋ'ʋn keŋ gɔs Gaf linɛ bɛ Filistia sʋ'ʋlimin la. Ba an sʋm gati ya tempʋʋs ayi' laa? Ba tɛɛns la yalimme gati ya tɛɛns laa?

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: Ya dig gadbanɛ ka ba maal nɛ wabʋg nyina nɛ kugsʋma banɛ yalim la zug. Ya gaansid pɛ'ɛs nɛ na'abanɛ mɔr kpaam la kɔtidi ɔnbidi ya ya'amin.

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: Ya yʋ'ʋm yʋʋm paala nwɛ'ɛd bʋnnwɛ'ɛda wʋʋ David n da niŋid si'em la.

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: Ya nuud daam nɛ nwama pɛ'ɛli-pɛ'ɛli ka sɔɔndi ya niŋgbina nɛ kpanyubisa, amaa ya ba'a kae nɛ Josef yaas san'auŋ la yɛlaa.

english_verse: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ yanam ka ba na mɔri lɔ'ɔŋ teŋ zʋŋ la yiiga; yanamɛ dit ka nuudi gbia'ad si'em la, li bɛn paae ya. Zugsɔb la kis Israel dim nyɛɛsim la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Wina'am la pɔ nɛ o mɛŋ yʋ'ʋr. Zugsɔb Wina'am Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ya ye, “M kisʋg anɛ Jakob yaas la tʋm si'el la. M nɛ'ɛsi ba kpi'euŋ zin'is la; m na nɔki ba tempʋʋg la nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin la wʋsa tisi ba dataas.”

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Dap piiga ya'a pʋn kpɛlim yir yinne ni, ba wʋsa na kpi.

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ka ba sizua ya'a kena ye o vaae banɛ kpi la mum ka bu'os ye, “Sɔ' kpɛlim yir la pʋʋginɛɛ?” Ba na yɛl ye, “Ayei, sɔ' lɛn kae!” Ka ba sizua la na lɛn yɛl ye, “Hei, sinni! Gu'usimi ka da kɛ ka ti pʋdig Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋrɛ.”

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la zi'el nɔɔr ye, o na nwa'ae yitita'ar la ka li lieb tandia'ana ka nwa' yibil la sɔɔm-sɔɔm.

english_verse: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.
translation_verse: Widi na zɔti yigin taaba tampiinsinɛɛ? Sɔ' na nwɛ' niigi vugusi atɛukʋnɛɛ? Amaa ya tiak sida ka li lieb yabid ka gɔs ka bʋʋd sɔb an onɛ ka' bʋʋdɛ.

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Ya maan sumalisim ye ya nyaŋ Lodebaa teŋ, ka yɛt ye, “Ti nyaŋ Karinam teŋ nɛ ti mɛŋ paŋ”

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: “M na kɛ ka teŋ si'a dim sʋnf duoe ka ba zabnɛ ya! Ba na mugusi ya hali lin yi Hamat teŋ za'anɔɔrin la ti paae Araba bɔn'ɔgin la.” Zugsɔb Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Amos da yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la nie si'eli pa'alimi nwa': o daa ti'ebidnɛ na'azɔmnam, saŋa kan ka Na'ab la ki'e o widi yamme naae ka li lɛm pin'ili busid na la.

english_verse: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
translation_verse: Ka na'azɔmnam la ɔnb si'el wʋsa naae la, ka m kaasi yɛl Zugsɔb la ye, ‘Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, kɛlli ti taali bas; Jakob yaas la na niŋ wala vʋ'ʋgɛ? Ba pɔɔdnɛ galis!’

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Ala ka Zugsɔb la tiak o pʋtɛn'ɛr ka yɛl ye, ‘Tɔ', nɛ'ɛŋa kʋ niŋɛ.’

english_verse: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la nie si'eli pa'alimi nwa': Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la ti'ebid ye o kad saria nɛ bugum; ka li na dii atɛuk nɛ li teŋir la wʋsa la'an nɛ teŋgbauŋ la.

english_verse: Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
translation_verse: Ka m kaasi yɛl Zugsɔb la ye, ‘Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba, m bɛlimnɛ, guomi li! Jakob yaas la na niŋ wala vʋ'ʋgɛ? Ba pɔɔdnɛ galis!’

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: Ala ka Zugsɔb la tiak o pʋtɛn'ɛr ka yɛl ye, ‘Nɛ'ɛŋa kʋ niŋɛ.’

english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: “On lɛm pa'alim si'eli nwa': makir nwiig daa bɛ Zugsɔb la nu'ugin ka o zi'e kpi'e zaŋguom kanɛ ka ba nɔk makir nwiigi maki li mɛ' la.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la bu'osim ye, ‘Amos, fʋ nyɛ bɔ?’ Ka m lɛbis ye, ‘Makir nwiig.’ Ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, ‘Gɔsima, m ye m maknɛ Israel dim banɛ aan m nidib la; m kʋ lɛm basi ba ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
translation_verse: “‘Ba na san'am Isaak yaasi pʋ'ʋsid zin'isieba la Ka Israel dimi maannɛ ba maana zin'isi'a la na lieb dabɔɔd; m na zaŋ zaba sʋ'ʋgʋ zab nɛ Jeroboam yidim la.’” Amos nɛ Amazaya

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
translation_verse: Amazaya onɛ an Betel teŋ maanmaan kpɛɛm la da tʋm yɛl Israel na'ab Jeroboam ye, “Amos gban'adi fʋ yɛla bɛ'ɛd Israel dim sʋʋgin. O pian'ad la na san'am teŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: Amos n yɛl si'em nwa': “‘Na'ab Jeroboam na kpi zaba ni, ka ba mɔr Israel dimi lɔ'ɔŋ teŋ zʋŋ, ba na lal nɛ ba mɛŋ teŋ.’”

english_verse: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
translation_verse: Amazaya da yɛl Amos ye, “Nɔdi'esaa, isigim lɛb Juda teŋin sa! Di'emi fʋ yɔɔd ani ka tʋmmi fʋ nɔdi'esʋg tʋʋma.

english_verse: Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
translation_verse: Da lɛn tʋm nɔdi'esʋg tʋʋma Betel teŋin ya'asɛ, bɔzugɔ li anɛ Na'ab la pʋ'ʋsim zin'ig ka mɛ an sʋ'ʋlim la wʋsa pʋ'ʋsim dɔɔg zin'ig.”

english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Amos da lɛbis o ye, “M da ka' nɔdi'es bɛɛ onɛ an nɔdi'es biiga. M pʋ tʋm ye m di'e yɔɔdɛ, amaa m da anɛ kɔnbkem ka mɛ sɛɛd kekama tiis.

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la daa yisi m kɔnbkem tʋʋma la pʋʋgin ka yɛlim ye, ‘Kem pian' nɔdi'esʋg pian'adi tisim nidib Israel dim la.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: “Dinzugɔ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': “Fʋ pu'a na lieb pu'agɔɔndiri giligid tempʋʋgin, ka ba na kʋʋ fʋ biribis nɛ fʋ bipumis zaba ni. Ba na maki fʋ paalʋ la pʋdigi tis nidib, ka mɔri fʋ mɛŋi lɔ'ɔŋ teŋ zʋŋ ka fʋ kpii anina. Bi'esʋg kae, ba na mɔr Israel dimi lɔ'ɔŋ teŋ zʋŋ, ka ba na lal nɛ ba mɛŋ teŋ.”

english_verse: and asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied. Then he said, “This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.
translation_verse: ka o bu'osim ye, “Amos, fʋ nyɛ bɔ?” Ka m lɛbis ye, “Pɛog nɛ walbi'ima.” Ani ka Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛlim ye, “Israel dim bɛog nieya; m kʋ lɛm basi ba ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Daakan la ya'a paae, yʋʋma linɛ ka ba yʋ'ʋm na'ayin la na lieb kaasig. Nidib na kpii widigi gilig zin'ig wʋsa digi dig! Li na fɔn baanlimm ka dammir kae!”

english_verse: You people crush those in need and wipe out the poor.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi nɛ', yanam banɛ nɔɔd fara dimi namisidi ba ka kʋʋd nɔŋ dim la,

english_verse: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
translation_verse: ya yɛt ye, “Nwadig na kpi bʋndaar ka ti kuosi ti zʋʋdɛ?” Bɛɛ “Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar paae li bɛn ka ti kuosi ti diibɔ?” Ya sied kuriba la makir, ka dʋ'ʋsid diib la ligidi, ka mɔri ya kuribabibis la filim banɛ da'ad la.

english_verse: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
translation_verse: Hali ya la'am kuosidnɛ kifaad, ka da' nɔŋ dim la nɛ anzurifa ligidi, ka da' nɔŋ dim banɛ an fara dim ka kʋ nyaŋi da' ta'ada la ka ba liebi ti yammis.

english_verse: I, the Lord, won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pɔ Jakob yaas karigimbaanɛ nɛ ba nyɛɛsim la yɛla ye, “M kʋ tam linɛ ka ba niŋid la baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: Your country will tremble, and you will mourn. It will be like the Nile River that rises and overflows, then sinks back down.
translation_verse: “Teŋ la mɛŋ kʋ dam nɛ'ɛŋa yɛlaa? Li na dam ka banɛ bɛ ani la wʋsa kaasid hali. Teŋ la mɛŋ na duosid wʋʋ Nail kɔldaug ku'om nɛ; li na gudigi dʋʋ agɔla ka lɛn lɛb teŋin wʋʋ Egipt kɔldaug nɛ.”

english_verse: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pɔya ye, “Daakan la ya'a paae, m na kɛ ka winnig kpɛn' nintaŋ tisʋʋs ka kɛ ka nintaŋ lieb lik dunia nwa' wʋsa.

english_verse: Your festivals and joyful singing will turn into sorrow. You will wear sackcloth and shave your heads, as you would at the death of your only son. It will be a horrible day.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ya winpʋ'ʋsʋm di'ema la lieb kaasig ka ya yʋʋma la lieb kukuma. M na kɛ ka ya pʋni ya zut ka yɛ bɔto fuud sʋnsa'aŋ zug. Li saŋa la, ya sʋnsa'aŋ na nwɛnɛ nid biyimmiri na kpi ka o kaasid ka li naar wʋsa, li na anɛ dabistɔɔgʋ tisi ya.

english_verse: I, the Lord, also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pɔya ye, ‘Daakan ya'a paae, m na kɛ ka kɔ'ɔm tita'ar li teŋin la. Li kʋ an diib kɔ'ɔm bɛɛ ku'onuudɛ, amaa li na anɛ Zugsɔb la labaar kɔ'ɔm.

english_verse: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
translation_verse: Nidib na ieed Zugsɔb la labaar; ba na naan atɛuk yinne nɔɔrin keŋ atɛuk yinne nɔɔrin, ba na yi ya-datiuŋʋ keŋ paae ya-nya'aŋ, amaa ba kʋ nyɛɛ li.’”

english_verse: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
translation_verse: Daakan la, na'akim kpi'ema nɛ pu'asadvɛnla na vib ku'onuud.

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: Banɛ pɔɔd Samaria dim win linɛ an kisʋg la, bɛɛ pɔɔd ye, “Ti pɔya nɛ Dan ba'ar la,” bɛɛ pɔɔd nɛ Beerseba teŋgban la, ba na lu ka kʋ lɛn duoe.
