english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: “M na piis si'el wʋsa yis teŋgbauŋ la zug,” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: “M na san'am ninsaalib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa, nɛ niis banɛ bɛɛ agɔl nɛ zimi banɛ bɛɛ atɛukʋn la. M ya'a ti san'am ninsaalib teŋgbauŋ nwa' zug, nimbɛ'ɛdnam la na dig wʋʋ tandia'ana nɛ.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. Juda tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛl ye, “M na namis Juda dim wʋsa nɛ banɛ bɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la wʋsa. M na san'am banɛ wʋsa kpɛlim bi'ela ka nan kpɛn dɔl Baal la; ka kɛ ka ba tam banɛ wʋsa maan maana tisid bada nɛ teŋgbana la.

english_verse: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord.
translation_verse: M na san'am nimbanɛ dʋt dɔɔd zugʋ pʋ'ʋsid nwadbibis la nɛ banɛ mɔr Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋri pɔɔd ka lɛm pɔɔd nɛ ba'ar kanɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Molek yʋ'ʋr la.

english_verse: Nothing will remain of anyone who has turned away and rejected me.
translation_verse: M na san'am banɛ daa dɔl mam ka pʋ lɛn dɔllim la, nɛ banɛ pʋ bɔɔd Zugsɔb yɛla bɛɛ ieed o sa'alʋg la.”

english_verse: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
translation_verse: Bɛi baanlimm Zugsɔb la tuon, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la dabisir la li'el ya. Zugsɔb maalnɛ malʋŋ ka pie banɛ ka o buol la ka ba bɛɛ ba kɔn'.

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Daakanɛ ka m na maali m malʋŋ la, daakan la m na namis tuongatib, nɛ Juda na'abiis, nɛ banɛ yɛɛd teŋ zʋŋ fuud la wʋsa.

english_verse: I will punish worshipers of pagan gods and cruel palace officials who abuse their power.
translation_verse: Daakan la m na namis banɛ ian'adi kpɛn'ɛd nɔŋ dim dɔɔdin ma'ad ziri ka faand la'adi pɛ'ɛnnɛ ba bada dɔɔd la.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ya ye, “Daakan la,” “kuŋ na nwɛ' Zimi Yaŋirin la, ka kaasig yi Yapaala la ni na, ka vuud na dammid zuoya la ni.

english_verse: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Kaasimi nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ, yanam banɛ yaa bɛ da' baba la, bɔzugɔ ba na kʋ kpikpinkpinnib la wʋsa, hali banɛ tɔlim anzurifanam la wʋsa mɛ na kpi'ilim.

english_verse: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
translation_verse: Saŋkan la, m na nɔk fita ie Jerusalem tempʋʋginɛ namis banɛ wʋsa tɛn'ɛsidi ba mɛŋ yɛla ma'aa la, banɛ nwɛnɛ kuan'ari gɛndig daam gan'arin ka li san'am la. Ba tɛn'ɛsidi ba sʋnfʋn sa ye Zugsɔb la pʋn kʋ tʋm linɛ an sʋm bɛɛ bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Anina ka m na kɛ ka faandib faaɛn ba areza'as la wʋsa, ka nwa'a ba ya' la sɔɔm-sɔɔm. Ba na mɛ' ya' ka kʋ nyaŋi kpɛn'ɛɛ, ka sɛ tiis ka kʋ dii li wala.” Zugsɔb dabistita'ar la yɛla

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb dabistita'ar la li'el ya, li bɛnɛ yammin-yammin. Kɛlisimi! Zugsɔb dabisir la saŋa, ba na kaasid nɛ sʋntɔɔg. Zabzabidib la tʋkpiidʋg ma'aa na dʋt anina na.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Dabiskan la na anɛ sʋnpɛɛn dabisir, sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ ɛndʋg na bɛɛ li daar. Yɛla nɛ san'auŋ na bɛ ka zibisʋg nɛ kpaandʋg bɛ zin'ig wʋsa, daakan la na anɛ saŋgbansabilig nɛ lik.

english_verse: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
translation_verse: M na namis nidib la, ka kɛ ka ba kennɛ babinnɛ ieed suor nwɛnɛ zʋnzɔɔs nɛ ban tʋm bɛ'ɛdi tis man Zugsɔb la zug. Ba ziim na kpa'ae suoraadin, ka ba niŋgbina pun'oe yadig teŋin la.

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Ba anzurifa bɛɛ ba sanlima kʋ tun'e faaɛn ba Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn daarɛ. Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn linɛ dit wʋʋ bugum la na di dunia la wʋsa. Bɔzugɔ o na kɛ ka bʋn linɛ wʋsa mɔr vʋm dunia kaŋa naae vuguri.”

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: ka dabisir la nyaan paae. Daakan la, ba na zii ya keŋ nwɛnɛ udug ka sisi'em ziidi li ken si'em la. Hali ka Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn dabisir la nyaan paae, ka o sʋnpɛɛn linɛ dit wʋʋ bugum la nyaan luu ya zug.

english_verse: If you humbly obey the Lord, then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger. Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Ieemi Zugsɔb la, yanam banɛ siedi ya mɛŋ ka siakid o nɔɔr la, Ieemi pʋpielim, tʋmmi linɛ dɔl suor ka sie ya mɛŋ Zugsɔb la tuon ka daasi'erɛɛ daakanɛ ka Zugsɔb Sʋnf na duoe la, ya na yi namisʋg la ni. Filistia dim tʋbtɛkir yɛla

english_verse: Gaza and Ashkelon will be deserted and left in ruins. Ashdod will be emptied in broad daylight, and Ekron uprooted.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kʋ ti kpɛlim Gaza teŋinɛ, ba wʋsa na bas teŋ la. Ba na ti san'am Askɛlon teŋ la ka li kpɛlim dabɔɔd. Ba na kad Asdod dimi yis nintaŋ tisʋʋs, ka mɛ vuoɛn Ekron teŋi bas.

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Yɛltɔɔg bɛ yanam Keret dim banɛ zin' Atɛuk baba la zug, Filistia dim teŋ kanɛ bɛ Keenan la, m na san'ami ya wʋsa, hali ka ya nid baa yinne kʋ kpɛlim.

english_verse: Your seacoast will be changed into pastureland and sheep pens.
translation_verse: Yanam tembanɛ bɛɛ atɛuk nɔɔrin la mɛ na lieb kɔnbkemnib sʋga nɛ pɛ'ɛs gbɛɛnb zin'ig.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Juda nimbanɛ kpɛn vʋe la na zin' anina. Ani ka ba na kemmi ba bʋnkɔnbid, zaamnɔɔr ka ba pɛ'ɛs la na digin Askɛlon dabɔɔdin. Bɔzugɔ ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la na gɔsidi ba, ka kɛ ka ba lɛn nyɛ zusʋŋ ya'as.” Moab nɛ Ammon dim tʋbtɛkir yɛla

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I've heard Moab and Ammon insult my people and threaten their nation.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛl ye, “Mam wʋm Moab nɛ Ammon dimi tʋ'ʋdi ya ka la'adi ya si'em. Ba vɔlisidi ya yɛt ye, ‘Ti na lɛn di'e ya paalʋ la.’”

english_verse: And so, I swear by my very life that Moab and Ammon will end up like Sodom and Gomorrah— covered with thornbushes and salt pits forever. Then my people who survive will take their land.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, Man Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la pɔya ye, “Asida sida mɛnɛ, Moab nɛ Ammon dim tɛɛns na san'am nwɛnɛ Sodom nɛ Gomora tɛɛnsi da san'am si'em la. Zin'iban na lieb yaarim bɔk, ka mɔbɛ'ɛd na yit anina saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ. Ka mam nimbanɛ kpɛn vʋe la na faaɛn ba ka di'e ba teŋ la wʋsa sʋ'oe.”

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ala ka Moab nɛ Ammon dim sid na nyɛ namisʋgʋ ba tita'alimin la, ban tʋ'ʋd ka la'ad Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb nidib la zug.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la sʋʋnr na duoe hali ka o kpɛn'ɛsi ba dabiem ka kɛ ba bada la lieb zaalim. Teŋgbauŋ la nidib wʋsa na pʋ'ʋs o ba mɛŋ tɛɛnsin, nɛ ban bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa. Kus nɛ Asiria dim tʋbtɛkir yɛla

english_verse: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mɛ na kɛ ka Kus dim la kpi tanpin.

english_verse: The Lord will reach to the north to crush Assyria and overthrow Nineveh.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na zaŋ o paŋ la san'am Asiria, ka kɛ ka Ninive teŋ la san'am ka teŋgbauŋ na kʋdig wʋʋ pipirig nɛ.

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: Niigi nɛ kɔnbid na digi anina vʋ'ʋsid, nɛ mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid buudi wʋsa. Ka viid buudi wʋsa na dʋʋ zi'e ba ya-wɛna la zug, ka ba kukuma kpɛn'ɛd takoronamin, ka tandia'ana digi ba za'anɔya ni, ka na'aziinr dasʋma banɛ ka ba zaŋi mɛɛ ba dɔɔd la na kpɛn dig paalʋ.

english_verse: This is the glorious city that felt secure and said, “I am the only one!” Now it's merely ruins, a home for wild animals. Every passerby simply sneers and makes vulgar signs.
translation_verse: Teŋkaŋa da bɛ nɛ m ba'a kae bɛllim ka si'el-si'el pʋ pak oo. O da yɛl o mɛŋ ye, “Mam ma'aa bɛ ka sɔ' kae nwɛnɛ ma” Teŋkan yʋ'ʋn liebnɛ dabɔɔd ka an bʋnkɔnbid gbɛɛnb zin'ig. Banɛ gat ani wʋsa la'adnɛ ka lɔbidi ba zut teŋ la san'am si'em la zug.

english_verse: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
translation_verse: Ba tuongatib nwa'amnɛ nwɛnɛ gbigima nɛ, ka ba sariakatib la an zaamnɔɔr zanku'a. Ba ɛɛnti kʋnɛ ɔnb wʋsa ka si'el pʋ nied bɛogɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
translation_verse: Ba nɔdi'esidib la anɛ tita'alnam, ka ba pʋʋg pʋ paad baa bi'elaa. Ba maanmaannib miligid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir, ka tiakid o wada la.

english_verse: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala Zugsɔb onɛ bɛ nɛ ba la anɛ Pʋpielim sɔb ka kʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ. Bɛog ya'a nie wʋsa o kati saria nɛ sida dabisir kae ka o gʋ'ʋŋid tʋʋm sʋma maalʋgɔ, la'an nɛ wala banɛ tʋm tʋʋmfɛn'ɛsa la zi' nyannɛ.

english_verse: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “M san'am tɛɛnsi bas; ka nwa'ae ba zin'ikpi'ema la wʋsa. M kɛya ka ba pala kpɛlim nɛɛm, ka nid baa yinne pʋ dɔlli li zugʋ gata. Ba tembɛda la san'am ya; hali baa nid yinne kʋ kpɛlim.

english_verse: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
translation_verse: M yɛli tis teŋ la ye, ‘M mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye ya na zɔɔm ka siaki m sa'alʋg! Ala ka ya bɛllim zin'ig kʋ san'am, ka m kʋ nwa'ae li bas bɛɛ kɛ ka namisʋg luu ya zugin naa.’ Amaa ba nini daa nan kpɛm mu'oenɛ nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd tʋʋma.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Just wait for the day when I accuse you nations. I have decided on a day, when I will bring together every nation and kingdom and punish them all in my fiery anger. I will become furious and destroy the earth.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Gu'usimi ka daar kenna, ka m na duoe zi'eni tu'a ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla. M gban'e ye m la'as tɛɛns wʋsa nɛ na'am sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa nidib, ka kpa'ae m sʋnpɛɛn kanɛ galis la yɛɛli ba. Man sʋʋnr kanɛ zabid hali la na kɛ ka Dunia wʋsa di bugum.

english_verse: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Ani ka m na pie m nidib nɔŋgbana ka li an nyain, ka ba na buol mam Zugsɔb yʋ'ʋr ka dʋ'ʋsi m yʋ'ʋr nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne.

english_verse: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
translation_verse: M nimbanɛ widigi bɛ Kus teŋ kɔldaad la nya'aŋ ka wɔ'ɔgidim la na mɔr piini na tisim.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Daakan la ba kʋ diisi ya nyan bɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka ya maali tisim la zugɔ. Bɔzugɔ m na yis nimbanɛ mɔr nyɛɛsim ka maan sumalisim li zug la teŋ nwa' pʋʋgini bas. Ya kʋ ti lɛn mɔr tita'alim man zuokanɛ ka m kɛ ka li bɛɛ li kɔn' tisim la zugɔ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: Amaa m na kɛ ka banɛ siedi ba mɛŋ nɛ banɛ gban'adi ba mɛŋ sʋ'ʋŋa, nɛ banɛ niŋid Zugsɔb yʋ'ʋr yadda la kpɛm bɛ teŋin la.

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
translation_verse: Israel dim banɛ kpɛlim la kʋ lɛn tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ; ba kʋ lɛm ma'ad dama'am, bɛɛ kɛ ka ziri pian'abɛ'ɛd yiti ba nɔɔrin naa. Ba na dit ka digi vʋ'ʋsid ka dabiem kae.” Sumalisim yʋʋma

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem and Judah, celebrate and shout with all your heart!
translation_verse: Zion pu'asada, yʋ'ʋmmi ka mɔr sumalisim; Israel dima, dʋ'ʋsimi ya kʋkɔya agɔla! Jerusalem pu'aba, kɛlli ka ya sʋnya ma'ae ka ya maal sumalisim!

english_verse: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yisi ya namisʋg la ka lɛbisi ya dataas la nya'aŋ. Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Na'ab la bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin! Ya kʋ lɛn zɔt dabiem ye yɛlbɛ'ɛsi'a na ti paae yaa.

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
translation_verse: Daakan la, ba na yɛl Jerusalem ye, “Zion teŋ dima, da zɔti dabiem, da kɛ ka ya nu'us gɛɛn.

english_verse: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am la bɛ nɛ ya, o anɛ gandaug kanɛ na faaɛn ya. O sʋnf na ma'ae ya zug hali. O na bɛ nɛ ya baanlimm nɛ o nɔŋilim o na maal sumalisim ya zug ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised: Your sorrow has ended, and you can celebrate.
translation_verse: Ye Yanam banɛ mɔr sʋnsa'aŋʋ ya malʋŋ tiɛnr yɛla la m na yisi li ya san'an, bɔzugɔ li anɛ ziid nɛ nyannɛ tisi ya.

english_verse: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la m na namis banɛ namsidi ya la; m na faaɛn banɛ an waba la ka la'asi ya nimbanɛ widig la na. M na nie ba zut zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka ba da di nyan, m na kɛ ka ba paam girima nɛ na'asi.

english_verse: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Saŋkan la m na la'asi ya, ka mɔri ya kul na. M na kɛ ka ya paam girima nɛ na'asi dunia nwa' nidib wʋsa sʋʋgin. Ya nini ni ka m na kɛ ka ya lɛm paam zusʋŋ ya'as!

english_verse: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua
translation_verse: Na'ab Darius na'am la yʋma ayi' saŋa, li nwadis ayuobʋ la dabisir yinne daar, ka Zugsɔb da pian' tis o nɔdi'es Hagai ka yɛl o ye o mɔɔlim tis Juda gɔmena Zerubabɛl, onɛ saamme an Sealtiel nɛ maanmaan kpɛɛm Josua, onɛ saamme an Jehozadak la

english_verse: You harvest less than you plant, you never have enough to eat or drink, your clothes don't keep you warm, and your wages are stored in bags full of holes.
translation_verse: Ya kuod bɛdegʋ ka lɛɛ bʋn fiin; ya dit ka pʋ tigida, ya nuud ka ku'onuud nam kpɛm mɔri ya; ya yɛɛd fuud ka waad kpɛm kpɛn'ɛdi ya; ya tʋmnɛ vaad yɔɔd ka li nwɛnɛ ya ligidi buoris la mɔri vɔnya ka li litnɛ.”

english_verse: Think about what I have said!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Maligin tɛn'ɛsi sʋ'ʋŋa!

english_verse: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
translation_verse: Kemi zuoya la zuti nwa' daad na mɛɛ m Yir la ka li paae m ya'am ka m yʋ'ʋr paam girima.

english_verse: You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins.
translation_verse: Ya tɛn'ɛsid ye ya na paam bɛdegʋ, amaa gɔsima li anɛ fiin; yanamɛ mɔr si'eli kul na la, m kɛya ka sisi'em widigi li. Bɔzug ka li aan ala? M Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la an dabɔɔg ka yanam lɛɛ bɛɛ anina mɛɛdi ya mɛŋ ya' nɛ nimmua la zug.” Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
translation_verse: “Yanam zug ka saa pʋ lɛn niida ka zʋʋd mɛ pʋ lɛm maana.

english_verse: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
translation_verse: Manɛ kɛ ka sawak bɛɛ ya pɔɔdin nɛ zuoya zut nɛ ya zʋʋd nɛ ya vain tiis nɛ ya kpaam tiis pɔɔdin wʋsa. Ka linɛ wʋsa ka ya kua la kʋ maalɛ, hali nɛ ya ninsaalib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid nɛ ya nu'ug tʋʋma wʋsa na an zaalim.” Nidib la siak Wina'am nɔɔr la yɛla

english_verse: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Zerubabɛl onɛ an Sealtiel biig, nɛ Josua onɛ an Jehozadak biig ka an maanmaan kpɛɛm la, nɛ nidib la wʋsa da siaki ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la nɛ Wina'am nɔdi'es Hagai nɔɔr, bɔzugɔ ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la tʋm o ba san'an na; ka nidib la wʋsa mɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.
translation_verse: Hagai onɛ an Zugsɔb tʋmtʋm la da mɔɔl Zugsɔb la labaari tis nidib la ye, “M na bɛ nɛ ya.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: And the work began on the twenty-fourth day of that same month.
translation_verse: Li da anɛ Na'ab Darius n da di na'am la yʋma ayi' la ni li nwadis ayuobʋ la dabpisi nɛ anaasi daar.

english_verse: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:
translation_verse: “Tu'asim tis Zerubabɛl onɛ an Sealtiel biig ka an Juda gɔmena la, nɛ Josua onɛ an Jehozadak biig ka an maanmaan kpɛɛm la, nɛ nidib la wʋsa. Bu'osimi ba ye,

english_verse: Does anyone remember how glorious this temple used to be? Now it looks like nothing.
translation_verse: ‘Anɔ'ɔnɛ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin kpɛla ka da nyɛɛm yikʋdʋg la vɛnlim an si'em? Ka nannanna yir la vɛnlim an wala? Li pʋ nwɛnɛ zaalim bɛɛ?’

english_verse: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.
translation_verse: ‘Da zɔti dabiem, nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ nɔnaar kanɛ ka m da zi'eli tisi ya, yanamɛ da yi Egipt teŋin na la, ye m siig la na kpɛm bɛ nɛ ya.’

english_verse: I will shake the nations, and their treasures will be brought here. Then the brightness of my glory will fill this temple.
translation_verse: M na mi'im tɛɛns wʋsa nidib, ka kɛ ka ba mɔr la'asʋma linɛ kpɛn' ba ya'am la wʋsa kena tis yikaŋa ni, ka pɛ'ɛli li nɛ m girima.’ Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ ala.

english_verse: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
translation_verse: ‘Yipaal kaŋa na mɔr girima gaad yikʋdʋg la,’ man Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, ‘M na kɛ ka sumalisim nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛ teŋin la.’ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.” Hagai nwɛ' maanmaannib sɔɔra

english_verse: to ask the priests for their opinion on the following matters:
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, ‘Bu'osim maanmaannib la ye wada la pʋʋgin yɛl ye bɔ?

english_verse: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a nɔk malʋŋ ni'im linɛ ka ba maali tis Zugsɔb ka li an kasi la pɔnbil o fuugin ka li si'is bodobodo, bɛɛ zɛɛnd, bɛɛ daam, bɛɛ kpaam, bɛɛ disi'a wʋsa, malʋŋ ni'im la na kɛ ka diib la lieb kasii?’” Ka maanmaannib la lɛbis o ye, “Ayei!”

english_verse: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Ka Hagai lɛm bu'os ye, “Ka nid ya'a si'is bʋnkpiilʋŋ ka li kɛ ka o lieb dian'ad sɔb, ka kena si'is la'abama, li pa'al ye la'ad la mɛ dian'anɛɛ?” Ka maanmaannib la lɛbis ye, “Ɛɛn, li lieb nɛ dian'ad.”

english_verse: So the Lord told Haggai to say: That's how it is with this entire nation. Everything you do and every sacrifice you offer is unacceptable to me.
translation_verse: Anina ka Hagai lɛbis ye, “Ala ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Li anɛ ala tis nimbama, nɛ teŋgbauŋ la nɛ ban maal si'el wʋsa. Dinzugɔ, linɛ wʋsa ka ba tʋm bɛɛ maal anina anɛ dian'ad.

english_verse: But from now on, things will get better. Before you started laying the foundation for the temple,
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsimi nɛ'ɛŋa yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa lin yi zinaa ken, lin daa an si'em tisi ya ka ya nyaan pin'ili ɛɛnb Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la.

english_verse: That same day the Lord spoke to Haggai again and said:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛl Hagai nwadig la dabpisi nɛ anaasi daar ya'as, ye,

english_verse: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord.
translation_verse: M kɛya ka sakuga nɛ ban'as san'ami ya zʋʋd linɛ ka ya kua la wʋsa; amaa la'an nɛ ala, ya pʋ tiaki ya sʋnya ka lɛb man san'an naa.’ Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Today you have completed the foundation for my temple, so listen to what your future will be like.
translation_verse: ‘Amaa lin yi zina, nwadis awai nwa' dabpisi nɛ anaasi daare mɔri ken la, tɛn'ɛsimi sʋ'ʋŋa; daakanɛ ka Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la daa ɛɛnb la.

english_verse: Although you have not yet harvested any grain, grapes, figs, pomegranates, or olives, I will richly bless you in the days ahead. God's Promise to Zerubbabel
translation_verse: Diib lɛm bɛ bʋʋrinɛɛ? Lin yi saŋkan la keŋ paae zina, ya vain nɛ kekama tiis la pʋ wanna, pomanganɛt nɛ olif tiis la pʋ lɛn wanna. Lin yi zina wa'ae la m na niŋi ya wʋsa bareka.’” Zugsɔb la zi'el nɔɔri tis Zerubabɛl si'em

english_verse: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth
translation_verse: “Yɛlim Zerubabɛl onɛ an Juda dim gɔmena la ye, ‘M na mi'im agɔl nɛ teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: and wipe out kings and their kingdoms. I will overturn war chariots, and then cavalry troops will start slaughtering each other.
translation_verse: M na widig na'anam nɛ ba sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa paŋ. M na san'am teŋ zʋŋ dim na'am paŋ, nɛ ba tanp widi nɛ tɛrekonam. Ba na zabi kʋ taaba.’

english_verse: I am the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo. In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Darius na'am la yʋma ayi' saŋa, li nwadis anii la ni ka Zugsɔb la da pian' tis o nɔdi'es Zakaria onɛ an Berekaya biig ka an Iddo yaaŋ la ye,

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord All-Powerful, was very angry with your ancestors. But if you people will return to me, I will turn and help you.
translation_verse: Dinzug yɛlim nidib la ye Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Lɛmmini m san'an na, ka mam mɛ na lɛbi ya san'an na.’ Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. They were warned by the earlier prophets to give up their evil and turn back to me, but they paid no attention.
translation_verse: Da aaɛn wʋʋ ya yaanam banɛ da ki'is kʋdimin nɔdi'esidib pian'ad, ban da yɛli ba ye, Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Basimini ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd suoya nɛ ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd tʋʋma la.’ Amaa ka ba pʋ kɛlis bɛɛ di'e man yɛli ba si'el la. Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Where are your ancestors now? Not even prophets live forever.
translation_verse: Ya yaanam la bɛ yaanɛ nannanna? Ka ya tɛn'ɛs ye ya nɔdi'esidib la na vʋe saŋa wʋsaa?

english_verse: But my warnings and my words spoken by the prophets caught up with your ancestors. So they turned back to me and said, “Lord All-Powerful, you have punished us for our sins, just as you had planned.” First Vision: Horses and Riders
translation_verse: Amaa m pian'ad la nɛ m zi'ela banɛ ka m da tisim nɔdi'esidib banɛ aan m tʋmtʋmnib la pʋ dii ya yaanam laa?” Li saŋa ka ba yʋ'ʋn da tiak ka yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la maali ti nɛ wʋʋ ti tʋʋma nɛ ti suoya la nar si'em, nwɛnɛ on gban'e ye o tʋm si'em la.” Dau kanɛ bɛ tutuud gbinnin la yɛla

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of Shebat, which was the eleventh month of that same year, the Lord spoke to me in a vision during the night: In a valley among myrtle trees, I saw someone on a red horse, with riders on red, brown, and white horses behind him.
translation_verse: Li daa anɛ yʋ'ʋŋ ka si'el nie pa'alim, ka m nyɛ ka dau ban'ad wiedzɛn'ug. O daa zi'enɛ tutuud teŋsʋk bɔn'ɔfaligin. Ka wiedzin'a nɛ wiedpugusʋg nɛ wiedpielig zi'e o nya'aŋ.

english_verse: An angel was there to explain things to me, and I asked, “Sir, who are these riders?” “I'll tell you,” the angel answered.
translation_verse: Ka m bu'os ye, “M zugdaana, nɛ'ɛnam an bɔnama?” Ka maliak kanɛ sɔnsid nɛ m la lɛbis ye, “M na pa'alif ban an si'el.”

english_verse: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, “These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.”
translation_verse: Ka dau kanɛ zi'e tutuud teŋsʋk la yʋ'ʋn pin'ili pa'annɛ li gbin ye, “Zugsɔb la tʋm si'em ba ye ba giligi kaae gɔs dunia wʋsa la, la.”

english_verse: Then the riders spoke to the Lord's angel, who was standing among the myrtle trees, and they said, “We have gone everywhere and have discovered that the whole world is at peace.”
translation_verse: Ba da lɛb na yɛl Zugsɔb maliak onɛ zi'e tutuud teŋsʋk la ye, “Tinam gilig dunia la wʋsa, ka nyɛ ka dunia la dig baanlimm ka sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛ.”

english_verse: So the angel told me to announce: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am very protective of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ka Maliak kanɛ pian'adi tisidim la yɛl ye m mɔɔlim labakaŋa ye, “Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Mam nɔŋ Jerusalem nɛ Zion yɛla hali,

english_verse: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.
translation_verse: amaa ka m sʋnf lɛɛ duoe nɛ tembanɛ tɛn'ɛs ye si'el kʋ nyaŋi maali ba la. Man sʋnf daa duonɛ bi'ela, amaa ba lɛn kɛ ka m nidib la namisʋg zu'oe galis.’”

english_verse: I also promise that my towns will prosper—Jerusalem will once again be my chosen city, and I will comfort the people of Zion. Second Vision: Animal Horns
translation_verse: Mɔɔlim keŋ tuon ka yɛli ba ye, “Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, Man tempʋʋs la na lɛm pɛ'ɛl nɛ arezak ya'as, ka mam Zugsɔb la na lɛn di'e Jerusalem ka li aan m mɛŋ din.” Iila anaasi nɛ dapa anaasi banɛ kʋnt la yɛla

english_verse: The angel who was sent to explain was there, and so I asked, “What do these mean?” His answer was, “These horns are the nations that scattered the people of Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem, and took away their freedom.” Then the Lord showed me four blacksmiths, and I asked, “What are they going to do?” He replied, “They are going to terrify and crush those horns.”
translation_verse: Ka m bu'os ye, “Bama kenna ye ba maal bɔ?” Ka o lɛbis ye, Iil bama da widig Juda ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi ziank o zug la, amaa banɛ mi' tʋʋma kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb la kenna ye ba kpɛn'ɛsi ba dabiem ka nyaŋi ba, ka san'am sʋ'ʋlim banɛ da zab nɛ Juda n widig o nidib la iila.

english_verse: and I asked, “Where are you going?” “To measure Jerusalem,” was the answer. “To find out how wide and long it is.”
translation_verse: Ka m bu'os ye, “Fʋ wa'ae ya?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “M kennɛ ye m mak Jerusalem gɔsi li yalʋŋ nɛ li wa'alim zem si'em.”

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me came toward me, when another angel came up to him
translation_verse: Ka maliak kanɛ pian'adi tisidim la gaad ka maliak yinne kenna ye o tʋ'ʋs o

english_verse: and said, “Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.
translation_verse: ka yɛl o ye, “Zɔm keŋ yɛl dasaŋ kanɛ zanl makir nwiig la ye, ‘Jerusalem anɛ tempʋkanɛ kʋ mɔr zaŋguomaa, bɔzugɔ nidib nɛ bʋnkɔnbid bɛdegʋ na bɛɛ anina.

english_verse: The Lord himself has promised to be a protective wall of fire surrounding Jerusalem, and he will be its shining glory in the heart of the city.” A Call to Action
translation_verse: Mam mɛŋi ye m an bugum zaŋguommi giligi li, ka na bɛɛ li pʋʋgin nɛ m girima la wʋsa.’” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: The Lord says to his people, “Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.
translation_verse: “Kemi na! Kemi na! Zɔm yii teŋ kanɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ la, bɔzugɔ manɛ da widigi ya gilig dunia lʋga anaasi la wʋsa.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Leave Babylonia and hurry back to Zion.”
translation_verse: “Zion dima kemi na! Yanam banɛ bɛ Babilon teŋin nɛ, zɔm yii na!”

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa', “Onɛ da na'as mam, ka tʋmim ye m keŋ pian' zɛrig sʋ'ʋlim banɛ da gban'e ya la, o yɛl ye, ‘Onɛ wʋsa si'isi ya si'isnɛ man nif bielif.

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: M sid na zab nɛ ba ka ba yammis na nyaŋi ba ka faaɛn ba la'ad.’” Ka ya baŋ ye Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la tʋm mam na.

english_verse: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.
translation_verse: “Zion nidiba, tansimi nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar, ka maal sumalisim bɔzugɔ, m kenna; m bɛɛ ya san'an.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: When he does, many nations will turn to him and become his people. At that time you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Daakan la sʋ'ʋlim bɛdegʋ na kɛn Zugsɔb la san'an na ka lieb o nidib. M na bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin ka ya baŋ ye Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la sid tʋm mam ya san'an na.

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na sʋ'ʋg Juda ka li aan o faar, teŋ kanɛ an kasi la ni, ka lɛn nɔk Jerusalem ka li an teŋ kanɛ ka o gaŋ ka nɔŋ hali.

english_verse: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.
translation_verse: “An baanlimm Zugsɔb la tuon, bɔzugɔ o naan zin'ikanɛ ka o bɛ ka li an kasi la yit na.”

english_verse: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.
translation_verse: Ani ka o pa'alim Josua onɛ an maanmaan kpɛɛm la ka o zi'e Zugsɔb maliak la tuon, ka Sʋntaana onɛ an teŋgbi'id la zi'e o datiuŋ ye o ma'aa ziri tabil o.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Satan, you are wrong. Jerusalem is my chosen city, and this man was rescued like a stick from a flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl Sʋntaana ye, “Sʋntaana! Man Zugsɔb la zɛrigif. Man onɛ gaŋ Jerusalem la zɛrigif! Dau kaŋa nwɛnɛ dakanɛ bɛ bugumini dit ka ba yaae li yis na.”

english_verse: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, “This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.”
translation_verse: Maliak la da yɛl banɛ zi'e anina la ye, “Yɛɛgiminɛ o fumilisa la.” Ka mɛ yɛl Josua ye, “Gɔsima, man yisi fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa, ka na nɔk fusʋma yɛɛlif.”

english_verse: I spoke up and said, “Also put a clean priestly turban on his head.” Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord's angel stood there watching.
translation_verse: Ka m yɛl ye, “Nɔkimi bantabig linɛ an nyain vilig o zug.” Ka ba sid nɔk bantabig linɛ an nyain lɔɔ o zug ka yɛɛl o fuug, saŋkan ka Zugsɔb maliak la nan zi'e anina.

english_verse: After this, the angel encouraged Joshua by telling him that the Lord All-Powerful had promised:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb maliak la da tis Josua nɔkaŋa ye,

english_verse: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, ‘Fʋ ya'a na dɔlli m wada la ka tʋm man bɔɔd si'el la, fʋ na sʋ'ʋgi m Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la nɛ li za'as la wʋsa, ka m na tisif zin'ig, nimbanɛ bɛ kpɛla la sʋʋgin.’”

english_verse: Listen carefully, High Priest Joshua and all of you other priests. You are a sign of things to come, because I am going to bring my servant, the Chosen King.
translation_verse: “Kɛlisim sʋ'ʋŋa, fʋn Josua onɛ an maanmaan kpɛɛm nɛ banɛ sʋŋidif ka zin' fʋ tuon la, ya anɛ zanbin linɛ pa'an bʋmbanɛ na ti kena la. M ye m mɔri m sankpan'as onɛ an ‘Wil la’ kena.

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi kugir kanɛ ka m digil Josua tuon! Kugir la mɔri nini ayɔpɔi, mam na sɔb zanbin si'a pa'ali li zug.” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. M na nɔk daar yinne yis teŋgbauŋ kaŋa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa.

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: “Daakan la sɔ' wʋsa na buol o kpi'a ka o kena zin'in o saman tiig nɛ o kekaŋ gbinnin.” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.
translation_verse: Ka maliak kanɛ pian'ad nɛ mam la lɛb na niem wʋʋ nidi na gbisid ka ba nie o gbɛɛmin si'em la.

english_verse: Then he asked, “What do you see?” “A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it,” I answered. “On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.
translation_verse: Ka bu'osim ye, “Fʋ nyɛ bɔ?” Ka m lɛbis ye, “M nyɛ sanlima fitir zi'esir ka laa sʋn'e li zug, ka fita ayɔpɔi zi'e li zug, ka yinne wʋsa mɔr laŋʋnama ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.
translation_verse: M mɛ lɛn nyɛ olif tiis ayi' ka li zi'e kpi'e li, ka yinne bɛ laa la datiuŋ ka yinne bɛ li dagɔbʋg.”

english_verse: Then he asked, “Don't you know?” “No sir,” I replied.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “Fʋn zi' nɛ'ɛnamɛ an si'elaa?” Ka m lɛbis ye, “Ɛɛn, m zugdaana, mam zi'.”

english_verse: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa pa'annɛ Zugsɔb labaar linɛ ka o yɛt Zerubabɛl ye, ‘Li ka' fʋ kpi'euŋ bɛɛ fʋ paŋa, amaa li anɛ m Siig la paŋ.’” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl.

english_verse: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, “God has been very kind.”
translation_verse: “Zuotita'arɛ, fʋ aan anɔ'ɔnɛ? Fʋ na birigi lɛbi dig sassi Zerubabɛl tuon. O na mɛ' Yir la kuoe ka nidib tansid nɛ kʋkɔtitada yɛt ye, Wina'am na niŋi li bareka! Wina'am na niŋi li bareka!”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb labaar kɛɛn m san'an na ye,

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Zerubabɛl nu'usi ɛɛnb Pʋ'ʋsim Yikaŋa; o nu'usi na lɛn kuoe li. Ala ka fʋ na baŋ ye Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la tʋm mam ya san'an na.

english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: “Mid ka ya nɛ'ɛsi tʋʋm kanɛ pin'il bi'ela! Nidib na maal sumalisim ba ya'a ti nyɛ ka Zerubabɛl zanl tanmɛɛdib makir nwiig la o nu'ugin. “”

english_verse: Then I asked the angel, “What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?
translation_verse: Ka m bu'os maliak la ye, “Olif tiis ayi' banɛ zi'e fita zi'esir datiuŋ nɛ dagɔbʋg la tʋʋm an bɔ?”

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: Ka m lɛm bu'os o ye, “Olif tiis wila ayi' banɛ mɔr vɔnya, ka kpaam dɔlisidi ken la gbin an bɔ?”

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “Fʋ zi' bama an si'elaa?” Ka m lɛbis ye, “Ɛɛn, m zugdaana, man zi'.”

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, Li pa'annɛ nidib ayi' banɛ ka ba gaŋ ka bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋi ba zutin ye ba tʋm tis Zugsɔb onɛ sʋ'oe dunia wʋsa la.

english_verse: When I looked the next time, I saw a flying scroll,
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn gɔsi nyɛ ka gbauŋ kpilim ian'ad agɔla.

english_verse: and the angel asked, “What do you see?” “A flying scroll,” I answered. “About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.”
translation_verse: Ka maliak la bu'osim ye, “Fʋ nyɛ bɔ?” Ka m lɛbis ye, “M nyɛnɛ gbauŋ ka li kpilim bɛɛ agɔlli ian'ad, ka li labisim nɛ li wa'alim pʋ pɔɔda.”

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Nɔpɔɔr linɛ sɔb gbauŋ kaŋa ni la na tiig teŋ la wʋsa. Gbauŋ la zin'ig yinne yɛtnɛ ye banɛ zuud la wʋsa, ba na yisi ba teŋ la zug; ka li zin'ig yinne yɛl ye banɛ pɔɔd ziri pɔɔr la, ba na yisi ba teŋ la zug.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “M na kɛ ka nɔpɔkaŋa kpɛn' na'ayiig wʋsa yin, la'an nɛ onɛ mɔri m yʋ'ʋr la pɔɔd yɔri-yɔri la yin. Ka m nɔpɔɔr la na kpɛlim anina hali nɛ lin na ti san'am si'el wʋsa, la'an nɛ daad nɛ kuga.” Pu'a kanɛ bɛ pɛogʋn la yɛla

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Ka Maliak kanɛ pian'ad nɛ m la yi tuon na, ka yɛlim ye, “Gɔsim agɔla ka fʋ na nyɛ ka si'el nied saŋgbauŋin la.”

english_verse: “I don't know what it is,” was my reply. “It's a big basket,” he said. “And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.”
translation_verse: Ka m bu'os ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa an bɔ?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Li anɛ pɛog kanɛ ka ba mɔri makid ki.” Ka lɛn yɛl ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa pa'annɛ nimbanɛ bɛ teŋ la zug wʋsa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.”

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: Ka liŋ linɛ pibili li la ʋk agɔla ka pu'a zin' pɛog la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛlim ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa pa'annɛ bugusim yɛla.” Ka da'ae pu'a la lɛbisi kpɛn'ɛs pɛog la pʋʋgin ka vɛ'ɛg liŋ tɛbisʋg la pibili li nɔɔr la.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Ka m gɔs agɔla ka nyɛ pu'ab ayi' ka ba bɛɛ m tuon, ka pɛbisʋg bɛɛ ba kpʋkpama ni! Ba da mɔr kpʋkpama ka li nwɛnɛ adaalʋŋ kpʋkpama nɛ, ka ba ʋk pɛog la ka li bɛ dunia nɛ saŋgbauŋ la teŋsʋk.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: Ka m bu'os maliak kanɛ pian'ad nɛ m la ye, “Ba mɔr pɛog la wa'ae yaanɛ?”

english_verse: “To Babylonia,” he answered, “where they will build a house for the basket and set it down inside.”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “Ba mɔri wa'anɛ Babilon teŋin, ye ba mɛ' yiri nɔki li niŋ. Yir la ya'a naae ba na niŋ pɛog la zin'ikanɛ ka li nar ye li bɛ la.”

english_verse: Finally, I looked up and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn gɔsi nyɛ ka tɛrekonama anaasi bɛɛ m tuon ka naan kʋntzɛn'ug zuoya ayi' la teŋsʋkʋ yit na.

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Ka wiedzɛn'ɛs tɛɛd yiiga tɛreko la, ka wiedsabila mɛ tɛɛd linɛ tia'al la,

english_verse: the third chariot was pulled by white horses, and the fourth by spotted gray horses.
translation_verse: ka wiedpiela tɛɛd linɛ paas atan' la, ka wiedpʋpɔnra mɛ tɛɛd tɛreko linɛ tia'al anaasi la, ba wʋsa da kpi'emnɛ hali.

english_verse: “Sir,” I asked the angel. “What do these stand for?”
translation_verse: Ani ka m bu'os maliak kanɛ pian'adi tisidim la ye, “M zugdaana, nɛ'ɛnam an bɔ?”

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Ka maliak la lɛbis ye, “Bama anɛ siis anaasi, banɛ bɛ arezana ni, ba yinɛ Zugsɔb la san'an na ye ba kaae dunia la wʋsa.

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Wiedsabila la tɛɛd tɛreko si'a la lɛbidi ya-datiuŋ baba, ka wiedpiela la lɛbid ya-tuona baba, ka wiedpʋpɔnra la lɛbid ya-dagɔbʋg baba.”

english_verse: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, “Start patrolling the earth.” When they had gone on their way,
translation_verse: Wiedbanɛ mɔr paŋ la yina la, ba kiridi tɔ'ɔtɔ ye ba kaae dunia la wʋsa. Ka o yɛl ye, “Kem kaae dunia la wʋsa!” Ka ba sid keŋ kaae li wʋsa.

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: Ka maliak la buolimi yɛl ye, “Gɔsima banɛ ken ya-datiuŋ baba la kɛ ka m sʋnf ma'ae zin'ikan la yɛla.” Josua na'am la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la labaar kɛɛn m san'an na yɛlim ye,

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Li anɛ onɛ na mɛ' Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la, ka na paam girima, ka zin'in o na'am gbauŋ la zugʋ gɔs o nidib. Maanmaan na zi'e o na'am gbauŋ la baba, ka ba nidib ayi' la na tʋm nɛ sumalisim nɛ nɔɔr yinne.”

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: Zupibig la anɛ nidiba atan' nwa' din, Heldai nɛ Tobija nɛ Jedaya nɛ Hen onɛ an na'asi sɔb hali ka an Zefanaya biig la, ka ba na nɔki li niŋ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka li tiɛndi ba yɛla.

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Banɛ bɛ lalli la na kena sʋŋi mɛ' Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la, linɛ na kɛ ka fʋ baŋ ye Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la sid tʋm mam fʋ san'an na. Nɛ'ɛŋa sid na niŋ, fʋ ya'a siaki dɔl Zugsɔb onɛ an fʋ Wina'am la nɔɔr.

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Darius n da di na'am la, li yʋma anaasi saŋa, nwadis awai la, li daba anaasi daar ka Zugsɔb la labaar kɛn o nɔdi'es Zakaria san'an na.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: Ba da bu'os maanmaannib nɛ nɔdi'esidib la bu'oskaŋa ye, “Li sʋm ye ti kpɛn kum saŋa wʋsa Pʋ'ʋsim Yir san'auŋ la yɛla, ka lɔɔd nɔɔr nwadis anu la ni wʋʋ tinamɛ maan si'em yʋma bɛdegʋ nwana laa?”

english_verse: It was then that the Lord All-Powerful told me to say to everyone in the country, including the priests: For
translation_verse: “Bu'osim teŋ la nidib nɛ maanmaannib la ye, ban da lɔɔd nɔɔr ka kaasid nwadis anu nɛ nwadis ayɔpɔi la ni yʋma pisyɔpɔi linɛ gaad la, li sid da anɛ man na'asi yɛla ka ya da lɔɔd nɔɔr laa?

english_verse: And when you eat and drink, isn't it for your own enjoyment?
translation_verse: Ka yanamɛ da dit ka nuud la, li ka'anɛ ya mɛŋ ka ya da diisidaa?

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: Li ka' yɛlbama ka Zugsɔb la da pian' dɔlis o nɔdi'esidib banɛ da pʋn dɛŋi bɛ la san'anɛ tis Jerusalem dim, saŋkanɛ ka ba da mɔr arezak pamm ka sumalisim bɛ, la'an nɛ tɛɛns banɛ gilig tempʋʋg la, nɛ Negef nɛ tɛɛns banɛ bɛ zuoya teŋir ka nidib da bɛ hali laa?” Tiakimi ka lɛbi Zugsɔb la san'an na

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an paŋ tita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, Sɛɛ ya tʋm nɛ sida, zɔmi taaba nimbaanlig ka mɔr nyɔɔg nɛ taaba.

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: Da namisi pʋkɔnya nɛ kpiibis nɛ saam banɛ la'am bɛ nɛ ya la, bɛɛ nɔŋ dima. Mɛ da tɛn'ɛsid bɛ'ɛdi tisid taabaa.

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: ka digilimi ba sʋnya wʋʋ tampiing nɛ, ka pʋ kɛlisid wada la bɛɛ pian'ad linɛ ka Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la da tis o nɔdi'esidib banɛ da bɛ kʋdimin sa laa. Ala ka Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la sʋnf da duoe hali.

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: “Man da buol la ba pʋ kɛlisɛ, ala ka ba sɔs ka m mɛ zan'as ka pʋ di'e, Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' li.

english_verse: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.
translation_verse: M da widigi baa kpɛn'ɛs tɛɛns wʋsa ni wʋʋ sisi'epiliŋi mɔri ba kennɛ. Ka ba lieb saam ka ba teŋ la kpɛlim dabɔɔd ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn nyaŋi lɛb naa. Ban da maal teŋ sʋŋ la si'em nwa' ka li lieb zaalim.”

english_verse: I love Zion so much that her enemies make me angry.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “M nɔŋ Zion yɛla hali, ka la'am nɔŋ nidib la mɛn.”

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa', “M na lɛb Zion Zuorin na ka bɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin. Ka ba na buon Jerusalem ye Tempʋkanɛ an Sida ka buon Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la zuor la ye Zuokanɛ an Kasi.”

english_verse: while boys and girls play in the streets.
translation_verse: Biribis nɛ bipumis na pɛ'ɛl tempʋʋg la suoya ni di'emid.

english_verse: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west,
translation_verse: Man Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “M na faanm nidib la yis tembanɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ nɛ ya-tuona la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: M na mɔri ba na ka ba zin'in Jerusalem teŋin. Ba na aan m nidib, ka mam mɛ na an sida nɛ pʋpielim Wina'am tisi ba.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: Man Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Yanam banɛ yʋ'ʋn wʋm pian'abama yit nɔdi'es banɛ da bɛ saŋa kanɛ ka ba ɛɛnb Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la, kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya mɛŋ ka Yir la mɛ'.

english_verse: Before that time, neither people nor animals were rewarded for their work, and no one was safe anywhere, because I had turned them against each other.
translation_verse: Tʋʋma la da nam pʋ pin'il la, ninsaal bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbʋg da kae na nyaŋi tʋm ka di'e yɔɔdɛ. Sɔ' da kae na nyaŋi tʋmm o mɛŋ tʋʋma nɛ ya'amlɛogɔ, bɔzugɔ man mɛŋ da tuguli ya ka ya zabid nɛ taab wʋʋ ya anɛ dataas nɛ.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna m kʋ lɛm maal banɛ kpɛlim la wʋʋ man da maan si'em la.” Man Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: “Bʋmbʋta la na nɔbig sʋ'ʋŋa, ka tiwanna la mɛ wal wala, ka teŋ la kɛ ka zʋʋd du'a. Saŋgbana na kɛ ka saa ni. Manɛ na tis nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa ka li an faari tis nimbanɛ kpɛlim la.”

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Juda nɛ Israel dima, nidib da pɔɔd nɔɔri tisid taaba ye, “Juda nɛ Israel yɛltɔɔg la buudi na paae ya. Amaa da zɔti dabiem, ka m na faaɛn ya ka tisi ya albareka. Kpɛ'ɛŋimini ya mɛŋ ka tʋmi.”

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: ala mɛn ka m gban'e ye m maal bʋnsʋŋʋ tis Jerusalem nɛ Juda dim ya'as. Da zɔti dabiem.

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ na maal si'em nwa': pian'ami sida tisi taaba, ka kadi saria linɛ an sʋm ka dɔl suori ya sariakadib zin'isin la;

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: da gban'e gban'abɛ'ɛdi sɛnbig taabaa, mɛ da pɔɔdi ziri pɔɔrɛ. Man kis nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la labaar da lɛn kɛn Zakaria san'an na ye

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Nɔlɔɔr kanɛ ka ya lɔɔd nwadis anaasi nɛ nwadis anu nɛ nwadis ayɔpɔi nɛ nwadis piiga ni la wʋsa na anɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ sumalisim la'asʋg nɛ di'ema malima tis Juda dim. Dinzugɔ ieemi sida nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.”

english_verse: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Saŋa kenna ka nidib bɛdegʋ na ti yi teŋ sieba kena,

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: ka tempʋsieba nidib na yɛl teŋ sieba dim ye, ‘Kɛlli ka ti keŋ tɔ'ɔtɔ iee Zugsɔb la ka wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la. Mam mɛŋ na keŋ.’

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Ka nidib bɛdegʋ nɛ sʋ'ʋlim banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ na kɛn Jerusalem na iee ka pʋ'ʋs man Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la.”

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, “Dabisban ya'a ti paae, nidib piiga na yi buudi wʋsa nii la'asi gban'e Jew nid yinne fuug nɔɔr ka yɛl o ye, ‘Kɛl ka ti la'am keŋ, bɔzugɔ ti wʋm ye Wina'am bɛɛ ya san'an.’”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord: His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la labaar yɛl ye, o zan'as Hadirak teŋ nɛ Damaskus teŋ la, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la yɔ'ɔg o nini gɔsid Israel dɔɔd nɛ ba nidib la wʋsa.

english_verse: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.
translation_verse: O mɛ zan'as Hamat teŋ kanɛ kpi'e Hadirak la, la'an nɛ Taya nɛ Sidon, hali la'an nɛ ban mi' tʋʋma hali la.

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Taya dim mɛɛ ba kpi'euŋ zin'ig ka la'as anzurifa nwɛnɛ titan, ka mɛ la'as sanlima digil wʋʋ suorin sa'ad nɛ.

english_verse: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la na nɔki ba arezak la wʋsa gaad ka san'ami ba kpi'euŋ zin'ig la bas atɛuk pʋʋgin, ka bugum na kanbi ba teŋ la wʋsa.

english_verse: Both Ashkelon and Gaza will tremble with fear; Ekron will lose all hope. Gaza's king will be killed, and Ashkelon emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Askɛlon teŋ dim na nyɛ ka zɔ dabiem, Gaza dim mɛ na namis bɛdegʋ, ka Ekron dim ti'ir la wʋsa gaad. Gaza dim kʋ lɛn nyɛɛ ba na'ab la, ka Askɛlon teŋ mɛ na kpɛlim dabɔɔd.

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Saam na kena di'e Asdod teŋ la, m na kɛ ka Filistia dim basi ba nyɛɛsim la ka kʋ lɛn nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgɔ.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: M kʋ lɛn kɛ ka ba ɔnb ni'im kanɛ mɔr ziim, bɛɛ nɔk dikanɛ kisi niŋi ba nɔɔrinɛ. Banɛ kpɛlim la na aan ti Wina'am la nidib ka lieb tuongatib Juda teŋin, ka Ekron dim la na liebi m nidib wʋʋ Jebus dimi an si'em la.

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: Amaa m na guri m teŋ la ka banɛ giligidi bɔɔd ye ba zu ka san'am la kʋ lɛn nyɛ suori kpɛn' naa. M kʋ lɛn siak ka onɛ mugusid nidib kena nyaŋi m nidib laa, bɔzugɔ nannanna manɛ yʋ'ʋn guri ba. Zion na'ab la kenna

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: Zion dima, mɔri sumalisim bɛdegʋ! Jerusalem dima, tansimi nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar gɔsimi ya, ya Na'ab la kennɛ ya san'an na, o anɛ pʋpielim sɔb ka mɔr nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' naarɛ, ka sie o mɛŋi ban'ad bʋŋ; o ban'adi bʋŋsia'asiŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: M na yis zaba tɛrekonam la wʋsa Efiram teŋin ka yis zaba widi la Jerusalem tempʋʋgin ka kɔ'ɔg zaba tiraug la. O na pian' sumbʋgʋsʋm yɛla tis sʋ'ʋlimnam la wʋsa. O na'am la na pin'il atɛuk yinne ni keŋ paae atɛuk yinne, ka naan Efiritis kɔldaugin la keŋ paae dunia bɛn wʋsa.

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim fʋ, man nɔk ziim maal nɔnaar nɛ fʋn la zug, m na faaɛn fʋ nidib la yis bʋmbu'azulʋŋin.

english_verse: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.
translation_verse: Lɛmmini ya kpi'euŋ zin'igin la, yammis banɛ yʋ'ʋn mɔr ti'irɛ; hali nannanna m mɔɔl ya ye m na lɛbisi ya bareka la nɔɔr ayi'.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: M na pɔnd Juda wʋʋ mam na gʋdi m tiraug ka li pɔnd si'em la ka Efiram dim an piema. Zion dima, m na nɔki ya nidib la, ka ya liebi m zaba sʋ'ʋg, ka zab nɛ Girik dim la. Zugsɔb la na yina

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na nie ba san'an; o piema la na ian'ad wʋʋ sa-ian'asʋg nɛ. Zugsɔb Wina'am la na pieb tanp na'atan la, ka ken nɛ sisi'em linɛ yit ya-dagɔbʋg la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na lusi ba. Ba na nyaŋi ba dataas nɛ luobkuga ka kʋʋ ba. Ba na maal tʋkpiidʋg wʋʋ ba anɛ danuudib nɛ; ka ba dataas ziim na kpa'ad wʋʋ maan ka ba maal ka kpa'ad ziim la laan si'em ka mɔri misid maan daka lʋga anaasi la.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan ba Wina'am la na faaɛn ba daakan la wʋʋ kɔnbkemi na faaɛn o kɔnbid si'em la. Ba na nyɛɛnnɛ o teŋ la zug wʋʋ sanlima nɛ anzurifa na tab na'am zupibigin nɛ.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Ba na vɛnl ka nidib ya'am kpɛn' ba hali! Zʋʋd la na kɛ ka dasam la nɔb sʋ'ʋŋa ka mɔr laafi, ka danpaalig la mɛ maal pu'asada la mɛn.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Sɔsimi Zugsɔb la saa yɛla sigsaa saŋa; li anɛ Zugsɔb la kɛt ka saŋgbana la'asid. Onɛ kɛt ka saa niidi tisid ninsaalib, ka zʋʋd yit teŋinɛ tisid sɔ' wʋsa.

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Bada la pian'adnɛ ziri pian'ad, ba'abʋgʋdib nyɛt si'el la ka' sida; ba zaansima la anɛ ziri, ba ma' ye ba bʋgʋnnɛ nidib la sʋʋnr amaa li wʋsa anɛ zaalim. Linzug nidib la yiridnɛ giligid wʋʋ pɛ'ɛs nɛ ka namisid ban pʋ mɔr kɔnbkem la zug.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: “Man sʋnf duonɛ nɛ kɔnbkemnib la, ka m na namis tuongatib la. Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la mɛŋ na guri ba o na gur o kɔnbid banɛ an Juda dim la, ka kɛ ka ba nwɛnɛ wiedkpi'ema na bɛ zaba ni nɛ.

english_verse: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.
translation_verse: Juda teŋin ka lɔdigin kugir la na yina onɛ an kpa'ar kanɛ ka ba na nɔk Fuug Sʋgʋr nwiig la lɔ, onɛ na an zaba tiraug, o san'an ka tuongatib wʋsa na yina.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Ba na la'as taaba nwɛnɛ zabzabid kpi'ema banɛ nyaŋi ba dataasi nɔɔd teŋin zaba ni. Zugsɔb la bɛ nɛ ba la zug, ba na zabi nyaŋ banɛ ban'ad widii zabid la.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka Juda nidib la paam paŋ ka faaɛn Israel nidib la bas. M na lɛbisi ba zin'il bɔzugɔ m zɔti ba nimbaanlig. Ba na nwɛnɛ man nan zi' zan'asi baa, bɔzugɔ manɛ aan ba Zugsɔb ba Wina'am ka na wʋmi ba sɔsʋg.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel nidib la na kpi'em wʋʋ zabzabkpi'ema nɛ, ka ba sʋnya ma'ae wʋʋ ba bɛ nɛ daam nuubin. Ba biis na nyɛ ka ba sʋnya ma'ae; ba sʋnf na malis Zugsɔb la maal si'eli tisi ba la zug.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: M na buoli ba ka la'asi ba m san'an. Sida-sida m na faaɛn ba; ba na lɛn zu'oe wʋʋ ban da an si'em la.

english_verse: Although I scattered my people in distant countries, they won't forget me. Once their children are raised, they will return—
translation_verse: La'an nɛ man widigi ba kpɛn'ɛs teŋzʋŋin la wʋsa, ba na bɛ teŋ lalli ka tiɛndi m yɛla. Ban nɛ ba biis la na tilig, ka lɛb na ya'as.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: M na yisi ba Egipt teŋin lɛbis na ka la'as banɛ bɛɛ Asiria teŋin la. M na mɔri ba kɛn Gilead nɛ Lebanon tɛɛnsin na, ka paalʋ kʋ bɛɛ siaki baa.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: Ba na dɔl yɛlbanɛ nwɛnɛ atɛuk ku'om yɛŋim si'em la nii gaad; ba na nyaŋ atɛuk linɛ dammid la. Nail kɔldaug nɛ li zulʋŋ la wʋsa, li na kpiɛn. Asiria dʋ'ʋsi-m-mɛŋ la na sig teŋin ka Egipt sʋ'ʋlim la mɛ gaad.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka ba nyɛ kpi'euŋ man Zugsɔb la ni ka kennɛ m yʋ'ʋr la pʋʋgin.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: Lebanon dima, yɔ'ɔgimi ya kʋlis; ka bugum kanbi ya na'aziinr tibɛda la!

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Kpʋkparig tiisɛ, kaasimi kuŋ, bɔzugɔ na'aziinr tiis la luya, ka girima tiis la san'am! Tikpi'ema banɛ bɛ Basan teŋinɛ, kaasimi kuŋ; Sian'akanɛ ka tiis da kpɛn' kippi la san'am ya!

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Kɛlisim kɔnbkemnib la kaasid kuŋ si'em; ban kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a ka li mɔr yam sʋma la san'am ya! Kɛlisim gbigima la nwa'am si'em; sian'anr linɛ bɛ Joodan kɔldaugin la san'amnɛ! Kɔnbkemniba ayi' la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ aan m Wina'am la yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “Gur kɔnbid banɛ ka ba zanbil ye ba kʋ la.

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Banɛ da' ba la kɔti ba ka keŋ zaalim ka sɔ' pʋ maali ba si'ela. Banɛ kuosidi ba la yɛl ye, ‘Bareka bɛ nɛ Zugsɔb la, man anɛ bʋmmɔr!’ Ba mɛŋ kɔnbkemnib la ba'a lɛn ka' nɛ baa.

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: M kʋ lɛn zɔ teŋ la nidib nimbaanlig ya'asɛ.” Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la. “M na lɛbis sɔ' wʋsa niŋ o kpi'a nɛ o na'ab nu'ugin. Ba na muk teŋ la nidib, ka m kʋ faaɛn ba yisi ba nu'uginɛ.”

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: Ala ka m kem kɔnbid banɛ ka ba zanbili ba ye ba kʋ la, li kas-kas anɛ kɔnbbanɛ ka ba mugusid ba hali la. Dinzug ka m nɔk balaya ayi', ka pʋd yinne ye, Nimbaanlzɔɔr ka pʋd yinne ye, Nɔɔr Yinne, ka m mɛŋ mɔri li kem kɔnbid la.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Nwadig yinne pʋʋgin ka m kad kɔnbkemniba atan'. Kɔnbid la da kisigim nɛ, ka m yaama yii ba;

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: ka m yɛl ye, “M kʋ lɛn aan ya kɔnbkemma. Kɛl ka banɛ kpiid la kpi, ka banɛ san'amid la san'am. Kɛl ka banɛ kpɛlim la ɔnb taaba.”

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Ka m nɔki m balaar linɛ buon Nimbaanlig la kɔ'ɔgi li, ka li pa'al ye m san'am nɔnaar kanɛ wʋsa ka m naal nɛ buudi wʋsa la.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Li da san'ami naae daakan la. Ka banɛ da'ad kɔnbidi kuosid la nyɛ ka baŋ ye li anɛ Zugsɔb la pian'ʋk.

english_verse: I told them, “Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it.” So they handed me my wages, a measly
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, “Nɔkimi lii lɔbi bas Pʋ'ʋsim Yir ligidi su'ab dɔɔgin la.” Ban zi'el m da' si'em la! Linzug ka m nɔk anzurifa ligidi pistan' la lɔbi bas Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la tis ligidgur la.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: M da lɛn kɔ'ɔg balaar kanɛ paas ayi' ka li yʋ'ʋr buon Nɔɔr Yinne la, san'am ba'abiidʋg linɛ bɛ Juda nɛ Israel dim sʋʋgin la.

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da lɛn yɛlim ye, “Maalimi fʋ mɛŋ nwɛnɛ kɔnbkem kanɛ an zɔlʋg nɛ.

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ m ye m gaŋnɛ kɔnbkem kanɛ na gɔsid teŋ la, onɛ ba'a kʋ bɛ nɛ kɔnbbanɛ bɔdig bɛɛ kɔnbbaanlʋg la, ka kʋ ti'eb banɛ pu'alim la, bɛɛ diis banɛ mɔr laafi laa, amaa o na gaans pɛbanɛ nɔbi mɔr kpaam la ɔnbid ka fʋgʋsidi ba tafɛɛd.

english_verse: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.
translation_verse: “Tɔɔg bɛ kɔnbkem kanɛ ka' gban'ar la zug, on kɛɛs kɔnbid la bas la! Zaba sʋ'ʋg na kie o nu'ug ka kʋns o datiuŋ nif! O nu'ug na kpi nyain, ka o datiuŋ nif zu'om nyain!”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la labaari nwa' zaŋi ken Israel dim yɛla. Zugsɔb onɛ maal saŋgbana, ka maal dunia ɛɛnbir ka nɔk vʋm niŋ ninsaal ni la, yɛl si'eli nwa':

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: “M na kɛ ka Jerusalem nwɛnɛ nwam kanɛ pɛ'ɛl nɛ daam, ka nimbanɛ gilig la wʋsa na nuu li bugi tu'usid ka gɛrid. Ba na kena lud Juda nɛ Jerusalem dim.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Daakan la, buudbanɛ bɛ dunia wʋsa ni ya'a ti la'asi giligi ba, m na kɛ ka Jerusalem kilim tampiing kanɛ pʋ bikida. Ka banɛ wʋsa mak ye ba bik o na pu'alimi ba mɛŋ.

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: Daakan la m na kɛ ka dabiem kpɛn' widi wʋsa, ka banɛ ban'ad la wʋsa zut fɛndig.” Zugsɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. “M na gur Juda nidib la, amaa ka kɛ ka buudi la wʋsa widi zu'om.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Ka Juda dim tuongatib la wʋsa na yɛli ba sʋnfʋn ye, ‘Jerusalem nidib la kpi'emnɛ bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la aan ba Wina'am.’

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: “Daakan la m na kɛ ka Juda tuongatib la nwɛnɛ daad ka ba la'asi nyu'oe ka dʋgʋl dʋk, bɛɛ bugum na bɛ kikan'a kpi'emis sʋʋgin. Ba na vaalim nimbanɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ nɛ ya-dagɔbʋg la wʋsa, amaa Jerusalem na kpɛn zi'e o naŋ-naŋ.”

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na gur Juda bɛllim zin'ig yiiga, ala ka David yaas nɛ Jerusalem teŋ nidib girima kʋ gaad Juda dima.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Daakan la Zugsɔb la na lus banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la, ala ka tadimnam banɛ bɛɛ ba sʋʋgin la na nwɛnɛ Na'ab David, ka Na'ab David yaas la mɛ na nwɛnɛ Wina'am, ka nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb maliak nɛ gaadi ba tuon.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Daakan la m na yii zab nɛ banɛ wʋsa zabid nɛ Jerusalem la. Ban kummi tisid onɛ ka ba kʋns la yɛla

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: “M na nɔk nimbaanlzɔɔr nɛ winsɔsʋg siigi bu'oe niŋ David yaas nɛ Jerusalem dim la zug. Ba na gɔsid man kanɛ ka ba kʋns la, ka kum hali, wʋʋ sɔ' na kaasidi o biyimmir kʋʋr si'em la, ka ba sʋnf san'am wʋʋ sɔ' sʋnfʋ na san'am o bikpɛŋ kum yɛla si'em la.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Daakan la kukuma na bɛ Jerusalem teŋin hali, wʋʋ ban kaasid Hadad Rimmon yɛla si'em Megido teŋin la.

english_verse: Everyone of each family in the land will mourn, and the men will mourn separately from the women. This includes those from the family of David, and the families of Nathan,
translation_verse: Teŋ la wʋsa na paam sʋnsa'aŋ, dɔɔg wʋsa nidib na la'as taaba kum kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb, dap nɛ ba pu'ab na kummi ba kɔn'ɔkɔn', David tuŋ la nɛ ba pu'ab, nɛ Natan tuŋ la nɛ ba pu'ab,

english_verse: and all other families as well.
translation_verse: nɛ dɔɔd banɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa nɛ ba pu'ab.”

english_verse: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la da yɛl ye, “Daakan la ku'om na yɔ'ɔgi bunni tis David yaas nɛ Jerusalem teŋ nidib, li na pie ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ dian'ad wʋsa yis.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: “Daakan la, mam na kpiis ba'ar wʋsa yʋ'ʋri yis teŋ la zug, ka ba kʋ lɛn tiɛn ba yɛla ya'asɛ,” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. “M na yis ziri nɔdi'esidib la nɛ kikiris banɛ dɔlli ba la wʋsa teŋ la zug.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a zan'as ka ye o pian'adnɛ nɔdi'esʋg pian'ad, o saam nɛ o ma du'adig na yɛl o ye, ‘Li anɛ tilas ye fʋ kpi, bɔzugɔ fʋ ma' ziri nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr.’ O ya'a pian' o nɔdi'esʋg la yɛla, o mɛŋ yidim na kʋns o kʋ.

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: “Daakan la nyan na gban'e nɔdi'es banɛ wʋsa yɛt ye Wina'am nie si'elnamɛ pa'ali ba la. O kʋ yɛ nɔdi'es fuugʋ ma' zirii.

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: O na yɛl ye, ‘Man ka' nɔdi'esa. Man anɛ kpaad; kuob ka man ti'e ka vʋe m dasannimin sa.’

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a bu'os o ye, ‘Ka fɛn'ɛbama yi yaanɛ fʋ niŋgbina ni?’ O na lɛbis ye, ‘M paam dɛmis la nɛ m zuanam yin.’” Ba kʋ kɔnbkem la ka kɔnbid la widig

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Sʋ'ʋgɔɔ, duom zab nɛ m kɔnbkemnib la, zam nɛ dau kanɛ li'elim la!” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la. “Kʋʋm kɔnbkem la, ka kɔnbid la widig,” ka mam mɛ na zab nɛ kɔnbbaanlʋg la.

english_verse: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Teŋ nwa' zug wʋsa, pʋdigir zin'is atan' pʋʋgin ayi' na kpi ka ba'as yɔri; la'an nɛ wala pʋdigir yinne na kpɛlim anina.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Pʋdigir yinne kanɛ kpɛlim la, m na mɔri ba na kpɛn'ɛs bugumin; ka nyɛligi ba siligi yis nyain wʋʋ anzurifa nɛ, ka maki ba wʋʋ sanlima nɛ. Ba na buol man yʋ'ʋr ka m siaki tisi ba; M na yɛl ye, ‘Ba anɛ m nidib,’ ka ba na yɛl ye, ‘Zugsɔb la anɛ ti Wina'am.’”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na'am dabisir la kenna, ka ba na pʋdig la'abanɛ ka ba faaɛn ya san'an la tis taaba ya nini ni.

english_verse: But first, he will bring many nations to attack Jerusalem—homes will be robbed, women raped, and half of the population dragged off, though the others will be allowed to remain.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, M na la'as buudi la wʋsa ka ba kena zab nɛ Jerusalem; ba na nyaŋ teŋ la ka kpɛn' yaanɛ vaae ya la'ad wʋsa, ka bib pu'ab la. Teŋ la nidib pʋsʋk na keŋ teŋ zʋŋ, amaa nimbanɛ kpɛlim la ba kʋ mɔri ba yi teŋin laa.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Ani ka Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋn na yii zab nɛ buudban la wʋʋ on da ɛɛn zabid si'em kʋdimin la.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
translation_verse: Daakan la o na kena zi'en Olif Zuor linɛ bɛ Jerusalem ya-nya'aŋ la zug, ka zuor la na buak zin'is ayi' yi ya-nya'aŋi paae ya-tuona, ka bʋmbɔk tita'ar na bɛ teŋsʋk, ka pʋsʋk lɛbid ya-datiuŋ ka pʋsʋk mɛ lɛbid ya-dagɔbʋg.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Ya na zɔɔ dɔl bɔn'ɔg kanɛ bɛ zuor la teŋsʋk la, bɔzugɔ li na dɔlis ala keŋ paae Azal teŋin. Ya na zɔ nwɛnɛ teŋi da dam Juda Na'ab Uzia saŋa ka ya da zɔ si'em la. Ani ka m Zugsɔb Wina'am la yʋ'ʋn na kena, nɛ o maliaknam wʋsa.
