english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Daakan la nɛɛsim nɛ waad kʋ bɛɛ, ka mɛligim ɛɛnti lii ga'aŋ la mɛ kʋ bɛɛ.

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Daakan la vʋm ku'om na pʋbid Jerusalem teŋin yit na, li pʋsʋk na keŋ atɛuk linɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ la, ka pʋsʋk keŋ atɛuk linɛ bɛ ya-tuona la; sɛɛung nɛ ʋʋn wʋsa.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na di dunia wʋsa na'am. Daakan la Zugsɔb yinne ma'aa na bɛ, ka on yʋ'ʋr ma'aa ka nidib na mi'.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Ban'akanɛ ka Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka li paae buudbanɛ zabid nɛ Jerusalem la nwa': ba na vʋe ka ba niŋgbina lɛɛ kpi, ba nini na pun'oe, ka ba zilima pun'oe ba nɔya ni.

english_verse: The Lord will make them go into a frenzy and start attacking each other,
translation_verse: Daakan la Zugsɔb la na kɛ ka dabiem kpɛn' ninsaal wʋsa. Sɔ' wʋsa na gban'e o tiraan nu'ugʋ vɛ'ɛgi zi'el, ka ba tuligi zabid nɛ taaba.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Buudbanɛ zabid nɛ Jerusalem ka ba nidib kpɛlim la wʋsa na ken anina na yʋʋm wʋsa wɔ'ɔgid Na'ab la, onɛ an Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, ka di Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ la.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ka teŋ kanɛ nidibi zan'as ka pʋ keŋ Jerusalem wɔ'ɔg Na'ab onɛ an Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, saa kʋ nii ba teŋinɛ.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa na an namisʋgʋ tis Egipt nɛ buudbanɛ wʋsa zan'as ye ba kʋ keŋ di Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ la.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Dʋk wʋsa linɛ bɛ Jerusalem nɛ Juda na an kasi tis Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, ka banɛ wʋsa kena ye ba maal maana la na nɔk dʋgid la dʋg. Daakan la banɛ kuosid la'ad kʋ lɛm bɛ Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la Pʋ'ʋsim Yinnɛ.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la labaar linɛ ka o tis Malakai ye o tis Israel dim la nwa'. Zugsɔb la nɔŋ Israel dim si'em

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “M nɔŋi ya. “Amaa ka ya bu'os ye, ‘Fʋ nɔŋi ti wala-wala?’” Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Esau da ka'anɛ Jakob ba'abiigaa? La'an nɛ wala, m da nɔŋ Jakob,

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: amaa Esau ka m kis, ka san'am o teŋ linɛ bɛ zuoya ni la, ka kɛ ka o faar la lieb wɛog bʋnkɔnbid zin'ig.”

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Esau yaas banɛ an Edom dim la ya'a yɛl ye, “La'an nɛ ban san'ami ti teŋ la, ti na maligim mɛ' dabɔɔd la.” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la na yɛl si'eli nwa' ye, “La'an nɛ ban na mɛ' la, m na nwa'ae li bas. Ba na buonnɛ ba ye Nimbɛ'ɛdnam Teŋ, nimbanɛ ka Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn bɛɛ ba zugin saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Ya na nyɛɛ li nɛ ya mɛŋ nini ka yɛl ye, ‘Zugsɔb la paŋ zu'oya hali o kpi'euŋ la tʋʋg Israel titɔndis la bɛn!’” Maan linɛ mɔr gba'ar yɛla

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Biig na'asid o ba', ka tʋmtʋm na'asid o zugdaan. Amaa man onɛ ka ba buon ye ba ba' la, na'asi kanɛ nar ye ba tisim la bɛ ya? M ya'a aan ba zugdaana, wɔ'ɔgir kanɛ nar ye m di'e la bɛ ya? “Li anɛ yanam maanmaannib la nɛ'ɛsidi m yʋ'ʋr la. “Amaa ya bu'osid ye, ‘Ti nɛ'ɛsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr wala-wala?’

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: “Li anɛ yanamɛ mɔr diib linɛ an dian'adi pa'annɛ m maan daka zug la yɛla. “Amaa ya bu'osid ye, ‘Li niŋ wala ka ti maalif dian'ad sɔba?’ “Li anɛ yanamɛ pʋ nannɛ m maan daka la, ka mɔr linɛ ka' sʋm maan maana la.

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a mɔr bʋnkɔnbid banɛ zu'om kena maan maana, lin ka'anɛ bɛ'ɛdɛɛ? Ka ya ya'a nɔk bʋnkɔnbwabir bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ bɛn'ɛda, lin ka'anɛ bɛ'ɛdɛɛ? Mɔrini li keŋ tisi ya Gɔmena la, ka gɔs ye o sʋnf na malis nɛ yaa? O na di'e lii?” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la bu'osid.

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb yɛl ye; “Nannanna yanam banɛ an maanmaannib la mɔr piinbama buudi ken Zugsɔb la san'an sɔsid ye o sʋŋi ti la, ya gɔs ka o na di'e lii?

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: “M naan bɔɔdin ye ya yinne yɔɔn Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la za'anɔya, ka ya kʋ lɛm mɔr piinyaalis la nyu'odi m bimbim la zugɔ! M sʋnf pʋ malis nɛ yaa.” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'. “M kʋ di'e piini linɛ bɛɛ ya nu'usin la.

english_verse: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Man yʋ'ʋr la na anɛ yʋ'ʋtita'ar tɛɛns wʋsa sʋʋgin, lin yi winnigi tansid zin'isi'a paae winnigi lit zin'isi'a la. Zin'ig wʋsa ba mɔr bʋnnyubisa nɛ maan sʋma linɛ an nyain kenna man yʋ'ʋr zug, bɔzugɔ man yʋ'ʋr anɛ yʋ'ʋtita'ar tɛɛns wʋsa sʋʋgin.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: “Amaa ya san'amidi m yʋ'ʋr maana la zin'igin, ka ziemi li, ka yɛt ye, ‘li ka' gbinnɛ.’

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Ya yɛt ye, ‘Nwa' anɛ zitita'ar!’ Ka naki ya nyɔnya nɛ'ɛsidi li.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'. Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Ya mɔri bʋnkɔnbid banɛ pu'alim nɛ waba nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ ka wiim mɔri ba kena maal maana, ya tɛn'ɛs ye mam na di'e lii?”

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Nɔpɔɔr bɛ onɛ wʋsa gaŋ bʋnkɔnbraug o bʋnkɔnbid sʋʋgin, ka zi'el nɔɔr ye o tis Zugsɔb la, ka filimmi li ya'as. M anɛ Na'atita'ar, ka nimbanɛ bɛ tɛɛns la wʋsa ni zɔti m yʋ'ʋr la.”

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Ya ya'a pʋ kɛlisɛ, ka pʋ gban'e ya sʋnfʋn ye ya na'asi m yʋ'ʋrɛ, m na kɛ ka nɔpɔɔr paae ya, ka kɛ ka ya bareka la lieb nɔpɔɔr. Ɛɛn, m pʋn pɔ nɔɔri tisi ya sa, bɔzugɔ ya pʋ gban'e ya sʋnfʋn ye ya na'asi ma.

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: “Yanam zug m na namisi ya yaas, ka nɔk bʋnkɔnbid banɛ ka ya mɔri maan maana la pʋti suoɛn ya nindaas, ka ba na vaae ya nɛ pʋt la mɔri keŋ.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: “M nɔnaar linɛ ka m da maal nɛ ba la da anɛ nɔnaar linɛ mɔr vʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm, linɛ ka m nɔki tis Levi dim la, ye ba zɔti m yʋ'ʋr ka na'asidim.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Yɛlsida pa'alʋg da bɛɛ ba san'an ka linɛ yʋ'ʋri buon ziri pʋ yii ba nɔɔrinɛ. Ba da dɔllim nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ burikinnim, ka fɛndig nidib bɛdegʋ yis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Maanmaannib sʋm ye ba pian'ad nɛ baŋir, ka nidib na di'edi ba pa'alʋg, bɔzugɔ ba anɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la tʋmtʋmnib.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Amaa ya fɛndig ya, ka bas yɛlsida suor la, ka ya pa'alʋg la kɛ ka nidib bɛdegʋ yidig; ala ka ya san'am nɔnaar linɛ ka m maal nɛ Levi dim la.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ya.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: “Ala ka m kɛ ka ba nɛ'ɛsi ya ka pɔ'ɔgi ya nidib la sʋʋgin, bɔzugɔ ya pʋ dɔlli m suoya la, ka mɔr baregaŋ nɛ m wada la pʋʋgin.” Juda ka' sida sɔba

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Ti wʋsa ka'anɛ ba' yinne biisɛɛ? Li ka'anɛ Wina'am yinne maali tii? Ka bɔɔ kɛ ka ti san'amid nɔnaar kanɛ ka ti mɔr nɛ taaba la? Ala ka ti san'amid nɔnaar kanɛ ka ti yaanam da maal la.

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Juda dim pʋ lɛn zi'e sida suorinɛ. Jerusalem nɛ Israel wʋsa tʋm yɛlkisʋg. Juda dim kɛ ka Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kanɛ ka Zugsɔb nɔŋ la lieb dian'ad, ban di teŋ zʋŋ pu'a banɛ pʋ'ʋsid wina banɛ yi teŋ zʋŋ na la.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Dau kanɛ maal nɛ'ɛŋa la wʋsa, o ya'a bɔɔd on an ninsi'a wʋsa, Zugsɔb la na yis o Jakob buudi la kallin, ka ba mɛ kʋ paas banɛ mɔr maana kenna tisid Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la nii.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ lɛn niŋid si'el anɛ ya kɛya ka Zugsɔb daka la pɛ'ɛl nɛ ya ninta'am, ka ya kum ka kaasid on pʋ lɛn di'esidi ya maana la zug, bɛɛ o di'e li ya nu'usin nɛ ya'amlɛog la yɛla.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Ya bu'osid ye, “Ka bɔ ka li aan ala?” Linɛ kɛ ka li aan ala la anɛ Zugsɔb la di sɛɛda fʋn nɛ pu'a kanɛ ka fʋ da di fʋ na'akinnim saŋa la, amaa fʋ pʋ bɛ nɛ pu'a la nɛ sidaa, la'an nɛ on an pu'a kanɛ ka fʋ da di nɛ nɔnaar la.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pʋ maali ba ka ba anɛ yinnee? Ba niŋgbiŋ nɛ ba siig la wʋsa anɛ o din. Bɔ ka o maali ba ka ba an yinnɛ? Li anɛ on bɔɔd ye ba ya'a du'a biis banɛ na an Wina'am din la zug. Alazugɔ gu'usim ka sɔ' da san'am nɔnaar kanɛ ka o maal nɛ o pu'a kanɛ ka o da dii o na'akinnim saŋa la.

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: Ya kɛya ka Zugsɔb la gɛɛn ya pian'ad. Amaa ya bu'osid ye, “Ti niŋ bɔ ka o gɛɛn ti pian'adɛ?” Li anɛ yanamɛ yɛt ye, “Banɛ wʋsa tʋm bɛ'ɛd la an sʋm Zugsɔb la tuon, ka o sʋnf malis nɛ ba la,” bɛɛ bu'osid ye, “Wina'am kanɛ an yɛlsida sɔb la bɛ yaanɛ la?”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: “Gɔsimi, m na tʋmmi m tʋmtʋm na ka o na gaadi m tuonnɛ maal suor la nyain. Ka Zugsɔb kanɛ ka ya ieed la na gbirigi kɛɛn o Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na. Tʋmtʋm kanɛ mɔɔn nɔnaar yɛla ka ya bɔɔd o hali la na kena.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' li.

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: “Amaa anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi mɔdig daakan ka o kenna la? O ya'a ti nie na anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi zi'enɛ? Bɔzugɔ o na nwɛnɛ bugum kanɛ ka ba nyɛligid kʋnt la, bɛɛ ki'ibʋ kanɛ ka ba piesid fuud ka li yit nyain la.

english_verse: The Lord will purify the descendants of Levi, as though they were gold or silver. Then they will bring the proper offerings to the Lord,
translation_verse: O na zin' wʋʋ onɛ nyɛligid anzurifa yisid dian'ad nɛ; o na gaans Levi dim la wʋʋ sanlim nɛ anzurifa ka ba nyɛligidi yisid dian'ad si'em la. Ala ka Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋn na nyɛ nimbanɛ na mɔr piini kɛɛn o san'an na nɛ pʋpielim.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋn na di'e Juda nɛ Jerusalem dim piini wʋʋ dabisa nɛ yʋma banɛ gaad la da an si'em la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: “Li kʋ yuugɛ ka m na kena kad saria. M na kɛn tɔ'ɔtɔ na di kasɛti pɔ'ɔg ba'abʋgʋdib la, nɛ pu'asan'auŋ nɛ dausan'auŋ dim la, nɛ banɛ dit ziri kasɛt, nɛ nimbanɛ filim ka mɔŋidi ba tʋmtʋmnib yɔɔd la, ka mugusid pʋkɔnya nɛ kpiibis, ka mɔŋid saam bʋʋd la, amaa ka pʋ zɔt man dabiem la.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' ya. Ya faand Wina'am

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: “Mam onɛ an Zugsɔb la, pʋ tiakida. Alazugʋ kɛ ka yanam Jakob yaas pʋ paam san'auŋ la.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Lin yii ya yaanam saŋa sa, ya fɛndig ya ka basi m zi'ela la ka pʋ dɔlisi lii. Fɛndigim lɛbinɛ m san'an na ka m mɛ na fɛndigi lɛbi ya san'an na.” Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' li. “Amaa ya bu'osid ye, ‘Ti na niŋ wala fɛndigi lɛbi fʋ san'an na?’

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: “Ninsaal na nyaŋi fan' Wina'am? La'an nɛ wala ya faandim. “Amaa ya bu'osid ye, ‘Ti faandif wala-wala?’ “Li anɛ yanamɛ pʋ pʋdigidi ya la'ad piiga ka yisid yinne tisidim la, bɛɛ tisid piini nɛ maana linɛ nar la.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Nɔpɔɔr bɛɛ yanam nɛ ya teŋgbauŋ la sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa zugin bɔzugɔ ya faandim nɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Mɔri pʋʋr piiga la wʋsa na kpɛn'ɛs la'ad dɔɔgin la, ka m Yir la na pɛ'ɛl nɛ diib.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' li. “Makiminimi gɔsi ye m kʋ yɔ'ɔg arezana za'anɔya la ka bareka bɛdegʋ sig na ka ya kʋ nyɛ dɔɔdi digilɛɛ?

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: M na kad bʋnvʋya ka ba kʋ nyaŋi san'ami ya zʋʋd la, ka ya tiis banɛ bɛ pɔɔdin la na wal sʋ'ʋŋa.” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' li.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Ala ka tɛɛns la wʋsa nidib na buonnɛ ya ye zusʋŋ dim, bɔzugɔ ya teŋ la na anɛ ya'amlɛog teŋ.” Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' ya.

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la lɛn yɛl ye, “Ya pian'ad pian'ayɔɔdi tisidim, amaa ka bu'os ye, ‘Ti pian'af ye bɔ ka li an pɔ'ɔgirɛ?’

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: “Ya yɛl ye, ‘Ti Wina'am dɔllim la ka' gbinnɛ. Tinamɛ giligidi tʋm linɛ tɔi ka pa'annɛ ti sʋnsa'aŋi tisid Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, li nyɔɔd an bɔ?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Amaa gɔsima, tita'alim dim la nyɛt bareka. Li ka' bi'esʋgɔ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la ken tuon; hali banɛ mɔri ba mɛŋi pa'asim nɛ Wina'am la, si'el pʋ niŋidi baa.’”

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Ala ka banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la da pian' tis taaba, ka Zugsɔb la kɛlis ka wʋm ban yɛt si'el la. Ba da sɔbi li yɛla niŋ gbana ni digil o tuon, ka li tiɛnd banɛ da zɔt Zugsɔb ka na'asid o yʋ'ʋr la yɛla.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, “Ba na ti lieb man nyɔɔrin kɔnbʋg, daakanɛ ka m ti ye m duoe tʋmi m tʋʋma la. M na zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig, nwɛnɛ ninsaali zɔt o bikanɛ di'ed o nɔɔr nimbaanlig si'em la.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ani ya'as ka ya na baŋ pʋpielim dim la nɛ banɛ an bugusim dim la an kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb si'em, ka mɛ nyɛ banɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am nɛ banɛ zan'as o la.”

english_verse: The day of judgment is certain to come. And it will be like a red-hot furnace with flames that burn up proud and sinful people, as though they were straw. Not a branch or a root will be left. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Asida sida, dabisir la kenna; li na diti nwɛnɛ bugum tita'ar linɛ kanbid si'el wʋsa nɛ. Dabisir kenna ka banɛ wʋsa an tita'alnam la nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim wʋsa na nwɛnɛ kikan'a, ka bugum na dii ba hali ka ba nya'ar bɛɛ vaung baa yinne kʋ kpɛlim.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' li.

english_verse: But for you that honor my name, victory will shine like the sun with healing in its rays, and you will jump around like calves at play.
translation_verse: “Amaa yanam banɛ na'asidi m yʋ'ʋr la, winnig kanɛ tansid nɛ pʋpielim la na mɔr laafi kɛɛn ya zugin na. Ka ya na ian'ad terib-terib wʋʋ na'abibis ka ba yɔ'ɔgi ba na'abaukʋn nɛ.

english_verse: When I come to bring justice, you will trample those who are evil, as though they were ashes under your feet. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ani ka ya na nɔɔd bugusim dim la; daakanɛ ka m ye m niŋ nɛ'ɛŋa la ba na nwɛnɛ tampɛligim ka ya nɔɔdi ba nɛ ya nɔba.” Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian' ya.

english_verse: Don't ever forget the laws and teachings I gave my servant Moses on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Tɛnrinɛ m tʋmtʋm Moses wada la, zi'ela nɛ wada banɛ ka m da tis o Horeb zuorin ye o tis Israel dim wʋsa la.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to send the prophet Elijah before that great and terrible day comes.
translation_verse: “Gɔsima, m na tʋmi m nɔdi'es Elaja ya san'an na ka Zugsɔb dabistita'ar linɛ an dabisbɛ'og la nyaan paae.

english_verse: He will lead children and parents to love each other more, so that when I come, I won't bring destruction to the land.
translation_verse: O na maal saamnam nɛ ba biis yɛla; ya'a ka' ala m na kena ka kɛ ka nɔpɔɔr li teŋ la zug na.”

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: “Gɔsima, pu'a kanɛ zi' dau la na tʋk pʋʋgʋ du'a biribiŋ, ka ba na pʋd o yʋ'ʋr ye, ‘Immanuel’, ka li gbin an ye, ‘Wina'am bɛ nɛ ti.’”

english_verse: From David to the time of the exile in Babylonia, the ancestors of Jesus were: David, Solomon , Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram; Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, Josiah, and Jehoiachin and his brothers.
translation_verse: Ka Josia du'a Jekonia nɛ bisieba. Saŋkan la ka ba gban'e Israel dimi mɔri ba keŋ Babilon teŋin la.

english_verse: more to the birth of the Messiah. The Birth of Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Ka Azor du'a Zadok. Ka Zadok du'a Akim. Ka Akim du'a Eliud.

english_verse: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo du'am da anɛ nwa'. O ma Mɛɛri da anɛ Josef pu'a-ɛliŋ. Ka Josef n da nam pʋ baŋ o la, ba nyɛ ka o mɔr pʋʋg linɛ an Wina'am Siig Kasi la din.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: Ka o sid Josef n da an sida sɔb ka pʋ bɔɔd ye o diis Mɛɛri nyan nidibin la zug, o da gban'e o pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye o su'a bas Mɛɛri.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: On da tɛn'ɛsid yɛlbama o sʋʋnrin la, ka Zugsɔb maliak kɛɛn o san'an zaansʋŋin na. Ka maliak la yɛl o ye, “Josef, David yaaŋa, da kɛ ka dabiem kpɛn'ɛf nɛ fʋn na di'e Mɛɛri ka o aan fʋ pu'a, bɔzugɔ bikanɛ pʋʋg ka o mɔr la, anɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la din.

english_verse: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
translation_verse: O na du'a biribiŋ, ka fʋ na pʋd o yʋ'ʋr ye Yesu, bɔzugɔ o na faaɛn o nidibi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin.”

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Yɛlbama wʋsa da niŋnɛ ye Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka o nɔdi'esidib yɛl si'el la niŋ amɛŋa ye,

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Ka Josef nie gbɛɛmini niŋ wʋʋ Zugsɔb maliak la yɛl o si'em la, ka pi'e o pu'a kul.

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: Amaa o da pʋ baŋ o, hali ka o ti du'a biribiŋ la. Ka o pʋd biig la yʋ'ʋr Yesu.

english_verse: When Jesus was born in the village of Bethlehem in Judea, Herod was king. During this time some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ba da du'a Yesu nɛ Betilehem teŋin linɛ bɛ Juda sʋ'ʋlimin la, Na'ab Herod n da an na'ab saŋsi'a la. Ka dap banɛ an baŋidib yi ya-nya'aŋi kɛn Jerusalem na

english_verse: and said, “Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.”
translation_verse: bu'osid ye, “Onɛ ka ba du'a ye o niŋ Jew dim na'ab la bɛ yaanɛ? Bɔzugɔ ti nyɛ nɛ o nwadbil ya-nya'aŋ, linzug ka ti kena ye ti pʋ'ʋs o.”

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na'ab Herod n da wʋm ala la, ka li pak on nɛ Jerusalem dim wʋsa.

english_verse: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, “Where will the Messiah be born?”
translation_verse: Ka o buol Wina'am maanmaannib kpɛɛmnam nɛ gbauŋmi'idibi bu'osi ba wʋsa ye, “Yaanɛ ka ba na ti du'a Kristo la?”

english_verse: They told him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote,
translation_verse: Ka ba yɛl o ye, “Betilehem teŋin linɛ bɛ Juda sʋ'ʋlimin la, bɔzugɔ Wina'am nɔdi'esidib la da sɔbnɛ ala ye,

english_verse: ‘Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel.’ ”
translation_verse: “‘Fʋn Betilehem kanɛ bɛ Juda sʋ'ʋlimin la, kɛlisim! Fʋ anɛ tembil Juda tɛɛns wʋsa sʋʋgin, amaa fʋ ni ka m ye m gaŋ sɔ' ka o na gɔs Israel teŋ la ka sʋ'oe li.’”

english_verse: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.
translation_verse: Ka Na'ab Herod su'a buol baŋidib la bu'osi ba saŋa kan ka nwadbil la daa nie.

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: Ka yɛli ba ye, “Kemi Betilehem iee sʋ'ʋŋa, ka ya ya'a nyɛ biig la, yanam lɛb na ka m baŋ, ka mam mɛ na keŋ pʋ'ʋs o.”

english_verse: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
translation_verse: Ka ban wʋm Na'ab la yɛl si'em la, ba duoe gaad. Ka nwadbil kanɛ ka ba daa nyɛ ya-nya'aŋ la, gaadi ba tuon hali paae zi'en biig la bɛ zin'isi'a la.

english_verse: They were thrilled and excited to see the star.
translation_verse: Ban nyɛ nwadbil la, ka ba sʋnya ma'ae. Ka ba maal sumalisim.

english_verse: When the men went into the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother, they knelt down and worshiped him. They took out their gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh and gave them to him.
translation_verse: Ban kpɛn' yin la nyɛ biig la nɛ o ma Mɛɛri la, ba igin teŋin pʋ'ʋs o, ka yidigi ba piini tis o, li da anɛ sanlima nɛ frankinsens nɛ mir.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am sa'ali ba zaansʋŋ pʋʋgin ye ba da lɛn lɛb Na'ab Herod san'anɛ. Alazug ka ba luaki lɛbi kuli ba mɛŋ teŋin. Josef nɛ o yidim zɔɔ keŋ Egipt teŋin

english_verse: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.”
translation_verse: Baŋidib la yii gaad la, ka Zugsɔb maliak nie o mɛŋi pa'al Josef zaansʋŋin ka yɛl o ye, “Duom zaŋ biig la nɛ o ma zɔɔ keŋ Egipt teŋin. Zin'inim ani ti paae saŋkanɛ ka m na yɛlif ka fʋ lɛb na, bɔzugɔ Na'ab Herod ieed biig la nɛ ye o kʋʋ o.”

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Ka Josef duoe yʋ'ʋŋʋ zaŋ biig la nɛ o ma keŋ Egipt teŋin

english_verse: where they stayed until Herod died. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “I called my son out of Egypt.” The Killing of the Children
translation_verse: zin'in anina hali ka Herod ti kpi. Linɛ kɛ ka Zugsɔb la da pian' si'eli dɔlis o nɔdi'esidib san'an la niŋ amɛŋa ye, “M buoli m biribiŋi yi Egipt teŋin na.” Na'ab Herod n kɛ ka ba kʋ biis la yɛla

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Na'ab Herod n da baŋ ye baŋidib nwa' zam o nɛ la, o sʋnf da pɛlignɛ hali. Ka o tʋm ye ba kʋ biribis banɛ bɛ Betilehem nɛ tɛɛns banɛ kpi'e anina la; banɛ an yʋma ayi' bɛɛ banɛ pʋ paae ala wʋsa, nwɛnɛ on bu'os baŋidib la baŋ saŋa la si'em la.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: Ala Ka Wina'am nɔdi'es Jeremia da yɛl si'em la niŋ amɛŋa ye,

english_verse: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
translation_verse: “Ba wʋm sɔ' kʋkɔr Rama teŋin, ka o kaasid ka fabin. Li anɛ Rakɛl n kaasid o biis la yɛla, ka pʋ siakid bɛliŋɔ bɔzugɔ o biis kae.” Ban yi Egipt n lɛb na la yɛla

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.

translation_verse: “Dinzugɔ yanamɛ bɔɔd ye nidib niŋ si'em tisi ya la, yanam mɛ niŋimini alaa tisi ba. Bɔzugɔ nwa' anɛ Wina'am wada nɛ o nɔdi'esidibi da sɔb si'em la. Yesu pa'al za'anɔɔr linɛ pɔɔd la yɛla

translation_verse: Ka Yesu gi'e gɔs o nya'andɔlib la ka yɛl Pita ye, “Lɛmmi m nya'aŋ sa, Sʋntaana! Fʋ tɛn'ɛsʋg anɛ ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛr ka ka' Wina'am dinnɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus then told the crowd and the disciples to come closer, and he said: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Ka buol nidib la nɛ o nya'andɔlib la la'as, ka yɛli ba ye, “Sɔ' ya'a bɔɔd ye o dɔl mam, asɛɛ o ki'is o mɛŋ yɛla, ka nɔk o kum dapuudiri zi ka dɔl man.

translation_verse: On mɛkama bɔɔd ye o gu' o nyɔvʋr, o nyɔvʋr la na bɔdig. Amaa on mɛkama bas o nyɔvʋr man zug nɛ labasʋŋ la yɛla, na nyɛɛ o nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself?
translation_verse: Nid ya'a nyɛ dunia nwa' la'ad wʋsa ka kɔ'ɔŋ o nyɔvʋrɛ o nyɔɔd an bɔ?

english_verse: What could you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Si'el kae ka nid na zaŋi tiak o nyɔvʋrɛ.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed of me and my message among these unfaithful and sinful people! If you are, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a zɔ nyan nɛ man nɛ m pa'alʋg la zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ an pu'asan'auŋ nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nwa' la, Ninsaal Biig la mɛ na zɔ on daana nyan saŋkanɛ ka o na ti lɛb na nɛ o Ba' Wina'am na'am nɛ maliak sʋma la.”

translation_verse: Ka saŋgbauŋ ma'asim kena ligili ba. Ka kʋkɔr yi saŋgbauŋ la ni na yɛl ye, “Oŋa aan m binɔŋir. Kɛlisimi nɛ o pian'ad.”

english_verse: So they kept it to themselves. But they wondered what he meant by the words “raised from death.”
translation_verse: Ka ba siak on yɛl si'el la, ka lɛɛ bu'osid taaba ye, “Vʋ'ʋg kumin la gbin an bɔ?”

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say that Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Ka ba bu'os Yesu ye, “Bɔ ka gbauŋmi'idib yɛl ye Elaja na kɛn yiiga na?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Elijah certainly will come to get everything ready. But don't the Scriptures also say that the Son of Man must suffer terribly and be rejected?
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbisi ba ye, “Sida Elaja na kɛn yiiga na maal si'el wʋsa. Ka bɔ ka li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, Ninsaal Biig na namis bɛdegʋ hali ka ba nɛ'ɛs o?

translation_verse: Nidib la da nyɛ Yesu la ka li lidigi ba, ka ba zɔɔ keŋ o san'an pʋ'ʋs o.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “What are you arguing about?”
translation_verse: Ka o bu'os o nya'andɔlib la ye, “Ya nwa'asid bɔ yɛla?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “Oo, zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ nidibi pʋ niŋid yadda, m na bɛ nɛ ya daba ala? Ya bɔɔd ye m mɔdignɛ ya hali paae saŋa wala? Mɔri biig la na.”

english_verse: Jesus asked the boy's father, “How long has he been like this?” The man answered, “Ever since he was a child.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu bu'os biig la saam ye, “Kikirig la dɔl o la, li yuug yaa?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “O biilimin sa.

english_verse: At once the boy's father shouted, “I do have faith! Please help me to have even more.”
translation_verse: Ka biig la saam tans ye, “M niŋ yadda amaa paasimi m yadda ka li pɔɔdnɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw that a crowd was gathering fast, he spoke sternly to the evil spirit that had kept the boy from speaking or hearing. He said, “I order you to come out of the boy! Don't ever bother him again.”
translation_verse: Yesu n nyɛ ka nidib la'asid o san'an la, ka o tans kikirig la ye, “Kikirig onɛ an gik nɛ tʋbkpida, yim ka bas biig la, ka da lɛn dɔl o ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: The spirit screamed and made the boy shake all over. Then it went out of him. The boy looked dead, and almost everyone said he was.
translation_verse: Ka kikirig la kaas kuŋ, ka lug biig la teŋin bɛ'ɛd bɛ'ɛdi ka nyaan yi. Ka biig la nwɛnɛ kum nɛ. Ka nidib la bɛdegʋ yɛl ye, “O kpinɛ.”

translation_verse: Ka Yesu zin'in ka buol o nya'andɔlib pii nɛ ayi' la, ka yɛli ba ye, “Onɛ bɔɔd ye o an kpɛɛm, on nɔkim o mɛŋi lieb biig, ka an sɔ' wʋsa tʋmtʋm.”

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks.
translation_verse: “Onɛ kɛ ka bibibis bama nwa' banɛ niŋim yadda la yinne tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, li naan aan sʋ'ʋm nɛ ban na nɔk nɛtita'ari lɔɔ kɔl o niŋgɔɔnr ka lɔb o basi atɛuk zuluŋin la.

english_verse: So if your hand causes you to sin, cut it off! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed than to have two hands and be thrown into the fires of hell that never go out.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ nu'ug ya'a kɛ ka fʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, fʋn fi'igimi li bas, bɔzugɔ li an sʋ'ʋm nɛ fʋn na kpɛn' arezana ka vʋe nɛ nu'ug yinne, gat fʋn na mɔr nu'us ayi' ka kpɛn' bugum teŋ ka li dit ka pʋ kpiisida.

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, get rid of it. You would be better off to go into God's kingdom with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell.

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What does the Law of Moses say about this?”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbisi bu'osi ba ye, “Moses da tisi ya nɔɔr ye bɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “Moses allows a man to write out divorce papers and send his wife away.”
translation_verse: Ka ba yɛl ye, “Moses da siak ye, dau tun'e kad o pu'a ka sɔb gbauŋʋ li yɛla tis o.”

english_verse: But in the beginning God made a man and a woman.
translation_verse: Amaa saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am da maal dunia la, o da maali ba nɛ dau nɛ pu'a.

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married.
translation_verse: Ka yɛl ye, ‘Nɛ'ɛŋa yɛla ka dau na bas o ba' nɛ o ma ka la'as nɛ o pu'a.

english_verse: He becomes like one person with his wife. Then they are no longer two people, but one.
translation_verse: Ka ba lɛn ka' ayi', amaa ba lieb nɛ yinne.’

english_verse: And no one should separate a couple that God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Wina'am la'as si'el la, mid ka ninsaal wɛligi li.”

translation_verse: Ka ba kpɛn' yin ka o nya'andɔlib la bu'os o on yɛl si'el la gbin.

english_verse: He told them, “A man who divorces his wife and marries someone else is unfaithful to his wife.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Onɛ bas o pu'a ka tɔɔm di pu'a, o anɛ pu'asan'auŋ sɔb.

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus so he could bless them by placing his hands on them. But his disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Ka ba mɔr biisi kɛn Yesu san'an na ye o zaŋ o nu'ugʋ pa'ali ba zug ka niŋi ba bareka. Ka o nya'andɔlib la kad nidib la.

english_verse: I promise you that you cannot get into God's kingdom, unless you accept it the way a child does.”
translation_verse: Amɛŋa ka m yɛti ya ye, onɛ pʋ di'e Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim la wʋʋ biiga, o kʋ kpɛn' li nii.”

translation_verse: Ka Yesu nyɛ, ka li pʋ niŋ o malisim. Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Kɛlli ka biis la kɛɛn m san'an na ka da kati baa, bɔzugɔ bamanam taab ka Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim la aan ba din.

english_verse: Jesus looked closely at the man. He liked him and said, “There's one thing you still need to do. Go sell everything you own. Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come with me.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu gɔs o, ka nɔŋ o, ka yɛl o ye, “Li kpɛlim bʋn yinne. Kem kuosi fʋ la'ad wʋsa ka zaŋ ligidi la tis nɔŋ dim ka nyaan kena dɔl man. Ala ka fʋ na nyɛ kpan'am arezana ni.”

english_verse: When the man heard Jesus say this, he went away gloomy and sad because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Ka on wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la, o sʋnf san'amnɛ hali ka o lɔ nindaa keŋ, bɔzugɔ o da mɔr kpan'am hali.

english_verse: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “It's hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu gɔs o nya'andɔlib la gilig ka yɛli ba ye, “Li tɔi hali nɛ banɛ mɔr areza'as la na kpɛn' Wina'am sʋ'ʋlimin.”

english_verse: The disciples were shocked to hear this. So Jesus told them again, “It's terribly hard to get into God's kingdom!
translation_verse: Ka o pian'ad la lidig o nya'andɔlib la. Ka Yesu lɛn yɛli ba ya'as ye, “M biisɛ, li tɔi hali ka sɔ' kpɛn' Wina'am sʋ'ʋlimin.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Li anɛ na'ana nɛ yʋgʋme na kpɛn' furipiim vɔɔnrin, gaad arezak daani na kpɛn' Wina'am sʋ'ʋlimin.”

english_verse: Jesus' disciples were even more amazed. They asked each other, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Ka ba ya'am iank hali bɛdegʋ. Ka ba bu'os taaba ye, “Ka li ya'a an ala, anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e nyɛ faangirɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus looked at them and said, “There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu gɔsi ba ka yɛli ba ye, “Li ya'a anɛ ninsaal nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ linɛ tɔi, amaa li pʋ tɔi tis Wina'am. Bɔzugɔ Wina'am san'an si'el mɛkama anɛ na'ana.”

translation_verse: Ka Simeon kaanb nɔsʋŋʋ niŋi ba zug ka yɛl Mɛɛri onɛ an biig la ma la ye, “Gɔsima, Wina'am gaŋ bikaŋa ye o kɛ ka Israel dim bɛdegʋ lu, ka bɛdegʋ mɛ dʋ. Onɛ an zanbin ka Wina'am tis na, ka nidib bɛdegʋ na ti zan'as o,

english_verse: and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.” Anna Speaks about the Child Jesus
translation_verse: ka linɛ ka ba su'a ba pʋtɛnda ni na nie paalʋ. Ka fʋn mɛŋ na paam sʋnsa'aŋ hali pamm.”

english_verse: The prophet Anna was also there in the temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. In her youth she had been married for seven years, but her husband died.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la mɛn, ka Wina'am nɔdi'es pu'ak mɛ daa bɛ ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Anna, ka o ba' yʋ'ʋr buon Panuel, onɛ an Aser dɔɔg nid la. On daa an pu'asadir la ka o kul sidi paae yʋma ayɔpɔi ka o sid la kpi.

english_verse: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free. The Return to Nazareth
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka o kena ye o pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka, ka tu'asid biig la yɛla tisid banɛ wʋsa gu'usid saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am na lɛn di'e Jerusalem teŋi lɛbisi tisi ba la.

english_verse: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
translation_verse: Ka Josef nɛ Mɛɛri naae linɛ wʋsa ka Zugsɔb la zi'eli ba la, ba lɛbi kul Nazaret teŋin linɛ bɛ Galile sʋ'ʋlimin la.

english_verse: The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him. The Boy Jesus in the Temple
translation_verse: Ka biig la nɔbig ka mɔr paŋ nɛ ya'am, ka Wina'am yɛlsʋm bɛɛ o zug. Yesu daa an biig ka kpɛlim Jerusalem la

english_verse: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover.
translation_verse: Yʋʋm-yʋʋm ka Yesu ba' nɛ o ma ken Jerusalem Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ la saŋa.

english_verse: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu daa an yʋma pii nɛ ayi' la, ka ba keŋ malʋŋ la wʋʋ ban ɛɛnti niŋid si'em la.

english_verse: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.
translation_verse: Ka malʋŋ la dabisa naae la, ka ba lɛbidi kun. Ka Yesu kpɛlim Jerusalem teŋin ka o ba' nɛ o ma pʋ baŋ ye o kpɛlim yaa.

english_verse: They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him.
translation_verse: Ba daa tɛn'ɛs ye o dɔlnɛ ba teŋ dim la, ka keŋ dabis mum ken. Ka ban iee o ba du'adib nɛ ba zuanam san'an ka pʋ nyɛɛ o la,

english_verse: Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.
translation_verse: Daba atan' daar ka ba nyɛɛ o Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, ka o zin' nɛ pa'annib la kɛlisid ka bu'osidi ba bu'osa.

english_verse: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
translation_verse: Ka ban wʋsa daa wʋm la daa tɛn'ɛsid hali o baŋir nɛ o ya'am lɛbisa la zug.

english_verse: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
translation_verse: Ka li lidig o ba' nɛ o ma ban nyɛɛ o la. Ka o ma bu'os o ye, “M biiga, bɔ ka fʋ niŋi ti wala? Man nɛ fʋ ba' ieef hali nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbisi ba ye, “Bɔ ka ya ieedi ma? Ya zi' ye li sʋ'ʋm ye m bɛɛ m Ba' yinnɛɛ?”

english_verse: But they did not understand what he meant.
translation_verse: Ka ba pʋ baŋ o pian'ad la gbinnɛ.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu dɔlli ba kul Nazaret teŋin, ka siaki ba nɔɔr. Ka o ma su'a yɛlbama wʋsa o sʋʋnrin.

english_verse: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu nɔbig ka mɔr ya'am ka Wina'am nɛ nidib kaanb sʋŋ bɛɛ o zugin.

english_verse: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Ka lampɔdi'esidib mɛ kena ye o sʋʋ ba Wina'am ku'om, ka bu'os o ye, “Pa'anna, ti na niŋ wala?”

english_verse: Do something to show that you really have given up your sins. Don't start saying you belong to Abraham's family. God can turn these stones into children for Abraham.
translation_verse: Tʋmmi tʋʋm banɛ pa'an ye ya tiaki ya sʋnya, ka da tɛn'ɛsid ye Abraham anɛ ya yaaba. Ka m yɛti ya ye, Wina'am tun'e zaŋ kuga nwa' maal yaasi tis Abraham.

english_verse: But to Herod the ruler, he said, “It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife.” John also said Herod had done many other bad things.
translation_verse: Amaa Joon da pian' zɛrig Na'ab Herod, on da faaɛn o mɛŋ bier pu'a onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Herodias n di hali ka tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sieba bɛdegʋ la zug.

english_verse: Annas and Caiaphas were the Jewish high priests. At that time God spoke to Zechariah's son John, who was living in the desert.
translation_verse: Ka Annas nɛ Kaifas an Wina'am maanmaannib kpɛɛmnam. Saŋa kan la ka Wina'am pian'ad kɛn Joon onɛ an Zakaria biig la san'an mɔɔgin na.

english_verse: Isaiah the prophet wrote about John when he said, “In the desert someone is shouting, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ din da sɔb Azaya onɛ an nɔdi'es la gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Sɔ' bɛ mɔɔgini mɔɔn ye, ‘Maalimi suori tis Zugsɔb la; maalim suoraugʋ tisi ti Wina'am la: kɛl ka li an sappi mɔɔgin la tis o.

english_verse: Fill up every valley and level every mountain and hill. Straighten the crooked paths and smooth out the rough roads.
translation_verse: Pɛ'ɛlimi bʋmbu'ad wʋsa ka li dʋ. Birigimi zuoya nɛ kʋkʋna wʋsa ka li sig. Maalimi suobanɛ ka' sʋm la ka ba lieb sassi, ka maal suogɔnlima nɛ zin'ibanɛ ka' sʋm la ka li an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Then everyone will see the saving power of God.’ ”
translation_verse: Wina'am faangir pipilim la na nie ka ninsaalib wʋsa nyɛɛ li.’”

english_verse: Crowds of people came out to be baptized, but John said to them, “You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Ka nidib bɛdegʋ la'asi kɛɛn o san'an na ye o sʋʋ ba Wina'am ku'om. Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Yanam banɛ nwɛnɛ wiigi nwa', anɔ'ɔn yɛli ya ye ya zɔm yi Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn linɛ kenna la ni?

english_verse: The crowds asked John, “What should we do?”
translation_verse: Ka nidib la bɛdegʋ bu'os o ye, “Ti na niŋ wala?”

english_verse: Some soldiers asked him, “And what about us? What do we have to do?” John told them, “Don't force people to pay money to make you leave them alone. Be satisfied with your pay.”
translation_verse: Ka soogianam mɛ bu'os o ye, “Ka tinama, ti na niŋ wala?” Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Da di'e sɔ' bʋn nɛ paŋa, bɛɛ gban'e nidib zaalim-zaalim, ka di'e si'ela. Kɛlli ka ya yɔɔd la siaki ya.”

english_verse: John said, “I am just baptizing with water. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
translation_verse: Ka Joon lɛbisi ba ye, “Man sʋʋdi ya nɛ Wina'am ku'om, amaa sɔ' bɛɛ mɔr paŋi gat man, onɛ kenna ka m pʋ nar ye m pidig o ta'adaa. O na sʋʋ ya nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi nɛ bugum.

english_verse: In many different ways John preached the good news to the people.
translation_verse: Pian'ad bɛdegʋ nwa' ka Joon da zaŋi sa'al nidib on da mɔɔn Wina'am labasʋŋ la.

english_verse: Finally, Herod put John in jail, and this was the worst thing he had done. The Baptism of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Li ba'as bɛ'ɛd anɛ Herod n da gban'e Joon kpɛn'ɛs sanrega ni la. Yesu Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb la yɛla

english_verse: While everyone else was being baptized, Jesus himself was baptized. Then as he prayed, the sky opened up,
translation_verse: Joon da sʋʋd nidib wʋsa Wina'am ku'om la, o daa sʋ Yesu Wina'am ku'om mɛn. On da sʋʋ naae la ka sɔsid Wina'am ka arezana yɔ'ɔg,

english_verse: and the Holy Spirit came down upon him in the form of a dove. A voice from heaven said, “You are my own dear Son, and I am pleased with you.” The Ancestors of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la sig o zugin na, ka ba nyɛ ka li nwɛnɛ dawan nɛ. Ka kʋkɔr yi arezana na ye, “Fʋ anɛ m binɔŋir ka m nini tigif hali.” Yesu Kristo yaanam la yɛla

english_verse: Enosh, and Seth. The family of Jesus went all the way back to Adam and then to God.
translation_verse: ka Keenan saam an Enos, ka Enos saam an Set, ka Set saam an Adam, ka Adam saam an Wina'am.

english_verse: After the sun had set, people with all kinds of diseases were brought to Jesus. He put his hands on each one of them and healed them.
translation_verse: Ka winnigi kpɛn'ɛd la ka ba mɔr ban'adnam banɛ wiim an kɔn'ɔb kɔn'ɔbi kɛn Yesu san'an na, ka o pa'al o nu'usi ba yinne-yinne zugin ti'ebi ba.

english_verse: The devil said to Jesus, “If you are God's Son, tell this stone to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Ka Sʋntaana yɛl o ye, “Fʋ ya'a an Wina'am Biig fʋn yɛlim kuga nwa' ka li kilim diib.”

english_verse: Then the devil led Jesus up to a high place and quickly showed him all the nations on earth.
translation_verse: Ka Sʋntaana mɔr o keŋ dʋ zuor zug ka pa'al o dunia sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa.

english_verse: Just worship me, and you can have it all.”
translation_verse: Dinzug fʋ ya'a siaki zun'e man, li wʋsa na niŋi fʋ din.”

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus to Jerusalem and had him stand on top of the temple. The devil said, “If you are God's Son, jump off.
translation_verse: Ka Sʋntaana lɛn dɔl o keŋ Jerusalem dʋ'ʋs o Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zug, ka yɛl o ye, “Fʋ ya'a an Wina'am Biig, fʋn basimi fʋ mɛŋi luna;

english_verse: He taught in the Jewish synagogues, and everyone praised him. The People of Nazareth Turn against Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ka o zamisi ba la'asʋg dɔɔdin ka ba wʋsa pian' o yɛla sʋ'ʋm. Ba zan'as Yesu Nazaret teŋin (Mat

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and as usual he went to the synagogue on the Sabbath. When he stood up to read from the Scriptures,
translation_verse: Ka Yesu keŋ Nazaret, ban da ugus o teŋ si'a la. Ka Jew dim Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar, ka o kpɛn' la'asʋg dɔɔgin wʋʋ on ɛɛnti kpɛn'ɛd si'em la, ka duoe zi'en ye o karim.

english_verse: “The Lord's Spirit has come to me, because he has chosen me to tell the good news to the poor. The Lord has sent me to announce freedom for prisoners, to give sight to the blind, to free everyone who suffers,
translation_verse: “Zugsɔb Siig la bɛɛ m ni, bɔzugɔ o gaŋim ye m mɔɔl labasʋŋ la tis nɔŋ dim. O tʋmim ye m mɔɔl yɔlisim yɛla tis banɛ bɛ sanrega ni la, ka nie zʋnzɔɔs nini, ka yis banɛ bɛ namisʋg pʋʋgin la bas,

english_verse: and to say, ‘This is the year the Lord has chosen.’ ”
translation_verse: ka mɔɔl saŋkan ka Zugsɔb na zɔ nidib nimbaanlig ka di'e ba.”

english_verse: Jesus closed the book, then handed it back to the man in charge and sat down. Everyone in the synagogue looked straight at Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka o kpilim gbauŋ la lɛbisi tis onɛ gur gbana la, ka zin'in. Ka nimbanɛ wʋsa bɛ la'asʋg dɔɔgin la gɔsid o kii.

english_verse: All the people started talking about Jesus and were amazed at the wonderful things he said. They kept on asking, “Isn't he Joseph's son?”
translation_verse: Ka ba pian' taaba o pian'asʋma la yɛla, ka bu'osid ye, “Li ka' Josef biig la nwaa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: You will certainly want to tell me this saying, “Doctor, first make yourself well.” You will tell me to do the same things here in my own hometown that you heard I did in Capernaum.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “M mi' ye ya na siilim siiliŋ kaŋa ye, ‘Tiim daana, ti'ebimi fʋ mɛŋ.’ Ka lɛn yɛl ye, ‘Bʋn lin ka fʋ daa niŋ Kapeenum teŋin ka ti wʋm la, niŋimi li fʋ mɛŋ teŋin kpɛla mɛn.’”

english_verse: But you can be sure that no prophets are liked by the people of their own hometown.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛl ye, “Amɛŋa ka m yɛti ya ye, Wina'am nɔdi'es baa yinne kʋ nyɛ pian'asʋŋ o mɛŋ teŋinɛ.

english_verse: Once during the time of Elijah there was no rain for three and a half years, and people everywhere were starving. There were many widows in Israel,
translation_verse: Amaa li anɛ amɛŋa ka m yɛti ya ye, pʋkɔnya bɛdegʋ da bɛ Israel teŋin Elaja saŋa la, ka saa pʋ nii yʋma atan' nɛ nwadis ayuobʋ, ka kɔ'ɔm tita'ar lu teŋin la wʋsa.

english_verse: but Elijah was sent only to a widow in the town of Zarephath near the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am pʋ tʋm Elaja ye o keŋ pʋkɔnbama la san'anɛ. Ka lɛɛ tʋm o nɛ pʋkɔɔnr yinne onɛ bɛ Zarefat teŋ linɛ bɛ Sidon sʋ'ʋlimin la.

english_verse: During the time of the prophet Elisha, many men in Israel had leprosy. But no one was healed, except Naaman who lived in Syria.
translation_verse: Ka kʋkɔma bɛdegʋ da bɛ Israel teŋin Elasia saŋa la, amaa baa yinne pʋ nyɛ laafi, asɛɛ Naaman onɛ yi Siriya sʋ'ʋlim la gʋllim nyɛ laafi.”

english_verse: But Jesus slipped through the crowd and got away. A Man with an Evil Spirit (Mark
translation_verse: Amaa ka o kpɛn bʋŋ nidib la sʋʋginɛ gaadi keŋ. Dau kanɛ ka kikirig dɔl o la yɛla (Mak

english_verse: Jesus went to the town of Capernaum in Galilee and taught the people on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu da keŋ Kapeenum teŋ kanɛ bɛ Galile sʋ'ʋlimin la. Ka Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar paae ka o pin'ili pa'an nidib la.

english_verse: His teaching amazed them because he spoke with power.
translation_verse: Ka on daa pa'annɛ ba si'em la lidigi ba, bɔzugɔ, pa'alʋg la daa mɔr paŋ hali.

english_verse: There in the synagogue was a man with an evil spirit. He yelled out,
translation_verse: Ka dau daa bɛ la'asʋg dɔɔgin la ka kikirig dɔl o. Ka o tans nɛ kʋkɔr tita'ar

english_verse: They all were amazed and kept saying to each other, “What kind of teaching is this? He has power to order evil spirits out of people!”
translation_verse: Ka ba wʋsa lidigi yɛt taaba ye, “Abɔ pa'alʋgʋ nwa'? Bɔzugɔ o mɔr paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ ka tansid kikiris ka ba yit.”

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Many People (Matthew
translation_verse: Ka o labaar gilig teŋkpɛmisin wʋsa. Yesu ti'eb nidib bɛdegʋ la yɛla (Mat

english_verse: Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simon's home. When Jesus got there, he was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick with a high fever.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu duoe yi la'asʋg dɔɔgin la kpɛn' Simon yir. Ka Simon diempu'a bɛn'ɛd ka o niŋgbina tʋl. Ka ba pian' o yɛla tis Yesu.

english_verse: Demons went out of many people and shouted, “You are the Son of God!” But Jesus ordered the demons not to speak because they knew he was the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ka kikiris mɛ yi sieba ni bɛdegʋ na tansid ye, “Fʋ anɛ Wina'am Biig.” Ka Yesu tansi ba ka pʋ siak ye ba pian' si'el si'ela ban da baŋ ye o anɛ Kristo onɛ an Faangid la zug. Yesu mɔɔn Wina'am labasʋŋ la (Mak

english_verse: The next morning Jesus went out to a place where he could be alone, and crowds came looking for him. When they found him, they tried to stop him from leaving.
translation_verse: Ka bɛog nie ka Yesu yi tempʋʋgin la keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka sɔ' kae. Ka nidib la bɛdegʋ iee o hali ti nyɛɛ o, ka mɔɔd ye o da lɛn yii ba san'anɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “People in other towns must hear the good news about God's kingdom. This is why I was sent.”
translation_verse: Amaa ka o yɛli ba ye, “Asɛɛ ka m mɔɔl Wina'am labasʋŋ la teŋ sieba ni mɛn, ka lin yɛla ka Wina'am tʋm mam na.”

english_verse: So he kept on preaching in the synagogues in Judea.
translation_verse: Ala ka o mɔɔn labasʋŋ la Juda sʋ'ʋlimin la'asʋg dɔɔdin.

english_verse: But Jesus would often go to some place where he could be alone and pray. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Walk (Matthew
translation_verse: Amaa o ɛɛnti ken zin'ikan ka nidib kae la sɔsid Wina'am. Yesu ti'eb pɔn'ɔr (Mat

english_verse: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, “My friend, your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu nyɛ banɛ ziid pɔn'ɔr la niŋ o yadda si'em la, ka yɛl pɔn'ɔr la ye, “M zua, m kɛɛ fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd taali bas.”

english_verse: Jesus got into the boat that belonged to Simon and asked him to row it out a little way from the shore. Then Jesus sat down in the boat to teach the crowd.
translation_verse: Ka o kpɛn' anrʋŋ yinne ni linɛ an Simon din ka yɛl o ye, “Da'ami li ka li keŋ bi'ela.” Ka o niŋ ala. Ka Yesu zin'in anrʋŋ la pʋʋgini pa'an nidib la.

english_verse: “Master,” Simon answered, “we have worked hard all night long and have not caught a thing. But if you tell me to, I will let the nets down.”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “Zugsɔba, ti namisnɛ yʋ'ʋŋ sa ka pʋ gban'e si'ela, amaa fʋn yɛl la zug m na lɔbi m sau la.”

english_verse: They did this and caught so many fish that their nets began ripping apart.
translation_verse: Ka ba niŋ ala ka gban'e zimi bɛdegʋ hali ka ba saunam la bɔɔd aansig.

english_verse: Then they signaled for their partners in the other boat to come and help them. The men came, and together they filled the two boats so full that they both began to sink.
translation_verse: Ka ba amisi buoli ba taaba anrʋŋ yinne la ni ye ba kena sʋŋi ba. Ka ba kena sʋŋi ba, ka ba pɛ'ɛl anrima ayi' la wʋsa nɛ zimi hali ka ba bɔɔd simmʋg.

english_verse: His partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were surprised too. Jesus told Simon, “Don't be afraid! From now on you will bring in people instead of fish.”
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka li da lidig Zebedee biis Jemes nɛ Joon banɛ da an Simon tʋmtʋm taaba la. Ka Yesu yɛl Simon ye, “Da zɔt dabiem, ka nannanna wa'ae sa, fʋ na mɔr nidib na ka ba dɔl mam nwɛnɛ fʋn daa gban'ad zimi si'em la.”

english_verse: The men pulled their boats up on the shore. Then they left everything and went with Jesus. Jesus Heals a Man (Matthew
translation_verse: Ka ba mɔr anrima la dʋ'ʋs gʋʋr, ka bas si'el wʋsa ka dɔl Yesu. Yesu ti'eb kʋkɔm la yɛla (Mat

english_verse: News about Jesus kept spreading. Large crowds came to listen to him teach and to be healed of their diseases.
translation_verse: Amaa Yesu labaar la daa lɛn yadig bɛdegʋ ka nidib bɛdegʋ kena ye ba kɛlis o pian'ad ka o ti'ebi ba wiim la.

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they went up on the roof, where they removed some tiles and let the mat down in the middle of the room.
translation_verse: Ka nidib la muk la zug ka ba pʋ nyaŋi nyɛ paalʋ mɔr o kpɛn'ɛɛ, ka zii o dʋ mɔpil la zugin kibig vɔɔnri sigis o nɛ o sɔŋ la nidib la sʋʋgini digil o Yesu tuon.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the experts began arguing, “Jesus must think he is God! Only God can forgive sins.”
translation_verse: Ka wada pa'annib la nɛ Farisii dim pin'ili bu'osid taaba ye, “Anɔ'ɔnɛ nwa' pian'adi san'amid Wina'am yʋ'ʋrɛ? Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi kɛ nidib tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi basɛ? Li ka'anɛ Wina'am gʋllim nɛ?”

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?
translation_verse: Bɔɔ an na'ana? Man na yɛl ye, ‘M kɛɛ fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd taali bas, bɛɛ duom keŋɛ?’

english_verse: But now you will see that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” Jesus then said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk home.”
translation_verse: Ala ka ya na baŋ ye Ninsaal Biig mɔr paŋ dunia nwa' ni na kɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd taali bas.” Ka o yɛl pɔn'ɔr la ye, “Duom zaŋi fʋ sɔŋ la kul.”
