translation_verse: Ka ti daa mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye onɛ na faaɛn Israel dim la. Amaa li anɛ daba atan' zina, ka yɛl kaŋa nwa' maal.

english_verse: Some women in our group surprised us. They had gone to the tomb early in the morning,
translation_verse: Ka pu'a sieba banɛ bɛɛ ti san'an la, kɛ ka ti lidig hali. Ba isigi keŋ yaʋgʋn la,

english_verse: Some men from our group went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said. But they didn't see Jesus either.
translation_verse: Ka ti ninsieba mɛ keŋ yaʋgʋn la, ka nyɛ ka li anɛ wʋʋ pu'ab la yɛl si'em la. Ka ba mɛ pʋ nyɛ oo.”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the two disciples, “Why can't you understand? How can you be so slow to believe all that the prophets said?
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “Zɔn nɛ ya'am pɔɔdim dima, bɔ ka ya pʋ niŋ Wina'am nɔdi'esidib la da yɛl si'el la wʋsa yadda?

english_verse: Didn't you know that the Messiah would have to suffer before he was given his glory?”
translation_verse: Li pʋ nar ye Kristo namis nɛ yɛlbama nwa' wʋsa, ka naan yʋ'ʋn dii o na'am laa?”

english_verse: Jesus then explained everything written about himself in the Scriptures, beginning with the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets.
translation_verse: Ka o pin'ili pa'annɛ ba o mɛŋ yɛla, wʋʋ Moses nɛ Wina'am nɔdi'esidib wʋsa da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋ pʋʋgin si'em la.

english_verse: They begged him, “Stay with us! It's already late, and the sun is going down.” So Jesus went into the house to stay with them.
translation_verse: Ka ba sɔs o ye, “Dɔlli ti keŋ gbɛn, bɔzugɔ zaam ma'anɛ ka yʋ'ʋŋ bɔɔd sɔb.” Ka o siak, ka dɔlli ba.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down to eat, he took some bread. He blessed it and broke it. Then he gave it to them.
translation_verse: Ka ban daa zin'in ye ba di la, o daa zaŋ bodobodo pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka, ka gbin'esi tisi ba.

english_verse: At once they knew who he was, but he disappeared.
translation_verse: Ka ba ya'am yʋ'ʋn nie, ka ba baŋ on an sɔ'. Ka o kpɛm mɛlimi ba tuon.

english_verse: They said to each other, “When he talked with us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us, didn't it warm our hearts?”
translation_verse: Ka ba bu'os taaba ye, “On pa'a pian'ad nɛ ti ka tu'asid linɛ bɛ Wina'am gbauŋ la suorin la, li pʋ niŋi ti sʋnya malisim hali?”

english_verse: So they got up and returned to Jerusalem. The two disciples found the eleven apostles and the others gathered together.
translation_verse: Ka ba duoe saŋkan la lɛb Jerusalem nyɛɛ o nya'andɔlib pii nɛ yinne nɛ banɛ bɛɛ ba san'an la, ka ba pʋn la'as taaba sa,

english_verse: And they learned from the group that the Lord was really alive and had appeared to Peter.
translation_verse: ka yɛt ye, “Amɛŋa, Zugsɔb la vʋ'ʋgya, ka nie o mɛŋi pa'al Simon.”

english_verse: Then the disciples from Emmaus told what happened on the road and how they knew he was the Lord when he broke the bread. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Ka ba nidib ayi' la mɛ tu'asi ba bʋn linɛ maal suorin la nɛ on gbin'es bodobodo la si'em, ka ba baŋ o la. Yesu nie o mɛŋ o nya'andɔlib san'an la yɛla (Mat

english_verse: While Jesus' disciples were talking about what had happened, Jesus appeared and greeted them.
translation_verse: Ka ban nam bɛ anina pian'ad nɛ'ɛŋa la, ka Yesu mɛŋ zi'eni ba sʋʋgin ka yɛli ba ye, “Sumalisim bɛ nɛ ya!”

english_verse: They were frightened and terrified because they thought they were seeing a ghost.
translation_verse: Ka ba yirig hali ka li lidigi ba ka ba tɛn'ɛs ye, ba nyɛnɛ silinsiiug.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Why are you so frightened? Why do you doubt?
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Bɔ ka li paki ya ka ya mɔri bi'esʋg pʋtɛnda ya sʋnya ni?

english_verse: Look at my hands and my feet and see who I am! Touch me and find out for yourselves. Ghosts don't have flesh and bones as you see I have.”
translation_verse: Gɔsimini m nu'us nɛ m nɔbpansimpana, ka baŋ ye manɛ la. Si'isiminimɛ gɔsi, silinsiiug mɔr niŋgbiŋ nɛ kɔnba wʋʋ yanamɛ nyɛɛm ka m an si'em laa?”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
translation_verse: Ka on pian' nɛ'ɛŋa naae la ka nɔk o nu'us nɛ o nɔbpansimpana pa'ali ba.

english_verse: The disciples were so glad and amazed that they could not believe it. Jesus then asked them, “Do you have something to eat?”
translation_verse: Ka ban nam bi'esid bʋnnyalima linɛ ka ba nyɛ ka li lidigi ba ka mɛ ma'ae ba sʋnya la zug, ka o bu'osi ba ye, “Ya mɔr si'eli na dii?”

english_verse: They gave him a piece of broiled fish.
translation_verse: Ka ba zaŋ ziiŋdʋgida tis o,

english_verse: He took it and ate it as they watched.
translation_verse: ka o nɔki lii ɔnbi ba nini ni.

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “While I was still with you, I told you that everything written about me in the Law of Moses, the Books of the Prophets, and in the Psalms had to happen.”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Pian'abama nwa' aan m pian'ʋk ka m daa pian' tisi ya mam daa nam bɛ nɛ ya la ye, lin wʋsa sɔbi m yɛla ka bɛ Moses wada gbana ni nɛ Wina'am nɔdi'esidib gbana ni nɛ yʋʋma gbana ni la niŋ sida.”

english_verse: He told them: The Scriptures say that the Messiah must suffer, then three days later he will rise from death.
translation_verse: O yɛli ba ye, “Ala ka li sɔb ye, Kristo la na namis ka daba atan' daar ka o vʋ'ʋg kumin.

english_verse: They also say that all people of every nation must be told in my name to turn to God, in order to be forgiven. So beginning in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ka ye o yʋ'ʋrin ka mɔɔnmɔɔnib na pin'il Jerusalem mɔɔli tis buudi wʋsa ye ba tiakim ka Wina'am na yisi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas.

english_verse: you must tell everything that has happened.
translation_verse: Ya nyɛ nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa ka na dii li kasɛt.

english_verse: I will send you the one my Father has promised, but you must stay in the city until you are given power from heaven. Jesus Returns to Heaven (Mark
translation_verse: M na tʋmi m Ba' zi'el nɔɔr sɔ' yɛla la tisi ya, amaa bɛɛi tempʋʋgin la ti paae saŋa kan ka ya na pɛ'ɛl nɛ onɛ bɛ saazug la paŋ.” Yesu kpɛn' arezana ni la yɛla (Mak

english_verse: Jesus led his disciples out to Bethany, where he raised his hands and blessed them.
translation_verse: Ka o dɔlli ba laligi paae wʋʋ Betani, ka ʋk o nu'us agɔla ka niŋi ba bareka.

english_verse: As he was doing this, he left and was taken up to heaven.
translation_verse: Ka on niŋidi ba bareka la ka kpɛn dʋt arezana ni ka basi ba.

english_verse: After his disciples had worshiped him, they returned to Jerusalem and were very happy.
translation_verse: Ka ba pʋ'ʋs o ka lɛb Jerusalem nɛ sumalisim bɛdegʋ,

english_verse: They spent their time in the temple, praising God.
translation_verse: ka kpɛm bɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la daar wʋsa tisid Wina'am bareka pʋ'ʋsim.

english_verse: From the very beginning the Word was with God.
translation_verse: Hali pin'ilʋgʋn sa Pian'ad la da bɛnɛ nɛ Wina'am.

english_verse: received its life from him, and his life gave light to everyone.
translation_verse: O san'an ka nyɔvʋr bɛ, ka nyɔvʋr la tis saalib nɛɛsim.

english_verse: The light keeps shining in the dark, and darkness has never put it out.
translation_verse: Ka nɛɛsim la nie nyain likin ka lik la pʋ nyaŋi kpiisi lii.

english_verse: God sent a man named John,
translation_verse: Wina'am da tʋm dau sɔ' ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Joon.

english_verse: who came to tell about the light and to lead all people to have faith.
translation_verse: O da kena ye o tu'as nidib nɛɛsim la yɛla. Ka li na yinɛ o san'an na ka nidib wʋsa niŋ Pian'ad la yadda.

english_verse: The true light that shines on everyone was coming into the world.
translation_verse: Yɛlmɛŋir nɛɛsim linɛ nied nyain tisid saalib wʋsa la da ken dunia nwa' ni na.

english_verse: The Word was in the world, but no one knew him, though God had made the world with his Word.
translation_verse: O da bɛ dunia ni, ka an onɛ maal dunia la, hali la'an nɛ wala dunia dim da pʋ baŋ oo.

english_verse: He came into his own world, but his own nation did not welcome him.
translation_verse: O kenɛ o mɛŋ teŋin na ka o mɛŋ teŋ dim pʋ di'e oo.

english_verse: They were not God's children by nature or because of any human desires. God himself was the one who made them his children.
translation_verse: Ba da lieb Wina'am biis ka li pʋ nwɛnɛ ninsaalibi du'ad si'em bɛɛ ninsaal bɔɔdim an si'em, amaa Wina'am mɛŋi aan ba Ba'.

english_verse: The Word became a human being and lived here with us. We saw his true glory, the glory of the only Son of the Father. From him the complete gifts of undeserved grace and truth have come down to us.
translation_verse: Ka Pian'ad la da lieb ninsaal ka bɛ nɛ ti. Ka ti nyɛɛ o na'am girima linɛ nie ti san'an ka nar nɛ on kanɛ aan ti Ba' Wina'am biyimmir la. O ni ka yɛlsʋm nɛ sida bɛ.

english_verse: Because of all that the Son is, we have been given one blessing after another.
translation_verse: Ka li yinɛ o albareka tita'arin ka ti wʋsa di'e o pʋpielim piini la yinne-yinne.

english_verse: Then when they asked him if he were Elijah, he said, “No, I am not!” And when they asked if he were the Prophet, he also said “No!”
translation_verse: Ka ba bu'os o ye, “Ka fʋ aan anɔ'ɔnɛ? Fʋ anɛ Elaja bɛɛ?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Ayei.” Ka ba lɛm bu'os o ye, “Ka fʋ anɛ Wina'am nɔdi'es la bɛɛ?” Ka o lɛn lɛbis ye, “Ayei.”

english_verse: Finally, they said, “Who are you then? We have to give an answer to the ones who sent us. Tell us who you are!”
translation_verse: Ka ba lɛm bu'os o ya'as ye, “Ka fʋ aan anɔ'ɔn bɛ? Tisimi ti lɛbiskan ka ti na tis banɛ tʋmi ti la na. Fʋ aan anɔ'ɔn kimm nɛ?”

english_verse: John answered in the words of the prophet Isaiah, “I am only someone shouting in the desert, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord!’ ”
translation_verse: Ka Joon lɛbisi ba nwɛnɛ Wina'am nɔdi'es Azaya da sɔb si'em la ye, “Manɛ an onɛ bɛ mɔɔgini mɔɔn ye, ‘Maalimi suor la ka li an sappi tis Zugsɔb la.’”

english_verse: Some Pharisees had also been sent to John.
translation_verse: Banɛ bu'os o la yinɛ Farisii dimin na,

english_verse: They asked him, “Why are you baptizing people, if you are not the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet?”
translation_verse: ka bu'os o ye, “Fʋ ya'a ka' Kristo la, ka ka' Elaja, ka ka' Wina'am nɔdi'es la, ka bɔ ka fʋ sʋʋd nidib la Wina'am ku'om?”

english_verse: John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.
translation_verse: Ka Joon lɛbis ye, “Mam sʋʋdi ya nɛ Wina'am ku'om, amaa sɔ' bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin ka ya zi' o.

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: O anɛ onɛ dɔlli m nya'aŋ na ka lɛɛ gatim, hali ka li pʋ nar ye m pidig o ta'adaa.”

english_verse: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany. The Lamb of God
translation_verse: Linɛ sɔb nwa' da niŋnɛ Betani teŋin Joodan mu'ar nya'aŋ, zin'ikanɛ ka Joon da sʋʋd nidib Wina'am ku'om la. Wina'am Pɛbil

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: Ka bɛog nie ka Joon nyɛ ka Yesu kenna, ka o yɛl ye, “Gɔsimi Wina'am Pɛbil onɛ yisid dunia tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi basid la.

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Oŋa ka m yɛl ye, ‘Sɔ' bɛɛ m nya'aŋi kenna, ka onɛ mɔr kpi'euŋʋ gatim la, bɔzugɔ, o da bɛ ka m kae.’

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: M da pʋ baŋ on an sɔ', amaa linɛ yɛla ka m da sʋʋd nidib Wina'am ku'om la anɛ ye li nie pa'al Israel dim ka ba baŋ o.”

english_verse: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.
translation_verse: Ka Joon yɛl ye, “M nyɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi naan arezana ni sigid na nwɛnɛ dawan nɛ zuon o zugin ka kpɛlim o ni.

english_verse: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: M daa zi' o, amaa Wina'am onɛ tʋmim na ye m sʋ nidib Wina'am ku'om la pa'alim ye, ‘Onɛ ka fʋ nyɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la sig o ni na ka kpɛlim la an onɛ sʋʋd nidib nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la.’

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: M nyɛɛ li ka dii li kasɛt ye onɛ an Wina'am Biig la.” Yesu yiiga nya'andɔlib la yɛla

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: Ka bɛog lɛn nie ka Joon da zi'e nɛ o nya'andɔlib ayi' ya'as.

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: Ka on nyɛ Yesu gat la ka o gɔs o ka ye, “Gɔsimi, oŋa an Wina'am Pɛbil la.”

english_verse: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka nya'andɔliba ayi' la wʋm la, ka dɔl Yesu.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu gi'e nyɛ ban dɔl o la ka bu'osi ba ye, “Ya bɔɔd bɔ?” Ka ba lɛbis o ye, “Rabbi,” “Fʋ gbɛɛnd yaa ni?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “Kemi na gɔsi.” Ka ba keŋ nyɛ on bɛ si'el, ka gbɛɛn o san'an daakan, bɔzugɔ li da anɛ winkɔɔr.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Nidiba ayi' banɛ wʋm Yesu pian'ad ka dɔl o la yinne yʋ'ʋri buon Andrew ka an Simon Pita ba'abiig.

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: Ka linɛ ka Andrew da niŋ yiiga anɛ, o keŋnɛ ie Pita ka yɛl o ye, “Ti nyɛ Mazaya la”

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: Ka o dɔl o kɛn Yesu san'an na, ka Yesu gɔs o ka ye, “Fʋ anɛ Joon biig Simon. Ba na buonif ye Kefas.” . Yesu buol Filip nɛ Nataniel

english_verse: Philip then found Nathanael and said, “We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Ka Filip nyɛ Nataniel ka yɛl o ye, “Ti nyɛ onɛ ka Moses da sɔb o yɛla, ka Wina'am nɔdi'esidib mɛ da sɔb la, onɛ an Josef biig Yesu onɛ yi Nazaret la.”

english_verse: Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip answered, “Come and see.”
translation_verse: Ka Nataniel bu'os o ye, “Bʋnsʋŋ si'a na nyaŋi yi Nazaret teŋin naa?” Ka Filip lɛbis o ye, “Kem na gɔs.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu nyɛ Nataniel ka o kenna la, ka o yɛl ye, “Gɔsimi, oŋa anɛ Israel nid amɛŋa ka pʋ mɔr taalɛ.”

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Ka Nataniel yɛl ye, “Fʋ niŋ wala baŋi ma?” Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “Saŋa kan ka fʋ pa'a bɛ kekaŋ gbinnin ka Filip buolif la, ka mam pʋn nyɛɛf.”

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Ka Nataniel yɛl ye, “Pa'anna, fʋ anɛ Wina'am biig, ka an Israel dim Na'ab.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Mam yɛl ye, m nyɛɛf ka fʋ bɛ kekaŋ gbinnin la zug ka fʋ niŋim yaddaa? Fʋ na nyɛ nyalim banɛ gat nɛ'ɛŋa.”

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Ka lɛn yɛl o ye, “Asida ka m yɛtif ye, fʋ na nyɛ ka arezana yɔ'ɔg ka Wina'am maliaknam dɔl Ninsaal Biig la san'anɛ dʋt ka sigid na.”

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: Ka daba atan' daar la ka pu'adiir di'ema daa bɛ Kana teŋin Galile sʋ'ʋlimin. Ka Yesu ma bɛɛ anina.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: Ka ba buol Yesu nɛ o nya'andɔlib ye ba kɛn di'ema la na.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: Ka ban nu daam pɔ'ɔg la, ka Yesu ma yɛl o ye, “Ba daam la naae nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “M ma, bɔ ka fʋ yɛt man linɛ ka m na maalɛ? M saŋa nam pʋ paae.”

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Ka o ma yɛl tʋmtʋmnib la ye, “Niŋimi on yɛli ya si'el wʋsa.”

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Jew dim malʋŋ linɛ an nu'ug pier la zug, ka ba mɔr kuga siins ayuobʋ anina ka siŋ wʋsa mɔr galamnam pisi bɛɛ pistan'.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “Pɛ'ɛlimi siins la nɛ ku'om.” Ka ba pɛ'ɛli ba hali ti paae nɔya bɛn.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Kabigim tisi onɛ gɔsid di'ema yɛla la.” Ka ba kabigi tis o.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: Ka onɛ gɔsid di'ema yɛla la pʋ baŋ lin yi si'el naa, amaa tʋmtʋmnib banɛ wik ku'om la mi'. Ka on lɛm daam la, ka buol pu'apaal sid la

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: yɛl o ye, “Sɔ' wʋsa tisidnɛ damalisiŋ di'ema pin'ilʋgʋn, ka ba ya'a ti nuu tig la ka ba yʋ'ʋn tisid danbɛ'ɛd. Amaa fʋn kpiank nɛ damalisiŋ la, hali ti paae nannanna.”

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Amaa Yesu daa pian'adnɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kanɛ aan o niŋgbiŋ la yɛla.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim malʋŋ linɛ an Kum Maliak Gaadʋg la da li'el ka Yesu keŋ Jerusalem

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Ka o nɔk nwiisi ʋgi li maal kpa'asiri kadi ba wʋsa nɛ ba pɛ'ɛs nɛ niigi yis Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la. Ka kpa'as nimbanɛ tia'asid ligidi la la'abaanlʋgʋ widig, ka lɛbigi ba teebulnam la.

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Ka o nya'andɔlib la tiɛn ye li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “M nini mu'oe nɛ Wina'am yir si'em la nwɛnɛ bugum dit man nɛ.”

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbisi ba ye, “San'ami Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kaŋa nwa' ka dabisa atan' daar ka m na duoe li zi'el.”

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”

translation_verse: Dinzug, on da kpi ka vʋ'ʋg kumin la o nya'andɔlib la da tiɛnya ye o da dɛŋi yɛl nɛ'. Ka ba niŋ Wina'am gbauŋ la yadda nɛ pian'akanɛ ka Yesu pian' la. Yesu n mi' linɛ bɛ saalib sʋnya ni la yɛla

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Farisii dim nid yinne da bɛ, ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Nikodemus. O da anɛ Jew dim kpɛɛm.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: Dau kaŋa da kɛn Yesu san'an yʋ'ʋŋ na yɛl ye, “Pa'anna, ti mi' ye fʋ anɛ pa'an onɛ yi Wina'am san'an na, bɔzugɔ sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi tʋm tʋʋm banɛ ka fʋ tʋm la ka li ya'a ka' Wina'am bɛɛ o sɔb nii.”

translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbisi yɛl o ye, “Amɛŋa mɛŋa ka m yɛtif ye, li ya'a ka' ba maligim du'af ya'asɛ, fʋ kʋ kpɛn' Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim la nii.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “Amɛŋa mɛŋa ka m yɛtif ye, ninkanɛ pʋ du'a nɛ ku'om nɛ Siiga, o kʋ nyaŋi kpɛn' Wina'am sʋ'ʋlimin laa.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Bʋn kanɛ du'a nɛ niŋgbiŋ anɛ niŋgbiŋ, ka bʋnkanɛ du'a nɛ Siig la anɛ siig.

translation_verse: Da kɛ ka li lidigif nɛ man yɛl ye, li sʋ'ʋm ka fʋ lɛn du'a la zugɔ.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Pɛbisim da'adi kennɛ lin bɔɔd si'el, ka fʋ wʋm lin vuud la, ka zi' lin yi zin'isi'a bɛɛ lin ken zin'isi'a. Onɛ du'a nɛ Siig mɛ anɛ ala.”

english_verse: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
translation_verse: Ka Nikodemus lɛbisi bu'os o ye, “Bʋn kaŋa na niŋ wala maalɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbisi bu'os o ye, “Fʋn anɛ Israel kpɛɛm onɛ pa'an nidib, ka zi' nwa'?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Amɛŋa mɛŋa ka m yɛtif ye, ti pian'adnɛ tinamɛ mi' si'el, ka di kasɛta tis tinamɛ nyɛ si'el. Amaa ya pʋ siaki ti pian'ad la.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: M ya'a yɛli ya dunia nwa' yɛla, ka ya pʋ siakɛ, wala ka m na yɛli ya arezana yɛla, ka ya siakɛ?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Sɔ' nan zi' dʋ arezana nii, asɛɛ onɛ yi arezana nii sig na la, onɛ an Ninsaal Biig la.

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ Moses n da bɛ mɔɔgin ka zaŋ waafʋ ʋk agɔl si'em la, ala mɛn ka ba na ʋk Ninsaal Biig la.

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ niŋ o yadda na nyɛ nyɔvʋr dinɛ ka' naarɛ.”

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Wina'am nɔŋ dunia hali ka tʋm o biyimmir la na. Ka onɛ niŋ o yadda la, kʋ bɔdigɛ, amaa o na nyɛ nyɔvʋr dinɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Alazug Wina'am pʋ tʋm o Biig dunia ni na ye o kʋʋs dunia dim bɛ'ɛdɛ, amaa ye dunia nyɛ faangir o ma'asim zug.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ niŋ o yadda la, ba kʋ kʋʋs o bɛ'ɛdɛ. Amaa onɛ pʋ niŋ o yadda la, Wina'am pʋn kʋʋs o nɛ bɛ'ɛd, on pʋ niŋ Wina'am biyimmir yadda la zug.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: On mɛkama tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kisnɛ nɛɛsim la bɛllim ka pʋ kennɛ li nii, o tʋʋma la na ti nie yɛla.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Amaa on mɛkama tʋm linɛ aan amɛŋa kennɛ nɛɛsim la ni na, ye o tʋʋm sʋma nie ka nidib baŋ ye li anɛ Wina'am tʋʋma. Yesu nɛ Joon la yɛla

translation_verse: Ka nɔŋgbannwa'ar yi Joon nya'andɔlibin nɛ Jew dim nid yinne Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb yɛla.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Ka ba kɛn Joon san'an na yɛl o ye, “Pa'anna, onɛ ka fʋ daa pian'ad o yɛla ka o daa kɛɛn fʋ san'an Joodan mu'ar gbɛogʋn la na bɛɛ anina sʋʋd nidib Wina'am ku'om, ka nidib bɛdegʋ ken o san'an.”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Ka Joon lɛbis o ye, “Sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi di'e si'ela asɛɛ linɛ ka Wina'am tis o.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Ya mɛŋ na di kasɛt ye m yɛl ye, ‘Li ka' manɛ an Kristo laa. Amaa ba tʋmimnɛ ka m gaad o tuon na.’

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Pu'adaane sʋ'oe o pu'apaal ka pu'adaan la zua zi'e ka wʋm o pian'ad la, ka mɔr sumalisim bɛdegʋ, bɔzugɔ on wʋm pu'adaan la kʋkɔr la zug. M mɔr sumalisim bɛdegʋ.

translation_verse: Li nar ka on dʋ ka man sie.” Onɛ yi arezana ni na la yɛla

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Onɛ yi agɔl na la gat si'el wʋsa, ka onɛ bɛ dunia ni anɛ dunia nid ka pian'ad dunia yɛla. Onɛ yi arezana ni na la gat si'el wʋsa

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: ka pian'ad on wʋm ka nyɛ si'el, amaa sɔ' pʋ di'e o pian'ad la.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Onɛ di'e o pian'ad la pa'al ye Wina'am an yɛlsida daan.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Onɛ ka Wina'am tʋm na la pian'adnɛ Wina'am labaar ka li anɛ Wina'am tis o Siig Kasi linɛ ka' makir la zug.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am nɔŋ o Biig la ka zaŋ si'el wʋsa niŋ o nu'usin.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Onɛ niŋ o Biig la yadda mɔr nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Ka onɛ pʋ siak Biig la nɔɔrɛ, o kʋ nyɛ nyɔvʋrɛ, ka Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn lɛɛ na bɛ on sɔb zugin.

english_verse: Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again.
translation_verse: On wʋm ban yɛt si'el la, o daa yi Juda sʋ'ʋlimin keŋ Galile sʋ'ʋlimin.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Li daa anɛ tilas ye o dɔlli yi Samaria sʋ'ʋlim;

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Ka pu'a la lɛbisi bu'os o ye, “Bɔ ka fʋn onɛ an Jew nid, sɔsid man onɛ an Samaria dim pu'a ye, m tisif ku'om.”

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Ka pu'a la lɛbisi yɛl ye, “M Zugsɔba, fʋ pʋ mɔr lɔbidiŋ ye fʋ wikɛ, ka bulig la mɛ zulim. Yaanɛ ka fʋ na paam vʋm ku'okaŋa?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Fʋ gat tinam yaab Jakob onɛ tis tinam bulig la, ka mɛ nu bulig la ku'om nɛ o biis nɛ o bʋnkɔnbid laa?”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ wʋsa na nu ku'okanɛ ka m na tis o la, ku'onuud kʋ maligim gban'e on sɔba. Amaa ku'okanɛ ka m na tis o la na ti nwɛnɛ bulig on sɔb pʋʋgin, ka li na buli tis o nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' naarɛ.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Ka pu'a la lɛbisi yɛl o ye, “M Zugsɔba, tisim ku'okan ka m nu, ka ku'onuud kʋ lɛm gban'e ma, ka m kʋ lɛn kɛn kpɛla na wikid ku'om.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Kem buoli fʋ sid na.”

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: Fʋ kulnɛ sidib anu nwa'. Ka onɛ ka fʋ bɛ nɛ o nannanna la ka' fʋ sida. Li anɛ yɛlmɛŋir ka fʋ yɛl.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Ka pu'a la yɛl Yesu ye, “M Zugsɔba, m baŋ ka fʋ anɛ Wina'am nɔdi'es.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Ti yaanam da pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am zuokaŋa zug. Ka yanam Jew dim yɛt ye, li sʋ'ʋm ka ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am nɛ Jerusalem.”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Pu'aa, siakim m ye, saŋa kenna, ka ya kʋ pʋ'ʋs zuokaŋa zug bɛɛ Jerusalem pʋʋgini tisidi ti Ba' Wina'am ya'asɛ.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Yanam pʋ'ʋsidnɛ tisid bʋnkanɛ ka ya zi'. Tinam pʋ'ʋsidnɛ tisid bʋnkanɛ ka ti mi', bɔzugɔ faangir la yitnɛ Jew dim san'an na.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Amaa saŋa kenna, ka li paae ya, ka banɛ pʋ'ʋsid amɛŋa tisidi ti Ba' Wina'am la na pʋ'ʋs nɛ siig nɛ yɛlmɛŋir. Ti Ba' Wina'am bɔɔdnɛ banɛ pʋ'ʋsid pʋ'ʋskan la buudi.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Wina'am anɛ siig, Ka li sʋ'ʋm ye banɛ pʋ'ʋsid o la pʋ'ʋsim o nɛ siig nɛ yɛlmɛŋir.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Ka pu'a la lɛbisi yɛl o ye, “M mi' ye Mazaya, onɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ la kenna, onɛ ka ba buon ye Kristo la. O ya'a ti kena, o na pa'ali ti si'el wʋsa.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Man onɛ pian'adi tisidif la, an on sɔb.”

translation_verse: Ka ban sɔnsi naae la, ka o nya'andɔlib la kena, ka li lidigi ba, on sɔnsid nɛ pu'a la, amaa ka sɔ' pʋ bu'os pu'a la ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ bɔɔda?” Bɛɛ bu'os Yesu ye, “Bɔ ka fʋn nɛ pu'a la sɔnsida?”

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka ba yi tempʋʋgin la kɛɛn o san'an na.

translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “M mɔr diibi na di, amaa ya zi'.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “M diib anɛ ye m tʋm onɛ tʋmi m la na bɔɔdim naae.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Ya pʋ yɛt ye, ‘Li kpɛlim nwadis anaasi ka ki bunib saŋa paae?’ Gɔsimi, m yɛti ya ye, gɔdigimi ya nindaasi gɔs pɔɔd la. Ba sid pɛlignɛ gur bunib.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Onɛ bʋn di'ednɛ yɔɔd, ka vaad zʋʋd la ka li nwɛnɛ nimbanɛ niŋ yadda kpɛn'ɛd nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarin si'em la. Bɔzugɔ onɛ bʋd nɛ onɛ bʋn na la'asi nyɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Ala ka pian'ʋk la niŋ amɛŋa ye, ‘Yinne bʋd nɛ. Ka yinne mɛ bʋn.’

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: M tʋmi ya nɛ ye ya keŋ bʋn dinɛ ka ya pʋ kuaa. Sieba daa kua. Amaa yanam di'enɛ tʋʋma la nyɔɔd.”

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Samaria dim bɛdegʋ banɛ bɛ teŋ kan la pʋʋgin daa niŋ Yesu yadda, pu'a la yɛl si'el la zug, ye, “O yɛl man zugin yɛla wʋsa.”

translation_verse: Ka Samaria dim la kɛɛn o san'an na la, ba sɔs o ye, o bɛ nɛ ba. Ka o kpɛlimmi ba san'an daba ayi'.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Ka o paae Kana linɛ bɛ Galile sʋ'ʋlimin; zin'ikanɛ ka o daa tiak ku'om ka li lieb daam la. Ka Kapeenum teŋin ka gɔmena kpɛɛm yinne bɛɛ ani ka o biig bɛn'ɛd.

translation_verse: M dɛŋin yɛli ya ye ya nyɛɛm, amaa la'an nɛ wala ya pʋ niŋim yaddaa.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Banɛ wʋsa ka m Ba' tisim la na kɛɛn m san'an na. Ka onɛ kɛɛn m san'an na m kʋ kad o basɛ;

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: M yi arezana nii sig na ye m tʋmnɛ onɛ tʋm man la bɔɔdim ka ka' m mɛŋ bɔɔdim.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ tʋm man la bɔɔdim anɛ anwa, ye on tisim ninsieba wʋsa la, ye m da kɛ ka baa yinne bɔdigɛ. Amaa o lɛɛ bɔɔd ye m vʋ'ʋgi ba wʋsa dunia naar daar la.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ka m Ba' la bɔɔdim anɛ anwa ye onɛ mɛkama nyɛ Biig la ka niŋ o yadda na nyɛ nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, ka m na vʋ'ʋg o dunia naar daar.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim nyɔn o, on yɛl ye, “Manɛ an dikanɛ yi arezana sig na la zug.”

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: Ka ba bu'os taaba ye, “Dau kaŋa nwa' ka'anɛ Josef biig Yesu, onɛ ka ti mi' o ba' nɛ o ma laa? Ka li niŋ wala ka o yʋ'ʋn yɛl ye o yinɛ arezana ni na?”

english_verse: Jesus told them: Stop grumbling!
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “Da nyɔnnɛ nɛ taaba.

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kae nyɛɛm Ba' la ka li ya'a ka' onɛ yi Wina'am san'an na la gʋllim nɛ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: Asida sida ka m yɛti ya ye, onɛ niŋim yadda mɔr nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Manɛ an nyɔvʋr diib la.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Ya yaanam da di dikanɛ ka ba buon ye manna la mɔɔgin, la'an nɛ wala ba da kpiya.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Amaa dikanɛ ka saal na di ka kʋ kpi anɛ linɛ yi arezana ni la na.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Manɛ an nyɔvʋr dikanɛ yi arezana nii sig na la ka sɔ' ya'a di dikaŋa o na vʋe saŋa mɛkama. Ka dikaŋa anɛ m niŋgbiŋ linɛ ka m na tis dunia dim nyɔvʋr yɛla.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “Asida sida ka m yɛti ya ye, asɛɛ ka ya di Ninsaal Biig la niŋgbiŋ ka nuu o ziim, ka ya'a ka' alaa ya pʋ mɔr nyɔvʋrɛ.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Onɛ dii m niŋgbiŋ ka nuu m ziim mɔr nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarɛ, ka m na vʋ'ʋg o dunia naar daar la.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Ka m niŋgbiŋ anɛ diib amɛŋa ka m ziim an bʋnnuudir amɛŋa.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Onɛ dii m niŋgbiŋ ka nuu m ziim kpɛn anɛ yinne nɛ mam ka mam mɛ an yinne nɛ on.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: M Ba' sʋ'oe nyɔvʋr ka tʋmi m na ka on zug ka m vʋe, ala mɛn ka onɛ di mam niŋgbiŋ na vʋe man zug.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa an dikanɛ yi arezana ni sig na, ka li ka'anɛ wʋʋ dikanɛ ka ya yaanam da di ka kpi laa. Amaa onɛ di dikaŋa la, na vʋe saŋa wʋsa.”

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: On daa pa'an nidib Kapeenum la'asʋg dɔɔgin la ka o yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa. Pian'ad linɛ tisid nyɔvʋr la yɛla

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Ka o nya'andɔlib la bɛdegʋ wʋmi li la, ba yɛl ye, “Pa'alkaŋa tɔi. Anɔ'ɔn na tun'e di'e li?”

english_verse: Jesus knew that his disciples were grumbling. So he asked, “Does this bother you?
translation_verse: Ka Yesu baŋ o pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye o nya'andɔlib la nyɔnnɛ li yɛla la ka yɛli ba ye, “Ya nɔki li ka li anɛ pɔ'ɔgirɛɛ?

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Ka ya ya'a nyɛ ka Ninsaal Biig la dʋti lɛbid zin'ikanɛ ka o daa pʋn bɛ la!

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Onɛ tisid nyɔvʋr la anɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi, ka niŋgbiŋ la anɛ zaalim. Pian'akanɛ ka m pian' tisi ya la tisid Siig nɛ nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Amaa ya sieba bɛ ka pʋ siakɛ.” Yesu da dɛŋim baŋ pin'ilʋgʋn sa banɛ pʋ niŋ o yadda nɛ onɛ na ti zam o la yɛla ka o yɛl nwa'.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛn yɛl ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa yɛla ka m daa yɛl ye, sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi kɛɛn m san'an na asɛɛ m Ba' la na tis suor.”

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Ka nɛ'ɛnam nya'aŋ o nya'andɔlib tita'am sa buaki keŋ ka pʋ lɛn dɔl o ya'asɛ.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Yesu bu'os o nya'andɔlib pii nɛ ayi' la ye, “Yanam mɛ na bɔɔd ye ya keŋɛ?”

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Ka Simon Pita lɛbisi bu'os o ye, “Zugsɔba, ti ye ti keŋ anɔ'ɔn san'anɛ? Fʋnɛ mɔr pian'akanɛ tisid nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' bɛn la.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Ka ti siaki li ka baŋ ye, fʋn ma'aa an ninkanɛ an sʋm nyain ka yi Wina'am san'an na.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbisi bu'osi ba ye, “Ka' manɛ gaŋ yanam pii nɛ ayi' laa? La'an nɛ wala ka ya yinne anɛ Sʋntaana!”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: O da pian' nɛ'ɛŋa Judas onɛ an Simon Iskariot biig la yɛla. O da anɛ nya'andɔlib pii nɛ ayi' la nid yinne onɛ da na ti zam o.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Ka nɛ'ɛŋa nwa' nya'aŋ la ka Yesu giligid Galile teŋin ka pʋ bɔɔd ye o giligid Juda teŋinɛ, Jew dimi bɔɔd ye ba kʋʋ o la zug.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Jew dim di'em kanɛ an Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ la da li'el la,

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: ka Yesu pitib yɛl o ye, “Basim kpɛla ka keŋ Juda teŋin ka fʋ nya'andɔlib la nyɛ tʋʋmnyalima banɛ ka fʋ tʋm la.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a bɔɔd ye o yʋ'ʋr yi paalʋ, o pʋ su'adi tʋmm o tʋʋmaa. Fʋ ya'a tʋm tʋʋm bama fʋn kɛ ka nidib bɛdegʋ baŋ.”

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: O pitib la pʋ niŋ o yadda, linzug ka ba yɛl o ala.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “Mam saŋa nam pʋ paae, amaa saŋa mɛkama yanam mɔr ya'a.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Dunia dim kʋ nyaŋi kis yanama, amaa ba kisnɛ man, bɔzugɔ man yɛti banɛ saŋa wʋsa ye ban bɛ bɛllim si'a la anɛ bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Yanam kem di'ema la. M nan kʋ keŋ di'em kaŋaa; bɔzugɔ m saŋa nam pʋ paae.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: On yɛl wala la ka kpɛlim Galile teŋin. Yesu bɛ Sʋga Gbɛɛnb Malʋŋ la ni

english_verse: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
translation_verse: Ka o pitib la gaadi naae la, ka o mɛ yuolim keŋ, ka pʋ nɛɛl o mɛŋa.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim ieed o di'ema la ni ka bu'osid ye, “O bɛ yaanɛ?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Ka nidib la bɛdegʋ nya'am, ka sieba ye, “O anɛ ninsʋŋ.” Ka sieba ye, “Ayei, o pa'annɛ nidib la linɛ an suobɛ'ɛd.”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Ka ban zɔt Jew dim la zug ka sɔ' pʋ nyaŋi pian' nɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Ka di'ema la ti paae pʋsʋk ka Yesu duo kpɛn' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la pa'an nidib.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Ka li lidig Jew dim la ka ba yɛt ye, “Dau kaŋa niŋ wala mɔr baŋir ka lɛɛ pʋ zamisɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbisi ba ye, “M pa'ala ka' m mɛŋ dinnɛ, amaa li anɛ onɛ tʋmim la na din.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Onɛ bɔɔd ye o tʋm Wina'am bɔɔdim, o na baŋ ye m pa'ala yinɛ Wina'am san'an na, bɛɛ m pian'adnɛ, nɛ m mɛŋ paŋa.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Onɛ pian'ad nɛ o mɛŋ paŋ la bɔɔdnɛ o mɛŋ yʋ'ʋr. Amaa onɛ bɔɔd ye onɛ tʋm o la na di'e yʋ'ʋr la, anɛ sida sɔb ka pʋ mɔr zirii.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Ya pʋ di'e wada Moses san'anɛɛ? Ka la'an nɛ wala ya sɔ' pʋ dɔlli li suorɛ. Bɔ ka ya ieed suoya ye ya kʋʋ ma?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Ka nidib la lɛbis o ye, “Kikirigi dɔllif. Anɔ'ɔnamɛ bɔɔd ye ba kʋʋ fɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbisi ba ye, “M daa tʋm tʋʋmnyalʋŋ yinne ka li lidigi ya.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Moses da yɛl ye, ya kpɛn'ɛm baŋʋ, . Amaa ya kpɛn'ɛsid biribis baŋʋ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Ka ya ya'a kpɛn'ɛsid biribiŋ baŋʋ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar ka li pʋ san'am Moses wada la, bɔ ka ya sʋnya pɛlig nɛ mam daa ti'eb dau Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la?

english_verse: Don't judge by appearances. Judge by what is right.
translation_verse: Da gɔs sɔ' nindaa ka pin'ili kad o saria, amaa kadimi saria nɛ sida.”

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Dinzug ka Jerusalem ninsieba bu'os ye, “Li ka'anɛ dau kaŋa ka ba bɔɔd ye ba kʋ laa?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Ka gɔsimi ya, o pian'adnɛ paalʋ ni ka ba pʋ niŋ o si'ela. Kpɛɛmnam sid siak ye o anɛ Kristo onɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ la bɛɛ?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Amaa ti mi' dau kaŋa yi si'el na, ka Kristo la ya'a ti nie sɔ' kʋ baŋ on yi si'el naa.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu da nan bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la pa'an nidib la, o da pian' nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Ɛɛn, ya sid mi'im ka mi' man yi zin'isi'a na. Li ka' m mɛŋ paŋ ka m nɔki kenaa. Amaa onɛ tʋm mam na la anɛ sida sɔb, ka ya zi' oo.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Ka man lɛɛ mi' o, bɔzugɔ onɛ tʋm man, ka o san'an ka m yina.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka ba ieed suor ye ba gban'e o, ka sɔ' pʋ si'is oo, bɔzugɔ o saŋa daa nam pʋ paae.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala nidib la tita'am da niŋ o yadda, ka yɛl ye, “Kristo la ya'a ti kena o na tʋm tʋʋmnyalima gaad dau kaŋa tʋm si'el laa?” Farisii dim tʋm nidib ye ba gban'e Yesu

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Ka Farisii dim wʋm nidib la nya'am Yesu yɛla si'em la, ka ban nɛ Wina'am maanmaannib kpɛɛmnam tʋm nidib ye ba gban'e o na.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛl ye, “M na bɛ nɛ ya yuug bi'ela ka lɛn lɛb onɛ tʋm mam na la san'an.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Ya na ti ieedim ka kʋ nyɛɛ ma, ka mam na bɛ zin'isi'a la ya kʋ nyaŋi kɛɛn ani naa.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim yɛl taaba ye, “Dau kaŋa gban'e ye o keŋ yaanɛ ka ti kʋ nyɛ oo? O gban'e nɛ ye o keŋ Girik dim tɛɛnsin, zin'ikanɛ ka Jew dim bɛ la pa'al Girik dim laa?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: Ka on yɛl ye, ti na ti ieed o ka kʋ nyɛɛ o, ka ye on bɛ zin'isi'a la ti kʋ nyaŋi kena la, li gbin an bɔ?” Wina'am Siig Kasi la yɛla

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Ka di'ema la naar dabisir linɛ an dabistita'ar la, ka Yesu duoe zi'en ka pian'ad nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Ku'onuud ya'a mɔr sɔ', on kemi m san'an na nu.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ Wina'am gbauŋʋ sɔbi siilim si'em la ye, ‘Onɛ niŋim yadda, nyɔvʋr ku'om na zɔti yit o san'an na.’”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: O yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa ka li gbin pa'alnɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la yɛla, ka banɛ niŋ o yadda la na ti di'e o. Saŋkan la Wina'am da nam pʋ tisi ba o Siig Kasi la, bɔzugɔ Yesu da nam pʋ nyɛ girima o kum vʋ'ʋgir la nya'aŋa. Bakir bɛ nidibin Yesu yɛla

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Ka ban wʋm pian'akan la, nidib la sieba yɛl ye, “Oŋa sid an Wina'am nɔdi'es la.”

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ka sieba ye, “Oŋa an Kristo la.” Amaa ka sieba bu'os ye, “Kristo la na niŋ wala yi Galile na?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Wina'am gbauŋ pʋ yɛl ye Kristo la na yinɛ David gbinnin na ka ba du'a o Betilehem teŋ kanɛ ka David da bɛ la naa?”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka bakir bɛ nidibin la o yɛla.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Ka sieba bɔɔd ye ba gban'e o amaa sɔ' pʋ si'is oo. Jew dim kpɛɛmnam pʋ niŋ Yesu yadda

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ keŋ ye ba gban'e o la lɛb maanmaannib kpɛɛmnam nɛ Farisii dim la san'an ka ba bu'os ye, “Bɔ ka ya pʋ gban'e o na?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Ka ba lɛbis ye, “Sɔ' nan zi' pian' nwɛnɛ dau kaŋaa.”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Ka Farisii dim la bu'osi ba ye, “Ka yanam mɛ yidig nɛ dɔl suobɛ'ɛd la bɛɛ?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Ka kpɛɛmnam la bɛɛ Farisii dim la sieba niŋ o yaddaa?”

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Nɔpɔɔr bɛ nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ zi' wada la zug.

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Ka Nikodemus onɛ daa dɛŋin kɛn Yesu san'an na ka aan ba nid yinne la bu'osi ba ye,

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Ti wada la tis suor ye ti kʋʋs sɔ' bɛ'ɛd ka pʋ wʋm o antu'a ka baŋ on tʋm si'elaa?”

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu keŋ Olif zuorin.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Ka bɛkɛung ka o lɛb Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na ya'as ka nidib la wʋsa kɛɛn o san'an na ka o zin' pa'annɛ ba.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ka gbauŋmi'idib nɛ Farisii dim mɔr pu'a onɛ ka ba kuk ka o san'am dau, ka zi'el o nidib la sʋʋgin,

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.

translation_verse: Ka ba lɛn buol dau onɛ daa an zu'om la yɛl o ye, “Pian'am Wina'am yʋ'ʋri fʋ laafi nyɛɛb la yɛla. Amaa tinam mi' ye dau kaŋa anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb.”

english_verse: The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “O ya'a anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb bɛɛ o ka' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔba m zi'. Mam mi' si'el anɛ ye, m daa anɛ zu'om ka yʋ'ʋn nyɛt.”

english_verse: “What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he heal your eyes?”
translation_verse: Ka ba bu'os o ye, “O niŋif bɔ? O niŋ wala laki fʋ nini la?”

english_verse: The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbisi ba ye, “M pʋn dɛŋin yɛli ya ka ya pʋ bɔɔd ye ya kɛlisɛ, ka bɔ ka ya bɔɔd ye ya wʋm ya'asɛ? Ya mɛ bɔɔd ye ya lieb o nya'andɔliba?”

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Ka ba tʋ'ʋd o ye, “Fʋnɛ aan o nya'andɔl, ka tinam anɛ Moses nya'andɔlib.

english_verse: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye Wina'am da pian' tisnɛ Moses, amaa dau kaŋa nwa', ti zi' on yi zin'isi'a naa.”

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: Ka dau la yɛl ye, “Nwa' anɛ lidigir. Ya zi' on yi si'el naa; la'an nɛ wala o laki m nini ka m nyɛt.

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye Wina'am kʋ kɛlis onɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb sɔsʋgɔ, amaa sɔ' ya'a pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am ka niŋid o bɔɔdim, o na wʋm o sɔsʋg.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.
translation_verse: Dunia pin'ilʋgʋn sa sɔ' nan zi' wʋm ye ba kɛ ka onɛ ka ba du'a o ka o an zu'om nini nyɛta.

english_verse: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ dau kaŋa ya'a pʋ yiin Wina'am san'an naa, o kʋ nyaŋi niŋin si'el-si'el la.”

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
translation_verse: Ka ba lɛbis o ye, “Ba du'af nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin, ka fʋ lɛɛ bɔɔd ye fʋ pa'ali tii?” Ka ba kad o yis.

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu wʋm ye ba kad dau la yis la, ka nyɛɛ o la, o bu'os o ye, “Fʋ niŋ Ninsaal Biig la yaddaa?”

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “M Zugsɔba, Ninsaal Biig la aan anɔ'ɔn ka m na niŋ o yadda?”

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Fʋ nyɛɛ o ka li anɛ onɛ pian'ad nɛf la.”

english_verse: The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka dau la yɛl ye, “M Zugsɔba, m niŋif yadda.” Ka na'as Yesu.

english_verse: Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
translation_verse: Yesu yɛl ye, “Sariakadib yɛla ka m kɛn dunia ni na, ka zʋnzɔɔs na nyɛt, ka banɛ nyɛt la na lieb zʋnzɔɔs.”

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard Jesus say this, they asked, “Are we blind?”
translation_verse: Ka Farisii dim sieba banɛ kpi'e nɛ o la wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la, ba bu'os o ye, “Dinzugɔ tinam mɛ anɛ zʋnzɔɔsɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbisi ba ye, “Ya ya'a aan zʋnzɔɔs ya kʋ mɔrin taalɛ. Ka yanamɛ sadigim yɛl ye ya nyɛt la, ya taal kpɛm bɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain only thieves and robbers climb over the fence instead of going in through the gate to the sheep pen.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ye, “Asida ka m yɛti ya ye, onɛ pʋ dɔl pɛ'ɛs za'anɔɔrin la kpɛn' bʋlʋʋgin laa ka dʋ zaŋguommi kpɛn', o sɔb anɛ faand bɛɛ na'ayiig.

english_verse: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ gur za'anɔɔr la na yɔ'ɔgi tis o. Ka o pɛ'ɛs la mi' o kʋkɔr la zug, o buoni ba yʋda ka gaad tuon ka ba dɔl o.

english_verse: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.
translation_verse: Ka o ya'a mɔr o pɛ'ɛs wʋsa yina, o gati ba tuon ka ba dɔl o, bɔzugɔ ba mi' o kʋkɔr.

english_verse: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ dɔl saanna, ba na zɔ ka bas o, bɔzugɔ ba zi' o kʋkɔrɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about. Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Siiliŋ kaŋa ka Yesu zaŋi siilimi ba, amaa ba pʋ gban'e o pian'ad la gbinnɛ. Yesu n an kɔnbkem sʋŋ la yɛla

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ya'as ye, “Asida ka m yɛti ya ye, manɛ an pɛ'ɛs la za'anɔɔr.

english_verse: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
translation_verse: Banɛ wʋsa dɛŋi m tuon na la anɛ banɛ faand bɛɛ na'ayiis, ka pɛ'ɛs la pʋ kɛlisidi baa.

english_verse: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
translation_verse: Manɛ an za'anɔɔr la. Ka onɛ dɔl za'anɔɔr kan la kpɛn' na nyɛ faangir. O na kpɛn' ka yina nyɛ diibi di.

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Na'ayiig la kena ye o zu ka kʋ, ka san'am ma'aa, ka man kena ye ba nyɛ nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarɛ.”

english_verse: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.
translation_verse: “Manɛ an kɔnbkem sʋŋ la. Kɔnbkem sʋŋ la pɛsig o nyɔvʋr pɛ'ɛs la yɛla.

english_verse: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
translation_verse: Amaa niŋ kanɛ ka ba yɔɔd o ligidi ye o kem kɔnbid pʋ sʋ'oe kɔnbid la. Alazug, o ya'a nyɛ ka kunduŋ kenna o na bas pɛ'ɛs la ka zɔ ka kunduŋ la gban'e ba ka widigi ba.

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, ban yɔɔd o ligidi la zug ka o gur pɛ'ɛs la, amaa o ba'a kae nɛ baa.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me.
translation_verse: “Manɛ lɛɛ an kɔnbkem sʋŋ la, ka mi' m kɔnbid ka ba mɛ mi' man

english_verse: Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep.
translation_verse: nwɛnɛ m Ba' Wina'am mi' man ka mam mɛ mi' o si'em la. Manɛ pɛsigi m nyɔvʋri tisim pɛ'ɛs la.

english_verse: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
translation_verse: M mɔr pɛsieba banɛ ka' bʋlʋʋg nwa' nii. Li nar ka m mɛ mɔri ba na ka ba kɛlisi m kʋkɔr, ka la'asi ba wʋsa gumm ka ba mɔr kɔnbkem yinne.

english_verse: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.
translation_verse: Ka man pɛsigi m nyɔvʋr la zug ka m Ba' la nɔŋim. Ka m na lɛn di'e li ya'as.

english_verse: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi zaŋi m nyɔvʋrɛ. M mɛŋ lɛɛ pɛsigi m nyɔvʋr. M mɔr paŋi na pɛsigi m nyɔvʋri kpi, ka lɛm mɔr paŋi na di'e li ya'as. M Ba' tisim nɔzi'elkaŋa.”

english_verse: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.
translation_verse: Ka pian' bama zug ka bakir lɛm bɛ Jew dim la sʋʋgin.

english_verse: Many of them said, “He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him?”
translation_verse: Ka ba tita'am sa yɛl ye, “Bɔ ka ya kɛlisid o, o anɛ gɛɛŋ ka kikirig dɔl o.”

english_verse: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
translation_verse: Ka sieba yɛl ye, “Li ka' onɛ ka kikirig dɔl o pian'adi nwaa. Kikirig na nyaŋi kɛ ka onɛ zu'om nyɛtaa?” Jew dim zan'as Yesu

english_verse: That winter, Jesus was in Jerusalem for the Temple Festival.
translation_verse: Ka di'ema saŋa linɛ ka ba tiɛnd Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir pier Jerusalem teŋin la paae. Li da anɛ sapal,

english_verse: One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch,
translation_verse: ka Yesu ken Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zin'ikanɛ ka ba buon Solomon za'ambɛŋ la.

english_verse: and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim la'asi gilig o ka yɛl o ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ kɛ ka ti bi'esidi fʋ yɛla hali nɛ anwa? Fʋ ya'a anɛ Kristo onɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ la, fʋn yɛlimi ti nyain-nyain.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbisi ba ye, “M daa yɛli ya, ka ya pʋ niŋim yaddaa. Tʋʋm banɛ ka m tʋmmi m Ba' yʋ'ʋrin la pa'al mam an sɔ'.

english_verse: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.
translation_verse: Amaa yanamɛ ka' m pɛ'ɛs la zug ka ya pʋ niŋim yaddaa.

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: M pɛ'ɛs wʋmmi m kʋkɔr, ka m mi' ba, ka ba dɔllim,

english_verse: and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.
translation_verse: ka m tisidi ba nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, ka ba kʋdim kʋ bɔdigɛ, ka sɔ' kae na nyaŋi faaɛn ba m nu'uginɛ.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: M Ba' onɛ nɔki ba tisim la mɔr paŋ hali gaad si'el wʋsa, ka sɔ' kae na nyaŋi faaɛn ba m Ba' la nu'uginɛ.

english_verse: and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Mam nɛ m Ba' la anɛ yinne.”

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim lɛn ye ba lɔb o nɛ kuga kʋ.

english_verse: But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “M pa'ali ya tʋʋm sʋma bɛdegʋ linɛ yii m Ba' la ni, ka tʋʋm sʋŋ ban yɛla ka ya lɔbidim nɛ kugaa?”

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim la lɛbis o ye, “Li ka'anɛ tʋʋm sʋma yɛlaa amaa Wina'am yʋ'ʋsan'auŋ la yɛla, bɔzugɔ fʋ anɛ ninsaal amaa fʋ ye fʋ anɛ Wina'am.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: In your Scriptures doesn't God say, “You are gods”?
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbisi ba ye, Li sɔbi ya wada ni ye, Mam, Wina'am, yɛl ye, “Ya anɛ Wina.”

english_verse: You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye Wina'am gbauŋ la anɛ sida saŋa wʋsa, ka banɛ ka o zaŋ o labaar la tis la, o buoni ba ye ba anɛ wina.

english_verse: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.
translation_verse: Ka la'an nɛ wala ka ya yɛt ye, mam kanɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ ka tʋmim dunia nwa' ni la san'amid Wina'am yʋ'ʋr, man yɛt ye, m anɛ Wina'am Biig la zug.

english_verse: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
translation_verse: M ya'a pʋ tʋmmi m Ba' tʋʋmaa, yanam da niŋinim yadda.

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Amaa m ya'a tʋm ka ya pʋn pʋ niŋim yadda, yanam siakimi m tʋʋma la, ka ya na nyɛ ka baŋ ye, m Ba' la anɛ yinne nɛ mam ka m mɛ an yinne nɛ o.

english_verse: Again they wanted to arrest Jesus. But he escaped
translation_verse: Ka ba lɛn zigid ye ba gban'e o, ka o tɔɔmi ba ni.

english_verse: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there,
translation_verse: Ka o tɔɔm anina keŋ lɔ'ɔŋ Joodan mu'ari paae zin'ikanɛ ka Joon da dɛŋin sʋʋd nidib Wina'am ku'om la kpɛlim ani.

english_verse: many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.”
translation_verse: Ka nidib bɛdegʋ kɛɛn o san'an na ka yɛl ye, “Joon pʋ tʋm tʋʋmnyalima, ka linɛ wʋsa ka o da pian' dau kaŋa yɛla la anɛ sida.”

english_verse: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka nidib bɛdegʋ niŋ o yadda anina.

english_verse: The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.
translation_verse: Dinzug o tanp la daa tʋm yɛl Yesu ye, “Zugsɔba, fʋ zua nɔŋir la ka' laafii.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu n wʋmi li la, ka yɛl ye, “Ban'akan kʋ kʋʋ o, amaa li anɛ ye Wina'am yʋ'ʋr nyɛ girima, ka linzug ka Wina'am Biig la yʋ'ʋr mɛ nyɛ girima.”

english_verse: But he stayed where he was for two more days.
translation_verse: on wʋm ye Lazarus ka' laafi la, o kpɛlim on daa bɛ zin'isi'a la daba ayi'.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
translation_verse: Ka lin nya'aŋ la ka o yɛl o nya'andɔlib la ye, “Kɛlli ka ti keŋ Juda ya'as.”

english_verse: “Teacher,” they said, “the people there want to stone you to death! Why do you want to go back?”
translation_verse: Ka o nya'andɔlib la yɛl o ye, “Pa'anna, ka' ani ka Jew dim daa bɔɔd ye ba lɔbif nɛ kuga la. Ka wala ka fʋ yɛl ye, fʋn na lɛn keŋi anina ya'asɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbisi bu'osi ba ye, “Li ka' daar yinne an nintaŋ tansib nɛ zaam ma'arɛ? Nid ya'a ken nintaŋ o kʋ tu'ugɛ, bɔzugɔ dunia nɛɛsim bɛ.

english_verse: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.”
translation_verse: Amaa nid ya'a ken yʋ'ʋŋ o tu'ugidnɛ, bɔzugɔ nɛɛsim kae.”

english_verse: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Ka on yɛli ba nwa' naae la, o yɛli ba ye, “Ti zua Lazarus gbisidnɛ. Amaa m na keŋ nie o gbɛɛmin la.”

english_verse: They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.”
translation_verse: Ka o nya'andɔlib la yɛl o ye, “Zugsɔba, o ya'a gbisidnɛ, o na nyɛ laafi.”

english_verse: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
translation_verse: Amaa Yesu yɛti ba nɛ Lazarus kum yɛla ka ba tɛn'ɛsid ye o yɛti ba nɛ o gbɛɛm yɛla.

english_verse: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
translation_verse: Yanam zug ka m mɔr sumalisim man daa ka' o san'an la, bɔzugɔ, ya na niŋim yadda. Amaa kɛlli ka ti keŋ o san'an.”

english_verse: Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.” Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
translation_verse: Ka Tomas, onɛ an liiba yinne la, yɛl o nya'andɔltaab la ye, “Kɛlli ka ti la'am keŋ nɛ o. Ka li ya'a an kum, tinam la'am kpi nɛ o.”

english_verse: When Jesus got to Bethany, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu paae la, o nyɛ ka Lazarus pʋn bɛ yaʋgʋn la daba anaasi sa.

english_verse: Bethany was less than three kilometers from Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ka Betani teŋ daa pʋ lal nɛ Jerusalem. Li anɛ wʋʋ maila ayi' nɛ.

english_verse: and many people had come from the city to comfort Martha and Mary because their brother had died.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim bɛdegʋ kena ye ba bɛlis Marta nɛ Mɛɛri ba taʋn kum la zug.

english_verse: When Martha heard that Jesus had arrived, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house.
translation_verse: Ka Marta n wʋm ye Yesu kenna la, o duoe yi ye o tʋ'ʋs o. Ka Mɛɛri kpɛlim zin' yin.

english_verse: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
translation_verse: Ka Marta yɛl Yesu ye, “Zugsɔba, fʋ ya'a daa bɛɛn kpɛla, man taʋn nwa' naan kʋ kpii nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Your brother will live again!”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Fʋ taʋn la na vʋ'ʋg ya'as.”

english_verse: Martha answered, “I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.”
translation_verse: Ka Marta yɛl o ye, “M mi' ye o na ti vʋ'ʋg kumin dunia kaŋa naar daar.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “I am the one who raises the dead to life! Everyone who has faith in me will live, even if they die.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Manɛ an kum vʋ'ʋgir nɛ nyɔvʋr. Onɛ niŋim yadda, hali o ya'a kpinɛ, o na vʋ'ʋg.

english_verse: “Yes, Lord!” she replied. “I believe you are the Christ, the Son of God. You are the one we hoped would come into the world.”
translation_verse: Ka Marta yɛl o ye, “M Zugsɔba, m niŋif yadda ye fʋ anɛ Kristo, Wina'am Biig, onɛ ka ba da ye o na kɛn dunia ni na la.”

english_verse: After Martha said this, she went and privately said to her sister Mary, “The Teacher is here, and he wants to see you.”
translation_verse: Ka on yɛl nwa' naae la, o su'a keŋ buol o pitʋ Mɛɛri yɛl o ye, “Ti Pa'an la bɛ kpɛla ka buonif.”

english_verse: As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went out to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka on wʋm la ka duoe tɔ'ɔtɔ keŋ o san'an.

english_verse: He was still outside the village where Martha had gone to meet him.
translation_verse: Yesu da nam pʋ kpɛn' teŋin laa, amaa ka kpɛm bɛ zin'ikanɛ ka Marta tʋ'ʋs o la.

english_verse: Many people had come to comfort Mary, and when they saw her quickly leave the house, they thought she was going out to the tomb to cry. So they followed her.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim banɛ bɛ yinnɛ bɛlisid Mɛɛri la nyɛ ka o duoe tɔ'ɔtɔ yi la, ka ba dɔl o tɛn'ɛsid ye, o kennɛ yaʋgʋn la ye o kaas.

english_verse: Mary went to where Jesus was. Then as soon as she saw him, she knelt at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
translation_verse: Ka Mɛɛri paae Yesu bɛ zin'isi'a la, ka nyɛɛ o, ka igin Yesu tuon ka yɛl o ye, “M Zugsɔba, fʋ ya'a daa bɛɛn kpɛla man taʋn nwa' naan kʋ kpii nɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw that Mary and the people with her were crying, he was terribly upset
translation_verse: Yesu daa nyɛ ka Mɛɛri kum ka Jew dim banɛ dɔl o la mɛ kum la, ka o sʋʋnr san'am hali, ka o sin'im bɛdegʋ,

english_verse: and asked, “Where have you put his body?” They replied, “Lord, come and you will see.”
translation_verse: ka bu'osi ba ye, yaanɛ ka ya su'a kum la? Ka ba yɛl o ye, “Ti Zugsɔba, kem na gɔs.”
