translation_verse: Yesu yɛl o ye, “Onɛ pʋn sʋ sa, o nɔba pier gʋllim siakya, ka li maal o niŋgbiŋ wʋsa ka li an nyain. Ya anɛ nyain, amaa ka' ya wʋsaa.”

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu daa pʋn mi' onɛ ye o zam o la zug, ka o yɛl ye ka' ya wʋsa an nyainnɛ.

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Ka on pie ba nɔba naae la, o lɛn yɛɛ o fuug, ka lɛbi zin'in, ka bu'osi ba ye, “Ya baŋ man niŋ si'el la gbinnɛɛ?”

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: “Ya buon man ye, Pa'an nɛ Zugsɔb. Li anɛ amɛŋa. M anɛ ala.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: M maal nwa' nɛ ye m pa'ali ya, ye yanam mɛ na maal wʋʋ mam maali ya si'em la.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: Amɛŋa ka m yɛti ya ye, tʋmtʋm kʋ gaad o zugdaana. Ka ban tʋm sɔ' la kʋ gaad onɛ tʋm o la.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: “Li ka' ya wʋsa yɛla ka m yɛta. M mi' man gaŋ sieba la. Amaa asɛɛ Wina'am gbauŋ la sɔb si'em la niŋ amɛŋa ye, ‘Onɛ ka man nɛ on la'am dit la yii m nya'aŋi zi'e m yɛla.’

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: “M yɛti ya nɛ nannanna ka li nam pʋ maalɛ. Ka li ya'a ti maal, ya na niŋim yadda ye manɛ la.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Ka onɛ zin' kpi'e nɛ Yesu la, gbɛligi bu'os o ye, “Zugsɔba, li aan anɔ'ɔnɛ?”

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu n pian' nɛ'ɛŋa la ka o sʋnf san'am ka o yɛl ye, “Asida ka m yɛti ya ye, ya yinne na zam man.”

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Ka Yesu nya'andɔl yinne onɛ ka o nɔŋ hali la zin' kpi'e nɛ o.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Ka Simon Pita ɛnbig nya'andɔl la ka yɛl o ye, “Bu'osim o onɛ yɛla ka o pian'ad la.”

english_verse: No one at the meal understood what Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ wʋsa la'am dit nɛ o la pʋ baŋ linɛ yɛla ka o yɛl o alaa.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Ka sieba tɛn'ɛs ye Judas n da mɔri ba ligidi kɔlʋg la yɛla ka Yesu yɛt o ye o da'am la'abanɛ ka ba bɔɔd malʋŋ diib dabisir la yɛla, bɛɛ o sʋŋim nɔŋdim la.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Li daa anɛ yʋ'ʋŋ, ka Judas di'e diib la naae la, ka kpɛn yi. Nɔzi'elpaal la yɛla

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Wina'am yʋ'ʋr ya'a nyɛ zʋn'or o Biig la zug, Wina'am mɛŋ na zun'e o Biig la yʋ'ʋr, ka li kʋ yuugɛ.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: “M biisɛ, m na bɛ nɛ ya saŋa bi'ela nwa'. Ya na ti ieedim, amaa m yɛti ya nwɛnɛ man daa yɛl Jew dim si'em la ye, man ken zin'isi'a la ya kʋ tun'e kɛɛn ani naa.

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Ka Simon Pita bu'os o ye, “M Zugsɔba, fʋ ken yaanɛ?” Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “Man ken zin'isi'a la, fʋ kʋ nyaŋi dɔl man nannanna. Amaa fʋ na ti yuolim dɔl mam keŋ.”

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Ka Pita bu'os o ye, “M Zugsɔba, bɔɔ niŋ ka m kʋ nyaŋi dɔllif nannanna? M na tun'e kpii fʋ zug.”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “Fʋ na kpi man zugɔɔ? Amɛŋa ka m yɛtif ye, fʋ na ki'is man nɔɔr atan' ka nɔraug nyaan kaas.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “Da kɛ ka si'el daami ya sʋnyaa. Niŋimi Wina'am yadda, ka niŋ man yadda mɛn.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: M Ba' yir mɔr dɔɔd bɛdegʋ. Ya'a ka'anɛ alaa, m naan kʋ yɛlinɛ ya ye, m kennɛ ye m maal zin'igi ya zugɔ.

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: Ka m ya'a keŋ maal zin'ig la naae, m na lɛn kena di'e ya lɛbi m san'an, ka ya na bɛ zin'ikanɛ ka m bɛ la.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Ka man ken zin'isi'a la ya mi' ani, ka lɛm mi' li suor mɛn.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Ka Tomas yɛl o ye, “M Zugsɔba, ti zi' fʋn ken zin'isi'a la. Ti na niŋ wala baŋi li suorɛ?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “Manɛ an suor nɛ yɛlmɛŋir nɛ nyɔvʋr. Sɔ' kae na nyaŋi keŋi m Ba' Wina'am san'anɛ, asɛɛ o paae man.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Ya ya'a baŋin man, ya naan baŋini m Ba' Wina'am mɛn. Ka lin pin'il nannanna ken sa, ya baŋ o ka nyɛt o.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Ka Filip yɛl o ye, “M Zugsɔba, pa'alimi ti Ba' la, ka tinamɛ bɔɔd si'eli la.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “Filip, man bɛ nɛ ya ka li yuug, ka fʋn nan kpɛn zi' maa? Bɔzugɔ onɛ wʋsa nyɛt man la nyɛti m Ba' mɛn. Ka bɔzug ka fʋ lɛn yɛt ye, ‘Pa'alimi ti Ba' la’?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋ siak ye m anɛ yinne nɛ m Ba' la, ka m Ba' la an yinne nɛ manɛɛ? Pian'abanɛ ka m pian'adi tisidi ya la ka' m mɛŋ pian'adɛ, amaa m Ba' kanɛ bɛ m ni la, onɛ tʋmm o tʋʋma.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Niŋimim yadda ye m anɛ yinne nɛ m Ba' la, ka m Ba' la mɛ an yinne nɛ man. Ka li ya'a ka' alaa, niŋim man yadda m tʋʋma la zug.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Yɛlmɛŋir ka m yɛti ya ye, onɛ niŋ man yadda la na tʋm tʋʋm banɛ ka man tʋm la. Hali o na tʋm tʋʋm titada ka di gaad ala, bɔzugɔ m kennɛ m Ba' san'an.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Linɛ wʋsa ka ya sɔs man yʋ'ʋrin la, m na maali li, ye m Ba' la yʋ'ʋr na nyɛ zʋn'or o Biig la zug.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Ya ya'a sɔs si'el nɛ man yʋ'ʋr, m na maali li.” Wina'am Siig Kasi la kenna yɛla

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: “Ya ya'a nɔŋ man, ya na siaki m nɔzi'elʋg la.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Ka m na sɔsi m Ba', ka o na tisi ya Sʋŋid sɔ'. Ka o na bɛ nɛ ya saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Onɛ an yɛlmɛŋir Siig la. Ka dunia dim kʋ nyaŋi di'e o, bɔzugɔ ba pʋ nyɛt o, ka mɛ pʋ baŋ oo. Yanam mi' o, bɔzugɔ o kpɛlimmi ya san'an, ka na bɛ ya ni.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: “M kʋ basi ya wʋʋ kpiibisɛ. M na lɛbi ya san'an na.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Li kpɛlim bi'ela ka dunia nidib kʋ lɛn nyɛɛm ya'asɛ, amaa yanam na nyɛtim. Man vʋe la zug, yanam mɛ na mɔr nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Daakan la ka ya na baŋ ye m anɛ yinne nɛ m Ba' la, ka yanam mɛ an yinne nɛ m, ka m an yinne nɛ ya.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: “Onɛ di'e man nɔzi'ela, ka siaki li, onɛ an onɛ nɔŋim. Ka onɛ nɔŋ man la, m Ba' Wina'am mɛ na nɔŋ o. Ka mam na nɔŋ o, ka nie m mɛŋi pa'al o.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Ka Judas, , bu'os o ye, “M Zugsɔba, wala ka fʋ na nie fʋ mɛŋi pa'al tinam, ka ka'anɛ dunia nidiba?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “Nid ya'a nɔŋ man, o na di'e m nɔɔr, ka m Ba' na nɔŋ o, ka tinam na kɛɛn o san'an naa kpɛlim o ni.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Onɛ pʋ nɔŋim pʋ di'edi m nɔɔrɛ. Ka pian'akanɛ ka ya wʋm la ka' m mɛŋ pian'adɛ, amaa li anɛ m Ba' onɛ tʋm mam na la pian'ad.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: “Pian'abama nwa' ka m pian'adi tisidi ya, man nam bɛ nɛ ya la.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Amaa Sʋŋid onɛ an Wina'am Siig Kasi ka m Ba' la na ti tʋm o ya san'an na nɛ m yʋ'ʋr la, onɛ na pa'ali ya si'el wʋsa, ka tɛɛnsi ya linɛ ka m daa pian' tisi ya la wʋsa.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: “M basi m sumbʋgʋsʋm tisi ya, ka li anɛ m mɛŋ sumbʋgʋsʋm ka m tisi ya, ka li pʋ nwɛnɛ dunia tisidi ya si'em la. Da kɛ ka ya sʋnya san'am bɛɛ dabiem kpɛn' yaa.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Ya daa pʋn wʋm ka m yɛli ya ye, m na yii ya san'an, ka na lɛbi ya san'an na. Ya ya'a nɔŋinim, ya naan maalin sumalisim, man kennɛ m Ba' san'an la, bɔzugɔ m Ba' la gatim.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ka nannanna m dɛŋi yɛti ya nɛ ka li nam pʋ paae. Ka li ya'a ti paae ya na niŋ man yadda.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Ka lin yi nannanna ken la, m kʋ lɛm pian' nɛ ya yuugɛ, bɔzugɔ Sʋntaana onɛ an dunia na'ab la kenna. Amaa o paŋ kʋ nyaŋi ma.

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: Amaa li anɛ tilas ye dunia dim baŋ ye m nɔŋi m Ba' la, ka dɔl o nɔzi'ela la.” “Duomi ka ti yi kpɛla keŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu pa'al o nya'andɔlib la nɛ siiliŋ ye, “Manɛ an vain tiig la amɛŋa. Ka m Ba' an onɛ gur tiig la.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Wilkanɛ bɛɛ m ni ka pʋ wanna, m Ba' nwaadi li nɛ basid. Ka wilkanɛ wʋsa wan la, o pɛsidi li nɛ maali li sʋ'ʋŋa ka li maligim wan bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Pian'akanɛ ka m pian' tisi ya la zug, ya anɛ nyain.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Kpɛm bɛ man ni ka mam mɛ na bɛɛ ya ni. Tiig wil kʋ tun'e walɛ, asɛɛ o kpɛm bɛ tiigin la. Ala mɛn ka ya kʋ tun'e niŋ si'ela asɛɛ ya kpɛm bɛ man ni.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: “Manɛ an tiig la, ka yanam an wila la. Onɛ kpɛm bɛ man ni ka mam mɛ bɛɛ o ni la, on sɔb na wal bɛdegʋ, bɔzugɔ ya kʋ tun'e niŋ si'ela asɛɛ ya kpɛm bɛ man ni.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Onɛ pʋ bɛ man ni nwɛnɛ wilkanɛ ka ba nwaae bas, ka li kʋdig la. Ba na la'as wilbanɛ lɔb bugumin, ka bugum dii ba.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a kpɛm bɛ man ni, ka m pian'ad bɛɛ ya ni, ya na sɔs yanamɛ bɔɔd si'el wʋsa ka li na niŋ ala tisi ya.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Ya tʋʋm sʋma bɛdegʋ dʋ'ʋsidi m Ba' Wina'am yʋ'ʋr. Ka ala mɛn ka li na pa'al ye ya anɛ m nya'andɔlib.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: “M Ba' nɔŋim si'em la, ala mɛn ka man nɔŋi ya. Kpɛm bɛɛ nɛ m nɔŋir la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a siaki m nɔzi'elʋg la, ya na kpɛlimmi m nɔŋilimin la, wʋʋ man siaki m Ba' nɔɔr ka kpɛlim o nɔŋilimin si'em la.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: “M yɛli ya yɛlbama ye ya di'e m sumalisim. Ka ya sʋnya na pɛ'ɛl nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: M nɔɔr zi'elʋgʋ nwa' ka m yɛti ya ye, ‘Nɔŋimi taaba, wʋʋ man nɔŋi ya si'em la.’

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Nɔŋir lɛn kae gaad nidi na kpi o zuanam zugɔ.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a siaki m nɔzi'ela, ya anɛ m zuanam.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: M ɛɛnti buoni ya nɛ ye, m tʋmtʋmnib. Amaa m kʋ lɛm buoli ya ala ya'asɛ, bɔzugɔ tʋmtʋm zi' o zugdaani niŋid si'ela. Amaa m buoni ya nɛ ye, m zuanam, bɔzugɔ m yɛli ya m Ba' yɛlim si'el la wʋsa.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Ka' yanamɛ gaŋi ma. Amaa manɛ gaŋi ya ye ya tʋm tʋʋm sʋma wʋʋ tisʋŋi wan walsʋma si'em la. Ka ya tʋʋm sʋma na kpɛlim. Ka ya ya'a sɔsi m Ba' Wina'am si'el man yʋ'ʋr zug o na tisi ya.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: M nɔzi'elʋg anɛ ye, ya nɔŋimi taaba. Dunia dim kisʋg la yɛla

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: “Dunia dim ya'a kisi ya, yanam baŋimi ye ba dɛŋi kisignɛ man yiiga.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a bɛɛn dunia dim sʋ'ʋlimin, ba naan nɔŋini ya wʋʋ ba mɛŋ nidib nɛ. Amaa ya ka' dunia dim sʋ'ʋlim nii. M gaŋi ya nɛ wɛligi yis dunia dim sʋ'ʋlim ni. Dinzug ka dunia dim kisi ya la.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Tiɛnmi yɛlkanɛ ka m yɛli ya la ye, ‘Tʋmtʋm pʋ gat o zugdaana.’ Ba ya'a namis man, ba na namisi ya mɛn. Ka ba ya'a daa siak mam pa'alʋg, ba mɛ na siaki ya pa'alʋg mɛn.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ba na niŋi ya nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa man zug, bɔzugɔ ba zi' onɛ tʋmi m la naa.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Man ya'a pʋ kɛɛn na tu'asini ba, ba naan kʋ mɔrin taalɛ. Amaa lin an si'em la linɛ na ligili ba taal la kae.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Onɛ kis man la, o kisi m Ba' la mɛn.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: M ya'a pʋ tʋmin tʋʋm kanɛ ka sɔ' nan zi' tʋmi ba san'an la, ba naan kʋ mɔrin taali ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zugɔ. Amaa ba nyɛ tʋʋmnyalima bama wʋsa ka la'an zan'as ka kis man nɛ m Ba' la wʋsa.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Lin na niŋ si'em la anɛ ye ban da dɛŋi sɔb si'el Wina'am gbauŋʋn la lieb amɛŋa ye, ‘Ba kisim zaalim-zaalim.’

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: “Sʋŋid onɛ ka m na tʋm o ya san'an na la na kena; onɛ an yɛlmɛŋir Siig ka na yii m Ba' Wina'am san'an na. O na dii m kasɛt.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: Ka yanam mɛ na di man kasɛt, bɔzugɔ pin'ilʋgʋn sa ka ya bɛɛ m san'an.”

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: “M yɛli ya nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa ye ya da yi yadda la nii.

english_verse: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa da niŋnɛ ye pian'akanɛ ka Yesu da pian' pa'al kum kanɛ buudi ka o na kpi la niŋ amɛŋa.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ka Pailet kpɛn' zakin la ya'as ka bu'os Yesu ye, “Fʋnɛ an Jew dim na'ab laa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “Bu'oskaŋa yinɛ fʋ mɛŋ san'an na bɛɛ sieba yɛli fʋ m yɛla?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Ka Pailet lɛbisi bu'os o ye, “M anɛ Jew nida? Fʋ mɛŋ buudi nɛ ba maanmaan kpɛɛmnamɛ gban'e fʋ tisim. Bɔ ka fʋ maalɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “M na'am ka' dunia nwa' dinnɛ. Li ya'a aannɛ ala m tʋmtʋmnib naanɛ zanbin nɛ Jew dim la ka ba kʋ gban'e ma.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Ka Pailet bu'os o ye, “Alaa fʋ anɛ na'aba?” Ka Yesu lɛbis ye, “Fʋnɛ yɛl ye, m anɛ na'ab. Nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka m kɛn dunia nwa' ni na ka ba du'am ye m pa'al yɛlsida la. Onɛ mɛkama an yɛlsida sɔb wʋmmi m kʋkɔr.”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Ka Pailet bu'os o ye, “Yɛlsida an bɔ?” Pailet kʋʋs Yesu ye o kpi (Mat

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ya mɔr malʋŋ ka yʋʋm-yʋʋm Kum Maliak Gaadʋg la saŋa ka li an ye m yis sanrega nid yinne tisi ya. Ya bɔɔd ye m yis Jew dim na'ab laa?”

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Ka ba tansid nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Ka' onɛ. Ti bɔɔdnɛ Barabbas.” Barabbas da anɛ na'ayiig kanɛ faand.

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Ka Pailet kɛ ka ba fieb Yesu.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Ka soogianam zaŋ gɔn'ɔsi ʋg na'am zupibigi pid o ka yɛɛl o fuzɛn'ug,

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: ka kɛɛn o san'an na yɛl o ye, “Naa, Jew dim na'aba,” ka nwɛ' o tampiank.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Ka Pailet lɛn yi nidibin la na ya'asi yɛli ba ye, “Gɔsimi ya, m na mɔr o kɛɛn ya san'an na ka ya baŋ ye m pʋ nyɛ taal o san'anɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu pid gɔn'ɔs zupibig ka yɛ fuzɛn'ugʋ yina. Ka Pailet yɛli ba ye, “Dau la nwa'.”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Ka maanmaannib kpɛɛmnam nɛ ba tʋmtʋmnib la nyɛɛ o la, ba tans ye, “Kpa'ami nɛ o dapuudir zugʋ kʋ. Kpa'ami nɛ o.” Ka Pailet yɛli ba ye, “Ya mɛŋ zaŋim o kpa', bɔzugɔ mam pʋ nyɛɛ o taalɛ.”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim la yɛl o ye, “Ti mɔr wada, ka li pa'al ye, li nar ka o kpi, bɔzugɔ o maal o mɛŋ ye o anɛ Wina'am Biig.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Ka Pailet n wʋm pian'abama la, ka dabiem maligim kpɛn' o.

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛm kpɛn' zakin la ya'as ka bu'os Yesu ye, “Fʋ yi yaa ni na?” Ka Yesu pʋ lɛbis oo.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Ka Pailet bu'os o ye, “Fʋ kʋ lɛbisi maa? Fʋ zi' ye m mɔr paŋ kanɛ na basif, bɛɛ kpa'af dapuudir zugɔɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “Wina'am ya'a pʋ tisi nɛf paŋa fʋ naan kʋ nyɛɛn paŋi nyaŋini ma. Dinzug onɛ mɔrim na niŋi fʋ nu'usin la, tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi gaad fʋ.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Pian'akaŋa yɛla ka Pailet ieed suor ye o bas o, amaa Jew dim da tansidi yɛt ye, “Fʋ ya'a bas dau kaŋa, fʋ ka' Room na'ab Siiza zuaa. Bɔzugɔ on mɛkama nɔk o mɛŋi maal na'ab bɔɔd ye o zab nɛ Siiza.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Ka Pailet n wʋm pian'abama la, o mɔr Yesu n yina ka zin'in sariakadib gbauŋ la zug linɛ bɛ zin'ikan ka Jew dim buon ye Gabbata la, ka li gbin an kuglamma la.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Daakan, ka ba ti'ebid Kum Maliak Gaadʋg daar la ka li an nintaŋ tisʋʋs. Ka Pailet yɛl Jew dim la ye, “Ya na'ab la nwa'.”

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Ka o yʋ'ʋn kɛɛs o tisi ba ye ba kpa' o dapuudir zugʋ kʋ. Ban kpa' Yesu dapuudir zug la yɛla (Mat

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Ka soogianam keŋ kɔ' yiiga daan la nɔba, nɛ o tiraan onɛ ka ba daa la'am kpa' kpi'el Yesu la nɔba.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim maanmaannib kpɛɛmnam yɛl Pailet ye o da sɔb ye, “Dau kaŋa anɛ Jew dim na'aba, amaa ye o sɔm ye, dau kaŋa yɛl ye, o anɛ Jew dim na'ab.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu nyɛɛ o ma nɛ o nya'andɔl kanɛ ka o nɔŋ la ka ba zi'e kpi'e o la, o yɛl o ma la ye, “M ma, fʋ biigi nwa'.”

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: Ka ba mɔr Yesu yi teŋin la ka kɛ ka o ziid o mɛŋ dapuudiri keŋ zin'ikan ka Jew dim buon ye Golgota la, ka li gbin an ye zunwana zin'ig.

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Ka ba kpa' o tabil dapuudir zug. Ka mɛ kpa' nidib ayi' tabil dapuuda zug, ka yinne bɛɛ o dagɔbʋg ka yinne bɛɛ o datiuŋ. Ka Yesu bɛɛ ba sʋʋgin.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Ka Pailet sɔb o yɛlaa tabil dapuudir la zug ka sɔbir la yɛl ye, “Yesu onɛ yi Nazaret, ka an Jew dim na'ab la.”

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Zin'ikanɛ ka ba da kpa' Yesu la da kpi'enɛ tempʋʋgin la ka Jew dim bɛdegʋ karim sɔb la. Ka sɔb la da sɔb nɛ Jew dim pian'ad nɛ Room dim pian'ad nɛ Girik dim pian'ad.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Ka Pailet lɛbis ye, “Mam sɔb si'em la linɛ kpɛm bɛ.”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Ka ba yɛl taaba ye, “Da kɛ ka ti aaɛn lii, kɛlli ka ti bʋgʋlʋm gɔs onɛ na di.” Nɛ'ɛŋa da niŋnɛ ala ye Wina'am gbauŋ la sɔb si'em la niŋ amɛŋa ye, “Ba pʋdigim fuudi tis taaba ka maal bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm m fuug la yɛla.” Soogianam la niŋ si'em la.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ma nɛ o mapit, nɛ Kleopas pu'a nɛ Mɛɛri Magdalen, zi'e kpi'e dapuudir la.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Ka ban kɛn Yesu san'an na nyɛ ka o kpi la, ba pʋ kɔɔ o nɔbaa.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Ka lɔmbɔn'ɔg bɛ zin'ikanɛ ka ba kpa' o la baba, ka Jew dim yaʋg bɛɛ li pʋʋgin, ka ba nam pʋ mum sɔ' li nii.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yʋ'ʋn baŋ ye si'el wʋsa naae ya la ka yɛl ye, “Ku'onuudi mɔrim.” O yɛl ala ye Wina'am gbauŋʋ sɔb si'em la niŋ amɛŋa.

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Ka nwam zi'e nɛ danmi'isʋg. Ka ba zaŋ sʋʋsʋ lɔs danmi'isʋgʋn la lɔ kikan'arini niŋ o nɔɔrin.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Ka on nu danmi'isʋg la ka ye, “Li naae ya,” ka su'un o zug ka kpi.

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Li da anɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar ti'ebʋg, ka bɛog kanɛ nied la an dabistita'ar, linzug ka Jew dim la pʋ bɔɔd ye niŋgbina la kpɛm bɛ dapuuda zugʋ li daarɛ, ka ba sɔs Pailet ye o kɛ ka ba kɔɔ ba nɔba, ka sigisi ba dapuuda la ni.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Ka soogia yinne zaŋ kpan nɛ kʋns o lʋgir ka ziim nɛ ku'om kpɛn yina.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Dau onɛ nyɛɛ li la dii li kasɛt, ka on tis kasɛt si'a la an sida. O mɛŋ mi' ye o pian'adnɛ sida ye ya mɛ siaki li.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Ka nɛ'ɛŋa da niŋnɛ ye Wina'am gbauŋ la sɔb si'em la lieb amɛŋa ye, “Baa o kɔnbir yinne, kʋ kɔ'ɔgɛ.”

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am gbauŋ lɛn sɔb zin'isi'a ya'as ye, “Ba na gɔs onɛ ka ba kʋns la.” Ban mum Yesu la yɛla (Mat

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: Ka dabisir la sadigim an Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar ti'ebʋg ka yaʋg la mɛ pʋ lal la, ka ba mum Yesu anina.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa nya'aŋ ka Josef onɛ yi Arimatea teŋin ka an Yesu nya'andɔl la keŋ sɔs Pailet ye o zaŋim Yesu niŋgbiŋ la tis o. Josef da anɛ Yesu nya'andɔl amaa on da zɔt Jew dim la zug ka o pʋ nɛɛl o mɛŋa. Ka Pailet siak ka o zaŋ niŋgbiŋ la keŋ.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Ka ba zaŋ Yesu niŋgbiŋ la bɔbig nɛ fuud nɛ bʋnnyubisa la, wʋʋ Jew dim kum malʋŋʋ an si'em la.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Ka Tomas lɛbisi yɛl o ye, “Fʋ anɛ m Zugsɔb nɛ m Wina'am.”

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Ka Alasid daar ka Mɛɛri Magdalen isigi keŋ yaʋgʋn la, ka li nam pʋ nie naae, ka o nyɛ ka kugir linɛ ligil yaʋg la bilig.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Ka nya'andɔl onɛ paae yiiga la mɛ kpɛn' yaʋgʋn la nyɛɛ li ka siak sida.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Ka Tomas onɛ ka ba buon Liibir ka an Yesu nya'andɔlib pii nɛ ayi' la nid yinne la da ka' ba san'an Yesu da kena laa.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: ka nyɛ maliaknam ayi' ka ba yɛ fupiela zin' zin'ikanɛ ka Yesu daa bɛ la. Ka yinne bɛ zug baba ka yinne mɛ bɛ nɔba baba.

english_verse: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Ka o zɔɔ keŋ Simon Pita nɛ nya'andɔl onɛ ka Yesu nɔŋ la san'an, ka yɛli ba ye, “Ba yis Zugsɔb la yaʋgʋn la ka ti zi' ban niŋ o si'ela.”

english_verse: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
translation_verse: Ka Pita nɛ nya'andɔl yinne la zɔɔ keŋ yaʋgʋn la,

english_verse: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.
translation_verse: ka yinne la zɔɔ gaad Pita paae yaʋgʋn la yiiga,

english_verse: He bent over and saw the strips of linen cloth lying inside the tomb, but he did not go in.
translation_verse: ka kunnɛ gɔs ka nyɛ fuud la, ka lɛɛ pʋ kpɛn' anii.

english_verse: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.
translation_verse: Ka Simon Pita paae kpɛm kpɛn', ka nyɛ fuud la digi,

english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: nɛ pien linɛ ka ba vilig o zug la ka li pʋ bɛ nɛ fuud la, amaa li mɛŋi kpilim ken dig zin'isi'a sa.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene stood crying outside the tomb. She was still weeping, when she stooped down
translation_verse: Ka Mɛɛri zi'e yaʋg la yiŋi kum, ka sʋ'ʋnnɛ gɔs yaʋg la pʋʋgin,

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Ka ba bu'os o ye, “Pu'aa, bɔ ka fʋ kaasida?” Ka o lɛbisi ba ye, “Ba nɔki m Zugsɔb la ka m zi' ban niŋ o si'ela.”

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu bu'os o ye, “Pu'aa, bɔ ka fʋ kaasida? Ka anɔ'ɔn ka fʋ ieeda?” Ka o tɛn'ɛs ye o anɛ onɛ gur lɔmbɔn'ɔg la ka yɛl o ye, “M diemaa, li ya'a anɛ fʋnɛ zaŋ o niŋgbiŋ la, fʋn yɛlim fʋn niŋ li si'el, ka m keŋ nɔki li.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Da si'isi ma; ka m nam pʋ dʋʋ m Ba' la san'anɛ. Amaa kemi m ba'abiis la san'anɛ yɛli ba ye, m dʋtnɛ onɛ aan m Ba' nɛ ya Ba' ka aan m Wina'am nɛ ya Wina'am la san'an.”

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: Ka on daa yɛli ba wala la, ka pa'ali ba o nu'us nɛ o lʋgir. Ka nya'andɔlib la mɔr sumalisim ban nyɛ Zugsɔb la zug.

english_verse: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them
translation_verse: Ka daakan yʋ'ʋŋ sisɔbir, linɛ an Alasid daar, ka Yesu nya'andɔlib la la'as taaba dɔɔgin, ka kpar za'anɔya, bɔzugɔ ba da zɔtnɛ Jew dim la dabiem. Ka Yesu kena zi'e ba sʋʋgin, ka yɛli ba ye, “Sumalisim na bɛ nɛ ya.”

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛn yɛli ba ya'as ye, “Sumalisim na bɛ nɛ ya! Nwɛnɛ m Ba' tʋm man si'em la, ala mɛn ka mam mɛ tʋmmi ya.”

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka on yɛl ala naae la, ka vʋ'ʋsi niŋi ba ni, ka yɛli ba ye, “Di'emi Wina'am Siig Kasi.

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ wʋsa ka ya niŋ suguru nɛ o ka yis o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas la, Wina'am mɛ na yisi li bas. Ka niŋkan wʋsa ka ya pʋ niŋ o suguru ka yis o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi basɛ, Wina'am mɛ kʋ yis o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi basɛ.” Yesu nɛ Tomas la yɛla

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Ka nya'andɔlib la sieba yɛl o ye, “Ti nyɛ Zugsɔb la.” Ka o yɛli ba ye, “M ya'a pʋ nyɛ ban kpa' o nu'ug la isa ka si'isi li nɛ m nu'ubil, ka si'is o lʋgirɛ, mam kʋ siakɛ.”

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: Ka daba anii lɛm paae, ka nya'andɔlib la la'as dɔɔgin ya'as, ka Tomas bɛ nɛ ba. Ka la'an nɛ ban kpar za'anɔya la Yesu kena zi'eni ba sʋʋgin, ka yɛli ba ye, “Sumalisim bɛ nɛ ya.”

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛl Tomas ye, “Zaŋimi fʋ nu'ubili si'isi m nu'us, ka zaŋi fʋ nu'ugʋ si'isi m lʋgir. Da bi'esida amaa niŋim yadda.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Ka Yesu bu'os o ye, “Fʋn nyɛ man la zug ka fʋ niŋ yaddaa? Albareka bɛ nɛ banɛ pʋ nyɛɛ, amaa ka lɛɛ niŋ yadda la.” Linɛ yɛla ka ba sɔb gbauŋ kaŋa nwa'

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Yesu da tʋm tʋʋmnyalima sieba bɛdegʋ o nya'andɔlib la nini ni. Ka tʋʋmnyalima ban pʋ sɔb gbauŋ kaŋa nii.

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: Ka m sɔb nɛ'ɛnam ye ya siak ye Yesu an Kristo la, onɛ an Wina'am Biig la, ka ya ya'a niŋ o yadda, ya na nyɛ nyɔvʋr o yʋ'ʋr zug.

english_verse: Jesus later appeared to his disciples along the shore of Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Lin nya'aŋ ka Yesu nie o mɛŋ ya'asi pa'al o nya'andɔlib la Tiberias bɛuŋ baba, ka lin niŋ si'em anɛ anwa.

english_verse: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.
translation_verse: Simon Pita nɛ Tomas onɛ ka ba buon Liibir la nɛ Nataniel, onɛ yi Kana linɛ bɛ Galile sʋ'ʋlim la, nɛ Zebedee biis, nɛ Yesu nya'andɔl sieba ayi' da la'am bɛ nɛ taaba.

english_verse: Simon Peter said, “I'm going fishing!” The others said, “We will go with you.” They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.
translation_verse: Ka Simon Pita yɛli ba ye, “M wa'anɛ ye m gban'e zimi.” Ka ba lɛbis ye, “Ti mɛ na keŋ.” Ka ba keŋ kpɛn' anrʋŋ, ka yʋ'ʋŋ kan wʋsa ba pʋ gban'e si'el si'ela.

english_verse: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.
translation_verse: Ka bɛogʋ yiligid la, ka Yesu zi'e bɛuŋ gbɛog, amaa o nya'andɔlib la pʋ baŋ ye li anɛ onɛ.

english_verse: Jesus shouted, “Friends, have you caught anything?” “No!” they answered.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu bu'osi ba ye, “M biisɛ, ya mɔr zimii?” Ka ba lɛbis o ye, “Ayei.”

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Lɔmminɛ ya sau la anrʋŋ la datiuŋ baba ka ya na gban'e.” Ka ba lɔbi li ka zimi pɛ'ɛli galis ka ba mak ye ba tɛɛgi niŋ anrʋŋʋn la gʋ'ʋŋ.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Ka nya'andɔl onɛ ka Yesu nɔŋ la yɛl Pita ye, “Li anɛ Zugsɔb la.” Pita daa yɛɛgnɛ o fuugʋ digil ka tʋmm o tʋʋma; ka on wʋm ye li anɛ Zugsɔb la, o zaŋ o fuug tɔ'ɔtɔ yɛ ka ianki li ku'omin la keŋ Yesu san'an.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Ka ban dʋ gbɛog la ba yi anrʋŋʋn la na ka nyɛ ka bugumsaana dit, ka zimi pa'ae ka bodobodo mɛ bɛ.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “Mɔri zimbanɛ ka ya gban'e la sieba na.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “Kemi na di.” Ka nya'andɔlib la sɔ'ɔsɔ pʋ mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋʋ na bu'os o ye, “Fʋ aan anɔ'ɔnɛ?” Bɔzugɔ ba baŋ ye onɛ an Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu zaŋ bodobodo nɛ zimi la tisi ba, ka ba ɔnb.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa da an nɔɔra atan' daan ka Yesu nie o mɛŋi pa'al o nya'andɔlib la on da vʋ'ʋg kumin la. Yesu sɔnsid nɛ Pita la yɛla

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Ka ban dii naae la, ka Yesu bu'os Simon Pita ye, “Simon, Joon biiga, fʋ sid nɔŋ mam gat bamaa?” Ka o lɛbis o ye, “Ɛɛn, m Zugsɔba, fʋ pʋn mi' ye m nɔŋif.” Ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Guri m pɛbibis la.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛm bu'os o nɔɔr ayi' daan ye, “Simon, Joon biiga, fʋ nɔŋi maa?” Ka o lɛbis o ye, “Ɛɛn, m Zugsɔba fʋ mi' ye m nɔŋif.” Ka o yɛl o ye, “Gurim pɛ'ɛs la.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛm bu'os o nɔɔr atan' daan ya'as ye, “Simon, Joon biiga, fʋ nɔŋi maa?” Ka Pita sʋnf san'am, on bu'os o nɔɔr atan' daan ye, “Fʋ nɔŋi maa la?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “M Zugsɔba, fʋ mi' si'el wʋsa, ka mi' ye m nɔŋif.” Ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Guri m pɛ'ɛs la.”

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛn yɛl o ye, “Asida ka m yɛtif ye, fʋn da an dasaŋ la, fʋ da lɔɔd viligi ken fʋn bɔɔd si'el, ka fʋ ya'a ti lieb bʋnkʋdʋg, fʋ na tiɛn fʋ nu'us ka sɔ' na lɔɔ fʋ vilig ka mɔri fʋ keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka fʋ pʋ bɔɔda.”

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Yesu yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa nɛ ye o pa'al kum kanɛ buudi ka Pita na kpi, ka li an zun'ori tis Wina'am. Ka nɛ'ɛŋa nwa' nya'aŋ ka Yesu yɛl o ye, “Dɔl man.” Nya'andɔl kanɛ ka Yesu nɔŋ la yɛla

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Ka Pita nyɛɛ o la ka bu'os Yesu ye, “Ka dau kaŋa mɛnɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu lɛbis o ye, “Li ya'a anɛ m bɔɔdim ye o kpɛm bɛ ka m ti lɛb na, fʋ ba'a bɔɔ bɛɛ li ni? Fʋn ya'a dɔl man.”

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Ka pian'ad la yadigi paae yadda niŋidib la ye nya'andɔl kan la kʋ kpii, amaa Yesu mɛŋ pʋ yɛl ye o kʋ kpii, ka lɛɛ ye, “Li ya'a anɛ m bɔɔdim ye o kpɛm bɛ ka m ti lɛb na, fʋ ba'a bɔɔ bɛɛ li ni?”

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Nya'andɔl kaŋa di kasɛt yɛlbama nwa' yɛla, ka sɔbi li. Ka ti baŋ ye o kasɛt la anɛ yɛlsida. Li naari nwa'

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Si'elnam bɛdegʋ bɛ ka Yesu da maal. Ka ba ya'a ye ba sɔbini li wʋsa gbana ni, m tɛn'ɛs ka ti kʋ nyɛɛn dɔɔd dunia nwa' ni digilinɛ lii.

english_verse: Theophilus, I first wrote to you about all that Jesus did and taught from the very first
translation_verse: Teofilus, m daa yɛli fʋ m yiiga gbauŋ la pʋʋgin Yesu da pin'ili tʋm ka pa'al nidib si'el la wʋsa

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: hali ti paae daakanɛ ka Wina'am zaŋ o dʋ arezana ni la. O da mɔr Wina'am Siig Kasi la paŋ ka pa'al tʋmtʋmnib banɛ ka o daa gaŋ la ban na tʋm si'em ka Wina'am nyaan zaŋ o dʋ arezana ni.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: Ka ban la'as nɛ Yesu dit la, ka o tisi ba nɔɔr ye, “Da yii Jerusalem yiŋa, amaa guri piinkanɛ ka m Ba' da yɛli zi'el ka m yɛli ya la.

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: Joon daa sʋʋ ya nɛ Wina'am ku'om. Amaa li kʋ yuugɛ ka mam na sʋʋ ya nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la.” Wina'am zaŋ Yesu dʋ arezana ni (Mak

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Ka tʋmtʋmnib la la'as taaba nɛ Yesu ka bu'os o ye, “Zugsɔba, fʋ na lɛn lɛbis Israel dim na'am la nannanna tisi baa?”

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛli ba ye, “Li pʋ nar ka ya baŋ saŋa nɛ dabisa banɛ ka m Ba' Wina'am da zi'el nɛ o mɛŋ paŋ la.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am Siig Kasi la ya'a kɛɛn ya san'an na, ya na di'e paŋ, ka na tu'asi m yɛla Jerusalem nɛ Juda nɛ Samaria nɛ dunia bɛn wʋsa.”

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: On tu'asi naae la, ka Wina'am zaŋ o dʋt ka ba gɔsid o ka saŋgbana ligil o.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: Ka ban nan kpɛn gɔsid agɔla la, ka dapa ayi' yɛ fupiela zi'e ba san'an,

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: ka bu'osi ba ye, “Galile dima, bɔzug ka ya zi'e gɔsid agɔla? Yesu onɛ yii ya san'anɛ ken arezana ni la, o na ti lɛb na wʋʋ yanamɛ nyɛɛ o ka o ken si'em la.” Mattias di'e Judas zin'ig

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
translation_verse: Ka ban paae Jerusalem la, ba dʋ girimbisa linɛ aan ba yir sigidirin la. Banɛ da bɛɛ ani la da anɛ Pita nɛ Joon nɛ Jemes nɛ Andrew nɛ Filip nɛ Tomas nɛ Bartolomew nɛ Mateo nɛ Jemes onɛ an Alfeus biig la nɛ Simon Zeelot nɛ Judas onɛ an Jemes biig la.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Bama wʋsa nɛ pu'ab sieba Yesu ma Mɛɛri nɛ o pitib da la'asid nɛ taaba sɔsid Wina'am.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: (Judas daa di'e tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka o tʋm la yɔɔd, on daa da' pɔɔg la, anina ka o li teŋin ka o pʋʋr punsig ka o nyɔɔd wʋsa yi.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ wʋsa bɛ Jerusalem wʋmi li yɛla, ka pʋd pɔɔg la yʋ'ʋr nɛ ba pian'ad ye Akɛldama. Li gbin anɛ Ziim Pɔɔg.)

english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: Ka Pita yɛl ye li sɔb Yʋʋma gbauŋʋn la ye, “Kɛl ka o yir la yɔ danzuunr, ka nidib kʋ lɛm bɛɛ aninaa.” Ka lɛn sɔb ye, “Kɛl ka sɔ' di'e o tʋʋma tʋm.

english_verse: So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
translation_verse: “Alazugɔ, li sʋm ye nid yinne paasi ti ni. Li sʋm ka o anɛ onɛ daa nyɛɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu kum vʋ'ʋgir la. Li mɛ sʋm ka o an onɛ daa pʋn bɛɛ ti san'an saŋa kanɛ ka ti Zugsɔb Yesu daa gɔɔnd nɛ ti lin pin'il Joon n da sʋʋd nidib Wina'am ku'om la, ti paae saŋkanɛ ka Yesu daa yii ti san'anɛ dʋ arezana la.”

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Ka ba yis nidib ayi'. Ka yinne yʋ'ʋr buon Josef onɛ ka ba buon ye Barsabas ka lɛm buon o ye Justus la. Ka yinne la yʋ'ʋr buon Mattias.

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: Ka ba sɔs Wina'am ye, “Ti Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ mi' ninsaalib pʋʋg. Pa'alimi ti nidib ayi' nwa' fʋn gaŋ sɔ'

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: ye o di'e Judas zin'igi tʋm tʋmtʋmnib la tʋʋma linɛ ka o bas ka keŋ o mɛŋ zin'igin la.”

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Ka ba bʋgʋlʋm ka li lu Mattias zugin ka ba zaŋ o paas tʋmtʋmnib pii nɛ yinne la kallin.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Tɔ'ɔtɔ ka vuud yi arezana ni na nwɛnɛ sisi'etita'ar nɛ pɛ'ɛl dɔkanɛ ka ba bɛ la.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Li saŋa ka Jew dim banɛ yi dunia sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa na da bɛ Jerusalem. Ba da anɛ banɛ dɔl Wina'am suor sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Ban wʋm vuud la, ka nidib bɛdegʋ la'as na, ka li lidigi ba bɛdegʋ, bɔzugɔ sɔ' wʋsa wʋm ka ba pian'ad o mɛŋ buudi pian'ad.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ka ba lidigi bu'osid taaba ye, “Gɔsima, nimbanɛ pian'ad nwa' wʋsa ka'anɛ Galile dimaa?

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Ka li niŋ wala ka ti wʋsa yinne-yinne wʋm ka ba pian'adi ti buudi pian'adɛ?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Ti yinɛ Partia nɛ Media nɛ Elam nɛ Mesopotamia nɛ Juda nɛ Kapadosia nɛ Pontus nɛ Asia,

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: nɛ Krete dim nɛ Arabia dim. Ka li niŋ wala ka ti wʋm ka ba pian'adi ti buudi pian'adi yɛt tʋʋm titada banɛ ka Wina'am tʋm la?”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Ka ba lidigi bu'osid taaba ye, “Yɛl kaŋa nwa' gbin lɛɛ an bɔ?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Amaa ka sieba pɔ'ɔgi ba, ka yɛt ye, “Nimbama nwa' nunɛ daam kʋʋl.” Pita n pian' tis nidib la (Joe

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Ka Pita duoe zi'en nɛ tʋmtʋmnib pii nɛ yinne la, ka yɛli ba nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Yanam banɛ aan m Juda dim taab nɛ banɛ bɛ Jerusalem kpɛla nwa' la, ya wʋsa baŋim yɛl kaŋa, ka kɛlis man ye m tu'asi ya si'el la.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Li nan anɛ bɛogʋn, dinzug, nidib nwa' pʋ nu daam kʋʋl nwɛnɛ yanamɛ tɛn'ɛsid si'em laa.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Amaa nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ bʋn linɛ ka Wina'am nɔdi'es Joel da pʋn sɔbi li yɛla ye,

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: “Wina'am yɛl ye, ‘Dunia naar ya'a ti li'el, m na kpa'ae m Siig Kasi la niŋ ninsaalib buudi wʋsa zug. Ya biribis nɛ ya bipumis na di'e Wina'am pian'adi tis nidib. Ka nie m yɛla pa'ali ya bibaanlʋg, ka ya ninkʋda zaansim zaansima.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Hali m na kpa'ae m siig la niŋi, m tʋmtʋm dap nɛ tʋmtʋm pu'ab dabisban la ni ka ba na di'e m pian'adi tis nidib.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: M na maal bʋnnyalima agɔl ka maal zanbina dunia zug. Ziim nɛ bugum na bɛ ka nyɔ'ɔs gbilim wʋʋ saŋgbana nɛ.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Winnig na ti lieb lik, ka nwadig mu'oe nwɛnɛ ziim nɛ, ka Zugsɔb dabistita'ar la naan paae.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Ka onɛ wʋsa buol Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, o na nyɛ faangir.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: “Israel dim wʋsa, wʋmmi pian'akaŋa nwa'. Wina'am daa tʋm tʋʋmnyalima nɛ bʋnnyalima nɛ zanbina Yesu onɛ an Nazaret dau la san'an, ka pa'ali ya ye onɛ tʋm o ya san'an na. Ya pʋn mi' nɛ'ɛŋa, bɔzugɔ li daa maalnɛ ya san'an.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Wina'am mi' si'el wʋsa. O bɔɔdim zug, ka o zaŋ Yesu niŋi ya nu'usin ka yanam nɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam gban'e o kpa' o tabil dapuudir zugʋ kʋ.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am san'am kum paŋ ka vʋ'ʋg o kumin, bɔzugɔ kum kʋ tun'e mɔr o.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Na'ab David da pʋn tu'as o yɛla saŋa kanɛ gaad la sa ye, “M nyɛt Zugsɔb la m tuon daar wʋsa. On bɛɛ m datiuŋ la zug, dabiem pʋ mɔri ma.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Dinzug, man sʋnf ma'ae nɛ ka m pian'ad nɛ sumalisim, ka m niŋgbina mɛ mɔr laafi ka si'el kʋ daami lii.

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ fʋ kʋ basim yaʋgʋnɛ, bɛɛ kɛ ka Onɛ an Kasi tisif la pun'oe.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Fʋnɛ kɛ ka m baŋ vʋm suor, fʋ na tisim sumalisim fʋ san'an.”

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: “M zuanama, kɛlli ka m ansigi tu'asi ya nyain ti yaab na'ab David yɛla. O da kpiya ka ba mum o ka o yaʋg bɛɛ ti san'an kpɛla hali ti paae zina.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: David da anɛ Wina'am nɔdi'es ka baŋ ye Wina'am pɔɔ zi'el ye o na kɛ ka nid yinne yii o yaas la sʋʋgin zin'in o na'am gbauŋ la zug.”

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: Dinzug, David da pʋn dɛŋi nyɛ Wina'am da ye o tʋm si'em la ka tu'as Kristo kum vʋ'ʋgir yɛla ye, “Wina'am pʋ bas o yaʋgʋn bɛɛ kɛ ka o niŋgbiŋ pun'oe.

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: Yesu kan la ka Wina'am vʋ'ʋg o kumin ka ti wʋsa nyɛɛ li ka tu'asidi ya li yɛla la.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka Wina'am dʋ'ʋs o zi'el o datiuŋ, ka o di'e Siig Kasi, linɛ ka o pʋn yɛli zi'el la. Yanamɛ wʋm ka nyɛt si'el nannanna la anɛ piini linɛ ka o tisi ti.”

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: David da pʋ dʋ arezana ni, amaa o da yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb la yɛli m Zugsɔb ye, Zin'inimi m datiuŋ,

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: hali ka m ti kɛ ka fʋ bi'emnam bɛɛ fʋ nɔba teŋir.”

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: “Dinzug, kɛlli ka Israel dim dɔɔg wʋsa baŋ ye li anɛ yɛlmɛŋir ye Yesu kanɛ ka ba daa kpa' tabil dapuudir zugʋ kʋ la, on la ka Wina'am kɛ ka o an Zugsɔb nɛ Kristo.”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Nidib la wʋm pian'ad nwa' la, ka li kpɛn' ba sʋnya ni hali, ka ba bu'os Pita nɛ tʋmtʋmnib la ye, “Ti ba'abiisɛ, ti na niŋ wala?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka Pita lɛbisi ba ye, “Tiakimi ya sʋnya, ka ya wʋsa yinne-yinne di'e Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb nɛ Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr, ka Wina'am na yisi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas. Ka ya na di'e Wina'am piini linɛ aan o Siig Kasi la.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Kaanbʋg la anɛ yanam nɛ ya biis din, nɛ banɛ bɛ lalli, hali nɛ nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ ka Zugsɔb la na ti buoli ba o san'an la.”

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: O da pian' pian'ad bɛdegʋ sa'ali ba nɛ nimmua ka yɛli ba ye, “Yisimi ya mɛŋ ka da la'asidi ya mɛŋ nɛ zʋmaʋŋ kaŋa nimbɛ'ɛdnam la.”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Ba da kpɛn zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ nɛ tʋmtʋmnib la pa'alʋg. Ka mɔr nɔɔr yinne ka la'asidi dit diib nɛ taaba ka sɔsid Wina'am. Yadda niŋidib la bɛllim yɛla

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am kɛ ka tʋmtʋmnib la tʋm tʋʋmnyalima nɛ zanbina bɛdegʋ, ka dabiem kpɛn' nidib la wʋsa.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ niŋ yadda la wʋsa mɔr nɔɔr yinne ka pʋdigid ban mɔr si'el wʋsa nɛ taaba.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Ba da kuosidi ba la'ad nɛ ba areza'as wʋsa pʋdigidi tisid taaba nwɛnɛ din nar ye sɔ' mɛkama di'e si'em.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Ka la'asid taaba daar wʋsa Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin. Ka mɛ la'asid yir yiri dit nɛ taaba, ka mɔr sumalisim nɛ pʋʋg yinne,

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: ka dʋ'ʋsid Wina'am yʋ'ʋr sʋ'ʋŋa, ka paam bareka nidib wʋsa san'an. Ka Zugsɔb la kɛ ka banɛ paamid faangir ka paasid yadda niŋidibin la kal ken tuon daar wʋsa.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Daar yinne ka Pita nɛ Joon dɔl taaba wa'ae Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin winkɔɔr linɛ an Winsɔsʋg saŋa.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Ka dau sɔ' bɛɛ anina an pɔn'ɔr o biilimin sa. Ka ba ziid o daar wʋsa mɔr o ken ka o zin' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔɔr linɛ ka ba buon Vɛnlim za'anɔɔrin la sɔsid nimbanɛ kpɛn'ɛd Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim yin la

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: On nyɛ Pita nɛ Joon ka ba bɔɔd ye ba kpɛn' la, ka o tiel nu'ugʋ sɔsid ye ba tis o si'el.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Ka Pita nɛ Joon gɔsid o kii; ka Pita yɛl o ye, “Gɔsimi ti.”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Ka o midig o nini gɔti ba, ka tɛn'ɛsid ye ba na tis o si'el.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Ka Pita yɛl o ye, “M pʋ mɔr anzurifa bɛɛ sanlima na tisi fɔ. Amaa m na tisif man mɔr si'el. Nɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ yi Nazaret la na yʋ'ʋr zug, duom keŋ.”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Ka Pita gban'e pɔn'ɔr la datiuŋ nu'ugʋ sʋŋ o ye o duoe. Anina yim ka o nɔba la kpɛm kpɛ'ɛŋ tɔ'ɔtɔ,

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: ka o duoe zi'en agɔl ka dɔlli ba kpɛn' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin, ka kpɛn ian'asid ka pian'ad Wina'am yʋ'ʋr sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Nidib la wʋsa daa nyɛɛ o ka o ken ka pian'ad Wina'am yʋ'ʋr sʋ'ʋŋa,

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: ka baŋ ye onɛ ɛɛnti zin' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔkanɛ ka ba buon Vɛnlim za'anɔɔrin la sɔsid la, li daa lidigi ba nɛ hali bɛdegʋ nɛ bʋnkanɛ niŋ o la. Pita pian' tis nidib Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Ka ban nyɛ pɔn'ɔr la mɔr laafi ka dɔl Pita nɛ Joon la, ka li lidig nidib wʋsa ka ba zɔɔ la'as taaba zin'ikanɛ ka ba buon Solomon za'ambɛŋ la.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Ka Pita nyɛ nidib la, ka bu'osi ba ye, “Israel dima, bɔɔ niŋ ka yɛl kaŋa nwa' lidigi ya? Bɛɛ wala ka ya gɔsidi ti nwɛnɛ li anɛ ti mɛŋ paŋ nɛ ti tʋʋm sʋma zugʋ duoe dau nwa' ka o kenna?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Li anɛ Wina'am onɛ ka Abraham nɛ Isaak nɛ Jakob nɛ ti yaanam da pʋ'ʋsid la dʋ'ʋs o Biig Yesu yʋ'ʋr. On la ka ya daa zaŋ o tis ye ba kʋʋ o, ka yɛl Pailet tuon ye ya zi' o, hali baa Pailet n daa bɔɔd ye o bas o la.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Amaa ya daa zan'as ninsʋŋ onɛ an kasi nɛ pʋpielim sɔb la, ka yɛl ye Pailet basim ninkʋʋd la tisi ya.

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: Ya kʋ onɛ sʋ'oe nyɔvʋr la, amaa ka Wina'am vʋ'ʋg o kumin. Tinamɛ daa nyɛɛ li ka dit kasɛti li yɛla.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Li anɛ yadda niŋir Yesu yʋ'ʋrin la kɛ ka dau kaŋa nwa' kpɛ'ɛŋ nwɛnɛ yanamɛ nyɛɛ o si'em la. Li anɛ yadda niŋir Yesu ni ka dau nwa' nyɛ laafi nyain zi'e ya wʋsa tuon nwa'.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: “M zuanama, nannanna m baŋ ye ya zi'ilim la zug ka yanam nɛ ya tuongatib daa niŋ ala.

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: Linɛ ka Wina'am da pʋn dɛŋi yɛl ka li yii o nɔdi'esidib nɔɔrin na la niŋ amɛŋa ye asɛɛ ka Kristo la namis.

english_verse: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, tiakimi ya sʋnya ka lɛb Wina'am san'an na, ka o na yisi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas, ka kɛ ka ya nyɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm Wina'am san'an.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: O tʋm Yesu onɛ an Kristo ka o pʋn dɛŋi gaŋ la tisi ya.

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: O na bɛ arezana ni hali paae saŋkanɛ ka si'el wʋsa na lieb bʋmpaala, nwɛnɛ Wina'am da pʋn dɛŋi kɛ ka o nɔdi'es sʋma banɛ an Kasi la pian' li yɛla pin'ilʋgʋn la.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Moses da yɛl ye, ‘Ya Zugsɔb Wina'am la na gaŋ o nɔdi'es yinne ya buudi sʋʋgin nwɛnɛ on da gaŋ mam si'em la. Asɛɛ ka ya kɛlis bʋn lin wʋsa ka o na tu'asi ya.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Ka on wʋsa pʋ di'e Wina'am nɔdi'es kan nɔɔrɛ, ba na san'am on daana ka yis o Wina'am nidib sʋʋgin.’

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: “Li anɛ sida ye, Wina'am nɔdi'esidib la wʋsa pian' li yɛla, lin yi Samuel saŋa sa, ba bɛdegʋ pian' ya, ka tu'as dabisbama yɛla.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Wina'am nɔzi'elʋg linɛ yi o nɔdi'esidib san'an na la anɛ ya din. Ka ya la'am di'e li nɛ nɔnakan ka Wina'am maal nɛ ya yaanam la. O da yɛl Abraham ye, ‘Fʋ yaas la ma'asim zug ka dunia buudi wʋsa na ti nyɛ Wina'am albareka.’

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ da vʋ'ʋg o Biig kumin la, tʋm o ya san'an yiiga, ye o niŋi ya albareka, ka fɛndigi ya wʋsa yinne-yinne ka yisi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pʋʋgin.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Ban nam tu'asidi tisid nidib la, ka maanmaan kpɛɛmnam nɛ banɛ gur Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la kpɛɛm, nɛ Sadusii dim kɛɛn ba san'an na.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Ka ba sʋnya pɛlig nɛ tʋmtʋmnib la ban pa'an nidib la ka mɔɔn Yesu kum vʋ'ʋgir labaari tisidi ba, ka nie pa'al ye kum vʋ'ʋgir bɛ la.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Ka ba gban'e ba kpɛn'ɛs sanrega ni ye bɛog nie, lin daa an sisɔbir la zug.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Amaa nimbanɛ da wʋm Wina'am labaar la bɛdegʋ sa daa niŋ o yadda. Ba dap kal daa anɛ wʋʋ tusa anu.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bɛogʋ nie la, ka na'anam nɛ kpɛɛmnam nɛ gbauŋmi'idib la la'as taaba Jerusalem.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Ka Annas, onɛ an maanmaan kpɛɛm, nɛ Kaifas nɛ Joon nɛ Alekzanda nɛ nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ yi maanmaannib tuŋʋn la la'as taaba.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Ka ba mɔri ba na zi'eli ba tuon ka bu'osi ba ye, “Anɔ'ɔn tisi ya paŋ bɛɛ nɔɔr ye ya maalim nwa'a?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi pɛ'ɛl Pita ka o yɛli ba ye, “Yanam banɛ sʋ'oe nidib la nɛ Israel kpɛɛmnama,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: ya ya'a bu'osidi ti zina nwa' ye ya baŋ tʋʋm sʋŋ kanɛ ka ti sa tʋm tis pɔn'ɔr la nɛ linɛ kɛ ka o nyɛ laafi la,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: m bɔɔd ye yanam Israel dim wʋsa baŋ ye li anɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ yi Nazaret na la zug ka nid nwa' zi'e ya tuon ka mɔr laafi la. Yesu kan la ka ya daa kpa' tabil dapuudir zugʋ kʋ ka Wina'am vʋ'ʋg o kumin la.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn Yesu yɛla ye, “‘Tampigkanɛ ka yanam tanmɛɛdib daa nɛ'ɛs la lieb lɔdigin tampigir.’

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Sɔ' lɛn kae mɔr faangirɛ. Ka yʋ'ʋsi'a lɛn kae dunia nwa' zugʋ na kɛ ka nidib nyɛ tiligirɛ.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ban wʋm ka Pita nɛ Joon tu'as nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ la, ka mɛ mi' ye ba anɛ tadimnam, ka pʋ zamis si'el-si'el la, li lidigi ba nɛ hali ka ba tiɛn ye ba daa bɛnɛ Yesu san'an.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Amaa ban daa nyɛ ka dau kanɛ paam laafi la zi'e ba san'an la, ba daa zi' ban na yɛli ba si'ela.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Alazug ka ba yɛli ba ye, ba yim kpikpɛŋ. Ka ba pin'ili nwɛ'ɛd taaba saawara ye,

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: “Ti na niŋ nimbama wala? Nidib banɛ wʋsa bɛ Jerusalem nwa' baŋi ba nyalima tʋʋm tita'ar la yɛla. Ti kʋ tun'e ki'isi lii.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Amaa tinamɛ na niŋ si'em ka ban tʋm si'el la da yadigi keŋ tuon anɛ, ti vɔlisi ba ye ba mid ka ba lɛn tu'as yʋ'ʋr nwa' yɛla tis nidib ya'as.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Dinzug ba buoli ba yɛli ba ye, ba mid ka ba lɛn tu'as bɛɛ pa'al nidib Yesu yɛla ya'as.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Amaa ka Pita nɛ Joon bu'osi ba ye, “Wina'am tuonnɛ, di nar ye ti siak yanam nɔɔr bɛɛ Wina'am nɔɔrɛ? Gandigimini ya mɛŋ.

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Tinam kʋ tun'e niŋ si'ela, asɛɛ ti tu'as bʋn linɛ ka ti nyɛ ka wʋm la.”

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: Dau kanɛ daa paam laafi ka li yinɛ Wina'am nyalima tʋʋma ni la da gaad yʋma pisnaasi. Yadda Niŋidib la sɔs sʋnkpi'euŋ la yɛla

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Ban daa basi ba la, ba daa keŋi ba taaba san'anɛ tu'asi ba maanmaan kpɛɛmnam nɛ teŋ la kpɛɛmnamɛ yɛli ba si'el la wʋsa.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Ban wʋmi li naae la, ka dʋ'ʋsi ba kʋkɔya nɛ ya'am yinne yɛt Wina'am ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ ka' tiraana; fʋnɛ maal agɔl nɛ dunia nɛ ku'otita'ar nɛ bʋn linɛ wʋsa bɛɛ li pʋʋgin.

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: Fʋ da kɛ ka ti yaab David, onɛ da aan fʋ tʋmtʋm la, tu'as nɛ Siig Kasi la paŋi yɛl ye, “‘Bɔɔ niŋ ka dunia buudi wʋsa sʋnya pɛligɛ? Bɔ ka ba san'amid saŋa gban'ad gban'ayaalisɛ?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Dunia na'anam duoe zi'e, ka banɛ sʋ'oe tɛɛns la'as taaba zan'as Zugsɔb la nɛ onɛ ka ba bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ o zug la.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Li anɛ yɛlmɛŋir ye Herod nɛ Pontus Pailet daa la'as taaba teŋ kaŋa nwa' ni, nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim nɛ Israel nidibi zan'as Yesu Kristo onɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋm sʋŋ ka fʋ gaŋ la.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: Ba maal bʋn linɛ wʋsa ka fʋ pʋn niŋi zi'el nɛ fʋ paŋ nɛ fʋ bɔɔdim la.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, nannanna gɔsim ban vɔlisid tinam banɛ aan fʋ tʋmtʋmnib la si'em. Tisimi ti sʋnkpi'euŋ ka ti mɔɔli fʋ labasʋŋ la.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Tiɛnmi fʋ nu'ug la kɛ ka banɛ bɛn'ɛd paam laafi ka tʋm tʋʋmnyalima nɛ zanbina fʋ tʋmtʋm sʋŋ Yesu onɛ an kasi la yʋ'ʋrin.”
