english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Ban sɔs Wina'am naae la, ka zin'ikanɛ ka ba la'as la dammid. Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi pɛ'ɛli ba wʋsa. Ka ba tu'as Wina'am pian'ad la nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ. Yadda niŋidib la pʋdigid si'el wʋsa nɛ taaba

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Ka nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ niŋ yadda la mɔr ya'am yinne la'an nɛ tɛn'ɛsa yinne. Ka nid baa yinne pʋ yɛl ye on mɔr si'el la, onɛ sʋ'oe lii, amaa li anɛ ba wʋsa din.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Ka tʋmtʋmnib la pian'ad Zugsɔb Yesu kum vʋ'ʋgir la nɛ paŋ tita'ar ka Wina'am yɛlsʋm bɛdegʋ bɛɛ ba wʋsa ni.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Sɔ' da ka' ba sʋʋgin la ka si'el pansig o bɔzugɔ, nimbanɛ da mɔr pɔɔd nɛ ya' la da kuosi li mɔr ligidi la na

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: ka yis ligidi la sieba su'a, ka kɛ linɛ kpɛlim la mɔr na niŋ tʋmtʋmnib la nu'usin. Ka o pu'a mi' li ti'ir.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Ka Pita bu'os ye, “Ananias, bɔ ka fʋ kɛ ka Sʋntaana kpɛn' fʋ sʋʋnrin ka fʋ ma' tis Wina'am Siig Kasi, ka yis ligidkanɛ ka fʋ kuosi fʋ la'ad la sieba su'a?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Fʋn nam pʋ kuosin la, li aannɛ fʋ din. Fʋn kuos la fʋ mɛ tun'e maali fʋ ya'am bɔɔd si'em. Ka bɔɔ niŋ ka fʋ tɛn'ɛs yɛl kaŋa fʋ sʋʋnrinɛ? Fʋ pʋ ma' tis ninsaala, amaa fʋ ma' tis nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi.”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Ananias n wʋm pian'akaŋa nwa' la, ka li teŋin kpi. Ka dabiem kpɛn' banɛ wʋm bʋn kaŋa nwa' la bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Ka dasam duoe zaŋ o vilig o nɛ pienni zii o keŋi mum.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Ka li pʋ yuugɛ ka o pu'a mɛ kena ka pʋ baŋ linɛ maalɛ.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Ka Pita bu'os o ye, “Yɛlimim, yanamɛ kuosi ya la'ad la, ligidi la wʋsa nwa' bɛɛ?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Ɛɛn, li wʋsa la.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Ka Pita bu'os o ye, “Bɔɔ niŋ ka ya niŋ nɔɔr yinne ye ya mak Zugsɔb Wina'am Siiga? Gɔsima banɛ mumi fʋ sid la nan zi'e za'anɔɔrin la. Ba mɛ na zii fʋ yi.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Ka pu'a la kpɛn li teŋin kpi Pita tuon, ka dasam la kena nyɛ ka o kpi sa, ka ba nɔk o keŋ mum kpi'el o sid.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Ka dabietita'ar kpɛn' banɛ niŋ yadda la wʋsa nɛ banɛ wʋm yɛlkaŋa nwa' la. Tʋmtʋmnib la tʋʋmnyalima la yɛla

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Ka tʋmtʋmnib la tʋm tʋʋmnyalima nɛ zanbina bɛdegʋ nidib la wʋsa sʋʋgin. Ka yadda niŋidib la la'as taaba zin'ikanɛ ka ba buon Solomon za'ambɛŋ la.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ pʋ niŋ Wina'am yadda la zɔ dabiem ka pʋ la'as nɛ ba, hali la'an nɛ nidibi pian' ba yʋ'ʋr sʋ'ʋŋa la.

english_verse: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Pu'ab nɛ dap banɛ da niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda la da paas nɛ hali lieb bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: Hali ka nidib mɔr ban'adnam na digili ba suoya ni nɛ sɔna ye Pita ya'a gaad anina o ma'asim na si'isi ba.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Ka nidib bɛdegʋ yi tembanɛ gilig Jerusalem la mɔr ban'adnam na, ka la'am mɔr banɛ ka kikiris dɔlli ba la kena. Ka ba wʋsa paam laafi. Tʋmtʋmnib la namisʋg yɛla

english_verse: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan kpɛɛm nɛ banɛ bɛɛ o san'anɛ an Sadusii dim la pin'ili bɛn'ɛd tʋmtʋmnib la fufum

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: ka gban'e ba kpɛn'ɛs sanrega ni.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Amaa ka Zugsɔb maliak keŋ yʋ'ʋŋ kan la yɔ'ɔg sanrega la za'anɔɔr ka mɔri ba yis yiŋ ka yɛli ba ye,

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: “Kem zi'enɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la tu'as nidib la nyɔvʋpaal labaar la yɛla.”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Ban wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la, ka keŋ kpɛn' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la bɛkɛungʋ pa'an nidib la. Ka maanmaan kpɛɛm nɛ banɛ bɛɛ o san'an la buol Israel dim kpɛɛmnam la nɛ Jew dim la wʋsa ye ba la'as na ka ba gban'e. Ka ba wʋsa la'as na, ka tʋm sanrega la ni ye ba mɔr tʋmtʋmnib la na.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Amaa ban tʋm sieba la paae la, ba pʋ nyɛɛ ba sanrega la nii, ka lɛb na yɛli ba ye,

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “Tinamɛ paae la ti nyɛ ka sanrega dɔɔg za'anɔɔr la kpar, ka banɛ gur la zi'e za'anɔɔrin la, ka ba yɔ'ɔg ka ti pʋ nyɛɛ ba anina.”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Banɛ gur Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la kpɛɛm nɛ maanmaannib kpɛɛmnam la wʋm yɛl kaŋa la, ba daa lidig nɛ hali pamm ka zi' yɛl la na ba'as si'em.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' kena yɛli ba ye, “Dap banɛ ka ya sa kpɛn'ɛs sanrega ni la zi'e Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la pa'an nidib.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ gur Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la kpɛɛm nɛ o nidib keŋ gban'e ba na, ka lɛɛ pʋ daami ba, ban zɔt ye nidib la na ti lɔbi ba nɛ kuga la zug.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Ban mɔri ba na zi'eli ba tuon la, ka maanmaan kpɛɛm la bu'osi ba ye,

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: “Ti daa pʋ yɛli ya ye ya mid ka ya lɛm pa'al sɔ' kpɛla nɛ yʋ'ʋkaŋa nwa' ya'asɛɛ? Amaa ya zan'asnɛ ka pɛ'ɛl Jerusalem wʋsa nɛ ya pa'alʋg la, ka mɔɔd ye ya zaŋ dau nwa' ziim zuol tinam zugin.”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Ka Pita nɛ o Tʋmtʋm taaba la lɛbisi ba ye, “Tinam na siak nɛ Wina'am nɔɔr ka ka' ninsaalib nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ ka ti yaanam da pʋ'ʋsid la daa vʋ'ʋg Yesu onɛ ka ya daa kpa' tabil dapuudir zugʋ kʋ la.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: On la ka Wina'am dʋ'ʋs o zin'ili o datiuŋ, ka o an tuongat nɛ faangidi tis Israel dim ye ba nyɛ suori tiaki ba sʋnya ka Wina'am yisi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Tinam nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi onɛ ka Wina'am tis na la anɛ kasɛtib yɛlbama ni. Onɛ an piini tis banɛ siak o nɔɔr la.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Ban wʋm pian'akaŋa nwa' la, ka ba sʋnya pɛlig hali ka ba bɔɔd ye ba kʋʋ ba.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Ka dau sɔ' duoe zi'en la'asʋg la sʋʋgin, ka an Farisii nid ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Gamaliel, o da anɛ onɛ pa'an Wina'am wada, ka lɛn an yʋ'ʋr daan nidib la sʋʋgin. Ka o tis nɔɔr ye ba yisim tʋmtʋmnib la yiŋ ka li niŋ bi'ela. Ka ba yisi ba.

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛl ye, “Israel dima, Gu'usiminɛ ya mɛŋ nɛ yanamɛ maan nimbama nwa' si'em la.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Ka lin nya'aŋ ka Judas onɛ yi Galile la mɛ duoe, nidib kaalʋg saŋa la ka ninsieba dɔl o. Ban da kʋʋ o la nimbanɛ da dɔl o la da widignɛ mɛn.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ nannanna m yɛti ya nɛ ye ya yisi ya nu'us nimbama yɛla ni; ka li ya'a anɛ ninsaalib tʋʋma, li na ti lieb zaalim.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Amaa li ya'a anɛ Wina'am din, ti kʋ tun'e san'ami lii. Daasi'erɛɛ ti na ti nyɛ ka ti zabid nɛ Wina'am.”

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Ka ba siak o yɛlʋg la, ka buol tʋmtʋmnib la kɛ ka ba bʋ' ba, ka yɛli ba ye, “Mid ka ya lɛn tu'as Yesu yʋ'ʋri tis nidib ya'as.” Ka basi ba ka ba keŋ.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka tʋmtʋmnib la yi la'asʋg la zin'igin nɛ sumalisim ban mi' ye Wina'am kaali ba paas banɛ sʋm ye ba namis ka di nyan Yesu yɛla la.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Daar wʋsa ka ba bɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka kpɛn'ɛd yaanɛ mɔɔn labasʋŋ la, ka pʋ bas nidib la zamisʋgɔ, ka yɛti ba ye Yesu an Kristo la.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Dabisban la ni nya'andɔlib la kal da paasidnɛ, ka Jew dim banɛ pian'ad Girik la nwa'asid nɛ Jew dim banɛ pian'ad Hibiru pian'ad la ka yɛt ye, ban sʋŋid nidib nɛ diib daar wʋsa la, ba pʋ tisid ban pʋkɔnya la si'ela.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Alazug ka tʋmtʋmnib pii nɛ ayi' la buol nya'andɔlib la wʋsaa yɛli ba ye, “Li pʋ nar ye ti bas Wina'am labaar mɔɔlʋg ka tʋm diib tʋʋma.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ ti zuanama, gɔsimi ya sʋʋgini gaŋ dapa ayɔpɔi banɛ an ya'am dim, ka Wina'am Siig Kasi bɛɛ ba ni bɛdegʋ, ka ti zaŋ tʋʋm kaŋa nwa' niŋi ba nu'usin.

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: Ka tinam na kpɛm pɛsigi ti mɛŋ nɛ Wina'am sɔsʋg nɛ labasʋŋ la mɔɔlʋg tʋʋma.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Ka ban yɛl si'em la niŋ nidib la wʋsa malisim. Ka ba gaŋ Sitivin onɛ niŋ yadda bɛdegʋ, ka Wina'am Siig Kasi bɛɛ o ni bɛdegʋ la, nɛ Filip nɛ Prokorus nɛ Nikanor nɛ Timon nɛ Parmenɔs nɛ Nikolas onɛ yi Antiok teŋin na ka dɔl Jew dim pʋ'ʋsim malʋŋ la.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Bama ka ba mɔri keŋ tʋmtʋmnib la san'an ka ba pa'ali ba nu'usi ba zut ka sɔs Wina'am tisi ba.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am pian'ad la yadigid ka nya'andɔlib la kal mɛ paasid bɛdegʋ Jerusalem ni. Ka maanmaannib la bɛdegʋ daa siaki niŋ Yesu yadda. Sitivin gban'ar la yɛla

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Wina'am albareka nɛ o paŋ tita'ar da bɛ Sitivin ni ka o tʋm tʋʋm nyalima pamm nidib la sʋʋgin.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Amaa ninsieba banɛ pʋ'ʋsid la'asʋg dɔkanɛ ka li yʋ'ʋr buon Sʋ'oe M Mɛŋ Dim ka yi Sairene teŋin nɛ Alekzandria teŋin, nɛ Jew dim sieba banɛ yi Silisia nɛ Asia tɛɛnsin na la, nwa'asid nɔŋgbannwa'ar nɛ Sitivin,

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: amaa ka pʋ tun'e lɛbisid o yam pian'abanɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi tis o ka o pian'ad laa.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Alazug ka ba bɔ ninsieba ka yɛli ba ye ba yɛlim ye, “Ti wʋm ka o pian' pian'abɛ'ɛdi tʋ'ʋd Moses nɛ Wina'am.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Ka ba kɛ ka nidib la sʋnf duoe la'an nɛ kpɛɛmnam nɛ gbauŋmi'idib la ka ba keŋ gban'e o mɔr o keŋ kpɛɛmnam la'asʋg zin'igin.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ka buol ziri kasɛtib ka ba ma'aa ziil o ye, “Dau kaŋa nwa' tʋ'ʋd Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kanɛ an Kasi la nɛ Wina'am wada la ka pʋ basida.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: Ti wʋm ka o yɛl ye, Yesu onɛ yi Nazaret la na san'am Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la ka tiak malima ban ka Moses tisi ti la.”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ zin' kpɛɛmnam la'asʋgʋn la wʋsa gɔsid Sitivin kii, ka nyɛ ka o nindaa nwɛnɛ maliak nindaa nɛ.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan kpɛɛm la bu'os Sitivin ye, “Ala bɛɛ?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “M ba'abiis nɛ m saamnama, kɛlisimi! Wina'am onɛ ka o na'am mɔr pipilim la, da nie o mɛŋi ti yaab Abraham san'an on da bɛ Mesopotamia teŋin ka nam pʋ keŋ zin'in Haran teŋin la,

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: ka yɛl o ye, ‘Yim ka basi fʋ teŋ nɛ fʋ buudi la, ka keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka m na pa'alif.’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: “Ka Abraham yi Kaldea dim teŋin la keŋ zin'in Haran teŋin. Ka o saam kum nya'aŋ ka Wina'am lɛn yis o keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka ya bɛ nwa' ni,

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: ka pʋ tis o paalʋ teŋ la ni ka li siak o nɔbir tiɛnrɛ, amaa Wina'am da yɛli zi'el ye, o na tis o teŋ kan la. Ka o kum nya'aŋ o yaas na ti sʋ'oe li, hali saŋkan la ka o nam pʋ du'a biiga.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Wina'am da yɛl o si'em nwa', ‘Fʋ yaas na lieb saam teŋ si'a linɛ ka' ya mɛŋ teŋa, ka ba na namisi ba yʋma kɔbisnaasi (

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Amaa m na ti namis sʋ'ʋlim kanɛ ka ba na ti an yammis la ka li nya'aŋ, ba na yii anina na lɛb na pʋ'ʋs mam kpɛla.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Wina'am da tis Abraham nɔɔr ye, on nɛ o yaas wʋsa kpɛn'ɛm baŋʋ ka li pa'al ye Wina'am nɛ Abraham siak taaba nɔɔr. Abraham n da du'a Isaak la li daba anii daar la ka o kpɛn'ɛs o baŋʋ. Ka Isaak du'a Jakob. Ka Jakob du'a ti Jew dim yaanam pii nɛ ayi' la.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: “Kpɛɛmnam la da mɔr fufum nɛ Josef ka kuos o tis Egipt teŋ dim. Amaa Wina'am da bɛ nɛ o,

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: ka yis o namisʋg wʋsa pʋʋgin kɛ ka o tʋʋma malis Egipt na'ab Faaro, ka tis Josef ya'am na'ab la tuon. Ka na'ab la tis o kpi'euŋ ka o sʋ'oe Egipt teŋ la nɛ o yir wʋsa.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: “Ka kɔ'ɔm tita'ar li Egipt nɛ Keenan tɛɛnsin mɔr namistita'ar na hali. Ka ti yaanam la kɔ'ɔŋ diib.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Jakob n da wʋm ye diib bɛ Egipt la, o da tʋmi ti yaanam ye ba keŋ Egipt n da na.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Ba lɛbig linɛ paasi abʋyi' la ka Josef kɛ ka o ba'abiis la baŋ o. Ka Faaro mɛ baŋ Josef ba' yidim.

english_verse: Joseph sent for his father and his relatives. In all, there were
translation_verse: Ka Josef tʋm buol o ba' Jakob nɛ o yidim wʋsa. Ba kal da paae pisyɔpɔi nɛ anu.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Ka Jakob duoe keŋ Egipt teŋin. Anina ka on nɛ ti yaanam da kpi.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Ka ba zii ba keŋ Sekɛm teŋin mumi ba yaʋg kanɛ ka Abraham da da' Hamor biis san'an la.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: “Amaa Wina'am kaanbʋg nɛ Abraham saŋa da li'el la, nidib da paasnɛ lieb bɛdegʋ Egipt teŋin.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Hali ka sɔ' ti di Egipt na'am ka zi' Josef yɛllɛ,

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: ka maal ya'ambɛ'ɛd nɛ ti buudi la, ka mugusi ti yaanam ka ba basi ba bilies ka ba kpi.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: “Lin saŋa ka ba da du'a Moses ka o an bivɛnliŋ ka paae Wina'am ya'am. Ka ba ugus o nwadis atan' o ba' yin.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Ka ban da bas o la, Faaro bipuŋ da nɔk o ugus. Ka o lieb o mɛŋ biig.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Ka Moses zamis Egipt dim ya'am wʋsa ka lieb nintita'ar, o pian'ad nɛ o tʋʋma wʋsa ni.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: ka nyɛɛ ba nid yinne ka Egipt nid namisid o. Ka o sʋŋi ti nid la kʋ onɛ an Egipt nid la yɔ sam.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: Moses da tɛn'ɛsid ye o buudi la na baŋ ye Wina'am bɔɔd ye o kɛ ka on yisi ba, ba fara la ni. Amaa ba da pʋ baŋɛ.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Ka bɛog nie ka o nyɛ Israel nidib ayi' ka ba zabid nɛ taaba. Ka o bɔɔd ye o kɛ ka ba naal nɔɔr la ka bu'osi ba ye, ‘M zuanama, ya anɛ ba'abiis ka bɔ niŋ ka ya zabid nɛ taaba?’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: “Amaa onɛ maal o kpi'e bɛ'ɛd la da'ae Moses, ka bu'os o ye, ‘Anɔ'ɔnɛ gaŋif ye fʋ sʋ'oe ti ka tu'a ti antu'a?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Fʋ bɔɔd ye fʋ kʋʋm nwɛnɛ fʋn sa kʋ Egipt dim dau la si'em laa?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Pian' kaŋa zug, ka Moses zɔɔ keŋ Midian teŋin lieb saan. Anina ka o du'a biis ayi'.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Yʋma pisnaasi gaad la nya'aŋ, o da bɛ nɛ mɔɔgin linɛ kpi'e Sinai zuor la, ka nyɛ ka bugum pielim bɛ tituugin ka Zugsɔb maliak nie o mɛŋ anina.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Moses n nyɛ li la ka li lidig o, ka o li'el ye o gɔsi li, Ka wʋm Zugsɔb la kʋkɔr,

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ka o yɛl ye, ‘Manɛ aan fʋ yaanam Wina'am la, m anɛ Abraham Wina'am nɛ Isaak Wina'am nɛ Jakob Wina'am.’ Ka Moses kirid ka pʋ nyaŋi gɔsi lii.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: “Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl o ye, ‘Pidigimi fʋ ta'ada la, ka zin'ikanɛ ka fʋ zi'e la anɛ kasi.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: M nyɛɛm nimbanɛ bɛ Egipt teŋin la namisid si'em, m wʋmi ba fabʋlʋg ka sig na ye m faaɛn ba. Alazug kem na ka m tʋmif Egipt teŋin.’

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: “Moses kanɛ ka ba da zan'as o, ka yɛl o ye, ‘Anɔ'ɔnɛ gaŋif ye fʋ sʋ'oe ti ka tu'a ti antu'a la?’ On la ka Wina'am da kɛ ka o maliak pian' tis o tituugin la. On la ka Wina'am tʋm ye o sʋ'oe o nidib ka yisi ba namisʋg pʋʋgin la.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: O da mɔri ba yi Egipt teŋin ka tʋm nyalima nɛ zanbina anina nɛ Atɛuk Zɛn'ugʋn la nɛ mɔɔgin la yʋma pisnaasi.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: “Moses kan la da yɛl Israel dim ye, ‘Zugsɔb Wina'am na tisi ya o nɔdi'es ka o nwɛnɛ mam nɛ ka yii ya mɛŋ buudi la sʋʋgin na.’

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: O da bɛ Wina'am nidib la sʋʋgin ban da bɛ mɔɔgin la nɛ maliak kanɛ da pian' tis o Sinai zuorin la nɛ ti yaanam, ka di'e Wina'am pian'ad linɛ vʋe la tisi ti.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: “Amaa ti yaanam da pʋ bɔɔd ye ba siak o nɔɔrɛ, ka zan'as o, ka tɛn'ɛsidi ba sʋnya ni bɔɔd ye ba lɛb Egipt teŋin.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Ka ba kud na'abil ka li an ba win ka maan maana li ni, ka maan sumalisim nɛ ba mɛŋ nu'usi kud si'el la.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Dinzug ka Wina'am basi ba ka ba pʋ'ʋsid bʋn linɛ wʋsa bɛ agɔl, wʋʋ lin sɔb Wina'am nɔdi'esidib gbana pʋʋgin si'em la ye, “‘Israel nidiba, ya da mɔr maana nɛ piini na tisim yanamɛ da bɛ mɔɔgin yʋma pisnaasi laa?

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Ya da zun'od Molek onɛ an teŋgban la, nɛ nwadbil Refan onɛ an ya win la, ya da maal bada anina pʋ'ʋsidi ba. Dinzugɔ, m na kɛ ka ba gban'e ya keŋ teŋ zʋŋ linɛ tʋʋg Babilon teŋ.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: “Ti yaanam da mɔr Fuug Sʋgʋr mɔɔgin la, ka Wina'am wada la bɛɛ li pʋʋgin. Ba da maali li nɛ, wʋʋ Wina'am da yɛl Moses ye ba maali li si'em la.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Ti yaanam banɛ da di'e Fuug Sʋgʋr la, ba da la'am zii li keŋ Josua da gaadi ba tuon ka ba faaɛn sʋ'ʋlim banɛ ka Wina'am da kad nidib la yis ka tisi ba la ni. Ka li kpɛm bɛ paae David saŋa.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: David da paae Wina'am ya'am ka sɔs o ye o kɛl ka o mɛ' yiri tis on kanɛ aan o yaab Jakob Wina'am la.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Amaa li anɛ Solomon n da mɛ' yir la tis Wina'am.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: “La'an nɛ wala, Wina'am onɛ gaad bʋn wʋsa la pʋ bɛ ya' banɛ ka ninsaalib mɛ nɛ nu'us nii, li anɛ wʋʋ Wina'am nɔdi'esi da yɛl si'em la ye,

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: “‘Zugsɔb yɛl ye, Arezana anɛ m na'am gbauŋ, ka dunia aan m nɔba zi'elʋg zin'ig. Yir bɔ buudi ka ya na mɛɛ tis mam? Ka m vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'ig na bɛ yaanɛ?

english_verse: I have made everything.”
translation_verse: Li ka' mam nu'usi maal si'el wʋsaa?’”

english_verse: You stubborn and hardheaded people! You are always fighting against the Holy Spirit, just as your ancestors did.
translation_verse: “Yanam banɛ zuti kpi'em, ka ya sʋnya digilim ka ya tʋba ziank la! Ya nwɛnɛ ya yaanam la nɛ. Ya zan'asid Wina'am Siig Kasi la saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Wina'am nɔdi'es kanɛ da bɛ, ka ya yaanam la da pʋ namis o? Hali ba da kʋ sieba banɛ da mɔɔn onɛ an pʋpielim sɔb la ken la na yɛla. Onɛ la ka ya zam o ka kʋʋ o la.

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: Ya anɛ banɛ da di'e Wina'am wada ban ka maliaknam da tisi ya la. Amaa ya pʋ siaki lii.” Ba lɔb Sitivin nɛ kuga

english_verse: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.
translation_verse: Ban wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la, ba sʋnya pɛlig nɛ, ka ba ga'adi ba nyina o yɛla.

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Amaa Sitivin da pɛ'ɛlnɛ nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la, ka gɔdigi gɔsid arezana ni kii, ka nyɛ Wina'am na'am pipilim ka li nie nyɛɛn pil-pil ka Yesu zi'e Wina'am datiuŋ.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Gɔsimi ya, m nyɛ ka arezana yɔ'ɔg ka Ninsaal Biig la zi'e Wina'am datiuŋ.”

english_verse: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen
translation_verse: Ka ba ɛndi ba tʋba ka tans nɛ kʋkɔtitada niŋ nɔɔr yinne la'as taaba zɔɔ gban'e o,

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: ka vɛ'ɛg o yis teŋ la yiŋi lɔb o nɛ kuga. Ka kasɛtib zaŋi ba fuudi gu'ul dasaŋ ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Saul.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Ka ban lɔbid Sitivin nɛ kuga la, ka o sɔs Zugsɔb la ye, “Zugsɔb Yesu, di'emi m siig!”

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: Ka igin teŋin tans nɛ paŋi yɛl ye, “Zugsɔba, kɛl nimbama nwa' taali bas.” On yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa la ka bas o mɛŋ.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Amaa Saul da kpɛ'ɛŋ o mɛŋ ye o san'am banɛ niŋ Yesu yadda la wʋsa ka kpɛn'ɛd yir wʋsa gban'ad pu'ab nɛ dapi kpɛn'ɛsid sanrega ni. Filip mɔɔl Wina'am labasʋŋ la Samaria

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Banɛ da zɔɔ widig la da kennɛ ka mɔɔn Wina'am labaar la zin'is wʋsa.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Ka Filip keŋ Samaria teŋ si'a mɔɔl Kristo labaar la tisi ba.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ da maal nɔɔr yinne ka kɛlisid Filip n tu'asidi ba si'el la, ban wʋm ka nyɛ tʋʋmnyalima banɛ ka o maal la.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: Kikiris da tansid nɛ paŋ ka yit ka basid ban mɔr sieba la. Ka nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ nu'us nɛ nɔba kpi la nyɛ laafi.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Ka sumalisim bɛdegʋ bɛ teŋ la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Dau sɔ' da bɛ teŋ la ni ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Simon. O da bʋgʋd nɛ ba'akɔlʋg ka li lidigid Samaria teŋ nidib. O da dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ ye o anɛ nintita'ar.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Ka nidib wʋsa kɛlisid o pian'ad sʋ'ʋŋa, banɛ an tadimnam nɛ kpi'emnam wʋsa da yɛt ye, “Dau kaŋa mɔr Wina'am paŋ kanɛ sid an paŋ tita'ar.”

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Nidib da siaki dɔl o sʋ'ʋŋa bɔzugɔ, on da kɛ ka ba lidigid nɛ o ba'akɔlʋg bʋgʋb la li da yuug ya.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Amaa ban da wʋm ka Filip mɔɔn Wina'am na'am nɛ Yesu Kristo labasʋŋ la, ba pu'ab nɛ dap wʋsa da niŋ yadda ka o sʋʋ ba Wina'am Ku'om.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Ka Simon mɛŋ mɛ niŋ yadda ka di'e Wina'am Ku'om sʋʋb ka bɛ Filip san'an ka nyɛt tʋʋmnyalima linɛ maan la ka li lidig o.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Yesu tʋmtʋmnib banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la da wʋm ye Samaria dim di'e Wina'am pian'ad la, ba da tʋm Pita nɛ Joon ba san'an.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka ban paae anina la, ka sɔs Wina'am tisi ba ye ba di'e Wina'am Siig Kasi la,

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ba da sʋʋ banɛ Wina'am Ku'om ka ba lɛɛ da nam pʋ di'e Siig Kasi la.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ani ka Pita nɛ Joon zaŋi ba nu'usi pa'ali ba zutin ka ba di'e Wina'am Siig Kasi la.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Simon n nyɛ ka li anɛ tʋmtʋmnib la nu'us pa'alʋg zug ka ba di'e Siig Kasi la, o da bɔɔd ye o tisi ba ligidi,

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba ye, “Tisimim paŋ kaŋa nwa' ka on mɛkama ka m pa'alim nu'us o zug na di'e Siig Kasi la.”

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Amaa Pita da yɛl o ye, “Fʋn nɛ fʋ ligidi la na ba'as yɔri fʋn tɛn'ɛs ye Wina'am piini la da'adi nɛ ligidi la zug!

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Fʋ nu'ug kae tʋʋma nwa' nii, ka fʋ pʋʋr mɛ kae li nii, bɔzugɔ fʋ sʋʋnr ka' nyain Wina'am san'anɛ.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: ka man nyɛya ka fʋ sʋnf pɛ'ɛl nɛ tɔɔg ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd gban'af.”

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Ka Simon lɛbis ye, “Sɔsim Zugsɔb la tisim, ka bʋn linɛ ka ya yɛl la baa yinne da paae ma.”

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Pita nɛ Joon da di kasɛt ka mɔɔl Zugsɔb labaari anina. Ban da lɛbid Jerusalem la, ba da mɔɔn labasʋŋ la Samaria tɛɛns bɛdegʋ ni. Filip nɛ Etiopia dau la yɛla

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb maliak da pian' tis Filip ye, “Duom kpa' nintaŋ dagɔbʋgʋ keŋ kidig pipirig suokanɛ yit Jerusalem ken Gaza la.”

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Ka o duoe keŋ, ka nyɛ Etiopia dau sɔ' ka o an nintita'ar Etiopia teŋin ka gur pu'ana'ab Kandase ligidi. Ka o keŋ Jerusalem sɔs Wina'am,

english_verse: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
translation_verse: ka lɛbidi kun ka zin' tɛreko kanɛ ka widi tɛɛd la ni karim Wina'am nɔdi'es Azaya gbauŋ.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am Siig la yɛl Filip ye, “Kem li'el tɛreko la, ka dɔlli li.”

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Ka Filip zɔɔ paae wʋm ka o karim Wina'am nɔdi'es Azaya gbauŋ. Ka Filip bu'os o ye, “Fʋ baŋ fʋn karim si'el nwa' gbinnɛ?”

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛbis ye, “M na niŋ wala baŋi li ka sɔ' pʋ pa'ali ma?” Ka o sɔs Filip ye, “Dum na zin'inɛ m san'an.”

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Wina'am gbauŋ zin'ikanɛ ka o karim la da sɔb nɛ ye, “Ba daa mɔr o keŋ wʋʋ pɛ'ɛkanɛ ka ba mɔri ken kɔdigir zin'igin nɛ, ka nwɛnɛ pɛbil kanɛ ka ba kiesid o kɔnbid, ka o an baanlimm ka pʋ ya'ae o nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: Ka ba pɔ'ɔg o ka pʋ kad o saria la ka li dɔl suor sʋ'ʋŋa. Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi tiɛn on kpi ka pʋ bas yaas la yɛllɛ, o nyɔvʋri naae dunia nwa' ni la zug.”

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Ka pu'ana'ab ligidgur la yɛl Filip ye, “Yɛlimi ma, Wina'am nɔdi'es Azaya tu'asid o mɛŋ yɛl bɛɛ ninsɔ' yɛla?”

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka Filip pin'il nɛ Wina'am gbauŋ kanɛ ka o karim la, mɔɔl Yesu labasʋŋ la tis o.

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: Ka Filip yɛl o ye, “Fʋ ya'a niŋ yadda nɛ fʋ sʋʋnr wʋsa fʋ na tun'e di'e Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb.” Ka o lɛbisi yɛl o ye, “Man siak ye Yesu Kristo la anɛ Wina'am Biig.”

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Ka o kɛ ka tɛreko la zi'en. Ka Filip nɛ on sig ku'omin la ka Filip sʋʋ o Wina'am ku'om.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Ban dʋ ku'omin na la, ka Zugsɔb la Siig zaŋ Filip n gaad. Ka ligidgur la pʋ lɛn nyɛɛ o ya'asɛ, ka gban'e o suori keŋ nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Nidib da nyɛ Filip Azotus teŋin. Ka o gat ka mɔɔn labasʋŋ la tɛɛns la wʋsa ni, hali paae Sizerea teŋin.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Saul kpɛm paasid o pian'ad la nɛ paŋ, ka nyaŋ Jew dim banɛ bɛ Damaskus la nie pa'ali ba ye, Yesu an Kristo la.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Duom kpɛn' tempʋʋgin la, ka ba na yɛlif fʋn na niŋ si'em.”

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Mam mɛŋ na pa'al o, on na namis si'em man Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr zug.”

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: On da paae Jerusalem la, ka bɔɔd ye o la'as nɛ nya'andɔlib la. Amaa ba da zɔt o nɛ dabiem, ban da pʋ niŋ o yadda ye o sid anɛ nya'andɔl la zug.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: O winsɔsʋg la pʋʋgin ka o nyɛ si'el ka li nwɛnɛ zaansʋŋ nɛ, ka dau sɔ' yʋ'ʋr buon Ananias ka o kpɛn' na tik o nɛ nu'us, ye o nini la lak.”

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Li pʋ yuugɛ ka si'el nwɛnɛ pa'ad nɛ kpɛn yi Saul nini la nii li. Ka o nini lak ka o nyɛt. Ka o duoe di'e Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb,

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Ka Saul kpɛm kpɛn'ɛsid Zugsɔb nya'andɔlib la dabiem mɔɔd ye o kʋʋ ba, ka keŋ maanmaan kpɛɛm san'an

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: ye o sɔb gbana tis o ka o mɔri keŋ Jew dim la'asʋg dɔɔd banɛ bɛ Damaskus teŋin la, ka o ya'a nyɛ sɔ' ka o dɔl Yesu suor ka an dau bɛɛ pu'a, on gban'e o lɔɔ mɔr o keŋ Jerusalem.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: On ti li'el Damaskus la, ka nɛɛsim yi arezana ni na nie nyain gilig o.

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: Ka o li teŋin, ka wʋm ka li yɛl o ye, “Saul, Saul, bɔ ka fʋ namisidi ma?”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Ka Saul lɛbis ye, “Naa, fʋ an anɔ'ɔnɛ?” Ka o lɛbis ye, “M anɛ Yesu onɛ ka fʋ namisid la.

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Ka dap banɛ dɔl o la zi'e baanlimm, ka lɛɛ wʋm kʋkɔr la, amaa ka pʋ nyɛ sɔ'ɔsɔ.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Ka Saul duoe lak o nini ka pʋ tun'e nyɛt si'ela. Ka ba vɛ' o mɔr o keŋ Damaskus.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Dabisa atan' ka o nini pʋ nyɛta, ka o mɛ pʋ di diib bɛɛ nu si'ela.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Nya'andɔlib la yinne da bɛ Damaskus, ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Ananias. Ka o nyɛ si'el ka li nwɛnɛ zaansʋŋ nɛ, ka Zugsɔb la buol o ye, “Ananias.” Ka o lɛbis ye, “Manɛ nwa', Zugsɔba.”

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl o ye, “Duom dɔl suor linɛ ka ba buon sappi suor la, keŋ Judas yin ka bu'os dau kanɛ yi Tarsus, ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Saul la yɛla. Ka o bɛɛ anina sɔsid Wina'am.

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Ananias lɛbis ye, “Zugsɔba, m pʋn wʋm dau nwa' tʋm Wina'am nidib bɛ'ɛd hali bɛdegʋ si'em Jerusalem teŋin.

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: Nannanna ka o di'e nɔɔr maanmaan kpɛɛmnam san'an ye o gban'e banɛ wʋsa aan fʋ nidib la.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Ananias ye, “Kem ka m gaŋ o nɛ ye o tʋmi m tʋʋma ka zaŋi m yʋ'ʋri keŋ nimbanɛ ka' Jew dim buudi la ni, nɛ na'anam nɛ Israel nidibin.

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Ka Ananias keŋ kpɛn' yin la ka tik Saul nɛ o nu'us ka yɛl o ye, “M ba'abiig Saul, Zugsɔb Yesu onɛ nie o mɛŋi pa'alif suorin saŋa kanɛ ka fʋ kennɛn na la, onɛ tʋm man fʋ san'an na ye fʋ nini la lak, ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la pɛ'ɛlif.”

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: ka di diib ka o paŋ lɛb na. Saul bɛ Damaskus teŋin Saul da kpɛlim nya'andɔlib la ni dabisa bi'ela Damaskus teŋin.

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: Ka li pʋ yuugɛ ka o kpɛn' la'asʋg dɔɔdin la mɔɔnnɛ yɛt ye, Yesu anɛ Wina'am Biig.

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Ka li lidig banɛ wʋmi li la wʋsa. Ka ba bu'osid ye, “Ka' dau kaŋa nwa' daa bɛ Jerusalem teŋin namisid nimbanɛ pʋ'ʋsid nɛ yʋ'ʋr kaŋa nwa' laa? Li ka'anɛ lin yɛla ka o kɛn kpɛla na ye o gban'e ba lɔɔ mɔri keŋ maanmaan kpɛɛmnam san'anɛɛ?”

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Ka dabisa bɛdegʋ gaad la ka Jew dim gban'e nɔɔr yinne ye ba kʋʋ o.

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: Amaa Saul da baŋ ban gban'e ye ba niŋ si'em la. Ba da gur teŋ la yaŋa ni nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa ye ba kʋʋ o.

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amaa o nya'andɔlib la da zaŋ o yʋ'ʋŋʋ kɛ ka o zin'in pɛogʋn ka ba sigis o vɔɔnr linɛ bɛ zaŋguomin. Saul n bɛ Jerusalem la yɛla

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Barnabas zaŋ Saul n mɔr o keŋ tʋmtʋmnib la san'anɛ pa'ali ba on daa nyɛ Zugsɔb la suorin, ka o pian' tis o si'em, nɛ Saul n mɔɔl Yesu yɛla nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ Damaskus teŋin si'em.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ala ka Saul da bɛ nɛ nya'andɔlib la Jerusalem, ka gɔɔndi mɔɔn nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr zug.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: O da pian'ad ka nwa'asid nɛ kpi'euŋ nɛ Jew dim banɛ wʋm Girik pian'ad la Zugsɔb Yesu yɛla. Amaa ka ba mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋ o.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Ka yadda niŋidib la baŋi li ka mɔr o keŋ Sizerea teŋin kɛ ka o gaadi keŋ Tarsus teŋin.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Ka yadda niŋidib la wʋsa banɛ bɛ Juda nɛ Galile nɛ Samaria la mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm. Ka ba kal paasid, ka ba yadda niŋir nɔbigid. Ka ba na'asid Zugsɔb la nɛ ba sʋnya wʋsa. Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi sʋŋidi ba. Pita n bɛ Lidda nɛ Joppa tɛɛnsin la yɛla

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Pita da gɔɔndi giligid zin'ig-zin'ig, o da keŋ ye o kaae Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Lidda teŋin la.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: Anina ka o nyɛ dau ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Aneas. Ka o bɛn' pɔn'ɔlim digi yʋma anii.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Ka Pita yɛl o ye, “Aneas, Yesu Kristo tisif laafi. Duom ka maali fʋ digisig la digil.” Ka o duoe yimmʋ.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: nimbanɛ wʋsa da bɛ Lidda nɛ Saron tɛɛnsin la nyɛɛ o la, ka nɔki ba mɛŋi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Pu'a sɔ' da bɛ Joppa teŋin ka an nya'andɔlib la yinne, ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Tabita. Li gbin anɛ Dokas bɛɛ Mɔlif. O da anɛ onɛ an tʋʋm sʋma daan, ka sʋŋid nɔŋ dim.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka ban'as gban'e o ka o kpi ka ba sʋʋ o digil girimbisa dɔɔgin.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Joppa da pʋ lal nɛ Lidda, ka nya'andɔlib la wʋm ye Pita bɛɛ anina la, ka tʋm nidib ayi' ye ba yɛl o ye o da yuugɛ ka kena.

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Ka Pita duoe dɔlli ba keŋ. Ka ba paae mɔr o dʋ girimbisa la zugʋ kpɛn' dɔɔgin la. Ka pʋkɔnya la wʋsa zi'e kpi'e nɛ Pita ka kaasid kʋʋr ka pa'an fubanɛ ka Dokas daa nam bɛ nɛ ba ka ʋgi tisi ba la.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Ka Pita yisi ba wʋsa yiŋ, ka igini sɔs Wina'am ka yɛl kpi'im la ye, “Tabita, duom.” Ka o lak o nini nyɛ Pita ka duoe zin'in.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Ka Pita gban'e o nu'ugʋ duoe o zi'el, ka buol yadda niŋidib nɛ pʋkɔnya banɛ niŋ yadda la zaŋ Dokas on vʋ'ʋg la tisi ba.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Joppa teŋin la dim wʋsaa wʋm yɛl kaŋa nwa' la, ka ba bɛdegʋ niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Pita da kpɛlim Joppa teŋin la dabisa bɛdegʋ. O da bɛ nɛ Simon onɛ an gbanzab la yin.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Dau sɔ' da bɛ Sizerea, ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Konelius. O da anɛ soogianam kɔbiga kpɛɛm ka ba buoni ba ye Itali dim soogianam.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: O da anɛ ninsʋŋ ka pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am, on nɛ o yidim wʋsa, ka sʋŋid Jew dim banɛ an nɔŋ dim, ka pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am daar wʋsa.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Ka daar yinne winkɔɔr ka li nwɛnɛ zaansʋŋ nɛ, ka o nyɛ maliak nyain. Ka maliak la yi Wina'am san'an kpɛn' o san'an na buol o ye, “Konelius.”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Ka on nyɛ maliak la ka dabiem kpɛn' o ka o yɛl ye, “Naa, wala?” Ka maliak la yɛl o ye, “Fʋ Winsɔsʋg nɛ fʋ tʋʋm sʋma la paae Wina'am san'an tiɛn Wina'am fʋ yɛla.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Tʋm nidib Joppa teŋin ka ba mɔr Simon Pita na.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: O signɛ Simon onɛ an gbanzab la yin. Ka o yir kpi'e nɛ atɛuk.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Ka maliak la tu'as o naae ka keŋ la, ka Konelius buol o tʋmtʋmnib ayi' nɛ soogia yinne onɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am ka mɛ an banɛ gur o la yinne,

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: ka o tu'asi ba linɛ maal la wʋsa naae, ka tʋmi ba Joppa teŋin.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Ka bɛog nie ka ba keŋ hali ti li'el teŋ la, ka saŋkan la nɔɔ ka Pita dʋ dɔɔg zug nintaŋ tisʋʋs ye o sɔs Wina'am.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Ka o kɔ'ɔm zabid ka o bɔɔd diib ye o di. Ban nam bɛɛ anina maan diib la, ka li nwɛnɛ o zaansim nɛ. Ka o nyɛ

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: ka arezana yɔ'ɔg, ka si'el nwɛnɛ pien tita'ar nɛ lɔ li nɔya anaasi sigid dunia ni na.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Ka bʋnkɔnbid buudi wʋsa la'an nɛ bʋnvuuda nɛ niis buudi wʋsa bɛɛ li pʋʋgin.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Ka o wʋm ka li yɛl ye, “Pita, duom ka kʋʋ lii ɔnb.”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Amaa ka Pita lɛbis ye, “Ayei, Zugsɔba, m nan zi' di linɛ kis ka an dian'adɛ.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Ka kʋkɔr la lɛn yɛl o ya'as ye, “Bʋn linɛ ka Wina'am maal sʋ'ʋŋa la, mid ka fʋ ye li kis.”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Ka li niŋ ala nɔɔr atan', ka yʋ'ʋn lɛb arezana ni.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Ka Pita nam bi'esid o pʋtɛn'ɛrin bʋn linɛ ka o nyɛ la gbin. Ka banɛ ka Konelius tʋm la bu'os Simon yir zin'ig ka kena zi'e yaŋirin,

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: ka buoli bu'osidi bɔɔd ye ba baŋ ye Simon Pita la sig nɛ anina bɛɛ?

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Pita nan tɛn'ɛsid linɛ ka o nyɛ la yɛla la, ka Wina'am Siig Kasi yɛl o ye, “Gɔsima, dap atan' bɔɔdif.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: Duom sigi bieli ba ka da bi'esida; ka manɛ tʋmi ba na.”

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Ka Pita sig teŋin keŋ dap la san'an yɛli ba ye, “Manɛ la ka ya ieed la. Ya kɛn labaar an bɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Ka ba yɛl o ye, “Konelius onɛ an soogianam kɔbiga kpɛɛm la tʋmi ti na, o anɛ ninsʋŋ ka pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am, ka Jew dim wʋsa pian'ad o yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa, ka Wina'am sa tʋm o maliak kanɛ an kasi o san'an yɛl o ye, o tʋm buolif na ka fʋ na tu'as o fʋn mɔr si'el.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Ka Pita di'e ba ka ba gbɛɛn o san'an. Ka bɛog nie ka o duoe dɔlli ba. Ka yadda niŋidib sieba banɛ bɛ Joppa la biel o keŋ.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Ka daba ayi' daar ka ba paae Sizerea teŋin. Ka Konelius guri ba ka buol o du'adib nɛ o zuanamɛ la'as.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Ka Pita kpɛn'ɛd la, ka Konelius tʋ'ʋs o igin o tuonnɛ pʋ'ʋs o nɛ na'asi.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Amaa ka Pita duoe o ka yɛl o ye, “Zi'enim, ka mam mɛ anɛ ninsaal wʋʋ fʋn an si'em la.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Pita daa pian'ad nɛ Konelius ka ba dɔl taaba kpɛn'ɛd la, o nyɛ ka nidib bɛdegʋ la'as.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Ya mɛŋ mi' ye Jew dim kis nɛ ban na la'as nɛ onɛ an buudzʋŋ bɛɛ ba kpɛn' o yin. Amaa Wina'am pʋn pa'al man ye m da buol nid ye dian'ad sɔb bɛɛ onɛ ka' nyainnɛ.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: Alazug ka fʋ tʋm buolim ka m pʋ zan'asɛ, ka kena. Bɔ yɛla ka fʋ tʋm buoli ma?”

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Ka Konelius lɛbis o ye, “Dabisa anaasi nwa' ka m daa bɛɛ m yinne sɔsid Wina'am saŋkaŋa nwa' win. Ka dau sɔ' yɛ fuug ka li nie nyain zi'e m tuon,

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: ka yɛl ye, ‘Konelius, Wina'am wʋmi fʋ sɔsʋg, ka tiɛn fʋn sʋŋid nɔŋ dim si'em la yɛla.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, tʋm Joppa teŋin buol Simon Pita na. O sig nɛ Simon onɛ an gbanzab ka o yir kpi'e atɛuk la yin.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Alazug ka m tʋm tɔ'ɔtɔ, ka fʋ maal sʋm ka kena la. Ti wʋsa bɛ Wina'am tuon kpɛla ye ti wʋm bʋn linɛ wʋsa ka Zugsɔb la yɛlif ye fʋ tu'asi ti la.” Pita pian'ad la yɛla

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Ka Pita pin'ili pian'ad ye, “M yʋ'ʋn baŋ ya ye li anɛ yɛlmɛŋir ye Wina'am pʋ gaansid nidiba.

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Amaa buudi wʋsa ni sɔ' ya'a pʋ'ʋsid o ka maan linɛ an sʋm, on daana paae o ya'am.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Ya mi' Wina'am daa kɛ ka ba zaŋ labasi'a tu'asi tis Israel teŋ dim la; ba daa mɔɔl labasʋŋ la yɛla pa'an ye sumbʋgʋsʋm yitnɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ aan ti wʋsa Zugsɔb la san'an na.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Ya mi' tʋʋm kanɛ da pʋn maal zin'ig wʋsa Juda teŋin la yɛla. Li da pin'il nɛ Galile teŋin Joon n da mɔɔn Wina'am Ku'om sʋʋb yɛla la nya'aŋ.

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Ya mi' Yesu onɛ yi Nazaret la yɛla, onɛ ka Wina'am da tis o Siig Kasi nɛ paŋ ka o ken zin'ig wʋsa tʋm tʋʋm sʋma, ka tisid banɛ wʋsa ka Sʋntaana namisid laafi la. Bɔzugɔ Wina'am da bɛɛ o san'an.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: “Ti di kasɛt nɛ bʋn linɛ wʋsa ka o tʋm Jew dim teŋin nɛ Jerusalem la. Ba da ya'al o dapuudir zugʋ kʋʋ o.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am da vʋ'ʋg o kumin dabisa atan' daar ka kɛ ka o nie o mɛŋ ka ti nyɛɛ o.

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: O da pʋ nie o mɛŋ nidib wʋsa san'anɛ, amaa li anɛ banɛ ka Wina'am da gaŋ la san'an ka o nie. Ka tinam banɛ la'am di ka nu nɛ o, o kum vʋ'ʋgir nya'aŋ la tu'asid nidib bʋn linɛ ka ti nyɛ.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: O yɛli ti ye ti mɔɔlim yɛl nidib ye on ka Wina'am zaŋi zi'el ye o kad banɛ vʋe nɛ banɛ kpi la saria.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Wina'am nɔdi'esidib la wʋsa da tu'as o yɛla, ye on mɛkama niŋ Yesu yadda, Wina'am na yis o daana tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas o yʋ'ʋr zug.” Banɛ ka' Jew dim di'e Wina'am Siig Kasi

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Pita nan tu'asid nɛ'ɛŋa la, ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la sig banɛ wʋsa wʋm pian'ad la zutin.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim yadda niŋidib banɛ dɔl Pita kena la lidig nɛ ban nyɛ ka Wina'am tisid nimbanɛ ka' Jew dim buudi o Siig Kasi la,

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: nɛ ban wʋm ka ba pian'ad teŋ zʋŋ pian'adi dʋ'ʋsid Wina'am yʋ'ʋr la zug.

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: Ani ka Pita yɛl ye, “Nimbama nwa' di'e Wina'am Siig Kasi la nwɛnɛ tinamɛ da di'e si'em la. Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na kadi ba ye ba da di'e Wina'am Ku'om sʋʋbɔ?”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba ye ba di'em Wina'am Ku'om sʋʋb nɛ Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr. Ka ba sɔs Pita ye o kpɛlimmi ba san'an dabisa bi'ela.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu tʋmtʋmnib nɛ yadda niŋidib banɛ bɛ Juda sʋ'ʋlim la wʋm ye nimbanɛ ka' Jew dim buudi mɛ di'e Wina'am pian'ad.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Ka Pita lɛb Jerusalem na ka Jew dim yadda niŋidib banɛ bɔɔd ye yadda niŋidib wʋsa kpɛn' baŋʋ la pɔ'ɔg Pita,

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: ka yɛl o ye, “Bɔɔ niŋ ka fʋ la'as nɛ nimbanɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ la dit nɛ ba?”

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Ka Pita pin'ili pa'ali ba bʋn linɛ daa maal hali pin'ilʋgʋn la sa ka ye,

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: “M daa bɛ nɛ Joppa teŋin sɔsid Wina'am ka li nwɛnɛ zaansʋŋ nɛ, ka m nyɛ ka si'el sigid na nwɛnɛ pien tita'ar nɛ lɔ luos anaasi yi arezana ni sigid na paae mam bɛ si'el la.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Ka mam gɔsidi li la, m nyɛ yin bʋnkɔnbid nɛ sian'arin bʋnkɔnbid nɛ bʋnvuuda nɛ niis.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm kʋkɔr ka li yɛl ye, ‘Pita, duom kʋʋ li di.’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: “Amaa ka m yɛl ye, ‘Ayei, Zugsɔba, bʋn linɛ kis ka an dian'ad nam pʋ kpɛn' man nɔɔrinɛ.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: “Ka kʋkɔr la lɛm pian' yi arezana ni na ye, bʋn lin ka Wina'am yɛl ye li an bʋnsʋŋ la mid ka fʋ yɛl ye li kis.

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa daa niŋnɛ ala nɔɔr atan', ka vɛ'ɛgi lɛb arezana ni ya'as.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: “Saŋkan la ka nidib atan' banɛ ka ba daa tʋmi m san'an na la yi Sizerea teŋin paae yikanɛ ka m daa bɛ la na.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la yɛlim ye m dɔlli ba keŋ ka da bi'esɛ. Ka yadda niŋidiba ayuobʋ bama bielim ka ti keŋ kpɛn' dau la yin.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Ka dau la yɛli ti on daa nyɛ maliak la ka o zi'e o yin ka ye o tʋm Joppa teŋin buol Simon onɛ ka ba buon Pita la na,

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: ka onɛ na tu'as o labaar kanɛ na tis o faangir on nɛ o yidim wʋsa.

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: “Ka man pin'il ye m pian' la ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la sigi ba zutin na, wʋʋ lin da niŋ tinam si'em pin'ilʋgʋn la.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Ka m tiɛn Zugsɔb la da yɛl si'el la ye, ‘Joon sʋʋd nidib la nɛ Wina'am Ku'om amaa ba na sʋʋ ya nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la.’

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Alazug Wina'am ya'a sadigim tisi ba piinkanɛ ka o da tisi ti, saŋkanɛ ka ti da niŋ Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yadda la, mam aan anɔ'ɔnɛ na ki'is Wina'am?”

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Ban wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la ka sin, ka dʋ'ʋsid Wina'am yʋ'ʋr sʋ'ʋŋa yɛt ye, “Alazugɔ Wina'am mɛ tis nimbanɛ ka' Jew dim buudi la suor ka ba na tiaki ba sʋnya ka nyɛ nyɔvʋr.” Antiok yadda niŋidib yɛla

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Banɛ da nyɛ namisʋg bɛdegʋ ka widig ban da kʋ Sitivin saŋsi'a la da keŋ hali paae Fonisia nɛ Saipuros nɛ Antiok tɛɛnsini mɔɔn Wina'am labaar la tisid Jew dim buudi gʋllim.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Amaa dap sieba banɛ da yi Saipuros nɛ Sairene sʋ'ʋlim la da keŋ Antiok teŋin pian' tis Girik dim ka mɔɔl Zugsɔb Yesu labasʋŋ la tisi ba.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la paŋ da bɛɛ ba san'an. Ka nidib bɛdegʋ niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda ka fɛndigi dɔl o.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Jerusalem la wʋm labakaŋa nwa' la, ka tʋm Barnabas Antiok teŋin.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: On da paae nyɛ Wina'am niŋi ba yɛlsʋm si'em la, li da niŋ o malisim hali. Ka o sa'ali ba wʋsa ye ba kpɛn dɔl Zugsɔb la nɛ sida ka da basɛ.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: O da anɛ ninsʋŋ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la pɛ'ɛl o, ka o yadda niŋir an bɛdegʋ. Ka nidib bɛdegʋ niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Barnabas da babis Saul Tarsus teŋin.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: On nyɛɛ o la o dɔl o lɛb Antiok na. Ka ba nɔk yʋʋm mummi la'asid nɛ Wina'am nidib ka pa'an nidib bɛdegʋ. Antiok teŋin ka ba pin'ili buon nya'andɔlib la ye, Kristo nidib.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Wina'am nɔdi'esidib da yi Jerusalem kɛn Antiok na.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Ka ba nid yinne onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Agabus la duoe zi'en. Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la pɛ'ɛl o, ka o tu'as yɛlkanɛ bɛ tuon, ka yɛl ye, kɔ'ɔm tita'ar na ti li dunia wʋsa zug. Li sid da niŋnɛ na'ab Klaudius zʋmaana ni.

english_verse: The followers in Antioch decided to send whatever help they could to the followers in Judea.
translation_verse: Ka nya'andɔlib la siak ye, sɔ' wʋsa yisim on mɔr si'el o paŋ bɛnnɛ tis, ka li sʋŋ yadda niŋidib banɛ bɛ Juda sʋ'ʋlimin la.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba da niŋ ala, ka zaŋi li niŋ Barnabas nɛ Saul nu'usin ye ba kem tis yadda niŋidib kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛ Juda sʋ'ʋlimin la.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la Na'ab Herod da namisid Wina'am nidib la sieba,

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: ka kɛ ka ba kʋ Jemes onɛ ba'abiigi an Joon la nɛ sʋ'ʋraug.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Ka on nyɛ ka li malis Jew dim sʋnya la, ka o kɛ ka ba gban'e Pita mɛn. Nɛ'ɛŋa da niŋnɛ bodobodo linɛ ka' danbin la diib saŋa.

english_verse: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.
translation_verse: Ban gban'e o kpɛn'ɛs sanrega la ka o kɛ ka soogianam pii nɛ ayuobʋ pʋdig anaas naasi gur o sʋ'ʋŋa, ka bɔɔd ye Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ nya'aŋ ka ba mɔr o yi nidib la san'an na.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Ba da kpɛn'ɛs Pita sanrega ni, amaa ka Wina'am nidib la sɔsid Wina'am tisid o hali ka pʋ basida. Maliak yis Pita sanrega ni

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Herod da zi'el dabisir kanɛ ka o na yis Pita niŋ nidib la nu'usin. Dabisir la da nan kpɛlim wʋʋ bɛog la, li yʋ'ʋŋ ka Pita digi soogianama ayi' sʋʋgin gbisid. Ka ba lɔɔ o nɛ bana ayi'. Ka banɛ gur la bɛ za'anɔɔrini gur sanrega la.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Ka tɔ'ɔtɔ yim ka Zugsɔb maliak nie o mɛŋ ka nɛɛsim nie nyain dɔɔgin la. Ka maliak la nwɛ' Pita lʋgiri nie o ka yɛl o ye, “Duom tɔ'ɔtɔ.” Ka bana la ka ba lɔɔ o nu'us la kɛnsigi li.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Ka maliak la yɛl o ye, “Yɛɛmi fʋ fuud, ka pidi fʋ ta'ada.” Ka o niŋ ala, ka maliak la lɛn yɛl o ye, “Lɔɔmi fʋ fugɔbʋg la ka dɔllim.”

english_verse: Peter left with the angel, but he thought everything was only a dream.
translation_verse: Ka Pita dɔl o yi yiŋ ka nam pʋ baŋ ye maliak la niŋid si'el la anɛ amɛŋaa, ka tɛn'ɛs ye li anɛ zaansʋŋ.

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: Ka ba gaad banɛ gur yiiga nɛ ayi' zin'igin la ti paad kʋnt za'anɔɔrin linɛ ken tempʋʋgin la, ka li yɔ'ɔgi li mɛŋ ka ba yi yiŋi dɔl suor la. Ka maliak la kpɛn bas Pita.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Ka Pita pʋtɛn'ɛr yʋ'ʋn nie ka o yɛl ye, “Nannanna m baŋ ya ye li anɛ amɛŋa, Zugsɔb la tʋm o maliak ka o faanm Herod nu'usin nɛ bʋn linɛ wʋsa ka Jew dim la bɔɔdin ye ba niŋim la.”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: On baŋ la, ka keŋ Joon onɛ ka ba buon Mak la ma Mɛɛri yin. Anina ka nidib bɛdegʋ da la'as taabaa sɔsid Wina'am.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Ka o paae yaŋirini kabir ka bipuŋ onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Roda la kena ye o gɔs.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: On baŋ Pita kʋkɔr la, ka o sʋnf ma'ae galis ka o pʋ yɔ'ɔg yaŋir laa, ka zɔɔ kpɛn' yɛl ye, “Pita zi'e yaŋirin la.”

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Ka ba yɛl bipuŋ la ye, “Fʋ gɛɛm nɛ.” Ka o zan'as ka yɛl ye, “Li anɛ onɛ la.” Ka ba lɛbis ye, “Li anɛ o maliak.”

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Pita kpɛn nwɛ'ɛd gam la. Ka ba yɔ'ɔgi nyɛ ka li an on la. Ka ba lidig hali.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: Ka Pita yibisi ba nɛ o nu'ug, ye ba an baanlimm. Ka o tu'asi ba Zugsɔb la niŋ si'em yis o sanrega la ni. Ka o yɛli ba ye, “Yɛlimi Jemes nɛ yadda niŋidib banɛ kpɛlim la.” Ka naan yii tɔɔm zin'isi'a.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Bɛogʋ nie la ka daauŋ tita'ar naan soogianam la sʋʋgin, ban bɔɔd ye ba baŋ linɛ niŋ Pita la zug.
