english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Ka Herod iee Pita gʋ'ʋŋ la ka tu'a banɛ gur sanrega la antu'a, ka bas nɔɔr ye ba kʋʋ ba. Lin nya'aŋ ka o yi Juda keŋ Sizerea teŋin kpɛlim anina. Herod kum la yɛla

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Ka na'ab Herod sʋʋnr pɛlig hali nɛ nimbanɛ bɛ Taya nɛ Sidon tɛɛnsin la. Ka ba la'as taaba dɛŋi nyɛ Bilastus onɛ an na'ab Herod saman na'ab la maal suor ye o nwɛ' na'ab nu'ug. Bɔzugɔ, ba diib daa yitnɛ na'ab la teŋin na.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Ka na'ab Herod daa zi'eli ba dabisir ye ba kɛɛn o san'an na. Ka dabsir la daa paae la, ka o yɛɛ o na'am kparibi zin' o na'am gbauŋ zug ka pian' tis nidib la.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Ka nidib la tans ye, “Nwa' anɛ win kʋkɔr ka li ka' ninsaal dinnɛ.”

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Anina yim ka Zugsɔb maliak kpɛn nwɛ' na'ab la, on pʋ dʋ'ʋs Wina'am yʋ'ʋr la zug. Ka zʋnzʋnya dii o ka o kpi.

english_verse: God's message kept spreading.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Wina'am pian'ad la yadigi paas.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Barnabas nɛ Saul n da naae ba tʋʋma Jerusalem la, ba da dɔl Joon Mak n lɛb Antiok.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Antiok teŋin la Wina'am nɔdi'esidib nɛ pa'annib da bɛ yadda niŋidib la sʋʋgin. Ba da anɛ Barnabas nɛ Simeon Niger nɛ Lusius onɛ yi Sairene na la, nɛ Manaen, onɛ ka ba da ugus o nɛ na'ab Herod la nɛ Saul.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Ka ba daa lɔ nɔɔri pʋ'ʋsid Zugsɔb la, ka Wina'am Siig Kasi yɛli ba ye, “Gaŋim Barnabas nɛ Saul ka ba bɛɛ ba gʋnni, ka ba tʋm tʋʋm kan ka m gaŋi ba ye ba tʋm la.”

english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Ka ba lɔ nɔɔr ka sɔs Wina'am, ka zaŋi ba nu'usi pa'ali ba zutin ka tʋmi ba ka ba yii keŋ. Saul bɛ Saipuros teŋin

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la tʋmi ba la, ka ba keŋ Selusia teŋin kpɛn' anrʋŋ anina keŋ Saipuros sʋ'ʋlimin,

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: ka ba paae Salamis teŋinɛ mɔɔl Wina'am pian'ad la Jew dim la'asʋg dɔɔdin. Ka Joon Mak da bɛ ka sʋŋi ba nɛ tʋʋma la.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Ba da lɔ'ɔŋ Saipuros teŋ kanɛ ka ku'om giligi li la, paae Pafos na, ka nyɛ ba'akɔlʋg daan ka o an Jew nid ka ma'aa ye o anɛ Wina'am nɔdi'es, ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Bar-Yesu.

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: O da anɛ teŋ kan gɔmena la zua. Gɔmena la da mɔr ya'am hali. O yʋ'ʋr da buoni Sergius Paulus. Ka o buol Barnabas nɛ Saul, on bɔɔd ye o wʋm Wina'am pian'ad la zug.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Amaa ba'akɔlʋg daan Bar-Yesu onɛ ka ba buon ye Elimas Girik pian'adin la kpɛ'ɛŋ o mɛŋi ki'isid Saul nɛ Barnabas ye o san'am gɔmena la yadda niŋir.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Amaa Saul, onɛ ka ba buon Paul la, da pɛ'ɛl nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la ka kpa' gɔsid ba'akɔlʋg daan la kii,

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: ka yɛl o ye, “Fʋn onɛ an Sʋntaana biig nɛ tʋʋm sʋma wʋsa bi'em nɛ zam daan la, wala ka fʋ mɔɔd ye fʋ san'am Zugsɔb la suor linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa la?

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, Zugsɔb la na namisif. Fʋ na zu'om ka kʋ tun'e nyɛt saŋa bi'ela.” Ka o kpɛn zu'om duoe babinnɛ bɔɔd ye sɔ' vɛ' o.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Ka gɔmena la daa nyɛ linɛ niŋ la ka niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda. Ka linɛ ka o zamis Zugsɔb la yɛla la mɛ lidig o hali. Paul n bɛ Antiok linɛ bɛ Pisidia la

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ka Paul nɛ o tʋmtʋm taaba kpɛn' anrʋŋʋ yi Pafos teŋin keŋ Perga teŋin linɛ bɛ Pamfilia sʋ'ʋlimin la. Ka Joon basi ba ka lɛb Jerusalem.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Ba da yi Perga gaadi paae Antiok linɛ bɛ Pisidia sʋ'ʋlimin la. Ka Jew dim Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar ka ba keŋ la'asʋg dɔɔgini zin'in.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Ka ban karim Wina'am wada nɛ Wina'am nɔdi'esidib gbana naae la, ka la'asʋg dɔɔg la kpɛɛmnam tʋmi ba san'an yɛli ba ye, “Ti zuanama, ya ya'a mɔr sa'alʋgʋ na sa'al nidib la, yanam pian'am tisi ba.”

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Alazug ka Paul duoe zi'en ka yibisi ba nɛ o nu'ug ka yɛli ba ye, “Israel nidib nɛ banɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am la, kɛlisimi.

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ ka Israel dim pʋ'ʋsid la da gaŋi ti yaanam ka dʋ'ʋsi ti buudi la, ban da nam an saamme bɛ Egipt teŋin la. Ka Wina'am mɔri ba yi Egipt teŋin na nɛ o paŋ tita'ar.

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, gu'usim ka yɛl banɛ ka Wina'am nɔdi'esidib da yɛl la da luu ya zutin nɛ.

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: O da san'am buudi ayɔpɔi Keenan sʋ'ʋlimin la ka tisi ba teŋ la ka ba sʋ'oe ka li aan ba faar.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Wina'am da pidig Saul na'am la, ka gaŋ David ka o di na'am la. Wina'am da yɛl ye, ‘M nyɛ Jese biig David ka o an onɛ paae m ya'am ka na tʋm linɛ wʋsa ka m bɔɔd.’”

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Paul da lɛn yɛl ye, “Na'ab David yaas la sʋʋgin ka Wina'am da kɛ ka faangid yii anina na tis Israel dim, onɛ an Yesu la, nwɛnɛ on da pʋn yɛl si'em zi'el la.

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: Yesu da nam pʋ kena la, ka Joon mɔɔli tis Israel nidib wʋsa ye ba tiakimi ba sʋnya ka di'e Wina'am Ku'om sʋʋb.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Ka Joon tʋʋma da bɔɔd naar la, o da bu'os nidib la ye, ‘Ya tɛn'ɛs ka m aan anɔ'ɔnɛ? Mam ka' on ka ya gur laa. Amaa sɔ' na kɛn mam nya'aŋ na, ka m pʋ nar nɛ mam na pidig o ta'adaa.’”

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: Ka Paul yɛl ye, “M ba'abiis banɛ an Abraham yaas nɛ banɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am nwɛnɛ tinam la, li anɛ tinam zug ka Wina'am kɛ ka faangir labaar la kɛɛn ti san'an na.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Jerusalem nidib nɛ ba kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa da pʋ baŋ ye Yesu an faangid laa. Ka mɛ pʋ baŋ nɔdi'esidib pian'ad la ka ba karim Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar wʋsa la gbinnɛ. Ban kad o saria ka kʋʋs o bɛ'ɛd la kɛ ka nɔdi'esidibi da yɛl si'el la niŋ amɛŋa.

english_verse: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
translation_verse: Ka ban da niŋ si'el wʋsa nwɛnɛ lin pʋn sɔb o yɛla si'em naae la, ka sigis o dapuudir la zugʋ pin' o yaʋgʋn.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am da vʋ'ʋg o kumin.

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: Dabisa bɛdegʋ ka o nie o mɛŋi pa'al banɛ da dɔl o yi Galile keŋ Jerusalem la, ka ba nyɛɛ o. Nannanna banɛ an kasɛtib ka tu'asidi tisid nidib la ban nyɛɛ o si'em.

english_verse: God made a promise to our ancestors. And we are here to tell you the good news
translation_verse: “Ti mɔri labasʋŋ la kɛɛn ya san'an na. Linɛ ka Wina'am da pʋn dɛŋi yɛli zi'eli ti yaanam la,

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: linɛ nwa' niŋ amɛŋa tis tinam banɛ aan ba yaas la, ka o vʋ'ʋg Yesu kumin. Li nwɛnɛ lin sɔb yʋʋma gbauŋʋn karʋŋ zuta ayi' la ni si'em la ye, “‘Fʋ anɛ mam Biig; zina ka m liebi fʋ Saam.’

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Wina'am da vʋ'ʋg Yesu kumin ka pʋ kɛ ka o niŋgbiŋ pun'oe la yɛla da pʋn sɔbnɛ o gbauŋʋn nwa' ye, ‘M na tisif bareka kanɛ ka m da pɔɔ zi'el David la.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Dinzug ka li lɛn yɛl yʋʋma gbauŋʋn la zin'isi'a ya'as ye, ‘Fʋ kʋ kɛ ka Onɛ an Kasi tisif la pun'oe.’

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: “David da tʋm linɛ paae Wina'am ya'am, o mɛŋ zʋmaana la saŋa, ka kpi ka ba mum o, o yaanam san'an ka o niŋgbiŋ pun'oe.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Amaa on ka Wina'am vʋ'ʋg o kumin la pʋ pun'oe.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: “Dinzugɔ m ba'abiisɛ, baŋimi ye dau kaŋa nwa' ma'asim zug ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yisib yɛla mɔɔnnɛ ya san'an la.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: “‘Gɔsimi, yanam banɛ an yʋ'ʋsan'auŋ dima, ya na vɔl ya'am kpi. M ye m tʋmnɛ tʋʋm tita'ar si'a ya zʋmaana nwa' ni, ka hali baa sɔ' ya'a pɛlig o pʋʋgʋ pa'ali ya, ya kʋ siak ye li sid na niŋɛ.’”

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Paul nɛ Barnabas n da yit la, ka nidib la sɔsi ba ye ba lɛm Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar kanɛ kenna la tu'asi ba bʋn linɛ ka ba tu'asi ba la ya'as.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: La'asʋg la widig la, ka Jew dim bɛdegʋ nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim buudii, ka lɛɛ dɔl Jew dim suor la da dɔl Paul nɛ Barnabas. Ka ba sa'ali ba ye ba kpɛm bɛ Wina'am yɛlsʋm la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar lɛm paae ya'as, ka teŋ la dim bɛdegʋ la'as taaba ye ba wʋm Wina'am pian'ad.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim la nyɛ ka nidib la an bɛdegʋ la, fufum gban'e ba nɛ ka ba pin'ili ki'isid Paul n tu'asid si'el la, ka pian'ad o pian'abɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Amaa Paul nɛ Barnabas tu'asi ba nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋʋ yɛli ba ye, “Li sʋm ka ti tu'as Wina'am pian'ad la tis yanam yiiga. Amaa yanamɛ zan'asi li ka gɔs ka ya pʋ nar nɛ nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naar la, ti na fɛndigi keŋ banɛ ka' Jew dim buudi la san'an.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la zi'el nɔsi'a tisi ti la sɔb ye, “‘M kɛya ka fʋ an nɛɛsim tis banɛ ka' Israel dim buudi la ka kɛ ka ba baŋ Wina'am yɛla nyain. Ala ka fʋ na mɔri m faangir la paae dunia bɛn wʋsa.’”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka' Jew dim buudi la wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la, ka di niŋi ba malisim hali ka ba wɔ'ɔg Wina'am yʋ'ʋr o pian'ad la zug. Ka Wina'am da gaŋ sieba ye ba nyɛ nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naar la niŋ o yadda.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb pian'ad la da mɔɔli widigi gilig sʋ'ʋlim kan la wʋsa.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Amaa Jew dim la da kɛ ka pu'a banɛ zɔt Wina'am ka ba yʋ'ʋr dʋ teŋin la, nɛ dap banɛ an tuongatib teŋin la, sʋnya pɛlig nɛ Paul nɛ Barnabas. Ka ba pin'ili namisidi ba ka kadi ba yisi ba sʋ'ʋlim la ni.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Ka Paul nɛ Barnabas kpa'asi ba nɔba titan ka li pa'al ye ba ba'a ka' nɛ baa, ka yii keŋ Ikonium teŋin.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka nya'andɔlib la mɔr sumalisim. Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi bɛɛ ba ni.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Paul nɛ Barnabas da keŋ Ikonium teŋin kpɛn' Jew dim la'asʋg dɔɔgin pian' hali ka nidib bɛdegʋ niŋ Wina'am yadda. Ba da anɛ Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dima.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Jew dim banɛ pʋ niŋ Yesu yadda la tugul banɛ ka' Jew dim la fɛndigi ba ya'am ka ba kisig nimbanɛ an Yesu nya'andɔlib la.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Ka Paul nɛ Barnabas zin'in anina yuug ka pian'ad Zugsɔb la yɛla nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ. Ka Zugsɔb tisi ba paŋ ka ba tʋm tʋʋmnyalima nɛ zanbina ka li pa'al nidib la ye Wina'am pʋpielim labaar la anɛ sida.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Ka teŋ la nidib pʋdig. Ka sieba bɔɔd Jew dim ka sieba bɔɔd Paul nɛ Barnabas.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim nɛ ba kpɛɛmnam bɔɔd ye ba diis Paul nɛ Barnabas nyan ka lɔbi ba nɛ kuga.

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Dau sɔ' da bɛ Listra teŋin an pɔn'ɔri zin' o nɔba zug ka pʋ tun'e kenna. O da pɔn'ɔlim nɛ o biilimin sa, ka nan zi' keŋɛ.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Ka o kɛlisid Paul pian'ad la. Ka Paul gɔs o kii ka baŋ ye o niŋ Wina'am yadda ye o na nyɛ laafi.

english_verse: and shouted, “Stand up!” The man jumped up and started walking around.
translation_verse: Alazug ka o yɛl pɔn'ɔr la nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Duom zi'en!” Ka dau la ianki agɔla zi'en ka pin'ili ken.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Ka nidib la bɛdegʋ nyɛ Paul n tʋm si'el la, ba tans nɛ Likaonia pian'ad ye, “Wina la sigi ti san'an na nwɛnɛ nidib nɛ.”

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Ba da nɔki ba wina yʋda pʋd o ba. Ba da pʋd Banabas yʋ'ʋr ye Zeus, ka pʋd Paul yʋ'ʋr Hemɛs, bɔzugɔ onɛ da aan ba antu'a tu'ad.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Zeus maanmaan la pʋ'ʋsim dɔɔg da bɛ nɛ teŋ la yiŋ. Maanmaan la nɛ nidib la da tɛn'ɛs ye ba anɛ wina, ka mɔr na'araad nɛ tiis puum keŋ teŋ la za'anɔɔrin na bɔɔd ye ba maal maana tis Barnabas nɛ Paul.

english_verse: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:
translation_verse: Amaa Paul nɛ Barnabas n wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la, ba aansi ba mɛŋ fuud ka kpɛn' nidib la sʋʋgin tansid ye,

english_verse: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: “Ti zuanama, bɔ ka ya niŋid nɛ'ɛnama? Tinam mɛ anɛ nidib nwɛnɛ yanam nɛ. Labasʋŋ la ka ti mɔɔnnɛ tisidi ya ye ya bas linɛ ka' gbinnɛ ka fɛndigi dɔl Wina'am onɛ vʋe ka maal saazug nɛ teŋgbauŋ nɛ atɛuk nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li ni la wʋsa.

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: Kʋdimin la, Wina'am da kɛ ka buudi wʋsa dɔlli ba mɛŋ suoya,

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: amaa ka lɛɛ tʋm tʋʋm sʋma pa'al ye o bɛ. O tisidi ti saa, nɛ zʋʋd bunib saŋa ye ti dii tig ka mɔr sumalisim.”

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ban da pian' pian'abama la, li da tɔi nɛ ban na giŋ nidib la ka ba da maal maana tisi baa.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim yi Antiok nɛ Ikonium tɛɛnsin kena nyaŋi fɛndig nidib la ya'am, ka ba lɔb Paul nɛ kuga, ka vuug o yis teŋin la, ka tɛn'ɛs ye o kpinɛ.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Amaa ka nya'andɔlib la la'asi gilig o ka o duoe kpɛn' teŋin la. Bɛogʋ nie la ka Paul nɛ Barnabas keŋ Derbe teŋin. Paul lɛb Antiok linɛ bɛ Siriya la

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Paul nɛ Barnabas da mɔɔl labasʋŋ la Derbe teŋin, ka nyɛ nya'andɔlib bɛdegʋ anina, ka lɛb Listra nɛ Ikonium ka nyaan lɛb Antiok teŋin naa

english_verse: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, “We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: kpɛmis banɛ niŋ Yesu yadda la ka sa'ali ba ye ba kpɛn zi'e ba yadda la ni kiŋ-kiŋ, ka yɛl ye, “Li nar ka ti namis yiiga ka naan kpɛn' Wina'am na'amin.”

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba da gaŋ kpɛɛmnamɛ tis yadda niŋidib banɛ la'asid teŋ-teŋ la wʋsa, ka lɔ nɔɔri sɔs Wina'am nɔki ba niŋ Zugsɔb onɛ ka ba niŋ o yadda la nu'usin.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Ka ban yi Pisidia la, ba gaadi keŋ Pamfilia.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Ka ban mɔɔl Wina'am pian'ad Perga teŋin naae la, ka gaadi keŋ Attalia linɛ bɛ teŋir la.

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: Anina ka ba kpɛn' anrʋŋʋ lɛb Antiok teŋin na. Bɔzugɔ, ani ka ba da sɔs Wina'am tisi ba ka ba pin'il tʋʋm kanɛ ka ba tʋm naae la.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Ban da paae Antiok la ka la'as Yesu nya'andɔlib la ka yɛli ba Wina'am nɔki ba tʋm si'em, nɛ on maal suori tis banɛ ka' Jew dim ye ba niŋ o yadda la,

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: ka zin'in nɛ nya'andɔlib la yuug.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Ka ninsieba yi Juda teŋin na pa'an yadda niŋidib la ye, “Ya ya'a pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ wʋʋ Moses wada la pa'an si'em laa ya kʋ nyaŋi paam faangirɛ.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa da kɛ ka Paul nɛ Barnabas nwa'as nɛ nidib la hali, ka dinzug ka ba gaŋ Paul nɛ Barnabas nɛ yadda niŋidib sieba ye ba keŋ tʋmtʋmnib la nɛ yadda niŋidib kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la san'an bu'osi baŋ yɛl la gbin.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Ka yadda niŋidib la yisi ba tʋm ka ba dɔlli yi Fonisia nɛ Samaria n yɛt nimbanɛ ka' Jew dim la tiakir la yɛla. Ka Fonisia nɛ Samaria dim yadda niŋidib la sʋnf ma'ae hali.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Ban paae Jerusalem la, ka yadda niŋidib nɛ tʋmtʋmnib la nɛ ba kpɛɛmnam wʋsa di'e ba. Ka ba tu'as Wina'am zaŋi ba tʋm tʋʋm sieba wʋsa.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Ka yadda niŋidib banɛ an Farisii dim la duoe zi'en ka yɛl ye, “Asɛɛ ka ba kpɛn' baŋʋ, ka ti zamisi ba, ka ba siak Moses wada la.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ka tʋmtʋmnib nɛ yadda niŋidib kpɛɛmnam la la'as ye ba gban'e yɛl kaŋa nwa' gbin.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Ka nwa'as nɔŋgban nwa'ar ka li yuug, ka Pita duoe zi'en ka yɛli ba ye, “M ba'abiisɛ, ya mi' ye pin'ilʋgʋn sa ka Wina'am da gaŋ mam ya ni ye m tu'as o labasʋŋ la tis banɛ ka' Jew dim la ka ba wʋm ka siak.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am onɛ mi' saalib pʋtɛnda la daa tisi ba o mɛŋ Siig Kasi la nwɛnɛ on daa tis tinam si'em la ka li pa'al ye o di'e ba.

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: Bakir daa kae tinam nɛ ban sʋʋgin nɛ. Ba daa niŋ Wina'am yadda ka o yisi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka ya makid Wina'am ka tisid o nya'andɔlib malimkpi'ema linɛ ka tinam nɛ ti yaanam da pʋ nyaŋi maalɛ?

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Tinam siakya ye ti paam faangir nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu pʋpielim pʋʋgin, nwɛnɛ lin niŋ si'em tis banɛ ka' Jew dim la.”

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ka nidib la wʋsa an baanlimm, ka kɛlisid Barnabas nɛ Paul n tu'asid tʋʋmnyalima nɛ zanbina banɛ ka Wina'am nɔki ba tʋm banɛ ka' Jew dim buudi sʋʋgin si'em la.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Ban pian' naae la, ka Jemes yɛl ye, “M ba'abiisɛ, kɛlisimi.

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Simon Pita pian' pa'ali ti Wina'am da dɛŋi gaŋ banɛ ka' Jew dim la pa'al ye o bɔɔd ye ba lieb o nidib mɛn.

english_verse: This agrees with what the prophets wrote,
translation_verse: Yɛlbama nwa' dɔlnɛ Wina'am nɔdi'esidibi sɔb si'em la ye,

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: “Nɛ'ɛŋa nya'aŋ m na lɛb na maligim maal David Fuug Sʋgʋr linɛ li teŋin la. M na maali li wɛn la wʋsa mɛɛ lɛbis, ka li lɛbi li naŋnaŋin.

english_verse: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ kpɛlim la na ieed Zugsɔb la, hali nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim buudi ka m gaŋ ye ba aan m nidib la.”

english_verse: I promised it long ago.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ nie nɛ'ɛnamɛ pa'al kʋdimin sa la yɛli li.

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: “Alazug mam pʋtɛn'ɛr anɛ ye ti da daam banɛ ka' Jew dim buudi ka fɛndigi lɛbid Wina'am san'an la naa,

english_verse: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: amaa ka lɛɛ sɔb gbauŋʋ yɛli ba ye ba da di ba'ar diibɔ ka li ka' nyainnɛ. Ka dap nɛ pu'ab da san'am taaba. Ka da ɔnb bʋnkɔnbid banɛ ka ba sianki kʋʋ, nɛ ni'im kanɛ nam mɔr ziim.

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Kʋdimin sa ka ba mɔɔl Moses pa'alʋg la tɛɛns wʋsa ni ka karim o sɔb la la'asʋg dɔɔdin, Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar wʋsa.”

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Ka tʋmtʋmnib nɛ yadda niŋidib wʋsa nɛ ba kpɛɛmnam tɛn'ɛs ye li an sʋm ka ba gaŋ nidibi ba sʋʋgin tʋmi ba Antiok teŋin la'an nɛ Paul nɛ Barnabas. Ka ba gaŋ Judas onɛ ka ba lɛm buon Barsabas la nɛ Silas. Nimbama anɛ banɛ ka yadda niŋidib la na'asidi ba.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Gbauŋ kanɛ ka ba da sɔbi tisi ba la nwa': Tinam banɛ an tʋmtʋmnib nɛ yadda niŋidib kpɛɛmnam la pʋ'ʋsid yadda niŋidib banɛ ka' Jew dim buudi, ka bɛ Antiok teŋin nɛ Siriya nɛ Silisia tɛɛnsin la.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: Ti wʋmya ye ninsieba yii ti san'an na daamidi ya nɛ pian'abanɛ fɛndigidi ya ya'am, amaa tinam pʋ tisi ba nɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.
translation_verse: Alazug ka ti la'as taaba gban'e nɔɔr yinne ye li an sʋm ka ti gaŋ ninsieba tʋmi ba ya san'an na. Ban nɛ ti zuanam Paul nɛ Barnabas

english_verse: These men have risked their lives for our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: banɛ zaŋi ba nyɔvʋya pɛ'ɛsigi ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo tʋʋma la na la'an kena.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka ti tʋm Judas nɛ Silas ye ba yɛli ya tinamɛ sɔb si'el la nɛ ba mɛŋ nɔɔr.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit has shown us that we should not place any extra burden on you.
translation_verse: Li an sʋm tis Wina'am Siig Kasi la nɛ tinam ye ti da ziili ya yɛla gaad lin nar si'em ka ya'a ka' bʋmbama nwa':

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: Ya da di ba'ar diibɔ, ka da ɔnb ni'im kanɛ nam mɔr ziim nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ ka ba sianki kʋʋ; ka dap nɛ pu'ab da san'am taabaa. Ya ya'a gban'e ya mɛŋ nɛ nɛ'ɛnam niŋir, ya maal sʋm. Wina'am na tisi ya yɛlsʋm.

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: Ba da yisi ba tʋm, ka ba keŋ Antiok teŋin la'as yadda niŋidib la, ka nɔk gbauŋ la tisi ba.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Ka nidib la karim gbauŋ la ka li niŋi ba sumalisim, bɔzugɔ, labaar la daa kpɛmisi ba nɛ hali bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Ka Judas nɛ Silas banɛ an Wina'am nɔdi'esidib la, pian' hali kpɛmis yadda niŋidib la.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: Ka zin'in nɛ yadda niŋidib la yuug bi'ela ka ba nyaan kɛɛsi ba nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Ka ba lɛb banɛ daa tʋmi ba la san'an.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Ka Paul nɛ Barnabas mɛ kpɛlim Antiok ka ban nɛ pa'annib bɛdegʋ banɛ bɛ anina la pa'an ka mɔɔn Zugsɔb pian'ad la. Paul nɛ Barnabas bakir yɛla

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: Dabisa bi'ela nya'aŋ ka Paul yɛl Barnabas ye ba lɛn kaae yadda niŋidib tɛɛns banɛ wʋsa ni ka ba daa mɔɔl Zugsɔb pian'ad la, gɔs ban an si'em.

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Ka Barnabas bɔɔd ye o dɔl Joon on yʋ'ʋri buon Mak la ka ba la'am keŋ.

english_verse: But Paul did not want to, because Mark had left them in Pamphylia and had stopped working with them.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Paul tɛn'ɛs ye li ka' sʋm ka ba dɔl onɛ daa zɔ ka basi ba Pamfilia teŋin ka pʋ dɔlli ba tʋm la.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: Ka ba nwa'as taaba pʋdig kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb. Ka Barnabas nɔk Mak ka ba kpɛn' anrʋŋʋ keŋ Saipuros teŋin.

english_verse: but Paul took Silas and left after the followers had placed them in God's care.
translation_verse: Ka Paul gaŋ Silas. Ka yadda niŋidib la sɔs Wina'am n tisi ba ye o guri ba nɛ o yɛlsʋm.

english_verse: They traveled through Syria and Cilicia, encouraging the churches.
translation_verse: Ka ba keŋ yi Siriya nɛ Silisia tɛɛnsin kpɛmisid yadda niŋidib la sʋnya.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Ka ba keŋ paae Derbe nɛ Listra tɛɛnsin na. Ka Wina'am nya'andɔl daa bɛ Listra ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Timoti, ka o ma an Jew dim nid, ka an yadda niŋid. Amaa ka o saam an Girik nid.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Ka Listra nɛ Ikonium yadda niŋidib pian' o tʋʋm sʋma yɛla.

english_verse: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.
translation_verse: Ka Paul bɔɔd ye Timoti dɔl o la zug ka o kpɛn'ɛs o baŋʋ, bɔzugɔ Jew dim wʋsa banɛ da bɛ zin'ikan la mi' ye o saam anɛ Girik nid.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Ka ba yii ken ka tu'asidi tisid yadda niŋidib la tʋmtʋmnib nɛ yadda niŋidib kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛ Jerusalem la gban'e si'em, ka yɛli ba ye ba dɔl gban'akaŋa.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Ka yadda niŋidib la yadda kpɛ'ɛŋ ka ba kal paasid daar wʋsa. Paul zaansim Troas teŋin

english_verse: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.
translation_verse: Ka Paul nɛ o taaba yi Frigia nɛ Galatia tɛɛnsin, ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la pʋ kɛ ka ba pian' Wina'am pian'ad Asia teŋin la.

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: Ka ba paae Misia teŋ bɛn na kpɛ'ɛŋ ye ba keŋ Bitinia teŋin. Amaa ka Yesu Siig pʋ siaki tisi ba suorɛ.

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: Ka ba dɔlli gaad Misia teŋin keŋ sig Troas teŋin.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
translation_verse: Ka li nwɛnɛ zaansʋŋ nɛ kɛn Paul san'an na yʋ'ʋŋ kan la, ka o nyɛ Masedonia dim dau ka o zi'e bɛlim o ye, “Kem Masedonia na sʋŋi ti.”

english_verse: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there. Lydia Becomes a Follower of the Lord
translation_verse: Ka on nyɛ zaansʋŋ la ka ti ti'eb tɔ'ɔtɔ ye ti keŋ Masedonia teŋin, tinamɛ gban'e ye Wina'am buoli ti ye ti tu'as labasʋŋ la tisi ba la zug. Lidia tiak Filipi teŋin

english_verse: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.
translation_verse: Ka ti kpɛn' anrʋŋ anina kpa' tituaa keŋ Samotires teŋin. Ka bɛog nie ka ti keŋ Niapolis teŋin.

english_verse: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.
translation_verse: Ka ti yi anina keŋ Filipi teŋin linɛ an Room Sʋ'ʋlim ka an Masedonia teŋ tita'ar la. Ka ti zin'in anina dabisa bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.
translation_verse: Ka Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar ka ti yi teŋin la keŋ kɔldaug baba; zin'ikanɛ ka ti tɛn'ɛs ye ti na nyɛ pʋ'ʋsim zin'ig. Ka ti zin'in anina pian' tis pu'ab banɛ la'as na la.

english_verse: One of them was Lydia, who was from the city of Thyatira and sold expensive purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the Lord God, and he made her willing to accept what Paul was saying.
translation_verse: Pu'a sɔ' da bɛɛ ani ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Lidia. O da yinɛ Tiatira na ka an onɛ kuosid fuvɛnla ka pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am. Ka Zugsɔb la yɔ'ɔg o pʋtɛn'ɛr ka o gban'e Paul pian'ad la gbin sʋ'ʋŋa ka niŋ yadda.

english_verse: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, “If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home.” Finally, we accepted her invitation. Paul and Silas Are Put in Jail
translation_verse: Ka on nɛ o yidim di'e Wina'am Ku'om sʋʋb. Ka o yɛli ti ye, “Ya ya'a siak ye m sid niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda, yanam kem na zin'ini m yin.” Ka ti siaki keŋ. Paul nɛ Silas bɛ sanrega ni

english_verse: One day on our way to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell the future. By doing this she made a lot of money for her owners.
translation_verse: Ka tinamɛ wa'ae pʋ'ʋsim zin'igin la, ka bipuŋ onɛ an yammʋg ka kikirig dɔl o tʋ'ʋsi ti. O da anɛ ba'abʋgʋd ka o bʋgʋb la ni ka o nyɛt kpan'am bɛdegʋ tisid banɛ sʋ'oe o la.

english_verse: The girl followed Paul and the rest of us, and she kept yelling, “These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how to be saved.”
translation_verse: Ka o dɔl Paul nɛ ti wʋsa tansid ye, “Nimbama nwa' anɛ Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el Wʋsa la tʋmtʋmnib, ba mɔɔnnɛ yɛti ya faangir la suor.”

english_verse: This went on for several days. Finally, Paul got so upset that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ, I order you to leave this girl alone!” At once the evil spirit left her.
translation_verse: O daa niŋ anwa paae nɔɔr si'em. Ka li ti zab Paul hali galis, ka o fɛndigi yɛl kikirig la ye, “M yɛtif nɛ Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr zug ye fʋ yim ka bas bipuŋ la.” Ani yim ka kikirig la yii o san'an.

english_verse: When the girl's owners realized they had lost all chances for making more money, they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them into court.
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ sʋ'oe o la baŋ ye ti'ir kanɛ ka ba daa mɔr ka nyɛt kpan'am la lɛn kae la, dinzug ka ba gban'e Paul nɛ Silas vɛ'ɛgi ba kpɛn' da'an banɛ sʋ'oe teŋ la tuon.

english_verse: They are telling us to do things we Romans are not allowed to do.”
translation_verse: Ba pa'annɛ malima banɛ pʋ dɔlli ti wadaa. Tinamɛ an Room nidib la ti kʋ siaki dɔl malimbamaa.”

english_verse: The crowd joined in the attack on Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off the two men and ordered them to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Ka nidib bɛdegʋ la'asi giligi ba ka onɛ tu'asid antu'a la pidig Paul nɛ Silas fuud nɛ paŋ ka bas nɔɔr ye ba fiebimi ba.

english_verse: After they had been badly beaten, they were put in jail, and the jailer was told to guard them carefully.
translation_verse: Ka ba bʋ' ba bɛdegʋ ka kpɛn'ɛsi ba sanrega ni ka yɛl onɛ guri sanrega dɔɔg la ye o gɔsimi ba sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: The jailer did as he was told. He put them deep inside the jail and chained their feet to heavy blocks of wood.
translation_verse: Ban yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa la zug ka o kpɛn'ɛsi ba dɔɔg kanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la, ka lɔɔ ba nɔba ta'al nɛ datitada.

english_verse: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing praises to God, while the other prisoners listened.
translation_verse: Amaa yʋ'ʋŋ tisʋʋs saŋa ka Paul nɛ Silas pʋ'ʋsid ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma tisid Wina'am ka banɛ la'am bɛ nɛ ba sanrega ni la kɛlisid.

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the jail to its foundations. The doors opened, and the chains fell from all the prisoners.
translation_verse: Tɔ'ɔtɔ ka teŋ dam hali ka sanrega dɔɔg ɛɛnbir la mɛ dammid. Ka za'anɔya wʋsa yɔ'ɔs. Ka bana la yidig nidib la wʋsa ni.

english_verse: When the jailer woke up and saw that the doors were open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped. He pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ gur sanrega la duoe gbɛɛmin ka nyɛ ka za'anɔya la yɔ'ɔs, ka o tɛn'ɛs ye ba su'anɛ yi, ka fuoe sʋ'ʋg ye o kʋʋ o mɛŋ.

english_verse: But Paul shouted, “Don't harm yourself! No one has escaped.”
translation_verse: Amaa ka Paul tans nɛ kʋkɔr kpi'euŋ ye, “Da pu'alimi fʋ mɛŋa, ka ti wʋsa bɛ kpɛla.”

english_verse: The jailer asked for a torch and went into the jail. He was shaking all over as he knelt down in front of Paul and Silas.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ gur sanrega la buol ka ba mɔr fitir na. Ka o va' bap-bap kpɛn' igin Paul nɛ Silas tuon ka kirid nɛ dabiem.

english_verse: After he had led them out of the jail, he asked, “What must I do to be saved?”
translation_verse: Ka mɔri ba yina bu'osi ba ye, “Dapa, m na niŋ wala ka nyɛ faangirɛ?”

english_verse: They replied, “Have faith in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved! This is also true for everyone who lives in your home.”
translation_verse: Ka ba yɛl o ye, “Niŋim Zugsɔb Yesu yadda ka fʋn nɛ fʋ yidim wʋsa na nyɛ faangir.”

english_verse: Then Paul and Silas told him and everyone else in his house about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka ba tu'as Zugsɔb la pian'ad tis on nɛ banɛ wʋsa bɛɛ o yin la.

english_verse: While it was still night, the jailer took them to a place where he could wash their cuts and bruises. Then he and everyone in his home were baptized.
translation_verse: Ka o nɔki ba yʋ'ʋŋ kan la, piesi ba fɛn'ɛd la. Ka ba sʋ on nɛ o yidim wʋsa Wina'am Ku'om.

english_verse: They were very glad they had put their faith in God. After this, the jailer took Paul and Silas to his home and gave them something to eat.
translation_verse: Ka o mɔri ba keŋ o yin ka tisi ba diib. Ka li niŋ on nɛ o yidim wʋsa sumalisim, ban niŋ Wina'am yadda la zug.

english_verse: The next morning the officials sent some police with orders for the jailer to let Paul and Silas go.
translation_verse: Ka bɛog nie ka banɛ tu'ad antu'a la tʋmi ba tʋmtʋmnib ye ba yɛl onɛ gur sanrega la ye, “Basim ka nidib ayi' la yi.”

english_verse: The jailer told Paul, “The officials have ordered me to set you free. Now you can leave in peace.”
translation_verse: Ka sanrega gur la yɛl Paul ye, “Antu'a tu'adib la tis nɔɔr ye m kɛ ka ya yi. Dinzugɔ yim keŋi nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.”

english_verse: But Paul told the police, “We are Roman citizens, and the Roman officials had us beaten in public without giving us a trial. They threw us into jail. Now do they think they can secretly send us away? No, they cannot! They will have to come here themselves and let us out.”
translation_verse: Amaa Paul yɛl tʋmtʋmnib la ye, “Tinam anɛ Room teŋ dim. Amaa ba sa bʋ' ti nidibin ka pʋ wʋmi ti nɔɔr pian'adɛ, ka kpɛn'ɛsi ti sanrega ni. Nannanna ba yʋ'ʋn yisidi ti, ka li nwɛnɛ su'adimnɛ. Ayei, kɛl ka ba mɛŋ kena yisi ti.”

english_verse: When the police told the officials that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, the officials were afraid.
translation_verse: Ka tʋmtʋmnib la keŋ yɛl antu'a tu'adib la nɛ'ɛŋa. Ka dabiem kpɛn' ba, ban wʋm ye Paul nɛ Silas anɛ Room dim la zug.

english_verse: So they came and apologized. They led them out of the jail and asked them to please leave town.
translation_verse: Ka ba mɛŋ kena nwɛ' ba nu'ug ka yisi ba ka bɛlimi ba ye ba yim teŋin la.

english_verse: But Paul and Silas went straight to the home of Lydia, where they saw the Lord's followers and encouraged them. Then they left.
translation_verse: Ka ba yi sanrega la ni keŋ kaae Lidia ka nyɛ yadda niŋidib la, ka pian' kpɛmisi ba sʋnya ka nyaan keŋ.

english_verse: After Paul and his friends had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they went on to Thessalonica. A synagogue was in that city.
translation_verse: Ba da dɔlli yi Amfipolis nɛ Apolonia tɛɛnsin gaadi kɛn Tɛsalonika na, zin'ikan la ka Jew dim la'asʋg dɔɔg da bɛ.

english_verse: So as usual, Paul went there to worship, and on three Sabbaths he spoke to the people. He used the Scriptures
translation_verse: Paul da kpɛn' anina Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir nɔɔra atan', wʋʋ on yiiti maan si'em la, ka tu'asidi ba dinɛ bɛ Wina'am gbauŋʋn la

english_verse: to show them that the Messiah had to suffer, but that he would rise from death. Paul also told them that Jesus is the Messiah he was preaching about.
translation_verse: bigisidi baa li gbin nyain ye li da anɛ tilas ye Kristo namis ka vʋ'ʋg kumin, ka ye, “Yesu on ka m mɔɔnnɛ o yɛla tisidi ya la an Kristo la.”

english_verse: Some of them believed what Paul had said, and they became followers with Paul and Silas. Some Gentiles and many important women also believed the message.
translation_verse: Jew dim la sieba da siaki dɔl Paul nɛ Silas la'an nɛ Girik dim nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am la'an nɛ pu'ab bɛdegʋ banɛ an tuongatib la.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders were jealous and got some troublemakers who hung around the marketplace to start a riot in the city. They wanted to drag Paul and Silas out to the mob, and so they went straight to Jason's home.
translation_verse: Amaa Jew dim la da bɛn'ɛd fufum ka buol bugusim dim sieba banɛ bɛ da'ani ka' tʋʋma la. Ka ba la'asi an bɛdegʋ ka maal tʋkpiidʋgʋ keŋ gilig Jason yiri ieed Paul nɛ Silas ye ba mɔri ba yi nidibin la na.

english_verse: But when they did not find them there, they dragged out Jason and some of the Lord's followers. They took them to the city authorities and shouted, “Paul and Silas have been upsetting things everywhere. Now they have come here,
translation_verse: Ka pʋ nyaŋi nyɛɛ ba ka gban'e Jason nɛ yadda niŋidib sieba mɔri ba keŋ teŋin kpi'emnam san'an ka tans ye, “Nimbama nwa' anɛ banɛ bɔɔd yɛla daam dunia wʋsa. Nannanna ba paae kpɛla na,

english_verse: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. All of them break the laws of the Roman Emperor by claiming that someone named Jesus is king.”
translation_verse: ka Jason di'e ba. Ba wʋsa ki'isid Room na'ab Siiza wada ka yɛt ye, na'asɔ' lɛm bɛ, ka ba buon o Yesu.”

english_verse: The officials and the people were upset when they heard this.
translation_verse: Ban wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la ka li zab nidib la nɛ teŋin kpi'emnam la.

english_verse: So they made Jason and the other followers pay bail before letting them go. People in Berea Welcome the Message
translation_verse: Ka ba di'e ligidi Jason nɛ banɛ dɔl o la san'an, ka na lɛbisi tisi ba, ba ya'a ti nyɛ ka ba pʋ kpɛn' yɛl si'a ni ya'asɛ, ka basi ba ka ba keŋ. Paul bɛ Berea teŋin

english_verse: That same night the Lord's followers sent Paul and Silas on to Berea, and after they arrived, they went to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋŋ sɔb ka yadda niŋidib la yis Paul nɛ Silas ka ba keŋ Berea teŋin. Ka ba paae anina keŋ kpɛn' Jew dim la'asʋg dɔɔgin.

english_verse: The people in Berea were much nicer than those in Thessalonica, and they gladly accepted the message. Day after day they studied the Scriptures to see if these things were true.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim banɛ bɛ Berea teŋin la pʋtɛnda nie gaad Jew dim banɛ bɛ Tɛsalonika la. Ka ba di'e pian'ad la nɛ nyɛlʋg, ka karim Wina'am gbauŋ la zamisid daar wʋsa ye ba gɔs ye Paul n tu'asidi ba si'el la an sida bɛɛ li ka' sida.

english_verse: Many of them put their faith in the Lord, including some important Greek women and several men.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim bɛdegʋ niŋ yadda la'an nɛ Girik dim pu'ab nɛ ba dap banɛ mɔr yʋ'ʋr nidib la sʋʋgin bɛdegʋ la.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders in Thessalonica heard that Paul had been preaching God's message in Berea, they went there and caused trouble by turning the crowds against Paul.
translation_verse: Jew dim banɛ bɛ Tɛsalonika la wʋm ye Paul mɔɔn Wina'am pian'ad Berea teŋin la, ka ba keŋ anina daam nidib la ka kɛ ka ba sʋnya pɛlig nɛ Paul nɛ Silas.

english_verse: At once the followers sent Paul down to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.
translation_verse: Ka yadda niŋidib la kɛ ka Paul keŋ atɛuk la gbɛog tɔ'ɔtɔ. Amaa ka Silas nɛ Timoti kpɛlim anina.

english_verse: Some men went with Paul as far as Athens, and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible. Paul in Athens
translation_verse: Ka banɛ biel Paul la mɔr o paae Atens na ka lɛbid ka Paul tɔlimi ba ye ba ya'a paae ban yɛl Silas nɛ Timoti ye ba kɛn nannanna na. Paul bɛ Atens teŋin

english_verse: While Paul was waiting in Athens, he was upset to see all the idols in the city.
translation_verse: Paul da gur Silas nɛ Timoti Atens teŋin, ka nyɛ ka teŋ la pɛ'ɛl nɛ wina nɛ bada, ka o sʋnf pɛlig.

english_verse: He went to the synagogue to speak to the Jews and to anyone who worshiped with them. Day after day he also spoke to everyone he met in the market.
translation_verse: Ka o keŋ Jew dim la'asʋg dɔɔgin tu'asid Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dima ka lɛɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am nwɛnɛ ban la. Daar woo ka o tu'asid nimbanɛ bɛ da'an nɛ la'asʋg zin'isin wʋsa.

english_verse: Some of them were Epicureans and some were Stoics, and they started arguing with him. People were asking, “What is this know-it-all trying to say?” Some even said, “Paul must be preaching about foreign gods! That's what he means when he talks about Jesus and about people rising from death.”
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ zamis ya'am hali ka ba buoni ba Epikurea dim nɛ Stoik dim, nwa'asid nɛ o. Ka sieba bu'os ye, “Bɔ ka yalim kaŋa nwa' bɔɔd ye o yɛlɛ?” Ka sieba yɛl ye, “Ti wʋm ye o mɔɔnnɛ win saamis yɛla” Paul da pa'an Yesu nɛ kum vʋ'ʋgir yɛla la kɛ ka ba da yɛl ala.

english_verse: They brought Paul before a council called the Areopagus, and said, “Tell us what your new teaching is all about.
translation_verse: Ka ba mɔr o keŋ Areopagus zin'ig kanɛ ka nidib la'as la, ka yɛl o ye, “Kɛl ka ti baŋ pa'alsaaŋ kanɛ ka fʋ tu'asid la;

english_verse: We have heard you say some strange things, and we want to know what you mean.”
translation_verse: ka yɛlbama nwa' anɛ yɛlsaaŋi tisi ti ka ti bɔɔd ye ti baŋi li gbin.”

english_verse: More than anything else the people of Athens and the foreigners living there loved to hear and to talk about anything new.
translation_verse: Ka Atens dim nɛ saam banɛ zin' anina la da pʋ tʋm si'ela, ka bɔɔd ye ba tu'asid ka kɛlisid yɛlpaala saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: So Paul stood up in front of the council and said: People of Athens, I see that you are very religious.
translation_verse: Ka Paul duoe zi'en Areopagus la'asʋg la sʋʋgin ka yɛl ye, “Atens nidiba, m baŋ ye ya si'el mɛkama wʋsa ni ya dɔl ba'a maalʋg yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: As I was going through your city and looking at the things you worship, I found an altar with the words, “To an Unknown God.” You worship this God, but you don't really know him. So I want to tell you about him.
translation_verse: Man gilig ka gɔs zin'ibanɛ ka ya pʋ'ʋsid la, m nyɛɛ ya pʋ'ʋsim malʋŋ zin'ig ka li sɔb anina ye, ‘WINA'AM KANƐ KA TI ZI' LA.’ Linɛ ka ya pʋ'ʋsid ka la'am zi' la, lin ka m ye m mɔɔli tisi ya la.

english_verse: This God made the world and everything in it. He is Lord of heaven and earth, and he doesn't live in temples built by human hands.
translation_verse: “Wina'am onɛ maal dunia nɛ linɛ bɛ li ni wʋsa, ka sʋ'oe saazug wʋsa la, pʋ zin' dɔɔd banɛ ka ninsaalib mɛ' la nii.

english_verse: He doesn't need help from anyone. He gives life, breath, and everything else to all people.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ linɛ wʋsa ka ninsaal tʋm tis o pʋ pa'al ye si'el pansig oo. O mɛŋ mɔr nyɔvʋr nɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm nɛ si'el mɛkama wʋsa tisid nidib wʋsa.

english_verse: From one person God made all nations who live on earth, and he decided when and where every nation would be.
translation_verse: Nid yinne ni ka o maal nidib buudi wʋsa kɛ ka ba bɛ dunia ni wʋsa. O mɛŋi zi'en saŋa tisid nɛ zin'ibanɛ ka ba na zin'in.

english_verse: God has done all this, so that we will look for him and reach out and find him. He isn't far from any of us,
translation_verse: O tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa ye ba iee o zin'ig, ka daasi'erɛɛ ba na nyɛɛ o. Amaa o pʋ lal nɛ tii.

english_verse: and he gives us the power to live, to move, and to be who we are. “We are his children,” just as some of your poets have said.
translation_verse: O ni ka ti bɛ ka vʋ'ʋsid ka ken, nwɛnɛ yanam Atens sʋ'ʋlim dim sieba da yɛl ye, ‘Tinam mɛ anɛ o biis la.’

english_verse: Since we are God's children, we must not think that he is like an idol made out of gold or silver or stone. He isn't like anything that humans have thought up and made.
translation_verse: “Tinamɛ sadigim aan o biis la, ti da tɛn'ɛs ye Wina'am bɛllim nwɛnɛ bada banɛ ka ninsaal nɔk sanlima bɛɛ anzurifa bɛɛ kuga, tɛn'ɛsi maal nɛ o nu'usɛ.

english_verse: In the past, God forgave all this because people did not know what they were doing. But now he says that everyone everywhere must turn to him.
translation_verse: Wina'am da pʋ mugus ninsaalib saŋkan ka ba da zi' on an si'em la. Amaa nannanna o tis nɔɔr zin'is wʋsa ye nidib wʋsa tiak ka bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: He has set a day when he will judge the world's people with fairness. And he has chosen the man Jesus to do the judging for him. God has given proof of this to all of us by raising Jesus from death.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ o zi'el dabisir ka ninkanɛ ka o gaŋ la na kad dunia nidib wʋsa saria nɛ sida. O pa'al nɛ'ɛnam nyain tis sɔ' wʋsa on vʋ'ʋg ninkan kumin la zug.”

english_verse: As soon as the people heard Paul say a man had been raised from death, some of them started laughing. Others said, “We will hear you talk about this some other time.”
translation_verse: Ban wʋm ye Paul pian'ad kum vʋ'ʋgir yɛla la, ka sieba la' o. Amaa ka sieba yɛl ye, “Ti bɔɔd ye ti wʋm ka o lɛm pian' pian'akaŋa ya'as.”

english_verse: When Paul left the council meeting,
translation_verse: Ka Paul yii ba san'an.

english_verse: some of the men put their faith in the Lord and went with Paul. One of them was a council member named Dionysius. A woman named Damaris and several others also put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Dionisius onɛ an Areopagus la'asʋg nid la nɛ pu'a sɔ' onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Damaris la nɛ ninsieba niŋ yadda ka dɔl Paul.

english_verse: Paul left Athens and went to Corinth,
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa nya'aŋ ka Paul daa yi Atens n keŋ Korint teŋin.

english_verse: where he met Aquila, a Jewish man from Pontus. Not long before this, Aquila had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Emperor Claudius had ordered the Jewish people to leave Rome. Paul went to see Aquila and Priscilla
translation_verse: Anina ka o nyɛ Jew dim dau onɛ an Pontus teŋin biig ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Akuila. On nɛ o pu'a Prisila daa kʋdim nan yinɛ Room linɛ bɛ Itali la kena. Bɔzugɔ, gɔmena Klaudius daa tis wada ye Jew dim wʋsa duom Room teŋin. Paul daa keŋ ye o kaae ba.

english_verse: and found out they were tent makers. Paul was also a tent maker, so he stayed with them, and they worked together.
translation_verse: Ban an gbanzabnam wʋʋ Paul la zug ka o kpɛlim anina, ka ba la'an tʋm.

english_verse: Every Sabbath, Paul went to the synagogue. He spoke to Jews and Gentiles and tried to win them over.
translation_verse: Ka o pian'ad la'asʋg dɔɔgin Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar wʋsa zigid ye o fɛndig Jew dim nɛ Girik dim ka ba siak o pian'ad la.

english_verse: But after Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, he spent all his time preaching to the Jews about Jesus the Messiah.
translation_verse: Silas nɛ Timoti da yi Masedonia paae na la, Paul da nɔknɛ o mɛŋ ya'a wʋsa tu'asid labasʋŋ la yɛt Jew dim la ye Yesu la an Kristo.

english_verse: Finally, they turned against him and insulted him. So he shook the dust from his clothes and told them, “Whatever happens to you will be your own fault! I am not to blame. From now on I am going to preach to the Gentiles.”
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim la ki'is o ka pian' pian'abɛ'ɛd o yɛla. Ka o kpa'as o fuug ka li bigis ye ban pian'ad si'em la ka' sʋ'ʋŋaa, ka yɛli ba ye, “Ya ya'a bɔdig, li anɛ ya mɛŋ zugin yɛl ka mam ba'a kae. Lin yi saŋkaŋa wa'ae m na keŋ banɛ ka' Jew dim la san'an.”

english_verse: Paul then moved into the house of a man named Titius Justus, who worshiped God and lived next door to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Ka o basi ba ka keŋ bɛ onɛ ka' Jew dim nid yin, onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Titius Justus ka o pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am, ka o yir da kpi'e la'asʋg dɔɔg la.

english_verse: Crispus was the leader of the synagogue. He and everyone in his family put their faith in the Lord. Many others in Corinth also heard the message, and all the people who had faith in the Lord were baptized.
translation_verse: La'asʋg dɔɔg la kpɛɛm da anɛ Krispus ka on nɛ o yidim wʋsa niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda. Ka Korint dim bɛdegʋ banɛ wʋm labasʋŋ la niŋ yadda ka ba sʋʋ ba Wina'am Ku'om.

english_verse: One night, Paul had a vision, and in it the Lord said, “Don't be afraid to keep on preaching. Don't stop!
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ yinne ka Paul zaansim ka Zugsɔb yɛl o ye, “Da zɔt dabiem, amaa kpɛm pian'am ka da basɛ;

english_verse: I am with you, and you won't be harmed. Many people in this city belong to me.”
translation_verse: ka m bɛ nɛf. Sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi daamif bɛɛ pu'alimi fɔ. Nimbanɛ bɛ teŋin nwa' bɛdegʋ anɛ m nidib.”

english_verse: Paul stayed on in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching God's message to the people.
translation_verse: Ka Paul zin'in anina yʋʋm nɛ pʋsʋk ka pa'an nidib la Wina'am pian'ad.

english_verse: While Gallio was governor of Achaia, some of the Jewish leaders got together and grabbed Paul. They brought him into court
translation_verse: Gallio da sʋ'oe Akaia sʋ'ʋlim saŋsi'a la, ka Jew dim duoe la'asi gban'e Paul n mɔr o keŋ kɔɔtʋ ni

english_verse: and said, “This man is trying to make our people worship God in a way that is against our Law!”
translation_verse: ka yɛl ye, “Niŋkaŋa nwa' zigidnɛ ye o fɛndig nidib la pʋtɛnda ka ba pʋ'ʋs Wina'am ka li pʋ dɔlli ti wada la suorɛ.”

english_verse: Even before Paul could speak, Gallio said, “If you were charging this man with a crime or some other wrong, I would have to listen to you.
translation_verse: Paul n nam bɔɔd ye o pian' la, ka Gallio yɛl Jew dim la ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa ya'a aannɛ linɛ ka'an sʋm bɛɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd si'a ka o maalin, m naan mɔdigin ka kɛlisi ya pian'ad la.

english_verse: But since this concerns only words, names, and your own law, you will have to take care of it yourselves. I refuse to judge such matters.”
translation_verse: Amaa lin anɛ pian'ad nɛ yʋda ka ya nwa'asid nɛ ya mɛŋ wada yɛla la, yanam mɛŋ gban'am maali li; ka mam kʋ niŋ nɛ'ɛŋa sariakata.”

english_verse: Then he sent them out of the court.
translation_verse: Ka kadi ba yis kɔɔtʋ la ni.

english_verse: The crowd grabbed Sosthenes, the Jewish leader, and beat him up in front of the court. But none of this mattered to Gallio. Paul Returns to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Ka ba wʋsa gban'e Sostenes onɛ an Jew dim la'asʋg dɔɔg kpɛɛm la bʋ' o kɔɔtʋ la tuon. Amaa ka Gallio ba'a kae ban tʋm si'el laa. Paul lɛb Antiok teŋin

english_verse: After Paul had stayed for a while with the Lord's followers in Corinth, he told them goodbye and sailed on to Syria with Aquila and Priscilla. But before he left, he had his head shaved at Cenchreae because he had made a promise to God.
translation_verse: Ka Paul zin'in Korint teŋin nɛ yadda niŋidib la ka li yuug. Ka o yʋ'ʋn kɛɛsi ba ka kpɛn' anrʋŋ nɛ Prisila nɛ Akuila keŋ Siriya teŋin. On da nam bɔɔd ye o kpɛn' anrʋŋ Senkiria teŋin la, ka pʋn o zug on da pʋ'ʋlʋm tis Wina'am la zug.

english_verse: The three of them arrived in Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He then went into the synagogue to talk with the people there.
translation_verse: Ka ba paae Efesus teŋin, ka Paul bas Prisila nɛ Akuila anina ka keŋ la'asʋg dɔɔgin tu'as Jew dim Yesu Kristo labasʋŋ la yɛla.

english_verse: They asked him to stay longer, but he refused.
translation_verse: Ka ba sɔs o ye o kpɛlimmi ba san'anɛ yuug. Amaa ka o zan'as,

english_verse: He told them goodbye and said, “If God lets me, I will come back.”
translation_verse: ka kɛɛsi ba ka ye, “Wina'am ya'a siak m na lɛbi ya san'an na ya'as.” Ka yi Efesus n kpɛn' anrʋŋ.

english_verse: Paul sailed to Caesarea, where he greeted the church. Then he went on to Antioch.
translation_verse: On paae Sizerea la, o keŋ Jerusalem pʋ'ʋs yadda niŋidib banɛ bɛɛ anina la ka nyaan keŋ Antiok.

english_verse: After staying there for a while, he left and visited several places in Galatia and Phrygia. He helped the followers there to become stronger in their faith. Apollos in Ephesus
translation_verse: Ka o yuug anina bi'ela ka gɔɔnd Galatia nɛ Frigia tɛɛnsin kpɛmisid yadda niŋidib la wʋsa sʋ'ʋŋa. Apollos bɛ Efesus nɛ Korint tɛɛnsin

english_verse: A Jewish man named Apollos came to Ephesus. Apollos had been born in the city of Alexandria. He was a very good speaker and knew a lot about the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dau sɔ' onɛ an Alekzandria teŋin biig ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Apollos daa kɛn Efesus na ka an onɛ mɔr baŋir ka mi' Wina'am gbauŋ la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: He also knew much about the Lord's Way, and he spoke about it with great excitement. What he taught about Jesus was right, but all he knew was John's message about baptism.
translation_verse: Dau nwa' paam zamisʋg Zugsɔb la suor yɛla ka kpɛ'ɛŋid o mɛŋi pa'an Yesu suor sʋ'ʋŋa, hali la'an nɛ lin an Joon Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb la yɛla ma'aa ka o mi' la.

english_verse: Apollos started speaking bravely in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him to their home and helped him understand God's Way even better.
translation_verse: Ka o pin'ili tu'asid nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ Jew dim la'asʋg dɔɔgin la. Ka Prisila nɛ Akuila wʋm o pian'ad la ka dɔl o keŋ bigis o Wina'am suor la yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa paas.

english_verse: Apollos decided to travel through Achaia. So the Lord's followers wrote letters, encouraging the followers there to welcome him. After Apollos arrived in Achaia, he was a great help to everyone who had put their faith in the Lord Jesus because of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ka o bɔɔd ye o keŋ Akaia teŋin ka yadda niŋidib banɛ bɛ Efesus teŋin la kpɛmis o, ka sɔb gbauŋʋ tis yadda niŋidib banɛ bɛ Akaia la ye ba di'em o sʋ'ʋŋa. Ka o paae anina sʋŋ banɛ ka Wina'am da pʋn tisi ba o yɛlsʋm ka ba niŋ o yadda la.

english_verse: He got into fierce arguments with the Jewish people, and in public he used the Scriptures to prove that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ka o nwa'as nɛ Jew dim la nyaŋi ba nidib la sʋʋgin, ka pa'ali ba Wina'am gbauŋ pʋʋgin ye Yesu an Kristo la.

english_verse: While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul traveled across the hill country to Ephesus, where he met some of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Apollos n da nam bɛ Korint teŋin la, ka Paul dɔlli yi tɛɛnsin la keŋ Efesus teŋin. Anina ka o nyɛ nya'andɔlib sieba,

english_verse: He asked them, “When you put your faith in Jesus, were you given the Holy Spirit?” “No!” they answered. “We have never even heard of the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: ka bu'osi ba ye, “Yanamɛ niŋ Yesu yadda la, ya di'e Wina'am Siig Kasi laa?” Ka ba lɛbis ye, “Ayei, ti nan zi' wʋm ye Siig Kasi bɛɛ.”

english_verse: “Then why were you baptized?” Paul asked. They answered, “Because of what John taught.”
translation_verse: Ka Paul bu'osi ba ye, “Bɔ Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb ka ya di'e?” Ka ba lɛbis ye, “Li anɛ Joon Wina'am Ku'om sʋʋb la ka ti di'e.”

english_verse: Paul replied, “John baptized people so they would turn to God. But he also told them someone else was coming, and they should put their faith in him. Jesus is the one that John was talking about.”
translation_verse: Ka Paul yɛl ye, “Joon Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb la pa'alnɛ ye ya tiakya ka bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. Joon da pa'al Jew dim la ye ba dɔl onɛ na kɛn on Joon nya'aŋ la na, o yʋ'ʋri buon Yesu.”

english_verse: After the people heard Paul say this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ban wʋm nɛ'ɛŋa la ka di'e Wina'am Ku'om sʋʋb Zugsɔb Yesu yʋ'ʋr zug.

english_verse: Then Paul placed his hands on them. The Holy Spirit was given to them, and they spoke unknown languages and prophesied.
translation_verse: Ka Paul nɔk o nu'usi pa'ali ba zutin ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la kɛɛn ba san'an na ka ba pian'ad pian'azʋna ka di'e Wina'am pian'adi tis nidib.

english_verse: There were about twelve men in this group.
translation_verse: Ba da anɛ wʋʋ nidib pii nɛ ayi'.

english_verse: For three months Paul went to the synagogue and talked bravely with the people about God's kingdom. He tried to win them over,
translation_verse: Nwadis atan' ka Paul da kpɛn'ɛd Jew dim la'asʋg dɔɔgin pian'adi tisid nidib nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ ka tu'asidi ba Wina'am na'am yɛla kpɛ'ɛŋid ye o fɛndigi ba.

english_verse: but some of them were stubborn and refused to believe. In front of everyone they said terrible things about God's Way. Paul left and took the followers with him to the lecture hall of Tyrannus. He spoke there every day
translation_verse: Ka sieba mɔr zukpi'euŋ ka pʋ siakɛ, ka pian'ad pian'ayɔɔd Zugsɔb suor la yɛla paalʋ. Ka Paul basi ba ka dɔl nya'andɔlib la keŋ Tirannus karindɔɔgin pa'an Wina'am yɛla daar wʋsa.

english_verse: for two years, until every Jew and Gentile in Asia had heard the Lord's message. The Sons of Sceva
translation_verse: O da niŋ ala yʋma ayi', ka Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim ka bɛ Asia tɛɛnsin la wʋsa wʋm Zugsɔb pian'ad la. Seva biis la yɛla

english_verse: God gave Paul the power to work great miracles.
translation_verse: Wina'am da nɔk Paul n tʋm tʋʋmnyalima hali.

english_verse: People even took handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched Paul's body, and they carried them to everyone who was sick. All of the sick people were healed, and the evil spirits went out.
translation_verse: Hali ba da nɔk piena nɛ fuud linɛ si'is o niŋgbina la mɔri keŋ si'is ban'adnam ka ba paam laafi, ka kikiris yi ka bas sieba.

english_verse: Some Jewish men started going around trying to force out evil spirits by using the name of the Lord Jesus. They said to the spirits, “Come out in the name of that same Jesus that Paul preaches about!”
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim sieba banɛ da giligidi kad kikiris nidib san'an la da makid ye ba kad kikiris nɛ Zugsɔb Yesu yʋ'ʋr ka yɛt kikiris la ye, “M yɛti ya nɛ Yesu yʋ'ʋr, on ka Paul mɔɔn o yɛla la, ye ya yim.”

english_verse: Seven sons of a high priest named Sceva were doing this,
translation_verse: Ba da anɛ Jew dim maanmaan kpɛɛm on yʋ'ʋri buon Seva la biis ayɔpɔi da tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa.

english_verse: when an evil spirit said to them, “I know Jesus! And I have heard about Paul. But who are you?”
translation_verse: Amaa ka kikirig la lɛbis ye, “M mi' Yesu ka mi' Paul. Ka yanam aan anɔ'ɔnama?”

english_verse: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and beat them up. They ran out of the house, naked and bruised.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ ka kikiris dɔl o la duoe nyaŋi ba, ka bʋ' ba pu'alim hali ka ba zɔɔ yi yin la bi'ela.

english_verse: When the Jews and Gentiles in Ephesus heard about this, they were so frightened that they praised the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim ka bɛ Efesus teŋin la wʋsa wʋmi li yɛla. Ka dabiem kpɛn' ba wʋsa. Ka ba dʋ'ʋsid Zugsɔb Yesu yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Many who were followers now started telling everyone about the evil things they had been doing.
translation_verse: Ka yadda niŋidib bɛdegʋ kɛn nidibin la na pɛligi ba pʋʋsi tu'asi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Some who had been practicing witchcraft even brought their books and burned them in public. These books were worth about
translation_verse: Ka tima dim sieba mɔri ba gbana na la'asi nyu'oe bugum ka li di sɔ' mɛkama nini ni. Ka ba gɛlig gbana la ligidi ka li an anzurifa ligidi tusa pisnu.

english_verse: So the Lord's message spread and became even more powerful. The Riot in Ephesus
translation_verse: Ala ka Zugsɔb pian'ad la da kpɛn yadigid ka paasid nɛ paŋ. Efesus dimi maan tʋkpiidʋg la yɛla

english_verse: After all this had happened, Paul decided to visit Macedonia and Achaia on his way to Jerusalem. Paul had said, “From there I will go on to Rome.”
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa nya'aŋ ka Paul tɛn'ɛs o sʋnfʋn ye o na gaadi yi Masedonia nɛ Akaia tɛɛnsin keŋ Jerusalem, ka ye, “M ya'a keŋ anina, asɛɛ ka m la'am keŋ Room teŋin.”

english_verse: So he sent his two helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia. But he stayed on in Asia for a while.
translation_verse: Ka o kɛ ka Timoti nɛ Erastus banɛ aan o sʋŋidib la keŋ Masedonia teŋin ka on mɛŋ kpɛlim Asia yuug bi'ela.

english_verse: At that time there was serious trouble because of the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la li da anɛ tɔɔgʋ tis banɛ dɔl Zugsɔb suor la Efesus teŋin.

english_verse: A silversmith named Demetrius had a business that made silver models of the temple of the goddess Artemis. Those who worked for him earned a lot of money.
translation_verse: Dau sɔ' da bɛ ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Demetrius. O da mɔri anzurifa maan Artemis winpu'a pʋ'ʋsim dɔbibis. Ka on nɛ banɛ tʋmi li tʋʋma la da nyɛt nyɔɔd bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Demetrius brought together everyone who was in the same business and said: Friends, you know we make a good living at this.
translation_verse: Ka o la'as o tʋmtʋm taaba yɛli ba ye, “Nidiba, ya mi' ye tʋʋma nwa' ni ka ti kpan'am yit na.

english_verse: But you have surely seen and heard how this man Paul is upsetting a lot of people, not only in Ephesus, but almost everywhere in Asia. He claims that the gods we humans make are not really gods at all.
translation_verse: Amaa ya wʋmya ka nyɛ dau onɛ ka ba buon Paul la yɛt nidib ye wina banɛ ka ba zaŋ nu'usi maal ka' wina! Bʋn kaŋa ka' Efesus teŋin kpɛla ma'aanɛ amaa la'an nɛ Asia sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa.

english_verse: Everyone will start saying terrible things about our business. They will stop respecting the temple of the goddess Artemis, who is worshiped in Asia and all over the world. Our great goddess will be forgotten!
translation_verse: Linɛ pak ka'anɛ ti tʋʋma la san'auŋ ma'aanɛ, amaa Artemis onɛ mɔr paŋ ka Asia sʋ'ʋlim nɛ dunia nidib wʋsa pʋ'ʋsid la yʋ'ʋr mɛ na san'am. Ba ya'a pʋ niŋ si'ela, o pʋ'ʋsim dɔɔg la na lieb zaalim.”

english_verse: When the workers heard this, they got angry and started shouting, “Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians!”
translation_verse: Ban wʋm pian'abama la, ba sʋnya pɛlignɛ ka ba tans ye, “Efesus dim winpu'a Artemis anɛ onɛ mɔr paŋ.”

english_verse: Soon the whole city was in a riot, and some men grabbed Gaius and Aristarchus, who had come from Macedonia with Paul. Then everyone in the crowd rushed to the place where the town meetings were held.
translation_verse: Ka tʋkpiidʋg yadig teŋin la wʋsa. Ka nidib la gban'e Gaius nɛ Aristarkus banɛ an Masedonia nidib ka dɔl Paul la, tɛɛgi ba zɔɔ keŋ teŋ la la'asʋg zin'igin.

english_verse: Paul wanted to go out and speak to the people, but the Lord's followers would not let him.
translation_verse: Ka Paul bɔɔd ye o kpɛn' nidibin la amaa ka o nya'andɔl taaba pʋ siakɛ.

english_verse: A few of the local officials were friendly to Paul, and they sent someone to warn him not to go.
translation_verse: Ka kpɛɛmnam sieba banɛ aan o zuanam tʋm o san'an na bɛllim o ye o da kpɛn' teŋ la la'asʋg zin'igin la.

english_verse: Some of the people in the meeting were shouting one thing, and others were shouting something else. Everyone was completely confused, and most of them did not even know why they were there.
translation_verse: Ka tʋkpiidʋg duoe nidibin la ka ba tansid kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb. Nidib la bɛdegʋ da zi' linɛ kɛ ka ba la'asɛ.

english_verse: Several of the Jewish leaders pushed a man named Alexander to the front of the crowd and started telling him what to say. He motioned with his hand and tried to explain what was going on.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim gaŋ Alekzanda ka o zi'en nidib la tuon, ka sieba tɛn'ɛs ye onɛ sʋ'oe antu'a la. Ka Alekzanda pa'al nɛ o nu'us ye nidib la an baanlimm ka o pian' tisi ba.

english_verse: But when the crowd saw that he was Jewish, they all shouted for two hours, “Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians!”
translation_verse: Amaa ban baŋ ye o anɛ Jew nid la, ka ba wʋsa la'asi maal tʋkpiidʋgʋ yuug hali yɛt ye, “Efesus dim winpu'a Artemis anɛ onɛ mɔr paŋ.”

english_verse: Finally, a town official made the crowd be quiet. Then he said: People of Ephesus, who in the world doesn't know that our city is the center for worshiping the great goddess Artemis? Who doesn't know that her image which fell from heaven is right here?
translation_verse: Ka teŋ la kpɛɛm yɛl nidib la ye ba an baanlimm ka yɛl ye, “Efesus nidiba, dunia nidib wʋsa mi' ye Efesus dim gur Artemis onɛ mɔr paŋ la dɔɔg, ka la'am gur kugir kanɛ naam saazugʋ li na la.

english_verse: No one can deny this, and so you should calm down and not do anything foolish.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi ki'is yɛlbama. Dinzugɔ kɛlli tʋkpiidʋg ka da niŋ sʋnkpi'euŋ yɔɔdɛ.

english_verse: You have brought men in here who have not robbed temples or spoken against our goddess.
translation_verse: Nimbama ka ya mɔri ba kpɛla na la pʋ kpɛn' ya wina dɔɔdin zu la'ad bɛɛ pian' pɔ'ɔgi baa.

english_verse: If Demetrius and his workers have a case against these men, we have courts and judges. Let them take their complaints there.
translation_verse: Ka Demetrius nɛ o tʋmtʋmnib ya'a mɔrin pian'ad nɛ sɔ', antu'a dabisir bɛ, ka banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ bɛ. Dinzug ya tun'e mɔr taaba paae antu'a tu'ad la tuon.

english_verse: But if you want to do more than that, the matter will have to be brought before the city council.
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a lɛm bɔɔd si'eli paas, li na maal nɛ nidibi la'asid zin'isi'a tu'ad antu'a la.

english_verse: We could easily be accused of starting a riot today. There is no excuse for it! We cannot even give a reason for this uproar.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ maal si'el zina la zug, ti bɛ nɛ yɛla ni. Ti kʋ nyaŋi yɛl linɛ kɛ ka ba maal tʋkpiidʋg nwaa. Ti mɛ kʋ nyaŋi tu'asi li gbin nyainnɛɛ, bɔzugɔ li pʋ mɔr gbinnɛ.”

english_verse: After saying this, he told the people to leave.
translation_verse: On yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa naae la ka yɛli ba ye ba widigim.

english_verse: When the riot was over, Paul sent for the followers and encouraged them. He then told them goodbye and left for Macedonia.
translation_verse: Tʋkpiidʋg la nya'aŋ ka Paul buol yadda niŋidib la kpɛmisi ba ka kɛɛsi ba ka yi keŋ Masedonia.

english_verse: As he traveled from place to place, he encouraged the followers with many messages. Finally, he went to Greece
translation_verse: Ka kpɛmisid yadda niŋidib banɛ bɛ tembanɛ wʋsa ka o dɔlli gat la, ka naan paae Akaia teŋin

english_verse: and stayed there for three months. Paul was about to sail to Syria. But some of the Jewish leaders plotted against him, so he decided to return by way of Macedonia.
translation_verse: zin'in anina nwadis atan'. O daa ti'eb ye o kpɛn' anrʋŋʋ keŋ Siriya teŋin ka wʋm ye Jew dim gban'e pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd o yɛla. Linzug ka o gban'e o pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye o lɛbi yi Masedonia.

english_verse: With him were Sopater, son of Pyrrhus from Berea, and Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica. Gaius from Derbe was also with him, and so were Timothy and the two Asians, Tychicus and Trophimus.
translation_verse: Pirus biig Sopata onɛ yi Berea teŋin na la, da dɔl o la'an nɛ Tɛsalonika nidib ayi', Aristarkus nɛ Sekundus, nɛ Derbe nid ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Gaius, nɛ Tikikus nɛ Trofimus, nidib ayi' bama da yinɛ Asia teŋin na, nɛ Timoti.

english_verse: They went on ahead to Troas and waited for us there.
translation_verse: Bama da gaad tuonnɛ guri ti Troas teŋin.

english_verse: After the Festival of Thin Bread, we sailed from Philippi. Five days later we met them in Troas and stayed there for a week. Paul's Last Visit to Troas
translation_verse: Ka bodobodo kanɛ ka' danbin malʋŋ la'asʋg dabisa la nya'aŋ, ka ti kpɛn' anrʋŋʋ yi Filipi teŋin, ka daba anu daar ka ti paae banɛ bɛ Troas teŋin la ka zin'in anina daba ayɔpɔi. Paul gaas Troas teŋin

english_verse: On the first day of the week we met to break bread together. Paul spoke to the people until midnight because he was leaving the next morning.
translation_verse: Asibid daar yʋ'ʋŋ yinne ka ti la'as ye ti di Zugsɔb diib. Ka Paul n bɔɔd ye o duoe bɛkanɛ nied la zug, ka o pian' tis nidib la ka yʋ'ʋŋ kena sʋdig.

english_verse: In the upstairs room where we were meeting, there were a lot of lamps.
translation_verse: Ka fita bɛdegʋ da bɛ girimbisa dɔkanɛ ka ti la'as la ni.

english_verse: A young man by the name of Eutychus was sitting on a window sill. While Paul was speaking, the young man got very sleepy. Finally, he went to sleep and fell three floors all the way down to the ground. When they picked him up, he was dead.
