english_verse: For two years Paul stayed in a rented house and welcomed everyone who came to see him.
translation_verse: Ka Paul zin'in yikanɛ ka o yɔɔdi li yɛla la ni yʋma ayi', ka di'esid ban wʋsa kennɛ o san'an na,

english_verse: He bravely preached about God's kingdom and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ, and no one tried to stop him.
translation_verse: ka pa'annɛ ba Wina'am na'am yɛla nɛ Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yɛla, ka pian'ad nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ ka sɔ' pʋ giŋid oo.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus. God chose me to be an apostle, and he appointed me to preach the good news
translation_verse: Man Paul, onɛ an Yesu Kristo tʋmtʋm, ka Wina'am buolim ye m an Yesu Kristo tʋmtʋm ka gaŋimi tʋm ye m mɔɔl o labasʋŋ la sɔbid nɛ'.

english_verse: that he promised long ago by what his prophets said in the holy Scriptures.
translation_verse: Wina'am da dɛŋi zi'el nɔɔr labasʋŋ la yɛla ka li lal, ka yii o nɔdi'esidibin ka li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn la.

english_verse: This good news is about his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ! As a human, he was from the family of David. But the Holy Spirit proved that Jesus is the powerful Son of God, because he was raised from death.
translation_verse: Ka ti ya'a tɛn'ɛs on an Wina'am ka an sʋm nyain la yɛla, ti nyɛ ka Wina'am vʋ'ʋg o kumin, ala ka o pa'al nɛ paŋ ye o anɛ o Biig.

english_verse: Jesus was kind to me and chose me to be an apostle, so that people of all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: Li yinɛ o san'an na ka Wina'am tisi ti yɛlsʋm ye ti an Yesu Kristo tʋmtʋmnib ka kɛ ka dunia buudi wʋsa niŋ o yadda ka siak o nɔɔr.

english_verse: You are some of those people chosen by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ka yanam banɛ ka Wina'am gaŋi ya ye ya an Yesu Kristo nidib la mɛ paas ani.

english_verse: This letter is to all of you in Rome. God loves you and has chosen you to be his very own people. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: M sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid yanam banɛ wʋsa bɛ Room teŋin ka Wina'am nɔŋi ya ka gaŋi ya ye ya aan o mɛŋ nidib la. Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na tisi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Paul mɔr nimmua ye o keŋ Room

english_verse: First, I thank God in the name of Jesus Christ for all of you. I do this because people everywhere in the world are talking about your faith.
translation_verse: Yiiga, m pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka Yesu Kristo nii ya wʋsa zug, ka mɛ pʋ'ʋs o dunia wʋsaa wʋmi ya yadda niŋir la zug.

english_verse: God has seen how I never stop praying for you, while I serve him with all my heart and tell the good news about his Son.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ ka m tʋmm o tʋʋma nɛ m ya'am wʋsa mɔɔn labasʋŋ o Biig la yɛla la, na dii m kasɛt ye saŋa wʋsa m tiɛndi ya yɛla

english_verse: In all my prayers, I ask God to make it possible for me to visit you.
translation_verse: m sɔsʋg pʋʋgin. M sɔsid o ye li ya'a aan o bɔɔdim on maal suor ka m nyaŋi kena kaae ya nannanna.

english_verse: I want to see you and share with you the same blessings that God's Spirit has given me. Then you will grow stronger in your faith.
translation_verse: M ya'amlɛog bɛɛ ya san'an hali ka m bɔɔd ye m nyɛɛ ya, ka kɛ ka ya na di'e piini linɛ yi Wina'am Siig Kasi ni na la, ka li kɛ ka ya nyɛ paŋ.

english_verse: What I am saying is that we can encourage each other by the faith that is ours.
translation_verse: Man yɛl si'el la anɛ ye, man nɛ yanam na la'an nyɛ sʋŋir. Ka yanam na sʋŋ mam, ka mam mɛ na sʋŋi ya ti Wina'am yadda niŋir pʋʋgin.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that I have often planned to come for a visit. But something has always kept me from doing it. I want to win followers to Christ in Rome, as I have done in many other places.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m bɔɔd ye ya baŋ ye m mɔ nɔɔr si'em sa, ye m kena kaae ya. Ka saŋkan la sa nɛ nwa', ka yɛlsieba vi'im ka m pʋ nyaŋɛ. M bɔɔd ye m kɛ ka Room dim sieba tiaki ba sʋnya ka dɔl Zugsɔb la, nwɛnɛ mam pʋn niŋ si'em banɛ ka' Jew dim san'an si'em la.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if people are civilized and educated, or if they are uncivilized and uneducated. I must tell the good news to everyone. That's why I am eager to visit all of you in Rome. The Power of the Good News
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m mɛ bɔɔd hali ye m mɔɔl labasʋŋ la yanam banɛ bɛ Room teŋin la. Wina'am labasʋŋ la mɔr paŋ

english_verse: I am proud of the good news! It is God's powerful way of saving all people who have faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: M pʋ zɔt nyan nɛ labasʋŋ la yɛla, bɔzugɔ li anɛ Wina'am paŋ linɛ kɛt ka nimbanɛ wʋsa niŋ o yadda la nyɛt faangir; Jew dim la yiiga nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim la. Linzug ka nyan pʋ mɔrim labasʋŋ la yɛlaa.

english_verse: The good news tells how God accepts everyone who has faith, but only those who have faith. It is just as the Scriptures say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.” Everyone Is Guilty
translation_verse: Li pa'annɛ ti Wina'am niŋid si'em kɛ ka ti an pʋpielim dim o tuon. Ka li anɛ ti yadda niŋir Yesu Kristo ni gʋllim kɛ ka ti mɔr pʋpielim. Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Onɛ an pʋpielim daan Wina'am tuon la na vʋe nɛ o yadda niŋir Wina'am ni.” Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn lu ninsaalib zug

english_verse: From heaven God shows how angry he is with all the wicked and evil things that sinful people do to crush the truth.
translation_verse: Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn naan arezana nii lut nidib zugʋ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ ba bugusim wʋsa linɛ ka ba tʋm la yɛla, bugusim linɛ ka ba tʋm ka li vi'id yɛlsida la.

english_verse: They know everything that can be known about God, because God has shown it all to them.
translation_verse: Bʋn linɛ ka ninsaal na tun'e baŋ Wina'am yɛla la nie nyain ba san'an; ka Wina'am mɛŋ nie li pa'ali ba.

english_verse: God's eternal power and character cannot be seen. But from the beginning of creation, God has shown what these are like by all he has made. That's why those people don't have any excuse.
translation_verse: Din yi saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am da maal dunia la hali ti paae zina, nidib nyɛt o nyalima bɛllim nɛ o paŋ kanɛ ka' naar la ka gban'e on maal si'el la gbin. Alazug, saalib kʋ nyaŋi yɛl ye ba zi' Wina'am yɛlaa.

english_verse: They know about God, but they don't honor him or even thank him. Their thoughts are useless, and their stupid minds are in the dark.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ ban mi' Wina'am la, ba pʋ tis o girimkanɛ nar ye o di'e laa, ka pʋ pʋ'ʋsid o bareka. Amaa ba tɛn'ɛsʋg lieb zɔlimis, ka ba ya'am an yɔɔg-yɔɔg, ka ba kʋ nyaŋidi gban'ad si'el gbinnɛ.

english_verse: They claim to be wise, but they are fools.
translation_verse: Ba yɛl ye ba anɛ ya'am dim, ka lɛɛ an zɔn,

english_verse: They don't worship the glorious and eternal God. Instead, they worship idols that are made to look like humans who cannot live forever, and like birds, animals, and reptiles.
translation_verse: ka pʋ tisid Wina'am onɛ mɔr na'am ka kʋ kpi la girimaa. Ba tiaknɛ Wina'am girima tis bʋmbanɛ ka saalib zaŋi ba nu'usi maal ka ba nwɛnɛ ninsaalib bɛɛ niis bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbid bɛɛ si'elnam banɛ vuudi ba pʋya zut la.

english_verse: So God let these people go their own way. They did what they wanted to do, and their filthy thoughts made them do shameful things with their bodies.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka Wina'am basi ba ye ba tʋm dian'ad tʋʋma linɛ ka ba ya'am bɔɔd ka diis taaba nyan nɛ ba niŋgbina.

english_verse: They gave up the truth about God for a lie, and they worshiped God's creation instead of God, who will be praised forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Ba bas Wina'am yɛlsida la ka lɛɛ dɔl dama'am, ka na'asid dinɛ ka Wina'am maal la, ka pʋ'ʋsidi li. Onɛ nar nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim saŋa kanɛ ka' naarɛ. Ami.

english_verse: God let them follow their own evil desires. Women no longer wanted to have sex in a natural way, and they did things with each other that were not natural.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka Wina'am basi ba ka ba tʋmmi ba ya'amlɛog tʋʋma dinɛ an dian'ad la. Ka pu'abi naan digin nɛ dap wʋʋ Wina'am bɔɔd ye li an si'em la, ka ba bas ka lɛɛ dig nɛ taaba.

english_verse: Men behaved in the same way. They stopped wanting to have sex with women and had strong desires for sex with other men. They did shameful things with each other, and what has happened to them is punishment for their foolish deeds.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka dap bas pu'ab ka mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ ba dap taaba. Ba niŋid si'elnam dinɛ mɔr nyan nɛ taaba. Ka dinzug ka ba di'ed namiskanɛ nar ye ba di'e la ba mɛŋ niŋgbina ni, ban niŋid si'el la yɛla.

english_verse: Since these people refused even to think about God, he let their useless minds rule over them. That's why they do all sorts of indecent things.
translation_verse: Ka ninsaalibi pʋ siak ye Wina'am sid an Wina'am la zug, ka o basi ba ka ba pɛ'ɛl nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛyɔɔd ka maan dinɛ pʋ nar ye ba maan na.

english_verse: They are evil, wicked, and greedy, as well as mean in every possible way. They want what others have, and they murder, argue, cheat, and are hard to get along with. They gossip,
translation_verse: Ba sʋnya pɛ'ɛl nɛ bɛ'ɛd buudi wʋsa. Ka linɛ an: bugusim nɛ fufum nɛ kisidim nɛ nɛnnim nɛ ninkʋʋr nɛ zaba nɛ dama'am nɛ sʋntɔɔg. Ba kɛɛnd,

english_verse: say cruel things about others, and hate God. They are proud, conceited, and boastful, always thinking up new ways to do evil. These people don't respect their parents.
translation_verse: ka fakidi ba taaba zut, ka kis Wina'am, ka an nimpʋnannib, ka mɔr nyɛɛsim, ka nwɛ'ɛdi ba mɛŋ nyɔ'ɔg, ka ieed suopaala tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka zan'asidi ba manam nɛ ba saamnam nɔya.

english_verse: They are stupid, unreliable, and don't have any love or pity for others.
translation_verse: Ba anɛ ninyɔɔd, ka ya'a kaanb ye ba na tʋm si'el, ba pʋ tʋmma, ka pʋ mɔr nɔŋir nɛ ba taaba, ka mɛ pʋ zɔt nimbaanliga.

english_verse: They know God has said that anyone who acts this way deserves to die. But they keep on doing evil things, and they even encourage others to do them.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ bam mi' ye Wina'am pʋpielim zi'elʋg la anɛ ye, ninkanɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bama nar nɛ kum, ka zan'as ka kpɛn tʋm ala. Ka linɛ an bɛ'ɛdi gaad ala anɛ ban yɛl ye nimbanɛ niŋid ala la anɛ ninsʋma la.

english_verse: Some of you accuse others of doing wrong. But there is no excuse for what you do. When you judge others, you condemn yourselves, because you are guilty of doing the very same things.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a kati fʋ taaba saria ka kʋʋsi ba bɛ'ɛd, fʋn pʋn kʋʋs nɛ fʋ mɛŋ bɛ'ɛd bɔzugɔ fʋn mɛ tʋm nɛ ala.

english_verse: We know that God is right to judge everyone who behaves in this way.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye Wina'am anɛ yɛlsida sɔb ka na kad nimbama saria ka li dɔl suor.

english_verse: Do you really think God won't punish you, when you behave exactly like the people you accuse?
translation_verse: M zua, fʋ ya'a yɛt banɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bama ye ba niŋ bɛ'ɛd, ka fʋn mɛ tʋm ala, fʋ tɛn'ɛs ye fʋ na nyaŋi pɔns Wina'am sariakadib la?

english_verse: You surely don't think much of God's wonderful goodness or of his patience and willingness to put up with you. Don't you know that the reason God is good to you is because he wants you to turn to him?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ fʋ ziemnɛ Wina'am an sʋ'ʋm ka mɔr suguru nɛ summɔtir bɛdegʋ nɛ ti la zugɔ? Fʋ zi' ye Wina'am an sʋ'ʋm la, o bɔɔd ye o kɛ ka fʋ tiak ka basi fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd laa?

english_verse: But you are stubborn and refuse to turn to God. So you are making things even worse for yourselves on that day when he will show how angry he is and will judge the world with fairness.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn an zukpi'euŋ sɔb ka zan'as ye fʋ kʋ tiak ka bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, fʋ paasi fʋ mɛŋ nɛ namisʋg linɛ ka fʋ na ti nyɛ daakanɛ ka Wina'am na kad saria nɛ yɛlsida, ka o sʋnpɛɛn nie paalʋ ni la.

english_verse: God will reward each of us for what we have done.
translation_verse: Wina'am na tis sɔ' mɛkama nyɔɔd wʋʋ on tʋm si'em.

english_verse: He will give eternal life to everyone who has patiently done what is good in the hope of receiving glory, honor, and life that lasts forever.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ mɔdigi tʋm tʋʋm sʋma, ka bɔɔd girima nɛ na'asi Wina'am san'an la, o na tisi ba nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: But he will show how angry and furious he can be with every selfish person who rejects the truth and wants to do evil.
translation_verse: Amaa banɛ bɔɔdi ba mɛŋ yɛla, ka zan'as sida ka siak tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, o sʋnpɛɛn nɛ tʋbtɛɛgir na luu ba zug.

english_verse: All who are wicked will be punished with trouble and suffering. It doesn't matter if they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: O na zaŋ namisʋg nɛ daamʋgʋ tis ninsaalib banɛ wʋsa tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. Jew dim la na nyɛɛ li yiiga, ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la mɛ tia'al.

english_verse: But all who do right will be rewarded with glory, honor, and peace, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Amaa o na zaŋ na'asi nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm tis nimbanɛ wʋsa tʋm tʋʋm sʋma. Jew dim na nyɛɛ li yiiga mɛn, ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la tia'al.

english_verse: God doesn't have any favorites!
translation_verse: Wina'am pʋ mɔr baregaŋ nɛ nidibaa.

english_verse: Those people who don't know about God's Law will still be punished for what they do wrong. And the Law will be used to judge everyone who knows what it says.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ ka' Jew dim ka pʋ mɔr wada la ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛd, ba na ba'as yɔri ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug. Ka Jew dim la mɔr wada la ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛd, Wina'am na kadi ba saria nɛ wada la.

english_verse: God accepts those who obey his Law, but not those who simply hear it.
translation_verse: Li ka' banɛ wʋm wada la an pʋpielim dim Wina'am tuonnɛ, ka lɛɛ anɛ banɛ niŋid wʋʋ wada la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: This proves that the conscience is like a law written in the human heart. And it will show whether we are forgiven or condemned,
translation_verse: Ba tʋʋma pa'al ye wada la yɛl si'el la bɛɛ ba sʋnfʋn, ka ba pʋtɛn'ɛr linɛ mi' sʋ'ʋm nɛ bɛ'ɛd la mɛ pa'al ye li an sida. Ka ba mɛŋ pʋtɛn'ɛr ɛɛnti kʋʋsi ba saŋa si'a ye ba tʋm sʋ'ʋm bɛɛ bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: when God appoints Jesus Christ to judge everyone's secret thoughts, just as my message says. The Jews and the Law
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ labasʋŋ kanɛ ka m mɔɔn la yɛt si'em la, daar kenna ka Wina'am na kad yɛlsu'ada banɛ bɛ nidib pʋtɛnda ni saria Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr zug. Jew dim nɛ wada la yɛla

english_verse: Some of you call yourselves Jews. You trust in the Law and take pride in God.
translation_verse: Ka fʋn kanɛ buoli fʋ mɛŋ ye Jew nid la, fʋ yɛla an bɔ? Fʋn mɔr Moses wada la zug ka fʋ nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg ye fʋ dɔl Wina'am tituaa bɛɛ?

english_verse: By reading the Scriptures you learn how God wants you to behave, and you discover what is right.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a mi' Wina'am bɔɔdim, ka wada la pa'alif fʋn na gaŋ linɛ an sʋm,

english_verse: You are sure that you are a guide for the blind and a light for all who are in the dark.
translation_verse: ka fʋ lɔɔ fʋ sʋʋnrin ye fʋ anɛ onɛ na gaad zʋnzɔɔs tuonnɛ pa'ali ba, ka an nɛɛsim tis banɛ bɛ likin,

english_verse: And since there is knowledge and truth in God's Law, you think you can instruct fools and teach young people.
translation_verse: ka zamisid banɛ an zɔn nɛ banɛ an biis, ka pa'annɛ fʋ taaba,

english_verse: But how can you teach others when you refuse to learn? You preach it is wrong to steal. But do you steal?
translation_verse: ka bɔ ka fʋ pʋ zamisi fʋ mɛŋa ka mɔɔn ye nidib da zuuda, ka fʋ mɛŋ lɛɛ zuuda?

english_verse: You say people should be faithful in marriage. But are you faithful? You hate idols, yet you rob their temples.
translation_verse: Fʋn kanɛ yɛl ye ba da san'am pu'ab la, fʋ mɛŋ san'am pu'ab bɛɛ? Ya pʋ siak ye ba maalim ba'arɛ, amaa ya mɛŋ zuud ba'ar la'ad.

english_verse: You take pride in the Law, but you disobey the Law and bring shame to God.
translation_verse: Ka nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ Wina'am wada, ka mɛ san'ami li ka diisid Wina'am nyan.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures tell us, “You have made foreigners say insulting things about God.”
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Yanam Jew dim zug, ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la pian'ad bɛ'ɛdi san'amid Wina'am yʋ'ʋr la.”

english_verse: Being circumcised is worthwhile, if you obey the Law. But if you don't obey the Law, you are no better off than people who are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a siak wada la, fʋ baŋʋ kpɛn'ɛb linɛ pa'al ye fʋ anɛ Wina'am nid yinne la mɔr nyɔɔd. Ka fʋ ya'a san'am wada la, fʋ baŋʋ kpɛn'ɛb la anɛ zaalim.

english_verse: In fact, if they obey the Law, they are as good as anyone who is circumcised.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ ka' Jew dim, ka pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ la ya'a siak wada la nɔɔr yɛlʋg, Wina'am na gɔsi ba wʋʋ banɛ kpɛn' baŋʋ.

english_verse: So everyone who obeys the Law, but has never been circumcised, will condemn you. Even though you are circumcised and have the Law, you still don't obey its teachings.
translation_verse: Banɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ la ya'a siaki di'e wada la, li na pa'al ye yanam Jew dim banɛ mɔr wada la ka kpɛn' baŋʋ ka lɛɛ san'am wada la tʋm taal.

english_verse: Just because you live like a Jew and are circumcised doesn't make you a real Jew.
translation_verse: Ka' onɛ an Jew nid paalʋ nii an Jew nid yɛlmɛŋir bɛɛ baŋʋ kpɛn'ɛb linɛ an sida anɛ niŋgbiŋin ma'aanɛ.

english_verse: To be a real Jew you must obey the Law. True circumcision is something that happens deep in your heart, not something done to your body. And besides, you should want praise from God and not from humans.
translation_verse: Amaa Jew nid yɛlmɛŋir anɛ onɛ an Jew nid o sʋnfʋn, ka baŋʋ kpɛn'ɛb linɛ an yɛlmɛŋir mɛ an linɛ yi ninsaal sʋnfʋn na ka Siig Kasi la tʋmi li, ka ka'anɛ linɛ sɔb gbana nii. Ninkaŋa sɔb di'ednɛ pian'asʋŋ Wina'am san'an ka ka' ninsaalibi nɛ.

english_verse: What good is it to be a Jew? What good is it to be circumcised?
translation_verse: Nyɔbɔɔ bɛɛ tis banɛ an Jew dim, bɛɛ nyɔbɔɔ bɛɛ tis banɛ kpɛn' baŋʋ la?

english_verse: It is good in a lot of ways! First of all, God's messages were spoken to the Jews.
translation_verse: Li anɛ bɛdegʋ. Yiiga daan, Wina'am da gu'uli ba o nɔɔr pian'ad.

english_verse: It is true that some of them did not believe the message. But does this mean that God cannot be trusted, just because they did not have faith?
translation_verse: Ka ba sieba ya'a da ka'anɛ yɛlsida dima li na kɛ ka Wina'am kʋ an yɛlsida sɔb bɛɛ?

english_verse: No, indeed! God tells the truth, even if everyone else is a liar. The Scriptures say about God, “Your words will be proven true, and in court you will win your case.”
translation_verse: Ayei, baa bi'elaa! Hali nidib wʋsa ya'a an ziri dim, Wina'am na kpɛn an sida sɔb. Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Li nar ka Wina'am din dɔl suor, ka o pian'ad mɔr sida o sariakadib pʋʋgin.”

english_verse: If our evil deeds show how right God is, then what can we say? Is it wrong for God to become angry and punish us? What a foolish thing to ask.
translation_verse: Ka tinam ya'a tʋm linɛ pʋ nara ka li kɛ ka Wina'am tʋʋm sʋma nie pa'al nyainnɛ, ti na yɛl ye bɔ? Ti na yɛl ye Wina'am tɛkidi ti tʋbir la o tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bɛɛ? Ayei, baa bi'elaa!

english_verse: But the answer is, “No.” Otherwise, how could God judge the world?
translation_verse: Wina'am ya'a ka'annɛ sida sɔba, o naan kʋ nyaŋi kadin dunia nidib saria.

english_verse: Since your lies bring great honor to God by showing how truthful he is, you may ask why God still says you are a sinner.
translation_verse: Ka m ya'a an ziri sɔb, ka m ziri la zug kɛ ka Wina'am yɛlsida la paasid ka o nyɛt girima, wala ka ba kad man saria ye m anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd daana?

english_verse: You might as well say, “Let's do something evil, so that something good will come of it!” Some people even claim that we are saying this. But God is fair and will judge them as well. No One Is Good
translation_verse: Ka bɔɔ kɛ ka ti kʋ yɛl ye; “Alaa kɛl ka ti tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka daasi'erɛɛ bʋnsʋŋ na kena?” Ninsieba tʋ'ʋd man yɛt ye manɛ yɛl ala. Wina'am na kʋʋsi ba yɛla bɛ'ɛd wʋʋ lin nar si'em. Sɔ' kae an pʋpiel la

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean that we Jews are better off than the Gentiles? No, it doesn't! Jews, as well as Gentiles, are ruled by sin, just as I have said.
translation_verse: Aa, tɔ. Tinam banɛ an Jew dim la an sʋm gat banɛ ka' Jew dim la bɛɛ? Ayei. M pʋn dɛŋim pa'al ye tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd mɔr paŋ nɛ Jew dim la'an nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim wʋsa.

english_verse: The Scriptures tell us, “No one is acceptable to God!
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Sɔ' kae tʋm sʋm, hali baa nid yinne mɛnɛ.

english_verse: Not one of them understands or even searches for God.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kae mi' li gbinni bakida, bɛɛ ieed on Wina'am.

english_verse: They have all turned away and are worthless. There isn't one person who does right.
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa fɛndignɛ; ba wʋsa yʋ'ʋn san'amnɛ. Sɔ' kae tʋm sʋm, hali baa nid yinne mɛnɛ.

english_verse: Their words are like an open pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies. Each word is as deadly as the fangs of a snake,
translation_verse: Ba kʋkɔya nwɛnɛ yaʋg za'anɔɔr linɛ ka ba pʋ yɔɔda. Ba pian'adnɛ ziri pian'ad ma'aa. Dunduug yabidi bɛɛ ba nɔŋgbana ni.

english_verse: and they say nothing but bitter curses.
translation_verse: Ba nɔɔr pian'ad anɛ nɔpɔɔr ma'aa ka tɔi wʋʋ yabid nɛ.

english_verse: These people quickly become violent.
translation_verse: Ba zɔti tɔ'ɔtɔ ken ye ba kʋ nid.

english_verse: Wherever they go, they leave ruin and destruction.
translation_verse: Ka zin'ikanɛ ka ba gaad wʋsa sʋnsa'aŋ na bɛɛ anina.

english_verse: They don't know how to live in peace.
translation_verse: Ba zi' sumbʋgʋsʋm suorɛ,

english_verse: They don't even fear God.”
translation_verse: ka mɛ pʋ zɔt Wina'am ka na gu'usɛ.”

english_verse: We know that everything in the Law was written for those who are under its power. The Law says these things to stop anyone from making excuses and to let God show that the whole world is guilty.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye wada la ya'a yɛl si'el, li yɛtnɛ tisid nimbanɛ dɔlli li la. Linzug ka nidib wʋsa banɛ mɔr wada la nɛ banɛ ka' li la, na sinni ba nɔɔr. Ka ba wʋsa na tu'asi ba yɛla Wina'am tuon ka kɔ'ɔŋ bʋʋd.

english_verse: God doesn't accept people simply because they obey the Law. No, indeed! All the Law does is to point out our sin. God's Way of Accepting People
translation_verse: Ninsaal kae na niŋ wada la yɛl si'em la ka an pʋpielim daan Wina'am tuonnɛ. Li anɛ wada la ni ka ninsaalib baŋ ye ba anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim. Wina'am kɛt ka nidib an pʋpielim dim o tuon

english_verse: Now we see how God does make us acceptable to him. The Law and the Prophets tell how we become acceptable, and it isn't by obeying the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ka nannanna Wina'am nie pa'al on niŋid si'em kɛt ka ninsaalib an pʋpielim dim o tuon. Ka Wina'am nɔdi'esidib nɛ wada la pa'ali ti li yɛla, ka li lɛɛ pʋ yinɛ wada la dɔllim ni naa.

english_verse: God treats everyone alike. He accepts people only because they have faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Wina'am kɛt ka ninsaalib banɛ wʋsa niŋ Yesu Kristo yadda la an pʋpielim dim o tuon. Sɔ' mɛkama anɛ yinne,

english_verse: All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ, saalib wʋsa tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka kɔ'ɔŋ Wina'am girima.

english_verse: But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am piini linɛ ka o tis nidib wʋsa la zugʋ kɛ ka ti nyɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd taal pɛ'ɛŋir, ka li yinɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ faaɛn ti la ni na.

english_verse: What is left for us to brag about? Not a thing! Is it because we obeyed some law? No! It is because of faith.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, bɔ yɛla kimm ka ti na tun'e nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgɔ? Ti kʋ tun'e nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg si'el-si'el yɛlaa. Li ka'anɛ ninsaalibi dɔl wada la na kɛ ka ba nyaŋi nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgɔ. Li anɛ ban niŋ Yesu Kristo yadda la zug.

english_verse: We see that people are acceptable to God because they have faith, and not because they obey the Law.
translation_verse: Ti gban'e ye sɔ' yadda niŋir Kristo ni gʋllim na kɛ ka Wina'am kɛ ka o an pʋpielim sɔb o tuon, ka ka'anɛ on dɔl wada la zugɔ.

english_verse: Does God belong only to the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is!
translation_verse: Ya tɛn'ɛs ye Wina'am anɛ Jew dim la Wina'am ma'aanɛɛ? Ayei, o anɛ Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim la wʋsa Wina'am.

english_verse: There is only one God, and he accepts Gentiles as well as Jews, simply because of their faith.
translation_verse: Wina'am anɛ yinne, ka na kɛ ka Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim la mɛ an pʋpielim dim o tuon, ba wʋsa yadda niŋirin.

english_verse: Do we destroy the Law by our faith? Not at all! We make it even more powerful.
translation_verse: Ya tɛn'ɛs ye tinam pa'al ye nidibi di'ed pʋpielim ba yadda niŋir zug la kɛt ka wada la an zaalim bɛɛ? Ayei, baa bi'elaa. Ti lɛɛ kɛ ka wada la zi'e sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Well then, what can we say about our ancestor Abraham?
translation_verse: Ti na yɛl Abraham onɛ an tinam banɛ an Jew dim yaab la yɛla ye bɔ? O da nyɛ bɔ?

english_verse: If he became acceptable to God because of what he did, then he would have something to brag about. But he would never be able to brag about it to God.
translation_verse: Li ya'a da aan Abraham tʋʋma zugʋ kɛ ka o lieb pʋpielim sɔb Wina'am tuon, o da naan mɔrin si'eli na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg, ka lɛɛ kʋ nyaŋi nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg Wina'am tuonnɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.”
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Abraham da niŋ Wina'am yadda, ka Wina'am gɔsi li ka yɛl ye o anɛ pʋpielim sɔb o tuon.”

english_verse: Money paid to workers isn't a gift. It is something they earn by working.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a tʋm tʋʋma, o di'ed yɔɔd. Ka ba lɛɛ kʋ gɛligi li ye li anɛ piini, amaa li lɛɛ anɛ linɛ nar ye o di'e.

english_verse: But you cannot make God accept you because of something you do. God accepts sinners only because they have faith in him.
translation_verse: Ninkanɛ ti'e o yadda niŋir ka ka'anɛ o tʋʋm sʋmaa, ka niŋ yadda ye o na di bʋʋd Wina'am tuon o yadda niŋir zug, Wina'am na gɔs niŋkan yadda niŋir ka o lieb pʋpielim daan o tuon.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: David mɛ da yɛl ninsaal sumalisim yɛla ka li bɛ Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, Wina'am gɔs ye o anɛ pʋpielim sɔb, ka li ka'anɛ o tʋʋma zugɔ. Ka ye,

english_verse: “What a blessing when God forgives our sins and our evil deeds. What a blessing when the Lord erases our sins from his book.”
translation_verse: Wina'am albareka bɛ nɛ ninkanɛ ka Zugsɔb la pʋ kaan o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bɛɛ gɔsi li la.”

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: Wina'am albareka linɛ ka David pian' li yɛla la, ka'anɛ nimbanɛ kpɛn' baŋʋ la din ma'aanɛɛ. Li mɛ anɛ nimbanɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ la din. Ti dɛŋi sɔb ye, “Abraham da niŋ Wina'am yadda, ka Wina'am gɔsi li ka yɛl ye o anɛ pʋpielim sɔb o tuon.”

english_verse: But when did this happen? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? Of course, it was before.
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsimi saŋkanɛ ka li da niŋ la yɛla. Li da anɛ Abraham da nam pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ la, ka ka' li nya'aŋa.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Abraham da siak baŋʋ kpɛn'ɛb la, ka li anɛ zanbin, ka pa'al ye saŋkanɛ ka o da nam pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ la, Wina'am da gɔs ka o an pʋpielim sɔb o tuon o yadda niŋir zug. Dinzugɔ, Abraham an banɛ wʋsa niŋ Wina'am yadda ka Wina'am gɔs ka ba an pʋpielim dim o tuon la yaab la'an nɛ bam pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ la.

english_verse: This also makes Abraham the father of everyone who is circumcised and has faith in God, as Abraham did before he was circumcised. The Promise Is for All Who Have Faith
translation_verse: Abraham mɛ an nimbanɛ kpɛn' baŋʋ la yaab, ka li ka'anɛ baŋʋ kpɛn'ɛb la ma'aanɛɛ, ka lɛɛ anɛ ban niŋ Wina'am yadda wʋʋ Abraham da niŋ si'em, ka da nam pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ la. Wina'am nɔzi'elʋg di'er la yɛla

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Wina'am da kaanbi tis Abraham nɛ o yaas, ye banɛ na ti sʋ'oe dunia ka li ka'anɛ Abraham da dɔl wada la zugɔ, amaa li anɛ on da niŋ Wina'am yadda ka o gɔs ka o an pʋpielim sɔb o tuon la zug.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Ka li ya'a aan banɛ dɔl wada la di'edin Wina'am yɛlsʋm la, ninsaalib yadda niŋir Wina'am ni, nɛ o kaanbʋg la na aan zaalim.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Wada la kɛt ka Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn luti ti zug. Ka wada la ya'a kae li ki'isʋg mɛ kʋ bɛɛ.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Linzug, ninsaalib banɛ niŋ Wina'am yadda la di'ed o kaanbʋg ka li yinɛ o pʋpielim ni na, ye Abraham yaas wʋsa sid na di'e o nɔzi'elʋg la. Ka li ka'anɛ o yaas banɛ dɔl wada la gʋllimnɛɛ, ka mɛ anɛ banɛ niŋ Wina'am yadda wʋʋ Abraham da niŋ si'em la. Abraham aan ti wʋsa yaab.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ Wina'am da yɛl si'em o gbauŋʋn ye, “M maalif nɛ buudi bɛdegʋ yaab la.” Alazug, nɔzi'elʋg nwa' anɛ linɛ bɛɛ ti yaab Abraham onɛ daa niŋ Wina'am sɔ' yadda la san'an. Onɛ kɛt ka kpi'im nied kumin na, ka kɛt ka linɛ kae bɛ.

english_verse: God promised Abraham a lot of descendants. And when it all seemed hopeless, Abraham still had faith in God and became the ancestor of many nations.
translation_verse: Abraham n da gɔs ka li an si'em la, ti'ir da kae nɛ biig nyɛɛbɔ. Ka o da niŋ Wina'am yadda ka mɔr ti'ir. Ka linzugʋ da kɛ ka o lieb buudi bɛdegʋ yaab. Li dɔlnɛ Wina'am da yɛl o ye, “Ala ka fʋ yaas mɛ na zu'oe la.”

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: O da pʋ bas o yadda niŋir nɛ Wina'am, ka mɛ pʋ bi'esid o kaanbʋgɔ. O yadda niŋiri kɛ ka o nyɛ paŋ ka tis Wina'am na'asi,

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: ka mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye Wina'am na nyaŋi maal si'el wʋsa o nɔzi'elʋg ni.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: Lin da sɔb si'em la ye Wina'am siak ka o an pʋpielim sɔb la ka'anɛ on zug gʋllimnɛɛ,

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: ka li mɛ anɛ tinam zug mɛn. Wina'am mɛ gɔs tinam ka ti an pʋpielim dim o tuon, tinam banɛ niŋ Wina'am onɛ vʋ'ʋgi ti Zugsɔb Yesu kumin yadda la.

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Wina'am da kɛ ka Yesu kpi ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug, ka vʋ'ʋg o kumin ye o kɛ ka ti an pʋpielim dim o tuon.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Wina'am kɛ ka ti an pʋpielim dim o tuon ka li yinɛ ti yadda niŋirin la, ti mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm Wina'am san'an, ka li anɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ma'asim la zug.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: Kristo kɛ ka ti nyɛ Wina'am pʋpielim piini ka mɔri li kiŋ-kiŋ, ka mɛ mɔr ti'ir ye ti na la'am di'e na'asi nɛ Wina'am. Ka li tisi ti sumalisim.

english_verse: But that's not all! We gladly suffer, because we know that suffering helps us to endure.
translation_verse: Ka ti mɛ mɔr sumalisim ti namisʋg la yɛla, bɔzugɔ ti mi' ye namisʋg kɛt ka ti nyaŋi mɔdigid.

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am pɛsig o nɔŋirɛ ti sʋnya ni, ka li yinɛ o Siig Kasi onɛ ka Wina'am tisi ti la ni na. Ka linzug ka ti'ir kaŋa ka' ziri ti'irɛ.

english_verse: Christ died for us at a time when we were helpless and sinful.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ da nan an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim ka ka' paŋ kanɛ na sʋŋi ti mɛŋ la, ka Kristo kpii tisi ti.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: Li tɔi ka sɔ' di'e pʋpielim sɔb kum kpi. Amaa daasi'erɛɛ sɔ' na siaki kpi ninsʋŋ yɛla.

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: Ka tinamɛ da nan an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la ka Kristo kpii tisi ti, ka ala ka Wina'am pa'ali ti on nɔŋi ti si'em.

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Ka o ziim la kɛ ka Wina'am kɛ ka ti an pʋpielim dim o tuon, linzug bi'esʋg lɛn kae ye Kristo na faaɛn ti ka ti kʋ nyɛ Wina'am sʋnpɛɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: Ti da anɛ dataas nɛ Wina'am, ka o Biig la kum kɛ ka o naal nɛ ti. Ka tinamɛ naal nɛ Wina'am la, bi'esʋg lɛn kae ye Kristo nyɔvʋr na faaɛn tii.

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: Ka linɛ lɛm paas anɛ ye ti maan sumalisim nɛ Wina'am niŋ si'el la ka li anɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo onɛ naali ti nɛ Wina'am la zug. Adam nɛ Yesu Kristo la yɛla

english_verse: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.
translation_verse: Dau yinne da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kɛn dunia ni na. Ka o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug ka kum kena. Ka linzug ka kum taas ninsaalib wʋsa, ban tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug.

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am da nam pʋ tis Moses o wada la, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd da bɛ. Amaa wada ya'a kae, Wina'am pʋ gɛligid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: Ka Adam saŋa ti paae Moses saŋa, kum pʋn paae nidib wʋsa, hali nɛ banɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li pʋ an wʋʋ Adam da zan'as Wina'am nɔɔr yɛlʋg si'em la. Adam nɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ kɛɛn o nya'aŋ na la nwɛnɛ taaba,

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: ka lɛɛ ka' bʋn yinnee. Amaa Wina'am piini kanɛ ka o tisi ti la nɛ Adam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la pʋ nwɛn taaba. Nidib bɛdegʋ ya'a kpi dau yinne tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug, alaa linɛ gaad ala anɛ Wina'am yɛlsʋm piini linɛ yit dau yinne onɛ an Yesu Kristo la pʋpielim ni ka zu'oe tis nidib bɛdegʋ la.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Linɛ dɔl Wina'am piini pʋ nwɛnɛ linɛ dɔl dau yinne la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Sariakadib linɛ dɔl tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yinne la anɛ kʋʋsbɛ'ɛd. Ka Wina'am piini linɛ dɔl tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bɛdegʋ anɛ ye Wina'am kɛ ka ti an pʋpielim dim o tuon.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Li anɛ sida ye dau yinne onɛ an Adam la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zugʋ kɛ ka kum paae nidib wʋsa. Amaa dau yinne onɛ an Yesu Kristo la tʋmm gaad ala, bɔzugɔ o kum zugʋ kɛ ka ti paam yɔlisim linɛ yit Wina'am pʋpielimin na.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Aa tɔ. Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yinne la kɛ ka nidib wʋsa nyɛ sariakadib bɛ'ɛd Wina'am san'an. Ala mɛn Yesu Kristo pʋpielim tʋʋm yinne kɛ ka Wina'am kɛ ka nidib wʋsa an pʋpielim dim o tuon, ka tisi ba nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Nid yinne la zan'as Wina'am nɔɔr la kɛ ka nidib bɛdegʋ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim Wina'am tuon. Ala mɛn ka nid yinne la siak Wina'am nɔɔr la kɛ ka Wina'am kɛ ka nidib bɛdegʋ an pʋpielim dim o tuon.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Wada la da kena ye li kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɔbig. Ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi nɔbig la, Wina'am pʋpielim piini mɛ nɔbig bɛdegʋ gaad ala.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nyaŋid nidib wʋsa ka ba kpiid. Ala mɛn Wina'am kɛ ka ti an pʋpielim dim o tuon la zug ka o pʋpielim sʋ'oe ti ka tisi ti nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarɛ, ka li yinɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, ti na yɛl ye bɔ? Ti na yɛl ye ti na kpɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ye Wina'am pʋpielim piini la nɔbig bɛɛ?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Ayei, baa bi'elaa. Li nwɛnɛ ti da kpinɛ, ka dinzug tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pʋ lɛn sʋ'oe tii. Dinzugɔ ti kʋ kpɛn niŋid wʋʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi nan sʋ'oe tii.

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ ya zi' ye tinam banɛ di'e Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb la lieb nɛ yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo ka mɛ lieb yinne nɛ o kum la?

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Kristo da kpiya ka ba mum o, ka Wina'am vʋ'ʋg o kumin nɛ o paŋ. Ala mɛn, ti daa di'e Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb ka li nwɛnɛ ti kpinɛ ka ba mumi ti nɛ o, ye ti vʋ'ʋg ka di'e vʋmpaal ka kpɛm bɛɛ li ni.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Li ya'a an sida ye ti da lieb yinne nɛ Kristo o kumin la, ala mɛn ti sid na an yinne nɛ o kum vʋ'ʋgirin la.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Ti mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye ba da kpa' ti bɛllim kʋdir la nɛ Yesu kum dapuudir la zug linɛ na san'am tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd paŋ, ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kʋ lɛn sʋ'oe ti.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a kpi, o nyɛ yɔlisim nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd paŋ.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Ka tinamɛ sadigim kpi nɛ Kristo la, ti siak ye ti mɛ na vʋe nɛ o.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye Wina'am sadigim vʋ'ʋg Kristo kumin la, o kʋdim kʋ lɛn kpii. Kum lɛn ka' paŋ o san'anɛ.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: O da kpi vuguri ka nyaŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li kʋ lɛn daam o; ka vʋm kanɛ ka o yʋ'ʋn vʋe la, o vʋenɛ tis Wina'am.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn, yanam mɛ gɔsimi ya mɛŋ ka li nwɛnɛ ya kpinɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pʋ lɛn tun'e yaa, ka lɛɛ vʋe Wina'am ni ka li anɛ Yesu Kristo zug.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd lɛn sʋ'oe ya niŋgbina ye ya siak ya'amlɛog bɛ'ɛd banɛ ka ya niŋgbina bɔɔd la.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Da pɛsigi ya niŋgbina luosi tis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li mɔri ba tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ, ka lɛɛ pɛsigi ya mɛŋi tis Wina'am; ka ya anɛ nimbanɛ ka o mɔri ya yi kumin keŋ vʋmin. Pɛsigimi ya niŋgbina luos wʋsa tis Wina'am ye o mɔri ba tʋm pʋpielim tʋʋma.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Wada la pʋ sʋ'oe yaa, amaa li anɛ Wina'am pʋpielim sʋ'oe ya. Linzug tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pʋ lɛn sʋ'oe yaa.

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Aa tɔ. Wada la pʋ sʋ'oe tii, ka Wina'am pʋpielim lɛɛ sʋ'oe ti. Linzug ti na kpɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bɛɛ? Ayei, baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a pɛsigi ya mɛŋ ka an sɔ' yammis ka siak o nɔɔr, ya sid anɛ onɛ ka ya siak la yammis. Alazug, ya ya'a siaki tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ya anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yammis ka li mɔri ya ken kumin. Ka ya ya'a siak Wina'am nɔɔr, ya anɛ o yammis, ka lin mɛ kɛ ka ya an pʋpielim dim Wina'am tuon.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka ye ya da anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yammis amaa ka yʋ'ʋn siaki di'e pa'alʋg kanɛ ka ba tisi ya la nɛ ya sʋnya wʋsa.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Wina'am da kɛ ka ya sʋ'ʋgi ya mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd san'an, ka mɛ kɛ ka ya an pʋpielim yammis.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: M mɔri ya ninsaalib bɛllim an si'em pa'annɛ ya, bɔzugɔ ya pʋ tun'e bakid pian'ad gbinnɛ. Ya daa ɛɛnti pɛsigi ya mɛŋi tis tʋʋmyɔɔd nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka li nɔbigid bɛdegʋ. Ala mɛn, nannanna pɛsigimi ya mɛŋi tis pʋpielim, ye ya niŋ linɛ an sʋm nyain.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ da an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yammis la, ya ba' da kae nɛ pʋpielim tʋʋma.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Ka tʋʋm banɛ ka ya da tʋm ka li mɔr nyannɛ ya san'an nannanna la da tisi ya bɔ nyɔɔdɛ? Tʋʋm ban la ba'asʋg anɛ kum.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Ka nannanna Wina'am kɛ ka ya sʋ'ʋgi ya mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd san'an, ka lieb o yammis. Ka li nyɔɔd anɛ ye ya yʋ'ʋn bɛnɛ kasi, ka li ba'asʋg anɛ nyɔvʋr dinɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɔɔd anɛ kum. Ka Wina'am piini an nyɔvʋr dinɛ ka' naarɛ. Ka ti di'e li tinamɛ an yinne nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo la.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, ya wʋsa mi' wada la yɛla, dinzugɔ ya na gban'e man ye m yɛl si'el la gbin. Wada la sʋ'oe nid nɛ o vʋm saŋa ma'aa.

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, wada la pʋʋgin, li anɛ tilas ye pu'a la'as nɛ o sid, o sid vʋm saŋa. Ka o sid ya'a kpi, pu'a la sʋ'oe o mɛŋ nɛ sid kulug wada la.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Alazug, o ya'a la'as nɛ dau sɔ' ka o sid la nan vʋe, ba na yɛl ye o san'am dau. Amaa o sid ya'a kpi, o sʋ'oe o mɛŋ nɛ sid kulug wada la. Ka o ya'a kul dau sɔ', o pʋ san'am dau.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, yanam mɛ anɛ ala. Yanamɛ an Kristo niŋgbina luos la zug, ya daa kpi ka wada la pʋ lɛn sʋ'oe yaa. Ka nannanna Kristo onɛ ka Wina'am vʋ'ʋg o kumin ye ti niŋ linɛ ma'ae Wina'am sʋnf la yʋ'ʋn sʋ'oe ya.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka ti da dɔlli ti ninsaalib bɔɔdim la, wada la da kɛ ka ti ya'amlɛog linɛ an bɛ'ɛd duoe ti niŋgbina ni ka ti tʋm bʋn linɛ ziid kum na.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Ka nannanna ti sʋ'oe ti mɛŋ wada la san'an. Ti daa kpi, ka wada la pʋ lɛn sʋ'oe tii. Linzug ti dɔl Wina'am nɛ vʋmpaal linɛ ka o Siig Kasi tisi ti la, ka li ka'anɛ wada kʋdig linɛ da sɔb la kɛ ka ti dɔl oo. Wada nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Ti na yɛl ye bɔ? Ti na yɛl ye wada la anɛ bʋmbɛ'ɛd bɛɛ? Ayei, baa bi'elaa. La'an nɛ lin an sida ye wada la anɛ bʋnsʋŋ la, wada la ya'a da ka'anɛ, m naan kʋ baŋin tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi an si'ela. Wada la ya'a da pʋ yɛlin ye, “Da mɔr fufummɛ,” m naan kʋ baŋin fufummi an si'ela.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nyɛɛ li suor nɔɔr yɛlʋg la ni, ka kɛ ka fufum buudi bɛdegʋ duoe m sʋnfʋn. Wada la ya'a ka'anɛ, ti naan kʋ mi'in tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Kʋdimin sa ka m da vʋe, ka da zi' wada la gbinnɛ, ka yʋ'ʋn baŋ nɔɔr yɛlʋg la gbin, ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yʋ'ʋn duoe m sʋnfʋn ka m kpi.

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: Ka wada kanɛ da an ye di mɔr vʋm na la, m nyɛ ka li mɔr nɛ kum na.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nyɛ suor wada la ni, ka ma'ami kpɛn'ɛsim kumin.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Alazug, wada la anɛ kasi; ka nɔɔr yɛlʋg la mɛ an kasi, ka an sʋm nyain.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: Ka bʋn linɛ an sʋm la mɔr kum na tisim bɛɛ? Ayei, baa bi'elaa. Li anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la niŋi li, ka nɔk nɔɔr yɛlʋg linɛ an sʋm la kʋʋm ye li nie pa'al ye li sid anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. Ka linzug ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yʋ'ʋn maligin zu'oe galis hali la. Bɔɔdim ayi' linɛ bɛ ninsaalin la yɛla

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye wada la anɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi din. Ka man anɛ ninsaal, ka nwɛnɛ yammʋg onɛ ka ba kuosi tis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Mam pʋ gban'e man niŋid si'el la gbinnɛ. Mam bɔɔd ye m niŋ si'el la, m pʋ niŋidi lii, amaa linɛ ka m kis la, din ka m niŋid.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: M ya'a tʋm mam pʋ bɔɔd si'el la, li pa'al ye m siak ye wada la an sʋm.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, li ka'anɛ manɛ niŋid nɛ'ɛŋa, ka lɛɛ anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ bɛɛ m ni la.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: M mi' ye bʋn linɛ an sʋm ka' m nii. M ye m yɛl ye, bʋn linɛ an sʋm ka' man ninsaal bɔɔdim san'anɛ. La'an nɛ tʋʋm sʋma ya'amlɛogʋ bɛɛ m san'an la, m pʋ nyaŋidi tʋmmi lii,

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: M ya'a tʋm linɛ ka m pʋ bɔɔda, li pa'al ye li ka'anɛ manɛ niŋidi lii, ka lɛɛ anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ bɛɛ m ni la.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m nyɛt ka mugusʋg kaŋa bɛ. Li anɛ ye, m ya'a bɔɔd ye m niŋ dinɛ an sʋm, m kʋ nyaŋɛ. Asɛɛ linɛ an bɛ'ɛd ma'aa ka m na tun'e niŋ.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Wina'am wada la kɛt ka m sʋnf ma'ad.

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛt wada si'a linɛ tʋm m niŋgbina ni ka zabid nɛ wada linɛ ka m pʋtɛn'ɛr bɔɔd la, ka lɔɔm wʋʋ m anɛ sanrega nid ye m siak tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ kuli m niŋgbina la.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Oi, bɔ sʋnsa'aŋʋ nwa' ka m nyɛta! Anɔ'ɔnɛ na faanm ka m niŋgbina nwa' kʋ dɔllimi keŋ kuminɛ?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Wina'am gʋllim na faanm, ka li yiti ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni na. M pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka. M mi' ye li an sʋm ye m tʋm Wina'am bɔɔdim, amaa m niŋgbina bɔɔdim nyaŋim ka m tʋm linɛ ka' sʋ'ʋm.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Wina'am Siig Kasi onɛ tisidi ti vʋm ka li yit Yesu Kristo ni la na, sʋ'oe m, ka kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ kum pʋ lɛn sʋ'oe ma. Dinzugɔ, nannanna nimbanɛ an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo kʋ nyɛ kʋʋs bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Wina'am tʋm o mɛŋ Biig, ka o lieb ninsaal, ka nwɛnɛ ninsaalib banɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim, ka kpii ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug. Ka o kum pʋʋgin Wina'am kad tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd saria ka san'ami li paŋ linɛ tʋmmi ti ninsaal bɔɔdim ni la. Ti ninsaal bɔɔdim kɛt ka wada la ka' paŋ la zug, wada la kʋ nyaŋi san'am tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd paŋa.

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: Wina'am niŋi li ye, tinam banɛ bɛllim dɔl Wina'am Siig Kasi bɔɔdim ka ka' ti ninsaalib bɔɔdim la na siaki niŋ wada la nɔɔr yɛlʋg linɛ an sida la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ bɛllim dɔlli ba ninsaalib bɔɔdim la nɔki ba ya'am niŋ ninsaalib bɔɔdim ni. Ka nimbanɛ bɛllim dɔl nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi bɔɔdim la nɔki ba ya'am niŋ Siig Kasi la bɔɔdim ni.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a nɔki fʋ ya'am niŋ ninsaalib bɔɔdimin, li anɛ kum. Ka fʋ ya'a nɔki fʋ ya'am niŋ Siig Kasi la bɔɔdimin, li anɛ nyɔvʋr nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.

english_verse: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a nɔki fʋ ya'am niŋ ninsaalib bɔɔdimin, fʋ anɛ Wina'am dataa ka pʋ siakid Wina'am wada laa, ka sid kʋ nyaŋi siaki lii.

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ dɔlli ba ninsaalib bɔɔdim la kʋ nyaŋi ma'ae Wina'am sʋnfɔ.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Wina'am Siig Kasi sadigim bɛɛ ya san'an la, ya bɛllim pʋ dɔlli ya ninsaalib bɔɔdim, ka lɛɛ dɔl nɛ Siig Kasi la bɔɔdim. Onɛ pʋ mɔr Kristo Siig Kasi la, ka' Kristo nida.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Ka Kristo ya'a bɛɛ ya san'an, ya siis mɔr nyɔvʋr yanamɛ lieb pʋpielim dim Wina'am tuon la zug, hali nɛ ya niŋgbina na kpi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug la.

english_verse: Yet God raised Jesus to life! God's Spirit now lives in you, and he will raise you to life by his Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am onɛ vʋ'ʋg Yesu kumin la Siig Kasi ya'a bɛɛ ya san'an, on onɛ vʋ'ʋg Yesu Kristo kumin la mɛ na tisi ya ninsaalib niŋgbina nyɔvʋr paal, ka li yinɛ o Siig Kasi linɛ bɛɛ ya san'an la.

english_verse: My dear friends, we must not live to satisfy our desires.
translation_verse: Aa tɔ, m ba'abiisɛ, ti di Wina'am sam, ka pʋ di ninsaalib bɔɔdim sam ye ti bɛllim dɔlli lii.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a dɔl ninsaalib bɔɔdim ya na kpi. Ka ya ya'a kʋʋ ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd tʋʋma ka basi li nɛ Siig Kasi paŋ, ya na vʋe.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ dɔlisid Wina'am Siig Kasi la anɛ Wina'am biis.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Siig Kasi kanɛ ka Wina'am tisi ya pʋ kɛ ka ya an yammis ka zɔt dabiem, ka lɛɛ kɛ ka ya an Wina'am biis ka buon Wina'am ye, “Ti Ba'.”

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Wina'am Siig Kasi mɛŋ kɛ ka ti mɛŋ siis mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye ti anɛ Wina'am biis.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Tinamɛ sadigim aan o biis la, ti na di'e yɛlsʋm banɛ ka o digil ye o tis o nidib la, ka mɛ na di'e li nɛ Kristo. Tinamɛ sadigim namis nɛ Kristo la, ti mɛ na di'e na'asi nɛ o arezana ni. Na'asi linɛ na ti bɛ la yɛla

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: M mi' ye namisʋg linɛ ka ti nyɛt nannanna la anɛ bi'ela, ka ti kʋ nyaŋi maki li nɛ na'asi linɛ na ti nie ka ti nyɛ laa.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Bʋmbanɛ ka Wina'am maal dunia nwa' wʋsa gur nɛ nimmua bɔɔd saŋa kanɛ ka Wina'am na kɛ ka o biis la nie na.

english_verse: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.
translation_verse: ye daar kenna ka Wina'am na faaɛn dunia wʋsa ka li kʋ ba'as yɔrii, ka na tis o biis yɔlisim linɛ mɔr girima.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye saŋkan sa ti paae zina, dunia wʋsa ʋʋnsidi nɛ tɔɔg nwɛnɛ pu'a ɛɛnti sa'ae bɔɔd du'am si'em la.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Ka li ka' dunia la ma'aanɛ, ka mɛ anɛ tinam banɛ mɔr Wina'am Siig Kasi linɛ aan o piini yiiga la. Tinam mɛ ʋʋnsidnɛ ti sʋnya ni, gur saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am na nie pa'al paalʋ ni ye ti aan o biis, ka kɛ ka ti niŋgbina nyɛ yɔlisim.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Ti'ir kaŋa ni ka ti nyɛ faangir. Amaa ti ya'a nyɛ linɛ ka ti mɔr ti'iri li yɛla, lin ka' ti'ir ya'asɛ. Anɔ'ɔn mɔr ti'ir nɛ linɛ ka o pʋn nyɛ?

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Ka ti ya'a mɔr ti'ir nɛ linɛ ka ti pʋ nyɛɛ, ti mɔdigidnɛ ka guri li.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn, Wina'am Siig Kasi la kena ye o sʋŋi ti, ti tadimisin. Ti zi' lin nar ye ti sɔs Wina'am si'em amaa Wina'am Siig Kasi mɛŋ sɔsid Wina'am tisidi ti ka kɛ ka ti ʋʋnsid ka sɔsidi ti sʋnya ni ka zi' tinamɛ yɛt si'ela.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am onɛ mi' ninsaalib sʋnya la mi' Siig Kasi la pʋtɛn'ɛr, on sɔsid Wina'am tisid o nidib ka li dɔl nɛ Wina'am bɔɔdim la zug.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye si'el mɛkama ya'a ti niŋ, Wina'am tʋmmi li ni ka maan sʋ'ʋm tisid nimbanɛ nɔŋ o ka o gaŋi ba nɛ o mɛŋ bɔɔdim la.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: O da gaŋ ninsieba ka ba na aan o nidib ka dunia nam pʋ maalɛ ka o da gban'e ye o na kɛ ka ba nwɛnɛ o Biig nɛ, ka li kɛ ka o Biig la na an kpɛɛm o pitib bɛdegʋ san'an.

english_verse: God then accepted the people he had already decided to choose, and he has shared his glory with them. God's Love
translation_verse: Ka buol nimbanɛ ka o da gban'e ye o na kɛ ka ba nwɛnɛ o Biig la o san'an, ka kɛ ka ba an pʋpielim dim o tuon, ka mɛ tisi ba girima. Wina'am nɔŋir la yɛla

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, bɔ ka ti na yɛlɛ? Wina'am ya'a bɛ nɛ ti, anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi niŋi ti si'ela?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am ya'a pʋ kɛ ka o mɛŋ Biig la pɔns kum, ka zaŋ o ka o kpii ti wʋsa zugɔ, o mɛ kʋ tisi ti si'el wʋsa zaalim bɛɛ?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi pian' nimbanɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ la yɛla bɛ'ɛdɛ? Li anɛ Wina'am mɛŋi kʋʋs ye ba mɔr bʋʋd.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi kadi ba saria ka kʋʋsi ba yɛla bɛ'ɛdɛ? Li ka' Yesu Kristo onɛ da kpi ka vʋ'ʋg kumin ka zin' Wina'am datiuŋ, ka nwɛ'ɛd nu'ugʋ ti yɛla la na kʋʋsi ti yɛla bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Bɔɔ na nyaŋi baki ti Kristo nɔŋilimi nɛ? Daamʋg bɛɛ yɛlpakir bɛɛ namisʋg bɛɛ kɔ'ɔm bɛɛ nɔŋ bɛɛ yɛltɔɔg bɛɛ kum na nyaŋi baki ti? Ayei.

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Li niŋnɛ wʋʋ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em ye, “Fʋn zug, ka ba kʋʋdi ti saŋa wʋsa. Ka maannɛ ti nwɛnɛ pɛ'ɛs ka ba ye ba kɔdig nɛ.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Ayei, ti anɛ nyaŋir dim yɛlbama wʋsa ni ka li yinɛ Kristo onɛ nɔŋi ti la ni.

english_verse: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future,
translation_verse: M mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye si'el kae na nyaŋi baki ti Kristo nɔŋir nii. Kum bɛɛ nyɔvʋr bɛɛ maliaknam bɛɛ si'elnam linɛ sʋ'oe nidib bɛɛ si'elnam linɛ mɔr paŋ bɛɛ linɛ niŋid nannanna bɛɛ linɛ na ti niŋ kʋ nyaŋi baki tii.

english_verse: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!
translation_verse: Hali si'elnam linɛ bɛɛ agɔl bɛɛ teŋin bɛɛ si'el mɛkama linɛ bɛ dunia nwa' wʋsa kʋdim kʋ nyaŋi baki ti Wina'am nɔŋilim linɛ yiti ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni la.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Asida mɛnɛ, m pʋ ma'ada; man anɛ Kristo nid. Wina'am Siig Kasi onɛ bɛɛ m ni la dit kasɛti m pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye m pʋ ma'ada.

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.
translation_verse: M mɔri sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ fabʋlʋg linɛ ka' makiri m sʋʋnrin.

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: Man naan siakin ye Wina'am lɛɛ pɔɔn nɔɔri tisin mam ka bakim Kristo ni m ba'abiis banɛ aan m buudi la yɛla.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Banɛ an buudkanɛ ka Wina'am da gaŋ la. O da kɛ ka ba aan o biis ka nyɛɛ o na'am paŋ. Ka o naal nɔɔr nɛ ba ka tisi baa o wada la nɛ o suor ye ba dɔlli li ka zun'e o. Ka ba di'e o kaanbʋg la,

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: ka an Abraham nɛ Isaak nɛ Jakob yaas. Ka Kristo onɛ daa lieb ninsaal la anɛ ba buudi. Wina'am onɛ sʋ'oe si'el wʋsa la, na nyɛ zʋn'or linɛ ka' naarɛ. Ami.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Lina pʋ pa'al ye, Wina'am pʋ dɔl on yɛt si'el laa. Li ka' Israel dim wʋsa an nimbanɛ ka Wina'am gaŋɛ.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: Dinzug, bibanɛ ka Abraham du'a wʋʋ ninsaalibi ɛɛnti du'a biis si'em la ka' Wina'am biisɛ. Ka banɛ ka ba du'a ka li yinɛ Wina'am kaanbʋg la ni nwɛnɛ Isaak la, banɛ sid an Abraham yaas nɛ Wina'am biis.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Wina'am da kaanbi yɛl ye, “Saŋkanɛ ka m na lɛb na la, Sara na du'a biribiŋ.”

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Li ka' lin ma'aanɛ, ti yaapu'a Rebɛka da du'anɛ liiba ka ba saam aan ti yaab Isaak.

english_verse: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.
translation_verse: Ka saŋkanɛ ka ba da nam pʋ du'a ba la, ban da nam pʋ niŋ si'el ka li an sʋm bɛɛ bɛ'ɛd la, ka Wina'am da yɛl ye, “Kpɛɛm la na lieb o pitʋ la tʋmtʋm.” Ka yɛl ala ye o bɔɔdim la na keŋ tuon. Alazug, Wina'am gaŋir daa yinɛ o bɔɔdimin na, ka ka' ye ba niŋnɛ si'el ka li nar ye ba aan o nidiba.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye Wina'am yɛl ye, “M da nɔŋ Jakob ka kis Esau.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Wina'am da yɛl Moses ye, “Man na zɔ nimbanɛ ka m gban'e ye m zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig, ka zʋ'ʋs nimbanɛ ka m gban'e ye m zʋ'ʋsi ba.”

english_verse: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.
translation_verse: Ka li pʋ dɔl ninsaalib bɔɔdim bɛɛ on niŋ si'em zugɔ, ka lɛɛ dɔlnɛ Wina'am nimbaanlzɔɔr.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Li da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, Wina'am yɛl Egipt na'ab Faaro ye, “M kɛ ka fʋ an na'ab ye m pa'alim paŋi zem si'em, ka li kɛ ka m yʋ'ʋr tiig dunia wʋsa.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Wina'am bɔɔd ye o zɔ sɔ' nimbaanlig la, on ka o zɔt o nimbaanlig ka on bɔɔd ye sɔ' an zukpi'euŋ sɔb la, o mɛ kɛt ka o aan ala. Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn nɛ o nimbaanlzɔɔr la yɛla

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Aa tɔ. Ya yinne na bu'osim ye, “Li ya'a an wala, bɔ ka Wina'am nyɛt nidib taalɛ? Anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi zan'as Wina'am bɔɔdim?”

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: M zua, fʋ aan anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi lɛbis Wina'am pian'adɛ? Dʋk kʋ bu'os onɛ ya'ab o la ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ ya'ab man wala?”

english_verse: Doesn't a potter have the right to make a fancy bowl and a plain bowl out of the same lump of clay?”
translation_verse: Onɛ ya'abid la mɔr suor ka o na nɔk ya'agbilli ya'ab on bɔɔd si'el ka mɛ mɔr suori na ya'ab dʋk kanɛ ligidi zu'oe nɛ onɛ ligidi pʋ zu'oe nɛ ya'agbil yinne.

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka Wina'am da tʋm. O da bɔɔd ye o pa'al o sʋnpɛɛn ka kɛ ka nidib wʋsa baŋ o paŋ. Dinzugɔ o da gban'e o mɛŋ ka mɔdig nɛ banɛ ka o sʋnpɛɛn na luu ba zug ka nar ye o san'ami ba la.

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: O daa lɛm bɔɔd ye o nie o girima linɛ galis la pɛsig tinam banɛ ka o zɔɔ ti nimbaanlig ka da pʋn ti'ebi ti ye ti di'e o girima la.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ Hosea da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, Wina'am yɛl ye, “Nimbanɛ da ka' m nidib la, m na nɔki ba ka ba aan m nidib. Ka buudkanɛ ka m pʋ nɔŋ la, m na gaŋi ba ka ba lieb buudkanɛ ka m nɔŋ.”

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: “Ka zin'ikanɛ ka ba yɛli ba ye, ‘Ya ka' m nidib la,’ ba na buoli ba anina ye, ‘Wina'am onɛ vʋe la biis.’”

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Wina'am nɔdi'es Azaya da yɛl paalʋ ni Israel dim yɛla ye, “La'an nɛ Israel dimi zu'oe wʋʋ titanbin'isʋg linɛ dig atɛuk nɔɔrin la, ba bi'ela ma'aa na nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ Azaya mɛ da dɛŋi yɛl si'em la ye, “Ya'a ka' Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la bas yaasi tisi ti la zugɔ, ti teŋ la wʋsa naan nwɛnɛ Sodom teŋ nɛ, ti naan nwɛnɛ Gomora dim nɛ.” Israel dim nɛ labasʋŋ la yɛla

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Aa tɔ. Bɔ ka ti na yɛlɛ? Buudbanɛ ka' Jew dim la da pʋ mɔɔd ye ba an pʋpielim dim Wina'am tuonnɛ, ka Wina'am lɛɛ kɛ ka ba an pʋpielim dim o tuon ka li anɛ ban niŋ o yadda la zug.

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: Bɔ ka ba pʋ nyɛɛ li? Li anɛ ban daa pʋ bɔɔdi li nɛ yadda, ka tɛn'ɛs ye ba na di'e li nɛ ba tʋʋma zug la. Ba tu'ug kugiri lu, kugkanɛ ka ba sɔbi li yɛla Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye,

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Wina'am yɛl ye, “Gɔsima, m digil kugir Zion Zuor zug. Kugkanɛ na kɛ ka nidib tu'usid, ka an tampinkanɛ na kɛ ka ba lu. Ka onɛ niŋ o yadda la, kʋ di nyan o zugɔ.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m bɔɔd nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa ka sɔsid Wina'am ye m mɛŋ buudi nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Ba zi' suokanɛ ka Wina'am kɛt ka nidib an pʋpielim dim o tuonnɛ, ka bɔɔdi ba mɛŋ suoya, ka linzug ba pʋ nɔki ba mɛŋi lɔ nɛ Wina'am suorɛ.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Kristo da kena kɛ ka wada la naae, ka Wina'am kɛ ka on mɛkama niŋ o yadda an pʋpielim daan o tuon. Buudi wʋsaa na tun'e nyɛ faangir la yɛla

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Moses da sɔb pʋpielim linɛ yi wada dɔllim ni la yɛla ye, “Onɛ siak wada nɔɔr yɛlʋg la na nyɛ nyɔvʋri li dɔllim pʋʋgin.”

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Ka ba da sɔb pʋpielim linɛ yi yadda niŋir Wina'am ni la yɛla ye, “Da yɛli fʋ mɛŋ ye, ‘Anɔ'ɔnɛ na dʋ arezana ni?’”

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ da yɛli fʋ mɛŋ ye, anɔ'ɔnɛ na sig kpi'imnam teŋinɛ?

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Ka li mɛ sɔb ye, Wina'am pian'ʋk la kpi'enif ka bɛɛ fʋ nɔɔrin nɛ fʋ sʋnfʋn. Li anɛ Wina'am yadda niŋir labaar linɛ ka ti mɔɔn la.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a yɛl nɛ fʋ nɔɔr paalʋ ni ye Yesu anɛ Zugsɔb la, ka siaki fʋ sʋnfʋn ye Wina'am da vʋ'ʋg o kumin, fʋ na nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.
translation_verse: Ti siaki ti sʋnfʋn ye Yesu anɛ Zugsɔb la, linzug ka ti lieb pʋpielim dim Wina'am tuon, ka yɛli li nɛ ti nɔɔr, ka linzug ka ti nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Li sɔbnɛ Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Onɛ mɛkama niŋ Kristo yadda la, kʋ di nyannɛ.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Gaŋir kae Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim la nii. Zugsɔb la anɛ Jew dim Zugsɔb, ka mɛ an banɛ ka' Jew dim la Zugsɔb, ka niŋid banɛ wʋsa sɔsid sʋŋir la zug bareka.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Onɛ wʋsa buol Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr, o na nyɛ faangir.”

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Nidib ya'a pʋ niŋ o yaddaa, ba na niŋ wala sɔs sʋŋir o san'anɛ? Ka ba ya'a pʋ wʋm labaar o yɛlaa, ba na niŋ wala niŋ o yadda? Sɔ' ya'a kae na mɔɔn labaar la, nidib na niŋ wala wʋmi li?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Ka wala ka nidib na tun'e mɔɔl labasʋŋ la, ka ya'a ka' ba tʋmi ba nɛ? Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Banɛ mɔɔn labasʋŋ la ken malisi ti sʋnf pamm.”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Ka li ka' nidib wʋsa siak labasʋŋ laa. Azaya da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Zugsɔba, anɔ'ɔn niŋi ti labaar la yadda.”

english_verse: No one can have faith without hearing the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir yitnɛ labaar la wʋmmʋg ni. Ka labaar la wʋmmʋg yit Kristo pian'ʋk la ni.

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Amaa m ye m bu'osi ya nɛ'ɛŋa ye, ya tɛn'ɛs ye nidib pʋ wʋm labaar laa? Sida ba wʋmya. “Ba tiig teŋ wʋsa, ka ba labaar paae dunia bɛn wʋsa.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: M na lɛm bu'osi ya ye, ya tɛn'ɛs ye, Israel dim pʋ gban'e Moses n sɔb si'el la gbin bɛɛ? Sida ba da gban'aya. Moses da dɛŋin yɛl ye, Wina'am yɛl Israel dim ye, “M na kɛ ka ba mɔr fufum nɛ nimbanɛ ka' ba buudii, ka kɛ ka ba sʋnf duoe nɛ buudbanɛ an yalimnam ka pʋ gban'ad yɛla gbinnɛ.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Ka Azaya yɛl nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ ye, “Wina'am yɛl ye, ‘Nimbanɛ pʋ ieedim la nyɛɛm, ka m mɛ nie m mɛŋi pa'al banɛ pʋ bu'osidi m yɛla la.’”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Amaa zaŋi ken Israel dim la yɛla, o yɛl ye, “Daar wʋsa m tiɛn m nu'us ye m di'e nimbanɛ tʋba zian'as ka ba pʋ siakidi m nɔɔrɛ.”

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: M ye m bu'osi ya ye, ya tɛn'ɛs ye Wina'am bas o mɛŋ nidib nɛ bɛɛ? Ayei, baa bi'elaa. M mɛŋ anɛ Israel nid, ka an Abraham yaaŋ, ka an Benjamin dɔɔg nid, ka Wina'am pʋ basi ma.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Wina'am pʋ bas o nimbanɛ ka o dɛŋin gaŋ la. Ya mi' linɛ sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye Elaja da pɔ'ɔg Israel dim Wina'am tuon ye,

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: “Zugsɔba, ba kʋʋ fʋ nɔdi'esidib, ka san'ami fʋ maan zin'ig la, ka mam ma'aa kpɛlim, ka ba mɔɔd ye ba kʋ mam mɛn.”

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Aa, tɔ. Israel dim pʋ nyɛ ban bɔɔd si'ela. Li anɛ ba bi'ela banɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ la da nyɛɛ li. Ka banɛ kpɛlim la pʋ siak Wina'am ka lieb tʋbpʋwʋmnib.

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Li anɛ ala nannanna. Nidib bi'ela bɛ ka Wina'am gaŋi ba o pʋpielim zug.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: O gaŋir yinɛ o pʋpielim ni, ka ka' ba tʋʋma zugɔ. Wina'am gaŋir ya'a yiin nidib tʋʋma ni, o pʋpielim la kʋ aan sida pʋpielim.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Hali ti paae zina, Wina'am kɛ ka ba ya'am an yɔɔg-yɔɔg, ka ba nini pʋ nyɛta, ka ba tʋba pʋ wʋmma.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: Ka David daa yɛl ye, “Wina'am na kɛ ka ba mɛŋ-mɛŋ diib lieb bɛndigʋ tisi ba ka ba na li ka nyɛ namisʋg.

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ba nini zu'om ka ba kʋ nyɛta, ka kɛ ka ba tadigi ku'usid teŋin saŋa wʋsa.”
