english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m bu'osi ya ye, ya tɛn'ɛs ye Israel dimi da yidig la, lin pa'al ye ba da ba'asnɛ yɔri bɛɛ? Ayei, baa bi'elaa. Ban yidig ka tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zugʋ kɛ ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la nyɛ faangir. Wina'am niŋ ala ye Israel dim na mɔr fufum nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim la.

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Nannanna nwa', m pian'adnɛ tisid yanam banɛ ka' Jew dim la. Ye Wina'am sadigim kɛ ka m an Kristo Tʋmtʋm ka tʋm yanam banɛ ka' Jew dim san'an la, m na'asid tʋʋm kanɛ ka Wina'am tisim la

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: ye li kɛ ka m mɛŋ buudi mɔr fufum nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim la. Ka ala ka m na faanm mɛŋ buudi sieba.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, Wina'am da zan'as ye Jew dim lɛn ka' o nidib la zugʋ da kɛ ka o naal nɛ dunia dim. Ka o ya'a lɛn di'e ba, li yʋ'ʋn na an wala? Li na nwɛnɛ kpi'imi lɛn vʋ'ʋg kumin na.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a nɔk bodobodo kanɛ ka fʋ gbin'e yiiga la tis Wina'am, linɛ kpɛlim la mɛ anɛ o din. Ka tiig nya'a ya'a an Wina'am din, tiig la wila mɛ anɛ o din.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Jew dim la nwɛnɛ Olif tiig linɛ bɛ yin nɛ. Ka Wina'am kɔ'ɔg tikaŋa wila sieba, ka nɔk mɔɔgin Olif tiig willi tɔ'ɔŋ yin tiig la, ka li lieb yinne. Yanam banɛ ka' Jew dim la nwɛnɛ mɔɔgin Olif tiig wil la, ka ya di'ed Wina'am yɛlsʋm linɛ yi Jew dim san'an na nwɛnɛ mɔɔgin Olif tiig wil la di'ed sʋ'ʋm linɛ yi yin olif tiig la ni na la.

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, da nwɛ'ɛdi nyɔ'ɔg ka nɛ'ɛs banɛ ka Wina'am kɔ'ɔgi ba bas nwɛnɛ yin tiig wila la. Da mɔr tita'alim; ka fʋ anɛ wil ma'aa. Nya'a maannif sʋ'ʋm, ka ka' fʋʋ maan nya'a sʋ'ʋm.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Fʋ na lɛbis ye, “Sida, Wina'am da kɔ' wila la bas la zugʋ kɛ ka paalʋ bɛɛ tis mam.”

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Li anɛ sida. Ban pʋ niŋ Wina'am yadda la zug ka o kɔ'ɔgi ba. Ka fʋn niŋ o yadda la zug ka fʋ kpɛn tɔ'ɔŋ nɛ o. Dinzugɔ, da mɔr tita'alim, amaa zɔm dabiem.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Gɔsim Wina'am nimbaanlzɔɔr nɛ o nimmua sariakadib la an si'em. O da kad banɛ lu la saria nɛ nimmua, amaa fʋn kanɛ kpɛn niŋ o yadda la, o na kpɛn zɔti fʋ nimbaanlig. Li ya'a ka' walaa, o mɛ na kɔ'ɔgi fʋ bas.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Ka Jew dim ya'a tiak ka lɛn niŋ Wina'am yadda, o na kɛ ka ba mɛ lɛn tɔ'ɔŋ nɛ yin tiig la; ka Wina'am na nyaŋi niŋ ala.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Wina'am ya'a daa nwaae fʋn onɛ an mɔɔgin olif tiig la wil la tug pɔɔgin olif tiig la, baŋim ye li kʋ tɔi nɛ on Wina'am na zaŋ pɔɔgin olif tiig la willi lɛn lɛbisi tugi li mɛŋ-mɛŋ olif tiig la ya'asɛ. Wina'am n zɔt nidib nimbaanlig si'em la yɛla

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m bɔɔd ye ya baŋ yɛlsu'adir kanɛ ka ya nan zi' wʋm. Ala ka ya kʋ tɛn'ɛs ye ya anɛ ya'am dim hali. Li anɛ ye Israel dim zukpi'euŋ la mɔri bɛn. Li na aan ala ti paae saŋkan ka banɛ ka' Jew dim wʋsa ka Wina'am gaŋ la kpɛn' Wina'am sʋ'ʋlimin.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Ka ala ka Israel dim wʋsa na nyɛ faangir. Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Faangid la na yi Zion zuorini kena, ka na yis Jakob yaas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Ka nɛ'ɛŋa na aan m nɔnaar nɛ ba, m ya'a yisi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas la.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Jew dim la da zan'as labasʋŋ la zug, ka ba lieb Wina'am dataas, ka li anɛ yanam banɛ ka' Jew dim la sʋ'ʋm nyɛɛb la zug. Wina'am n gaŋ Jew dim buudi nɛ ba yaanam la zug ka ba mɛ an nimbanɛ ka o nɔŋ.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Wina'am pʋ gaŋid nidib ka tisidi ba o piini ka lɛn tiakid o ya'am.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ yanam banɛ ka' Jew dimi da zan'as Wina'am, ka o yʋ'ʋn zɔɔ ya nimbaanlig ka li anɛ Jew dim la zan'as o la zug,

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: ala mɛn ka Jew dim la zan'as Wina'am nannanna ka li kɛ ka ba paam nimbaanlzɔɔr nwɛnɛ yanamɛ paam si'em la.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Nidib wʋsa zan'as Wina'am, ka Wina'am kɛ ka li lɔɔ ba wʋʋ ba bɛ nɛ sanrega ni, ye o na zɔ nidib wʋsa nimbaanlig.

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Wina'am yɛlsʋm nɛ o ya'am nɛ mi'ilim galis nɛ pamm! Anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi baŋ o pʋtɛn'ɛr bɛɛ baŋ o suoya?

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn la ye, “Sɔ' kae mi' Zugsɔb pʋtɛn'ɛrɛ, bɛɛ na nyaŋi sa'al oo,

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: bɛɛ na tis o si'el ye o ti lɛbisi yɔɔ.”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Wina'am maal si'el wʋsa. Ka on zug ka si'el wʋsa kpɛm bɛ ye li tis o na'asi. Wina'am na nyɛ na'asi ka li ka' naarɛ. Ami.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m ba'abiisɛ, Wina'am zɔɔ ti nimbaanlig ka li yʋ'ʋn zu'oe la zug, ka m san'anɛ ya ye ya nɔki ya mɛŋ, ka kɛ ka li an maan linɛ vʋe tis Wina'am an sʋm nyain ka ma'ae Wina'am sʋnf. Nɛ'ɛŋa an sida zun'ori tis Wina'am.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Da tu'asidi linɛ wʋsa ka dunia dim niŋid laa. Kɛlli ka Wina'am tisi ya ya'am paal, ka li na tiaki ya bɛllim. Ka ya na nyaŋi baŋ Wina'am bɔɔdim, bʋn linɛ an sʋm nɛ linɛ ma'ad Wina'am sʋnf.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Wina'am pʋpielim piinkanɛ ka o tisim la zug, ka m yɛti ya wʋsa ye ya da ʋki ya mɛŋi gaad yanamɛ an si'em laa, ka lɛɛ tɛn'ɛs nɛ sida ye ya anɛ yanamɛ kpɛn an si'em la, ka li dɔlnɛ yadda niŋir linɛ ka Wina'am tisi ya la.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ ti saalibi mɔr niŋgbiŋ yinne, ka li mɔr luos bɛdegʋ, ka luos wʋsa mɔri ba tʋʋma gʋn-gʋn,

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: ala mɛn, ti anɛ yinne nɛ Kristo ka nwɛnɛ niŋgbiŋ yinne nɛ, la'an nɛ tinamɛ an bɛdegʋ la. Ka ti wʋsa tɔ'ɔŋ taaba wʋʋ niŋgbiŋ yinne luosi tɔ'ɔŋ taaba si'em la.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Ti di'ed piini kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb, ka li yinɛ Wina'am pʋpielim ni. Dinzugɔ, ti nɔkim piini la sʋŋ taaba. Onɛ piini an nɔdi'esʋg, on di'em Wina'am nɔɔr pian'adi tis nidib ka li dɔlnɛ ti yadda niŋiri zem si'em.

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: Onɛ piini an ye o sʋŋ nidib, on sʋŋim,,, bɛɛ onɛ piini an ye o pa'al nidib Wina'am yɛla, on pa'alim.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Ka onɛ piini an ye o kpɛmis nidib, on kpɛmisimi ba sʋnya. Onɛ piini an tisib, on tisim nɛ o sʋnf wʋsa. Ka onɛ piini an ye o an tuongat, on tʋmmi li sʋ'ʋŋa. Ka onɛ piini an nimbaanlzɔɔr, on maalimi li nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ya nɔŋir an sida nɔŋir, ka kisi bʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka gban'e linɛ an sʋm nɛ ya nu'us ayi'.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Ka nɔŋ taaba sʋ'ʋŋa yanamɛ an ba'abiis nɛ taaba Kristo san'an la, ka ti'e ye ya tis taaba na'asi,

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: ka tʋm bɛdegʋ tis Wina'am ka da zɔti gbanya'am, ka pɛsigi ya mɛŋi tʋm Wina'am tʋʋma nɛ nimmua.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Ka ya ti'ir kɛ ka ya mɔr sumalisim, ka mɔdigi ya yɛltɔɔd pʋʋgin, ka pʋ'ʋsi Wina'am saŋa wʋsa,

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: ka sʋŋ Wina'am nimbanɛ bɔɔd sʋŋir, ka di'e saamme ya yaan.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Sɔsim Wina'am ye o tis banɛ namisidi ya la albareka. Sida, sɔsim o ka o tisi ba albareka, ka da tisi ba nɔpɔɔrɛ.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Maalim sumalisim nɛ banɛ mɔr sumalisim. Ka mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ banɛ mɛ mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Mɔri pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne nɛ taaba, ka da mɔri tita'alim, ka lɛɛ siaki la'as nɛ tadimnam. Ka da tɛn'ɛs ye ya nini nienɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Da lɛbis bɛ'ɛd nɛ bɛ'ɛdɛ. Kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya mɛŋi tʋm linɛ ka nidib wʋsa gɔs ka li an sʋm.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Li ya'a na nyaŋ, yanam mɔɔmi ka bɛ nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ nidib wʋsa.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: M ba'abinɔŋa, kʋdim da lɛbis bɛ'ɛd nɛ bɛ'ɛdɛ, ka lɛɛ kɛ ka Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn niŋi li. Bɔzugɔ, li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Manɛ na yɔ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sam.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Niŋimi wʋʋ lin sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Fʋ dataa kɔ'ɔm ya'a zabid, fʋn tisim o diib ka o di, ka ku'onuud ya'a mɔr o, fʋn tisim o ku'om ka o nu; ka fʋ ya'a niŋ ala, li nwɛnɛ fʋn na vaae bugumsaana linɛ diti pa'al o sɔb zug.”

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sʋ'ʋgi yaa, ka lɛɛ nɔki tʋʋm sʋma nyaŋi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Nid wʋsa siakim nimbanɛ sʋ'oe teŋ la nɔɔr. Bɔzugɔ sɔ' pʋ mɔr paŋa, asɛɛ linɛ yi Wina'am san'an na. Li anɛ Wina'am kɛ ka nimbanɛ sʋ'oe teŋ la mɔr paŋ.

english_verse: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.
translation_verse: Ka on mɛkama zan'as nimbanɛ sʋ'oe teŋ la nɔɔr, o zan'asnɛ linɛ ka Wina'am zi'el la. Ka onɛ wʋsa niŋid ala, ieednɛ tʋbtɛɛgiri tisid o mɛŋ.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛdi zɔt paŋ dim, ka ka' nimbanɛ tʋm sʋ'ʋm laa. Ya ya'a pʋ bɔɔd ye ya zɔ nimbanɛ mɔr paŋ la, yanam tʋm linɛ nar, ka o pian' ya,

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ o anɛ Wina'am nidi ya sʋŋir zug. Ya ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛd yanam zɔm o; ka o sid mɔr paŋ kanɛ na tisi ya namisʋg. O anɛ Wina'am tʋmtʋm, ka di'ed Wina'am sʋnpɛɛnni namisid nimbanɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd la.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Alazug, li nar ye ya siak nimbanɛ mɔr paŋ la nɔɔr, ka ka'anɛ ye ya luak Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn ma'aanɛɛ, ka mɛ anɛ ye ya mi' ye linɛ an sʋm.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Ka li mɛ anɛ dinzug ka ya yɔɔd lampɔ la. Nimbanɛ tʋʋma an ye ba sʋ'oe nidib la tʋmnɛ Wina'am tʋʋma.

english_verse: Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands.
translation_verse: Da mɔri sɔ' sammɛ. Yanamɛ na mɔr sam si'a anɛ ye ya nɔŋ taaba. Onɛ mɛkama nɔŋ o tiraan siak Wina'am wada la wʋsa.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Wina'am nɔyɛlʋgʋ nwa', “Mid ka ya san'am pu'ab. Mid ka ya kʋ nid. Mid ka ya zu. Mid ka ya mɔr fufum” Nɔɔr yɛlʋg bama nɛ banɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa la'as nɛ bʋn yinne ni, ka linɛ an ye, “Nɔŋimi fʋ tiraan wʋʋ fʋn nɔŋi fʋ mɛŋ si'em la.”

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Onɛ nɔŋ o tiraan kʋ tʋm o bɛ'ɛdɛ. Dinzugɔ ya ya'a nɔŋ taaba, ya siak wada la wʋsa.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Li nar ye ya niŋ ala yanamɛ mi' saŋa la an si'em la zug. Saŋa paae ya ye ya duoe gbɛɛmin. Ti faangir saŋa yɔe, ka pʋ lal wʋʋ tinamɛ da nam pin'ili niŋ Yesu Kristo yadda si'em la.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ bɔɔd gaadʋg, ka bɛog bɔɔd nier. Dinzugɔ ti basim lik tʋʋma linɛ an bɛ'ɛd la, ka nɔk Wina'am zaba la'ad linɛ an tʋʋm sʋma la.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ti bɛllim an sʋ'ʋŋa nwɛnɛ nimbanɛ bɛ nɛɛsimin, ka ti da nu daam kʋʋl bɛɛ san'am pu'ab bɛɛ zabid nɛ nidib bɛɛ mɔr fufummɛ.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Dɔlli ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ka niŋidi wʋʋ on niŋid si'em la, ka bas ka da lɛn tɛn'ɛsid yanamɛ na niŋidi ya niŋgbiŋ bɔɔdim si'em la ya'asa.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Di'em ninkanɛ yadda pɔɔd, ka da nwa'asid nɛ o, o tɛn'ɛsʋg la yɛlaa.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Ninsɔ' yadda niŋir tun'e kɛ ka o di si'el wʋsa, ka onɛ yadda pɔɔd la kis ni'im.

english_verse: But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone.
translation_verse: Ka ninkanɛ dit si'el wʋsa la da nɛ'ɛs ninkanɛ kis ni'im laa. Ka onɛ kis ni'im da yɛl onɛ pʋ kis si'el la ye o niŋ linɛ ka' sʋ'ʋm; bɔzugɔ Wina'am di'e o.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Fʋ aan anɔ'ɔnɛ na kad sɔ' tʋmtʋm saria? O ya'a mɔr bʋʋd bɛɛ o ka' bʋʋdɛ, li anɛ o mɛŋ Zugsɔbi na yɛl o ye o di bʋʋd bɛɛ o luya. Ka o sid na di bʋʋd ka zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ, bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb la na tun'e kɛ ka o zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Nid yinne gɔs ka dabis-si'a an sʋm gaad dabis-sieba. Ka sɔ' gɔs ka dabisa wʋsa zem nɛ. Sɔ' wʋsa kɛl ka o pʋtɛn'ɛr an yinne.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɛkama gɔs ka dabis-si'a bɛɛ li kɔn', o sɔb niŋid ala ye o na'as Zugsɔb la. Ka onɛ dit si'el wʋsa ditnɛ tisid Zugsɔb la girima, on pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka diib la yɛla la zug. Ka onɛ mɛ kis disieba diib la, niŋid ala ye o mɛ na'as Zugsɔb la, ka mɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kae vʋe o mɛŋ yɛla, bɛɛ kpiid o mɛŋ bɔɔdim ma'aanɛɛ.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a vʋe, ti vʋnɛ tis Zugsɔb la. Ka ti ya'a kpi, ti kpinɛ tis Zugsɔb la. Aa tɔ, ti ya'a vʋe bɛɛ ti ya'a kpinɛ, ti anɛ Zugsɔb la nidib.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Kristo da kpi ka lɛn vʋ'ʋg kumin la ye o an banɛ kpi nɛ banɛ vʋe la Zugsɔb.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Ka fʋnɛ, bɔ ka fʋ kati fʋ ba'abiig saria? Bɛɛ bɔ yɛla ka fʋ nɛ'ɛsidi fʋ ba'abiiga? Ti wʋsa na zi'en Wina'am tuon ka o kadi ti saria.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Zugsɔb yɛl ye, ‘Hali nɛ man vʋe nwa', nidib wʋsa na igin man tuon, ka zilim wʋsa na tu'asi tis Wina'am.’”

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Aa tɔ, ti yinne-yinne na tu'as o mɛŋ yɛla wʋsa tis Wina'am.

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, kɛlli ka ti bas ka da kati ti ba'abitaaba saria, ka lɛɛ gban'e ka da nɔk si'eli niŋi ti ba'abiig suorin linɛ ta'asid o luuga.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Mam an yinne nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu la kɛ ka m baŋ sida ye diib kae an dian'adɛ. Amaa sɔ' ya'a tɛn'ɛs ye diib bɛɛ an dian'ad, li anɛ dian'adi o sɔb san'an.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Fʋ ba'abiig sʋnf ya'a san'am fʋn dit disi'a la zug, fʋ pʋ tʋm nɔŋilim tʋʋmaa. Da kɛ ka dikanɛ ka fʋ di la san'ami fʋ ba'abiig onɛ ka Kristo kpii o zug laa.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka linɛ ka fʋ gɔs ka li an sʋm la lieb bɛ'ɛd nidib pian'adinɛ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka' diib bɛɛ nuub yɛla pak Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim la nii. Linɛ pak lɛɛ anɛ pʋpielim nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm kanɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi tisid la.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Wina'am nini na tig banɛ wʋsa dɔl Kristo anwa, ka saalib mɛ na dii ba kasɛt sʋŋ.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ ti mɔɔmi ka ɛɛnti niŋ linɛ na mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm ka na sʋŋi ti ba'abitaaba.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka diib zug kɛ ka fʋ san'am linɛ ka Wina'am maal la. Diib wʋsa nari ba di, amaa li ka' sʋ'ʋm ka fʋ di linɛ na kɛ ka fʋ taaba lu tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdinɛ.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Linɛ an sʋm ye fʋ niŋ anɛ ye fʋ da di ni'im bɛɛ nu daam bɛɛ niŋ si'el linɛ na kɛ ka fʋ ba'abiig luu.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka fʋn niŋ yadda si'em zaŋi ken bʋmbama ni, kpɛlim fʋn nɛ Wina'am san'an ma'aa. Albareka bɛ nɛ ninkanɛ tʋm linɛ an sʋm, ka pʋ kʋʋs o mɛŋ bɛ'ɛd la zug.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Onɛ bi'esid si'el yɛla ka dii li la, tʋm taal; bɔzugɔ, o pʋ dii li nɛ yadda. Ka linɛ wʋsa pʋ dɔl nɛ yadda anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Li nar ka tinam banɛ yadda niŋir Yesu Kristo ni kpi'em la sʋŋ nimbanɛ ka ba yadda niŋir pɔɔd la, ka ala ka ba na nyɛ sʋnkpi'euŋʋ ba yadda niŋir ni. Ti da mɔɔd ye ti ma'ae ti mɛŋ sʋnfɔ.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Amaa kɛlli ka ti wʋsa niŋi dinɛ an sʋm ka ma'adi ti ba'abiig sʋnf, ka li na sʋŋ o ka o yadda niŋir kpi'em.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Ka Kristo da pʋ niŋ dinɛ ma'ad o mɛŋ sʋnfɔ, ka lɛɛ niŋ ka li dɔlnɛ lin sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Banɛ tʋ'ʋdif la tʋ'ʋdnɛ mam.”

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: M sɔsid Wina'am onɛ tisidi ti summɔdigir nɛ kpɛmisʋg la ye o na kɛ ka yanamɛ dɔl Yesu Kristo la kɛ ka ya mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne,

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: ka dinzug ka ya wʋsa na mɔr nɔɔr yinne zun'e Wina'am onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo Ba' la. Banɛ ka' Jew dim la zun'od Wina'am

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Gban'ami nɔɔr yinne nɛ taaba ka na'as Wina'am, wʋʋ Kristo da di'e yanam si'em la.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: M yɛli ya ye Kristo da lieb Jew dim la tʋmtʋm ye o pa'al ye Wina'am an sida sɔb, ka mɛ ye o kɛ ka Wina'am n da kaanbi ti yaanam yɛla la lieb sida,

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: ka mɛ ye banɛ ka' Jew dim la na zun'e Wina'am on zɔti ba nimbaanlig la zug. Li da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Alazugɔ, m na na'asif banɛ ka' Jew dim tuon; m na yʋʋm wɔ'ɔgi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Ka li lɛn sɔb ye, “Yanam banɛ ka' Jew dim la la'an nɛ Jew dim la, mɔri sumalisim.”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Ka lɛn sɔb ye, “Nimbanɛ ka' Jew dim la wʋsa, zun'omi Zugsɔb la. Buudi wʋsa, zun'omin o bɛdegʋ.”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am nɔdi'es Azaya mɛ sɔb ye, “Nya'ar kanɛ yi Jese gbinnin la na bul na ka Wina'am kɛ ka o sʋ'oe buudi wʋsa. Ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la na mɔr ti'ir o ni.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: M sɔs Wina'am onɛ tisidi ti ti'ir la, ye o na kɛ ka ya mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛdegʋ ya yadda niŋir Kristo ni la zug. Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi paŋ na kɛ ka ya ti'ir nɔbig bɛdegʋ. Linɛ kɛ ka Paul sɔb nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ la yɛla

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye ya anɛ banɛ an tʋʋm sʋma dim, ka mɔr mi'ilim sʋ'ʋŋa ka na nyaŋi pa'al taaba linɛ nar.

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Mam mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ ka dɛŋi sɔb yɛlsieba ye m tiɛn ya li yɛla, Wina'am tisim pʋpielim piini si'a ka m an Yesu Kristo Tʋmtʋm ye m tʋm o tʋʋma banɛ ka' Jew dimin la zug. M tʋm wʋʋ maanmaannibi ɛɛnti tisid Wina'am piini si'em la ka mɔɔn Wina'am labasʋŋ la ye banɛ ka' Jew dim la na an piini tis Wina'am linɛ na malis o, ka o Siig Kasi kɛ ka ba an sʋm nyain.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Mam an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo la kɛ ka m nyaŋidi nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ tʋʋm kanɛ ka m tʋmmi tisid Wina'am la.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: M kʋ pian' si'eli gaad Kristo zaŋimi kɛ ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la siak Wina'am ka li anɛ m pian'ad nɛ m tʋʋma

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: nɛ paŋ kanɛ kɛ ka m nyaŋidi tʋm nyalima tʋʋma nɛ Siig Kasi paŋ la. Alazug, din yi Jerusalem giligi keŋ paae Illirikum teŋin m mɔɔl Kristo labasʋŋ la zin'ibama wʋsa.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Ka ɛɛnti bɔɔd nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa ye m mɔɔl Kristo labasʋŋ zin'ibanɛ ka ba nam pʋ wʋm o yɛla la, ka ka' ye m dɔlis sɔ' nɔbaa, ka anɛ manɛ pin'ili li pa'alʋg.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Nimbanɛ ka ba pʋ yɛli ba o yɛla la, na baŋi li. Ka banɛ nam pʋ wʋm o yɛla la na gban'e li gbin.” Paul gban'e ye o keŋ kaae Room dim

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Lina giŋim saŋa bɛdegʋ ka m pʋ nyaŋi kɛɛn ya san'an naa.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Ka nannanna ka m yʋ'ʋn naae m tʋʋma tembama ni, ka mɛ da bɔɔd yʋma bɛdegʋ ye m kena kaae ya,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: ka linzug ka m mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye m na nyɛɛ ya, saŋkanɛ ka m ti gati ken Spain teŋin la, ka m na bɛ ya san'an saŋa bi'ela ka li na malisim, ka ya nyaan sʋŋim ka m gaad.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Masedonia nɛ Akaia tɛɛnsin, tɛn'ɛs ye li an sʋm ka nɔk piini tɔlim tis tadimnam banɛ an Wina'am nidib ka bɛ Jerusalem la.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ba mɛŋi tɛn'ɛs ye li an sʋm ka niŋ ala. Ka li mɛ nar ye ba sid niŋ ala. Jew dim la da kɛ ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la la'am di'e Wina'am albareka linɛ sʋŋidi ba siis. Ka linzug ka li an sʋm ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la sʋŋ Jew dim ka ba di'e albareka linɛ na sʋŋi ba niŋgbina.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: M ya'a tɔlis ligidkanɛ ka Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Masedonia nɛ Akaia la'as la wʋsa tis Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Jerusalem la naae, m na kena kaae ya ka nyaan gaadi keŋ Spain.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Ka m mi' ye m ya'a paae ya san'an na m na mɔr Kristo albareka bɛdegʋ na.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m bɛlimmi ya nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr nɛ Siig Kasi nɔŋilim zug ye, ya la'an nɛ mam mɔɔ sɔs Wina'am man yɛla.

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: Sɔsimi Wina'am ka o yisim banɛ ka' Wina'am nidiba ka bɛ Juda teŋin la nu'usin, ka tʋʋm kanɛ ka m ye m tʋm Jerusalem ni la malis Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛɛ anina la.

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, li ya'a an Wina'am bɔɔdim, m na kɛɛn ya san'an na nɛ sumalisim, ka nyɛ nimma'asim ya san'an.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ tisid sumbʋgʋsʋm na bɛ nɛ ya wʋsa. Ami.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: M pian'adi ti taʋn Foebe onɛ tʋm Wina'am tʋʋma Senkiria karindɔɔgin la.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Alazug, o ya'a ti kena yanam di'em o nwɛnɛ lin nar ye Wina'am nidib di'ed taaba si'em ti Zugsɔb yʋ'ʋr zug, ka sʋŋ o nɛ on bɔɔd si'el wʋsa nwɛnɛ on sʋŋid nidib bɛdegʋ si'em la; hali nɛ mam mɛŋ.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi Prisila nɛ Akuila, m tʋmtʋm taaba banɛ tʋm Yesu Kristo tʋʋma la.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: Ba da siak ye ba kpi man zug. M pʋ'ʋsidi ba pamm li zug, ka li ka' mam ma'aanɛɛ, amaa la'an nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim ka an Wina'am nidib la wʋsa mɛ pʋ'ʋsidi ba.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Ka pʋ'ʋs Wina'am nimbanɛ la'asidi ba yin la. Ka pʋ'ʋs m zua sʋŋ Epenetus onɛ bɛ Asia teŋin la. Onɛ daa dɛŋi siaki dɔl Yesu Kristo yiiga.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Ka pʋ'ʋs Mɛɛri onɛ da tʋm hali tisidi ya la.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Ka pʋ'ʋs Andronikus nɛ Junias banɛ aan m du'adib ka da la'am bɛ sanrega ni nɛ mam la. Kristo tʋmtʋmnib la mi' ba sʋ'ʋŋa; ka ba mɛ da dɛŋi dɔl Kristo man yiiga.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi m zua sʋŋ Ampliatus onɛ ka m nɔŋ Kristo zug la.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Ka pʋ'ʋs Urbanus, ti tʋmtʋm tiraan onɛ tʋm Kristo tʋʋma la, nɛ m zua sʋŋ Stakis.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Ka pʋ'ʋs Apelles onɛ ka nidib bɛdegʋ baŋ ye o dɔl Kristo nɛ sida la. Ka pʋ'ʋs Aristobulus yidim.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka pʋ'ʋsi m du'ad Herodion. Ka pʋ'ʋs Narkissus yidim banɛ niŋ Zugsɔb yadda la.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka pʋ'ʋs Trifaena nɛ Trifosa banɛ tʋm Zugsɔb tʋʋma la. Ka pʋ'ʋsi m zua sʋŋ Persis onɛ tʋm bɛdegʋ tisid Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Ka pʋ'ʋs Rufus onɛ ka nidib bɛdegʋ mi' o tʋʋma Kristo zug la, nɛ on daa nɔŋim wʋʋ o biig la.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Ka pʋ'ʋs Asinkritus nɛ Flegon nɛ Hermes nɛ Patrobas, nɛ Hermas nɛ m ba'abiis wʋsa banɛ bɛ nɛ ba la.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Ka pʋ'ʋs Filologus nɛ Julia nɛ Nereus nɛ o taʋn nɛ Olimpas nɛ Wina'am nidib wʋsa banɛ bɛ nɛ ba la.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi taaba nɛ nɔŋir. Kristo nidib wʋsa pʋ'ʋsidi ya. Sa'alʋg

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m sa'ali ya ye ya gu'us nɛ nimbanɛ mɔr wɛligiri kennɛ ya san'an na ka maan si'elnam linɛ lugid nidib la, ba zan'as ka pʋ dɔl pa'alʋg kanɛ ka ya di'e laa. Luakimini ya mɛŋ nɛ ba.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: Banɛ niŋid ala la pʋ tʋmmi ti Zugsɔb Kristo tʋʋmaa ka lɛɛ tʋm nɛ ba mɛŋ ya'amlɛog tʋʋma. Ba ma'ad nimbanɛ pʋtɛnda pʋ kpi'em la pian'ad nɛ nɔmalisiŋ.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ wʋm yanamɛ siak labasʋŋ la si'em la, ka linzug ka m mɔr sumalisim ya yɛla. Ka m bɔɔd ye ya mɔr ya'am nɛ linɛ an sʋm, ka da mɔri pʋtɛn'ɛr nɛ linɛ an bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Li kpɛlim bi'ela ka Wina'am onɛ tisidi ti sumbʋgʋsʋm na san'am Sʋntaana paŋ ka kɛ ka ya nyaŋ o. Ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yɛlsʋm na bɛ nɛ ya. Pʋ'ʋsʋg ya'as

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: M tʋmtʋm tiraan Timoti pʋ'ʋsidi ya. Ka m du'adib Lukius nɛ Jason nɛ Sosipata mɛ pʋ'ʋsidi ya.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Man Tertius, onɛ sɔbid linɛ ka Paul pian' gbauŋ kaŋa ni la, pʋ'ʋsidi ya ti Zugsɔb yʋ'ʋr zug.

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Zun'omi Wina'am onɛ kɛt ka ya mɔr paŋi ya yadda niŋir ni la. Ala ka labasʋŋ kanɛ ka m pa'ali ya, nɛ linɛ ka m mɔɔli tisi ya Yesu Kristo yɛla la, nɛ yɛlsu'adir linɛ yʋ'ʋn nie paalʋ ni la yɛli ti. Yɛlsu'adir la da su'aya ka li yʋma lal,

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: ka Wina'am nɔdi'esidib sɔb ka li yʋ'ʋn nie paalʋ. Ka Wina'am onɛ vʋe ka ka' naar la tis nɔɔr ka buudi wʋsa baŋi li, ye nidib bɛdegʋ siak Wina'am ka niŋ o yadda.

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ mɔr ya'am gaad sɔ' wʋsa la di'em na'asi saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr zug. Ami.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Man Paul onɛ ka Wina'am da buolim ka m an Yesu Kristo Tʋmtʋm la, nɛ ti ba'abiig Sostenes

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: n sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa nwa' tisid yanam banɛ an Wina'am nidibi bɛ karindɔɔg kanɛ bɛ Korint teŋin la; yanam banɛ ka o maali ya bɛ nyain ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ka buoli ya ye ya an kasi la, hali nɛ banɛ bɛ zin'is wʋsa ka buonnɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ye o anɛ ba Zugsɔb nɛ tinam Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na tisi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Bareka pʋ'ʋsim

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: M pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka saŋa wʋsa ya yɛla, o pʋpielim kanɛ ka ya di'e Yesu Kristo ni la zug.

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, yanamɛ gur saŋkanɛ ka ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na ti nie o mɛŋ na la, ya pʋ gʋ'ʋŋ piini yinne di'erɛ.

english_verse: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
translation_verse: Wina'am na guri ya ala sʋ'ʋŋa paae dunia naar bɛn. Ka ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo lɛbig daar na ka o kʋ nyɛ yɛlbɛ'ɛsi'a ya nii.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ buoli ya ka ya niŋ nɔɔr yinne nɛ ti Zugsɔb onɛ aan Biig Yesu Kristo la anɛ sida sɔb. Bakir Wina'am nidib sʋʋgin la yɛla

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m sɔsidi ya nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr zug ye ya wʋsa siakim taaba nɔɔr, ka bakir da bɛɛ ya sʋʋginɛ. Niŋimi nɔɔr yinne nɛ taaba ka mɔri pʋtɛn'ɛr nɛ gban'ar yinne.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, Kloe yidim sieba kena tu'asim nyain ye nɔŋgbannwa'ar bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin.

english_verse: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
translation_verse: Li anɛ anwa: sɔ' yɛt ye, “Man dɔlnɛ Paul,” ka sɔ' mɛ yɛt ye, “Man dɔlnɛ Apollos,” ka sɔ' mɛ yɛt ye, “Man dɔlnɛ Pita,” ka sɔ' mɛ yɛt ye, “Man dɔlnɛ Kristo.”

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Kristo wɛlig nɛ zin'is kɔn'ɔb kɔn'ɔbaa? Li da ka'anɛ Paul n da kpi dapuudir zugʋ tisi yaa, li da anɛ Kristo. Ba pʋ sʋʋ ya Wina'am ku'om ye ya an Paul nya'andɔliba, amaa ye ya dɔlnɛ Kristo.

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: M pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka ye m pʋ sʋʋ ya yinne Wina'am ku'om asɛɛ Krispus nɛ Gaius.

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi yɛl ye, ba da sʋʋ o Wina'am ku'om ka o an Paul nya'andɔl la.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Ɛɛn sida, m mɛ da sʋ Stefanas nɛ o yidim Wina'am ku'om. Amaa m pʋ lɛm baŋ man sʋ sɔ' ya'asɛ

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Kristo pʋ gaŋim ye m sʋ nidib Wina'am ku'om, amaa ye m mɔɔl Wina'am labasʋŋ la tis nidib, ka li ka'anɛ wʋʋ ninsaalib mi'ilim; bɔzugɔ li ya'a anɛ saalib mi'ilim pian'ad yɛla, alaa Kristo kum dapuudir zug la na lieb zaalim. Kristo kum pa'an Wina'am paŋ nɛ o ya'am si'em

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ bɔdig la nɔk Kristo kum dapuudir zug labaar la ka li anɛ yalimis. Ka tinam banɛ paam faangir la mi' ye li anɛ Wina'am paŋ.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Mam na san'am ya'am dim la ya'am, ka kɛ ka mi'ilim dim mi'ilim mɛlim.”

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ an ya'am daana? Anɔ'ɔnɛ an gbauŋmi'ida? Dunia nwa' nɔŋgbannwa'ar daan bɛ yaanɛ? Wina'am kɛ ka dunia kaŋa nwa' ya'am anɛ yalimis.

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Wina'am ya'am pʋʋgin ka o kɛ ka nidib kʋ baŋ o nɛ ba mɛŋ ya'am, ka lɛɛ gban'e ye o zaŋ yalimis labakanɛ ka ti mɔɔl la tilig banɛ niŋ o yadda la.

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: Jew dim bɔɔd ye bʋnnyalima maal ka ba niŋ o yadda, ka Girik dim bɔɔd ya'am.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Amaa tinam mɔɔnnɛ Kristo kum dapuudir zug la yɛla, labaar kanɛ ka Jew dim nɔk ka li an sisin, ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la nɔk ka li an yalimis.

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: Amaa Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim ka Wina'am gaŋ la, mi' ye Kristo kum labaar la anɛ Wina'am paŋ nɛ ya'am.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Bʋn linɛ ka Wina'am maal ka ninsaalib nɔki li ka li an yalimis la, mɔr ya'am gaad ninsaalib ya'am. Ka bʋn linɛ ka Wina'am niŋ, ka li kɛ ka ninsaalib tɛn'ɛs ye o ka' paŋ la mɔr paŋi gaad ninsaalib paŋ.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, tɛnri yanamɛ daa an si'em saŋkan ka Wina'am daa buoli ya la. Li ya'a anɛ dunia nwa' yɛla, ya pamm daa ka' banɛ mɔr ya'am bɛɛ paŋ bɛɛ an nintitada.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Wina'am gaŋ dinɛ ka dunia dim tɛn'ɛs ka li an yalimis ye o diis ya'am dim nyan ka mɛ gaŋ linɛ ka dunia dim tɛn'ɛs ka li ka' paŋ la, ye o diis paŋ dim nyan,

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: ka gaŋ dinɛ ka dunia dim pʋ gɔsi lii, nɛ dinɛ ka ba nɛ'ɛs, nɛ dinɛ ka ba tɛn'ɛs ka li an zaalim la, ye o san'am dinɛ ka dunia dim tɛn'ɛs ka li an nimmua bʋn la.

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: O niŋ nɛ'ɛŋa ye nid kʋ nyaŋi dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ Wina'am tuonnɛ.

english_verse: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am kɛya ka ya an nɔɔr yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo, ka on zug ka ti mɔr ya'am, ka an pʋpielim dim Wina'am tuon, ka lieb o nidib, ka yi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sʋ'ʋlim ni.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: Alazug ka li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Onɛ bɔɔd ye o nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg, on nwɛ'ɛm nyɔ'ɔg nɛ linɛ ka Zugsɔb la tʋm la.”

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, man daa kɛɛn ya san'an na la, m daa pʋ mɔɔl Wina'am labaar la tisi ya nɛ nɔmi'ilim nɛ ninsaalib ya'am,

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: ka daa gban'e ye m kʋ mɔɔl si'el yɛla asɛɛ Yesu Kristo yɛla gʋllim, nɛ on kpi dapuudir zug la.

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: Man daa bɛɛ ya san'an la, m daa ka' paŋa, ka dabiem nɛ kikirʋg daa mɔrim.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: M daa pʋ tu'as labaar la nɛ mi'ilim pian'ad linɛ malis nidib ka li kɛ ka ba siaki lii, ka lɛɛ daa tu'asi li nɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi pa'al o paŋ,

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: ye ya yadda niŋir Yesu Kristo ni pʋ yi ninsaalib ya'amin naa, ka lɛɛ yinɛ Wina'am paŋin na. Wina'am ya'am an si'em la yɛla

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Ka la'an nɛ lin an sida la, ti mɛ pian'ad nɛ ya'am tisid banɛ mi' Wina'am sʋ'ʋŋa. Li ka' dunia nwa' nidib ya'am bɛɛ banɛ sʋ'oe dunia nwa' ya'am. Nimbama nwa' paŋ na lieb zaalim.

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: Amaa ya'am kanɛ ka mam mɔri tu'asid nwa' anɛ Wina'am ya'am linɛ daa su'a ka nidib pʋ baŋi lii. Li anɛ bʋnkanɛ ka o da pʋn gaŋ hali ka nam pʋ maal dunia la, ye ti kpɛn' Wina'am na'am la ni.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Banɛ sʋ'oe dunia kaŋa nwa' sɔ' pʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ. Ba ya'a daa mi'inɛ li, ba naan kʋ kpa'an Zugsɔb onɛ an na'atita'ar la dapuudir zugɔ.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Ka li dɔlnɛ lin sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Linɛ ka tʋbir nam pʋ wʋm, ka nif mɛ nam pʋ nyɛ la, linɛ ka nid nam pʋ tɛn'ɛs ye li na maal la, lin ka Wina'am maali ti'ebi gur banɛ nɔŋ o la.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am kɛ ka ti baŋi li, ka li yinɛ o Siig Kasi ni na. Siig Kasi la baŋid si'el kam zan' hali nɛ Wina'am yɛlsu'ada.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ lɛɛ na tun'e baŋ linɛ bɛ ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛrin ka li ya'a ka' o siig kanɛ bɛɛ o ni la? Ala mɛn sɔ' mɛ zi' Wina'am pʋtɛn'ɛrɛ, asɛɛ Wina'am Siig la ma'aa.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ di'e dunia kaŋa siiga, amaa ti di'enɛ Siig kanɛ yi Wina'am san'an na ye li kɛ ka ti baŋ piinkanɛ ka Wina'am tisi ti zaalim-zaalim la.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Ka ti pʋ pian'ad nɛ pian'abanɛ ka ninsaalib pa'ali ti nɛ ba ya'am la, ka lɛɛ pian'ad nɛ pian'abanɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi pa'ali ti, ka bigisid Wina'am yɛlsida tisid nimbanɛ ka Wina'am Siig bɛɛ ba ni la.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Amaa ninkanɛ ka Wina'am ka' o ni kʋ nyaŋi di'e piini banɛ yit Wina'am Siig la ni naa, lin an yalimis o san'an la zug. Ka banɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la bɛɛ ba ni la ma'aa baŋi li yɛla.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Onɛ ka Wina'am Siig bɛɛ o ni na nyaŋi baŋ linɛ an sʋm nɛ linɛ an bɛ'ɛdi bak. Amaa sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi kad on daana saria.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ lin sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Anɔ'ɔnɛ mi' Zugsɔb la pʋtɛn'ɛr ka na nyaŋi sa'al o?” Amaa tinam yadda niŋidib mɔr Kristo pʋtɛn'ɛr.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, sida, m daa pʋ tun'e pian' tisi ya wʋʋ man pian'adi tisid nimbanɛ mɔr Wina'am Siig Kasi si'em laa. M daa pian' tisi ya nwɛnɛ dunia kaŋa nidib ka nwɛnɛ bilies Kristo ni.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: M daa tisidi ya nɛ bin'isim ka ka' sa'abɔ, bɔzugɔ ya daa nam pʋ siak sa'ab diibɔ. Hali nannanna ya nan kʋ tun'e dii lii,

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: yanamɛ nan kpɛn tʋm nwɛnɛ dunia kaŋa nidib la zug. Fufum ya'a bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin ka ya nwa'asid nɛ taaba, li pʋ pa'al ye ya anɛ dunia kaŋa nwa' nidib ka tʋm nwɛnɛ ba nɛɛ?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Ka ya yinne ya'a yɛl ye, “Man dɔlnɛ Paul,” ka yinne ye, “Man dɔlnɛ Apollos,” ya pʋ nwɛnɛ dunia nidiba?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Man aan anɔ'ɔn ka Apollos aan anɔ'ɔnɛ? Ti kʋdim anɛ tʋmtʋmnib banɛ daa kɛ ka ya di'e Wina'am. Ti yinne-yinne tʋmnɛ tʋʋm kanɛ ka Zugsɔb la tisi ti ye ti tʋm la.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Man daa tʋmnɛ nwɛnɛ m bʋtnɛ biili nɛ, ka Apollos dɔn'ɔsidi li, ka Wina'am kɛ ka li nɔbig.

english_verse: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
translation_verse: Onɛ bʋt nɛ onɛ dɔn'ɔsid anɛ zaalim. Wina'am ma'aa kɛt ka biili la nɔbigid.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Baregaŋ ka' onɛ bʋt nɛ onɛ dɔn'ɔsid san'anɛ. Wina'am na yɔ sɔ' mɛkama wʋsa on tʋm si'em.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Ti anɛ tʋmtʋmnib nɛ taaba. Yanam nwɛnɛ Wina'am pɔɔg nɛ, ka mɛ lɛn nwɛnɛ Wina'am yir nɛ.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Man zaŋ piinkanɛ ka Wina'am tisim la tʋm nwɛnɛ tanmɛɛd sʋŋʋ na ɛɛnb ɛɛnbir, ka sɔ' mɛ sʋn'ʋli li zug. Amaa sɔ' mɛkama gu'usim o mɛŋ on mɛɛd si'em.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo ken daar la na, sɔ' wʋsa tʋʋma an si'em la na nie paalʋ. Bugum na pa'ali li. Ka bugum la na mak nid wʋsa tʋʋma ka pa'al lin an si'em.

english_verse: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
translation_verse: Bugum ya'a pʋ di sɔ' tʋʋma, o na dii li nyɔɔd.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Ka bugum ya'a di sɔ' tʋʋma, o kʋ dii li nyɔɔdɛ. Amaa ninkan na tilig nwɛnɛ onɛ zɔɔ pɔns bugumin nɛ.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Ya zi' ye ya anɛ Wina'am yir ka o Siig Kasi bɛɛ ya nii?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a san'am Wina'am yir, Wina'am mɛ na san'am o. Wina'am yir anɛ o mɛŋ din gʋllim, ka yanamɛ an yikan la.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Sɔ' da ma' o mɛŋa. Sɔ' ya'a bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin ka tɛn'ɛs ye o anɛ ya'am sɔb dunia kaŋa nwa' ni, li an sʋm ka o kilim yalim dunia nwa' ni, linɛ na kɛ ka o lieb ya'am sɔb.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Linɛ ka dunia dim tɛn'ɛs ka li an ya'am la, anɛ yalimis Wina'am san'an. Li dɔlnɛ lin sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Wina'am bɛnt ya'am dimnɛ gban'adi ba, ba mi'ilim pʋʋgin.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Ka lɛn sɔb zin'isi'a ye, “Zugsɔb mi' ye ya'am dim tɛn'ɛsa anɛ zaalim.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: li ya'a anɛ mam bɛɛ Apollos bɛɛ Pita bɛɛ dunia kaŋa nwa' bɛɛ nyɔvʋr bɛɛ kum bɛɛ linɛ bɛ nannanna bɛɛ saŋa linɛ na ti kena la, yanamɛ sʋ'oe bama wʋsa.

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: Ka Kristo mɛ sʋ'oe ya, ka Wina'am sʋ'oe Kristo.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Li sʋm ye saalib gɔsidi ti ka ti sid anɛ Kristo tʋmtʋmnib banɛ ka Wina'am gu'uli ti nɛ yɛlsu'adir linɛ aan amɛŋa la.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Li sʋ'ʋm ye onɛ ka ba zaŋ tʋʋma niŋ o nu'usin an yɛlsida sɔb.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Li pʋ daam man baa bi'ela ye yanam bɛɛ ninsieba pian'adi m yɛla wʋʋ ya anɛ sariakatib la. Hali m pʋ pian'adi m mɛŋ yɛla wʋʋ sariakata.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Man pʋtɛn'ɛr anɛ nyain, amaa li pʋ pa'al ye m pʋ maal bɛ'ɛdɛ. Zugsɔb la an onɛ kad man saria.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, da nwɛnɛ sariakatibi dɛŋi kʋʋs sɔ' ye o maal bɛ'ɛd ka Zugsɔb la nam pʋ kenaa. O ya'a ti kena, o na ti yis linɛ su'a likin paalʋ ni na, ka nie linɛ bɛ ninsaalib wʋsa pʋtɛnda ni. Saŋkan la Wina'am na pian' sɔ' wʋsa pian'asʋŋ linɛ nar o.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, yanam sʋ'ʋm yɛla ka m nɔk nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa mak nɛ mam mɛŋ nɛ Apollos ye ya zamis tinam san'an yɛlʋg linɛ ye, “Dɔl Wina'am gbauŋ la yɛl si'em la tituaa.” Di na kɛ ka ya kʋ nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg nɛ nid yinne ka gɔs yinne zaalim.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ maali ya ka ya bɛɛ ya kɔn' nɛ sieba? Bɔ ka ya mɔr ka li ka' ye Wina'am tisi ya? Ka ya ya'a di'e li, wala ka ya dʋ'ʋsidi ya mɛŋi nwɛnɛ ya pʋ di'e li?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Ya pʋn mɔr yanamɛ bɔɔd si'el wʋsa, ka pʋn kilim bʋndaannam! Ka mɛ lieb na'anam hali ka tinam pʋ paasɛ. M naan bɔɔdin ye ya sid aan na'anam, ka ti wʋsa la'an di na'am.

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Man san'an, m tɛn'ɛsya ka Wina'am gaŋ tinam banɛ an tʋmtʋmnib la ka ti an tadimnam, nwɛnɛ nimbanɛ ka ba kʋʋd paalʋ ni, ka dunia dim wʋsa nɛ maliaknam la'am gɔsidi ti la.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Tinam anɛ zɔn Kristo zug, amaa yanam anɛ ya'am dim Kristo ni. Tinam ka' paŋa, amaa yanam mɔr paŋ. Nidib nɛ'ɛsid tinam amaa ba na'asid yanam.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Lin paae saŋkaŋa nwa', tinam giligid nɛ kɔ'ɔm nɛ ku'onuud ka yɛɛd kparikɛɛndi giligid zin'ig-zin'ig ka ba bʋ'ʋdi ti,

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: Ti tʋm bɛdegʋ diisidi ti mɛŋ. Ba ya'a pɔ nɔɔri tisi ti, ti lɛbisidnɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsʋg. Ba ya'a namisi ti, ti mɔdigidnɛ.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a pian' ti pian'abɛ'ɛd, ti lɛbisidnɛ pian'amalisiŋ. Ti lieb nɛ tadimnam ka nwɛnɛ dunia tampʋʋr nɛ dunia sa'ad nɛ, hali paae nannanna.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: M pʋ sɔb nɛ'ɛŋa tisi ya ye m diisi ya nyannɛ, amaa ye m pa'ali ya nwɛnɛ ya anɛ man mɛŋ binɔŋa.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Hali baa ya ya'a mɔr sʋŋidib tusa piiga yanamɛ dɔl Kristo la zug, ya mɔri ba' yinne ma'aa. Bɔzugɔ ya nyɔvʋr bɛllim nɛ Yesu Kristo nɔɔr yinne la'asʋg la, manɛ liebi ya saam, mam mɔr labasʋŋ la kena tisi ya la zug.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m bɛlimmi ya ye ya dɔlli man maan si'em la.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa yɛla ka m tʋm Timoti ya san'an na. O anɛ m mɛŋ binɔŋir, on an yɛlsida sɔb Zugsɔb ni la zug. Onɛ na tiɛn ya mam bɛ bɛllim si'a Kristo ni ka li dɔl nɛ bʋn linɛ wʋsa ka m pa'an yadda niŋidib banɛ bɛ zin'is wʋsa la.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Ya sieba mɔr nyɛɛsim tɛn'ɛsid ye m kʋ kena kaae yaa.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la ya'a bɔɔd, li kʋ yuugɛ ka m na kɛɛn ya san'an na, ka baŋ linɛ ka nyɛɛsim dim nwa' na tun'e maal, ka ka' ba pian'ad la ma'aanɛɛ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim ka'anɛ nɔɔr pian'adɛ, amaa li lɛɛ mɔri paŋ.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Ya bɔɔd dinɛ? M kena fiebi ya nɛ kpa'asa bɛɛ m kena nɛ nɔŋilim nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Nidib yɛt ye pu'asan'auŋ bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin. Lina anɛ bʋn linɛ ka hali banɛ pʋn pʋ dɔl Yesu Kristo kis. M wʋm ye nid yinne bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin dig nɛ o saam pu'a.

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Ka li ya'a sid aan ala, wala ka ya bɛɛ anina dʋ'ʋsidi ya mɛŋa? Li pʋ sʋ'ʋm ka ya sʋnya san'aminɛɛ? Li sʋ'ʋm ka ya yisin dau onɛ maal yɛlbɛ'ɛd kaŋa la ya kallin.

english_verse: I am with you only in my thoughts. But in the name of our Lord Jesus I have already judged this man, as though I were with you in person. So when you meet together and the power of the Lord Jesus is with you, I will be there too.
translation_verse: nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu paŋ, ka li nwɛnɛ m bɛ nɛ anina nɛ yanam nɛ. Yanamɛ la'asid taaba ka m pʋtɛn'ɛr bɛɛ ya san'an ka ti Zugsɔb Yesu bɛ nɛ ya nɛ o paŋ la,

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: zaŋimi dau kaŋa niŋ Sʋntaana nu'usin ka o san'am ninkaŋa niŋgbina, ka ti Zugsɔb la ken daar na, ka o siig lɛɛ paam faangir.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Li pʋ sʋ'ʋm ka ya mɔr nyɛɛsim. Ya pʋ baŋ ye danbin fiin nwa' kɛt ka bodobodo zɔ'ɔm ukidaa?

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: Yisim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd banɛ ka ya maal ka li nwɛnɛ danbin kʋdig la ya san'an, ka ya na lieb nyain, ka nwɛnɛ bodobodo zɔ'ɔm kanɛ ka danbin kae. Sida m baŋya ye ya nwɛnɛ bodobodo kanɛ ka' danbinnɛ. Bɔzugɔ, ba daa kʋ Kristo ka o nwɛnɛ Wina'am Kum Maliak Gaadʋg malʋŋ pɛbili ti yɛla.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ ti yisim pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ nwɛnɛ danbin kʋdig la, ka tʋm sida nɛ linɛ an nyain tʋʋma, ka li nwɛnɛ ti maalnɛ tiɛnr malʋŋ ka ɔnb bodobodo kanɛ ka' danbinnɛ.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Man daa sɔb gbauŋ si'a la, m daa yɛli ya ye ya da la'asid nɛ banɛ san'amid pu'ab bɛɛ dapa.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Amaa Ka'anɛ banɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am ka an pu'asan'auŋ dima, pu'abɔɔdib bɛɛ fufum dim bɛɛ na'ayiis bɛɛ banɛ maan bada la ka m ye ya da la'as nɛ baa, ka li ya'a an ala, ya ya'a na yinɛ dunia kaŋa ni.

english_verse: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
translation_verse: M daa sɔbi tisi ya ye ya da dɔl nɛ onɛ yɛl o mɛŋ ye o anɛ Wina'am nid, ka an pu'abɔɔd bɛɛ fufum daan bɛɛ maan ba'ar bɛɛ an nintʋ'ʋs bɛɛ onɛ nuud daam kʋʋn bɛɛ onɛ faand nidib la'adɛ. Hali da zin'in ye fʋ di nɛ niŋkan sɔba.

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Ya yinne ya'a mɔr antu'a nɛ o ba'abiig, ka pʋ mɔri keŋ banɛ an Wina'am nidib san'an ka ba la'asi maalɛ, ka mɔri keŋ banɛ ka' Wina'am nidib kɔɔtʋ ni maal, li pʋ mɔr nyannɛɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Ya zi' ye Wina'am nidib na ti kad dunia dim sariaa? Ka ya ya'a na ti kad dunia dim saria, ya kʋ nyaŋi tu'a antu'abibis yɛla nannannaa?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Ya zi' ye tinamɛ na ti kad maliaknam saria, ka kɛti dunia kaŋa nwa' yɛlaa?

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Ka ya ya'a mɔr antu'a bama, bɔ ka ya mɔri ken banɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am san'anɛ?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ nyannɛ tisi ya. Wina'am nidib sʋʋgin sieba ya'a nwa'as nɛ taaba, nid sɔ' ka' ya sʋʋgini mɔr ya'am na tun'e maali ba pian'ad la?

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: Amaa yadda niŋid yinne mɔr o tiraanɛ ken sariakatib banɛ ka' yadda niŋidib la kɔɔtʋ ni ka ba tu'ad!

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Li ya'a an sida ye ya mɔri taaba ken sariakatib banɛ ka' yadda niŋidib san'an, ya diisnɛ ya mɛŋ nyannɛ la. Hali ba ya'a pɔ'ɔgi ya bɛɛ filimmi ya li pʋ sɔn'oe yaa?

english_verse: But instead, you cheat and rob other followers.
translation_verse: Amaa ya tulignɛ maan taaba bɛ'ɛd ka filim banɛ aan ya ba'abiis, Wina'am suorin la.

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Ya pʋ baŋ ye tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim kʋ ti kpɛn' Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim la nii? Da ma' ya mɛŋa; nimbanɛ an pu'asan'auŋ dim bɛɛ banɛ maan bada bɛɛ dap banɛ dig nɛ ba dap taaba la,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: bɛɛ na'ayiis bɛɛ banɛ mɔr fufum, bɛɛ banɛ nuud daam kʋʋn bɛɛ banɛ tʋ'ʋd nidib bɛɛ faandib, baa ba nid yinne kʋ kpɛn' Wina'am sʋ'ʋlimin laa.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Ya sieba daa anɛ ala. Ka Wina'am daa pie ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka ya lieb o mɛŋ nidib, ka o kɛ ka ya an pʋpielim dim o tuon, yanamɛ an yinne nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la zug. Tisimi Wina'am girima nɛ ya niŋgbina

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Sɔ' na yɛl ye, “M mɔr suori na maal man bɔɔd si'el wʋsa.” Sida. Amaa li ka' si'el wʋsa an sʋm tisid oo. O na yɛl ye, “M mɔr suori na maal man bɔɔd si'el wʋsa.” Sida. Amaa m kʋ siaki lieb si'el yammʋgɔ.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: “Diib bɛ nɛ pʋʋr yɛla, ka pʋʋr mɛ bɛ diib yɛla.” Sida! Amaa Wina'am na san'ami babayi' la wʋsa. Niŋgbiŋ la pʋ bɛ nɛ dausan'auŋ bɛɛ pu'asan'auŋ yɛllɛ, amaa li bɛnɛ Zugsɔb la yɛla ka onɛ mɛ sʋ'oe li.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Wina'am vʋ'ʋg Zugsɔb la kumin nɛ o paŋ, ka o paŋ la mɛ na vʋ'ʋgi ti.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Ya zi' ye Kristo sʋ'oe ya niŋgbina luos wʋsaa? Dinzugɔ li na an sʋm ye m zaŋ Kristo niŋgbina la'as nɛ pu'agɔɔnda niŋgbina bɛɛ? Ayei baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Ya zi' ye onɛ la'as o mɛŋ nɛ pu'agɔɔndir on nɛ pu'agɔɔndir la lieb nɛ niŋgbiŋ yinnee? Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn dau nɛ o pu'a yɛla ye, “Babayi' la na lieb niŋgbiŋ yinne.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ la'as o mɛŋ nɛ Zugsɔb la on nɛ Zugsɔb la anɛ yinne siig la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Luakim dausan'auŋ nɛ pu'asan'auŋ. Bɔzugɔ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa banɛ ka ninsaal maan pʋ bɛɛ o niŋgbina pʋʋginɛ, amaa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dinɛ an pu'asan'auŋ bɛ nɛ ninsaal niŋgbina ni.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Ya zi' ye ya niŋgbina la anɛ Siig Kasi onɛ ka Wina'am tisi ya ka o bɛɛ ya san'an la yirɛɛ? Ya pʋ sʋ'oe ya mɛŋa.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Wina'am da' ya nɛ. Dinzugɔ na'asimi Wina'am nɛ ya niŋgbina.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Nannanna, yanamɛ daa sɔb gbauŋ si'a la ka m sɔbidi lɛbisidi ya. Li sʋ'ʋm ka dau da di pu'a.

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: Amaa pu'asan'auŋ bɛdegʋ bɛɛ ya teŋin la zug, dau mɛkama sʋ'ʋm ye o mɔr o mɛŋ pu'a ka pu'a mɛ mɔr o mɛŋ sid.

english_verse: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
translation_verse: Li sʋ'ʋm ye dau tʋm o daulim tʋʋma tis o pu'a, ka pu'a mɛ niŋ ala tis o sid.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ pu'a pʋ sʋ'oe o mɛŋ niŋgbinaa. Li anɛ o sidi sʋ'oe li. Ka dau mɛ pʋ sʋ'oe o mɛŋ niŋgbinaa. Li anɛ o pu'a sʋ'oe li.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Pu'a nɛ o sid da zan'as taabaa. Asɛɛ ban na gban'e ye ba lɔ nɔɔr ka zaŋ saŋa bi'ela sɔs Wina'am, ka naan lɛn la'as nɛ taaba, ka Sʋntaana da maki ba, bɔzugɔ ba kʋ tun'e gban'e ba mɛŋa.

english_verse: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
translation_verse: M tɛn'ɛsʋg anɛ ye li naan aan sʋ'ʋm ka dau wʋsa an wʋʋ man an si'em la. Amaa ninsaal mɛkama mɔr o mɛŋ piinkanɛ ka Wina'am tis o. Ti wʋsa yinne-yinne mɔr piini kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: M yɛt nɛ'ɛŋa tisidnɛ nimbanɛ ka' pu'ab bɛɛ ka' sidib la nɛ pʋkɔnya, ye li an sʋm tisi ba ka ba kpɛm bɛɛ ba gʋllim wʋʋ man bɛ si'em la.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Amaa ba ya'a kʋ nyaŋi gban'e ba mɛŋa, dap on dim pu'ab ka pu'ab mɛ kul sidib. Li an sʋ'ʋŋa ka ya niŋ ala gaad yanamɛ na ti mɔri li ya'amlɛog ka li zabid wʋʋ bugum.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: M mɔr nɔyɛlʋgʋ na tis nimbanɛ mɔr pu'ab bɛɛ mɔr sidib la. Ka li anɛ Zugsɔb la din ka ka' man dinnɛ. Li anɛ ye pu'a da bas o sida.

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: Amaa o ya'a bas o sid, on zin', ka da tɔɔm kul sida, bɛɛ onɛ o sid la naalim taaba. Ka dau mɛ da bas o pu'a.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ man mɛŋ nɔɔr yɛlʋg ka m yɛt nimbanɛ kpɛlim la. Li ka' Zugsɔb la yɛlʋgɔ. Li anɛ ye onɛ siak Wina'am ya'a mɔr pu'a sa, ka pu'a la ka' yadda niŋida, ka siak ye ba la'am bɛ, on da bas oo.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Pu'a onɛ siak Wina'am ya'a kul sid sa, ka dau la ka' yadda niŋida, ka siak ye ba la'am bɛ, on da bas oo.

english_verse: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, pu'a kanɛ an Wina'am nid la tun'e kɛ ka o sid an nyain, ka dau kanɛ an Wina'am nid la tun'e kɛ ka o pu'a an nyain. Nɛ'ɛŋa ya'a ka'an ala, ba biis naan aan dian'ad dim. Ka lin an si'em la, biis la mɛ anɛ nyain.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ ka' yadda niŋid ya'a bɔɔd ye o bas onɛ an yadda niŋid, on niŋim ala. Li ka' mugusʋg ye pu'a bɛɛ dau onɛ an yadda niŋid la'as nɛ onɛ ka' yadda niŋida. Wina'am buoli ti ye ti bɛ nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.

english_verse: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
translation_verse: “Pu'a onɛ an yadda niŋida, fʋ niŋ wala baŋ ye fʋ kʋ tun'e faaɛn fʋ sida? Ka dau onɛ an yadda niŋida, fʋ niŋ wala baŋ ye fʋ kʋ tun'e faaɛn fʋ pu'a?” Bɛ nwɛnɛ fʋn da an si'em ka Wina'am buolif la

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Sɔ' mɛkama dɔl bɛllim kanɛ ka Wina'am tis o, nɛ on daa an si'em ka Wina'am buol o la. Nɛ'ɛŋa an linɛ ka m tisid nɔɔr Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ zin'is wʋsa.

english_verse: If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised.
translation_verse: Onɛ kpɛn' baŋʋ, ka Wina'am nyaan buol o, on da mɔɔd ye o yis baŋʋ la isiri basɛ. Onɛ mɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ ka Wina'am buol o, on da kpɛn'ɛ.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ kpɛn' baŋʋ nɛ onɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ wʋsa anɛ zaalim. Linɛ pak anɛ Wina'am nɔɔr yɛlʋg la siakir.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Sɔ' mɛkama kpɛm bɛ on daa an si'em ka Wina'am buol o la.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a daa anɛ yammʋg saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am buolif, fʋn da kɛ ka li paki fɔ. Amaa fʋ ya'a na nyɛ yɔlisim suor fʋn di'em.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ ka Zugsɔb la buol, ka o an yammʋg, anɛ Zugsɔb la yɔlisim nid. Ala mɛn, yɔlisim nid on ka Kristo buol, anɛ o yammʋg.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Wina'am da' ya nɛ. Dinzugɔ, da liebi wʋʋ yammisi tis nidiba.
