english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ bipumis banɛ pʋ kul sidib la yɛla, m pʋ di'e nɔɔr Zugsɔb la san'anɛ, amaa m tu'asidnɛ m pʋtɛn'ɛri mɔr si'el linɛ ka m paam Zugsɔb la san'an o nimbaanlzɔɔr la yɛla ye ya na siak ye man yɛl si'el la anɛ yɛlsida.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Tɔɔgʋ an si'em nannanna la zug, man tɛn'ɛs ye li sʋ'ʋm ka nid na kpɛn an wʋʋ on pʋn an si'em la.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a mɔr pu'a, fʋn da mɔɔd ye fʋ bas oo. Ka fʋ ya'a an dakɔɔnr mɛn fʋn da ieed ye fʋ di pu'a.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ ya'a li'a pu'a ka o kulif, fʋ pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Ka onɛ mɛ pʋ mɔr sid ya'a kul sid, o pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Mam bɔɔd ye ya luak yɛlbanɛ paad dap banɛ mɔr pu'ab bɛɛ pu'a banɛ mɔr sidib dunia nwa' ni la.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, linɛ ka m yɛl la gbin anɛ ye, saŋa kanɛ ka Wina'am zi'eli tisi ti la pʋ lɛn zu'oe. Nannanna wa'ae sa, li an sʋm ka banɛ mɔr pu'ab la bɛ nwɛnɛ ba ka' pu'aba,

english_verse: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.
translation_verse: ka banɛ kaasid nwɛnɛ ba sʋnya pʋ san'am, ka banɛ la'ad nwɛnɛ ba ka' sumalisim, ka banɛ da'ad nwɛnɛ ba pʋ sʋ'oe lii,

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: ka banɛ mɔr dunia la'adi maan ban bɔɔd si'em da kɛ ka li yɛla lɔɔ ba zutɛ. Ka dunia kaŋa an si'em nannanna la, ye li gaadnɛ.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: M pʋ bɔɔd ye si'elnam daami yaa. Dakɔɔnr gɔsidi on na niŋ si'em tʋm Zugsɔb la tʋʋma, ka niŋ si'em ka li na malis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Ka pu'a daan gɔsid dunia yɛla nɛ on na niŋ si'em ka li malis o pu'a.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ o ya'am bɔɔdim pʋdignɛ. Ka pu'a onɛ ka' sid gɔsidnɛ Zugsɔb la tʋʋma yɛla, on na niŋ si'em ka o niŋgbina nɛ o siig na ti an Wina'am din. Ka onɛ mɔr sid gɔsidnɛ dunia la'ad nɛ on na niŋ si'em ka li malis o sid.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Yanam sʋ'ʋm zug ka m yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa ye m sʋŋi ya. M pʋ kpɛ'ɛŋid ye m vi' ya suor nɛ linɛ aan ya bɔɔdim. Amaa m bɔɔd ye ya tʋm linɛ an sʋm nɛ dinɛ nar, ka zaŋi ya mɛŋ wʋsa pɛsig Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Nid ya'a mɔr o bipuŋ ka o bii tʋʋg sid kulig, ka li mɔr pɔ'ɔgir, on kɛl ka o kul sid nwɛnɛ on tɛn'ɛs si'em o sʋʋnrin la. O ya'a zaŋ o bipuŋ la tis sid, o maal sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, onɛ tisid o bipuŋ sid maal sʋ'ʋŋa. Ka onɛ mɛ pʋ tisid o bipuŋ sid maal sʋ'ʋŋa gaad ala.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Pu'a onɛ kul sid, ka o nam vʋe, o pʋ sʋ'oe o mɛŋa. Ka o sid ya'a kpi, suor bɛ ka o na tun'e kul onɛ ka o bɔɔd, amaa li sʋm ye o an onɛ pʋ'ʋsid Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Ka man tɛn'ɛs ya ka o ya'a kpɛm bɛ wʋʋ on an si'em la, li na malis o gaad on na kul dau. Man mi' ye m mɔr Wina'am Siig ka pa'annɛ ya.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Nannanna m sɔbidnɛ yɛti ya bada diib yɛla. Ti mi' ye yanamɛ yɛl si'em ye, ti wʋsa mɔr mi'ilim la, anɛ sida. Mi'ilim kɛtnɛ ka ninsaal dʋ'ʋsid o mɛŋ, amaa nɔŋir kpɛmisidi nidib.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a tɛn'ɛs ye on mi' si'el, o mi'ilim la nam pʋ paae wʋʋ lin sʋ'ʋm ye o mi'in si'em laa.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Amaa nid ya'a nɔŋ Wina'am, Wina'am mi' o, ka gɔsid o.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Aa tɔ, m yɛti ya nɛ bada diib yɛla. Ti mi' ye ba'ar anɛ bʋn linɛ pʋ vʋeya, ka mɛ mi' ye Wina'am yinne ma'aa bɛ.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Ka li ka' sɔ' wʋsa mi' nɛ'ɛŋa. Ninsieba miilim bada hali ka ba ya'a di ba'ar diib ba kpɛn tɛn'ɛsidi li yɛla ye li sid anɛ ba'ar diib. Ba pʋtɛnda pʋ kpi'ema, ka ba tɛn'ɛs ye diib la miligi ba nɛ.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Diib pʋ kɛt ka ti li'en Wina'am; ti ya'a pʋ dii, li mɛ pʋ kɛt ka ti lal nɛ oo, ka ti ya'a di, li pʋ kɛt ka ti gat tuonnɛ.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Amaa gu'usimi ka ya yɔlisim kanɛ ka ya mɔri na di bada diib la da kɛ ka nimbanɛ yadda pʋ kpi'em Wina'am ni la kpɛn' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdinɛ.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Dau kanɛ yadda pʋ kpi'em nɛ'ɛŋa yɛla ya'a nyɛ fʋn onɛ mɔr mi'ilim, ka fʋ bɛ ba'a maalʋg zin'igin dit diib, nɛ'ɛŋa kʋ kɛ ka o di ba'ar diibɔɔ?

english_verse: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a niŋid wala tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi san'ami fʋ ba'abiig onɛ yadda pʋ kpi'em la, fʋ tʋmnɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pɔ'ɔg Kristo.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, man ya'a na di si'el ka li kɛ ka m ba'abiig tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd m mɛ kʋdim kʋ ɔnb ni'im ya'asa, linɛ na kɛ ka m ba'abiig da kpɛn' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdinɛ.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Mam pʋ mɔr yɔlisim? M ka' Kristo tʋmtʋmma? M pʋ nyɛ Yesu onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb la? Ka li ka'anɛ m tʋʋma Zugsɔb la nii kɛ ka ya lieb yadda niŋidiba?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Hali sieba ya'a pʋ siak ye m anɛ Kristo Tʋmtʋmma, li nar ka yanam siak. Yanamɛ an yadda niŋidib la, nie pa'al ye m anɛ Kristo Tʋmtʋm.

english_verse: When people question me, I tell them
translation_verse: Nidib ya'a yɛl ye m ka' Kristo Tʋmtʋmma, mam na lɛbisi ba si'em nwa'.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Man nɛ Barnabas pʋ mɔr suor ye ba tisi ti diib nɛ ku'om ti tʋʋma zugɔɔ?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ mɔr suori na kɛ ka pu'a kanɛ mɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am dɔlli ti gɔɔnd nwɛnɛ ti Tʋmtʋm taaba la nɛ Zugsɔb pitib la nɛ Pita niŋid si'em la bɛɛ?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Ya tɛn'ɛs ye man nɛ Barnabas ma'aa nar ye ti tʋmmi diisidi ti mɛŋaa?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Soogia bɛ yaanɛ tʋm zaalim ka pʋ di'ed yɔɔdɛ? Anɔ'ɔnɛ sɛɛd tiis ka kʋ dii li wala? Ka anɔ'ɔn kimm kem niigi ka kʋ nuu ba bin'isim.

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Li sɔb wada banɛ ka Wina'am da tis Moses gbauŋʋn la ye, “Mid ka ya li'a na'araad banɛ kuod la nɛ yʋgʋd.” Li anɛ niigi ka Wina'am daa yɛt bɛɛ?

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Ayei, li anɛ tinam yɛla, bɛɛ ka' alaa? Ɛɛn nwa' sɔbnɛ ti zug. Bɔzugɔ onɛ kuod ki la kuodnɛ ka onɛ bʋ'ʋdi li la mɛ bʋ'ʋd, ka babayi' la wʋsa mɔr ti'ir ka mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye ba na pʋdigi lii di.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ daa tu'asi ya labasʋŋ la, li daa nwɛnɛ ti bʋtnɛ siig bʋmbʋʋda nɛ, alazug ti mɔr suor ka ti na di'e la'abanɛ an sʋm ya san'an ka li nwɛnɛ ti bunnɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Sieba ya'a mɔr suokanɛ ka ba na di'e la'asʋma ya san'an, tinam mɔr suor hali ka li gaad ala. Amaa ti pʋ zaŋ suokan la ye ti di'e si'eli ya san'anɛ. Amaa ti siak ye ti kʋ maal si'el linɛ na giŋ Kristo labasʋŋ la mɔɔlʋgɔ.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Ya mi' ye banɛ tʋm Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, ba diib bɛ nɛ anina. Ka banɛ maan maana tisid Wina'am ka tʋm maan maalʋg zin'igin tʋʋma la, mɛ di'edi ba diib anina.

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn, Zugsɔb la tis nɔɔr ye banɛ mɔɔn labasʋŋ la na paamidi ba si'el wʋsa nɛ anina.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Amaa mam pʋ zaŋ suoya banɛ ka m mɔr la yinne di'e si'ela, ka mɛ pʋ sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa ye ya tisim si'ela. Hali m ya'a kpi, sɔn'oe sɔ' na kɛ ka m kʋ nyaŋi nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgɔ.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: M pʋ mɔr suori na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg mam mɔɔn labasʋŋ la zugɔ. Bɔzugɔ, li anɛ tilas ye m niŋid ala. M ya'a pʋ mɔɔl labasʋŋ la, yɛltɔɔg na bɛɛ m zugin.

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: M ya'a mɔɔl labasʋŋ la nɛ m mɛŋ bɔɔdim, m na di'e li yɔɔd. Amaa m ya'a pʋ mɔɔli li nɛ m mɛŋ bɔɔdim, li anɛ ye m kʋdim mɔɔnnɛ sa.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Ka nɛ' ya'a an sida bɔɔ an man yɔɔdɛ? Li anɛ sumalisim kanɛ ka m nyɛti yit mam mɔɔn labasʋŋ la zaalim ka pʋ di'ed si'el sɔ' san'anɛ la'an nɛ mam mɔr suori na di'e la.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: Hali baa man mɔr yɔlisim ka sɔ' pʋ sʋ'oe m la, m zaŋi mɛŋi lieb yammʋgʋ tis nidib wʋsa ye m mɔri ba bɛdegʋ kɛn Kristo san'an na.

english_verse: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
translation_verse: M ya'a bɛ Jew dim san'an, m liebidi wʋʋ Jew nid nɛ ye m mɔri ba kɛn Kristo san'an na. Ka m ya'a bɛ nɛ banɛ dɔl wada banɛ ka Wina'am da tis Moses la san'an, m liebidnɛ wʋʋ ba nid yinne baa nɛ mam pʋ dɔl wada la, ye m mɔri ba kɛn Kristo san'an na.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ pʋ dɔl wada la san'an ka m mɛ daa lieb wʋʋ ba nid yinne, ye m mɔri ba kɛn Kristo san'an na. Ka nɛ'ɛŋa pʋ pa'al ye m pʋ dɔl Wina'am wada laa. M dɔlnɛ Kristo wada.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ yadda pʋ zu'oe la san'an, ka m daa mɛ lieb wʋʋ ba yinne ye m sʋŋi ba. M dɔlnɛ suoya kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb nidib buudi wʋsa san'an, ye m tiligi ba sieba.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Labasʋŋ la zug m niŋid nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa ye m ti di'e li bareka.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Ya mi' ye zɔɔgin, zɔtzɔtib wʋsa zɔtnɛ, amaa ba yinne ma'aa dit ka di'ed piini. Dinzugɔ kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya mɛŋ bɛdegʋ, wʋʋ zɔtzɔtibi zɔt si'em la, ye ya ti di'e piini Wina'am san'an.

english_verse: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
translation_verse: Zɔtzɔtib wʋsa gban'adi ba mɛŋ si'el wʋsa ni ye ba di'e piinkanɛ kʋ yuug ka san'am. Ka tinam gban'adi ti mɛŋ ye ti di'e piinkanɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Dinzug mam pʋ zɔt yɔɔg, yɔɔgɔ. M mɛ pʋ zabid yɔɔg-yɔɔg wʋʋ onɛ zabidi nwɛ'ɛd sisi'em la.

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: Amaa mugusidi m mɛŋi tʋm nwɛnɛ yammʋg nɛ, bɔzugɔ, m pʋ bɔɔd ye mɔɔn labasʋŋ la tisid nidib ka mam mɛŋ ti kɔ'ɔŋ yɔɔd Wina'am san'anɛ.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m bɔɔd ye ya tɛn'ɛs linɛ da niŋi ti yaanam banɛ da dɔl Moses la. Wina'am da nɔk saŋgbauŋʋ guri ba wʋsa, ka ba wʋsa lɔ'ɔŋ atɛuk linɛ buon atɛuk Zɛn'ug la.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Ba wʋsa da di nɛ siig diib yinne,

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: ka nu siig ku'om yinne; bɔzugɔ, ba da nunɛ ku'okanɛ yi tampinkanɛ ka Wina'am kɛ ka li dɔlli ba la. Tampinkan da anɛ Kristo mɛŋ.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Amaa nɛ wala wʋsa, Wina'am sʋnf da pʋ malis nɛ ba nidib bɛdegʋ, ka o kɛ ka ba kpi, ka ba niŋgbina dig zin'is kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb mɔɔgin la.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋanam wʋsa da anɛ zanbina nɛ sa'alʋgʋ tisi ti ye ti da bɔɔd tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nwɛnɛ ban da niŋid si'em laa.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Da maannɛ bada wʋʋ ba sieba da niŋ si'em, ka li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Nidib da zin'ini di ka nu ka duoe wa'a ba'amaannib wa'a.”

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Ba ye, “Suor bɛ ka ti na maal si'el wʋsa.” Ɛɛn, sida. Amaa li ka' si'el wʋsa mɔr nyɔɔdɛ. “Suor bɛ ka ti na maal si'el wʋsa.” Amaa li ka' si'el wʋsa kpɛmisid nidiba.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Ti mɛ da mak ye ti kpans Zugsɔb la wʋʋ ba sieba da niŋ si'em, ka wiigi da kʋʋ ba la.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Ka mɛ da nyɔn Wina'am wʋʋ ba sieba da nyɔn si'em, ka kum maliak da kʋʋ ba la.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa da niŋnɛ, ye li sa'ali ba. Ka ba sɔbi li ka li an nimmua sa'alʋgʋ tis tinam banɛ bɛ saŋa kanɛ ka dunia naar li'el la.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, onɛ tɛn'ɛs ye o niŋid sʋ'ʋm, ka zi'e sʋ'ʋŋa, on gu'usim, ka ya'a ka' ala, o na lu.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ye makir banɛ buudi paadi ya la nan mi' paae sieba mɛn. Amaa Wina'am anɛ yɛlsida sɔb, ka kʋ kɛ ka makir kanɛ gaadi ya paŋ la paae yaa. Ya makir pʋʋgin, o na maal suor ka tisi ya paŋ ka ya nyaŋi li.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m ba'abiisɛ, luakimi nɛ bada maalʋg.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: M pian'adi tisidi ya nwɛnɛ ya anɛ nimbanɛ mɔr ya'am. Alazug, baŋimi man yɛt si'el la gbin.

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Nwam kanɛ ka ti yiiti zaŋi pʋ'ʋs bareka tis Wina'am la, ti ya'a nu nwam kaŋa ni, ti pʋ naalimnɛ nɛ Kristo ziim bɛɛ? Ka bodobodo kanɛ ka ti gbɛn'ɛsid la, ti ya'a ɔnb bodobodo kaŋa, ti pʋ naalimnɛ nɛ Kristo niŋgbiŋ bɛɛ?

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ pʋdigid bodobodo gbil yinne dit la zug, ti anɛ niŋgbiŋ yinne la'an nɛ tinamɛ zu'oe la.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Gɔsimi Israel dimi niŋid si'em la. Banɛ dit diib banɛ ka ba maali tis Wina'am maan maalʋg zin'ig la, ba anɛ yinne nɛ Wina'am onɛ sʋ'oe maan maalʋg zin'ig la.

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka m yɛt nwa'? Ya tɛn'ɛs ye man yɛl ye ba'ar bɛɛ diib linɛ ka ba maannɛ tisidi li la anɛ si'el bɛɛ?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Ayei, m yɛt ye, linɛ ka ba'amaannib maannɛ tisid bada la, ba maannɛ tisidnɛ kikiris, ka pʋ maannɛ tisid Wina'am. M pʋ bɔɔd ye ya an yinne nɛ kikirisɛ.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Ya kʋ nyaŋi nu Zugsɔb nwam la ni, ka lɛn nu kikiris nwam la nii, ka mɛ kʋ nyaŋi di Zugsɔb la diib, ka lɛn di kikiris diibɔ.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Ti bɔɔd ye fufum kpɛn' Zugsɔb la bɛɛ? Ya tɛn'ɛs ye ti mɔr paŋi gaad o?

english_verse: We should think about others and not about ourselves.
translation_verse: Sɔ' da tɛn'ɛsid o mɛŋ yɛlsʋm ma'aanɛ, amaa o mɛ tɛn'ɛsim o taaba yɛla.

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Ɔmmi ni'im kanɛ wʋsa ka ba kuosid da'an. Ka da kɛ ka ya pʋtɛnda kɛ ka ya bu'osid bu'osaa.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Teŋgbauŋ la anɛ Zugsɔb la din, nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a keŋ onɛ ka' yadda niŋid yin ka o tisif diib, fʋn dim linɛ ka o mɔra zi'eli fʋ tuon la, ka da bu'os ye bɔ ni'imi nwaa.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Li ka'anɛ fʋn mɛŋ pʋtɛn'ɛr yɛlaa, amaa li anɛ sɔ' pʋtɛn'ɛr yɛla. Bɔzug ka m mɔr yɔlisim ka sɔ' pʋtɛn'ɛr kati m saria?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: M ya'a pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka ka di diib, bɔ ka sɔ' na pɔ'ɔg mam nɛ bʋn linɛ ka m pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka li yɛla la?

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a di bɛɛ nu bɛɛ niŋ si'el mɛkama, yanam niŋimi li wʋsa ka li dʋ'ʋs Wina'am yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Da niŋ si'el Jew dim bɛɛ Girik dim bɛɛ Wina'am nidib san'an ka li daami baa.

english_verse: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
translation_verse: Niŋimi wʋʋ man niŋid si'em la. Hali m mɔɔd ye m tʋm linɛ malis sɔ' mɛkama si'el wʋsa pʋʋgin. Bɔzugɔ m pʋ bɔɔd man mɛŋ sʋ'ʋm yɛla ma'aanɛ, amaa nidib wʋsa sʋ'ʋm yɛla, ye ba paam faangir.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Tu'asimi man tʋʋma wʋʋ man tu'asid Kristo tʋʋma si'em la.

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: M pian'adi ya ka li anɛ yanamɛ tiɛndi m yɛla si'el wʋsa ni ka mɔr pa'alʋg kanɛ ka m tɔlisi tisi ya la zug.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Amaa m bɔɔd ye ya baŋ ye Kristo an dau wʋsa zugdaan, ka dau mɛ aan o pu'a zugdaan, ka Wina'am mɛ an Kristo zugdaan.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, dau onɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bɛɛ di'ed Wina'am pian'adi tisid nidib, ka si'el pil o zug, o sɔb diis nɛ Kristo nyan.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Ka pu'a onɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bɛɛ di'ed Wina'am pian'adi tisid nidib, ka si'el pʋ pil o zugɔ, o diis nɛ o sid nyan. Li nwɛnɛ o pʋn o zug la nɛ.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Pu'a ya'a zan'as ka pʋ pil o zugɔ, on kiesim o zuobid. Ti mɛ mi' sʋŋa ye pu'a ya'a pʋn o zug bɛɛ kies o zuobid, li anɛ nyannɛ tis o, alazug, o ligilim o zug.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Wina'am maal dau nwɛnɛ o mɛŋ ye o tis o girima la zug, lin ka li pʋ nar ye o zaŋ si'eli pil o zugɔ. Alazug, pu'a la mɛ mɔr girima tisid dau.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Wina'am da pʋ zaŋ pu'a kɔnbiri maal dau, amaa o da zaŋ nɛ dau kɔnbiri maal pu'a.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Wina'am mɛ da pʋ maal dau pu'a zugɔ, amaa o da maalnɛ pu'a dau zug.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Maliaknam la zug, li sʋ'ʋm ka pu'a zaŋ si'eli ligil o zugʋ pa'al ye o bɛ nɛ o sid la nu'usin.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb nidib la pʋʋgin, pu'a bɛ nɛ dau nu'usin, ka dau mɛ bɛ pu'a nu'usin.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Wina'am da zaŋ dau maal pu'a. Ala mɛn ka pu'ab mɛ du'ad dap. Ka si'el wʋsa yit nɛ Wina'am san'an na.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Yanam mɛ tɛn'ɛsim gɔsɛ. Li sʋm ye pu'a pʋ'ʋs Wina'am paalʋ ni ka si'el ka' o zuginɛɛ?

english_verse: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
translation_verse: amaa zuobid anɛ vɛnlim tis pu'a. Wina'am maal o zuobid ka li wa'am ye li an o zupibig.

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' ya'a bɔɔd ye o nwa'asi li yɛla, mam na lɛbis si'el anɛ ye, tinam bɛɛ Wina'am nidib pʋ mɔr malʋŋ si'a linɛ bɛ zugpilib pʋʋginɛ. Zugsɔb nɔnaar diib la yɛla (Mat

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: M pʋ zun'odi ya yɛlkanɛ ka m ye m yɛli ya laa, bɔzugɔ ya ɛɛnti la'as taaba ka ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd gati ya tʋʋm sʋma.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Yiiga zin'igin, m wʋmya ye ya ya'a ɛɛnti la'as taaba ye ya pʋ'ʋs Wina'am, wɛligir bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin. M mɛ siak ye labaya la sieba anɛ sida.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Bi'esʋg kae, ye wɛligir na bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin ye ba baŋ banɛ dɔl sida suor la paalʋ nii.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ ya ya'a la'as, sɔ' mɛkama ditnɛ o mɛŋ diib, ka sieba kɔ'ɔm zabid ka sieba nuu kʋʋl.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Alazug, ya ya'a ɛɛnti ɔnb bodobodo la ka nu nwam kaŋa ni, ya mɔɔnnɛ Zugsɔb la kum yɛla gur o lɛbig na.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɛkama pʋ baŋ Zugsɔb la niŋgbiŋ la gbinnɛ, ka mɛ di ka nu, o na nyɛ kʋʋsbɛ'ɛd on di ka nu la zug.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Ka ban dii naae la, ka o zaŋ nwam, ka yɛl ye, “Nwam kaŋa anɛ Wina'am nɔnapaal linɛ an man ziim. Ya ya'a ɛɛnti nuu li, yanam niŋimi li ka li tiɛn m yɛla.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Man daa di'e pa'al si'a Zugsɔb la san'an, linɛ nwa' ka zaŋi tɔlisidi tisidi ya: Yʋ'ʋŋ kanɛ ka ba zammi ti Zugsɔb la, ka o zaŋ bodobodo

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka, ka gbin'esi li, ka ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ m niŋgbiŋ kanɛ ka m tisi ya. Niŋimini ala ka li tiɛndi ya m yɛla.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, onɛ mɛkama ɔnb Zugsɔb la bodobodo ka nu o nwam la ni, ka li pʋ sʋ'ʋm ye o di ka nuu, o tʋm nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi tis Zugsɔb la niŋgbiŋ nɛ o ziim la.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa tɛn'ɛsim sʋ'ʋŋa ka nyaan ɔnb bodobodo kaŋa ka mɛ nu nwam kaŋa ni.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka ya bɛdegʋ an ban'adnam, ka sieba ka' paŋa, ka sieba kpi la.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a maki ti mɛŋ yiiga sʋ'ʋŋa, ti kʋ kpɛn' Wina'am sariakadib nii.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la kad tinam saria ka namisidi ti ye ti zamis ka da ti la'as nɛ dunia nidibi nyɛ kʋʋsbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m ba'abiisɛ, ya ya'a la'as taaba ye ya di Zugsɔb diib la, yanam on gur taaba.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Onɛ kɔ'ɔm zabid, on dim o yin ka nyaan kena, ka da kpɛn' Zugsɔb la sariakadib nii. Li ya'a anɛ yɛl banɛ kpɛlim la, m ya'a ti kena, m na sa'ali ya li yɛla.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Ya mi' ye yanamɛ daa nan ka' yadda niŋidib la, ba'a kpiilima daa mɔri ya dɔl suobɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m bɔɔd ye ya baŋ ye Wina'am Siig Kasi la ya'a bɛ sɔ' ni, o kʋ tun'e pian' Yesu yɛla bɛ'ɛdɛ. Ka sɔ' mɛ kʋ tun'e yɛl ye Yesu anɛ Zugsɔba, ya'a ka' ye Wina'am Siig Kasi la bɛɛ o sɔb nii.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Siig Kasi la tisid piini kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb. Amaa li wʋsa yitnɛ Siig Kasi yinne la ni.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: Tʋʋma kɔn'ɔb kɔn'ɔbi bɛ. Amaa li anɛ Zugsɔb yinne ka ti tʋmmi tisid.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Tʋʋma kɔn'ɔb kɔn'ɔbi bɛ. Amaa li anɛ Wina'am yinne tisid nidib ya'am ka ba tʋmmi li.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Wina'am Siig Kasi la tisid yadda niŋidib wʋsa piini si'a linɛ pa'an Siig Kasi la paŋ ye li sʋŋ Wina'am nidib wʋsa.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Siig Kasi la tisid ninsieba piini ka ba pian'ad ya'am pian'ad, ka tisid sieba mi'ilim pian'ad,

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: ka tisid sieba yadda tita'ar Wina'am ni, ka tisid sieba piini linɛ na ti'eb ban'adnam,

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: ka tisid sieba paŋ ka ba na nyaŋi tʋm tʋʋmnyalima, ka tisid sieba piini ka ba di'ed Wina'am nɔɔri tisid nidib, ka tisid sieba ya'am ka ba na nyaŋi baŋ linɛ yi Siig Kasi la san'an na nɛ linɛ pʋ yii o san'an naa, ka tisid sieba piini ka ba na tun'e pian' pian'azʋna, ka tisid sieba ka ba na tun'e tu'as pian'azʋna la gbinnɛ an si'el.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Li anɛ Siig Kasi yinne la niŋid nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa. O tisid sɔ' mɛkama nɛ piini gʋn-gʋn wʋʋ on bɔɔd si'em. Niŋgbiŋ yinne nɛ luos bɛdegʋ la yɛla

english_verse: The body of Christ has many different parts, just as any other body does.
translation_verse: Kristo nidib nwɛnɛ niŋgbiŋ yinne mɔr luos bɛdegʋ si'em la. Hali nɛ lin mɔr luos buudi kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb la li kpɛn anɛ niŋgbiŋ yinne.

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Tinam wʋsa banɛ an Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim, yammis nɛ banɛ ka' yammis la wʋsa, Kristo tisi ti wʋsa Wina'am Siig Kasi yinne ka kɛ ka ti lieb niŋgbiŋ yinne. Wina'am tʋm o Siig Kasi yinne la tisi ti wʋsa.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Niŋgbiŋ la pʋ mɔr luoa yinne ma'aanɛ. Li mɔri luos bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Nɔbir ya'a yɛlin ye, “Man ka' nu'ug la zug, m ka' niŋgbiŋ la nii,” lin kʋ nyaŋi kɛ ka o ka' niŋgbiŋ la nii.

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Tʋbir mɛ ya'a yɛlin ye, “Man ka' nif la zug, m ka' niŋgbiŋ la nii,” lin kʋ nyaŋi kɛ ka o ka' niŋgbiŋ la nii.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Niŋgbiŋ la wʋsa ya'a aannɛ nifɔ, li ye li niŋin wala wʋm pian'adɛ? Ka li ya'a aannɛ tʋbirɛ, li ye li niŋin wala wʋm nyuugɔ?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Lin an si'em la, Wina'am maal niŋgbiŋ luos wʋsa tɔ'ɔŋ wʋʋ on bɔɔd si'em.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Li wʋsa ya'a aannɛ luoa yinne ma'aa, niŋgbiŋ naan kʋ bɛɛnɛ.

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Lin an si'em la, luos bɛdegʋ bɛ, amaa li anɛ niŋgbiŋ yinne.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, nif kʋ nyaŋi yɛl nu'ug ye, “M pʋ bɔɔdi fʋ sʋŋirɛ.” Zug mɛ kʋ nyaŋi yɛl nɔba ye, “M pʋ bɔɔdi ya sʋŋirɛ.”

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Ka ti niŋgbiŋ la luos banɛ nwɛnɛ ba ka' paŋ la ya'a kae, niŋgbiŋ la kʋ tʋm.

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: Ti gɔsid niŋgbina luos banɛ ka ti nɛ'ɛs la sʋ'ʋŋa, ka na'asid nyan luos banɛ ka ti pʋ bɔɔd ye nidib nyɛ la liginnɛ ba.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Ka li pʋ nar ka ti ligin luosʋma laa. Wina'am mɛŋ maali ti niŋgbina ka tis luos banɛ ka ti gɔs ka ba nyɔɔd pʋ zu'oe la na'asi gaad luoa mɛkama.

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ wɛligir kae ti niŋgbina la nii. Luos kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb la bɔɔd taaba sʋŋir.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ luoa yinne ya'a namisid, luos la wʋsa mɛ namisidnɛ. Luoa yinne ya'a nyɛ na'asi, luos la wʋsa mɔri sumalisim.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Ya wʋsa nwɛnɛ Kristo niŋgbiŋ nɛ. Ka sɔ' kam wʋsa mɛ nwɛnɛ o niŋgbiŋ la luaa sieba.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Wina'am gaŋnɛ tʋmtʋmnib o nidib sʋʋgin ka ba an kpɛɛmnam, ka gaŋ nɔdi'esidib ka ba tia'ali ba, ka nyaan gaŋ pa'annib, ka yʋ'ʋn gaŋ banɛ maan tʋʋmnyalima, ka lɛn gaŋ sieba ka ba na tun'e ma'ae ban'as, ka gaŋ sieba ka ba sʋŋid nidib ka gaŋ sieba ka ba gɔsid ka bigisid nidib tʋʋma an si'em, ka gaŋ sieba ka ba pian'ad pian'azʋna.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Ti wʋsa ka' tʋmtʋmnib bɛɛ nɔdi'esidib bɛɛ pa'anniba. Li ka' ti wʋsa mɔr paŋi na tʋm tʋʋmnyalima

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: bɛɛ ti'eb ban'adnam bɛɛ pian' pian'azʋna, bɛɛ nyaŋi tu'as pian'azʋna la gbinnɛ.

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Bɔɔmi piintitada gaad bʋn wʋsa. Ka m na pa'ali ya suor linɛ gati ba wʋsa.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: M ya'a pian'ad ninsaalib pian'ad buudi nɛ maliaknam pian'ad, ka pʋ mɔr nɔŋilim, m kʋdim nwɛnɛ lʋmmir bɛɛ binnir linɛ vuudnɛ.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Ka m ya'a mɔr nɔdi'esʋg piini linɛ ka Wina'am tisid ka m nyaŋi baŋ yɛlsu'ada wʋsa, ka mɔr mi'ilim wʋsa, ka m yadda kpi'em Wina'am ni ka na nyaŋi yɛl zuor ka li viki tɔɔm, ka pʋ mɔr nɔŋilim, m anɛ zaalim.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Ka m ya'a zaŋ man mɔr si'el wʋsa tis nɔŋ dim, hali ka zaŋi m niŋgbiŋi tis ka ba nyu'oe nɛ bugum, ka pʋ mɔr nɔŋilim, m ka' nyɔɔdɛ.

english_verse: Love is patient and kind, never jealous, boastful, proud, or
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ mɔr nɔŋilim, mɛ mɔr suguru, ka sʋŋid nidib, ka pʋ mɔr fufum bɛɛ dʋ'ʋsi-m-mɛŋa.

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Ba ka' nyɛɛsim bɛɛ tita'alim bɛɛ bɔɔdi ba mɛŋ sʋŋir ma'anɛ, bɛɛ sɔ' ya'a maali ba bɛ'ɛd ba pʋ mɔri lii ba sʋʋnrinɛ.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: Nɔŋilim pʋ mɔr sumalisim nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, amaa li mɔr sumalisim nɛ bʋnsʋma.

english_verse: Love is always supportive, loyal, hopeful, and trusting.
translation_verse: Nɔŋilim dit suguru nɛ si'el wʋsa. Yadda nɛ ti'ir nɛ mɔdigir ka' sierɛ.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Ti mi'ilim nɛ ti nɔdi'esʋg pʋ paae Wina'am mi' si'em la.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Amaa linɛ an nyain ka ka' gba'ar la ya'a ti kenna, linɛ kae nyain ka mɔr gbada la na gaad.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Man daa an biig la, m daa pian'ad ka tɛn'ɛsid ka gban'ad yɛla gbin nwɛnɛ biig nɛ. Ka man yʋ'ʋn nɔbig la ka bas biilim tʋʋma.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ mi' si'el nannanna la anɛ bi'ela nwɛnɛ tinamɛ gɔsid gɔtiŋin ka li an zibisʋg si'em la. Amaa saŋkan la ti na nyɛ si'el wʋsa nyain. Man mi' si'el nan anɛ bi'ela. Amaa m na ti baŋi li sʋ'ʋŋa nyain nwɛnɛ Wina'am mi' man nyain si'em la.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Yadda nɛ ti'ir nɛ nɔŋilim, bʋnama atan' nwa', na bɛ saŋa wʋsa. Amaa nɔŋilim gati ba wʋsa.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka nɔŋilim aan ya bʋmbɔɔdim gaad si'el wʋsa, ka bɔɔe Siig Kasi piini la bɛdegʋ. Linɛ gaadi li wʋsa anɛ nɔdi'esʋg piini linɛ yi Wina'am san'an na la.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Onɛ pian'ad pian'azʋna o pʋ pian'adi tisid nidiba, amaa o pian'adnɛ tisid Wina'am, ka sɔ' kʋ baŋ on yɛt si'el laa, bɔzugɔ o pian'adnɛ yɛlsu'ada nɛ Siig la paŋ.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ di'esid Wina'am pian'adi tisid nidib, pian'adnɛ sʋŋid nidib ka mɛ kpɛmisidi ba, ka bɛlisidi ba.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Onɛ pian'ad pian'azʋna sʋŋidnɛ o mɛŋ. Ka onɛ di'esid Wina'am nɔɔri pian'adi tisid nidib sʋŋidnɛ Wina'am nidib.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye ya wʋsa pian'ad pian'azʋna, ka bɔɔd ye ya di'esid Wina'am nɔɔr pian'ad la tisid nidibi gat ala. Onɛ di'esid Wina'am nɔɔr pian'ad la tisid nidib gat onɛ pian'ad pian'azʋna. Amaa o ya'a tu'as pian'azʋŋ la gbin ka li sʋŋ nidib, ba pʋ gat taabaa.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m ya'a kɛɛn ya san'an na pian'ad pian'azʋna, m na niŋ wala sʋŋi ya? M kʋ sʋŋi yaa, asɛɛ ka m nie linɛ yi Wina'am san'an na pa'ali ya, bɛɛ tisi ya baŋir, bɛɛ m di'e Wina'am nɔɔr pian'ad bɛɛ pa'al si'a tisi ya.

english_verse: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
translation_verse: Bʋn linɛ ka' nyɔvʋr ya'a maan vuud nwɛnɛ wiigi piebid bʋra-bʋra ka li ka' gbinnɛ, fʋ ye fʋ niŋ wala baŋ lin piebid si'el yɛla?

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Na'atan ya'a piebid ka pʋ pieb tanp piebʋgɔ, anɔ'ɔnɛ na ti'ebi yi tanpɔ?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Ala mɛnɛ ya ya'a pian'ad pian'azʋŋ ka li gbin ka' nyainnɛɛ, sɔ' na niŋ wala baŋ yanamɛ yɛt si'ela. Ya pian'ad la na anɛ zaalim.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: M ya'a zi' pian'ad gbinnɛ, m anɛ saanne tis onɛ pian'ad la, ka onɛ pian'ad la mɛ an saanne tisim.

english_verse: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ sadigim bɔɔd Siig Kasi piini la, bɔɔmi piini linɛ na kpɛmis Wina'am nidib bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, onɛ pian'ad pian'azʋŋ, on sɔsim Wina'am ka o kɛ ka o nyaŋi tu'asi li gbin.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: M ya'a pʋ'ʋs Wina'am nɛ pian'azʋŋ, m siigi pʋ'ʋsid, amaa m ya'am ka' li nii.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Ka bɔ ka m na niŋ yʋ'ʋsɛ? M na pʋ'ʋs nɛ m siig ka mɛ lɛm pʋ'ʋs nɛ m ya'am, ka yʋ'ʋm nɛ m siig ka mɛ yʋ'ʋm nɛ m ya'am.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka nɛ fʋ siig, nid onɛ la'as nɛf ka zi' fʋn yɛt si'el la, na niŋ wala siaki fʋ pʋ'ʋsim ye, “Ami?”

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Hali fʋ Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim la ya'a an sʋ'ʋŋa gba, li ka' sʋŋiri tis ninkanɛ.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: M pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka man pian'ad pian'azʋna gat yanam wʋsa la.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am nidib la'asʋgʋn m bɔɔd ye m pian' ya'am pian'ad anu pa'al nidibi gaad mam na pian' pian'ad tusa piiga nɛ pian'azʋŋ.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, da nwɛnɛ biisi ya pʋtɛnda nii. Amaa aaɛn wʋʋ biisi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pʋʋgin. Kɛl ka ya pʋtɛnda nwɛnɛ kpɛɛmnam pʋtɛnda nɛ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, M na kɛ ka nimbanɛ pian'ad pian'azʋna nɛ teŋ zʋŋ nidib, M na pian' tis nimbama, la'an nɛ wala wʋsa, ba kʋ kɛlisɛ. Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: Dinzug, pian'azʋna anɛ zanbinnɛ tis banɛ ka' yadda niŋidib, ka ka' banɛ an yadda niŋidiba. Ka nɔdi'esʋg an yadda niŋidib din ka ka' banɛ ka' yadda niŋidiba.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Yadda niŋidib wʋsa ya'a la'as taaba, ka sɔ' wʋsa pin'ili pian'ad nɛ pian'azʋna, ka yiŋ dim kpɛn' na, ba kʋ yɛl ye ya gɛɛmnɛɛ?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Amaa yadda niŋidib wʋsa ya'a la'as taaba ka sɔ' wʋsa di'esid Wina'am nɔɔr pian'adi tisid nidib ka yiŋ nid kpɛn' na, on wʋm si'el wʋsa la na kɛ ka o baŋ o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka kad o mɛŋ saria.

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: Yɛlsu'ada banɛ bɛ o sʋʋnrin na nie paalʋ ni, ka o na igini pʋ'ʋs Wina'am ka pɛlig o pʋʋgʋ yɛl ye, “Asida, Wina'am bɛɛ ya ni.” Yadda niŋidib la'asʋg suoya dɔllim la yɛla

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m ba'abiisɛ, ya ya'a la'as taaba ye ya pʋ'ʋs Wina'am, sɔ' mɔri yʋʋm, ka sɔ' mɛ mɔr pa'alʋg, ka sɔ' mɔr si'el linɛ ka Wina'am nie pa'al o, ka sɔ' mɔr pian'azʋŋ, ka sɔ' mɛ mɔr pian'azʋŋ la gbinni na tu'asi tis nidib. Niŋimi si'el wʋsa ka li sʋŋ Wina'am nidib.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Ninsieba ya'a pian' pian'azʋna, nidib ayi' bɛɛ nidiba atan' gʋllim pian'am yinne-yinne, ka sɔ' mɛ tu'as ban yɛl si'el la gbin.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' ya'a kae na nyaŋi tu'as pian'azʋna la gbinnɛ, onɛ pian'ad pian'azʋŋ la da pian' yadda niŋidib la'asʋgʋn nɛ, ka lɛɛ pian' tis o mɛŋ nɛ Wina'am.

english_verse: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka nɔdi'esidiba ayi' bɛɛ atan' pian'. Ka banɛ kpɛlim la gɛligi gɔs ye li an sʋ'ʋŋa bɛɛ.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Ka nid yinne ya'a pian'ad ka Wina'am Siig Kasi nie si'eli pa'al sɔ' la'asʋgʋn la, onɛ dɛŋim pian'ad la na bas pian'ad.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Ya wʋsa yinne-yinne na nyaŋi di'e Wina'am nɔɔr pian'adi tis nidib, ka ya wʋsa zamis ka paam kpɛmisʋg.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ mɔr Wina'am Siig nɔdi'esʋg piini la tun'e gban'e ba mɛŋ nɛ nɔdi'esʋg piini la yɛla.

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Wina'am pʋ tʋm yɔɔg, yɔɔgɔ amaa o tʋmnɛ nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Nwɛnɛ lin tʋm si'em Wina'am nidibi la'asid zin'is wʋsa si'em la,

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: kɛlli ka pu'ab sinni ba nɔɔr baanlimm karindɔɔd wʋsa ni, bɔzugɔ ba ka' suori na pian'ad la'asʋgʋnɛ. Amaa ba siemi ba mɛŋ wʋʋ Jew dim wada la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Si'el ya'a bɛ ka ba bɔɔd ye ba baŋ, ban on bu'osimi ba sidibi ba yaan. Li anɛ nyan nɛ pu'abi na pian'ad yadda niŋidib la'asʋgʋn.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Ya tɛn'ɛs ye li anɛ yanam ni ka Wina'am labaar la pin'ilɛɛ? Ka anɛ yanam gʋllim ni ka li kenaa?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Onɛ tɛn'ɛs ka o an Wina'am nɔdi'es bɛɛ o anɛ onɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi bɛɛ o ni, on siakim ye linɛ ka m sɔbidi tisidi ya nwa' anɛ Zugsɔb la nɔɔr yɛlʋg.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' ya'a pʋ kɛlis nɛ'ɛŋa, yanam on da kɛlisi nɛ oo.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m ba'abiisɛ, bɔɔmi Wina'am nɔdi'esʋg, ka da zan'asi pian'azʋnaa.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Maalimi si'el wʋsa sʋ'ʋŋa, ka da kɛ ka li an yɔri-yɔri.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, nannanna m bɔɔd ye m tiɛn ya labasʋŋ kanɛ ka m da mɔɔli tisi ya, ka ya di'e li mɔr kiŋ-kiŋ la yɛla.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a mɔri li kiŋ-kiŋ, li na faaɛn ya. Ka li ya'a ka' alaa, ya yadda niŋir anɛ zaalim.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Alazug, yɛlkpan linɛ ka m daa di'e la, m zaŋi tii ya. Ka linɛ an ye Kristo kpii ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug, ka li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Ka ba da mum o, ka Wina'am vʋ'ʋg o kumin daba atan' daar, ka li mɛ dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb si'em la.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Ka lin nya'aŋ ka o nie o mɛŋ saŋa yinne o nya'andɔlib banɛ gaad kɔbisnu la san'an. Ba sieba bɛdegʋ nan vʋe, ka sieba kpi.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Ka o nie o mɛŋ Jemes san'an, ka yʋ'ʋn nie o mɛŋ tʋmtʋmnib la wʋsa san'an.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Lin wʋsa nya'aŋ ka o nyaan nie o mɛŋi pa'al man onɛ nwɛnɛ onɛ ka ba yuolim du'a la.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Manɛ an kpaanr tʋmtʋmnib la wʋsa san'an, ka pʋ nar ka ba buolim ye Tʋmtʋmma, man da namisid Wina'am nidib la zug.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Wina'am pʋpielim zug ka m kilim man an si'em nannanna nwa' la. Ka pʋpielim kanɛ ka Wina'am tisim la ka' zaalim, ka man tʋm gaad bama wʋsa. Ka li daa ka' m mɛŋi tʋmi lii. Wina'am pʋpielim zug ka m daa nyaŋi tʋmi li.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, li ya'a daa anɛ man onɛ mɔɔn labaar la bɛɛ banɛ; ti wʋsa mɔɔn labaar linɛ ka m pʋn tiɛn ya li yɛla la, nɛ linɛ ka ya daa siak la. Ti kum vʋ'ʋgir la yɛla

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Ka ti labaar ya'a an ye Kristo vʋ'ʋg kuminɛ, wala ka ya sieba yɛl ye, banɛ kpi kʋ vʋ'ʋg kuminɛ?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ka li ya'a an sida ye banɛ kpi kʋ vʋ'ʋg kuminɛ, alaa li pa'al ye Kristo da pʋ vʋ'ʋg kuminɛ.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Ka Kristo ya'a da pʋ vʋ'ʋg kuminɛ, alaa ti labasʋŋ la mɔɔlʋg anɛ zaalim, ka yanam yadda la mɛ an zaalim.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Li ya'a an sida ye banɛ kpi pʋ vʋ'ʋgid kuminɛ, alaa Wina'am da pʋ vʋ'ʋg Kristo kuminɛ, ka lin pa'al ye tinam ma'adi ziri Wina'am yɛla, tinamɛ yɛl ye Wina'am vʋ'ʋg Kristo kumin la zug.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Banɛ kpi ya'a pʋ vʋ'ʋg kuminɛ, alaa Wina'am da pʋ vʋ'ʋg Kristo kuminɛ.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Ka Kristo ya'a pʋ vʋ'ʋg kuminɛ, ya yadda niŋir la anɛ zaalim, ka ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kpɛm bɛɛ ya ni.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: Li mɛ na pa'al ye banɛ an Kristo yadda niŋidib ka kpi la bɔdignɛ.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ka li ya'a anɛ dunia nwa' yɛla ma'aa ka ti mɔr ti'ir Kristo ni, alaa ti mɔr nimbaanligi gat sɔ' mɛkama dunia ni.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Amaa nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ sida ye Wina'am vʋ'ʋg Kristo kumin, ka o sid an onɛ vʋ'ʋg kumin yiiga.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ lin yi ninsaal yinne ni na ka kum kɛn dunia ni na la, ala mɛn ka li yi ninsaal yinne ni na kum vʋ'ʋgir bɛ mɛn.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Adam zug ka nidib wʋsa kpiid. Ala mɛn ka banɛ an Kristo nidib na vʋ'ʋg kumin.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' mɛkama mɔr o saŋa, ka Kristo vʋ'ʋg kumin yiiga la, ala mɛn ka banɛ aan o nidib mɛ na ti vʋ'ʋg o lɛbig daar la na.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Dunia naar na kena, ka Kristo na san'am banɛ sʋ'oe dunia nwa' paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ dim nɛ na'anam wʋsa paŋ, ka zaŋ sʋ'ʋlim la yʋ'ʋn lɛbisi tis o Ba' Wina'am.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ li anɛ tilas ye Kristo di na'am hali ti paae saŋkanɛ ka o dataas wʋsa na bɛ o nu'usin.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Kum anɛ dataa kanɛ ka o na ti yuolim san'am.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Li yɛl Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “O zaŋ si'el wʋsa niŋ o nu'usin.” Amaa li pʋ pa'al ye si'elnam wʋsa la paas Wina'am onɛ lɛɛ zaŋ si'el mɛkama wʋsa niŋ Kristo nu'usin laa.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Si'elnam wʋsa ya'a ti bɛ Kristo nu'usin, on onɛ an Wina'am Biig la mɛ na niŋ o mɛŋ Wina'am onɛ zaŋ si'el wʋsa niŋ o nu'usin la. Ka Wina'am na an si'el wʋsa ka sʋ'oe wʋsa.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Nidib ya'a kʋ vʋ'ʋg kuminɛ, bɔ ka ninsieba di'ed ku'om sʋʋbi tisid banɛ pʋn kpi la? Kum ya'a kʋdim kʋ vʋ'ʋgɛ, bɔ ka ba niŋid nɛ'ɛŋa?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Ka bɔ ka ti kpɛn'ɛsidi ti mɛŋ yɛla ni saŋa wʋsa?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgʋ ya yɛla, yanamɛ bɛ si'em Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni la zug. Nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka m yɛti ya ye m pʋ lal nɛ kum daar wʋsa la.

english_verse: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
translation_verse: M daa nyɛ yɛla Efesus teŋin nwɛnɛ onɛ zab nɛ gbigima nɛ, ka lin ya'a an dunia nwa' yɛla ma'aa, li nyɔɔd an bɔ? Kum ya'a pʋ vʋ'ʋgida, siiliŋ la yɛl si'el la anɛ sida ye, “Kɛlli ka ti di ka nu, ka bɛog ti saa na kpi.”

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka sɔ' ma'aa yaa: “Dɔllimtaa bɛ'ɛd san'amid ninvʋsʋŋ.”

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ya ya'am lɛb na nwɛnɛ din nar si'em, ka basi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd; bɔzugɔ, ya sieba nan zi' Wina'am. Li anɛ nyan nɛ yanamɛ kɛ ka li kpa' tilas ye m sɔb anwana la. Niŋgbiŋ kum vʋ'ʋgir la yɛla

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' na bu'os ye, “Wala ka banɛ kpi la na ti vʋ'ʋg kuminɛ? Niŋgbiŋ bɔ buudi ka ba na ti mɔra”

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Zɔlʋga! Fʋ zi' ye fʋ ya'a bʋd si'el bielif ka li ye li bul, asɛɛ pak la pun'oe ka bul la yʋ'ʋn vʋ'ʋgɛɛ?

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am tisid bielif kanɛ ka fʋ bʋd la nɛ on Wina'am bɔɔd niŋgbiŋ si'a, ka mɛ tisid bielif buudi wʋsa niŋgbiŋ kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Li ka' niŋgbina wʋsaa nwɛn na. Ninsaalib mɔri niŋgbiŋ buudi yinne, ka bʋnkɔnbid niŋgbina mɛ bɛɛ li kɔn', ka niis niŋgbina mɛ bɛɛ li kɔn', ka zimi niŋgbina mɛ bɛɛ li kɔn'.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Saazug bʋnam mɔri ba mɛŋ niŋgbina, ka dunia bʋnam mɛ mɔri ba mɛŋ niŋgbina. Vɛnlim bɛ saazug bʋnam niŋgbina la ni, ka vɛnlim mɛ bɛ dunia bʋnam niŋgbina la ni.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Winnig mɔr o mɛŋ vɛnlim, ka nwadig mɛ mɔr vɛnlim si'a. Ka nwadbibis vɛnlim mɛ bɛɛ li gʋnni. Hali nwadbibis la sʋʋgin ba vɛnlim bɛ gʋn-gʋn.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Ala ka li mɛ na ti an kum vʋ'ʋgir saŋa. Niŋgbiŋ ya'a sig teŋin, li pun'odnɛ. Amaa Wina'am ya'a ti vʋ'ʋgi li, li pʋ pun'oda.

english_verse: These ugly and weak bodies will become beautiful and strong.
translation_verse: Kum mumnɛ nɛ ziemis, ka na ti vʋ'ʋg nɛ vɛnlim. Li mumnɛ nɛ tadimis ka na ti vʋ'ʋg nɛ paŋ.

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: Li ya'a sig teŋin, li anɛ dunia ni niŋgbiŋ. Amaa Wina'am ya'a ti vʋ'ʋgi li, li anɛ arezana ni niŋgbiŋ. Ti mɔr niŋgbina linɛ an dunia ni din. Ala mɛn ti na ti mɔr niŋgbina linɛ an arezana ni din.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Adam onɛ da an yiiga sɔb ka Wina'am maal la da lieb ninsaal ka vʋ'ʋsid.” Yesu onɛ an ninkanɛ kpɛlim nya'aŋ la anɛ siig onɛ tisid nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Li ka' arezana ni niŋgbina la ka ti di'ed yiiga. Ti di'edi dunia ni din la yiiga, ka nyaan di'ed arezana ni din.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Wina'am da maal yiiga dau, Adam la, nɛ teŋ titan. Amaa dau onɛ tia'al la yinɛ arezana ni na.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Dunia nidib wʋsa nwɛnɛ nid onɛ ka Wina'am da zaŋ teŋ titani maal la. Ka Wina'am nidib mɛ nwɛnɛ nid onɛ da yi arezana ni na la.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ nwɛnɛ nid onɛ ka Wina'am maal nɛ teŋ titan la, ala mɛn ti na ti nwɛnɛ nid onɛ yi arezana ni na la.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, nɛ'ɛŋa ka m sɔbidi yɛti ya ye, ninsaal niŋgbina anɛ dunia ni din, ka kʋ nyaŋi kpɛn' Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim la nii. Niŋgbiŋ linɛ pun'od la kʋ nyaŋi di'e nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi yɛlsu'adir kaŋa. Sieba na kpi, amaa li ka' wʋsaa.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: Ka dunia naar, na'atan ya'a ti pieb, ti wʋsa na tiak yimmʋ, nwɛnɛ nini amisid si'em la. Na'atan na pieb, ka banɛ kpi na vʋ'ʋg nɛ niŋgbina linɛ kʋdim kʋ kpii, ka Wina'am na tiaki ti niŋgbina.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ nɛ'ɛŋa ya'a ti niŋ, ala ka linɛ sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Wina'am vɔl kum ka nyaŋi li, ka kum kʋ lɛm bɛɛ” la na niŋ amɛŋa. Li lɛn sɔb ye,

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Li anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi kɛt ka kum nyɛt paŋi tɔɔnd nidib. Ka li anɛ wada la kɛt ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nyɛt paŋ.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Ka ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka on tisi ti kum nyaŋir paŋi ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni la.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m ba'abinɔŋa, yanamɛ sadigim mi' ye bʋn linɛ ka ya niŋid Zugsɔb yɛla ka' zaalim la, mɔdigim zi'eni kiŋ-kiŋ ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya mɛŋ saŋa wʋsa ya tʋʋma nii tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: M sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa nɛ ye m yɛli ya ligidi kanɛ ka ya la'asid ye ya sʋŋ Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Juda teŋin la yɛla. Niŋimi wʋʋ man daa yɛl Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Galatia teŋin ye ba niŋ si'em la.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Alasid daar wʋsa, sɔ' wʋsa yisim zemis on tʋm nyɛ ligid si'a digil, ka m ya'a ti paae na ligidi la'asʋg kʋ lɛm bɛɛ.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: M ya'a ti paae na, m na sɔb gbauŋʋ tʋm nimbanɛ ka ya mɛŋ na ti gaŋ la, ka ba mɔr piini la keŋ Jerusalem.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Ka li ya'a lɛn nar ye m keŋ, ban on dɔllim ka ti keŋ. Paul gban'ar la yɛla

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: M gban'e ye m dɔlli yi Masedonia teŋin, ka lin nya'aŋ m na kena kaae ya.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Daasi'erɛ m na yuugi ya san'an bi'ela bɛɛ bɛ nɛ ya ka waad saŋa ti gaad, ka ya sʋŋim ka m gaadi keŋ zin'ig kanɛ wʋsa ka m na keŋ.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: M pʋ bɔɔd ye m kaae ya ka li nwɛnɛ m gatnɛ ka yina, amaa m mɔr ti'ir ye m na bɛɛ ya san'anɛ yuug, Zugsɔb la ya'a maal suori tisim.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Amaa m na kpɛm bɛ Efesus teŋinɛ paae Pentekost daar.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Suor yɔ'ɔg kpɛla tisim, ka m na tʋm Wina'am tʋʋma kanɛ mɔr nyɔɔd, amaa dataas la zu'oya.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Timoti ya'a kɛɛn ya san'an na, yanam di'em o ka o bɛɛ ya san'an, ka da kɛ ka o sʋnf san'am. Bɔzugɔ o tʋmnɛ Zugsɔb la tʋʋma nwɛnɛ man tʋm si'em la.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Mid ka ya sɔ' nɛ'ɛs o, amaa sʋŋimin o ka o gaadi kɛɛn m san'an na nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Bɔzugɔ, m gur o nɛ ye o dɔlli ti ba'abibanɛ lɛbid na la.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ ti ba'abiig Apollos yɛla, m kpɛmisid o saŋa wʋsa ye on nɛ ti ba'abibama la kena kaae ya. Ka o kʋdim pʋ bɔɔd ye o kɛn nannanna naa. O ya'a paam suor, o na kena. Sa'alʋg nɛ pʋ'ʋsʋg

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Gu'usimi, ka zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ ka da basi ya yadda niŋir Wina'am nii. Mɔri sʋnkpi'euŋ nɛ paŋ.

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Tʋmmini ya tʋʋma wʋsa nɛ nɔŋilim.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Ya mi' ye Stefanas nɛ o yidimi da dɛŋi lieb yadda niŋidib Akaia teŋin yiiga, ka pɛsigi ba mɛŋi tʋmmi tisid Wina'am nidib. M ba'abiisɛ, m bɛlimi ya nɛ

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: ye ya pɛsigi ya mɛŋi tis nimbama, nɛ ya tʋmtʋm taaba wʋsa nɛ banɛ tʋm bɛdegʋ sʋŋid Wina'am nidib la.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: M mɔr sumalisim Stefanas nɛ Fortunatus nɛ Akaikus n daa paae na la, bɔzugɔ ba daa sʋŋim nɛ sʋŋir kanɛ ka yanam pʋ nyaŋi sʋŋim la.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Ba kpɛ'ɛŋ man nɛ yanam sʋnya alazug, na'asimi nimbanɛ nwɛnɛ bama.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Asia sʋ'ʋlimin la pʋ'ʋsidi ya. Akuila nɛ Prisila nɛ Wina'am nimbanɛ la'asidi ba yin la pʋ'ʋsidi ya sʋ'ʋŋa, yanam wʋsaa an yinne nɛ ti Zugsɔb la zug.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Ba'abiis la wʋsa pʋ'ʋsidi ya. Pʋ'ʋsimi taaba nɛ nɔŋilim.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Man mɛŋ nu'ug ka m sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa, ye man Paul n pʋ'ʋsidi ya.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɛkama pʋ nɔŋ Zugsɔb la, kaanb bɛ'ɛd bɛ on sɔb zugin. Ti sɔsidi ti Zugsɔb ye o kena.

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb Yesu yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ ya.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: M nɔŋilim bɛ nɛ ya wʋsa, tinamɛ an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo la zug. Ami!

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Man Paul, onɛ ka Wina'am gaŋim nɛ o bɔɔdim ye m an Yesu Kristo Tʋmtʋm la, nɛ ti ba'abiig Timoti, sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid Wina'am nimbanɛ wʋsaa bɛ Korint nɛ Akaia tɛɛnsin la wʋsa.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na tisi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Yɛltɔɔg pʋʋgin sʋŋir yɛla

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo Ba' la bareka, on onɛ aan ti Ba' ka zɔti ti nimbaanlig, ka an Wina'am ka sʋŋir wʋsa yit o san'an na la.

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: O sʋŋidi tii ti yɛltɔɔd wʋsa pʋʋgin, ye ti nyaŋidi nɔkid sʋŋir kanɛ ka ti di'ed Wina'am san'an la sʋŋid banɛ wʋsa mɔr yɛltɔɔd.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ sadigim nyɛt namisʋg bɛdegʋ Kristo zug la, ala mɛn ka ti na di'e sʋŋir bɛdegʋ yit Kristo san'an na.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a nyɛ yɛltɔɔg, li anɛ yanam sʋŋir nɛ ya faangir yɛla. Ka tinam ya'a nyɛ sʋŋir Wina'am san'an, yanam mɛ na nyɛ sʋŋir, ka li na yinɛ lin ni, ka ya na di'e paŋi nyaŋi mɔdigi ya namisʋg pʋʋgin nwɛnɛ tinamɛ nyɛ namisʋg si'em la.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Ti ti'ir kanɛ ka ti mɔri ya yɛla la ka' bi'esʋgɔ. Bɔzugɔ, ti mi' ye yanamɛ sadigim namisid wʋʋ tinamɛ namisid si'em la, ya na di'e sʋŋir wʋʋ tinamɛ di'ed si'em la mɛn.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, ti bɔɔd ye ya baŋ yɛltɔɔg kanɛ ka ti daa nyɛ Asia teŋin la yɛla. Yɛltɔɔg la daa daami ti bɛdegʋ ka gaadi ti paŋ bɛn, ka ti daa pʋ lɛn tɛn'ɛsid vʋm yɛlaa.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Li ya'a an sida, ti tɛn'ɛs ka li nwɛnɛ ba kadi ti saria kʋʋs kɔɔtʋ ni ka li an kum. Nɛ'ɛŋa niŋnɛ ye ti da ti'e ti mɛŋ paŋa, amaa ka lɛɛ ti'enɛ Wina'am onɛ vʋ'ʋgid nidib kumin la.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: O faaɛn ti yɛltɔɔg tita'ar dinɛ an kum la ni, ka ti mi' ye o na lɛn faaɛn ti, ka mɔr ti'ir o san'an ye o na lɛn faaɛn ti ya'as,

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: wʋʋ yanamɛ sɔsid Wina'am tisidi ti si'em la. Dinzugɔ nidib bɛdegʋ na pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka on niŋ si'eli tisi ti la zug. Bʋn dinɛ kɛ ka Paul tiak o suor la yɛla

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Tinam nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ'ɛŋa yɛla bɔzugɔ ti pʋtɛnda dit kasɛt ye ti nyaŋi gban'e ti mɛŋ dunia nwa' ni. Linɛ gaadi li wʋsa anɛ tinam nɛ yanam bɛllim an sʋ'ʋŋa si'em la, ka li yinɛ Wina'am an sʋm nyain ka an yɛlsida daan la ni. Li anɛ Wina'am pʋpielim zug ka li ka'anɛ ninsaalib ya'am kɛ ka ti nyaŋi tʋm alaa.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Ti ɛɛnti pʋ sɔbid dinɛ ka ya na karim ka kʋ nyaŋi gban'e li gbinnɛ.

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ daa gban'e li gbin bi'ela la, m mɔr ti'ir ye ya na gban'e linɛ ka ti sɔb la gbin sʋ'ʋŋa ye Yesu Kristo lɛbig daar la na, ya na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg tinam yɛla wʋʋ tinamɛ na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgʋ ya yɛla si'em la.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: M daa mi' nɛ' yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa, linzug ka m daa gban'e ye m na kena kaae ya yiiga ka ya di nyɔɔd nɔɔr ayi' la.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: M daa gban'e ye m na kɛɛn ya san'an na ka nyaan gaadi keŋ Masedonia teŋin, ka m ya'a ti lɛbid na m na lɛn kaae ya ka ya sʋŋim ka m gaadi keŋ Juda teŋin.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Ya tɛn'ɛs ye m gban'ar la ka' sʋ'ʋŋa? Bɛɛ ya tɛn'ɛs ye m gban'ar la dɔlnɛ ninsaalib bɔɔdim dinɛ ka m na siak ye ɛɛn ka lɛn yɛl ye ayei nɛɛ?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Wina'am anɛ yɛlsida sɔb, ala mɛn ka li an sida ye tinamɛ yɛti ya si'el la, ti kʋ kpanbidi siakid ye ɛɛn nɛ ayei nɛɛ.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo onɛ an Wina'am Biig, ka mam Paul nɛ Timoti nɛ Silvanus daa mɔɔl o yɛla ya san'an la pʋ mɔr bi'esʋgɔ. Li anɛ ɛɛn o san'an saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Li yinɛ Yesu Kristo ni na ka Wina'am siak ye ɛɛn, ye o na niŋ linɛ ka o kaanbi li yɛla la wʋsa. Ka linzug ka ti pʋ'ʋsʋg pʋʋgin ka li yinɛ Yesu Kristo ni ka ti yɛl ye, “Ami” ka li tisid Wina'am na'asi.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Li anɛ Wina'am kɛt ka tinam nɛ yanam zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ Kristo san'an, ka gaŋi ti ye ti tʋm o tʋʋma,

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Wina'am aan m kasɛt ye mam pʋ lɛb Korint la, m faaɛn ya nɛ yak.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
