translation_verse: Ti pʋ bɔɔd ye ti mugusi ya ka ya siak dinɛ ka ya pʋ niŋ yaddaa; ti mi' ye ya zi'e sʋ'ʋŋa ya yadda niŋir la ni. Ti lɛɛ tʋm nɛ taaba ye ya nyɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: M daa gban'e m sʋʋnrin ye man ye m kena kaae ya kaasi'a la kʋ kɛ ka ya sʋnf san'am.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Ka m ya'a kɛt ka ya sʋnf san'amid, anɔ'ɔnɛ bɛɛ na tisim sumalisim? Sɔ' kae, asɛɛ yanam banɛ ka m kɛ ka ya sʋnf san'am la.

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: M daa pʋ bɔɔd ye nimbanɛ na tisim sumalisim la kɛ ka m mɔr sʋnsa'aŋa, ka linzug ka m daa sɔb gbauŋ kan la. M mi' ya sʋ'ʋŋa ka mi' ye m ya'a mɔr sumalisim, yanam mɛ na mɔr sumalisim.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Man daa sɔbid ye m tisi ya la m daa mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ daamʋg m sʋnfʋn bɛdegʋ, ka li kɛ ka m kaasid, ka li ka' ye m bɔɔd ye m kɛ ka ya sʋnf san'am, ka anɛ ye m kɛ ka ya baŋ man nɔŋi ya si'em bɛdegʋ. Lin nar ye ba bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb taal si'em

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Nid yinne ya sʋʋgin ya'a kɛ ka sɔ' sʋnf san'am, li ka' ye o san'amnɛ man sʋnfɔ, amaa o san'amnɛ yanam wʋsa sʋnf. M pʋ bɔɔd ye ya sʋnf san'am bɛdegʋʋ.

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: Nannanna li nar ka ya dii o suguru ka kpɛmis o sʋnf, ka li kɛ ka o sʋnf da san'am bɛdegʋ ka o luu.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: M bɛlimi ya nɛ ye ya kɛ ka o lɛm baŋ ye ya sid nɔŋ o.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: M daa sɔb gbauŋ kaŋa nɛ ye m kpansi ya gɔs ye ya na siak man yɛti ya si'el la bɛɛ ya kʋ siakɛ.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a di sɔ' suguru, mam mɛ na dii o daana suguru. Ka si'el ya'a bɛɛ an ye m di suguru ka kɛɛ bas, m na kɛɛ li bas Kristo tuon yanam zug

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: ka li kɛ ka Sʋntaana da nyaŋi tii. Bɔzugɔ ti mi' o gban'abɛ'ɛd la yɛla. Paul sʋnsa'aŋ Troas teŋin la yɛla

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Man daa paae Troas teŋin ye m mɔɔl Kristo labasʋŋ la, ka nyɛ ka Zugsɔb la pʋn ti'eb suosʋŋʋ digil.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: Amaa ka m daa pʋ mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm mam pʋ nyɛɛm ba'abiig Titus anina la zug. Dinzug ka m kɛɛs nidib la ka gaadi keŋ Masedonia teŋin. Tinamɛ kɛt ka nidib baŋid Kristo la yɛla

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Amaa ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka bɔzugɔ, onɛ dɔlisid Kristo san'ani tisidi ti nyaŋir ka dɔlisidi ti san'ani kɛt ka ti mɔɔn Kristo labaar la ka li tiigid zin'ig wʋsa wʋʋ tudaar linɛ nyuugʋ malis nɛ.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
translation_verse: Banɛ bɔdig la san'an ti nwɛnɛ nyuug bɛ'ɛd dinɛ an kum tisi ba. Amaa ti anɛ nyuug dinɛ an sʋm ka an nyɔvʋri tis banɛ nyɛ faangir la. Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi tʋm tʋʋm kaŋa?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Tinam pʋ nwɛnɛ nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ mɔɔn Wina'am labaar wʋʋ ba kuosid la'adi bɔɔd nyɔɔd la. Amaa ti anɛ banɛ ka Wina'am gaŋi tii tʋm, ka ti pian'ad sida Wina'am tuon ka an yinne nɛ Kristo.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Ya tɛn'ɛs ye ti lɛm pin'ili pian'adnɛ tinamɛ an sʋm si'em bɛɛ? Bɛɛ ya tɛn'ɛs ye ti nwɛnɛ nimbanɛ bɔɔd gbana dinɛ na pa'al tinamɛ an sʋm si'em tisi ya bɛɛ yiti ya san'an na?

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Yanam mɛŋ nwɛnɛ gbauŋ ka ti sɔbi ti sʋnya ni, ka sɔ' wʋsa baŋ ka karimi li.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: Ya pa'ali ya mɛŋ ye ya anɛ gbauŋ ka Kristo mɛŋ sɔb ka li yinɛ tinam tʋʋma la ni. O pʋ nɔk si'eli sɔb kuglammir zugɔ, ka lɛɛ nɔk Wina'am onɛ vʋe la Siig Kasi la sɔb ninsaalib sʋnya ni.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Ti yɛt nɛ' nɛ kpi'euŋ ka li anɛ tinamɛ mɔr Wina'am ti san'an ka li yinɛ Yesu Kristo ni na la.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Si'el ka' ti san'anɛ pa'al ye tinam mɛŋ tɛn'ɛs ye ti na nyaŋi tʋm tʋʋm kaŋaa. Amaa li anɛ Wina'am kɛ ka ti nyaŋidi tʋmmi li.

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: O tisi ti paŋ kanɛ ka ti na nyaŋi tʋm nɔnapaal la tʋʋma. Nɔnaar Paal la ka'anɛ wada ka ba sɔbɛ, amaa li yinɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la ni na. Bɔzugɔ, wada linɛ ka ba sɔb la ziidi kum na, amaa ka Siig Kasi la tisid nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Wina'am da tis wada dinɛ ta'asid kum la na ka li sɔb kuglammir kanɛ ka ba kpi'a la zug, ka o na'am pipilim nie nyain li tisibin la. Ka Moses nindaa pɛlig ka nyɛɛn pil-pil, ka Israel dim pʋ nyaŋi gɔsi lii, la'an nɛ pipilim la da sied la. Wada dinɛ ta'asid kum la ya'a da mɔr pipilim anwa,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: ka labasʋŋ dinɛ tisid Wina'am Siig Kasi la kʋ mɔr pipilim gaad ala?

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Ka wada dinɛ kɛ ka nidib nyɛt kʋʋsbɛ'ɛd la ya'a da mɔr pipilim, labasʋŋ dinɛ kɛ ka ti an pʋpielim dim Wina'am tuon la kʋ pɛligi gaad alaa?

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Sida, pipilim dinɛ bɛ nannanna nwa' gaad pipilim dinɛ da bɛ la bɛdegʋ, ka dinzug ka pipilim dinɛ da bɛ la lieb zaalim.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Linɛ kʋ ya'as naar la ya'a da mɔr pipilim, dinɛ bɛ nannanna nwa' ka kʋ naae la, kʋ mɔr pipilim bɛdegʋ gaad alaa?

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ mɔr ti'ir kaŋa la zug, ka ti sʋnf kpi'em,

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: ka ti pʋ nwɛnɛ Moses onɛ da nɔk pienni lus o nindaa ye Israel dim da nyɛɛ o nindaa pipilim dinɛ sied la naarɛ.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Amaa li da ligil Israel dim la ya'am nɛ. Ka lin yi saŋkan la ti paae zina, ba ya'a karim nɔnaar kʋdʋg gbauŋ la, li nwɛnɛ pien la nan kpɛm bɛnɛ, ka ba pʋ gban'ad ban karim si'el la gbinnɛ. Li anɛ onɛ di'e Kristo ma'aa ka pien la na pilig.

english_verse: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
translation_verse: Sida, saŋkan la ti paae zina, ba ya'a karim Moses gbauŋ la, pien la nan kpɛn ligili ba ya'am nɛ.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' ya'a siak ka dɔl Zugsɔb la, pien la na bɔdig o ni.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb onɛ ka ba dɔl la anɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi. Ka Zugsɔb Siig Kasi la bɛ si'el la, yɔlisim mɛ bɛ anina.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: Pien pʋ ligil tinam banɛ wʋsa dɔl Zugsɔb la nindaasɛ. Ka Zugsɔb la na'am pipilim nie ti ni, ka tiakidi ti ye ti nwɛnɛ on an si'em la. Ka o na'am pipilim bɛɛ ti ni nɔbigid bɛdegʋ paasid. Ka li wʋsa yinɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Siig Kasi la ni na.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Wina'am zɔti ti nimbaanlig la zug ka o tisi ti tʋʋm kaŋa, dinzug ka ti pʋ sin'igida.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ti zan'asnɛ ye ti kʋ dɔl nyan tʋʋma nɛ dinɛ ka nidib su'adi tʋm la wʋsa, ka mɛ pʋ ma'ad nidib bɛɛ tiakid Wina'am pian'ad ye li dɔl ziri suoyaa, ka lɛɛ pian'ad yɛlsida paalʋ ni, ka niŋidi li Wina'am tuon. Ti pa'ali ti mɛŋ nimbanɛ mɔr ya'am mi' dinɛ an sʋm nɛ bɛ'ɛd la ye ba baŋ ye ti niŋid dinɛ an sʋm.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Ka hali labasʋŋ kanɛ ka ti mɔɔn la ya'a ligilnɛ, li ligilnɛ tis banɛ bɔdig la.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: Sʋntaana onɛ sʋ'oe dunia nwa' la kɛ ka banɛ pʋ niŋ Wina'am yadda la ya'am an lik, ka ba kʋ nyaŋi baŋ labasʋŋ linɛ yit Kristo onɛ nwɛnɛ Wina'am an si'em la girima la.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ mɔɔnnɛ ti mɛŋ yɛlaa, ka lɛɛ mɔɔn ye Yesu Kristo an Zugsɔb la, ka tinam lɛɛ aan ya tʋmtʋmnib Yesu zug.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, Wina'am onɛ da yɛl ye, “Kɛl ka nɛɛsim nie nyain likin la,” onɛ kɛ ka o nɛɛsim nie ti sʋnfʋn nyain ye li tisi ti baŋir dinɛ an Wina'am na'am pipilim dinɛ ka ti nyɛ Kristo san'an la. Ti paŋ ka'alim pa'an Wina'am paŋi an si'em

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: Amaa kpan'am linɛ ka ti mɔr la kɛ ka ti nwɛnɛ dʋgid banɛ ka ba su'a si'el dinɛ ligidi zu'oe bɛdegʋ, ye li pa'al ye paŋ tita'ar dinɛ ka ti mɔr la ka' tinam dinnɛ, ka lɛɛ anɛ Wina'am bʋn.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Ti nyɛt mugusʋg si'el wʋsa ni amaa ti giinla pʋ pu'asida, ka pʋtɛnda yutim saŋa si'a ka ti kpɛn mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye ti na yii li ni,

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: ka mɔr dataas bɛdegʋ, la'an nɛ la ti pʋ kɔ'ɔŋ zuaa, ka nyɛt dɛmis ka pʋ kpii,

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Ti vʋm saŋa wʋsa ka ti nyɛt namisʋg dinɛ zemis nɛ kum Yesu zug, ye nidib na nyɛ o nyɔvʋri ti niŋgbina dinɛ na kpi la ni.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Aa tɔ, kum tʋm tinam san'an, amaa ka vʋm lɛɛ tʋm yanam san'an.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye sɔ' yɛl ye, “Man niŋ Wina'am yadda la zug ka m pian'ad.” Tinamɛ mɛ niŋ o yadda wʋʋ on niŋ si'em la zug ka ti mɛ pian'ad.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Ka mi' ye Wina'am onɛ vʋ'ʋgi ti Zugsɔb Yesu kumin la mɛ na vʋ'ʋg tinam mɛn nɛ Yesu, ka la'asi ti nɛ yanamɛ mɔri ti keŋ o tuon.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Li wʋsa anɛ yanam sʋ'ʋm nyɛɛb zug ka Wina'am pʋpielim yadigid ka nidib nyɛɛ li ka paasid, ala ka ba bareka pʋ'ʋsʋg la mɛ paasidi tisid Wina'am na'asi.

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, ti giinla pʋ pu'asida. Hali la'an nɛ ti ninsaal niŋgbina tadigid la, Wina'am kɛt ka ti nyɛt vʋmpaali ti siigin daar wʋsa.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Namisʋg dinɛ ka ti nyɛt la anɛ bi'ela ka na gaad, ka lɛɛ kɛ ka ti na nyɛ na'asi tita'ar dinɛ ka' naarɛ, ka li gati ti namisʋg la bɛdegʋ, ka ti kʋ nyaŋi maki li nɛ ti namisʋg laa.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Ti nɔki ti sʋnfʋ lɔ nɛ bʋn dinɛ ka ti pʋ nyɛtaa, amaa ka'anɛ bʋn dinɛ ka ti nyɛta. Bʋn dinɛ ka ti nyɛt la kʋ ya'as naarɛ, ka dinɛ ka ti pʋ nyɛt la na bɛ yʋma dinɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye ti niŋgbina dinɛ nwɛnɛ fuug dɔɔg la ya'a ti san'am, ti na paam niŋgbiŋ si'a arezana ni ka li nwɛnɛ dɔkanɛ ka Wina'am mɛŋ mɛ' ka ka' ninsaaliba. Niŋgbiŋ kan la na bɛ yʋma dinɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Ti mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ dunia nwa' ni ka bɔɔd nɛ ti sʋnf wʋsa ye Wina'am na nɔki ti arezana niŋgbiŋ la yɛɛli ti wʋʋ fuug nɛ.

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ ti ya'a yɛ arezana fuug la ti kʋ ken biellɛ.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ bɛɛ ti dunia niŋgbiŋin la, ka ti mɔr daamʋgʋ ti sʋnfʋn ka sin'immi li zug. Li ka'anɛ ye ti pʋ bɔɔd ye ti mɔri ti dunia niŋgbiŋ laa; li lɛɛ anɛ ye ti bɔɔd ye Wina'am nɔki ti arezana niŋgbiŋ la yɛɛli ti bɔzugɔ vʋm na nyaŋ niŋgbiŋ dinɛ na kpi la.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Li anɛ Wina'am ti'ebi ti ye ti nyɛ tiakir kaŋa, ka tisi ti o Siig Kasi ye li pa'al ye ti na di'e on ye o tisi ti si'el la wʋsa.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ ti ɛɛnti mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ bɛdegʋ, ka mi' ye ti ya'a bɛɛ ti dunia niŋgbiŋin, ti ka' Zugsɔb san'an arezana nii.

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: Ka li ka'anɛ tinamɛ nyɛt o la kɛ ka ti dɔl oo, ka anɛ ti yadda niŋir yɛla.

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: Ti mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ bɛdegʋ ka na bɔɔdin ye ti basini ti dunia niŋgbiŋ la ka mɔrini ti arezana niŋgbiŋ la bɛ Zugsɔb san'an.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Ti gban'e nɛ ti sʋnf wʋsa ye ti ma'ae Zugsɔb la sʋnf ti ya'a vʋe ti niŋgbiŋ dinɛ an dunia nwa' yir la, bɛɛ ti ya'a ti kae niŋgbiŋin la ka bɛ arezana nii.

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: Li anɛ tilas ye ti wʋsa na ti zi'en Kristo tuon ka o kadi ti saria. Sɔ' mɛkama na ti di'e linɛ nar o; li ya'a an sʋm bɛɛ bɛ'ɛd, li dɔlnɛ on tʋm si'em dunia nwa' ni. Yesu Kristo san'an ka ti naalim nɛ Wina'am

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ tinamɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la dabiem nɛ ti sʋnf wʋsa la zug ka ti mɔɔd ye ti kɛ ka nidib siak Wina'am. O mi' tinamɛ an si'em sʋ'ʋŋa. Ka m mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye yanam mɛ mi' ya sʋnfʋn tinamɛ an si'em la.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ lɛm mɔɔd ye ti yɛli ya tinam sʋ'ʋm yɛla ya'asa. Ti lɛɛ mɔɔd ye ti kɛ ka ya mɔr si'eli na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgʋ ti yɛla. Ka mɔr si'eli na yɛl nimbanɛ nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg ban an si'em ka nidib nyɛti li paalʋ la, ka ka' ban an si'em ba sʋnfʋnɛ.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Ti sid anɛ gɛɛmisɛ? Li ya'a aan ala, li anɛ Wina'am yɛla. Ka ti ya'a pʋ gɛɛm li anɛ yanam mɛŋ zug.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Kristo nɔŋiri sʋ'oe ti, ka ti baŋ sʋ'ʋŋa ye dau yinne da kpii tis nidib wʋsa, ka dinzug ka nidib wʋsa da la'am kpi nɛ o.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Ka mɛ baŋ ye o da kpii tisi ba ye banɛ mɔr vʋmpaal o zug la kʋ lɛn vʋe ye ba niŋi ba mɛŋ bɔɔdim, ka lɛɛ vʋe ye ba niŋ on, onɛ kpi ka vʋ'ʋg kuminɛ tisi ba la bɔɔdim. Wina'am kɛ ka ti tiaki an nimpaala la

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ tɛn'ɛs nidibi an si'em la, pʋ lɛn dɔlnɛ ti ninsaalib pʋtɛndaa. Hali ti ya'a daa tɛn'ɛs Kristo an si'em la ka li dɔlnɛ ti ninsaalib pʋtɛnda, ti pʋ lɛn niŋid alaa.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a an yinne nɛ Kristo, Wina'am maal o ka o an nimpaal. Ka o bɔɔdim kʋdig la gaad ya, ka o yʋ'ʋn mɔr bɔɔdim paal.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Wina'am niŋi li wʋsa ka naali ti nɛ o mɛŋ, ka li yinɛ Kristo ni na, ka tisi ti tʋʋma ye ti kɛ ka nidib mɛ naal nɛ o.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Ti labaar anɛ ye Wina'am da bɛ Kristo ni ka da naal dunia dim nɛ o mɛŋ ka yisi ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas, ka gu'uli ti o naalʋŋ labaar la. Tinamɛ di'e Kristo zin'igi tʋm si'em la yɛla

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Dinzug ti anɛ Kristo tʋmtʋmnib banɛ zi'e o zi'esim ka Wina'am dɔlisidi ti nii buon nidib. Alazug, ti sɔsidi ya nɛ Kristo yʋ'ʋr zug ye ya naal nɔɔr nɛ Wina'am.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Kristo pʋ mɔr tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Ka Wina'am da kɛ ka o di'e ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa ye tinam lieb yinne nɛ o la, ka ti na di'e Wina'am pʋpielim.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ tʋm nɛ taaba Wina'am ni la, ti bɛlimi ya ye yanam banɛ di'e Wina'am pʋpielim piini la da kɛ ka li an zaalim ya san'anɛ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Wina'am da yɛl o gbauŋʋn ye, “Saŋkanɛ ka m siak ye m tisi ya m yɛlsʋm la, ka m wʋmi ya sɔsʋg. Ka faangir daar la ka m sʋŋi ya.” M na yɛli ya ye saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am siak ye o tisi ya o yɛlsʋm la anɛ nannanna nwa', ka faangir daar la an zina.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ niŋid si'el dinɛ na vi' sɔ' suor ka o luu, ka sɔ' da nyɛ taalɛ ti tʋʋma nii.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ tʋm si'el wʋsa, ti niŋidi li pa'an ye ti anɛ nimbanɛ an Wina'am tʋmtʋm sʋma. Ti daa nyɛt daamʋg nɛ fara nɛ yɛltɔɔd.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: Ba daa bʋ'ʋdi ti ka kpɛn'ɛsidi ti sanrega ni. Ka nidib bɛdegʋ giligi ti kisi ti. Ti daa tʋm tʋʋm kpi'ema bɛdegʋ, ka pʋ gbisida. Ka kɔ'ɔm daa mɔri ti, ka ti mɔdig yɛlbama ni wʋsa.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: Ti niŋid dinɛ wʋsa an nyain, ka gban'ad si'elnam gbin nɛ mɔdigir nɛ ti tʋʋm sʋma nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la paŋ nɛ sida nɔŋilim

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: nɛ ti sida pian'ad nɛ Wina'am paŋ la wʋsa pa'al ye ti anɛ nimbanɛ tʋm o tʋʋma sʋ'ʋŋa. Ti mɔr pʋpielim ka li an ti zaba la'ad ka li bɛ datiuŋ nɛ dagɔbʋg,

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: ka nyɛt na'asi nɛ nyan nɛ tʋ'ʋd nɛ zʋn'or. Ba niŋidi ti wʋʋ dama'anam ka ti lɛɛ an sida dim,

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: ka niŋidi ti wʋʋ ba zi' tii amaa nidib bɛdegʋ mi' ti, ka niŋidi ti wʋʋ ti kpinɛ ka ti lɛɛ mɔr nyɔvʋr, ka namisidi ti ka ti lɛɛ pʋ kpii.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: Ti nyɛt sʋnsa'aŋ ka lɛɛ mɔr sumalisim, ka an wʋʋ nɔŋ dim ka lɛɛ kɛ ka nidib bɛdegʋ di'ed yɛlsʋm bɛdegʋ, ka pʋ mɔr si'el dunia nwa' nii, ka lɛɛ mɔr si'el wʋsa Wina'am tuon.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: M zua sʋma banɛ bɛ Korint teŋinɛ, ti pian'adi ya nɛ nyain-nyain ka pie ti pʋʋgʋ tisi ya, ka yɔ'ɔgi ti sʋnf wʋsa tisi ya.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: M pian'adi tisidi ya wʋʋ ya anɛ m biis nɛ, yanam mɛ niŋimi ala ka yɔ'ɔgi ya sʋnya tisim mɛn. Da naal nɔɔr nɛ banɛ zi' Wina'am

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Da mɔr nɔɔr yinne nɛ banɛ ka' yadda niŋidib la ye ya niŋ si'ela. Pʋpielim nɛ bɛ'ɛd kʋ nyaŋi la'as taabaa. Bɛɛ lik na nyaŋi an yinne nɛ nɛɛsim?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Kristo nɛ Sʋntaana kʋ nyaŋi siak taaba nɔɔrɛ. Ka onɛ an yadda niŋid kʋ nyaŋi mɔr nɔɔr yinne nɛ onɛ ka' yadda niŋida.

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kʋ nyaŋi an yinne nɛ badaa. Tinam mɛŋ anɛ Wina'am onɛ vʋe la yir. Li dɔlnɛ Wina'am da yɛl o gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “M na bɛɛ ba sʋʋgin ka la'am ken nɛ ba. M na aan ba Wina'am. Ka ba na aan m nidib.”

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: “M na aan ya Ba' ka yanam mɛ aan m biribis nɛ m bipumis, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em la.”

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: M zuanɔŋa, kaanb bama anɛ ti din. Dinzugɔ kɛlli ka ti bas si'el wʋsa dinɛ kɛt ka ti niŋgbina nɛ ti siis an dian'ad la, ka lieb nyain. Kɛlli ka ti na'asid Wina'am ka aan o nimbanɛ an kasi ka an nyain. Paul n mɔr sumalisim nɛ Korint dim la yɛla

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ya nɔŋilim an bɛdegʋ ti san'an. Ti pʋ tʋm sɔ' bɛ'ɛdɛ, ka pʋ san'am sɔ' yadda niŋirɛ, ka pʋ nɔki ti tʋʋma zugʋ di'e si'el sɔ' san'anɛ.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Man pian' nɛ'ɛŋa la, m pʋ yɛl ye ya tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ; m pʋn dɛŋi yɛl ye, tinam nɔŋi ya nɛ hali. Ka ti ya'a vʋe bɛɛ ti kpinɛ ti kʋ basi ti nɔɔr yinne laa.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Mam mi' ya pʋʋg sʋ'ʋŋa la zug ka m nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgʋ ya yɛla. Ti yɛltɔɔd wʋsa pʋʋgin m nam mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ; ka mɔr sumalisim bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Hali nɛ tinamɛ daa paae Masedonia teŋin la, ti daa pʋ nyɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm. Yɛltɔɔd daa bɛ zin'is wʋsa ka zaba mɛ bɛ. Ka ti mɛŋ mɔr dabiem ti sʋnfʋn.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am onɛ kɛt ka banɛ mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ nyɛt kpɛmisʋg la daa kɛ ka Titus kena, ka ti sʋnf kpɛ'ɛŋ,

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: ka li ka' o ken la na ma'aanɛɛ, amaa on daa yɛli ti yanamɛ daa kpɛ'ɛŋ o sʋnf si'em la. O yɛli ti yanamɛ bɔɔd hali ye ya nyɛɛm, ka mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ si'em nɛ dinɛ daa niŋ la, Ka sɔ' ya'a pian' bɛ'ɛd man yɛla, yanam ɛɛnti kpɛ'ɛŋi ya mɛŋi lɛbis sʋ'ʋm man yɛla. Ka dinzug ka m sumalisim maligim paas bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Hali gbauŋ kanɛ ka m daa sɔb la ya'a daa san'ami ya sʋnya, m sʋnf pʋ san'am man sɔbi li laa. M nyɛ ka m gbauŋ la daa san'ami ya sʋnya, amaa li anɛ saŋa bi'ela.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: M mɔr sumalisim nannanna, ka li ka'anɛ man daa kɛ ka ya sʋnf san'am la yɛlaa, ka lɛɛ anɛ ya sʋnsa'aŋ la daa kɛ ka ya tiaki ya suoya la zug. Sʋnsa'aŋ kaŋa anɛ dinɛ ka Wina'am tisi ya, ka dinzug ka gbauŋ kanɛ ka ti daa sɔb la pʋ kɛ ka ya nyɛ bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Sʋnsa'aŋ dinɛ ka Wina'am kɛt ka li paad nidib la tiakidi ba sʋnya ka linzug ka ba na nyɛ faangir. Li pʋ mɔr ye m ya'a daa baŋinɛ, amaa dunia sʋnsa'aŋ dɔlli kum.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Ya nyɛ Wina'am kɛ ka ya sʋnsa'aŋ dɔl suosi'a. Li daa kɛ ka ya tɛn'ɛs dinɛ daa niŋi ya san'an la yɛla nɛ nimmua, ka kɛ ka ya mɔɔd bɛdegʋ ye ya pa'al ye ya ka' taal yɛlkaŋa nii, ka ya sʋnya duoe, ka ya zɔt dabiem, ka bɔɔd nɛ ya sʋnya wʋsa ye ya nyɛɛm ka mɔɔd ye ya niŋ dinɛ an sʋm, ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya mɛŋ ye ya namis onɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kaŋa la. Ya pa'alya ye ya ka' taal yɛlkaŋa wʋsa nii.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Hali nɛ man daa sɔbi tisi ya si'em la, m daa pʋ sɔbi li onɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kaŋa bɛɛ onɛ ka o maal bɛ'ɛdi tis o la zugɔ, ka lɛɛ sɔbi li ye li kɛ ka ya baŋ sʋ'ʋŋa Wina'am tuon yanamɛ nɔŋi ti bɛdegʋ si'em.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Ka dinzugʋ kɛ ka ti sʋnya kpɛ'ɛŋ. Li ka'anɛ lin ma'anɛ, li mɛ malisi ti tinamɛ nyɛ ka Titus mɔr sumalisim bɛdegʋ la. Bɔzugɔ ya kɛya ka o sʋnsa'aŋ la naae, dinɛ kɛ ka ti sumalisim paas bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: M daa nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgʋ ya yɛla Titus san'an ka ya mɛ pʋ diisim nyannɛ. Ti ɛɛnti pian'ad sida tisidi ya. Ala ka tinamɛ daa pian'ad si'eli nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg Titus ni la daa sid an sida.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: Titus tɛnri ya wʋsaa kpɛ'ɛŋi ya mɛŋi siak o nɔɔr ka di'e o nɛ zɔtim si'em la. Dinzug ka o nɔŋilim ya san'an nɔbigid bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: M mi' ye ya na niŋ man yɛli ya si'el la wʋsa dinzug ka m mɔr sumalisim.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, ti bɔɔd ye ya baŋ Wina'am tis o nimbanɛ bɛ Masedonia teŋin la pʋpielim si'em.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: M yɛli ya ye ba daa tis ka li zemisi ba paŋi na tun'e si'em, hali ba tis ka li gaadi ba paŋ bɛn.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: Ba daa sɔsi ti nɛ nimmua ye ba bɔɔdim anɛ ye ti tisi ba suor ka ba mɛ sʋŋ Wina'am nidib la.

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: Ba daa niŋ ka li gaad tinamɛ tɛn'ɛs si'em la. Ba daa zaŋi ba mɛŋ yiiga tis Zugsɔb la la'an nɛ tinam mɛn, ka li dɔl Wina'am bɔɔdim an si'em.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ ti kpɛ'ɛŋ Titus onɛ pin'il ligidi la'asʋg tʋʋma ya san'an la ye o sʋŋi ya ka ya naae pʋpielim tʋʋm kaŋa.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Amaa nwɛnɛ yanamɛ nyaŋidi maan si'el wʋsa si'em la, ya yadda niŋir Kristo ni, ya pian'ad Wina'am yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa ka mɔr Wina'am mi'ilim bɛdegʋ ka mɔɔd ye ya sʋŋ nidib ka nɔŋi ti bɛdegʋ. Kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya mɛŋi mɛ tʋm pʋpielim tʋʋm kaŋa.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: M pʋ yɛt nwa' nɛ paŋa. Amaa m zaŋ nɛ ninsieba tʋm si'el la ye m mak ka baŋi ya sida nɔŋilim la zem si'em.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Ya mi' ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo pʋpielim an si'em. Hali la'an nɛ on da an yɛlsʋm wʋsa daan la, o da lieb nɔŋdaan yanam sʋ'ʋm nyɛɛb zug. Li anɛ on lieb nɔŋdaan la kɛ ka yanam lieb kpan'am dim.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Mam mɔr sa'alsi'a tisidi ya yɛlkaŋa nwa' ni anɛ ye, yʋʋm kanɛ gaad la yanamɛ da dɛŋ yiiga tis, ka li ka' din ma'aanɛ, amaa ya da mɔr ya'amlɛog ye ya tʋmi li.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Nannanna naami tʋʋm kanɛ ka ya daa mɔɔd nɛ ya'amlɛog ye ya tʋm naae li la, ka li zemisi ya paŋ bɛn. Kɛlli ka ya tisib la zemis yanamɛ mɔr si'em.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a mɔr ya'amlɛog ye o tis piini, Wina'am na di'e o piini la ka li dɔlnɛ on tis ka li zemis on mɔr si'em bɛn la, ka ka'anɛ dinɛ ka o pʋ mɔra.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Ti bɔɔdim ka' ye ti yis sieba ba namisʋgʋn ka li lieb mugusʋgʋ tisi yaa. Amaa li sʋ'ʋm ye li zem taaba.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: Ka yanamɛ mɔr bɛdegʋ nannanna la, sʋŋimi banɛ an nɔŋ dim la. Ban mɛ na ti mɔr bɛdegʋ ka sʋŋi ya, ya bɔɔdim saŋa. Ala ka ya wʋsa na zem taaba.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Ninkanɛ vaae bɛdegʋ la pʋ mɔr ka li zu'oe galisɛ. Ka ninkanɛ vaae bi'ela la pʋ mɔr ka li pɔɔdi galisɛ.”

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka on kɛ ka Titus mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye o sʋŋi ya wʋʋ tinamɛ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr si'em la.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: O daa pʋ siaki ti kpɛmisʋg ma'aanɛ, amaa o mɛ daa mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye o sʋŋi ya, ka gban'e nɛ o mɛŋ bɔɔdim ye o kɛɛn ya san'an na.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Ti ye ti tʋm nɛ ti ba'abiig sɔ' ka on nɛ Titus kena. O anɛ on ka Wina'am nidib wʋsa na'asid o on tʋm si'em ka mɔɔn labasʋŋ la zug.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Karindɔɔd la mɛ daa lɛn gaŋ o ye o giligid nɛ ti ka sʋŋidi ti nɛ pʋpielim tʋʋm kaŋa. Ti tʋm pʋpielim tʋʋm kaŋa ye ti na'as Zugsɔb la, ka sid pa'al ye ti bɔɔd ye ti sʋŋ.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Ti gu'usidi ti mɛŋ ye sɔ' da pian' bɛ'ɛd nɛ piintita'ar kanɛ ka ti tʋm la yɛlaa,

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: ka bɔɔd ye ti niŋ dinɛ an sʋm Wina'am tuon nɛ ninsaalib san'an mɛn.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Ti mɛ lɛn tʋmnɛ ti ba'abiig sɔ' ya'as ye o paasi ba. Ti daa nyɛ on tʋm si'em saŋa bɛdegʋ ka baŋ ye o ti'e ye o sʋŋ. Nannanna o mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr bɛdegʋ ye o sʋŋi ya, on mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye ya na niŋ tinamɛ yɛli ya si'em la zug.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ ti ba'abiig Titus yɛla, o anɛ m tʋmtʋm tiraan onɛ tʋm nɛ man ye ti sʋŋi ya. Ka li ya'a anɛ ti ba'abibanɛ ye ba dɔl o la yɛla, ba anɛ banɛ ka Wina'am nidib tʋmi ba na, ye li kɛ ka Kristo nyɛ na'asi.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Pa'alimini ba ya nɔŋilim, nɛ dinɛ kɛ ka ti nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgʋ ya yɛla la, ka Wina'am nidib nyɛ ka baŋ ye li anɛ sida.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: Li pʋ lɛn nar ye m sɔbi yɛli ya piini dinɛ ka ya na tis Wina'am nidib la yɛlaa.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: M mi' ye ya mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye ya sʋŋ, ka nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgʋ tisid Masedonia nidib la. M yɛti ba ye yʋʋm sa ka Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Akaia teŋin la da ti'eb ye ba sʋŋ. Yanamɛ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye ya sʋŋ si'em la, kpɛmisimini ba bɛdegʋ sa.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: Amaa m tʋmnɛ ti ba'abibama ye li pa'al ye man nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgʋ ya yɛla yɛlkaŋa nwa' ni la da lieb zaalim, amaa ka lɛɛ an sida, ka ya sid ti'eb nɛ ya piini la wʋʋ man yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Masedonia dim la sieba ya'a dɔllimi kena ka nyɛ ka ya pʋ ti'ebɛ, nyan na dii ti bɛdegʋ, ka m pʋ lɛn yɛt yanam yɛlaa. Nyan na dii ti, tinamɛ daa tɛn'ɛs ye ya na ti'eb nɛ ya piini la zug.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Ka dinzug ka m gɔs ka li nar ye m tʋmi ti ba'abiis la ka ba gaad tuon na kɛ ka ya dɛŋi ti'eb piinkanɛ ka ya zi'el nɔɔr ye ya tis la. Ala ka m ya'a ti paae na, ka ya pʋn ti'eb nɛ ya piini la, li na pa'al ye ya tisidnɛ nɛ ya bɔɔdim ka ka' sɔ' mugusi ya.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Tɛnri ye ninkanɛ bʋd bi'ela na bun bi'ela, ka onɛ bʋd bɛdegʋ na bun bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ya sɔ' mɛkama niŋ wʋʋ on gban'e si'em la, ka ka'anɛ sʋnsa'aŋ bɛɛ sɔ' mugusidi yaa. Wina'am nɔŋ onɛ tisid piini nɛ sumalisim,

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Wina'am na nyaŋi tisi ya ka li gaad yanamɛ bɔɔd si'em. Ka ya na mɔr yanamɛ bɔɔd si'el wʋsa, ka ya na nyaŋi tis piini ka li sʋŋ tʋʋm sʋma wʋsa.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn pʋpielnam yɛla si'em la ye, “O nɔk piini bɛdegʋ tis nɔŋ dim, ka o pʋpielim la na bɛ yʋma dinɛ ka' naarɛ.”

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ tisid kpaad bʋmbʋta ka tisid nidib diib ka ba dit la, o mɛ na tisi ya yɛlsʋm ka li zemisi ya bɔɔdim ka kɛ ka li nɔbig, ka mɛ kɛ ka yanamɛ tisid si'el nɛ yamlɛog la nɔbig.

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: O na kɛ ka ya na mɔr arezak bɛdegʋ ka na kpɛn ken tuonnɛ tisid piini saŋa wʋsa. Ka li kɛ ka li dɔlisi ti ni ka ya piini la an bareka pʋ'ʋsim tis Wina'am.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Sʋŋir kanɛ ka ya tisid Wina'am nidib la pʋ sʋŋid ban ma'aanɛ, amaa li mɛ kɛt ka nidib bɛdegʋ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Sʋŋir kaŋa pa'an yanamɛ an si'em ka kɛ ka nidib nyɛt ka ya siaki dɔl Kristo labasʋŋ la. Dinzug ka ba na zun'e Wina'am ka pʋ'ʋs o bareka yanamɛ mɔr nɔɔr yinne nɛ ba ka tisidi ba piintitada, ka mɛ mɔr nɔɔr yinne nɛ Wina'am nidib wʋsa la.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: Ban sɔsid Wina'am tisidi ya la, ba sʋnf na bɛɛ ya san'an, yɛlsʋm tita'ar dinɛ ka Wina'am tisi ya la zug.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka o piintita'ar dinɛ zu'oe gat tinamɛ na nyaŋi pian' li yɛla la.

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Man Paul, onɛ ka ya yɛl ye m ya'a bɛɛ ya san'an m zɔtnɛ dabiem, amaa m ya'a ka' ya san'anɛ, m mɔri sʋnkpi'euŋʋ pian'ad la, m bɛlimidi ya nɛ Kristo sumbʋgʋsʋm,

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: ka sɔsidi ya ye m ya'a ti kena, m kʋ lɛm pian'ad nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋɔ. M mi' ye m na nyaŋi mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋʋ sa'al banɛ yɛl ye ti tʋʋma dɔlli ti ninsaalib bɔɔdim la.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: Hali la'an nɛ tinamɛ bɛ dunia ni la ti pʋ nwɛ'ɛd tanp nwɛnɛ dunia nidibi niŋid si'em laa.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Zaba la'abanɛ ka ti mɔri zabid la ka'anɛ dunia nwa' dinnɛ. Ti lɛɛ mɔri Wina'am zaba la'ad dinɛ gaad zaba la'ad wʋsa la san'amid kpi'euŋ zin'is wʋsa.

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: Ka san'amid ziri nɔŋgbannwa'ar wʋsa nɛ dinɛ wʋsa na dʋ'ʋsi li mɛŋ nɛ nyɛɛsim ye li gu' nidib ka ba da baŋ Wina'am la. Ti nyaŋ pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd wʋsa ka ba siaki an Kristo din.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Ya gɔsidi si'elnam yiŋ ma'aa ka gban'adi ya gban'ar. Sɔ' ya'a bɛ ka tɛn'ɛs ye o anɛ Kristo nid, on tɛn'ɛsim ye tinam mɛ anɛ Kristo nidib wʋʋ on an si'em la.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: M nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ paŋ kanɛ ka Wina'am tisi ti la yɛla, dinɛ kɛ ka ti kpɛmisidi ya, ka ka'anɛ dinɛ na san'ami ya yaddaa. Hali m pʋ zɔti li nyan nɛ man nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg laa.

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: M pʋ bɔɔd ye m niŋ ka li nwɛnɛ m kpɛn'ɛsidi ya nɛ dabiem nɛ m gbana laa.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Sieba yɛt ye, “O gbana la kpi'emnɛ ka tɛbis hali. Amaa o ya'a bɛɛ ti san'an o mɔr dabiem ka o pian'ad ka' gbinnɛ.”

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Ninkan daana baŋim ye lin ka ti yɛt gbana ni la, ti ya'a kɛɛn ya san'an na, ala ka ti mɛ na niŋ.

english_verse: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
translation_verse: Ti pʋn kʋ yɛl ye ti an sʋm wʋʋ banɛ tɛn'ɛs ye ba an sʋm hali si'em laa. Ba ya'a makidi ba mɛŋ nɛ taaba ka mamisidi ba mɛŋ nɛ ba taaba, ba ka' ya'am.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Ti lɛɛ kʋ nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg ka li gaad Wina'am tisi ti si'el la bɛnnɛ, amaa ti na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgʋ zemis tʋʋm kanɛ ka o tisi ti la bɛn. Ka ti tʋʋma ya san'an la zemis on tisi ti si'em la ka ya mɛ paasi li ni.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgʋ gati li bɛn lin sadigim an sida ye tinamɛ daa an yiiga dim banɛ kɛɛn ya san'an na nɛ Kristo labasʋŋ la.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ ti pʋ nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ tʋʋm banɛ ka sieba tʋm la nwɛnɛ tinamɛ tʋmi lii, ka lɛɛ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye ya yadda niŋir Wina'am ni na nɔbig ka ti na nyaŋi tʋm ya san'an ka li gaad tinamɛ daa ɛɛnti tʋm si'em la, ka li zemis nɛ Wina'am tisi ti si'em la bɛn.

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: Ala ka ti yʋ'ʋn na mɔɔl labasʋŋ la tɛɛns banɛ bɛ ya tuon la. Bɔzugɔ, ti pʋ bɔɔd ye ti nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg nɛ tʋʋm kan ka sɔ' dɛŋi tʋm o sʋ'ʋlim kanɛ ka Wina'am tis o ye o tʋm la nii.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: Li dɔlnɛ lin da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn si'em la ye, “Onɛ bɔɔd ye o nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg on nwɛ'ɛm nyɔ'ɔg nɛ linɛ ka Zugsɔb la tʋm.”

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Li ka'anɛ ninkanɛ pian' o mɛŋ yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa la an ninsʋŋɔ, amaa li anɛ ninkanɛ ka Wina'am pian' o yɛla sʋ'ʋm la an ninsʋŋ.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Amaa m zɔti dabiem ye ba na ti ma' ya fɛndigi ya pʋtɛnda ka ya bas ka kʋ dɔl Kristo sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ ya sʋnf wʋsaa, nwɛnɛ Hawa ka waaf la da ma' o nɛ ya'ambɛ'ɛd si'em la.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a kɛɛn ya san'an na mɔɔn Yesu sɔ' yɛla, ka li ka' Yesu onɛ ka ti mɔɔl la yɛlaa, bɛɛ ya di'e siig kanɛ bɛɛ li kɔn' nɛ dinɛ ka ya pʋn di'e sa la, bɛɛ ya di'e labasʋŋ dinɛ bɛɛ li kɔn' nɛ dinɛ ka ya siak la, ya siakidi di'ed o sɔba nɛ na'ana.

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: M pʋ tɛn'ɛs ka banɛ ka ya gɔs ka ba an Yesu Kristo tʋmtʋmnib hali la gat mam nɛ.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Hali nɛ mam pʋ zamis nɔmi'ilim pian'ad la, m mɔr baŋir. Ti yɛli ya nɛ' wʋsa yɛla nyain si'el wʋsa pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: M daa mɔɔl Wina'am labasʋŋ la ya san'an, ka daa pʋ kɛ ka ya yɔ si'ela; ka siem mɛŋ ye yanam lɛɛ dʋ. Ya tɛn'ɛs ye man daa tʋm si'el la, anɛ bɛ'ɛdi tisi ya?

english_verse: I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you.
translation_verse: M daa di'e ligidi Wina'am nidib sieba san'an ye m sʋŋim mɛŋ ka lɛɛ tʋm tisi ya.

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Man daa bɛɛ ya san'an la, m ya'a daa bɔɔd si'el wʋsa, m daa pʋ daamidi yaa. Amaa li daa anɛ ti ba'abiis banɛ yi Masedonia na la daa tisidim man bɔɔd si'el wʋsa. Man daa pʋ daami ya si'el yɛla la, m na kpɛn aan ala nɛ dabisbanɛ bɛ tuon la.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Li anɛ sida ye Kristo yɛlsida bɛɛm ni. Alazug, li anɛ sida ye sɔ' kae Akaia tɛɛnsin la na vi'im ka kɛ ka m an baanlimm nɛ m nyɔ'ɔg nwɛ'ɛb la yɛlaa.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka m yɛl anwa? Mam pʋ nɔŋi ya la zug bɛɛ? Ayei. Wina'am mi' ye m nɔŋi ya.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: M na kpɛn niŋ man niŋid si'em nannanna la ka li kɛ ka ziri dim la kʋ nyɛ suori nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgʋ yɛl ye ba tʋm wʋʋ tinamɛ tʋm si'em laa.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Nimbama nwa' buudi anɛ nimbanɛ ma'ad ye ba anɛ tʋmtʋmnib, ka ma'ad ziri ba tʋʋma yɛla, ka tiaki ba mɛŋ wʋʋ ba anɛ Kristo tʋmtʋmnib banɛ an sida dim.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Li ka' yɛlsaaŋa. Hali Sʋntaana tun'e tiak o mɛŋi tu'as wʋʋ o anɛ maliak sʋŋ nɛ.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Sʋntaana tʋmtʋmnib ya'a tiaki ba mɛŋi tu'as wʋʋ nimbanɛ tʋm pʋpielim tʋʋma la, li ka' bʋnnyalimaa. Ba daar ya'a ti paae, ba na di'e dinɛ nari ba wʋʋ ba tʋʋma an si'em la. Paul namisʋg la yɛla

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Dinɛ ka m pʋn dɛŋi yɛli ya la ka m yɛti takid, sɔ' da tɛn'ɛs ye m anɛ zɔlʋgɔ. Amaa ya ya'a tɛn'ɛs ye m sid anɛ zɔlʋg, yanam dim suguru ka kɛlisim pian'ad wʋʋ yanamɛ kɛlisid zɔn pian'ad si'em la, ka m nyaŋi nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg bi'ela.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Man yɛl si'el nannanna la pʋ yit Zugsɔb san'an naa. Li ya'a anɛ m nyɔ'ɔg nwɛ'ɛb yɛla, m pian'adi wʋʋ zɔlʋg nɛ.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ sadigim nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg dinɛ an dunia bʋn yɛla la, mam mɛ na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ sadigim an ya'am dim la, dimi suguru nɛ banɛ an zɔn la!

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a tansi ya wʋʋ ya anɛ o yammis, bɛɛ di'e si'eli ya san'an yanamɛ na'asidi ba la yɛla, bɛɛ mɔri ya ba nu'usin, bɛɛ ziemi ya, bɛɛ nwɛ' ya tampian'as, ya mɔdigid ka dit suguru nɛ ba.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Linɛ kpɛn'ɛsim nyan la anɛ ye m daa siak ye ti tadignɛ li ni. Sɔ' ya'a mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋʋ na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg nɛ si'el yɛla, mam mɛ mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋʋ na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgʋ li yɛla. M pian'ad nɛ wʋʋ zɔlʋg nɛ.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg ye ba anɛ Hibiru dimaa, mam mɛ anɛ Hibiru nid, ba ya'a anɛ Israel dimaa, mam mɛ anɛ Israel nid, ba ya'a ye ba anɛ Abraham yaasɛɛ, mam mɛ tun'e lɛbis ye m anɛ ba yinne.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a yɛl ye ba anɛ Kristo tʋmtʋmnib, m tun'e lɛbis ye man anɛ Kristo tʋmtʋm sʋŋɔ gaadi ba. M pian'ad nɛ wʋʋ onɛ ka' ya'am nɛ. Mam tʋm bɛdegʋ gaad ban tʋm si'em la. Ba kpɛn'ɛsim sanrega nɔɔr bɛdegʋ gaad bam kpɛn'ɛsi ba si'em la. Ba fiebim nɔɔr bɛdegʋ gaad bam fiebi ba si'em la. Hali saŋa bɛdegʋ ka m pʋ lal nɛ kum.

english_verse: Five times my own people gave me
translation_verse: Nɔɔr anu ka Jew dim fieb mam nɛ kpa'asa nɔɔr pistan' nɛ awai wai.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Nɔɔr atan' ka Room dim bʋ'ʋm. Nɔɔr yinne ka nidib lɔb man nɛ kuga. Nɔɔr atan' ka m bɛ anrʋŋʋn ka li tʋ'ʋs tampiins ka san'am atɛukʋn. Ka nɔɔr yinne ka m bɛ ku'omin dabis mum.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: M daa nyɛ yɛltɔɔd m gɔɔndim pʋʋgin. Ku'om daa ye li diim, ka faandib giŋim ye ba faanm la'ad. Ka m Jew dim taaba nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim mɔ ye ba san'am man. Ka m nyɛ yɛltɔɔd atɛuk pʋʋgin. Ka banɛ an zam dim mɔ ye ba san'amim.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: M daa tʋm tʋʋm kpi'ema. Ka ken nɔɔr bɛdegʋ ka pʋ gbisida. M mi' dinɛ an kɔ'ɔm nɛ ku'onuud. Ka m ken ka pʋ nyɛ diib bɛɛ gbɛɛnsir bɛɛ fuudi na pil waadɛ.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Linɛ paas la, daar wʋsa m sʋnf mu'oe nɛ, nɛ Wina'am nidibi bɛ zin'isieba la wʋsa yɛla.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a pʋ kpi'em nɛ o Wina'am dɔllim la nii, li nwɛnɛ manɛ pʋ kpi'ema. Ka sɔ' ya'a kɛ ka o tiraan tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, m sʋnf ɛɛnti san'amnɛ.

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Li ya'a nar ye m nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg, m na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg nɛ dinɛ pa'annɛ m tadimis la.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb Yesu saam ka o yʋ'ʋr nyɛt zʋn'or ka li ka' naar la, mi' ye m pʋ ma'ada.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Man daa bɛ Damaskus teŋin la, ninkanɛ ka Na'ab Aretus kɛ ka o sʋ'oe Damaskus la daa kɛ ka ba gu'ud teŋ la za'anɔɔrin ye ba gban'am.

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: Ka sieba daa nɔk nwiigi lɔ pɛog ka kɛ ka m zin'in pɛogʋn la, ka ba nɔki li tud takoro ni sigisim yiŋ ka m zɔ.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Li nar ka m nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg, hali la'an nɛ nyɔ'ɔg nwɛ'ɛb la ka' nyɔɔd la. M na pian' dinɛ ka Zugsɔb la niedi pa'annim ka li nwɛnɛ zaansʋŋ nɛ, nɛ yɛlsu'ada banɛ ka o kɛ ka li nied ka m baŋi ba.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Nannanna m ti'eb ye m kena kaae ya linɛ paasid nɔɔra atan'. M nɔŋi ya ka bɔɔd ye ya mɛ nɔŋim, ka pʋ bɔɔd ye m di'e ya ligidii, ka mɛ pʋ bɔɔd ye m yɛla daami yaa. Ya nwɛnɛ m biis nɛ. Li pʋ nar ye biis diisi ba saamnama, amaa li anɛ saamnamɛ na diisi ba biis.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: M na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg dau kaŋa yɛla ka lɛɛ kʋ nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgʋ m mɛŋ yɛlaa. Asɛɛ bʋn dinɛ pa'al ye m anɛ tadim la yɛla ma'aa ka m na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: M ya'a bɔɔdin ye m nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg m naan kʋ aan zɔlʋgɔ, m naan pian'adin dinɛ an sida la yɛla. Amaa m kʋ niŋi lii, m pʋ bɔɔd ye sɔ' ti tɛn'ɛsi m sʋ'ʋm yɛla gaad on nyɛ ka m niŋid si'el nɛ on wʋm ka m yɛl si'el la.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Si'el bɛ m niŋgbiŋinɛ kɛ ka laafi pɔ'ɔgim, dinɛ kɛ ka m pʋ nyaŋidi nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ yɛlsu'adtitada dinɛ ka Wina'am niedi tisidim la. Ka dinɛ zabidim niŋgbiŋin la yinɛ Sʋntaana san'an na daamidim ye li kɛ ka m kʋ nyaŋi nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgɔ.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Nɔɔra atan' ka m sɔs Zugsɔb la ye o yisimi li m san'an.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Amaa ka o lɛbisim ye, “Man yɔlisim la siakif, fʋ tadʋŋ saŋa ka m pa'annɛ m paŋi zem si'em.” Dinzug m mɔr sumalisim ka nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ mam pʋ kpi'em la ye Kristo paŋ na bɛɛm san'an.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Dinzugʋ kɛ ka m ya'a pʋ kpi'ema, bɛɛ nidib ya'a tʋ'ʋdim bɛɛ m ya'a nyɛt yɛltɔɔd bɛɛ namisʋg bɛɛ daamʋg Kristo zug, m mɔr sumalisim. Saŋkanɛ ka m tadig la, ka m mɔr paŋ! Paul ba'a bɛ nɛ Korint dim la yɛla

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: M maali m mɛŋ wʋʋ yalim nɛ. Ka li anɛ yanamɛ kɛ ka m aan ala. Yanamɛ naan pa'alin mam an sʋm si'em. Hali baa m ya'a an zaalim, li pʋ pa'al ye m sʋ'ʋm pʋ paae nimbanɛ ka ya tɛn'ɛs ye ba anɛ tʋmtʋmnib ka an sʋm galis laa.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: M daa mɔdigi tʋm bʋnnyalima nɛ tʋʋm titada ya san'an ka li pa'al ye m sid anɛ Kristo tʋmtʋm.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Ya di'e yɛlsʋm ka li zemis nɛ Wina'am nidib sieba di'e si'em la. Yɛlsʋm kanɛ ka ya pʋ di'e anɛ, mam pʋ kɛ ka m yɛla daami ya la ma'aa. M bɛlimmi ya ye ya di suguru m taal kaŋa yɛla.

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: M na mɔr sumalisim nɛ mam na nɔk mam mɔr si'el nɛ m mɛŋ wʋsa tis, ka li sʋŋi ya. M ya'a nɔŋi ya bɛdegʋ, yanam na nɔŋim bi'elaa?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Ya sieba yɛt ye, li an sida ye m yɛla pʋ daami yaa. Ka ye m lɛɛ mɔri ya'am, ka nyaŋi ya nɛ dama'am.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: M daa pʋ kɛ ka nimbanɛ ka m tʋmi ya san'an la sɔ'ɔsɔ zammi ya di'e si'eli ya san'anɛ tisi ma.

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: M daa bɛllim Titus ye o kɛɛn ya san'an na, ka kɛ ka ti ba'abiig sɔ' la'am dɔl o. Titus daa pʋ zammi ya di'e si'ela. Bɛɛ m ma'aanɛɛ? Ka mam nɛ Titus tʋm nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne, ka dɔl suor yinne.

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Ya ɛɛnti tɛn'ɛsid ye tinamɛ yɛt nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa la, ti mɔɔdi ye ti pian' yisi ti mɛŋi ya san'an bɛɛ? Ayei, li ka' alaa. Ti pian'ad gbauŋʋn nwa' nɛ Wina'am tuon anɛ linɛ ka Kristo bɔɔd ye ti pian' la. Ka li wʋsa anɛ ye ti sʋŋ yanam banɛ aan ti ba'abinɔŋa la.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: M zɔt dabiem ye m ya'a kɛɛn ya san'an na, m pa'ati nyɛ ka ya pʋ nwɛnɛ man bɔɔd ye ya aan si'em laa, ka ya mɛ na nyɛ ka mam mɛŋ kʋ niŋ wʋʋ yanamɛ bɔɔd ye m niŋin si'em la mɛnɛ. M ya'am ian'adnɛ ye m pa'ati nyɛ ka ya zabid nɛ taaba ka nyuun, ka ya sʋnf duod nɛ taaba, ka ya wɛligid nɛ taaba, ka san'ami ya taaba zut, ka kɛɛnd taaba, ka niŋid yɔɔd yɔɔdi, ka mɔr nyɛɛsim.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: M mɛ lɛn zɔt ye m ya'a kena Wina'am na diisim nyannɛ ya tuon, ka m sʋnf na san'amnɛ ya sieba banɛ daa tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka nam pʋ tiaki ba sʋnya nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ dian'ad tʋʋma nɛ yalimis dinɛ ka ba daa tʋm la yɛlaa.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa paasid nɔɔr atan' ka m na kena kaae ya. “Sɔ' ya'a mɔr taal nɛ o tiraan ka li an antu'a, asɛɛ ka o daana mɔr kasɛtib ayi' bɛɛ atan'.”

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: M daa pʋn dɛŋi sa'ali ya nɛ nimmua man daa bɛɛ ya san'an nɔɔr ayi' daan la. La'an nɛ man ka' ya san'an la, m lɛn takidi li. M ya'a ti lɛb na, m kʋ bas banɛ daa dɛŋi tʋm bɛ'ɛd bɛɛ banɛ yuulim tʋm laa,

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ, ya bɔɔd ye ya baŋ ye li sid anɛ Kristo tisim suor ka m pian'ad nɛ'. Li ka' o kɔ'ɔŋi paŋ nɛ on na maali ya si'ela, amaa o mɔr paŋ hali ya ni.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Li anɛ sida ye on da bɛ dapuudir zug la o da ka' paŋa, ka kpi. Ka li lɛɛ anɛ Wina'am paŋ la kɛ ka o vʋe. Ka tinam an yinne nɛ Kristo la ti mɛ ka' paŋa, ka Wina'am paŋ la kɛ ka ti la'an vʋe nɛ Kristo ka tʋm nɛ o paŋi ya san'an.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Pɛligimini ya pʋʋgʋ gɔs ye ya sid niŋ Kristo yadda. Kpansimini ya mɛŋi gɔs ye Kristo bɛɛ ya ni? Li ya'a ka' alaa ya lunɛ.

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: M mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye ya na baŋ ye tinam ka' nimbanɛ bas Wina'am dɔllim.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Ti sɔsid Wina'am ya zug ye ya da tʋm dinɛ an bɛ'ɛdɛ. Ka' ye ti dʋ'ʋsidi ti mɛŋ ye nidib nyɛ tinamɛ nyaŋ makir la zugɔ, amaa ye li kɛ ka ya maal dinɛ an sʋm, hali baa li ya'a nwɛnɛ ti lunɛ gba.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Ti kʋ nyaŋi niŋ si'el dinɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am sida suor laa, amaa asɛɛ dinɛ an yɛlsida la ma'aa.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Tinam ya'a tadig ka yanam lɛɛ mɔr paŋ, ti mɔr sumalisim. Ka sɔsid Wina'am ye ya bɛllim wʋsa na an sʋm.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Man ka' ya san'an la zug ka m sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisidi ya, m ya'a ti kena li pʋ nar ye m zaŋ Zugsɔb la tisim paŋ si'a la tʋm nɛ sʋntɔɔgɔ. O tisim o paŋ la ye m sʋŋi ya ka ka' m san'ami yaa.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Ba'asʋgɔ, m ba'abiisɛ, mɔɔm tʋmi dinɛ an sʋm, kɛlisimi man yɛt si'el la, ka mɔri pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne, ka bɛ nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm, ka Wina'am onɛ tisid nɔŋilim nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm la, na bɛ nɛ ya.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na tisi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Kristo da pɛsig o mɛŋi tis ye ba kʋʋ o tinam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug, wʋʋ ti Ba' Wina'am bɔɔdim an si'em la, ye o faaɛn ti dunia bɛ'og nwa' ni.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Wina'am na nyɛ zʋn'or ka li ka' naarɛ. Ami. Labasʋŋ yinne gʋllim la yɛla

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Li pakim nɛ lin pʋ yuugɛ ka ya ta'am bas Wina'am onɛ buoli ya Kristo pʋpielim zug la, ya bas o ka tɔɔm di'e labasi'a,

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: la'an nɛ lin ka' labasʋŋ la. Amaa ninsieba bɛ fɛntidi ya pʋtɛnda ye ba tiak Kristo labasʋŋ la.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Hali baa tinam bɛɛ maliak ya'a yi arezana ni na mɔɔl labasi'a linɛ bɛɛ li kɔn' nɛ tinamɛ mɔɔl si'eli ya san'an la, Wina'am nɔpɔɔr na bɛ on sɔb zug.

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Ti daa pʋn yɛli li, ka m lɛn yɛti li ya'as ye, sɔ' ya'a mɔɔl labasi'a ka li bɛɛ li kɔn' nɛ yanamɛ di'e si'el la, Wina'am nɔpɔɔr na bɛ on sɔb zug.

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Ya tɛn'ɛs ye m mɔɔdi ye m kɛ ka nidib pian' m yɛla sʋ'ʋm bɛɛ? Ayei, m bɔɔd ye Wina'am pian' m yɛla sʋ'ʋm. Ka ya tɛn'ɛs ye m mɔɔdi ye m ma'ae nidib sʋnya bɛɛ? Ayei, m ya'a mɔɔdin ye m ma'an nidib sʋnya, m naan kʋ aan Kristo tʋmtʋmma. Paul n lieb tʋmtʋm la yɛla

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m bɔɔd ye ya baŋ ye labasʋŋ linɛ ka m mɔɔn la pʋ yi ninsaalib pʋtɛnda ni naa.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Ka m mɛ daa pʋ di'e li sɔ' san'anɛ, ka sɔ' mɛ daa pʋ yɛli lii pa'ali ma. Li lɛɛ daa anɛ Yesu Kristo mɛŋi daa nie lii pa'alim.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Ya pʋn wʋm man daa dɔl Jew dim malima la ka daa ɛɛnti niŋid si'em la. M daa namisid Wina'am nidib bɛdegʋ, ka mɔɔd ye m san'ami ba suor la.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: M daa anɛ onɛ mɔr mi'ilim ka ken tuon hali nɛ ti Jew dim malima ni la gaadi m Jew taaba banɛ zem nɛ mam la. Ka m pʋtɛn'ɛr daa gban'e ye m dɔlli ti yaanam malima la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am daa gban'e ye o nie o Biig la pa'alim ye o kɛ ka m mɔɔl o Biig la labaari tis banɛ ka' Jew dim la, m daa pʋ keŋ sɔ' san'an ye o zamisi ma.

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: M mɛ daa pʋ keŋ Jerusalem banɛ pʋn dɛŋ man an tʋmtʋmnib la san'anɛɛ. Amaa m daa keŋ nɛ Arabia sʋ'ʋlimin, ka lin nya'aŋ ka m lɛb Damaskus teŋin.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Yʋma atan' nya'aŋ ka m nyaan keŋ Jerusalem ye m kaae Pita, ka daa bɛɛ o san'anɛ paae dabis pii nɛ anu,

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: ka pʋ nyɛ tʋmtʋm sɔ' ya'asa, asɛɛ Jemes onɛ an Zugsɔb pitʋ la ma'aa.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Wina'am mi' ye linɛ ka m sɔbid o tuon nwa' la anɛ sida, ka ka' dama'am.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Lin nya'aŋ ka m nyaan yi Jerusalem keŋ zin'isieba banɛ bɛ Siriya nɛ Silisia tɛɛnsin la.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Juda teŋin la wʋmi m yɛla ka lɛɛ nam pʋ nyɛɛm nɛ ba ninii.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Ba lɛɛ daa wʋm nɛ ka sieba yɛti m yɛla ye, “Onɛ daa namisidi ti la yʋ'ʋn mɔɔnnɛ yadda niŋir yɛla pa'an linɛ ka o daa mɔɔd ye o san'am la.”

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Ka man zug ka ba zun'e Wina'am.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Yʋma pii nɛ anaasi nya'aŋ, ka mam nɛ Barnabas nyaan lɛb Jerusalem ka Titus mɛ la'am dɔlli ti.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Wina'am n daa nie pa'alim ye o bɔɔd ye m keŋ la zug ka m daa keŋ. Ka mam nɛ Wina'am nimbanɛ an kpɛɛmnam la la'asi gban'e gban'ar. Ka li anɛ mam nɛ ban ma'aa ka ka' nidib sʋʋginɛɛ. Ka m yɛli ba labasʋŋ kanɛ ka m mɔɔnnɛ tisid banɛ ka' Jew dim la an si'em; ka pʋ bɔɔd ye tʋʋm kanɛ ka m daa tʋm ka nan kpɛn tʋmmi li la an zaalim.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Hali la'an nɛ m dɔllim taa Titus onɛ an Girik nid la, ba daa pʋ mugus o ye o kpɛn' baŋʋʋ.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Yɛlkaŋa daa duonɛ ka li anɛ ninsieba banɛ daa ma' ye ba anɛ Wina'am nidib ka su'a kpɛn' ti sʋʋgin ye ba baŋ tinamɛ an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo la ka li kɛ ka ti sʋ'oe ti mɛŋ Jew dim malima la ni si'em. Ba daa bɔɔd ye ba kɛ ka ti dɔl malima la, ka aan li yammis.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: Ti daa pʋ siaki ba bɔɔdim la baa bi'ela, bɔzugɔ, ti daa pʋ bɔɔd ye labasʋŋ la tiakɛ ka lɛɛ nam kpɛm bɛɛ ya san'an nwɛnɛ din nar si'em.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ ka ya tɛn'ɛs ye ba anɛ tuongatib la; m yɛt nwa'anɛ, bɔzugɔ ban an si'em la pʋ paki ma. Wina'am n nyɛt ninsaal ka o an si'em la, ninsaal pʋ gɔsid o tiraan ka o aan alaa.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Amaa ba yʋ'ʋn siakya ye Wina'am gu'ulim labasʋŋ la ye m mɔɔli li tis banɛ ka' Jew dim la, wʋʋ on mɛ gu'ul Pita labasʋŋ la ye o mɔɔli li tis Jew dim si'em la.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am paŋ kɛ ka Pita an Kristo Tʋmtʋmi tʋm Jew dim la san'an, ka mɛ kɛ ka mam mɛ tʋm banɛ ka' Jew dim la san'an.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Ka Jemes nɛ Pita nɛ Joon, banɛ ka ya gɔs ka ba an kpɛɛmnam la, baŋ ye Wina'am gu'ulim tʋʋm sʋŋ kaŋa, ka gban'e mam nɛ Barnabas nu'usi pa'al ye ti mɔr nɔɔr yinne ka na tʋm Wina'am tʋʋma, ka ti siaki tis taaba ye tinam na tʋm banɛ ka' Jew dim la san'an, ka ban mɛ na tʋm Jew dim la san'an.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Yɛl yinne ma'aa ka ba daa sɔsi ti, ka lin anɛ ye ti tɛnr ka sʋŋi ba tadimnam la. Ka mam mɛ daa pʋn gban'e m sʋʋnrin ye man tʋm si'em la. Paul daa yɛl Pita o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Ka ti ba'abiis banɛ an Jew dim la daa paas Pita biriku'anim la ni, ka ba biriku'anim la daa mɛ vɛ'ɛg Barnabas ka o yidigi dɔl ban niŋid si'el la.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Ka man daa nyɛ ka ban tʋm si'em la pʋ dɔl nɛ labasʋŋ la yɛla la, ka m yɛl Pita ba wʋsa tuon ye, “Fʋ anɛ Jew nid, bɔ ka fʋ tʋm wʋʋ onɛ ka' Jew nida? Wala ka fʋ bɔɔd ye fʋ mugus banɛ ka' Jew dim la ye ba dɔl Jew dim malima?” Yadda niŋir zug ka ti nyɛ faangir

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Ka ti ya'a kpɛ'ɛŋidi ti mɛŋ ye ti lieb pʋpielim dim Kristo san'an, amaa ka nyɛ ka ti anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim nwɛnɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim la, li pa'al ye Kristo anɛ onɛ zi'e tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nya'aŋ bɛɛ? Ayei baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: M ya'a daa dɔl Jew dim wada ka basi li, ka ti lɛm pin'ili dɔlli li, li pa'al ye m san'amid wada la nɛ.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Wada la paŋ zugɔɔ, m kpinɛ tis wada la, ka li kɛ ka m na tun'e vʋe tis Wina'am.
