english_verse: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
translation_verse: Ba da la'am kpa'am dapuudir zug nɛ Kristo ka m kpi, ka li lɛn ka' ye m vʋe nɛ m mɛŋ vʋm, amaa li anɛ Kristo vʋm bɛɛ m san'an. Ka man yʋ'ʋn bɛ bɛllim si'a la anɛ yadda kanɛ ka m niŋ Wina'am Biig onɛ daa nɔŋim, ka kpii m yɛla la ni.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: M pʋ kɛ ka Wina'am pʋpielim la an zaalim. Sɔ' ya'a an pʋpielim daan Wina'am tuon, ka li yinɛ o wada siakir ni, Kristo kum la anɛ zaalim.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Yanam Galatia dim anɛ zɔn! M pa'ali ya Kristo kum dapuudir la zug yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa, ka li nie nyain ya nini ni. Anɔ'ɔnɛ ma'aa ya?

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye m bu'osi ya yɛl yinne ma'aa, ya daa di'e Wina'am Siig Kasi la ka li yinɛ yanamɛ dɔl wada la yɛl si'el la bɛɛ yanam wʋm labasʋŋ la ka niŋ Kristo yadda la?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Ya anɛ zɔn bɛɛ? Ya daa pin'ili anɛ Wina'am nidib, ka li yinɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi paŋ la ni. Ka nannanna ka ya yʋ'ʋn bɔɔd ye ya naae li nɛ ya mɛŋ paŋ bɛɛ?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Ya namisʋg la wʋsa anɛ zaalim bɛɛ? Ayei, li ka' zaalim.

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Wina'am tisi ya o Siig Kasi ka tʋm tʋʋm nyalima ya san'an la anɛ yanamɛ dɔl wada la bɛɛ yanamɛ wʋm labasʋŋ la ka niŋ Kristo yadda la zugɔ?

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ye nimbanɛ niŋ Wina'am yadda la sid anɛ Abraham yaas.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Wina'am gbauŋ da pʋn yɛl ye Wina'am na kɛ ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la lieb pʋpielim dim o tuon ba yadda niŋir zug, ka dinzug ka ba da pʋn dɛŋi yɛl Abraham labasʋŋ la mɔɔlʋg yɛla hali ka li nam pʋ paae, ye on zug ka dunia buudi wʋsa na paam albareka.

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Abraham da niŋ Wina'am yadda ka di'e albareka. Ala mɛn banɛ niŋ Wina'am yadda la na di'e albareka wʋʋ on da di'e si'em la.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Nɔpɔɔr bɛ nimbanɛ ti'e wada ma'aa la zugin, bɔzugɔ li sɔbnɛ ye, “Nɔpɔɔr bɛ banɛ wʋsa pʋ dɔl wada la yɛl si'em nwɛnɛ din sɔb Wada Gbauŋʋn si'em la zugin.”

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Li anɛ nyain ye sɔ' kae na di bʋʋd wada la dɔllim yɛla ma'aanɛ, bɔzugɔ “Pʋpielim sɔb na vʋe nɛ o yadda niŋir yɛla.”

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Li sɔb ye, “Nɔpɔɔr bɛ nɛ onɛ mɛkama kpi ka ba ya'al o tiig zug.” Dinzugɔ, Kristo n da kpi dapuudir zug la, o da kpɛn' nɔpɔɔr la ni, ka faaɛn ti yis nɔpɔɔr linɛ ka wada la mɔr la nu'usin.

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: O faaɛn ti ye yɛlsʋm kanɛ ka Wina'am zi'el nɔɔr ye o na tis Abraham la mɛ na an banɛ ka' Jew dim la din, ban an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo la zug, ka lin mɛ na kɛ ka tinam banɛ niŋ yadda la di'e Wina'am Siig Kasi linɛ ka o kaanb ye o na tisi ti la. Wada la nɛ nɔzi'ela yɛla

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m ye m zaŋ nɛ nidib bɛllim an si'em la pa'ali ya si'el. Nidib ayi' ya'a siaki pian' si'el yɛla ka sɔbi li, ka tik nu'ug, sɔ' kae na tiaki lii, bɛɛ paas si'ela.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Tɛnri ye Wina'am da kaanbi tis nɛ Abraham nɛ o yaaŋ. Li da pʋ sɔb ye o zi'el nɔɔri tis on nɛ yaas ka li pa'al ye li anɛ nimbabiga. Amaa li lɛɛ sɔb nɛ ye o yaaŋ, ka li pa'al ye nid yinne; ka ninkanɛ an Kristo la.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ faar la ya'a anɛ wada la dɔllim yɛla, li kʋ lɛn dɔlnɛ kaanbʋg laa. Amaa li anɛ Wina'am da kaanb la zug ka o tis Abraham yɛlsʋm kan la.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Amaa ya na bu'osim ye, ka bɔzug ka Wina'am mɛ da lɛn tis wada la? O da tisi li ye li pa'ali ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi an si'em, ka bɔɔd ye li bɛɛ ala ti paae saŋa kanɛ ka Abraham yaaŋ onɛ ka o da kaanbi tis la kena. Maliaknam da di'e wada la Wina'am san'anɛ tis Moses, ka o tɔlisi li tis nidib la, ka an nu'unwɛ'ɛd Wina'am nɛ nidib la sʋʋgin.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Nu'unwɛ'ɛd pʋ zi'e nid yinne ma'aa yɛllɛ. Amaa Wina'am onɛ an yinne la da tʋmi li o kɔn'ɔkɔn'. Wina'am wada tisib la gbin yɛla

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Ya tɛn'ɛs ye wada la nɛ Wina'am kaanbʋg la ki'isidnɛ taaba bɛɛ? Ayei baa bi'elaa. Wina'am ya'a da tisin wada linɛ nyaŋidi kɛt ka nidib vʋe, nidib naan sid aan pʋpielim dim o tuon ban siak wada la zug.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Amaa li da sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye dunia dim wʋsa bɛ nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nu'usin. Ka linzug banɛ niŋ Yesu Kristo yadda la na di'e Wina'am nɔzi'elʋg linɛ ka o tisid banɛ niŋ yadda la.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, wada la da sʋ'oe ti ka aan ti tuongati ti paae saŋa kanɛ ka Kristo kena ka ti lieb pʋpielim dim Wina'am tuon tinamɛ niŋ o yadda la zug.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Nannanna ka yadda niŋir saŋa paae la, wada la pʋ lɛn sʋ'oe ti ya'asa.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ya wʋsa anɛ Wina'am biis, ka li yinɛ ya yadda niŋir Yesu Kristo ni la.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Banɛ wʋsa di'e Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb la pa'al ye ba anɛ Kristo nidib, ka Kristo bɛɛ ba san'an ka nwɛnɛ o mɛŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Alazug, bakir lɛn kae Jew dim nɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim, bɛɛ yammis nɛ banɛ sʋ'oe ba mɛŋ, bɛɛ dap nɛ pu'ab sʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a an Kristo nid fʋ anɛ Abraham yaaŋ ka na di'e linɛ ka Wina'am da kaanb ye o na tis la.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: Man yɛt si'el la anɛ ye, ba gɔsid bikanɛ na ti dii o saam faar la wʋʋ o anɛ yammʋg nɛ, o biilim saŋa, hali la'an nɛ on sid sʋ'oe si'el wʋsa la.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: Ka on nan an biig la, nidib bɛɛ na pa'an o si'el wʋsa hali ti paae saŋa kanɛ ka o saam zi'el o la.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn tinamɛ da nan an biisi zaŋi ken Wina'am yɛla ni la, ti da anɛ yammis ka dunia la sʋ'oe ti.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am zi'el saŋsi'a la da paae la, Wina'am da tʋm o mɛŋ Biig na ka pu'a du'a o, ka o bɛ Jew dim wada la nu'usin.

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: O da tʋm o ye o faaɛn banɛ ka wada la sʋ'oe ba la, ka tisi ba suor amɛŋa linɛ na kɛ ka ba lieb o biis.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ an Wina'am biis la zug ka o da kɛ ka siig kanɛ bɛɛ o biig la ni la mɛ kɛɛn ya sʋnfʋn na, onɛ na kɛ ka ti nyaŋi buol Wina'am ye, “M Ba'.”

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Dinzug fʋ lɛn ka' yammʋgɔ, amaa fʋ anɛ Wina'am biig. Ka fʋn sadigim aan o biig la, o na tisif on zi'el si'el wʋsa ye o tis o biis la. Galatia dim yɛlaa pak Paul si'em

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Saŋa linɛ gaad ka ya da nan zi' Wina'am la, ya da dɔlli si'elnam linɛ ka' Wina'am, ka aan li yammis.

english_verse: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna ka ya yʋ'ʋn mi' Wina'am la, wala ka ya lɛm bɔɔd ye ya lɛbi dɔl linɛ ka' paŋ bɛɛ mɔr gban'arɛ? Bɔ ka ya bɔɔd ye ya lɛn liebi li yammis ya'asɛ?

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Ya dɔlnɛ dabis-sieba nɛ nwadsieba nɛ saŋa sieba nɛ yʋʋm sieba malima!

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: M zɔti dabiem ye m tʋʋm kanɛ ka m daa tʋmi ya san'an la na lieb zaalim.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m bɛlimmi ya ye ya an wʋʋ mam an si'em la; ka mam mɛ an wʋʋ yanam nɛ. Ya pʋ tʋm mam bɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Ya mi' ye saŋkanɛ ka m daa mɔɔl labasʋŋ la ya san'an yiiga la, m daa ka' laafi sʋ'ʋŋaa.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ m niŋgbina la daa an si'em la, ya daa pʋ nɛ'ɛsim bɛɛ gɔsim yɔrii, amaa ya daa di'e m sʋ'ʋŋa wʋʋ m anɛ Wina'am maliak bɛɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Ya daa mɔr sumalisim man zug. Ka bɔɔ lɛn niŋ ka ya tiakɛ? M tis sida ye, li ya'a nyaŋidin, ya daa naan kpigi ya mɛŋ nini tisinim.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: M yʋ'ʋn liebnɛ ya dataa man yɛti ya linɛ an sida la bɛɛ?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Nimbama la bɔɔdi ya yɛla, amaa ba mɔri pʋtɛn'ɛr bɛ'ɛd. Ba bɔɔd ye ba baki ya nɛ tinam ka ya lɛɛ bɔɔd ban yɛla.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a tɛn'ɛs sʋ'ʋŋa o taaba yɛla, li sʋ'ʋm ye o bɔɔdi ba yɛla. Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ sida, baa m ya'a bɛɛ ya san'an bɛɛ m ya'a ka' ya san'anɛɛ.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: M naan bɔɔdin ye m bɛɛn nɛ ya san'an nannanna, ka nyaŋi tiakin mam pian'ad si'em nɛ ya la. Ya yɛla pakim nɛ hali ka m zi' mam na niŋ si'em. Haga nɛ Sara yɛla

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: M ye m bu'os yanam banɛ bɔɔd ye wada la sʋ'oe ya la ye, ya pʋ wʋm wada la yɛl si'el laa?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Li yɛl ye Abraham da du'anɛ biis ayi'. Ka yinne an yammʋg biig, ka yinne an pu'a kanɛ ka' yammʋg la biig.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Ba da du'a bikanɛ an pu'a yammʋg biig la nɛ wʋʋ ban ɛɛnti du'ad si'em la. Amaa ba da du'a bikanɛ an pu'a kanɛ ka' yammʋg biig la ka li dɔl wʋʋ Wina'am kaanbi zi'el si'em la.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Pu'ab ayi' nwa' nwaasnɛ nɔnaar nam ayi' la; nɔnaar yinne yinɛ Sinai zuor zug na ka ba du'a bibanɛ na kilim yammis la. Pu'a kan yʋ'ʋri buon Haga.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: Haga nwaasnɛ Sinai zuor linɛ bɛ Arabia teŋin la, ka mɛ nwaasnɛ Jerusalem nɛ Jew dim wada linɛ bɛ nannanna nwa' la. Ka Jerusalem nɛ nimbanɛ dɔlli li malima la anɛ yammis wʋʋ Haga nɛ o yaas la an si'em la.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Amaa Jerusalem linɛ bɛ arezana ni la mɔr yɔlisim ka aan ti ma.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Pu'a kundu'arɛ, mɔr sumalisim. Ka pu'a kanɛ mɛ pʋ nyɛ du'am tɔɔg la maalim vuud nɛ sumalisim. Pu'a kanɛ an kʋndu'ar ka o sid bas o la na mɔr biis bɛdegʋ gaad pu'a kanɛ ka o sid mɔr o la. Dinzug kʋndu'ar la na mɔr sumalisim.”

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, ya anɛ Wina'am biis wʋʋ Isaak nɛ, ka li yinɛ Wina'am kaanbʋgʋn la na.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Abraham saŋa la, bikanɛ ka ba da du'a wʋʋ ban yiti du'ad si'em la, da namisid bikanɛ ka ba du'a o ka li yi Wina'am Siig Sʋŋin na la. Li mɛ anɛ ala nannanna.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsimi Wina'am gbauŋ la yɛl si'em la ye, “Kadim pu'a kanɛ an yammʋg la nɛ o biig la; ka o biig la nɛ pu'a kanɛ ka' yammʋg la biig la kʋ ti la'am pʋdigi ba saam faar laa.”

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Ala, m ba'abiisɛ, tinam nwɛnɛ pu'a kanɛ ka' yammʋg la biis nɛ, amaa pu'a kanɛ mɔr yɔlisim la biis.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Kristo da faaɛn ti ye ti sʋ'oe ti mɛŋ wada la san'an. Dinzugɔ, zi'enimi kiŋ-kiŋ ka da siaki lieb yammis ya'asɛ.

english_verse: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi sʋŋa, mam Paul yɛti ya ye, ya ya'a siak ka ba kpɛn'ɛsi ya baŋʋ, li pa'al ye ya Kristo dɔllim la ka' nyɔɔdɛ.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ bɔɔd ye ya an pʋpielim dim Wina'am tuon ya wada dɔllim zug la, baŋimi ye ya baki ya mɛŋ nɛ Kristo ka yisi ya mɛŋ Wina'am na'amin.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Ka tinamɛ an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo la zug, li yɛla pʋ pak ye ti kpɛn' baŋʋ bɛɛ ti pʋ kpɛn'ɛɛ. Linɛ pak anɛ tinamɛ na niŋ Yesu yadda ka li yiti ti nɔŋilimin.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Ya da tʋm sʋ'ʋŋa, ka anɔ'ɔnɛ kɛ ka ya pʋ lɛn dɔl sida?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Linɛ ka ba nɔki pan'asi ya ka ya bas sida la pʋ yi Wina'am onɛ buoli ya la san'an naa.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Ala ka ba ye, “Li anɛ danbin bi'ela kɛt ka bodobodo gbil ukid la.”

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: M mɔr kpi'euŋ nɛ Zugsɔb la ni ye ya tɛn'ɛsa kʋ bɛɛ li kɔn' nɛ man pa'ali ya si'el laa. Ka onɛ yutimi ya pʋtɛndaa kʋdim an sɔ' wʋsa Wina'am na namis o sɔba.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m ya'a kpɛm mɔɔn baŋʋ kpɛn'ɛsʋg yɛla, bɔ ka Jew dim namisidi ma? Li ya'a aan sida, Jew dim naan kʋ tɛn'ɛsidin ye man mɔɔn Kristo kum dapuudir zug yɛla la ka' sʋ'ʋm.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: M naan bɔɔdin ye nimbanɛ daamidi ya tɛn'ɛsa yɛt ye li nar ka ya kpɛn' baŋʋ la maligim san'ami ba mɛŋ niŋgbiŋi paas.

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, Wina'am gaŋi ya ye ya mɔr yɔlisim. Dinzugɔ da kɛ ka ya yɔlisim la kɛ ka ya tʋm ya ninsaalib ya'amlɛog bɔɔdim, ka lɛɛ sʋŋ taaba nɛ nɔŋilim.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Wada la wʋsa la'as nɛ an yinne ye; “Nɔŋimi fʋ tiraan nwɛnɛ fʋn nɔŋi fʋ mɛŋ si'em la.”

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Ya ya'a zabid nɛ taaba wʋʋ ya anɛ bʋnyuos, yanam gu'usimi ka ya na san'am taaba. Wina'am Siig Kasi bɔɔdim nɛ ninsaalib bɔɔdim

english_verse: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Man yɛti ya si'el anɛ ye, kɛlli ka ya bɛllim dɔlnɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la bɔɔdim, ka da niŋi ninsaalib ya'amlɛogʋ bɔɔd si'ela.

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Linɛ ka ninsaalib ya'amlɛog bɔɔd bɛɛ li kɔn' nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la bɔɔdim. Bama ayi' la anɛ dataas. Ka dinzug ya kʋ nyaŋi niŋ yanamɛ bɔɔd si'em la.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Wina'am Siig Kasi ya'a sʋ'oe ya, wada la pʋ lɛn sʋ'oe yaa.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Ti ninsaalib bɔɔdim niŋid si'el la nie paalʋ, ka kɛt ka nidib mɔr pu'asan'auŋ nɛ dian'ad tʋʋma nɛ tʋʋmyaalis

english_verse: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
translation_verse: nɛ bada maalʋg nɛ sɔntʋʋma nɛ datatʋʋma nɛ zabtaasim nɛ nyuur nɛ sʋnpɛɛn nɛ dindiisim nɛ nɔŋgbannwa'ar.

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: Nɛ fufum dim nɛ banɛ nuud daam kʋʋn nɛ di'emyaalis nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd banɛ nwɛnɛ bama buudi, m yɛti ya wʋʋ man daa yɛli ya si'em la ye, onɛ mɛkama niŋid bama kʋ di Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim la faarɛ.

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ mɛŋ gban'ar. Wada la kʋ yɛl nid ye o da niŋ bamaa.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ an Yesu Kristo nidib la, ba ninsaalib bɔɔdim nɛ li ya'amlɛog la kpiya nɛ Kristo, ka li pʋ lɛn sʋ'oe baa.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Wina'am Siig Sʋŋʋ sadigim tisi ti vʋm paal la, kɛlli ka ti bɛllim dɔlnɛ o bɔɔdim.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ti mɔr nyɛɛsim bɛɛ kɛt ka ti taaba sʋnf duod bɛɛ mɔr nyʋʋr nɛ taabaa.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ya'a kɛ ka sɔ' lu, yanam banɛ ka Siig Kasi la bɛɛ ya ni bɛdegʋ la sʋŋim o nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm, ka o duoe ka lɛn an sʋm. Ka mɛ gu'usi ya mɛŋ ka ya pa'ati nyɛ makir.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Sʋŋimi taaba ya yɛltɔɔd pʋʋgin, ka ala ka ya na dɔl Kristo wada la.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a tɛn'ɛs ye o anɛ sʋ'ʋm hali, ka lɛɛ pʋ kpi'ema, o ma'ad o mɛŋ.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Sɔ' mɛkama kpansim o mɛŋ bɛllim an si'em. Ka li ya'a an sʋm, o tun'e nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg nɛ o mɛŋ yɛla. Ka li lɛɛ ka' ye o mak o mɛŋ nɛ o tiraana.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa mɔɔm o mɛŋ yɛla.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Onɛ zamis Kristo labaar la on pʋdigim bʋnsʋŋ linɛ ka o mɔr la nɛ onɛ zamis o la.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Da ma'aa ya mɛŋa. Sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi ma' Wina'am wʋʋ o anɛ zɔlʋgɔ. Nid na bʋn on bʋd si'el la buudi. Li mɛ anɛ ala nidib bɛllim ni.

english_verse: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
translation_verse: Sɔ' bɛllim ya'a dɔl ninsaalib bɔɔdim, li nyɔɔd anɛ kum. Ka sɔ' bɛllim ya'a dɔl Wina'am Siig Kasi la bɔɔdim, lin nyɔɔd mɛ anɛ nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, da kɛ ka ti gɛn ka basi tʋʋm sʋma tʋʋmaa. Ka ti ya'a pʋ basɛ ka li saŋa paae, ti na nyɛɛ li nyɔɔd.

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi mam sɔb ka li an sɔb bɛda si'em, li anɛ man mɛŋ Paul nu'ugʋ sɔb.

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Nimbanɛ pa'annɛ ba mɛŋ la bɔɔd ye ba mugusi ya ka ya kpɛn' baŋʋ la. Ba kʋdim niŋidi lin ye li kɛ ka ba da nyɛ Kristo kum dapuudir namisʋg laa.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Hali nimbanɛ malima an baŋʋ kpɛn'ɛb la, ba pʋ niŋid wada la yɛl si'el laa, ka bɔɔd ye yanam lɛɛ kpɛn' baŋʋ ka ba na nyaŋi nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg nɛ yanamɛ siaki di'e bʋn linɛ an niŋgbina malima la.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ mam, man kʋdim kʋ nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg nɛ si'el yɛlaa, asɛɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo kum dapuudir la yɛla ma'aa. Li anɛ o kum dapuudir la zugʋ kɛ ka dunia yɛla pʋ lɛn sʋ'oe ma, ka li nwɛnɛ m kpinɛ, ka m ba'a lɛn kae nɛ li yɛlaa.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Li pʋ pak ye sɔ' kpɛn' baŋʋ bɛɛ o pʋ kpɛn'ɛɛ, linɛ pak anɛ tinamɛ na mɔr vʋmpaal la.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Wina'am na tis nimbanɛ dɔl suokaŋa la sumalisim ka zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig, la'an nɛ Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Man ye m naae nɛ si'eli nwa'. Sɔ'ɔsɔ da lɛn daami ma; ka isa banɛ bɛɛ m niŋgbina ni mam dɔl Yesu yɛla la zug pa'al ye m anɛ o nid.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yɛlsʋm na bɛ nɛ ya siis. Ami.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Mam Paul onɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ ka m an Yesu Kristo Tʋmtʋm la sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Efesus teŋin ka an yadda niŋidib Yesu Kristo ni la.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm na bɛ nɛ ya. Wina'am bareka linɛ bɛ Kristo san'an la

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo Ba' la di'em zʋn'or, onɛ tisi ti albareka linɛ aan o piini wʋsa ka yii o san'an arezana ni na nɛ siig piini wʋsa linɛ bɛ Kristo ni la.

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Dunia da nam pʋ pin'il la, Wina'am da pʋn dɛŋin gaŋi ti ye ti aan o nidib ka an yinne nɛ Kristo ka an nyain o tuon ka gbada kae.

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: On nɔŋi ti la zug ka o gban'e ye o zaŋi ti ka ti lieb o biis, ka li yinɛ Yesu Kristo mɛŋ ni na. O gban'anɛ ala nɛ o mɛŋ ya'ambɔɔdim,

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: ye li kɛ ka o pʋpielim piintita'ar linɛ ka o tisi ti, tinamɛ an yinne nɛ o Binɔŋir la zug nyɛ zʋn'or.

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Ka o kɛ ka ti baŋ yɛlsu'adir linɛ aan o bɔɔdim sʋŋ kanɛ ka o gban'e ti yɛla ka li yinɛ Kristo ni la.

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: Wina'am gban'e saŋsi'a la ya'a ti paae li bɛn o na la'as bʋnam banɛ wʋsa bɛ arezana nɛ dunia ni la ka Kristo an Zugsɔb.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ wʋm sida labasʋŋ linɛ kɛ ka ya nyɛ faangir la, ya siak Kristo ka an yinne nɛ o, ka Wina'am tisi ya o Siig Kasi wʋʋ on zi'el si'em. Ka Siig Kasi la an zanbin

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: ka li pa'al ye ti na nyɛ linɛ wʋsa ka o zi'eli tisi ti la, ti paae saŋa kanɛ ka ti na di'e li wʋsa. Paul Wina'am sɔsʋg

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛnam zug, nɛ mam wʋm ye ya niŋi ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yadda ka mɔr nɔŋir nɛ Wina'am nidib wʋsa la,

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: m pʋ gu'oe ka kpɛm pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka ya zug ka tɛnri sɔsid Wina'am ya yɛla.

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: M kpɛn sɔsid ye ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo Wina'am onɛ aan ti Ba' kanɛ an girima sɔb la na tisi ya Siig la ya'am ka nie pa'ali ya Wina'am an si'em ka ya baŋ o.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: Ka nie ya pʋtɛnda ka ya baŋ yɛlsida nɛ ti'ir linɛ yɛla ka o gaŋi ya la. Ka lɛn baŋ zi'elsʋŋ kanɛ ka o tis o nidib la malisim an si'em,

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: ka mɛ baŋ o paŋ linɛ galis ka ka' makir ka bɛ tinam banɛ siak o la ni la. Paŋ kanɛ bɛ tinam ni la nwɛnɛ paŋ tita'ar kanɛ

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: ka o zaŋi vʋ'ʋg Kristo kumin ka zin'il o, o datiuŋ arezana ni la.

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: Kristo na'am gat na'anam wʋsa na'am nɛ paŋ dim wʋsa, ka mɔr yʋ'ʋri gat sɔ' wʋsa, ka li ka'anɛ dunia kaŋa ma'aanɛ, amaa la'an nɛ dunia kanɛ na ti kena la.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Wina'am gaŋ Kristo ka o an Wina'am nidib la Zugsɔbi sʋ'oe si'el wʋsa, ka kɛ ka o na an si'el wʋsa zugdaan.

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: Wina'am nidib la anɛ Kristo niŋgbiŋ, ka o ni ka si'el wʋsa maali naae.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ gaad la, ya da ka' nyɔnvʋrɛ, ka li anɛ ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ ya taal linɛ ka ya da niŋid la zug,

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Li saŋa la, ya daa dɔlnɛ dunia nwa' suoya nɛ Sʋntaana onɛ sʋ'oe banɛ mɔr paŋ agɔla la. Onɛ an sibɛ'ɛd kanɛ bɛ banɛ zan'as Wina'am nɔɔr la nii tʋm nɛ ba la.

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ti wʋsa mɛ da la'am bɛ nɛ ba saŋa linɛ gaad la mɔɔd ye ti ma'ae ti niŋgbiŋ nɛ ti ya'am bɔɔdim. Wina'am nɔpɔɔr da tun'e lu tinam zug na mɛn wʋʋ dunia dim wʋsa nɛ.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: hali baa la'an nɛ ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi da kɛ ka ti nwaas wʋʋ ti kpinɛ siigin la, o la'am vʋ'ʋgi ti nɛ Kristo. Li anɛ o pʋpielim zug ka o faaɛn ya.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Ka tinamɛ la'as nɛ Yesu Kristo la zug ka Wina'am la'am vʋ'ʋgi ti nɛ Kristo ka kɛ ka ti zin'in nɛ o arezana ni,

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: ye saŋa linɛ na ti kena la, o na nie pa'al o pʋpielim linɛ ka' bɛn la an si'em, nɛ on tisidi ti yɛlsʋm tinamɛ an yinne nɛ Kristo la zug.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Ka o pʋpielim zug ka o tisi ya faangir ka li yinɛ ya yadda niŋir Kristo ni na, ka li ka'anɛ ya mɛŋ tʋʋma zugɔ. Li wʋsa anɛ Wina'am piini la niŋ ala,

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: ka ka'anɛ ninsaal tʋʋma yɛla ka sɔ' na nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgɔ.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Li anɛ Wina'am maali ti ka ti an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo ye ti tʋm tʋʋm sʋma linɛ ka o pʋn dɛŋi ti'ebi digil ye ti tʋm la. Tinamɛ la'asi an yinne nɛ Kristo la yɛla

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ ninsaalib du'am pʋʋgin, ya da anɛ banɛ ka' Jew dim buudii, ka Jew dim banɛ kpɛn'ɛd baŋʋ la buonnɛ ya ye Apʋ-kpɛn'-baŋʋ dim, .

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, tɛnri ye saŋa linɛ gaad la ya da ka' yinne nɛ Kristo. Ya da anɛ teŋ zʋŋ nidib ka pʋ pɛ'ɛs Israel teŋgbauŋ nɛ nɔnaar kanɛ ka Wina'am da kaanbi tisi ba la. Ya da bɛ dunia nwa' ni ka pʋ mɔr ti'irɛ, ka mɛ zi' Wina'am.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna, nɛ Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr zug, yanam banɛ daa lal nɛ o la yʋ'ʋn liel o ka li yinɛ Kristo ziimin na.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Kristo aan ti zabpansid ka nɔki ti buudi ayi' la la'as ka ti lieb yinne, ka nwa'ae zaba zaŋguom

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: linɛ an Jew dim malʋŋ nɛ ba wada la. O kum la kpiis malʋŋ la ye o kpanb buudi ayi' la o san'an ka ba an buudi yinne ka mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ taaba.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Ka o kum dapuudir zug la kɛ ka buudi ayi' la naal nɔɔr nɛ Wina'am ka ti lieb buudi yinne ka zabir naae.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka Kristo kena mɔɔl sumbʋgʋsʋm labasʋŋ la tis yanam banɛ lal nɛ banɛ bɛ yamma la.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka o zug ka ti buudi ayi' la wʋsa mɔr suor nɛ Siig Kasi yinne la ni ye ti li'eli ti Ba' Wina'am san'an.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Linzug ka ya kʋdim lɛn ka' teŋ zʋŋ dim bɛɛ saama, ka lɛɛ anɛ Wina'am nidib ka bɛɛ o sʋ'ʋlimin la ka aan o yidim.

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: Ka ba nɔki ya mɛɛ sʋn'ʋl ɛɛnb kanɛ ka Yesu tʋmtʋmnib nɛ nɔdi'esidib da ɛɛnb la zug. Ka Yesu Kristo an dɔɔg la ɛɛnbir kugir la,

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: onɛ kɛ ka yir la wʋsa la'asi tɔ'ɔŋ taaba ka li gban'e kiŋ-kiŋ, ka yaligidi liebid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir linɛ an nyain ka pɛsigi tis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: Ka yanamɛ an yinne nɛ o la zug ka Wina'am Siig Kasi mɛɛ yaa maal ka ya an Wina'am yir ye o bɛɛ anina.

english_verse: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
translation_verse: Man Paul anɛ sanrega nid Kristo ni ka li anɛ yanam banɛ ka' Jew dim la zug.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: Bi'esʋg kae ye ya pʋn wʋm ye Wina'am yɛlsʋm zug ka o zaŋ tʋʋm nwa' tisim ye m tʋm ya sʋŋir zugɔ.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Wina'am nie yɛlsu'adir kaŋa pa'al mam wʋʋ man pʋn sɔbi li giŋa si'em la.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a karim gbauŋ nwa', ya na gban'e yɛlsu'adir kanɛ ka mam mi' Kristo yɛla la gbin.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Saŋa linɛ gaad la Wina'am da pʋ nie lii tis kʋdimin dima, amaa ka o Siig la yʋ'ʋn nie li pa'al o tʋmtʋmnib nɛ o nɔdi'esidib.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Ka yɛlsu'adir la yɛla anɛ ye labasʋŋ la mɔɔlʋg kɛt ka banɛ ka' Jew dim buudi wʋsa la'asid nɛ Jew dimi pʋdigid Wina'am piini ka la'an di'ed linɛ ka o zi'el nɔɔri tisi ti, tinamɛ an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo la zug, ka di'e o kaanbʋg la yit Yesu Kristo ni.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Li da anɛ Wina'am yɛlsʋm piini zug ka o gaŋim ka tisim o paŋ la ye m lieb onɛ mɔɔnnɛ o labasʋŋ la.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Manɛ an Wina'am nidib la wʋsa kpaanr, la'an nɛ wala, o tisim suor ye m mɔɔl labasʋŋ linɛ ka' makir Yesu Kristo ni la tis buudbanɛ ka' Jew dim la.

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: Ka kɛ ka nidib wʋsa nyɛ yɛlsu'adir suor linɛ ka Wina'am onɛ maal bʋn wʋsa la da su'a yʋʋm pʋkʋdʋgin la.

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: Ka li na yinɛ yadda niŋidibin la na ka na'anam nɛ paŋ dim banɛ bɛ saazug baŋ Wina'am ya'am linɛ ka' bɛn la.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Wina'am niŋ nɛ'ɛnam ka li dɔlnɛ on gban'e si'em, saŋa kanɛ ka dunia da nam pʋ pin'il la, ka li yinɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo san'an ka li niŋ sida.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ an yinne nɛ Kristo nɛ ti yadda niŋir la zug ka ti mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋʋ na nyaŋi keŋ Wina'am tuon.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m sɔsidi ya ye ya da kɛ ka ya sʋnya san'am man namisidi ya yɛla la zugɔ, ka m namisʋg la anɛ ya sumalisim. Paul Wina'am sɔsʋg

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m igini m duma zugʋ ti Ba' Wina'am tuon,

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: on kanɛ tisid buudi wʋsa banɛ bɛ saazug nɛ dunia ni ba yʋda la.

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: M sɔsid ye Wina'am onɛ girima nɛ o mɔrim galis la na tisi ya paŋ kanɛ na kpɛmisi ya sʋnya ka yit o Siig Kasi la ni na.

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: Ka sɔsid ye Kristo na bɛɛ ya sʋnya ni, yanamɛ niŋ o yadda la, ka o kɛ ka ya ba'a nya'a o nɔŋilimin la.

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: Ala ka yanam nɛ Wina'am nidib wʋsa na paam Siig paŋi nyaŋi baŋ Yesu nɔŋilim wa'am ka labis ka dʋ ka zulim si'em.

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: Asida, ya sid na baŋ o nɔŋilim linɛ gat nidibi na tun'e baŋi li si'em, la'an nɛ din tɔi nɛ yanamɛ na nyaŋi baŋi li wʋsa ka li kɛ ka ya pɛ'ɛl nɛ Wina'am bɔɔdim la.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Mam onɛ an sanrega nid Zugsɔb la yɛla la sɔsidi ya ye ya dɔl suor linɛ nar nɛ Wina'am gaŋi ya si'em la.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Li an sʋm ka ya sie ya mɛŋ ka an baanlimm ka mɔr suguru nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm linɛ yi nɔŋirin,

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya mɛŋ ka mɔr nɔɔr yinne linɛ yi Wina'am Siig Kasi la ni na, ka mɔri li nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm ka li la'asidi ya gumm.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Niŋgbiŋ yinne bɛ, ka Wina'am Siig Kasi yinne ma'aa mɛ bɛ. Ka Wina'am buoli ya ye ya mɔr ti'ir yinne.

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb yinne bɛ, nɛ yadda yinne nɛ Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb yinne

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: nɛ Wina'am yinne onɛ aan ti wʋsa Ba', onɛ gat si'el wʋsa, ka o paŋ dɔlisidi ti wʋsa ni tʋm, ka o lɛm bɛɛ ti wʋsa ni.

english_verse: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.
translation_verse: Ka ti wʋsa yinne-yinne di'e pʋpielim piini linɛ dɔl Kristo bɔɔdim la.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Dinzug ka li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “On daa dʋʋ agɔl la, o daa mɔr banɛ an yammis bɛdegʋ keŋ, ka tis nidib piini.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Linɛ sɔb ye, “O dʋʋ agɔl la” gbin an bɔ? Li anɛ ye o daa dɛŋin sig na hali ti paae dunia teŋir.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Ka on kanɛ sig na la an onɛ mɛ dʋʋ agɔla sa, gaad dunia nɛ saazug wʋsa ye o tiig dunia zin'ig wʋsa la.

english_verse: so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong.
translation_verse: Ka ba pa'al Wina'am nidib ka ba na tʋmm sʋŋid taaba ken tuon, ka Kristo niŋgbiŋ linɛ aan o nidib la nɔbigidi

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: ti paae saŋa kanɛ ka ti wʋsa mɔr nɔɔr yinne linɛ dɔlli ti nɔɔr siakir nɛ tinamɛ baŋ Wina'am Biig la yɛla, ti bi' paae wʋʋ Kristo zemis si'em la.

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: Ala ka ti kʋ lɛn an wʋʋ bibibis banɛ ka' ya'am, ka ba mɔri ti yutim yɔri-yɔri ka pa'annɛ ti pa'al yaalis linɛ yit dama'anam nɛ bibi'es san'anɛ.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Amaa lɛɛ pian'ami sida la tis taaba nɛ nɔŋilim, ka li anɛ tilas ye ti wʋsa bɛ wʋʋ labasʋŋ la pa'al si'em la ka nɔbig yɛla wʋsa ni ti paae Kristo,

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: onɛ nwɛnɛ zug linɛ kɛ ka niŋgbiŋ la wʋsa la'asi tɔ'ɔŋ taaba nɛ li duta wʋsa la. Ka li yinne-yinne ya'a niŋid linɛ nar, niŋgbiŋ la wʋsa nɔbigidnɛ sʋ'ʋŋa, ka li yinɛ nɔŋirin na ka li biid. Ti bɛllim paal la yɛla

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: Ba pʋtɛnda pʋ nie, ka ba pʋ paas nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka Wina'am tisid la nii, ba zi'ilim nɛ ba kpaana la zug

english_verse: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
translation_verse: ka ba sʋnya digilim ka ba ba'a kae nɛ nyannɛ, ka bɔɔd tʋʋmyɔɔd nɛ li buudi wʋsa.

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: basimi yanamɛ da an si'em ya bɛllim kʋdirin linɛ kɛ ka dama'am ya'amlɛog kɛ ka ya san'am la,

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: ka tiaki ya pʋtɛnda bɔɔdim ka li lieb bʋmpaala.

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ya bɛllim an bɛllim paala linɛ ka Wina'am maal ka li nwɛnɛ o la, ka yanamɛ niŋid si'el an sida nɛ pʋpielim linɛ dɔl Wina'am suor.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, basimi dama'am ka pian'adi sida tisidi ya kpi'es; ka ti la'asi an niŋgbiŋ yinne nɛ taaba.

english_verse: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
translation_verse: Fʋ sʋnf ya'a duoe fʋn da tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ, ka mɛ da kɛ ka zaam ma'ae ka fʋ nan mɔr sʋnpɛɛnnɛ.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: Ka da tis Sʋntaana suor hali baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Onɛ daa zuud on da lɛn zu ya'asɛ, amaa li sʋm ye o tʋm ka nyɛɛ o mɛŋ nu'ug tʋʋma bʋn, ka na tun'e sʋŋ nɔŋ dim.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ya nɔya pian'ad bɛ'ɛdɛ, amaa kɛlli ka linɛ yiti ya nɔɔrin an pian'asʋŋ, ka li sʋŋ banɛ kɛlisid la, ka ba bii ba bɛllim pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Da niŋi linɛ na kɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la sʋnf san'amnɛ yaa, bɔzugɔ onɛ dɛŋi zanbili ya gur daakanɛ ka o na tisi ya yɔlisim wʋsa la.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Basimi sʋntɔɔg nɛ sʋnpɛɛn nɛ ɛndʋg nɛ nɔŋgbannwa'ar, nɛ yʋ'ʋsan'auŋ nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd wʋsa,

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: ka sʋŋidi taaba nɛ nimbaanlzɔɔr ka tis taaba suguru nwɛnɛ Wina'am dɔlis Kristo ni si'em yisi ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas la.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Wina'am an si'em la, ya mɛ aan ala, wʋʋ biis banɛ ka ba saam nɔŋ.

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ka mɔri nɔŋir wʋʋ Kristo nɔŋi ti si'em, ka pɛsig o mɛŋi maal maan sʋŋʋ tis Wina'am ti yɛla la.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ sadigin an Wina'am nidib la, mid ka ya kɛ ka pu'asan'auŋ nɛ dausan'auŋ nɛ dian'ad buudi wʋsa nɛ ya'amlɛog bɛɛ ya ni.

english_verse: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
translation_verse: Mɛ da pain'adi pian'ayɔɔd nɛ galim yɔɔd linɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ, amaa lɛɛ pʋ'ʋsimi Wina'am bareka.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Baŋimi ye pu'asan'auŋ sɔb bɛɛ dausan'auŋ sɔb bɛɛ dian'ad sɔb bɛɛ fufum sɔb kʋ di faar Kristo nɛ Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim la nii. Onɛ mɔr fufum nwɛnɛ ba'amaan nɛ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛnam zug, ka Wina'am sʋnf pɛlig nɛ banɛ zan'as o nɔɔr la. Dinzugɔ, da kɛ ka sɔ' ma' ya nɛ pian'ayaalisɛ.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Alazug da la'asidi nɛ baa.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Saŋsi'en la, ya da bɛ nɛ likin, amaa ya yʋ'ʋn bɛ nɛ nɛɛsim ni ka an yinne nɛ Zugsɔb la. Linzug, niŋimi wʋʋ banɛ bɛ nɛɛsiminɛ niŋid si'em la.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, nɛɛsim bɛllim nyɔɔd anɛ pʋpielim nɛ yɛlsida nɛ yɛlsʋm wʋsa.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya mɛŋi baŋi linɛ ma'ad Zugsɔb la sʋʋnr.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ya ba'a bɛ nɛ lik tʋʋma linɛ ka' nyɔɔdɛ, amaa viigimi tʋʋm yaalis la paalʋ.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Li anɛ nyan hali nɛ sɔ' na pian'ad banɛ ki'isid la su'adi tʋm si'el la.

english_verse: But the light will show what these things are really like.
translation_verse: Nɛɛsim ya'a viig si'el gbin nyain yis paalʋ na, fʋ na baŋi li bʋn gbin nyain-nyain.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Ka linɛ nied wʋsa liebidnɛ nyain. Dinzug ka li sɔb ye, “Gbɛɛm sɔba, duom ka vʋ'ʋg kumin, ka Kristo na kɛ ka li nie fʋ san'an.”

english_verse: These are evil times, so make every minute count.
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ ka ya nyɛ suor wʋsa, yanam niŋim linɛ an sʋm, ka dabisa la anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd saŋa.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ da aaɛn zɔnnɛ, amaa baŋimi Zugsɔb la bɔɔdim an si'em.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Da nuud daam kʋʋnɛ nyaa, ka li anɛ tʋʋm yaalis. Amaa kɛlli ka Wina'am Siig Kasi sʋ'ʋgi ya.

english_verse: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
translation_verse: Pian'am tisi taaba nɛ yʋʋma banɛ sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn, nɛ yʋʋma banɛ ka Wina'am nidib sɔb, nɛ yʋʋma banɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi tis, ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma kɔn'ɔb, kɔn'ɔbi zun'od Wina'am yʋ'ʋr nɛ ya sʋnf wʋsa.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: Ka si'el mɛkama ni, pʋ'ʋsimini ti Ba' Wina'am bareka nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋrin saŋa mɛkama. Pu'ab nɛ ba sidib la yɛla

english_verse: Honor Christ and put others first.
translation_verse: Siakimi taaba nɔya, yanamɛ na'asid Kristo la zug.

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Pu'aba, siakimini ya sidib nɔya wʋʋ yanamɛ siakid Zugsɔb la nɔɔr si'em la.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Ka sid la an pu'a la zugdaan wʋʋ Kristo an Wina'am nidib la zugdaan si'em la, banɛ aan o niŋgbiŋ linɛ ka o faaɛn la.

english_verse: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am nidibi sadigim siak Kristo nɔɔr la, pu'ab mɛ niŋim ala mɛnɛ tisi ba sidib yɛla mɛkama wʋsa ni.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Sidiba, nɔŋimini ya pu'ab wʋʋ Kristo nɔŋ Wina'am nidib ka pɛsig o mɛŋi tisi ba yɛla si'em la.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: O niŋ ala ye o gaŋi ba ka ba an Wina'am din ka sʋʋ ba Wina'am ku'om ka ba an nyain labasʋŋ la ni,

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: ye o zaŋi ba ka ba an yinne kɛɛn o mɛŋ tuon na ka ba an nyain ka gbada kae wʋʋ pu'a kun sid nɛ vɛnlim pipilim ka si'el kae san'amid o vɛnlim la.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Ala mɛnɛ, sidiba, nɔŋimini ya pu'ab wʋʋ ya mɛŋ niŋgbina nɛ. Onɛ nɔŋ o pu'a nɔŋ o mɛŋ.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' kae kis o mɛŋ niŋgbinaa. O lɛɛ diisidi li nɛ ka gɔsidi li wʋʋ Kristo niŋid si'em tisid Wina'am nidib la,

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: tinamɛ aan o niŋgbiŋ wila la zug.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: “Dinzug, dau na bas o ba' nɛ o ma ka la'as nɛ o pu'a ka babayi' la lieb niŋgbiŋ yinne.”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ yɛlsu'adir tita'ar ka man zaŋi li mak nɛ Kristo nɛ karindɔɔg yɛla.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ya wʋsa yinne-yinne nɔŋ o pu'a wʋʋ o mɛŋ nɛ. Ka pu'a la mɛ na'asim o sid.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Biisɛ, siakimini ya du'adib nɔya, Zugsɔb la ni, ka ala dɔl suor.

english_verse: and you will have a long and happy life.”
translation_verse: ka ala ka si'el wʋsa na an sʋm tisif, ka fʋ nyɔvʋr na wa'am dunia nwa' ni.”

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Saamnama, da kɛ ka ya biis sʋnya pɛlig nɛ sa'al galisʋgɔ, amaa zaŋimi zamisʋg linɛ dɔl Zugsɔb suor la sʋŋi ba. Yammis nɛ ba zugdaannam la yɛla

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Yammisɛ, siakimini ya zugdaannam nɔya dunia nwa' ni nɛ na'asi zɔtim nɛ sʋnf yinne, wʋʋ ya dɔlli Kristo nɛ.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Li ka'anɛ ban na bɛ nɛ ya gʋllim ka li kɛ ka ba tɛn'ɛs ye ya an sʋm, amaa niŋimi wʋʋ ya anɛ Kristo yammis ka tʋm Wina'am bɔɔdim nɛ ya sʋnya wʋsa.

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: Tʋmmi ya tʋʋma nɛ sumalisim wʋʋ ya tʋmnɛ tisid Zugsɔb la ka ka' nidiba,

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: ka mɔri pʋtɛn'ɛr ye onɛ tʋm tʋʋm sʋŋ wʋsa na dii li nyɔɔd Zugsɔb Kristo la san'an, o ya'a an yammʋg bɛɛ o ka' yammʋgɔ.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ an zugdaannama, niŋimin ala mɛnɛ tisidi ba, ka da mugusidi baa, ka mɔri pʋtɛn'ɛr ye yanam nɛ ban wʋsa mɔri Zugsɔb yinne arezana ni, onɛ pʋ mɔr baregaŋa. Zaba la'abanɛ ka Wina'am tisid la yɛla

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Linɛ kpɛlim anɛ ye, ya mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ Zugsɔb la ni la'an nɛ o paŋ tita'arin la.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Yɛɛmi Wina'am zaba la'ad la wʋsa ka ya na nyaŋi zi'en kiŋ-kiŋ, ka ala ka Sʋntaana bibi'elim ya'am kʋ nyaŋi lugi yaa.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, ti pʋ zabid nɛ saaliba, amaa ti zabidi nɛ sibɛ'ɛdnam kpi'emnam banɛ an paŋ dim nɛ na'anam banɛ sʋ'oe dunia linɛ an lik tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla la, nɛ sibɛ'ɛdnam wʋsa banɛ bɛ saazug.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, nɔkimi Wina'am zaba la'ad la wʋsa bɔbigi wʋʋ Room dim soogianamɛ niŋid si'em la, ka dabisbɛ'og ya'a kena ya na nyaŋi ya dataas. Ka zaba la ya'a ti naae ya na kpɛn zi'e yanamɛ zi'e si'el la kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, ti'ebim zi'en ka nɔk sida lɔ wʋʋ sɛnbidiŋ nɛ, ka bɔbig pʋpielim wʋʋ gbanti'edʋgʋ lusi ya nyɔ'ɔg.

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: Ka pid ta'ada linɛ an sumbʋgʋsʋm yit labasʋŋin la ka li ti'ebi ya ka ya keŋ mɔɔl labasʋŋ la.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Ka linɛ lɛm paas anɛ ye, ya zanli gbanti'edis linɛ an yadda ka na tun'e kpiis piema linɛ dit nwɛnɛ bugum pielim, linɛ ka Sʋntaana tɔɔnd la.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka pidi kʋnt zupibis linɛ an faangir, ka nɔki Wina'am Siig Kasi zaba sʋ'ʋg linɛ an Wina'am pian'ad la.

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: Niŋimi nɛ'ɛnam ka sɔsidi nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la saŋa wʋsa nɛ winsɔsʋg buudi wʋsa. Kpɛn sɔsidi Wina'am tisid nidib wʋsa,

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: ka mɛ sɔs Wina'am tis mam, ye Wina'am na kɛ ka m nyaŋi pian' sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ paŋi kɛ ka labasʋŋ linɛ su'a la nie.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Labaar la yɛla ka m liebi li tʋmtʋm ka ba lɔɔm nɛ bana. Sɔsimi Wina'am ye m na tun'e pa'ali li ka dabiem kae wʋʋ lin sʋm ye m pian'an si'em la. Pʋ'ʋsʋg

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ aan ti Ba' la nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na tisi ti ba'abiis la wʋsa nɔŋir nɛ sumalisim nɛ yadda niŋir.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Yɛlsʋm na bɛ nɛ banɛ nɔŋi ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo nɛ nɔŋir linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Mam Paul nɛ Timoti banɛ an Yesu Kristo tʋmtʋmnib la sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid Wina'am nidib banɛ an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo ka bɛ Filipi teŋin la, la'an nɛ Wina'am nimbanɛ an tuongatib nɛ sʋŋidib la.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na tisi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Paul bareka pʋ'ʋsim nɛ winsɔsʋg yɛla

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: M ya'a ɛɛn tɛn'ɛsi ya yɛla, li kɛtnɛ ka m pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: Ka m ya'a ɛɛnti sɔsid Wina'am tisidi ya wʋsa m sɔsidnɛ nɛ sumalisim,

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: tinamɛ an tʋmtʋm taaba hali pin'ilʋgʋn sa ti paae zina la.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: M mi' hali ye Wina'am onɛ pin'il tʋʋm sʋŋʋ ya sʋnya ni la, na tʋmi lii naae Yesu Kristo ken dabisir la na.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: Li an sʋm ka m tɛn'ɛsi ya wʋsa yɛla ala, mam mɔri ya pʋtɛn'ɛr sʋŋ la zug. Dinzugɔ ba ya'a lɔɔm nɛ bana bɛɛ ti la'am pa'annɛ nidib ye labasʋŋ la an sida ya na la'an di'ed Wina'am pʋpielim piini la nɛ man.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am baŋ ye m ya'am bɔɔdi ya wʋsa nɛ nɔŋilim linɛ yi Yesu Kristo ni na.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: Ka m sɔsid Wina'am ye ya nɔŋilim na pɛ'ɛs hali nɛ mi'ilim nɛ baŋir amɛŋa,

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: ye ya gaŋ linɛ an sʋm ka an nyain ka dian'ad kae la gur Yesu Kristo lɛbig dabisir na.

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: Ka pɛ'ɛl nɛ pʋpielim wala linɛ yi Yesu Kristo san'an naa tisid Wina'am yʋ'ʋr zʋn'or nɛ na'asi la. Paul sanrega ni bɛllim la yɛla

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m bɔɔd ye ya baŋ ye linɛ niŋi m la sid sʋŋ ka labasʋŋ la ken tuon.

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: Li kɛ ka gɔmena yin soogianam wʋsa nɛ sɔ' mɛkama baŋ ye ban lɔɔm nɛ bana la, li anɛ Kristo yɛla.

english_verse: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
translation_verse: Ka ban lɔɔm nɛ bana zug kɛ ka ti ba'abiis la tita'am pamm kpɛmisʋg ka pian'ad Wina'am labaar la yɛla nɛ kpi'euŋ ka dabiem kae.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Sieba mɔɔn Kristo yɛla la nɛ fufum nɛ nɛnnim ka sieba tʋm nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛsʋŋ.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Ka pʋtɛn'ɛsʋŋ dim la mɔɔnnɛ linɛ nɛ nɔŋilim ka baŋ ye Wina'am zi'el man ye m gu' banɛ zan'as labasʋŋ la.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Ka sieba pʋ mɔɔn Kristo yɛla nɛ pʋpielim, amaa ba mɔɔnnɛ nɛ nɛnnim ka bɔɔd ye m namiskanɛ ka m nyɛt sanrega ni la paas.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Li pʋ pakɛ. Linɛ gaadi li wʋsa anɛ Kristo labaar la mɔɔlʋg; hali li ya'a dɔlnɛ pʋtɛn'ɛsʋŋin bɛɛ pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛdinɛ, li kpɛm malis man.

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ka m mi' ye li yitnɛ ya Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim nɛ Yesu Kristo Siig Kasi la sʋŋir ni na, ka linɛ maal la na tisim faangir.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Linɛ ka man bɔɔd hali ka mɔr ti'iri li yɛla anɛ ye m ya'a kpi bɛɛ m ya'a vʋe m kʋ di nyannɛ amaa m lɛɛ na mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ ka li kɛ ka Kristo nyɛ na'asi man ni nannanna, wʋʋ on nyɛti ya san'an si'em saŋa wʋsa la.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ mam, m ya'a vʋe, m vʋe nɛ Kristo zug, ka m ya'a lɛn kpi nɛ, li anɛ nyɔɔdi tisim.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Ka m ya'a vʋe ka na tʋm tʋʋm sʋma li an sʋm. Amaa mam bɔɔd ba' nɛ ma la zug, m kʋ nyaŋi gban'e linɛ ka m na gaŋɛ.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye m yi bɛllim kaŋa nwa' nii keŋ bɛ nɛ Kristo; bɔzugɔ linɛ an sʋm hali.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: M mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ nɛ man yɛl si'el la ka linzug ka m mi' ye m na kpɛm bɛ nɛ ya wʋsa, ka ya yadda niŋir Yesu Kristo ni na keŋ tuon nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: Ka m ya'a ti bɛ nɛ ya ya'as, ya na tun'e nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg hali Yesu Kristo ni.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Lin an si'em wʋsa kɛlli ka ya bɛllim dɔl nɛ Kristo labasʋŋ la, ka m ya'a kɛɛn ya san'an na bɛɛ m ya'a pʋ kenaa, m na wʋm ye ya gban'e pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne kiŋ-kiŋ, ka mɔɔd nɛ yadda yinne nɛ nɔɔr yinne ye labasʋŋ la siakir na keŋ tuon.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Da zɔti ya dataas dabiem baa bi'elaa, ka ya sʋnkpi'euŋ na pa'ali ba ye ba na ba'as bɛ'ɛd. Amaa ka lɛɛ pa'al ye yanam na nyɛ faangir linɛ yi Wina'am san'an na la.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Wina'am tisi ya suor ye ya dɔl Kristo, ka li ka'anɛ ye ya niŋ o yadda ma'aanɛ, amaa ye ya siaki namis o zug.

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: Ka ya namisʋg nwɛnɛ yanamɛ da nyɛ man namisid si'em la, ka nan kpɛn wʋmid ye m bɛɛ li pʋʋgin nannanna la.

english_verse: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
translation_verse: Ya bɛllim Kristo ni ya'a sadigim kpɛmisi ya, ka o nɔŋilim la bɛlisi ya, ka ya an banɛ la'am di'e Wina'am Siig Kasi la, ka mɔr nɔŋilim nɛ nyɔɔg nɛ taaba,

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: alazugɔɔ mɔɔmi ka mɔri pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne, nɛ nɔŋilim yinne ka an yinne Siig pʋʋgin, ka mɔr gban'ar yinne. Ya ya'a niŋ ala, li na kɛ ka m sumalisim la pɛ'ɛl.

english_verse: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
translation_verse: Da niŋɛ si'el linɛ yi nɛnnim nɛ tita'aliminɛ amaa lɛɛ siemi ya mɛŋ ka tɛn'ɛsi ye ya taaba an sʋm gati ya.

english_verse: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ya wʋsa pʋtɛn'ɛr gban'e ye ya sʋŋ taaba, ka ka'anɛ ya mɛŋ yɛla ma'aanɛ.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Pʋtɛn'ɛr kanɛ nar ye ya mɔr anɛ Yesu Kristo pʋtɛn'ɛr.

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ on an nwɛnɛ Wina'am an si'em la, o da pʋ tɛn'ɛs ye li sʋ'ʋm ye o dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋi pa'al ye on nɛ Wina'am zem nɛ.

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: Ka lɛɛ sie o mɛŋ ka lieb wʋʋ yammʋgʋ an si'em la, ka ba du'a o ka o lieb ninsaal.

english_verse: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
translation_verse: Ka on nie wʋʋ ninsaali an si'em la, o sie o mɛŋ ka siak kum wʋʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb nɛ hali kpi dapuudir zug.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Linzug ka Wina'am dʋ'ʋs o hali, ka tis o yʋ'ʋr linɛ gat yʋda wʋsa.

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: Dinzug, nɛ Yesu yʋ'ʋr zug, linɛ wʋsa bɛ saazug bɛɛ teŋin bɛɛ teŋ teŋir, na igin o tuon ka dʋ'ʋs o yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' mɛkama na yɛl ye, Yesu Kristo an Zugsɔb la, ka li zun'e ti Ba' Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr. Ti anɛ nɛɛsim dunia nwa' ni

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, yanam banɛ aan m zuasʋma nwa'; mam daa bɛ nɛ ya ka ya siakidi m sa'alʋg si'em la, niŋimi ka li gaad ala la'an nɛ man ka' ya san'an la, ka tʋmmi tʋʋma linɛ aan ya faangir yɛla la sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ kikirʋg nɛ dabiem.

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, Wina'am tʋmmi ya ni daar wʋsa ka kɛt ka ya mɔr ya'amlɛog ye ya siak o nɔɔr, ka tʋm linɛ na ma'ae o sʋʋnr.

english_verse: Do everything without grumbling or arguing.
translation_verse: Niŋimi si'el mɛkama ka nyunyɔlis nɛ nɔŋgbannwa'ar da bɛɛ,

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: ye ya an nyain ka taal ka'asigɛ, ka an Wina'am bibanɛ bɛ zʋmaʋŋ bɛ'ɛd nɛ ninyɔɔdnam sʋʋgin ka lɛɛ pʋ mɔr gba'arɛ, ka nie nyain wʋʋ nwadbibis banɛ bɛ saŋgbana ni la,

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: ka gban'e nyɔvʋr pian'ad la kiŋ-kiŋ. Ya ya'a niŋ ala, m na nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔgʋ ya yɛla Yesu Kristo ken daar na, ye m zigib nɛ m tʋʋma la wʋsa pʋ niŋ zaalim.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Hali baa m ya'a zaŋi m nyɔvʋri tis ka li nwɛnɛ maan nɛ yanam yadda niŋir zug, li na malis mam ka m na maal sumalisim nɛ ya wʋsa.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Ala mɛnɛɛ, li sʋ'ʋm ka ya sʋnya ma'ae ka ya mɔr sumalisim nɛ mam. Timoti nɛ Epafroditus yɛla

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: M mɔr ti'iri ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni ye ti kʋ yuugɛ ka na tʋm Timoti ya san'an na ka o na tisi ya m labaar ka m sʋnf ma'ae.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: On ma'aa mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne nɛ mam ka on ba' sid bɛ nɛ ya yɛla hali.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Sɔ' mɛkama zigidnɛ o mɛŋ yɛla ka ka'anɛ Yesu Kristo yɛlaa.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Ka ya mi' Timoti an sʋm si'em ka mi' ye mam nɛ on tʋm labasʋŋ tʋʋma la nwɛnɛ dau nɛ o biigi niŋid si'em.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye mam ya'a baŋi m yɛla la na naae si'em m na tʋm o ya san'an na tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: M mɛ mɔr ti'ir Zugsɔbin la ye li kʋ yuugɛ ka m mɛ na kena.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: M tɛn'ɛs ka li nar ye m tʋmi m ba'abiig, Epafroditus onɛ aan m tʋmtʋm tiraan ka lɛn aan m soogia tiraan ka an onɛ ka ya tʋm o ye o sʋŋim la.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: O bɔɔd nɛ o sʋʋnr wʋsa ye o nyɛɛ ya, bɔzugɔ, o sʋnf san'amnɛ yanamɛ wʋm o ban'as yɛla la.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Sida, o daa bɛn'ɛdnɛ ka nwaas kum, ka Wina'am zɔɔ o nimbaanlig, ka li ka'anɛ on ma'aa nimbaanliga, amaa la'an nɛ mam mɛn, ka m sʋnsa'aŋ da lɛm pɛ'ɛsɛ.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m mɔɔd nɛ nimmua hali ye m tʋm o ya san'an na, ka ya ya'a nyɛɛ o, ya sʋnya na malis, ka m ya'am na digin mɛn.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Di'emin o nɛ sumalisim on aan ya ba'abiig Zugsɔb la ni la zug. Ka na'asidi nimbanɛ mɛ nwɛn o la,

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ li da kpɛlim bi'ela ka o kpi Kristo tʋʋma la yɛla, ka kɛɛs o nyɔvʋr ye o sʋŋ mam nɛ linɛ ka ya mɛŋ pʋ nyaŋi sʋŋim la.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Linɛ naad wʋsa anɛ ye, m ba'abiisɛ, mɔri sumalisim Zugsɔb la ni. Li pʋ daam man ye m lɛn sɔb bʋn kan yɛla ya'asɛ, bɔzugɔ li anɛ sʋŋiri tisidi ya.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Gu'usimi ya mɛŋ nɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam la, banɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, la'an nɛ banɛ kpɛn'ɛsid nidib baŋʋ ka pa'an ye ba anɛ Wina'am nidib la.

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Tinam banɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am nɛ o Siig Kasi paŋ la an banɛ kpɛn' baŋʋ linɛ nar la. Ti pʋ nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ ninsaalib tʋʋma amaa ti lɛɛ nwɛ'ɛdnɛ nyɔ'ɔg nɛ Yesu Kristo tʋm si'el la.

english_verse: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
translation_verse: M ya'a bɔɔdin, m naan tun'e nwɛ'ɛdin nyɔ'ɔg nɛ bʋmbama ni. Sɔ' ya'a tɛn'ɛs ye o mɔr suokanɛ na kɛ ka o nwɛ' nyɔ'ɔg nɛ saalib tʋʋma, manɛ lɛɛ gat.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
