translation_verse: Ban du'a mam la daba anii daar ka ba kpɛn'ɛsim baŋʋ. Man anɛ Israel nid yinne ka an Benjamin dɔɔg nid ka an Hibiru nid amɛŋa, ka Jew dim wada la dɔlisʋg yɛla ka m an Farisii nid.

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: Ka li ya'a anɛ nimmua yɛla m da namisid Wina'am nimbanɛ niŋ Yesu yadda. Ka li ya'a anɛ pʋpielim linɛ an wada siakir la yɛla la, m da ka' gba'arɛ.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Ka yɛlbanɛ wʋsa ka m naan nɔkin ka li an nyɔɔdi tisim la, Kristo yɛla, ka m nɔki li ka li an zaalim.

english_verse: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
translation_verse: Asida, m tɛn'ɛs ye si'el mɛkama anɛ zaalim. Ka Yesu Kristo baŋir yɛla an sʋm gati li wʋsa. On yɛla ka m lu si'el mɛkama ni ka nɔki li ka li an sa'ad, ye Kristo lɛɛ na aan m nyɔɔd,

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: ka man nɛ on lieb yinne. M pʋ lɛm mɔr pʋpielim linɛ aan m mɛŋ din linɛ an wada suor dɔllimm. M yʋ'ʋn mɔri pʋpielim linɛ yi Yesu Kristo yadda niŋirin ka an Wina'am din linɛ ka ti di'ed nɛ yadda niŋir.

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: Mam bɔɔd si'el anɛ mam na baŋ Kristo nɛ o kum vʋ'ʋgir la paŋ, ka la'am namis nɛ o ka nwɛnɛ o nɛ, o kum pʋʋgin,

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: ka mɔr ti'ir ye m mɛ na ti vʋ'ʋg kumin. Wina'am piini di'er nyidigir la yɛla

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: Li ka' ye m pʋn dɛŋi nyɛ piini la nɛ, bɛɛ lieb sʋ'ʋm naae, amaa m nyidigidnɛ ye m gban'e piini kanɛ yɛla ka Yesu Kristo gaŋim la.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m pʋ tɛn'ɛs ye m nyaŋi paam nannɛ. Linɛ zug ka m nyidigid la anɛ ye m tam linɛ gaad la ka lɛɛ mɔɔd ye m paam linɛ bɛ tuon la.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: M zɔtnɛ hali ye m paae zɔɔg la naar bɛn, ka di'e piini la. Ka piini la anɛ ye Wina'am buol mam arezana ni ka li yi Yesu Kristo ni na.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka tinam banɛ yadda bi' la mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr kan mɛn, ka sɔ' ya'a mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛsi'a, Wina'am na nie li ka ya baŋ.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ti gban'e linɛ ka ti dɛŋi siak la kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, la'asimi nɛ ya taaba tu'asi mam tʋʋma, ka kpansid banɛ bɛllim tu'asi ti bɛllim an si'em la.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: M dɛŋi yɛli ya nɔɔr bɛdegʋ, ka lɛn yɛti ya nɛ ninta'am ye nidib bɛdegʋ bɛ ka an dataas nɛ Yesu Kristo dapuudir la yɛla.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Ba ba'asʋg anɛ san'auŋ, ka ba niŋgbiŋ bɔɔdim aan ba Wina'am. Ba nɔkid linɛ an nyan la nwɛ'ɛdi ba nyɔ'ɔg, ka ba ya'am kpɛn' linɛ an dunia bʋn ma'aa.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Amaa tinam anɛ arezana nidib, zin'ikanɛ ka ti guri ti faangid Yesu Kristo yiib na la.

english_verse: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_verse: Onɛ na tiaki ti tadʋŋ niŋgbiŋ la ka li nwɛnɛ o niŋgbiŋ linɛ vɛnl pil-pil la. O na niŋ ala nɛ o paŋ kanɛ kɛ ka o nyaŋ ka sʋ'oe si'el mɛkama wʋsa la.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Alazugɔ m ba'abibanɛ ka m nɔŋ hali ka bɔɔd ye m nyɛɛ ya la, linɛ na ma'ae m sʋnf ka tisim nyɔɔd anɛ yanamɛ na nyaŋi zi'en Zugsɔb la san'an kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: M bɛllim Yuodia nɛ Sintike ye ban an yinne nɛ Zugsɔb la, ba niŋim nɔɔr yinne nɛ taaba.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: M zɔɔng amɛŋa, m mɛ sɔsidif ye fʋ sʋŋ pu'ab la. Ba daa la'as nɛ mam tʋm Kristo labasʋŋ la tʋʋma nɛ Klemen nɛ o tʋmtʋm taaba banɛ kpɛlim ka ba yʋda sɔb nyɔvʋr paal dim gbauŋʋn la.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Mɔri sumalisim saŋa wʋsa yanamɛ an yinne nɛ Zugsɔb la, m na lɛn yɛl ya'as ye, mɔri sumalisim.

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka nidib wʋsa nyɛ yanamɛ bɛ bɛllim sʋŋ si'em. Tɛnri ye Zugsɔb la kenna li'elnɛ.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka si'el yɛla paki yaa, amaa ya pʋ'ʋsim wʋsa pʋʋgin yɛlimi Wina'am yanamɛ bɔɔd si'el ka pʋ'ʋs o bareka.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Wina'am na tisi ya sumbʋgʋsʋm linɛ galis ka ninsaalib kʋ nyaŋɛ gban'e li gbinnɛ, ka na guri ya sʋnya nɛ ya tɛn'ɛsa Yesu Kristo ni.

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: M Ba'abiisɛ, li ba'asʋg anɛ anwa. Kɛlli ka ya ya'am kpɛn' si'el mɛkama linɛ an sida nɛ linɛ mɔr na'asi nɛ linɛ dɔl suor nɛ linɛ an nyain nɛ linɛ vɛnl nɛ linɛ wʋsa tigid nini. Si'el ya'a bɛɛ an sʋm hali bɛɛ nar nɛ wɔ'ɔgir, yanam tɛn'ɛsim bʋmbama yɛla.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Niŋimi linɛ wʋsa ka ya zamis bɛɛ di'e, bɛɛ wʋm, bɛɛ nyɛɛm san'an la, ka Wina'am onɛ tisidi ti sumbʋgʋsʋm la na bɛ nɛ ya. Piini bareka pʋ'ʋsʋg yɛla

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: Mam mɔr sumpielim pamm Zugsɔb la san'an, ya ba'a lɛm bɛɛ m ni la zug. M mi' ye ya ba'a sid daa bɛɛ ni, amaa ya daa ka' suosi'a na pa'ali lii.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: Man yɛt nɛ'ɛŋa la pʋ pa'al ye si'eli pɔ'ɔgi ma. Bɔzugɔ, m pʋn zamis ye m bɛllim ya'a an si'em wʋsa li kʋ paki ma.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: M mi' tadʋŋʋ an si'em ka lɛm mi' mɔrim an si'em. M zamis ye m tun'e bɛ hali baa li ya'a bɔɔd lin an si'em wʋsa, li ya'a an tigir bɛɛ kɔ'ɔm bɛɛ kpan'am bɛɛ nɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: M tun'e tʋm si'el mɛkama wʋsa nɛ paŋ kanɛ ka Kristo tisidim la.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Ka la'an nɛ wala sa ya maal sʋ'ʋm yanamɛ la'an sʋŋim nɛ m namisʋgʋn la.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Yanam Filipi dim mi' labasʋŋ la mɔɔlʋg pin'ilʋgʋ ya teŋin la yɛla, mam daa yi Masedonia ka tɔɔm la, Wina'am nidib pʋ naan teŋ si'a tisim bɛɛ di'e si'eli m san'anɛ asɛɛ yanam ma'aa.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ man daa bɛ Tɛsalonika teŋin la, ya daa tɔlim sʋŋim nɔɔr bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Li ka' piini ka mam bɔɔda, amaa m bɔɔd ye ya nyɔɔd linɛ digi guri ya la paas.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: M di'e piinbanɛ wʋsa ka ya tis Epafroditus ye o mɔri kena la ka li siaki m bɔɔdim. Li anɛ wʋʋ bʋn linɛ ka li nyuug malis ka ba nyu'oe tis Wina'am ka o di'ed nɛ sumalisim nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Ka m Wina'am onɛ ka m siak ka dɔl la na tisi ya linɛ mɛkama nar nɛ ya, ka li dɔlnɛ o kpan'am tita'ar linɛ bɛ Yesu Kristo ni la.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am na nyɛ zʋn'or saŋa kanɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Ami. Pʋ'ʋsʋg

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsim Wina'am nimbanɛ an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo la wʋsa. Ti ba'abiis banɛ la'am bɛ nɛ m la pʋ'ʋsidi ya.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Wina'am nidib wʋsa pʋ'ʋsidi ya; hali linɛ gat anɛ na'ab Siiza yidim la.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yɛlsʋm na bɛ nɛ ya.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Mam, Paul onɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ ka m an Yesu Kristo Tʋmtʋm nɛ ti ba'abiig Timoti

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid yanam banɛ an Wina'am nidib, ka an yinne nɛ Kristo ka bɛ Kolosae teŋin ka aan ti ba'abitaaba banɛ an yadda niŋidib la. Ti Ba' Wina'am na tisi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Paul bareka pʋ'ʋsim nɛ winsɔsʋg yɛla

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a ɛɛnti sɔsidi ya yɛla, ti pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ba' la bareka.

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ ti wʋm yanamɛ niŋ Yesu Kristo yadda ka nɔŋ Wina'am nidib la wʋsa si'em,

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: ka li anɛ yadda nɛ nɔŋilim linɛ ka ya mɔri zaŋi ken ti'ir kanɛ ka ya mɔr nɛ linɛ ka Wina'am digil arezana ni guri ya la zug. Ya pʋn dɛŋi wʋm ti'ir kanɛ bɛ Wina'am sida labasʋŋ linɛ

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: ka ba mɔɔli tisi ya la ni. Dunia zin'ig wʋsa nidib bɛdegʋ siakid Wina'am labasʋŋ la, ka ba kal paasid wʋʋ lin mɛ niŋidi ya san'an si'em saŋa kanɛ ka ya wʋm Wina'am pʋpielim yɛla ka sid baŋi li ti paae nannanna la.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Ya zamis nɛ'ɛŋa Epafras onɛ aan ti tʋmtʋm tiraan Yesu Kristo ni, ka lɛn an Kristo tʋmtʋm amɛŋa ka zi'e ti nɔba zugʋ ya yɛla la.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: O yɛli ti yanamɛ mɔr nɔŋilim Wina'am Siig Kasi la ni si'em.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka lin yi daakanɛ ka ti wʋmmi ya labaar la ti paae nannanna, ti pʋ basɛ ka kpɛn sɔsid Wina'am tisidi ya. Ti sɔsid Wina'am ye ya baŋ o pʋtɛn'ɛri bɔɔd si'em sʋ'ʋŋa, nɛ ya'am nɛ baŋir linɛ ka Wina'am Siig la tisid.

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: Ti sɔsid ye o kɛ ka ya tʋʋma an wʋʋ Zugsɔb la bɔɔd ye li an si'em la, ka ma'ae o sʋʋnr bɛdegʋ, ka ya tʋm tʋʋm sʋŋ wʋsa, ka ya baŋir Wina'am yɛla maligim pɛ'ɛs.

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am paŋ tita'ar la zug ka ya na mɔr paŋ bɛdegʋ mɛn, ye ya tun'e mɔdig sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ sumalisim

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: ka na pʋ'ʋsidi ti Ba' Wina'am bareka, on maali ya ka ya nar ye yanam nɛ ya Wina'am nidib taaba di'e linɛ aan ya din ka bɛ Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim linɛ an nyain la ni la.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, onɛ faaɛn ti Sʋntaana sʋ'ʋlim linɛ an lik la nii kpɛn'ɛs o Binɔŋir la sʋ'ʋlimin.

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ ka ba pʋ nyɛt la an si'em la Yesu mɛ sid anɛ ala. O anɛ bʋnkanɛ maal la wʋsa kpɛɛm.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Ka li yinɛ o san'an na ka Wina'am maali li wʋsa, bʋn banɛ bɛ dunia ni bɛɛ saazug, bɛɛ bʋn nyɛta, bɛɛ banɛ ka ti pʋ nyɛtaa bɛɛ banɛ mɔr na'am bɛɛ sʋ'ʋlim, bɛɛ paŋ bɛɛ kpi'euŋ la. Ka bʋn wʋsa maalʋg yinɛ o san'an ka anɛ o mɛŋ yɛla.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: O pʋn dɛŋim bɛ ka si'el-si'el nan kae, ka o paŋ kɛ ka li wʋsa an gumm.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Onɛ an Wina'am nidib kpɛɛm wʋʋ zugʋ an yiiga si'em niŋgbiŋin la, ka lɛn an yiiga sɔb banɛ vʋ'ʋg kumin la, ye o an si'el wʋsa kpɛɛm.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Ka li malis Wina'am ye on an si'em la wʋsa Yesu mɛ anɛ ala.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: Li yinɛ o san'an ka Wina'am zaŋ o ziim kanɛ yi kum dapuudir zug la maal sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ bʋn linɛ bɛ saazug nɛ dunia ni wʋsa la.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ gaad la ya daa anɛ bi'emnam nɛ Wina'am, ka mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Amaa Yesu Kristo kum yɛla ka o naal nɔɔr nɛ ya ka na zi'eli ya ka ya an kasi Wina'am tuon ka ya kʋ lɛm mɔr gba'ar bɛɛ taalɛ.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Alazug ya ya'a kpɛm mɔri ya yadda la kiŋ-kiŋ wʋʋ ɛɛnb sʋŋ nɛ, ka pʋ bas ti'ir linɛ ka ya wʋm labasʋŋin laa, li na niŋ ala. Nwa' anɛ labasʋŋ kanɛ ka ba daa mɔɔli tis sɔ' wʋsa onɛ bɛ dunia ni. Labakan la ka mam Paul liebi li tʋmtʋm la. Paul n tʋm si'em tis Wina'am nidib la yɛla

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Ka nannanna nwa', m mɔr sumalisim nɛ man namisidi ya yɛla la. Namiskanɛ ka m namisid la ye li niŋnɛ paae li bɛn nwɛnɛ Kristo daa yɛl ye m na namis la. Ka li anɛ o niŋgbiŋ linɛ aan o karindɔɔg la yɛla ka m namisid.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: Ya yɛla ka Wina'am gaŋi m ye m lieb o nidib la sʋŋid ka mɔɔn o labaar la sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Labaar la da anɛ yɛlsu'adir saŋa kanɛ gaad la, amaa nannanna li yʋ'ʋn nie tis o nidib.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am gban'e ye o kɛ ka o nidib baŋ ye yɛlsu'adir la anɛ yɛlsʋm tita'ari mɛ tis buudi wʋsa. Yɛlsu'adir la anɛ ye Kristo anɛ yinne nɛ ya ka tisi ya ti'ir ka ya na bɛ nɛ Wina'am.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Ti mɔɔn Kristo yɛla, ka sa'an sɔ' mɛkama, ka pa'annɛ ya nɛ ya'am ye ya bi' Kristo ni ka ti zaŋi yaa pa'al Wina'am.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Linzug ka m kpɛ'ɛŋi m mɛŋ ka mɔ hali nɛ paŋ tita'ar linɛ ka Kristo tisim ka li tʋmmi m ni la.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye ya baŋ mam kpɛ'ɛŋidi m mɛŋ si'em ya yɛla nɛ banɛ bɛ Laodisea nɛ banɛ pʋ nyɛɛm nɛ nif nan la.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: M niŋid ala ye li kpɛmisi ba sʋnya ka ba la'as taaba nɛ nɔŋilim ka li kɛ ka ba baŋ Wina'am yɛlsu'adir linɛ an Kristo la nyain-nyain ka da bi'esidi li yɛla baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: Ka Kristo san'an ka baŋir nɛ mi'ilim wʋsa bɛ.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: M yɛli ya nwa' nɛ ka sɔ' da ma'aa ya nɛ ya'am gɔnlʋŋɔ.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Baŋimi ye hali baa man ka' ya san'an la, m ba'a bɛ nɛ ya ka m sʋnf malis nɛ ya suor la dɔllim nɛ yanamɛ siaki gban'e Kristo kiŋ-kiŋ la. Tinamɛ an yinne nɛ Kristo ti bɛllimin la yɛla

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ yanamɛ sadigim siak ye Yesu Kristo an Zugsɔb la, kɛlli ka yanam nɛ on la'am bɛ nɛ nɔɔr yinne,

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: ka gban'e o nwɛnɛ tiig nya'a ba'a teŋ kiŋ-kiŋ si'em la, ka ya yadda niŋir nɔbig, ka kɛ ka ya bɛllim Yesu ni an wʋʋ tinamɛ pa'ali ya si'em la, ka tisidi Wina'am bareka pʋ'ʋsim bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Gu'usimi, ka sɔ' da pan'asi ya nɛ pa'al zaala linɛ nwɛnɛ ya'am pa'ala ka an dama'am nɛ pa'al kʋda nɛ saalib yiiga pa'ala ka pʋ yi Kristo ni na laa.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: Ka yanamɛ an yinne nɛ o la zug ka ya nyɛ nyɔvʋr bɛdegʋ. Kristo anɛ kpɛɛm ka sʋ'oe linɛ wʋsa mɔr paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ daa di'e Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb la, li nwaasnɛ wʋʋ ba la'am mumi ya nɛ Kristo. Ka yanamɛ niŋ Wina'am yadda on vʋ'ʋg Kristo kumin si'em la, li mɛ nwaasnɛ wʋʋ ya la'am vʋ'ʋgi nɛ o.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ ya saalib bɔɔdim linɛ pʋ dɔl suor la da kɛ ka ya zi' Wina'am ka nwɛnɛ banɛ kpinɛ. Ka Wina'am kɛ ka ya la'am vʋ'ʋg nɛ o. O da yisi ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa bas.

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: Yesu yis wada kanɛ daa sɔb ka li kati ti saria, ka mɔŋidi ti bʋʋd la kpa' tabil o dapuudir la zug.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: Kristo kum dapuudir la yɛla kɛ ka o san'am sibɛ'ɛdnam banɛ mɔr paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ wʋsa ka diisi ba nyan paalʋ ni, on nyaŋi ba la zug.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, da kɛ ka sɔ' zɛrigi ya nɛ yanamɛ dit bɛɛ nuud si'el yɛla, bɛɛ yʋʋm-yʋʋm malima bɛɛ nwadpaalis malima bɛɛ daba ayɔpɔi Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar yɛlaa.

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: Bʋmbama da nwaasnɛ linɛ na ti kena la, ka li mɛŋ-mɛŋ an Kristo.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ninkanɛ ma' ye o sikid o mɛŋ ka pʋ'ʋsid maliaknam nyaŋi pan'asif ka fʋ kɔ'ɔŋ yɔɔd la. Ninkan sɔb ma'adnɛ ye Wina'am nie si'eli pa'al o, ka o niŋgbiŋ ya'am la kɛ ka o dʋ'ʋsid o mɛŋ ka li gbin kae.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Ninkan pʋ tɔ'ɔŋ nɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ an zug niŋgbiŋin la. Li anɛ Kristo paŋ la kɛt ka niŋgbiŋ la giinla nɛ duta tɔ'ɔŋ taaba gumm ka nɔbigid wʋʋ Wina'am bɔɔd si'em la. Tinamɛ kpi ka vʋ'ʋg nɛ Kristo la yɛla

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Yanamɛ sadigim nwɛnɛ ya la'am kpinɛ nɛ Kristo ka bas saalib yiiga pa'ala la, da niŋidi wʋʋ ya bɛllim kʋdig la ka siak wada banɛ buudi ye,

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: “Da di nɛ'ɛnam bɛɛ da lɛmmi li bɛɛ da si'isi li laa!”

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Banɛ maan bʋmbama wʋsa na ba'as yɔri, bɔzugɔ ba anɛ ninsaalib zi'ela nɛ pa'ala.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Wadbama nwɛnɛ ya'am pa'alʋg linɛ kɛt ka nidib namisid ka li ka' gbinnɛ nɛ ba zam sikimmɛŋ nɛ niŋgbina namisʋg, amaa ka ka' paŋ ye li kad yuob bɛɛ ya'amlɛog bɔɔdim.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ sadigim vʋ'ʋg kumin nɛ Kristo la, kɛlli ka ya sʋnf bɔɔdim bɛ nɛ bʋn linɛ bɛ arezana ni, zin'ikanɛ ka o zin' Wina'am datiuŋ la.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ya pʋtɛn'ɛr gban'e nɛ bʋn linɛ bɛ arezana ni, ka ka'anɛ bʋn linɛ bɛ dunia nii;

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: ka ya kpinɛ ka vʋm kanɛ ka ya mɔr la yʋ'ʋn su'a nɛ Kristo onɛ bɛ Wina'am san'an la.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Ka Kristo onɛ aan ya nyɔvʋr la ya'a nie, ya na la'am bɛ nɛ o, ka bɛɛ o girima la ni. Bɛllim kʋdir nɛ bɛllim paal la yɛla

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Basimi ya niŋgbiŋ bɔɔdim linɛ an pu'asan'auŋ bɛɛ dian'ad tʋʋma bɛɛ ya'amlɛog galisʋg bɛɛ pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd bɛɛ fufum la. Bɔzugɔ, fufum anɛ bɛ'ɛdi nwɛnɛ ba'ar maalʋg nɛ.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Li anɛ tʋʋm bama yɛla ka Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn lut banɛ zan'asid o nɔɔr la zug na.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Ya da niŋid ala mɛn saŋkanɛ ka ya da la'am bɛ nɛ ba la.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ basi ya bɛllim kʋdir la, da ma'adi tisidi taaba,

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: ka lɛɛ tiaki bɛllim paal linɛ ka Wina'am maannɛ tisidi ya saŋa mɛkama, ka ya nwɛnɛ o mɛŋ ka baŋid o yɛla paasid sʋ'ʋŋa si'em la.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Bɛllim paallin la, li ba'a kae ye oŋa anɛ Girik nid bɛɛ Jew nid bɛɛ o kpɛn' baŋʋ bɛɛ o pʋ kpɛn' bɛɛ o anɛ saan bɛɛ o yinɛ mɔɔgin na, bɛɛ o anɛ yammʋg bɛɛ o ka' yammʋgɔ, amaa Kristo ma'aa an si'el wʋsa ka bɛɛ o nidib wʋsa ni.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ an banɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ ye ya aan o nimbanɛ an nyain ka o nɔŋ la, aaɛn banɛ zɔt nimbaanlig, ka sʋŋidi nidib, ka siedi ya mɛŋ, ka an pʋtɛn'ɛsʋŋ dim, ka an suguru dim

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: nɛ banɛ gban'adi ba mɛŋ ka kɛt taaba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi basid wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yisi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas si'em la; yanam mɛ niŋimin ala mɛn.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Ka linɛ gaadi li wʋsa anɛ ye ya mɔr nɔŋilim ka linɛ la'asid si'el wʋsa ka li an gumm.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka Kristo sumbʋgʋsʋm la sʋ'oe ya sʋnya ka li anɛ sumbʋgʋskan yɛla ka Wina'am buoli ya, ka ya an niŋgbiŋ yinne la. Ka pʋ'ʋsidi Wina'am bareka.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Mɔri Kristo labaar la sʋ'ʋŋa ya sʋnya nii zamisid ka sa'an taaba nɛ ya'am ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma linɛ bɛ Wina'am gbauŋʋn la, nɛ Wina'am nidib yʋʋma nɛ yʋʋm banɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi tisi ya la, ka kpɛm pʋ'ʋsidi Wina'am bareka saŋa wʋsa ya sʋnya ni.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Linɛ wʋsa ka ya maan; li ya'a anɛ tʋʋma bɛɛ pian'adɛ, yanam on niŋimini li Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋrin, ka pʋ'ʋsidi ti Ba' Wina'am bareka nɛ Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr zug. Ti bɛllim nɛ taaba la yɛla

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Pu'aba, siakimini ya sidib nɔya, ka li nar ka pu'a banɛ dɔl Zugsɔb la niŋid ala.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Sidiba, nɔŋimini ya pu'ab, ka da tɔi bɛɛ nyiidi baa.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Biisɛ, siakimini ya saamnam nɛ ya manam nɔya si'el wʋsa ni ka linɛ malis Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Du'adiba, da nyiidi ya biisɛ, ka ba na sin'ig.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Yammisɛ, siakimini ya zugdaannam nɔya si'el wʋsa ni ka da tʋmmi ban na bɛ nɛ ya ma'aa ka ba tɛn'ɛs ye ya anɛ tʋʋm sʋma dima, amaa ka lɛɛ tʋm nɛ pʋʋg yinne, Zugsɔb la na'asi yɛla.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Linɛ wʋsa ka ya tʋm, yanam on tʋmmi li nɛ pʋʋg yinne wʋʋ ya tʋmnɛ tisid Zugsɔb la, ka ka' ninsaaliba.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: Ya mi' ye Zugsɔb la na tisi ya faar linɛ ka o da yɛli zi'el ye o na tis o nidib la. Li anɛ Kristo onɛ an Zugsɔb la ka ya tʋmmi tisid.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb la na di'e o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɔɔd bɔzugɔ Wina'am pʋ mɔr baregaŋa.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Zugdaannama, niŋimi linɛ an sʋm nɛ linɛ zemisi tisi ya yammis. Ka baŋi ya pʋtɛnda ni ye ya mɛ mɔr Zugsɔb onɛ bɛ arezana ni. Sa'alʋg

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Kpɛn sɔsimi Wina'am saŋa wʋsa ka gu'usidi ka pʋ'ʋsid o bareka.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: La'an sɔsi tisinɛ ti ye Wina'am na tisi ti suor ka ti mɔɔl o labaar la, ka nie o yɛlsu'adir linɛ an Kristo yɛla la tis nidib; ka li yɛla, ka ba lɔɔm nɛ bana.

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: Sɔsimi Wina'am ye m nyaŋi pian' nie li nyain wʋʋ lin nar ye m niŋ si'em la.

english_verse: When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time.
translation_verse: Mɔri ya'am nɛ yanamɛ niŋid si'em tisid banɛ ka' yadda niŋidib la, ka nɔki ya saŋa la tʋm linɛ an sʋm.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ya nɔɔr pian'ad mɔri mimilim wʋʋ yaarim nɛ, ka baŋ yanamɛ na lɛbis lin nar si'em tis sɔ' mɛkama. Pʋ'ʋsʋg

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Tikikus onɛ aan ti ba'abinɔŋir nɛ ti sʋŋid amɛŋa nɛ ti tʋmtʋm tiraan onɛ an yinne nɛ ti Zugsɔb la na yɛli ya m yɛla.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: Lin yɛla ka m tʋm o ya san'an na, ye ya baŋ tinamɛ an si'em, ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya sʋnya.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: On nɛ Onesimus onɛ aan ti ba'abinɔŋir asida ka aan ya teŋ nid la ka m tʋm o ya san'an na. Ba na yɛli ya linɛ wʋsa maan kpɛla.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Aristarkus onɛ ka tinam nɛ on la'am bɛ sanrega ni la pʋ'ʋsidi ya. Mak onɛ an Barnabas ansiŋ la mɛ pʋ'ʋsidi ya. M pʋn dɛŋi pa'ali ya o yɛla, ka o ya'a kena yanam on di'em o nɛ nu'us ayi'.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Josua onɛ ka ba buon Justus la mɛ pʋ'ʋsidi ya. Nidib atan' bama ma'aa an Jew dim banɛ la'an tʋm nɛ mam ye Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim la yɛla keŋ tuon. Ban niŋid si'em la bʋgʋnnɛ m sʋʋnr.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Epafras onɛ aan ya teŋ nid ka an Yesu Kristo tʋmtʋm la mɛ pʋ'ʋsidi ya. O tɛn'ɛsidi ya yɛla saŋa mɛkama ka sɔsid Wina'am nɛ nimmua, ye ya zi'en kiŋ-kiŋ ka bi' ka baŋ linɛ ka Wina'am bɔɔd sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: M nyɛ on tʋm namis yanam nɛ Laodisea dim nɛ Hierapolis dim wʋsa yɛla si'em.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luk onɛ an du'ata kanɛ ka ti nɔŋ la nɛ Demas pʋ'ʋsidi ya.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi ti ba'abiis banɛ bɛ Laodisea teŋin, nɛ Nimfa nɛ Wina'am nimbanɛ la'asid o yin la.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a karim gbauŋ kaŋa naae, yanam kɛlli ka ba karimi lii tis Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Laodisea la mɛn. Ka yanam mɛ karim Laodisea dim gbauŋ la.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Yɛlim Arikipus ye, “Mɔɔm ka naae tʋʋm kanɛ ka fʋ di'e Zugsɔb san'an la.”

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Mam Paul n sɔb pʋ'ʋs kaŋa nɛ m mɛŋ nu'ug. Tɛn'ɛsimi ban lɔɔm nɛ bana la yɛla. Wina'am yɛlsʋm na bɛ nɛ ya.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Man Paul nɛ Silvanus nɛ Timoti sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid yanam banɛ an Wina'am nidib ka bɛ Tɛsalonika teŋin ka bɛɛ ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni la. Wina'am na tisi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Tɛsalonika dim bɛllim nɛ ba yadda niŋir la yɛla

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Ti pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka saŋa wʋsa ya zug, ka tiɛndi ya yɛla ti winsɔsʋgin.

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: Ti mɛ tɛnri ya yɛla ti Ba' Wina'am tuon yanamɛ niŋ yadda ka mɔr nɔŋilim linɛ kɛ ka ya tʋm bɛdegʋ ka mɛ mɔr ti'ir kanɛ kɛt ka ya kpi'em ka mɔdigi bɛɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni la.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiis banɛ ka Wina'am nɔŋa, ti mi' ye onɛ gaŋi ya,

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ tinamɛ daa mɔr labasʋŋ la na tisi ya la, li daa ka'anɛ pian'ad ma'aanɛ, amaa li daa mɔri paŋ nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi nɛ paŋ kanɛ tiakid sʋnya. Tinamɛ daa bɛ nɛ ya la, ya daa mi' ti bɛllim daa an si'em. Li daa anɛ yanam sʋ'ʋm zug.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Ya anɛ banɛ daa tu'asid tinam nɛ Zugsɔb la bɛllim an si'em, ka hali baa yanamɛ paam namisʋg bɛdegʋ la, ya di'e labaar la nɛ sumalisim linɛ yit Wina'am Siig Kasi la ni na.

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: Linzug ka yadda niŋidib banɛ bɛ Masedonia nɛ Akaia sʋ'ʋlimin mɛ an banɛ tu'asidi ya.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ wʋm Zugsɔb la labaari ya san'an. Ka li ka'anɛ nimbanɛ bɛ Masedonia nɛ Akaia la ma'aanɛɛ, amaa la'an nɛ banɛ bɛ zin'is wʋsa mɛ wʋmi ya yadda niŋir Wina'am ni la yɛla. Ka si'el kae ka ti na lɛn yɛli baa.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Nimbama wʋsa pian'ad yanamɛ daa di'e ti sʋ'ʋŋa si'em, ka bas bada ka dɔl Wina'am onɛ vʋe ka sid an Wina'am la,

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: ka gur o Bikanɛ ka o da vʋ'ʋg o kumin la na ti yi arezana ni na. Yesu onɛ faaɛn ti Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn kanɛ na ti kena la ni.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, ya mi' ye tinamɛ daa kena kaae ya la, li daa pʋ niŋ zaalim,

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: ya mi' ye ba daa namisi ti, ka diisi ti nyan hali Filipi teŋin, ka ti nyaan kɛɛn ya san'an Tɛsalonika teŋin na. Wina'am daa tisi ti sʋnkpi'euŋ ka ti tu'as labasʋŋ dinɛ yii o ni na la tisi ya, hali la'an nɛ sieba daa daami ti bɛdegʋ la.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ daa tu'asidi ya antu'a si'a la pʋ yi dama'amin bɛɛ pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛdinɛ; li mɛ ka' ye ti bɔɔdnɛ ye ti zam nidiba.

english_verse: God was pleased to trust us with his message. We didn't speak to please people, but to please God who knows our motives.
translation_verse: Wina'am gɔsi ti ka ti nar ka o gu'uli ti o labasʋŋ la zug, ka ti pian'ad wʋʋ on bɔɔd si'em la. Ti pʋ mɔɔd ye ti ma'ae ninsaalib sʋnya, ka lɛɛ mɔɔd ye ti ma'ae Wina'am onɛ kpansidi ti sʋnya la.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Ya mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye ti daa pʋ tu'as dama'am pian'ad bɛɛ su'a maal si'el linɛ an fufummɛ. Wina'am aan ti kasɛt.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ nɔŋi ya la zug, ka ti daa siak ye ti tisi ya labasʋŋ linɛ yi Wina'am ni na la, ka la'am pɛsigi ti mɛŋi tisi ya. Ti daa nɔŋi ya bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, ya tɛnr ye tinamɛ daa mɔɔn Wina'am labasʋŋ la tisidi ya la, ti daa tʋmnɛ yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa ye ti yɛla da daami yaa.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yanam nɛ Wina'am anɛ kasɛtib tinamɛ daa niŋid si'em yanam yadda niŋidib san'an la. Ti daa bɛ nɛ ya nɛ kasi nɛ pʋpielim pʋʋgin ka gba'ar kae.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Ya mi' ye ti daa sa'ali ya yinne-yinne wʋʋ dau sa'an o biis si'em la,

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya sʋnf ka yɛli ya ye ya dɔl suor kanɛ na ma'ad Wina'am sʋnf. Onɛ buoli ya ye ya kpɛn' o sʋ'ʋlimin nɛ o na'amin la.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ daa mɔr labaar linɛ yi Wina'am ni na tisi ya la, ya daa wʋm ka di'e li ka baŋ ye li anɛ labaar linɛ pʋ yi ninsaalib ni naa, ka baŋ ye li anɛ labaar linɛ yi Wina'am ni na. Ka li sid tʋm, yanam banɛ an yadda niŋidib la sʋnya ni. Dinzug ka ti pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, ya daa nyɛ namisʋg, wʋʋ Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Juda teŋin ka dɔl Yesu daa nyɛ namisʋg si'em la. Ya nyɛ namisʋgʋ ya mɛŋ buudi ni wʋʋ ban nyɛ Jew dim san'an si'em la.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Ba da kʋ Zugsɔb Yesu nɛ Wina'am nɔdi'esidib, ka mɛ kadi ti yis, ka li duoe Wina'am sʋnf,

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: ka vi' ti ye ti da pian' tis banɛ ka' Jew dim la ka ba nyɛ faangirɛ. Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kaŋa kena paasi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd banɛ ka ba tʋm la wʋsa ni ka li yʋ'ʋn zu'oe galis. Ka Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn yʋ'ʋn luu ba zug. Paul daa bɔɔd ye o kaae ba ya'as

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, tinamɛ daa yii ya san'an saŋa bi'ela la, ti daa baknɛ nɛ niŋgbina ka ka'anɛ sʋʋnrin bakirɛ. Dinzug ka ti daa mɔɔd hali ye ti kena kaae ya ya'as.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Ti daa bɔɔd ye ti lɛbi ya san'an na. Man Paul daa mɔ nɔɔr si'em ye m lɛbi ya ni na, amaa ka Sʋntaana vi' ti.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Saŋkanɛ ka ti Zugsɔb Yesu na ti lɛb na ka ti bɛɛ o tuon la, ya yɛla ka ti na nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg ka mɔr ti'ir nɛ sumalisim. Ka' ala bɛɛ?

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Yanam zug ka ti na nyɛ na'asi nɛ sumalisim.

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, tinamɛ zi' yanamɛ an si'em la kɛ ka ti kʋ lɛn nyaŋi mɔdig ya'asa, ka siak ye ti bɛ Atens teŋinɛ ti kɔn'ɔkɔn',

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: ka tʋmi ti pitʋ Timoti onɛ aan ti tʋmtʋm tiraan Wina'am ni ka pa'an Kristo labasʋŋ la, ye o kena sʋŋi ya, ya yadda niŋir pʋʋgin, ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya sʋnya

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: ka namisʋg bama da kɛ ka ya sɔ' bas Wina'am suor la dɔllim. Ya mi' ye li anɛ Wina'am bɔɔdim ye ti namis.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ daa nam bɛ nɛ ya la, ti daa dɛŋi yɛli ya ye ti wʋsa na nyɛ namisʋg. Ka li sid niŋ ala wʋʋ yanamɛ mi' li si'em la.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, man daa kʋ nyaŋi mɔdig la kɛ, ka m tʋm Timoti ye o kena ka m baŋi ya yadda niŋiri an si'em. Bɔzugɔ m zɔti dabiem ye Sʋntaana pa'ati pan'asi ya, ka ti tʋʋma ya san'an la lieb zaalim.

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna Timoti yii ya san'anɛ lɛb na, ka mɔr labasʋŋʋ ya nɔŋilim nɛ ya yadda niŋir la yɛla na, ka yɛli ti ye ya tɛn'ɛsidi ti yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa saŋa wʋsa, hali ka bɔɔd ye ya nyɛɛ ti, wʋʋ tinamɛ bɔɔd ye ti nyɛɛ ya si'em la.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m ba'abiisɛ, tinamɛ wʋmi ya yadda niŋiri an si'em la yɛla kɛ ka ti sʋnya kpi'emi ya yɛla ti daamʋg nɛ ti namisʋg pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ zi'e kiŋ-kiŋ ka dɔl Zugsɔb la, ka ti bɛllim sid na an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Nannanna ti na niŋ wala nyaŋi pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka ya zug, ka li zemis nɛ sumalisim linɛ ka ti sid mɔri ya yɛla la Wina'am tuonnɛ?

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa ti sɔsid o nɛ ti sʋnya wʋsa, ye ti nyɛɛ ya nɛ nif ya'as, ka sʋŋi ya nɛ dinɛ pansigi ya, ya yadda niŋirin.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Ti sɔsidi ti Ba' Wina'am, nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ye o maal suori tisi ti, ka ti kɛɛn ya san'an na.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Ti sɔsid Zugsɔb la ye o kɛ ka ya taaba nɔŋilim nɛ nimbanɛ bɛ kpɛla wʋsa nɔŋilim an si'em la na nɔbig bɛdegʋ wʋʋ tinamɛ nɔŋi ya si'em la,

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: ye o kpɛ'ɛŋi ya sʋnya ka saŋkanɛ ka ti Zugsɔb Yesu na kena nɛ o nidib wʋsa la, ya na di bʋʋd ka kʋ mɔr gba'arɛ ka an kasi ti Ba' Wina'am la tuon.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Tɔ', ti ba'abiisɛ, ya daa zamisi ti san'an yanamɛ na bɛ si'em ka li ma'ae Wina'am sʋnf. Ya kpɛn aan ala. Ti san'anɛ ya ka bɛlimmi ya nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu yʋ'ʋr ye ya niŋ ka li gaad ala.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ya mi' nɔɔr yɛlʋg banɛ ka ti daa tisi ya nɛ Zugsɔb Yesu paŋ la,

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: ye Wina'am bɔɔd ye ya bɛllim an sʋm ka an nyain, ka ya luak dian'ad tʋʋma,

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: Ka li ka'anɛ ya'amlɛog linɛ an bɛ'ɛd wʋʋ ba'amaannib banɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am niŋid si'em laa.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Ka nɛ'ɛŋa pʋʋgin, mid ka sɔ' tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bɛɛ pɔnbil o ba'abiig. Ti daa dɛŋin yɛli ya, ka sa'ali ya nɛ paŋ ye, Zugsɔb na namis banɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛbama.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Wina'am daa pʋ gaŋi ti ye ti tʋm dian'ad tʋʋma, amaa ye ti bɛ nyain.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ onɛ zan'as pa'alkaŋa, o pʋ zan'as ninsaala, o zan'asnɛ Wina'am onɛ tisi ti o Siig Kasi la.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Li lɛn kae ye ti sɔbi tisi ya, ya ba'abiis nɔŋilim yɛlaa. Wina'am pʋn zamisi ya ye ya nɔŋ taaba.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: Li anɛ sida ye ya nɔŋi ya ba'abiis wʋsa banɛ bɛ Masedonia sʋ'ʋlimin la. Ti ba'abiisɛ, ti bɛlimmi ya ye ya kɛ ka nɔŋilim la gaad lin an si'em la,

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: ka ya kpɛ'ɛŋi ya mɛŋi an baanlimm, ka gɔsi ya mɛŋ tʋʋma, ka bɔɔ ya mɛŋ nu'ug tʋʋma diisidi ya mɛŋ wʋʋ tinamɛ daa yɛli ya si'em la.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: Ala ka ya na nyɛ na'asi banɛ ka' yadda niŋidib la san'an ka kʋ ti'e ye sɔ' tisi ya yanamɛ bɔɔd si'ela. Zugsɔb lɛbig la na yɛla

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, ti bɔɔd ye ya baŋ yɛlsida zaŋi ken banɛ kpi la yɛla, ka li kɛ ka ya sʋnya da san'am wʋʋ banɛ pʋ mɔr ti'irɛ.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Ti siak ye Yesu kpiya ka lɛn vʋ'ʋg kumin, ka mɛ siak ye banɛ daa an Yesu nidib ka kpi la, Wina'am na vʋ'ʋgi ba nɛ Yesu.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ Zugsɔb la pa'alʋg ka ti yɛti ya ye, saŋkanɛ ka Zugsɔb la na ti kena la, tinam banɛ nan kpɛn vʋe la kʋ dɛŋ banɛ kpi la yiiga la'as nɛ Zugsɔb la.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la mɛŋ na ti yi arezana nii sig na ka tans nɛ kpi'euŋʋ tis nɔɔr; ka maliak kpɛɛm la mɛ mɔɔl nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ka Wina'am na'atan pieb. Ka banɛ pʋn kpi Kristo suorin la na vʋ'ʋg kumin yiiga.

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am yʋ'ʋn na nɔk tinam banɛ nan kpɛn vʋe la la'as nɛ ba tʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la saŋgbana ni. Ka ti yʋ'ʋn na bɛ Zugsɔb la san'an saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, kpɛmisimi taaba sʋnya nɛ pian'abama.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, li lɛn kae ye ti sɔb si'eli tisi ya Zugsɔb ken la saŋa nɛ dabisa la yɛlaa.

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, ya pʋm mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye Zugsɔb dabisir la na kena wʋʋ na'ayiigi ken yʋ'ʋŋ si'em na la.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Nidib ya'a ti yɛt ye, “Laafi nɛ nimma'asim bɛ,” saŋkan la ka tɔɔg na kpɛn luu ba zugin, wʋʋ pu'a ɛɛnti sa'ae du'am si'em la, ka ba kʋ nyaŋi yii li nii.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, ya ka' lik dim ka Zugsɔb la dabisir na kpɛn libigi ya wʋʋ na'ayiiga.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Ya wʋsa anɛ nɛɛsim nidib, ka bɛ linɛ an nyain la ni, ti ka' banɛ an yʋ'ʋŋ bɛɛ lik nidiba.

english_verse: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, ti da an nwɛnɛ banɛ gbisid la, amaa ti nɛi ka da an wʋʋ onɛ nu daam kʋʋlɛ.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Banɛ gbisid la gbisidnɛ yʋ'ʋŋ. Ka banɛ nuud daam kʋʋn la mɛ kʋʋn yʋ'ʋŋ.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Amaa tinamɛ an nɛɛsim nidib la zug, kɛlli ka ti gban'anɛ ti mɛŋ, ka nɔk yadda nɛ nɔŋilim yɛ wʋʋ nyɔ'ɔgin gbanti'edʋg nɛ, ka pid kʋnt balaŋir linɛ an ti'ir linɛ an faangir la gu' ti zut.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Wina'am pʋ gaŋi ti ye ti nyɛɛ o sʋnpɛɛnnɛ, amaa ye ti di'e faangir linɛ yiti ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni na la.

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: O da kpii ti zug, ye saŋkanɛ ka o ti kenna la, ti ya'a vʋe bɛɛ ti ya'a kpinɛ, ti na la'am bɛ nɛ o.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, kpɛmisimi taaba sʋnya, ka sʋŋ taaba ya yadda niŋirin wʋʋ yanamɛ niŋid si'em la. Sa'alʋg nɛ pʋ'ʋsʋg

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, ti bɛlimmi ya ye ya na'as banɛ ka Zugsɔb la gaŋi ba ye ba guri ya ka tʋm o tʋʋma ya sʋʋgin ka pa'annɛ ya la.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Tisimini ba na'asi bɛdegʋ, ka nɔŋi ba, ba tʋʋma la zug, ka mɔri sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ taaba.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, ti kpɛmisidi ya sʋnya ye ya sa'al banɛ mɔr gbanya'am la, ka kpɛmis banɛ pʋ mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ la sʋnya, ka sʋŋ banɛ ka' paŋi ba yadda niŋir pʋʋgin la, ka mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ ba wʋsa,

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: ka gu'us ka ya sɔ' da lɛbis o tiraan bɛ'ɛd on tʋm bɛ'ɛd la zugɔ, ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya mɛŋi tʋm tʋʋm sʋma tis taaba nɛ nidib wʋsa.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Mɔri sumalisim daar wʋsa,

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: ka sɔsidi Wina'am saŋa wʋsa,

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: ka pʋ'ʋs o bareka si'el mɛkama ni; ka li anɛ Wina'am bɔɔdim linɛ yi Yesu Kristo ni na ye ya niŋid ala.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Da zan'asi Wina'am Siig Kasi laa,

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Kpansimi si'el wʋsa, ka gban'e dinɛ an sʋm,

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: ka luak bʋmbɛ'ɛd buudi wʋsa.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Ti sɔsid Wina'am onɛ tisidi ti sumbʋgʋsʋm la ye o kɛ ka ya an sʋm nyain. Ka lɛn sɔs o ye o na mɔri ya sʋ'ʋŋa, ka Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo la ya'a ti lɛb na, ka ya siis nɛ niŋgbina an sʋm ka gba'ar kae.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ gaŋi ya la anɛ sida sɔb, ka na tʋm ala.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, sɔsimi Wina'am tisi ti,

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: ka pʋ'ʋsi ya ba'abiis wʋsa sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: M yɛti ya, nɛ Zugsɔb paŋ ye ya karim gbauŋ kaŋa tisi ya ba'abiis wʋsa.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yɛlsʋm na bɛɛ ya san'an. Ami.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Man Paul nɛ Silvanus nɛ Timoti sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid yanam banɛ an Wina'am nidibi bɛ Tɛsalonika teŋin, ka bɛ ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni la.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na tisi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Kristo na lɛb na kad saria

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, ya yadda niŋir nɛ ya nɔŋilim nɛ taabaa nɔbigid bɛdegʋ la zug, ka li nar ka an sʋm ye ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka saŋa wʋsa ya zug.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Ka linzug ka tinam mɛŋ nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgʋ ya yɛla Wina'am nidibi la'asid zin'isi'a wʋsa. Ti nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgʋ ya mɔdigir nɛ ya Wina'am yadda niŋir nɛ mugusʋg nɛ namisʋg linɛ paadi ya la zug.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa pa'al ye Wina'am kad saria nɛ yɛlsida, o maali ya ka ya nar nɛ yanamɛ na bɛɛ o sʋ'ʋlimin la, ka li anɛ yanamɛ bɛɛ o sʋ'ʋlimin la zug ka nidib namisidi ya.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Wina'am anɛ sida daan ka na namis banɛ namisidi ya la,

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: ka kɛ ka tinam nɛ yanam banɛ namisid la vʋ'ʋs, saŋkanɛ ka Zugsɔb Yesu na ti yi arezana nii lɛb na nɛ o maliaknam banɛ mɔr paŋ tita'ar nɛ bugum pielim la.

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: O na ti namis banɛ zi' Wina'am nɛ banɛ pʋ siaki ti Zugsɔb Yesu labasʋŋ la.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: Daakanɛ ka o na kena la ba na, paam namisʋg linɛ ka' naarɛ, ka ba na yisi ba Zugsɔb la nɛ o na'am paŋ tita'ar la ni.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la ka ti na nyɛɛ o, ka o na bɛɛ o mɛŋ nidib nɛ banɛ wʋsa niŋ o yadda la ni, ka ti na tis o na'asi. Yanam mɛ na ti paas, bɔzugɔ ya mɛ daa siak Wina'am labaar kanɛ ka ti daa kena tu'asi tisi ya la.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Linzug ka ti sɔsid Wina'am tisidi ya saŋa wʋsa ye o na kaali ya pɛ'ɛs banɛ nar ye ba bɛɛ o sʋ'ʋlimin la. Ka mɛ sɔs o ye o paŋ la na kɛ ka yanamɛ gban'e si'eli ya pʋtɛn'ɛrin nɛ ya yadda linɛ tʋm tʋʋma la paae li bɛn.

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Ti sɔsid Zugsɔb Yesu ye o bɛɛ ya ni ka yanam mɛ bɛɛ o ni. Ka ya wʋsa na nyɛ zʋn'or. Li wʋsa yinɛ Wina'am nɛ Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ni na.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Man ye m yɛli si'el nannanna la anɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo lɛbig na nɛ tinamɛ na ti la'as taaba tʋ'ʋs o la yɛla. Ti ba'abiisɛ, ti bɛlimi ya

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: ye ya ya'a wʋm labaar ye Zugsɔb la pʋn lɛb na, yanam da kɛ ka li daami ya bɛɛ li kpɛn'ɛsi ya dabiem ka ya mɔr pʋtɛnda ayi', yi'. Li ya'a anɛ sɔ' yɛl ala ka ba tɛn'ɛs ye li yinɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la ni, bɛɛ sɔ' pa'al ala, bɛɛ sɔ' karim gbauŋ ka ya tɛn'ɛs ye li yinɛ ti san'an na,

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: yanam da kɛ ka sɔ' ma' ya nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa nii. Daakan la kʋ kena, asɛɛ ka saŋkanɛ ka nidib bɛdegʋ la'asi zan'as Wina'am la kena, ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb onɛ ka li zi'el ye o keŋ bugum teŋ la nie na.

english_verse: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
translation_verse: O na kisig dinɛ wʋsa ka ba buon ye Wina'am la, la'an nɛ bʋn linɛ wʋsa ka nidib zun'odi li la, ka dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋi gaadi ba wʋsa. Hali o na kpɛn' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yinɛ zin'in ka yɛl ye o anɛ Wina'am.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Ya pʋ tɛnr ye man daa nan bɛɛ ya san'an la, m daa yɛli ya nɛ' wʋsa?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Ka nannanna yɛl si'a bɛɛ vi' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd daan la ka ya mi' li, ka li saŋa ya'a ti paae, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd daan la na nie na.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛsu'ada la pʋn pin'ili tʋm sa. Ka onɛ nam vi' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd daan la suor la na kpɛn niŋid ala ti paae saŋkanɛ ka ba na yis o suorin la ka bas paalʋ.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd daan la yʋ'ʋn na nie na. Ka Zugsɔb Yesu nɔɔr pɛbisim na kʋʋ o. Ka o ken la nɛɛsim na san'am o.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Sʋntaana na kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd daan la kena. O na mɔr paŋ tita'ar, ka maan ziri bʋnnyalima,

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: ka ma' nimbanɛ ka san'auŋ bɔɔdi paae ba la dama'am buudi wʋsa. Bam pʋ nɔŋ sida linɛ na kɛ ka ba paam faangir la zug ka ba na san'am.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Linzug ka Wina'am na tisi ba ziri pʋtɛn'ɛr, ka ba siak linɛ an ziri,

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: ala ka nimbanɛ wʋsa pʋ siak linɛ an sida ka bɔɔd tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, na nyɛ kʋʋsbɛ'ɛd. Ya faangir zug ka Wina'am gaŋi ya

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiis banɛ ka Zugsɔb nɔŋa, li nar ka ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka saŋa wʋsa on gaŋi ya pin'ilʋgʋn sa la zug. Yanamɛ niŋ yadda nɛ linɛ an sida la zug ka o Siig Kasi la kɛ ka ya an o nimbanɛ an sʋm ka an nyain ka nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ daa mɔɔl labasʋŋ la tisi ya la zug ka Wina'am buoli ya ye ya nyɛ faangir ka yanam nɛ Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ti la'an di'e o girima.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Dinzug ti ba'abiisɛ, zi'enimi kiŋ-kiŋ, ka dɔlli yɛlsida linɛ ka ti pian' tisi ya bɛɛ linɛ ka ti sɔb gbauŋʋn tisi ya la.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Ti pʋ'ʋsidi ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo mɛŋ nɛ ti Ba' Wina'am onɛ nɔŋi ti ka tisi ti sʋnkpi'euŋ kanɛ ka' naarɛ nɛ pʋpielim nɛ ti'ir linɛ an sʋm la.

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: Ka sɔs o ye o na kpɛ'ɛŋi ya sʋnya, ka tisi ya paŋ ka ya na tʋm linɛ an sʋm ka mɛ pian'ad linɛ an sʋm.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, li ba'asʋg anɛ ye ya sɔsimi Wina'am tisi ti, ye ti Zugsɔb labaar la na kpɛn yadigid tɔ'ɔtɔ ka nyɛ na'asi wʋʋ lin daa niŋi ya ni si'em la.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Ka sɔs o ye o faaɛn ti nimbɛ'ɛdnam san'an ka li ka' nidib la wʋsa siak Wina'am labaar la.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la anɛ onɛ an yɛlsida daan, ka na tisi ya paŋ ka guri ya, ka Sʋntaana da nyaŋi yaa.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la kɛya ka ti niŋi ya yadda, ka mi' ye ya niŋid tinamɛ yɛli ya si'el la, ka na kpɛn niŋid ala.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Ti sɔsid Zugsɔb la ye o na kɛ ka ya baŋ Wina'am nɔŋilim la an si'em, ka mɔdigi wʋʋ Kristo mɔdig si'em la. Sa'alʋg

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, ti yɛti ya nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr zug ye ya baki ya mɛŋ nɛ ya ba'abiis banɛ an gbanya'anam ka pʋ dɔl pa'alʋg kanɛ ka ti tisi ya la.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Yanam mɛŋ mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye li nar ka ya tu'as tinamɛ daa tʋm si'em la. Tinamɛ daa bɛ nɛ ya la, ti daa ka' gbanya'anama,

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: ka pʋ dit sɔ' diib zaalim, ka lɛɛ tʋm bɛdegʋ nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa, ye ti yɛla da daami ya.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: Li ka'anɛ ye ti daa pʋ mɔr suokanɛ na di'e sʋŋiri ya san'anɛ, amaa ti daa tʋmnɛ ala ye ya nyɛ ka tu'as.

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ daa nam bɛ nɛ ya la, ti daa yɛli ya ye, “Onɛ pʋ tʋm, on da dii.”

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Ti wʋm ye sieba bɛɛ ya sʋʋgin zin' ka mɔr gbanya'am ka kpɛn'ɛd nidib yɛla ni, ka pʋ tʋmma.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Linzug ka ti yɛt nimbama, ka san'anɛ ba nɛ Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo paŋ ye ba tʋmmi ba tʋʋma baanlimm, diisi ba mɛŋ.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Ti ba'abiisɛ, da gɛn ka basi linɛ an tʋʋm sʋmaa.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a zan'as ka pʋ siak linɛ ka ti yɛli ya gbauŋ kaŋa ni laa, yanam kpansim o, ka luak o ka kɛ ka nyan dii o.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Da niŋin o wʋʋ o anɛ ya dataa, ka lɛɛ sa'al o wʋʋ ya ba'abiig nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb onɛ an sumbʋgʋsʋm daan la na tisi ya sumbʋgʋsʋm saŋa wʋsa nɛ si'el wʋsa ni, ka na bɛ nɛ ya wʋsa.

english_verse: I always sign my letters as I am now doing: PAUL.
translation_verse: Man Paul n sɔbid nɛ m mɛŋ nu'ugʋ pʋ'ʋsidi ya. Anwa ka m sɔbid ka zanbinnɛ m gbana wʋsa.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yɛlsʋm na bɛ nɛ ya wʋsa.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Man Paul, onɛ an Yesu Kristo tʋmtʋm ka li anɛ Wina'am onɛ aan ti faangid nɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ aan ti ti'ir la tisim nɔɔr;

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: ka m sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid fʋn Timoti onɛ niŋ Yesu Kristo yadda ka liebim biig amɛŋa la. Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na tisif yɛlsʋm nɛ nimbaanlzɔɔr nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Ziri pa'alʋg dim la sa'alʋg

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Man daa wa'ae Masedonia teŋin la, m daa tisif nɔɔr ye fʋ kpɛm bɛ Efesus teŋin ka sa'al ninsieba ye ba da pa'an ziri pa'ala la.

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: Ka da dɔl teŋkʋdʋgin sɔlima nɛ yaanam yʋda kaalʋg linɛ ta'asid nɔŋgbannwa'ar ka pʋ sʋŋid ka Wina'am tʋʋma linɛ an yadda niŋir la ken tuonnɛ.

english_verse: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
translation_verse: Dinɛ kɛ ka m yɛla anwa la anɛ ye nɔŋilim linɛ an nyain la yitnɛ pʋtɛn'ɛr sʋŋin nɛ pʋpielim nɛ yadda niŋir linɛ an amɛŋa ni na.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Ninsieba bas nɛ nɛ'ɛnam ka pian'ad pian'ayaalis.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Ba sʋnya lɔnɛ ye ba an banɛ pa'an Wina'am wada la, amaa ba zi' ba mɛŋi pian'ad si'el la gbinnɛ, bɛɛ pʋ mi' ban bʋmbanɛ ka pian'ad nɛ kpi'euŋ la gbinnɛ.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye ti ya'a nɔk wada la tʋm lin nar si'em, li an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: Ti mɛ mi' ye ba pʋ zi'el wada la nɛ pʋpielim dim yɛlaa, amaa banɛ pʋ dɔl wada suor la, nɛ banɛ pʋ siakid linɛ an yɛlsida nɛ banɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suorɛ nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim nɛ bugusim dim nɛ banɛ pʋ dɔl pʋ'ʋsim suorɛ nɛ banɛ kʋʋdi ba saamnam nɛ ba manam nɛ banɛ an ninkʋʋdib

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: nɛ pu'ab nɛ dap banɛ san'amid taaba nɛ dap banɛ dig nɛ ba dap taaba wʋʋ pu'ab nɛ, nɛ banɛ zuud nidibi gban'ad, nɛ dama'anam, nɛ ziri kasɛtib, nɛ banɛ niŋid linɛ mɛkama pʋ dɔl pa'alsʋŋɔ.

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: Pa'alʋg la dɔlnɛ labasʋŋ linɛ niedi pa'an Wina'am onɛ an albareka nɛ girima sɔb ka o niŋi m nu'usin ye m mɔɔl la. Wina'am n zɔ Paul nimbaanlig la yɛla

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: M pʋ'ʋsidi ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo bareka on tisim paŋ la. M pʋ'ʋsid o nɛ on baŋim pʋʋg ka gaŋim ye m tʋm tʋʋm kaŋa nwa' la.

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: Hali baa saŋsi'en ka m da san'amid o yʋ'ʋr, ka namisid o, ka tʋ'ʋd o la, o la'am zɔɔm nimbaanlig, bɔzugɔ man da nam pʋ niŋ Yesu yadda la, m da pʋ baŋ man niŋid si'ela.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Ka Zugsɔb la tisim pʋpielim piini ka li galis, nɛ Yesu Kristo yadda niŋir nɛ nɔŋilim linɛ bɛɛ o san'an la.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Nwa' anɛ yɛlmɛŋir ka m yɛt, ka li nar ye sɔ' mɛkama di'e li sʋ'ʋŋa, “Yesu Kristo kɛn dunia ni na ye o faaɛn tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim,” ka man tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi gat sɔ' wʋsa.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Mam onɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim kpɛɛm la, paam nimbaanlzɔɔr Yesu Kristo ni ka li pa'al nidib la o suguru linɛ ka' bɛn la an si'em, ka an zanbinnɛ tis banɛ na ti yuolim niŋ o yadda la ka ba di'e nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Na'akanɛ sʋ'oe zʋmaana wʋsa la, o pʋ kpiida, nidib mɛ pʋ nyɛt o nɛ ninii, o anɛ Wina'am kanɛ an yinne, zʋn'or nɛ na'asi anɛ o din, saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ. Ami.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: M biig Timoti, nɔzi'elkaŋa ka m tisidif, ka li dɔl linɛ ka Wina'am nɔdi'es da pian' fʋ yɛla la. Kɛl ka nɛ'ɛŋa kpɛmisif ka fʋ zab zabsʋŋ linɛ na kad yɛlbɛ'ɛd la.

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: Kpɛm mɔr yadda niŋir nɛ pʋpielim ya'am. Ninsieba pʋ siak pʋpielim ya'am linɛ bɛɛ ba san'an la, ka li san'amidi ba yadda niŋir.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Ba sieba anɛ Himeneus nɛ Alekzanda, banɛ ka m kɛɛsi ba niŋ Sʋntaana nu'usin ye ba zulig ya'am ka da san'am Wina'am yʋ'ʋrɛ.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Linɛ an yiiga ka m kpɛmisidif anɛ ye winsɔsʋg wʋsa ni, sɔsimi Wina'am linɛ aan ya bɔɔdim ka sɔsi tis nidib ka pʋ'ʋs o bareka nidib wʋsa yɛla.

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye ya sɔs Wina'am tis na'anam nɛ kpi'emnam ka ti bɛ nɛ laafi ka daamʋg kae, ka ti dɔl Wina'am suor nɛ nimmua yɛla wʋsa ni.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa an sʋm ka malisi ti faangid Wina'am sʋʋnr

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: onɛ bɔɔd ye nidib wʋsa nyɛ faangir ka lɛm baŋ yɛlsida suor la.
