english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Wina'am yinne ma'aa bɛ. Ka nu'unwɛ'ɛd yinne ma'aa mɛ bɛ nidib nɛ Wina'am sʋʋgin, onɛ an Yesu Kristo la,

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka Wina'am da gaŋim ye o tʋmim ka m mɔɔnnɛ li, ka pa'al banɛ ka' Jew dim la ye ba niŋim Wina'am yadda ka baŋ linɛ an sida. M yɛtnɛ yɛlsida, ka pʋ ma'ada.

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye zin'ig wʋsa, dap pʋ'ʋsid ka ʋki ba nu'us linɛ an nyain la, pʋ'ʋs Wina'am. Ka sʋnpɛɛn nɛ nɔŋgbannwa'ar kae.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Ka pu'ab mɛ yɛɛd fuud linɛ nar ka na su'a ba nyan sʋ'ʋŋa, ka ka'anɛ zuobid lɔɔb yɛla bɛɛ sanlima la'ad bɛɛ kugvɛnla linɛ buon pɛɛl ka li ligidi zu'oe la, nɛ fuud ban ka ba ligidi zu'oe laa.

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: Amaa ba lɛɛ tʋm tʋʋm sʋma linɛ nar nɛ pu'ab banɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: Li sʋm ye pu'ab an baanlimm ka zamis ka siak banɛ sʋ'oe ba la nɔɔr.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: M pʋ siak ye pu'ab pa'an dapa, bɛɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ ka sʋ'oe baa. Ba an baanlimm;

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: ka Wina'am da dɛŋi maalnɛ Adam ka nyaan maal Hawa.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Sʋntaana da pʋ ma' Adam, amaa o nyaŋi ma' Hawa, ka o san'am Wina'am nɔɔr.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Amaa pu'ab na paam faangir ka li yitnɛ ba biis du'am pʋʋgin, ba ya'a kpɛn zi'e ba yadda niŋirin nɛ nɔŋilim ka an nyain ka mɔr ya'am sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Nwa' anɛ yɛlmɛŋir ka m yɛti ya ye, sɔ' ya'a bɔɔd ye o an karindɔɔg kpɛɛm, o gaŋ tʋʋm sʋŋ.

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: Onɛ an Karindɔɔg kpɛɛm asɛɛ ka o an onɛ ka' gba'arɛ, ka an pu'ayiŋdaan ka gban'ad o mɛŋ, ka mɔr ya'am, ka an onɛ tʋm linɛ dɔl suor sʋ'ʋŋa, nɛ onɛ di'esid saam nɛ sumalisim, ka an onɛ na tun'e pa'al nidib sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: O sɔb da an danuud bɛɛ onɛ bɔɔd zabaa, amaa o bɛ baanlimm, ka an onɛ pʋ mɔr nɔŋgbannwa'arɛ, ka da nɔŋ ligidi galisɛ,

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: ka tun'e gɔsid o yidim wʋsa sʋ'ʋŋa, ka o biis siakid o nɔɔr ka mɔr na'asi o yɛla wʋsa ni.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a pʋ nyaŋi gɔs o yidima, o na niŋ wala guri Wina'am nidiba?

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Ka da an ninkanɛ niŋ yadda paalim nannɛ. Li ya'a ka' ala o na mɔr nyɛɛsim ka ba kad o saria ka li an bɛ'ɛd wʋʋ Sʋntaana nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka yiŋ dim baŋ ye o an ninsʋŋ, ya'a ka' ala o na di nyan ka lu Sʋntaana bɛndigin.

english_verse: Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.
translation_verse: Tuongatib banɛ mɛ sʋŋid Karindɔɔg kpɛɛmnam nar ye ba an nimmua dim, ka da mɔr pian'ad ayi', yi, bɛɛ kɛ ka daam kuli baa, bɛɛ dɔl zam suoya ye ba nyɛ nyɔɔdɛ.

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: Li nar ka ba gban'e yɛlsu'adir linɛ ka Wina'am pa'ali ti ka ti siak la sʋ'ʋŋa, ka ba pʋtɛnda an nyain.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ba kpansi ba yiiga, ka ba ya'a sid anɛ yɛlsida dim, ban on nyaan tʋm Karindɔɔg kpɛɛm tʋʋma.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ka ba pu'ab la mɛ an banɛ tʋm nɛ nimmua, ka da yɛɛsida, ka gban'adi ba mɛŋ, ka an yɛlsida dim si'el wʋsa ni.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka tuongat an pu'ayiŋ daan ka na nyaŋi gɔsi ba biis nɛ ba yidim wʋsa sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Tuongatib banɛ sid tʋm sʋ'ʋŋa la nyɛt na'asi, ka na nyaŋi pian' Yesu Kristo yadda niŋir yɛla nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ. Yɛlsu'adtita'ar la yɛla

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: La'an nɛ man mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye li kʋ yuugɛ ka m na kɛɛn fʋ san'an na la, m sɔbid sa'al bama ye

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: daasi'erɛɛ, m ya'a yuug ka nyaan kena, di na kɛ ka fʋ baŋ fʋn na niŋ si'em ka Wina'am nidib la baŋ din nar ye ba bɛ bɛllim si'a, ka li pa'al ye ba sid anɛ Wina'am onɛ vʋe la la'asʋg nimbanɛ zi'e yɛlsida la zug kiŋ-kiŋ wʋʋ zan'antɔlig nɛ zaŋguoma sʋŋid dɔɔg si'em la.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kae na bi'es yɛlsu'adir linɛ an bʋntita'ari bɛɛ ti Wina'am dɔllim ni laa. O da nie na nɛ niŋgbiŋ. Ka Wina'am Siig bigis ye o an sʋm. Ka maliaknam nyɛɛ o. Ka ba mɔɔl o yɛla tɛɛns wʋsa ni. Ka dunia nidib siaki li. Ka Wina'am di'e o lɛb o na'am zin'igin.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Wina'am Siig Kasi la nie pa'al nyain ye, dunia naar saŋa la, ninsieba na basi ba yadda niŋir ka dɔl siis banɛ ma'ad nidib la, nɛ sibɛ'ɛdnam pa'alʋg.

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: Pa'al bama yitnɛ banɛ an biriku'an nɛ ziri dim banɛ ka ba pʋtɛnda digilim wʋʋ kʋnt tʋʋli nyɛligi li nɛ.

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: Nimbama pa'an ye pu'ab da kul sidib bɛɛ dap da di pu'aba, ka lɛn kisig nidib disieba linɛ ka Wina'am maal ye banɛ niŋ o yadda ka baŋ yɛlsida suor la na tun'e dii li nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim la.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Bʋn linɛ wʋsa ka Wina'am maal la anɛ sʋ'ʋŋa ka ba ya'a di'e li nɛ Wina'am bareka pʋ'ʋsim si'el-si'el pʋ kisa.

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Wina'am labaar la nɛ ti winsɔsʋg la kɛ ka li lieb kasi ka ti na nyaŋi dii li. Paul kpɛmisid Timoti

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a pa'ali fʋ ba'abitaaba la nɛ'ɛŋa fʋ na an Yesu Kristo tʋmtʋm sʋŋ, bɔzugɔ fʋ di'e Wina'am labaar la nɛ sida nɛ yadda niŋir nɛ pa'al sʋŋ linɛ ka fʋ dɔl la.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Zan'asimi pu'anya'as sɔlima linɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suor ka ka' gbinnɛ, ka mɛ zan'as linɛ an yalim tʋʋma, amaa kpɛ'ɛŋimi fʋ mɛŋi zamis Wina'am suor nɛ li tʋʋma.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Nɛ' yɛla ka ti kpɛ'ɛŋid hali nɛ tʋʋm kpi'ema, ka mɔr ti'ir nɛ Wina'am onɛ vʋe ka an nidib wʋsa faangid la; li kas-kas anɛ banɛ niŋ o yadda la.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka sɔ' ziemif fʋn an dasaŋ la zugɔ, amaa niŋim linɛ an sʋm ka ba mɛ tu'asif, ka mɛ tu'asi fʋ pian'ad nɛ fʋ tʋʋma nɛ fʋ nɔŋilim nɛ fʋ yadda niŋir nɛ bɛllim linɛ an nyain.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Karim Wina'am gbauŋ la tis nidib la, ka pa'annɛ ba, ka lɛn san'anɛ ba hali nɛ mam na ti kena.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Da bas piini linɛ ka nɔdi'esidib da di'e Wina'am san'anɛ tisif saŋkanɛ ka kpɛɛmnam da nɔki ba nu'usi pa'ali fʋ zug la.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Tʋm tʋʋm bama ka nɔki fʋ mɛŋi pɛsig tʋʋma la, ka ba nyɛ fʋn kpɛ'ɛŋidi fʋ mɛŋ si'em.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Gu'usimi fʋ mɛŋ sʋ'ʋŋa ka mɛ gu'us fʋn pa'an si'el la sʋ'ʋŋa. Mɔdigim tʋm ala, ka linɛ na kɛ ka fʋn nɛ banɛ kɛlisidi fʋ pian'ad la paam faangir.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Bʋnkʋdʋg ya'a tʋm linɛ pʋ nara, fʋn da tans oo, amaa sa'alim o baanlimm wʋʋ fʋ mɛŋ saam nɛ, ka niŋid dasam wʋʋ fʋ ba'abiis nɛ.

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: Niŋim pu'anya'as wʋʋ fʋ manam nɛ ka niŋ pu'a banɛ pʋ kʋdig la wʋʋ fʋ tanp nɛ. Niŋim ala nɛ pʋpielim.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Na'asim pʋkɔnya banɛ sid an pʋkɔnya la ka sʋŋi ba.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Ka pʋkɔɔnr ya'a mɔr biis bɛɛ yaas, ban on niŋim wʋʋ banɛ pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am niŋid si'em, ka sʋŋi ba mɛŋ yidim. Ala ka ba na yɔɔ ba ugusʋg la sam ka linɛ ma'ad Wina'am sʋʋnr.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Ka pʋkɔnkanɛ bɛɛ o kɔn' ka bɔɔd sʋŋir zaŋid o ti'iri niŋid Wina'am ni ka sɔsid Wina'am nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa bɔɔd sʋŋir.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Ka pʋkɔnkanɛ gɔɔndi tʋm o mɛŋ bɔɔdim yɔri-yɔri la pʋn dɛŋi kpinɛ, hali la'an nɛ on vʋe la.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Sa'alimi ba nɛ'ɛŋa ka ba da mɔr gbadaa.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a pʋ gɔsid o du'adiba, on sɔb zan'as linɛ ka ti siak la nɛ; li kas-kas anɛ o mɛŋ yidim. Hali on sɔb anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔbi gat banɛ ka' yadda niŋidib la.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: Pʋkɔɔnr ya'a pʋ gaad yʋma pisyuobʋ, ka mɛ pʋ an onɛ da kul sid yinne ma'aanɛ, ban da paas o pʋkɔnya la kallinɛ.

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka nidib pian' o tʋʋm sʋma yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa, ka o an onɛ ugusid o biis, ka an onɛ di'esid saam, ka piesid Wina'am nidib nɔba, ka an onɛ sʋŋid banɛ namisid, ka an onɛ pɛsig o mɛŋi tis tʋʋm sʋma wʋsa.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Da paasid pʋkɔnya banɛ nam pʋ kʋdig la kallinɛ, ka dapbɔɔdim tun'e kɛ ka ba bas ban zaŋi ba mɛŋi pɛsig Kristo tʋʋma la ka kul sidib,

english_verse: and become guilty of breaking their promise to him.
translation_verse: ka san'ami ba yiiga nɔzi'elʋg la ka kpɛn'ɛsi ba mɛŋ sariakadibin.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Ka linɛ paas la, ba anɛ gbanya'anam ka giligid yaan. Li ka'anɛ lin ma'aanɛɛ, amaa ba yɛɛsid ka nwɛ'ɛdi ba mɛŋi gɛntid nidib yɛla ni, ka pian'ad linɛ pʋ nara.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m bɔɔd ye pʋkɔnya banɛ pʋ kʋdig kul sidib, ka du'a biis, ka gɔsidi ba yidim. Ala ka dataas kʋ nyaŋi nyɛɛ ti gbadaa,

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Pu'a sɔ' ya'a an yadda niŋid ka mɔr pʋkɔnya o du'adibin on gɔsimi ba, ka da nɔk yɛlbama niŋ Wina'am nidib nu'usinɛɛ; ala ka karindɔɔg la na tun'e sʋŋ pʋkɔnbanɛ sid bɔɔd sʋŋir la.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Na'asimi karindɔɔg kpɛɛmnam banɛ tʋmmi ba tʋʋma sʋ'ʋŋa la, li kas-kas anɛ banɛ mɔɔn Wina'am labaar nɛ banɛ pa'an la.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Wina'am gbauŋ sɔb ye, “Mid ka ya li'a na'araad banɛ kuod la nɛ yʋgʋd.” Ka lɛn sɔb ye, “Li nar ka onɛ tʋm di'e o yɔɔd.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a yɛl ye kpɛɛm sɔ' tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, yanam da kɛlisɛ, asɛɛ ka kasɛtib paae ayi' bɛɛ atan'.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Zɛrigim banɛ zan'as tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd basib la yadda niŋidib wʋsa tuon, ka banɛ kpɛlim la na zɔ dabiem.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: M tisif nɔkaŋa Wina'am tuon nɛ Yesu Kristo tuon nɛ maliaknam tuon ye fʋ tʋm tʋʋm bama nɛ sida, ka da mɔr baregaŋa.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Da gbirigi pa'annɛ fʋ nu'us nidib zutin ye fʋ sɔs Wina'am tisi baa, da la'as nɛ sieba tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Kɛl ka fʋ bɛllim an nyain.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Da nuud ku'om gʋllimnɛɛ, amaa num daam bi'ela, fʋ pʋʋgʋ ɛɛnti zabid la zug; ka fʋ nɔŋ ban'as hali.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Ninsieba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nie paalʋ ka li paae ban na kadi ba saria. Ka sieba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd mɛ niedi dɔlli ba nya'aŋ mɛn.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka tʋʋm sʋma mɛ nied paalʋ. Hali banɛ su'a ka nam pʋ nie la na ti nie.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka banɛ an yammis la baŋ ye li nar ka ba na'asi ba zugdaannam la sʋ'ʋŋa, ka sɔ' da san'am Wina'am yʋ'ʋr nɛ ti pa'alʋg la.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Ka yammis banɛ ka ba zugdaannam an yadda niŋidib la da zan'as ye ba kʋ na'asi ba, ban an ba'abiis la zugɔ, amaa ba tʋmmi ba tʋʋma sʋ'ʋŋa bɔzugɔ banɛ tʋʋma ka ba tʋm la anɛ yadda niŋidib nɛ banɛ ka ba nɔŋ. Pa'alim ka kpɛmisi ba ka ba tʋm nɛ'ɛnam. Sida kpan'am la yɛla

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a pa'an ziri pa'ala, ka pʋ siaki di'e ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo pian'ad linɛ an yɛlsida ka dɔl Wina'am suor laa,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: o sɔb anɛ tita'al, ka zi' si'el si'ela. O mɔri pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd ka nɔŋ nɔŋgbannwa'ar nɛ antu'a yaalis linɛ ta'asid zaba nɛ fufum nɛ yʋ'ʋsan'auŋ nɛ tɛn'ɛsbɛ'ɛd nɛ

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: a-pʋ-siakid taaba pian'ad linɛ fɛndigid nidib ya'am ka pʋ mɔr yɛlsida, ka tɛn'ɛsid ye Wina'am suor dɔllim anɛ linɛ na kɛ ka ba paam ligidi.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a dɔl Wina'am nɛ sida ka fʋ nif tig fʋn mɔr si'el, li anɛ nyɔɔd dinɛ galis.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ mɔr si'eli kɛn dunia ni naa, ka mɛ kʋ nyaŋi zaŋ si'el dunia nwa' ni keŋɛ.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a mɔr diib nɛ fuud, li siaki ti.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Banɛ bɔɔd ye ba an kpan'am dim la na kpɛn' makirin, ka lu Sʋntaana bɛndigin, ba bɔɔdim la anɛ bɛ'ɛd, ka na mɔri ba kpɛn'ɛs san'auŋ nɛ kum pʋʋgin.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ ligidi nɔŋilim anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd buudi wʋsa nya'ar. Ninsieba nini mu'oe nɛ ligidi yɛla hali ka li kɛ ka ba yi yadda niŋirin, ka namisidi ba mɛŋ nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ bɛdegʋ. Paul kpɛmis Timoti

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn, onɛ an Wina'am nid la, zan'asim nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa, ka dɔl Wina'am pʋpielim suor la sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ yadda niŋir nɛ nɔŋilim nɛ mɔdigir nɛ suguru.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Zam zabsʋŋ linɛ an yadda niŋir yɛla la. Kpɛ'ɛŋimi fʋ mɛŋi gban'e nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naar ka Wina'am daa buolif ka fʋ pɛligi fʋ pʋʋgʋ pian' pian'asʋŋ nidib bɛdegʋ tuon la kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: M tisif nɔkaŋa Wina'am onɛ tisid si'el wʋsa nyɔvʋr la tuon, nɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ da di kasɛt ka pian' nie nyain Pontus Pailet tuon la,

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: ye fʋ di'e sa'alʋg la, ka guri li sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ pʋpielim ka gba'ar kae, ti paae Yesu Kristo onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb la lɛbig saŋa na.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: O lɛbig la na anɛ Wina'am zi'el saŋa si'a la. On ma'aa an na'ab, o mɔr albareka ka an na'anam na'ab, nɛ Zugsɔbnam Zugsɔb.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: On ma'aa pʋ kpiida ka bɛ nɛɛsim linɛ nie nyain galis ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi li'el ani, ka sɔ' kae nyɛɛ o bɛɛ na nyaŋi nyɛɛ o. Na'asi nɛ paŋ anɛ o din saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ. Ami.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Sa'alim banɛ mɔr kpan'am dunia kaŋa nwa' la ye ba da mɔr nyɛɛsim, bɛɛ mɔr ti'ir nɛ ba kpan'am linɛ pʋ ya'asid naar la, ka ba zi' lin na an si'em, amaa mɔr ti'ir nɛ Wina'am onɛ tisi ti si'el wʋsa linɛ na malisi ti sʋnya la.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Sa'alimi ba ka ba tʋm tʋʋm sʋma, ka kɛ ka ba tʋʋm sʋma an bɛdegʋ ka tisid piini ka an banɛ pʋdigid bam mɔr si'el nɛ ba taaba.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Nɛ' an suor kanɛ ka ba na su'a ba mɛŋ kpan'am linɛ an ɛɛnb kpi'euŋʋ gur bɛog sa. Ala ka ba na paam nyɔvʋr linɛ sid an sida la.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Timoti, gur linɛ ka ba gu'ulif la. Luakim pian'ayɔɔd linɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suorɛ nɛ ziri nɔŋgbannwa'ar linɛ ka sieba gɔs ka li an baŋir la.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Sieba gɔs ka ba mɔri li, dinzug ka ba yidig ka yii ba yadda niŋir la pʋʋgin. Wina'am na tisi ya wʋsa yɛlsʋm.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Man Paul onɛ ka li an Wina'am bɔɔdim ka o kɛ ka m an Yesu Kristo Tʋmtʋm la sɔb linɛ dɔl o kaanbʋg linɛ an nyɔvʋr ka bɛ Yesu Kristo ni la.

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: M sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid Timoti onɛ aan m binɔŋir la. Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na tisif yɛlsʋm nɛ nimbaanlzɔɔr nɛ sumalisim. Pʋ'ʋsʋg nɛ kpɛmisʋg la yɛla

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: M pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am onɛ ka m dɔl nɛ pʋpielim nwɛnɛ m yaanamɛ da dɔl si'em la bareka. Saŋa wʋsa m tɛn'ɛsidi ya yɛla m winsɔsʋgin.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: M kpɛn tɛnri fʋ sʋnsa'aŋ la yɛla ka bɔɔd hali ye m nyɛɛf ka m sʋnf ma'ae.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: M mɛ tiɛn fʋ yadda niŋir amɛŋa linɛ da dɛŋi bɛɛ fʋ yaapu'a Lois ni ka mɛ bɛɛ fʋ ma Yunis ni la. M mi' ye li mɛ bɛɛ fʋ ni.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka m tiɛndif ye fʋ kɛ ka Wina'am piini linɛ ka m daa pa'alim nu'usi fʋ zugin ka fʋ di'e li ka li bɛɛ fʋ ni la maligim nie.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Wina'am pʋ tisi ti dabiem Siiga, amaa Siig kanɛ mɔr paŋ nɛ nɔŋilim nɛ mɛŋ gban'ar.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ da zɔt nyan nɛ fʋn na yɛl linɛ ka fʋ mi' ti Zugsɔb yɛla la, ka mɛ da zɔt nyan nɛ mam onɛ an sanrega nid o yɛla laa, amaa mɛ siakim namisʋg linɛ aan fʋ din labasʋŋ la yɛla nɛ Wina'am paŋ.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Onɛ faaɛn ti ka buoli ti ye ti bɛ bɛllim linɛ an sʋm, ka li ka'anɛ ti tʋmnɛ si'el zugɔ, amaa li anɛ o mɛŋ bɔɔdim nɛ o pʋpielim piini zug ka o tisi ti Yesu Kristo ni yʋma banɛ gaad ka dunia nam pʋ pin'il la.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Amaa Yesu Kristo ken la ni na ka o pʋpielim piini la yʋ'ʋn nie nyain ka o faaɛn ti ka san'am kum paŋ, ka kɛ ka ti nyɛ nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarɛ ka li yinɛ Wina'am labasʋŋin la na.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Labasʋŋ la yɛla ka o gaŋim ye m an Kristo Tʋmtʋm nɛ onɛ pa'an ka lɛm mɔɔnnɛ li yɛla la.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: Li anɛ lina zugʋ kɛ ka m namisid amaa m pʋ zɔti li nyannɛ. M mi' onɛ ka m niŋ o yadda la, ka mɛ mi' ye o na nyaŋi gur linɛ ka m gu'ul o la sʋ'ʋŋa ti paae Wina'am sariakadib daar.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Dɔl pa'alsʋŋ linɛ ka m pa'alif la nɛ nɔŋilim nɛ yadda niŋir linɛ bɛ Yesu Kristo ni la.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Gur yɛlsida linɛ ka ba gu'ulif la nɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi onɛ bɛɛ ti ni la sʋŋir.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Fʋ pʋn mi' ye banɛ bɛ Asia la wʋsa basim nɛ, la'an nɛ Pigelus nɛ Hermogenes.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb na zɔ Onesiferus yidim nimbaanlig bɔzugɔ o kaadim ka bʋgʋnnɛ m sʋnf, ka pʋ zɔt nyan nɛ ban lɔɔm nɛ bana laa.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: On paae Room na la, o ie mam nɛ nimmua ti nyɛɛm.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na zɔɔ o nimbaanlig sariakadib daar. Fʋ pʋn mi' sʋŋir kanɛ ka o sʋŋim Efesus teŋin la.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: M biiga, kpɛ'ɛŋimi fʋ mɛŋ nɛ pʋpielim piini linɛ bɛ Yesu Kristo ni la.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Ka fʋn wʋm si'el mam san'an nidib bɛdegʋ tuon la, tɔlisimi li tis yɛlsida dim banɛ na tun'e pa'al sieba mɛn.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Di'em namisʋg linɛ aan fʋ din, fʋn an Yesu Kristo soogia sʋŋ la zug.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Onɛ tʋm soogia tʋʋma ba'a kae nɛ banɛ ka' soogianam yɛla nii, amaa on bɔɔd si'el anɛ o ma'ae o kpɛɛm la sʋnf.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Li nar ka kpaad onɛ tʋm tʋʋma hali la dɛŋi dii o zʋʋd la nyɔɔd.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsim man yɛt si'el la, ka Zugsɔb na kɛ ka fʋ baŋ si'el wʋsa gbin.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsim Yesu Kristo yɛla, onɛ da vʋ'ʋg kumin la, o anɛ na'ab David yaaŋ. Nɛ'ɛŋa an labasʋŋ kanɛ ka m mɔɔn la.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: Labasʋŋ kaŋa zug ka m namisid ka ba lɔɔm nɛ bana wʋʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb nɛ. Amaa Wina'am pian'ad la pʋ lɔ nɛ banaa.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka m mɔdigid si'el wʋsa ni ye banɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ la mɛ nyɛ faangir linɛ bɛ Yesu Kristo ni la, nɛ na'asi linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ yɛlmɛŋir ye, “Ti ya'a la'am kpi nɛ o, ti mɛ na vʋe nɛ o.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Ka ti ya'a mɔdig nɛ o, ti mɛ na di na'am nɛ o. Ti ya'a zan'as o, o mɛ na zan'asi ti.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Ti ya'a ka' yɛlsida dima, o na kpɛn an yɛlsida sɔb, bɔzugɔ o kʋ zan'as o mɛŋa.” Tʋmtʋm kanɛ ka Wina'am tis sida

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Tiɛnmi fʋ nidib la nɛ'ɛŋa, ka sa'ali ba Wina'am tuon, ka ba da mɔr nɔŋgbannwa'ar linɛ pʋ mɔr nyɔɔdɛ. Li san'amidnɛ banɛ wʋmi li la.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Kpɛ'ɛŋim ka nɔki fʋ mɛŋi tis Wina'am ka fʋ tʋʋma paae Wina'am ya'am, ka mɛ an onɛ pʋ zɔt nyan nɛ o tʋʋmaa, ka pa'an pian'ad linɛ an yɛlsida la.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Zan'asim pian'ayɔɔd linɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suorɛ bɔzugɔ, banɛ niŋid ala la na maligim bie ka ba bas Wina'am suor la dɔllim.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Ba pa'alʋg la nwɛnɛ fɛn'ɛkʋdʋgʋ ɔnbid niŋgbiŋi yaligid si'em la. Pa'aniba ayi' bɛɛ ba sʋʋgin, ka banɛ an Himeneus nɛ Piletus,

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: banɛ bas yɛlsida suor ka yɛt ye kum vʋ'ʋgir la gaad ya sa, ka mɛ san'amid ninsieba yadda niŋir.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am ɛɛnbkpi'euŋ la zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ, ka o zanbin la sɔb anina ye, “Zugsɔb la mi' banɛ aan o nidib.” Ka lɛn sɔb ye, “Banɛ wʋsa sid ye ba anɛ Wina'am nidib la, basimi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.”

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Yitita'ar pʋ mɔr sanlima bɛɛ anzurifa la'ad ma'aanɛ, amaa daad nɛ ya'ad la'ad mɛ bɛ, ka ba yisid sieba dabis-sʋma daar, ka sieba mɛ an daar wʋsa tʋʋma la'ad.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a pie o mɛŋ nyain ka yis o mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin, o na lieb tʋʋm sʋma lauk linɛ an kasi, ka li nar ye yidaan nɔki li tʋm tʋʋm sʋma.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Zan'asim dasam bɔɔdim linɛ an bɛ'ɛd ka kpɛ'ɛŋ nɛ nimmua ye fʋ an yɛlsida sɔb ka mɔr yadda niŋir nɛ nɔŋilim nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm, la'an nɛ banɛ pʋ'ʋsidi ti Zugsɔb nɛ pʋpielim la.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Zan'asim yalim bu'os yaalis ka fʋ mi' ye li mɔri zaba kenna.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Mid ka Zugsɔb tʋmtʋm an onɛ nɔŋ zaba. Amaa o na'asim nidib wʋsa ka an pa'an sʋŋ ka mɛ mɔr suguru,

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: ka nɔk ya'am san'anɛ o dataas ka daasi'erɛɛ Wina'am na kɛ ka ba tiak ka baŋ yɛlsida la,

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: ka luak Sʋntaana bɛndig linɛ ka o dɛŋi bɛnd ye ba tʋm o bɔɔdim la.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Baŋim nɛ'ɛŋa. Li na tɔi hali tis Wina'am nidib dunia naar saŋa,

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: nidib na an banɛ nɔŋi ba mɛŋ nɛ banɛ nɔŋ ligidi hali nɛ banɛ nwɛ'ɛdi ba nyɔ'ɔg nɛ banɛ mɔr nyɛɛsim nɛ banɛ tʋ'ʋd nidib nɛ banɛ pʋ siakidi ba saamnam nɛ manam nɔya nɛ banɛ pʋ mɔr bareka pʋ'ʋsim nɛ banɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suorɛ

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: nɛ banɛ pʋ nɔŋ ban kpin sieba nɛ banɛ pʋ mɔr sɔ' nyɔɔgɔ nɛ banɛ san'ami ba taaba yʋda nɛ banɛ pʋ gban'adi ba mɛŋa nɛ banɛ ka ba taaba zɔti ba dabiem nɛ banɛ kis linɛ an sʋm

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: nɛ filim-filim dim nɛ haya dim nɛ tita'alnam nɛ banɛ bɔɔd linɛ na ma'adi ba mɛŋ sʋnya gat Wina'am.

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: Ba niŋidnɛ wʋʋ ba dɔlnɛ Wina'am suor, amaa ka pʋ pa'annɛ li paŋa. Luakim nimban buudi.

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Ka ba sieba su'adi kpɛn'ɛd yaanɛ ma'ad pu'a banɛ ka' ya'am, ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pɛ'ɛli ba, ka ba ya'amlɛog nyaŋidi ba,

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: ka ba kɛlisid sɔ' mɛkama ka kʋ nyaŋi baŋ linɛ an sidaa.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ Jannes nɛ Jambres n da zan'as Moses si'em la, ala mɛn ka nimbama mɛ zan'asid sida la. Ba anɛ banɛ pʋ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛsʋŋɔ, ka pʋ niŋ Yesu Kristo yadda nɛ sida.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Amaa ba tʋʋma kʋ keŋ tuonnɛ, bɔzugɔ nidib wʋsa na nyɛ ka ba anɛ zɔn wʋʋ Jannes nɛ Jambres n daa an si'em la. Paul kpɛmis Timoti

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: Fʋ mi' m pa'alʋg la wʋsa nɛ m tʋʋma nɛ m bɛllim an si'em nɛ m pʋtɛn'ɛri gban'e si'el nɛ m yadda niŋir, nɛ m suguru nɛ m nɔŋilim nɛ m mɔdigir,

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: nɛ m namisʋg nɛ m fara, Yesu dɔllim la yɛla. Fʋ mi' ban daa namisim Antiok nɛ Ikonium nɛ Listra tɛɛnsin Yesu yɛla ka m mɔdig si'em. Ka Zugsɔb la faanm nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa ni.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Asida ka m yɛt ye banɛ wʋsa bɔɔd ye ba dɔl Wina'am ka an yinne nɛ Yesu Kristo la, ba na namisi ba.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Nimbɛ'ɛdnam nɛ zam dim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la na kpɛm paasid bɛdegʋ, hali ba na ma'ad nidib ka ma'adi ba mɛŋ.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Amaa ya'a an fʋn, kpɛn tɛnr linɛ ka fʋ zamis ka siak la sʋ'ʋŋa;

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ fʋ mi' fʋn zamisi li sieba san'an. Fʋ biilimin sa fʋ baŋ Wina'am gbauŋ sʋ'ʋŋa linɛ na nyaŋi tisif ya'am ka fʋ niŋ Yesu Kristo yadda ka nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Pian'ad linɛ wʋsa bɛ Wina'am gbauŋʋn la yinɛ o san'an na ka an sʋm nɛ pa'alʋg nɛ sa'alʋg ka bigisid bɛ'ɛd nɛ sʋ'ʋm nɛ zamisʋg linɛ yit pʋpielimin na,

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: ka na sʋŋ Wina'am tʋmtʋm ka o tʋm linɛ wʋsa an sʋm.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: M zi'enɛ Wina'am nɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ na ti lɛb na nɛ o na'am sʋ'ʋlim kad banɛ vʋe nɛ banɛ kpi saria la tuonnɛ tisidif nɔkaŋa ye:

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: Fʋ mɔɔlim Wina'am pian'ad la saŋa kanɛ an sʋm nɛ saŋa kanɛ ka' sʋ'ʋm. Sa'alimi ba ka zɛrigi ba ka kpɛmisi ba ka pa'ali ba nɛ suguru saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, saŋa kenna ka nidib kʋ mɔdigi kɛlis linɛ an sida pa'alʋgɔ, amaa ka na dɔlli ba mɛŋ ya'amlɛog bɔɔdim. Saŋkan la, ba na la'as pa'annib bɛdegʋ banɛ na pa'annɛ ba linɛ malisi ba tʋba ma'aa.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: Ba na fɛndig ka kʋ kɛlis sida laa ka lɛɛ kɛlisid linɛ an sɔlima.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Amaa fʋn kʋdim gban'ami fʋ mɛŋ ka mɔdigi di fara, ka an onɛ mɔɔn Wina'am labasʋŋ la, ka tʋmmi fʋ tʋʋma la wʋsa.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Saŋa paaeya ye m vʋm naae. M kum la na nwɛnɛ maan ka ba maali tis Wina'am.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: M zab zabsʋŋ la nyaŋ, ka zɔɔ paae zɔɔg la bɛn, ka nan kpɛn zi'e sida la ni.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Ka nannanna, pʋpielim na'am zupibig linɛ ka Zugsɔb onɛ kad saria nɛ pʋpielim la digi gurim; o na ti yɔɔm dabiskan la daar, ka li ka'anɛ mam ma'aanɛ amaa la'an nɛ banɛ wʋsa mɔr o lɛbig na ti'ir la. Paul tɔlim n tis Timoti mɛŋ

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ mɛŋi kɛɛn m san'an nannanna na.

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Kresens keŋ Galatia, ka Titus keŋ Dalmatia, ka Demas nɔŋ dunia kaŋa ka basim ka keŋ Tɛsalonika.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Ka Luk gʋllim kpɛlim bɛɛ m san'an. Dɔl Mak na ka o mɔr sʋŋiri m tʋʋma la zin'igin.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: M tʋm Tikikus Efesus teŋin.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a kenna, fʋn on mɔrim waad fukanɛ ka m daa bas Kaapus san'an Troas teŋin la, nɛ m gbana la, ka li kas-kas anɛ gbauŋ banɛ ka ba nɔk gbauŋʋ maali sɔb la.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Alekzanda onɛ kʋnt si'elnam la niŋi m bɛ'ɛd hali, ka Wina'am na yɔɔ o li sam wʋʋ on niŋ si'em la.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Fʋn mɛ gu'usimi fʋ mɛŋ nɛ o, bɔzugɔ o daa ki'isi ti pian'ad la hali nɛ kpi'euŋ.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Man daa dɛŋi tu'ad kɔɔtʋ ni ye m yisi m mɛŋ la, sɔ' daa pʋ zi'enim nya'aŋi sʋŋi ma; ba wʋsa daa basim nɛ. M sɔsid Wina'am ye o basi ba taali tisi ba.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la daa zi'em nya'aŋ ka tisim paŋ ye m mɔɔl pian'ad la sʋ'ʋŋa ka banɛ ka' Jew dim la bɛdegʋ wʋm. O daa faanmi yi gbigim nɔɔrin.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la na faanm linɛ wʋsa an bɛ'ɛd zin'igin ka mɔrimi kpɛn'ɛs o na'amin la. O na nyɛ na'asi dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Ami. Pʋ'ʋsʋg

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsim Prisila nɛ Akuila, nɛ Onesiferus yidim.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Erastus kpɛlim Korint teŋin, ka Trofimus bɛn'ɛd ka m kɛ ka o kpɛlim Miletus teŋin.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Kpɛ'ɛŋimi fʋ mɛŋi kena, ka sapal nyaan paae. Yubulus nɛ Pudens nɛ Linus nɛ Klaudia nɛ ti ba'abiis wʋsa pʋ'ʋsidif.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb na bɛ nɛ fʋ siig. Wina'am yɛlsʋm na bɛ nɛf.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Mam Paul onɛ an Wina'am yammʋg nɛ Yesu Kristo Tʋmtʋm la sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa ye m kɛ ka banɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ la yadda niŋir keŋ tuon ka nɔbig, ka ba baŋ Wina'am yɛlsida, linɛ kɛt ka ba dɔl Wina'am suor la.

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: Ti mɔr ti'ir ye ti na nyɛ nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naarɛ, ka Wina'am onɛ ka' ziri sɔb la, da zi'el nɔɔri tisi ti saŋkanɛ ka dunia da nam pʋ maal la.

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: Li saŋa paae la, Wina'am onɛ aan ti faangid la nie nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naar la yɛla o pian'ad pʋʋgin tisim ye m mɔɔl.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: M sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid Titus onɛ ka tinam nɛ on la'an niŋ Yesu Kristo yadda ka o liebi m biig amɛŋa la. Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti faangid Yesu Kristo na tisif yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Titus tʋʋma Krete teŋin la yɛla

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: Linɛ yɛla ka m kɛ ka fʋ kpɛlim Krete teŋin la anɛ ye, fʋ naae linɛ pʋ naae la, ka gaŋ kpɛɛmnam yadda niŋidibin la teŋ-teŋ wʋʋ man daa yɛlif si'em la.

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛm pʋ sʋm ye o mɔr gba'arɛ, li sʋm ka o an pu'ayiŋ daan, ka o biis niŋ Yesu Kristo yadda, ka ka' ninyɔɔd bɛɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnama.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Kpɛɛm onɛ sʋ'oe Wina'am nidib nar ka o ka' gba'arɛ, ka da mɔr nyɛɛsim bɛɛ sʋnpɛɛn bɛɛ an danuud bɛɛ zaba sɔb bɛɛ nɔŋ ligidi hali tʋʋgi li bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka o an onɛ di'esid saam nɛ sumalisim, ka an onɛ tʋm linɛ an sʋm, ka mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛsʋŋ, ka dɔl Wina'am suor sʋ'ʋŋa ka o bɛllim an kasi ka gban'ad o mɛŋ sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka o siaki dɔl yɛlmɛŋir pa'alʋg linɛ ka ba zamis o la, ka na nyaŋi zaŋ yɛlsida pa'alʋg la kpɛmis sieba, ka na nyaŋi pa'al banɛ ki'isid la ban gbɛlig zin'isi'a.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Nidib bɛdegʋ bɛɛ an banɛ ki'isidi ti pa'alʋg la, ba anɛ ziri dim ka ba pian'ad ka' gbinnɛ. Li kas-kas anɛ banɛ dɔl Jew dim malima linɛ an baŋʋ kpɛn'ɛb yɛla la.

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: Li nar ka fʋ kɛ ka ba an baanlimm, bɔzugɔ ba nwa'ad nidib ya', ban pa'an linɛ pʋ nar ye ba pa'al la zug, ye ba di'e nyɔɔd linɛ pʋ nari ba la.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Hali ba mɛŋ nɔdi'es yinne da ye, “Krete dim anɛ ziri dim saŋa wʋsa, ba nwɛnɛ mɔɔgin bʋnyuos nɛ, ka an gbanya'anam nɛ dindiisnam.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Yɛl kaŋa anɛ sida, dinzugɔ, sa'alimi ba nɛ kpi'euŋ, ka ba na zi'e ba yadda la ni kiŋ-kiŋ,

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: ka zan'asi Jew dim sɔlima nɛ nɔzi'ela linɛ yit nimbanɛ ki'isid yɛlsida la san'an na.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Bʋn wʋsa anɛ nyain tisid onɛ an nyain la, amaa banɛ an dian'ad dim, ka pʋ siakid Wina'am la, si'el-si'el ka' an nyain tisi baa, bɔzugɔ ba ya'am nɛ ba pʋtɛnda wʋsa anɛ dian'ad.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Ba yɛt nidib ye ba mi' Wina'am, amaa ba tʋʋma pa'an ye ba zan'as Wina'am. Ba anɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam, ka pʋ siakid Wina'am nɔɔrɛ, ka pʋ nar nɛ ban na nyaŋi tʋm tʋʋm sʋŋ si'aa.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: Li anɛ tilas ye fʋ pa'ali ba linɛ dɔl suor ka an pa'alsʋŋ.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Pa'alim dap kʋda la ye ba an nimmua dim nɛ banɛ mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛsʋŋ, ka an banɛ siakid pian'ad sʋ'ʋŋa, ka mɛ mɔr nɔŋilim nɛ mɔdigir sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Ka mɛ pa'an pu'anya'as ka ba mɔr na'asi ba bɛllim pʋʋgin, ka da bɔɔd bayɛog bɛɛ ba kɛ ka daam kuli baa, amaa ka pa'an linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: Ala ka ba na sa'al pu'a banɛ pʋ kʋdig la, ka ba nɔŋi ba sidib nɛ ba biis,

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: ka gban'adi ba mɛŋ ka da an dian'ad dima, ka an yipu'a sʋma, ka zɔt nidib nimbaanlig, ka siakidi ba sidib nɔya; ala ka nidib kʋ nɛ'ɛs Wina'am labasʋŋ laa.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn, sa'alim dasam la ka ba gban'adi ba mɛŋ

english_verse: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.
translation_verse: si'el wʋsa ni. Kɛl ka fʋ mɛŋ an zanbinnɛ tisi ba ka li yii fʋ tʋʋm sʋma ni. Mɔr nimmua nɛ yɛlsida fʋ pa'alʋg pʋʋgin,

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: nɛ pian'asʋŋ linɛ ka ba kʋ nyaŋi zɛrigi fɔ. Ala ka banɛ ki'isidif la di nyan, bɔzugɔ ba kʋ nyɛ taal si'a fʋ san'anɛ.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Kɛl ka yammis siakidi ba zugdaannam nɔya ka da ki'isidi baa, ka tʋm si'el wʋsa linɛ na ma'ae ba sʋnya,

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: ka da zuudi ba la'adɛ, ka lɛɛ pa'al ye ba sid anɛ sida dim ka tʋm dinɛ nar. Ala ka nidib na baŋ ye Wina'am onɛ aan ti faangid la pa'ala an sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Wina'am yɔlisim la nie tis nidib wʋsa ye ba nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: Li pa'annɛ ti ye ti zan'as linɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suorɛ, nɛ dunia bɔɔdim, ka gban'e ti mɛŋ ka bɛ bɛllim linɛ ka' gba'arɛ ka dɔl Wina'am suor dunia nwa' ni.

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ nan gu'usid ka mɔr albareka ti'ir nɛ ti Wina'am tita'ar nɛ ti faangid Yesu Kristo na'am dabistita'ar la nier la,

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: o nɔk o mɛŋi tisi ti ye ti nyɛ yɔlisim ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pʋʋgin, ka kɛ ka ti lieb o mɛŋ nimbanɛ an nyain, ka mɔɔd ye ba tʋm tʋʋm sʋma.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Pa'alim nɛ'ɛnam ka sa'ali ba, ka kpɛmisi ba sʋnya nɛ fʋ paŋ wʋsa. Da kɛ ka sɔ'ɔsɔ pɔ'ɔgi fɔ.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Tiɛnmi nidib la ka ba siak na'anam nɛ gɔmena kpi'emnam nɔya, ka niŋ ban yɛl si'el, ka ti'eb ye ba siaki tʋm tʋʋm sʋma nɛ linɛ wʋsa ka ba yɛli ba.

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: Ba da pian'ad sɔ' yɛla bɛ'ɛdɛ, ka da bɔɔd zabaa, ka an suguru dim banɛ na'asid nidib wʋsa.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, saŋa kanɛ gaad la, tinam mɛ da anɛ zɔn, ka pʋ di'ed sa'aligɔ, ka ba ma' ti ka ya'amlɛog nɛ li buudi kɛ ka ti lieb yammis, ka mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛdi ti bɛllim wʋsa ni ka nɛn nidib, ka nidib kisi ti ka ti mɛ kis taaba.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am onɛ aan ti faangid la sʋŋir nɛ o nɔŋilim nie la,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: o faaɛn ti ka li ka' ti tʋʋm sʋma zugɔ, amaa li anɛ o mɛŋ nimbaanlzɔɔr la yɛla. O faaɛn ti nɛ o Siig Kasi linɛ pie ti ka li an du'am-paal nɛ nyɔvʋpaal la.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: O tisidi ti o Siig Kasi la bɛdegʋ ka li yi Yesu Kristo onɛ aan ti faangid la ni,

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: ye ti an bʋʋd dim o tuon ka li yii o mɛŋ yɔlisim la ni ka ti mɔr ti'ir ye ti na di faar linɛ an nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naar la.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Pian'akaŋa anɛ yɛlsida. M bɔɔd ye fʋ pa'ali ba yɛlbama nɛ kpi'euŋ, ka banɛ niŋ Wina'am yadda la na gu'usid ka tʋm tʋʋm sʋma saŋa wʋsa. Yɛlbama anɛ sʋm hali ka mɔr nyɔɔdi tisid sɔ' wʋsa.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Amaa basimi yalim bu'osa nɛ yaanam yʋda la yɛla nɛ nɔŋgbannwa'ar nɛ zaba linɛ an Jew dim wada la yɛla, bɔzugɔ lin wʋsa anɛ zaalim ka ka' nyɔɔdɛ.

english_verse: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a bɔɔd ye o wɛligi ya yanam bɔɔm saŋa sa'al o nɔɔr yinne bɛɛ ayi', ka o ya'a zan'as yanam kɛl o bas.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Fʋ mi' ye ninkaŋa buudi tiaknɛ an nimbɛ'ɛd ka pʋ dɔl suosʋŋɔ. O pʋn kad o mɛŋ saria bɛ'ɛd. Paul tɔlʋŋ linɛ ka o yuolim tis Titus la yɛla

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: M ya'a tʋm Atemas bɛɛ Tikikus fʋ san'an na, fʋn kpɛ'ɛŋi fʋ mɛŋi kɛɛn m san'an Nikopolis teŋin na, ka m gban'e ye m bɛɛ anina sapal saŋa.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Kpɛ'ɛŋimi fʋ mɛŋi sʋŋ Zenas onɛ an lɔya ka pa'an wada la, nɛ Apollos ka ba nyaŋi keŋi ba ken la ka si'el da pɔ'ɔgi baa.

english_verse: Our people should learn to spend their time doing something useful and worthwhile.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ti nidib la zamis ka tʋm tʋʋma linɛ nar ye ba tʋm ka li sʋŋi ba, ka ba da bɛ zaalim-zaalim.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Banɛ wʋsa bɛ nɛ m la pʋ'ʋsidif. Pʋ'ʋsimi ti taaba banɛ an yadda niŋidib ka nɔŋi ti la. Wina'am yɛlsʋm na bɛ nɛ ya wʋsa.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Man Paul onɛ an sanrega nid Yesu Kristo yɛla la, nɛ ti ba'abiig Timoti sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisidi ti zua sʋŋ Filimon onɛ aan ti tʋmtʋm tiraan la,

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: nɛ ti taʋn Afia nɛ Akipus onɛ aan ti soogia tiraan Yesu Kristo tʋʋma ni la, nɛ Wina'am nimbanɛ la'asidi fʋ yin la.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo na tisif yɔlisim nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Filimon nɔŋilim nɛ o yadda niŋir

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: M pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka saŋa mɛkama ka tiɛndi fʋ yɛla m winsɔsʋgin,

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ m wʋm fʋn niŋi ti Zugsɔb Yesu yadda si'em la'an nɛ nɔŋilim linɛ ka fʋ mɔr nɛ yadda niŋidib la.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: M sɔsid Wina'am ye tinamɛ an yadda niŋidib nɛ taaba la, na kɛ ka ti gban'e bʋnsʋŋ kanɛ wʋsa ka ti mɔr Kristo ni la gbin.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: M ba'abiiga, fʋ nɔŋilim la tis man sumalisim ka li kpɛ'ɛŋi m sʋnf hali, bɔzugɔ fʋ ma'ae yadda niŋidib la wʋsa sʋnya. Onesimus yɛla

english_verse: Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ mam mɔr suor Kristo nii na tun'e tisif nɔɔr nɛ kpi'euŋ ye fʋ niŋ linɛ nar la,

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: tinamɛ nɔŋ taaba la zug ka m bɛlimif. Man Paul onɛ an Yesu Kristo ninkʋdʋg ka bɛ sanrega ni Yesu Kristo zug la,

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: sɔsidi fʋ m biig Onesimus onɛ ka m lieb o saam man daa bɛ sanrega ni la yɛla .

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: O daa ka' tʋmmir saŋa linɛ gaad la, amaa o yʋ'ʋn mɔr tʋmmir mam nɛ fʋn san'an.

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: Nannanna nwa', m lɛbisid on kanɛ aan m nyɔɔrin kɔnbʋg la tisidif.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Li naan bɔɔdin bɛdegʋ ye o kpɛlimmi m san'an ka zi'enɛ fʋ nɔba zugʋ sʋŋinim, man nam bɛ sanrega ni Wina'am pian'ad yɛla la.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Amaa m pʋ bɔɔd ye m tʋm si'el ka fʋ zi' li ti'irɛ, ka fʋn gban'e ye fʋ maal si'el na an fʋ mɛŋ bɔɔdim ka ka' mugusʋgɔ.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Daasi'erɛ, linɛ kɛ ka o daa yii fʋ san'an saŋa bi'ela la, anɛ ye fʋ lɛn di'e o ya'as ka o bɛɛ fʋ san'an saŋa wʋsa,

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: ka lɛn ka' fʋ yammʋga, amaa o gat yammʋg; o yʋ'ʋn anɛ fʋ ba'abinɔŋir. M nɔŋ o bɛdegʋ, amaa fʋn na nɔŋ o gaad ala, bɔzugɔ o anɛ fʋ yammʋg ka mɛ aan fʋ ba'abiig, Zugsɔb la ni.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Ka fʋ ya'a sid anɛ m dɔllim taa, fʋn di'em o wʋʋ fʋn naan di'enim si'em la.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Ka o ya'a daa tʋmif nɛ bɛ'ɛd bɛɛ mɔri fʋ si'el, fʋn gi'elimi li, ka li aan m sam.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Man Paul n sɔb nɛ'ɛŋa nɛ m mɛŋ nu'ug, ye m na yɔɔ li wʋsa. Hali tun'e yɛl ye m sam dɔlli fʋ zaŋi keŋi fʋ mɛŋ-mɛŋ nyɔvʋr pʋʋgin.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Ɛɛn, m ba'abiiga, m bɔɔd nyɔɔdi fʋ san'an tinamɛ an yinne nɛ Zugsɔb la zug. Bʋgʋlimi m sʋʋnr nɛ bʋn linɛ dɔl Kristo ni.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye fʋ ti'eb saam dɔɔgʋ digilim, bɔzugɔ m mɔr ti'ir ye Wina'am na di'e ya wʋsa winsɔsʋg ka yisim kpɛla lɛbisi ya san'an na. Pʋ'ʋsʋg

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafras onɛ ka ti la'am bɛ sanrega ni Yesu Kristo yɛla la, pʋ'ʋsidif.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: M tʋmtʋm taaba Mak nɛ Aristarkus nɛ Demas nɛ Luk mɛ pʋ'ʋsidif.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo yɔlsim la na bɛ nɛ ya wʋsa.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Wina'am da kɛ ka o nɔdi'esidib pian'ad o yɛla kʋdimin la tisidi ti yaanam, saŋa bɛdegʋ nɛ suoya kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Amaa nannanna Wina'am pian'adi tisid ti ka li yit o Biig la san'an na. O Biig la ka o gaŋ o ye o sʋ'oe si'el wʋsa, ka li yinɛ o san'an na ka Wina'am maal dunia nɛ linɛ bɛ saŋgbauŋin la wʋsa.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Wina'am na'am girima la nienɛ nyain o Biig la ni, ka Wina'am an si'em la, o mɛ anɛ ala. Ka li yinɛ o pian'ad linɛ mɔr paŋ la ni ka o gɔsid bʋn wʋsa. Ka on pie ninsaal tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, ka yʋ'ʋn zin' Wina'am onɛ an kpi'euŋ sɔbi gat si'el wʋsa la datiuŋ. Wina'am Biig la gat maliaknam

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Wina'am dʋ'ʋs o ka o gat maliaknam. Ka yʋ'ʋr kanɛ ka o di'e la gat maliaknam yʋda.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, Wina'am nan zi' yɛl maliak ye, “Fʋ anɛ mam Biig; zina ka m liebi fʋ Saam.” Ka mɛ pʋ yɛl maliak ye, “Man na aan o saam ka o na aan m Biiga.”?

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Ka on tʋm o bikpɛŋ dunia ni na la, o lɛn yɛl ye, “Kɛl ka Wina'am maliaknam wʋsa na'as o.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Ka yɛl maliaknam banɛ aan o tʋmtʋmnib la yɛla ye, “O kɛ ka o maliaknam la an wʋʋ pɛbisim nɛ, ka o tʋmtʋmnib la mɛ an wʋʋ bugum pielim nɛ.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Amaa o Biig la yɛla, o yɛl ye, “O Wina'am, fʋ na'am la na bɛ saŋa kanɛ ka' bɛnnɛ; ka pʋpielim na aan fʋ sʋ'ʋlim la dansaar.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Fʋ nɔŋ pʋpielim, ka kis linɛ an bɛ'ɛd. Dinzug ka Wina'am, onɛ aan fʋ Wina'am la, na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ gaadi fʋ taaba ka kpa'ae sumalisim kpaam niŋif wʋʋ tudaar nɛ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Ka lɛn ye, “Zugsɔba, pin'ilʋgʋn ka fʋ da digil teŋgbauŋ la ɛɛnbir, ka fʋ nu'us maal saŋgbana la wʋsa.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: Ba na bɔdig, amaa ka fʋ na kpɛm bɛ; ba wʋsa na ti kpi nwɛnɛ fuug nɛ, amaa fʋn na kpɛm bɛ.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Ba nwɛnɛ fuud ka fʋ na kpilim, ka tiaki ba wʋʋ fupaala. Amaa fʋn anɛ fʋ naŋ-naŋ, ka fʋ yʋma kʋdim kʋ naae.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Ka maliak kanɛ ka Wina'am nam mi' yɛl o ye, “Zin'inimi m datiuŋ, hali ka m ti kɛ ka fʋ bi'emnam bɛɛ fʋ nɔba teŋirɛ?”

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Ka maliaknam an bɔ? Ba anɛ wʋʋ siis nɛ, ka tʋmnɛ tisid Wina'am. Ka o tʋmi ba ye ba sʋŋ banɛ na ti paam faangir la.

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ li nar ka ti gban'e tinamɛ wʋm yɛlsida si'a la sʋ'ʋŋa, ka da basi lii.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Ka pian'akanɛ ka maliaknam da yɛl la ya'a sadigim an sida, onɛ zan'as ka pʋ dɔlli li na di'e namisʋg linɛ nar o.

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: Ka ti ya'a nɛ'ɛs Wina'am faangir tita'ar kaŋa, ti na niŋ wala pɔns namisʋg la? Zugsɔb la da dɛŋi pian' faangir la yɛla yiiga, ka banɛ wʋmi li la pa'ali ti ye li anɛ sida.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am mɛ pa'al ye li anɛ sida, nɛ tʋʋmnyalima nɛ tʋʋm kpi'ema buudi-buudi nɛ o Siig Kasi piini linɛ ka o pʋdigidi li o ya'am bɔɔd si'em. Faangir la sʋ'ʋd la yɛla

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am pʋ kɛ ka maliaknam sʋ'oe dunia linɛ ka o da nan ye o maal ka ti pian'adi li yɛla laa.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn zin'isi'a ka sɔ' yɛl ye, “Ninsaal an bɔ, ka fʋ tɛnr o yɛla ala? Bɛɛ ninsaal biig an bɔ, ka fʋ ba'a bɛɛ o ni?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Fʋ maal o ka maliaknam gaad o nɛ bi'ela, amaa ka fʋ tis o girima nɛ na'asi,

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: ka ye fʋ zaŋ si'el wʋsa niŋ o nu'usin.” Ka on zaŋ si'el wʋsa niŋ o nu'usin la zug, li pa'al ye si'el kae ka ninsaal pʋ sʋ'oe lii. Amaa lin an si'em la, ti nam pʋ nyɛ ka o sʋ'oe si'el mɛkamaa.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Amaa ti nyɛ Yesu, onɛ ka Wina'am da sie o gaad maliaknam saŋa bi'ela, ye on Wina'am ka o yʋ'ʋn pid o na'am zupibig nɛ na'asi, kum namisʋg la yɛla. Ka li anɛ Wina'am pʋpielim kɛ ka o kpii tis sɔ' wʋsa yɛla ka nyɛ na'asi.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Li sʋ'ʋm ye Wina'am onɛ maan ka gɔsid si'el wʋsa la, kɛ ka Yesu onɛ aan ti faangid la an sʋ'ʋŋa on namis la yɛla, ye Wina'am ti zaŋ o biis bɛdegʋ ka ba kpɛn' o nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naar la ni.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ an kasi la nɛ nimbanɛ ka o maal ka ba an kasi la, wʋsa anɛ Ba' yinne. Dinzug ka Yesu pʋ zɔt nyan nɛ on na buoli ba ye o ba'abiisɛ.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: O yɛl ye, “M na yɛli m ba'abiis fʋn tʋm si'eli tisim la, m na yʋ'ʋm dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr nidib bɛdegʋ tuon.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Ka lɛn ye, “M na ti'enɛ Wina'am.” Ka lɛn yɛl ya'as ye, “Manɛ nwa' bɛ nɛ biis banɛ ka Wina'am tisim la.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Ka biis la wʋsa sadigim mɔr niŋgbiŋ nɛ ziim la, on mɛ da mɔr niŋgbiŋ kan la mɛn, ye o kum la yɛla ka o na nyaŋi san'am Sʋntaana onɛ mɔr paŋi sʋ'oe kum la

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: ka tis banɛ ka kum zɔtim yɛla kɛ ka ba lieb yammisi ba bɛllim wʋsa ni la yɔlisim.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Ka li an sida ye o ba'a kae nɛ maliaknama, amaa Abraham yaas la ka o ba'a bɛ nɛ ba.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Dinzugʋ kɛ ka o maal o mɛŋ nwɛnɛ o ba'abiis nɛ si'el mɛkama wʋsa ni, ye o lieb maanmaan kpɛɛm onɛ an nimbaanlzɔt ka an yɛlsida sɔb Wina'am tʋʋma ni, ka maan suguru sɔsʋg maan nidib tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Sʋntaana daa mak o ka o namis pamm la zug, li kɛnɛ ka o na nyaŋi sʋŋ banɛ wʋsa ka Sʋntaana makidi ba.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, m ba'abiis banɛ ka Wina'am buol ye ya pɛ'ɛs arezana sʋ'ʋlimin la, zaŋiminɛ ya pʋtɛn'ɛr wʋsa niŋ Yesu onɛ an Wina'am tʋmtʋm nɛ maanmaan kpɛɛm ka ti pɛligi ti pʋʋgʋ tu'asidi o yɛla tisid nidib la ni.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: O anɛ yɛlsida sɔbi tis onɛ gaŋ o la wʋʋ Moses n da an yɛlsida sɔb si'em Wina'am yidimin la.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Dau kanɛ mɛɛd yiri di'ed na'asi gat yir la mɛŋ si'em la, ala mɛn ka Yesu nar na'asi bɛdegʋ gat Moses.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Yir mɛkama, ti mi' ye sɔ' mɛɛ li, ka Wina'am an onɛ mɛɛd si'el mɛkama wʋsa.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Moses da anɛ tʋmtʋm ka an sida sɔb Wina'am yidimin la wʋsa, ka da yɛt nidib la bʋnkanɛ ka Wina'am ye o ti nie bɛog sa.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Amaa Kristo mɛ da anɛ biribiŋ onɛ an sida sɔb ka gur Wina'am yidim, dinzugɔ ti ya'a mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ nɛ ti'ir ye ti anɛ o yidim, ti na nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgʋ li yɛla. Wina'am nidib vʋ'ʋsʋm la yɛla

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Alazugɔ, nwɛnɛ Siig Kasi la yɛt si'em la ye, “Zina, ya ya'a wʋm Wina'am kʋkɔr,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: yanam da digilimi ya sʋnya wʋʋ ya yaanamɛ da ki'is o si'em mɔɔgin ka zan'as Wina'am nɔɔr la.

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Ani ka ya yaanam da mak mam, ye ba kpansi mɛ gɔs, la'an nɛ ban da nyɛ man da tʋm si'em yʋma pisnaasi la.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Dinzug ka m sʋnf da pɛlig nɛ zʋmaʋŋ kan dim la. Ka m yɛl ye, ‘Saŋa wʋsa ba ya'am pʋ dɔl mam bɔɔd si'ela, ba mɛ pʋ baŋ man suoya la an si'em.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Ala ka m sʋnf pɛlig nɛ ba ka m pɔ nɔɔri zi'el ye, ‘Ba kʋdim kʋ kpɛn' m vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'igin laa.’”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, gu'usimi ka ya sɔ' da mɔr sʋnf bɛ'ɛd linɛ pʋ niŋid Wina'am yadda, ka o fɛndig ka bas Wina'am onɛ vʋe la suorɛ.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Amaa kpɛmisimi taaba daar wʋsa linɛ buon ye Zina la, ka baa nid yinne ya san'an da digilim o sʋʋnr nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dama'am pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Ti di'ednɛ ti pʋʋr nɛ Kristo, ti ya'a mɔri ti pin'ilʋg yadda la kiŋ-kiŋ ti paae dunia nwa' bɛn.

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnamɛ da wʋm ka zan'as la? Li ka'anɛ banɛ ka Moses da gaadi ba tuonnɛ dɔlli yi Egipt la na?

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Ka anɔ'ɔnam ka o da pɔ nɔɔr ye ba kʋdim kʋ kpɛn' o vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'igin la? Li da ka'anɛ banɛ da zan'as o nɔɔr laa?

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Ala ka ti baŋ ye ba da pʋ nyaŋɛ kpɛn', ban pʋ niŋ Wina'am yadda la zug.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, Wina'am kaanbʋg linɛ ka o tis ye ti kpɛn' o vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'igin la nan zi'e la, kɛlli ka ti gu'usi ka ya sɔ' da gʋ'ʋŋ kpɛn'ɛbɔ.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Labasʋŋ la paae ti san'an na nwɛnɛ lin paae ba san'an si'em la, amaa labakanɛ ka ba wʋm la pʋ mɔr nyɔɔdi ba nii, bɔzugɔ ban wʋmi li la, ba pʋ di'e li nɛ yadda.
