english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Ka tinam banɛ niŋ o yadda la kpɛn'ɛd o vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'igin wʋʋ on yɛl si'em la ye, “M sʋnf pɛlig nɛ ba ka m pɔ nɔɔri zi'el ye, ‘Ba kʋdim kʋ kpɛn' m vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'iginɛ.’” O yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa, la'an nɛ on da naae o tʋʋma linɛ an dunia maalʋg la.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Ka o gbauŋ la yɛl zin'isi'a dabiskanɛ an daba ayɔpɔi daar la yɛla ye, “Wina'am da maal dunia la naae la, o da vʋ'ʋs daba ayɔpɔi la daar.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Ka lɛn yɛt kpɛla ya'as ye, “Ba kʋdim kʋ kpɛn' m vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'iginɛ.”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Li nan kpɛn zi'enɛ ye sieba na kpɛn' li ni, ka banɛ da dɛŋi wʋm labasʋŋ la gʋ'ʋŋ kpɛn'ɛb ba zan'asʋg la zug.

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Alazug ka Wina'am lɛn gaŋ dabis-si'a ya'as ka li buon ye Zina. Ka Na'ab David da pian' li yɛla yʋma bɛdegʋ linɛ gaad la nwɛnɛ lin daa dɛŋi yɛl si'em la ye, “Zina, ya ya'a wʋm Wina'am kʋkɔr, yanam da digilimi ya sʋnya.”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Josua ya'a da tisini ba vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'ig, Wina'am da kʋ lɛm pian' dabis-si'a yɛla ya'asɛ.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Ka lin an si'em la, vʋ'ʋsʋm dabis-si'a kpɛm bɛ Wina'am nidib la yɛla.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ onɛ kpɛn'ɛd Wina'am vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'igin la mɛ na vʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ tʋʋma ni nwɛnɛ Wina'am da vʋ'ʋs o tʋʋma ni si'em la.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ ti kpɛ'ɛŋimi ti mɛŋ ka kpɛn' vʋ'ʋsʋm zin'igin la, ka sɔ' da tu'as banɛ da ki'is o nɔɔr ka gʋ'ʋŋ kpɛn'ɛb la.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Wina'am pian'ad la vʋenɛ ka tʋm. Li pʋlimnɛ ka diti gat zaba sʋ'ʋg kanɛ dit nɔya ayi', ka kunsidi paad siig nɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm bɛn, wʋʋ sʋ'ʋgʋ kɛnsid niŋgbina sʋn'ʋla nɛ kɔnba pʋʋgin biim si'em la. Ka nied ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛr nɛ o bɔɔdim nyain pa'an.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Si'el kae na nyaŋi su'a Wina'am san'anɛ. Li wʋsa dignɛ paalʋ onɛ tuon ka ti wʋsa na zi'enɛ tu'asi ti tʋʋma la. Yesu an maanmaan kpɛɛm la

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, tinamɛ pʋn mɔr maanmaan kpɛɛm tita'ar onɛ an Wina'am biig Yesu ka o dɛŋi gaad arezana ni la, kɛlli ka ti mɔri ti yadda la kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Ti mɔr maanmaan kpɛɛm onɛ zɔti ti nyɔɔg tinamɛ pʋ kpi'em la yɛla; o da nyɛ makir nɛ li buudi wʋsa nwɛnɛ tinamɛ nyɛt si'em la, la'an nɛ wala o pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ kɛlli ka ti li'el o yɛlsʋm na'am gbauŋ la nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ ka di'e o nimbaanlzɔɔr nɛ o yɛlsʋm la, ka li sʋŋi ti, ti yɛlpakir saŋa.

english_verse: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.
translation_verse: Ba gaŋid maanmaan kpɛɛm wʋsa nɛ nidib sʋʋgin ka nɔk o ka o zi'enɛ ba nɔba zug, ban nɛ Wina'am sʋʋgin, tis piini ka maal maana tis Wina'am ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: On pʋ kpi'ema ka na tun'e lu tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin la zug, o na tun'e zɔ nimbaanlig nɛ banɛ bɛ zi'ilimin ka yidigid la.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Alazug, li anɛ tilas ye o maal maana tis Wina'am o mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug la'an nɛ nidib la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' pʋ dʋ'ʋsid o mɛŋ ye o anɛ maanmaan kpɛɛm, asɛɛ Wina'am gaŋ o wʋʋ on da gaŋ Aaron si'em la.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Ala mɛn, Kristo da pʋ dʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ ye o lieb maanmaan kpɛɛm, amaa Wina'am da gaŋ o, ka yɛl o gbauŋʋn ye, “Fʋ anɛ man Biig; zina ka m liebi fʋ Saam.”

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ka lɛn yɛl zin'isi'a ye, “Fʋ anɛ maanmaan onɛ tʋʋma ka' naarɛ nwɛnɛ Melkizedek la.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Yesu da bɛ dunia nwa' ni saŋa si'a la, o da sɔs ka bɛlim Wina'am nɛ kaasig tita'ari tis onɛ mɔr paŋi na tun'e faaɛn o kumin la. Ka on na'as Wina'am la zug ka o wʋm o sɔsʋg la.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ on aan o Biig la, o zamis nɔɔr siakir o namisʋgʋn.

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: Ka on lieb sʋ'ʋm naae la zug ka faangir linɛ ka' naar la yit o san'an na tisid banɛ wʋsa siakid o nɔɔr la,

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: ka Wina'am nɔk o pa'al ye o anɛ maanmaan kpɛɛm onɛ lɛdig Melkizedek zin'igin. Banɛ basid Wina'am dɔllim sa'alʋg la yɛla

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Ti mɔr pian'ad bɛdegʋ yɛlkaŋa yɛla, amaa li tɔi nɛ mam na pa'ali ya si'em ka ya baŋ nyain, bɔzugɔ ba ya'a zamisidi ya, ya pʋ gban'ad si'el gbin tɔ'ɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Saŋa paae ya ka li nar ye ya an pa'annib, amaa ya nan kpɛm bɔɔd ye ba lɛm pa'annɛ ya Wina'am yɛla linɛ an yiiga pa'ala la, nwɛnɛ biisi bɔɔd bin'isim ka ka' digan'alʋg si'em la.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ mɛkama mu'ad bin'isim anɛ biig ka nan ka' ya'am na baŋ yɛlsida yɛlaa.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ bi' la dit digan'ala, bɔzugɔ ba zamisnɛ mi' linɛ an sʋm nɛ bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, kɛlli ka ti basi Kristo pa'ala banɛ ka ti da zamis pin'ilʋgʋn la, ka nɔbigi ka basi tinamɛ da lieb karimbiis ka ba pa'ali ti si'el ka ti niŋ Wina'am yadda la, ka keŋ tuonnɛ nɔbig ka da kpɛn nwɛnɛ ti pin'ilnɛ bɔɔd ye ti paam tiakiri ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ ti yadda niŋir Wina'am san'anɛ.

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: Ka bas Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb pa'alʋg nɛ anɔk nu'usi pa'al nidib zutin yɛla nɛ kum vʋ'ʋgir yɛla nɛ sariakadib linɛ ka' bɛn la yɛla.

english_verse: Let's grow up, if God is willing.
translation_verse: Wina'am ya'a siak, ti na niŋ ala.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Teŋ kanɛ di'ed saku'om bɛdegʋ la, du'ad zʋʋdi tisid kpaadib ka ba di'ed Wina'am yɛlsʋm.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Amaa teŋ kanɛ yit gɔn'ɔs nɛ natis la ka' nyɔɔdɛ, li pʋ lal nɛ nɔpɔɔrɛ, ka li ba'asʋg anɛ bugum na dii li.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: M zuanɔŋa, la'an nɛ tinamɛ pian'ad anwa la, ti mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋʋ ya yɛla, ka mi' ye ya mɔr yɛlsʋm linɛ dɔlnɛ faangir la.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Wina'am anɛ onɛ niŋid linɛ nar, o kʋ tami ya tʋʋm nɛ nɔŋilim kanɛ ka ya pa'al o zaŋi keŋ yanamɛ sʋŋ o nidib si'em hali ka nam kpɛn niŋid ala la.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Ti bɔɔd ye ya yinne-yinne tʋm ala mɛn nɛ nimmua ti paae li bɛn ka li kɛ ka ya mɔr ti'ir ka bi'esʋg kae.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: Ti pʋ bɔɔd ye ya mɔr gbanya'am, amaa tʋmmi nwɛnɛ ya taaba banɛ niŋ Wina'am yadda, ka mɔdig ka di'e Wina'am nɔzi'elkanɛ ka o digil la. Wina'am kaanbʋg la yɛla

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Wina'am da kaanbi tis Abraham, ka sɔ' kae gat on Wina'am la zug, ka o pɔ nɛ o mɛŋ,

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Ka Abraham da mɔdig ka di'e Wina'am kaanbʋg la.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Ka ninsaal ya'a ye o pɔ nɔɔr, o pɔɔdnɛ onɛ gat o, ka li pa'al ye on yɛl si'el la anɛ amɛŋa ka li gu'oe nɔŋgbannwa'ar wʋsa.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Wina'am da bɔɔd ye o nie li nyain pa'al banɛ na ti di'e faar kanɛ ka o kaanbi zi'el ka li kʋdim kʋ tiak la zug, ka o pɔɔ pɛ'ɛs o kaanbʋgʋn la.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Ka yɛlbama ayi' nwa' pʋ tun'e tiakida, ka ban yɛla ka Wina'am kʋ ma' baa bi'ela. Dinzug ka tinam banɛ zɔɔ keŋ o san'an ye o faaɛn ti la na mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ nɛ ti'ir linɛ digi ti tuon la.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ti mɔr ti'ir kaŋa nwa' ka li tisi ti vʋm ka dabiem kae, nwɛnɛ anrʋŋ kʋnti ba' ku'omin kiŋ-kiŋ si'em la. Ti'ir kan la mɔri ti nɛ kpɛn'ɛd pʋ'ʋsʋg dɔɔg la pʋʋgin ti paae Kasi Zin'ig linɛ ka pien la bɛŋ la

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu onɛ lieb maanmaan kpɛɛm saŋa kanɛ ka' bɛn la lɛdig Melkizedek zin'igin. Ka ti ti'ir bɛɛ o ni, ka o zi'e ti nɔba zugʋ gaadi ti tuonnɛ kpɛn'ɛd Wina'am zin'igin la.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Melkizedek da anɛ Salem Na'ab nɛ Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el Wʋsa la maanmaan. Abraham n da keŋ tanp ka nyaŋ na'anam anaasi ka kunna la, Melkizedek da tʋ'ʋs o ka niŋ o zug albareka.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Ka Abraham da yis la'abanɛ ka ba fan' la yinne piiga wʋsa pʋʋgin tis o. Melkizedek yʋ'ʋr la gbin anɛ ye, “Pʋpielim Na'ab,” ka lɛn an Salem Na'ab, ka li gbin anɛ “Sumbʋgʋsʋm Na'ab.”

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Si'el kae pa'al ye o mɔr ba' nɛ ma nɛ yaanama. Si'el kae mɛ pa'al o du'am nɛ o kum saŋaa, ka o kpɛn an maanmaan saŋa wʋsa nwɛnɛ Wina'am Biig la nɛ.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi Melkizedek n da mɔr kpi'euŋ si'em; hali ti yaayalinyak Abraham da tis o pʋdigir yinne piiga wʋsa pʋʋgin linɛ an la'ad linɛ ka ba da faaɛn zaba ni la.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am tis nɔsi'a ye banɛ an Levi yaas ka mɛ an Abraham yaas ka an Wina'am maanmaannib la, di'es si'el wʋsa nidibin la pʋdigir yinne piiga wʋsa pʋʋgin. Ba di'esidi ba buudi la ni hali la'an nɛ ban an Abraham yaas la.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Melkizedek da ka' Levi yaaŋa, amaa o di'e pʋdigir yinne piiga pʋʋgin Abraham san'an ka niŋ on onɛ di'e Wina'am kaanbʋg la zug bareka.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Li anɛ sida ye onɛ tisid albareka gat onɛ di'edi li la.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a gɔs maanmaannib banɛ di'esid pʋdigir yinne piiga wʋsa pʋʋgin la, ba anɛ ninsaalib ka na ba'asi kpi; amaa ya'a an Melkizedek on gaadi ba wʋsa bɔzugɔ o vʋenɛ nwɛnɛ Wina'am gbauŋʋ yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Sɔ' tun'e yɛl ye hali Levi mɛŋ onɛ di'esid pʋdigir yinne piiga wʋsa pʋʋgin la da yɔ yinne piiga wʋsa pʋʋgin ka li naanɛ o yaab Abraham nu'usin keŋ Melkizedek san'an,

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ Melkizedek n da tʋ'ʋs Abraham la, Levi da nan bɛnɛ o yaab Abraham niŋgbiŋin.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Levi buudi la maanmaannib tʋʋma ya'a da an linɛ kɛt ka nidib bɛ bɛllim sʋŋɔ, wala ka li da lɛn kpa tilas ye maanmaan onɛ nwɛnɛ Melkizedek ka ka' onɛ nwɛnɛ Aaron kena?

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaan ya'a tiak, asɛɛ ka wada la mɛ tiak.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ ka ba pian'ad o yɛla la buudi bɛɛ li kɔn', ka buud kan la nid nan zi' tʋm maanmaan tʋʋma.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Li anɛ sida ye Zugsɔb la anɛ Juda dɔɔg nid, amaa Moses da pʋ pʋdig dɔkaŋa yɛla on da pian'ad maanmaannib yɛla la. Maanmaan onɛ nwɛnɛ Melkizedek la yɛla

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Ka tinamɛ yɛl si'el la maligin nie nyain, maanmaan sɔ' kena nwɛnɛ Melkizedek nɛ.

english_verse: That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end.
translation_verse: Li ka'anɛ wada linɛ dɔl ninsaal du'am yɛlaa, amaa li anɛ nyɔvʋr linɛ ka' naar la paŋ yɛla ka o lieb maanmaan.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am gbauŋ yɛl ye, “Fʋ anɛ maanmaan onɛ tʋʋma ka' naarɛ, nwɛnɛ Melkizedek nɛ.”

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Nɔzi'elkʋdʋg la n pʋ kpi'ema ka ka' gbin la zug, ka Wina'am uugi li labil.

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: Moses nɔzi'elʋg la da pʋ nyaŋi kɛ ka si'el wʋsa an sʋ'ʋŋa. Amaa ti'ir linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa bɛɛ tisi ti ka kɛ ka ti li'el Wina'am san'an na.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am maal Yesu ka o an maanmaan ka pɔ ye, “Zugsɔb la tis nɔɔr ka kʋ tiak o pʋtɛn'ɛrɛ, o yɛl ye, ‘Fʋ anɛ maanmaan onɛ tʋʋma ka' naarɛ.’”

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: Zi'el kaŋa zugʋ kɛ ka Yesu zi'en ka li pa'al ye nɔnakaŋa an sʋm gaad nɔnaar kʋdʋg la.

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Linɛ lɛm bɛɛ li kɔn' anɛ ye, nɔnakʋdʋgin la maanmaannib bɛdegʋ da bɛ amaa ka kum kɛ ka ba pʋ kpɛm bɛɛ ba tʋʋma la nii.

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Amaa Yesu pʋ kpiid la zugʋ kɛ ka o an maanmaan saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ banɛ wʋsa kɛn Wina'am san'an na ka li yinɛ Yesu ma'asim zug la, o nyaŋi faandi ba wʋsa. Bɔzugɔ, o vʋe ka bɛ Wina'am tuonnɛ nwɛ'ɛd Wina'am nu'ugʋ ba zug.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Li nar ka ti mɔr maanmaan kpɛɛm wʋʋ oŋa nwa' an nyain ka bɛɛ o kɔn' ka gba'ar nɛ dian'ad kae la. O fuoe o mɛŋi yis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim zin'igin, ka Wina'am dʋ'ʋs o gaad saŋgbauŋ.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: O pʋ nwɛnɛ maanmaan kpɛɛm bama la, banɛ ka li nar ye ba maal maana daar wʋsa ba mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla yiiga, ka nyaan maal nidib la yɛla la. On lɛɛ nɔknɛ o mɛŋi maal maannɛ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla vuguri.

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Wada la gaŋ maanmaannib kpɛɛmnam banɛ an dap ka mɔr gbɛlʋŋ la; amaa Wina'am zi'el nɔɔr linɛ yuolim kɛn wada la nya'aŋ na ka gaŋ Biig onɛ an sʋm ka ka' gbɛlʋŋ la saŋa kanɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ pian'ad si'el yɛla la anɛ nwa'. Ti mɔr maanmaan kpɛɛm onɛ zin' girima sɔb na'am gbauŋ datiuŋ arezana ni.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: Onɛ tʋm Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma linɛ an Fuug Sʋgʋr amɛŋa ka Zugsɔb la mɛŋ maal, ka ka' ninsaala.

english_verse: Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer.
translation_verse: Ba gaŋid maanmaan kpɛɛm wʋsa ye o tis piini ka maal maana tis Wina'am. Alazug li mɛ nar ye ti Maanmaan Kpɛɛm kaŋa nwa' mɛ mɔr si'eli na tis Wina'am.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ka o ya'a bɛɛn dunia nwa' ni, o kʋ aan maanmaan baa bi'elaa, bɔzugɔ maanmaannib banɛ tisid piini linɛ dɔl wada suor la pʋm bɛ.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Ba tʋʋma zin'ig nwaasnɛ wʋʋ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir linɛ bɛ arezana ni la. Alazug ka Moses n da ye o ti' Fuug Sʋgʋr linɛ na an Wina'am zin'ig la, Wina'am da pa'al o ye, “Gu'usim ka maali li ka li nwɛnɛ mam pa'alif si'em zuor zug la dede.”

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Amaa nɔnaar kanɛ ka Kristo an nu'unwɛ'ɛd la, an sʋm gat nɔnaar kʋdʋg la, bɔzugɔ li mɔr nɔzi'ela nɛ kaanb sʋma.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Ka yiiga nɔnaar la ya'a da pʋ mɔrin gbadaa, li pʋ narin ye ti mɔr nɔnaar si'a ya'asɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Amaa Wina'am n da nyɛ ka nidib la mɔr gbada la zug, ka o yɛl o gbauŋʋn ye, “‘Dabisa kenna ka m na maal nɔnapaal nɛ Israel dim nɛ Juda dim la.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Li kʋ nwɛnɛ nɔnaar kanɛ ka m da maal nɛ ya yaanam saŋa kanɛ ka m da gban'e ba nu'ug ka mɔri ba yi Egipt teŋin la, bɔzugɔ, ba da san'amim nɔnaar la dinzug ka m da basi ba.’ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: ‘Nɛ'ɛŋa an nɔnaar kanɛ ka m na maal nɛ Israel dim dabisban la nya'aŋ’, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la, M na nɔki m wada la niŋi ba pʋtɛn'ɛrin ka sɔbi li ba sʋnya ni. M na aan ba Wina'am, ka ban mɛ na aan m nidib.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Sɔ' kʋ lɛm pa'al o tiraan bɛɛ o ba'abiig ye, ‘Baŋim Zugsɔb la,’ bɔzugɔ ba wʋsa na baŋ mam, lin yii ba biisin paae ba kpɛɛmnamin.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: M na kɛɛ ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd taal wʋsa bas ka kʋ lɛn tiɛn li yɛla ya'as baa bi'ela.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am n buon nɔnakaŋa ye, “bʋmpaal” la zugʋ kɛ ka yiiga bʋn la an bʋnkʋdir. Ka linɛ lieb bʋnkʋdir ka lɛn ka' tʋʋm la na mɛlim.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Nɔnaar kanɛ da maal yiiga la da mɔr maana suoya nɛ Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim zin'ig linɛ bɛ dunia ni.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Ba da maalnɛ Fuug Sʋgʋr ka bɛŋi li, ka fita zi'esir bɛɛ li ni, nɛ teebul nɛ bodobodo linɛ an piini tisid Wina'am la. Zin'ikan la ka ba buon ye Kasi Zin'ig la.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Li da mɔr maan daka linɛ ka ba nɔk sanlima maal, ka nyu'od tudaari li zug. Ka Nɔnaar Daka linɛ ka ba bʋlig nɛ sanlima la mɛ bɛ, ka sanlima yubig bɛɛ li pʋʋgin, ka manna linɛ da an diib ka Wina'am da tisi ba mɔɔgin la mɛ bɛ yubig la pʋʋgin, ka Aaron dansaar linɛ da bus vaand la nɛ kuglamma banɛ ka Wina'am nɔnaar sɔbi li zug la mɛ bɛ.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Ka Kerubnam banɛ ka ba nɔk sanlima kud ka ba an bʋnkɔnbid linɛ pa'an Wina'am paŋ la bɛ daka la zug, ka ba kpʋkpama ma'asim pil suguru sɔsʋg liŋ la. Amaa nannanna ti kʋ nyaŋi pian' bama yɛla naae nyainnɛ.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Ka ban maali maal si'el wʋsa naae wʋʋ lin nar si'em la, maanmaannib la kpɛn'ɛd zin'ikanɛ bɛŋ la ni saŋa mɛkama maannɛ ba maana.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Amaa maanmaan kpɛɛm la ma'aa kpɛn'ɛd dɔkanɛ bɛ pʋʋgin sa la ni yʋʋm wʋsa pʋʋgin nɔɔr yinne. O pʋ kpɛn'ɛd nɛɛm, amaa o mɔri maan ziim kpɛn'ɛdi tisid Wina'am o mɛŋ yɛla nɛ nidib la tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛsi'a ka zi' la yɛla.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la pa'al ye yiiga Fuug Sʋgʋr la nan kpɛn zi'e la, suor kae na kpɛn' Wina'am Kasi Wʋsa Kasi Zin'ig la nii; bɛŋir la nan bɛ la zug.

english_verse: This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa nwa' mamis nɛ pa'al saŋa kaŋa yɛla. Nɔnaar kʋdig saŋa la, ba da tisid piini ka kʋʋd kɔnbidi maan maana ka li kʋ nyaŋi kɛ ka banɛ pʋ'ʋsid la pʋtɛn'ɛr nie nyainnɛ.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: Li yɛla anɛ diib nɛ nuub nɛ Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb nɛ niŋgbiŋ wada ma'aa linɛ zi'e ti paae saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am yʋ'ʋn na maali li sʋ'ʋŋa la.

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Ka Kristo da kena wʋʋ maanmaan kpɛɛm zaŋi ken bʋnsʋma banɛ pʋn bɛ la, o da kpɛn' pʋ'ʋsim dɔtita'ar linɛ an sʋm gaad Fuug Sʋgʋr linɛ ka saalib maal la. Li bɔɔdi pa'al ye li pʋ paas bʋn banɛ ka ba maal dunia nwa' zug la.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: O da pʋ kpɛn' Kasi Wʋsa Kasi Zin'igin la nɛ bʋʋs ziim bɛɛ niigi ziim maal maana tis Wina'am. Amaa o lɛɛ zaŋ o mɛŋ ziim bɔ faangir suor linɛ ka' naari tisi ti.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Bʋʋs nɛ Niigi ziim nɛ na'asa'abil kanɛ ka ba nyu'oe la tampɛligim ya'a yugus banɛ ka malima pʋʋgin kɛ ka ba ka' nyain la niŋgbina, ka di nyaŋi pie ba niŋgbina ka ba an nyainnɛ,

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: Kristo ziim yʋ'ʋn na niŋ wala? Li na tʋm gaad ala bɛdegʋ, ka na pie ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ ta'asid kum na la, ka kɛ ka ti pʋtɛn'ɛr an nyain ka ti tʋm Wina'am onɛ vʋe la tʋʋma. Li anɛ Kristo onɛ nɔk o mɛŋi tis Wina'am ka gba'ar kae, ka li yinɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi kanɛ bɛ saŋa linɛ ka' naar la ni na.

english_verse: Christ died to rescue those who had sinned and broken the old agreement. Now he brings his chosen ones a new agreement with its guarantee of God's eternal blessings!
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa zug, Kristo anɛ nu'unwɛ'ɛd nɔnaar paallin la, ye banɛ ka Wina'am buoli ba la na di'e kaanb sʋŋ kanɛ ka' naarɛ; bɔzugɔ nannanna Kristo kum tisi ba yɔlisim ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd banɛ ka ba da tʋm nɔnakʋdʋgin la.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a yɛli zi'el onɛ na ti dii o faar, asɛɛ ka ba ti pa'al ye onɛ zi'el nɔɔr la sid kpiya.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ zi'el nɔɔr la ya'a kpɛn vʋe, pian'ʋk la pʋ kpi'ema, asɛɛ ka o ti kpi ka li yɛla duoe.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Ala mɛnɛ kɛ ka yiiga nɔnaar la da pʋ tʋm tʋʋma, ka li ya'a ka' ziim ti yii.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Moses n da mɔɔl Wina'am nɔɔr yɛlʋg la wʋsa nidib la wʋsa ni la, o da nɔk na'abibis ziim nɛ bʋʋs ziim nɛ ku'om ka nɔk pɛ'og kɔnbid nɛ nyulinnyu'us la zu'as nɔnaar gbauŋ la nɛ nidib la wʋsa,

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: ka yɛl ye, “Zikaŋa ka Zugsɔb nɔk ye o maal nɔnaar nɛ ya ka tis nɔɔr ye ya siaki li la.”

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka Moses da zu'as ziim la Fuug Sʋgʋr la zug nɛ Wina'am malʋŋ la'ad la wʋsa zug.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Ya'a an sida, Wina'am wada la gban'anɛ viki ye asɛɛ ba pie si'el wʋsa nɛ ziim ka li lieb nyain. Ka ziim ya'a pʋ yii, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd mɛ kʋ yii. Kristo malʋŋ linɛ yis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Alazug ka li da nar ye ba maal malima ka bʋmbanɛ nwɛnɛ arezana bʋnam la lieb nyain, amaa li anɛ tilas ye bʋmbanɛ bɛ arezana la maana an sʋm gat ala.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Amaa Kristo da pʋ kpɛn' Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir linɛ ka saal nu'us maali li ka li tu'as bʋn linɛ aan amɛŋa laa, ka lɛɛ kpɛn' arezana mɛŋirin ka nie Wina'am tuonnɛ zi'e ti nɔba zug.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: O mɛ pʋ nɔk o mɛŋi maal maannɛ tis Wina'am daar wʋsa wʋʋ maanmaan kpɛɛm kpɛn'ɛd Kasi Wʋsa Kasi Zin'igin yʋʋm-yʋʋm nɛ ziim linɛ ka' o mɛŋ ziim laa.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Li ya'a aan ala, o naanɛ namisidin daar wʋsa dunia pin'ilʋgʋn sa. Ka lin an si'em la, o nie vuguri yʋma naar bɛn ye o kad tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ on nɔk o mɛŋi maal maan la.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Li anɛ tilas ye saal wʋsa kpi vuguri ka li nya'aŋ ka sariakadib bɛ la.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka Kristo nɔk o mɛŋi maal maan vuguri ye o di'e nidib bɛdegʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas. Ka o ya'a ti lɛb na, o pʋ ye o lɛn nɔknɛ nidib taali basɛ, amaa o ye o mɔri faangir na tis banɛ gur o la.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Wada kanɛ ka Wina'am da tis Jew dim la nwaasnɛ bʋnsʋma linɛ aan amɛŋa ka nan kenna la, ka lɛɛ ka' yinne nɛ linɛ aan amɛŋa la. Bɔzugɔ ba da maan maana yʋʋm-yʋʋm ka li pʋ kɛ ka banɛ li'el Wina'am la lieb sʋ'ʋm nyainnɛ.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ka maan bama ya'a da kɛt ka banɛ pʋ'ʋsid la liebid nyain, ba kʋ lɛm mi'in tʋʋmbɛ'ɛsi'a ba pʋtɛnda nii. Alazug, ba naan basin maana maalʋg

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Dinzug, Kristo da kɛn dunia ni na la, o da yɛl Wina'am ye, “Fʋ pʋ bɔɔd bʋnkɔnbid nɛ zʋʋd malimaa, amaa ninsaal niŋgbiŋ linɛ ka fʋ maali tisim la.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Nyu'or maana nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maana da pʋ ma'ae fʋ sʋnfɔ.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Ani ka m yɛl ye, ‘Manɛ nwa', m kenna; li pʋn sɔbi m yɛla Gbauŋʋn la. O Wina'am, m bɔɔd ye m tʋmi fʋ bɔɔdim.’”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Kristo da pʋn dɛŋi yɛl ye, “Fʋ pʋ bɔɔd bʋnkɔnbid piini linɛ nyu'od nɛ maana nɛ piini wʋsa, bɔzugɔ, li pʋ malisi fʋ sʋʋnrɛ.” O yɛl nɛ'ɛŋa la'an nɛ ban daa dɔl wada suori maannɛ li la.

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋn yɛl ye, “Gɔsima, m kena ye m maali fʋ bɔɔdim.” Wina'am kpiis yiiga malima la, ka zi'el linɛ tia'al la.

english_verse: So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu niŋ Wina'am bɔɔdim ka nɔk o mɛŋ niŋgbiŋi maal maannɛ tisi ti vuguri, ka ti lieb Wina'am nidib ka an nyain.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Ka maanmaannib wʋsa zi'e ba tʋʋma ni daar wʋsa maan maana pɛndigid ka li kʋ nyaŋi yis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Amaa Kristo da nɔk o mɛŋi maal maan vuguri nidib tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla la, ka yʋ'ʋn zin'in Wina'am datiuŋʋ

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: ti paae saŋkanɛ ka o dataas na lieb o nɔba kʋk.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Ka maan vugur la kɛ ka banɛ ka o kɛ ka ba lieb Wina'am nidib la an kasi saŋa wʋsa.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi mɛ dii o kasɛti tisi ti ka ye,

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “‘Nɛ'ɛŋa an nɔnaar kanɛ ka m na maal nɛ ba dabisbanɛ kenna la,’ Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em la. M na nɔki m wada la niŋi ba sʋnya ni ka sɔbi li ba pʋtɛn'ɛrin.”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Ka lɛm paas ye, “Ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ ba wada ki'isʋg la M kʋ lɛn tiɛn li yɛla ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am sadigim yisi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas la, li pʋ lɛn nar ye ba maal maan tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛlaa. Tinamɛ na li'el Wina'am si'em la yɛla

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m ba'abiisɛ, ti yʋ'ʋn mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ ye ti na tun'e kpɛn' Kasi Wʋsa Kasi Zin'igin la Yesu ziim la zug.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: O maal nyɔvʋr suopaalig amɛŋa ka li gat fukanɛ daa giŋ Wina'am dɔɔgin la; ka linɛ aan o niŋgbiŋ la.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Tinam mɔr maanmaan tita'ar onɛ gur Wina'am yidim.

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, kɛlli ka ti li'el Wina'am nɛ ti sʋnf wʋsa nɛ yadda linɛ ka' bi'esʋgɔ, nɛ sʋnya linɛ ka ba pie ka li an nyain ka taal kae ka pie ti niŋgbina nɛ ku'osʋŋ.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Ka gban'e ti'ir kanɛ ka ti mɔr ka mɔɔnnɛ di yɛla paalʋ la kiŋ-kiŋ; bɔzugɔ Wina'am onɛ zi'el nɔɔr la anɛ sida sɔb.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ti tɛn'ɛsi tinamɛ na niŋ si'em ka kpɛmis taaba nɛ nɔŋilim nɛ tʋʋm sʋma.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Ka da bas taaba la'asʋg wʋʋ sieba niŋid si'em laa, amaa ya kpɛmisim taaba, sʋ'ʋŋa yanamɛ nyɛ ka Zugsɔb ken dabisir la li'el la.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a di'e Wina'am sida la ka kpɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ pɔn'ɔsim, maana lɛn kae na yis tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ ka ti mɔr dabiem pʋtɛn'ɛr nɛ sariakadib nɛ bugum linɛ ye li di Wina'am dataas la.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a da san'am Moses wada la, ka kasɛtib ayi' bɛɛ atan' bɛ, ba kʋ zɔɔ o nimbaanliga, asɛɛ o daana kpi.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: Onɛ nɛ'ɛs Wina'am Biig la, ka nɔk nɔnaar ziim linɛ kɛt ka o an Wina'am nid la niŋid yɔri-yɔri ka tʋ'ʋd Siig Kasi onɛ pa'an Wina'am yɛlsʋm la, li namisʋg na an wala? Asida, on din na gaad ala.

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Ti mi' Wina'am yɛl si'em ye, “Sam yɔɔb anɛ m din ka mam na yɔɔ li.” Ka lɛn yɛl ya'as ye, “Zugsɔb la na kad o nidib saria.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Li mɔr dabiem nɛ nidi na kpɛn' Wina'am Onɛ Vʋe la nu'usin.

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Tiɛnmi saŋa kanɛ ka ya da di'e Wina'am yɛlsida nɛɛsim la. Ya mɔdig nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ ka nyɛ namisʋg bɛdegʋ ka nyaŋi zi'en kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Ka saŋa sieba ka ba tʋ'ʋdi ya ka namisidi ya nidibin. Ka saŋa sieba mɛn ka ya siaki zi'e nɛ ya taaba banɛ ka ba namisidi ba.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Ya zɔ banɛ bɛ sanrega ni la nimbaanlig, ka siak nɛ sumpielim ka ba faaɛn ya la'ad bɔzugɔ ya mi' ye ya mɛŋ mɔr la'asʋma linɛ gat nɛ'ɛŋa linɛ kʋ san'am.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, da basi ya sʋnkpi'euŋ linɛ mɔr nyɔɔd bɛdegʋ la,

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: ka li nar ye ya mɔr summɔdigir ye ya niŋ Wina'am bɔɔdim ka di'e o nɔzi'elʋg la.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Ka li sɔb ye, Wina'am yɛl ye, “Li kpɛlim bi'ela, ka onɛ kenna la kena ka kʋ yuugɛ.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Ka pʋpielim sɔb na vʋenɛ o yadda niŋir zug. Ka o sɔb ya'a nyɔbigidi lɛbid nya'aŋ, m sʋnf kʋ malis nɛ o sɔba.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Tinam ka' banɛ nyɔbigidi lɛbid nya'aŋ ka paamid san'auŋ la, amaa ti anɛ banɛ niŋ yadda ka paam faangir.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir anɛ dinɛ ka ti mɔr ti'ir viki ye ti na paam ka nam pʋ nyɛ nɛ ninii.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Wina'am da pian' kʋdimin dim yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka ti baŋ ye Wina'am da pian'anɛ ka dunia la maal. Alazug, o da zaŋnɛ linɛ ka ti pʋ nyɛt nɛ ti nini la maal linɛ ka ti nyɛt nɛ nini.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Abɛl da maal maannɛ tis Wina'am, ka li an sʋm gaad Kain maan la. O yadda niŋir zug ka Wina'am di'e o piini la ka pian' o yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa ye o anɛ pʋpielim sɔb. Ka o yadda niŋir zugɔ, hali baa on kpi la, ba kpɛm tiɛnd o tʋʋma yɛla.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Wina'am da nɔk Enok n dʋ agɔl ka o pʋ kpii, ka li nya'aŋ ba pʋ lɛn nyɛɛ o, on da nɔk o la zug. Ka on da nam pʋ nɔk o la, ka Wina'am yɛl ye o tʋʋma ma'ad o sʋʋnr.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Ka yadda niŋir ya'a kae, sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi ma'ae Wina'am sʋʋnrɛ. Alazug, onɛ bɔɔd ye o li'el Wina'am, asɛɛ o siak ye o bɛ, ka mɛ siak ye o na tis banɛ ieed o nɛ yɛlmɛŋir la ba yɔɔd.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Wina'am da dɛŋi sa'al Noa nɛ nimmua nɛ yɛlbanɛ ka sɔ' nan zi' nyɛ la, ka o siaki maal anrʋŋ tita'ari faaɛn o yidim la. Noa yadda niŋir tʋʋma pa'al ye dunia dim ka' sʋ'ʋm. Ka o di'e nɔzi'elʋg linɛ an pʋpielim ka yi o yadda niŋirin la.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Abraham yadda niŋir zug ka Wina'am da buol o ka o siak Wina'am nɔɔr, ka yii keŋ teŋ kanɛ ka o na ti di'e digil o yaas ka li aan ba faar la, la'an nɛ on da zi' on ken teŋ si'a la.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Ka yadda niŋir zug, ka Abraham da kpɛn' teŋ kanɛ ka Wina'am da kaanbi tis o la, hali ka bɛ fuug sʋgʋrin wʋʋ o anɛ saan nɛ. Isaak nɛ Jakob mɛ da di'e faar kan la.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Ti yaab Abraham daa guri teŋ kanɛ ka Wina'am mɛŋ-mɛŋ na ɛɛnb ka lɛn mɛɛ li la.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka hali baa Abraham da kʋdigi galis ka o pu'a Sara mɛ an kʋndu'ar la, o da nyaŋi du'a ka li anɛ on da niŋ yadda ye Wina'am kaanb si'el la li na niŋ ala la.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Dinzug ka dau onɛ da kʋdig ka pʋ lal nɛ kum la ni ka yaas bɛdegʋ yina galisi nwɛnɛ nwadbibis nɛ, ka lɛn nwɛnɛ mu'ar nɔɔrin tanbin'isi nɛ.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Nimbama wʋsa kpinɛ nɛ yadda ka nam pʋ di'e nɔzi'ela laa, amaa ka nyɛɛ li lalli, ka ba sʋnya malis, ka ba siak ye ba anɛ saam nɛ zɔɔma dunia ni.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Ka banɛ pian'ad anwa la, pa'al ye ba ieednɛ ba mɛŋ teŋ.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a da tɛn'ɛsid teŋ kanɛ ka ba yi la na, ba naan bɔɔdin suor ye ba lɛb ani.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Ka lin an si'em la, ba bɔɔdnɛ arezana linɛ an teŋ sʋŋ hali la. Dinzugɔ, Wina'am pʋ zɔt nyan nɛ ban na buol o ye ba Wina'am. Bɔzugɔ, o ti'eb teŋi tisi ba.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: Wina'am da yɛl o ye, “Li anɛ Isaak tuŋʋn ka fʋ na paam yaas banɛ ka m kaanbi zi'el la.”

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Abraham da mi' ye Wina'am tun'e vʋ'ʋg Isaak kumin, alazug li sid nwɛnɛ Abraham da di'e Isaak nɛ kumin.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Isaak tis Jakob nɛ Esau wʋsa albareka.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Jakob da bɔɔd kum ka tis Josef biis ayi' albareka, ka zaŋ o mɛŋi dɛllim o dansaar ka wɔ'ɔg Wina'am.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Josef n da bɔɔd kum la, ka yɛl Israel dim ye ba na ti yi Egipt teŋin, ka zi'el nɔɔr ye ba ya'a ti yiti lɛbidi ba mɛŋ teŋin la, ban nɔkim o niŋgbiŋ la mum anina.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Moses ba' nɛ o ma da su'a o nwadis atan' ka pʋ zɔ dabiem nɛ na'ab la tis wada si'a la, bɔzugɔ ba da nyɛ ka o an bivɛnliŋ hali.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Moses da nɔbig, ka zan'as ye ba da buol o Na'ab Faaro pu'ayua biiga.

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: O gaŋ ye o la'am namis nɛ Wina'am nidib la gat on na nyɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd malisim linɛ pʋ ya'asid naarɛ.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: Ka siak ye ba ya'a tʋ' o Kristo yɛla, li an sʋm gat kpan'am linɛ bɛ Egipt teŋgbauŋʋn wʋsa, bɔzugɔ o mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye o mɔr yɔɔd ka li bɛ tuon.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka o bas Egipt ka pʋ zɔ dabiem nɛ Na'ab la sʋnpɛɛnnɛ ka mɔdig, bɔzugɔ o nyɛ Wina'am onɛ ka ninsaalib pʋ nyɛt nɛ ba nini la.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka o kɛ ka ba maan Kum Maliak Gaadʋg maan, ka misidi ba yaŋa nɛ ziim la ye maliak onɛ kʋʋd bikpɛɛmnam la da kʋ Israel dim bikpɛɛmnama.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Israel dim da lɔ'ɔŋ Atɛuk Zɛn'ug la wʋʋ ku'om ɛɛn kpiɛn ka kɛ teŋ kpi'emis si'em la, ka Egipt dim mɛ tu'as ye ba lɔ'ɔŋ ka ku'om la dii ba.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Jeriko teŋ zaŋguom bɛda la da lu, saŋkanɛ ka Israel dim da keŋ gilig teŋ la daar wʋsa nɔɔr yinne keŋ paae daba ayɔpɔi la.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Rahab onɛ da an pu'agɔɔndir la tilig, on da di'e nimbanɛ kena ye ba labisi gɔs Jeriko teŋ la, ka pʋ kpi nwɛnɛ banɛ da zan'as la.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Bɔ ka m na lɛn yɛl ya'asɛ? M ka' saŋa na pian' Gideon nɛ Barak nɛ Samson nɛ Jefita nɛ David nɛ Samuel nɛ Wina'am nɔdi'esidib la yɛlaa.

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: Ba yadda niŋir zug ka ba nyaŋ na'anam sʋ'ʋlim, ka sʋ'oe nidib nɛ yɛlsida, ka di'e nɔzi'ela, ka kpar gbigima nɔya,

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: ka bʋk bugum la paŋ, ka pɔns nɛ zaba sʋ'ʋraug, ka nyɛ paŋi ba tadimisin ka lieb paŋ dim zaba ni, ka nyaŋ teŋ zʋŋ zabzabidib.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋir zug ka Wina'am da nie pu'abanɛ nidibi kpi la tisi ba. Ka sieba namisid bɛdegʋ ka zan'as yɔlisim, bɔzugɔ ba bɔɔd ye ba ti vʋ'ʋg kumin ka nyɛ nyɔvʋr paal.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Ba da la'adi ba sieba ka fiebid sieba, hali ka lɔ sieba kpɛn'ɛs sanrega ni,

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: ka lɔb sieba nɛ kuga kʋ, ka nɔk kampinta sʋ'ʋgʋ buak sieba zin'is ayi', ka kʋ sieba nɛ sʋ'ʋraad. Ka sieba yɛ pɛ'ɛs nɛ bʋʋs gbana yiridi gin ka pʋ mɔr si'el si'ela, ka ba namisidi ba ka niŋidi ba linɛ pʋ nara.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Ba da kʋdim yiridnɛ gin wʋʋ ba pʋ nar ye ba bɛ dunia nwa' nii. Ba da ginnɛ mɔɔgin nɛ zuoya ni ka gbɛɛnd bʋmbu'adin nɛ tampinlɛma ni.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Hali baa ba yadda niŋir yɛla kɛ ka ba nyɛ yʋ'ʋsʋŋ la, ba sɔ' da nam pʋ di'e Wina'am kaanbʋg la;

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ, Wina'am da pʋn dɛŋi gban'e ye o maal bʋnsʋma banɛ gaad ala tisi ti. Ka li anɛ tinam nɛ banɛ na lieb yinne na kɛ ka ba an nyain ka gba'ar kae.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ nidib bɛdegʋ banɛ mɔdig namisʋgʋn sadigim giligi ti la, kɛlli ka ti mɛ basi zitɛbisa nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ gban'e ti kiŋ-kiŋ la, ka mɔdigi zɔ zɔɔs linɛ bɛɛ ti tuon la.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Ka gɔsid Yesu onɛ aan ti yadda la pin'ilʋg nɛ onɛ na lɛn naae li sʋ'ʋŋa la. Sumalisim linɛ daa digi gur o la zug ka o daa mɔdig dapuudir la zug, ka pʋ zɔɔ li nyannɛ, ka yʋ'ʋn zin' Wina'am na'am gbauŋ datiuŋ.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Tɛn'ɛsimi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dimi daa ki'is o ka namis o ka o mɔdig si'em, ka li sʋŋ ka ya giinla da siɛn ka ya tadigɛ.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ zabid nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, ya pʋn nam pʋ paae zin'ikanɛ ka ba na kʋʋ ya.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Da tam sa'al kanɛ bɛ Wina'am gbauŋʋn linɛ kpɛmisidi ya wʋʋ saamnamɛ san'anɛ ba biis si'em la ye, “M biiga, da nɛ'ɛs Zugsɔb la sa'alʋgɔ; o ya'a zɛrigif, fʋn da kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf pɛligɛ.

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb la tɛɛgidnɛ banɛ ka o nɔŋ la tʋba, ka namisid banɛ wʋsa ka o siak ye ba anɛ o biis la.”

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Siakimi namisʋg wʋʋ saamnamɛ tɛɛgidi ba biis tʋba si'em la; bɔzugɔ, ya ya'a paam namisʋg, li pa'al ye Wina'am maannɛ ya nɛ wʋʋ o biis nɛ. Biig na tun'e ba ka o saam pʋ tɛɛgidi o tʋbirɛ?

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Wina'am ya'a basi ya ka pʋ tɛɛgidi ya tʋba wʋʋ saamnamɛ niŋidi ba biis si'em la, li pa'al ye ya anɛ tampiinb ka ka' o mɛŋ biisɛ.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Li ya'a anɛ ti dunia nwa' saamnam, ba tɛɛgidi ti tʋba ka ti kpɛn tisidi ba na'asi. Ka li ya'a aan ala, wala ka ti kʋ sigisi ti mɛŋi tisi ti Ba' Wina'am onɛ sʋ'oe ti siis nɛ ti vɔm la.

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Ti dunia nwa' saamnam tɛɛgidi ti tʋba saŋa bi'ela nwɛnɛ ban tɛn'ɛs ye li nar si'em. Amaa Wina'am ya'a tɛɛgi ti tʋba, o niŋidnɛ ti sʋ'ʋm zug ye li kɛ ka tinam nɛ on la'am bɛ kasi bɛllim.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a ti tɛɛgidi ti tʋba, li zabidi ti nɛ ka ti sʋnf san'am. Amaa li nya'aŋ ka li nyɔɔd an sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ pʋpielim tis banɛ nyɛ sʋŋiri li pʋʋgin la. Sa'alʋg

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ ʋgʋsimi ya nu'us banɛ an zɛla la, ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya duma banɛ bʋk la,

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: ka maal pʋpielim suori dɔl, ka banɛ yadda niŋiri pʋ zu'oe ka nwaas wʋʋ ba anɛ waba la da pɔn'ɔlim naae ka lɛɛ nyɛ laafi.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya mɛŋ ka bɛ nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ nidib wʋsa ka pɛsigi ya mɛŋi tis Zugsɔb la. Ka mɛŋ pɛsigir ya'a ka'asigɛ, sɔ' kʋ nyɛ Zugsɔb laa.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ka sɔ' da gʋ'ʋŋ Wina'am pʋpielim piini la di'erɛ, ka sɔ' da mɔr pitɔɔg linɛ daamid nidib bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' da tʋm dian'ad tʋʋma bɛɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suor wʋʋ Esau onɛ da zaŋ o kpɛuŋ faari kuos diib yinne yɛla laa.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Ya baŋ ye lin nya'aŋ la o da bɔɔd ye o di'e o kpɛuŋ faar la ka o saam zan'as, ka o pʋ nyaŋi tiak linɛ ka o gban'e laa, hali la'an nɛ on da kaasi bɔɔdi li nɛ nimmua la.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Ya pʋ keŋ zuokanɛ dit bugum ka ninsaal na tun'e si'is wʋʋ Israel dimi da keŋ Sinai zuorin si'em la. Ba da nyɛ bugum tita'ar nɛ lik nɛ zibisʋg nɛ sisi'em

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: ka wʋm na'atana piebʋg nɛ kʋkɔr kanɛ ka nidib wʋmi li ka bɛlim ye li da lɛm pian' tisi ba ya'asɛ.

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: Ka ba kʋ nyaŋi mɔdig nɔɔr yɛlʋg linɛ ka ba di'e ye, “Hali baa bʋnkɔnbʋg ya'a si'is zuor la, ban lɔm o nɛ kuga kʋ la.”

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: Ban nyɛ si'el la da tɔi hali, ka Moses yɛl ye, “Mam kiridnɛ nɛ dabiem.”

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Amaa yanam kɛn Zion Zuokanɛ an Wina'am onɛ vʋe la teŋin na ka an Jerusalem amɛŋa linɛ bɛ arezana ni la. Anina ka maliaknam banɛ ka' bɛn la bɛ, ka la'asi maan sumalisim.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: Ka bikpɛɛmnam banɛ yʋda sɔb arezana ni la mɛ la'asid anina. Ka Wina'am onɛ an si'el wʋsa sariakat ka sʋ'oe si'el mɛkama la, nɛ pʋpielim dim siis banɛ ka ba maali ba sʋ'ʋm naae la mɛ bɛɛ anina.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Ya mɛ kenɛ Yesu onɛ an nɔnapaal la nu'unwɛ'ɛd san'an na, ka mɛ kɛn ziim kanɛ ka ba zu'as ka li pian'ad sʋ'ʋŋa gat Abɛl ziim la san'an na.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Baŋimi ka da zan'as onɛ pian'ad laa. Ka banɛ zan'as onɛ san'anɛ ba dunia ni la sadigim pʋ nyaŋi luak namisʋg la, ti na niŋ wala zan'as onɛ bɛ arezana nii san'anɛ ti la ka luak namisʋgɔ?

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: O kʋkɔr la da kɛ ka teŋ mi'im, ka nannanna o nɔzi'elʋg la kpɛm bɛ ye, “M na mi'im dunia nɔɔr yinne ya'as, ka ka'anɛ dunia ma'aanɛɛ, amaa la'an nɛ saazug.”

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: On yɛl ye, “M na lɛn kɛ la” pa'annɛ ye bʋn linɛ ka Wina'am maal la na mi'im sʋʋg, ka linɛ kʋ tun'e mi'im la na kpɛlim.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ kɛlli ka ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka nɛ na'asi nɛ dabiem; tinamɛ na di'e na'am sʋ'ʋlim linɛ kʋ tun'e mi'im la,

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ti Wina'am la anɛ bugum kanɛ kanbid.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Kpɛn nɔŋi taaba nwɛnɛ ba'abiis nɛ.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Da basi saam di'esʋgɔ, ka ala ka sieba da maal maliaknam saauŋ ka pʋ baŋ ye ba anɛ maliaknama.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Tɛnri banɛ bɛ sanrega ni yɛla nwɛnɛ yanam nɛ banɛ la'am bɛ sanrega ni nɛ. Mɛ tɛnri banɛ ka ba namisidi ba la, nwɛnɛ yanam nɛ banɛ la'am namisid nɛ.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Dɔlisimi pu'adiir suor sʋ'ʋŋa, ka da kɛ ka dian'ad tʋʋma bɛ li nii, ka Wina'am na kad pu'asan'auŋ nɛ dausan'auŋ dim la saria.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Mɛ da kɛ ka ligid nɔŋilim kpɛn' yaa. Kɛl ka ya sʋnya malis nɛ yanamɛ mɔr si'el la; ka Wina'am yɛl ye, “M kʋdim kʋ basi yaa.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, ti yinne-yinne na tun'e pian' nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ ye, “Zugsɔb la aan m sʋŋid, m kʋ zɔt dabiem. Ninsaal na nyaŋi niŋim bɔ?”

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Tɛnri ya tuongatib banɛ pian'ad Wina'am pian'adi tisidi ya la. Tɛn'ɛsimini ba nyɔvʋr bɛllim an si'em, ka mɛ tu'asi ba yadda niŋir la.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo pʋ tiakida. On sa an si'em su'os la, ala mɛn ka o an zina, ka na kpɛn aan ala saŋa mɛkama.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka nidib pa'ali ya pa'al yɔɔd kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb ka li yutimi ya pʋtɛndaa. Li nar ye ti paam sʋnkpi'euŋ linɛ yit Wina'am pʋpielim piini la ni ka ka' diib malima dɔlisʋg linɛ pʋ tisid banɛ dit la nyɔɔdɛ.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Ti mɔr maan zin'ikanɛ ka banɛ tʋm Jew dim maan zin'igin la pʋ mɔr suori na di maan kanɛ maal anina laa.

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: Maanmaan kpɛɛm la mɔr bʋnkɔnbid ziim kpɛn'ɛd Kasi Wʋsa Kasi Zin'ig la ni maan tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd maan, amaa ka nyu'oe bʋnkɔnbʋg la la'asʋg zin'ig la yiŋ.

english_verse: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka Yesu namis teŋ la kpikpɛŋ ye o ziim la pie nidib la ka ba lieb Wina'am nimbanɛ an nyain.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, kɛlli ka ti yi teŋ la kpikpɛŋi la'am di nyan kanɛ ka o di la;

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: ka dunia nwa' ni, ti pʋ mɔr teŋ kanɛ na bɛ yʋma dinɛ ka' naarɛ, amaa ti ieedi teŋ kanɛ bɛ saazug ka na kena la.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Da basi tʋʋm sʋma maalʋgɔ, mɛ da tami taaba sʋŋirɛ bɔzugɔ, tʋʋm bamanamɛ ma'ad Wina'am sʋʋnr.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Siakimi ya tuongatib nɔya ka tʋm ban yɛl ye ya tʋm si'el wʋsa. Banɛ gɔsidi ya yɛla, ka na ti zi'en Zugsɔb la tuonnɛ tu'asi ba tʋʋma an si'em. Siakim tisi nɛ ba, ka ba na tʋm nɛ sumalisim ka da nyɔnna. Ka ba ya'a nyɔn, li kʋ mɔr nyɔɔdi tisi yaa.

english_verse: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.
translation_verse: Sɔsimi Wina'am tisi ti; ka ti mi' ye ti pʋtɛn'ɛr anɛ nyain, ka ti bɔɔd ye ti tʋm si'el wʋsa sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: M kpɛmisidi ya bɛdegʋ sa ye ya sɔs Wina'am, ka m nyaŋi lɛbi ya san'an na tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ an sumbʋgʋsʋm sɔb ka vʋ'ʋgi ti Zugsɔb Yesu kumin la, onɛ an kɔnbkem onɛ gur pɛ'ɛs la ziim ka kɛ ka ti mɔr nɔnaar nɛ Wina'am saŋa kanɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: Wina'am na maali ya sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ si'el mɛkama ni ye ya tʋm o bɔɔdim, ka tʋm linɛ na ma'ad o sʋʋnri ya ni ka li yi Yesu Kristo onɛ na di'e na'asi saŋkanɛ ka' bɛn la ni. Ami.

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, m bɔɔd ye m kpɛmisi ya ka ya di'e sa'al kanɛ ka m sɔb la, m bɔɔd ye ya nɔki li; bɔzugɔ m sɔbi li nɛ giŋa.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ye ba yisi ti ba'abiig Timoti sanrega ni bas, ka o ya'a lɛb tɔ'ɔtɔ na, on nɛ mam na la'an kene kaae ya.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi ya tuongatib la nɛ Wina'am nidib la wʋsa. Banɛ yi Itali teŋin la pʋ'ʋsidi ya.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Wina'am yɛlsʋm na bɛ nɛ ya wʋsa. Ami.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Man Jemes onɛ an Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo tʋmtʋm la sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am nimbanɛ widig teŋ-teŋ la. Makir nɛ kpansib yɛla

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ makir kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb ya'a paae ya yanam mɔr sumalisim Yesu Kristo ni,

english_verse: You know you learn to endure by having your faith tested.
translation_verse: bɔzugɔ ya mi' ye ya ya'a nyɛ makiri ya yadda niŋir pʋʋgin li kɛt ka ya nyaŋidi mɔdigid.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya mɛŋ ka mɔdigi paae li bɛn ka gbada kae. Ala ka ya na bi' ya bɛllim pʋʋgin ka kʋ kɔ'ɔŋ si'el, si'ela.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Ya'am ya'a pansig sɔ' ya sʋʋgin, on sɔsim Wina'am ka o tis o; bɔzugɔ Wina'am anɛ onɛ tisid nidib wʋsa ka li galisid ka pʋ nyɛt sɔ' taalɛ.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a sɔs o, asɛɛ ka ya niŋ o yadda ka da bi'es baa bi'elaa. Bɔzugɔ onɛ wʋsa bi'esid la nwɛnɛ mu'ar ku'opila ka pɛbisim da'ad ka li tʋʋlim si'em la.

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Li nar ka ti ba'abiig onɛ an nɔŋdaan mɔr sumalisim bɔzugɔ ba na dʋ'ʋs o.

english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: Amaa kpan'am daan mɛ mɔr sumalisim ba ya'a sigis o, bɔzugɔ o kpan'am la na gaad nwɛnɛ mɔɔd puum gat si'em la.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Nwɛnɛ winnigi ɛɛnti dʋ ka li tʋlig ka mɔɔd ziank ka li puum sʋʋg ka li vɛnlim san'am si'em la, ala mɛn ka kpan'am daan na kpi, hali ka nan kpɛm bɛɛ o tʋʋma ni. Makir yɛla

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Albareka bɛ nɛ onɛ nyaŋi mɔdig makir pʋʋgin. O ya'a nyaŋ makir la, Wina'am na tis o nyɔvʋr zupibig linɛ an piinkanɛ ka o da zi'el nɔɔri tis banɛ nɔŋ o la.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Makir ya'a paae sɔ', on da yɛl ye, “Wina'am makidi ma.” Bɔzugɔ bʋmbɛ'ɛd kʋ nyaŋi mak Wina'am. Alazug Wina'am pʋ makid sɔ'ɔɔ.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Sɔ' mɛkama ya'amlɛogʋ pan'asid o ka o kpɛn'ɛd makirin.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Ka ya'amlɛog ya'a nɔk pʋʋg li du'adi tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka li mɛ ya'a nɔbig li du'adi kum.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: M ba'abinɔŋa, da kɛ ka sɔ' ma'aa yaa.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Piinkanɛ wʋsa an sʋ'ʋm ka an nyain yitnɛ ti Ba' onɛ bɛɛ agɔl ka maal winnig nɛ linɛ wʋsa kɛt ka li nied nyain la san'an na. O pʋ tiakida ka kpɛn aan o naŋnaŋin.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: O mɛŋ bɔɔdim ka o maali ti nɛ o yɛlsida pian'ad ye ti an yiiga dim bʋn linɛ ka o maal wʋsa ni. Onɛ wʋm ka tʋm la yɛla

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: M ba'abinɔŋa, baŋimi nɛ'ɛŋa, sɔ' mɛkama wʋsa kɛlisimi sʋ'ʋŋa ka pian'ad baanlimm, ka o sʋnf da pɛligid tɔ'ɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
translation_verse: Dinzug basimi linɛ an dian'ad tʋʋma wʋsa, nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ nɔbigid la, ka sie ya mɛŋi di'e Wina'am pian'ad kanɛ ka o zaŋi niŋi ya sʋnya ni la, ka linɛ na nyaŋi faaɛn ya.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Da ma'aa ya mɛŋi kɛlisid Wina'am pian'ad la, ka basi lii, amaa siakim tʋmi lin yɛt si'el la.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa kɛlis pian'ad la ka pʋ tʋmi lii, nwɛnɛ ninsaali na gɔs gɔtiŋin nyɛɛ o mɛŋi an si'em.

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: On gɔs o mɛŋ ka keŋ la o tam on pa'a an si'em nɛ.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ gɔs Wina'am wada linɛ an sʋm ka tisid yɔlisim la, ka mɔɔd sʋ'ʋŋa, ka pʋ tam on wʋm si'el la, ka siaki tʋmi li, Wina'am na niŋ o bareka on tʋm si'el la yɛla.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa tɛn'ɛsid ye o anɛ onɛ dɔl Wina'am, ka pʋ gban'e o nɔɔrɛ, o ma'ad o mɛŋ, ka o Wina'am dɔllim la an zaalim.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Wina'am dɔllim linɛ an nyain ti Ba' Wina'am san'an anɛ anwa: fʋn na sʋŋ kpiibis nɛ pʋkɔnya ba fara pʋʋgin, ka da kɛ ka dunia tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd kpɛn' fɔ.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, da dɔllini ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo ka lɛm mɔri baregaŋa.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Li ya'a nwɛnɛ arezak daani pid sanlima baans ka yɛ fusʋma kpɛn' ya la'asʋgʋn na, ka nɔŋdaan mɛ yɛ kparikɛɛndi kpɛn' na,

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: ka ya tis onɛ yɛ fusʋma la na'asi ka yɛl o ye, “Naa, zin'inim kpɛla,” amaa ka yɛl nɔŋdaan la ye, “Fʋn zi'inim ani sa!” bɛɛ “Zin'inim teŋin!”

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a niŋ ala, ya pʋ mɔr baregaŋ nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd dimi ya sʋʋgin ka lieb sariakatiba?

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: M ba'abiis banɛ ka m nɔŋa, baŋimi ye ninsieba tun'e an nɔŋ dim dunia nwa' ka Wina'am gaŋi ba ka ba niŋ o yadda nɛ ba sʋnf wʋsa ka ti di'e na'am kanɛ ka o kaanbi zi'el banɛ nɔŋ o la.

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Amaa ya nɛ'ɛsid nɔŋ dim. Li ka' areza'as dimi namisidi ya ka gban'adi ya ken sariakatib tuon laa?

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Li ka' banɛ san'amid yʋ'ʋsʋŋ kanɛ ka Wina'am tisi ya laa?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a siaki tʋm Wina'am sʋ'ʋlim wada linɛ sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Nɔŋimi fʋ tiraan wʋʋ fʋn nɔŋi fʋ mɛŋ si'em la,” ya tʋm linɛ an sʋ'ʋm.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a mɔr baregaŋ, ya tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, ka wada la na pa'ali ya ye ya tʋm taal.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa siaki tʋm wada la yɛl si'el la wʋsa, ka san'am yinne, o san'ami li wʋsa.
