english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Wina'am onɛ yɛl ye, “Mid ka ya san'am pu'a bɛɛ dau la,” onɛ mɛ lɛn yɛl ye, “Mid ka ya kʋ nid.” Hali baa fʋ ya'a pʋ san'am pu'a ka kʋ nid, fʋ anɛ onɛ san'am wada la.

english_verse: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
translation_verse: Pian'ami ka tʋm wʋʋ nimbanɛ ka ba na ti kadi ba saria ka li dɔl wada suor linɛ tisid yɔlisim.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Wina'am ya'a ti kad saria, o kʋ zɔ nimbaanlig nɛ ninkanɛ pʋ zɔt o taaba nimbaanliga. Bɔzugɔ nimbaanlzɔɔr nyaŋid sariakadib. Yadda niŋir nɛ li tʋʋma la yɛla

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, li sʋ'ʋm an bɔɔ tis ninkanɛ yɛl ye o niŋ Wina'am yadda ka o tʋʋma pʋ pa'alɛ? Yadda niŋir kan la na tilig oo?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Li ya'a nwɛnɛ ya ba'abiigi bɛ ka ka' fuugɔ, ka mɛ pʋ mɔr diibi na dii,

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: li sʋ'ʋm an bɔ ka ya yinne yɛl o ye, “Kem nɛ sumalisim, di sʋ'ʋŋa ka pil fuug ka waad da kpɛn' fɔ,” ka lɛɛ pʋ tis o, o niŋgbiŋi bɔɔd si'el la. Li sʋŋir an bɔ?

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka yadda niŋir gʋllim ka tʋʋma kae mɛ an zaalim.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' na yɛl ye, “Fʋn mɔr yadda ka mam mɔr tʋʋma.” Pa'alim mam fʋ yadda niŋir ka li tʋʋma kae, ka mam mɛ na pa'ali fʋ m yadda niŋir nɛ m tʋʋma.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Ya niŋ yadda ye Wina'am yinne ma'aa bɛ. Li an sʋ'ʋm. Hali kikiris mɛ siaki li ka kirid nɛ dabiem.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Yalim nwa'! Fʋ bɔɔd ye fʋ baŋ ye yadda niŋir ma'aa ka tʋʋma kae pʋ mɔr nyɔɔdɛɛ?

english_verse: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
translation_verse: Ti yaab Abraham da niŋ wala lieb pʋpielim sɔb Wina'am tuonnɛ? Li anɛ o tʋʋma pʋʋgin, on da zaŋ o biig Isaak ye o kʋʋ maal maannɛ tis Wina'am la.

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Fʋ nyɛɛ o yadda niŋir nɛ o tʋʋma la'an tʋm nɛ taaba si'em? O tʋʋma la kɛ ka o yadda niŋir la paae li bɛn.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Ka linɛ sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn la niŋ amɛŋa ye, “Abraham da niŋ Wina'am yadda ka Wina'am gɛlig o yadda niŋir ka yɛl ye o anɛ pʋpielim sɔb o tuon.” Alazug ka Wina'am buol o ye o zua.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Ya nyɛ yaa, ninsaal tʋʋma na kɛ ka o lieb pʋpielim sɔb Wina'am tuon ka li ka' o yadda niŋir ma'aanɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Niŋgbiŋi na bɛ ka siig kae ka li an zaalim si'em la, ala mɛn ka yadda niŋir ya'a bɛ ka tʋʋma kae, li anɛ zaalim mɛn.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, li pʋ sʋ'ʋm ye ya bɛdegʋ mɔɔd ye ya an pa'anniba. Bɔzugɔ ya mi' ye tinam banɛ an pa'annib la ba na ti kadi ti saria ka li kpi'ɛm.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Ti wʋsa tʋm tʋʋm linɛ pʋ dɔl suor saŋa bɛdegʋ. Sɔ' ya'a pʋ pian' linɛ pʋ tu'alɛ, o sid anɛ ninsʋŋ amɛŋa ka na nyaŋi kɛ ka o niŋgbiŋ wʋsa tʋm linɛ an sʋ'ʋm.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a li'a widi nɛ saliba ye ba niŋ tinamɛ bɔɔd si'el, ti nyaŋidi ba niŋgbina wʋsa ka ba fɛndigidi kpa'ad tinamɛ bɔɔd si'el.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Gɔsim anrintitada an si'em, hali la'an nɛ bam bɛdim ka pɛbisim da'adi ba ken la, onɛ dɔribid la tun'e nwɛdigi ba nɛ dabil ka ba keŋ bam bɔɔd zin'isi'a.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka ninsaal zilim an fiin niŋgbiŋin la, amaa ka nyaŋidi pian'ad nyɛɛsim pian'ad. Gɔsim bugum bi'ela ɛɛnti la'aŋ sian'atita'ari dii li si'em.

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Zilim mɛ nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ. Li mɔr tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd buudi wʋsa ti niŋgbina ni, ka kɛt ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd san'amidi ti niŋgbiŋ wʋsa. Ka kɛ ka bugum linɛ yit Sʋntaana san'an na la la'aŋi ti, ti bɛlim pʋʋgin.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Ninsaal na nyaŋi milis niis nɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ ken nɛ nɔba, nɛ banɛ vuudi ba pʋʋr zug nɛ banɛ bɛ ku'omin wʋsa.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Amaa ninsaal kae na nyaŋi milis o zilimmɛ. Bʋn linɛ wʋsa yit zilimin na tɔi nɛ ka kʋʋd wʋʋ yabid nɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Nɔkanɛ ka o mɔri na'asid Wina'am la nɔkan nɔɔ ka o lɛn nɔkidi pɔɔd nɔɔri tisid o tiraan ya'as. M ba'abiisɛ, li pʋ sʋ'ʋm ka li aan ala.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Ku'osʋŋ nɛ ku'otɔɔg na nyaŋi yi bulnɔɔr yinne ni naa?

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, ka kekaŋ na nyaŋi wal olif wala? Bɛɛ gaan tiig na nyaŋi wal kekama? Alazug bulkanɛ bʋn ku'otɔɔg mɛ kʋ nyaŋi bul ku'osʋŋɔ. Ya'am linɛ an zin'isa ayi' la yɛla

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ mɔr ya'am nɛ baŋiri ya sʋʋginɛ? On pa'alimi li nɛ o tʋʋm sʋŋ linɛ ka o tʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ ya'am la.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Amaa ya ya'a mɔr fufum nɛ nɛnnim yanam da nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg ka ma' ziri zan'as yɛlsida la.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa ka' ya'am kanɛ yi arezana ni naa. Li anɛ dunia nɛ Sʋntaana bʋn, ka li ka' Wina'am bʋnnɛ.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Fufum nɛ nɛnnim ya'a bɛ zin'isi'a, daamʋg nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ li buudi wʋsa na bɛɛ anina.

english_verse: But the wisdom that comes from above leads us to be pure, friendly, gentle, sensible, kind, helpful, genuine, and sincere.
translation_verse: Amaa ya'am kanɛ yi Wina'am san'an na la anɛ nyain, ka an baanlimm, ka zɔt nidib nimbaanlig, ka sʋŋid nidib bɛdegʋ, ka tʋm tʋʋm sʋma bɛdegʋ, ka pʋ gaansida ka an pʋʋg yinne.

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Banɛ an zabpansidib na bun sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ pʋpielim.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Bɔ ka ya zabid ka nwa'asid nɛ taaba? Li ka'anɛ ya niŋgbina ya'amlɛog yɛlaa?

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Ya bɔɔd si'elnam ka pʋ paam. Ya kʋʋd nidib ka mɔr fufum nɛ ya taaba bʋnam ka pʋ paam. Dinzug ka ya zabid ka nwa'asid nɛ taaba. Ya pʋ mɔra, yanamɛ pʋ sɔs Wina'am la zug.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Ya sɔsid ka pʋ paamida, bɔzugɔ yanamɛ pʋ sɔs ka li dɔl suor la zug. Ya sɔsidnɛ si'elnam linɛ aan ya ya'amlɛog bʋn ye ya di.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ an pu'asan'auŋ nɛ dausan'auŋ dim la, ya zi' ye onɛ maal zuod nɛ dunia la anɛ Wina'am dataa? Dinzugɔ onɛ mɛkama bɔɔd ye o maal zuod nɛ dunia na lieb Wina'am dataa.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ ya tɛn'ɛs ye linɛ sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, Wina'am Siig kanɛ ka o niŋi ti ni la guri ti nɛ dasʋŋ la anɛ zaalim?

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Wina'am tisidi ti yɔlisim si'a la galis nɛ hali. Alazug ka li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Wina'am zan'asid nyɛɛsim dim, ka tisid banɛ siedi ba mɛŋ yɔlisim la.”

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, zaŋimi ya mɛŋi pɛsigi tis Wina'am. Zan'asimi Sʋntaana, ka o na zɔ ka basi ya.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Li'elimi Wina'am san'an na ka o mɛ na li'eli ya san'an. Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim nɛ pʋtɛnda ayi', yi dima! Piemi ya nu'us nɛ ya sʋnya.

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Kaasimi ka fabil nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ. Tiakimi ya la'ab ka li lieb kaasig, ka ya sumalisim lieb sʋnsa'aŋ.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Sigisimini ya mɛŋ Wina'am tuon ka o na dʋ'ʋsi ya. Taaba sariakadib yɛla

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, da pian'adi bɛ'ɛdi tisid taaba. Onɛ pian' bɛ'ɛdi tis o tiraan bɛɛ kad o saria, o pian'adi bɛ'ɛdi tisid Wina'am wada la ka kati li saria. Fʋ ya'a kad wada la saria, fʋ pʋ dɔl wada laa, amaa fʋ anɛ onɛ kad wada la saria.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Wina'am ma'aa an onɛ tisid wada ka an sariakat. On ma'aa na nyaŋi tis nyɔvʋr ka san'ami li. Ka fʋn tɛn'ɛs ka fʋ aan anɔ'ɔnɛ na kadi fʋ tiraan saria? Da nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg bɛog yɛlaa

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi! Yanam banɛ yɛt ye, “Zina bɛɛ bɛog ti na keŋ teŋ kaŋa di yʋʋm anina ka tɔlim nyɛ nyɔɔd la.”

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Hali ya zi' ya nyɔvʋri saa na an si'em bɛogɔ. Ya nwɛnɛ kpaandʋgʋ ɛɛnti yina ka li niŋ bi'ela ka li gaad la.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Li sʋm ka ya ɛɛnti yɛl ye, “Wina'am ya'a bɔɔd, ti na vʋe ka tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa nɛ nɛ'ɛŋa.”

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Amaa ya pa'annɛ ya mɛŋ ka mɔr nyɛɛsim. Nyɔ'ɔg nwɛ'ɛb bama wʋsa anɛ bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɛkama mi' linɛ an sʋm, ka pʋ tʋmi lii, o tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Arezak dima, kɛlisimi! Kaasimi ka fabili bɔzugɔ sʋnsa'aŋ kennɛ ya san'an na.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Ya areza'as pun'oe ya. Yɔɔr mu'a ya fuud.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Teŋinzɛn'ɛm kpɛn' ya sanlima nɛ ya anzurifa. Teŋinzɛn'ɛm la na liebi ya kasɛt, ka na dii ya niŋgbina wʋʋ bugum nɛ. Ya la'as areza'asi digili gur naar dabisa la.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Ya ma'ad tʋmtʋmnib banɛ tʋmmi ya pɔɔdin, ka mɔŋi ba yɔɔd ka ba kaasidi ziinnɛ ya. Ka ya bunnib la kaasig paae Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la tʋba ni.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Ya bɛ nɛ dunia nwa' ni maannɛ ya ya'amin. Ya maali ya mɛŋi nɔbi gur kʋʋb daar.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Ya kʋʋs sida dim ye ba tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd hali ka ba pʋ nwa'as nɛ yaa, ka ya la'an kʋʋ ba. Mɔr suguru namisʋg saŋa

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m ba'abiisɛ, mɔdigimi ka Zugsɔb la naan ti lɛb na. Gɔsimi kpaadi mɔdigid si'em gur ka sigsaa nɛ nya'aŋ saa ti ni, ka li naan ti du'a biel sʋma la.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Yanam mɛ mɔdigim ka gban'e ya mɛŋ ka Zugsɔb la lɛbig na li'el ya.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, da nyɔnnɛ taabaa, ka ya ya'a niŋid ala, Wina'am na kadi ya saria. Gɔsimi, sariakat la zi'e za'anɔɔrin.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Zaŋimi Zugsɔb nɔdi'esidib banɛ da pian'ad o yɛla la namisʋg nɛ ba mɔdigir ka li an zanbinnɛ tisi ya.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Ti buon nimbama ye albareka dim ka li anɛ bam mɔdig la zug. Ya wʋm Job n da mɔdig si'em ka nyɛ Wina'am da maal si'em tis o li naarin la. Zugsɔb la anɛ nimbaanlzɔt nɛ onɛ mɔr nyɔɔg.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, linɛ gaadi li wʋsa-wʋsa anɛ ye, da pɔ baa bi'elaa. Da pɔɔ mak nɛ teŋ bɛɛ saazug bɛɛ si'el si'ela. Kɛl ka ya “ɛɛn” an “ɛɛn” ka ya “ayei” an “ayei” ka li kɛ ka ya kʋ kpɛn' taalinɛ. Yadda winsɔsʋg

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a bɛɛ ya san'anɛ bɛ yɛla ni, on sɔsim Wina'am. Onɛ sʋʋnri mɛ ma'ae on yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma na'as Wina'am.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a bɛɛ ya san'an bɛn'ɛd on buolim Wina'am nidib kpɛɛmnam ka ba sɔs Wina'am tis o ka bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ o zugin nɛ Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Ka winsɔsʋg kanɛ ka ba sɔs nɛ yadda la na tilig ban'ad la. Zugsɔb la na duoe o. Ka o ya'a tʋmnɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd o na yisi li bas.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Pɛligimi ya pʋʋsi tu'asi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi tis taaba, ka sɔs Wina'am tis taaba, ka ya na nyɛ laafi. Sida sɔb winsɔsʋg mɔr paŋ ka tʋm tʋʋma.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Elaja da anɛ ninsaal wʋʋ tinam nɛ, ka sɔs Wina'am hali ye saa da nii, ka saa pʋ nii yʋma atan' nɛ nwadis ayuobʋ.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Ka o lɛn sɔs ya'as ye saa niim ka saa ni ka zʋʋd maal.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: M ba'abiisɛ, ya yinne ya'a yi sida la ni ka sɔ' mɔr o lɛb na,

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: tɛnri bʋnkaŋa ye, onɛ mɛkama fɛndig tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd daan o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd suoya ni, na tilig tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb siig kumin, ka kɛ ka Wina'am yis o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bɛdegʋ bas.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Man Pita onɛ an Yesu Kristo Tʋmtʋm la sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid Wina'am nimbanɛ widigi bɛ tɛɛns banɛ buon Pontus nɛ Galatia nɛ Kapadosia nɛ Asia nɛ Bitinia ni ka an saam la.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am dɛŋi baŋi ya ka gaŋi ya ye o Siig Kasi maali ya nyain ka ya siak Yesu Kristo nɔɔr ka o pie ya nɛ o ziim la. Wina'am na paasi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm ka li galis. Ti'ir amɛŋa la yɛla

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ti pʋ'ʋs Wina'am onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo Ba' la bareka. Bɔzugɔ, nimbaanlzɔɔr linɛ zu'oe la zugʋ kɛ ka ti paam du'am-paalig linɛ mɔr ti'ir amɛŋa ka yi Yesu Kristo kum vʋ'ʋgirin la.

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: Wina'am digil faar linɛ ka' tiraan ye o tis o biis. Li anɛ faar kanɛ kʋ san'am ka pʋ pun'oda, ka li vɛnlim pʋ pɛligida, ka li bɛ arezana ni guri ya.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: Ya yadda niŋir zug ka Wina'am paŋ guri ya ye ya nyɛ faangir linɛ ka o ti'eb ye li nie naar saŋa la na.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa ni ka ya na mɔr sumalisim, hali baa nannanna ka ya na paam namisʋg kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb saŋa bi'ela la.

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Makir banɛ paadi ya la anɛ ye li pa'al ye ya yadda la sid anɛ sida. Hali ba mɔri bugum makid sanlima linɛ na tun'e san'am la. Alazug, asɛɛ ka ba maki ya yadda linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa gat sanlima la ka li nyaŋi zi'en kiŋ-kiŋ. Ala ka ya na di'e girima nɛ na'asi Daakanɛ ka Yesu Kristo na nie la na.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Ya pʋ nyɛɛ o ka la'an nɔŋ o, ka pʋ nyɛt oo ka niŋid o yadda, ka ya sʋnf malis nɛ sumalisim linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: Ya yadda niŋir la nyɔɔd anɛ ya nyɛ faangir.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Li anɛ faangir kaŋa yɛla ka Wina'am nɔdi'esidib banɛ da pian' o yɔlisim linɛ na ti aan ya din la da tɛn'ɛsidi li yɛla hali ka ieedi li la.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Kristo Siig Kasi kanɛ daa bɛ nɔdi'esidibin la da nie pa'ali ba namisʋg kanɛ ka Kristo na nyɛ, ka nyaan nyɛ na'asi kanɛ na dɔlli li nya'aŋ la. Ba da mɔɔd ye ba baŋ saŋa la na ti an si'em nɛ lin na ti kɛn saŋa si'a na.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Wina'am da nie pa'ali ba ye ba pʋ tʋmmi tisidi ba mɛŋa, amaa li anɛ yanam zug ka ba da pian' yɛlbanɛ ka mɔɔnmɔɔnib da mɔɔli tisi ya ka li yinɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi onɛ ka o da tʋm o ka o yi arezana ni la na. Hali maliaknam bɔɔd ye ba gban'e bʋn kaŋa gbin.

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ ti'ebimi ka mɔr ya'am, ka gban'e ya mɛŋ, ka mɔri ti'ir sʋ'ʋŋa nɛ yɔlisim linɛ na kɛɛn ya ni na Yesu Kristo nier saŋa la.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ an banɛ siakid nɔɔr yɛlʋg la, da kɛ ka ya ya'am kpɛn' nɛ yɛlbɛ'ɛd linɛ ka ya da zi' ka bɛɛ li ni laa.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Amaa aaɛn kasi wʋʋ Wina'am onɛ buoli ya la an kasi si'em la ya tʋʋma wʋsa ni.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ li pʋn sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn la ye, Mam Wina'am anɛ kasi, alazug, yanam mɛ an kasi.

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Onɛ ka ya buon ye ya Ba' la sadigim an onɛ kad saalib saria nɛ yɛlmɛŋiri ba tʋʋma ni ka baregaŋ kae la, dinzugɔ zɔmi dabiem ka bɛ wʋʋ saam nɛ dunia nwa' ni. Bɛllim paal la yɛla

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Ya mi' ye li ka'anɛ bʋn linɛ san'amid wʋʋ sanlima nɛ anzurifa da tisi ya yɔlisim suoyɔɔd banɛ ka ya zamisi ya yaanam ni la.

english_verse: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
translation_verse: Amaa li anɛ Kristo onɛ an pɛbil kanɛ ka' gba'ar bɛɛ dɛŋ la ziim ka o da zaŋi maal maannɛ tisi ya yɔlisim.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Wina'am da gaŋ o ka dunia nam pʋ pin'ilɛ amaa o yʋ'ʋn nie naar saŋa nwa' ya yɛla.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Li yinɛ o san'an na ka ya niŋ Wina'am onɛ vʋ'ʋg Yesu kumin ka tis o zʋn'or la yadda. Alazug ya yadda nɛ ya ti'ir bɛ nɛ Wina'am ni.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ sadigim siak, ka pie ya pʋʋs ye ya nɔŋi ya ba'abiis nɛ sida la, nɔŋimi taaba nɛ nimmua ya sʋnya ni.

english_verse: Do this because God has given you new birth by his message that lives on forever.
translation_verse: Ba du'a ya du'am-paal ka li ka' du'am kanɛ mɔr san'auŋɔ, amaa linɛ bɛ ka vʋe saŋa wʋsa, ka li yinɛ Wina'am pian'ad linɛ bɛ ka tisid vʋm saŋa wʋsa la ni.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Li sɔb ye, “Ninsaalib wʋsa nwɛnɛ mɔɔd nɛ, ka ba vɛnlim nwɛnɛ mɔpuum banɛ bɛ mɔɔgin nɛ. Mɔɔd la ziankid ka li puum la sʋʋgid,

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: amaa Zugsɔb pian'ad la kpɛm bɛ nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Zugsɔb pian'ad la an labasʋŋ kanɛ ka ba da mɔɔli tisi ya la.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: “Dinzugɔ basimi pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛd wʋsa, nɛ dama'am nɛ zam nɛ fufum, nɛ taaba kikɛung.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka ya ya'am kpɛn' nɛ Wina'am yɛla wʋʋ bibibisi bɔɔd bin'isim si'em la. Ala ka ya na bi' ya faangir la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ sadigim nyɛ Zugsɔb la an sʋm si'em la, niŋimin ala.

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: “Yanamɛ kɛɛn o san'an na la, o anɛ kugkanɛ vʋe, ka nidib zan'as o, amaa Wina'am gaŋ o ka o an sʋm hali tis o.

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka Wina'am nɔki ya, ka ya nwɛnɛ kugbanɛ ka o mɛ' yiri tis o mɛŋ, ka mɛ maal maan sʋma linɛ ma'ad Wina'am sʋʋnr ka li yi Yesu Kristo ni na.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ka li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Gɔsima, m dɛŋi gaŋi lɔdigin kugir linɛ an bʋnsʋŋ hali ka zaŋi li ɛɛnb ɛɛnbir Zion teŋin. Ka onɛ niŋ o yadda, o kʋ di nyannɛ.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ niŋ o yadda la, o anɛ kugsʋŋ hali tisi ya. Amaa banɛ pʋ niŋ o yadda la, li sɔbi ba yɛla ye, “Kugkanɛ ka tanmɛɛdib daa nɛ'ɛs la lieb lɔdigin kugir.”

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Amaa yanam anɛ nimbanɛ ka o gaŋ, ka an na'adɔɔg nɛ maanmaannib ka an sʋ'ʋlim kanɛ an kasi, ka an nimbanɛ an Wina'am mɛŋ din, ye ya wɔ'ɔg on kanɛ yisi ya likinɛ lɛbis nɛɛsim linɛ an nyalima ka ka' tiraan la ni.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ gaad la ya da ka' Wina'am nidiba, amaa nannanna ya yʋ'ʋn anɛ o nidib. Ba da pʋ zɔti ya nimbaanliga, amaa ba yʋ'ʋn zɔti ya nimbaanlig.

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: M zuanɔŋa, m san'anɛ yanam banɛ an saam dunia ni la ye ya bas saalib bɔɔdim linɛ zabid nɛ ya Wina'am dɔllim la,

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Kpɛn tʋmmi tʋʋm sʋma nimbanɛ zi' Wina'am la sʋʋgin, ka ba ya'a nwa'asid nɛ ya wʋʋ ya anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim, ban on nyɛɛ ya tʋʋm sʋma ka na'as Wina'am, daakanɛ ka o na ti kena la. Siakimi tuongatib nɛ kpɛɛmnam nɔɔr

english_verse: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb yʋ'ʋr zug, siemi ya mɛŋ Room na'ab onɛ sʋ'oe paŋ la san'an ka onɛ sʋ'oe na'anam wʋsa,

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: ka lɛn sie ya mɛŋ gɔmenanam san'an, bɔzugɔ Room na'ab la tʋmi ba ye ba tɛɛg banɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la tʋba ka zun'e banɛ tʋm tʋʋm sʋma, ka mɛ sie ya mɛŋ saalib banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ wʋsa tuon.

english_verse: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
translation_verse: Li anɛ Wina'am bɔɔdim ye ya tʋʋm sʋma gu'oe banɛ an zɔn ka pian'ad nɛ zi'ilim la.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Bɛi wʋʋ nimbanɛ mɔr yɔlisim, amaa da kɛ ka ya yɔlisim la tisi ya suor ka ya tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, ka lɛɛ bɛi wʋʋ tʋmtʋmnib nɛ.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Na'asimi nidib wʋsa, ka mɔri ba'abiidʋg nɔŋilim. Zɔmi Wina'am ka na'as Room na'ab la.

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ an yammis la, siakimi ya zugdaannam nɔya nɛ na'asi bɛdegʋ. Ka' zugdaan sʋma la ma'aanɛ, amaa la'an nɛ banɛ an nimbɛ'ɛdnam la.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a namisid namiskanɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ ka mɔdig ka li anɛ yanamɛ an Wina'am nidib la zug, li na ma'ae Wina'am sʋʋnr.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Fʋ ya'a tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka ba sigisif nɛ kpisiŋkpila ka fʋ sin ka mɔr suguru, li sʋ'ʋm an bɔ? Amaa fʋ ya'a tʋm linɛ dɔl suor ka namisi li yɛla, ka niŋi li nɛ suguru, li ma'adnɛ Wina'am sʋnf.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Li anɛ tʋʋm bama yɛla ka Wina'am daa buoli ya ka Kristo da namisi ya yɛla ka li an zanbinnɛ tisi ya ye ya mɛ tʋm ala.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: O da pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, ka dama'am mɛ pʋ yii o nɔɔrinɛ,

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: ka ban daa tʋ'ʋd o la, o kʋdim pʋ lɛbis ye anwa nɛ anwaa, ka ban namis o la, o mɛ pʋ vɔlisi ba, ka pɛsig o mɛŋ onɛ kad saria nɛ sida la nu'usin.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Kristo mɛŋ mɛŋi da zii ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd o niŋgbiŋin dapuudir la zug, ye ti bas tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd bɛllim ka lɛɛ bɛ nɛ pʋpielim. Ban daa pu'alim o la zugʋ kɛ ka ya paam laafi.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Ya da nwɛnɛ pɛ'ɛsi bɔdig ka yirid yɔri-yɔri, amaa ya yʋ'ʋn lɛbi ya kɔnbkem nɛ onɛ guri ya siis la san'an na.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Ala mɛn pu'aba, siakimini ya sidib nɔya, ka ala ka ba sieba ya'a pʋ siak labaar la, ba na ba'asi tiak ka li ka'anɛ ya nɔɔr pian'adɛ, amaa ba pu'ab la mɔr zʋgsʋŋ la zug.

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ ba na kpansi nyɛ yanamɛ bɛ sida bɛllim ka mɔr na'asi si'em la.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Da kɛ ka ya ba'a bɛ nɛ yiŋ nak galisʋg linɛ ka ya nɔk ka li an vɛnlim, nwɛnɛ zuobid lɔɔb nɛ sanlima la'ad nɛ fusʋma yɛɛbɔ.

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: Amaa kɛlli ka ya vɛnlim aaɛn na'asi linɛ su'a ya sʋnya ni nwɛnɛ sanlima linɛ ka' san'auŋɔ, ka an sʋm Wina'am san'an.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Ala ka pu'a banɛ da bɛ kʋdimin ka pɛsigi ba mɛŋ ka nɔki ba ti'iri niŋ Wina'am ni la da vɛnl, amaa ka siakidi ba sidib nɔya.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Sara anɛ onɛ da siak o sid Abraham nɔɔr ka buon o ye o zugdaan. Ya ya'a niŋ dinɛ nar ka pʋ zɔt dabiem, ya anɛ o pu'ayuos.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Ala mɛnɛ yanam banɛ an pu'ab sidiba, bɛɛi nɛ ba nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛsʋŋ, ka na'asidi ba, ba tadʋŋ la zug, nɛ yanamɛ la'an di'ed nyɔvʋr linɛ an Wina'am pʋpielim piini la. Ya ya'a niŋ ala, ya Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim kʋ vi'. Nidi na namis tʋʋm sʋŋ yɛla

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Li naar wʋsa anɛ ye, ya wʋsa bɛ nɛ taaba nɛ nɔɔr yinne, ka mɔri nyɔɔg nɛ taaba, nɛ ba'abiidʋg nɔŋir, nɛ nimbaanlzɔɔr ka siedi ya mɛŋ.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a tʋmi ya bɛ'ɛd, yanam da yɔɔni li sammɛ. Ka sɔ' ya'a tʋ' ya, yanam da lɛbisi yaa, amaa lɛɛ tim o bareka. Wina'am da buoli ya ye ya bɛllim aan ala, ka di faar linɛ aan o albareka la.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Ala ka li sɔb ye, “Onɛ wʋsa nɔŋ vʋm ka bɔɔd ye o vʋe yuug ka o bɛllim malis, asɛɛ o gban'e o zilim ka li da pian'ad bɛ'ɛdɛ ka mɛ da kɛ ka fʋ nɔɔr pian'ad an zirii.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: Basim bɛ'ɛd tʋʋma ka fɛndigi tʋm linɛ an sʋm; gban'am sumbʋgʋsʋm nu'us ayi' ka da basɛ.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la nindaa kpa'anɛ gɔsid banɛ an pʋpielim dim la, ka o tʋba yɔ'ɔgi kɛlisidi ba sɔsʋg; amaa o bid tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la kudug.”

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Ka ya ya'a mɔɔd ye ya tʋm linɛ dɔl suorɛ, anɔ'ɔnɛ na tʋmi ya bɛ'ɛdɛ?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Hali baa ya ya'a namis linɛ ka ya tʋm ka li dɔl suor, ya na nyɛ bareka. Alazug da mɔri dabiem ka kɛ ka li paki yaa.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Amaa ya sʋnya ni, gban'ami ye Kristo anɛ Zugsɔb. Ti'ebimi saŋa wʋsa ka sɔ' ya'a bu'osi ya ti'ir kanɛ ka ya mɔr la yɛla ya na nyaŋi pa'al ka o gban'e li gbin. Amaa niŋimini li ka siedi ya mɛŋ nɛ na'asi,

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: ka kɛ ka ya pʋʋs an nyain, ka ba ya'a tʋ' ya nɛ yanamɛ tʋmmi tisid Kristo la zugɔ, ban on di nyan.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ya ya'a tʋm sʋ'ʋm ka namis ka li an Wina'am bɔɔdim sɔn'oe yanamɛ na tʋm linɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ ka namis.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Kristo da kpii ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla vuguri, on kanɛ an pʋpiel la kpii tis banɛ ka' pʋpielnama, ye o mɔri ya keŋ Wina'am san'an. Ba da kʋʋ o niŋgbiŋin amaa ka Siig Kasi kɛ ka o vʋe.

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: Ka Siig Kasi la ni ka o keŋ mɔɔl labasʋŋ la tis siis banɛ bɛ sanrega ni la.

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: Ban banɛ da pʋ siak Wina'am nɔɔr yɛlʋg la, saŋkan ka o da gu'usid nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm ka Noa kpa'ad anrʋŋ tita'ar la. Nidib anii ma'aa da nyɛ faangir ku'om la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Ku'okaŋa nwaasnɛ Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb linɛ yʋ'ʋn tisi ya faangir la. Li ka'anɛ niŋgbiŋ dian'ad pier yɛlaa, amaa li anɛ linɛ na kɛ ka ya pʋtɛn'ɛr an nyain Wina'am ni. Li faaɛn ya ka li yinɛ Yesu Kristo kum vʋ'ʋgirin.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo kan la keŋ arezana ni zin' Wina'am datiuŋ ka sʋ'oe maliaknam nɛ banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ nɛ paŋ la.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔɔ, Kristo sadigim namis niŋgbiŋin la, ya kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya mɛŋ nɛ pʋtɛn'ɛr kan mɛn; ka onɛ mɛkama namis niŋgbiŋin, o ba'a lɛn ka' nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Ka lin yi nannanna wa'ae sa, ya niŋgbina bɛllim pʋ dɔl ninsaal bɔɔdim amaa Wina'am bɔɔdim.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Saŋa kanɛ gaad la, ya da san'am saŋa tʋm linɛ ka banɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am tʋm la. Dinɛ an: pitɔtʋʋma nɛ pu'ab bɛɛ dap bɔɔsim nɛ danuur nɛ ala'as taaba di'em, di'em yaalis nɛ bada maalʋg.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Ka yanamɛ pʋ lɛn la'asid nɛ ba tʋmmi ba gɛɛntʋʋma la, ka ba pʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ ka tʋ'ʋdi ya.

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Amaa ba na ti yɛl ban tʋm si'el wʋsa tis onɛ ti'ebi gur ye o kad banɛ vʋe nɛ banɛ kpi wʋsa saria la.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka ba da mɔɔl labasʋŋ la tis banɛ kpi la ye, hali baa Wina'am na kadi ba saria niŋgbiŋin ban an saalib la, ba tun'e vʋe nɛ siigin wʋʋ Wina'am nɛ. Wina'am piini mɔrim yɛla

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Bʋn wʋsa naar pʋ lalla. Dinzugɔ gban'aminɛ ya mɛŋ ka mɔr nimmua nɛ ya Wina'am pʋ'ʋsʋg.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Linɛ gati li wʋsa anɛ ya mɔr nɔŋilim nɛ taaba nɛ nimmua, ka onɛ mɔr nɔŋilim la sɔ' ya'a tʋm o bɛ'ɛd o kʋ gɔs ka li an si'ela.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Maalimi taaba saauŋ ka da nyɔnnɛ taabaa.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Yanam banɛ di'e Wina'am pʋpielim piini kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb la gɔsimini li sʋ'ʋŋa ka zaŋ linɛ an Wina'am yɔlisim la tʋm linɛ an sʋ'ʋm tis taaba.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Onɛ mɛkama pian'ad on baŋim ye o pian'adnɛ Wina'am pian'ad. Ka onɛ mɛ sʋŋid, mɛ baŋim ye Wina'am tis o paŋ kanɛ ka o mɔri sʋŋid la. Ti ya'a niŋida ala, li kɛtnɛ ka Wina'am yʋ'ʋr nyɛt dʋ'ʋsʋg ka li yinɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ nar nɛ na'asi nɛ paŋ linɛ ka' bɛn la ni. Ami. Kristo dɔllim namisʋg yɛla

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: M zuanɔŋa, da kɛ ka namistita'ar linɛ na kpansi ya la paki ya wʋʋ li anɛ bʋnsaaŋi tisi yaa.

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Amaa lɛɛ mɔri sumalisim yanamɛ la'am namis nɛ Yesu la zug, ala ka ya na mɔr sumalisim bɛdegʋ o na'am pipilim la nier saŋa.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a tʋ'ʋdi ya Yesu Kristo yʋ'ʋr la yɛla, ya mɔr albareka bɔzugɔ, Wina'am Siig Kasi onɛ mɔr na'asi bɛdegʋ la bɛɛ ya zug.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Amaa li pʋ sʋm ye ya namisid ka li anɛ ye ya anɛ ninkʋʋdib bɛɛ na'ayiis bɛɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim bɛɛ banɛ nwɛ'ɛdi ba mɛŋi gɛntid nidib tʋʋma ni zugɔ.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala, sɔ' ya'a namis on niŋ Kristo yadda la zug, on da zɔti li nyannɛ. O lɛɛ zu'om Wina'am ban mɔr Kristo yʋ'ʋri buon o la.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Saŋa paae ya ye Wina'am kad saria, ka li na pin'il nɛ o yidim yiiga, ka li ya'a pin'il nɛ tinam banɛ aan o yidim la, banɛ pʋ siak Wina'am labasʋŋ la ba'asʋg na an wala?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Li sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn ye, “Ka li ya'a tɔi nɛ sida sɔbi na nyɛ faangirɛ, ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim banɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suor la na di'e yaanɛ?”

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, kɛlli ka banɛ namisid ka li dɔl Wina'am bɔɔdim la niŋ linɛ an sʋ'ʋm ka nɔki ba mɛŋi pɛsig Wina'am onɛ maali ba ka an yɛlsida sɔb la.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: Mam onɛ an yadda niŋidib kpɛɛm nɛ banɛ da nyɛ Kristo ka o namis la yinne, banɛ na di'e na'asi linɛ na ti nie la yinne, sa'an yanam banɛ an m kpɛɛm taaba la,

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: ye ya guri Wina'am nimbanɛ ka o gu'uli ya wʋʋ pɛ'ɛs la, nɛ ya'amsɛug ka ka'anɛ mugusʋgɔ. Tʋmmi nɛ nimmua ka da tʋmmi nyɔɔd linɛ an ligidi yɛlaa.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: Da wɛbigidi banɛ bɛɛ ya nu'usin laa, amaa niŋimi sʋ'ʋm ka li an zanbinnɛ tisi ba.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Ka kɔnbkem kpɛɛm la ya'a ti nie, ya na di'e na'am zupibig linɛ pipilim kʋ san'am.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Ala mɛn yanam banɛ pʋ kʋdig la, siemi ya mɛŋ kpɛɛmnam la tuon. Ya wʋsa siemini ya mɛŋi tisi taaba; ka li sɔb ye, “Wina'am zan'asid nyɛɛsim dim ka lɛɛ tisid banɛ sie ba mɛŋ la yɔlisim.”

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ siemini ya mɛŋi niŋi Wina'am onɛ an paŋ sɔb la nu'usin, ka li saŋa ya'a paae o na dʋ'ʋsi ya.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Zaŋimi ya yɛlpakir wʋsa ziil o; bɔzugɔ o ba'a bɛ nɛ ya.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Aaɛn banɛ gban'adi ba mɛŋ, ka ti'eb sʋ'ʋŋa. Ka ya dataa Sʋntaana gɔɔndnɛ giligidi nwa'am wʋʋ gbigim nɛ ieed nid ye o gban'e ɔnb.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Niŋimi Yesu Kristo yadda sʋ'ʋŋa ka zan'as Sʋntaana, ka ya mi' ye ya ba'abiis banɛ bɛ zin'ig wʋsa la namisidnɛ namiskanɛ ka ya namis la buudi mɛn.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Wina'am sʋ'oe yɔlisim wʋsa, ka buoli ya o na'asi linɛ ka' bɛn la ni, yanam banɛ an yinne nɛ Kristo la. Ka ya ya'a namis saŋa bi'ela li nya'aŋ la, Wina'am mɛŋ na maali ya sʋ'ʋm ka zi'eli ya kiŋ-kiŋ, ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: O san'an ka na'am paŋ bɛ, saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Ami. Pʋ'ʋsʋg

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: M ba'abiig Silvanus onɛ an sida sɔb la sʋŋim, ka m sɔb gbauŋ kaŋa giŋa kpɛmisidi ya ye, nwa' anɛ Wina'am yɔlisim amɛŋa, gban'aminɛ li kiŋ-kiŋ.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Babilon, ka Wina'am mɛ da la'am gaansi ba nɛ ya la, pʋ'ʋsidi ya la'an nɛ Mak onɛ liebi m biig la.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Pʋ'ʋsimi taaba nɛ nɔŋilim pʋ'ʋsʋg. Sumalisim na bɛ nɛ yanam banɛ an yinne nɛ Kristo la.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Man Simon Pita onɛ an Yesu Kristo yammʋg nɛ o Tʋmtʋm la sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid banɛ ka ti Faangid Yesu Kristo nɛ ti Ba' Wina'am pʋpielim kɛ ka ya niŋ o yadda, linɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa nwɛnɛ tinamɛ niŋ o yadda si'em la.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Wina'am na pɛ'ɛsi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm bɛdegʋ, yanamɛ baŋ Wina'am nɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu la. Wina'am gaŋi ti ka li ka' viigirɛ

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Wina'am paŋ la tisi ti si'el mɛkama linɛ na kɛ ka ti vʋe ka bɛ wʋʋ Wina'am bɔɔd ye ti bɛ si'em la, ka li yinɛ tinamɛ baŋ onɛ buoli ti nɛ o mɛŋ girima nɛ o sʋ'ʋm pʋʋgin la.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Li yinɛ nɛ'ɛnamin ka o tisi ti o kaanbʋg linɛ an sʋm hali la ye ya luak san'auŋ linɛ bɛ dunia ni ka yi saalib ya'amlɛog linɛ an bɛ'ɛd la, ka lɛɛ lieb wʋʋ Wina'am an si'em la.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ ya ya'a mɔr nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa ka li nɔbigid, li na kɛ ka ya kpi'em nɛ ya Wina'am tʋʋma ka baŋi ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ ka' nɛ'ɛnama, o nwɛnɛ zʋnzɔŋ onɛ ka zi'ilim bɛɛ o ni ka o tam ye Wina'am pʋn pie o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yis ka o an nyain.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m ba'abiisɛ, kpɛ'ɛŋimi nɛ nimmua ka kɛ ka Wina'am buoli ya ka gaŋi ya la niŋ amɛŋa, ka ya ya'a niŋid nɛ'ɛŋa ya kʋ gʋ'ʋŋ baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Ala ka ya na nyɛ suor sʋ'ʋŋa kpɛn' Yesu Kristo onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb nɛ ti Faangid la sʋ'ʋlimin, saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Linzug ka m bɔɔd ye m tiɛndi ya saŋa mɛkama yɛlbama yɛla, hali baa yanamɛ pʋn dɛŋim baŋi li ka gban'e kiŋ-kiŋ nɛ yɛlsida kanɛ ka ya di'e la.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: M tɛn'ɛs ye mam nan vʋe la, li nar ka m tiɛn ya,

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: mam sadigim baŋ ye li kpɛlim bi'ela ka m niŋgbiŋ la bɔdig wʋʋ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo pa'alim si'em la.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: M na mɔ ka m ya'a ti kae ka ya na nyaŋi tiɛnd yɛlbama saŋa mɛkama. Pita n nyɛ Kristo na'am la yɛla

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Ti pʋ dɔl sɔlima linɛ yi ninsaalib mi'iliminɛ yɛti ya ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo paŋ nɛ o ken la na yɛlaa, amaa tinam mɛŋ nini sid nyɛɛ o na'am zu'oe si'em.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ o di'e na'asi nɛ zʋn'or linɛ yii ti Ba' Wina'am san'an na, saŋkan ka kʋkɔr da yi Wina'am paŋ tita'ar nɛ o girima ni na yɛl ye, “Oŋa aan m binɔŋir, onɛ ka m sʋnf ma'ae o yɛla hali.”

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Ka tinam mɛŋ wʋm kʋkɔr kanɛ yi arezana ni na la, saŋkan ka tinam nɛ on da la'am bɛ zuor kanɛ an kasi zug la.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Ka li maligim kɛ ka ti baŋ ye Wina'am nɔdi'esidib pian'ad la an sida. Li an sʋm ka ya kpɛ'ɛŋi ya mɛŋ ka kɛlis yɛlbama sʋ'ʋŋa; ka li nwɛnɛ fitiri nie likinɛ ti paae bɛog yiligir ka Kristo onɛ an nwaddar la nie ya sʋnya ni.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Yɛlkanɛ gaadi li wʋsa anɛ ya baŋ ye, Wina'am nɔdi'esidib pian'ad linɛ sɔb Wina'am gbauŋʋn la baa yinne pʋ yi ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛrin naa.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Li mɛ da pʋ yi ninsaalib san'an naa, amaa Wina'am Siig Sʋŋʋ da kɛ ka ba pian' pian'ad linɛ yi Wina'am san'an na.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Amaa ziri nɔdi'esidib mɛ da bɛ nidib sʋʋgin, ala nɔɔ ka ziri pa'annib mɛ na bɛ ya sʋʋgin. Ba na su'a mɔr ziri pa'ala linɛ ken nɛ san'auŋ la, hali ba na ti ki'is Zugsɔb onɛ da' ba la ka li kɛ ka ba nyɛ san'auŋ tɔ'ɔtɔ.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Yadda niŋidib bɛdegʋ na dɔlli ba tʋʋmyaalis la, ka linzug ka nidib na pian'ad sida la yɛla bɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
translation_verse: Ziri pa'annib la an dasʋŋ dim la zug, ba na pɔnrimi ya nɛ ba mɛŋ sɔlima nyɛ nyɔɔd. Kʋdimin sa ka Wina'am pʋn kʋʋsi ba bɛ'ɛd, onɛ na san'ami ba la pʋ gbisida.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Wina'am da pʋ di suguru nɛ maliaknam banɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, ka lɔbi ba bas bugum teŋ bʋmbɔk zulʋŋ linɛ an zibisʋg la guri sariakadib daar.

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: Wina'am mɛ da pʋ di suguru nɛ kʋdimin dima, ka kɛ ka ku'om dii ba, ka lɛɛ tilig Noa onɛ da mɔɔn pʋpielim yɛla la nɛ o yidim nidiba ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: Ka mɛ kʋʋs Sodom nɛ Gomora tɛɛns bɛ'ɛd ka kɛ ka bugum dii ba nyain, ka ba kilim tampɛligim ka li an sa'alʋgʋ tis banɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suor la.

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: Lot onɛ an pʋpielim sɔb la da bɛ nɛ ba daar wʋsa ka nyɛt ka wʋmi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, kɛ nɛ ka li san'am o sʋnf la.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Li ya'a an ala, Zugsɔb la mi' on na niŋ si'em faaɛn banɛ dɔl o amɛŋa la makir pʋʋgin, ka niŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la namisʋgʋn gur sariakadib daar.

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: Ka li kas-kas anɛ banɛ dɔl ya'amlɛog linɛ an dian'ad ka nɛ'ɛsid Wina'am kpi'euŋ la. Ba mɔr nyɛɛsim nɛ tita'alim ka pʋ zɔt dabiem nɛ ban na tʋ'ʋd banɛ mɔr paŋ ka bɛɛ agɔla la,

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: hali ka maliaknamɛ mɔr paŋ ka kpi'emi gati ba la, ba pʋ tʋ'ʋd banɛ bɛɛ agɔl la Zugsɔb la tuonnɛ.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Amaa nimbama nwa' tʋ'ʋd linɛ ka ba pʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ. Ba nwɛnɛ bʋnkɔnbid bɛɛ bʋnvʋsieba, ka ba bɛllim anɛ ba gban'e ba kʋ. Ba pian'adi bɛ'ɛd nɛ linɛ ka ba zi', ka na san'am wʋʋ bʋnkɔnbid la nɛ.

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: Ba yɔɔd na anɛ bɛ'ɛd wʋʋ ban tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd si'em la. Ba sʋnya malis nɛ ya'amlɛog linɛ ka ba niŋid paalʋ ka li an dian'adi ba niŋgbina ni la. Ba anɛ dian'ad dim nɛ banɛ mɔr gbada, ba la'am dit nɛ ya ka pa'annɛ ba ya'amlɛog.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Ba ya'am gban'anɛ pu'asan'auŋ ka pʋ tigid nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Ba pan'asid banɛ sʋnya pʋ kpi'em la, ka mɔr fufum linɛ an bɛ'ɛd la mi'ilim, ka Wina'am nɔpɔɔr bɛɛ ba zug.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Ba bas suosʋŋ la nɛ ka bɔdig, ka dɔl Balaam onɛ an Beor biig la suor, onɛ bɔɔd ye o di'ed yɔɔd linɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la.

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: Amaa Balaam da nyɛ sa'alʋg o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla. O bʋŋ da pian' o nɛ ninsaal kʋkɔr ka kɛ ka o bas zɔlim tʋʋma.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Nimbama nwɛnɛ bulnɔya banɛ pʋ bʋn ku'om, ka nwɛnɛ kpaandʋg linɛ ka sisi'em da'adi ken. Ka Wina'am ti'eb zin'ikanɛ an lik tita'ari guri ba.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Ba mɔri pian' yɔɔdi nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg ka mɔr tʋʋmyɔɔd ya'amlɛogʋ pan'asid nimbanɛ pin'ili zɔt ye ba yi ka bas nimbanɛ an tʋʋmyɔɔd dim la.

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: Ba yɛti ba ye ba na nyɛ yɔlisim amaa ka ba mɛŋ an yammisi tis itʋŋ linɛ ziid san'auŋʋ kenna la, bɔzugɔ linɛ mɛkama kul sɔ' kɛti ka o liebidi li yammʋg.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a baŋ Yesu Kristo onɛ aan ti Zugsɔb nɛ ti Faangid la ka yi linɛ kɛt ka saalib liebid dian'ad dim la ni, ka pan'asʋg lɛn nyaŋi ba ka ba kpɛn' li ni, ba bɛllim na maligim san'am hali gaad yiigin la.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a pʋ baŋin pʋpielim suorɛ, li naan aan sʋ'ʋm tisi ba, gat ban baŋi li ka lɛm bas Wina'am nɔɔr yɛlʋg kanɛ ka o tisi ba la.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Lin niŋi ba si'em la pa'al ye siilima la yɛl si'em la anɛ sida ye, “Baa lɛn lɛb o tiindin,” ka lɛn ye, “Kukur kanɛ ka ba sʋʋ o nyain la lɛb bian'ar nwɛ'ɛb.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: M bɔɔd ye ya tɛnr pian'abanɛ ka Wina'am nɔdi'es sʋma da dɛŋi pian' yʋʋmpʋkʋda la, nɛ ti Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Faangid la nɔɔr yɛlʋg kanɛ ka o tʋmtʋmnib pian' tisi ya la.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Amaa linɛ nar ye ya baŋ yiiga anɛ ye dunia naar saŋa la, zamdim na ti kena ka pa'an dinɛ dɔlli ba mɛŋ ya'amlɛogʋ bɔɔd si'el.

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: Ba na yɛl ye, “Yesu da yɛl nɔɔri zi'el ye o na lɛb na la li bɛ yaanɛ? Hali ka ti yaanam ti kena kpi, ka si'el wʋsa ken sʋ'ʋŋa nwɛnɛ dunia pin'ilʋgʋnɛ da an si'em la.”

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Ba anɛ banɛ mi' ka zan'as ye ba siak ye hali dunia pin'ilʋgʋn sa, Wina'am da zaŋ nɛ o nɔɔr pian'adi maal saazug nɛ dunia nwa'. Ku'om ka o da zaŋi maal teŋgbauŋ la ka kɛ ka li yi ku'omin na

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Li anɛ ku'okan la da uaki san'am dunia kanɛ da dɛŋi bɛ la.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Li anɛ pian'ʋk kan la gur agɔl nɛ teŋgbauŋ la nɛ bugum na ti dii li, ka li digi gur sariakadib nɛ banɛ zan'as Wina'am la san'auŋ daar.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as
translation_verse: M zuanɔŋa, da tami yɛlkaŋa, ye Wina'am ni daar yinne nwɛnɛ yʋma tusir nɛ, ka yʋma tusir mɛ nwɛnɛ daar yinne nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la pʋ bʋgis nɛ linɛ ka o kaanb la wʋʋ sieba tɛn'ɛsid si'em laa, amaa o mɔri suguru nɛ ya, ka pʋ bɔɔd ye sɔ' san'am, o lɛɛ bɔɔdi ye sɔ' mɛkama tiak o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Amaa Zugsɔb la ken daar na nwɛnɛ na'ayiigi ken si'em na la. Daakan la saazug na dam hali ka saŋgbana bɔdig, bugum na kanb si'el wʋsa. Dunia nɛ bʋn linɛ bɛɛ li ni wʋsa na kanb ka si'el wʋsa nie paalʋ.

english_verse: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
translation_verse: Ka nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa sadigim na san'am la, ya bɛllim nar ye li an wala? Asɛɛ ka ya bɛllim an kasi ka ya pɛsigi ya mɛŋi dɔl Wina'am suor,

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: ka guri Wina'am ken daar na ka kpɛ'ɛŋidi ya mɛŋ ye li niŋ tɔ'ɔtɔ. Daakan la bugum na kanbi san'am saŋgbana, ka bugum la tʋʋlʋg nyɛlig si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Amaa ti na gur Wina'am kaanb nɔsi'a ye, “Saazug paal nɛ dunia paal na bɛ la, zin'ikan la an pʋpielim dim teŋ.”

english_verse: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
translation_verse: Alazug, m zuanɔŋa, yanamɛ sadigim gur nɛ'ɛŋa la, kpɛ'ɛŋimi ya mɛŋ ka gba'asi'a da bɛ ya nii, aaɛn burikinnam ka mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm Wina'am ni.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Mɔrini ya pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye Zugsɔb suguru la gbin anɛ ye ya nyɛ faangir. Ala mɛn ka ti ba'abinɔŋir Paul daa sɔbi tisi ya nɛ ya'am linɛ ka Wina'am tis o la.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: O sɔbnɛ ala o gbana la wʋsa ni, pian'ad yɛlbama yɛla. Ka o pian'ad la tɔi hali nɛ tinamɛ na nyaŋi gban'e li gbin, ka banɛ zi' si'el la nɛ banɛ pʋ kpi'em nɛ ba yadda niŋirin la tiaki li ka li lieb san'auŋʋ tisi ba, nwɛnɛ ban niŋid si'em nɛ Wina'am gbana wʋsa la.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Alazug, m zuanɔŋa, yanamɛ pʋn dɛŋi mi' li la, gu'usimi ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim da kɛ ka ya yidig bɛɛ basi ya zi'esim ya yadda niŋir la nii.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Amaa kɛlli ka Wina'am yɔlisim nɛ baŋir linɛ yii ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo onɛ aan ti faangid la ni nɔbigi ya san'an. O yʋ'ʋr na nyɛ na'asi nannanna nɛ saŋa kanɛ ka' naarɛ! Ami.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Ti sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa nɛ yɛti ya pian'ad linɛ an nyɔvʋr ka da bɛ dunia pin'ilʋgʋn sa la. Ti wʋm o pian'ad, ka nyɛɛ o nɛ ti nini. Sida ti nyɛɛ o, ka ti nu'us si'is o.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Nyɔvʋr la da nie paalʋ ka ti nyɛɛ o nɛ ti nini ka dii li kasɛt. Onɛ an nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' naarɛ ka ti mɔɔn o yɛla tisidi ya. O da bɛ nɛ ti Ba' Wina'am ni, ka nie ti san'an.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ nyɛ ka wʋm si'el la ka ti yɛti ya mɛn, ka ya na la'as nɛ ti nɔɔr yinne, ka mɔr nɔɔr yinne kanɛ ka ti mɔr nɛ ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ o Biig Yesu Kristo la.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Ti sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa ye ti sumalisim la paae li bɛn. Wina'am anɛ nɛɛsim

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Labakaŋa ka ti wʋm o Biig la san'an ka mɔɔli tisi ya. Wina'am anɛ nɛɛsim, ka lik ka' o san'an baa bi'elaa.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a yɛl ye ti mɔr nɔɔr yinne nɛ o, ka lɛɛ bɛ likin, linɛ ka ti yɛt la, nɛ linɛ ka ti tʋm la anɛ dama'am.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Amaa ti ya'a ken nɛɛsimin, nwɛnɛ Wina'am bɛ nɛɛsimin si'em la, ti mɔr nɔɔr yinne nɛ taaba, ka o Biig Yesu ziim la pie ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa, ka kɛ ka ti lieb nyain.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a yɛl ye ti ka' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, ti ma'anɛ ti mɛŋ, ka sida ka' ti san'anɛ.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a pɛligi ti pʋʋsi tis Wina'am, o anɛ yɛlsida sɔb, ka na kɛɛ ti taali bas, ka pie ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka ti lieb pʋpielim dim.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a yɛl ye ti pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, ti buol o nɛ dama'am sɔb, ka o pian'ad ka' ti san'anɛ.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, m sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa nɛ tisidi ya ye ya da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Amaa sɔ' ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛd, Yesu Kristo onɛ an pʋpiel la na nwɛ' ti Ba' Wina'am nu'ugʋ tisi ti.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Kristo kum la kɛ ka Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn pʋ lɛm bɛɛ ti zugʋ ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛlaa. Li ka' tinam ma'aa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka o yisɛ, amaa li anɛ dunia la wʋsa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a siak Wina'am nɔɔr yɛlʋg la li pa'al ye ti sid mi' o sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a yɛl ye o mi' o, ka pʋ siak o nɔɔr yɛlʋgɔ, ninkan anɛ dama'am sɔb, ka yɛlsida ka' o san'anɛ.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' ya'a siak o pian'ad la, ninkan sid nɔŋ o bɛdegʋ. Nɛ'ɛŋa na kɛ ka ti baŋ sʋ'ʋŋa ye ti bɛ Wina'am san'an.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa yɛl ye o anɛ Wina'am nid on bɛ sʋ'ʋm nwɛnɛ Yesu Kristo da bɛ si'em la. Nɔyɛlʋg paal la yɛla

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: M binɔŋa, nɔɔr yɛlʋg kanɛ ka m sɔbidi tisidi ya la ka' yɛl paallɛ. Li anɛ yɛlkʋdʋg kanɛ ka ya da mɔr yanamɛ da dɔl Yesu Kristo pin'ilʋgʋn sa la. Yɛlkʋdʋg la anɛ labaar kanɛ ka ya pʋn wʋm.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Amaa yɛlʋg kanɛ ka m sɔbidi tisidi ya la anɛ yɛl paal. Ti nyɛɛ li yɛlsida la nɛ Kristo san'an nɛ yanam san'an, bɔzugɔ lik la gaadya ka yɛlmɛŋir nɛɛsim la yʋ'ʋn nie nyɛɛn.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Onɛ yɛl ye o bɛ nɛɛsim la ni, ka kis o ba'abiig, o nam kpɛm bɛ nɛ likin.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Onɛ nɔŋ o ba'abiig bɛ nɛ nɛɛsim la ni. Dinzugɔ, si'el kae na kɛ ka o tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Amaa onɛ kis o ba'abiig la bɛ nɛ likin, ka kennɛ li ni, ka zi' on kɛn si'ela, lik la zu'om o la zug.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, m sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisidi ya, bɔzugɔ Wina'am dii ya suguru ka yisi ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas Kristo yʋ'ʋr zug la.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: M saamnama, m sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisidi ya, bɔzugɔ yanamɛ mi' onɛ da bɛ dunia pin'ilʋgʋn sa la zug. Dasamma, m sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisidi ya, yanamɛ nyaŋ Sʋntaana la zug. M biisɛ, m sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisidi ya, yanamɛ mi' ba' la zug.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, m sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisidi ya, yanamɛ mi' ti ba' Wina'am la zug. M saamnama, m sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisidi ya, yanamɛ mi' onɛ da bɛ dunia pin'ilʋgʋn sa la zug. Dasammaa, m sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisidi ya, yanamɛ mɔr paŋ, ka Wina'am pian'ad bɛɛ ya ni, ka ya nyaŋ Sʋntaana la zug. Da nɔŋi dunia la

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Da nɔŋi dunia la bɛɛ bʋn linɛ wʋsa bɛɛ li nii. Ya ya'a nɔŋ dunia la, ya pʋ nɔŋi ya Ba' Wina'am.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Bʋn linɛ bɛ dunia ni, ka ka' sʋ'ʋm nwa', niŋgbina bɔɔdim linɛ an bɛ'ɛd nɛ nini gɔsig linɛ an bɛ'ɛd nɛ nidibi na dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ ban mɔr si'el bɛɛ ban na nyaŋi maal si'el yɛla, bama wʋsa pʋ yii ti Ba' Wina'am san'anɛ. Amaa li yinɛ dunia la ni na.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Dunia nɛ bʋn linɛ wʋsa bɛɛ li ni, ka nidib mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ li la na gaad. Amaa onɛ tʋm Wina'am bɔɔdim la na bɛ yʋma dinɛ ka' naarɛ. Kristo dataa la yɛla

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, dunia la naar li'el nɛ. Ba daa yɛli ya ye Kristo dataa na kena; hali nannanna, Kristo dataas bɛdegʋ pʋn kena, dinzug ka ti baŋ ye dunia naar la li'el nɛ.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Nimbama nwa' ka' Wina'am nidib amɛŋaa, dinzug ka ba yii ti san'an. Ba ya'a aan o nidib, ba naan kpɛliminɛ ti san'an. Amaa ban basi ti la pa'al nyain ye ba ka' Wina'am nidiba.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Kristo tisi ya Wina'am Siig Kasi la, dinzugɔ ya wʋsa mi' yɛlsida la.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Man sɔbidi tisidi ya la, li ka'anɛ ya zi'inɛ yɛlsida la zugɔ, amaa li anɛ yanamɛ mi' li, ka mɛ mi' ye dama'am pʋ yit yɛlsida ni na la zug.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ an dama'am sɔba? Li anɛ onɛ ki'isid ye Yesu ka' Kristo la. Onɛ zan'asi ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ o Biig la, onɛ an Kristo dataa.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Onɛ zan'as Biig la mɛ zan'as o Ba' Wina'am. Ka onɛ siak Biig la mɛ siak o Ba' la.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka pian'ad kanɛ ka ya wʋm ka dɔl Yesu Kristo pin'ilʋgʋn sa la kpɛm bɛɛ ya sʋnya ni. Li ya'a kpɛm bɛɛ ya sʋnya ni, ya na kpɛm bɛɛ ti Ba' la nɛ o Biig la san'an.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: M sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisidi ya ye m yɛli ya nimbanɛ zigid ye ba ma'aa ya kpɛn'ɛs mɔɔg la yɛla.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Kristo da tisi ya Wina'am Siig Kasi la, o nam bɛɛ ya san'an. Wina'am Siig Sʋŋʋ bɛɛ ya san'an la, ya pʋ ieed sɔ' ye o pa'ali yaa. Amaa o Siig Kasi la pa'annɛ ya si'el wʋsa la anɛ yɛlsida, ka ziri kae. Siakimi Siig Kasi la pa'alʋg ka kpɛlimmi Kristo ni.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, kpɛliminɛ o san'an, ka o ken la daar ti na mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ, ka kʋ zɔt nyannɛ o ken la daarɛ.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Ya mi' ye Kristo anɛ pʋpiel, dinzugɔ baŋimi ye onɛ wʋsa tʋm dinɛ an sʋm la anɛ Wina'am biig.
