english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi Wina'am nɔŋi ti si'em. O nɔŋilim la zu'onɛ galis, ka o buonnɛ ti ye o biis. Sida ti anɛ o biis. Dunia dim la zi' Wina'am la zugʋ kɛ ka ba zi' tii.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: M binɔŋa, nannanna ti anɛ o biis. Ka tinamɛ na ti an si'em la nam pʋ nie paalʋʋ. Amaa ti mi' ye Kristo ya'a ti kena ti mɛ na lieb wʋʋ on an si'em la, tinamɛ na ti nyɛ on an si'em la zug.

english_verse: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa mɔr ti'ir kaŋa Kristo ni mɔɔd ye o mɛŋ an nyain, nwɛnɛ Kristo an nyain si'em la.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, o san'am Wina'am wada la. Bɔzugɔ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd san'amnɛ wada.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Ya mi' ye Kristo da pʋ mɔr tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, amaa ka lɛɛ kena yis tinam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ onɛ wʋsa bɛ Kristo ni pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Ka onɛ nan kpɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la nam pʋ nyɛ oo bɛɛ baŋ oo.

english_verse: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, da kɛ ka sɔ' ma'aa yaa. Onɛ wʋsa tʋm dinɛ an sʋm anɛ pʋpielim sɔb wʋʋ Kristo an pʋpielim sɔb si'em la.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd anɛ Sʋntaana nid bɔzugɔ dunia pin'ilʋgʋn sa ka Sʋntaana pin'ili tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. Ka onɛ wʋsa tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd anɛ o nid. Wina'am Biig la da kena ye o san'amnɛ Sʋntaana tʋʋma.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa an Wina'am biig pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, Wina'am vʋm bɛɛ o ni la zug. Wina'am aan o Ba' la zug, o kʋ lɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa kɛ ka ti baŋ banɛ an Wina'am biis nɛ banɛ an Sʋntaana biis. Onɛ wʋsa pʋ tʋm dinɛ an sʋm, bɛɛ pʋ nɔŋ o tiraan ka' Wina'am biiga. Nɔŋimi taaba

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Labaar kanɛ ka ya da wʋm pin'ilʋgʋn sa la anɛ nɛ'ɛŋa, li sʋm ye ti nɔŋ taaba.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Da nwɛnɛ Kain onɛ an Sʋntaana nid ka da kʋʋ o mɛŋ pitʋ la. Bɔ ka o da kʋʋ o? Li anɛ o mɛŋ tʋʋma da an bɛ'ɛd, ka o pitʋ tʋʋma an sʋm la zug.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, m ba'abiisɛ, dunia nidib ya'a kisi ya, yanam da kɛ ka li lidigi yaa.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Tinam mi' ye ti yi kumin keŋ nyɔvʋrin bɔzugɔ ti nɔŋi ti ba'abiis. Onɛ wʋsa pʋ nɔŋ o ba'abiis nam bɛ nɛ kumin.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa kis o ba'abiis anɛ ninkʋʋd. Ya mi' ye ninkʋʋd pʋ mɔr nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' naar la o san'anɛ?

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Lin niŋ si'em ka ti baŋ nɔŋilim nwa': Kristo n da kpii ti yɛla la kɛ ka ti baŋ nɔŋilim an si'em. Ka li mɛ sʋ'ʋm ye tinam mɛ kpi ti ba'abiis zug.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a an arezak daan, ka nyɛ ka si'el pansig o ba'abiig, ka o pʋ zɔɔ o nimbaanliga, Wina'am nɔŋilim na niŋ wala bɛɛ o san'anɛ?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, da kɛ ka ti nɔŋilim an nɔɔrin pian'ad ma'aanɛɛ, amaa li sʋ'ʋm ka ti tʋmi li nɛ yɛlsida nɔŋilim. Mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ Wina'am tuon

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa kɛ ka ti baŋ ye ti anɛ yɛlsida dim, ka ti bɛ Wina'am tuon nɛ sʋnkpi'euŋ.

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: Hali ti pʋtɛnda ya'a mɔŋi ti bʋʋd, Wina'am gati ti pʋtɛnda ka mi' si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: M binɔŋa, ti pʋtɛnda ya'a pʋ yɛl ye ti tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, ti sʋnf kpi'em Wina'am tuon,

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: linɛ wʋsa ka ti sɔs o san'an, o na tisi ti, tinamɛ siak o nɔɔr yɛlʋg ka tʋm dinɛ malis o la zug.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Nɔɔr yɛlʋg la anɛ nwa', ye ti niŋ o Biig Yesu Kristo yadda, ka nɔŋ taaba wʋʋ on zi'el nɔɔr si'em tisi ti la.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Banɛ wʋsa siak Wina'am nɔɔr yɛlʋg bɛ nɛ Wina'am ni, ka Wina'am mɛ bɛɛ ba ni. On tisi ti o Siig Kasi la, kɛ ka ti baŋ ye o bɛɛ ti ni.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: M zuanɔŋa, da siaki onɛ wʋsa yɛl ye o mɔr Wina'am Siig Kasi laa, amaa kpansimin o sɔbi gɔs ye siig kanɛ ka o mɔr la yinɛ Wina'am san'an naa. Bɔzugɔ ziri nɔdi'esidib bɛdegʋ gilig dunia la wʋsa.

english_verse: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ na niŋ si'em baŋ Wina'am Siig Kasi la nwa': Li anɛ onɛ wʋsa nie paalʋ yɛl ye Yesu Kristo da lieb ninsaal la, onɛ mɔr Wina'am Siig Kasi la.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ wʋsa ki'is Yesu pʋ mɔr Siig kanɛ yi Wina'am san'an naa. On sɔb mɔri sibɛ'ɛd linɛ yi Kristo dataa la san'an na. Ya da wʋm ye sibɛ'ɛd onɛ ki'isid Kristo la na kena. Nannanna o pʋn bɛ dunia la ni.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, yanam anɛ Wina'am din, ka nyaŋ ziri nɔdi'esidib la. Siig Kasi kanɛ bɛɛ ya san'an la mɔr paŋ hali gat sibɛ'ɛd kanɛ bɛ dunia ni la.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Ziri nɔdi'esidib la anɛ dunia la din, linzug ka ba pian'ad dunia yɛla, ka dunia dim mɛ kɛlisidi ba.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Amaa tinam anɛ Wina'am nidib, ka onɛ wʋsa mi' Wina'am na kɛlisi ti. Ka onɛ wʋsa zi' Wina'am kʋ kɛlisi tii. Nɛ'ɛŋa ka ti na nyaŋi baŋi bak yɛlsida Siig nɛ ziri Siig. Wina'am anɛ nɔŋilim Sɔb

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: M zuanɔŋa, nɔŋilim yinɛ Wina'am san'an na, dinzug kɛlli ka ti nɔŋ taaba. Onɛ wʋsa nɔŋ o tiraan anɛ Wina'am biig, ka mi' o.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ wʋsa pʋ nɔŋ o tiraan zi' Wina'am, bɔzugɔ Wina'am anɛ nɔŋilim daan.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Wina'am nɔŋi ti si'em nwa'. O tʋm o Biyimmir dunia ni na, ka on zug ka ti na mɔr nyɔvʋr.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Nɔŋilim anɛ anwa. Li ka'anɛ tinamɛ dɛŋi nɔŋ Wina'am yiigaa. Wina'am lɛɛ dɛŋi nɔŋi ti, ka tʋm o Biig, ka o Biig la zug ka o yisi ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: M zuanama, Wina'am ya'a nɔŋi ti anwana, li sʋ'ʋm ka tinam mɛ nɔŋ taaba.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Sɔ' nan zi' nyɛ Wina'am. Amaa ti ya'a nɔŋ taaba, Wina'am bɛɛ ti ni, ka o nɔŋilim sid bɛɛ ti ni.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye ti bɛ nɛ Wina'am ni ka o mɛ bɛɛ ti ni, bɔzugɔ o tisi ti Siig la.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Ti nyɛ ya ka di kasɛt ye ti Ba' Wina'am tʋm o Biig na ka o lieb dunia dim wʋsa faangid, ka ti mɔɔli li yɛla.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa nie li paalʋ yɛl ye Yesu anɛ Wina'am Biig, Wina'am bɛɛ o san'an, ka on mɛ bɛɛ o ni.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Tinam mɛŋ baŋ nɔŋilim kanɛ ka o mɔr nɛ ti, ka ti ti'ir bɛɛ ani. Wina'am anɛ nɔŋilim sɔb. Ka onɛ wʋsa mɔr nɔŋilim bɛ nɛ Wina'am ni ka on mɛ bɛɛ o ni.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Lin an si'em la, ka nɔŋilim nie ti san'an nyain, ka li kɛ ka ti pʋ mɔr bi'esʋg sariakadib daarɛ, bɔzugɔ dunia kaŋa ni ti nwɛnɛ on an si'em la nɛ.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Nɔŋilim pʋʋgin pʋ mɔr dabiem. Nɔŋilim linɛ aan amɛŋa la ni dabiem kae, bɔzugɔ namisʋg yɛla kɛ ka dabiem bɛ. Onɛ zɔt dabiem la pʋ mɔr nɔŋilim amɛŋaa.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Ti mɔr nɔŋilim, bɔzugɔ Wina'am dɛŋi nɔŋi ti.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a yɛl ye, “Mam nɔŋ Wina'am,” ka kis o ba'abiig, o anɛ dama'am sɔb. O ya'a pʋ nɔŋ o ba'abiig onɛ ka o nini nyɛt o la, o na niŋ wala nɔŋ Wina'am onɛ ka o nini pʋ nyɛt o la.

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Nɔzi'elkaŋa ka Kristo tisi ti, ye onɛ wʋsa nɔŋ Wina'am, li sʋ'ʋm ka o nɔŋ o ba'abiis mɛn.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa siak ye Yesu an Kristo la, o anɛ Wina'am biig. Onɛ wʋsa nɔŋ dau sɔ', mɛ nɔŋ dau la biig.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Anwana kɛ ka ti baŋ ye ti nɔŋ Wina'am biis. Li anɛ tinamɛ nɔŋ Wina'am ka siakid o nɔɔr yɛlʋg wʋsa la zug.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Tinamɛ na nɔŋ Wina'am si'em nwa': asɛɛ ti siak o nɔɔr yɛlʋg la. Ka o nɔɔr yɛlʋg la pʋ tɔi galisɛ.

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa an Wina'am biig na tun'e nyaŋ dunia la. Linɛ kɛt ka ti nyaŋid dunia la anɛ ti yadda niŋir Yesu Kristo ni.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Anɔ'ɔnɛ nyaŋid dunia la? Li anɛ onɛ siak ye Yesu anɛ Wina'am Biig la ma'aa. Yesu Kristo an si'em la yɛla

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo anɛ onɛ da kena. O da kena di'e Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb ka kpi ka o ziim yi, o da pʋ kena di'e Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb ma'aanɛɛ, o mɛ da di'e kum mɛn. Ka Siig Kasi la dii li kasɛt, bɔzugɔ Siig Kasi la an yɛlsida Sɔb.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Ti mɔr kasɛtiba atan' banɛ siak ye nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ sida.

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Bʋnama atan' bama anɛ Wina'am Siig Kasi la nɛ o Wina'am ku'om sʋʋb nɛ o kum. Ka bama atan' la anɛ nɔɔr yinne.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Ti siak linɛ ka nidib yɛli ti Wina'am Biig la yɛla la, amaa Wina'am pa'ali ti si'el la gaad, bɔzugɔ li anɛ Wina'am mɛŋi pa'ali ti o Biig la yɛla.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ onɛ mɛkama siak o Biig la mi' o yɛla o sʋnfʋn. Ka onɛ mɛkama pʋ siak Wina'am, o buol o nɛ ziridaan, on pʋ siak Wina'am pa'ali ti si'el o Biig la yɛla la zug.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Kasɛt la anɛ anwa: Wina'am tisi ti nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' naarɛ, ka nyɔvʋr kaŋa bɛ nɛ o biig la ni.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Onɛ wʋsa di'e o Biig la mɔr nyɔvʋr kaŋa. Ka onɛ wʋsa pʋ di'e Wina'am Biig la, pʋ mɔr nyɔvʋr kaŋaa. Nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' naar la yɛla

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: M sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisid yanam banɛ niŋ Wina'am Biig la yadda la ye li kɛ ka ya baŋ ye ya mɔr nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka ti mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ Wina'am tuon. Ti mi' sʋ'ʋŋa ye ti ya'a sɔs si'el wʋsa ka li dɔl o bɔɔdim, o na wʋm tisi ti.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Ti ya'a baŋ ye o wʋm tisi ti, ti mɛ na baŋ ye tinamɛ sɔs si'el la ti na di'e li.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a nyɛɛ o ba'abiig ka o tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ kʋ ta'as o kuminɛ, on sɔsim Wina'am tis o, ka Wina'am na tis o nyɔvʋr. M yɛt nɛ'ɛŋanɛ tisid banɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi pʋ ta'asid kum na la. Amaa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sieba bɛ ta'asid nidib kumin. M pʋ yɛl ye ya sɔsim Wina'am din yɛlaa.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Ninsaalibi niŋid si'el wʋsa ka li ka' sʋ'ʋm la anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd Wina'am tuon. Amaa li ka' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa ta'asid nidib kuminɛ.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Ti mi' ye banɛ an Wina'am biis la pʋ kpɛn ken tuonnɛ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Wina'am Biig la mɛŋ guri ba sʋ'ʋŋa, ka Sʋntaana kʋ nyaŋi daami baa.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Ti mɛ mi' ye tinam anɛ Wina'am biis. Amaa dunia la wʋsa bɛ nɛ Sʋntaana nu'usin.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Ti mɛ lɛm mi' ye Wina'am Biig la kena ka tisi ti ya'am kanɛ gban'ad si'el gbin, linɛ na kɛ ka ti baŋ onɛ an sida sɔb la. Ka ti bɛ nɛ sida sɔb, onɛ aan o biig Yesu Kristo la. O sid anɛ Wina'am ka an onɛ tisid nyɔvʋr kanɛ ka' naarɛ.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: M biisɛ, da dɔlli linɛ ka' Wina'am.

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: Mam onɛ an kpɛɛm la sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisid fʋn kanɛ an pu'a ka Wina'am gaŋ la nɛ fʋ biis. M sid nɔŋif ka li ka'anɛ mam ma'aanɛ amaa li anɛ banɛ wʋsa mi' sida la.

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ li anɛ yɛlsida linɛ bɛɛ ti san'an, ka na kpɛm bɛɛ ti san'an yʋma dinɛ ka' naar la zug:

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ o Biig Yesu Kristo na tisi ti yɛlsʋm ka zɔɔ ti nimbaanlig ka tisi ti sumbʋgʋsʋm linɛ yit Wina'am onɛ an Yesu Kristo ba' la ni na. Lina wʋsa anɛ tinam banɛ mɔr sida nɛ nɔŋilim la din. Sida nɛ nɔŋilim

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Li malisim bɛdegʋ man nyɛ ka biis la sieba dɔl sida la nwɛnɛ ti Ba' Wina'am da zi'el nɔɔr si'em tisi ti la.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Nannanna, m zua sʋŋɔɔ, m pʋ sɔbid linɛ an zi'el paalɛ, amaa li anɛ linɛ ka ya pʋn wʋm pin'ilʋgʋn sa la. M sɔsidif nɛ ye ti nɔŋim taaba.

english_verse: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
translation_verse: Nɔŋilim la gbin anɛ ye, ti siakim Wina'am nɔɔr yɛlʋg la wʋsa. Nwɛnɛ yanamɛ da wʋm pin'ilʋgʋn sa si'em la, o nɔzi'elʋg la anɛ ye, ya bɛɛ o nɔŋilim la ni.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Ziri dim bɛdegʋ banɛ pʋ siak ye Yesu da lieb ninsaali kɛn dunia ni na la gilig dunia la wʋsa. Nimban buudi anɛ ziri dim ka an Kristo dataas.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Baŋimi ya mɛŋ ka da san'am linɛ ka ti daa tʋm tisi ya la, ka ya na di'e nyɔɔd la wʋsa.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɛkama pʋ dɔl Kristo pa'alʋgɔ, ka paas o mɛŋ pa'alʋg, o pʋ dɔl Wina'am. Onɛ mɛkama dɔl pa'alʋg la, o dɔlli ti Ba' Wina'am nɛ o Biig la.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Sɔ' ya'a kɛɛn ya san'an na ka pʋ mɔr pa'al kaŋa naa, yanam da di'e o ya yinnɛ, hali pʋn da pʋ'ʋs oo.

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Onɛ pʋ'ʋs o mɛ na lieb o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd tiraan. Pʋ'ʋsʋg

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: M mɔr pian'ad bɛdegʋ ye m yɛli ya, ka pʋ bɔɔd ye m sɔbi li gbauŋʋn tisi yaa. M tɛn'ɛs ye m na kaae ya, ka pian' tisi ya m mɛŋ. Ka ti sumalisim la an bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Fʋ bier onɛ ka Wina'am gaŋ la biis pʋ'ʋsidif sʋ'ʋŋa.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Man onɛ an kpɛɛm la sɔbid nɛ'ɛŋa tisid fʋn Gaius, onɛ ka m sid nɔŋ amɛŋa la.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: M zua nɔŋirɛ, m sɔs Wina'am ye fʋ si'el wʋsa na an sʋm, ka fʋ na bɛ laafi, ka mi' ye fʋ siig mɔr laafi Wina'am tuon.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Li malisim bɛdegʋ nɛ ti zuanam sieba paae na ka yɛl fʋn dɔl yɛlsida la sʋ'ʋŋa si'em la. Ti mi' ye fʋ bɛllim pʋʋgin fʋ dɔl yɛlsida la daar wʋsa.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Si'el kae na tisim malisim gaad man wʋm ye m biis la dɔl yɛlsida laa.

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: M zua nɔŋirɛ, fʋ anɛ yɛlsida sɔb nɛ fʋn niŋ si'eli sʋŋ yadda niŋidib la, hali la'an nɛ ban an saam la. Gaius la yɛla

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Ba tu'asi fʋ nɔŋilim la yɛla tis Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ kpɛla la. Sʋŋimi ba ka ba keŋ tuon. Kɛl ka fʋn sʋŋi ba si'em la malis Wina'am.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ Kristo tʋʋma yɛla, ka ba yii ken, ka zan'as banɛ ka' Kristo nidib la sʋŋir.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ li sʋ'ʋm ka ti sʋŋi ti tʋmtʋm taaba nwa' ka ba mɔɔl sida pian'ad la tis nidib. Diotrefes nɛ Demetrius yɛla

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: M daa sɔb si'eli tis Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛɛ fʋ teŋin la. Ka Diotrefes onɛ bɔɔd ye o niŋi ba tuongat la pʋ siak man sɔb si'el la.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: M ya'a ti kena m na tu'asi ya on tʋm si'el ka kɛɛndi ti ka ma'adi tisidi ti la. Ka lin pʋ sia'al oo, ka o lɛn zan'asi ti taaba di'er. O vi'id banɛ bɔɔd ye ba di'e ba la, ka kadi ba yis Wina'am nidib la sʋʋgin.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: M zua sʋŋɔ, da tu'asidi linɛ an bʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ. Tu'asim linɛ an sʋm. Onɛ mɛkama tʋm dinɛ an sʋm anɛ Wina'am nid. Onɛ mɛkama tʋm dinɛ an bʋmbɛ'ɛd zi' Wina'am.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Sɔ' wʋsa pian'ad Demetrius yɛla sʋ'ʋm, hali yɛlmɛŋir dim la mɛ pian'ad o yɛla sʋ'ʋm. Ka tinam mɛ dii o yɛlsida la kasɛt. Fʋn mɛŋ mi' ye ti kasɛt la anɛ sida. Pʋ'ʋsʋg

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: M mɔr pian'ad bɛdegʋ na yɛlif, ka pʋ bɔɔd ye m sɔbi niŋ gbauŋʋn nɛ.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: M mɔr ti'ir ye m na kena kaaf dabisa ayi' nwa' ni, ka ti pian' tis taaba.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Sumalisim bɛ nɛf. Fʋ zuanam wʋsa pʋ'ʋsidif. Pʋ'ʋsimi ti zuanam la yinne-yinne tisi ti.

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: M zuanɔŋa, m kpɛ'ɛŋi m mɛŋ hali ye m sɔbi tisi ya faangir linɛ aan ti wʋsa din la yɛla. Li nar ye m sa'ali ya ye ya mɔ nɛ banɛ bɔɔd ye ba san'am pa'alʋg linɛ ka ti siak ka Wina'am niŋ o nidib nu'usin vuguri la.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Nidib banɛ ka kʋdimin dim da kʋʋsi ba yɛla bɛ'ɛd la su'a gɛndigi ya sʋʋgin. Ba anɛ banɛ zi' Wina'am ka tiak o pʋpielim piini la tʋm tʋʋmyaalis, ka ki'isid Yesu Kristo onɛ aan ti kpi'euŋ sɔb nɛ ti Zugsɔb gʋllim la.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ yanamɛ dɛŋi baŋi li sʋ'ʋŋa la, m bɔɔd ye m tiɛn ya ye Wina'am an onɛ da faaɛn o nidib Egipt teŋin, ka li nya'aŋ ka o da kʋʋ ba sieba banɛ pʋ niŋ o yadda la.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Maliaknam banɛ mɛ da basi ba sʋ'ʋlim ka bas linɛ sid aan ba bɛllim zin'ig la, Wina'am da lɔɔ ba nɛ bana banɛ ka' san'auŋɔ, ka niŋi ba likinɛ gur sariakadib dabistita'ar la daar.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka Sodom nɛ Gomora dim nɛ tɛɛns banɛ kpi'e ba la da tʋm dian'ad tʋʋma nɛ tʋʋmyaalis, ka nyɛ namisʋgʋ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la yɛla, ka banɛ namis bugum linɛ pʋ kpiigid ni la, an sa'alʋgʋ tisi ti.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn ka banɛ zi' Wina'am la kpɛn dɔl zaansima ka li kɛ ka ba dian'adi ba mɛŋ, ka zan'as kpi'euŋ dim ka tʋ'ʋd banɛ mɔr paŋi bɛɛ agɔla la.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Hali maliak kpɛɛm, Maikel n da nwa'asid nɛ Sʋntaana Moses onɛ da kpi la niŋgbiŋ yɛla la, da pʋ kpi'em ye o zɛrig Sʋntaanaa, amaa ka lɛɛ yɛl ye, Zugsɔb la na namis o.

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Amaa nimbama nwa' tʋ'ʋd linɛ mɛkama zu'oe gaadi ba ya'am baŋir. Nimbama nwɛnɛ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ ka' ya'am ka mi'inɛ ban na si'isi ba niŋgbiŋ wʋʋ bʋnkɔnbid banɛ pʋ tɛn'ɛsid si'em la, ka li na kɛ ka ba san'ami ba mɛŋ.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Tɔɔg na paae ba! Ban tuund Kain suoya ka pɛsigi ba mɛŋi dɔl suobɛ'ɛd wʋʋ Balaam da pɔ'ɔg ka dɔl suobɛ'ɛd ye o nyɛ nyɔɔd, ka kpi mɛn wʋʋ Kora nɛ sieba da zan'as Wina'am nɔɔr ka kpi si'em la.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Nimbama anɛ banɛ mɔr gbada ka la'am diti ya nɔŋilim dikanɛ ka ya dit nɛ taaba la, ba mɔr nyɛɛsim ka mɔɔd ye ba sʋŋidi ba mɛŋ ma'aa. Ba nwɛnɛ saŋgbana banɛ ka saa kae ka sisi'em da'adi li ken, ka nwɛnɛ tiis banɛ pʋ mɔr wala, ba walib saŋaa. Ba kpinɛ tɔl ka ba vɔɔn ba bas.

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: Ba lɛn nwɛnɛ atɛuk ku'opila banɛ mɔr paŋ hali ka da'ad pumpuum linɛ aan ba nyan tʋʋma la, ka lɛn nwɛnɛ nwadbibis banɛ gɔɔnd ka Wina'am ti'eb lik tita'ari guri ba saŋa kanɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Enok onɛ yi Adam tuŋʋn na ka an zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ paas ayɔpɔi la, da di'e Wina'am pian'adi tis nidib la ye, “Gɔsimi, Zugsɔb la kenna nɛ o maliaknam tusa-tusa

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: ye o kad saalib wʋsa saria, ka kʋʋs tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim wʋsa banɛ pʋ dɔl Wina'am suorɛ, ka tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka pʋ mɔr ya'a nɛ Wina'am ka pian'ad pian'abɛ'ɛdi ki'isid o la.”

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Ba anɛ banɛ nyɔn hali ka zɛrigidi ba taaba; ka niŋid bɛ'ɛd linɛ aan ba mɛŋ ya'amlɛog, ba nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg hali, ka pian'ad nɛ nɔŋgban malisiŋ ye ba nyɛ ban bɔɔd si'el. Sa'alʋg

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: M zuanɔŋa, tɛnri yɛl kanɛ ka ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo tʋmtʋmnib da dɛŋi pian' ye li na niŋ la.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: Ba da yɛli ya ye naar saŋa la, ninla'adib na bɛ, banɛ la'ad Wina'am ka dɔl saalib ya'amlɛog bɔɔdim ka pʋ dɔl Wina'am suor la.

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Nimbama nwa' ziidi wɛligiri kenna. Ba mɔri saalib itʋŋ ma'aa ka Wina'am Siig Kasi ka' ba nii.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Amaa m zuanɔŋa, yanam lɛɛ sʋŋimi taaba ka kpɛ'ɛŋi ya Wina'am yadda niŋir linɛ an kasi la ni, ka kɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi sʋŋi ya nɛ ya winsɔsʋgin.

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Kpɛlimmi Wina'am nɔŋilimin la guri ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo nimbaanlzɔɔr linɛ ta'asid nyɔvʋr dinɛ ka' naar la.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Zɔm banɛ bi'esid la nimbaanlig.

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Tɛɛgim sieba yis bugumin na ka faaɛn ba. Ka zɔ sieba nimbaanlig nɛ dabiem, amaa gu'usim ka da kpɛn' ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ dian'a ba la nii. Wina'am zʋn'or

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: On gʋllim aan ti Wina'am nɛ ti faangid, o na nyɛ na'asi nɛ girima nɛ kpi'euŋ ka li yinɛ ti Zugsɔb Yesu Kristo san'an yʋma banɛ gaad la nɛ nannanna nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ. Ami.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Yɛlbanɛ ka Yesu Kristo da nie pa'al o tʋmtʋmnib la sɔbnɛ gbauŋ kaŋa ni. Wina'am da nie nɛ'ɛŋa ye o bigis o tʋmtʋmnib yɛlbanɛ na kena ka li kʋ yuugɛ. Kristo da tʋmnɛ maliak o tʋmtʋm Joon san'an ka o yɛl o yɛlbama.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Joon da yɛl bʋn linɛ ka o nyɛ la wʋsa. Ka nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa anɛ labaar kanɛ yi Wina'am san'an na, nɛ yɛlsida linɛ ka Yesu Kristo da nie pa'al o la.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
translation_verse: Albareka bɛ nɛ onɛ karim Wina'am nɔɔr pian'ʋk kanɛ ka o nɔdi'es da pian' la nɛ banɛ wʋmi li ka siak bʋn linɛ sɔb gbauŋ kaŋa nwa' ni la. Bɔzugɔ saŋa la li'el ya ka nɛ'ɛŋanam na niŋ. Joon pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am nidib banɛ la'as tɛɛnsa ayɔpɔi la

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Man Joon n sɔbid gbauŋ kaŋa tisid karindɔɔd ayɔpɔi banɛ bɛ Asia sʋ'ʋlimin la. Wina'am onɛ da bɛ, ka kpɛm bɛ, ka na ti bɛ la, nɛ siisa ayɔpɔi banɛ bɛɛ o na'am gbauŋ tuon la, nɛ Yesu Kristo onɛ dit kasɛt Wina'am yɛla nɛ sida ka an onɛ da vʋ'ʋg kumin yiiga ka an dunia na'anam na'ab la na tisi ya yɛlsʋm nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm. Yesu Kristo nɔŋi ti ka kpi ka o ziim yisi ti, ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: ka kɛ ka ti an na'anam nɛ maanmaannib ka tʋmmi tisid o Ba' Wina'am. O na nyɛ zʋn'or nɛ na'am, saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Ami.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Gɔsimi, onɛ kenna nɛ saŋgbana la. Sɔ' mɛkama na nyɛɛ o, la'an nɛ banɛ kʋns o la. O ya'a ti kena, dunia buudi wʋsa na kum o yɛla. Sida, li na niŋ. Ami.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Zugsɔb Wina'am la yɛl ye, “Manɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb ka da bɛ, ka nam bɛ, ka na ti bɛ la. Manɛ an Alfa nɛ Omega.” Joon n da nyɛ Kristo la yɛla

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Man Joon anɛ ya ba'abiig onɛ la'as nɛ ya Yesu sʋ'ʋlimin, ka dit fara ka mɔdigid nɛ ya tinamɛ an yinne nɛ Yesu la zug. Man daa mɔɔn Wina'am pian'ad ka yɛt man mi' si'el Yesu Kristo yɛla la zug, ka ba daa mɔrimi keŋ Patmos teŋ kanɛ ka ku'om giligi li la.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Zugsɔb la dabisir la daar ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la kpɛn'ɛm, ka m wʋm kʋkɔtita'ar linɛ kum wʋʋ na'atannɛ piebidi m nya'aŋ nɛ.

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: Ka li yɛl ye, “Sɔm linɛ ka fʋ nyɛ la digil, ka zaŋ gbauŋ la tɔlim tis karindɔɔd ayɔpɔi banɛ an Efesus nɛ Smirna nɛ Pergamum nɛ Tiatira nɛ Sardis nɛ Filadelfia nɛ Laodisea dim la.”

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Man fɛndig ye m gɔs ye anɔ'ɔnɛ pian'adi tisidim la, ka nyɛ sanlima fitazi'esa ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' zi'e ba sʋʋgin nwɛnɛ Ninsaal Biig la yɛ fuug linɛ wa'ami paae o nɔba. Ka sanlima sɛnbidiŋ lɔɔ o nyɔ'ɔg.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: Ka o zuobid pɛligi nwɛnɛ gungum bɛɛ sakuga nɛ. Ka o nini nwɛnɛ bugum pielim nɛ.

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: Ka o nɔba nyɛɛn nwɛnɛ kʋntzɛn'ug ka ba nyɛligi li bugumin ka duusi li ka li lieb nyain. Ka o kʋkɔr vuud nwɛnɛ ku'om na zɔt ka suugid nɛ paŋ si'em la.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: Ka o mɔr nwadbibis ayɔpɔi o datiuŋ nu'ugin. Ka sʋ'ʋraug linɛ dit tuon nɛ nya'aŋ yi o nɔɔrin na. Ka o nindaa nyɛɛn nwɛnɛ nintaŋ tisʋʋs winnig nɛ.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Man daa nyɛɛ o la m igin o tuon ka nwɛnɛ ninkanɛ kpi nɛ. Ka o zaŋ o datiuŋ nu'ugʋ pa'alim zug ka ye, “Da zɔt dabiem, ka manɛ an yiiga nɛ nya'aŋ daan la.

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Manɛ an onɛ vʋe la. M daa kpinɛ, amaa m yʋ'ʋn vʋe saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ, ka mɔr kum nɛ kpi'im teŋ saafinam.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: “Dinzug, sɔm bʋn linɛ ka fʋ nyɛ la, linɛ bɛ nannanna, nɛ linɛ na ti niŋ nya'aŋ.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Nwadbibis ayɔpɔi linɛ ka fʋ nyɛ m datiuŋ nu'ugin nɛ sanlima fitazi'esa ayɔpɔi la yɛlsu'ada la gbin anɛ anwa: Nwadbibis ayɔpɔi la anɛ Wina'am nimbanɛ la'as zin'isa ayɔpɔi la maliaknam, ka fitazi'esa ayɔpɔi la an Wina'am nimbanɛ la'as zin'isa ayɔpɔi la.”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ka man nyɛ sɔ' la yɛlim ye, “Sɔm nɛ'ɛŋa tis maliak onɛ bɛ Efesus karindɔɔgin la. Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ tɔlʋŋ dinɛ yi onɛ mɔr nwadbibis ayɔpɔi o datiuŋ nu'ugin la na, onɛ ken sanlima fitazi'esa ayɔpɔi sʋʋgin la.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: Tɔlʋŋ la nwa': ‘M mi' yanamɛ tʋm si'em nɛ yanamɛ kpɛ'ɛŋidi ya mɛŋ si'em. M mi' ya summɔtiri an si'em, ka mi' ye ya pʋ siakidi di'ed nimbɛ'ɛdnama, ka mak banɛ ye ba anɛ Kristo tʋmtʋmnib amaa ka ka' ala la gɔs ka nyɛ ka ba anɛ ziri dim.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: M mi' ye ya mɔdigid ka namisid man zug ka pʋ gɛɛn basɛ.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: La'an nɛ wala man nyɛɛ ya taali an si'em nwa'. Ya pʋ nɔŋim wʋʋ yanamɛ daa pin'ili dɔllim ka nɔŋim si'em laa.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Tiɛnmi yanamɛ daa niŋid si'em ka bas la. Tiakimi ya tʋʋma ka tʋm yanamɛ daa dɛŋi tʋm si'em yiiga la. Ya ya'a pʋ tiaki ya suoya, m na kɛɛn ya san'an na nɔki ya fita zi'esir la yisi li zin'igin.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Amaa nɛ'ɛŋa ka ya niŋid ka li an sʋm. Ya kis linɛ ka Nikolaitan nidib la niŋid, nwɛnɛ man kisi li si'em la.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: Onɛ mɔr tʋba na wʋm, on wʋm linɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la yɛt karindɔɔd la. Onɛ nyaŋ yɛlbɛ'ɛd wʋsa, m na tis o suor ka o di tiig linɛ tisid nyɔvʋr ka bɛ Wina'am lɔmbɔn'ɔgin la wala.’” Kristo tɔlʋŋ kanɛ an Smirna dim din la yɛla

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ka man nyɛ sɔ' la lɛn yɛlim ye, “Sɔm nɛ'ɛŋa tis maliak onɛ bɛ Wina'am nimbanɛ bɛ Smirna teŋin la. Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ tɔlʋŋ linɛ yi onɛ an yiiga nɛ nya'aŋ la ni na, onɛ da kpi ka lɛn vʋ'ʋg la.

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: “Tɔlʋŋ la nwa': ‘M mi' ya namisʋg la yɛla, ka mi' ye ya anɛ nɔŋ dim, amaa sida ya anɛ kpan'am dim, ka mi' pian'abɛ'ɛd din ka banɛ yɛl ye ba anɛ Jew dim ka ka' ala la pian'adi ya yɛla. Ba anɛ Sʋntaana nidib.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Da zɔ yanamɛ ye ya di fara si'a la dabiem. Kɛlisimi! Sʋntaana na kɛ ka ba kpɛn'ɛsi ya sanrega ni maki ya, ka ya na nyɛ namisʋg dabpiiga. Niŋimini m yadda hali li ya'a anɛ kum, ka m na tisi ya piini linɛ an nyɔvʋr.’

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: “Onɛ mɔr tʋba na wʋm, on wʋm linɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la yɛt karindɔɔd la. Onɛ nyaŋ yɛlbɛ'ɛd wʋsa la, kum kanɛ paasid ayi' la kʋ niŋ o si'ela.” Kristo tɔlʋŋ kanɛ an Pergamum dim din la yɛla

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ka man nyɛ sɔ' la lɛn yɛlim ye, “Sɔm nɛ'ɛŋa tis maliak onɛ bɛ Pergamum karindɔɔgin la. Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ tɔlʋŋ kanɛ yi onɛ mɔr sʋ'ʋraug dinɛ ka li tuon nɛ nya'aŋ wʋsa dit la ni na.

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: “Tɔlʋŋ la nwa': ‘M mi' ye yanamɛ bɛ si'el la anɛ zin'ikanɛ ka Sʋntaana na'am gbauŋ bɛ. Amaa ya dɔllim nɛ sida, hali saŋkanɛ ka ba daa kʋ Antipas onɛ daa diti m kasɛt nɛ sida tisid nidibi ya teŋin la, zin'ikanɛ ka Sʋntaana bɛ la, ya nan kpɛn niŋidim yadda.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Amaa ya taal anɛ anwa bi'ela. Sieba bɛɛ ya ni ka dɔl Balaam onɛ da pa'al Balak on na niŋ si'em kɛ ka Israel dim tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la pa'alʋg. O da kɛ ka ba di ba'ar diib, ka mɛ kɛ ka dap nɛ pu'ab san'am taaba.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Ala mɛn, yanam mɛ mɔr nidibi ya ni ka ba dɔl Nikolaitan dim pa'alʋg.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Tiakimini ya suoya, ya'a ka' alaa, m na kena zab nɛ nimban dim nɛ sʋ'ʋraug linɛ yiti m nɔɔrin na la.’

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: “Onɛ mɔr tʋba na wʋm, on wʋm linɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la yɛt karindɔɔd la. Onɛ nyaŋ yɛlbɛ'ɛd wʋsa, m na tis o diib linɛ yit saazug la na ka o di, ka tisi ba wʋsa yinne-yinne kugpiel linɛ zug ka yʋ'ʋpaal sɔb la, sɔ' kʋ baŋi lii, asɛɛ onɛ di'e li la.” Kristo tɔlʋŋ kanɛ an Tiatira dim din la yɛla

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ka man nyɛ sɔ' la lɛn yɛlim ye, “Sɔm nɛ'ɛŋa tis maliak onɛ bɛ Tiatira karindɔɔgin la. Li anɛ tɔlʋŋ kanɛ yi Wina'am Biig onɛ nini nwɛnɛ bugum pielim, ka o nɔba nyɛɛnnɛ nwɛnɛ kʋntzɛn'ug ka ba duus la ni na.

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: “Tɔlʋŋ la nwa': M mi' ya tʋʋma nɛ ya nɔŋilim nɛ ya yadda niŋir nɛ yanamɛ niŋid si'el la'an nɛ ya summɔtir la, ka lɛm mi' ye ya tʋm nannanna gat yanamɛ daa pin'ili dɔllim ka tʋm si'em la.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: “Amaa man nyɛɛ ya taal si'em nwa'. Ya siaki di'e Jezebɛl, pu'a kanɛ yɛl ye o anɛ Wina'am nɔdi'es la. O pa'alʋg la ma'adi m tʋmtʋmnib la kpɛn'ɛsid mɔɔg, ka pu'ab nɛ dap san'amid taaba, ka dit bada diib.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: M tis o saŋa ye o tiak o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd, amaa o pʋ bɔɔd ye o bas o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd laa.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Dinzug m na kɛ ka o digin nɛ namisʋg. Ka banɛ la'as nɛ o tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ya'a pʋ basi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la, ban mɛ na namis bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: M na kɛ ka o biis kpi. Ka karindɔɔd la wʋsa na baŋ ye manɛ an onɛ mi' nidib pʋtɛnda nɛ ba bɔɔdim la, ka yɔ sɔ' mɛkama wʋsa wʋʋ on tʋm si'em.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: Amaa ya sieba banɛ bɛ Tiatira ka pʋ dɔl pa'alkaŋa, ka mɛ pʋ zamis linɛ ka sieba buon Sʋntaana yɛlsu'ada la, m kʋ mɔr ziid na ziili yaa.

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Amaa gban'ami linɛ ka ya mɔr la kiŋ-kiŋ hali nɛ mam na ti kena.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Onɛ mɔr tʋba na wʋm, on wʋm linɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la yɛt karindɔɔd la.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: Ka man nyɛ sɔ' la lɛn yɛlim ye, “Sɔm nɛ'ɛŋa tis maliak onɛ bɛ Sardis karindɔɔgin la. Nɛ'ɛŋa an tɔlʋŋ kanɛ yi onɛ mɔr Wina'am siisa ayɔpɔi nɛ nwadbibis ayɔpɔi la ni na. “Tɔlʋŋ la nwa': ‘M mi' ya tʋʋma an si'em; nidib tɛn'ɛsid ye ya vʋe amaa ya kpinɛ.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Dinzug, duomi ka kpɛmis linɛ kpɛlim ka bɔɔd kum la, ka ya tʋʋma la pʋ tig Wina'am nini.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Tɛnri pa'alʋg kanɛ ka ya daa wʋm ka di'e la. Siakimini li ka tiaki ya sʋnya. Ya ya'a pʋ tiakɛ, m na kɛɛn ya san'an na nwɛnɛ na'ayiig nɛ, hali ka ya kʋ baŋ saŋkanɛ ka m na kenaa.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: “‘Amaa ya nidib bi'ela bɛ Sardis ka pʋ dian'a ba fuudɛ. Ban na yɛ fupiela dɔllim, ban nar la zug.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Onɛ nyaŋ yɛlbɛ'ɛd wʋsa na ti yɛ fupiela wʋʋ ban nɛ, m kʋ kpiis o yʋ'ʋr nyɔvʋpaal dim gbauŋʋn laa, ka na yɛli m Ba' nɛ o maliaknam la san'an nyain ye o anɛ man nid.’

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: “Onɛ mɔr tʋba na wʋm, on wʋm linɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la yɛt karindɔɔd la.” Kristo tɔlʋŋ linɛ an Filadelfia dim din la yɛla

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ka man nyɛ sɔ' la lɛn yɛlim ye, “Sɔm nɛ'ɛŋa tis maliak onɛ bɛ Filadelfia karindɔɔgin la. Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ tɔlʋŋ dinɛ yi onɛ an kasi ka an sida sɔb la ni na, onɛ mɔr David saafi la, ka yɔ'ɔgid ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi yɔɔ, ka yɔɔd ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi yɔ'ɔgɛ.

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: “Tɔlʋŋ la nwa': ‘M mi' ya tʋʋma an si'em. Gɔsimiya, m yɔ'ɔg kʋlʋŋʋ tisi ya ka sɔ' kae na nyaŋi yɔɔ. M mi' ye ya paŋ pʋ zu'oe, la'an nɛ wala, ya siaki m pian'ad la ka pʋ ki'is ye ya zi' ma.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Gɔsima, banɛ an Sʋntaana nidib ka an ziri dim ka ma' ye ba anɛ Jew dim, ka ka' Jew dim la, m na kɛ ka ba kena igini ya tuon ka baŋ ye m nɔŋi ya.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Yanamɛ siaki m nɔzi'elʋg ka mɔdig la zug, m mɛ na mɔri ya sʋ'ʋŋa ka ya kʋ kpɛn' yɛlkanɛ na ti kɛn dunia ni na mak dunia nidib wʋsa laa.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: M na kɛn nannanna na. Gban'ami yanamɛ mɔr si'el la sʋ'ʋŋa, ka sɔ' da nyaŋi faaɛn ya yɔɔd la.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Onɛ nyaŋ yɛlbɛ'ɛd wʋsa, m na maal o ka o an zan'antɔligʋ m Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir ka kʋdim kʋ lɛn yii aninaa. Ka m na sɔbi m Wina'am yʋ'ʋri tabil o zugin, nɛ m Wina'am teŋ Jerusalem Paal dinɛ na yi Wina'am san'an arezana nii sig na la yʋ'ʋr, ka mɛ na sɔbi m mɛŋ yʋ'ʋpaali tabil o.’

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: “Onɛ mɔr tʋba na wʋm, on wʋm dinɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la yɛt karindɔɔd la.” Kristo tɔlʋŋ linɛ an Laodisea dim din la yɛla

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ka man nyɛ sɔ' la lɛn yɛlim ye, “Sɔm nɛ'ɛŋa tis maliak onɛ bɛ Laodisea karindɔɔgin la. Li anɛ tɔlʋŋ dinɛ yi onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Ami la ni na; onɛ an sida sɔb ka dit kasɛt linɛ an sida la, ka sʋ'oe bʋn linɛ ka Wina'am maal la wʋsa.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: “Tɔlʋŋ la nwa': ‘M mi' ya tʋʋma an si'em ka mi' ye ya pʋ ma'asa ka mɛ pʋ tʋllaa. Man bɔɔdin nɛ yanamɛ naan aan ma'asiga bɛɛ yanamɛ naan aan tʋʋliga.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Amaa yanamɛ sadigim pʋ ma'as bɛɛ tʋlli m tʋʋma ni la, m na tʋbisi ya yisi m nɔɔrin.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Ya yɛt ye ya anɛ kpan'am dim ka mɔr dinɛ ka ya bɔɔd ka si'el pʋ pansigi yaa. Ka zi' yanamɛ mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ nimbaanlig si'em. Ya anɛ nɔŋ dim ka an sawɛnya nɛ zʋnzɔɔs.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ m san'anɛ ya nɛ ye ya da' sanlima linɛ an sanlim sʋŋ man ni ka paam kpan'am, ka mɛ lɛn da' fupiela lusi ya sawɛnya la, ka da' tiim niŋi ya nini la ka tun'e nyɛt.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Banɛ ka m nɔŋ la ka m tansid ka tɛɛgidi ba tʋba. Dinzugɔ tiakimini ya suoya nɛ nimmua ka da di'emidiya.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Kɛlisimi. M zi'enɛ za'anɔɔrini kabirid. Ka sɔ' ya'a wʋmi m kʋkɔr ka siak, m na kpɛn' o yin na ka man nɛ on la'asi di.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: “‘Onɛ nyaŋ yɛlbɛ'ɛd wʋsa, m na tis o suor ka o la'asi zin' nɛ mam, m na'am gbauŋ la zug, nwɛnɛ man nyaŋ yɛlbɛ'ɛd wʋsa ka la'as nɛ m Ba' Wina'am zin' o na'am gbauŋ zug si'em la.’

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: “Onɛ mɔr tʋba na wʋm, on wʋm linɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la yɛt karindɔɔd la.”

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa nya'aŋ ka m nyɛ, ka arezana kʋlʋŋ yɔ'ɔg. Ka kʋkɔr kanɛ ka m dɛŋi wʋm la pian'adi tisidim ka li vuud nwɛnɛ na'atannɛ. Ka li yɛlim ye, “Dʋm kpɛla na, ka m na pa'alif dinɛ na niŋ nɛ'ɛŋa nya'aŋ.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Li pʋ yuugɛ ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la kpɛn'ɛm, ka m nyɛ ka na'am gbauŋ dig arezana ni ka sɔ' zin' li zug.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Ka o nindaa nyɛɛnnɛ nwɛnɛ kugvɛnla linɛ yʋ'ʋri buon jaspa nɛ kanelian la. Ka saa dindɛog buoɛn gilig na'am gbauŋ la, ka dindɛog la bɔɔnsim an dɛn'ɛm.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Ka na'am gbana pisi nɛ anaasi gilig na'am gbauŋ la, ka kpɛɛmnam pisi nɛ anaasi yɛ fupiela ka pid sanlima zupibisi zin' ba zug.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Ka sa-ian'asʋg yit gbauŋ la ni na nɛ vuud nɛ satansʋg. Ka fita ayɔpɔi la'aŋi dit na'am gbauŋ la tuon. Bama an Wina'am siisa ayɔpɔi la.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Ka si'el nwɛnɛ mu'ari dig na'am gbauŋ la tuonnɛ nwɛnɛ gɔtiŋi nie nyain. Ka bʋnvʋya anaasi zi'e gilig na'am gbauŋ la, ka nini pɛ'ɛli ba tuon nɛ nya'aŋ wʋsa.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Ka yiiga bʋnvʋr la nwɛnɛ gbigim nɛ, ka onɛ tia'al la nwɛnɛ na'araug nɛ, ka onɛ tia'al atan' la mɔr ninsaal nindaa. Ka bʋnvʋr onɛ tia'al anaasi la nwɛnɛ siltita'ar kanɛ ian'adnɛ.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Ka bʋnvʋya la yinne wʋsa mɔr kpʋkpama ayuobʋ, ka mɔr nini zin'ig wʋsa, hali nɛ ba kpʋkpama lɛŋʋn. Ka yʋ'ʋm yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa ka pʋ basida yɛt ye, “Kasi! Kasi! Kasi! Ti Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la anɛ kasi. Onɛ da bɛ, ka nan bɛ, ka na ti bɛ la.”

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ka bʋnvʋya anaasi la ya'a ɛɛnti zun'od ka na'asid onɛ bɛ saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ ka zin' na'am gbauŋ zug ka pʋ'ʋsid o bareka la,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “Ti Zugsɔb Wina'am fʋnɛ nar nɛ fʋn na di'e pipilim nɛ na'asi nɛ zʋn'or nɛ paŋ, bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ maal si'el wʋsa, li anɛ fʋ bɔɔdim ka fʋ maali ba ka ba bɛ la.”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ gbauŋ ka li sɔbi li tuon nɛ nya'aŋ, ka li tabil nɛ titabir zin'isa ayɔpɔi. Ka onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ la zug mɔri li o datiuŋ.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ maliak kanɛ mɔr paŋ hali ka o mɔɔnnɛ tansid ye, “Anɔ'ɔnɛ nar ka na nyaŋi lak titabir la ka yɔ'ɔg gbauŋ la?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Amaa sɔ' daa kae arezana ni bɛɛ dunia ni bɛɛ teŋ teŋiri na nyaŋi lak gbauŋ la gɔsi li pʋʋginɛ.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Ka m kaas hali, bɔzugɔ sɔ' daa kae nar nɛ on na lak gbauŋ la bɛɛ gɔsi li pʋʋgin la zug.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Ka kpɛɛmnam la ni yinne yɛlim ye, “Da kaasida. Gɔsima, onɛ an Juda dɔɔg gbigim ka an na'ab David yaaŋ la, nyaŋ yɛlbɛ'ɛd wʋsa ka na nyaŋi yɔ'ɔg gbauŋ la nɛ titabir linɛ tabil zin'isa ayɔpɔi la.”

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ Pɛbil ka o zi'e na'am gbauŋ dinɛ ka bʋnvʋya anaasi nɛ kpɛɛmnam gilig la teŋsʋk. Ka Pɛbil la nwɛnɛ onɛ ka ba daa kʋ o, ka o vʋ'ʋg kumin, ka mɔr iila ayɔpɔi nɛ nini ayɔpɔi dinɛ an Wina'am siisa ayɔpɔi banɛ ka o tʋm dunia wʋsa ni na la.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Ka Pɛbil la keŋ di'e gbauŋ la onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug la datiuŋ.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Ka ba yʋ'ʋm yʋʋm paalli yɛt ye, “Fʋnɛ nar nɛ fʋn na di'e gbauŋ la, ka laki li titabir la, bɔzugɔ ba daa kʋʋf nɛ. Ka fʋ ziim la faaɛn ninsaal buudi wʋsa nɛ pian'ad gʋn-gʋn nɛ buudi gʋn-gʋn la'an nɛ sʋ'ʋlim gʋn-gʋn, ka ba lieb Wina'am din.

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: Fʋ maali ba ka ba an sʋ'ʋlim na'anam nɛ maanmaannib ye ba tʋm Wina'am tʋʋma, ka na di na'am dunia ni.”

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Ka m gɔs ka nyɛ maliaknam tusa-tusa, ka ba zi'eni gilig na'am gbauŋ la nɛ bʋnvʋya anaasi nɛ kpɛɛmnam la.

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm ka ba dʋ'ʋsidi ba kʋkɔya yʋ'ʋmmi yɛt ye, Pɛbil onɛ ka ba da kʋ ka o vʋ'ʋg la nar ye o di'e paŋ nɛ kpan'am nɛ ya'am nɛ kpi'euŋ nɛ na'asi nɛ zʋn'or nɛ sɛn'uŋ.

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm ka bʋnvʋr mɛkama linɛ bɛ arezana ni nɛ dunia ni nɛ teŋ teŋir nɛ atɛukʋn wʋsa yɛt ye, “Bareka nɛ na'asi nɛ zʋn'or nɛ paŋ bɛ nɛ Pɛbil la nɛ onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug la saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.”

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Ka bʋnvʋya anaasi la siak ye, “Ami.” Ka kpɛɛmnam la vanbini zun'e Pɛbil la nɛ onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug la.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ ka Pɛbil la lak titabir linɛ tabil zin'isa ayɔpɔi la yinne. Ka m wʋm ka bʋnvʋya anaasi la yinne yɛl nɛ kʋkɔr dinɛ nwɛnɛ satansʋg nɛ ye, “Kem na.”

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: Ka m gɔsi nyɛ wiedpiel. Ka onɛ ban'ad o la mɔr tiraug. Ka ba tis o na'am zupibig. Ka o yina an paŋ daan ye o zabi nyaŋ si'el wʋsa.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ka Pɛbil la lak titabir kanɛ tabili paas ayi' la. Ka m wʋm ka bʋnvʋr onɛ paas ayi' la yɛl ye, “Kem na.”

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Ka wiedzin'a mɛ yina. Ka ba tis onɛ ban'ad o la paŋ ye o sa'as zaba dunia ni ka nidib kʋ taaba. Ka o di'e zaba sʋ'ʋtita'ar.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Ka Pɛbil la lak titabir kanɛ tabili paas atan' la. Ka m wʋm ka bʋnvʋr onɛ paas atan' la yɛl ye, “Kem na.” Ka m gɔs ka wiedsabilig bɛ anina. Ka onɛ ban'ad la mɔr linɛ makid la o nu'ugin.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm ka si'el vuudi nwɛnɛ kʋkɔr linɛ yi bʋnvʋya anaasi la sʋʋgin yɛt ye, “Ki makir ligidi na zem nidi na tʋm daar yinne tʋʋma yɔɔd. Ka kizɛn'ug bʋtiŋ bibis atan' mɛ an nid daar yinne tʋʋma yɔɔd. Amaa da san'ami kpaam nɛ daam laa.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ka Pɛbil la lak titabir linɛ tabili paas anaasi la, ka m wʋm ka bʋnvʋr onɛ paas anaasi la yɛl ye, “Kem na.”

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ ka wiedpipɛlʋg bɛɛ anina, ka onɛ ban'ad o la yʋ'ʋr buon Akum, ka bam buon zin'isi'a ye Kpi'im Teŋ la, dɔl o nya'aŋ. Ka ba tis Akum nɛ Kpi'im Teŋ dunia pʋdigir yinne pʋdigir anaasi la ni ye ba sʋ'oe, ka kʋʋd nidib nɛ zaba sʋ'ʋg nɛ kɔ'ɔm nɛ wiim nɛ bʋnyuos banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ zug.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Ka on lak titabir linɛ tabili paas anu la, ka m nyɛ banɛ ka ba kʋʋ ba, ban mɔɔn Wina'am pian'ad ka dit kasɛt linɛ an yɛlsida la zug, ka ba bɛ maan bimbim la teŋir,

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: ka tansid ye, “Zugsɔb tita'ar, onɛ an kasi nɛ sida sɔba, li na yuugi paae wala ka fʋ na kad nidib nwa' saria ka namisi ba ka tɛki ba tʋba ban kʋʋd nidib la yɛla?”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Ka ba tisi ba wʋsa fupiela, ka yɛli ba ye, “Vʋ'ʋsimi bi'ela ka guri ya tʋmtʋm taaba banɛ an yadda niŋidib ka kpɛlim dunia ni la, ka ba ti kʋʋ ba nwɛnɛ ban kʋ yanam si'em la, ka ba kal la bɛn paae.”

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ ka o lak titabir linɛ tabili paas ayuobʋ la. Ka teŋ dam bɛdegʋ, ka nintaŋ kilim liki sɔbig wʋʋ vugulimnɛ, ka nwadig la wʋsa mu'oe nwɛnɛ ziim nɛ.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Ka nwadbibis la yi saŋgbauŋin lit teŋin na nwɛnɛ kekama ka sisi'em ɛɛnti da'adi fanrid kekaŋ kansa ka li sʋʋgidi lit teŋin si'em la.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Ka saŋgbauŋ la mɛlim nwɛnɛ gbauŋ ka ba kpilim nɛ. Ka zuoya nɛ tɛɛns banɛ ka ku'om gilig la wʋsa vurisi tɔɔm.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Ka dunia na'anam nɛ nintitada nɛ soogia kpɛɛmnam nɛ kpan'am dim nɛ paŋ dim nɛ sɔ' wʋsa, yammis nɛ banɛ ka' yammis wʋsa, na su'a tampinlɛma ni nɛ tampiins sian'asim zuoya zut,

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: ka tans zuoya la nɛ tampiins la ye, “Lim diinli ti ka su'a ti, ka onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug la da nyɛɛ ti, ka Pɛbil la mɛ kʋ nyɛɛ ti nɛ o sʋnpɛɛn la.

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Ka Pɛbil la nɛ onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug la sʋnpɛɛn dabistita'ar paae na, ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi zi'enɛ o sʋnpɛɛn la tuonnɛ.”

english_verse: from Benjamin. People from Every Nation
translation_verse: ) ka yi Israel dim dɔɔd la wʋsa ni na.

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: “Da pu'alim teŋ la bɛɛ atɛuk la bɛɛ tiisɛ, asɛɛ ka ba ti zanbil tʋmtʋmnib la zanbina ba gbɛ'ɛdin.”

english_verse: Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm banɛ ka ba zanbili ba nɛ Wina'am zanbina ba gbɛ'ɛdin la kal, ka li an tusa kɔbiga nɛ tusa pisnaasi nɛ anaasi (

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: yɛt ye, “Ami, bareka nɛ zʋn'or nɛ ya'am nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsʋg nɛ na'asi nɛ paŋ nɛ kpi'euŋ anɛ ti Wina'am din saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Ami.”

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa nya'aŋ la ka m gɔs, ka nidib la'as bɛdegʋ, ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi kaal nidib la wʋsaa. Ba daa yinɛ teŋgbana wʋsa nɛ buudi wʋsa nɛ dɔɔd wʋsa nɛ pian'ad wʋsa ni na, yɛ fupiela zi'e na'am gbauŋ la nɛ Pɛbil la tuon ka mɔr kpʋkparis wila ba nu'usin,

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: ka pian'ad nɛ kʋkɔtitada ye, “Ti faangir yitnɛ ti Wina'am onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ la zug nɛ Pɛbil la san'an na.”

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Ka maliaknam la wʋsa zi'eni gilig na'am gbauŋ la, nɛ kpɛɛmnam la, nɛ bʋnvʋya anaasi la, ka ba vanbin na'am gbauŋ la tuonnɛ zun'od Wina'am

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Ka kpɛɛmnam la yinne bu'osim ye, “Anɔ'ɔnamɛ an nimbanɛ yɛ fupiela la? Ka ba yi yaanɛ na?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛbis o ye, “Naa, fʋnɛ mi', ka man zi'.” Ka o yɛlim ye, “Nimbama yinɛ fara tita'arin na, ka piesi ba fuud Pɛbil la ziimin ka ba pɛlig.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Linzug ka ba zi'e “Wina'am na'am gbauŋ la tuon ka tʋmmi tisid o nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ o Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la. Ka onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug la bɛ nɛ ba la zug, o na guri ba.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Ka kɔ'ɔm kʋ lɛm gban'e ba; bɛɛ ku'onuud gban'e baa, Nintaŋ tʋʋltita'ar kʋ lɛn luu ba zug bɛɛ li tʋligi baa.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: Pɛbil onɛ bɛ na'am gbauŋ la teŋsʋk la na guri ba, ka na dɔlli ba keŋ nyɔvʋr ku'om bun zin'isi'a la. Ka Wina'am na ɛɛns ninta'am wʋsa ba nini ni.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Ka Pɛbil la lak titabir linɛ tabili paas ayɔpɔi la, ka arezana ni an baanlimm saŋa bi'ela.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ maliaknam ayɔpɔi banɛ zi'e Wina'am tuon la ka ba tisi ba na'atana ayɔpɔi.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Ka maliak sɔ' mɔr sanlima laa dinɛ ka ba niŋid tudaari la, keŋ zi'e maan teebul la baba. Ka ba tis o tudaari bɛdegʋ ye o paasi li Wina'am nidib winsɔsʋgin niŋ sanlim bimbim linɛ zi'e na'am gbauŋ la tuon la tis Wina'am.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Ka tudaari dinɛ ka ba nyu'oe la nyɔ'ɔs nɛ Wina'am nidib la winsɔsʋg yi maliak onɛ zi'e Wina'am tuon la nu'usin dʋt agɔl.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Ka maliak la nɔk tudaari laa la mu'oe bugum bimbim la zugʋ pɛ'ɛl laa la lɔbigi li dunia ni. Ka satansʋg nɛ vuud nɛ sa-ian'asʋg nɛ teŋ dammʋg naam. Na'atana la yɛla

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Ka maliaknam ayɔpɔi banɛ mɔr na'atana ayɔpɔi la ti'eb ye ba piebi ba.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Ka yiiga maliak la pieb o na'atan. Ka sakuga nɛ bugum gɛndig nɛ ziim kpa'adi lut dunia ni na. Ka bugum di dunia pʋdigir atan' ni pʋdigir yinne, ka mɛ di tiis pʋdigir atan' ni pʋdigir yinne, ka di mɔma'asa wʋsa.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas ayi' la pieb o na'atan. Ka ba lɔb si'el ka li nwɛnɛ zuotita'ar linɛ ka bugum dit, ka li lu atɛukʋn la. Ka ku'om la pʋdigir yinne pʋdigir atan' la ni kilim ziim.

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: Ka bʋnvʋya banɛ bɛ ku'omin la pʋdigir la yinne pʋdigir atan' la ni kpi wʋsa. Ka anrima la pʋdigir la yinne pʋdigir atan' la ni san'am wʋsa.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas atan' la pieb o na'atan. Ka nwadbil tita'ar dit nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ yi saŋgbauŋin li kɔldaadin nɛ ku'om tansid zin'isi'a bun la pʋdigir yinne pʋdigir atan' la ni.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Nwadbil la yʋ'ʋri buon Tɔɔg. Ka ku'om la pʋdigir yinne kilim tɔɔg. Ka nidib bɛdegʋ nu ku'om la ka kpi, din lieb tɔɔg la zug.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas anaasi la pieb o na'atan. Ka winnig la pʋdig zin'isa atan', ka nwadig la mɛ pʋdig zin'isa atan', ka nwadbibis la mɛ pʋdig zin'isa atan'. Ka si'el nwɛ' ba pʋdigir yinne-yinne, ka ba wʋsa pʋdigir yinne-yinne la kilim lik. Ka nintaŋ linɛ nie nyain la pʋdigir la yinne pʋdigir atan' la ni kilim lik. Ka yʋ'ʋŋ pʋdigir la yinne pʋdigir atan' la ni mɛ kilim lik.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Ka m gɔsi nyɛ siltita'ar onɛ ian'ad agɔl lalli, ka wʋm ka o yɛt nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Sʋnsa'aŋ bɛ, sʋnsa'aŋ bɛ. Maliaknama atan' banɛ kpɛlim la ye ba piebi ba na'atana la, ka ba ya'a ti piebi ba, sʋnsa'aŋ na bɛ tis banɛ wʋsa bɛ dunia ni.”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas anu la pieb o na'atan. Ka m nyɛ nwadbil ka o yi saŋgbana ni lu dunia ni na. Ka ba tis o bʋmbɔk dinɛ zulim ka ka' bɛn la saafi.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Ka nwadbil la yɔ'ɔg bʋmbɔk la, ka nyɔ'ɔs yina nwɛnɛ bugum tita'ar nyɔ'ɔs nɛ, ka kɛ ka winnig nɛ saŋgbauŋ la sɔbigi kilim lik.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Ka na'azɔmnam yi nyɔ'ɔs la nii sig dunia ni na. Ka ba tisi ba paŋ nwɛnɛ namisi mɔr paŋ dunia ni si'em la,

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba ye, ba da san'am si'elnam wʋsa linɛ nɔbigid teŋinɛɛ, amaa ba pu'alim nimbanɛ pʋ mɔr Wina'am zanbina ba gbɛ'ɛdin la gʋllim.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
