translation_verse: Ka na'azɔmnam la daa pʋ mɔr suori na kʋ nida, ka lɛɛ na namisidi ba nwadis anu. Ka tɔɔg kanɛ ka ba daa nyɛti ba niŋgbina ni la nwɛnɛ naŋ tɔɔnbi zabid si'em la.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Ka nwadis anu nwa' saŋa, nimbama na ieed kum ka kʋ nyɛɛ lii, ka mɛ na bɔɔd kum, ka kum na zɔ ka basi ba.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Ka na'azɔmnam la nwɛnɛ widi banɛ ti'ebi gur zaba nɛ, ka mɔr linɛ nwɛnɛ sanlima zupibisi ba zutin. Ka ba nindaas nwɛnɛ nidib nindaas nɛ.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: Ka ba zuobid wa'ami nwɛnɛ pu'ab zuobid nɛ. Ka ba nyina nwɛnɛ gbigim nyina nɛ.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Ka si'el ligili ba nyɔ'ɔd la nwɛnɛ kʋnt zaba gbanti'edʋg nɛ. Ka ba kpʋkpama vuudi nwɛnɛ tanp widi tɛɛd tanp tɛrekonamɛ zɔti ken zaba ni nɛ.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: Ka ba mɔr zʋya ka tɔɔnd nwɛnɛ namis nɛ. Ka ba zʋya la mɔr paŋi na pu'alim nidib nwadis anu.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ gur bʋmbɔk la daa aan ba na'ab. Ka o yʋ'ʋr nɛ Hibiru pian'ad anɛ Abadon, ka Girik pian'ad an Apoliyon. Li gbin anɛ Asan'auŋ.

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Yiiga sʋnsa'aŋ la gaad ya. Amaa sʋnsa'aŋ ayi' kpɛlim na kena.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas ayuobʋ la pieb o na'atan. Ka m wʋm ka kʋkɔr yi sanlima teebul maan zin'ig dinɛ zi'e Wina'am tuon lɔdis anaasi la ni na,

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: yɛl maliak onɛ paas ayuobʋ mɔr na'atan la ye, “Yidigim maliaknam anaasi banɛ ka ba lɔ Efiritis mu'arin la.”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Ka ba bas maliaknam banɛ ka ba ti'ebi gur yʋʋm kaŋa nɛ nwadig kaŋa nɛ dabiskaŋa nɛ saŋa kaŋa ye ba kʋ ninsaalib pʋdigir yinne pʋdigir atan' ni la.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm soogianam banɛ an wiedban'adib la kal. Ba kal an tusa tus-kɔbisyi' (

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Ka lin nie pa'alim la ka m nyɛ widi nɛ banɛ ban'adi ba la. Ban daa an si'em nwa': Banɛ ban'ad widi la daa yɛnɛ zaba gbanti'edis linɛ mu'oe nwɛnɛ bugum ka an sabilig nɛ dɔnbʋʋlim. Ka widi la zut nwɛnɛ gbigima zut nɛ. Ka bugum nɛ nyɔ'ɔs nɛ tan linɛ nyɛligi dit wʋʋ kidibir yiti ba nɔya ni na.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Ka yɛltɔɔd atan' bama, bugum nɛ nyɔ'ɔs nɛ tan linɛ nyɛligi dit wʋʋ kidibir dinɛ yit widi la nɔya ni la daa kʋ ninsaalib pʋdigir la yinne pʋdigir atan' la ni.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Widi la paŋ daa bɛ nɛ ba nɔya nɛ ba zʋya ni. Ka ba zʋya la daa nwɛnɛ wiigi nɛ mɔr zut ka ba mɔri li pu'alim nidib.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ daa kpɛlim ka yɛlbama pʋ kʋʋ ba la, daa pʋ tiak ka bas ban maan si'el nɛ ba mɛŋ nu'us la dɔllimm, ka mɛ pʋ bas kikiris nɛ sanlima bada la nɛ anzurifa nɛ kʋntzɛn'ug bada nɛ kuga bada nɛ daad bada banɛ kʋ tun'e nyɛ bɛɛ wʋm bɛɛ keŋ la pʋ'ʋsʋgɔ.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Ba mɛ daa pʋ basi ba ninkʋʋsim nɛ ba ba'akɔn bʋgʋb nɛ ba pu'abɔɔsim bɛɛ ba na'ayiigim la ka tiakɛ.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ maliak tita'ar si'a ka o yi arezana ni sigid na. Ka saŋgbauŋ ligil o nwɛnɛ fuug nɛ, ka saa dindɛog buoɛn gilig o zug. Ka o nindaa nwɛnɛ winnig nɛ ka o nɔba nwɛnɛ bugum zan'antɔlis nɛ.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: O daa mɔr gbauŋbil o nu'ugin ka li lak. Ka o datiuŋ nɔbir zi'e atɛukʋn, ka o dagɔbʋg nɔbir zi'e teŋ.

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: Ka o tans nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar linɛ nwɛnɛ gbigim kaasig nɛ. Ka on tansi naae la, ka satansida ayɔpɔi tansi siak.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Ka ban pian' naae la m daa bɔɔd ye m sɔb. Amaa m daa wʋm ka kʋkɔr pian' yi arezana ni na ye, m su'am dinɛ ka satansida ayɔpɔi la yɛl la. Ka ye m da sɔbi lii.

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ ka m nyɛ ka o zi'e atɛukʋn nɛ teŋin la ʋk o datiuŋ nu'ugʋ kpa' arezana,

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: ka pɔ nɛ Wina'am onɛ bɛ saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ ka maal saazug nɛ dunia nɛ atɛuk nɛ bʋn linɛ wʋsa bɛɛ ba ni la ye, li kʋ lɛn yuugɛ.

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas ayɔpɔi la ya'a ti bɔɔd ye o pieb o na'atan la, Wina'am yɛlsu'ada la na tʋm naae, nwɛnɛ on da yɛl o nɔdi'esidib banɛ aan o tʋmtʋmnib la si'em la.

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Ka kʋkɔr kanɛ ka m wʋm ka li pian' arezana nii tisim la, lɛm pian' tisim ye, “Kem di'e gbauŋ dinɛ laki bɛ maliak onɛ zi'e atɛukʋn nɛ teŋin la nu'ugin.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Ka m keŋ maliak la san'an yɛl o ye o tisim gbauŋbil la. Ka o yɛlim ye, “Nɔkimi li ɔnb. Ka ye li na kilim tɔɔgʋ m pʋʋgin, amaa li na malisi m nɔɔrin nwɛnɛ siind nɛ.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Ka m di'e gbauŋbil la o nu'ugin ɔnbi li. Ka li malis nwɛnɛ siindi m nɔɔrin. Amaa man vɔl la, ka li kilim tɔɔgʋ m pʋʋgin.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' yɛlim ye, asɛɛ ka m lɛn di'e Wina'am pian'adi tis nidib. Ka ye Wina'am pian'ad la anɛ buudi nɛ teŋgbana nɛ pian'ad nɛ na'anam bɛdegʋ din.

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Amaa da mak zak linɛ bɛ yiŋ laa, bɔzugɔ ba zaŋi lii tis banɛ ka' Wina'am nidib la ka ba na nɔɔdi giligid Jerusalem Teŋ sʋŋ la nwadis pisnaasi nɛ ayi'.

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Nidib ayi' bama anɛ Olif tiis ayi' nɛ fitazi'esa ayi' banɛ zi'e dunia Zugsɔb la tuon la.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a zigid ye o pu'alimi ba, bugum yitnɛ ba nɔya ni na san'amidi ba dataas la. Ala ka ba kʋʋd onɛ zigid ye o pu'alimi ba la.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Bama mɔr paŋ kanɛ na gban'e saa, ka saa kʋ ni saŋa kanɛ ka ba tʋmmi ba nɔdi'esʋg tʋʋma la, ka lɛm mɔr paŋi na kɛ ka ku'om kilim ziim, ka mɛ mɔr paŋi na zaŋ yɛltɔɔd buudi wʋsa pu'alim dunia dim saŋa kan ka ba bɔɔd wʋsa.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Ba ya'a ti naae labaar la mɔɔlʋg, bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og onɛ yi bʋmbɔk dinɛ ka' bɛn la ni la na zab nɛ ba nyaŋ ka kʋʋ ba,

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: ka ba niŋgbina na dig teŋ tita'ar la suoraugʋn, zin'ikanɛ ka ba da kpa' ba Zugsɔb dapuudir zug la. Ba buon tɛɛns la yʋda ye Sodom nɛ Egipt.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Ka nimbanɛ yi buudi nɛ pian'ad nɛ teŋgbana wʋsa ni na, na gɔsi ba niŋgbina la daba atan' nɛ pʋsʋk, ka kʋ kɛ ka ba mumi baa.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Ka dunia nidib sʋnya na ma'ae nidib ayi' nwa' kum la yɛla. Ba na maal sumalisim ka tis taaba piini, bɔzugɔ nɔdi'esidib ayi' nwaa kɛ ka nidib namis dunia ni la zug.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Ka daba atan' nɛ pʋsʋk la nya'aŋ, vʋ'ʋsʋm linɛ tisid nyɔvʋr la na yi Wina'am san'an kena kpɛn' ba ni ka ba vʋ'ʋg. Ka dabiem bɛdegʋ kpɛn' banɛ nyɛɛ li la.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Ka nidib ayi' la wʋm ka kʋkɔtita'ar yi arezana ni na yɛli ba ye, “Dʋmmi kpɛ' na.” Ka ba dataas la gɔsidi ba ka ba kpɛn'ɛd saŋgbauŋin dʋt arezana ni.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Saŋkan la yim, ka teŋ dam hali. Ka Jerusalem teŋ la pʋdig zin'is piiga ka yinne luu san'am. Teŋ la dam la, ka nidib tusa ayɔpɔi kpi. Ka dabiem kpɛn' nimbanɛ kpɛlim la, ka ba na'as Wina'am onɛ bɛ arezana ni la.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Sʋnsa'aŋ dinɛ paas ayi' la gaad ya. Amaa sʋnsa'aŋ linɛ paasida atan' la na kɛn nannanna na. Na'atan ayɔpɔi daan la yɛla

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Maliak onɛ paas ayɔpɔi la pieb o na'atan la, ka kʋkɔtitada vuud arezana nii yɛt ye, “Dunia sʋ'ʋlim kilimi ti Zugsɔb nɛ o Kristo la din, ka o na an na'ab saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: “Ti pʋ'ʋsid Zugsɔb Wina'am tita'ar, onɛ bɛ ka da bɛ la bareka, on zaŋ o paŋ tita'ar la ka pin'il o na'am la zug.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Ka banɛ ka' Wina'am nidib la sʋnya duoe bɛdegʋ, amaa fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la saŋa paae na ka fʋ na kad banɛ kpi la saria, ka fʋ na yɔɔ fʋ tʋmtʋmnib banɛ aan fʋ nɔdi'esidib, nɛ nimbanɛ na'asidif la, banɛ an kpi'emnam nɛ tadimnam wʋsa, ka san'am banɛ san'am teŋgbauŋ la.”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir dinɛ bɛ arezana ni la yɔ'ɔg ka ba nyɛ Wina'am Nɔnaar Daka la. Ka sa-ian'asʋg nɛ vuud nɛ satansʋg nɛ teŋ dammʋg nɛ sakuga naam bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Ka o mɔr pʋʋg ka bɔɔd du'am ka li zabid o ka o kaasid hali.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Ka zanbin tita'ar nie saŋgbana ni na ya'as. Li daa anɛ bʋnyua zɛn'ug, ka o mɔr zuta ayɔpɔi nɛ iila piiga. Ka pid na'am zupibisi o zut la wʋsa ni.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Ka nwadbibis pʋdig zin'is atan' ka bʋnyua la ʋk o zʋʋri da'ae pʋdigir yinne yis saŋgbauŋin bas dunia ni na. Ka o zi'e pu'a onɛ bɔɔd du'am la tuonnɛ gur ye pu'a la du'a ka o ɔnb biig la.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Ka pu'a la du'a biribiŋ onɛ na sʋ'oe buudi wʋsa nɛ paŋ ka nyaŋi ba nɛ kʋnt dansaar. Ka ba zɛ biig la mɔr o keŋ Wina'am nɛ o na'am gbauŋ la tuon.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Ka pu'a la zɔɔ keŋ mɔɔgin. Anina ka Wina'am maal zin'igi digil pu'a la, zin'ikanɛ ka ba na gɔs o dabisa tusir nɛ kɔbisyi' nɛ pisyuobʋ.

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Ka zaba kɔ' arezana ni. Ka maliak kpɛɛm Maikel nɛ o maliaknam la zab nɛ bʋnyua la, ka on mɛ la'as o maliaknam ka ba zab nɛ Maikel.

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: Amaa o paŋi daa pɔɔd la zug ka ba nyaŋi ba ka kadi ba yis arezana ni.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Ba da lɔb bʋnyua onɛ da bɛ kʋdimin sa ka o yʋ'ʋr buon kikiris na'ab bɛɛ Sʋntaana ka ma'ad dunia kpɛn'ɛsid mɔɔg la bas dunia ni na. On nɛ o maliaknam wʋsa ka ba da lɔbi bas dunia ni na.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm kʋkɔtita'ar arezana ni ka li yɛl ye, “Nannanna ti Wina'am faangir nɛ o paŋ nɛ o na'am la nɛ o Kristo la paŋ mɛ paae na, bɔzugɔ ba nɔk onɛ gbi'idi ti ba'abiis Wina'am tuon nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ la lɔbi yis arezana ni.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Ka ba nɔk Pɛbil la ziim nɛ labaar kanɛ ka ba mɔɔn nɛ sida la zabi nyaŋ o, ka pʋ zɔ dabiem nɛ kum ka lɛb nya'aŋi ba nyɔvʋr yɛlaa.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Dinzugɔ, arezana maalim sumalisim nɛ banɛ wʋsa bɛɛ anina la. Amaa sʋnsa'aŋ na bɛ teŋgbauŋ nɛ atɛukʋn, bɔzugɔ Sʋntaana sigi ba ni na. Ka o sʋnf pɛlig hali on mi' ye o saŋa kpɛlim nɛ bi'ela la zug.”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Ka bʋnyua la baŋ ye ba nɔk o lɔbi bas dunia ni na la, ka o kad pu'a kanɛ du'a biig la ye o gban'e o.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Ka ba daa tis pu'a la niiŋ tita'ar kpʋkpama ayi' ye o ianki keŋ mɔɔgin, zin'ikanɛ ka ba maal o yɛla ka na gur o yʋma atan' nɛ pʋsʋk ka waaf la kʋ nyaŋi nyɛɛ o la.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Ka waaf la pʋʋs ku'om ka li yii o nɔɔrin na nwɛnɛ kɔldaug nɛ pʋbidi dɔl pu'a la ye ku'onwiis la dii o mɔri gaad.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Amaa ka teŋ la tans mugulim fuoɛn ku'om kanɛ yi bʋnyua la nɔɔrin na la sʋŋ pu'a la.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Ka bʋnyua la sʋʋnr pɛlig nɛ pu'a la hali, ka o keŋ ye o zab nɛ pu'a la yaas banɛ kpɛlim ka siak Wina'am nɔɔr ka gban'e Yesu n mɔɔl labasi'a la nu'us ayi' la.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Ka bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la zi'e mu'ar la gbɛogʋ gur.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og ka o yi atɛukʋn la naa mɔr iila piiga nɛ zuta ayɔpɔi. Ka na'am zupibis piiga bɛ iila la ni. Ka yʋda linɛ san'amid Wina'am yʋ'ʋr la sɔb o zutin la.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og kanɛ ka m daa nyɛ la daa nwɛnɛ wɛog baa nɛ. Ka o nɔb-ɛɛns an bʋntitada, ka o nɔɔr nwɛnɛ gbigim nɔɔr nɛ. Ka bʋnyua la daa tis bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la o mɛŋ paŋ nɛ o na'am gbauŋ nɛ o kpi'euŋ.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Ka bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la zug yinne daa nwɛnɛ ba pu'alim o nɛ, amaa ka sapu'ad la bin'ei. Ka li pak dunia dim wʋsa ka ba dɔl bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Nidib wʋsa daa zun'od bʋnyua la, on tis bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la o paŋ la zug, ka mɛ zun'od bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la ye, “Anɔ'ɔnɛ mɔr paŋ nwɛnɛ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og nwa? Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e zab nɛ o?”

english_verse: The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for
translation_verse: Ka ba tis bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la suor ka o pian'ad nyɛɛsim pian'ad ka san'amid Wina'am yʋ'ʋr, ka lɛn kɛ ka o mɔr paŋ nwadis pisnaasi nɛ ayi'.

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Ka o tʋ'ʋd Wina'am ka san'amid Wina'am yʋ'ʋr nɛ zin'ikanɛ ka o bɛ la nɛ banɛ bɛ arezana ni la wʋsa.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Ka ba tis o suor ka o zab nɛ Wina'am nidib ka nyaŋi ba, ka tis o paŋ kanɛ na nyaŋ buudi nɛ dɔɔd nɛ pian'ad nɛ teŋgbana wʋsa.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Nidib banɛ wʋsa bɛ dunia ni ka ba yʋda pʋ sɔb nyɔvʋpaal dim gbauŋʋn la na zun'e bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la. Asɛɛ nimbanɛ yʋda da sɔb ka dunia nam pʋ pin'il la ma'aa. Gbauŋ la anɛ Pɛbil kanɛ ka ba da kʋʋ o la din.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Dinzug, onɛ mɔr tʋba on wʋm.

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Onɛ ka ba na gban'e o la, ba na gban'e o mɔri keŋ, ka onɛ ka ba na kʋʋ o nɛ sʋ'ʋraug la, ba sid na kʋʋ o. Linzug li sʋm ye Wina'am nidib mɔr mɔdigir ka niŋ Wina'am yadda.

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og ya'as ka o yit teŋin naa mɔr iila ayi' ka li nwɛnɛ pɛbil iila nɛ, ka o pian'ad nwɛnɛ bʋnyua nɛ.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Ka zi'e yiiga bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la nɔba zugʋ mugusid dunia dim wʋsa ka kɛ ba zun'od yiiga bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og onɛ sapu'adi yʋ'ʋn bin'ei la.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Ka maal bʋnnyalimtitada nɛ zanbina hali ka kɛ ka bugum yi agɔlli sig teŋgbauŋʋn na ka nidib nyɛɛ li.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: On daa dɛŋi maal zanbinsieba nɛ yiiga bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la paŋ la zugʋ daa kɛ ka o ma' dunia nidib wʋsa. O daa ma' ba ye ba mɛɛm win, ka li zun'e bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og onɛ ka ba daa pu'alim o nɛ sʋ'ʋraug ka o nan vʋe la.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Ka ba tis bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og onɛ paas ayi' la suor ka o tis win linɛ nwɛnɛ yiiga bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la vʋ'ʋsʋm ka o na tun'e pian' ka kɛ ka ba kʋ banɛ pʋ siak ye ba pʋ'ʋs win kanɛ ka ba maal la.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Ka lɛm mugus nidib wʋsa banɛ anɛ, tadimnam nɛ kpi'emnam nɛ kpan'am dim nɛ nɔŋ dim la'an nɛ yammis nɛ banɛ ka' yammisɛ, ye ba di'em zanbina ba datiuŋ nu'usin bɛɛ ba gbɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' daa kʋ tun'e da' bɛɛ kuos si'ela, asɛɛ ka o mɔr bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la zanbin linɛ aan o yʋ'ʋr la, bɛɛ o yʋ'ʋr la kal.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Lina bɔɔd ye fʋ mɔr ya'am ka nyaŋi baki li sʋ'ʋŋa. On mɛkama mɔr ya'am na tun'e baŋ bʋnyua la kal la gbin, bɔzugɔ kal la gbin anɛ dau sɔ' yʋ'ʋr. Li kal anɛ kɔbisyuobʋ nɛ piis yuobʋ nɛ ayuobʋ (

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm kʋkɔr ka li yi arezana ni na vuudi nwɛnɛ ku'osusuud tita'ar nɛ satansʋg tita'ar nɛ, ka mɛ nwɛnɛ kɔnnwɛ'ɛdibi nwɛ'ɛdi ba kɔna si'em la.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Ka ba zi'e na'am gbauŋ nɛ bʋnvʋya anaasi nɛ kpɛɛmnam la tuon ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋm paal dinɛ ka sɔ' kʋ tun'e zamisɛ, asɛɛ nidib tusa kɔbiga nɛ pisnaasi nɛ anaasi banɛ ka Wina'am faaɛn ba dunia ni la ma'aa.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Bama anɛ dap banɛ luaki ba mɛŋ nɛ pu'ab ka an nyain, ka dɔl Pɛbil la ken on ken zin'isi'a wʋsa, ka nyɛ faangir ninsaalib sʋʋgin, ka an yiiga dim wʋʋ waldɛɛnna banɛ ka ba zaŋi tis Wina'am nɛ Pɛbil la.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Ziri pian'ad pʋ yiti ba nɔɔrinɛ, ka ba mɛ pʋ mɔr taalɛ. Maliaknam atan' la yɛla

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ maliak sɔ' ka o ian'ad agɔla sa ka mɔr labasʋŋ kanɛ ka' naar ye o mɔɔli tis nidib wʋsa banɛ bɛ dunia ni, la'an nɛ teŋgbana nɛ buudi nɛ pian'ad buudi nɛ nidib buudi wʋsa.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Ka o pian' nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Zɔmi Wina'am ka zun'e o yʋ'ʋr la, bɔzugɔ saŋa kanɛ ka o na kad nidib saria la paaeya. Zun'om Wina'am onɛ maal arezana nɛ dunia nɛ mu'a nɛ ku'om bunɛ tansidi yit zin'isi'a la wʋsa.”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas ayi' la dɔl yiiga daan la ka yɛl ye, “Babilon teŋ tita'ar la san'amya. Li sid san'amya. Teŋ la daa nwɛnɛ pu'agɔɔndir nɛ ka kɛ ka nidib buudi wʋsa tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd; o nwɛnɛ daam linɛ kpi'em ka ba nu nɛ.”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas atan' la dɔl yiiga maliaknama ayi' la pian'ad nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Sɔ' ya'a zun'e bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la nɛ o win la ka di'e zanbin la o gbɛ'ogʋn bɛɛ o nu'ugin,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: Wina'am sʋnf na pɛlig nɛ o nwɛnɛ daam linɛ kpi'em ka o kpa'ae nɛ sʋnpɛɛnni niŋ o bʋtiŋin la kɛ ka o nuu li. O na namis Maliaksʋma nɛ Pɛbil la tuon ka kpɛn' bugum linɛ nyɛligid nwɛnɛ kidibir la.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a di'e bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la zanbin bɛɛ zun'e li nɛ li win la, o na namis bugum dinɛ ka li nyɔ'ɔs dʋt agɔl saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛn la ni, ka kʋ nyɛ vʋ'ʋsʋm nintaŋ bɛɛ yʋ'ʋŋɔ.”

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Linzug li an sʋm ye Wina'am nimbanɛ siak o nɔɔr ka dɔl Yesu nɛ yadda niŋir la mɔdig.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm ka kʋkɔr yi arezana ni na ye, “Sɔm nɛ'ɛŋa: Lin yi zina ken sa, albareka bɛ nɛ banɛ dɔl Zugsɔb la ka kpii o ni la.” Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la siak ye, “Sida, ba na vʋ'ʋs nɛ tʋʋm kpi'ema ka ba tʋʋm sʋma na dɔlli ba.” Dunia bunib la yɛla

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Ka m gɔsi nyɛ saŋgbauŋ piel ka sɔ' zin' li zugʋ nwɛnɛ Ninsaal Biig ka pid sanlima zupibig o zugin, ka mɔr gɔn'ɔg linɛ nɔɔri dit hali o nu'ugin.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Ka maliak sɔ' yi Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la yɛl onɛ zin' saŋgbauŋ zug la nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Nɔkim gɔn'ɔg la bʋn, bɔzugɔ saŋa la paaeya, ka dunia la bi'igi siak bunib.”

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ zin' saŋgbauŋ zug la zaŋ o gɔn'ɔg la yuligi bʋn dunia la.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Ka maliak si'a yi arezana Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na, mɔr gɔn'ɔg linɛ nɔɔri dit.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ sʋ'oe bugum la yi maan bimbimin la na yɛl maliak onɛ mɔr gɔn'ɔg linɛ nɔɔri dit la nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Nɔkim gɔn'ɔg la pɔn' vain tiis wala linɛ bɛ dunia ni la. Bɔzugɔ wala la bi'ig ya ka li pɔn'ɔb saŋa paae.”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Ka maliak la nɔk o gɔn'ɔg la yulig dunia la ni pɔn' vain wala la, ka nɔki li niŋ zin'ig kanɛ ka ba nwiakid wala la ku'om la. Li nwiakir la an Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn tita'ar la.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Ka ba yi teŋ la yiŋi nwiak wala la, ka ziim yi zin'ikanɛ ka ba nwiaki li la nwɛnɛ mu'ar tita'ar nɛ. Ka li wa'alim an wʋʋ mail kɔbis yi'. Ka wief ya'a sigi li ni, li zulʋŋ na paae o salibir.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn nyɛ bʋnnyalʋŋ tita'ar si'a linɛ an zanbinnɛ bɛ arezana ni. Ka li an maliaknama ayɔpɔi nɛ yɛltɔɔd ayɔpɔi. Bama an yɛltɔɔd banɛ kpɛlim nya'aŋ la, bɔzugɔ ban naari an Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn la naar.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ si'el linɛ nwɛnɛ mu'ar ka an nyain wʋʋ gɔtiŋ nɛ, ka bugum gɛndig. Ka m lɛn nyɛ banɛ zabi nyaŋ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la nɛ o win nɛ o yʋ'ʋr kal la, ka ba zi'e kpi'e mu'ar la mɔr kɔna dinɛ ka Wina'am tisi ba la ba nu'usin,

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: ka yʋ'ʋm Wina'am tʋmtʋm Moses nɛ Pɛbil la yʋʋma ye, “Zugsɔb Wina'am tita'arɛ, fʋnɛ tʋm tʋʋm titada nɛ tʋʋmnyalima. Fʋnɛ an buudi wʋsa na'ab, ka fʋ suoya an sʋm nɛ sida.

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: Zugsɔba, fʋn gʋllim an sʋm, anɔ'ɔnɛ kʋ zɔɔf ka zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋrɛ? Buudi wʋsa na kenaa zʋn'ʋf, bɔzugɔ fʋ pʋpielim tʋʋma la nie paalʋ.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa nya'aŋ ka m gɔsi nyɛ ka arezana Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la yɔ'ɔg, ka Wina'am Fuug Sʋgʋr linɛ an kasi la bɛɛ anina.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Ka maliaknama ayɔpɔi banɛ mɔr yɛltɔɔd ayɔpɔi linɛ kpɛlim nya'aŋ la, yi Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na yɛ fupiela banɛ an nyain, ka sanlima sɛnbidis lɔɔ ba nyɔ'ɔd.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ka bʋnvʋya anaasi la, yinne nɔk sanlima laas ayɔpɔi linɛ ka Wina'am onɛ bɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛn la sʋnpɛɛn pɛ'ɛli ba la tis maliaknama ayɔpɔi la.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am na'asi nɛ o paŋ pɛ'ɛl Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la nwɛnɛ nyɔ'ɔs nɛ. Ka sɔ' daa kʋ tun'e kpɛn' li nii, ti paae saŋkanɛ ka yɛltɔɔd ayɔpɔi banɛ ka maliaknama ayɔpɔi mɔr la ti naae.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm kʋkɔtita'ar ka li pian'adi yit Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na yɛt maliaknama ayɔpɔi la ye, “Kem kpa'ae Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn linɛ pɛ'ɛl laas ayɔpɔi la dunia zug.”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Ka yiiga maliak la keŋ kpa'ae o laa la dunia zug. Ka fɛn'ɛpɔn'ɔsa banɛ zabid hali kiib banɛ mɔr bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la zanbin nɛ banɛ na'asid o win la niŋgbina.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas ayi' la kpa'ae o laa la niŋ atɛukʋn. Ka atɛuk la ku'om tiak nwɛnɛ onɛ kpi ziim nɛ, ka bʋnvʋya banɛ bɛ atɛukʋn la wʋsa kpi.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas atan' la kpa'ae o dinnɛ niŋ kɔlis nɛ ku'om bun zin'isieba la ni, ka ku'om la kilim ziim.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm maliak onɛ kpa'ae o din ku'omin la ka o yɛl Wina'am ye, “Fʋnɛ an Kasi, ka da bɛ, ka kpɛm bɛ ka na ti bɛ. Fʋ dɔl sida suori fʋ sariakadib la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: Ba kʋʋ fʋ nidib nɛ fʋ nɔdi'esidib dinzug ka fʋ tis banɛ kʋʋ ba la ziim ye ba nu. Ban nar ye ba di'e si'eli la.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm kʋkɔr ka li yi maan maalʋg zin'igin la na yɛl ye, “Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔba, fʋ sariakadib la anɛ sida ka dɔl suor.”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas anaasi la kpa'ae o laa la winnig la zug. Ka ba tis winnig la paŋ ye o dit nidib la wʋʋ bugum nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Ka tʋʋltita'ar tʋlig nidib la, ka ba pɔɔd nɔɔri tisid Wina'am onɛ sʋ'oe yɛltɔɔd bama la yʋ'ʋr. Amaa ba pʋ tiaki ba sʋnya ka na'as Wina'am.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas anu la kpa'ae o laa la niŋ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la na'am gbauŋ la zug. Ka bʋnyua la sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa lieb lik. Ka nidib dummi ba zilima ba niŋgbina saaɛn tɔɔg la zug,

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: ka tʋ'ʋd Wina'am onɛ bɛ arezana ni la ba niŋgbina zabir nɛ ba fɛn'ɛd la zug. Amaa ba pʋ tiaki ba sʋnya ka basi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd laa.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas ayuobʋ la kpa'ae o laa la niŋ Efiritis mu'atita'arin la, ka mu'ar la ku'om kpiɛn ka maal suori tis na'anam banɛ yi ya-nya'aŋ la.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ kikiris atan' ka ba nwɛnɛ lɔmisnɛ yit bʋnyua la nɔɔrin nɛ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la nɔɔrin nɛ ziri nɔdi'es la nɔɔrin na.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Ba anɛ Sʋntaana kikiris banɛ maan bʋnnyalima ka yii keŋ dunia na'anam wʋsa nii la'asi ba ye ba nwɛ' tanp, Wina'am onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la dabistita'ar la daar.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: Wina'am yɛl ye, “Kɛlisimi, m na kena nwɛnɛ na'ayiigi ken si'em la. Albareka bɛ nɛ onɛ nɛi ka pʋ gbisɛ, ka kɛ ka o fuud bɛɛ o san'an ka kʋ keŋ biel ka nidib nyɛɛ o nyannɛ.”

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Ka kikiris la la'as na'anam la keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka Hibiru dim buon ye Amageddon la.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Ka maliak onɛ paas ayɔpɔi la kpa'ae o laa la pɛbisimin. Ka kʋkɔtita'ar yi na'am gbauŋ dinɛ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la na yɛl ye, “Li naae ya.”

english_verse: There were flashes of lightning, roars of thunder, and the worst earthquake in all history.
translation_verse: Ka sa-ian'asʋg nɛ vuud nɛ satansʋg bɛ ka teŋ dam bɛdegʋ. Teŋ nan zi' damm ala hali lin yi ninsaal pin'ilʋg saŋa sa. Teŋ la da damnɛ bɛ'ɛd bɛ'ɛdi.

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Ka teŋ dammʋg la pʋdig teŋ tita'ar la zin'isa atan'. Ka dunia tɛɛns la wʋsa san'am. Ka Wina'am tiɛn Babilon teŋ tita'ar la yɛla, ka kɛ ka Babilon nu o sʋnpɛɛn tita'ar bʋtiŋ daam la.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Tɛɛns banɛ ka ku'om giligi ba la da mɛlimnɛ, ka zuoya wʋsa bɔdig.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Ka maliaknam ayɔpɔi banɛ mɔrin laas ayɔpɔi la yinne kɛɛn m san'an na yɛlim ye, “Kem na, ka m pa'alif ban ye ba namis pu'agɔɔndir tita'ar onɛ an teŋ tita'ar ka kpi'e kɔlis bɛdegʋ la si'em.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Dunia na'anam la tʋm dian'ad tʋʋma nɛ pu'agɔɔndir la, ka nimbanɛ bɛ dunia ni la mɛ niŋ ala.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am Siig Kasi la daa pɛ'ɛlim ka maliak la ziimɛ keŋ mɔɔgin. Ka m nyɛ pu'a ka o ban'ad bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og zin'a, ka yʋda linɛ tʋ'ʋd Wina'am sɔbi gilig bʋnyua la niŋgbiŋ wʋsa. Ka bʋnyua la mɔr zuta ayɔpɔi nɛ iila piiga.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Ka pu'a la yɛ fuzɛn'ug nɛ sanlima la'ad nɛ kugvɛnla bɛdegʋ, ka mɔr sanlima bʋtiŋ linɛ pɛ'ɛl nɛ dian'ad linɛ yi o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin la na.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Yʋ'ʋkaŋa da sɔb o gbɛ'ogʋn: Li anɛ yɛlsu'adir, Babilon linɛ an teŋ tita'ar la pu'agɔɔnda wʋsa ma Nɛ dunia wʋsa tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ma.

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ ka pu'a la nu Wina'am nidib nɛ nimbanɛ daa niŋ Yesu yadda ka ba kʋʋ ba la ziim kʋʋl. Man nyɛɛ o la, ka li lidigim hali.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Ka maliak la bu'osim ye, “Bɔ ka fʋ lidigɛ? M na pa'alif pu'a la nɛ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og onɛ ka o ban'ad ka o mɔr zuta ayɔpɔi nɛ iila piiga la yɛlsu'adir la gbin.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og onɛ ka fʋ nyɛ la da vʋe saŋsi'en ka pʋ lɛn vʋeya, ka na naam bʋmbɔk zulʋŋ la nii dʋ na. O ya'a dʋ na o na keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka ba na san'am o la ni. Ka nimbanɛ bɛ dunia ni ka ba yʋda pʋ sɔb nyɔvʋpaal dim gbauŋʋn ka dunia nyaan pin'il la, na gɔs bʋnyua la ka li lidigi ba. Bɔzugɔ bʋnyua la da vʋe ka pʋ lɛn vʋeya, amaa o na lɛn vʋ'ʋg ya'as.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: “Nɛ'ɛŋa pa'annɛ ya'am nɛ onɛ gban'ad si'el gbin. Zuta ayɔpɔi la anɛ zuoya ayɔpɔi banɛ ka pu'a la zin' ba zut la.

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: Ba mɛ anɛ na'anama ayɔpɔi. Ka anu kpi, ka onɛ paasi ayuobʋ la an na'ab nannanna ka yinne nam pʋ di na'am. O ya'a ti di na'am o na bɛ dabisa bi'ela.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ka bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og onɛ da vʋe ka pʋ lɛn vʋe la, paas anii na'anama ayɔpɔi la ni, ka na keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka ba na san'am o la.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: “Ka iila piiga banɛ ka fʋ nyɛ la anɛ na'anam piiga, amaa ba nam pʋ di'e na'am laa. Ban nɛ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la na ti la'asi di'e na'am la saŋa bi'ela.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Ka ba piiga la na mɔr gban'ar yinne ka na tis bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la ba paŋ nɛ ba kpi'euŋ.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Ba na zab nɛ Pɛbil la, ka Pɛbil la nɛ o nya'andɔlib banɛ ka o da buoli ba o san'an ka gaŋi ba ka ba an sida dim la, na zabi nyaŋ bʋnyua la nɛ na'anam la, bɔzugɔ Pɛbil la an zugsɔbnam Zugsɔb nɛ na'anam Na'ab.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Ka maliak la yɛlim ye, “Kɔlis banɛ ka fʋ nyɛ ka pu'a la bɛɛ ani la, anɛ nidib nɛ tigir nɛ buudi kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb nɛ pian'ad buudi kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Ka iila piiga banɛ ka fʋ nyɛ la nɛ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la na kisig pu'agɔɔndir la, ka zaŋ on mɔr si'el wʋsa ka bas o biel, ka ɔnb o niŋgbiŋ ka kɛ ka bugum dii o.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Wina'am nɔki niŋi ba sʋnya ni, ka kɛ ka ba niŋ o bɔɔdim ka siaki tis bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la ba na'am paŋi ti paae saŋkanɛ ka Wina'am pian'ad la na niŋ amɛŋa.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Pu'a kanɛ ka fʋ nyɛ la anɛ teŋ tita'ar kanɛ sʋ'oe dunia na'anam wʋsa.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa nya'aŋ ka m lɛn nyɛ maliak sɔ' ka o yi arezana nii sigid na. O daa mɔr kpi'euŋ hali, ka o pipilim kɛ ka dunia wʋsa nie nyain.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: Ka o tans nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Babilon teŋ tita'ar la san'am ya. Li sid san'am ya, ka yʋ'ʋn kilim zin'ikanɛ ka sibɛ'ɛdnam nɛ kikiris nɛ bʋmbɛ'ɛdnam nɛ niimbi'es pɛ'ɛl anina.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Tɛɛns wʋsa daa mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ pu'agɔɔndir la, nɛ o dian'ad tʋʋma linɛ nwɛnɛ dankpi'euŋ la. Ka dunia na'anam digin nɛ pu'agɔɔndir la. Pu'agɔɔndir la mɔr o kpan'am la dit yɔɔg-yɔɔg la zugʋ kɛ ka dunia kpikpinkpinnib nyɛ kpan'am o ni.”

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm kʋkɔr ka li yi arezana ni na yɛl ye, “M nidiba, yiminɛ o san'an na, ka da la'as nɛ o tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ, ala ka ya kʋ la'as nɛ o namisɛ.

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Bɔzugɔ o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la la'as nɛ dʋʋ paae saazug, ka Wina'am tɛnr o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Niŋim o wʋʋ on ɛɛnti niŋidif si'em la, ka yɔɔ o abʋyi' wʋʋ o tʋʋma an si'em. Pɛ'ɛlim o bʋtiŋ la nɛ daam kanɛ kpi'emi gaad on tisif si'el la nɔɔr ayi'.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Tisim o namisʋg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ka li zem wʋʋ on tisid o mɛŋ na'asi nɛ bʋnsʋma si'em la. Ka o yɛt o mɛŋ ye, ‘Man anɛ pu'ana'ab nwa', m ka' pʋkɔɔnrɛ, m kʋ baŋ namisʋg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋa.’

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Alazug namisʋg na sig o zugin daar yinne na, ka sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ kɔ'ɔm nɛ kum na gban'e o, ka bugum na dii o, Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ kad o saria la an paŋ tita'ar Sɔb la zug.”

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Dunia na'abanɛ digin nɛ o ka dit malisim nɛ o la, ya'a ti nyɛ bugum kanɛ dit o la nyɔ'ɔs, ba na kaas ka fabil o yɛla.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Dabiem na ti kpɛn' ba ka ba zi'e lalli sa yɛt ye, “Wai! Wai! Fʋn kanɛ an teŋ tita'arɛ, Babilon teŋ kanɛ mɔr kpi'euŋɔ, Nannanna nwa', fʋ san'auŋ paae na!”

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Ka dunia kpikpinkpinnib mɛ kaas ka fabil o zug, sɔ' kae na lɛn da' ba la'ad la zug.

english_verse: There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble.
translation_verse: Sɔ' pʋ lɛn da'adi ba sanlima nɛ anzurifa nɛ kugvɛnla, nɛ fusʋma nɛ fuzɛn'ɛs nɛ fubanɛ nyɛɛn kil-kil la, nɛ daad banɛ buudi wʋsa nyuugʋ malis la, nɛ la'abanɛ ka ba zaŋ wabʋg nyina bɛɛ daad banɛ ligidi zu'oe bɛɛ anzurifa bɛɛ kʋnt bɛɛ sanlima bɛɛ kugvɛnla maal la,

english_verse: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
translation_verse: nɛ kakaduru nɛ pulis nɛ tudaari nɛ mir nɛ frankinsens, nɛ daam nɛ olif kpaam nɛ zɔ'ɔm nɛ ki nɛ niigi nɛ pɛ'ɛs nɛ widi nɛ widi tɛrekonam nɛ yammis nɛ ninsaalib nyɔvʋya.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: Ka kpikpinkpinnib la yɛt o ye, “La'abanɛ ka fʋ bɔɔd ye fʋ mɔr la gaad ya, fʋ kpan'am nɛ fʋ la'avɛnla la lɛn kae, fʋ kʋ lɛn nyɛɛ ba ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Kpikpinkpinnib banɛ kuosid la'abama ka nyɛt kpan'am o san'an la na zɔɔ keŋ zi'e lallisa; o namisʋg la dabiem na mɔri ba. Ba na kaasid ka fabinnɛ yɛt ye,

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: “Oi, Oi, teŋ tita'ar, linɛ nwɛnɛ pu'a onɛ yɛ fusʋma nɛ fuzɛn'ɛs nɛ sanlima nɛ kugvɛnla la'ad bɛdegʋ.

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
translation_verse: Nannanna ka kpan'am la ta'an san'am.” Ka banɛ an anrima kpɛɛmnam nɛ nimbanɛ kpɛn'ɛd anrima duosid suor, nɛ nimbanɛ tʋm anrima tʋʋma nɛ banɛ ken nɛ anrima kpiisid la zi'e lallisa.

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: Ba ya'a nyɛ bugum la dit o ka nyɔ'ɔs duod la, ba na kaasid ka yɛt ye, “Teŋ tita'ar nam mi' bɛɛ nwɛnɛ teŋ tita'ar kaŋaa?”

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Ka na bugi ba zut nɛ titan ka kaasidi fabinnɛ yɛt ye, “Oi, Oi, teŋ tita'ar kanɛ ka banɛ mɔr anrima kpiisid atɛukʋn ka daa nyɛt kpan'am o san'an, nannanna la ta'am san'amnɛ anwaa!”

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Ka maliaktita'ar zaŋ kugir ka li zem wʋʋ nɛtita'ar nɛ lɔb atɛukʋn la ka yɛl ye, “Babilon teŋ tita'ar la ba na ti ʋki li lɔb anwa, ka sɔ' kʋ lɛn nyɛɛ li ya'asɛ,

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Ba kʋ lɛn wʋm ka sɔ' nwɛ' kɔn bɛɛ yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma bɛɛ piebid wiig bɛɛ na'atan teŋ la nii. Ka nidib mɛ kʋ lɛn tʋm tʋʋm si'a aninaa, ka mɛ kʋ lɛn nɛɛm nɛɛr ka ba wʋmi li vuudɛ.

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: Fitir bugum kʋ lɛn nie aninaa, sɔ' kʋ lɛn wʋm pu'apaal nɛ o sid kʋkɔrɛ. Teŋ la kpikpinkpinnib da an kpi'emnam dunia nwa' ni, ya zaŋi ya sɔntʋʋma ma' tɛɛns wʋsa kpɛn'ɛs mɔɔg.

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Ba da kʋ nɔdi'esidib nɛ Wina'am nidib banɛ bɛɛ ba kɔn' la nɛ Babilon teŋin, nɛ banɛ ka ba da kʋʋ ba dunia ni la wʋsa.” Dinzug ka Wina'am san'ami li la.

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Nɛ'ɛŋa nya'aŋ ka m wʋm nidib bɛdegʋ kʋkɔya vuud arezana nii yɛt ye, “Zun'omi Wina'am. Ka yɔlisim nɛ na'asi nɛ paŋ anɛ o din.

english_verse: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
translation_verse: O kad saria nɛ sida nɛ yɛlmɛŋir. Ka kad pu'agɔɔndtita'ar onɛ san'am dunia nɛ o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la saria, ka namis o, on kɛ ka o tʋmtʋmnib la kpi la zug.”

english_verse: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
translation_verse: Ka nidib la lɛn tans ya'as ye, “Zun'omi Wina'am. Ka bugum dit teŋ tita'asi'a la nyɔ'ɔs dʋt nɛ agɔl saŋa dinɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.”

english_verse: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
translation_verse: Ka kʋkɔr yi na'am gbauŋ la ni na ye, “Yanam banɛ an tʋmtʋmnib nɛ tadimnam nɛ kpi'emnam banɛ zɔt Wina'am la, zun'om Wina'am.”

english_verse: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn wʋm kʋkɔr dinɛ vuud nwɛnɛ nidib bɛdegʋ vuud nɛ ka nwɛnɛ ku'om suugid nɛ paŋ si'em la nɛ satansʋg tita'ar nɛ, ka li yɛl ye, “Zun'omi Wina'am, on an Zugsɔb Wina'am tita'ar ka an na'ab la zug.

english_verse: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
translation_verse: Kɛlli ka ti maal sumalisim ka ti sʋnya malis ka ti na'as Wina'am, ka Pɛbil la pu'adiir la saŋa paaeya, ka pu'a la mɛ ti'eb.

english_verse: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
translation_verse: Ka maliak la yɛlim ye, “Sɔm nɛ'ɛŋa, ‘Albareka bɛ nɛ banɛ ka ba buoli ba ye ba kɛn Pɛbil la pu'adiir di'ema la na.’” Ka lɛn ye, “Dina an Wina'am pian'ad amɛŋa.”

english_verse: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
translation_verse: Ka m vanbin o tuon ye m na'as o. Amaa ka o yɛlim ye, “Da niŋ alaa, ka man anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm tiraan nɛ fʋ ba'abiis banɛ mɔr Yesu Kristo kasɛt sʋŋ la nid yinne. Zun'om Wina'am.” Yesu kasɛt la anɛ linɛ ka Wina'am Siig la nie pa'al. Onɛ ban'ad wiedpiel la yɛla

english_verse: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ ka arezana yɔ'ɔg, ka wiedpiel bɛɛ anina, ka onɛ ban'ad o la yʋ'ʋr buon Yɛlsida Sɔb. Ka o kad saria ka zabid zaba nɛ sida.

english_verse: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
translation_verse: O nini daa nwɛnɛ bugum pielim nɛ, ka o pid na'am zupibis bɛdegʋ o zugin, ka mɔr yʋ'ʋr ka li sɔb o ni ka sɔ' zi' lii, asɛɛ on gʋllim.

english_verse: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
translation_verse: Ka o yɛ fukanɛ ka ba lɔs ziimin. Ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Wina'am Pian'ad.

english_verse: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
translation_verse: Ka arezana zabzabidib yɛ fupielis linɛ an nyain ban'ad wiedpielisi dɔl o.

english_verse: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
translation_verse: Ka sʋ'ʋditiŋ yii o nɔɔrin na, ka o na zaŋi li zabi nyaŋ buudi wʋsa ka sʋ'ʋgi ba nɛ paŋ, nwɛnɛ kʋnt dansaar nɛ. Ka Wina'am tita'ar la sʋnpɛɛn na luu ba zut nwɛnɛ ban nɔɔdi nwiakid vain si'em la.

english_verse: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋr sɔb o fuugin nɛ o gbɛrin ye, Na'anam Na'ab nɛ zugsɔbnam Zugsɔb.

english_verse: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ maliak ka o zi'e winnigin, ka yɛl niis banɛ ian'ad agɔl la nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar ye, “Kemi na la'as Wina'am di'emtita'arin la di,

english_verse: You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: ka di na'anam niŋgbina nɛ zabzabidib kpɛɛmnam la nɛ zabzabidib nɛ widi nɛ wiedban'adib nɛ nidib wʋsa, banɛ an yammis nɛ banɛ ka' yammisɛ nɛ tadimnam nɛ kpi'emnam la wʋsa niŋgbina.”

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la nɛ dunia na'anam nɛ ba zabzabidib ka ba la'as ye ba zab nɛ onɛ ban'ad wief la nɛ o zabzabidib.

english_verse: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Amaa ka ba gban'e bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la nɛ o ziri nɔdi'es onɛ daa zi'e bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la nɔba zugʋ tʋm tʋʋm nyalima la. O daa dɔlis nɛ tʋʋm nyalima bama ma' banɛ mɔr bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la zanbina nɛ banɛ na'asid o win la. Ka lɔb bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la nɛ o ziri nɔdi'es la bas bugum mu'ar kanɛ dit nɛ kidibir la ni.

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ka sʋ'ʋg kanɛ yi wiedban'ad la nɔɔrin na la kʋʋ o dataas banɛ kpɛlim la. Ka niis wʋsa dii ba niŋgbina tig.

english_verse: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ na'am gbana ka ba tis banɛ zin' li zugin la paŋ ka ba na kad saria, ka lɛn nyɛ nimbanɛ ka ba da kʋʋ ba ka li anɛ ban da mɔɔn yɛlsida linɛ ka Yesu pa'al li ba la, nɛ Wina'am pian'ad la yɛla. Nimbama daa pʋ zun'od bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la nɛ o win laa, bɛɛ di'ed o zanbina ba gbɛ'ɛdin bɛɛ nu'usinɛɛ, ka yʋ'ʋn vʋ'ʋg na ka la'as nɛ Kristo an na'anam yʋma tusir la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
translation_verse: Banɛ paam yiiga kum vʋ'ʋgir la na nyɛ albareka ka an kasi. Ka kum kanɛ paas ayi' la kʋ nyaŋi baa, ba na an Wina'am nɛ Kristo maanmaannib ka na la'as nɛ Kristo di na'am yʋma tusir. Ban nyaŋ Sʋntaana la yɛla

english_verse: At the end of the
translation_verse: Yʋma tusir la ya'a ti gaad, ba na bas Sʋntaana

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: ka o yi sanrega la ni ka ma' buudi wʋsa banɛ bɛ dunia lʋga anaasi banɛ ka ba buonnɛ ba ye Gog nɛ Magog la. Ba na la'asi ba wʋsa keŋ zaba. Ba zan' na la'as bɛdegʋ nwɛnɛ atɛuk nɔɔrin titanbin'isʋg nɛ.

english_verse: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
translation_verse: Ka ba yina pɛ'ɛl teŋgbauŋ la ka gilig Wina'am nidibi la'asi bɛ zin'isi'a nɛ teŋ kanɛ ka Wina'am nɔŋ la. Amaa bugum yi arezana ni na dii ba.

english_verse: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
translation_verse: Ka maliaknam nɔk Sʋntaana onɛ ma'ad dunia nidib la lɔb o bas bugum mu'ar linɛ diti nyɛligid wʋʋ kidibir la ni, zin'ikanɛ ka ba dɛŋi lɔb bʋnkɔnbbɛ'og la nɛ ziri nɔdi'es la bas la. Anina ka ba na namisid nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ, saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Wina'am n kad saria la yɛla

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Ka m lɛn nyɛ na'am gbauŋ piel tita'ar ka sɔ' zin' li zug. Ka teŋgbauŋ nɛ saŋgbauŋ zɔɔ mɛlim o tuon, ka sɔ' pʋ lɛn nyɛɛ ba ya'asɛ.

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ banɛ kpi la, banɛ an tadimnam nɛ kpi'emnam, ka ba zi'e na'am gbauŋ la tuon. Ka sɔ' lakid gbana, ka mɛ lɛn lak gbauŋ si'a linɛ an gbauŋ kanɛ ka ba sɔb banɛ mɔr nyɔvʋpaal la yʋda niŋ la. Ka Wina'am kad banɛ kpi la saria ka li dɔlli ba tʋʋma daa an si'em ka li sɔb gbana la ni.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Ka atɛuk bas banɛ daa kpi li pʋʋgin la. Ka kum nɛ Kpi'im Teŋ mɛ bas nimbanɛ daa kpii bɛɛ ba ni la. Ka Wina'am kadi ba wʋsa saria ka li dɔlli ba tʋʋma daa an si'em.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Ka maliaknam nɔk kum nɛ Kpi'im Teŋi lɔbi bas mu'ar linɛ pɛ'ɛl nɛ bugum la ni. Bugum mu'ar kaŋa anɛ kum ayi' la.

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' yʋ'ʋr ya'a pʋ sɔb nyɔvʋr paal dim gbauŋʋn laa, ba na lɔb o sɔba bas bugum mu'ar la ni.

english_verse: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
translation_verse: Ka m nyɛ saŋgbauŋ nɛ teŋgbauŋ paal. Ka yiiga saŋgbauŋ nɛ teŋgbauŋ nɛ atɛuk gaad ka lɛn kae.

english_verse: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
translation_verse: Ka m wʋm ka kʋkɔr tita'ar pian'adi yit na'am gbauŋʋn la na yɛt ye, “Wina'am yir yʋ'ʋn bɛ nidib sʋʋgin; o na bɛ nɛ ba, ka ba na aan o nidib. Ka Wina'am mɛŋ na bɛɛ ba ni ka aan ba Wina'am.

english_verse: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
translation_verse: O na ɛɛnsi ba ninta'am wʋsa. Yɛlkʋda la wʋsa gaad ya, ka kum nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ kaasig nɛ tɔɔg kʋ lɛm bɛ ya'asɛ.”

english_verse: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug la yɛl ye, “M maan si'el wʋsa nɛ bʋmpaala.” Ka yɛlim ye, “Sɔm nɛ'ɛŋaa digil bɔzugɔ pian'ad la anɛ sida ka an yɛlmɛŋir.”

english_verse: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.
translation_verse: Ka yɛlim ye, “Li naae ya. Manɛ an Alfa nɛ Omega, ka an si'el wʋsa pin'ilʋg nɛ li naar. Ka ku'onuud ya'a kʋʋd sɔ', mam na tis o nyɔvʋr ku'om linɛ bun zaalim ka o nu.

english_verse: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Ka onɛ nyaŋ yɛlbɛ'ɛd wʋsa la na di'e nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa. Ka mam na aan o Wina'am ka on mɛ na aan m biig.

english_verse: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amaa dabiem dim la nɛ banɛ ka' yadda, nɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam nɛ ninkʋʋdib nɛ banɛ tʋm dian'ad tʋʋma nɛ banɛ dit tima nɛ banɛ an ba'amaannib nɛ ziri dim la wʋsa zin'ig anɛ bugum mu'ar linɛ pɛ'ɛl nɛ bugum ka diti nyɛligid wʋʋ kidibir la. Nɛ'ɛŋa an kum linɛ paas ayi' la.” Jerusalem Tempaal la yɛla

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Ka maliaknam ayɔpɔi la ni yinne banɛ daa mɔr laas ayɔpɔi ka li pɛ'ɛl nɛ yɛltɔɔd ayɔpɔi linɛ kpɛlim nya'aŋ la yɛlim ye, “Kem na ka m pa'alif Pu'a Paal la, onɛ an Pɛbil la pu'a la.”

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Ka maliak la nɔkim Siigin mɔrimi keŋ dʋ zuotita'ar kanɛ wa'am la zug, ka pa'alim Jerusalem Teŋ linɛ an Kasi, ka li yi Wina'am san'an arezana nii sigid na.

english_verse: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am na'am paŋ pipilim nyɛɛn, ka teŋ la mɛ nyɛɛn wʋʋ kugvɛnla linɛ ka ba buon jaspa la ka li nyɛɛn wʋʋ gɔtiŋ la.

english_verse: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Teŋ la mɔr zaŋguom titada nɛ za'anɔya pii nɛ ayi' ka za'anɔya nɛ kʋlis pii nɛ ayi' la wa'am. Ka maliaknam pii nɛ ayi' gur za'anɔya la. Ka Israel dim dɔɔd pii nɛ ayi' la yʋda sɔb kʋlis la ni.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: Ka za'anɔya atan' bɛ ya-nya'aŋ, ka atan' bɛ ya-datiuŋ, ka atan' bɛ ya-dagɔbʋg ka atan' bɛ ya-tuona.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Ka ba ɛɛnb teŋ la zaŋguoma la kuga pii nɛ ayi' zug. Ka tʋmtʋmnib pii nɛ ayi' la yʋda sɔb kuga la zug.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Ka maliak kanɛ pian' tisim la mɔr sanlima daug linɛ ka ba mɔri makid la ye o mak teŋ la nɛ li kʋlis nɛ li zaŋguoma la.

english_verse: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about
translation_verse: Teŋ la anɛ mauk, ka li wa'alim nɛ li yalʋŋ la zem taaba. Ka maliak la mak teŋ la nɛ daug linɛ ka ba mɔri makid la. Ka li yalʋŋ an mail tusir nɛ kɔbisnaasi. Ka li wa'alim nɛ li yalʋŋ nɛ li wa'alim teŋin dʋ zugin la wʋsa zem taaba.

english_verse: Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about
translation_verse: Ka maliak la mɛ mak zaŋguoma la ka li wa'alim la an nɔbir makir kɔbisyi'. Maliak la mɔr si'eli makid la wa'alim la.

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Ka ba nɔk kugvɛnla linɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Jaspa la mɛ' zaŋguoma la. Ka teŋ la mɛŋ an sanlima ka nyɛɛn wʋʋ gɔtiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald,
translation_verse: Teŋ la ɛɛnbir la, ba da zaŋ nɛ kugvɛnla nɛ li buudi wʋsa ɛɛnb ɛɛnbir la ka li vɛnl hali. Kugbanɛ ka ba da ɛɛnb yiiga la da anɛ jaspa. Ka onɛ paas ayi' la an safir. Ka atan' la an agat. Ka anaasi an emeral.

english_verse: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
translation_verse: Ka anu an onik. Ka ayuobʋ an kanelian. Ka ayɔpɔi daan la an kirisolat. Ka anii an bɛril. Ka awai an topas. Ka piiga an kirisopras. Ka pii nɛ yinne an jasin. Ka pii nɛ ayi' an ametis.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Ba da nɔknɛ kugvɛnla linɛ yʋ'ʋri buon pɛɛl la maal kʋlis za'anɔya pii nɛ ayi' la. Kʋlʋŋ yinne wʋsa ba da nɔknɛ pɛɛl mummi maal. Ka teŋ la suoya la an sanlima nyɛɛn wʋʋ gɔtiŋ nɛ.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: Ka m pʋ nyɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir teŋ la nii, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ an paŋ tita'ar Sɔb la nɛ Pɛbil la aan anina Pʋ'ʋsim Yir.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am na'am paŋ nɛ Pɛbil la nyɛɛnnɛ li ni, ka li nie nyain. Linzug ka teŋ la pʋ bɔɔd winnig nɛ nwadig ye ba tisi li nɛɛsim.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Ka dunia sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa na gɔɔnd nɛɛsim la ni. Ka dunia na'anam na mɔri ba kpan'am keŋ teŋ la ni.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Ka teŋ la za'anɔya pʋ yɔɔd nintaŋa, bɔzugɔ yʋ'ʋŋ kae aninaa.

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: Ka ba na mɔr dunia na'am nɛ kpan'am kɛn teŋ la ni na.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Ka linɛ ka' nyain wʋsa nɛ onɛ tʋm nyan tʋʋma nɛ ziri dim kʋ kpɛn' teŋin laa. Nimbanɛ yʋda sɔb Pɛbil la gbauŋʋn linɛ an nyɔvʋpaal dim gbauŋ la ma'aa na kpɛn' teŋ la pʋʋgin.

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Ka maliak la lɛm pa'alim kɔldaug kanɛ ku'om tisid nyɔvʋr la, ka li ian'ad wʋʋ gɔtiŋ nɛ ka yit Wina'am nɛ Pɛbil la na'am gbauŋ la ni,

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: ka bɛ teŋ la suotita'ar la sʋʋgin. Ka tiig linɛ tisid nyɔvʋr la zi'e mu'ar la gbɛɛd ayi' la ni, ka wan wala nɔɔr pii nɛ ayi' yʋʋm pʋʋgin, ka wan nɔɔr yinne nwadig pʋʋgin. Ka tiig la vaand tisid dunia sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa laafi.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Ka Wina'am nɔpɔɔr la kʋ lɛm bɛ ya'asɛ, bɔzugɔ Wina'am nɛ Pɛbil la na'am gbauŋ na bɛɛ li ni. Ka o tʋmtʋmnib na zun'e o,

english_verse: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.
translation_verse: ka nyɛɛ o nindaa. Ka o yʋ'ʋr na sɔbi ba gbɛ'ɛdin.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Ka yʋ'ʋŋ kʋ lɛm bɛɛ. Ka Zugsɔb Wina'am na kɛ ka li an nyain, ka ba kʋ lɛm bɔɔd fitir nɛ nintaŋ ani. Ka ba na di na'am saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ. Yesu na kena la yɛla

english_verse: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
translation_verse: Ka maliak la yɛlim ye, “Yɛlbama anɛ asida. Ka Zugsɔb Wina'am onɛ tisid o nɔdi'esidib o Siig Kasi la tʋm o maliak ye o kena pa'al o tʋmtʋmnib yɛlbanɛ kʋ yuugɛ ka niŋ la.”

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: Yesu yɛl ye, “Li kʋ yuugɛ ka m na kena. Albareka bɛ nɛ onɛ siak gbauŋ kaŋa nɔdi'esʋg la yɛt si'el la.”

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Man Joon n an onɛ wʋm ka nyɛ yɛlbama wʋsa. Ka man daa wʋm ka nyɛ li naae la, ka vanbin maliak onɛ pa'alim yɛlbama la tuon ye m zun'e o.

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: Amaa ka o yɛlim ye, “Da niŋ alaa. Ka mam mɛ anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm tiraan la'an nɛ fʋ ba'abiis banɛ an nɔdi'esidib nɛ nimbanɛ siak bʋn linɛ bɛ gbauŋ kaŋa ni la. Zun'om Wina'am.”

english_verse: Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛl man ye, “Da su'a gbauŋ kaŋa nɔdi'esʋg la yɛt si'el laa, bɔzugɔ saŋa la li'el ya, ka yɛlbama wʋsa na niŋ.

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Kɛl ka onɛ an tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd daan kpɛn aan ala. Ka onɛ tʋm dian'ad tʋʋma kpɛn niŋim ala. Ka onɛ an pʋpiel on kpɛn tʋm linɛ an sʋm. Ka onɛ sʋʋnri an nyain on kpɛn aan ala.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu yɛl ye, “Kɛlisimi, li kʋ yuugɛ, ka m na kena. Yɔɔd la bɛɛ m san'an, ka m na tis sɔ' wʋsa o tʋʋma yɔɔdi an si'em.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Manɛ an Alfa nɛ Omega, ka an yiiga daan nɛ nya'aŋ daan ka an bʋn wʋsa pin'ilʋg nɛ li naar.”

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: Albareka bɛ nɛ banɛ pie ba fuud nyain la, bɔzugɔ ba na mɔr suori na di nyɔvʋr tiig la wala, ka na dɔl za'anɔɔri kpɛn' teŋ la ni.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Ka nimbɛ'ɛdnam nɛ banɛ dit tima la nɛ banɛ tʋm dian'ad tʋʋma la nɛ ninkʋʋdib la nɛ ba'amaannib la nɛ nimbanɛ wʋsa nɔŋ ye ba ma' ziri la kʋ kpɛn' teŋ la pʋʋginɛ, ka na bɛ nɛ teŋ la yiŋ.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: “Man Yesu tʋmi m maliak ye o yɛli ya yɛlbama ka fʋ tu'asi tis Wina'am nidib la. Manɛ an na'ab David yaaŋ nɛ bɛogʋn nwaddar linɛ nyɛɛn la.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Wina'am Siig Kasi nɛ Pɛbil Pu'apaal la yɛl ye, “Kem na.” Ka onɛ wʋmi li la mɛ yɛlim ye, “Kem na.” Onɛ wʋsa ka ku'onuud mɔr o la, kɛl ka o kena, ka onɛ mɛ bɔɔd la, kɛl ka o di'e piini linɛ an nyɔvʋr ku'om la zaalim. Li naari nwa'

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Man Joon san'an sɔ' mɛkama onɛ wʋm nɔdi'esʋg la yɛl si'el gbauŋ kaŋa ni la nɛ nimmua ye: Onɛ paas si'el gbauŋ kaŋa ni, Wina'am na maligim paas on sɔb yɛltɔɔd linɛ sɔb gbauŋ kaŋa ni la.

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: Ka sɔ' ya'a yis si'el nɔdi'esʋg gbauŋ kaŋa ni, Wina'am na mɔŋ on sɔb o pʋdigir linɛ bɛ nyɔvʋr tiig la sɔb gbauŋ kaŋa ni la.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Onɛ yɛt ye yɛlbama anɛ sida la yɛl ye, “Sida li kʋ yuugɛ, ka m na kena.” Li an sʋm. Ti Zugsɔb Yesu, kem na.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Ti Zugsɔb Yesu yɛlsʋm na bɛ nɛ Wina'am nidib wʋsa. Ami.
